jobs.title: ICT Specialist (BUSINESS Analyst)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive remuneration package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS).
jobs.summary: ICT business analyst needed by the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria to coordinate business needs analysis and requirements elicitation for ICT projects.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate and a National Diploma in Computer Science / Information Technology (NQF level 6). Minimum of 3 years supervisory experience in business case and business requirement specification (BRS) development. Job related knowledge: Business Process Re-engineering (6 SIGMA). Business System Analysis. Business Process Modelling (IDEF, BPEL, BPML). Functional design and user requirement specifications (UML). Business case development. Basic finance and accounting. Understanding of the Application Development Process (SDLC). Working knowledge of BPM Toolsets such as Case Wise or ARIS. Job related skills: Computer literacy, good grooming and presentation skills, good telephone etiquette, Good organisational skills, good people skills, High level of reliability, Communication skills (verbal and written). Team worker skills. Facilitation skills. Presentation skills. Planning and organising skills. Project Management skills. Ability to work under pressure. Teamwork. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate and manage the analysis of business needs, user requirements, objectives and goals for ICT programmes/projects within the agreed frameworks. Prepare for requirements elicitation. Conduct JAD sessions. Documents elicitation. Review /confirm documented requirements. Circulate document for formal sign-off. Map business processes and audit business systems. Map As-Is business processes. Conduct Gap-Analysis. Map To-Be business processes. Review/Confirm documented processes. Prepare business cases for systems development programmes/projects. Understand Business objectives. Conduct business impact analysis/stakeholder analysis. Schedule initial briefing session with all relevant stakeholders. Obtain High- Level functional requirements. Understand High-Level Business processes. Research/investigate solution options. Obtain Financials. Review/Confirm documented Business Case. Circulate Business Case for sign-off. Perform transversal business systems analysis. Assess Requirements against Transversal System. Assess organisational readiness. Define transition requirements. Prepare solution validation assessment. Develop Master Systems/ICT Plans. Conduct evaluation of existing ICT environment. Perform Gap Analysis between current environments & desired departmental strategic vision. Identify, evaluate & recommend future state technologies to modernize ICT environment. Draft Master Systems Plan. Review/Confirm MSP. Circulate MSP for sign-off.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Sehoole Tel No: (012) 319 6527
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email ICTSrecruit85@nda.gov.za

af.title: IKT-spesialis (Business Analyst)
af.summary: IKT-besigheidsontleder word deur die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria benodig om ontleding van besigheidsbehoeftes en vereiste-onttrekking vir IKT-projekte te koördineer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Rekenaarwetenskap / Inligtingstegnologie (NQF level 6) beskik. Minimum van 3 jaar toesigervaring in besigheidsaak- en besigheidsvereistespesifikasie- (BRS) ontwikkeling. Werkverwante kennis: Business Process Re-engineering (6 SIGMA). Besigheidsstelselontleding. Business Process Modelling (IDEF, BPEL, BPML). Funksionele ontwerp en gebruikervereistespesifikasies (UML). Ontwikkeling van besigheidsake. Basiese finansies en rekeningkunde. Begrip van die Application Development Process (SDLC). Werkende kennis van BPM-nutsgoed soos Case Wise of ARIS. Werkverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie versorging en aanbiedingsvaardighede, goeie telefoonetiket, goeie organisatoriese vaardighede, goeie mensevaardighede, 'n Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Spanwerksvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Spanwerk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur die ontleding van besigheidsbehoeftes, gebruikervereistes, doelwitte en strewe vir IKT-programme/projekte binne die ooreengekome raamwerke. Berei voor vir vereiste-onttrekking. Hou JAD-sessies. Dokumenteer onttrekking. Hersien/bevestig gedokumenteerde vereistes. Sirkuleer dokument vir formele ondertekening. Karter besigheidsprosesse en oudit besigheidstelsels. Karter As-Is besigheidsprosesse. Voer Gap-Analysis uit. Karter To-Be besigheidsprosesse. Hersien/bevestig gedokumenteerde prosesse. Berei besigheidsake voor vir stelselontwikkelingsprogramme/projekte. Begryp besigheidsdoelwitte. Voer besigheidsimpakontleding/belanghebbende-ontleding uit. Skeduleer aanvanklike inligtingsessie met alle tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Verkry High-Level funksionele vereistes. Begryp High-Level besigheidsprosesse. Ondersoek/ondersoek oplossingsopsies. Verkry finansies. Hersien/bevestig gedokumenteerde Business Case. Sirkuleer Business Case vir ondertekening. Voer transversale besigheidstelselontleding uit. Evalueer vereistes teen Transversal System. Evalueer organisatoriese gereedheid. Definieer oorgangsvereistes. Berei oplossingsvalidasie-assessering voor. Ontwikkel Master Systems/ICT Plans. Voer evaluering van bestaande IKT-omgewing uit. Voer Gap Analysis uit tussen huidige omgewings en verlangde departementele strategiese visie. Identifiseer, evalueer en beveel toekomstige staattegnologieë aan om IKT-omgewing te moderniseer. Opstel van Master Systems Plan. Hersien/bevestig MSP. Sirkuleer MSP vir ondertekening.

zu.title: Isikhulu se-ICT (Mhloli Wezabhizinisi)
zu.summary: Umhloli wezabhizinisi we-ICT uyadingeka oMnyangweni Wezolimo ePretoria ukuze ahlole kanambambili isibaluli sezidingo zabhizinisi nokutholwa kwezidingo kumaprojekthi we-ICT.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe kwi-Computer Science / Information Technology (NQF level 6). Ukweseka okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 kokuhlola ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sezabhizinisi nesibaluli sezidingo zabhizinisi (BRS). Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukulungisa kabusha inqubo yabhizinisi (6 SIGMA). Ukuhlola amasistemu ezingcali zabhizinisi. Ukumodela inqubo yabhizinisi (IDEF, BPEL, BPML). Izibaluli zokwakhiwa okusebenzayo kanye nezibaluli sezidingo zomsebenzisi (UML). Ukuthuthukiswa kwesimo sezabhizinisi. Izimali okuyisisekelo kanye nokubala. Ukuqonda inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokusebenza (SDLC). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamathuluzi e-BPM afana ne-Case Wise noma i-ARIS. Amandla ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuzilungisa kahle nendlela yokuzibonakalisa, amasiko ahle kahle ocingo, amandla okuhlela okuhle, amandla okusebenza nabantu, izinga eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa, amandla okuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amandla okusebenza njengeqembu. Amandla okwenza kube lula. Amandla okuzibonakalisa. Amandla okucela nokuheha. Amandla okuphatha amaprojekthi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ukusebenza njengeqembu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Hlela kanambambili uphathe ukuhlola izidingo zabhizinisi, izidingo zomsebenzisi, izinjongo kanye namagajintsho ohlelweni lwama-ICT ngaphakathi kohlaka oluvunyelwe. Zibkelelele ukulungiselela ukutholwa kwezidingo. Yenza iziqendu ze-JAD. Bhala okutholiwe. Buyeza/uqinisekise izidingo ezibhaliwe. Sasaza umyalo wokuqinisekisa ngokusemthethweni. Modela izinqubo zabhizinisi futhi hlela ukuhlola amasistemu ezingcali. Modela izinqubo zabhizinisi ezikhona. Yenza ukuhluka-Isimo. Modela izinqubo zabhizinisi ezingafuneka. Buyeza/uqinisekise izinqubo ezibhaliwe. Lungiselela izimo sezabhizinisi zohlelo lokuqasha izinhlelo/iprojekthi zokuthuthukiswa kwamasistemu. Qonda izinjongo zezingcali. Yenza ukuhlola umthelela wezingcali/ukuhlola abahlotshanisi. Hlela inqubo yokuqala yokwazisa bonke abahlotshanisi abahlobene. Thola izidingo ezibucayi ukwakhiwa okusebenzayo. Qonda izinqubo zezingcali ezingeni eliphezulu. Cephu/phanda izinketho zezixazululo. Thola izimali. Buyeza/uqinisekise isimo sezabhizinisi esibhaliwe. Sasaza isimo sezabhizinisi ngenhloso yokusayina. Yenza ukuhlola amasistemu ezingcali eziqendile. Hlolisisa izidingo ngokumelana neSistimu Eziqendile. Hlola ukulungelelana kwenhlangano. Chaza izidingo zoshintsho. Lungiselela ukuhlolwa ukuqinisekisa izixazululo. Thuthukisa Izindaba Zezinhlelo/I-ICT. Yenza ukuhlola imvelo ye-ICT ekhona. Yenza ukuhluka-Isimo phakathi kwemvelo yamanje kanye nobuhinga bokuhlosile komnyango. Hlola, hlola futhi nutuse amathuluzi ezinga elizayo ukwakha kabusha imvelo ye-ICT. Bhala Indaba YeziHlelo. Buyeza/uqinisekise i-MSP. Sasaza i-MSP ngenhloso yokusayina.

xh.title: Ispeshalisti ye-ICT (Mhloli weqhinga)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umhloli weqhinga le-ICT ngokusesikweni Isebe leZolimo ePretoria ukuze alungiselele ukuhlolwa kwezidingo zeqhinga nokubumba iimfuno zeeprojekthi ze-ICT.
xh.requirements: Kufunuka abafaka izicelo babe nesignatsha yesigaba se-12 kwaye babe neDiploma yaseLizwe kwakhompyutha Sayensi / IInkqubo Zolwazi (inqanaba le-NQF 6). Kufuneka babe nokuba bengaphantsi kolawulo kweminyaka eyi-3 ngokwamava ekuphuhliseni igqelo leshishini kunye nezicatshulwa zeemfuno zeshishini (BRS). Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwenza kwakhona iinkqubo zezoshishino (6 SIGMA). Ukuhlolwa kweenkqubo zoshishino. Ukumodela iinkqubo zoshishino (IDEF, BPEL, BPML). Ulwazi lwezicatshulwa zokwakha iinkqubo zemisebenzi nokucacisa iimfuno zabasebenzisi (UML). Ukuphuhliswa kwegqelo leshishini. Iimali zesiseko kunye nokubala. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yoPhuhliso lwe-Aplikheyishini (SDLC). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamathuluzi e-BPM afana ne Case Wise okanye i ARIS. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukubhekisa ngokusesikweni kwiikhompyutha, amakhono elungiselelo nokubonisa ngokusesikweni, amakhono aphuhliweyo efonu, amakhono aphuhliweyo olwangqinano, amakhono aphuhliweyo abantu, inqanaba eliphezulu lokuqinisekisa, amakhono ekuhamba kolwimi (ethethwayo nereyithiwe). Amakhono okusebenza njengesigqiza. Amakhono okulawula iinkqubo zemfazwe. Amakhono okubonisa ngokusesikweni. Amakhono okuqamba nokulungiselela. Amakhono oLawulo loMsebenzi. Ikakhono lokusebenza ngamandla. Ukusebenza njengesigqiza. Ilayisense yomqhubi evunyiweyo.
xh.duties: Lungiselela ulawule nokuhlolwa kwezidingo zeshishini, iimfuno zabasebenzisi, iinjongo nezithunywa zeenkqubo/iiprojekthi ze-ICT ngaphakathi kohlaka oluvunyiweyo. Lungiselela ukubumba iimfuno. Qhube iinkqubo ze-JAD. Qamba izicatshulwa zemfuno. Phinda uqinise izicatshulwa ezingezwe. Sasaza umbhalo ukuze usayine ngokusesikweni. Yenza imodeli yeenkqubo zeshishini kwaye uhlole iinkqubo zoshishino. Yenza imodeli ye-nkqubo yeshishini ekhoyo. Qhube uHlolo lweSithuba. Yenza imodeli ye-nkqubo yeshishini eza kubakho. Phinda uqinise izinkqubo ezingeziweyo. Lungiselela iigqelo leshishini kwiinkqubo/iiprojekthi zophuhliso lwenkqubo. Qonda iinjongo zeshishini. Yenza uhlolo lomphumo wolwazi/uhlolo lwabanyuli. Cwangcisa inkqubo yokwazisa ngakunene nabo bonke abanyuli abahlobeneyo. Fumana iimfuno zolwazi ngenqanaba eliphezulu. Qonda iinkqubo zeshishini ngenqanaba eliphezulu. Phanda/phenatha iinketho zeyesixhobo. Fumana iimali. Phinda uqinise igqelo elingezweyo leshishini. Sasaza iGqelo leshishini ukuze lisayinwe. Yenza uhlolo lweenkqubo zeshishini ezihamba hamba. Hlola iimfuno ngokuthelekiswa neNkqubo eHamba hamba. Hlola ulungelelwaniso loshishino. Chaza iimfuno zeshishino. Lungiselela uhlolo lokwamkela isixhobo. Phuhlisa iNdlela eNkulu yeNkqubo/ye-ICT. Qhube uhlolo lwendawo ye-ICT ekhoyo. Yenza uHlolo lweSithuba phakathi kwendalo ekhoyo & umbono oqhubekayo webhinqa lolwazi lwalulo. Qaphela, hlola & tusa iindlelasenkqubo zangomso ukuze zitshintshe iinkqubo ze-ICT. Yenza iNkqubo eNkulu yeeNkqubo. Phinda uqinise i-MSP. Sasaza i-MSP ukuze isayinwe.

jobs.title: Land Administrative Officer
jobs.summary: Facilitate the disposal of agricultural state land, including farm evaluation, caretaker appointment and advertising, requiring a National Diploma in Agriculture with two years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a National Diploma in Agriculture (NQF Level 6). Minimum of two (2) years’ relevant experience in Land or Land Reform Administration. Job Related Knowledge: Computer literacy. Analytical skills. PFMA. Planning and organizing. Project Management. Job Related Skills: Facilitation skills. Project Management. Planning. Initiative. Interpersonal skills. Problem solving abilities. Interpretation of findings. Analytical. Computer literacy. Report writing skills. Drivers’ license. Extended working hours.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the disposal of Agricultural State Land: Identify the repossessed farm by Debt Management. Appoint the caretaker to look after the farm. Facilitate the Evaluation of farm to determine the productive market value. Advertise the farm through local media. Facilitate the appointment of the successful candidate. Prepare the lease agreement. Provide Infrastructure support: Ensure the proper maintenance and caretaking of farms. Conduct inspection on farms to determine the condition. Conduct needs analysis to check the gaps and what is needed. Eradication of poisonous plants. Construction of gabions and fire breaks. Rehabilitation of dams. Render advisory services to inter- governmental departments and clients on land management matters: Attend to state land queries from inter-governmental departments and clients. Attend to parliamentary queries through the ministerial office. Provide farming advise to leases/ clients. Facilitate the rental collection and other departmental levies: Send monthly statements to leases. Make follow up on none paying leases. Liaise with finance with regard to verification of payments. Facilitate the eviction of none complying leases. Refer none paying leases to legal services. Maintenance of database: Update provincial and state land database. Update asset management database. Update the new developments in the farm. Update job creation and applicant database

af.title: Grondadministratiewe beampte
af.summary: Fasiliteer die beskikkingstelling van staatslandbouland, insluitend plaaswaardasie, die aanstelling van 'n oppasser en advertensies; vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma in Landbou met twee jaar se relevante ervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Nasionale Diploma in Landbou (NQF Level 6). Minstens twee (2) jaar se relevante ervaring in Grond- of Grondhervormingsadministrasie. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analitiese vaardighede. PFMA. Beplanning en organisering. Projekbestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Projekbestuur. Beplanning. Inisiatief. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvermoë. Interpretasie van bevindings. Analities. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Bestuurderslisensie. Verlengde werksure.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die beskikkingstelling van staatslandbouland: Identifiseer die gereposeerde plaas deur Skuldbestuur. Stel die oppasser aan om na die plaas te kyk. Fasiliteer die evaluering van die plaas om die produktiewe markwaarde te bepaal. Adverteer die plaas deur plaaslike media. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van die suksesvolle kandidaat. Berei die huurooreenkoms voor. Verskaf infrastruktuurondersteuning: Verseker behoorlike instandhouding en oppas van plase. Doen inspeksie op plase om die toestand te bepaal. Doen behoefte-analise om die gapings en wat nodig is, na te gaan. Uitroeiing van giftige plante. Konstruksie van gabions en brandgordels. Rehabilitasie van damme. Lewer advisiewe dienste aan intergoermentele departemente en kliënte oor grondbestuursake: Spreek staatslandnavrae van intergoermentele departemente en kliënte aan. Spreek parlementêre navrae deur die ministeriële kantoor aan. Verskaf plaasadvise aan huurders/kliënte. Fasiliteer huurinvordering en ander departementele heffings: Stuur maandelikse state aan huurders. Volg nie-betalende huurders na. Skakel met finansies met betrekking tot verifikasie van betalings. Fasiliteer die ontruiming van nie-nakomende huurders. Verwys nie-betalende huurders na regsdienste. Instandhouding van databasis: Werk provinsiale en staatslanddatabasis op. Werk batesbestuurdatabasis op. Werk die nuwe ontwikkelinge op die plaas op. Werk werkskeppings- en aansoekerderdatabasis op

zu.title: Ofisi Wezokuphathwa Kwabelo Mhlaba
zu.summary: Qhasha elokulahlekelwa yizwe ngcolile umhlaba wezolimo, okuhlanganisa nokuhlola amasimu, ukumisa abanakekeli nokukhangisa, kudinga i-Diploma Yezizwe Ezikwindla eZolimo ngeminyaka emi-2 yomsebenzi ohambisana naleyo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Diploma Yezizwe Ezikwindla eZolimo (NQF Level 6).. Ubuncane beminyaka emibili (2) yomsebenzi ohambisana nawo ekuqanjweni noma ekuqanjweni kabusha komhlaba.. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono ekuhlaziya. PFMA. Ukuphepha futhi ukuhlela. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amakhono ahambisana nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuqhasha. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuphepha. Isiqondiso. Amakhono abantu. Ikhono lokuxazula izinkinga. Ukuhumusha okutholakele. Ukuhlaziya. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okubhala imibiko.. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Ukusebenza amahora amanengi.
zu.duties: Qhasha elokulahlekelwa yizwe ngcolile umhlaba wezolimo: Qaphela isimu esithathiwe nguPhathi Lamangikirethi.. Misa onakekelayo ukuba anakekele isimu.. Qhasha ukuholwa kwesimu ukwazi inani lenani lemarike.. Khangisa isimu kumayidiya Wendawo.. Qhasha ukumiswa komuntu ophumelele.. Lungelelana isivumelwano sokuqashisa.. Nikeza inkxaso yesakhiwo: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okulungile nokunakekela amasimu.. Hlola amasimu ukwazi isimo.. Yenza ukuhlaziya izidingo ukuze ubone izikhala okudingekayo.. Ukususwa kwezitshalo ezibulala. Ukwakhiwa kwe-gabions nokuphula umlilo. Ukuphinda uvuse amadamu. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuweluleka kumayunithi kahulumeni namaklayenti ngemibhalo yekuphathiwa kwomhlaba: Phendula imibuzo yomhlaba wesizwe kumayunithi kahulumeni namaklayenti.. Phendula imibuzo yaphalamende ngesikhungo sombungazwe.. Nikeza izeluleko zezolimo koqashisi/nakumaklayenti.. Qhasha ukuqoqwa kwerent namanye amaholo omnyango: Thumela izitatimende nyanga zonke kuqashisi.. Landela abangahlezi bakhokhe.. Xhumana nezimali ngokuqinisekiswa kokukhokha.. Qhasha ukuxoshwa kwabo abangahambisani naqashiso.. Holisa abangakhokhiyo kumasevisi ezezomthetho. Ukugcinwa kwesisekelo sedatha: Buyekeza isisekelo sedatha somhlaba wesifunda nasesizwe.. xh.summary: Unceda ekushiyweni komhlaba welowo karhulumente wezolimo, kuquka nokuqonda amaplasi, ukumiswa kwabagadi nokushicilelwa, kufuneka abe neDiploma yesiLizwe ezolimini (NQF Level 6) eneminyaka mibini (2) yokugqiba kwamava ahambelana nalenkxaso.

Ucango. Inq``yamba. Amandla abantu phakathi kwabo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Ukuqondisisa iimveliso. Ukuhlola. Ukuzoba ngokwekhompyutha. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Amaxesha amaninzi osebenzise.
xh.duties: Unceda ekushiyweni komHlaba wezolimo karhulumente: Qamba iplasi elithathiwe ngoLawulo lweetyala. Misela umgadi alondele aplasi. Phatha ukuqondiswa kweplasi ukwazi ukuba lignceke elinani elibonelelayo kumthengiso. Shicilela iplazi kumajoni endawo. Phatha ukumiselwa komfaki ofumene isithuba. Lungiselela isivumelwano sokurenta. Nikeza inkxaso esiseko: Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nolondolozo lulungile kwamaplasi. Hlola amaplasi ukuze uqonde ukuba ekuluhlelobeni luni. Yenza uqondo lwemfuno ukuze ubone iziphelo nendawo efunekayo. Ukugqithwa kwezityalo ezibulala. Ukwakhiwa kweegabions nemiqolo yomlilo. Ukuvuselela amadama. jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Governance
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer overseeing governance and compliance review of payment batches within the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management / Financial Accounting / Cost Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in finance and governance administrative environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Financial procedures, Treasury Regulations and Basic Accounting System (BAS). Job related skills: Computer literacy, Interpersonal skills, Organising and planning skills, Communication skills (written and verbal), Analytical skills, Problem solving skills, financial management skills and Report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Pre and post compliance review of payment batches. Conduct compliance review on payment batches. Clear communication of queries to client offices where discrepancies are identified. Maintain a register of both complainant and non-compliant payment batches. Monthly and quarterly. Coordination of audit inputs: Receive, analyse and distribute request for information (RFI) for external audit. Receive, analyse and distribute audit queries and follow up timeously. Update the RFI and Audit Findings registers. Attend Audit Sterring Committee meetings. Attend to queries from Internal Audit. Monthly and quarterly reporting. Render general office support services. Supervise, motivate and develop staff through individual performance agreements. Provide assistance in the developing / reviewing of operational plan. Compile various submissions / memoranda and responses. Administer leave forms / attend to queries. Make travel / conference bookings and confirmations. Provide secretariat services. Administer the procurements of goods and services. Compile, manage and maintain of the Departmental Management Plan inputs. Compile, manage and maintain of Procurement Plan inputs. Serve as a budget coordinator.

af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 Sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Besigheidsadministrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Finansiële Rekeningkunde / Kosterekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Interne Oudit. Minimum van 2 jaar ervaring in 'n finansiële en goewerneurskap administratiewe omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Publieke Diens Regulasies, Finansiële prosedures, Tesourie Regulasies en Basiese Rekeningkunde Stelsel (BAS). af.duties: Voor en na nakoming hersiening van betaling groepe. Voer nakoming hersiening op betaling groepe uit. Duidelike kommunikasie van navrae na kliënt kantore waar afwykings geïdentifiseer word. zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathwa: Ukubusa
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sokuphathla esibheke ukubusa kanye nenhlathulo yokuhambisana kwemigqabo yokukhokha ngaphakathi kwi-Department of Agriculture e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafakizicelo kumele babe ne-Sithifikethi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwi-Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management / Financial Accounting / Cost Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing. Okungenani unyaka we-2 wobuhlobo bemisebenzi kwindawo yokuphathwa kwezimali nokubusa. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Regulations, Izindlela zezimali, i-Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu, Amakhono wokuhlela uphumelelise, Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuvezwa ngomlomo), Amakhono wokuhlaziya, Amakhono wokuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuphatha izimali kanye namakhono wokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Inhlathulo yokuhambisana yangaphambi nangemva kokukhokha imigqabo. Ukwenza inhlathulo yokuhambisana kwemigqabo yokukhokha. Ukuxhumana ngokucacileyo ngemibuzo kwamakomishi abathuli lapho kutholakala iziphithiphithi. Ukugcina umrejista wemigqabo yokukhokha edingayo nengahambisani njalo. Nyanga zonke ne-X quarter. Ukulungisa izinto zokuhlola: Ukwamukela, ukuhlaziya nokusatshalalisela izicelo zolwazi (RFI) zokuhlola ngaphandle. Ukufuna, ukuhlaziya nokusatshalalisela imibuzo yokuhlola kanye nokulandela ngokushesha. Ukubuyisa i-RFI kanye namarejista we-Audit Findings. Ukubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ye-Audit Steering Committee. Ukuphendula imibuzo evela ku-Internal Audit. Ukubika nyanga zonke nenyanga yekota. Ukunikeza izinkonzo zokusekela ejinali ohlweni. Ukuphatha, ukukhuthaza nokuqasha izisebenzi ngemivumelano yemisebenzi yomuntu ngamunye. Ukusiza ekwakheni / ukuhlola ipulani yokusebenza. Ukulungisa izicelo ezahlukene / imemoranda kanye nezipendulo. Ukuphatha amafomu eholo / ukuphendula imibuzo. Ukwenza izibhuku zokuhamba / zenkomfa kanye neziqiniseko. Ukunikeza izinkonzo zikasohli. Ukuphatha ukuthenga izimpahla kanye nezenkonzo. Ukulungisa, ukuphatha kanye nogciniwe kokufaka i-Departmental Management Plan. Ukulungisa, ukuphatha nokugcina okufakwe kwi-Procurement Plan. Ukuba ngumsatshuli webhajethi.

xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQelo 12 kunye neDiploma yesiLwimi kwiNtengiso yoLawulo / uLawulo loLuntu / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo lweShishino / uBalo lweMali / uBalo lweXabiso / uLawulo lweMali / uKuhlolwa ngaphakathi. Amandla ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amandla okuziphatha nabantu, amandla okuhlela nokuceba, amandla okunxibelelwana (okubhalwayo nokuthethwayo), amandla okuhlola, amandla oksela iingxaki, amandla okulawula imali kunye namandla okubala iingxelo.

Nxibelela ngokuchanekileyo iingxaki kumaziko axhamlayo xa kubonakala iziphene. Gcina irejista yemibambo yentlawulo ecalayo nengangqalanga kumigqalisano. Ngenyanga nakwindlela yenyanga ezintathu. Ulungelelwaniso lwezigqibo zokuuhlola: Amkela, hlola ngandlela ithi yayiswa iicelo zenkcazelo (RFI) zokuuhlola ngaphandle. Amkela, hlola ngandlela ithi yayiswa iingxaki zokuuhlola ulandele ngexesha. Hlaziya iirejista zeRFI kunye neziMbalwa zokuUhlola. Thatha inxaxheba kwindibano zeKomiti eLawula ukuHlola. Phendula iingxaki ezingenela kokuHhlola ngaphakathi. Iingxelo zangamnyama nakwindlela yenyanga ezintathu. Yenzisa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zoxhaso lolungelelwanise. Lawula, gcinela umdla ngokusebenzisa kunye nokuzelela abasebenzi ngamadebheda emisebenzi yokuqonda. Nikeza inkxaso ekuyeni / ukuhlolweni kohlulo lomsebenzi. Qamba iingxelo ezahlukeneyo / iimemo kunye namaxhwebhe. Lawula iifom zomvuzo / phendula iingxaki. Yenza iingxelo zokuhamba / indibano kwaye uqinisekise. Yenza iinkonzo zengxoxo ebalulekileyo. Lawula ukuthengwa kwezinto kunye neenkonzo. Qamba, lawula kwaye ugcine iingalelo zoLungelelwaniso lweSebe. Qamba, lawula kwaye ugcine iingalelo loLungelelwaniso lokuthenga. Yiba ngumlawuli webhajeti.

xh.title: Isikhulu sezolulo: Iintsolo Nemigalelo
xh.summary: Isikhulu sezolulo esilawulayo esiphatha iintsolo kunye nokuzinikela kwemigaqo yemigalelo, uphando kunye neenjongo zomthetho kwiSebe leZolimo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneba benesi Satiqhoboshi seNqanaba le-12 kunye neDiploma yoLwazi kwiSebe Likawonke-wonke / uLawulo lwesiSebe Lukawonke-wonke / uLawulo loShishino / uLawulo loQhinga loShishino / neMali yesiSebe Lukawonke-wonke / ukuBala kweMali / uLawulo lweMali. Kufuneka abe nExp Y xesha elimnye kakhulu kwiminyaka ey-1. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesebe: Iimigaqo zoLwazi LkaWonke-Wonke, iinkqubo zemali, iimigaqo zeTreasury, iNkqubo eYilweyo yoBala iMali (BAS). Amandla ohambelana nesebe: Ulwazi lwesixhobo sokuqamba ngokubhalwe, amandla okuhamba nabantu, amandla okuhlela nokucwangcisa, amandla okuthetha nokubhala (okubhalisiweyo nokuvela ngomlomo), amandla okuhlola nokuphonononga, amandla okusombulula iingxaki namandla okulawula imali.
xh.duties: Ulolulwa lweentsolo nemigalelo. Ukwenza oluphononongo lokuzinikela kwemigaqo yeentsolo nemigalelo. Ukwenza uphando lweentsolo kunye nemigalelo ngokuthetha nabantu abahlukeneyo. Ukuqamba nokuphonononga iimemo koBulumko ukufumana isigqibo somthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba izigqibo zemithetho ziyaphenywa. Ukugcina nokuhlaziya iirejista zeentsolo nemigalelo. Nikezela ngemveliso kumphumo wemigaqo kunye neNkqubo eZenza ngokubhalwayo. Ukwenza ukuvuselela ngaphakathi kwesebe ngeentsolo kunye nemigalelo. Iingxelo nyanga zonke neyesine. Ukucotha i-akhawunti yesikrobiso. Ukuqamba amajornali ukuze kuqhwe i-akhawunti yesikrobiso yeMoto eNtukumbweyo. Ukulungiselela ulungelelwaniso lwamajornali aphenyiweyo kwiRejista zeZintsolo kunye neMigalelo ngenjkikelo nobugcigca. Ukunika inkxaso yolulo lwesebe jikelele. Ukuqondisa, ukhuthaza nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi ngokuvumelana ngokuwenza umsebenzi wabo ngabanye. Ukunika inkxaso ekuphuhliseni nokuhlelweni kweplani yokusebenza. Ukudibanisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo / iimemo kunye neempendulo. Ukulawula iifomu zeve / ukuphendula iimibuzo. Ukwenza iirezevasi zokuhamba / kwangaphambili ezingqamaniswa nobuchule nakuzinikela ngokwenyaniseko. Ukunika inkxaso yeenkonzo zeSikreta. Ukulawula ukuthengwa kweempahla kunye neenkQubo. Ukuqamba, ukulawula nokugcina iPlani yoLawulo lwemfuno. Ukuqamba, ukulawula nokugcina iPlani yoKuthengwa kwempahla.

jobs.title: Senior Secretary
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 at 16h00 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial support to the Director at the Department of Defence in Pretoria, requiring Grade 12 and computer literacy.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Grade 12/NQF Level 4. Secretarial experience will be an advantage. Special requirements (skills needed): Language skills and the ability to communication well with people at different levels. Computer literate (MS Word, Excel and Power Point) and good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational skills. Good inter-personal skills. High level of reliability. Good communication skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refers the calls to the correct role. Record appointments and events in the dairy of the Director. Operate office equipment like fax and photocopying machine. Liaises with travelling agencies to make travelling arrangements for Chief Director. Processes travel and subsistence claims for Director. Follow up the arrangements and discuss with the Chief Director when the relevant documents are received to ensure that the Director endorsed the accommodation prior confirmation. Arrange meetings and events for Director. Book venues, invites role player, organise refreshments and set up schedules for meetings and events. Process all invoices that emanate from activities of the work of the Director. Records basic minutes of the meetings of the Director. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Establish and maintain filing system in the office of the Director. Administers matters like the leave for the Director. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collect all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Manage the correspondences in and out of the Director’s office. Ensure that documents submitted for the Director’s approval adhere to set norms and standards. Remain abreast with the procedures and processes that apply in the DOD to ensure efficient and effective support to the Director. Study the relevant Public Service and departmental prescripts/policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly.
jobs.enquiries: Brigadier General M.J. Ledwaba Tel No: (012) 339 5019/Leading Seaman T.B. Leburu Tel No: (012) 339 5001
jobs.applications: Department of Defence, Chief Directorate Human Resource Management, Private Bag X976, Pretoria, 0001, may hand delivered to: Bank of Lisbon Building, 400 Paul Kruger Street, Pretoria 0001 or email to: Tshegofatso.Leburu@dod.mil.za
jobs.notes: It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through       the    filling  of     this   posts    with     candidates     whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity in line with the numeric targets as contained in our Employment Equity plan. Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office i.e effective 01 January 2021 or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. Should an application be received using incorrect application employment form Z83, it will be disqualified, which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant and which must be accompanied by a detailed CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge & experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview which should not be older than six months. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in applications being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit a separate form Z83 (as well as the documentation mentioned above) in respect of each post being applied for. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. Should an application be received where an applicant applies for more than one post on the same applications form, the application will only be considered for the first post indicated on the application and not for any of the other posts. Under no circumstances will photostat copies or faxed copies of application documents be accepted. The successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks and qualification and employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The level of appointments is dependent upon, qualifications, relevant experience and research output. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The competency assessment will be limited to successful candidates in the interview process only. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability checks (pre-employment screening) which may include social media profiles checks. A successful candidate will have to undergo a full security vetting while in the employ of the department and negative outcome shall nullify employment contract. Failure to submit the required documents will result in your application not being considered. Successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests within one (1) month of appointment. Applicants who do not receive confirmation or feedback within 3 (three) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. For more information on the job description(s) please contact the person indicated in the post details. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POST

af.title: Senior Sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Direkteur by die Department of Defence in Pretoria, wat Graad 12 en rekenaargeletterdheid vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Graad 12/NQF Vlak 4. Sekretariële ervaring sal 'n voordeel wees. Spesiale vereistes (vaardighede benodig): Taalvaardighede en die vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke te kommunikeer. Rekenaarvaardig (MS Word, Excel en Power Point) en goeie telefoonetiket. Deglike organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële ondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe in verwys die oproepe na die korrekte rol. Neem afsprake en gebeurtenisse in die dagboek van die Direkteur op. Bedryf kantoortoerusting soos faks- en fotokopieermasjien. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reatreëlings vir die Hoofdirekteur te tref. Verwerk reis- en besteaansclaes vir die Direkteur. Volg die reëlings op en bespreek met die Hoofdirekteur wanneer die tersaaklike dokumente ontvang is om te verseker dat die Direkteur die akkommodasie voor bevestiging goedgekeur het. Reëls vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die Direkteur. Bespreek plekke, nooi rolspelers, organiseer verversings en stel skedules vir vergaderings en gebeurtenisse op. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortvloei uit die werksaktiwiteite van die Direkteur. Neem basiese notule van die vergaderings van die Direkteur. Stel roetine-korrespondensie en verslae op. Stel 'n lêerstelsel in die kantoor van die Direkteur op en onderhou dit. Administreer sake soos verlof vir die Direkteur. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verversings ens. Versamel alle tersaaklike dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bestuur korrespondensie in en uit die Direkteur se kantoor. Verseker dat dokumente wat vir die Direkteur se goedkeuring ingedien word, aan vasgestelde norme en standaarde voldoen. Bly op hoogte van die prosedures en prosesse wat in die DOD van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die Direkteur te verseker. Bestudeer die tersaaklike Openbare Diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word.

zu.title: Umabhalane Omkhulu
zu.summary: Nika inkonzo yokweseka ababhalane kwiDirektha eDepartment of Defence ePretoria, kudingeka i-Grade 12 nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.requirements: Ukuncamela kwe-Grade 12/NQF Level 4. Isipiliyoni sokuba ngumabhalane sibe yinzuzo. Izidingo ezikhethekile (amakhono adingekayo): Amakhono wolimi nendlela yokuxhumana kahle nabantu abakuwo wonke amazinga. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel kanye ne-Power Point) nendlela enhle yokuphendula ifoni. Amakhono ahlelekile okuhlela izinto. Amakhono ahle kahle okuxhumana nabantu. Izinga eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana. Ikono lokusebenza ngobuhlakani nokugcina imfihlo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yokweseka ababhalane iDirektha. Yamukela amakholi efoni aye athumbele endaweni efanele. Bhala izabelo nezinkathi kumagqabantshiwe eDirektha. Sebenzisa izinto zofisi njengemishini yefaxi nokwenza amakhophi. Xhumana namawebhusayithi okuhamba ukuze ahlelele ukuhamba kweChief Director. Cubungula izikhalazo zokuhamba nokukhokha iDirektha. Landela izinhlelo zokuhamba sixoxe neChief Director lapho amadokhumenti afunekayo etholakala ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi iDirektha ivumile indawo yokuhlala ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa. Hlela izinkulumo nezinkathi zeDirektha. Gcina izindawo, mema abadlali bezingxoxo, hlela okokuphuzwayo futhi ulungise izikhathi zezinkulumo nezinkathi. Cubungula yonke imaliyethi evela emisebenzini kaDirektha. Bhala iminithi yezinkulumo zeDirektha. Bhala izindatshana ezijwayelekile namabhiko. Saka futhi ulondoloze indlela yokugcina amafayela ofisini kaDirektha. Phatha izindaba ezinjengeholo iDirektha. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezenzakalelayo njengamapeni, ukudla njll. Qoqa wonke amadokhumenti afanele ukuze iDirektha ikwazi ukuqaliswa kwezinkulumo. Phatha izindatshana ezitholakala nezithunyelwa ofisini kaDirektha. Qiniseka ukuthi amadokhumenti ethunyelwa kuDirektha okuvuma ukuthi alandelwa imithetho nemigomo esethuliwe. Gcina ukwaziswa ngemigama nendlela esetshenziswa kuDOD ukuze kuqiniseke ukweseka okusebenzayo nokuqondile iDirektha. Funda imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi nengumnyango namadokhumenti ewolunye ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuyaqondakala kahle ukusetshenziswa kwawo.

xh.title: Unobhala Ophezulu
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yophando komsebenzi kwiDirektha kwiSebe leziNkululeko ePretoria, kufuneka ube nefom yeshumi kwaye ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.requirements: Ugqibo lweGraji 12/inqanaba le-NQF 4 njengesiseko. Amava okuba ngunobhala kuya kuba luncedo. Iimfuno ezikhethekileyo (amakhono afunekayo): Amakhono olwimi nendlela yokukwazi ukuchazwa kakuhle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukeneyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel ne-Power Point) nendlela elungileyo yokuziphatha kwindlebe. Amakhono alungelelienyo ombuso. Amakhono amabalwa phakathi kwabantu. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokwathembeka. Amakhono okunxibelelwana alungileyo. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuchule nangabakho abangesiqwenga.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yophando komsebenzi njengonobhala kwiDirektha. Thatha amacele ocingo uze uwadlulise kwindlela efanelekileyo. Qulatha iindibano nemi biaso kwindlebe yokuqamba kwiDirektha. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofisi njengofeksi nomshini wokutsala iikopi. Thethathana namagosa eendwendwo ukwenza ilungiselelo leendwendwo loBhala-jikelele. Cima inkqubo yokuhamba nokubonelela ngokutya ukwenzela iDirektha. Landela ilungiselelo uze uxuxe neBhala-jikelele xa amaxwebhu afunekayo efunyenwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba iDirektha ivunye indawo yokuhlala ngaphambi kokuqinisekiswa. Lungelela iindibano nemibiaso ngeDirektha. Faka izindlu zokudibana, mema abadlali bemibiaso, lungela ukutya okutyiwa ngexesha leendibano usete ulwazi lwexesha lweendibano nemibiaso. Cima zonke iindleko ezivela kumashishini womsebenzi weDirektha. Qulatha imizuzu eyisisiseko yamandibano kaDirektha. Balisa iindlela zonxibelelwano neengxelo ezisetyenziswa rhoqo. Misela uze ulondoloze indlela yokugcina amaxwebhu kufisi yeDirektha. Lawula izinto ezinjengokubayiwa kweDirektha. Yiba nolwazi lokuthenga izinto ezisetyenziswa rhoqo ezinjengesikrini esityhala, ukutya okutyiwa ngexesha elithileyo nkqu. Gqithela zonke amaxwebhu afunekayo ukwenza iDirektha ukwazi ukulungelela iindibano. Lawula zonke iindlela ezifika nasezihamba kufisi yeDirektha. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu anikelwa ukuba iDirektha ivume iye ngokwezigaqo nemilinganiselo ezikiweyo. Zigcine uzazi iinkqubo nezithintelo ezisebenza kwiDOD ukuqinisekisa ukuba inkxaso efanelekileyo kwiDirektha inikwa ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo. Funde iimpisana zeNkonzo kaRhulumathi nezeSebe kwaye emaxwebhweni ukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuba izicelo zawo ziqondwa ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Director: SOC Governance and Legal Assurance
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 at 16h00 (Walk-in) 23h59 (online). N.B: It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department on or before the set deadline.
jobs.summary: Lead SOC governance and legal assurance at the Department of Electricity and Energy, developing compliance review instruments and providing technical advisory services to executive management.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate degree in LLB or equivalent at NQF level 7 recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), plus the pre-entry certificate for SMS (Nyukela). Additional requirements as an Admitted Attorney or an Advocate. Plus 5 years of experience at the middle/senior managerial level in Legal or Corporate Governance. Knowledge of: Legislative and policy prescripts relevant to the Department and its SOE’s. Corporate governance as it applies to the public and private sector, Company law, PFMA, Project Management, Strategic Planning, Risk Management and a strong legal background. Skills: Communication, Financial Management, Problem solving and Analytical skills. Honesty and integrity; change management, strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation, people management and empowerment. Thinking Demand: Information evaluation; decision- making, creativity, Tact, work individuality and in a group.
jobs.duties: Undertake the development of standardised SOC governance review and reporting instruments. Lead or partake in SOC governance assurance projects to assess compliance and enable DEE management structures to facilitate corrective action where required. Provide technical advisory services to executive management and the shareholders on the appointment and dismissal of SOC Board Members. Develop and coordinate the implementation of the DEE’s legal assurance policy regime and standardised legal instrument assurance framework for the SOC Group. Align existing and/or develop legal instruments for the governance of SOCs in the group. Draft legal opinions on the shareholder interface process with SOC Boards. Manage the Directorate. ENQUIRIES Mr Tshepo Makhubela Tel No: (012) 406 7577 APPLICATIONS Email to Vacancies5@dee.gov.za
jobs.applications: Submit your completed application using one of the following methods, post: The Director-General, Department of Electricity and Energy, Private Bag X96, Pretoria, 0001, or hand deliver at Matimba House Building 192 Visagie Street (Corner Paul Kruger & Visagie Street), Pretoria, or email directly to the email address dedicated to a specific post. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Ms M Palare Tel No: (012) 406 7426.
jobs.notes: Females from all races, African, Indians, Coloured and White are encouraged to apply. OTHER POSTS Applicants are informed to submit their application(s) by completing the 2021 version of the Z83 form quoting the relevant reference number and a comprehensive CV only. The CV must indicate qualifications, experience “if any” and the period thereof. The 2021 version of the Z83 form is obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za/documents. It is important to ensure that the Z83 is completed in full. This means that all fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. It is acceptable under section E, F, G, for applicants to indicate “refer to CV or see attached” due to the limited space provided on the Z83 form. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, but if you are already in Public Service just indicate “N/A”. Please initial the form and sign the declaration. Email application(s) must strictly be submitted as one (1) PDF document or attachment (i.e. Z83 and CV scanned as one PDF document). It is also important to indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Use the correct email address associated with the post. JPEG (picture/snapshot) application will not be accepted. Failure to do so, your application will be disqualified. Applications submitted using the incorrect application form (old Z83) will not be considered. Each advertised post must be accompanied by its own application for employment. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must submit an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) if shortlisted. The Department does not accept applications via fax. Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. No SMS post appointment shall be implemented without the relevant candidate producing the pre-entry certificate for SMS (Nyukela) obtainable from www.thensg.gov.za . Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the administration of the recruitment process or possible employment and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s) at any stage of the recruitment process. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into a performance agreement within three (3) months from the date of appointment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: SBK-bewind en regversekerheid
af.summary: Voer SBK-bewind en regversekerheid by die Department of Electricity and Energy, deur nakomingsherviewingsinstrumente te ontwikkel en tegniese adviesdienste aan uitvoerende bestuur te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike LLB-graad of ekwivalent op NQF vlak 7 erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), plus die toelingsertifikaat vir SMS (Nyukela). Bykomende vereistes as 'n toegelate prokureur of advokaat. Plus 5 jaar se ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in Regte of Korporatiewe Bewind. Kennis van: Wetgewende en beleidsvoorskifte wat relevant is tot die departement en sy SOE's. Korporatiewe bewind soos dit van toepassing is op die publieke en private sektor, Maatskappyreg, PFMA, Projekbestuur, Strategiese beplanning, Risikobestuur en 'n sterk regsagtergrond. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie, Finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Eerlikheid en integriteit; veranderingbestuur, strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Dienslewering innovering, mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Denkvraag: Inligtingevaluering; besluitneming, kreatiwiteit, takt, werkindividualiteit en in 'n groep.
af.duties: Onderneem die ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde SBK-bewindsherleiding en verslagdoeningsinstrumente. Lei of neem deel aan SBK-bewindversekerheidsprojekte om nakoming te assesseer en DEE-bestuursstrukture in staat te stel om korrektiewe optrede te fasiliteer waar nodig. Verskaf tegniese adviesdienste aan uitvoerende bestuur en die aandeelhouers oor die aanstelling en ontslag van SBK-raadslede. Ontwikkel en koördineer die implementering van die DEE se regversekerheidsbeleidregime en gestandaardiseerde regsinstrumentversekerheidsraamwerk vir die SBK-groep. Belyn bestaande en/of ontwikkel regsinstrumente vir die bewind van SBK's in die groep. Ontwerp regsmenings oor die aandeelhouer-koppelvlakproses met SBK-rade. Bestuur die Direktoraat. NAVRAE Mnr Tshepo Makhubela Tel No: (012) 406 7577 AANSOEKE E-pos na Vacancies5@dee.gov.za

zu.title: Umqondisi: Eshumayela I- SOC Ukuphathwa Komthetho Nokuqinisekiswa
zu.summary: Hola ukuphathwa kwe- SOC nokuqinisekiswa komthetho eDepartment of Electricity and Energy, ukuthuthukiswa kwamathuluzi okuhlola ukuzinza nokunikezwa kweenkonzo zeseluleko ezenzululwizi ezibalulekile kubaphathi abaphakeme.
zu.requirements: I-degree efanelekile ye- LLB noma okulinganayo ezinga le- NQF 7 elivunyiwe yi- South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), kanye nesatifikedi sokungena ngaphambili se- SMS (Nyukela). Izidingo ezingeziwe njengoba kukhankaswe ukuba ngu- Admitted Attorney noma i- Advocate. Kanti nokuba namaphuzu eminyaka eyi- 5 ngokulingana nokuqashwa kwindawo yabaphathi abangaphakathi/abaphakeme eMthethweni noma e- Corporate Governance. Ulwazi mayelana: Nemiyalo yomthetho namapholisi ahlobene noMnyango nase- SOE’s balawulayo. Ukuphathwa kwe- corporate njengoba kusebenza kumongo wezomphakathi nowangasese, umthetho we- Company, i- PFMA, ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, ukuhlela okunembile, ukuphathwa kwengozi nesizinda somthetho esiqinile. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukuqiniseka nokuba nokuzethemba; ukuphathwa izehlakalo, ikhono lokubamba iqhaza eliphakeme nokuhola. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezenkonzo, ukuphathwa kwabantu nakho konikeza amandla. Imino Yekhono Lokucabanga: Ukuhlola ulwazi; ukwenza izinqumo, ukudalwa, ukuziphatha kahle, ukusebenza ngabunye nangaphakathi kwesiqhobo.
zu.duties: Landelana ekuthuthukisweni kokuhlola ukuphathwa kwe- SOC okumiswe ngokwemithetho kwakho namathuluzi okubika. Kennis van: Alle tersaaklike nasionale beleide rakende klimaatsveranderingsmitigasie en -aanpassing, energie en omgewing. Omgewingsverdrae en -protokolle. Kennis van prosesse van omgewingsverdrae, insluitende die bekragtiging van omgewingsverdrae deur South Africa. Nasionale wetgewing en Wette rakende klimaatsverandering, energie en omgewing. Vaardighede: Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, analitiese en interpretasievaardighede, besonderheidsgeoriënteerde vermoë om te prioritiseer en meervoudige take te hanteer, rekenaarvaardigheid, voorleggingsvaardighede, verslagskryf en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Denkeise: Feitegeoriënteerd, vermoë om vinnig ingeligte besluite te neem, probleemoplossing, konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Koitioneer die ontwikkeling en implementering van die omgewingsbestuursplan en klimaatsveranderingsbeleid, en die omgewingsbestuurstelsel om voldoening aan omgewingsbestuursplanne en -beleid, insluitend kweekhuisgasvrystellings, te monitor. Verskaf ondersteuning en advies oor mitigasie-ingrywings wat lae-koolstofontwikkeling in die energiesektore ondersteun, insluitend Koolstofbegrotings. Verteenwoordig die departement in eksterne beleidsinisiatiewe, beide nasionaal en internasionaal, rakende klimaatsverandering en omgewingsnakoming. Verskaf analitiese ondersteuning vir beleidsnotas wat verband hou met hernubare energie, energie-doeltreffendheid, klimaatsverandering en omgewing. Bestuur die integrasie met die nasionale klimaatsveranderingsreaksiebeleid en ander verwante omgewingsbeleid. Ontwikkel of dra by tot die ontwikkeling van opvoedkundige of voorligtingsprogramme oor klimaatsverandering en omgewingsnakoming. Verskaf ondersteuning en advies oor mitigasie-ingrywings wat lae-koolstofontwikkeling in die energiesektor ondersteun, insluitend koolstofbegroting. Verskaf bestuursaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umhleli: Ukuphathwa Koshintsho Lwesimo Sezulu
zu.summary: Hlela uhlelo lokuphathwa kwemvelo namapholisi oshintsho lwesimo sezulu ehhovisi eliyingqayi le-Department of Electricity and Energy e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor of Science ehambisana nezindinganelo kuma-Natural Sciences noma i-Environmental Sciences ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 evunyiwe yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA), okuhambisana namafomu eminyaka engu-3-4 yokuhlolwa kwamandla kanye nokugxila emvelweni, amandleni noma intuthuko ebusisayo. Ukwazi kabanzi: Wonke amapholisi ezwe afanele mayelana nokunciphisa nokuzivikela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu, amandla nemvelo. Izivumelwano namaphrothokholi zemvelo. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo zezivumelwano zemvelo, okuhlanganisa ukuvuma izivumelwano zemvelo i-Ningizimu Afrika. Umthetho wezwe nama-Act mayelana nokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu, amandla nemvelo. Amaskills: Amakhono ohlelolwimi olushiwo nolubhalwayo amakhono ohlelo, amakhono okuhlaziya nokuhumusha, ikhono lokubuka imininingwane nokubeka ngapambili nokwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okwenza okuhamba kahle, ukubhala imibiko namakhono abantu. Izidingo zokucabanga: Ukugxila ezincazelweni, ikhono lokwenza izinqumo ezinolwazi ngokushesha, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kuphathwe iziphuqi.
zu.duties: Hlela ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuphathwa kwemvelo namapholisi oshintsho lwesimo sezulu, ohlelweni lokuphathwa kwemvelo okuwulondezulu kokuhambisana nahlelo namapholisi okuphathwa kwemvelo, okuhlanganisa nokukhishwa kwegesi ye-Green House Gas. Nikela nousekelo namacebo mayelana nezinyathelo zokunciphisa ezisekela intuthuko enekhabhoni ephansi emkhakheni wamandla okuhlanganisa nabejethi yekhabhoni. Mela i-Department kumazinga ephashe aphandle kwezinhlelwe zamapholisi, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele mayelana nokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu nokuhambisana nemvelo. Nikela nousekelo wokuhlaziya mayelana nemibiko yamapholisi ehlobene namandla avuselelekayo, ukuhamba kahla kwamandla noshintsho lwesimo sezulu nemvelo. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa nomthetho wezwe wokusabela ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu namanye amapholisi ohlobene nawo emvelweni. Thuthukisa noma nikele ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lokuFundisa noma lokuXhumana nabantu ngokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu nokuhambisana nemvelo. Nikela nousekelo namacebo mayelana nezinyathelo zokunciphisa ezisekela intuthuko enekhabhoni ephansi emkhakheni wamandla okuhlanganisa nabejethi yekhabhoni. Nikela izinkalo zokuphatha.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkonzo: ulawulo lokuTshintsha kweKlima
xh.summary: Lungisa iicwangciso zolawulo lwendalo neenkqubo zopolitiko ngokutshintsha kwelizulu kwiNtloko yeSebe leKagesi namandla ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seNzululwazi (Bachelor of Science) kwiZululwazi eZemvelo okanye iziZululwazi zendalo kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 7 elivunyiweyo liSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA), kananjelo neminyaka yamava emi-3-4 kwikagesi nanemfundo ekhethekileyo kwendalo, ikagesi okanye intshukumo egcinayo. Ulwazi nge: Zonke iinkqubo zopolitiko kazwelonke ezithundulula ngenxulumene nokunciphisa nokuzivikela ekutshintsheni kwelizulu, ikagesi nendalo. Iivumelwano neenkqubo zomthetho zendalo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zeevumelwano zendalo, kuquka nokuviswa kwesetyhula seendalo ngurhulumente waseSouth Africa. Umthetho kazwelonke neMithetho yepaliyameni malunga nokutshintsha kwelizulu, ikagesi nendalo. Ikhono: Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokuvelisa iilwimi, ikhono lokuhlaziya nokucazulula, ikhono lokujonga iinkcukacha nokugxininisa kumagqabantshintshi, ukwazi ukusebenzisaikhompyutha, ikhono lokubonelela ngeengxelo, ukubhala iingxelo nakho konakho ukwenza ubudlelwane nabantu. Iimfuno zokuqonda: Ukuba nobuchule kwiimininingwane, ikhono lokwenza isigqibo esikum olu lwazi ngokukhawuleza, ukusombulula iingxaki, nolawulo lokuphatha iingxabano.
xh.duties: Lungisa uphuhliso nokusebenzisa icebo lolawulo lwendalo neenkqubo zopolitiko ngokutshintsha kwelizulu, inkqubo yolawulo lwendalo yokujonga ukuzithoba kwiicwangciso neenkqubo zolawulo lwendalo, kuquka nokukhutshwa kwe-Green House Gas emissions. Nikezela inkxaso kunye nenkxumbo yezigqibo zokunciphisa ezixhasa uphuhliso olusesiKarboni esincinileyo kwimimandla yekagesi kuquka nokuqikelela i-Carbon Budgets. Mela iSebe kumimiselo yeenkqubo zangaphandle, ngamazwe ngamazwe nangaphakathi kwelizwe malunga nokutshintsha kwelizulu nokuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Nikezela inkxaso yohlaziyo lwemigaqo enxulumene nekagesi ephindwayo, ukusebenza kakuhle kwekagesi, nokutshintsha kwelizulu nendalo. Phatha ukudibanisa nenkqubo yomgaqo-nkqubo kazwelonke yokuphendula ekutshintsheni kwelizulu nakuwo onke amanye amagqabantshintshi olawulo lwendalo. Phuhlisa okanye yale ngaphezulu ekuphuhliseni iinkqubo zemfundo okanye zokuthunyelwa kolwazi malunga nokutshintsha kwelizulu nokuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yendalo. Nikezela inkxaso kunye nenkxumbo yezigqibo zokunciphisa ezixhasa uphuhliso olusesiKarboni esincinileyo kwimandla yekagesi kuquka noqikelelo lwekhabhoni. Phatha imisebenzi yabantu abalawulayo.

af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1
af.summary: Bestuur mediese adviesdienste en gesondheidsorgmonitering vir COID-dienste by die Compensation Fund se Limpopo provinsiale kantoor.
af.requirements: MBCHB. 10 jaar se funksionele ervaring in die mediese omgewing. Assesserering van mediese/ongeskiktheids-eise sal 'n voordeel wees. Registrasie by die HPCSA. Kennis: Medies-verwante wetgewing en reguleringskennis en implementering, mediese hulpkennis (gevallebestuur), Compensation Fund-beleide, prosedures, prosesse, nakomingbestuur, risikobestuur en fondsbestuur, begroting en finansiële bestuur, kliëntediens (Batho Pele-beginsels), tegniese kennis, mediese anatomie, mediese terminologie, toepassing van AMA-riglyne, Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury-regulasies, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Protection of Personal Information Act (POPI). Vaardighede: Mediese beleidsbestuur, beroepsgesondheidkennis, kliniese uitmuntendheid en advies, projeksbestuur en beplanning, inligtinganalise en interpretasie, digitale bekwaamheid/mediese stelsels (IT-stelselbeheerontwerpe), kliniese risikobeperking, kliniese kodering, gehalteversekering en verbetering, navorsing en vergelyking, belanghebbende-ontwikkeling en bestuur, onderhandeling, konsensus- en koalisievorming.
af.duties: Bestuur mediese adviesdienste vir alle COID-dienste. Bestuur en monitor gesondheidsorg. Bestuur mediese eiseverwerking. Bestuur en verskaf ondersteuning aan mediese diensverskaffers. Bestuur alle hulpbronne in die subdirektoraat.

zu.title: Ithuba Lokwelapha Izinga 1
zu.summary: Phatha izinsiza zokuweluleka kokwelapha kanye nokulawula inhlalakuhle yezempilo kumasevisi e-COID esikhundleni esikhungweni sesifunda sase-Limpopo sikaFayindi lokuhlinzeka.
zu.requirements: MBCHB. 10 iminyaka yohluvo olusebenzayo emkhakheni wokwelapha. Ukulinganisa izimangalo zokwelapha/zokukhonzakala kuzongeza inzuzo. Ukuqashelwa ku-HPCSA. Ulwazi: Ukuqondisisa & ukulawula nomthetho ohlobene nokwelapha nokuphumelelisa kwakho, ulwazi lwezinsiza zokwelapha (ulawulo lamacala), izinqubomgomo zikaFayindi lokuhlinzeka, izinqubo, izinqubo ezithile, ukuphathwa kokuhambisana, ukuphathwa kengozi nokubuswa kukaFayindi, ukubhajetha nokuphathwa kwezimali, isevisi yamakhasimedi (Imigomo kaBatho Pele), ulwazi lobuchwepheshe, ukwakheka komzimba wokwelapha, izinkulumo zokwelapha, ukusetshenziswa kwemihlahlandlela ye-AMA, umthetho wesevisi yomphakathi, uMthetho wokuPhathwa kweMali yoMphakathi (PFMA), imithetho yesikhwama sikaZwelonke, inkqubomgomo yokuthenga okukhethwa kakhulu, uMthetho wokuthuthukisa uFinyelelo lwelwazi, uMthetho wokuVikela Ulwazi Buqu (POPI). Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo yokwelapha, ulwazi lwezempilo zomsebenzi, ukugqamuka ngokwelapha kanye nokuweluleka, ukuphathwa nokuhlela amaphrojekhi, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha ulwazi, ukuzidela/ukuzijwayeza okwesikhombisa / amasistimu okwelapha (Izinhlelo zokuLawula ama-Sistimu e-IT), ukunciphisa ingozi yokuqhuba, ukufaka ikhodi yokuqhuba, ukuqinisekiswa kokulingana nentuthuko, ucwaningo kanye nokulinganisa, ukuthuthukiswa nokuphathwa kwabahlobene, ukuxoxisana, ukuvumelana nokwakha ubudlelwano.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zokuweluleka kokwelapha yonke imisebenzi ye-COID. Phatha futhi ulawule inhlalakuhle yezempilo. Phatha ukucubungula izimangalo zokwelapha. Phatha futhi unikeze inkxaso kubaphathi bezinsiza zokwelapha. Phatha wonke amathuluzi esigaba esincane.

xh.title: Isikhululi sokwenzisa iZiko leZempihlanga ngokuqinisekileyo Esi-1
xh.summary: Lawula iinkonzo zomceli-mngeni wezempilo nokuqwalasela okusesikweni kwezempilo ukwenzela iinkonzo ze-COID kwiofisi yephondo le-Limpopo ye-Fundi yokuNxibelelanisa.
xh.requirements: MBCHB. Iminyaka eyi-10 yamava okusebenza kwimeko yezempilo. Ukwenza isalathiso kwezinxaxheba zezempilo/ukungakwazi kuyakuba luncedo. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. Ulwazi: & Ulwazi lokuzisa inkqubo ngokusemthethweni kwezempilo nokuyisebenzisa, Ulwazi lwezempilo (ulawulo lweziganeko), iinkqubo ze-Fundi yokuNxibelelanisa, Iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokwenza, uLawulo lokuziphumezelela, uLawulo loMngcipheko noLawulo lwe-Fundi,okuQwalasela imali kwezimali kunye noLawulo lweziNkampani ezinceda abantu, iinkonzo zoQeqesho (iMigaqo ye-Batho Pele), Ulwazi lokuQeqesha, Ulwazi ngokwakha umzimba, iGama lezempilo, ukusebenzisa imigaqo ye-AMA, uMthetho wesebe likarhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zoLuntu (PFMA), iinkqubo ze-National Treasury, iNgqungquthela yeNkqubo yePolasi yoKhetho, uMthetho woKuthuthuzela ukufikelela kwelwazi, uMthetho woKhuselo lwelwazi loBuqu (POPI). Amakhono: uLawulo lweNkqubo yezEmpilo, Ulwazi ngokuQwalasela iNkokhelo, uPhumelelo kwezEmpilo noKucebisa ngayo, uLawulo noCocwo lweProjekthi, uQwalaselo nokutolika iNkcazelo yolwazi, uKwazi ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yamakhono obungcali / iNkqubo yezempilo (iNkqubo ye-IT yokulawula iNdlela), ukunciphisa ingozi kwezempilo, uKudibanisa kwezempilo, uQinisekiso lweNgangamva nokuyiphucula, uPhando noKulinganisa ngaphezulu, uPhuculo noLawulo babaThintileyo, uXheliswano, uDibano noManyano lokuLunga.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zomceli-mngeni wezempilo kuwo onke amasebe e-COID. Lawula ukuqwalasela okusesikweni kwezempilo. Lawula ukuqwalasela kwezinxaxheba zezempilo. Lawula unikezela inkxaso kubanikazi beenkonzo zezempilo. Lawula onke amacebo kwinkqubo entsonkothiyo yesikhundla se-ofisi esezantsi.

Valid driver’s License. Four (4) years functional experience in Health and Hygiene inspection/ services. Knowledge: Departmental policies and procedures, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Act and Regulations, OHS Act and Regulations, OHS standard, OHS Management System. Skills: Facilitation, Planning and Organising, Computer literacy, Interpersonal, Problem Solving, Interviewing, listening and observation, Presentation, Innovative, Analytical Research, Project management.
jobs.duties: Provide inputs into the development of Health and Hygiene policies and ensure implementation of OHS strategy for the Department of Labour in terms of OHS Legislation. Conduct complex inspections for Health and Hygiene regularly as per the inspection programme. Conduct technical research on the latest trends in Occupational Health and Hygiene within identified sectors. Provide support for enforcement action, including preparation of reports for legal proceedings.

af.title: Hoofinspekteur: Beroepsgezondheid en -higiëne
af.summary: Hoofinspekteur benodig in Groblersdal om beroepsgezondheids- en higiëne-inspeksies uit te voer en OHS-strategieë vir die Department of Employment and Labour te implementeer.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) / Voorgraadse bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Omgewingsgesondheid / Beroepsgezondheid / Higiëne / Analitiese Chemie / Chemiese Ingenieurswese. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vier (4) jaar funksionele ervaring in Gesondheids- en Higiëne-inspeksies / -dienste. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Batho Pele-beginsels, Public Service Act en Regulasies, OHS Act en Regulasies, OHS-standaard, OHS-bestuurstelsel. Vaardighede: Fasilitering, Beplanning en organisering, Rekenvaardigheid, Interpersoonlik, Probleemoplossing, Ondervraging, luister en waarneming, Voorlegging, Innoverend, Analitiese navorsing, Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Lewer insette tot die ontwikkeling van Gesondheids- en Higiënebeleide en verseker implementering van OHS-strategie vir die Department of Labour volgens OHS-wetgewing. Voer gereeld ingewikkelde inspeksies vir Gesondheid en Higiëne uit volgens die inspeksieprogram. Doen tegniese navorsing oor die jongste tendense in Beroepsgezondheid en -higiëne binne geïdentifiseerde sektore. Bied ondersteuning vir handhawingsaksies, insluitend die voorbereiding van verslae vir regsgedinge.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esinhloko Sokuhlola: Isempilo Yomsebenzi Nokucoza
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isikhulu Esinhloko Sokuhlola e-Groblersdal ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlola ngempilo yomsebenzi nokucoza, futhi kusetshenziswe izindlela ze-OHS kwi-Department of Employment and Labour.
zu.requirements: Three (3) year National Diploma (NQF 6) / Undergraduate bachelor's degree (NQF 7) in Environmental Health / Occupational Health / Hygiene/ Analytical Chemistry / Chemical Engineering. Ilayisense lokushayela elisebenzayo. Four (4) years functional experience in Health and Hygiene inspection/ services. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, Imigomo ye-Batho Pele, Public Service Act kanye nezimiso leyo, OHS Act kanye nezimiso leyo, izinga le-OHS, I-OHS Management System. Amakhono: Ukumatasa, Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Kubantu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukubuza izintvhuxo, ukulalela nokuqaphela, Ukwethula, Ukuba nobusuko, Ukuhlola ucwaningo, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Nikeza iminikelo ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zeze-Health and Hygiene futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo ye-OHS yi-Department of Labour ngokomthetho we-OHS. Yenza ukuhlola okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-Health and Hygiene njalo njengokohlelo lokuhlola. Yenza ucwaningo lobuchwepheshe mayelana nezinto ezintsha ezithinta i-Occupational Health and Hygiene kumasekti aqoshiwe. Nikeza inkuxa ekwenzeni isenzo sokuphoqa, okuhlanganisa nokulungiselela imibiko yezinqamulo zomthetho.

xh.title: I-Principal Inspector: Occupational Health and Hygiene
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Principal Inspector eGroblersdal ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kwezempilo ezomsebenzini nakwizihlangothi, kwaye kuqatshelwe iinkqubo ze-OHS kwi-Department of Employment and Labour.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) yeminyaka emithathu (3) / I-Undergraduate bachelor's degree (NQF 7) kwi-Environmental Health / Occupational Health / Hygiene/ Analytical Chemistry / Chemical Engineering. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa esemthethweni. Ishishini lokusebenza leminyaka emine (4) kukuhlolwa/iinkonzo kwezempilo nakwizihlangothi. Ulwazi: Iindlela zolawulo nezenzo zesebe, i-Batho Pele Principles, i-Public Service Act nakwi-Regulations, i-OHS Act nakwi-Regulations, isitath_modified senziwe-OHS standard, i-OHS Management System. Amandla: Ukubonelela inkqaso, ukuqamba iplani nokuqamba ngokwakho, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nokuziphatha phakathi kwabantu, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukuphendula iimibuzo, ukulalela nokutsha amehlo, i-Presentation, ukuzaca umbono, ukuphonononga ngokwe-analytical, ulawulo lwenqubo.
xh.duties: Nika izimvo kwindalo yeendlela zolawulo nezenzo kwezempilo nakwizihlangothi, uze uqinisekise ukusebenza kwenkqubo ye-OHS kwesebe le-Department of Labour ngokwelizwi lomthetho we-OHS. Yenza ukuhlolwa okunzima kwizempilo nakwizihlangothi ngokweqela njengoko kukhankanyiwe kwinkqubo yokuhlola. Yenza uphononongo olunolwazi malunga namashishini amasha kukuziphatha kwezempilo ezomsebenzini nakwizihlangothi kumacandelo atholakeleyo. Nika inkxaso ekwenzeni isigqibo sokuginyitha kuqoqosho, kuquka nolungiselelo lweendawo zokuxela ezomthethweni.

Registration with the relevant, recognised professional body is an advantage but not compulsory. Knowledge: Departmental policies and procedures, Occupational Health and Safety Act, as amended, Regulations (21), South African National Standards (Codes)- incorporated Codes become regulations, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, Unemployment Insurance Act. Skills: Planning and Organising, Communication skills, Computer Literacy, Facilitation skills, Interpersonal skills, Conflict handling skills, Negotiation skills, Problem solving skills, Interviewing skills, Presentation skills, Innovation skills, Analytical skills, Verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: To plan and independently conduct inspection with the aim of ensuring compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, Act 85 of 1993, Regulations and incorporated Standard. To confirm registration of with the Unemployment Insurance Act and the Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Plan, investigate and finalise independently incidents and complaints reported pertaining to the OHS Act and the relevant regulations and enforce as and when necessary, appear in Court as a State witness. Plan and conduct allocated proactive inspections as per schedule to monitor compliance with the relevant labour legislation, including compiling and consolidating reports emanating from such inspections. Plan and conduct advocacy campaigns on all labour legislation independently, analyse the impact thereof, consolidate and compile a report. Contribute at a higher level to planning, drafting and maintenance of regional inspection plans and reports, including execution of analysis and compilation of consolidated statistical reports on regional and allocated cases.

af.title: OHS: Inspekteur: Siviele en Konstruksie-ingenieurswese
af.summary: Voer beroepsgezondheids- en veiligheidsinspeksies uit om nakoming van tersaaklike wetgewing by die Lephalale Arbeidsentrum te verseker.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n drie (3) jaar erkenne kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike veld, d.w.s. Konstruksie-ingenieurswese. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Registrasie by die tersaaklike, erkende professionele liggaam is 'n voordeel maar nie verpligtend nie. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Wet op Beroepsgezondheid en Veiligheid, soos gewysig, Regulasies (21), Suid-Afrikaanse Nasionale Standaarde (Kodes)- geïnkorporeerde Kodes word regulasies, Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en Siektes, Wet op Werkloosheidsversekering. Vaardighede: Beplanning en Organisering, Kommunikasievaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Fasiliteringsvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Konflikhanteringvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede, Voorleggingsvaardighede, Innovasievaardighede, Analitiese vaardighede, Mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Om inspeksies te beplan en onafhanklik uit te voer met die doel om nakoming van die Wet op Beroepsgezondheid en Veiligheid, Wet 85 van 1993, Regulasies en geïnkorporeerde Standaarde te verseker. Om registrasie met die Wet op Werkloosheidsversekering en die Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en Siektes te bevestig. Beplan, ondersoek en finaliseer onafhanklik voorvalle en klagtes wat aanhangig gemaak is met betrekking tot die OHS-wet en die tersaaklike regulasies en dwing af soos wanneer nodig, verskyn in die Hof as 'n staatgetuie. Beplan en voer toegewysde proaktiewe inspeksies volgens skedule uit om nakoming van die tersaaklike arbeidswetgewing te monitor, insluitend die opstel en konsolideer van verslae wat uit sulke inspeksies voortspruit. Beplan en voer onafhanklik voorligtingsveldtogte oor alle arbeidswetgewing uit, ontleed die impak daarvan, konsolideer en stel 'n verslag op. Dra by op 'n hoër vlak tot beplanning, opstel en onderhoud van streeksinspeksieplanne en verslae, insluitend uitvoering van ontleding en samestelling van gekonsolideerde statistiese verslae oor streeks- en toegewysde gevalle.

zu.title: I-OHS: Isiphigi: Injiniyela Yemisebenzi Yolwakhiwo Nesakhiwo
zu.summary: Qamba ukubukeka kwezokuphepha nokugcinwa kwempilo ezimisebenzini ukuze qinisekiswe ukuziphendula kwemithetho ehlobene eLephalale Labour Centre.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samabanga Aphezulu kanye neneliso elishumi kuqatshiwa emkhakheni ohlobene, okungukuthi, Injiniyela Yokwakha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukubhalisa emtimbeni wezifundo eziyinhloko eziqashiwe kuyinzuza kodwa akuyona impumelelo. Ulwazi: Izinqubo namapholisi eMnyangweni, umthetho wezokuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezimisebenzini njengoba ulungisiwe, Izinqubo (21), izifundo zeSizwe saseNingizimu Afrika (Amakhowedi) - Amakhowedi ahlanganisiwe aba yizinqubo, umthetho weMali Ekhokhelwa Ngezilimali Nezifo Ezimisebenzini, umthetho we-MV1. Amakhono: Ukulungiselela kanye Nokuqamba, Amakhono Okuxhumana, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha, Amakhono Okukhuthaza, Amakhono Okuxhumana Nabantu, Amakhono Okuphatha Ukungqubuzana, Amakhono Okuxoxisana, Amakhono Okuxazulula Izinkinga, Amakhono Okuphendula Kubuzo, Amakhono Okwethula, Amakhono Okuba Nogqozi, Amakhono Okuhlaziya, Amakhono Okukhuluma Nabantu kanye Nokubhala.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi uzenze inkambiso yokubuka ngokuzimela nenhloso yokugunyaza ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho wezokuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezimisebenzini, umthetho ka-85 ka-1993, Izinqubo kanye neSifundo esihlanganisiwe. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa komthetho we-MV1 kanye nomthetho weMali Ekhokhelwa Ngezilimali Nezifo Ezimisebenzini. Cubungula, iphenze futhi iqede ngokuzimela izehlo nezikhalazo ezibikiwe ezihlobene noMthetho we-OHS kanye nezinqubo ezihlobene, futhi uqinise noma kunjani, uve eNkundleni Yezinkantolo njengofakazi bkaHulumeni. Hlela futhi wenze ukubukwa okuhleliwe okwabiwe njengohlelo lwesikhathi ukuze ulawule ukuziphendula komthetho wezabasebenzi ohlobene, okuhlanganisa nokwakha nokuhlanganisa imibiko evela kuleyo nkambiso. Hlela futhi wenze imikhuba yokukhuthaza ngemithetho yonke ezimisebenzini ngokuzimela, ukuhlaziya umthelela wayo, uhlanganise futhi uwakhe umbiko. Nikela ngezinga eliphezulu ekweni uhlelo, ekwakheni nasekugcineni amaphulani kanye nemibiko yokubuka yendawo, okuhlanganisa nokwenza ukuhlaziya nokuhlanganisa imibiko yezibalo ehlanganisiwe mayelana nezimo zendawo kanye nalezo ezelwe.

xh.title: OHS: Isiphenduli: Injiniya yokuLwa noKwakha

Twee (2) jaar se funksionele ervaring in die Inspection and Enforcement Service. Cwangcisa uze wenze iinKqubo zokuHlolo ezicwangciswayo njengoko kucwangciswe ukulawula ukulandela umthetho osebenzayo ogqitha kwilabhu, kuquka ukubhala nokuqamba iingxelo eziyimvelaphi kwezo nkalo. Cwangcisa uze wenze amaNqanaba okuZihambisa kuwo onke amathetho abalabhu ngokuzimela. Hlola umphumo wawo, uqambe uze ubhale ingxelo. Nikela ngokwakho kwelinye icala kwiCwangciso, ukubhala nokuGcina iplani neengxelo zokuHlola kwicandelo kwaye uze uphucule ulwazi lokuhlola nokuqamba iingxelo ezibonakalisa izibalo zocala neendaba ezabelwe.

Umthetho wezisekelo zamakhono wenzuzo. Isipiliyoni esithile mayelana nemithetho yabasebenzi. Umthetho ohlabezela izikhathi ezisisekelo zomsebenzi. Isiphathamandla senani lesimo esitholakala kumnyango ophethe ukuphathwa komsebenzi. I-SDLA. Umthetho wokuqinisekisa impilo yabasebenzi nokuvikela abasebenzi ezinkingeni. I-COIDA. Umthetho wezimali ezikhokhelwa abantu abangasebenzi. I-UI Contributions Act. Umthetho wokulingana kwezikhundla zomsebenzi. Amakhono: Ukwenza izinhlelo nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukusebenzisana nemithombo yokusebenza. Ukusebenzisana kwabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Inkinga yokuxhumana nokwazisa ngokusho kwezwi nokuqamba izwi.
zu.duties: Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokubhalisa ehlobene namasevisi okusebenza ngokomthetho (BCEA, COIDA, UI, OHS, EEA, LRA). Hola izikhungo zomsebenzi ukuze ubone ukuthi izinsizakusebenza eziyimfuneko ziyatholakala yini nenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimiso zenkonzo ze-IES kanye nezenzo zayo. Qoqa, hlanganisa futhi uhlanganise imibiko yezibalo ye-IES uyinikeze ongqongqoshe. Hlela futhi ulawule ukucwaninga kwasendaweni nakwesifundazwe. Lungela umtapo wolwazi wokuqinisekisa isenzo aze abe yisiqinisekiso kulesosimi somsebenzi, kumvikeli womphakathi nakulesosimi sabajaji.

Ukusebenza ngeKhompyutha. Emaxabantu. ukuxela iingxaki. iNtetho (eyesalathwayo nesezibhalwayo).

Qhuba ukuqwalasela kwiilabhori senta ukuze kujongwe ukuba izixhobo eziyimfuneko zisezweni nangoluhlobo lokuphucula iinkqubo namathuba e-IES.
