zu.summary: Umphathi oyinhloko obonelela ngeholo eliyisinqamba ekuphathweni kwawolintshi namabhishi, okuhlanganisa izindlela zokuvikela nokuhlinzeka ngemiyalo, kuMnyango Wezihlahla Zamatshe, Zokwezinhlanzi Nendawo.
zu.requirements: Izitifikidi ezinganinga kuleveli ye-NQF 8 kwezEzenzululwazi Zemvelo/ IzEzenzululwazi Zemvelo noma isitifikadi esilingana esihlobene njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okuncike konyakeni ongaphezulu kwe-8 weminyaka yokuqashelwa kokutholakala ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa noma enkundleni ephathelene. Ukuphothula ngemphumelelo Inhlelo Yokubusa Nokuholwa Kabanzi Kweziphathmandla Zikahulumeni Wamphela (Inhlelo Yangothango) njengokuqashiwe yiSikole Sombuso (NSG). Ulwazi nokuqonda izindlela zenziwa sezululwazi, ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ulwazi lokuPhatha Imvelo/Izenzululwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho kazwelonke, izivumelwano namasabelo athile kanye nethonya lawo ekwezinhlanza. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinjongo ezingokuphela kanye nezikhandlela ezibalulekile zikahulumeni. Ubudlelwano nobungcweti: Ikhono Elikhulu Lokubusa Nokuholwa, Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Namaphrojekthi, Ukuphathwa Kokwandisa Abantu Nokunikeza Amandla, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Koshintsho, Ulwazi Ngokuphathwa Kwolwazi, Nohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kokulethwa Kwenkonzo. Ukubeka izinto endleleni ehlelekile kanye nohlelo oluhlelekile, Ikhono elihle lokukhuluma, Nokuqonda, kanye nokuqonda okujulile. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukuchaza, nokuphoqa ukuze kusetshenziswe iziqondiso, izindlela kanye nomthetho. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkungaba enkulu kakhulu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Kuphathwe isiqondiso esikhulu esibheke phambili, ukubusa, ukuphathwa nokusekelwa ngaphakathi komthetho kanye nezinhlelo ezisebenza ekuphathweni okuhlanganisiwe kwamabhishi. Kuhlinzeka ngeholo eliyisinqamba ekwakhekeni nokuphoqa ukuqashwa izindlela zokuvikela amawolintshi, ukuhlinzekwa nokugcinwa kwemiyalo yesevisi ye-Southern Ocean namasevisi e-Antarctic ukuze kususelele izinkanuko ze-South Africa, kuqinisekiswe ukuhlangana okuzinzile kwezombusazwe namaphesinde okuhlola imvelo yamabhishi. Kuhlinzwa ngesiqondiso esikhulu esibheke phambili esivezelwe isifundo, ukubusa, ukuphathwa nokusekelwa ocwaningweni lwamabhishi namawolintshi; izindlela zokuqonda ushintsho nokuphendula, kanye nokuhlakanisha, ukuthuthukisa nokuphoqa ukusebenza kwamaphrojekthi amabhishi ahlanganisiwe. Kuphathwe, kuquputywa, kuqondiswa kwaye kubikwa ngokusebenza kwezinhlelo ezingaphakathi kwezoMnotho Wamawolintshi

zu.summary: Umphathi: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi Zobuhlelwe-buhlotshi ePretoria, ethola R1,317,384 ngonyaka, edinga izifundo ze-NQF7 nokuthi abe namafemu eminyaka yeshumi (5) esimweni sokuphatha esimweni esiphakeme.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesifundo esiphezulu (NQF7) kuSayensi Yemvelo / Ukuphathwa Kwemvelo noma iziqu ezihambisana nendlela ohambisana nayo endaweni ehlobene, njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani ukutholwa kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) ukutholwa kweminyaka esimweni sokuphatha esimaphakathi / esiphezulu endaweni ehlobene. Ukuphothulula ngemfundo ye-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoba kugunyazwe yi-National School of government (NSG) okuhambiswe ngaphambi kokwethulwa. Ulwazi ngokuhlela nokusebenzisa ukuphathwa kwemithombo yemvelo; ukuphathwa kwemithombo yemvelo noma intuthuko yasemaphandleni esekelwe kwimithombo yemvelo; ukuphathwa kwezohlelo lwemithombo yemvelo, ukuphathwa kokusebenza kanye nokuqashelwa / ukuhlela; ukutholwa nokwazi ulwazi embonini yokwengeza inani. Isidlulelo sokuqamba futhi sisebenzise izinqubomgomo. Amafundi aphakeme ekuphathwa kwezimali nasekuqashelweni kwezinhlelo. Ulwazi kanye nokutolikwa komthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Amafundi mahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe kanye nokuqoshiwe). Isidlulelo sokuqoqa futhi sihlaziye ulwazi. Amasu obuqotho obukhombisa ukuhlola. Isidlulelo sokuqasha isiqondiso esijwayelekile kanye nokuhola iqembu elifana namagatsha amaningi.
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso esiphezulu, ukuqashelwa okubuchwepheshe kanye nokuqashisa izimpendulo zomthetho mayelana nobuhlelwe-buhlotshi kanye noshintshlolwazi. Nikeza isiqondiso esiphezulu, ukuqashelwa okubuchwepheshe nokulawula ukuqashisa komthetho we-bio-safety, ukuqinisekisa ukuqashelwa okuphumelelayo, ukuqaphela, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlobo ezingezansi ezivela ngaphandle kanye nokungenela ezinhlobeni. Qamba futhi uhlanganise uhlelo lwesabelo samazwe nasenzansi sokuphathwa kwezinhlobo ezingezansi ezivela ngaphandle kanye nama-GMOs eNingizimu Afrika. Qamba futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, umthetho, izimiso kanye namakhaphu okuhlaziya izingozi, okufaka hlanga ukunikezwa kwezimiso eziphathwa ngamandla amakhulu kwezinhlobo ezingezansi ezivela ngaphandle. Qamba izikhundla kanye nokuhola izingxoxo kwizindikimba ezyingxenye ye-Biodiversity Risk Management Directorate. Qamba imibiko yamaphulatifomu amaningana mayelana nokuqashisa izinqumo ezamukelwe yithi Conference of the Parties. Qapha ukuqashelwa kwezindlela ezidlula amagatsha ngokuzinza ukumelana nezinselelo zoshintsho lomhlaba, okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezingezansi ezivela ngaphandle, izakhiwo ezihlotshiwe, kanye noshintsho lolwazi, okudlula kuyo yonke imisebenzi. Facilitate co-development projects and proposals for funding to implement sector strategies that enhance resilience to global change challenges. Serve/co-chair project steering committees of strategic projects that contribute towards the implementation of government strategies. IMIBUZO : Mr B Kgope Tel No: (012) 399 9165 AMANYE AMAPHOSTI

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo loMngcipheko weeNkcuba-ntle
xh.summary: Umphathi: Ulawulo loMngcipheko weeNkcuba-ntle ePretoria, unikezela ngo R1,317,384 ngonyaka, lifuna izifundo zeNQF7 namava eminyaka emihlanu enkundleni yabaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esinguniweyo (NQF7) kwiSayansi yeNdalo / uLawulo lweNdalo okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo kwindawo ephathelene nayo njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Ukuze ube namava amabalwa angu- (5) eminyaka kwinqanaba lomphathi ophakathi/ophhezulu kwindawo ephathelene nayo. Ukuqhuba ngempumelelo iNkqubo yangaphambi kokuqaliswa kokungena kwabaphathi abaphezulu njengokuqiniswe yiSikolo sikaRhulumente weSizwe (NSG) ezikelwe ngaphambi kokwenziwa isikhundla. Ulwazi malunga nokucwangcisa nokusebenzisa ulawulo lwezibalo zendalo; ulawulo lwezibalo zendalo okanye intshukulo yasezweni elasemaphandleni esekwe kwizibalo zendalo; ukulawula imisebenzi noku/asoko Ukucwangcisa ukusebenza kolwimi; imava nolwazi lwenkosi lwamaxesha onke ekwandiseni ixabiso. Ulwazi lokuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Amandla aphambili ekulawulenii mali nasekuqhubeni iiprojekthi. Ulwazi kuni Qonde umMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Amandla aluncedo lokuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi lokugcina nahlaziya iinkcukacha. Amandla okuba ngumkhokeli agqithiswe ngamava. Ulwazi lokunika isikhokelo iindidi ezahlukeneyo kwaye ukhokela iqela lezaphakamiso.
xh.duties: Unike isikhokelo esingunyawo, isikhokelo sendlela yobuchwephesha kwaye ulawule iimpendulo zeenkqubo zomngcipheko wezinto ephilileyo ngokutshintsha kwemozulu. Unike isikhokelo esingunyawo, isikhokelo sobuchwephesha kwaye ulawule ukusebenza komthetho we-bio-safety, uqinisekisa isikhokelo, ulwalamano lokuqwalasela ulawulo lwezinto ezingamthethwe kulwelo nezinto ezihlaselayo. Uyakha uchaza i-stratej yezizwe ekulawulweni iintlobo ezingamthethwe zisuka kulezo nangeentla ze-GMO eMzantsi Afrika. Uyakha usebenzisa iinkqubo, umthetho, iimigaqo kunye namakhephu okuqwalasela umngcipheko, kuqulathe ukunikwa kolwazi olubonelelayo ngemisebenzi yezitya ezihlaselayo. Ukuyila iindawo zeenguqu ezikulawulo loMngcipheko weNkcuba-ntle kwaye ukhokela iingxoxo ngamaphandla alo. Ulungisa iingxelo ngaphezu komthetho ngokuphumelelwa kwezigqibo ezamkelwe yiNkomfa yamaQela. Uqwalasela ukudibanisa imisebenzi ngokuchasana nemiqobo yemibi ehlabathi, iquka izitya ezingamthethwe nezihlaselayo, i-GMO, ukutshintsha kwemozulu, kuyo yonke iinkalo. Ukhuthaza uluntu lokwenza ngokubambisana iiprojekthi namacebiso okufumana imali yokwenza i-stratej ezolungele umba wokuziqhelanisa nobunzima ngokutshintsha kwemozulu. Ungumlo mnye wekomiti yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezenza isandimala ekuphumelelweni kweeknkqubo zikaRhulumente.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Volhoubare Bosbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-rol in Pretoria om die Nasionale Wette op Woude te administreer en af te dwing, beleide te ontwikkel, en lisensies vir beskermde bome te prosesseer.
af.duties: Administreer, implementeer, monitor en dwing die bepalings van die National Forests Act (NFA), 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998) af. Hersien, wysig en ontwikkel NFA-beleide, strategieë, riglyne en Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's). Verskaf tegniese advies by die verwerking van lisensies vir beskermde bome, staatswoude en natuurlike woude. Hersien en kommenteer op Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)-verslae en ander spialisverslae vir ontwikkeling wat woude en beskermde boomspesies beïnvloed. Hersien en pas Bosboutariewe vir bosbouprodukte en -dienste jaarliks aan in ooreenstemming met Tesourie-regulasies. Bevold nakoming en voer handhawing uit met betrekking tot die NFA en neem die relevante administratiewe of kriminele handhawingsmaatreëls vir NFA-oortredings. Skakel met die Directorate of Legal Services en die State Law Advisor rakende regsmenings en die interpretasie van bepalings van die Wet. Verskaf ondersteuning by Parlementêre en media-navrae. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae op vir die Direktoraat. Verhoog die Bosbouprofiel deur deelname aan Omgewingsforums en die aanbieding van kapasiteitsbouprogramme soos NFA-opleiding aan verskeie belanghebbendes, insluitend die SAPS, Regbank, Landdros en Aanklaers en Staatsorgane. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van Bosbeamptes. Verskaf insette tot dokumente en tegniese advies aan Staatsorgane en ander belanghebbendes oor die bepalings van die Wet.

zu.title: Umnenhlanganisi: Ukuphathwa Kwezihlahla Ezingavunjwa Zibusayo
zu.summary: Indima kaMnenhlanganisi ePretoria yokuphatha nokuphoqelela iNational Forests Act, ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, kanye nokucubungula amalayisense wemithi evikeliwe.
zu.duties: Phatha, sekela ngomsebenzi, qaphula futhi phoqelela izimiso zeNational Forests Act (NFA), 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998). Buka kabusha, lungisa futhi thuthukisa izinqubomgomo ze-NFA, izindlela, iziqondiso kanye ne-Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Nikeza izeluleko ezinobuchwepheshe ekucubungulweni kwamalayisense wemithi evikeliwe, izihlahla zombuso kanye nezihlahla zendabuko. Buka kabusha futhi phawula ngemibiko ye-Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) kanye namanye emibiko yochwepheshe mayelana nentuthuko ekuhintula izihlahla kanye nezinhlobo zemithi evikeliwe. Buka kabusha futhi hlela ngokuhamba konyaka izimali eziyisibheqeke ezinkonzini nasezimweni zezinto ezitholakala ezihlahleni ngokuvumelana nezimiso ze-Treasury. Khuthaza ukuhambisana nomthetho futhi wenze ukuphoqelela ngokuhlobene ne-NFA, futhi thatha izinyathelo zokuphoqelela ngokulawula iziqu noma ngokwesigwebo sezizonzo mayelana nokweqa izimiso ze-NFA. Xhumana ne-Directorate of Legal Services kanye ne-State Law Advisor mayelana nezinkomba zomthetho kanye nokuqonda izimiso zomthetho. Nikeza inkxaso mayelana nemibuzo ye-Parliament nezokuxhumana nabantu. Hlanganisa imibiko yanyanga zonke, yesikhashana kanyeneyonyaka ye-Directorate. Nyusa inhlalo ye-Forestry ngokuthi uhambe kuma-Environmental Forums futhi uqhube izinhlela zokwakha ikhono njengokukwaziswa kwe-NFA kubazuzi bezenzo abahlukahlukene okuhlanganisa i-SAPS, i-Judiciary, i-Magistrate kanye ne-Prosecutors kanye ne-State Organs. Wenze ukulungiselela kokubeka abaphathi bezihlahla. Nikeza izibhalo ezisuka emibukweni futhi ukunikeza izeluleko ezinobuchwepheshe kuma-Organs of State kanye nabanye abazuzi bezenzo ngokwemiso zalomthetho.

xh.title: Umphathi woMbane: iMimo yoQondo lweHlathi eliQhubekayo
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wombane ePretoria sokuphatha nokusebenzisa umthetho weZwelonke weHlathi, ukuthuthisa iinkqubo, nokucubungula iilayisensi zamakhaya avelusiweyo.
xh.duties: Phatha, faka ekusebenzini, hlola ukusebenza kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziwa kwezimagqibo zomthetho weZwelonke weHlathi (NFA), 1998 (Act No. 84 of 1998). Pinda ucinge, ulungise kwaye uthuthuse iinkqubo, iindlela, iziqondiso namagqibo oBusebenziso aQhelekileyo (SOPs) ze-NFA.nika iingcebiso ezobuchwephesha ekucubungulweni kweelayisensi zamakhaya avelusiweyo, amahlathi karhulumente namahlathi endalo. Pinda ucinge kwaye uchaze ngeeNqobo zoVavanyo loMhlaba oQhashiweyo (EIA) nakwezinye iireyipho zabachwephesha ngephuhlizo elithintela amahlathi nahlobo zamakhaya avelusiweyo. Pinda ucinge kwaye ulungise iindleko zeSihlathi kwimveliso namasevisi ehlathi ngamnyaka unyaka ngokuthobela iimigaqo zeQongo leMali. Khuthaza ukuthobela kwaye wenze ukusebenzisa komthetho nge-NFA kwaye uthathe izithuba ezifanelekileyo zolawulo okanye ezomthetho wezono ukwenzela iingabo ezingafaneleyo ze-NFA. Thintana neNdawo yeeNkonzo zeMthetho kunye neMcebisi woMthetho woRhulumente malunga neengcinga zamthetho nenguqulelo yezimagqibo zomthetho. Nikela inkxaso kumabuzo ePhalamande nalawo maphakathi. Hlanganisa iireyipho zenyanga, zexesha lemithi nayomnyaka wonyaka ukwenzela leNdawo. Nyusa iNqanaba leSihlathi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwiNkqubo zeNdalo kwaye uqhube iinkqubo zokuthuthisa amandla njengakwemfundo ye-NFA kumahlulahlula abathathi-nxaxheba abaquka ngeSAPS, oBuhlengi, abaMiso bomTsetfo kwaye oBambe oRhwetyo kunye namaQamba oRhulumente. Qinisekisa uLungiselelo lokuMiswa koBaphathi beHlathi. Nikela izimvo kumaxwebhu kunye neengcebiso ezobuchwephesha kumaQamba oRhulumente nakwelawanye abathathi-nxaxheba ngezimagqibo zomthetho.

Verseker die effektiewe lewering en koördinering van hulpdienste oor Hoofkantoor en streekskantore. Ondersteun die bestuur en monitering van Diensvlakooreenkomste (SLA's) om nakoming en optimale dienslewering te verseker. Bied bystand met die beplanning, koördinering en implementering van hulpdiensprojekte. Voer gereelde inspeksies van fasiliteite en dienste uit om te verseker dat aan vereiste standaarde voldoen word. Stel gedetailleerde inspeksie- en nakomingsverslae op, wat bevindings uitlig en korrigerende maatreëls voorstel. Administreer en ondersteun die bestuur van kontrakte/SLA's, insluitend prestasie-opsporing en verslagdoening. Monitor en verseker die beskikbaarheid van skoonmaakpersoneel, toerusting en materiaal vir doeltreffende dienslewering. Superviseer en lei 'n span, insluitend prestasiebestuur, opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verseker konstante skoonmaakdienslewering by alle streekskantore, insluitend die aanspreek van diensgaping. Bestuur en los diensverwante klagtes op en implementeer korrigerende en voorkomende maatreëls. Verskaf ondersteuning oor telekommunikasiedienste, insluitend die koördinering van installasies en verskuiwings van telefoonlyne. Fasiliteer die onderhoud, herstel en vervanging van defekte of verouderde telefoontoerusting. Voer bewustheids- en nakomingsveldtogte uit wat verband hou met hulp- en telekommunikasiedienste.

zu.title: Onyusiwe Umqondisi: Obusizo kanye Nenoxhoxho Lokuxhumana
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onyusiwe Umqondisi ePretoria ukuze ahlole izinsizakalo zokusekela obusizo okuhlanganisa ukucwila, ukulondolozwa kwezempilo kanye nemisebenzi yokulekelela ngokudla eKuphathweni Kwezihlahla, Ezentlazo Nasezolimo.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe Ezibalulekile Ekuqaleni Kwezinsizakalo, Ekuqaleni Kwepropathi, Ekuqondisweni Komphakathi (NQF6) noma izifundo ezithintekayo njengoba kunikwa isikhundla ngokuthi SAQA. Isipilingo samawula angu-3 yokuhamba phambili kwezinsizakalo Ebusizweni Nokuxhumana Ngesixhobo. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuphatha. Ekuqaleni Kwemali noma inhloko eqondene nayo. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuqashwa kwabasebenzi. Isakhono sokuqoqa futhi uhlaziye ulwazi. Ukuphathwa kwezinkuleko. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuhlolelana nokubhala imibiko. Isakhono sokuhlela nokuhlela. Isakhono sokuxhumana esihle (okubhaliwe nokuqhubekayo). Isakhono esihle sokuhlobana nabantu. Isakhono sokusebenza wedwa nangesikhathi esisodwa kubantu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsizakalo ezibandakanya ukusekela obusizo, ngokugqamisa ukucwila kanye ngezinsizakalo zokulondolozwa kwezempilo, ukulekelela ngokudla kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene. Qinisekisa ukwethulwa okusebenzayo kanye nohlolelwano lwezinsizakalo zokusekela ehhovisi elikhulu nasemahhovisi wendawo. Sekela ukuphathwa kanye nokuqashwa kwezivumelwano ezinamazinga okusebenza (SLA) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa kwayo nokuhlinzwa ngesinsizakalo esihle. Siza ekuhleleni, ukuhlolelaneni, kanye nokuphethweni kwezinhloko zemisebenzi yezinsizakalo zokusekela. Yenza izivivinyo ezivamile zezindawo nezinsizakalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela emigqeni ebalulekile. Qamba imibiko eqoshwayo yokuqashwa nokulandelwa, iveze izinto ezitholakele futhi inikeze izindlela zokulungisa. Phatha futhi usekele ukuphathwa kwezinkuleko/SLA, okuhlanganisa nokulandela ukusebenza kanye nokubika. Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukutholakala kwabasebenzi bokucwila, ezokusebenza, nezinto zokusebenza ukuze kuhlinzwe ngensizakalo esebenzayo. Phatha futhi uqonde iqembu, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kokusebenza, ukuqeqesha, nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusimama kokuhlinzwa ngokucwila emahhovisi onke andawona, kuhlanganise nokuqeda izikhala ezikho ezinsizakalweni. Phatha futhi uxaze izikhalazo ezihlobene nezinsizakalo, futhi usebenzise izindlela zokulungisa nokuvikela. Nikela ngesekelo ezinsizakalweni zokuxhumana ngesixhobo, okuhlanganisa nohlolelwano lokuvelisa nokushintsha imigqa yefoni. Qedela ukulungiswa, ukulungiswa, kanye nokushintsha imishini yefoni ephukileyo noma endala. Yenza amakhampeni wokwazisa nokulandela emigqeni mayelana nezinsizakalo zokusekela nokuxhumana ngesixhobo.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkulumbuso: Oboxeke nabaQhagamshelo bakaThungo
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMncedi weNkulumbuso ePretoria ukuze uhlele iinkonzo zoxhaso zoboxeke eziquka ukucoxa, ukuhlanzeka nokunika ukutya kwinkonzo eDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-Facilities Management, Property Management, Public Administration (NQF6) okanye izidanga ezifanelekile njengoko zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyaka engama-3 yamava kwi-Auxiliary and Telecommunication Services. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yentshaphazo. I-Financial and project management okwalo hambo elinxulumeneyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo ye-HR. Ikhono lokuthola kwaye uhlolisise ulwazi. Ulawulo lwamagqabantshintshi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuhlelelisa nokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokuceba nokuqhelanisa. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana (elibhalwayo nokuqhankqalayo). Ikhono elihle lokuziphatha kwabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa nakwisiqhingi.
xh.duties: Yeza iinkonzo ezingenamva zoXhaso lwoxeke, zinxulumene ngokuyimoxa nezezonxibelelwano zokucoxa nokuhlanzeka, izinto ezinika ukutya nemisebenzi enxulumeneyo. Qinisekisa ukunikwa ngaphandle kokubandebelelana kwezindlela nokuhlelelisa iinkonzo zoxhaso kulo lonke iNtloko yoMzi apho nasekubeni iofisi zamaphondo. Xhasa ukulawula nokuhlola ama-Service Level Agreements (SLAs) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithobilela nokunikwa kwamava amaxhala iinkonzo. Mnca ekucebeni, ukuhlelelisweni, nasekusebenziseni iiprojekthi zezenkonzozo zoxhaso. Yenza ipephaso nangamaxesha athile kwiziseko zezenkonzo nasezinkonzeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithoba kwemigaqo efunekayo. Qamba iingxelo echanekileyo zepephaso nokuzithobilela, kuze kugqitywe okubonwayo kutyhilwe kwaye kutyhilwe izigqibo ezilungisa oku qhubekayo. Yenza isixhobo sokulawula amagqabantshintshi/ama-SLA, kuquka ukulandela inkqubo yokusebenza nokwenza iingxelo. Hlola uze uqinisekise ukubakho komsebenzi wokucoca, iqxuva, neematshini azelelwe ukusetyenziswa ukuba inkonzo izothiswa ngokubandebelelekileyo. Qhagamshela uze umenzele iqela labantu, kuquka ukulawula inkqubo, ukuzifundisa, nophuhliso basebenzi. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kwexesha elilinganayo lesebenzi lokucoca kuzo zonke iiofisi zamaphondo, kuquka nokulunga izikhewu zesebenzi. Lawula uze usombulule iingxelo ezinxulumene nesebenzi uze usebenzise izigqibo ezilungisa nangabangela okungalindelekanga. Yiza ngenkxaso ngezonxibelelwano zomnxeba, kuquka ukuhlelelisa ukufakelwa nokutshintshwa kothungo olutsalayo. Yenza isixhobo sokugcina, ukulungisa, nokuqabusha imishini yomnxeba egula okanye ende indalo ngexesha. Yenza iinkqubo zokuxhasa ulwazi nangokuzithobilela ezinxulumene nezenkonzozo zoxhaso nezenkonzozo zonxibelelwano.

jobs.summary: Administer mining and oceans-related appeals, convene appeals committee meetings, and coordinate legal processes within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.

An extensive understanding of law administration, Public Services and Departmental procedures. Understand the facilitation of project management, research methodologies and presentation. Have good reporting / professional writing, policy formulation and negotiation skills. af.title: Regsadministratiewe beampte (MR5): Mynwese-appèlle
af.summary: Administreer mynwese- en oseaanverwante appèlle, reël vergaderings van die appèlkomitee en koördineer regtsprosesse binne die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
af.requirements: LLB-graad of 'n tersynde kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring na kwalifisering binne die tersynde veld. 'n Uitgebreide begrip van regsadministrasie, Public Services en departementele prosedures. Die aansoeker moet 'n breë kennis hê van strategiese koördinasie, beleidsontwikkeling, risikobestuur en ouditprosedures. Begrip van die fasilitering van projekbestuur, navorsingsmetodes en voorlegging. Oor goeie verslagdoenings-/professionele skryf-, beleidsformulerings- en onderhandelingsvaardighede beskik. Die vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed, asook nakoming van tydslyne is noodsaaklik. Die vermoë om met moeilike mense te werk en konflikte op te los. Die ampsdraer moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Koördineer en administreer appèlle ooreenkomstig die tersynde wetgewing en riglyne, met 'n spesifieke fokus op Oceans and Coasts-verwante appèlle. Ontvang en reageer op alle appèlverwante navrae van belanghebbendes, insluitend die appèllante en aansoekers. Reël die appèlkomiteevergadering om die appèlle te bespreek, afhangende van die kompleksiteit van die appèl. Behartig die indiening van gefinaliseerde appèlle ooreenkomstig interne indieningsbeleide en -riglyne. Koördineer en administreer permitsappèlle. Stel ministeriële voorleggings en appèlbeslissings ten opsigte van oseaan- en kusappèlle op. Verseker dat alle gronde vir appèl, antwoordstellings en lynfunksiekomentaar in 'n logiese volgorde in die appèlbeslissing vasgelê word. Berei notas oor appèlle vir die Minister voor. Verskaf algemene regsondersteuning. Verskaf ondersteuning aan litigasie oor appël-aangeleenthede deur konsultasies met prokureurs by te woon en die rekord op te stel.

zu.title: Iphini Elopharetha EzeMthetho (MR5): Izikhalazo ZezeMigodini
zu.summary: Ukuphatha izikhalazo ezihlobene nezomgodi nolwandle, ukubutha imihlangano yamakomidi ezikhalazo, kanye nokuqukumbela izinqubo zomthetho ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-LLB noma izifundo ezihambisana nazo njengoba zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ubumunzame obungaphansi kwamashumi ayisishiyagalombye (8) eminyaka isiphothiwe izifundo, kuleyo ndawo ehambisana naleso. Ukuqonda okujulile ngokuphathwa komthetho, izeNkonzo Zikahulumeni kanye nezinqubo ze-Department. Umfaki isiklamo kufanele abe nolwazi olubanzi lokuqukumbela ngokohlelo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye nezinqubo zokuhlola. Ukuqonda ukukhuthazwa kokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, izindlela zocwaningo kanye nesethulo. Ukuba nobuso bokubika / ukubhala ngobungcweti, ukwakheka kwezinqubomgomo kanye namakhono empikiswano. Ikhono lokuqoqa bese kuqikiza ulwazi, kanye nokuba nokuqaphela izikhathi ezibekiwe kubalulekile. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Lo msebenzi kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqukumbela bese kuphathwa izikhalazo ngokomthetho othile kanye nomqondo ohambisana nawo, ngenhloso eziqhamuke kwezinye izikhalazo eziyimo yogwunjini kwe-Oceans and Coasts. Ukuthola bese kuphendulwa yonke imibuzo ehlobene nezikhalazo evela kubalingisi, okuhlanganisa abashiywe isikhundla nabafaki. Ukubutha imihlangano yamakomidi ezikhalazo ukuxoxa ngezikhalazo, kuye ngobunzima besikhalazo. Ukubakhona ekugcineni amafa ezikhalazo ezigqiliwe ngokomthetho wokugcina ophakathi kanye nomqondo. Ukuqukumbela bese kuphathwa izikhalazo zemvume. Ukubhala izethulo kanye nezinqumo zezikhalazo ngezikhalazo ezihlobene nolwandle kanye noggwini. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amabiza ezikhalazo, izitatimende eziphendulayo kanye nemibhalo yokuthi isabelwe kumabhizinisi ahambisana aze abhalwe ngokulandelana okulogikele kwinzincumo yesikhalazo. Ukulungiselela izinto ezifingqiwe zoMcwebi ngalezo zikhalazo. Ukunikeza inkxaso yomthetho ngokuvamile. Ukunikeza inkxaso ezindabeni zezikhalazo eziyisimo esimangalisayo ngokuba khona emithethweni yakho kubanyelwe nabafundi bese kuhlanganiswa urekhodi.

xh.title: Ofisi woLawulo lwezomthetho (MR5): Iingxoxo zaseMigodini
xh.summary: Ukuphephisa iingxoxo ezidityaniswa nemigodi nolwandle, ukuqamba iindibano zekomiti yeengxoxo, nokuquka iinkqubo zomthetho ngaphakathi kwisebe lezoMthi, ukuZalwa kweentlanzi nokuTshabalalisa iindalo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB okanye nesiqinisekiso esihambelana neso esamkelwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalwa (8) eminyaka emva kokuqalisa isidanga kummandla ohambelana noku. Ukuqonda okubanzi ngolawulo lomthetho, iinkonzo zoLuntu nemiNqubo yesebe. Umfundi kufunke anelolwazi olubanzi ngokuquka ngokwezicwangqiso, ukuthuthukwa kweenkqubo zolawulo, ukulawula iingozi nemiNqubo yokuhlola. Ukuqonda ukwenzela kwenkqubo yolawulo lweeprojekthi, iindlela zophando nezibonelo. Ukuba nolwazi lokubika / okubhalwa ngobuchwepheshe, ukumiswwa kweenkqubo zolawulo nakhono lokuxoxisana. Ikhono lokuthuthumba nokuhlalutya ulwazi, nokuzinikela kumaxesha abekiweyo kubalulekile. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuqondanisa iingxabano. Umphathi kufunke anelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukuquka nokupephisa iingxoxo ngokwemithetho nolulwazi oluhambelana nalo, nengqondo ethile kwiingxoxo ezihambelana noLwandle nakuNtlambe. Ukufumana nokuPhendula nawuphi na umbuzo ongxoxo ohambelana nawo ovela kubathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nabaxoxi nabafaki izicelo. Ukuqamba indibano yekomiti yeengxoxo ukuxoxwa kweengxoxo, kuxhomekeke kwingqi yengxoxo. Ukubakho kogcino lweengxoxo ezigqityiweyo ngokwemigaqo nolulwazi lokugcina yase ngaphakathi. Ukuquka nokupephisa iingxoxo zemvume. Ukucazulula ingeniselo loNgangezomthetho nezigqibo zengxoxo ngokwamalunga olwandle naseNtlambe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba onke amabakhasi engxoxo, iinkcazelo eziphendulayo nezimvo zomgca wemisebenzi zibhalwe ngokulandelelana ngokweNqanaba elingatshukiyo esigqibini singxoxo. Ukuqulunqa iincwadana zokwazisa uNgangezomthetho ngeengxoxo. Ukunikela inkxaso yomthetho jikelele. Ukunikela inkxaso kumacala ngeengxoxo ngokubakho kwiindibano nomceli nokuqulunqa irekhodi.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: Akkommodasie en
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte wat akkommodasie-ondersteuningsdienste, kantoorherlokasies en fasiliteitsnakoming by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Cape Town verskaf.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Openbare Bestuur of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van twee jaar (2) relevante ervaring in 'n relevante veld. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Finansiële Bestuur, Projektebestuur, HR-praktyke Uitgebreide administratiewe ervaring. Kennis van Kontrakbestuur, monitering en beheer, Openbare Diens- en Departementele prosedures. Vaardighede, Kommunikasievaardighede (geskryf en gesproke), Leierskaps- en bestuursvaardighede. Koördinerings-, organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede, Administratiewe en verslagdoening. Oor beskik oor beplannings- en organisasie-, probleemoplossings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk, in staat wees om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om beleid toe te pas, in staat wees om individueel en in spanne te werk en vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk en onder druk te organiseer en te beplan. Sin vir verantwoordelikheid en vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre span te lei en konflikte op te los. In staat wees om inligting en verslae in te samel en te interpreteer.
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal akkommodasie-ondersteuningsdienste moet verskaf. Bystand verleen met die opstel van akkommodasiebehoeftesbepalings. Die herlokasie van kantore fasiliteer. Verseker fasiliteitsnakoming aan alle geboureëls. Versoen fakture teenoor verpligtingsregister. Opstel van Diensvlakooreenkomste- regsverwante aangeleenthede en kantoorakkommodasie-aanbiedings. Maandelikse verslag oor instandhouding en kantoorinspeksie verskaf. Administreer hulpdienste, die voorsiening van higiënedienste en voedselhulpdienste. Verseker die voorsiening van doeltreffende skoonmaak- en higiënedienste in die Coastal Region. Verwerk al die logistiek en fakture vir die afdeling. Rapporteer voorraad op 'n maandelikse basis. Verkryging van goedere en dienste.

zu.title: Induna Yezabasebenzi Abangensisisekelo: Izindawo Zokuhlala Nezempilo
zu.summary: Induna Yezabasebenzi Abangensisisekelo enikeza izinsiza zokwesekela izindawo zokuhlala, ukushintshwa kwezofisi nokuzelelana kwezinto emnyangweni i-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yasemavesi (NQF6) kwi-Public Management noma iziqu ezifanayo ezifanele. Ubuncwane beminyaka emibili (2) yeminyaka yamava ohlotshaneni olufanele. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo zokuphatha. I-Financial Management, i-Project Management, Izinqubo ze-HR Ulwazi olubanzi lokuphathwa kwezinto. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezinkontileka, ukuqapha nokuqaphisisa, izinqubo ze-Public Service nezomnyango. Amakhono, amakhono okuxoxa (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo), amakhono obuholo bokuphatha. Amakhono okuhlela, ukulungiselela nokuqamba, ukuphathwa kwezinto nokubhala okubikayo. Ukuba nokuqamba nokuhlela, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzithandela, ukuba ikhono lokuqoqa futhi uhlaziye ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenzisa izinqubo, ukuba ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye nasemapulangini kanye nekhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegandaganda elikhulu futhi uhlele futhi uqambe ngaphansi kwegandaganda. Inzwelo ebophayo kanye nekhono lokuhola iqembu elihlukene futhi laxonxa izimpixano. Ukuba ikhono lokuqoqa futhi uchaze ulwazi nengikadiphothi.
zu.duties: Owayeqokunziwe kuzodingeka anikeze izinsiza zokwesekela izindawo zokuhlala. Usize ekwakheni ukulinganiswa kwezidingo zezindawo zokuhlala. Aphulelele ukushintshwa kwezofisi. Qinisekisa ukuzelelana kwezinto nazo zonke izinqubo zokwakha. Ukulinganisa amafomu okuthengisa ngesibhebhi sokuzibophezela. Bhala ama-Service Level Agreements- izindaba ezihlotshaniswe umthetho nezinkokhelo zezindawo zokuhlala ezofisi. Nikeze ingikadiphothi yenyanga ngokwakhiwa nokuhlolwa kwezofisi. Phatha izinsiza ezibambezele, ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka kanye nezinsiza zokusiza ngokudla. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kokuhlanzeka nokusebenza kahle ezindaweni zaselugwini. Hlela konke ukuthutha kwezinto nama-invoice wesigaba. Bika izinto zesitolo nyanga zonke. Thenga izimpahla kanye nezinsiza.

Ulwazi lokuLawula iiContracts, ukuqonda nokulawula, iinkqubo zeNkonzo kaBaphakathi nezaseSebe. Amakhono, amakhono okuThetha (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo), amakhono okuBukela nokulawula. Amakhono okuQabanisa, okuHlela nokuCwangcisa, iNkonzo yeNkonzo nokubhala iingxelo. Ukuba nokuhlala nokuhlela, amakhono okuSombulula iingxaki nakusombulula iingxaki. Ukuba nakhona ukusebenza iiyure ezide ngokuzithandela, ukuba nakhona ukuqokelela nokuHlaziya ulwazi. Ukuba nakhona ukusebenzisa iinkqubo, ukuba nakhona ukusebenza ngabanye nakumanqanaba amaninzi nakwamaqela nokuSebenza ngaphantsi komthwalo ongumgangatho ongqongqo nokuHlela noCwangcisa ngaphantsi komthwalo. Inkanuko yokuzimisela nokuBa nakhona ukubaNgumkhosi weqela elinganqanaba amaninzi nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukuba nakhona ukuqokelela nokuHlaziya ulwazi neengxelo.
xh.duties: Umntu ophethe elo sixeba kuyakufuneka anike iinkonzo zoxhaso lweendawo zokuhlala. Ukuncedisa ngokuqamba iindlela zokuqikelela iimfuno zeeNkonzo. UkuQhankqashela ukwenziwa kweendawo zokuhlala. ukuQinisekisa izakhiwo ngokwemigaqo yayo yonke. UkuHambelanisa iinvoices ne commitment register. UkuBhala iService Level Agreements - izinto ezimalunga ngomthetho nokuHlala kweendawo zokuhlala eziyi office. UkuNika ingxelo yenyanga ngeenkxalabo noKuHlolwa kweendawo zokuhlala eziyi office. UkuLawula iinkonzo ezithe vethe, ukuNikezela ngamakhonzo ogoco kwiNkonzo yokutya. UkuQinisekisa ukuNikezelwa kweenkonzo zokuCoca nokuGcina ugoco koNyiliwoyo woLwandle. UkuQhuba onke amashishino nokuNikezelwa kweendawo ngemithetho yesebe. Ukwenza iingxelo ngenyanga ngesitokhwe. Ukuthenga iimpahlu ngeNkonzo.

Isakhono sokusebenza isikhathi eside ngokuzithandela. Isakhono sokuthola kanye nokuhlonza incazelo. Izakhono ezinhle zokuzwana nabantu abaningi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukukhipa imvume yemisila eyedwa kanye nezilwane ezinela. Ukucubungula isicelo samapasi. Ukuqonda ukubandwa kwengozi kwezinhlobo ezibhalwe nezilwane ezinela ngamandla okungena. Ukuxhumana kanye nokucoma abahloniphwayo ngamapasi emisila eyedwa kanye nezilwane ezinela. Ukuvumelana kanye nokungena kumhlangano omningi ukuze kwenzeke ukusebenza kwemithetho nezinqumo ezihambisana namapasi kanye nendlela Yokuvumelana nokungena kumhlangano omningi ukuze kwenzeke ukusebenza kwemithetho nezinqumo ezihambisana. Ukuyila kanye nogcina inani lawonke amapasi. Ukunikeza umbiko ohalfunywa incazelo yamapasi kanye negama lokubika ku-halfunywa ngencazelo yamapasi Ukubuyekeza kanye nogcina incazelo yamapasi. Ukuqonda ukucinga ukuze kutholakale amagama okungafanele kwezilwane kwesicelo samapasi. Ukunikeza ukubuyisa isibani ngemithetho yemisila eyedwa kanye nezilwane ezinela.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Forest Enterprise Development
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk wat klerklike ondersteuning, rekordbestuur en verkrygingsbystand vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Blootstelling aan Kantooradministrasie / Omgewing sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Basiese kennis van Public Service Regulation en PFMA. Kennis van verkrygingsprosesse, organisering en beplanning. Rekenaarvaardighede en kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike mense te werk en vermoë om konflikte op te los. Wees verantwoordelik en lojaal.
af.duties: Lewer algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste; Neem, organiseer, stoor, vang korrespondensie en inligting op en haal dit terug. Werk registers by en lewer administratiewe dienste. Hanteer roetine-navrae, maak fotokopieë, ontvang of stuur e-posse. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis, handhaaf die lêerstelsel vir die kantoor. Tik dokumente en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en handhaaf die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die kantoor. Verskaf toeleweringsketting-klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent; Skakel met interne en externe belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantoorartikels. Hou en handhaaf die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Hou en handhaaf verlofregisters; personeelrekords en bywoningsregister vir die kantoor. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent, Vang besteding op en werk dit by. verifieer die korrektheid van subkontant- en reis-aansprake van amptenare. Dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in. Hanteer telefoonrekenings en klein kontant vir die landgoed en streekkantoor.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokuphathwa: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinhlela Zesihlahla
zu.summary: Umphathi wezokuphathwa onikeza inkxaso yezomsebenzi, ephatha irekhodi futhi enikeza usizo lokuthenga izimpahla ze-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF) noma izifundo ezilinganayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi ezokuphathwa kwezofisi noma kwemvelo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngomthetho wezimpahla zomphak Nehlangano nezika-PFMA. Ulwazi ngokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi yokuthenga, ukuhlela, nokweluleka. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nendlela yokukhuluma. Amandla okuba ngezinhlobo ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu. Isidingo sokusebenza wedwa nasenhlanganweni. Isidingo sokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu. Isidingo sokusebenza nabantu abayingozi kanye nendlela yokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukube nesibopho nokuthembeka.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza ezijwayelekile zezokuphathwa; Qamba, hlela, gcina, bumba futhi buyisela imibhalo yolwazi. Buyisela izinhlu futhi nikeza izinsiza zokuphathwa. Sebenzisa imibuzo evamile, yenza amakhophi, amukele noma uthumele ama-imeyili. Sula amadokhumenti/amasenthkishi kubantu abahlukahlukene njengokuqashiwe, gcina isiphethu sezinsiza zokulondoloza izinsiza zefayela zesofisi. Thayipha amadokhumenti futhi/noma eminye imibhalo lapho kudingeka khona. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinhlu zemibhalo ezingena naphuma yesofisi. Nikeza izinkxaso zokuthungathwa kwempahla kulunga ngaphakathi; Xhumana nabantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngendlela yokuthengiswa kwezimpahla nezinsiza. Thola izilinganiso, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga izimpahla ezijwayelekile zefayela. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinhlu zempahla kulunga ngaphakathi. Nikeza izinsiza zokuqedela. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinhlu zekholishi zemvula; imibhalo yezigcwele nesibalo sokubakho esofisini. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphathwa kwezimali kulunga, futhi buza futhi buyisela okusha. Qinisekisa ukuthi iziphakamiso zokuhamba nabasebenzi ziqinisekisiwe. Thumela kumphathi ukuba akugunyaze. Sebenzisa izikhwama zefoni nezimali ezincinci zokulinga zendlu nezofisi yendluli.

xh.title: Mntu oQhoboshayo Kolawulo: Ukuphuhliswa kweShishino leHlathi
xh.summary: Umntu oqhoboshayo kolawulo onika inkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo, ulawulo lwamaxwebhu nencoko yezinto kwiSebe leZoHlathi, zeNtlanzi nokuKusingqongileyo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 (NQF) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa yiSAQA. Ulwazi kuLawulo lweOfisi / uKusingqongileyo kuya kuba yingenelo elongeleyo. Ulwazi olusetyenzayo ngeMigaqo yoBummandla boLwazi yoQobo kwaye nalula kwiNtengiso kunye noQoqosho. Ulwazi ngokusebenza kweenkqubo zethengiso, ukuqamba ngendlela, nokucwangcisa. Amakhono okusebenza nakompyutha namakhono okunxibelelana nabantu. Amakhono amabaliso obudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamntu namnye kwaye nakuqembu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olumandla. Ulwazi lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kunye nolwazi lokuxazula iingxaki. Ukuzithathela izidyhivu nokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Nika iinkxaso zomsebenzi wolawulo jikelele; Qamba, hlela, gcina, bathathe, kwaye uphinde uthathe iincoko namaxwebhu. Hlaziya iirejista kwaye unike iinkxaso ezolawulo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo, yenza iikopi ezithathwayo, zamkele, okanye uthumele iiimeyile. Sabela amaxwebhu/amatyhala kubathathi-nxaxheba abahlukeneyo njengoko kufunekile, zigcine iinkqubo zokulungiselela iifayili zofisi. Theka amaxwebhu kunye/namanye amaxwebhu nxaxheba xa kufunekayo. Gcina kwaye uhlaziye irejista yamaxwebhu ayingenayo naphuma kofisi. Nikezela ngenkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo kumthetho wokuhambisa izinto ngaphakathi kwelungu; Qhagamshelana nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthenga izinto kunye neenkonzo. Fumana iintengo, gqiba iifomu zethengo ezifanele ukuthengisa izinto zofisi ezisemgangathweni. Gcina kwaye uhlaziye irejista yempahla yelungu. Nikezela ngenkxaso yeenkonzo zokuhambisa izinto. Gcina kwaye uhlaziye iirejista zezeni; amaxwebhu abasebenzi kwaye irejista yokubakho kofisi. Lungiselela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Nikezela ngenkxaso yolawulo lweemali kwelungu, Bathathe kwaye uhlaziye imali ochithwayo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweetyiyo zokuhamba kwaye nazityhalo zabasebenzi. Thumela kumphathi wokuze avume. Phatha iiafowunti zefowuni kwaye zibe nemali encinci yokuhlola kwisimo nakofisi yommandla.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se Grade 12. I qualification yesemva kwe-matric namava ohlwini ezokuphatheka kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokuqhuba izindaba zokuphatheka. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono amahle ohlotshaneni nabantu. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqubo zomphakathi. Amakhono amahle ohlelo nokuhlela. Ikono lokusebenza amahora amade ngokuzithandelayo nokuhlela ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ikono lokuqoqa ukuhlaziya ulwazi. Ikono lokulandela imithetho, ukusebenza eyedwa, nokusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi wezokuphatheka ngenkxaso yezokuhamba kwesikhungo: amukele ubhalise unxibelelwano olungena noluphuma. Yenza izikopi ezibhalwe ngqo. Gcina ulawule uhlelo lwamafayela kwesikhungo. Siza ngokuphathwa kwezimali ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Thenga izimpahla nezinsiza kusetshenziswa izinqubo ezifanele. zu.requirements: I-GGrade 9 noma isitifiketi se-ABET Level 1 noma 2. Ukwazi ukutshala, ukulwa nomlilo, ukunciphisa okukhula kabusha. Amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono abantu nokulalela. Ukwelula uhlelo nokuphumeza, ukuhlobana nabantu, ukwamukela ibhodo, ukusebenza njengesiqhaza nokuzithiba.

Yenza imisebenzi yokuvikela nokucisha umlilo. Lawula ukutheleleka kwezilwane/ukhula olungafunekiwe, vikela izakhiwo. Ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo. Yenza izinsiza zokuvuna: yenza ukumaka kwezinkuni nokulinganisa kwemigqa wezinkuni. Zala izitshalo nezihlahla: yenza ukugcina okubhalwayo kwezitshalo/izihlahla. Khiqiza futhi ucubunge imigqa wezinkuni: ukusika/ukumisa/ukwelashwa kwemigqa, nikeza usizo ekuthengiseni imigqa.

xh.summary: Nceda ngeemisebenzi yesilviculture, ukulungisa nokutyalwa kwezihlahla kwi-Mzimkhulu Estate phantsi kwe-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-Grade 9 okanye i-ABET Level 1 okanye 2. Ulwazi ngokutyalwa kwezihlahla, ukulwa nomlilo, ukunciphisa i-coppice. Amakhono aunxibelelwano, amakhono oxhumo nabantu nakuncokolwa. Uqhelaniso nokuphumeza izigqibo, uqhathaniso-lwabantu, ukwamkela urezebiso, ukusebenza njengesiqheto nobuzenzela.
xh.duties: Yenza iimisebenzi yesilviculture kumatyala wezihlahla nasezihlateni zendalo. Lungisa iindawo ezonakalisiweyo. Yenza ukuphawula iindawo, ukubala nokuphawula izihlahla, ukunciphisa i-coppice. Hlaziya uhlobo lobhalo ngeembona zomsebenzi, ukutyalwa kwezihlahla, ukushenxa ngesandla/nangamachiza, lugcine iindawo zokwandiswa, ukususa iindidi zobukumshani. Yenza iimisebenzi zokhuseleko nokucotha komlilo. Lawula ukutheleleka kwezilwanyana/izihlahla ezilahlekileyo, ukhusele iinfrastrakhure. Ukugcinwa kweenfrastrakhure. Yenza iinkonzo zokuqhotywa kwezihlahla: yenza ukuphawula kweelogi nokulinganisa kweepoli. Khulisa izityalo nezihlahla: yaza ugqoziweyo Izityalo/izihlahla. Yenza uphononongo lweepoli: ukuqaqa/ukomisa/ukunyanga iipoli, nika inkxaso ekuthengiseni iipoli.

jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing clerical support for contract management at Government Printing Works in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate. A three-year Degree in Supply Chain Management, plus 2 years’ Experience in Contract Management field will and NQF5 certificate in contract management be an added advantage, knowledge of contract Management framework and administering of contract register will be added advantage. Other: Understanding of all relevant Supply Chain Management legislative framework, regulations and prescripts. Basic understanding of the PFMA, PPPFA, Financial Framework, Contract Management Framework, Supply Chain Management Framework, Treasury Regulations, GRAP, BBBEE) and understanding of all Public Service regulations and departmental policies and procedures.
jobs.duties: Provide clerical support in the administering of contract agreements: Prepare motivations for contracts and provide inputs for motivations to the Manager. Ensure accurate invoices of contractors for submittance to the Assistant Director for approval of payment by the Director when orders are delivered. Compile submissions to Legal for drafting of SLA and addendums. Provide clerical support in the monitoring of service level agreements: Ensure that service level agreements are in line with all relevant legislation, regulations and GPW prescripts, policies, and procedures. Ensure that contracts are properly executed, maintained, and updated by tracking contract performance, monitoring contract compliance, and ensuring that contractual obligations are met. Monitor and check the validity period of the Contracts/Service Level Agreements (SLA’s) to ensure the extension/renewal of SLA’s before it expires, if required. Maintain all contract-related documents, including creating, organizing, and filing of documents. Compile basic reports related to contract management, including contract status, performance, compliance, and risks. Assist with all contractual activities as governed by the Contract Management Framework throughout the contract life cycle including service reviews and inception meetings.

Stel voorleggings aan Regs op vir die opstel van SLA's en addenda. Verskaf skriftelike ondersteuning by die monitering van diensvlakooreenkomste: Verseker dat diensvlakooreenkomste in ooreenstemming is met alle relevante wetgewing, regulasies en GPW-voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures. Verseker dat kontrakte behoorlik uitgevoer, gehandhaaf en opgedateer word deur kontrakprestasie op te spoor, kontraknalewing te monitor en te verseker dat kontraktuele verpligtinge nagekom word. Monitor en kontroleer die geldigheidsperiode van die Kontrakte/Diensvlakooreenkomste (SLA's) om die verlenging/vernuwing van SLA's voor die vervaldatum te verseker, indien nodig. Verskaf doeltreffende administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir die Subafdeling: Verskaf bystand met logistieke ondersteuning, die bestelling en uitreiking van stasieery, ens. Behoorlike bewaring van personeelrekords. Aantal kontrakte waarop prysaanpassings gedoen is as gevolg van CPI-verhoging of PSMA-jaarlikse verhoging. Aantal kontrakvervaldaadstellingsbriewe wat aan die eindgebruiker gekommunikeer is. Werk kontrakregisters van diensverskaffers op en handhaaf dit: Verseker oplaaiing, akkurate verslagdoening en rekordhouding van alle kontrakinligting wat in die Outomatiese Kontrakregister in die Subdirektoraat verskyn soos vereis. Handhaaf alle kontrakverwante dokumente, insluitend die skep, organiseer en liasseer van dokumente. Stel basiese verslae op wat verband hou met kontrakbestuur, insluitend kontrakstatus, prestasie, nalewing en risiko's. Bystand verleen met alle kontraktuele aktiwiteite soos beheer deur die Kontrakbestuursraamwerk regdeur die kontraklewensiklus, insluitend dienshersienings en aanvangsvergaderings.

zu.title: Clerk Wolusebenzo: Ekuqondweni Kwezinkontirakwa
zu.summary: Clerk wolusebenzo onikeza usizo olubhalwe phansi ekuphathweni kwezinkontirakwa e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. I-degree eminyaka emithathu ku-Supply Chain Management, kanye neminyaka emi-2 yemfumo Yokuqondwa kwezinkontirakwa kanye nesitifiketi se-NQF5 ekuqondweni kwezinkontirakwa kuzoba ngusizo olwengeziwe, ulwazi ngohlelo lokuqondwa kwezinkontirakwa nokuphathwa kwesibuko sezinkontirakwa kuzoba ngusizo olwengeziwe. Okunye: Ukuqonda uqobo ngemithetho yonke ehlobene nohlelo lokuphathwa kwe-Supply Chain Management, imithetho nezinkomba. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo i-PFMA, i-PPPFA, i-Financial Framework, i-Contract Management Framework, i-Supply Chain Management Framework, i-Treasury Regulations, i-GRAP, i-BBBEE) kanye nokuqonda imithetho yonke yesevisi yomphakathi kanye namapholisi namagama asebenzayo omnyango.
zu.duties: Nika usizo olubhalwe phansi ekuphathweni kwezivumelwano zezinkontirakwa: Lungiselela izizathu zezinkontirakwa futhi unikeze izincombolo kumanabala wamaphrojekthi ukuze ahambise kwaMphathi. Qinisekisa izi-invoisi ezifanele zebakhiwo basebenza zokuhanjiswa kwi-Assistant Director ukugunyazwa ukukhokhelwa nguMphathi lapho izinto zithunyelwa. Hlanganisa izincomelo ku-Law ukulungiselela ukuqamba i-SLA kanye nokwengezwa. Nikeza usizo olubhalwe phansi ekuqapheleleni izivumelwano zenani lesevisi: Qinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano zenani lesevisi zihambisana nayo yonke imithetho, izimiso kanye nezinkomba ze-GPW, amapholisi, namagama asebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkontirakwa ziphathwe ngendlela efanele, zigcinwe, futhi zibuyekeziwe ngokulandelana ukusebenza kwezinkontirakwa, ukuqaphela ukuzinza kwezinkontirakwa, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izibopho zezinkontirakwa sezifezekiwe. Qaphela futhi uhlole isikhathi sokuqakambisa kwezinkontirakwa noma izivumelwano zenani lesevisi (SLA's) ukuze uqinisekise ukwandiswa noma ukubuyiselwa kwazo ngaphambi kokuqedwa kwesikhathi, uma kudingeka. Nikeza usizo lolawulo olusebenzayo kwesevisi yesigaba esingaphansi: Nikeza usizo ngokwesekela ezinsizeni, ukuthengiswa nokunikelwa kwezinto zokubhala, njll. Ugcinwa okufanele kwezarekhodi zabasebenzi. Inani lezinkontirakwa lapho kwenziwa khona ulungiso lwehintela ngenxa yenyukelo ye-CPI noma inyukelo yonyaka ye-PSIRA. Inani lezincwadi ezikhombisa ukuphela kwezinkontirakwa ezithunyelwe kumsebenzisi wokugcina. Buyekeza futhi ugcinwe isibuko sezinkontirakwa sabanikezeli besevisi: Qinisekisa ukulayisha, ukubika okufanele kanye nokugcina izinkomba zazo zonke izinkontirakwa ezibonakala kusibuko sezenzululwuli sezinkontirakwa kwizesigaba noma isikhulu njengoba kudingeka. Gcina wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nezinkontirakwa, okuhlanganisa ukudala, ukuhlela, kanye nokufaka amafayela. Hlanganisa imibiko yisisekelo ehlobene nokuphathwa kwezinkontirakwa, okuhlanganisa isimo sezinkontirakwa, ukusebenza, ukuzinza, kanye nengozi. Siza nazo zonke izenzo zezinkontirakwa njengoba kuqondiswe uhlelo lokuqondwa kwezinkontirakwa kuwo wonke umjikelezo wempilo yezinkontirakwa okuhlanganisa nokuqashwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nezinsobanqa zokuqalisa.

xh.title: Clerk kolawulo: uLawulo lweZivumelwano
xh.summary: Clerk kolawulo onikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yecle ekulawulweni kwezivumelwano e Government Printing Works e Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se Grade 12. I Degree yeminyaka emithathu kwi Supply Chain Management, kunye neminyaka yamava2 kwigatya loLawulo lweZivumelwano kwaye isatifikethi se NQF5 ekulawulweni kwezivumelwano siza kuba luzuvo olongezelelekileyo, ulwazi ngendlela yokusebenza kolawulo lwezivumelwano nokuqhuba irejista yezivumelwano kuya kuba luzuvo olongezelelekileyo. Ezinye: Kuqondwa yonke imithetho eluncedo yamagatya e Supply Chain Management, imigaqo kunye namagama obulungisa. Ukuqonda okuyintsingiselo kwe PFMA, PPPFA, i Financial Framework, i Contract Management Framework, i Supply Chain Management Framework, i Treasury Regulations, i GRAP, i BBBEE) nokuqonda zonke imigaqo yeNkonzo kaWonke wonke namacebo amasebe namanyathelo.
xh.duties: Yinkxaso yecle ekwenziweni kwezivumelwano: Lungiselela iingcombolo kumzimba wezivumelwano kwaye uze namagqabantshintshi kwiingcombolo kuMphathi. Qinisekisa izifaki ezichanekileyo zangabashukumi begqithise kwi Assistant Director ukuvunywa kwentlawulo ngu Director xa kuthunyelwa iiodolo. Hlanganisela izibhalo kuMzimba woMthetho ngenjongo yokulungiselela i SLA kwaye wongeze izihloko ezingezantsi. Yinkxaso yecle ekulandeleleni kwezivumelwano zenkonzo: Qinisekisa ukuba izivumelwano zenkonzo zilandelana nayo yonke imithetho, imigaqo kunye namagama obulungisa e GPW, iingqinisiso, namanyathelo. Qinisekisa ukuba izivumelwano ziqhutywa ngokuchanekileyo, zigcinwe, zize zibuyekezeke ngokulandelela inkqubo yezivumelwano, ukulawula ukuhambelana kwezivumelwano, nokuqinisekisa ukuba izigqibo ezithintelwe zizivumelwano zihamba njengoko kufuneka. Qwalasela kwaye uhlolo ixesha lokusebenza kwezivumelwano/izivumelwano zenkonzo (SLA's) ukuqinisekisa ukwandiswa/ukuvuselelwa kwe SLA's ngaphambi kokuba iphele, ukuba kuyimfuneko. Yinkxaso yemisebenzi yequmrhu elisezantsi: Yinkxaso ngenkqubo yokuhambisa izinto, ukuodola nokunikwa kweepeni, njalo njalo. Ugcinlo olulungileyo lwezazisi zabasebenzi. Inani lezivumelwano ukuba lajengiswa ixabiso ngenxa yenyuko kwi CPI okanye inyuko yonyaka kwi PSIRA. Inani lezivumelwano eziyalela ngokusondela ixesha lokuphela kwiwo ziye zaziswe kumsebenzisi osebenzisa isiphelo. Buyela ngokubuyekeza kwaye ugcine irejista zabahlinzeki bezivumelwano: Qinisekisa ukufakela, ukuchaza ngokuchanekileyo kwaye kugcinwe ulwazi lwezivumelwano kuwo onke abavela kwi Automated Contract register equmrhwini ongezantsi njengoko kufuneka. Gcina zonke ixatyi ezingokwemvelo kwezivumelwano, kuquka ukudala, ukulungelelanisa, kwaye ugcine ixatyi. Hlanganisela iingxelo ezisisiseko ezibhekise kolawulo lwezivumelwano, kuquka imeko yezivumelwano, inkqubo, ukuhambelana, namachinga. Yinkxaso kumashishini onke amayela nezivumelwano njengoko alawulwa ngumthetho we Contract Management Framework kulo lonke ixesha lemvilo yezivumelwano, kuquka ukuqwalasela iinkonzo kwaye kube namimagqungqushela okuqalisa.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Printing Outsourcing
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 per annum (Level 05), plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: Administration clerk providing support for printing outsourcing processes at Government Printing Works in Pretoria, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and supply chain knowledge.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate. A three-year Degree in Supply Chain Management, NQF5 certificate in contract management plus 2 years’ Experience in Supply Chain Management field will be an added advantage. Other: Understanding of all relevant Supply Chain Management legislative framework, regulations and prescripts. Basic understanding of the PFMA, PPPFA, Financial Framework, Contract Management Framework, Supply Chain Management Framework, Treasury Regulations, GRAP, BBBEE) and understanding of all Public Service regulations and departmental policies and procedures.
jobs.duties: Render effective and efficient administration support in the process of printing outsourcing: Provide administration support in the process of printing outsourcing in accordance with all relevant prescripts, policies, and procedures. Check and verify contract printers quotes and invoices are in accordance to contract tariffs. Keep record of daily monitoring of printing contracts (working progress, etc). Verify GPW specifications in line with the printing contract. Liaise with external contractors and government departments (national and provincial) to ensure smooth-running and correct printing outsourcing. Render support with the preparation of quotations: Check and verify quotations are prepared in line with the required specifications. Accurate recordkeeping and filing of quotations. Render administrative support in the quality control and inspections processes: Keep record of quality control and inspections, and risks identified. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to monitor the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of printing products in accordance with agreed specifications and deadlines. Administration, recordkeeping, and reporting: Provide support services to the Division such by keeping proper records system, photocopying, scanning, and filing and organising of documents. Proper keeping of personnel records, maintaining of the leave register for the section. Accurate reporting on time when required. Participate in the review and updating of standard operating procedures: Incorporate approved changes into SOPs in consultation with the supervisor. Review existing SOPs and identify outdated, unclear or missing information. Provide input on operational challenges and proposed improvements to existing SOPs. Maintain records of reviewed and updated SOPs for reference and compliance purposes. Service Standard and Monitoring of Suppliers. Assist with all monitoring and performance assessment of contracted suppliers on good and services delivered to be in line with the Contract Management Framework. Report any poor quality of service directly to the Contract Management unit
