af.title: Administrasieklerk: Drukwerk-Uitbesteding
af.summary: Administrasieklerk wat ondersteuning bied vir drukwerk-uitbestedingsprosesse by Government Printing Works in Pretoria, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en kennis van die voorsieningsketting vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. 'n Driejaargraad in Supply Chain Management, 'n NQF5-sertifikaat in kontrakbestuur plus 2 jaar se ervaring in die Supply Chain Management-veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ander: Begrip van alle relevante Supply Chain Management-wetgewende raamwerke, regulasies en voorskifte. Basiese begrip van die PFMA, PPPFA, Financial Framework, Contract Management Framework, Supply Chain Management Framework, Treasury Regulations, GRAP, BBBEE) en begrip van alle Public Service-regulasies en departementele beleide en prosedures.
af.duties: Lewer doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasieondersteuning in die proses van drukwerk-uitbesteding: Verskaf administrasieondersteuning in die proses van drukwerk-uitbesteding in ooreenstemming met alle relevante voorskifte, beleide en prosedures. Kontroleer en verifieer dat kontrakdrukkers se kwotasies en fakture ooreenstem met kontraktariewe. Hou rekord van daaglikse monitering van drukkontrakte (werksvoortgang, ens.). Verifieer GPW-spesifikasies in ooreenstemming met die drukkontrak. Skakel met eksterne kontrakteurs en regeringsdepartemente (nasionaal en provinsiaal) om gladde verloop en korrekte drukwerk-uitbesteding te verseker. Lewer ondersteuning met die voorbereiding van kwotasies: Kontroleer en verifieer dat kwotasies voorberei word in ooreenstemming met die vereiste spesifikasies. Akkurate rekordhouding en liasserings van kwotasies. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning in die gehaltebeheer- en inspeksieprosesse: Hou rekord van gehaltebeheer en inspeksies, en geïdentifiseerde risiko's. Koördineer met relevante belanghebbendes om die gehalte, akkuraatheid en tydige aflewering van drukprodukte in ooreenstemming met ooreengekomde spesifikasies en sperdatums te moniteer. Administrasie, rekordhouding en verslagdoening: Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan die Afdeling deur 'n behoorlike rekordstelsel te hou, fotokopiëring, skandering en liassering en ordening van dokumente. Behoorlike berging van personeelrekords, onderhoud van die verlofregister vir die afdeling. Akkurate verslagdoening betyds wanneer vereis. Neem deel aan die hersiening en opdatering van standaardbedryfsprosedures: Inkorporeer goedgekeurde veranderinge in SOP's in oorleg met die toesighouer. Hersien bestaande SOP's en identifiseer verouderde, onduidelike of ontbrekende inligting. Verskaf insette oor operasionele uitdagings en voorgestelde verbeterings aan bestaande SOP's. Onderhou rekords van hersiende en opgedateerde SOP's vir verwysings- en nakomingsdoeleindes. Diensstandaard en monitering van verskaffers. Bied aan by alle monitering en prestasie-assesserings van kontrakverskaffers oor goedere en dienste wat gelewer is om in ooreenstemming te wees met die Contract Management Framework. Rapporteer enige swak gehalte van diens direk aan die Contract Management-eenheid

zu.title: Iklerka Kolawulo: Ukuxhasha Kokushicilela
zu.summary: Iklerka kolawulo ehlinzeka ngokwesekela kumchango wokuxhasha kokushicilela e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, edinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12 nolwazi ngesonto lephantsi lezinto.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12. IDigri yeminyaka emithathu kwi-Supply Chain Management, isitifiketi se-NQF5 kuphatho wemivumelano kanye namaphuzu eminyaka engu-2 wokuhlangenwe nakho enkundleni ye-Supply Chain Management kuzoba nzuzo ehambisana nayo. Okunye: Ukuqonda yonke imigomo yomthetho ehlobene ne-Supply Chain Management, imithetho nemiyalelo. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwe-PFMA, PPPFA, Financial Framework, Contract Management Framework, Supply Chain Management Framework, Treasury Regulations, GRAP, BBBEE) kanye nokuqonda yonke imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi namapholisi namasu omnyango.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yaselawulo esebenzayo nenhle ekwichibi lokuxhasha kokushicilela. Hlinzeka ngokwesekela kolawulo ekwichibi lokuxhasha kokushicilela ngokuvumelana nawo wonke imiyalelo, amapholisi, namasu ahlobene. Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izikhashana nezikweletu zezishicileli zemivumelano zivumelana namaxeshi emivumelano. Gcina irekhodi lokugadlela nsuku zonke imivumelano yokushicilela (inqubo yomsebenzi, njll). Qinisekisa imimiselo ye-GPW ngokuvumelana nemivumelano yokushicilela. Xhumana nabakhiqizi bangaphandle namakhasimende kahulumeni (kazwelonke nasezifundeni) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukugqamka nokushicilela okufanele okuxhashiwe. Hlinzeka ngokwesekela ekulungeniseni izikhashana. Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izikhashana zilungiswe ngokuvumelana nemimiselo edingekayo. Gcina ngokuchanekileyo amarekhodi futhi ufake ezikhashana. Hlinzeka ngokwesekela kolawulo ekwichibi lokulawula izinga kanye nemicimbe yokuhlola. Gcina irekhodi lokulawula izinga kanye nokuholaza, kanye nezingozi ezitholakele. Hlanganisana neqembu elihlobene ukugadlela izinga, ukuqiniseka, kanye nokulethwa ngokushesha kwemikhiqizo yokushicilela ngokuvumelana nemimiselo evunyelwe kanye nangesikhathi. Lawulo, ukugcina amarekhodi, nokubika. Hlinzeka ngokwesekela isigaba ngokugcina isistimu efanele yamarekhodi, ukushicilela, ukuskanini, kanye nokufaka futhi uhlole amadokhumenti. Gcina ngokufanele amarekhodi abasebenzi, ukugcina irekhodi leholo lesigaba. Bika ngokuchanekileko ngesikhathi edingwa ngaso. Hlanganyela ekubukweni futhi ekubuyekeleni imiyalelo emisiwe yokusebenza. Faka izinguquko ezamukelekile kwimiyalelo yokusebenza ngokubonisana nomphathi. Buyekeza imiyalelo yokusebenza ekhona futhi uhlofe ulwazi oludala, olungacacile noma olulele. Nikeza umbono ngezinkinga zokusebenza kanye nezindwana ezithunyelwe zokuthuthukisa imiyalelo yokusebenza ekhona. Gcina amarekhodi emiyalelo ebukwe futhi ebuyekeziwe ngenjongo yokuqonda nokuqinisekisa ukuziphatha. Izinga Lenkonzo kanye Nokuqaphela Abahlinzeki. Siza ngokugadlela konke kanye nokuhlola ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki abayibonesi ngamakhasimende ngokwemikhiqizo kahulumenu ukuba ihambisane ne-Framework yokuphathwa kwemivumelano. Buka yonke inkonzo yensimbi ebi emazinga ngqo kwesigaba sokuphathwa kwemivumelano.

xh.title: Clerk yolawulo: ePrint Outsourcing
xh.summary: Umntu omlawula ukwenza iinkonzo zoncedo olawu kwinkqubo yentengiselwano yopusho e-Government Printing Works e-Pretoria, kufuna isiqibo se-G12 kwaye ulumkiwe ngomtsetzo wokwenza imiseshani yamahlebo.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi se-G12. Iziqibo Degree yeminyaka emininzi kwinkqubo ye-Supply Chain Management, isiqibo se-NQF5 kulawulo lwentsebenziswano kunye namarhulumi eminyaka emininxi Experience kwinkqubo ye-Supply Chain Management iya kuba lusaziwa. Ezinye: Ukuqonda kwo onke amagunya e-Supply Chain Management, imigqatho nemyalelo. Ukuqonda okuyintsimumva i-PFMA, i-PPPFA, uMgqatho wezimali, Umgqatho wolawulo lwentsebenziswano, umgqatho we-Supply Chain Management, i-Treasury Regulations, i-GRAP, i-BBBEE) nokuqonda kwo onke iimvotho zorhulumente namagunya kurhulumente nemigaqo yelasebe.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo efanelekileyo nesebenzayo kwinkqubo yentengiselwano kopusho: Yinkxaso yolawulo kwinkqubo yentengiselwano kopusho ngokwemigaqo, iinqwaphi-mthetho, namanyuzelo ahambelana nayo. Qinisekisa ukuqinisekisa kwamagama kwabaphathi bentsebenziswano yopusho nezityalo ukuba ziyakwanelisa iindleko zentsebenziswano. Gcina irekhodi lokulandela ngemini entsebenziswaneni yopusho (inkqubela phambili komsebenzi, njl.). Qinisekisa iindleko ezaheneyo ze-GPW ngokulawulwa kwentsebenziswano yopusho. Thintana nabathengisi bangaphandle namasebe karhulumente (kwelizwe nemaprovincial) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngokuhanjiswa kwaye kungenakuphuka kokuhanjiswa kopusho. Nika inkxaso kwilungiselelo lamagama: Qinisekisa ukuba amagama alungiselwe ngokomgangatho ofunekayo. Gcina amarekhodo achanekileyo igcino kwamagama ahanjisiweyo. Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwinkqubo yokulawula nomgangatho nezikhethekwa: Gcina irekhodo lolawulo nomgangatho wezinto ezikhetiweyo, namaxhoba aqondeke. Hlela-konke ngabanye abantu abasem_BINDI ukuze kulawulwe umgangatho, uchane nokutyhuthwa ngexesha elide qho lemveliso ezakhiwe ngokwemigangatho nangokwamaxhesha ekunqumenwe kuso. Ulawulo, ukugcina amarekhodo, nokubika: Yinkxaso iinkonzo kwicandane ngokugcina inkqubo yamarekhodo echaneke, kopishi, iskeni kwaye uhlele amaxwebhu. Gcina ngokufanelekileyo amarekhodo abantu, ulawule irejista yokurharhula kule cande. Bika ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha xa kufuneka. Thatha inxaxheba kwihlengahlengiso lokubuyekezwa kolwenziwo lomgaqo-osasazo: Faka utshintsho oluvunyiweyo kumagaqo-osasazo ngokubonisana nomlawuli. Buyekeza i-SOPs ezikhoyo uze uphe iinkcukacha ezindayo, ezingachanekanga ezitshiwoyo ezikhutshiweyo. Nika izimvo ngoluvu lokusebenza nokuphuculwa okusandulayo kwi-SOPs ezikhoyo. Gcina amarekhodo afutshane -osasazo abuyekezweyo kwaye azuhlaziyo ngenjongo yesalathiso nentsebenziso. Izinga lenkonzo nokulandela abathengisi. Nceda kuwo onke ukulandela kunye nokuqinisekiswa komgangatho kwabathengisi abantshebenzisanana ubukho obuhamba kunye nezenzo ezibekwa kumgagqo-iSovini Contract Management. Baza nayiphi na inkonzo engomgqathyweni ombi ngqo kwicandane le-Contract Management.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Internal Audit and Risk Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package), (basic salary consist of 70% of total package, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary) and a flexible portion]. The flexible portion of the package can be structured according to the Senior Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed to lead Internal Audit and Risk Management for the Department of Health in Pretoria, requiring NQF 7 in Auditing and five years' senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and an NQF 7 qualification in Auditing/ Accounting/Risk Management / Forensic Investigation. NQF 8 qualification in the above will be an advantage. Registration with the Institute of Internal Auditors as a Certified Internal Auditor. At least five (5) years’ experience at a senior managerial level in managing a complex Internal Audit function and providing assurance to senior management and an audit committee/governance structure as well as experience in developing risk-based audit strategies/plans, managing QAIP, and overseeing audit engagements and reporting. Knowledge of Public-sector ethics, fraud risk management and mechanisms for addressing corruption, maladministration and financial misconduct. Knowledge of governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks. Knowledge of applicable legislation and regulatory frameworks (e.g. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Knowledge of Global Internal Audit Standards, internal audit principles and professional practices. Good communication (verbal and written), leadership, Interpersonal, strategic capability, financial management, programme and project management, planning, monitoring, and evaluating, knowledge management, client orientation and customer focus skills. Ability to work independently and maintain professional objectivity. Ability to work under pressure and meet statutory and governance reporting deadlines. Ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information Ability to testify or provide expert evidence where required, particularly where forensic investigations form a substantive part of the post. Willingness to travel when required. A valid driver’s license. SMS pre-entry Certificate is required for appointment finalization.
jobs.duties: Oversee, coordinate and provide strategic capability and leadership to the Internal Audit Activities (IAA). Develop, implement and periodically review the Internal Audit Strategy, Three-Year Rolling and Risk-Based Internal Audit Plan, aligned to the Department's strategic objectives (APP), risk profile and approved Internal Audit Charter. Provide strategic leadership on compliance audit, forensic audit and investigation to strengthen the department’s governance, compliance and internal control environment. Prepare and present reports on Internal Audit, Compliance, risk and forensic matters. Prevent and address fraud, corruption and other irregularities, and promote accountability and a sound culture of compliance. Provide strategic leadership, direction and oversight of performance, information technology and financial audit in the department. Provide strategic leadership and direction in the planning and implementation of performance, information technology and financial audit programmes in line with departmental priorities and identified risks. Provide strategic support to audit committee. Communicate, risk exposures, governance weaknesses, control deficiencies, fraud risks, resource limitations and any impairment to Internal Audit independence or objectivity. Support the ARC in assessing the effectiveness and performance of the Internal Audit function without assuming management responsibility. Management of resources and finance. Develop and implement the strategic direction, operational plans, budget and resource requirements of the Chief Directorate. Ensure effective management of procurement, financial and administrative resources in accordance with applicable public-sector requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Q Gambu Tel No: (012) 395 8413
jobs.applications: The Director-General, National Department of Health, Private Bag X399, Pretoria, 0001. Hand delivered application may be submitted at Reception (Brown Application Box), Dr AB Xuma Building, 1112 Voortrekker Rd, Pretoria Townlands 351-JR or should be forwarded to recruitment@health.gov.za quoting the reference number on the subject e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Ms M Shitiba
jobs.notes: All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment batteries. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of candidate. Applications should be submitted on the new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and should be accompanied by a CV only (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed). The Z83 must be fully completed (in line with DPSA Practice note), failure to comply will automatically disqualify the applicant. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested prior to the final selection phase. Applications should be on one PDF format (If emailed). Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with the requirements will not be considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications and national certificates (where applicable) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. The Department reserves the right not to fill the posts. The successful candidate will be subjected to personnel suitability checks and other vetting procedures. Applicants are respectfully informed that correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If notification of an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, candidates may regard their application as unsuccessful. The Department will not be liable where applicants use incorrect/no reference number(s) on their applications. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Interne Oudit en Risikobestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig om Interne Oudit en Risikobestuur vir die Department of Health in Pretoria te lei, met 'n vereiste van NQF 7 in Ouditing en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Ouditing/Rekeningkunde/Risikobestuur/Forensiese Ondersoek. 'n NQF 8-kwalifikasie in bogenoemde sal 'n voordeel wees. Registrasie by die Institute of Internal Auditors as 'n Certified Internal Auditor. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in die bestuur van 'n komplekse Interne Oudit-funksie en die verskaffing van versekering aan senior bestuur en 'n ouditkomitee/bestuursstructuur, asook ervaring in die ontwikkeling van risikogebaseerde ouditstrategieë/planne, die bestuur van QAIP, en die toesig oor oudit-opdragte en verslagdoening. Kennis van openbare-sektor-etiek, bedrog-risikobestuur en meganismes vir die hantering van korrupsie, wanadministrasie en finansiële wangedrag. Kennis van bestuurs-, risikobestuur- en nakomingsraamwerke. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en regulatoriese raamwerke (bv. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Kennis van Global Internal Audit Standards, interne oudit-beginsels en professionele praktyke. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), leierskap, interpersoonlike, strategiese vermoë, finansiële bestuur, program- en projekbestuur, beplanning, monitering en evaluerings-, kennisbestuurs-, kliëntoriëntasie- en klantfokusvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en professionele objektiwiteit te handhaaf. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en statutere en bestuursverslagdoenings sperdatums na te kom. Vermoë om hoogs vertroulike en sensitiewe inligting te hanteer. Vermoë om getuienis te lewer of kundige bewys te verskaf waar nodig, veral waar forensiese ondersoeke 'n wesenlike deel van die pos uitmaak. Bereidwilligheid om te reis wanneer nodig. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. SMS-toelatingsertifikaat word vereis vir die finalisering van die aanstelling.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor, koördineer en verskaf strategiese vermoë en leierskap aan die Interne Oudit-aktiwiteite (IAA). Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien periodiek die Interne Oudit-strategie, driejaar-rollys en risikogebaseerde Interne Oudit-plan, in ooreenstemming met die departement se strategiese doelwitte (APP), risikoprofiel en goedgekeurde Interne Oudit-handves. Verskaf strategiese leierskap oor nakomingsoudit, forensiese oudit en ondersoek om die departement se bestuurs-, nakomings- en interne beheeromgewing te versterk. Berei verslae voor en bied dit voor oor interne oudit-, nakomings-, risiko- en forensiese aangeleenthede. Voorkom en hanteer bedrog, korrupsie en ander onreëlmatighede, en bevorder verantwoordbaarheid en 'n klanke nakomingskultuur. Verskaf strategiese leierskap, rigting en toesig oor prestasie-, inligtingstegnologie- en finansiële oudit in die departement. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting in die beplanning en implementering van prestasie-, inligtingstegnologie- en finansiële ouditprogramme in ooreenstemming met departementele prioriteite en geïdentifiseerde risiko's. Verskaf strategiese ondersteuning aan die ouditkomitee. Kommunikeer risikoblootstellings, bestuursswakhede, beheertekorte, bedrogrisiko's, hulpbronbeperkings en enige benadeling van Interne Oudit-onafhanklikheid of objektiwiteit. Ondersteun die ARC in die assessering van die doeltreffendheid en prestasie van die Interne Oudit-funksie sonder om bestuursverantwoordelikheid oor te neem. Bestuur van hulpbronne en finansies. Ontwikkel en implementeer die strategiese rigting, operasionele planne, begroting en hulpbronbehoeftes van die Hoofdirektoraat. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van verkrygings-, finansiële en administratiewe hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met toepaslike openbare-sektorvereistes.

zu.title: Umqondisi Omkhulu: Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi Nolawulo Kwezengozi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umqondisi Omkhulu okuzohola Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi Nolawulo Kwezengozi kuMnyango Wezempilo ePretoria, kudinga i-NQF 7 kulo Bhalazi Nokuhlola futhi namaphuzu eminyaka eyisihlanu yemvelaphi yokuba ngumphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesiqu se-NQF 7 kwi-Bhalazi/ Ukweleta/ Ulawulo Kwezengozi/ Uphenyo Lokudlula. Isiqu se-NQF 8 kulezi zinto ezingenla kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-Institute of Internal Auditors njengoba ukuhlola okugunyaziwe. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yemvelaphi ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme ekulawulen i-nkqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi ebalulekile nokunika isiqiniseko eziphathweni zobusobalahle abaphathi abaphezulu kanye nekomidi yokuhlola/ isakhiwo sobulungiswa futhi imvelaphi ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo/ zomqulu wokuqapha ezisekelwe ezigosini. ukulawula i-QAIP, nokubuka ukuba ngaphakathi nokubika mayelana nokuhlola. Ukwazi ngezimilo zomphakathi, ukulawula kwezengozi zenqubo yokukhohlisa futhi izindlela zokulawula ukungalawuleki, ukuphatha kabi nokuziphatha okungalungile kwemali. Ukwazi ngobulungiswa, ulawulo lwezengozi, futhi nokuhambisana namasakhiwo. Ukwazi ngemithetho nayemasakhiwo omlawuliwe (isb. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations). Ukwazi ngezidingo Ezinganga Ephakathi Zokuhlola Ngaphakathi, izimilo zokuqapha ngaphakathi futhi izinkalo zomsebenzi wezobungcaleni. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ubuholi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ikhono lokuqamba emikhakheni, ukuphatha imali, ukulawula uhlelo nomqulu wemisebenzi, ukwakheka, ukulawula futhi ukuhlola, ukulawula ulwazi, ukugxila kumthengi futhi amakhono okugxila kumthengi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ndawonye futhi ugcine ukubukwa ngokobungcaleni. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokucindezelwa futhi uhlangabezane neziphethelo ezisemthethweni nezobulungiswa zokubika. Ukukwazi ukuphatha ukwaziswa okuyimfihlo kakhulu okuzwela kakhulu. Ukukwazi ukufakazela noma ukunikela ubufakazi bokwaziswa lapho kudingeka, ikakhulukazi lapho izipheno zokudlula zingxenye ephathelene nesisodwa sokuqashwa. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kanti noma kunjalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela elivunyiwe. Isitifiketi sokungena ngaphambi se-SMS sitholakala kumqulu wokugqitshwa kweso.
zu.duties: Qapha, hlanganisa futhi unike ikhono eliqambe lokuba ngumqondisi nokuhola izinkalo zokuqapha Ngaphakathi (IAA). Thutha, phumeza futhi uhlole ngesikhathi esithile umqulu wokuqapha Ngaphakathi, umqulu wokukhanyisa kweMinyaka Eyisithathu futhi onesiqu sokusekelwe kwezengozi, ogqamile nokuqondiswa kweMnyango (APP), ikhasimodi kwezengozi futhi evunyiwe isibhengezo sokuqapha Ngaphakathi. Nikeza ubuholi obuqambe kokuqapha ukuvumelaniswa, ukwahlola nokuphenya ukugqamisa ukulawula kukaMnyango, ukuvumelanisa futhi isimo sokulawula ngaphakathi. Lungisa futhi zwekela izibinqo kuqapha Ngaphakathi, ekuvumelaniseni, izengozi futhi izinto eziphathelene nokudlula. Thibela futhi addressing ukukhwesa, ukungalawuleki futhi okunye okungalungile futhi ukhuthaze ubunye kanye nesiko esihle sokuvumelaniswa. Nikeza ubuholi obuqambe, isiqondiso nokuqapha ngokwenzayo, ulwaziobuchwepheshe futhi ukuhlola imali kuMnyango. Nikeza ubuholi obuqambe futhi isiqondiso ekwakheni futhi ekuqaliseni kohlelo lokwenzayo, ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe futhi ukwahlola imali ngokuhambisana nezinhloso kanye nezingozi ezitholakele zikaMnyango. Nikeza ukusekela ngokubuqamba eqondisiwe ekomidini yokuhlola. Yisisebenziso, izengozi ezingathunyelwa, izithondo zobulungiswa, izinto ezingekho ekuqeqeshweni, izingozi zokukhwesa, imikhawulo yezinsiza nanoma yikuphi ukusilela ekwenzeni ukuqapha Ngaphakathi ngokuzimela noma ukubukwa ngokuthi ungahle wenze. Sekela i-ARC ekuhloleni ukusebenza kakhulu futhi ngokwenzayo kweqapha leqapha Ngaphakathi ngaphandle kokuthatha uxanduva lokuphatha. Ukuphatha izinsiza nemali. Thutha futhi phumeza isiqondiso esiqambe, amaphulani okusebenza, isabelo nezidingo zezinsiza zikaMqondisi Omkhulu. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokuqasha, ezimalini futhi izinsiza zokuphatha ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomphakathi ezingenla ezisebenzayo.

xh.summary: Kufuneki ugqithiswe uMqondisi oyiNtloka ukuba ahodule ukuKhangela ngaphakathi noLawulo lweengozi kwiSebe lezempilo ePretoria, kufuneka abe ne-NQF 7 kwiAuditing aneminyaka emihlanu yamava ohlolwimo abangokaqonda abaphezulu.

Isatifikethi se-SMS sifuneka sifike ngaphambi kokugqibezela isithuba.
xh.duties: Qwalasela, lungisa unikezele ngokomqondiso ophambili kunye noqhankqalazo kumisebenzi yoKukhangela ngaphakathi (IAA). Qamba, faka kulawulo kwaye uqale ngemihla yokubuyela kuMqondiso oKukhangela ngaphakathi, iThree-Year Rolling neRisk-Based Internal Audit Plan, elingana njengoko ngengcali yeSebe (APP), ngokwesiphithiphithi somngcipheko kunye noMgaga oKukhangela ngaphakathi ovunyiweyo. Nike ngokomqondiso ophambili uqhankqalazo kwi Auditing elandelayo, ukukhangela i-Audit yophando ukuze kunikelwe isandla kwiSakhiwo soKulawula, ukulandelana kweenkqubo kubhalwe ngaphakathi kolawulo iSebe. Qamba iinkcazelo malunga nokuKhangela ngaphakathi, ukulandelana kweenkqubo kumba wamaza sokukhangela, ukukhawuleziswa kolungelelwaniso nokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni. thintela kwaye ulungele iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokurhoxiswa ngemigaqo, ukurhoxiswa kolawulo olunganga ndithi okunye okungalunganga kwaye ukhuthaze olo lawulo kwaye kuvele isiko sokulandela imigaqo elungileyo. Nikela ngokomqondiso ophambili, iindlela nokugxila ekuphumeleleni, ulwulo lobunyani bezixhobo ezikumaziko aphakathi nobunzima bokuqwalasela urhwebo lwezemali. Nikela ngokomqondiso ophambili nendlela ekwenziweni nakulawulo lophumelelwano, ubunyani bezixhobo ezikumaziko nobunzima bezezimali kwinkqubo yoorhwebo ngokomdla weSebe kwaye ngokuchazi iindidi ezihlola nokubakho kweengozi. Nikela ngokomqondiso ophambili isixhaso kwiKomiti yokukhangela. thumela, iziphithiphithi ezingamaza angabakho, izinto ezibangele inxaxhi-ba, ubukho bokungabi namandla, imilinganiselo yobukho bokungabi namandla imali, ukungabikho kwezibonelelo kunye nangasiphi na isiphithiphithi ekuzimehleni kolawulo lwangaphakathi. Sika inxaxheba kwiKomiti yoKukhangelo (ARC) ekulinganiseleni amandla nokuphumelela kweSebe soKukhangela ngaphakathi, ngaphandle kokuthatha onke amaxanduva okulawula. ulawulo lwezibonelelo nemali. Qamba faka kulawulo ukulawulwa komqondiso ophambili, iinkqubo ezilawulwayo, amanye amafutha nezidingo zesibonelelo soMqondisi oyiNtloko. Qinisekisa ulawulo olululo lwesixeli esithengiswa ngemali kunye nezibonelelo ezilawulwa ngokusetyenziswa ngokwamava obulumko bakawonke-wonke alingana namadingo alawulwayo.

jobs.title: Internship
jobs.summary: Microbiology or biotechnology graduates needed for a 24-month internship coordinating import and export permits and auditing laboratories and tissue banks in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 certificate, National Diploma or degree (NQF 6) in Microbiology / Biotechnology. Good communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, attention to detail, scientific analytic in relation to Chapter 8 Regulations and Applications, and computer literacy skills.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the import and export permit programme as per Regulations No. R. 181. Audit Microbiology laboratories for registration with the Department of Health and monitoring them on biosafety and biosecurity as per Regulations No. R. 178. Register and conduct audit of Tissue Banks and Stem Cell Banks as per Regulations R. 182. And Regulations No. R. 183 respectively. Respond to queries from clinical trial industry, Health Research, post graduate student in health sciences, tissue banks and stem cell banks.
jobs.enquiries: M Kgasi Tel No: (012) 395-9029
jobs.notes: The National Department of Health invites unemployed graduates who seek practical work experience and who are interested in the Public Service career to apply for internship (an occupationally based work experience opportunity) in the occupation mentioned below for a minimum of twenty-four (24) months. The applicants must not have been exposed or have participated in an internship programme. The Department aims to enhance the employability of unemployed graduate as potential employees through this internship programme. OTHER POST

Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike, aandag aan detail, wetenskaplike analitiese vaardighede in verband met Hoofstuk 8 Regulasies en Aansoeke, en rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede.
af.duties: Koördineer die invoer- en uitvoerpermitprogram volgens Regulasies No. R. 181. zu.title: I-Internship

Phendula imibuzo evela emkhakheni we-clinical trial industry, Health Research, abafundi be-post graduate ezibalweni zezempilo, ama-tissue banks nama-stem cell banks.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Legal and Legislative Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Chief Director of Legal and Legislative Services at the Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria, offering R1,554,696 per annum at SMS Level 14.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Undergraduate Qualification LLB degree (NQF Level 7) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ relevant experience at the Senior Managerial level in Law environment. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Strong knowledge and understanding of Public Service Regulation, Public Service Act, TVET College operation and Governance, White Paper on PSET and South Africa post-school education and training landscape particularly its legislative framework, policies and regulations as well as legislation applicable in the public service, expertise in the government corporate management framework, financial management, problem solving and analysis, people management and empowerment, risk management, strategic planning and supply chain management prescripts. Proven strategic management and leadership capabilities and strong communicator with the ability to interact with the TVET College management. Expertise in litigation, contract drafting, and interpretation of statutes. Skills required: strategic capability and leadership; people management and empowerment; programme and project management; change management; client orientation and excellent verbal and written communication. Be proactive, committed with integrity. A valid driver’s license and willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: To manage the provision of legal and legislative services. Provide legal and legislative services for Education Institution. Provide legal and legislative services to skills development. Provide legal support to corporative services and planning and policy development. Render legal support for university institutions, technical vocational education and training institution. Provide strategic direction for the functioning of the Chief Directorate. Promulgate internal management directives and procedures for the Chief Directorate. Present and obtain approval for the strategic business plan of the Chief Directorate. Define goals and objectives for the Chief Directorate. Manage the performance target for the Chief Directorate. Control the allocated budget of the Chief Directorate according to departmental prescripts. Compile performance agreement for sub-ordinates and ensure the development and mentoring of allocated members. Manage the budgetary programme and ensure sound record management of the Chief Directorate. Giving legal advice and drafting legal opinions on the application and effects of national legislation, providing strategic direction to the Unit and quality assurance on all legal issues and legal documentation in support of the Minister, Director-General, and the Department. Provide day-to-day management of the Legal Services Unit and provide overall legal support. Manage and administer information and documents for the Department as a Deputy Information Officer. Conduct Strategic Planning, Budgeting and MTEF processes of the Chief Directorate to ensure high performance and cost effectiveness of legal services. Management of Legal risks. Manage all resources of the Directorate. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Regs- en Wetgewingsdienste
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur van Regs- en Wetgewingsdienste by die Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria, teen R1,554,696 per jaar op SMS Level 14.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike voorgraadse kwalifikasie LLB-graad (NQF Level 7) soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se relevante ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in 'n regsomgewing. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed soos deur die NSG goedgekeur. Sterk kennis en begrip van Public Service Regulation, Public Service Act, TVET College-bedryf en -bestuur, White Paper on PSET en die Suid-Afrikaanse na-skoolse opvoeding en opleidingslandskap, veral sy wetgewende raamwerk, beleide en regulasies sowel as wetgewing wat in die publieke diens van toepassing is, kundigheid in die regeringskorporatiewe bestuursraamwerk, finansiële bestuur, probleemoplossing en analise, menslike hulpbronbestuur en bemagtiging, risikobestuur, strategiese beplanning en voorsieningskettingbestuursvoorskrifte. Bewese strategiese bestuurs- en leierskapsvermoëns en 'n sterk kommunikeerder met die vermoë om met die TVET College-bestuur te skakel. Kundigheid in litigasie, kontrakopstel en die interpretasie van statute. Vereiste vaardighede: strategiese vermoë en leierskap; menslike hulpbronbestuur en bemagtiging; program- en projekbestuur; veranderingsbestuur; kliëntgerigtheid en uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Wees proaktief, toegewyd en met integriteit. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Om die voorsiening van regs- en wetgewingsdienste te bestuur. Verskaf regs- en wetgewingsdienste vir onderwysinstellings. Verskaf regs- en wetgewingsdienste vir vaardigheidsontwikkeling. Verskaf regssteun vir korporatiewe dienste en beplanning en beleidsontwikkeling. Lewer regssteun vir universiteitsinstellings en tegniese beroepsunderwys- en opleidingsinstellings. Verskaf strategiese rigting vir die funksionering van die Hoofdirektoraat. Proklameer interne bestuursdirectiewe en prosedures vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Dien voor en verkry goedkeuring vir die strategiese besigheidsplan van die Hoofdirektoraat. Definieer doelwitte en oogmerke vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur die prestasieteiken vir die Hoofdirektoraat. Beheer die toegekende begroting van die Hoofdirektoraat volgens departementele voorskrifte. Stel prestasieooreenkomste op vir ondergeskiktes en verseker die ontwikkeling en mentorskap van toegekende lede. Bestuur die begrotingsprogram en verseker deeglike rekordbestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat. Gee regsadvies en opstel regsmenings oor die toepassing en gevolge van nasionale wetgewing, verskaf strategiese rigting aan die Eenheid en gehaltversekering oor alle regsaangeleenthede en regsdocumentasie ter ondersteuning van die Minister, Direkteur-generaal en die Departement. Verskaf daaglikse bestuur van die Regsdiens-eenheid en verskaf algehele regssteun. Bestuur en administreer inligting en dokumente vir die Departement as 'n Adjunk-inligtingsbeampte. Voer strategiese beplanning, begroting en MTEF-prosesse van die Hoofdirektoraat uit om hoë prestasie en kostedoeltreffendheid van regsdienste te verseker. Bestuur van regsriseke. Bestuur alle hulpbronne van die Direktoraat. N.B. Alle gekorte lys kandidate sal 'n toepaslike bevoegdheidsoefening moet voltooi.

zu.title: Umdlweshu Ongunya: Isevisi Yezomthetho Nezomthethomthetho
zu.summary: Umdlweshu Ongunya wezomthetho nezomthethomthetho eDepartment of Higher Education and Training ePretoria, enikeza R1,554,696 ngonyaka ezingeni le-SMS Level 14.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zesiqu esingaphansi kweziqu ezingaphezulu LLB (NQF Level 7) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yeziphalaphala ezihambisana nendima ezingeni labaphathi abaphezulu kwindawo yomthetho. Ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoba kugunyazwe yi-NSG. Ulwazi olujulile nokukuqonda kwe-Public Service Regulation, i-Public Service Act, ukusebenza nokuphathwa kwe-TVET College, i-White Paper on PSET kanye nenhlalo yemfundo ekolishi laphuma isikoleni eNingizimu Afrika ikakhulukazi umthethomgomo wayo, izinqubomgomo nemithetho kanye nomthetho osebenza khona kwinkonzo kahulumeni, amakhono ekuphathwa kwenkampani kahulumeni, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa nabantu nokuwasiza, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukuhlela ibhizinisi ngokuhlelekile kanye nemithetho yokuphatha inxibelelwano yensiza. Amakhono abonakalayo okuphatha ngokuhlelekile nokuba ngumholi kanye nokuba ngumxhumanisi onamandla ongakwazi ukuxhumana nabaphathi be-TVET College. Amakhono ekulwenziwa komthetho, ukubhala izinhlamvama, nokuhumusha imithetho. Amakhono adingekayo: ikhono lokuhlela ngokuhlelekile nokuholwa; ukuphathwa nabantu nokuwasiza; ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi; ukuphathwa izinguquko; ukuqondiswa kumthengi nokuthumela imiyalezo ngomlomo nakubhalwe kahle. Ukuba nomoya wokuqala ukwenza izinto, ukuqinisekiswa nokuqotho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nesono sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwenikezwa kwezomthetho nezomthethomthetho. Ukunikeza izinkonzo ezingomthetho nezomthethomthetho kumathuluzi emfundo. Ukunikeza izinkonzo ezingomthetho nezomthethomthetho ekukhulisweni kwamakhono. Ukunikeza inkxaso yomthetho kumasevisi abambisana nalolu hlelo kokuqamba nenhlelo-mgomo. Ukunikeza inkxaso yomthetho ematikhungu emfundo ephezulu, namatikhungu emfundo yobuchwepheshe nokuqeqeshwa emisebenzi. Ukunikeza isiqondiso esihlelekile kumisebenzi yesikhungo sokuphatha abaphathi abaphezulu. Ukwethula futhi uthole igunya lezinqumo ezibhalwe phansi zokuphatha okungaphakathi kanye nendlela yokusebenza kuso isikhungo. Ukuhlanganisa futhi uthole imvume yohlelo lwebhizinisi esihleleke kahle lesikhungo. Ukuchaza amagolide nezinhloso zaleso sikhungo. Ukuphatha ukwenza imigomo yokuhlolwa kwesikhungo. Ukulawula ibhajethi eledluliselwe esikhungweni ngokuya nemiqulu yomnyango. Ukubhala isivumelwano sokusebenza kwabaholi abangezansi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhuliswa kokuqeqeshwa kwamalungu abekwe kulawulo. Ukuphatha uhlelo lwebhajethi kanti futhi iqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwezibhalo ezilungele lesikhungo. Ukunikeza izeluleko zomthetho kanye nokubhala izinhlomoya zomthetho ngokusebenzisa nemiphumela yomthetho kazwelonke, ukunikeza isiqondiso esihlelekile kweqembu kanye neqiniso lwezinto ezingomthetho mayelana nazo zonke izinkinga ezomthetho namadokhumenti omthetho onikela inkxaso kuNgqongqoshe, kuMhloli Jikelele, nakulo umnyango. Ukuphatha izinkonzo ezingomthetho nsuku zonke kanye nokunikeza inkxaso ephelele yomthetho. Ukuphatha nokuqasha ukwaziswa namadokhumenti ohlelo njengoba kumiyo uMnyanka wolwazi. Ukuhlola ngokuhlelekile ukuhlela, ukubhala ibhajethi kanye nemikhakha ye-MTEF kwesikhungu ukuze kugqamise ukwenza ngemphumela nokusebenza kwezomthetho ngemali ebiza kakhulu. Ukuphatha izingozi ezingomthetho. Ukuphatha wonke amagengu ohlelo. N.B. Bonke abagqwayizwe abakusi emgcawini kuzofuneka bagcwalise isivivinyo sedlela abakwazi ngaso

xh.title: Ikhaka lemongameli: Iinkonzo zeZomthetho nokuQulunqa iMithetho
xh.summary: Ikhaka lemongameli leeNkonzo zeZomthetho nokuQulunqa iMithetho kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha ePretoria, linika R1,554,696 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 14.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seSiqu esifanelekileyo se-LLB (NQF Level 7) njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. Amava amabalulekileyo angaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba lokulawula abaphezulu kwindawo yomthetho. Ukuqwalaselwa ngempumelelo kwenkqubo yeNyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengokuqinisekiswe yi-NSG. Ulwazi olunamandla nokuqonda kweeNqumamthetho zeNkonzo kaRhulumente, uMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente, ukusebenza nokulawulwa kwe-TVET College, iWhite Paper kwi-PSET nendawo yemfundo yaseNingizimu Afrika emva kwesikolo nokuqeqesha ngokukodwa umthetho wayo, iinkqubo neenkqubo zomthetho kanjalo nomthetho osebenza kwinkonzo kaRhulumente, amandla kwisikhokelo sokuqulunqa iinkqubo zorhulumente, ulawulo lweemali, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela, ulawulo lwabantu nokuba nakho amandla, ulawulo loyingozi, ucingo lucelwe kakhulu kwaye iinkqubo zokuhlinzwa ngezinto. Amandla aqinisekisiweyo okulawula isicwangciso sobuqhawe nobukhosi beentlanga nokwazi ukunxibelelana nabaphathi be-TVET College. Amandla ekusetyenziseni umthetho, ekubhaleni iinkontraki, nakutolikweni kweemithetho. Amakhono afunekayo: isakhono sobuqhawe nobukhosi; ulawulo lwabantu nokuqeqeshwa kwabo; ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo; ulawulo lokutshintsha; ukuqhela kumaxhwebhu nendlela entle yokuthetha nokubhala. Makabe ngumntu othatha isigqibo ngokukhawuleza, onokuzimisela ngokuzinza. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo nentembeko yokuhamba.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zomthetho nokuqulunqa imithetho. Ukunika iinkonzo zomthetho nokuqulunqa imithetho kwiZiko leMfundo. Ukunika iinkonzo zomthetho nokuqulunqa imithetho ekuphuhliseni amakhono. Ukunika inkxaso yomthetho kwiinkonzo zeqela ekucwangciseni nasekuphuhliseni inkqubo. Ukunika inkxaso yomthetho kwiindawo zeyunivesithi, iindawo zemfundo yamavolontiya nobugcisa bokuzilolonga. Ukunika isalathiso esingundoqo ukusebenza kweKhaka leBaphathi. Ukuphuma nabakhethi abangaphakathi iinkqubo zolawulo nendlela zokusebenza zeKhaka leBaphathi. Ukubonisa nokufumana isigqrnikelo senkqubo yeshishini leKhaka leBaphathi. Ukuchaza iinjongo nemiqobo yeKhaka leBaphathi. Ukulawula iinjongo zemveliso yeKhaka leBaphathi. Ukulawula imigangatho yemali eqokiweyo yeKhaka leBaphathi ngokweendikimba zesebe. Ukuqamba isivumelwano semveliso kubalawuli abangaphantsi kuwo kuqinisekiswa ukuphuhlisa nokukhokela amalungu abekwe kwindima. Ukulawula inkqubo yemali nokuqinisekisa ulawulo olulunge iirekhodi zeKhaka leBaphathi. Ukunikela ngeliso lomthetho nokubhala iimvo zomthetho ngokusetyenziswa nemiphumela yomthetho kazwelonke, ukunika isalathiso esingundoqo kuYuniti nokuqinisekisa ngomgangatho kuzo zonke iingxaki zomthetho nokuqwalaselwa kwamaxwebhu omthetho ngenkxaso kaNgqongqoshe, uMongameli oNgunye, nesebe. Ukunikela ngolawulo lwemihla ngemihla loYuniti leeNkonzo zoMthetho nokunikela ngolonke inkxaso yomthetho. Ukulawula nokuqulunqa iinkcukacha namaxwebhu esebe njengoSekela lawuli weenkcukacha. Ukuqhuba uCwangciso olungundoqo, ukwakha iNgxaki yeMali nemiCimbi ye-MTEF yeKhaka leBaphathi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngamandla nokusebenza kweendleko ezingekho nzima kweenkonzo zomthetho. Ulawulo lweengozi zomthetho. Ukulawula yonke imithobo yeKhaka leBaphathi. N.B. Onke abakhethiweyo kuya kufuneka bagqibe isicwangciso sokulingana esifanelekileyo

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Audit & Quality Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role overseeing internal audit and quality management at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a diploma in internal auditing and IIASA membership.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma in Internal Auditing/Degree (NQF Level 6) in Internal Auditing. A post graduate qualification in internal auditing, forensic auditing or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. Registered member of the institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Certified Internal Auditor or Professional Internal Auditor designations or relevant professional designations will be an added advantage. Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience in an internal auditing environment. Minimum 3 years’ relevant supervisory experience in internal auditing environment. Computer literacy (MS Office – advanced Excel preferred). Valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge and Skills: Sound knowledge of internal auditing principles and practices. Knowledge of the CET Act, Public Audit Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and public sector governance frameworks. Understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) and Global Internal Audit Standards. Knowledge and understanding of risk management, internal control frameworks, and corporate governance principles (King IV/V report). Understanding of public sector policies, including DHET/TVET regulatory and compliance requirements. Understanding of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015). Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills. Excellent report writing, presentation, and communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls. Strong planning, coordination, and organisational skills. Ability to interpret legislation, policies, and procedures and apply them during audits. Proficiency in compiling audit working papers and maintaining quality audit files. High attention to detail, accuracy, and compliance with auditing standards. Ability to work independently and under pressure while meeting strict audit timelines. Professionalism, accountability, and ethical conduct. Sound judgement and objectivity. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion.
jobs.duties: Prepare audit notification letters in line with the approved Annual Audit Plan. Conduct preliminary surveys to gain an understanding of systems, processes, and controls. Prepare Audit Planning Memoranda (APMs). Perform risk assessments and develop risk-based audit programmes. Identity control weaknesses and areas of improvement. Prepare and maintain quality audit files in compliance with Global Internal Audit Standards. Conduct audits in accordance with approved audit programmes and methodologies. Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls. Compliance and maintenance of the ISO 9001 standards. Assess safeguarding of assets against fraud, irregularities, and losses. Review compliance with the CET Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, and Institutional policies. Engage auditees during fieldwork and discuss preliminary findings. Perform follow-up audits on previously reported findings and recommendations. Draft clear, accurate, and evidence-based audit reports. Identity root causes and provide practical, value-adding recommendations. Conduct exit meetings and prepare minutes. Submit audit reports within agreed timelines. Support reporting to Executive Management and the Audit and Risk and Management Committee. Maintain effective professional relationships with internal stakeholders. Provide advisory input on governance, risk management, and internal control matters, where required. Guide and support management in addressing audit findings and management action plan.
jobs.enquiries: Should you have enquiries or experience any problem submitting your application contact Ms RN Selepe Tel No: (012) 401 1955 / Ms JM Nyalunga Tel No: (012) 401 1940
jobs.applications: Email to asdinternalaudit@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant position. Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Note: Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. Preference will be given to African male, African female, Coloured male, Coloured female, White male, Indian male and White female as per the EE targets of the College. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudit en Kwaliteitsbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos wat toesig hou oor interne oudit en kwaliteitsbestuur by die Department of Higher Education and Training se hoofkantoor, wat 'n diploma in interne oudit en IIASA-lidmaatskap vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Interne Oudit/Degree (NQF Level 6) in Interne Oudit. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in interne oudit, forensiese oudit of 'n tersaaklike nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geregistreerde lid van die Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Certified Internal Auditor- of Professional Internal Auditor-benamings of tersaaklike professionele benamings sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
