Kennis van die CET Act, Public Audit Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, en openbare-sektor-bestuursraamwerke. Begrip van die International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) en Global Internal Audit Standards. Kennis en begrip van risikobestuur, interne beheerraamwerke, en korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels (King IV/V-verslag). Begrip van openbare-sektorbeleid, insluitend DHET/TVET-regulerings- en nakomingsvereistes. Begrip van Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015). Sterke analitiese, ondersoekende en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Uitstekende verslagdoenings-, voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om die toereikendheid en doeltreffendheid van interne beheermaatreëls te evalueer. Sterke beplannings-, koördinerings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om wetgewing, beleid en prosedures te vertolk en dit tydens oudite toe te pas. Vaardigheid in die opstel van ouditwerklêers en die handhawing van gehalte-ouditlêers. Hoë aandag aan besonderhede, akkuraatheid en nakoming van ouditstandaarde. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk terwyl streng oudittydlyne nagekom word. Professionaliteit, aanspreeklikheid en etiese gedrag. Geoormerkte oordeel en objektiwiteit. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en diskresie uit te oefen.
af.duties: Berei ouditkennisgewingsbriewe voor in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde Jaarlikse Ouditplan. Voer voorlopige opnames uit om 'n begrip van stelsels, prosesse en beheermaatreëls te kry. Berei Audit Planning Memoranda (APM's) voor. Voer risikobevalings uit en ontwikkel risikogebaseerde ouditprogramme. Identifiseer beheerswakhede en areas vir verbetering. Berei en handhaaf gehalte-ouditlêers in ooreenstemming met Global Internal Audit Standards. Voer oudite uit ooreenkomstig goedgekeurde ouditprogramme en -metodologieë. Evalueer die toereikendheid en doeltreffendheid van interne beheermaatreëls. Nakoming en handhawing van die ISO 9001-standaarde. Beoordeel die beskerming van bates teen bedrog, onreëlmatighede en verliese. Hersien nakoming van die CET Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations en instellingsbeleid. Betrek geouditeerdes tydens veldwerk en bespreek voorlopige bevindings. Voer opvolgoudite uit op voorheen gerapporteerde bevindings en aanbevelings. Opsteller van duidelike, akkurate en bewysgebaseerde ouditverslae. Identifiseer oorsake en verskaf praktiese, waarde-toevoegende aanbevelings. Hou afsluitingsvergaderings en berei notule voor. Dien ouditverslae binne ooreengekome tydlyne in. Ondersteun verslagdoening aan Uitvoerende Bestuur en die Audit and Risk and Management Committee. Handhaaf effektiewe professionele verhoudings met interne belanghebbendes. Verskaf adviserende insette oor bestuur, risikobestuur en interne beheeraangeleenthede waar nodig. Lei en ondersteun bestuur in die aanspreek van ouditbevindings en die bestuursaksieplan.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqonga: Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi Nokuphathwa Kwekhwalithi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi weqonga okholelwa ekuholweni ngaphakathi nokuphathwa kwekhwalithi entengo yamahhovisi e Department of Higher Education and Training, esidinga idiploma ekuholweni ngaphakathi nokuba ilungu le-IIASA.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma ku-Internal Auditing/I-Degree (NQF Level 6) ku-Internal Auditing. Isiqu sangemva kokuqeda ekuholweni ngaphakathi, ekuholweni kwe-forensic noma isiqu esihambisana sangemva kokuqeda kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ilungu elibhalisiwe le-institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Iziqu ze-Certified Internal Auditor noma i-Professional Internal Auditor noma ezinye iziqu zobuchwepheshe ezihambisana nazo kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Okungenani ubudalo obungu-5 bemisebenzi ehambisana nayo endaweni yokuholwa ngaphakathi. Okungenani ubudalo obungu-3 bokulawula abasebenzi ekuholweni ngaphakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office – i-Excel ebanzi ithandwa kakhulu). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono, ulwazi namazimsula: Ukuqonda okuhle kwezimiso nendlela yokuholwa ngaphakathi. Ulwazi nge-CET Act, i-Public Audit Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations, nezinhlelo zokubuswa komphakathi. Ukuqonda kwe-International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) kanye ne-Global Internal Audit Standards. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kengozi, izinhlelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi, nezimiso zokubuswa kwenhlangano (umbiko we-King IV/V). Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa izidingo zokulawula nokuhambisana nemithetho ze-DHET/TVET. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwekhwalithi (i-ISO 9001:2015). Amakhono amahle okuhlaziya, ukuphenya, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko, okwenza iziboniso, nokuithwebhula avela emlonyeni) okuhle. Ukukwazi ukulinganisa ukwanelela nokusebenza kahle kolawulo lwangaphakathi. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, nokuhlela izinhlelo. Ukukwazi ukuhumusha umthetho, izinqubomgomo, nendlela ezisetshenziswayo nokuzisebenzisa ngesikhathi kokuholwa. Ukukwazi ukulungiselela amaphepha okusebenza okuholwayo nokugcina amafayela okuhola aphilile. Ukunakisisa imininingwane, ukunemba, nokuhambisana nemithethonqubo yokuholwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa bese uyinikezela ingqondo ngenkathi uhlangabezana namasuwo okuhola axhomeke esikhathini. Ukuba nogqozi, ukubekezeleleka, nokuziphatha ngokuyilunga. Isahluleko esihle nobuqhethe. Ukukwazi ukugcina imfihlo nokusebenzisa isiphephelo.
zu.duties: Lungiselela amagazini okwazisa ngekuholwa ngokuhambisana nehlelo elamukelekile le-Annual Audit Plan. Yenza iziphimo zokuqala ukuze uthole ukuqonda izinhlelo, inqubo, nolawulo. Lungiselela i-Audit Planning Memoranda (APM). Yenza ukulinganiselwa kwezingozi futhi uhlele izinhlela zokuholwa ezingohluleme ngozingozi. Hlonza iziqu ezingazimbali kolawulo nemikhakha okudinga ukuthuthukiswa. Lungiselela futhi ugcine amafayela okuhola aphilile ngokuhambisana ne-Global Internal Audit Standards. Hola ngokuhambisana nezinhlela nezindlela zokuhola ezamukelwe. Hlola ukwanelela nokusebenza kahle kolawulo lwangaphakathi. Ukuhambisana nokugcina izindinganiso ze-ISO 9001. Linganisa ukukhathazeka kwempahla ekukhohlakeni, ezingezinye, nas ezithini. Phinda ubheke ukuhambisana ne-CET Act, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, kanye nezinqubomgomo zesikhungo. Xhumana nalabo baholwayo ngesikhathi somsebenzi wasensimini futhi sixoxe ngemiphumela yokuqala. Yenza okokuholwayo kokuqhuba okulandelana ngemiphumela nezinkomba edlule. Bhalu imibiko yokuhola ecacile, enembile, nesekelwe izibonakaliso. Hlonza izimbangela ezingezise nhlobo futhi unikeze izinkomba ezisebenzayo, ezenza inzuzo. Yenza izinkumpani zokuphuma futhi ulungiselela amaminithi. Hambisa imibiko yokuholwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Sekela ukubika kwabaphathi abaphakeme kanye ne-Audit and Risk and Management Committee. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle obusemthethweni nalabo abangaphakathi abanomthwalo. Nikeza ngaphandle ngenkathi kudingeka malulekile ngemibuzo yokubuswa, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, nezindaba zolawulo lwangaphakathi. Qondisa futhi usekele abaphathi ekulawuleni imiphumela yokuhola nenhlelo yokwenza abaphathi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weSekela: Ulwavo lwangaphakathi & Ulawulo Lwemilinganiselo
xh.summary: Indima yomncedisi wesekela obukele ulwavo lwangaphakathi nolawulo lwemilinganiselo kwiziko eliphezulu lesebe lemfundo ephakamileyo nokuqeqesha, lifuna idiploma kulwavo lwangaphakathi nolunga kwi-IIASA.
xh.requirements: National Diploma in Internal Auditing/Degree (NQF Level 6) in Internal Auditing. Isidanga senqanaba lepostgraduate kulwavo lwangaphakathi, ulwavo lwezenzo ezingezonyanisanga okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo sepostgraduate siza kuba yithuba elinzuzo. Lunga elibhalisiweyo lesigqi se-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Iikelasi ze-Certified Internal Auditor okanye i-Professional Internal Auditor okanye iikelasi ezifanelekileyo zobugcisa ziza kuba yithuba elinzuzo. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava ahambelana nawo kwimo yolwavo lwangaphakathi. Okungenani eminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelana nawo okulawula kwimo yolwavo lwangaphakathi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ikhompyutha (MS Office – i-Excel ephakamileyo iphendulwa). Ilayiseni yomqhubi egqityiweyo. Amandla, ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olululo lemigaqo nendlela zolwavo lwangaphakathi. Ulwazi nge-CET Act, Public Audit Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, kunye namakhowarijensi olawulo lwabantu banikela. Ukuqonda kwamagama e-International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) naku-Global Internal Audit Standards. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula ingozi, amakhowarijensi olawulo langaphakathi, nalemigaqo yolawulo lwebhodorithathi (King IV/V report). Ukuqonda iinkqubo zelawulo zabantu banikela, kuquka iinkqubo zolawulo nokuhambelana koluyilo lwe-DHET/TVET. Ukuqonda iinkqabo zoLawulo Lwemilinganiselo (ISO 9001:2015). Amandla amakhulu okuhlalutya, uphando, nokuqonda iingxaki. Amandla amakhulu okubhala iingxelo, okubonelela, nokuqhathanisa (okubhaliweyo nokuqhathaniswa). Amandla okulinganisa ukwaneleka nokusebenza kolawulo lwangaphakathi. Amandla amakhuluokuqamba, ulungelelwaniso, nokuqumba. Amandla okutolika umthetho, iinkqubo, nendlela ezisetyenziswayo nokuwazisa ngexesha lolwavo. Ukuqonda ukudibanisa amaphepha olwavo okusebenza nokugcina iifayile zolwavo ezinemilinganiselo. Ukuqwalasela ngasemva kolunye, ukuchaneka, nokuhambelana nokoqeqesho lolwavo. Amandla okusebenza yedwa naphantsi koxinzelelo ngelixa ugcwalisa iixa ezibaluleweyo zolwavo. Ubulungisa, ukuziphendula, nokuziphatha ngokunesipho. Isigqibo esilulo nokungabi nacamcu. Amandla okugcina ixumba leenkcukacha nokuzisebenzisa ngokucokisekileyo.
xh.duties: Lungiselela iiletile zokuqwembesa lolwavo ngokuhambelana neNqubo yeMdululwavo yomNyaka eVunyiweyo. Yenza iziphondo ekuqaleni ukuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, nolawulo. Lungiselela iMemo zoLungiselelo loLwavo (APMs). Yenza unqginisiso lwengozi uthibe inqubo yolwavo esekelwe kwingozi. Qaphela iindonga ezibuthathaka kulawulo nendawo ezintoniweyo ezikulungele ukuphuculwa. Lungiselela zigcine iifayile zolwavo ezinemilinganiselo ngokuhambelana nama-Global Internal Audit Standards. Yenza ulwavo ngokuhambelana nemiqulu yolwavo nendlela ezisetyenziswayo ekuqinisekisiweyo. Linganisa ukwaneleka nokusebenza kolawulo lwangaphakathi. Ukukhunyeleka negcinwa kolwazi lwe-ISO 9001 standards. Qwalasela ukhuselo kwizinto ezingenisa intsolo, ukuqamba, iingxaki ezihlukahlukeneyo, kunye nezinto ezilahlekileyo. Qwalasela ukukhunyeleka nge-CET Act, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, nendleba isebenza ngokomgaqo weenkqubo. Hlanganyela nalwavo abaqeqeshwa ngexesha lokwenza iintshukumo nokuqonda iziphumo. Qhuba ulwavo olulandelayo kumaluqobo othenjwe ngaphambili nezithembiso ezinikezelwe. Bhala iingxelo zolwavo ezicacileyo, ezichanekileyo, ezenza isibongo malunga nobungqina abuzayo. Qonda iimbangi ezingundoqo neziqu eziphucula ukwenzeka kwezinto ezenza isibongo. Yenza iindibano zokuphuma ulwavo ugqibele inkcazelo ngokwenziweyo. Thumela iingxelo zolwavo ngaphakathi kwamaxesha avunyiweyo. Nceda inkcazelo ekuyurhulumente weNkulumbuso ne-Komiti yoLwavo nokuLawulwa kweengozi. Gcina ubudlelwane obukhoyo nabantu ngaphakathi koluntu. Nikela isalathiso sabaluleke kwiinkqubo, ulawulo lwengozi, nendlela zolawulo olubanzi kwangaphakathi lapho kufuneka. Qondisa nceda abalawuli ukugcina amaqhinga olwavo ezele inkqubo isebenzisa emva kwemithetho yolwavo.

jobs.title: Senior Management Information System Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Central Johannesburg TVET College, Central Office
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: Manage the TVETMIS system at Central Johannesburg TVET College, overseeing data capturing, validation and reporting.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. A recognised three (3) year National Diploma (NQF level 6) / Bachelor’s Degree in Information Management / Data Management or equivalent qualification. 3-5 years working experience in Data Management / TVETMIS environment or any relevant knowledge. Computer literate and competent in Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Good verbal and written communication skills. Presentation and report writing skills. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges including knowledge of the TVETMIS and annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions. Knowledge and understanding of Information Management. Knowledge, understanding, application and interpretation of office management, data warehouse and IT prescripts. Good administrative, planning, organizing, problem solving, project management, team leadership, analytical, client orientation and team leadership skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure proper management of TVETMIS as well as the capturing and extraction of college data. Perform validation of data on a regular basis. Set up the system in readiness for enrolment and support other business processes. Control the quality of captured data and report if there are errors. Maintain the college TVETMIS. Manage student and staff data. Use various tools and extract data to facilitate statistical reporting. Interact with the service provider regarding upgrades and request for assistance. Capture all the approved enrolments / registrations and assessments on the system by the predetermined time. Ensure the compilation and submission of reports. Provide statistical information weekly, monthly, quarterly etc. Ensure the compilation, monitoring of academic examination and staff statistics of the college and submit reports on quarterly basis to management and DHET. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual reports as requested. Ensure the maintenance and capturing of inputs captured on ITS system and other related systems. Set up the student system for registration of students and ensure creditability and reliability. Monitor the capturing, quality control, validation, run procedure, create file and ensure that entries are submitted on time. Ensure efficient and effective administration of all academic related student system administration for programmes, course and qualification. Oversee the load general system, student programmes, lecturing timetables, assessment marks, class groups, census dates and academic qualifications curriculum. Maintain calculation criteria as per guidelines from Head Office. Ensure that MIS licenses are renewed before expiry dates. Ensure the effective and efficient maintenance of the TVETMIS. Management of human, physical and financial resources.
jobs.enquiries: Mr MB Khakhu Tel No: (011) 351 6000
jobs.applications: Instructions: The Central Johannesburg TVET College (CJC) invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by clicking on this link https://cjcz83.ngnscan.co.za/apply. Apply and follow the easy prompts/instructions.
jobs.notes: If you apply for the first time, you will be required to register by clicking the register button to register. After registering, you will be allowed to log in and apply for your chosen post (s). Upload the supporting document namely, a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. The shortlisted candidates will also be requested to submit confirmation or service letter from their previous employer, confirming their employment status/ history. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualification(s) evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointment promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The college reserves the right not to make appointment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. CJC is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. Due to the college financial constraints, candidates will be responsible for their traveling and accommodation.

af.title: Senior Bestuursinligtingstelselbeampte
af.summary: Bestuur die TVETMIS-stelsel by Central Johannesburg TVET College en hou toesig oor datacapturering, validasie en verslagdoening.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. 'n Erkende drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) / Baccalaureusgraad in Inligtingsbestuur / Databestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 3-5 jaar werkervaring in Databestuur / TVETMIS-omgewing of enige relevante kennis. Rekenaarvaardig en bevoeg in Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasiervaardighede. Voorleggings- en verslagskryfvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van beleide en die bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die TVETMIS en jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur die Higher Education Institutions. Kennis en begrip van Inligtingsbestuur. Kennis, begrip, toepassing en interpretasie van kantoorbestuur, data-warehouse en IT-voorskrifte. Goeie administratiewe, beplannings-, organisatoriese, probleemoplossings-, projekbestuurs-, spanleierskaps-, analitiese, kliëntoriëntasie- en spanleierskapsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker behoorlike bestuur van TVETMIS asook die capturering en onttrekking van kollegedata. Voer gereeld validasie van data uit. Stel die stelsel gereed vir inskrywing en ondersteun ander besigheidsprosesse. Beheer die kwaliteit van vasgelêde data en rapporteer as daar foute is. Onderhou die kollege se TVETMIS. Bestuur student- en personeeldata. Gebruik verskeie gereedskap en onttrek data om statistiese verslagdoening te fasiliteer. Skakel met die diensverskaffer rakende opgraderings en versoek om hulp. Vang alle goedgekeurde inskrywings / registrasies en assesserings teen die voorafbepaalde tyd op die stelsel vas. Verseker die opstel en indiening van verslae. Verskaf weekliks, maandeliks, kwartaalliks ens. statistiese inligting. Verseker die opstel en monitering van akademiese eksamen- en personeelstatistieke van die kollege en dien kwartaalliks verslae by bestuur en DHET in. Stel maandelikse, kwartaalse en jaarlikse verslae soos versoek op. Verseker die onderhoud en capturering van insette wat op die ITS-stelsel en ander verwante stelsels vasgevang is. Stel die studentestelsel op vir registrasie van studente en verseker geloofwaardigheid en betroubaarheid. Monitor die capturering, gehaltebeheer, validasie, voer prosedures uit, skep lêers en verseker dat inskrywings betyds ingedien word. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie van alle akademies-verwante studentestelseladministrasie vir programme, kursusse en kwalifikasies. Hou toesig oor die lading van die algemene stelsel, studenteprogramme, doseringsroosters, assesseringspunte, klasgroepe, census dates en akademiese kwalifikasiekurrikulum. Onderhou berekeningskriteria volgens riglyne van Head Office. Verseker dat MIS-lisensies voor verloopdatums hernu word. Verseker die doeltreffende en effektiewe onderhoud van die TVETMIS. Bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlezi Phansi Wezokwaziso Wezinga Eliphezulu
zu.summary: Phatha inosistele i-TVETMIS e-Central Johannesburg TVET College, bheka ngaphezu kokubhala idatha, ukuqinisekisa nokubika.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. I-National Diploma (NQF level 6) yeminyaka eyithathu (3) evunyiwe / i-Bachelor's Degree e-Information Management / Data Management noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Uhumushi weminyaka engu-3-5 ezenzakeni ye-Data Management / isiqondisi se-TVETMIS noma naluphi ulwazi oluhlobene nalokho. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha futhi ube nobuchule kwi-Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono okubamba iphrezentheshini nokubhala umbiko. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi ngemithethonqubo nesimo sokuphatha kwe-TVET Colleges okuhlanganisa ulwazi nge-TVETMIS nezidingo zokubika ngonyaka ngokwezikhungo ze-Higher Education Institutions. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Information Management. Ulwazi, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa nokutolisha izinhlaka zokuphatha ihhovisi, idatha yenhla kanye nezinhla ze-IT. Amakhono amahle okuphatha, ukuhlela, ukuhlelela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukubamba iqhaza ekubukeni izinto ngokufanayo, ukuqondisisa, ukugxila kumthengi nokuqondisa iqembu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwe-TVETMIS kanye nokubhala nokukhipha idatha yekolishi. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwedatha njalo. Hlela inosistelele ukuba silungele ukubhaliswa nokusekela ezinye izinqubo zebhizinisi. Lawula izinga lemithombo yedatha ebhaliwe bese ubika uma kukhona amaphutha. Gcina i-TVETMIS yekolishi. Phatha idatha yabafundi nabasebenzi. Sebenzisa izithako ezahlukene futhi ukhiphe idatha ukuze kulula ukubika ngokwesibalo. Thintana nomhlinzeki wesevisi ngokuthuthuka nokucela usizo. Bhala zonke izibhaliso / ukubhaliswa nokuhlola okuvunyiwe kwesistimu ngosuku olumisiwe. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa nokuhlinzwa kwemibiko. Hlinzka ngolwazi ngesibalo nsuku zonke, nyanga zonke, kota njll. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa, ukuqashwa kwezikhombande zokuhlola okufundwayo kanye nezibalo zabasebenzi zekolishi bese uhlinza imibiko ekwota kubaphathi ne-DHET. Lungisa imibiko yanyanga zonke, kota njengoba iyacelwa. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokubhalwa kwemininingwana ebanjwe kusistimu ye-ITS kanye nezinye izistimu eziyhlobene. Hlela isistimu yabafundi yokubhaliswa kwabafundi bese uqinisekisa ukuzethemba nokuthembeka. Bheka ukubhalwa, ukulawula izinga, ukuqinisekiswa, ukuqhuba inqubo, ukudala ifayela bese uqinisekisa ukuthi okufakwayo kuniketwa ngesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle kokuphatha isistimu yabafundi yonke mayelana neziqu, izifundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Bheka ngaphezulu kwesistimu ejwayelekile yokulayisha, izinhlelo zabafundi, uhlelo lwesikhathi sokufundisa, amamaki okuholayo, amaqembu eklasi, izinsuku zokuqamba isibalo kanye nekhariyikhulamu yeziqu. Gcina izinkomba zokubala njengoba kukhombiswe i-Head Office. Qinisekisa ukuthi amalayisense e-MIS abuyekezwa ngaphambi kokuba ephelelwe yisikhathi. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okusebenza kahle nangokuphumelela kwe-TVETMIS. Ukuphatha okuyimfihlo, okungokwenzuko kanye nezinsiza ezimali.

xh.title: ISiphathi esiPhakamileyo soMphathi weNkqubo yoLawulo loLwazi
xh.summary: Lawula inkqubo ye-TVETMIS kwiKholeji yase-Central Johannesburg TVET, elawula ukuqokelelwa kolwazi, ukuqinisekisa nokwenza iingxelo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye eselinganayo. I-National Diploma (NQF level 6) yeminyaka elithathu (3) evunyiweyo / i-Bachelor's Degree eLawulweni loLwazi / eLawulweni loLwazi okholejwe okulinganayo. Iiminyaka elithoba (3-5) yamava asebenzayo eLawulweni loLwazi / kwindawo ye-TVETMIS okanye nolunye ulwazi oluhambelanayo. Ukuba liliterate kakhompyutha anobuchule kwi-Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Outlook/Teams. Amabali amade ngomlomo nawabhalwayo. Amabali apapashwayo nokubhala iingxelo. Ilayisense yomqeshi egunyazisiweyo. Ulwazi ngamacebo anemigaqo-siseko kwinkqubo yolawulo kwe-TVET Colleges kuquka nokuluma ngokwe-TVETMIS nokuvelisa iingxelo ngonyaka njengoko kufunwa ziNqumbe ezeMfundo eziPhakamileyo. Ulwazi nomvumbo wolwazi ngokuLawulwa kolwazi. Ulwazi, kuqondwa, ukusetyenziswa nokutolikwa kolawulo lofiso, indawo yokugcina i-data nemigaqo ye-IT. Amabali obuntu kukwaziswa kolawulo, ukulungiselela, ukuqamba, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ukukhokela iqela, ukwahlulwa phantsi, ukumiselwa kuluntu nokukhokela iqela.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwe-TVETMIS nakuqokelelwa nokuqoshiwa kolwazi kukholeji. Qamba ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi njalo. Misela inkqubo ibe silondoloze ngokusiyilwa nokwamkelwa kolwazi nanjengokuxhasa ezinye iinkqubo zoshishino. Lawula ngobuchule i-data eqoshiweyo uze wenze ingxelo ukuba kukho iimpazamo. Gcina i-TVETMIS yekholeji. Lawula i-data yabafundi nabasebenzi. Sebenzisa izixhobo ezahlukeneyo uze uqoshe i-data ukuze ulawule iingxelo ngobalo. Ndibonisana nomboneleli wenkonzo malunga nokuphucula nokusela ixesha. Qosha konke ukwamkelwa / ukubhaliswa kunye nokulinganiswa kwenkqubo ngexesha elichaziweyo. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa nokunikezelwa kweengxelo. Nikezela iinkcukacha ngobalo ngamanye, ngeveki, ngenyanga, njalo njalo. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa, ukulawulwa ngokubakho kwezifundo, njengezibalo zabanini bakho nabasebenzi bekholeji uze unikeze iingxelo ngeveki njalo kubaphathi nakwi-DHET. Qamba iingxelo ngamanya, ngeveki nganye nangonyaka njengoko kuceliwe. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokuqoshwa kolwazi olungenisiweyo kwenkqubo ye-ITS nakwezinye iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Misela inkqubo yabafundi ngokubhaliswa kwabafundi uze uqinisekise ukwethembeka nokuqina. Qwalasela ukuqoshwa, ukulawula ubuchule, ukuqinisekiswa, ukuqhube kweziyobisi, ukuyila iifayile nokwenza okuqinisekisa ukuba izinto zingeniswa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo nangobuchule bonke ulawulo lwenkqubo yabafundi ezibalwa kwizifundo, iinkqubo, amakhosi amafutshane nezigqibo. Lawula ingxelo ye-system, amakholom weenkqubo zabafundi, iwwaka elinganiselwayo lezifundo iinkqubo, ukulinganisa iimaphu, amagumbi, iindlu ngokubakho kwabantu nemikhosi yobuchule. Gcina imigaqo yokubala njengoko kubekiwa yi-Head Office. Qinisekisa ukuba iilayisense ze-MIS zithwalwa ngaphambi kokuba ziphelelwe lixesha. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngobuchule nokusebenza kakhulu kwe-TVETMIS. Ukulawula abantu, izixhobo nemali.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: ICT Security
jobs.summary: Assistant Director ICT Security at the Independent Police Investigative Directorate national office, paying R487197 per annum, closing 23 October 2026.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in ICT as recognized by SAQA or related field. 3- 5 years’ working experience in ICT security environment. Knowledge Requirements: Knowledge and understanding of government regulations / prescripts / policies. Knowledge and understanding of departmental policies relating to ICT. Knowledge of Firewall systems. Knowledge on network monitoring tools. Knowledge and understanding of DMZ Zone. Knowledge of ICT Security audit including server room compliance standards, Knowledge of Hacking/penetration test. Knowledge of different software systems and components. Knowledge of software and hardware configurations. Knowledge of desktops, server hardware and software. Ability to evaluate documentation. Knowledge of software application systems. Knowledge of back-up and recovery systems. Knowledge of disaster recovery testing and business continuity. Understanding of ICT network infrastructure and other related matters. Skills and Competencies: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Demonstrated customer service skills and focus. Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and projects. Ability to think and act tactically. Interpersonal skills. Project management skills. Troubleshooting skills. Presentation Skills. Skill to analyse and evaluate systems, data, etc.
jobs.duties: Coordinate ICT Security operations: Administer and monitor firewall activities, provide monthly and quarterly reports, Monitor ICT security compliance with departmental policies, procedures and prescripts, Monitor the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) on the network and generate reports. Administer and monitor user activity on the network and reporting any violations. Protect data and system integrity: Conduct network penetration and detection/prevention tests and submit monthly reports. Conduct back-ups testing for integrity and restore purposes. Verify that all systems and equipment on the Disaster Recovery (DR) site are updated in line with the Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP). Verify that archiving of emails is properly conducted for both outgoing and incoming communications. Update software and hardware systems and equipment at the DR site. Conduct ICT security risk and Compliance: Identify and report on ICT security risks and threats and escalate complicated matters. Compile monthly and quarterly reports. Identify information assets (ICT Systems), potential threats and vulnerability. Evaluate ICT systems quarterly (software & hardware) and submit reports. Conduct market research and benchmarking on ICT security Technologies to improve services and submit reports. Document all ICT security –related changes on system/networks and implementation. Provide ICT security input for network upgrades, design and installations. Respond to security related queries and solve them. Implement systems and conduct Application Testing: Publish approved projects to the web application for processing and implementation. Test new software and applications before deployment to ensure compliance. Certify software and hardware before installation or implementation. Manage resources and Record-keeping: Conduct maintenance and awareness campaigns on ICT security matters. Update all ICT security equipment and software records in registers. Verify equipment and software for disposal to ensure compliance with policies and prescripts.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. T Moletsane Tel No: (012) 399 0016
jobs.applications: Independent Police Investigative Directorate, National Office Private Bag X941, Pretoria, 0001 or hand deliver to Benstra Building, 473 Stanza Bopape & Church Street, Arcadia, Pretoria, or email Recruitment14@ipid.gov.za (Please indicate the post name and reference number on the subject line) when applying through e-mail. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. DS Baloyi Tel No: (012) 399 0202
jobs.notes: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on applications but must submit Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applications quoting the correct reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application form (old Z83) will not be considered. Each application for employment form must be fully completed, signed and initialled by the applicant. Failure to sign this form may lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. A recently updated, comprehensive CV as well as a fully completed and initialled new signed Z83 (Section A, B, C & D are compulsory and section E, F and G are not compulsory if CV it is attached). However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part-F must be answered. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification; it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other for integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panel shall score both technical exercises as additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical competency exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the Department. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Due to the large number of applications, we envisage to receive, applications will not be acknowledged, if you have not been contacted within three (3) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Therefore, only shortlisted candidate for the post will be required to submit the documents on or before the date of the interview. The successful candidate will have to undergo security vetting. His / her character should be beyond reproach. The appointment is subject to security clearance, verification of qualifications and competency assessment (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). The Department reserves the right to fill or not fill the any advertised posts. Applicants must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations against them. Should this be uncovered during / after the interview took place, the application will not be considered and in the unlikely event, that the person has been appointed such appointment will be terminated. The successful candidate will be appointed subject to positive results of the security vetting process. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. The successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12 months and will be required to sign a performance agreement. The suitable candidate will be selected with the intention of promoting representivity and achieving affirmative action targets as contemplated in the Department’s Employment Equity Plan. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: IKR-sekuriteit
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur IKR-sekuriteit by die nasionale kantoor van die Independent Police Investigative Directorate, teen R487197 per jaar, sluit 23 Oktober 2026.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in IKR soos erken deur SAQA of 'n verwante veld. 3- 5 jaar se werkervaring in 'n IKR-sekuriteitsomgewing. Kennisvereistes: Kennis en begrip van regeringsregulasies/voorskifte/beleide. Kennis en begrip van departementele beleide rakende IKR. Kennis van Firewall-stelsels. Kennis van netwerkmoniteringsnutsmiddels. Kennis en begrip van DMZ-sone. Kennis van IKR-sekuriteitsoudit insluitend nakomingsstandaarde vir die bedienerkamer. Kennis van indringering/metingstoetse. Kennis van verskillende sagtewarestelsels en -komponente. Kennis van sagteware- en hardewarekonfigurasies. Kennis van lessenaarrekenaars, bedienerhardeware en -sagteware. Vermoë om dokumentasie te evalueer. Kennis van sagtewaretoepassingstelsels. Kennis van rugsteun- en herwinningsstelsels. Kennis van rampherwinningtoetsing en besigheidskontinuïteit. Begrip van IKR-netwerkinfrastruktuur en ander verwante aangeleenthede. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Getoonde kliëntediensvaardighede en -fokus. Bewese vermoë om veelvuldige take en projekte te bestuur. Vermoë om takties te dink en op te tree. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Projektebestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om stelsels, data, ens. te ontleed en te evalueer.
af.duties: Koördineer IKR-sekuriteitsbedrywighede: Administreer en monitor firewallaktiwiteite, verskaf maandelikse en kwartaalverslae, Monitor IKR-sekuriteitsnakoming met departementele beleide, prosedures en voorskifte, Monitor die Gedemilitariseerde Sone (DMZ) op die netwerk en genereer verslae. Administreer en monitor gebruikeraktiwiteit op die netwerk en rapporteer enige skendings. Beskerm data- en stelselintegriteit: Voer netwerkindringings- en opsporings/voorkomingstoetse uit en dien maandelikse verslae in. Voer rugsteuntoetse vir integriteit en herwinningsdoeleindes uit. Verifieer dat alle stelsels en toerusting op die Disaster Recovery (DR)-werf opgedateer is in ooreenstemming met die Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP). Verifieer dat argivering van e-posse behoorlik uitgevoer word vir beide uitgaande en inkomende kommunikasie. Dateer sagteware- en hardewarestelsels en -toerusting by die DR-werf op. Voer IKR-sekuriteitsrisiko en -nakoming uit: Identifiseer en rapporteer oor IKR-sekuriteitsrisiko's en -bedreigings en skaal ingewikkelde aangeleenthede op. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op. Identifiseer inligtingsbates (IKR-stelsels), potensiële bedreigings en kwesbaarhede. Evalueer IKR-stelsels kwartaalliks (sagteware en hardeware) en dien verslae in. Voer marknavorsing en benchmarking oor IKR-sekuriteitstegnologieë uit om dienste te verbeter en dien verslae in. Dokumenteer alle IKR-sekuriteitsverwante veranderinge aan stelsels/netwerke en implementering. Verskaf IKR-sekuriteitsinsette vir netwerkopgraderings, -ontwerp en -installasies. Reageer op sekuriteitsverwante navrae en los dit op. Implementeer stelsels en voer toepassingstoetse uit: Publiseer goedgekeurde projekte op die webtoepassing vir verwerking en implementering. Toets nuwe sagteware en toepassings voor ontplooiing om nakoming te verseker. Sertificeer sagteware en hardeware voor installasie of implementering. Bestuur hulpbronne en rekordhouding: Voer instandhouding en bewusmakingsveldtogte oor IKR-sekuriteitsaangeleenthede uit. Dateer alle IKR-sekuriteitsuitrusting en -sagtewerekords in registers op. Verifieer toerusting en sagteware vir wegdoening om nakoming van beleide en voorskifte te verseker.

zu.title: Osiba Ohlabelelayo: Ukuphepha kwe-ICT
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsizi nomqondisi wokuphepha kwe-ICT ehhovisi lesizwe le-Independent Police Investigative Directorate, elikhangwa iholo le-R487197 ngonyaka, kuvalwa ngosuku lokuvala 23 October 2026.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zomlinganiso we-NQF level 7 kwi-ICT njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA noma indawo ehlobene nayo. Unyaka we-3 kuya kwengu-5 wobuchwepheshe bokusebenza endaweni yokuphepha kwe-ICT. Izidingo Zolwazi: Ulwazi noqonde ngemithethokahulumende / imilawu / izinqubomgomo. Ulwazi noqonde ngezinqubomgomo zomnyango ezihlobene ne-ICT. Ulwazi ngamasistimu we-Firewall. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi okulawula inethiwekhi. Ulwazi noqonde nge-DMZ Zone. Ulwazi ngokuhlolwa kokuphepha kwe-ICT kuhlanganise nezizinga zokuhambisana kwe-server room, Ulwazi nge-Hacking/penetration test. Ulwazi ngamasistimu wezinhlelo ezahlukene namalunga. Ulwazi ngokumiswa kwezinhlelo ze-software ne-hardware. Ulwazi ngama-desktops, i-server hardware ne-software. Ikhono lokuhlola amadokhumenti. Ulwazi ngamasistimu wezinhlelo ze-software. Ulwazi ngamasistimu we-back-up nokubuyisa ulwazi. Ulwazi ngokuhlolwa kwe-disaster recovery nokuphikelelwa komsebenzi. Ukuqonda kwamasistimu e-ICT network infrastructure namanye amaphuzu ahlobene nayo. Amandla Nobuchwepheshe: Amandla amahle okuxhumana okubhalwayo nokuKhulunywa. Amandla abonakalayo okukhonza abathengi nokugxila kubo. Ikhono eliboniswe lokupatha imisebenzi eminingi namaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokucabanga nokuqhuba ngobuhlakani. Amandla okuxhumanisa nabantu. Amandla okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amandla okuxazula izinkinga. Amandla okubukeka. Ikhono lokuhlaziya bese kuqondwa amasistimu, idatha, njll.
zu.duties: Qondanisa imisebenzi yokuphepha kwe-ICT: Lawula futhi ulinde izinkalo ze-firewall, unikeze imibiko yenyanga nezinyanga ezinhlanu, Ulawule ukuhambisana kokuphepha kwe-ICT nezinqubomgomo zomnyango, izinqubo nemilawu, Ulawule i-Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) einethiwekini futhi uqambe imibiko. Lawula futhi ulinde umsebenzi womsebenzisi einethiwekini futhi ukhathe noma yikuphi ukuphuleka. Vikela idatha nokuzinza kwesistimu: Yenza ukuhlolwa kokungena nokuqaphela/vimbela inethiwekhi futhi uhambise imibiko yenyanga. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwe-back-ups ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza nangobuyela emuva. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amasistimu nezinto zokusebenza esikweni se-Disaster Recovery (DR) zibuyekeziwe ngokuvumelana ne-Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP). Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulondoloza i-imeyili kwenziwe kahle kokubili ukuthumela nokwamukela izixhumisi. Buyekeza izinhlelo ze-software ne-hardware nezinto zokusebenza esikweni se-DR. Yenza ukuphepha kwe-ICT ngengozi nokuhambisana: Bonisa futhi ukhathe ngengozi nokusengotsha kokuphepha kwe-ICT bese ukhuphula izindaba ezibucayi. Qamba imibiko yenyanga nezinyanga ezinhlanu. Bonisa amafa wolwazi (I-ICT Systems), ukusengotsha okungaba khona nokuthelela. Hlola amasistimu e-ICT kwamanyanga ambalwa (i-software & i-hardware) futhi uhambise imibiko. Yenza ucwaningo lwemakethe ukuqathanisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphepha kwe-ICT ukuze kube yimpilo ukukhonza bese uhambisa imibiko. Shicilela wonke amashintsho ahlobene nokuphepha kwe-ICT kumasistimu/inethiwekhi nokusetshenziswa. Nikeza izinkombandlela zokuphepha kwe-ICT ekweni kabusha, ekumiseni nasekufakeni inethiwekhi. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene nokuphepha uyisixazule. Setsha amasistimu futhi uenze ukuhlolwa kwe-Application: Shicilela amaphrojekthi avunyelwe ewebhusayithi ukuze kucutshungulwe futhi kusetshenziswe. Hlola i-software ezinhlelo ezintsha phambi kokusetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza. Qinisekisa i-software ne-hardware phambi kokufaka noma ukusetshenziswa. Phatha izinsiza nokulondoloza amarekhodi: Yenza ukulondolozwa kanye nemikhankaso yokuqaphisa izindaba zokuphepha kwe-ICT. Buyekeza wonke amarekhodi ezinto zokusebenza ne-software zokuphepha kwe-ICT kumasitili. Qinisekisa izinto zokusebenza ne-software ezaqediwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza nezinqubomgomo nemilawu.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNhlekolo: Ikhaya leNhleko leTeknoloji yolwazi (ICT Security)
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNhlekolo yamakhompyutha (ICT Security) kwihovu lelona leZiko leNgcinelelo yePholisa, uhlahlelwa nge-R487197 ngonyaka, kuvalwa nge-23 October 2026.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esingangoqwanaba 7 le-NQF kwi-ICT njengakuqatywa yi-SAQA okanye kwelinye icandelo. Unyaka wama-3 ukuya kowa-5 wobugcisa obusebenzayo kwimeko yokhuseleko lwe-ICT. Iimfuno zolwazi: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemigaqo yokurhulumente / izibhalo / iinkqubo zempilo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngeenkqubo zolwazi ze-isebe ezithintela le-ICT. Ulwazi ngeendlela zemithambo yokuthintela imilambo. Ulwazi ngeziphako zokuqaphela intshukumo yothungelwano. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). Ulwazi ngokuqinisekiswa kwekhuseleko le-ICT kuquka nemigaqo yolawulo legumbi leeseva, Ulwazi ngevavanyo lokungena ngekhompuyutha. Ulwazi ngeendlela zahlukileyo zezicelo zeenkqubo namacandelo azo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo lwe-software nentonga yamakhompyutha. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha zesitya, iintonga neesoftware zeseva. Isakhono sokuqwalasela amaxwebhu. Ulwazi ngeendlela zezicelo zesoftware. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokulondoloza nokuqeda ubungozi bokulahleka kolwazi. Ulwazi ngokuvavanya inkqubo yokuphela kobungozi nobumbeko-boxakeka. Ukuqonda ngokwakhiwo kolwazi lothungelwano lwe-ICT nezinye izinto ezinxulumene nayo. Amakhono namaphawu: Amakhono am aphathwa kakuhle wobuwe obubhalisiwe nasemlonyeni. Amakhono abonakalisiweyo enkonzo yabathengi kwaye ugqamise kuyo. Isakhono esityhilweyo sokulawula imisebenzi namaprojekthi amaninzi. Isakhono sokucinga nokusebenza ngokomeko. Amakhono obudlelwaneabantu. Amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono okubonisa. Isakhono sokuqhuba oluqwalasyo kwaye solule iinkqubo, iimpendulo, nokunye.
xh.duties: Ulungiselela iinkqubo zokhuseleko lwe-ICT: Lawula ukuqwalasela umsebenzi wemithambo yokuthintela imilambo, uze unikeze iingxelo znyanga nazethanga, Qaphela ukuzithobela emthethweni kolwazi lokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo, iinkqubo nezikwadi zesebe, Qaphela i-Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) kwintshukumo yolwazi uze wakhe iingxelo. Lawula ukuqaphela intshukumo yomsebenzisi kuthungelwano oluvela kwaye unike iingxelo zemithetho ethileyo ephukileyo. Mkhusela ukuzinza kolwazi nomenzi wenkqubo: Qhuba uvavanyo lokugqitha ngenkundla bese uvavanya ukungena nokuvala ubungozi uze unike iingxelo ngenyanga zonyaka. Yenza uvavanyo lokuqinisekiswa kokulondoloza iinkcukacha zolwazi kwaye uvavanye ukubuyisela inkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo nentonga yamakhompyutha kwisikhululo sokuqala isidwangalixesha lokuzisombakula (DR) zihlaziyiwe ngokweNkqubo yoQaliso lolawulo lokuqala isidwangalixesha (DRP). Qinisekisa ukuba iimeyile ezisusiwo zigcinwa kakuhle kubo babaphuma baye bayafika nakunye oonxibelelwano. Hlaziya amakhompyutha kwaye usebenziseesoftware nentonga yamakhompyutha kwisikhululo se-DR. Qhuba ulawulo lweengozi zokhuseleko lwe-ICT nokuqwalasela ukuzinza: Phawula kwaye unike iingxelo ngeengozi zokhuseleko lwe-ICT nazisongelo aze wazisa iindawo ezibi ngokwezimo. Qhuba iingxelo znyanga nazethanga zonyaka. Phawula izixhobo zolwazi (inkqubo zolwazi ze-ICT), iingozi ezinokubakho nokungalunganga. Qwalasela iinkqubo ze-ICT nyanga ezithatha nexesha elithathu kuleminyaka (i-software nentonga yamakhompyutha) uze unike iingxelo. Qhuba uphando lwentengiso kwaye ulungelelanise olu phando ngokwamandla okhuseleko lwe-ICT ekuqhakamshiseni iinkonzo uze unike iingxelo. Qamba ixwebhu lonke inguqu zokhuseleko lwe-ICT kwiinkqubo/olwazi lothungelwano nokuzisebenzisa. Nikezela iingcali zolwazi ngokwakhuseleko kwiqhinga lokuhazi, ukuqamba nokuziswa kolwazi lothungelwano. Phendula imibuzo enxulumene nolwazi lokhuseleko kwaye uyisombakule. Sebenzisa iinkqubo ukuqwalasela uvavanyo lwezicelo: Shicilela iiprojekthi ezamkelekileyo kwi-app yokunxibelelwano lwenkqubo ukuze kuziwenze ngokomsebenzi nokumiswa. Vavanya i-software nezicelo entsha phambi kokumiswa aze wangenise ukuze uqinisekise ukuzithobela emthethweni. Qinisekisa i-software nentonga yamakhompyutha phambi kokuzifaka aze uzimise. Lawula izixhobo nokugcina iirekhodi: Qhuba imisindo nezaziso zolwazi lwe-ICT ngokumkhuseleko. Hlaziya zonke iirekhodi zokhuseleko lwe-ICT entonga yamakhompyutha isoftware nakwiinkqubo zokubukisa ezifakelo. Qinisekisa ukuxhapha kwentonga yamakhompyutha isoftware ukuze uqinisekise ukuzithobela emthethweni ngokwemigaqo namagqathu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Corporate Services
jobs.summary: Manage corporate services including financial administration, payroll, S&T claims and expenditure control reports for the Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Kimberley.

Working knowledge and experience of PERSAL. Provide budget breakdown and cash-flow. Compile and submit funds shifts requests to cover negatives and unforeseen expenditure. Manage Human Resource Administration Service: Facilitate the implementation of employee compensation, general conditions of service, benefits, and incentives. Certifying of invoices for goods and services received (e.g. GRV) and forwarding of Goods Received Voucher to invoicing Unit. Personnel developments. Assess staff performance Apply discipline. Ensure compliance with prescribes regulations, guidelines and policies.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Bestuur korporatiewe dienste, insluitend finansiële administrasie, loonstaat, S&T-eise en bestuursbeheerverslae vir die Independent Police Investigative Directorate in Kimberley.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Bestuur / Administrasie / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken; 3 tot 5 jaar se toesigervaring in die finansiële en menslikehulpbron-omgewing; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Beleide vir menslikehulpbronbestuur, menslikehulpbronstelsels en -prosedures, prestasiebestuur, kennis van projekbestuur, Public Service Act, regulasies en resolusies, werwings- en seleksiestrategieë, Kode vir Remunerering, uitgebreide kennis van wetgewing wat menslikehulpbronbestuur (MHB) reguleer. Uitgebreide kennis van regulatoriese raamwerke soos Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Regulatory Framework wat MHB-praktyke regeer, Employment Equity Act, MHB-verwante beleide, stelsels en prosesse, prosedures en beste praktyk. Werkende kennis en ervaring van PERSAL. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kliëntediensoriëntasie, emosionele intelligensie, spandeelname, werkkennis, buigsaamheid, deurlopende verbetering, vermoë om goed met alle vlakke van belanghebbendes te skakel, identifisering van oorsake, voorlegging, beplanning en organisering, sterk analitiese vaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, onderhandelingsvaardighede, finansiële bestuur, prestasiebestuur, eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Bestuur finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste. Versoek en ontleed bestuursbeheer C-verslae. Dien S&T-eise by Finansies in vir verwerking. Kontroleer en dien oortyd-eise by Finansies in vir verwerking. Dien klein kontantafstemmings by Nasionale Kantoor in. Dien loonstaat by Finansies in. Kontroleer en valideer fakture, sertifiseer fakture vir dienste ontvang (bv. GRV). Verskaf motivering vir die variansie tussen besteding en kontantvloei. Verskaf begrotingsopdeling en kontantvloei. Stel fondskuittrekingsversoeke op en dien in om negatiewe en onvoorsiene besteding te dek. Bestuur menslikehulpbron-administrasiedienste: Fasiliteer die implementering van werknemervergoeding, algemene diensvoorwaardes, voordele en aansporings. Monitor die vaslegging van verlof, erkenning van langdiens en PILIR. Fasiliteer en koördineer die beëindiging of bedankings van werknemers, insluitend skuldvorms. Verskaf advies oor menslikehulpbronbeleid en -praktyke. Fasiliteer die verwerking van arbeidsverhoudinge-aangeleenthede. Hou en onderhou werkregisters van alle MHB-aangeleenthede. Verskaf sekretariële dienste tydens onderhoude. Bestuur voorsieningskettingondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer die goedere-ontvangsbewyse (GRV) wat binne 2 dae na ontvangs van die faktuur van SCM by SCM ingedien word. Kontroleer en valideer fakture. Sertifiseer fakture vir goedere en dienste ontvang (bv. GRV) en stuur die Goedere-Ontvangsbewys na die faktureenheid. Koördineer die implementering van die vraag- en procureringsplanne vir die provinsie. Verifikasie van die bate-register. Verifikasie van die bate-register. Verifikasie van voorraadbeheer. Bestuur fasiliteite, vervoer en rekordbestuursdienste: fasiliteer daaglikse herstelwerk aan die gebou. Koördineer die gebruik van voertuie. (verifieer die logboek, voer inspeksie van die voertuig uit). Stel verslae op vir enige skade en verliese van die voertuig. Monitor en verifieer telefoongebruik vir die individue in die kantoor. Voer gehaltekontrole op reisversoeke uit voor uitreiking van voertuig. Verifieer of die rekordregister korrek is. Suprvisseer menslikehulpbron / personeel: allokeer en verseker gehalte van werk. Personeelontwikkeling. Assesseer personeelprestasie. Pas dissipline toe. Verseker voldoening aan voorgeskrewe regulasies, riglyne en beleide.

Failure to fully complete, initial and sign the Z83 form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. All applications must reach the Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services (JICS) on/or before the closing date and time. JICS cannot be held responsible for server delays. Applications submitted in any other way other than the published link or hand delivery will be treated as invalid. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached”. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part “F” must be answered and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Non- RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants      who     do     not    comply     with    the    abovementioned instructions/requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate’s suitability based on the posts’ technical and generic requirements. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). Please note by responding to the advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used for the sole purpose of this application and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent unless required by law. Due to the large number of responses anticipated, correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. The JICS reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement. All costs associated with an application will be borne by the applicant. The appointment will be made according to the Public Service Act of 1994.
