af.title: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrumbesoeker
af.summary: Onafhanklike Korrektiewe Sentrumbesoekers word in agt bestuursstreke benodig om werfbesoeke uit te voer, gevangenes te ondervra en klagtes te hanteer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat beskik. Rekenaarvaardig en akkuraat. 'n Aanbeveling vir nominasie as 'n ICCV deur 'n gemeenskapsorganisasie (nie ouer as ses (6) maande nie). Vermoë om onafhanklik en as 'n span te werk. Gemeenskapsgesind en goeie kennis van die Batho Pele-beginsels. Selfvertroue en vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). 'n Bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kwalifiserende aansoeke van individue wat in gemeenskappe woon wat in die omgewing van die korrektiewe sentrum waar die pos gevul moet word, is.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die uitvoer van werfbesoeke en verslagdoening oor dringende sake. Om gereelde onderhoude en konsultasies met gevangenes en DCS-amptenare rakende klagtes en verpligte sake uit te voer. Ontvang en vaslegging van alle klagtes/versoeke op die databasis. Oopmaak en instandhouding van saaklêers. Opvolg van uitstaande klagtes. Indiening van maandelikse verslae. Voorsiening van statistiese ontleding van alle ontvangste klagtes. Bystand aan navrae. Uitvoer van alle redelike opdragte deur die toesighouer/Streeksbestuurder.

zu.title: Isivakashi Esizimele Senkabikhono Sokulungisa Abagwenzi
zu.summary: Izivakashi Ezizimele Zenkabikhono Sokulungisa Abagwenzi zidingwa kuzona ezinkundleni zezingqongo eziyisishiyagalombili ukuze kwenziwe ukuvakashela iziteshi, kubuzwe abagwenzi kubhekwe nezikhalazo.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12/Senior Certificate. Kumele bakwazi ukusebenza ngemodeli yakhompyutha kanye nokuba nokulondolozwa kwemininingwane ehlelekile. Ukunconywa njengesakhamuzi se-ICCV sikhulunywe ngumbutho womphakathi (osunguliweyo kungadluli izinyanga eziyisithupha (6)). Ukuba namlipho ukusebenza kodwa nangokuhlanganyela njengeqembu. Ukuba nomoya wokwenza okulungela umphakathi nokwazi kahle imigingo yamaphuzu aliBatho Pele. Ukuzithiba kanye namlipho ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Amlipho okuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nangokubhala). Ilaysensi yokushayela ibe ngaphezulu ngaleyo ndlela. Izikhundla zizonikezwa ngaphezulu abafakeli abazothola izidingo ababekule imiphakathi eduze nenyikhono yokulungisa abagwenzi lapho isikhundla sifanela ukuzaliswa khona.
zu.duties: Umntu owayo kulesi sikhundla uzoba nomsebenzi wokwenza ukuvakashela iziteshi kanye nokubika ngemicabango ephuthumayo. Ukuqhuba ukuphendula nokweluleka abagwenzi nabaqashi be-DCS mayelana nezikhalazo kanye nezidingo ezibekiwe. Ukumukwa nokugcinwa kwazo zonke izikhalazo/izicelo kwidathabheysi. Ukuqalwa nokulondolozwa kwamafayela ezikhalazo. Ukulandela ukuthi kuhamba kangakanani izikhalazo ezingakedlulwa. Ukulandelwa kwemibalo yenyanga ngayonyanga. Ukunikeza ukutolikwa kwebalo lezibalo lezo zonke izikhalazo ezitholakele. Ukuzwelana nemibuzo. Ukwenza yonke imiyalo esemthethweni exhushwe ngumphathi/Umphathi Wendawo.

xh.title: Umngeni Wetiko Lokulungisa Ozigelayo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abangu-Abengeni Wetiko Lokulungisa Ozigelayo kummandla wabamelwe abasibho ukwenza iindwendwe kumaziko, kudiba nababoshiwe nokusingatha iinkhalazo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12/Senior Certificate. Ukuba nolwazi lwekhompyutha nokuchaneka. Ukuzithandela komnikelo njengommandla ICCV ngurhulumente komkhankatho (ongadali kusixhenxe (7) iinyanga). Ukuba nolwazi lokuzoba ngamandla namandla ngesithukuthezi. Ukuba ngumntu othanda izinto zenkolo nelwazi olubanzi ngesiseko seBatho Pele. Ukuba nolwazi lokuba nolwimi nokusebenza ngamandla. Ukuba nolwazi lokuqamba ngolwimi (ngokuthetha nangokubhalwa). Ilayisensi yokushuka iya kuba ngumphethu. Iya kubakho inkathazo kubafaka isicelo abafumaneka kubantu abahlala kumakhaya asekufutshani kwesiko lokulungisa apho isithuba sifuneka kuso.
xh.duties: Umntu oya kufakwa kule sithuba uya kubizwa ngokwenza iindwendwe kumaziko nokuxela ngemiba ebalulekileyo. Ukwenza iintitshala ezizezidibana nababoshiwe nanabasebenzi beDCS malunga neenkhalazo nemiba ebalulekileyo. Ukufumana nokubhala zonke iinkhalazo/iicelo kwidatabase. Ukuvula nokulondoloza iifayile zeziMfuno. Ukwenza iinkqubo ezizangeziweyo ngeenkhalazo ezingekabone. Ukuhamba ngezinto emva kwexesha ngeenkhalazo ezingekona. Ukunikela ngeembiwo zenyanga. Ukunikela ngohlobo lweenkalo zonke iinkhalazo ezifunyenwe. Ukuphendula iimibuzo. Ukwenza konke okufunwayo ngumnikelo ngumnikelo/Isekeli Mongameli WoMmandla.

jobs.title: Chief Land Claims Commissioner
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum (Level 15), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of the package) and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS). (5 years employment contract)
jobs.summary: Chief Land Claims Commissioner position at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, offering R1,885,710 per annum at SMS Level 15.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Honours Degree / Advanced Diploma in Social Sciences / Economics / Natural Sciences / Law or Development Studies (NQF Level 8) and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 8 years of experience at senior managerial level in Land Reform / Restitution Environment. Demonstrated leadership in a large complex organisation. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Understanding of key priorities of government, as well as the Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP), Infrastructure planning and implementation, Public Service Act, Public Financial Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Project management, Programme management, Strategic capacity and planning, Budgeting, Expenditure reporting, Monitoring and evaluation, Human resource management, Supply chain management, Knowledge of the Constitution and Land Reform legislation. Job related skills: Communication (Both verbal and written), Strategic planning and leadership, Presentation and facilitation, Report writing, People management, Financial management, Business management / Public management, Monitoring and evaluation, Negotiation and conflict resolution, Customer focus and Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provides strategic leadership and guidance for the provision of Restitution services in the following areas: Provide strategic leadership and direction as well as implement the functions of the Commission are described in the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994. Provide access to rights in land, including land ownership and sustainable development. Serve as the Head of the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights and the Branch Restitution. Advise the Executive Authority on policy development and implementation. Interface with broader processes around land reform at the national level. Interface with the Director-General: Land Reform and Rural Development in his/her capacity as the accounting officer of the Commission. Ensure that Restitution projects are of high quality and conform to policy objectives of poverty eradication and sustainable development. Ensure effective governance, accountability and compliance with relevant legislation. Drive organisational performance, transformation and service delivery. Coordinate strategic planning and compilation of APP. Provide financial management services to the Commission. Provide legal support to Commission in terms of restitution issues. Provide risk and compliance services to the Commission. Manage Commission finances, human resource and assets. Coordinate service delivery. Provides strategic management and direction to the Branch: Develops Restitution strategic plan in agreement with the Director-General: Department of land Reform and Rural Development. Develops and reports on annual Restitution operational and work plans linked to the Restitution Act. Prepares financial reports/statements on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. Estimates progress review and budget adjustments on an annual basis. Prepares technical procedures and standards according to policy. Sets realistic goals and objectives for the Commission and the Branch to be attained. Coordinates the development and maintenance of Branch system and controls. Ensures protection of the Branch from risk and fraud at all times. Develops a well-defined communication strategy for the Branch. Provides strategic direction towards an effective and efficient commission: Oversee implementation towards establishing schedule 3 (A) Entity. Approves business Case and legislation. Redesign the settlement models in sector categories. Foster stakeholder relations and partnerships across government, business and civil society. Lead and Manage the Business unit in accordance with good Governance: Ensure participation at Quality Control Committees (QCC) and signing approval of claims. Manage Restitution Legal Matters including Litigation and Compliance matters. Manage IT Systems. Manage expenditure risk. Ensure that revised institutional form is implemented. Develop a detailed business process linked to the standard operating procedures and time frames to ensure effective information and records management. Ensure that the Statutory commission meetings are held in compliance with the Restitution. Decide on request for access to information in terms of PAIA: Undertake functions as the information officer of the Commission. Manage the identification and locate records. Ensure that the third parties are notified where required. Take decisions on whether to grant/deny access. Manage the calculated charges applicable to fees. Provide access to records if the decision is to grant access.
jobs.enquiries: Dr AF van Staden Tel No: (012) 312 9626
jobs.applications: Nominations or applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post274@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and Indian Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofgrondvorderingskommissaris
af.summary: Hoofgrondvorderingskommissaris pos by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, wat R1,885,710 per jaar aanbied op SMS Vlak 15.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 Sertifikaat en Honneurs Graad / Gevorderde Diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Ekonomie / Natuurwetenskappe / Regte of Ontwikkelingsstudies (NQF Vlak 8) en 'n Nyukela sertifikaat (Voor-toetrede Sertifikaat tot die SMS) voor aanstelling ingedien. Minimum van 8 jaar se ondervinding op senior bestuursvlak in Grondhervorming / Restitutie Omgewing. Getoonde leierskap in 'n groot komplekse organisasie. 'n Geldige bestuurder lisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van sleutel prioriteite van regering, asook die Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP), Infrastruktuur beplanning en implementering, Public Service Act, Public Financial Management Act, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Projekbestuur, Programbestuur, Strategiese kapasiteit en beplanning, Begroting, Uitgawes verslagdoening, Monitering en evaluerings, Menslike hulpbronbestuur, Voorsieningkettingbestuur, Kennis van die Grondwet en Grondhervormingswetgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (Beide mondeling en skriftelik), Strategiese beplanning en leierskap, Voorlegging en fasilitering, Verslagdoening, Personeelbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Besigheidsbestuur / Openbare bestuur, Monitering en evaluering, Onderhandeling en konflikoplossing, Kliëntefokus en Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en leiding vir die voorsiening van Restitusiedienste in die volgende areas: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting asook implementeer die funksies van die Kommissie soos beskryf in die Restitutie van Grondregte Wet No. 22 van 1994. Verskaf toegang tot regte op grond, insluitend grondeienaarskap en volhoubare ontwikkeling. Dien as die Hoof van die Kommissie op Restitutie van Grondregte en die Tak Restitutie. Stel die Uitvoerende Gesag oor beleidsontwikkeling en implementering. Skakel met breër prosesse rondom gronderhervorming op nasionale vlak. Skakel met die Direkteur-generaal: Land Reform and Rural Development in sy/haar hoedanigheid as die rekenpligtige beampte van die Kommissie. Verseker dat Restitutieprojekte van hoë gehalte is en voldoen aan beleidsdoelwitte van armoede-uitroeiing en volhoubare ontwikkeling. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur, verantwoordingsplicht en voldoening aan relevante wetgewing. Dryf organisatoriese prestasie, transformasie en dienslewering aan. Koördineer strategiese beplanning en opstel van APP. Verskaf finansiële bestuursdienste aan die Kommissie. Verskaf regssteun aan die Kommissie rakende restitutiekwessies. Verskaf risiko- en voldoeningsdienste aan die Kommissie. Bestuur Kommissie se finansies, menslike hulpbronne en bates. Koördineer dienslewering. Verskaf strategiese bestuur en rigting aan die Tak: Ontwikkel Restitutie strategiese plan in ooreenstemming met die Direkteur-generaal: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development. Ontwikkel en verslag doen oor jaarlikse Restitutie operasionele en werksplanne gekoppel aan die Restitutiewet. Berei finansiële verslae/ state voor op 'n maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse basis. Skat voortgangs hersiening en begrotings aanpassings op 'n jaarlikse basis. Berei tegniese prosedures en standaarde voor volgens beleid. Stel realistiese doelwitte en oogmerke vir die Kommissie en die Tak om bereik te word. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van Tak stelsel en kontroles. Verseker beskerming van die Tak teen risiko en bedrog te alle tye. Ontwikkel 'n goed gedefinieerde kommunikasie strategie vir die Tak. Verskaf strategiese rigting tot 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige kommissie: Oorsien implementering na die instelling van skedule 3 (A) Entiteit. Keur besigheidsgeval en wetgewing goed. herontwerp die skikking modelle in sektor kategorieë. Bevorder belanghebbende verhoudings en vennootskappe oor regering, besigheid en die burgerlike samelewing. Lei en Bestuur die besigheidseenheid in ooreenstemming met goeie Bestuur: Verseker deelname by Gehaltebeheer Komitees (GBK) en tekengoodkeuring van eise. Bestuur Restitutie Regsake insluitende Litigasie en Voldoeningsake. Bestuur IT Stelsels. Bestuur uitgawerisiko. Verseker dat die hersiene institusionele vorm geïmplementeer word. Ontwikkel 'n gedetailleerde besigheidsproses gekoppel aan die standaard bedryfsprosedures en tydsraamwerke om doeltreffende inligting en rekordbestuur te verseker. Verseker dat die Statutêre kommissie vergaderings gehou word in ooreenstemming met die Restitutie. Besluit op versoek vir toegang tot inligting in terme van PAIA: Onderneem funksies as die inligtingbeampte van die Kommissie. Bestuur die identifisering en opspoor van rekords. Verseker dat derde partye in kennis gestel word waar vereis. Neem besluite oor of toegang verleen/ geweier word. Bestuur die berekende koste van toepassing op fooie. Verskaf toegang tot rekords indien die besluit is om toegang te verleen.

zu.title: uMqashi oyinhloko Wezinsizakusebenza Zomhlaba
zu.summary: Isikhundla somQashi oyinhloko Wezinsizakusebenza Zomhlaba kumnyango weLand Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, ohlinzeka ngoR1,885,710 ngonyaka ezingeni le-SMS Level 15.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Honours Degree / Advanced Diploma kwezeSayensi Zomphakathi / i-Economics / Izayensi Zendalo / i-Law noma i-Development Studies (NQF Level 8) kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (Isitifiketi sokungena ngaphambi kokuba yi-SMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka engu-8 ngokungenisa izinto ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphathwa kwindawo yokuguqulwa komhlaba / yokubuyiselwa. Ukuboniswa kobuholi enkampanini enkone enamagatsha. Ilelisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda ngemibhalo ehlelekile kahulumeni, kanye ne-Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP), ukweluleka nokusebenzisa izinsiza, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Financial Management Act, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, ukuphathwa kwezinhlela, ukuphathwa kwezinhlela, amandla okuzila nokuhlela, ukwenza isabelo sezezimali, ukubika ukusetshenziswa kwemali, ukuqashwa nokuhlolwa, ukuphathwa kwezinsizakusebenza zomuntu, ukuphathwa kwezinto ezitholakala kalula, ulwazi ngomthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho wokuguqulwa komhlaba. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (Ngokukhuluma nangokubhala), ukuhlela okuhlelekile nokuba ngumholi, ukwethula nokweseka, ukubhala imibhalo, ukuphatha abantu, ukuphatha izimali, ukuphatha ibhizinisi / ukuphatha kahulumeni, ukuqashwa nokuhlolwa, ukuxoxisana nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Unikeza ubuholi bokuhlela okuhlelekile kanye nezindlela zokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokubuyiselwa komhlaba kulawo makhondo alandelayo: Unikeza ubuholi bokuhlela okuhlekekile kanye nokuqondisa kanye nokusebenzisa imisebenzi yeKhomishani njengoba kuchazwe ku-Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994. Unikeza ukufinyelela kwamalungelo emhlaba, okuhlanganisa nokubamba umhlaba kanye nentuthuko egqamelayo. Uveza njengenhloko yeKhomishani yokubuyisela amalungelo omhlaba kanye neshishelo lokubuyisela. Uphakamisa iNkantolo yeZomphakathi ngokuthuthukiswa nokusebenziswa kwemigomo. Uxhuma kweminye imikhuba ekhuluma ngokuguqulwa komhlaba ezingeni lenkulu. Uxuma noDirector-General: Land Reform and Rural Development enkundleni yakhe njengonozuzwana weKhomishani. Uqinisekisa ukuthi imigidingo yokubuyisela inomgang athandathu futhi ihambisana nemigomo nokuqeda ubumpofu nakunentuthuko egqamelayo. Uqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, ukubophela kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho ohlobene. Ukhombisa ukuthi inkampani ikwazi ukusebenza kahle, okushintshayo kanye nokuletha isevisi. Uhlanganisa ukuhlela okuhlehekile kanye nokuhlela ukwakheka kwe-APP. Unikezela ngemisebenzi yokuphatha izimali eKhomishanini. Unikezela ngokwesekwa ngomthetho eKhomishanini mayelana nezinkinga zokubuyisela. Unikezela ngemisebenziengoMayelana nokuqashwa nokuhlolwa kwezengozi eKhomishanini. Uphatha izimali, izinsizakusebenza zomuntu nezimpahla eKhomishanini. Uhlanganisa ukuletha isevisi. Uphathwa ngokuhlela okuhlekekile kanye nokuqondisa kweshishelo: Uthuthukisa uhlelo lokubuyisela oluhlehekile ngokuvumelana noDirector-General: Department of land Reform and Rural Development. Uthuthukisa kanye nokubika ngohlelo lokusebenza olungeminyaka yonke nobukuqeda ngemisebenzi ehlobene noMthetho Wokubuyisela. Ulungiselela imibhalo/izitatimende sezimali njalo ngenyanga, kanye nakwindlu yezimali ngonyaka. Uqagela ulwazi lokubuka kuqhubekele phambili kanye nokulungiswa kwesabelo ngonyaka. Ulungiselela izinqubo ezibucayi kanye namazinga ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Uhlela amagcala okwenza kanye nemigomo nenhloso-yokugcina yeKhomishani kanye neshishelo. Uhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nogciniwe kwamaphuzu eshishelo kanye nokulawula. Uqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kweshishelo ekubeni kungabi nalunga noma ukungalungeli ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uthuthukisa isu lokuxhumana esichaziwe kahle leshishelo. Unikeza isu sokuhlela ekubeni khomishani esebenzayo kanye nesikhathi: Uyobheka ukusetshenziswa ngokuholela ekubeni kwakho isikhathi samanje kwe-Schedule 3 (A) Entity. Uvuma iBizinesi kanye nomthetho. Ushintsha amamodeli okuxazulula izinkinga ngamagatsha. Ukhuthaza ubudlelwano nabahlanganyeli kanye namakhonsathi kahulumeni, ngokusobala kanye nenhlangano yomphakathi. Uholaphathe ibhizinisi ngokuhambisana nokulawula okuhle: Uqinisekisa ukubamba kwengxenye kuKhomishani Yokuqasha Isimiso (QCC) kanye nokuvuma ukusayina kwamalungelo. Uphatha izinkinga zomthetho ezihlobene nokubuyisela kuhlanganise nokuvela enkantolo nokuhambisana nomthetho. Uphatha amasistemu e-IT. Uphatha ingozi yokusebenzisa imali. Uqinisekisa ukuthi umumo olushintshiwe womphakathi usebenza. Uthuthukisa inqubo yebhizinisi eningiliziwe ehlobene nokuqashwa kwaye osekela izinhlelo zokusabela kanye nesikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kolwazi nemibalu. Uqinisekisa ukuthi imihlangano yeKhomishani esemthethweni ibanjwa ngokuhambisana nokubuyisela. Uquma ngosizo lokungena kulwazi ngokuhambisana nePAIA: Uthatha imisebenzi njengonozuzwana welwazi weKhomishani. Uphatha ukubonwa kanye nokuqasha imibhalo. Uqinisekisa ukuthi baphathi bezokuqasha batiywa lapho kudingeka khona. Uthatha izinqumo ngokuthi ungunikeza / unganiki ukungena. Uphatha izinkokhelo ezibaliwe ezihambisana nezimali. Unikeza ukungena kwemibhalo uma isinqumo senukunikela.

xh.title: Ikomishinali Ephatha Iba Ngunaphakathi Wezibhalo Zomhlaba
xh.summary: Isithuba seKhomishinali Ephatha Iba Ngunaphakathi Wezibhalo Zomhlaba kwisebe i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, sinika R1,885,710 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 15.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezibaluleayo: Abafaki isicelo kufunelu babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 kunye ne-Honours Degree / Advanced Diploma kwiiSayensi Zezenzululwazi / I-Ityala ezimalini / I-Sayensi Yendalo okanye iMfundo Yophuhliso (NQF Level 8) kunye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela (Isatifikethi sokungena ngaphambili kwi-SMS) esinikelwe phambi kokunikelwa isithuba. Iminyaka engu-8 yamava kwinqanaba leempathi eziphakamileyo kwimo Yokuguqulwa Komhlaba / Okubuyiselwa komhlaba. Ukwabonisa ubuquki ekubeni ngookhokheli kwisikhululo esikhulu nesidumbisayo. Ilayisenesi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda iipolisi eziphambili zorhulumente, nakwindlela ebanzi Yokwakhiswa kwamaphandle eMzantsi (CRDP), uqhelaniso lolwangcango lweziseko zomsebenzi nokusebenzisa, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Financial Management Act, i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ulawulo lweenkqubo, uluntu lokwakha nokuceba iindlela, ukulinganisa imali, iingxelo zokuqithiswa kwemali, ukugqitha nokuhlolwa, ulawulo lweemisebenzi yabantu, ulawulo lwenkqubo yokufumanisa izinto, ulwazi lweMgaqo-siseko namagazethi okuGuqula iNkqubo yomHlaba. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (Njengoko kuthethwa njenjalo nakubhalwa), uqhelaniso lokuceba iindlela nobukhokheli, okwethulwa nokulawula iindibano, ukubhala iingxelo, ulawulo lwabantu, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo loshishino / ulawulo lwenkonzo zorhulumente, ukugqitha nokuhlolwa, ukuxoxisana nokusombulula iingxabano, ukugxila nakwinxulumene namakhasimende nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Unika inqeqheba yokulawula nokuqhelisa ekubeni kukhona iinkonzo zokuBuyiselwa komhlaba kwezi ndawo zilandelayo: Unika inqeqheba yokulawula nokuqhelisa ukwenza umsebenzi weKhomishini njengoko kuchazwe kumagazethi we-Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994. Ukubonelela ukufikelela kwamalungelo emhlabeni, kuquka ulwazi lokuba ngumntu ohlotywe ngomhlaba nophuhliso olomeleleyo. Ukubakho njengenhloko yeKhomishini yoBuyiselwa koMhlaba naseNgcwele loBuyiselwa koMhlaba. Ukunceda iNkulu yeNtloko ngendlela yokulawula iindlela zophuhliso nokusebenza kweenkqubo. Ukuqhagamshelana nokuqhuba iinkqubo ezibanzi zokuguqula umhlaba kwelizwe. Ukubonelela ukwenza umsebenzi noMongameli oNobeko: i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development njengomntu ongasemthethweni oqwalasela iimali zeKhomishini. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba amaphulo okuBuyisela omhlaba luluhlobo oluphakamileyo lwaye alandele iinjongo zepolisi zokutshatyalaliswa kobumpoxo nophuhliso olomeleleyo. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo, ukubakho nexhala lokwenza izinto ngokulandela umthetho. Ukubeka iNkqubo yophuhliso koluntu, inguquko nokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Ukuqhelanisa nokulungiselela i-APP. Ukubonelela ulawulo lweemali nakwiKhomishini. Ukubonelela inkxaso yomthetho nakwiKhomishini kwimiba yokubuyiswa komhlaba. Ukubonelela ulawulo lweengozi nokwenza izinto ngokulandela umthetho. Ukulawula iimali, amathambo kunye namafa eKomishini. Ukuqhelanisa ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Unika ulawulo oluphakathi nobuqu ekubeni ukubakho kobuquki kunye nokuqhelisa iNgcwele: Yakha indlela ejoliswe kokuBuyiselwa komhlaba ngokuvumelana noMongameli oNobeko: i-Department of land Reform and Rural Development. Yakha aze achaze ngayo ngonyaka iindlela zokuBuyiselwa ezinkqubo zomsebenzi ezidityaniswe nomGazethe wokuBuyiselwa komhlaba. Ulungisa iingxelo/izatikethi zeemali nyanga nenyanga, kwikota nakuyonke iminyaka. Uqwalasela ukuphuhliswa kwexesha nokubuyela imali ngemva kokuhlola inyaka zonke. Ulungisa iindlela namagqabantshintshi ezoqeqesho ngokulandela iNkqubo. Misela iinjongo namaphupha angaqediweyo weKhomishini naseNgcwele ukuba afikelelwe. Uqhelanisa ekwakheni nokugcina ulawulo lweNkqubo eNgcwele. Uqinisekisa ukukhuselwa kweNgcwele kwiingozi nobudlelwane bonke iintsuku. Yakha indlela echazwe kakuhle yokunxibelelana ngenkungu yeNgcwele. Unika inqeqheba ekubeni kukhona iKhomishini esebenzayo nakoqeqesho: Ukuqwalasela ukusebenzisa indlela ekumiselweni koluntu oluqhagamshelene kumGaqo 3 (A) Entity. Ugunyazisa iNgcali yoShishino naba chazwe ngomthetho. Uyila ngokutsha iindlela zokuqwalasela iindidi ezahlukeneyo zoluntu. Uyakha amaqhagamshelo nobudlelwane phakathi korhulumente, ushishino noluntu. Yaye ulawule iqela loshishino ngokulandela ulawulo oluhle: Qinisekisa ukubakhona kwabaxhasi beeKomiti Zolawulo (QCC) nokusayina ukugunyaziswa kwezibhalo. Yaye ulawule iMiba zeMthetho yoBuyiselo komHlaba eziquka imiba yokuziphikisa nokulawula. Uyayilawula iiNkqubo ze-IT. Yaye ulawula iingozi ezingaphezu kweemali. Uqinisekisa ukuba indlela elitsha yoluntu iqwalaselwe nokuba isebenza. Yakha iinkqubo ezichaziweyo zoshishino ezidityanisiweyo nendlela yokusebenza naxesha ukuba kuqinisekiswe ulawulo lwemaxhoba nolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuba iindibano ezithintelwe ngumthetho zeKhomishini zibanjwa ngokulandela umthetho wokuBuyiselwa. Uyakha izicelo zokubonelela ngolwazi ngokulandela i-PAIA: Uzenza umsebenzi njengomphathi wolwazi weKhomishini. Uyakha olu lwazi olupheleleyo athi abantu bafuna ulwazi. Yaye uqinisekisa ukubakho kwezaziso ezithintelwe abantu abangaphandle apho kufuneka khona. Uthatha iigqibo zokuba makube nokuba hayi ukubonelela ngolwazi. Yaye ulawula imirarho ezidityanisiweyo nokuqikelela iimali efunekayo. Ubonelela ngolwazi xa isigqibo sithi makubonelelwe ngolwazi.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum (Level 15), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 8 qualification and Nyukela certificate.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and minimum qualification at NQF Level 8 in Financial Management including Accounting / Business Administration / Commerce / Supply Chain Management / Public Finance as recognised by South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a senior managerial position. Must demonstrate high level of competency in financial administration, financial accounting and supply chain management. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge and experience in Generally Recognise Accounting Principles (GRAP) and modified cash standards. Knowledge of the public sector budget reform process. Ability to effectively manage alignment of budget with priority programmes of service delivery. Ability to act as change agent and manage in accordance with the strategic vision and objective of the Department. Knowledge of financial management in relation to the regulatory framework for the Public Service e.g Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury Regulations, the Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations. Understand the Constitutional mandate and key priorities of the Department. Cash flow forecasting. Job related skills: Communication skills (both verbal and written) and Negotiation, Monitoring and evaluation, Coordination and facilitation, Financial analysis, Risk management, Problem solving with Financial and supply chain legal framework, Project management, Change management, Excellent people management. Personal Attributes: Departmental empowerment on Financial and Supply Chain requirements, Integrity, Ethical and empathetic leadership, Good interpersonal relations, ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines, Ability to work in a team and independently, Strong character, Problem solving and analysis, decisive decision making, client orientation and customer focus, Proactive Communication with all stakeholders, Good financial judgement.
jobs.duties: Manage and render supply chain management services. Manage demand management plan and acquisition services. Manage logistics, assets and contract management. Ensure that internal procedures and control measures are in place. Provide advice and contribute towards the financial aspects of the strategic planning process of the Department. Compile delegations of authority in respect of financial and procurement matters. Provide inputs into the formulation of the medium-term objectives, policies, and strategies in support of the strategic and operational plans of the Department. Monitor and oversee the collection of revenue by the Department. Manage governance and assurance management services. Provide timely and accurate financial and operational information necessary for strategic decision making to all Branches and exercise oversight into programme performance. Compilation of accurate annual financial statement and timeous submission in accordance with applicable standards and legislative requirements. Good audit outcomes. Responsiveness towards queries from Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), Parliament and Audit Committees. Ensure effective management and implementation of good corporate governance in the Department. Manage the budget performance services. Manage budget performance. Provide financial performance. Manage state of expenditure. Provide financial and administrative support. Render office service support. Provide supply chain support. Facilitate, coordinate and administer projects.
jobs.enquiries: Dr AF van Staden Tel No: (012) 312 9626
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post275@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and Indian Males, and African, Coloured and Indian Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof Finansiële Beampte
af.summary: Hoof Finansiële Beampte by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n minimum kwalifikasie op NQF Level 8 in Finansiële Bestuur insluitend Rekenkunde / Besigheidsadministrasie / Handel / Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Openbare Finansies soos erken deur die South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Minimum van 8 jaar se ervaring in 'n senior bestuurspos. Moet 'n hoë vlak van bevoegdheid in finansiële administrasie, finansiële rekenkunde en voorsieningskettingbestuur toon. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis en ervaring in Generally Recognise Accounting Principles (GRAP) en gewysigde kontantstandaarde. Kennis van die openbare sektor se begrotingshervormingsproses. Vermoë om die belyning van die begroting met prioriteitsprogramme van dienslewering doeltreffend te bestuur. Vermoë om as veranderingagent op te tree en te bestuur in ooreenstemming met die strategiese visie en doelwit van die departement. Kennis van finansiële bestuur in verhouding tot die regulerende raamwerk vir die Staatsdiens bv Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie-regulasies, die Public Service Act en Public Service Regulations. Begrip van die grondwetlike mandaat en kernprioriteite van die departement. Kontantvloeivoorspelling. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik) en onderhandeling, monitering en evaluering, koördinering en fasilitering, finansiële ontleding, risikobestuur, probleemoplossing met finansiële en voorsieningskettingregulerende raamwerk, projektebestuur, veranderingbestuur, uitstekende personeelsbestuur. Persoonlike eienskappe: Departementele bemagtiging oor finansiële en voorsieningskettingvereistes, integriteit, etiese en empatiese leierskap, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom, vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk, sterk karakter, probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitende besluitneming, kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus, proaktiewe kommunikasie met alle belanghebbendes, goeie finansiële oordeel.
af.duties: Bestuur en lewer voorsieningskettingbestuursdienste. Bestuur die vraagbestuursplan en verkrygingsdienste. Bestuur logistiek, bates en kontrakbestuur. Verseker dat interne prosedures en beheermaatreëls in plek is. Verskaf advies en dra by tot die finansiële aspekte van die strategiese beplanningsproses van die departement. Stel delegasies van gesag ten opsigte van finansiële en verkrygingsaangeleenthede op. Verskaf insette tot die formulering van die mediumtermyn-doelwitte, belede en strategieë ter ondersteuning van die strategiese en operasionele planne van die departement. Monitor en hou toesig oor die invordering van inkomste deur die departement. Bestuur goewernantskap en versekeringsbestuursdienste. Verskaf tydige en akkurate finansiële en operasionele inligting wat nodig is vir strategiese besluitneming aan alle Takke en oefen toesig uit oor programprestasie. Opstel van akkurate jaarlikse finansiële state en tydige indiening in ooreenstemming met toepaslike standaarde en wetgewende vereistes. Goeie oudit-uitkomste. Reaksie op navrae van die Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), Parlement en Ouditkomitees. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur en implementering van goeie korporatiewe goewernantskap in die departement. Bestuur die begrotingsprestasiedienste. Bestuur begrotingsprestasie. Verskaf finansiële prestasie. Bestuur staatkundige van besteding. Verskaf finansiële en administratiewe ondersteuning. Lewer kantoor_diensondersteuning. Verskaf voorsieningskettingondersteuning. Fasiliteer, koördineer en administreer projekte.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezezimali Omkhulu
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezezimali Omkhulu e-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e-Pretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 8 nesitifiketi se-Nyukela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakelwayo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye neziqu ezingaphansi ezingeni le-NQF Level 8 kwi-Financial Management okuhlanganisa i-Accounting / Business Administration / Commerce / Supply Chain Management / Public Finance njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (Isitifiketi sokungena phambi kwi-SMS) esinikwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-8 yamava esikhundleni esiphezulu sokuphatha. Kumele abonise izinga eliphezulu lekhono ekuphathweni kwezimali, izibalo ezezimali nakwinqubo yokuhlinzeka. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi namava kwi-Generally Recognise Accounting Principles (GRAP) namazinga okushintshiwe kwemali. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokulungisa isabelo semali esikhungweni sikahulumeni. Ikhono lokuphatha ngokusebenza ukuhambisana kwesabelo semali namaphrogramu abalulekile okuletha izinsiza. Ikhono lokuba ngumphathi woshintsho nokuphatha ngokuvumelana nombono wamasu kanye nenhloso yomnyango. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali ngokuhlobene nesakhiwo somthetho we-Public Service, njenge-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) ne-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Act kanye ne-Public Service Regulations. Ukuqonda igunya loMthethosisekelo kanye nezinto ezibalulekile zomnyango. Ukuqagela ukugeleza kwemali. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuxhumana (kokubhalayo nokukhulunyayo) kanye nokuxoxisana, Ukugadangisa nokuhlola, Ukuhlanganiswa nokweseka, Ukuhlaziya izimali, Ukuphathwa kwezengozi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngesakhiwo somthetho wezezimali nokuhlinzeka, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, Ukuphathwa koshintsho, Ukuphathwa kwabantu okuhle. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Ukunikezwa kwamandla komnyango ngezidingo ezezimali nokuhlinzeka, Ukuqotho, Ukuphatha ngokuzwela nokuziphatha kahle, Ukuxhumana kahle nabantu, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelwa nokufeza izikhathi ezibalulekile, Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nodwa, Isimo esomelele, Ukuxazulula nokuhlaziya izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo ngokuqinile, ukuqondiswa komthengi kanye nokugxila komthengi, Ukuxhumana ngaphambili nabanikazi bomsebenzi bonke, Isilinganiso esihle sezimali.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi nikeze izinkonzo zokuphathwa kwesicu sokuhlinzeka. Phatha icebo lokuphathwa kwezidingo kanye nezenzo zokuthenga. Phatha amalogistics, izimpahla kanye nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Qinisekisa ukuba khona kwezinqubo zangaphakathi kanye nezinyathelo zokulawula. Nika izeluleko futhi ngene ngomphumela ezimeni ezezimali zenqubo yokwakha amasu omnyango. Qamba ukudluliselwa kwamandla ngemayelana nezindaba ezezimali zokuthenga. Nika izindingo ekwakheni izinhloso zesikhathi esiphakathi, amapholisi, namasu ukuze useke amasu kanye namapulani okusebenza omnyango. Qaphela futhi ulawule ukuqoqwa kwezimali zengeniso ngumnyango. Phatha izinkonzo zokulawula nokuphathwa kokuqinisekiswa. Nikeza ngokusheshisiso futhi ngokunembile izinkomba ezezimali nezokusebenza eziyimfuneko ekwenzeni izinqumo ngamasu kuyo yonke imikhakha futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwamaphrogramu. Ukuqamba kwezinkomba ezezimali ezinembile zonyaka nokuzinika ngesikhathi ngokuvumelana namazinga afanele kanye nezidingo zomthetho. Imiphumela emihle yokuhlola. Ukuzwela imibuzo evela ku-Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), i-Parliament kanye namakomithi okuhlola. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokusetshenziswa kokulawulwa kahle kwezinhlelo komnyango. Phatha izinkonzo zokusebenza kwesabelo semali. Phatha ukusebenza kwesabelo semali. Nikeza ngokusebenza kwezezimali. Phatha isimo sezimali ezichithiwe. Nika ngesekelo lezezimali nolawulo. Nikela ngesekelo lezinkonzo zofisi. Nikeza ngesekelo lesicu sokuhlinzeka. Seseka, hlanganisa futhi ulawule amaphrojekthi.

xh.title: I-Nozabisemali eNjineli
xh.summary: I-Nozabisemali eNjineli kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, ifuna isidanga se-NQF Level 8 nesatifikethwa se-Nyukela.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona msebenzi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethwa seQabakaLothwetho (Grade 12) nesidanga esingowona msebenzi se-NQF Level 8 kwi-Financial Management kuquka i-Accounting / Business Administration / Commerce / Supply Chain Management / Public Finance njengoko kuqatshwa yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) nesatifikethwa se-Nyukela (Isatifikethwa sokungena phambili kwi-SMS) esinikezelwa phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufuneka abe nolwazi olungaphaya kweminyaka eyi-8 esikhundleni somphathi ophakamileyo. Kufuneka abonise inqanaba eliphezulu lobuchule kulawulo lwemali, ebalwenzimali nakwintlawulo yohwebo. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nemfundo kwi-Generally Recognise Accounting Principles (GRAP) nemigangatho yemali eguqiweyo. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yenguqu yebhajeti kwicandelo likawonke-wonke. Ikhamelo lokulawula ngokusebenzayo ulungelelwaniso lwebhajeti neenkqubo eziphambili zokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Ikhamelo lokuba ngummeli wo Guqulo nokuLawula ngokwesonkezo nabakho mangcipheko wesebe. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwemali mayelana noguqu olubekiweyo lomthetho kwiNkonzo kaWonke-wonke umzekelo i-Public Financial Management Act (PFMA) nee-Treasury Regulations, uMthetho weNkonzo kaWonke-wonke neeMigaqo yeNkonzo kaWonke-wonke. Ukuqonda igunya loMgaqo-siseko nengqwalasela eziphambili zeSebe. Ukuchazwa kwesiphithiphithi semali. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono eXoxo (emlonyeni nakubhalwe) nekuNxibelelaniselana, uQwalaselo nokuLinganisa, uQhagamshelwano nokukhokeza, uLinganiso lwemali, uLawulo loMngcipheko, ukuSombulula iingxaki nomGangatho womthetho weMali nentlawulo yohwebo, uLawulo lweeNkqubo, uLawulo lwaGuqulo, uLawulo oluhle lwabantu. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukuzinika amandla kwisebe ngemfuno yeMali nentlawulo yohwebo, uQqba-lwazi, uLawulo olungcolisekiyo noluzingelwe ngumonde, uQhagamshelwano oluhle lwabantu, ikhamelo lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuqinisekisa ukuba kugqitywa kwexesha, ikhamelo lokusebenza nakwikomokhulu nakodwa, ukuzimisela okunamandla, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuZalathisa, ukwenza izigqibo ezisigqibezelayo, uqondisiso kumthengi nagqithisele kumthengi, uNxibelelwano olusengaphambili nabo bonke abanomdla, isigqibo esihle semali.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokunikela iinkonzo zolawulo lwentlawulo yohwebo. Ukulawula iplani yolawulo lwemfuno neenkonzo zokufumana izinto. Ukulawula ulawulo lwe-logistics, iiaseti nekhowudi yamagama. Qinisekisa ukuba ziikhona iindlela zangaphakathi nezithintelo zolawulo. Nikela icebiso kwaye unike isapho kumacala emali enkqubo yokuqwalasela iyonke imigangatho yeSebe. Hlanganisela amagunya ebakhoki malunga nemali nemizekelo yokuthenga. Nikela izinto ezingeniswa kumgca ophakathi webhajethi, iinkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo ezixhasa iiplani eziyimigangatho nezoSebenzo zeSebe. Qwalasela kulawulookuqokelelwa kwemali yeSebe. Lawula ulawulo nokuqinisekisa iinkonzo zolawulo. Nikela iinkcukacha zemali nesebenzo ngexesha elifanelekileyo ezifuneka kwizigqibo eziyimigangatho kuyo yonke iintsebe kwaye uqwalasele inkqubo yokuqhuba phambili. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezitatimende zemali yonyaka ezibalulekileyo nokunikezelwa ngexesha elide njengoko kubekiweyo kwimigangatho esebenzayo nemfuno yomthetho. Iziphumo ezihle zokqwalaselo. Ukusabela kwimibuzo evela ku-Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA), iPalamente neeKomiti zoQwalaselo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nokuphumeza ulawulo oluhle lweshishini kwiSebe. Lawula iinkonzo zokuqhuba phambili kwexabiso. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenza yexabiso. Nikezelwa ngemali. Lawula imeko yokuchithwa kwemali. Nikeza inkxaso yemali nolawulo. Nikela iinkonzo zikawonkewonke zendawo yokusebenza. Nikela inkxaso yentlawulo yohwebo. Qhagamshela, qhoboshela ulawulo lweenkqubo.

jobs.title: Director: Communal Property Institutions
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Director to manage the registration and compliance of Communal Property Institutions in Pretoria, requiring a relevant degree and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor's Degree in Humanities / Social Science / Legal Qualification (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualification and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 5 years' relevant experience at a middle / senior managerial level in the management of various legal entities environment. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Policy development, Communal Property Association (CPA) Act, Stakeholder management, Conflict resolution and Land Reform legislation. Job related skills: Panning and organising, Policy analysis and interpretation, Report writing, Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project), Interpersonal relations, Negotiations, Project management, Presentation and Communication (verbal and written. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Register Communal Property Institutions (CPI) (Entities). Review/manage the screening of the submissions for compliance. Approve compliant applications. Issue the registration certificate. Ensure the update of the Communal Property Association (CPA) register. Develop CPI policy, procedures, systems and guidelines. Engage with different stakeholders (CPAs, other Government Departments, Municipalities, Community-based organisations, etc.) to identify policy, legislation and implementation gaps. Collate, analyse and consolidate information into a policy, legislation and implementation proposals. Prepare a draft submission to the policy unit. Design internal systems, procedures and guidelines. Ensure the dissemination of new policy, procedures and legislation to stakeholders (internal and external). Provide implementation support to the Provincial Offices. Ensure that the CPA members and implementers are trained both at District and Provincial levels. Ensure that all the Director-General, Ministerial and Presidential Hotline enquiries are attended to. Develop/review the CPA Strategy. Ensure the vetting of Land Rights Management Facility (LRMF) submissions. Ensure the production of CPA annual report. Ensure collection and collation of information from provinces on the functionality of CPA’s. Submit CPA reports to the Director-General, Registrar, Deputy Minister and Minister. Establish and maintain CPA register. Ensure the registration of all CPAs in both electronic Land Administration Web (LAW) and hard copy register. Ensure update of the CPA files.
jobs.enquiries: Mr B Zulu Tel No: (012) 312 8153
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post276@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. OTHER POSTS To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Kommunal Property Institutions
af.summary: Direkteur om die registrasie en nakoming van Kommunele Eiendomsinstellings in Pretoria te bestuur, wat 'n tersaaklike graad en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring op senior vlak vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad in Geesteswetenskappe / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Regskwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) of 'n verwante equivalente kwalifikasie en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Voor-toeltingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling oorgedra word. Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op 'n middel-/bestuursvlak in die bestuur van 'n omgewing van verskeie regsentiteite. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Beleidsonwikkeling, die Wet op Kommunale Eiendomsverenigings (CPA), Belanghebbendesbestuur, Konflikoplossing en Landhervormingswetgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering, beleidsanalise en -interpretasie, verslagdoening, rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project), interpersoonlike verhoudings, onderhandelinge, projekbestuur, aanbieding en kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Registreer Kommunele Eiendomsinstellings (KEI) (Entiteite). Hersien/verbestuur die sifting van voorleggings vir nakoming. Keur toepaslike aansoeke goed. Reik die registrasiesertifikaat uit. Verseker die opdatering van die Kommunale Eiendomsvereniging (CPA)-register. Ontwikkel KEI-beleid, prosedures, stelsels en riglyne. Raadpleeg verskillende belanghebbendes (CPA's, ander Regeringsdepartemente, Munisipaliteite, Gemeenskapsgebaseerde organisasies, ens.) om leemtes in beleid, wetgewing en implementering te identifiseer. Versamel, ontleed en konsolideer inligting in voorstelle vir beleid, wetgewing en implementering. Berei 'n konsepvoorlegging vir die beleidsunit voor. Ontwerp interne stelsels, prosedures en riglyne. Verseker die verspreiding van nuwe beleid, prosedures en wetgewing aan belanghebbendes (intern en ekstern). Verskaf implementeringsteun aan die Provinsiale Kantore. Verseker dat die CPA-lede en implementeerders op beide Distrik- en Provinsiale vlak opgelei word. Verseker dat alle navrae van die Direkteur-generaal, Ministeriële en Presidensiële Hotlyn bygewoon word. Ontwikkel/herview die CPA-strategie. Verseker die ondersoek van Land Rights Management Facility (LRMF)-voorleggings. Verseker die vervaardiging van die CPA-jaarverslag. Verseker die insameling en samestelling van inligting van provinsies oor die funksionaliteit van CPA's. Dien CPA-verslae by die Direkteur-generaal, Registrateur, Onderminister en Minister in. Stig en onderhou die CPA-register. Verseker die registrasie van alle CPA's in beide die elektroniese Land Administration Web (LAW) en die register in harde kopie. Verseker die opdatering van die CPA-lêers.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Izikhungo Zempahla Eseqokiwe
zu.summary: Umqondisi ophatha ukubhalisa nokuhambisana nomthetho kwezikhungo zempahla eseqokiwe ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ezihambisana nale ndima kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlelo lokusebenza njengomphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenakunjalo: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree kwezabantu / ezenzululwazi ezihlotshaniswe nomphakathi / Isiqu sezomthetho (NQF Level 7) noma isiqu esihambisana nalokhu kanye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela (Isatifikethi sokungena ku-SMS) esithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-5 yohlelo lokusebenza oluhambisana nalendima ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi / ophakeme ekuphathweni kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhungo sezomthetho. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, uMthetho wezinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe (CPA), ukuphathwa kwabathintekayo, ukuxazulula izinkinga nomthetho wokulungisa umhlaba. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukucubungula nokuhlela, ukuhlaziya nokutolikwa kwezinqubomgomo, ukubhala imibiko, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project), ubuhlobo abantu abangabakhona, izingxoxo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlela, okuyimibhalo kanye nokuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukuzithabela ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Bhalisa izikhungo zempahla eseqokiwe (CPI) (Izikhungo). Hlola/Phatha ukucubungula okuthunyelwe ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho. Gumula izicelo ezingezona ezingaphansi komthetho. Khishwa isatifikethi sokubhalisa. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlu lwezinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe (CPA) luvuselelwa. Yenza izinqubomgomo, izinqubo, izinhlelo kanye nemihlahlandlela ye-CPI. Xhumana nabathintekayo abahlukene (izinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe, eminye iminyango kahulumeni, omasipala, izinhlangano ezisekelwe emaphakathini, njll.) ukuze kutholakale izikhala ezikhona kwezinqubomgomo, umthetho kanye nokuphoqelelwa kokusebenza. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise ulwaze lubhe emasinisini wezinqubomgomo, umthetho kanye nezinketho zokuphoqelela ukusebenza. Lungiselela ukuthunyelwa kwesicelo esiyisibonelo kwinhlangano yezinqubomgomo. Hlela izinhlelo zangaphakathi, izinqubo kanye nemihlahlandlela. Qinisekisa ukusakazwa kwezinqubomgomo ezintsha, izinqubo nomthetho kubathintekayo (bongaphakathi nangaphandle). Nikeza inkxaso yokuphoqelelwa kokusebenza kumahhovisi ezifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi amalungu nezisebenzi be-CPA begqoke ukugqoqelelwa kumazinga ezifundazwe nasemazinga emimandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo evela kwi-Director-General, ezingaba ngabantu beNkulu kanye nayo eyi-Hotline kaMongameli iphathelwe. Thuthukisa/hlaziya inqubo ye-CPA. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwakho konke okuthunyelwe ku-Land Rights Management Facility (LRMF). Qinisekisa ukukhiqizwa kwemibiko yonyaka ye-CPA. Qinisekisa ukuqoqwa nokuhlanganiswa kolwazi oluvela ezifundazweni ngokusebenza kwezinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe (CPA). Thumela imibiko ye-CPA ku-Director-General, ku-Registrar, ku-Deputy Minister nakho kwaMinistr. Misakaza futhi ulondoloze uhlu lwezinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe (CPA). Qinisekisa ukubhalisa kwazo zonke izinhlangano zempahla eseqokiwe (CPA) ngokushayeleko kunazo zonke izinhlelo zokuphathwa komhlaba kagesi (LAW) kanye ohlwini lwemibhalo eqondile. Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwamafayela e-CPA.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Iziko leePropati eZenzelekayo ngokudibana
xh.summary: Um lawuli onikezela ngolawulo lokubhalisa nokuzelelana nemithetho yeziKozo zeePropati eZenzelekayo ngokudibana ePretoria, kufuneka abe nengqondo efanelekileyo kunye nokulinganiswa kweminye emithi yeminyaka emihlanu kokusingathwa kwabaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQela le-12 kunye neDegree yeBachelor kumanzi oluntu / eZenzululo lwentlalo / Izifundo zeZomthetho (NQF Level 7) okanye isifaniso esinxulumene neso nesenikelayo kunye nesatifikethi seNyukela (iSatifikethi sokungena ngaphambi kokuba kwi-SMS) esinikelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukulinganiswa okuncinane kweminyaka emi-5 yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lophathi laphakathi / phezulu kolawulo lwemizekelo yamathumba amahlulu omthetho. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuphuhliswa kweenqlega, iCommunal Property Association (CPA) Act, ulawulo lwamalungu abathintwa nangabanye, ukuxazulula iingxabano nolwabiwo lomthetho wezolimo. Ikhono elihambelana nomsebenzi: Ulungiselelo lweenkqubo kunye nolawulo, luhlalutyo noluguqulo lweenqlega, ukubhala iingxelo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project), ubudlelwane nabantu, iinkqubo zokuxoxisana, ulawulo lwamaphulo, okunikezelwayo nokuNxibelela (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo. Ukuzimisela okuhamba.
xh.duties: Bhalisa iziKozo zeePropati eZenzelekayo ngokudibana (CPI) (Izinto). Phinda ulawule ukuhlolwa kweenkqubo zokuzelelana nemithetho. Vuma izicelo ezelelana nemithetho. Nikeze isatifikethi sobhaliso. Qinisekisa ukuhlaziywa kwesatifikethi sobhaliso se-Communal Property Association (CPA). Phuhlisa inqamba, iinkqubo, iindlela ezilawulwayo nemiqathango ye-CPI. Zibandakanye nabahlulahlukeneyo abathintwa nangabanye (CPAs, namanye amasebe oRhulumente, amaMasepala, iintlangano zoluntu, njl.) ukuze achonge amathuba olwazi, umthetho nokuqutywa kwenkqubo. Qokelela, hlalutya wenze idumbu lolwazi lubemgqonyezweni wemigqibo yolwazi lweqonga lomthetho nokuqutywa kwenkqubo. Lungiselela isicelo esingadliwayo soku singathelwa kwinndlu yeenqamba. Yila iindlela ezilawulwayo zeenkqubo zangaphakathi, iinkqubo nokuqhuba imiqathango. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa kwenqamba entsha, iinkqubo nomthetho kwabathintwa nangabanye (abangaphakathi nangaphandle). Nikeza inkxaso yokwenza inkqubo kumaziko amaphondo. Qinisekisa ukuba amalungu e-CPA kunye nabayenzayo bafundiswa kwinqanaba lesithili nasekuwohlokeni lwephondo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imibuzo ye-Director-General, yabaphathi abangamakomishinala nalawo kumthetho kaMongamana iphathelwe nayo. Phuhlisa/phinda ubuke iNdlela ka-CPA. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kweenkqubo ze-Land Rights Management Facility (LRMF). Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kongezo lwamava onyaka we-CPA. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa kwexwebhu lolwazi kumaphondo ngokusebenza kobudlelwane kuka-CPA. Thumela iingxelo ze-CPA kwi-Director-General, iRegistrar, uMongamana wokuncedisa noMongamana. Sakhela zigcine ubhaliso kwaye ulondoloze ubhaliso we-CPA. Qinisekisa ukubhalisa kwayo yonke i-CPA kwi-Land Administration Web (LAW) yezikrobha kunye nangokubhaliweyo ubhaliso. Qinisekisa ukuhlaziywa kwamafayile e-CPA.

jobs.title: Deputy Registrar of Deeds
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Deeds Registry: Mthatha Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/259 North-West Deeds Registry: Mahikeng Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/260 Western Cape Deeds Registry: Cape Town Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/261 South Gauteng Deeds Registry: Johannesburg Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/262 Limpopo Deeds Registry: Polokwane Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/263 North-West Deeds Registry: Vryburg Ref No: 3/1/1/1/2026/264
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive remuneration package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for the Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Registrar of Deeds positions at SMS Level 13 across six deeds registries in South Africa, requiring an LLB or related legal qualification and Deeds Registration Law diploma.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a B Proc (NQF Level 7) / LLB (NQF Level 7) / B Uris (NQF Level 7) / Advance Diploma: Estate and Trust Administration or related equivalent qualification (NQF Level 7) with Diploma in Deeds Registration Law and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum relevant experience of 5 years at the Middle / Senior Managerial level / Assistant Registrar of Deeds / Deeds Law Lecturer / Deputy Registrar of Deeds in property conveyance. A valid driver’s licence. Knowledge of Registration of deeds, Interpretation of Statute, Examination of Deeds, Research and information analysis, Human Resources Prescripts, Project Management Principles and Tools, Court procedures, Supply Chain Management Prescript and Financial Management. Computer skills. Communication skills. Organising skills. Problem-solving skills. Interpersonal skills. Report writing skills. Presentation skills. Policy analyses and development. Good judgement and assertive skills. Time management. Management of resources. Negotiation. Influencing skills. Appropriate courses in Management Practices.
jobs.duties: Manage the process of examination and the registration of deeds and documents. Manage examination and register deeds in compliance with Deeds Registries Act of 1937 and Titles Act of 1986 as well as common, statutory and case law and recognized practices and procedures and Chief Registrar of Deeds directives. Analyse standards of examination and draft report to Registrar. Grant hearings to Conveyancers with regard to examination matters and make rulings. Provide rural development support pertaining to the registration matters. Advise the Courts on request regarding the feasibility of the applications. Comment on Draft Bills and Chief Registrars Circulars regarding land registration and related matters. Oversee the execution process. Approve requests for late and expedited executions and for final black-booking. Oversee conveyancing problems encountered on deeds and give guidance. Oversee execution register of Conveyancers. Oversee the sorting and distribution of deeds. Oversee the workload, workflow, processes and standards and implement corrective measures to prevent and address backlogs/challenges. Manage the turnaround times for deeds to be made available from lodgement to execution. Oversee statistics, exception reports and implement corrective measures. Approve request for withdrawal of deeds. Oversee the update of procedure manual. Manage deeds training and development and library services. Manage the Practice Committee / Examiner Forum and issue circulars. Manage implementation of deeds training and examination development plan. Oversee library services.
