af.title: Onderregistrator van Aktes
af.summary: Onderregistrator van Aktes posisies op SMS Vlak 13 by ses akteregistries oor Suid-Afrika, waarvoor 'n LLB of verwante regskwalifikasie en 'n diploma in Akteregistrasiereg vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n B Proc (NQF Vlak 7) / LLB (NQF Vlak 7) / B Uris (NQF Vlak 7) / Gevorderde Diploma: Boedel en Trustadministrasie of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 7) met 'n Diploma in Akteregistrasiereg en 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Voor-toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien word. Minimum relevante ervaring van 5 jaar op Middle / Senior Bestuursvlak / Assistentregistrator van Aktes / Aktereg Dosent / Onderregistrator van Aktes in eiendomsoordrag. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van Registrasie van aktes, Interpretasie van Statute, Ondersoek van Aktes, Navorsing en inligtingontleding, Menslike Hulpbronne Voorskrifte, Projekbestuursbeginsels en -instrumente, Hofprosedures, Voorsieningskettingbestuur Voorskrif en Finansiële Bestuur. Rekenaarkundighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Organiseringsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Beleidontleding en -ontwikkeling. Goeie oordeel en selfversekerde vaardighede. Tydbestuur. Bestuur van hulpbronne. Onderhandeling. Beïnvloedingsvaardighede. Toepaslike kursusse in Bestuurspraktyke.
af.duties: Bestuur die proses van ondersoek en die registrasie van aktes en dokumente. Bestuur ondersoek en registreer aktes in ooreenstemming met die Akteregistrieswet van 1937 en die Titelswet van 1986 asook algemene, statutêre en case law en erkende praktyke en prosedures en Hoofregistrator van Aktes se richtlyne. Ontleed standaarde van ondersoek en opstel van verslag aan Registrator. Verhoor vergun aan Aktebesorgers met betrekking tot ondersoekaangeleenthede en lewer uitsprake. Verskaf landelike ontwikkelingssteun met betrekking tot registrasie-aangeleenthede. Adviseer die Howe op versoek met betrekking tot die uitvoerbaarheid van die aansoeke. Lewer kommentaar op Konsepwetsontwerpe en Hoofregistrator se Sirkulaires met betrekking tot grondregistrasie en verwante aangeleenthede. Hou toesig oor die tenuitvoerleggingsproses. Keur versoeke goed vir laat en versnelde tenuitvoerleggings en vir finale swartboeking. Hou toesig oor aktebesorgingsprobleme wat by aktes ondervind word en gee leiding. Hou toesig oor die tenuitvoerleggingsregister van Aktebesorgers. Hou toesig oor die sortering en verspreiding van aktes. Hou toesig oor die werklading, werkvloei, prosesse en standaarde en implementeer korrigerende maatreëls om agterstande/uitdagings te voorkom en aan te spreek. Bestuur die omkeertye vir aktes om beskikbaar gestel te word vanaf indiening tot tenuitvoerlegging. Hou toesig oor statistieke, uitsonderingsverslae en implementeer korrigerende maatreëls. Keur versoeke goed vir onttrekking van aktes. Hou toesig oor die bywerking van die prosedurehandleiding. Bestuur akte-opleiding en -ontwikkeling en biblioteekdienste. Bestuur die Praktykkomitee / Ondersoekerforum en uitreik sirkulaires. Bestuur implementering van akte-opleidings- en ondersoekontwikkelingsplan. Hou toesig oor biblioteekdienste.

zu.title: oSekela Mmeli Bemafa
zu.summary: Izikhundla zoSekela Mmeli Bemafa ezingeni le-SMS Level 13 kuzo zonke izikhungo eziyisithupha zemafa eNingizimu Afrika, ezidinga i-LLB noma izifundo ezihlobene nemithetho kanye nediploma yokuMiswa kwemithetho yokuBhalisa amafa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-B Proc (NQF Level 7) / LLB (NQF Level 7) / B Uris (NQF Level 7) / Advance Diploma: Estate and Trust Administration noma izifundo ezihlobene ezilinganayo (NQF Level 7) enediploma ku-Deeds Registration Law kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokubekelwa esikhundleni. Okuncane ukuziphoqa okuhlobene iminyaka eyi-5 ezingeni lomphathi ongumphakathi / omkhulu / oSekela Mmeli Bemafa / Onitshe imithetho yamafa / oSekela Mmeli Bemafa ekudlulisweni kwempahla. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ukubhaliswa kwamafa, ukuhumusha umthetho, ukuhlola amafa, ucwaningo nanalysis yemininingwane, imiyalo yezinsizakusebenza zabantu, imigaqo namathuluzi okuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi, izinqumo zinkantolo, imiyalo yokuphatha yentambo yokuhlinzeka kanye noMphatho weMali. Amakhono omthombo. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuhlela. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana nomuntu. Amakhono okubhala umbiko. Amakhono okubamba inkomfa. Ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo. Ukwehluleka okuhle kanye namakhono okuzithibela. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukuphatha izinsizakusebenza. Ukuxoxisana. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Izifundo ezifanele ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yokuhlolwa nokubhaliswa kwamafa namadokhumenti. Phatha ukuhlolwa nokubhaliswa kwamafa ngokuvumelana ne-Deeds Registries Act of 1937 kanye ne-Titles Act of 1986 kanye nomthetho ojwayelekile, omthetho kanye nomthetho wezinkantolo kanye nezinqubo eziqashelwa kanye nemiyalo yoMmeli Mmeli Bemafa Oholiwe. Hlaziya amazinga okuhlolwa ubhale umbiko kuMmeli Bemafa. Nikela izinkulungwane kubathuli bamafa ngezindaba zokuholwa uthathe izinqumo. Nikele inkxaso yentuthuko yasemaphandleni ngokuqond nezindaba zokubhaliswa. Luletha izinkantolo ngocelo ngokwenzeka kwezicelo. Phawula ngamabhili ashayiwe namasamu oMmeli Bemafa Oholiwe ngebhaliso kwethu nokuhlobene nalezindaba. Qaphela inqubo yokwenza. Vuma izicelo zokwenza ngemuva nangokushesha kanye nokubhala okokugcina okumnyama. Qaphela izinkinga zokudluliswa empahleni ezitholakala emafeniholela kakhulu ukubukeka kwamafa kanye nokulungiswa okwenziwe ukuvimbela nokuphatha isibambo/izinkinga. Phatha isikhathi esibekiwe sokuthi amafa abekhona ukusuka ekubhalisweni kuye kokwenza. Qaphela izibalo, imibiko yezimo ezingajwayelekile uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Vuma isicelo sokukhishwa kwamafa. Qaphela ukulungiswa kwesikhombisi sendlela. Phatha ukufundiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwamafa kanye nezinsiza zedolobha. Phatha iKomidi Yokusebenza / iHlelo Labaholi kanye nokukhipha amasemu. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokufundiswa nokuhlola kwamafa kanye nohlelo lokuthuthuka. Qaphela izinsiza zedolobha.

xh.title: Under-Sekreta wezaMagunya
xh.summary: Izithuba zikaUnder-Sekreta wezaMagunya kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13 kumaziko amanqamlezana emagunya ayisithandathu e-South Africa, efunisa i-LLB okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nemithetho nediploma ye-Deeds Registration Law.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona phantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 kunye ne-B Proc (NQF Level 7) / LLB (NQF Level 7) / B Uris (NQF Level 7) / Advance Diploma: Estate and Trust Administration okanye izifundo ezinjengalezo ezilinganayo (NQF Level 7) nediploma ye-Diploma in Deeds Registration Law kunye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Amava afanelekelayo okuninzi kwiminyaka engu-5 kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lababhalwe / njenga-Assistant Registrar of Deeds / njengesityhala se-Deeds Law / njengoDeputy Registrar of Deeds kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa propati. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi malunga nobhaliso lwemagunya, ukutolikwa komthetho, ukuhlolwa kwamagunya, uphando nokuhlalutya ulwazi, imiyalelo yoQoqosho lweZabantu, iinkqubo nezixhobo zoLawulo lweeProjekthi, iinkqubo zeNkundla, imiyalelo yoLawulo loQoqosho lokuQokelela nokuThengisa kunye noLawulo lweziMali. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okunxibelelana. Amandla okuqamba. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okunxibelelana nabantu. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Amandla okubonisa. Ukuhlalutya nokuqumba iinkqubo. Amandla amagugu okuphawula nokuzimisela. Ukulawula ixesha. Ukulawula izibonelelo. Ibuso. Amandla okunika inkuthazo. Iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zoLawulo.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yokuhlola nobhaliso lwamagunya namaxwebhu. Lawula ukuhlola ubhalise imagunya ngokumiselwa koMthetho we-Deeds Registries Act of 1937 noMthetho we-Titles Act of 1986 nangokwomthetho oqhelekileyo, omtatho, nekhol yamacala namagunya aqaphelekileyo nendlela yokusebenza namagunya akawonke oMthetho kwaye noMlawuli ongusihlalo wamagunya. Hlalutya imigangatho yokuhlola uze udibe ingxelo kuSekreta wamagunya. Nikela ngamava kubo abaBhalisi ngezinto ezimalunga nokuhlola uze wenze iinqophiso. Nikela ngenkxaso yophuhliso lwemimandla eyayindawo ngakumbi ngakumbi kwezinto ezimalunga nobhaliso. Celisa iinkundla ngesicelo malunga nokwenzeka kwezicelo. Phawula ngokuDityaniswa koMthetho nemiQondiso yoMlawuli ongusihlalo malunga nobhaliso womhlaba ngezinto ezingomnye. Qwalasela inkqubo yokuphumeza. Landela izicelo zokuvela kwexesha elifutshane nokuqhuba ngokukhawuleziswa kwamagunya nokwenza uphawu olugqibeleleyo lokubhuka okumnyama. Lawula iingxaki zokudluliselwa kwamagunya ezibangelwe kumagunya uze unike inkqeqheso. Qwalasela irejista yokuphumeza yabaBhalisi. Qwalasela ukulungiselela nokwahlulelana kwamagunya. Lawula umthwalo wokusebenza, ukutya kokusebenza, iinkqubo nemigangatho uze usebenzise izithintelo ezilungileyo ukuze uwenzele kwaye ulungise iingxaki/izithintelo. Lawula ixesha elithathwa kwamagunya ukuba afumanisweokusukela kuncedo lokungenisa kuye kukuphumeza. Qwalasela izibalo, iingxelo ezingezizo ezifanelekileyo uze usebenzise izithintelo ezilungileyo. Vumela izicelo zokukhutshwa kwamagunya. Lawula ukuhlaziwa kwesikhokelo seendlela. Lawula uqeqesho nokuphuhlisa amagunya kunye neenkqubo zethala leefayili. Lawula iKomiti yeKonvo / iNkundla yabaHloli uze upapasha imiqondiso. Lawula ukusebenzisa iplani yokukhuthaza uqeqesho kwaye uhlale uphuhlise ukuhlola amagunya. Qwalasela iinkqubo zeethala leefayili.

zu.title: Isekela-Mzali Wezwi Elibhalwe Emthethweni
zu.summary: Qaphela inqaba yokubhalisa kanye namaphrothesesokusebenza e-Western Cape Deeds Registry e-Cape Town, okudinga i-LLB noma iziqu ezihambisana ne-NQF Level 7.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okubi nguqozo: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-B Proc (NQF Level 7) / LLB (NQF Level 7) / B Uris (NQF Level 7) / Advance Diploma: Estate and Trust Administration (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezingamalunganelo ahlobene (NQF Level 7) kanye ne-Diploma in Deeds Registration Law kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ukuze ube nolwazi oluncane weminyaka engu-5 ezingeni lomphathi wesikhathi esiphakathi / esiphakeme / Isikali-Mzali Wezwi Elibhalwe Emthethweni / Onfundisa umthetho wezwi / Isibopho somphathi wezwi kusetshenziswa abashicileli besinto. Ilayisense yokuqasha elisebenzayo. Ulwazi ngemikhakha: Ukubhaliswa kwamagama, ukuhumusha kwemithetho, ukuqapha izwi, ucwaningo kanye nokuqoqwa kwolwazi, iziyalezo zamabhibha labantu, imigomo nempilo yokuphatha amaphrojekthi, izinqubo zezinkantolo, imigomo yokuphatha isikweletu se-Supply Chain kanye neqoqo kwezimali. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Amakhono okuhlela izinto. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ohlotshaneni nabantu. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono yokwethula. Ukuthathwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo. Isahlulelo esihle kanye namakhono aqinile. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukuphatha izinsiza. Ukuzelela. Amakhono okunyusa ukuthinta abanye. Amakilasi ayingqikithi ezinhlelweni zokuphatha.
zu.duties: Bheke inqaba yokubhalisa. Bheke ukukhabela, iphurothesesi yokuhamba kwezinto kanye nezindinganiso bese usefaka izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikeza imiyalo ekumeni nasekususeni kwesithiyo. Bheke inxulumano kanye nokupha imiyalo kubathengi. Bheke inqaba yolwazi kanye namasevisi e-DOTS. Phatha izikhathi zokuphendula ekunikezweni kolwazi kubathengi. Phatha isistimu yokulandela amagama. Phatha izikhathi zokuphendula kumibuzo ye-DOTS, phatha imibuzo kahulumeni / yomnyango bese uhlanganisa umbiko. Vumela uhlelo lokwenza kwesibuko sabadlayo. Bheke ukugqamwa kombiko wocwaningo lokuqabakwa kwabathengi. Vumela iplani yokuthuthukiswa kokuqedwa kwesibuko. Bheke ukugcinwa kwamagama / amadokhumenti endaweni ethile. Gcina amagama kanye namadokhumenti endaweni ethile. Thumela amagama abhalisiwe namadokhumenti. Hlola ukubhaliswa kwedathabhesi yamagama. Hlola idathabhesi yamagama abhalisiwe. Buyela idathabhesi yamapulezinsi. Phatha izikhathi nezindinganiso zokubhaliswa kwamagama e-Deeds Registration System (DRS). Phatha amasevisi okusekela kumasistimu okubhaliswa kwamagama. Nikeza ukusekela amasistimu okubhaliswa kwamagama. Xhumana nenhloko kaMthethisi ngemikhakha yokubhalisa. Bheke ukusekelwa kwedeski ethinta izinto ezenzakalayo. Faka isandla ekuthuthukisweni okuseduze nasemthethweni okuphuma ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Nikeza ukusekela imigomo yokuthuthukiswa okuseduze nasemthethweni. Thatha inxaxheba kumakomidi ehlelo lesifundazwe. Nikeza imiyalo emikhakheni ethinta ukubhaliswa. Nikeza imiyalo ngokusetshenziswa komthetho wesifundazwe emikhakheni ethinta ukubhaliswa.

xh.title: Isekela-Mmili wezeSatyamentwana
xh.summary: Qwalasela candelo lokubhalisa kunye neenkqubo zokuqhuba imisebenzi kwi-Western Cape Deeds Registry eCape Town, kufuneka kubekho LLB okanye izifundo ezinxulumeneyo eziseNqanaba le-NQF 7.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezifunekayo: Abafakeli kufuneka babe ne-Satifikethi yeBhedi yama-12 kunye ne-B Proc (NQF Level 7) / LLB (NQF Level 7) / B Uris (NQF Level 7) / Advance Diploma: Estate and Trust Administration (NQF Level 7) okanye izifundo ezingumphathelelwano ezinxulumeneyo (NQF Level 7) ezinceda ngeDiploma kwiDeeds Registration Law kunye nesatifikethi se-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esinikezwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufuneka kube nokungenwa kweminye eli-5 idlulileyo ngomgangatho ophakathi / ophezulu womlawuli / Nceda-Mmili wezeSatyamentwana / Onyathi weDeeds Law / Isekela-Mmili wezeSatyamentwana kwindlela yokudlulisa izinto. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi malunga: Ukubhalisa kwezatya, Inkcazelo yeMithetho, Ukuqwalasela kwezatya, Uphononongo kunye nokwahlula ulwazi, iMigaqo yokuQonda abaSebenzi, iMigaqo kunye nezixhobo zoLawulo lweeProjekthi, iinkqubo zeNkundla, iMigaqo yoQwalaselo loMthetho weeKhaya kunye noQwalaselo lweMali. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okunxibelelana. Amandla okuqamba. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okusebenza nabantu. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Amandla okubonelela. Ukuhlola nokuphuhlisa iingqongo-mthetho. Isigqibo esilungileyo namandla okuzimisela. Ukuqonda ixesha. Ulawulo lwezinto. Iinkcxaxheba. Amandla okuphazamisa. Iimfundo ezifanelekileyo kuQhinga loLawulo.
xh.duties: Qwalasela candelo lokubhalisa. Qwalasela umthwalo wemisebenzi, iinkqubo zokuqhuba imisebenzi namazinga uze ufakamise izigqibo zolungiso. Nikela ingqiqiselo malunga nokubhala nokususa iinterdict. Qwalasela ibhayografi kwaye unike ingqiqiselo abaxhasi. Qwalasela candelo lolwazi kunye neenkonzo ze-DOTS. Lawula iinkqubo zemithetho yokuqukumbela ixesha kule nkonzo yokunikela ulwazi kubaxhasi. Lawula inkqubo yokuqwalasela izatya. Lawula iinkqubo zemithetho yokuqukumbela ixesha kwimibuzo ye-DOTS, lawula iimviziyi zikaMongameli / zesebe uze uqulunke ingxelo. Vuma isicwangciso senzo sebhuku yokuphawula iingxelo zokwaneliseka kwabaxhasi. Qwalasela isicwangciso sokuphucula iinkonzo. Qwalasela ukugcina izatya / amaxwebhu endaweni egcinwayo. Gcina izatya namaxwebhu endaweni egcinwayo. Yiza izatya namaxwebhu ezibhalisiweyo. Gcina ukuvuselelwa kwedatabase yokubhalisa izatya. Vuselela irejista yomhlaba. Lawula iinkqubo zemithetho yokuqukumbela ixesha namazinga okubhala ulwazi lwezatya kwi-Deeds Registration System (DRS). Lawula iinkonzo zexhaso kwiinkqubo zokubhalisa izatya. Nikela inkxaso kwiinkqubo zokubhalisa izatya. Qhagamshelana ne-ofisi yoMmili oMkhulu malunga neengxaki zekqubo. Qwalasela inkxaso yedesiki yosizo ekwayo kwinkqubo. Nikela iinkonzo zexhaso zokubhalisa izatya zophuhliso lwemaphandla ngenkqubo yokulungisa umhlaba. Nikela inkxaso kuqeqesho lophuhliso lwemaphandla ngenkqubo yokulungisa umhlaba. Thatha inxaxheba koomabandla obuqonda bezemiphakathi. Nikela ingcebiso malunga nezinto ezinxulumene nokubhalisa. Nikela ingcebiso malanga nokusebenzisa umthetho wephondo ekubhaliseni.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Financial Management in Pretoria, requiring a diploma or degree in finance and three years of management experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a Degree or National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of three (3) years’ experience at a junior / middle management level in financial management. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations, and related financial legislation. Government budgeting processes and Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Financial management principles, practices, and procedures. Management accounting and financial reporting standards. Supply Chain Management (SCM) policies, procedures, and regulations. Asset and inventory management principles. Risk management and internal control frameworks. Audit processes and governance requirements. Project financial management and expenditure control. Revenue and cash flow management. Strategic planning and performance management. Public Service legislative and regulatory framework. Corporate governance principles and best practices. Financial systems and management information systems. Labour relations and human resource management principles. Job related skills: Strategic planning. Leadership ability. Financial management. Analytical thinking. Innovation and creativity. Planning and Organising. Problem-solving. Interpersonal relations. Human resources management. Negotiation and decision-making. Report writing. Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Communication (verbal and written). Project management. Facilitation and presentation. Training and development. Technical and administrative ability (Basic Accounting System (BAS) and Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Provide effective financial management support. Coordinate the preparation and implementation of the annual budget and operational plans. Monitor budget performance and expenditure trends against approved allocations. Ensure effective allocation and utilisation of financial resources. Provide financial advice and support to management to facilitate informed decision- making. Monitor compliance with financial policies, procedures, and applicable legislation. Provide effective financial planning, monitoring and reporting. Monitor budget implementation progress and identify all variances against approved budget. Analyse financial performance and recommend corrective actions where necessary. Prepare and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual financial management reports. Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial reports. Analyse financial performance and provide recommendations for improvement. Coordinate the preparation of annual financial statements and audit processes. Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans. Coordinate year-end financial statement preparation and audit processes. Provide effective financial management and administration. Implement and maintain appropriate financial management systems and controls. Provide support for the preparation of information on the status of financial resources as required. Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets and funding allocations. Support project managers in financial planning, forecasting, and expenditure monitoring. Ensure compliance with project funding requirements and reporting obligations. Render supply chain and other physical resources management services. Provide financial oversight and support for procurement processes. Manage the procurement of goods and services for the Directorate and Branch in accordance with applicable legislation and policies. Ensure effective use of physical resources and equipment. Monitor compliance with supply chain management policies and procedures. Monitor asset management practices and ensure proper recording, safeguarding, and accounting of assets. Ensure effective utilisation and control of physical resources and equipment. Support inventory management and asset verification processes. Render payments and expenditure management services. Oversee the processing, verification, and authorisation of payments in accordance with delegated authority and financial policies. Ensure suppliers are paid within prescribed timeframes. Review payment reconciliations and resolve outstanding payment-related issues. Monitor expenditure trends and implement measures to prevent unauthorised, irregular, fruitless, and wasteful expenditure. Ensure all payments are supported by complete and accurate documentation. Monitor and report on expenditure commitments and accruals. Ensure compliance with payment processes and financial control measures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 Or by email to Post277@Dlrrd.Gov.Za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Finansiële Bestuur in Pretoria, wat 'n diploma of graad in finansies en drie jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Graad of Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Finansiële Rekeningkunde / Bestuursrekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op 'n junior / middelbestuursvlak in finansiële bestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations, en verwante finansiële wetgewing. Regeringsbegrotingsprosesse en Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Finansiële bestuursbeginsels, -praktyke en -prosedures. Bestuursrekeningkunde en finansiële verslagdoeningsstandaarde. Supply Chain Management (SCM)-beleide, -prosedures en -regulasies. Bate- en voorraadbestuursbeginsels. Risikobestuur en interne beheerraamwerke. Ouditprosesse en goeweransvereistes. Projekfinansiële bestuur en bestuurbesteding. Inkomste en kontvloei-bestuur. Strategiese beplanning en prestasiebestuur. Openbare diens-wetgewings- en reguleringsraamwerk. Korporatiewe goeweransbeginsels en best practices. Finansiële stelsels en bestuursinligtingstelsels. Arbeidsverhoudinge en menslikehulpbronbestuursbeginsels. Werksverwante vaardighede: Strategiese beplanning. Leierskapsvermoë. Finansiële bestuur. Analitiese denke. Innovasie en kreatiwiteit. Beplanning en organisering. Probleemoplossing. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Menslikehulpbronbestuur. Onderhandeling en besluitneming. Verslagskrywing. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Projekbestuur. Fasilitering en voorlegging. Opleiding en ontwikkeling. Tegniese en administratiewe vermoë (Basic Accounting System (BAS) en Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf effektiewe finansiële bestuursondersteuning. Koördineer die voorbereiding en implementering van die jaarlikse begroting en operasionele planne. Monitor begrotingsprestasie en bestedingsneigings teenoor goedgekeurde toekenningen. Verseker effektiewe toekenning en benutting van finansiële hulpbronne. Verskaf finansiële advies en ondersteuning aan bestuur om ingeligte besluitneming te fasiliteer. Monitor nakoming van finansiële beleide, prosedures en toepaslike wetgewing. Verskaf effektiewe finansiële beplanning, monitering en verslagdoening. Monitor die vordering van begrotingsimplementering en identifiseer alle afwykings teenoor die goedgekeurde begroting. Analiseer finansiële prestasie en beveel korrigerende maatreëls aan waar nodig. Berei en bestuur maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële bestuursverslae voor. Verseker die akkuraatheid, volledigheid en tydigheid van finansiële verslae. Analiseer finansiële prestasie en verskaf aanbevelings vir verbetering. Koördineer die voorbereiding van jaarlikse finansiële state en ouditprosesse. Monitor die implementering van ouditaanbevelings en aksieplanne. Koördineer die voorbereiding van jaarstate en ouditprosesse. Verskaf effektiewe finansiële bestuur en administrasie. Implementeer en handhaaf toepaslike finansiële bestuurstelsels en -beheer. Verskaf ondersteuning vir die voorbereiding van inligting oor die status van finansiële hulpbronne soos vereis. Monitor projekbesteding teenoor goedgekeurde begrotings en befondsingstoekenning. Ondersteun projekbestuurders in finansiële beplanning, vooruitskatting en bestedingsmonitering. Verseker nakoming van projekbefondsingsvereistes en verslagdoeningsverpligtinge. Lewer voorsieningsketting- en ander fisiese hulpbronbestuursdienste. Verskaf finansiële toesig en ondersteuning vir verkrygingsprosesse. Bestuur die verkryging van goedere en dienste vir die Direktoraat en Tak in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en beleide. Verseker effektiewe gebruik van fisiese hulpbronne en toerusting. Monitor nakoming van voorsieningskettingbestuursbeleide en -prosedures. Monitor batebestuurspraktyke en verseker behoorlike optekening, beveiliging en rekeningkunde van bates. Verseker effektiewe benutting en beheer van fisiese hulpbronne en toerusting. Ondersteun voorraadbestuur en bateverifikasieprosesse. Lewer betalings- en bestuursdienste vir besteding. Hou toesig oor die verwerking, verifikasie en magtiging van betalings in ooreenstemming met gedelegeerde gesag en finansiële beleide. Verseker dat verskaffers binne voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke betaal word. Hersien betalingverbonde en los uitstaande betalingverwante kwessies op. Monitor bestedingsneigings en implementeer maatreëls om ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende besteding te voorkom. Verseker dat alle betalings deur volledige en akkurate dokumentasie gesteun word. Monitor en rapporteer oor bestedingsverpligtinge en toekomsrekeninge. Verseker nakoming van betalingsprosesse en finansiële beheermaatreëls.

zu.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwezezimali
zu.summary: Isekela Mongameli Wokuphathwa Kwezezimali ePretoria, ofuna i-diploma noma i-degree kwezezimali kanye neminyaka emithathu yobuchule bokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo esingenani: Abafakelayo kumele babe nesi-Certificate se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree noma i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwi-Financial Accounting / Management Accounting / Financial Management noma iziqu ezingako. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yobuchule ezingeni lokuphatha elisezansi / eliphakathi ekuphathweni kwezezimali. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-Treasury Regulations, kanye nomthetho wezezimali ohlobene nayo. Inqubo yokubhajetha kahulumeni kanye ne-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Izimiso, izinqubo, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izimali. Amaphuzu okubalwa kokuphathwa kwezezimali namazinga okubika ngokwezezimali. Izinqubomgomo, izinqubo, kanye nomthetho we-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Izimiso zokuphathwa kwamasethi nokutholakala kwezinto. Imithetho yokuphathwa kengozi nezimiso zokulawula ngaphakathi. Inqubo yokuhlola kanye nezidingo zokubuswa. Ukuphathwa kwezezimali kwamaphrojekthi kanye nokulawula ukusebenzisa imali. Ukuphathwa kwemali engenayo nakwe-mali ephumayo. Ukulekelela i-strategic planning kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Umthetho nomthetho ophathekayo wesevisi kahulumeni. Izimiso zokubuswa kwenkampani kanye nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu. Amasistimu wezezimali kanye namasistimu olwazi lokuphatha. Ubudlelwano basebenzi kanye nezimiso zokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukulekelela i-strategic planning. Ikhono lokuhola. Ukuphathwa kwezezimali. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukubasise nokudala okusha. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuxoxisana nokwenza izinqumo. Ukubhala izibalo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-Microsoft Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-Project). Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuhola nokwethula. Ukuqeqesha nokuqhuba ekuthuthukisweni. Ikhono lobuchule nengxenye yengqondo (i-Basic Accounting System (BAS) kanye ne-Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Ukuzithoba ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Nika ukusekelwa okusebenzayo ekuphathweni kwezezimali. Hlelanganisana ukulungiswa nokusetshenziswa kwebhajethi yonyaka kanye namaqhubeza-ajo ebusuku. Landa ukusebenza kwebhajethi kanye nezindlela zokusebenzisa imali uma kuqhathaniswa nezabelo ezivunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukwabelwa okusebenzayo nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zezezimali. Nikeza izeluleko zezezimali nokusekelwa ekuphathweni ukukhuthaza ukwenza izinqumo ezinolwazi. Landa ukuthobela izinqubomgomo zezezimali, izinqubo, kanye nomthetho ohlobene naye. Nikeza ukulekelela okusebenzayo kwezezimali, ukulanda nokubika. Landa inqubo yokusebenza ibhajethi bese uzithola zonke izinguquko ezenzeke kule bhajethi evunyelwe. Hlaziya ukusebenza kwezezimali utsulele izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Lungisa bese uphatha izibalo zokuphathwa kwezezimali nyangazonke, nyangeni, kanye nezinyanga zonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi ngokweqiniso, ukugcwaliseka, kanye nokusheshayo kwezibalo zezezimali. Hlaziya ukusebenza kwezezimali bese unikeza izinkomba zokuthuthukisa. Hlelanganisana ukulungiswa kwesibalo sonyaka wezezimali kanye nokuqhuba ukuhlola. Landa ukusebenza kwezinkomba zokuqhuba ukuhlolo kanye neqhubeza-ajo. Hlelanganiswa ukulungiswa kwezibalo zokugcina unyaka kanye nokuqhuba ukuhlola. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezezimali nokuphathwa okusebenzayo. Setha bese ulondoloza izimiso zokuphatha izimali kanye nolawulo. Yenza isikhathi sokulungiswa kolwazi ngohlelo lwemali njengoba kudingeka. Landa ukusebenziswa imali yephrojekthi uma kuqhathaniswa nezabelo zebhajethi nemali evunyelwe. Sekela abaphathi bamaphrojekthi ekuhleleni imali, ekuqageleni, nasekulandeni ukusebenziswa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izidingo zokubhajetha iphrojekthi kanye nezibopho zokubika. Yenze i-supply chain kanye nezinye izinsiza eziyizinto eziphathwayo. Nikeza ukugadwa kwezezimali nokusekelwa ekwenzeni izinkambu zokuthenga. Phatha ukuthenga izimpahla kanye namasevisi i-Directorate ne-Branch ngokuvumelana nomthetho ohlobene naye kanye nezinqubomgomo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemithombo eziyizinto kanye nezimoto. Landa ukuthobela izinqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-supply chain management. Landa izindlela zokuphathwa kwamasethi bese uqinisekisa ukushiywa kwesikhathi esihle, ukugada, kanye nokubalwa kwamasethi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nolawulo lwemithombo eziyizinto nezimoto. Sekela ukuphathwa kokutholakala kwezinto kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamasethi. Yenze izinkokhelo kanye namasevisi okuphathwa kokusebenzisa imali. Qapha ukulungiswa, ukuqinisekiswa, kanye nemvume yamakhonseshi ezezimali ngokuvumelana negunya elinikiwe kanye nezinqubomgomo. Qinizekisa ukuthi abakhiye bahathwa ngosuku olumisiwe. Cabangisisa izibalo sokuhambisana kwamakhonsesho bese uxazula izinkinga ezingasenhlangothi zokukhokha. Landa izindlela zokusebenzisa imali bese usetha izinyathelo zokuqamba imali ezingavunyelwe, engajwayelekile, ezingamnandi, kanye nokuqothula imali. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amakhonsesho axhaswe ukucacisa ngokugcwele nokubhala ngokweqiniso. Landa bese ubika ngamabhalwe amakhonsesho nakwezimali ezigciniweyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izinqubo zamakhonsesho kanye nezinyathelo zolawulo lwezezimali.

xh.title: Isebe LeliPhondo: Ukulawula Kwezimali
xh.summary: Isebe elingumyaleli welixa lokulawula izimali ePretoria, lifuna idiploma okanye iziqondo kwezimali kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafakelwayo kufuneken'ibe nesatifikethi seGredi 12 kunye neDegree okanye iDiploma yaseLizwe (NQF Level 6) kwi-Akhawunti yeZimali / Ukulawula kwe-Akhawunti yeZimali / Ukulawula Kwezimali okanye iziqondo ezithrelated ezilinganayo. Ukube ngaphezulu kweminyaka emithatu (3) yamava kwinqanaba lokulawula elinganeminyaka engama-junior / middle kwinxulumene nokulawula izimali. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egunyaziweyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesebe: UMthetho woLawulo lweZimali ekuLiwini (PFMA). Iimigaqo zeTreasury, kunye nomthetho wezimali ongenele. Iinkqubo zorhwebo karhulumente kunye ne-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Iimpawu, iinkqubo, kunye nemigaqo yokulawula izimali. Izipimo kunye neendlela zokulawula kwezimali. Iinkqubo zokubika ngemali kunye neendlela ezichaziweyo. Iinkqubo kunye nemigaqo ye-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Iimpawu zokulawula izithwembu nokuhamba kwezinto. Iindonga zokulawula iingozi kunye nezakhiwo zolawulo lwangaphakathi. Iinkqubo zovavayo kunye neemfuno zorhwebwano. Ukulawula imali yamaphulo kunye nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali. Ukulawula inzuzo kunye nokuhamba kwe-cash. Ukucinga ngokwenza iplani eqhubekayo phambili kunye nokulawula inkqubo. Inkqubo yomthetho kunye nokuqatshelwa kweenkqubo karhulumente. Iimpawu zokuzinika ngokwenza urhwebo karhulumente kunye neendlela ezilungileyo. Iinkqubo zokubika ngemali kunye neendlela ezidinga ulwazi lokulawula. Iimpawu zobudlelwane bomsebenzi kunye neendlela zokulawula abasebenzi. Amandla okucinga ngokwenza iplani eqhubekayo phambili. Amandla okuba ngumkhokeli. Ukulawula izimali. Ukucinga ngokuphonononga. Inovathi kunye nokudala izinto. Ukwenza iplani ekulungiseleleni. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukulawula abantu. Ukuthengisa kunye nokuthatha isigqibo. Ukubhaliweyo ngokwenziwa kweenkqubo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project). Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi nangokubhaliweyo). Ukulawula amaphulo. Ukwenza inkqubo ihamba phambili kunye nokuseta iinkqubo. Ukuziphathisa kunye nokubakhokhela. Amandla okwenza izinto ngokwenza iinkqubo (Basic Accounting System (BAS) kunye ne-Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yonkqubo yokulawula izimali. Lungelanisa ukulungiselela nokusebenzisa isibali somyaka kunye neenkqubo. Hlola ukusebenza kwebhajethi kunye nendlela yokuchitha imali ngokumelene nokuqatshelwa okugunyaziweyo. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa okusebenzayo nokusebenzisa imali. Nika ingcebiso ngenkxaso ezimali kubaphathi ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha isigqibo. Hlola ukumelana kweenkqubo ezimali, imigaqo, kunye nomthetho osebenzayo. Nika inkqubo esebenzayo yokucinga, ukuhlola nokubika ngezimali. Hlola inkqubo yokusebenzisa ibhajethi uze uqaphele onke amahluko ngokumelene nebhajethi egunyaziweyo. Phonononga ukusebenza kwezimali uze ucele ukwenziwa kolungiselelo apho kufuneka khona. Lukiselele ukulawula okwenziwayo nyanga zonke, nkqamela kunye neminyaka yonke kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo, ukugqibelela, kunye nokuqhuba ngexesha ngokubikiweyo. Phonononga ukusebenza kwezimali uze unike iingcebiso zokuphucula. Lungelanisa ukulungiselela iinkqubo zonyaka zezimali kunye nokuvinjwa kwazo. Hlola ukusebenzisa iingcebiso zovavayo kunye neenkqubo zenkqubo. Lungelanisa ukulungiselela iinkqubo zonyaka zezimali zokubhaliweyo kunye nokuvinjwa kwayo. Nika inkxaso esebenzayo kwiinkqubo zokulawula izimali. Sebenzisa ukulawula iinkqubo ezimali ezifanelekileyo. Nika inkxabo ngokulungiselela ulwazi ngemo yemali ngokufunwa. Hlola ukuchithwa kwemali yamaphulo ngokumelene nokuqatshelwa okugunyaziweyo. Nika inkxaso kubaphathi bamaphulo ngokucinga, ukuqikelela kunye nokuhlela ukuchithwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukumelana neenkqubo ezimali zokuqatshelwa okugunyaziweyo. Nika iinkonzo zokuqatshelwa kwe-supply chain ezinye iinkonzo ezimali. Nika ulawulo ezimali kunye nenkxaso kwiinkqubo zokuqatshela. Lawula ukuthengwa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kunye neenkonzo ezahlukeneyo ukuze zisebenze ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinto zomzimba. Hlola ukumelana nemigaqo neenkqubo zokuqatshelwa kwezinto. Hlola iinkqubo zokulawula izinto ukuqinisekisa ukubhalwa kakuhle, ukugcinwa kakuhle, kunye nokubala kakuhle kwezinto. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nokulawula izinto zomzimba. Nika inkxaso kwiinkqubo zokulawula izinto ezikwi-akhawunti. Hlola inkqubo yemali kunye nokulawula ukuchithwa kwemali. Lawula ukucutshungwa, ukuqinisekiswa, kunye negunya lokuhlawulela imali. Qinisekisa ukuba nabathengisi bahlawulelwa ngexesha. Cinga ngeengxaki ezahlukileyo zokuhlawulela imali. Hlola ukuchithwa kwemali uze usebenzise iindlela ezahlukileyo zokuthintela ukuchithwa okungalunganga, okungalunga, okungalungelelananga kunye nokuchithwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo zokuhlawulela zikho zonke iinkqubo ezifunekayo. Hlola nokubika ukuchithwa kwemali kunye nokuqokelelwa kwayo. Qinisekisa ukumelana neenkqubo zokuhlawulela kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwezimali.

jobs.title: Chief Network Controller
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Chief Network Controller position in Polokwane requiring a National Diploma in IT and two years of experience, paying R413,001 per annum at Level 8.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Computer Sciences / Information Technology or related equivalent qualifications (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 2 years relevant experience in Information Technology (IT) Support. Experience with hardware and software. Experience in network support. Experience in IT technical support. Appropriate network management experience. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Technical aspects of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) goods and services. Information Technology Acts and Policies. Government ICT systems. Understanding management of information and the formal reporting system. Internal systems change control. Project management principles and tools. Job related skills: Planning and Organising. Communication (verbal and written). Advanced computer literacy. Project management. Interpersonal relations. The ability to work efficiently and effectively at all times.
jobs.duties: Provide IT user support to clients (office). Resolve IT support calls, queries or issues as they arise. Log IT support calls on Information Technology Service Management (ITSM). Render IT security. Ensure a secure environment by installation and uploading antivirus software. Ensure that users log on to the workstation using passwords. Install and update Anti-virus software to all workstations. Identify IT requirements. Advise clients on IT equipment procurement. Inspect all the switches and network points. Ensure that all ICT related work is done according to agreed standard and quality. Verify the warranty of ICT equipment before allocation. Maintain IT applications. Ensure that all applications are up and running daily. Uninstall unwanted applications on the workstation. Provide server management services. Monitor access to server rooms. Maintain inventory of all server room related equipment. Monitor Local Area Network (LAN) performance and report any anomalies. Maintain networks and hardware. Install and troubleshoot hardware and software. Assist with planning, design, implementation, and maintenance of LAN infrastructure.
jobs.enquiries: Mr KE Senosha Tel No: (015) 495 1904
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 61 Biccard street, Polokwane, 0700 or by email to Post267@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofnetwerkbeheerder
af.summary: Hoofnetwerkbeheerder-pos in Polokwane wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en twee jaar se ervaring vereis, wat R413,001 per jaar op Vlak 8 betaal.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Diploma in Rekenaarwetenskappe / Inligtingstegnologie of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasies (NQF Vlak 6). Minimum van 2 jaar relevante ervaring in Inligtingstegnologie (IT)-ondersteuning. Ervaring met hardeware en sagteware. Ervaring in netwerkondersteuning. Ervaring in IT-tegniese ondersteuning. Toepaslike netwerkbestuurservaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Tegniese aspekte van Inligting- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IKT)-goedere en -dienste. Inligtingstegnologie-wette en -beleid. Regering IKT-stelsels. Begrip van bestuur van inligting en die formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Interne stelselsveranderingsbeheer. Projekbestuursbeginsels en -nutsprogramme. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organiserend. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid. Projekbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Die vermoë om te alle tye doeltreffend en effektief te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf IT-gebruikerondersteuning aan kliënte (kantoor). Los IT-ondersteuningsoproepe, navrae of kwessies op soos wat hulle ontstaan. Log IT-ondersteuningsoproepe op Inligtingstegnologie-diensbestuur (ITSM). Lewer IT-sekuriteit. Verseker 'n veilige omgewing deur antivirus-sagteware te installeer en op te laai. Verseker dat gebruikers met wagwoorde by die werkstasie aanmeld. Installeer en dateer antivirus-sagteware op alle werkstasies op. Identifiseer IT-vereistes. Adviseer kliënte oor IT-toerusting-aankope. Inspekteer al die skakelaars en netwerkpunte. Verseker dat alle IKT-verwante werk volgens ooreengekome standaard en gehalte gedoen word. Verifieer die waarborg van IKT-toerusting voor toekenning. Onderhou IT-toepassings. Verseker dat alle toepassings daagliks aan die gang is en werk. Deïnstalleer ongewenste toepassings op die werkstasie. Verskaf bedienerbestuursdienste. Monitor toegang tot bedienerkamers. Onderhou inventaris van alle bedienerkamer-verwante toerusting. Monitor Local Area Network (LAN)-prestasie en rapporteer enige anomalieë. Onderhou netwerke en hardeware. Installeer en los hardeware- en sagtewareprobleme op. Help met beplanning, ontwerp, implementering en onderhoud van LAN-infrastruktuur.

zu.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu Woxhumano
zu.summary: Isikhundla somLawuli Omkhulu Woxhumano ePolokwane esifuna i-Diploma Yezwe ku-IT neminyaka emibili yamava, kuhlinzekwa ngoR413,001 ngonyaka ngizinga I-8.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 ne-Diploma Yezwe kwi-Computer Sciences / Information Technology noma iziqu ezihambisanayo ezilinganayo (NQF Level 6). Ubumfihlo bokuba nobekho emuva kweminyaka engu-2 yamava ahambelanayo kusiza nge-Information Technology (IT). Ukuhlala ngesikhathi esihle kwezezimali kubuye kubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwamava akho. Iminyaka emibili yamava ahambelanayo kusiza nge-IT Support. Amava ngamahadiwehhoki nobuhlakani bekhompyutha. Amava e-IT technical support. Amava ahambisanayo e-network management. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhambisana nomsebenzi: Izici zobuchwepheshe zezinto nezinsizakalo ze-Information and Communications Technology (ICT). Izilinganiso nezinkomba ze-Information Technology Acts. Izimiso ze-Government ICT systems. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kolwazi kanye nesimiso sokubika esisemthethweni. Ukushintsha ukulawulwa kwezimiso zangaphakathi. Izimiso nezinsizakalo zoMsebenzi wePulosent. Amakhono ahambisanana nomsebenzi: Ukubeka ihlelo nokuHlela. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangesibhali). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngobuchwepheshe. Imfundo yokusebenza kabanzi nabanye. Ikhono lokusebenza ngcono nangempumelelo noma kunini.
zu.duties: Nikeza abathengi ngezinsiza ze-IT (ofisi). Susa izinkinga, imibuzo noma izinkinga ezingenayo ngokwesiza nge-IT ngokuya kwenzeka. Bhalisa izinsiza ngokusebenzisa i-ITSM (Information Technology Service Management). Nikeza ngezinsiza ze-IT. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa konke okufanelekile ukugcina ulwazi ku-anti-virus. Hlinzeka ngohlelo lokuzivikela komuntu ngamunye ngokungena ohlelweni. Susa ohlelo lwamadivayisi nanoma yikuphi okungalungile ohlelweni. Fakela i-anti-virus kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcine ukutholakala kolwazi ngokushintshana phakathi nokusebenzisa imikhiqizo ekhona. Bhekisisa amaswithisi namaphoyinti e-network ngokuzijwayeza. Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi ngcono we-LAN ohlelweni ngokushintshana kwemisebenzi. Hlola ukuthi ake kwenzeke imisebenzi yokunquma ukuphathwa komsebenzi ngokususwa kwamaphutha nangokuhlinzekwa kokutholakala kokulungiselelwa. Hlola izinqobo ezisetshenziswa ku-IT kuphela. Bhalisa nokugcina imisebenzi yezinto ezenza imisebenzi yamaphoyinti. Gcina ukuqhathaniswa kolwazi nokusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo. Hlola izinsizakalo zomsebenzi ophakathi kwabakhulu nabagcina imali. Bhalisa ukulawulwa kokuhamba kwemisebenzi ngendlela efanayo. Gcina amaphoyinti wokuqinisekisa imali yesikhathi. Hlola ukusebenza kahle kwesimiso se-LAN nezinsizakalo zokusungula amaphoyinti amasha. Bhalisa imisebenzi eminingi engenayo izimpawu ze-LAN. Gcina imali namaphoyinti ohlelo. Faka izinto ezintsha ohlelweni lwamaphoyinti alingekho emthethweni. Hlola ukuhamba kwemisebenzi yamaphoyinti amakhulu nangokuthoma, lapho kubalulekile khona, kanye nokuhlela imisebenzi yamaphoyinti amakhulu.

xh.title: Isikhokelo esiNtloko seNethiwekhi
xh.summary: Isikhundla sika Isikhokelo esiNtloko seNethiwekhi e Polokwane sifuna i National Diploma kwi IT kunye neminyaka emibini yamava, sihlawula nge R413,001 ngonyaka kwinqanaba Level 8.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno eziphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ne Grade 12 Certificate kunye ne National Diploma kwi Computer Sciences / Information Technology okwezifundo ezisisindulwa eziyimngcipheko (NQF Level 6). Okanye iminyaka engu 2 yamava ahambelanayo kwi Information Technology (IT) Support. Amandla kwi hardware nakwi software. Amandla kwi network support. Amandla kwi IT technical support. Amava afaneleyo ekulawulweni i network. Ilayisensi yomshayeli esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Iimpawu zobuchwepheshe ze Information and Communications Technology (ICT) izinto neenkonzo. Iinkqubo ze Information Technology Acts kwi Policies. Iinkqubo ze Government ICT systems. Kuqonda ukulawula ulwazi nendlela ezenziwa ngayo iinkxaso ezisemthethweni. Ulawulo lokutshintsha iinkqubo zangaphakathi. Iimigaqo neezixhobo zokulawula iiprojekthi. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuqamba kwaye uhambelanise. Unxibelelwano (olwenziwa ngomlomo nokubhalwe). Ukubakhaya nakwikhompyutha kwakangethamsanqa. Ukulawula iiprojekthi. Iziqukopha zabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nanjalo ngexesha lonke.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yomsebenzisi we IT kumaxhoba (ofisi). Susa iinkxaso ze IT, iimibuzo okwiingxaki ezivela njengoko zibakho. Bhala iinkxaso ze IT kwi Information Technology Service Management (ITSM). Yenza i IT security. Qinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo ngokufakela nokulayisha isoftware ye antivirus. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzisi bangena kwi workstation usebenzisa amagama agqithisayo. Faka uhlaziye isoftware ye Anti-virus kuzo zonke i workstation. Chaza iimfuno ze IT. Celisa abaxhoba ngokuthenga izixhobo ze IT. Linganisa zonke i switch kunye neendawo ze network. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi ehambelana ne ICT yenziwa ngokwemilinganiselo nengxoxwe ngayo nangobuninzi bomgangatho. Qinisekisa isigqibo se ICT equipment ngaphambi kokabelana. Gcina izicelo ze IT. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke izicelo ziyasebenza zithi ziphila qho mihla le. Sukususa izicelo ezingafunekiyo kwi workstation. Zenza iinkonzo zokulawula iseva. Qaphela ukungena kwiilagi zeseva. Gcina uluhlu lwazo zonke izixhobo ezihambelana nelagi yeseva. Qaphela ukusebenza kwe Local Area Network (LAN) kwaye wenze ingxelo nantiphi na inkxakaxaka. Gcina i network kunye ne hardware. Faka kwaye uxilise i hardware nakwi software. Nceda ngokuqamba, ngokuyila, ngokuphumeza, nasekugcineni i LAN infrastructure.

jobs.title: Principal Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: The Department of Land Reform and Rural Development seeks a Principal Cadastral Officer in Cape Town to capture and maintain cadastral survey data, requiring an NQF Level 5 geomatics qualification and six years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in a geomatics or cadastral survey environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership. Creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management. Negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of for proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principles and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amended, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.

af.title: Prinsipe Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development soek 'n Prinsipe Kadastrale Beampte in Cape Town om kadastrale opmetingsdata vas te lê en te onderhou, met 'n NQF Level 5-kwalifikasie in geomatics en ses jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of 'n Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5) hê. Minimum van 6 jaar se geomatics-ervaring na kwalifikasie in 'n geomatics- of kadastrale opmetingsomgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geografiese Inligtingstelselsagteware en -grondbeginsels. Kennis van die Surveyor-General se Kantoor se Standaardbedryfsprosedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opmetings. Werksverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandeling.
af.duties: Vas lê, onderhou en werk alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vas lê alfa-en-numeriese inligting vanuit nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) en onderneem wiskundige konsekwentheidstoetse en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landpersele. Werk kadastrale opmetingsdatabasisse by deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfanumeriese bewaarplek te handhaaf. Vas lê en verifieer eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente. Attend aan ingewikkelde onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit op wettige opdrag. Trek af, kanselleer en ondeken kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpersele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Attend aan komplekse wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Trek kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in 'n goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanwysings van nuut ingediende voorleggings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opmetingsrekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksietitelplanne uit. Werk die notasieblaaie by deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperceel. Doen navorsing en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting op en verskaf dit aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfotos, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) ooreenkomstig ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opmetingsinligting met betrekking tot landperceelgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Vas lê, onderhou en werk ruimtelike data met eenvoudige sowel as meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vas lê nuut ingediende dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, werk dit by en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Doen navorsing na moontlike bronne van foute indien oorvleuelings bespeur word en spreek foute gepas aan. Gebruik kadastrale opmetingsberekeningsbeginsels en ander wettige databronne om die gehalte van landperceelgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, ondekking of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (gewysigde, ondekte of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bewerkings uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerdebeelddatabasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Isikhundla Esikhulu Sezomhlaba Wonke Namasheya
zu.summary: I-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ifuna Isikhundla Esikhulu Sezomhlaba Wonke Namasheya e-Cape Town ukugcina nibuyelele imininingwane yolwazi lwe-cadastral, kudingeka iziqu ze-Geomatics ze-NQF Level 5 neminyaka eyisithuphu yamava.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Kubekho okungenani eminyakeni eyi-6 yamava kwesimo sezomhlaba emva kokuthola iziqu endaweni yezomhlaba noma yocwaningo lwe-cadastral. Ulwazi oluhlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Ulwazi mayelana ne-Geographical Information Systems Software nezisekelo zalo. Ulwazi mayelana nezinqubo nezenzo ezijwayelekile zehhovisi likaSurveyor-General. Ulwazi ngocwaningo lwe-Cadastral. Amakhono ahlotshaniswa nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukubhekabheka iqembu. Ukuqamba. Ukuqala kwabathengi nokuqonda izidingo zabo. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Bamba, zigcine futhi zibuyekeze imininingwane ye-alpha numeric yamadokhumenti we-cadastral alula kanye nalawo adidayo. Bamba ulwazi lwe-alpha kanye ne-numeric kumadokhumenti we-cadastral athunyelwe ntsha (alula nabadidayo) futhi wenze ukuhlola ukuvumelana kwemathematika kanye nokugqinisekiswa kwemininingwane yamasheya omhlaba amtsha abhekisiwe. Buyekeza izinqolobana zolwazi locwaningo lwe-cadastral ngokwengeza noma ukulungisa yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe (elula nadedidayo) ukuze kugcinwe isikhungo se-electronic alpha-numeric. Bamba futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti we-cadastral okomlando alula nabadidayo. Yilozonke izinkinga ezinzima ekugcineni amadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokwezinqubo ezimthethweni. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanswa kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokomyalo osemthethweni. Susa, khansela futhi ufake amaphawu kumadokhumenti we-cadastral anamasheya omhlaba abhalisiwe, izikweletu noma izinkalo. Yilozonke ukulungiswa okudadayo kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe nabhalisiwe. Faka yonke imidokhumenti we-cadastral evunyiwe ntsha kusilolwazi. Khuphula futhi ukhuphe amarekhodi we-cadastral. Buyisela emuva amarekhodi we-cadastral abuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi we-cadastral esimeni esihle sokusebenza. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral alula nabadidayo. Hlola izibizo zamafomu athunyelwe ntsha. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamadiagramu amalula nabadidayo kanye namapulani jikelele. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamarekhodi ocwaningo. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamapulani abantu abahlala ndawonye amalula nabadidayo. Buyekeza amakhasi okubhala ngokwengeza yonke into yomhlaba we-cadastral evunyiwe. Cwaninga futhi unikeze ulwazi we-cadastral kumakhasimba angaphakathi nangaphandle. Khuphula futhi unikeze ulwazi we-cadastral kumakhasimba. Nikeza izithombe ezibukwa phezulu, izithombe ezilungisiwe namamephu avela kuNational Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokwezivumelwano zesevisi ezisayiniwe. Yenza ucwaningo olulula ngolwazi locwaningo lwe-cadastral olumayelana namagajada omasheya omhlaba kumakhasimba nakuLand Reform. Bamba, gcina futhi buyekeze imininingwane yendawo ngedokhumenti we-cadastral alula nabadidayo. Bamba amadokhumenti athunyelwe ntsha ukuze uhlole ukuba kukhona na ukubhana kwendawo ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa. Faka imininingwane, buyekeze futhi ugcine imininingwane eqinisekisiwe yendawo we-cadastral, okuhlanganisa ukufaka nobuyekezwa kwemininingwane yokomlando. Cwaninga imithombo yamaphutha etholakala uma kubhanwa bese ulungisa amaphutha ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisisa izimiso zokubala zocwaningo lwe-cadastral kanye naneminye imithongo eqinisekisiwe yemininingwane ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yemininingwane yamagajada omasheya omhlaba. Skene yonke imidokhumenti we-cadastral ngesikhathi kuvunyelwa, kulungiswa, kufakwa amaphawu noma ikhishwa bese ukwenza ukuhlola ikhwalithi. Skene imidokhumenti we-cadastral evunyiwe ntsha. Phinda uskene yonke imidokhumenti we-cadastral ebuyekeziwe (elungisiwe, nefakwe amaphawu noma ephumisiwe). Xhumanisa izithombe ezibekiwe eziskeniwe nemininingwane ye-alpha numeric. Yenza izinto bese uhlola ikhwalithi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi izinqolobana zezithombe eziskeniwe zicocekile futhi ziqinisekisiwe.

xh.title: ISikhululu SezobuCacisa iMida wezomhlaba
xh.summary: Isebe loLungiswa koMhlaba nentuLondolozo yaseMaphandla lifuna iSikhululu SezobuCacisa iMida wezomhlaba eCape Town ukuba sibambe kwaye sigcine iidata zocaciso lomida, kwaye sifuna isiqinisekiso seGeomatics seNQF Level 5 namashumi amathandathu eminyaka yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaki-zicelo kufuneka beneseSetifikathi yebanga le-12 kunye neSetifikathi yesiZwe kwiGeomatics okanye iSetifikathi yesebe lokulinganisa umhlaba (NQF Level 5). Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-6 yamava kwiGeomatics emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso kwindawo yeGeomatics okanye yokucacisa imida. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeenkcukacha zeSoftware yoNgcinezelo lwendalo. Ulwazi ngeenqobo ezizeNqanaba zoKusebenza eziZinzileyo kunye neenqubo zeOfisi kaMlinganisi-Jikelele. Ulwazi ngokuCacisa imida. Amandla ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutywa. Ukwenza iigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Umdali. Ukwazinikelela kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngemilomo nangokubhalwa). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucazulula nokuqamba izicwangciso. UkuLawula iingxabano. Iinkcazelo ezivunyelwayo.
xh.duties: Bamba, gcina kwaye uhlaziye idatha yamanani namagama oxanduva lwemibhalo yemida elula nakhula gqitha ngenqanaba. Bamba ulwazi ngamagama namanani kwimibhalo yemida entsha ethunyelweyo (elula nentsenguxoki) kwaye uqwalasele ukungqamana kwemathematika kwaye uqinisekise idatha yecebo lomhlaba elityhiweyo elitsha. Hlaziye idathabase yocaciso lomida ngokongeza okanye ulungise imibhalo yamkelekileyo yonke (elula nentsenguxoki) ukugcina indawo yamagama namanani yabakhethiweyo. Bamba kwaye uqinisekise imibhalo yemida yasemandulo elula nentsenguxoki. Qwalasela ukugcinwa okuthe nkqo kwemibhalo yemida ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni. Yenza ukushenxisa okanye ukurhoxisa imibhalo yemida ngokwesilumkiso esemthethweni. Susa, rhoxisa kwaye uqinisekise imibhalo yemida nemiqobo yomhlaba ebhalisiweyo, iinkqinqezhi okanye iinkonzo. Qwalasela iinguqulo ezinzima kwimibhalo yemida evunyiweyo nesebhalisiweyo. Faka imibhalo yemida yonke entsha evunyiweyo kwigcino. Khupha kwaye uzinike imibhalo yemida. Phinda ufake imibhalo yemida ebuyiweyo. Lungisa kwaye ugcine imibhalo yemida kwindalo esemngciphekweni wokusebenza. Yenza ukuhlalutya kobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yemida elula nakhula gqitha ngenqanaba. Qwalasela iindawo zemibhalo ethunyelweyo entsha. Yenza ukuhlalutya kobuchwepheshe kwemiqulu nemiqulu yeenkcukacha elula nentsenguxoki. Yenza ukuhlalutya kobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo yocaciso. Yenza ukuhlalutya kobuchwepheshe kwemiqulu yamagama elula nentsenguxoki. Hlaziya ipepha lembhalo ngokongeza yonke imigca yomhlaba evunyiweyo. Phanda kwaye uzinike iinkcukacha zemida kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Buyisa kwaye uzinike iinkcukacha zemida kubathengi. Zinike iifoto zomoya, iifoto ezilungisiweyo namaphu avela kuLwazi lweZwe loMhlaba (NGI) ngokwemigaqo ebusayinide elandelayo. Yenza uphando olusetyanzwayo ngeenkcukacha zocaciso lomida ezimalana nemida yomhlaba kubathengi nakuLungiswa koMhlaba. Bamba, gcina kwaye uhlaziye idatha yesithuba ngeemibhalo yemida elula nentsenguxoki. Bamba imibhalo ethunyelweyo entsha ukuze uqiniseke ukuba akukho gqitha-tolo kwidata yesithuba ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya kwaye ugcine idataseti ethembekileyo yeencukacha zemida, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziya idatha yasemandulo. Phanda iimbangi ezinokuba ngummoya weempazamo zikwisigqithwa-gqithwa kwaye ulungise iimpazamo ngendlela efanelekileyo. Sebenzisa iingcamango zokubala ezisemthethweni nemithombo yedata ukuphucula ulwazi loxanduva lwemida. Skeni imibhalo yemida yonke xa ivunyiwe, ilungiswa, iqinisekiswa okanye irhoxiswa kwaye wenze ukugcinwa komgangatho. Skeni imibhalo yemida entsha evunyiweyo. Phinda uskeni imibhalo yemida yonke ehlaziyiweyo (elungisiweyo, eqinisekisiweyo okanye erhoxisiweyo). Qagamshela iifoto ezigcinwe kwescanner kwidata yamanani namagama. Yenza imisebenzi kwaye uqwalasele ukugcinwa komgangatho ukuqinisekisa ukuba iiscreeni zescan ezithi zingcolileyo zisecacileyo nathembekile.
