af.title: Prinsipale Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Prinsipale Kadastrale Beampte in Cape Town wat kadastrale data vaslegging en instandhouding hanteer, Vereis Graad 12 en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics met 6 jaar ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 Sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum van 6 jaar geomatics ervaring na kwalifikasie in 'n geomatics of kadastrale opname omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geographical Information Systems sagteware en grondbeginsels. Kennis van Surveyor-General's Office Standard Operating Procedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opnames. Werksverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap. Kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur. Onderhandeling.
af.duties: Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente. Vaslegging van alfa- en numeriese inligting vanuit nuut ingedien kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) en onderneem wiskundige konsekwentheidskontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landpersele. Bywerking van kadastrale opname databasisse deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek in stand te hou. Vaslegging en verifikasie van eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente. Behartiging van ingewikkelde instandhouding van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse. Uitvoer van onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente op wettige instruksie. Aftrek, kanselleer en endosseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpersele, huurkontrakte of servitute. Behartiging van komplekse wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Invoeg van alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief. Uittrek en uitreik van kadastrale rekords. Herlê van terugbesorgde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente. Kontroleer van benamings van nuut ingediende voorleggings. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van opname rekords. Uitvoer van tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titel planne. Bywerking van die notasie velle deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperceel. Navorsing en verskaffing van kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Onttrek en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfoto's, geregistreerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) ooreenkomstig ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Uitvoer van basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opname inligting met betrekking tot landperceel grense vir kliënte en Land Reform. Vaslegging, instandhouding en bywerking van ruimtelike data met eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente. Vaslegging van nuut ingediende dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Byvoeging van data, bywerking en instandhouding van 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Navorsing van moontlike bronne van foute indien oorvleuelings opgespoor word en adresseer foute toepaslik. Benut kadastrale opname berekeningsbeginsels en ander wettige bronne van data om die kwaliteit van landperceel grensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endossering of onttrekking en voer kwaliteitkontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (gewysigde, geendosseerde of onttrekte) kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Uitvoer van bedrywighede en kwaliteitkontrole om te verseker dat die geskandeerde beeld databasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Inhloko Yelesikhundla Sezomhlaba (Cadastral Officer)
zu.summary: Inhloko Yelesikhundla Sezomhlaba eCape Town ephatha ukuqoqa nokugcina imininingwane yezomhlaba, edinga isitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye nesitifiketi sebanga lezwe (National Certificate) kwi-Geomatics eminyakeni eyi-6 yamava.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavamile: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye nesitifiketi sebanga lezwe (National Certificate) kwi-Geomatics noma isitifikati Sikhulu Soxwayo (Survey Officer Certificate) (NQF Level 5). Umkhawulo eminyakeni eyi-6 yamava kwezomhlaba emva kokuthola izifundo kulesimo sezomhlaba noma esikhundleni soxwayo lwemihlaba. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngamaphrogramu we-Geographical Information Systems kanye nezesisekelo. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokusebenza emisiwe kanye namasu eNdiwa Yesikhulu Soxwayo (Surveyor-General's Office). Ulwazi ngamaxwayo omhlaba (Cadastral Surveys). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuba ngumphathi wesiqondo. Ubuciko. Ukuqaphela izidingo zabathengi kanye nokuphendula. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezixuku. Ukuxoxisana ngezinkinga.
zu.duties: Qoqa, gcina bese ubuyekeza imininingwane efanayo neyesibalo yamadokhumenti ahlukene nomhlaba abulula kanye nawo abucayi. Qoqa imininingwane efanayo neyesibalo kulawo madokhumenti amasha abhaliwe ahlobene nomhlaba (abulula noma abucayi) bese wenza ukuhlola ukungahambelani kwemibhalo kanye nokuqinisekisa imininingwane yemitha yomhlaba entsha ephakanyisiwe. Buyekeza izigciningo zemibhalo yoxwayo lomhlaba ngokwengeza noma ukulungisa lidokhumenti ngalinye elamukelekwe (elilula noma elibucayi) ukuze kugcinwe isigciningo sekhompyutha semininingwane efanayo neyesibalo. Qoqa bese uqinisekisa amadokhumenti omhlaba abulula noma abucayi abade bengasebenzi. Zibheke ekuhlinzekweni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwamadokhumenti omhlaba ngokusho kwemigqabo emisiwe yomthetho. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti omhlaba ngokusho komyalo osemthethweni. Susa, khansela bese ufaka iziqinisekiso kumadokhumenti omhlaba anemitha yomhlaba ebhalisiwe, izivumelwano zokuhlinzeka noma amalungelo okudlula. Zibheke ekuhloleni okuyinkimbinkimbi kwamadokhumenti omhlaba amukelekwe noma abhalisiwe. Faka wonke amadokhumenti amasha omhlaba amukelekwe esigciniweni. Khupha bese upha irekhodi lomhlaba. Buyeza emuva irekhodi lomhlaba libuyisiwe. Lungisa bese ugcina irekhodi lomhlaba libukeka kuhle futhi lisetshenziswa kalula. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti omhlaba abulula noma abucayi. Hlola iziqondiso zalawo madokhumenti amasha abhaliwe afakwe ngaphakathi. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamadiyagramu kanye namaphulani jikelehe abulula noma abucayi. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamarekhodi oxwayo. Yenza ukuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe kwamaphulani wezihloko ezihlukene abulula noma abucayi. Buyekeza amakhasi okubhala ngokwengeza umtha ngamunye womhlaba oqashiwe. Buza bese unikeza imininingwane yomhlaba abathengi bangaphakathi noma bangaphandle. Khupha bese unikeza imininingwane yomhlaba kubathengi. Nikeza izithombe ezithathwe esibhakabhakeni, izithombe ezilungiwe namamephu avela ku-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokusho kwezivumelwano ezibhaliwe zamazinga okusebenza. Yenza ucwaningo oluyisisekelo ngemininingwane yoxwayo lomhlaba ehlobene nemingcele yemitha yomhlaba kubathengi naku-Land Reform. Qoqa, gcina bese ubuyekeza imininingwane yesikhala ngamadokhumenti omhlaba abulula noma abucayi. Qoqa amadokhumenti amasha abhaliwe ukuze kubonakale uma kunawo ama-overlap kwesikhala ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa. Faka imininingwane, buyekeza bese ugcina uhlu lwemininingwane eqinisekisiwe yesikhala somhlaba, okuhlanganisa ukwengeza nokubuyekeza imininingwane yamandulo. Buza ngemithombo ephathelene namaphutha uma kutholakale ama-overlap bese ulungisa amaphutha ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisa izimiso zokubala zoxwayo lomhlaba kanye namanye amaphuzu angokoqobo amininingwaneni ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yemininingwane yemingcele yemitha yomhlaba. Skena wonke amadokhumenti omhlaba uma ewamukelekwe, alungiwe, eqinisekisiwe noma ekhishiwe bese wenza ukuhlola ikhwalithi. Skena amadokhumenti amasha omhlaba amukelekwe. Skena kabusha wonke amadokhumenti omhlaba abuyekeziwe (alungiwe, aqinisekisiwe noma akhishiwe). Xhumanisa izithombe ezibuyisiwe ezifakiwe nemininingwane efanayo neyesibalo. Yenza imisebenzi bese uhlola ikhwalithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izigciningo zezithombe ezibuyisiwe zihhlanze futhi ziqinisekile.

xh.title: ISikhulu Esiphambili SezobuKadastre
xh.summary: ISikhulu Esiphambili SezobuKadastre e Cape Town esibamba nokuhlaziya iinkcukacha zedatha yobukadastre, kufuneka kube nekhesithi yeGreyidi 12 nesatifikedi seZwelonke kwiGeomatics kunye neminyaka engama-6 yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki zicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikedi seGreyidi 12 nesesatifikedi seZwelonke kwiGeomatics okanye isatifikedi seSikhuli Sokutya (NQF Level 5). Kubandebele iminyaka engama-6 yamava emsebenzini wegeomatics emva kokuthweswa idigri kwindawo yemisebenzi yobukadastre noma yotyalo lwamagazulu. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngesoftwe yeNkqubo yolwazi lwezeZibalo nemigaqo yayo. Ulwazi lwezaNqumamvuzo kunye neenkqubo zoBume benkqubo zoKusebenza kwiNdiwe yoGunya loBakali-migangatho. Ulwazi ngemigangatho yeKadastre. Amanyathelo ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutywa. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela. Ubuchule bokuyila. Ukwazinikela kumthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngemilomo nangokubhaliswa). Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Ukuqamba ngokulungelelanisa. Uku Lawula iingxaki. Iindlela zokuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Bamba, hlaziya uze uvuse idatha yokwahlula ngokwezinombolo ngokwalfabhethi kumaxwebhu obukadastre alula nakuwo alula kakhulu. Bamba iinkcukacha ngokwalfabhethi nangokwezinombolo kumaxwebhu obukadastre atsha afakiweyo (alula aze abe namaxongo) uze uwenze ukuhlalutywa kokuhambelana kwemathimatika nokqinisekisa idatha kwimizila yomhlaba emitsha eckunyuliweyo. Hlaziya idata yobakadastre ngokongeza okanye ukulungisa lonke ixwebhu elamkelekileyo (elula elinamaxongo) ukuze igcinwe kwindawo yedatha yokubhala ngokwalfabhethi nangokwezinombolo. Bamba uze uqinisekise amaxwebhu obukadastre abhidwa ngokomlando (alula elinamaxongo). Jongana nokuhlaziywa okunzima kwamaxwebhu obukadastre ngokomthetho oyilayo. Yenza ukutshintshwa okanye ukurhoxiswa kwamaxwebhu obukadastre ngokwemiyalelo yomthetho. Tshuba, rhoxisa uze ufake izalathiso kumaxwebhu obukadastre anomhlaba obhalisiweyo, iinkqubo zokuhlala okanye iinkonzo zokudlula. Jongana nokulungiswa okunzima kwamaxwebhu obukadastre abhalisiweyo namkelekileyo. Faka lonke ixwebhu obukadastre elitsha elamkelekileyo kwindawo yokugcina. Khupha uze unikeze iirekhedi zobukadastre. Buyisela iirekhedi zobukadastre ezibuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze uzigcine iirekhedi zobukadastre zikulungele ukusetyenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola ngezandla kwamaxwebhu obukadastre alula nakuwo alula kakhulu. Hlola iinkcazelo zokunikwa kwamaxwebhu atsha afakiweyo. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezandla kwadayagram ezilula nangamacandelo amaninzi nakwiiplani ezijikelezayo. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezandla kwiirekhedi zotyalo lamagazulu. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezandla kwiplani ezilula nangamacandelo amaninzi zesihloko sezicandelo. Hlaziya amaphepha okuphawula ngokongeza yonke imigca yomhlaba wobukadastre owamkelekileyo. Phanda uze unikeze iinkcukacha zobukadastre kumthengi ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Khupha uze unikeze iinkcukacha zobukadastre kumthengi. Nikeza iifoto ezisuka mgangweni, imifuziselo echanekileyo namamephu avela kwiZiko leZolwazi iGeospatial Nasionali (NGI) ngokweliganqubo leminsetfo lemigangatho yesevisi. Yenza uphando olususweni kumanqaku obukadastre malunga nemida yomhlaba kumthengi nakuLwaziso loMhlaba. Bamba, hlaziya uze uvuse idatha ekwindawo ngamaxwebhu obukadastre alula nakuwo alula kakhulu. Bamba amaxwebhu afakiweyo atsha ukuze ukwazi ukubona ukuba kukho na iindawo ezihlanganayo ngaphambi kokuzamkelwa. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya uze ulonde idatha echanekileyo yobukadastre ekwindawo, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziywa kwedatha yomlando. Phanda iindawo ezingajongo zingabangela iimpazamo ukuba zitholakala kwaye uzilungise ngendlela echanekileyo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zokubala zobukadastre namanye amachoko amthetho e data ukuphucula umgangatho we nkukacha zemida yomhlaba. Tsala zonke amaxwebhu obukadastre xa samkelekile, alungisiwe, afinwe okanye arhoxisiwe uze wenze ukukhangela umgangatho. Tsala amaxwebhu obukadastre amkelekileyo atsha. Phinda kutshale zonke amaxwebhu obukadastre ehlaziyiweyo (alungisiwe, afinwe okanye arhoxisiweyo). Qamba iimbowana zetsali ezidityaniswe nedatha ebalwa ngealfabhethi nezimbali. Yenza imisebenzi yokukhangela umgangatho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba idata yemifanekiso etsaliweyo ihlanjululwe yaye ichanekile.

jobs.title: Principal Geomatics Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Principal Geomatics Officer based in Mowbray, requiring a National Certificate in Geomatics and six years' experience to capture and manage geospatial data.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in geomatics, geospatial information science. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of surveying, photogrammetry, cartography, geo-spatial information science. Good Geographical Information Science (GIS) knowledge regarding data capture, structuring and manipulation. Knowledge of aerial photo interpretation for topographic mapping. Knowledge including feature identification and data representation. Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems software. Performance management and monitoring. Theory, principles and practices of standards. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership and creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management and negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture different geospatial data into the Integrated Topographic System. Interpret imagery and map the topographical features. Ensure topological rules are applied in accordance with the topographic standard. Document the processes for application of topographical rules. Ensure all topographical features metadata is captured. Map the land cover classes in accordance with the defined standard. Perform geospatial data analysis according to the requirements. Quality check the accuracy of mapped land cover classes in accordance with requirements. Ensure compliance to the standards in maintaining geospatial in the database. Monitor availability of archives tapes. Contribute / participate in the development of procedure and standard documents. Provide reports on the monitoring of the Tape Library equipment’s and software. Ensure random checks on readability of archive tapes. Extract and provide geospatial data from the database. Process the aerial imagery spatial flight plan data (photo, flight lines and boundary) in the database and provide a report. Provide report on all completed and published vector data to Integrated Topographic Information System (ITIS) for aerial Imagery. Store all aerial imagery ground position system data files in the database according to the defined structure. Acquire, process and produce geospatial information for all mapping purposes. Source, edit and manipulate geospatial data for creating maps. Prepare, validate and import geospatial data for map spatial environment. Validate the processed geographic names and ancillary data. Ensure application of defined cartographic generalisation principles to enhance geospatial data during map production. Ensure compliance to standards and specifications at all times. Undertake photogrammetric absolute orientation of aerial imagery in accordance with standards and specifications. Perform quality check and verify accuracy of processed data as required. Archive the final maps and geospatial data in accordance with the standard. Disseminate, promote and quality assure geo-spatial information and services to clients. Provide and ensure the correctness of geo-spatial information to clients in accordance with service delivery standards. Create awareness to internal and external clients. Report on quality related issues and participate in processes to ensure quality. Assist with the revision of datasets of products and services for established vendors with district municipalities. Assist with stock management and stock reconciliations. Maintain copyright of geospatial information. Ensure correctness of invoices and quotations. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide advice to clients on use of products and services, including the Geoportal. Acquire, validate and process ancillary data for topographic mapping purposes. Verify and ensure all geo- spatial data and materials for field annotation are accurate for each map. Use the different ancillary geospatial data and verify all the changes detected on previous edition map are recorded. Prepare a report with all the queries classified from digital field annotation for each map. Source ancillary data and authenticate the geographic names and their geographic position in a map. Ensure all captured and processed ancillary data meets the requirements and available in the database (Integrated Topographic Data).

af.title: Hoof Geomatika-beampte
af.summary: Hoof Geomatika-beampte gebaseer in Mowbray, vereis 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika en ses jaar ervaring om geospatiale data vas te lê en te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Opmetingsbeampte-sertifikaat (NQF Vlak 5) hê. Minimum van 6 jaar geomatika post-kwalifikasie ervaring in geomatika, geospatiale inligtingswetenskap. Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van landmeting, fotogrammetrie, kartografie, geo-spatiale inligtingswetenskap. Goeie Geografiese Inligtingswetenskap (GIS) kennis rakende data vaslegging, strukturering en manipulasie. Kennis van lugfoto-interpretasie vir topografiese kartering. Kennis insluitend kenmerksidentifisering en data-voorstelling. Kennis van Geografiese Inligtingstelsels-sagteware. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Teorie, beginsels en praktyke van standaarde. Werkverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap en kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur en onderhandeling.
af.duties: Leg verskillende geospatiale data in die Geïntegreerde Topografiese Stelsel vas. Interpreteer beeldmateriaal en karteer die topografiese kenmerke. Verseker dat topologiese reëls ooreenkomstig die topografiese standaard toegepas word. Dokumenteer die prosesse vir die toepassing van topografiese reëls. Verseker dat alle topografiese kenmerke se metadata vasgelê is. Karteer die landbedekkingsklasse ooreenkomstig die gedefinieerde standaard. Voer geospatiale data-analise volgens die vereistes uit. Kontroleer die akkuraatheid van gekarteerde landbedekkingsklasse ooreenkomstig vereistes. Verseker nakoming van die standaarde by die instandhouding van geospatiale data in die databasis. Monitor beskikbaarheid van argiefbande. Dra by / neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van prosedure- en standaarddokumente. Verskaf verslae oor die monitering van die Bandbiblioteek se toerusting en sagteware. Verseker lukrake kontroles op leesbaarheid van argiefbande. Haal geospatiale data uit die databasis en verskaf dit. Verwerk die lugbeeldmateriaal se ruimtelike vlugplan-data (foto, vluglyne en grens) in die databasis en verskaf 'n verslag. Verskaf 'n verslag oor alle voltooide en gepubliseerde vektordata aan die Geïntegreerde Topografiese Inligtingstelsel (ITIS) vir lugbeeldmateriaal. Stoor alle lugbeeldmateriaal se grondposisie-stelsel data-lêers in die databasis volgens die gedefinieerde struktuur. Verkry, verwerk en produseer geospatiale inligting vir alle karteringsdoeleindes. Bron, redigeer en manipuleer geospatiale data vir die skep van kaarte. Berei geospatiale data voor, valideer en voer dit in vir die kaart se ruimtelike omgewing. Valideer die verwerkte geografiese name en aanvullende data. Verseker toepassing van gedefinieerde kartografiese generaliseerbeginsels om geospatiale data tydens kaartproduksie te verbeter. Verseker te alle tye nakoming van standaarde en spesifikasies. Onderneem fotogrammetriese absolute oriëntasie van lugbeeldmateriaal ooreenkomstig standaarde en spesifikasies. Voer gehaltekontrole uit en verifieer akkuraatheid van verwerkte data soos vereis. Argiveer die finale kaarte en geospatiale data ooreenkomstig die standaard. Verspreid, bevorder en verseker gehalte van geo-spatiale inligting en dienste aan kliënte. Verskaf en verseker die korrektheid van geo-spatiale inligting aan kliënte ooreenkomstig diensleweringstandaarde. Skep bewustheid by interne en eksterne kliënte. Rapporteer oor gehalteverwante kwessies en neem deel aan prosesse om gehalte te verseker. help met die hersiening van dataversamelings van produkte en dienste vir gevestigde verkopers met distriksmunisipaliteite. help met voorraadbestuur en voorraadafstemming. Onderhou outeursreg van geospatiale inligting. Verseker korrektheid van fakture en kwotasies. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf advies aan kliënte oor die gebruik van produkte en dienste, insluitend die Geoportaal. Verkry, valideer en verwerk aanvullende data vir topografiese karteringsdoeleindes. Verifieer en verseker dat alle geo-spatiale data en materiaal vir veldannotasie akkuraat is vir elke kaart. Gebruik die verskillende aanvullende geospatiale data en verifieer dat alle veranderings wat op die vorige uitgawekaart opgemerk is, aangeteken is. Berei 'n verslag voor met al die navrae wat vanuit digitale veldannotasie vir elke kaart geklassifiseer is. Bron aanvullende data en verifieer die geografiese name en hul geografiese posisie op 'n kaart. Verseker dat alle vasgelêde en verwerkte aanvullende data aan die vereistes voldoen en beskikbaar is in die databasis (Geïntegreerde Topografiese Data).

zu.title: Isikhundla Esiphezulu SezobuGeomatics
zu.summary: Isikhundla Esiphezulu SezobuGeomatics esiseMowbray, esifuna Isitifiketi Sezwe kuzobuGeomatics namava eminyaka eyisithupha sokuthumba nokuphatha idatha yesikhala sezwe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 nesisetshenziswa kanye nesitifiketi seNational Certificate in Geomatics noma isitifikati sokuba yiSurvey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Kuncani eminyakeni engu-6 yamava emsebenzini wegeomatics ngemva kokuthola izifundo, kuzobuGeomatics, isayensi yemininingwane yesikhala sezwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokuhlola, i-photogrammetry, ukwenza izindikimaphi, nesayensi yemininingwane yesikhala sezwe. Ulwazi oluhle lweGeographical Information Science (GIS) mayelana nokuthumba, ukwakheka nokushintsha idatha. Ulwazi ngokuhumusha izithombe ezixukile zokuqonda izindikimaphi zomhlaba. Ulwazi olubandakanya ukuhlukaniswa kwemvelo nokumela kwemininingwane. Ulwazi lwesoftswedi yeGeographical Information Systems. Ukuphatha nokugcina ukusebenza. Itheori, imigomo namasiko emizingodu. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucazulula. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukubusa iqembu nokudala. Ukugxila kubathengi noku.phendula. Ukuxhumana (ngokuthi nangokubhala). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuhlelela. Ukuphatha izingxabano nokuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Thumba idatha ehlukene yesikhala sezwe kwiIntegrated Topographic System. Humusha izithombe futhi udwebe izici zezindikimaphi zomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ye-topological isetshenziswa ngokuvumelana nomzingodu wezindikimaphi. Qopha izinqubo zokusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezindikimaphi. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane yezici zezindikimaphi zomhlaba ithunyiwe. Dweba amakilasi okubhokwe komhlaba ngokuvumelana nomzingodu ochaziwe. Yenza ukuhlaziya idatha yesikhala sezwe ngokwezidingo. Hlola izinga lokunemba kwamakilasi okubhokwe komhlaba adwebiwe ngokwezidingo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe emizingodwini ekugcineni idatha yesikhala ezwe kwidathabhesi. Buka ukutholakala kwamathayiphu ohlu lolwazi oludaliwe. Faka isandla / thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni amadokhumenti esinqumiso kanye namamithetho. Yez imibiko ekubukeni amadivayisi nesoftware eThini Lebhuloheli. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kokuhlolwa okungalindelekile kwesifundi samathayiphu ohlolwini. Khupha futhi unike idatha yesikhala ezwe kudathabhesi. Lungisa idatha yohlelo lwe-flight plan yezithombe ezixukile ezisesikhathini (photo, flight lines and boundary) kudathabhesi bese unikeza umbiko. Nikela umbiko ngayo yonke idatha ye-vector eqediwe futhi eshicilelwe kwiIntegrated Topographic Information System (ITIS) ngezithombe ezixukile. Gcina yonke idatha yamafayela ohlelo lwe-aerial imagery ground position kudathabhesi ngokokwakheka okushiwo. Thola, lungisa futhi khiqiza imininingwane yesikhala sezwe ngenhloso yazo zonke izindikimaphi. Thola, hlela futhi shintsha idatha yesikhala sezwe ukuze kudwetshwe izindikimaphi. Lungele, qinisekisa futhi faka idatha yesikhala sezwe kummandla wezindikimaphi. Qinisekisa amagama ezwe ahluziwe kanye nedatha enza okuseduze. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemigimo ye-cartographic generalisation yokwenza idatha yesikhala sezwe ibe mnandi ukuyisebenzisa ekukhiqizweni kwezindikimaphi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe imigimo futhi izinkomba ngaso sonke isikhathi. Yenza u-orientation ngokuphelele i-photogrammetric yezithombe ezixukile ngokwezinkomba kanye nemigomo. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwesibonelo futhi qinisekisa inani lokunemba kwedatha ehluziwe njengoba kudingeka. Gcina izindikimaphi zokugqama futhi idatha yesikhala sezwe ngokomzingodu. Sakaza, khuthaza futhi qinisekisa isibonelo semininingwane nezinsiza zesikhala ezwe kubathengi. Nikela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yesikhala ezwe ilungile kubathengi ngokuvumelana namazinga okuletha inkonzo. Dala ukwazi kubathengi banganaphandle nangaphandle. Nikela umbiko ngokuhlobene nezinkinga zezinga futhi thatha inxaxheba kuzinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isibonelo. Siza ekuvavanyeni izinqumblu zemikhiqizo kanye nezinsiza kubathengi abahlukene kummasipala wesifunda. Siza ekuphathweni kwezimpahla kanye nokuqinisekisa izimpahla. Gcina ilungelo lokushicilela kwemininingwane yesikhala ezwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izipikili nezincoko zemali zilungile. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa nezokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Nikeza izeluleko kubathengi ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo nezinsiza, okubandakanya i-Geoportal. Thola, qinisekisa futhi kwenze idatha enza okuseduze ukukhiqizwa kwezindikimaphi zomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke idatha nempahla yesikhala ezwe yokushicilela ebivini ilungele isibonelo ngasinye sephedi. Sebenzisa idatha ehlukene enza okuseduze yesikhala ezwe bese uqinisa ukuthi yonke imishwauzela etholakale kumbhalo wangaphambili ibhalwe. Lungele umbiko onazo zonke izibuzo ezihlukaniswe kusuka ebivini ye-digital yensezo ngasinye. Thola idatha enza okuseduze bese uqinisekisa ukuzinza kwamagama ezwe kanye nesikhala sawo esindikimeni. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke idatha eyisiya edingiwe ihlangabezana nezidingo futhi iyatholakala kudathabhesi (Integrated Topographic Data).

xh.title: ISikhululu Esibiholo seGeomatics
xh.summary: ISikhululu Esibiholo seGeomatics esekwe kwiMowbray, sifuna iNational Certificate kwiGeomatics neminyaka yamava emi-6 yokuqamba nokulawula iidata ezingpezulu.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neGrade 12 Certificate kwaye babe neNational Certificate kwiGeomatics okanye iSurvey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Kufuneka babe neminyaka engu-6 yamava kwiGeomatics emva kokufumana isidanga, kwisayensi yolwazi lwebhedi yeGeomatics. Ulwazi oluxhomekekiswe emsebenzini: Ulwazi ngokuqamba iintlobo zemilinganiselo, iifotogrametri, ukuzingela umhlaba, kwakunye nesayensi yolwazi lwebhedi. Ulwazi oluhle lwesayensi yolwazi lwebhedi (GIS) malunga nokubamba iidata, ukuyila nokuyilawula. Ulwazi ngokutolika iifoto ezidiniweyo zokuqamba iintlobo zemilinganiselo. Ulwazi olubandakanya ukubona iimpawu nokumela iidata. Ulwazi ngamahlelo esiGquba-magcisa. Ukuqonda ukulawula kwaye uphawule inkqubo. Ithiyori, iingqiqo namazinga amagqabantshashi. Amandla axhomekekile kumsebenzi: Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuwachaza. Ukwenza izigqibo. Ukuba ngumkhokeli kwinqanaba nokuqamba. Ukuqwalasela umthengi nokuphendula. Unxibelelwano (ngolwimi nangokubhalisa). Ukuzazi ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokucinga nokuhlela. Ukulawula iingxabano nokuxoxwa ngamacebo.
xh.duties: Qamba iidata ezahlukeneyo zomhlaba kwisebe elihlangene lemilinganiselo. Qonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeemaphu kwaye uzamele iimpawu zemilinganiselo ekuhambeni. Qinisekisa ukuba amacebo abekwe ngokumayelana nemilinganiselo eqikelelweyo. Bhala iinkqubo zokusebenzisa amacebo okulinganisa. Qinisekisa ukuba i-metadata yazo zonke iimpawu zemilinganiselo ibanjwe. Zingela iindidi zemilinganiselo ngokumayelana namazinga achaziweyo. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kweidata emhlabeni ngokumayelana neemfuno. Hlola ukuchaneka kweendidi zemilinganisyo ngokumayelana neemfuno. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina kwamazinga ekugcineni iidata esisebenziswayo. Qaphela ukubakho kweeposi ezibaliweyo. Nikela/ngathatha inxaxheba ekwakheni iinkqubo namaxwebhu. Nikela ngemiba yokuqaphela iinkqubo zokugcina iifayile ngehlelo. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa okungalungelelaniswanga kolwazi olubaliweyo. Khupha unike iidata kwidatabase. Yaza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeedata ezisetyenziswa ekubambeni iifoto nasekubakweni iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Nikela nengxelo malunga neefoto ezifunwayo kumapu ahamba phambili. Gcina zonke iifayile zeGeo-spatial Data kwidatabase ngokwezakhiwo ezichaziweyo. Zoba iindidi ezahlukeneyo zemilinganisyo ngokwezakhiwo ezichaziweyo. Yenza iianiysis yeidata ngokweemfuno. Hlola ukuchaneka kwezinto ezingezisiyo kunye nemilinganiselo. Qinisekisa ukuba kunye nokulawula iinkqubo ezikwizinga lokuhamba phambili. Hlola ukuchaneka kwemilinganiselo ngokweemfuno. Gcina zonke iindlela zemilinganiselo kwidatabase ngokomthetho ochaziweyo. Qaphela ukubakho kwamagama apha. Nikela/ngathatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuqamba amacebo. Nikela nengxelo malunga nokuqaphela iinkqubo ezibaliweyo. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa okungalungelelaniswa kolwazi lweefayile. Khupha unike iidata kwidatabase. Phatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeziphenduli kwaye unike ingxelo. Nikela nengxelo malunga neefoto ezibaliweyo nezazisiweyo kumapu ahamba phambili kwisebe elihlangene. Gcina zonke iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeGeo-spatial Data ezibaliweyo kwidatabase ngokomthetho ochaziweyo. Fumana, yaza uphendule iidata yokulinganisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zemilinganiselo. Hlola ukuchaneka kwemilinganiselo nengqwalasela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zemilinganiselo. Lungiselela, qinisekisa ufake iidata kwidatabase ngokweemfuno. Qinisekisa ukulunga kwamagama nezinye iidata ezikwiditya. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa amagama nezinye iidata ngokweemfuno. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwamagqabantshashi amagama ukulungisa iidata ngexesha lokuqamba amapu. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina kwamazinga namacebo ngalo lonke ixesha. Yenza isimo esichanekileyo seefoto ezahlukeneyo ngokweemfuno namacebo. Hlola ukuchaneka kwedata eqediweyo. Gcina amapu afake isigqibo namagama ebhedi ngokomthetho oqikelelweyo. Sasaza, ukhuthaze ukuze qinisekiswe ukulunga kolwazi nemisebenzi. Nikela ngolwazi oluchanekileyo abathengi ngokweemfuno. Yaza izaziso kumthengi yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikela nengxelo malunga nokuqaphela imiba yokulunga. Nceda ngokuhlehlwa kweefayile zemisebenzi. Nceda ngokulawula iinkqubo zemisebenzi. Gcina ilungelo lokushicilela. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwemirhumo kunye neemfuno. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo. Nikela ngeliso abathengi ngokusebenzisa imisebenzi. Fumana, qinisekisa uphendule iidata yokwenza amapu. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke iidata ihamba ngokwemilinganiselo ngokweemfuno. Sebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeedata. Lungiselela ingxelo ngeemfuno ezinengxaki. Fumana iidata. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iindlela ezahlukeneyo zemilinganiselo ngokweemfuno zikwizinga elidibana neemfuno. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke iidata igcinwe ngokomthetho oqikelelweyo ngokweemfuno.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and receptionist support to senior management in Pretoria, requiring a Grade 12 certificate, a relevant diploma and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Secretarial / Office Administration / Management or relevant equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in rendering a support service to senior management. Job related knowledge: Relevant legislation / policies / prescripts and procedures, Telephone etiquette, Basic knowledge on financial administration. Job related skills: Sound organisational ability. Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Good interpersonal relations. High level of reliability. Communication (verbal and written). Language and ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds. Ability to do research and analyse documents and situations. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Self- management and motivation. Willingness to work extended hours. Classified Secrets Security Clearance.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretarial / receptionist support service to the manager. Receives telephone calls in an environment where, in addition to the calls for the senior manager, discretion is required to decide to whom the call should be forwarded. In the process the job incumbent should finalise some enquiries. Performs advanced typing work. Operates and ensures that office equipment, e.g. printers and photocopies are in good working order. Record the engagements of the senior manager. Utilises discretion to decide whether to accept / decline or refer to other employees’ requests for meetings, based on the assessed importance and urgency of the matter. Coordinates with and sensitises / advises the manager regarding engagements. Compiles realistic schedules for appointments. Render administrative support service. Ensures the effective flow of information and documents to and from the office of the manager. Ensures the safe keeping of all documentation in the office of the manager in line with relevant legislation and policies. Obtains inputs, collates and compiles reports, e.g.: Progress reports, Monthly reports and management reports. Scrutinises routine submissions / reports and make notes and / or recommendations for the manager. Respond to enquiries received from internal and external stakeholders. Drafts documents as required. Does filling of documents for the manager and the unit where required. Collects, analyses and collates information requested by the manager. Clarifies instructions and notes on behalf of the manager. Ensures that travel arrangements are well coordinated. Prioritises issues in the office of the manager. Manages the leave register and telephone accounts for the unit. Handles procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. for the activities of the manager and the unit. Obtains the necessary signatures on documents like procurement advice and monthly salary reports. Provides support to manager regarding meetings. Scrutinises documents to determine actions / information / other documents required for meetings. Collects and compiles all necessary documents for the manager to inform him / her on the contents. Records minutes / decisions and communicates to relevant role-players, follow-up on progress made. Prepares briefing notes for the manager as required. Coordinates logistical arrangements for meetings when required. Supports the manager with the administration for the manager’s budget. Collects and coordinates all the documents that relate to the manager’s budget. Assists manager in determining funding requirements for purposes of Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) submissions. Keeps records for expenditure commitments, monitors expenditure and alerts manager of possible over and under spending. Checks and correlates Basic Accounting System (BAS) reports to ensure that expenditure is allocated correctly. Identifies the need to move funds between items, consults with the manager and compiles draft memos for this purpose. Compares the MTEF allocation with the requested budget and informs the manager of changes. Studies the relevant public service and departmental prescripts / policies and other documents and ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Remains up to date with regard to the prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to his / her work terrain to ensure efficient and effective support to the manager. Remains abreast with the procedures and processes that apply in the office of the manager.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Mabuza Tel No: (012) 312 8135
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post266@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en ontvangersondersteuning aan senior bestuur in Pretoria, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat, 'n relevante diploma en drie jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Sekretariële / Kantooradministrasie / Bestuur of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan senior bestuur. Werksverwante kennis: Relevante wetgewing / beleide / voorskrifte en prosedures, telefoonetiket, basiese kennis van finansiële administrasie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Gesonde organisatoriese vermoë. Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office). Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Taal en vermoë om goed te kommunikeer met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde. Vermoë om navorsing te doen en dokumente en situasies te ontleed. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Selfbestuur en motivering. Bereidwilligheid om buite-gewone ure te werk. Klassifiseerde Geheime Sekuriteitsklarering.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariële / ontvangersondersteuningsdiens aan die bestuurder. Neem telefoonoproepe in 'n omgewing waar, benewens die oproepe vir die senior bestuurder, diskresie vereis word om te beslis na wie die oproep aangestuur moet word. In die proses behoort die posbekleër sommige navrae af te handel. Voer gevorderde tikwerk uit. Bedryf en verseker dat kantoor.toerusting, bv. drukkers en fotostaatmasjiene, in 'n goeie werkende toestand is. Neem die afsprake van die senior bestuurder op. Gebruik diskresie om te beslis of om versoeke om vergaderings te aanvaar / te weier of na ander werknemers te verwys, gebaseer op die beoordeelde belangrikheid en dringendheid van die saak. Koördineer met en stel die bestuurder in kennis / advies gee rakende afsprake. Stel realistiese skedules vir afsprake op. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdiens. Verseker die doeltreffende vloei van inligting en dokumente na en van die kantoor van die bestuurder. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor van die bestuurder in ooreenstemming met relevante wetgewing en beleide. Verkry insette, stel saam en opstel verslae, bv.: Vorderingsverslae, Maandelikse verslae en bestuursverslae. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings / verslae en maak notas en / of aanbevelings vir die bestuurder. Reageer op navrae wat van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes ontvang word. Stel dokumente op soos vereis. Doen lêwerk van dokumente vir die bestuurder en die eenheid waar vereis. Versamel, ontleed en stel inligting wat deur die bestuurder versoek word, saam. Verduidelik instruksies en notas namens die bestuurder. Verseker dat reëreëlings goed gekoördineer word. Prioritiseer sake in die kantoor van die bestuurder. Bestuur die verlofregister en telefoonrekenings vir die eenheid. Hanteer verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verfrissings ens. vir die aktiwiteite van die bestuurder en die eenheid. Verkry die nodige handtekeninge op dokumente soos verkrygingsadvies en maandelikse salarisverslae. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die bestuurder rakende vergaderings. Ondersoek dokumente om aksies / inligting / ander dokumente wat vir vergaderings vereis word, te bepaal. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente vir die bestuurder saam om hom / haar oor die inhoud in te lig. Neem notule / besluite op en kommunikeer dit na relevante rolspelers, en volg vordering op. Berei voorleggingnotas vir die bestuurder voor soos vereis. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings wanneer vereis. Ondersteun die bestuurder met die administrasie van die bestuurder se begroting. Versamel en koördineer alle dokumente wat met die bestuurder se begroting verband hou. Bystand aan die bestuurder in die bepaling van befondsingsvereistes vir doeleindes van Mediumtermynbestedingsraamwerk (MTEF) voorleggings. Hou rekords van bestedingsverpligtinge, monitor besteding en waarsku die bestuurder van moontlike oor- en onverbesteding. Kontroleer en korreleer Basiese Rekenaarstelsel (BAS) verslae om te verseker dat besteding korrek toegewys word. Identifiseer die behoefte om fondse tussen items te skuif, oorleg met die bestuurder en stel konsepkennisgewings hiervoor op. Vergelyk die MTEF-toewysing met die versoekte begroting en stel die bestuurder van veranderinge in kennis. Bestudeer die relevante openbare diens en departementele voorskrifte / beleide en ander dokumente en verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Bly op hoogte van die voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat op sy / haar werksterrein van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die bestuurder te verseker. Bly tuis in die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Umsekeli Dlamu
zu.summary: Nikela ngenkonzelo yesikhashana kanye nokwamukela abantu ababhekise kubaphathi abaphezulu ePretoria, kudingeka ifayideka le-Grade 12, idiploma ehambisana naleso sikhundla kanye neminyaka emithathu yomcondo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane kakhulu: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma kwi-Secretarial / Office Administration / Management noma iziqu ezingulinganayo nezihambisana nalezi. Kadinga iminyaka engu-3 yomcondo ekunikeni inkonzolo yasekelo kubaphathi abaphezulu. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Umthetho / amapholisi / imiyalo kanye nendlela ezidingekayo, Indlela yokuziphatha ekucisheni ucingo, Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuqashwa kwezimali. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono elihle lokuhlela. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Izinga eliphakeme lokwethembeka. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhulunywa kanye nokubhaliwe). Ulimi kanye nakhono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abakumazinga ahlukene kanye nabalaphi bavela kwezinye izindawo. Ikhono lokucwaninga kanye nokuhlaziya amadokhumenti kanye nezimo. Ikhono lokwenza izinto ngobuhlakani kanye ngokuziphepha. Ukuzilawula kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuzmotivisha. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza amahora amaningi. Isitifiketi sokuvunywa ukuba nolwazi ngemfihlo ehlukiwe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkonzolo yesikhashana / yokwamukela abantu kumphathi. Amukela amakholi ocingo emhlabeni lapho, ngaphezu kwamakholi ahambisana nomphathi ophakeme, kudingeka uqonde kabani kufanele adluliselwe kubani ikholi. Kuleyo ndlela umsebenzi kufanele aqedele imibuzo ethile.enza umsebenzi ohlelekile wokuthayipha. Pheqeza futhi aqiniseke ukuthi izinto zesehlobo zomsebenzi, njengabapheqezi kanye nokushumayela zisebenza kahle. Bhalo izinkomfa komphathi ophakeme. Sebenzisa inhlakaniplo yakhe ukuzwa ukuthi wamukele / wala noma waphendule izicelo zabasebenzi abanye zokuhlangana, ngokusekelwe esigabeni sokubaluleka nokuphuthuma kwenhlangano. Xhumana kanye nomsakazi / weluleke umphathi ngohlelo lokuhlangana. Qamba izeshejuli ephilayo sezinhlelomzimbo. Nikela ngenkonzolo yabasizi. Qinisekisa ukusakazeka okusebenzayo kolwazi kanye namadokhumenti ukuya kule ndlu yomphathi futhi okuvela kuyo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuphepha kwawo wonke amadokhumenti kule ndlu yomphathi ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye namapholisi. Thola imininingo, uhlanganise futhi wakhe imibiko, isb: imibiko yentuthuko, imibiko yenyanga yonke kanye nemibiko yokuphatha. Hlola imibiko evamile / emijwayele kwenze izinkomba futhi / noma izincoma komphathi. Phendula imibuzo etholwe kubaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Bhala amadokhumenti njengoba kudingeka. Gcina amadokhumenti komphathi noma kwilapho kudingeka khona. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise imininingo ecelwaumphathi. Cacisa imiyalo kanye nezinkomba emhlbeni womphathi. Qiniseka ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhamisa zihleliwe. Phatha ngokubaluleka izindaba zomphathi. Phatha irekhodi lokushiya kanye namabhilidi ocingo egatsha. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezivamile njengamapentshisi, ukudla okuncane njll. kwezinhlelo zomphathi nasegatsheni. Thola izigqibo ezidingekayo emadokhumenti njengeseluleko sokuthenga kanye namabhilidi eholo. Nikela ngesekelo komphathi ngokuhlobene nezinkomfa. Hlola amadokhumenti ukuzwa ukuthi yimiphi izenzo / ulwazi / eminye imidokhumenti edingekayo ezinkomfweni. Qoqa futhi uhlanganise onke amadokhumenti okumaneumphathi amkhombise ngokuqonda. Bhalo imizuzu / izinqumo futhi uxhume nabahlanganyeli abaphambili, ulandelele inqubo elandelwayo. Bhala izinkomba zokulumela komphathi lapho kudingeka. Hlela izinhlela zokulandelana kwezinto kuma-mhlangano lapho kudingeka. Nxanelaumphathi ngokuphatheka kwezimali zebhajethi yomphathi. Qoqa futhi uhlanganise onke amadokhumenti ahlobene nebhajethi yomphathi. Sizaumphathi ekubekeni imfuneko yemali ngokuhlobene nokunikwa i-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF). Gcina amarekhodi okuzibophezela ezimalini, lundele imali yokushitsha kanye nokukhalaumphathi ngokuqedwa okungaba khona nokungasebenzi kahle kokuchitha. Hlola kanye noqhayanise imibiko ye-Basic Accounting System (BAS) ukuzwisa ukuthi imali ichithwe kahle. Zwa isidingo sokushintsha imali phakathi kwezinto, wanxibelelane nomphathi wakhe imemorandumokusukela kulesosizini. Theka isabelo se-MTEF nesabelo esiceliwe, watshelaumphathi ngokushintsha. Fundisisa imiyalo yomphakathi / amapholisi kanye namanye amadokhumenti, aze aqinisekise ukuzwisisa kokusebenziswa kwawo. Gcwelise ukwaziswa mayelana nemiyalo / amapholisi / indlela ezisebenza emhlabeni wakhe ukunika isekelo esipilile nafoyede kumphathi. Zinake imigomo kanye nendlela ezingangena ngayo endlini yomphathi.

xh.title: Nomthunywa
xh.summary: Kunikela ngenkxaso yobunyuli bokwamkela abantu kwaye ngokubhala iingxelo kubaphathi abaphezulu ePretoria, kufuneka abe necastifye yesiGarade 12, idiploma enxulumene nayo kunye namava eminyaka emithathu.

jobs.title: Senior Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral data, verifying land parcel information using GIS software for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 3 years geomatics post qualification experience in a Geomatics / Cadastral survey environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems Software and fundamentals. Knowledge of Surveyor-General’s Office Standard Operating Procedures and processes. Knowledge of Cadastral Surveys. Job related skills: Analysing and report writing. Interpersonal relations. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Presentation and /attributes: Confidentiality, fairness, respect and honesty.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted cadastral documents (simple and complex) and undertake mathematical consistency checks of and data verification of for proposed new land parcels. Update cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document (simple and complex) to maintain and electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify simple and complex historical cadastral documents. Attend to complicated maintenance of cadastral documents in accordance with legislated processes. Perform withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents upon lawful instruction. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Attend to complex amendments of approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements. Perform technical examination of simple and complex diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of simple and complex sectional title plans. Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Research and supply cadastral information to internal and external clients. Retrieve and supply cadastral information to clients. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from National Geospatial Information (NGI) according to signed service level agreements. Carry out basic research into cadastral survey information pertaining to land parcel boundaries for clients and Land Reform. Capture, maintain and update spatial data with simple as well as more complex cadastral documents. Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Research possible sources of error if overlaps are detected and address errors appropriately. Utilise cadastral survey calculation principle and other legitimate sources of data to improve the quality of land parcel boundary information. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement or withdrawal and execute quality checking. Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated (amend, endorsed or withdrawn) cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data. Carry out operations and do quality checking to ensure that the scanned image databases are clean and accurate.
