af.title: Senior Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Vang en onderhou kadastrale data, verifieer landperkinligting met behulp van GIS-sagteware vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Cape Town.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Opnamebeampte-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Minimum van 3 jaar geomatica-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n Geomatika / Kadastrale opname-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Geografiese Inligtingstelsels-sagteware en grondbeginsels. Kennis van die Surveyor-General se Kantoor se Standaard Bedryfsprosedures en prosesse. Kennis van kadastrale opnames. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analiseering en verslagskryf. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Voorlegging en /eienskappe: Konfidensialiteit, billikheid, respek en eerlikheid.
af.duties: Vang, onderhou en werk alfanumeriese data van eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente by. Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingediende kadastrale dokumente (eenvoudig en kompleks) en onderneem wiskundige konsekventiekontroles en dataverifikasie van voorgestelde nuwe landperke. Werk kadastrale opnamedatabasisse by deur die toevoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument (eenvoudig en kompleks) om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vang en verifieer eenvoudige en komplekse historiese kadastrale dokumente. Handhaaf ingewikkelde onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse. Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente op wettige instruksie uit. Trek af, kanselleer en endosseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landperke, huurkontrakte of servitute. Handhaaf ingewikkelde wysigings van goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Haal kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer benamings van nuut ingediende voorleggings. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van eenvoudige en komplekse seksionele titelplanne uit. Werk die aantekenvelle by deur die toevoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperk. Navors en verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte. Haal kadastrale inligting op en verskaf dit aan kliënte. Verskaf lugfotos, geregtefieerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van National Geospatial Information (NGI) volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Voer basiese navorsing oor kadastrale opname-inligting met betrekking tot landperkgrense vir kliënte en Land Reform uit. Vang, onderhou en werk ruimtelike data by met eenvoudige asook meer komplekse kadastrale dokumente. Vang nuut ingediende dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg data by, werk dit by en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en bywerking van historiese data. Ondersoek moontlike bronne van fout indien oorvleuelings opgespoer word en spreek foute toepaslik aan. Benut kadastrale opname-berekeningsbeginsel en ander wettige databronne om die gehalte van landperkgrensinligting te verbeter. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endossement of onttrekking en voer gehaltekontrole uit. Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle bygewerkte (wysig, endosseer of onttrek) kadastrale dokumente. Skakel die gedeponeerde skandeerbeelde aan die alfanumeriese data. Voer bewerings uit en doen gehaltekontrole om te verseker dat die skandeerbeeld-databasisse skoon en akkuraat is.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlezi Wezomini Zomhlaba
zu.summary: Bhiqaza futhi ulondoloze imininingwane yomhlaba, uhlole ulwazi ngamapolesi omhlaba usebenzisa software ye-GIS kumnyango wezokuLungiswa Komhlaba nokuPhuhliswa Kwamapulazi e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 nesesitifiketi se-National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Okuncane iminyaka engu-3 yokuhlakanipha emsebenzini we-geomatics emkhakheni we-geomatics / Cadastal survey. Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngesofthiwe ye-Geographical Information Systems nemithelela yayo. Ulwazi nge-Standard Operating Procedures kanye nenzinkambiso zika-Surveyor-General's Office. Ulwazi nge-Cadastral Surveys. Ikhono elihlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlaziya kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ubudlelwano nabantu. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokwethula futhi ngezici: Ukugcina imfihlo, ukulunga, inhlonipho kanye nokuqotho.
zu.duties: Bhiqaza, lonkele futhi uvuselele imininingwane ye-alpha numeric yamadokhumenti alula nakhulu ajulile e-cadastral. Bhiqaza imininingwane ye-alpha kanye ne-numeric ezitholakala kumadokhumenti amasha e-cadastral athunyelwe (alula najulile) futhi wenze ukuhlola okuhlobene ne-mathematical consistency kanye nokuqinisekisa imininingwane yamapolesi amasha omhlaba atushiwe. Vuselela imininingwane e-database yesurvey yase-cadastral ngokufaka noma ukulungisa yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe (elula najulile) ukuze kugcinwe nendawo electronic yokulondoloza imininingwane ye-alpha-numeric. Bhiqaza futhi uqinisekise imininingwane yamadokhumenti ahistoro e-cadastral (alula najulile). Ukweluleka ekugcineni amadokhumenti e-cadastral ejulile ngokusho kwezinkambiso zemithetho. Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhansela kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral ngokusho komyalo osemthethweni. Susa, khansela futhi uvume amadokhumenti e-cadastral anamapolesi omhlaba abhalisiwe, izivumelwano zokuhasha noma iziphoqo. Yeza kumalungiso ajulile amadokhumenti e-cadastral avunyiwe nabhaliwe. Faka yonke imininingwane yamadokhumenti e-cadastral amasha evunyiwe kundawo yokulondoloza. Khishela futhi ufake imininingwane yomhlaba e-cadastral. Phinda ufake imininingwane yomhlaba e-cadastral ebuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine imininingwane yomhlaba e-cadastral esimweni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlolo kwesobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti e-cadastral alula nakhulu ajulile. Hlola ukuklanywa kwemitshilo ethunyelwe entsha. Yenza ukuhlolo kwesobuchwepheshe kwamadiagrams alula najulile kanye nama-general plans. Yenza ukuhlolo kwesobuchwepheshe emininingwaneni yesurvey. Yenza ukuhlolo kwesobuchwepheshe kwamapulani esiyingi samagatsha (sectional title plans) alula nakhulu ajulile. Vuselela amakhasi okuqapha ngokufaka wonke amapolesi omhlaba e-cadastral avunyiwe. Cinga futhi unikeze imininingwane e-cadastral kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khishela futhi unikeze imininingwane e-cadastral kubathengi. Nikeza izithombe ezithathwe emoyeni, imininingwane e-cacisiwe namaphuza e-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokusho kwezivumelwano ezisayiniwe. Yenza ucwaningo oluyisiseko kumaniningwane a-cadastral survey ahlobene namagiba amapolesi omhlaba kubathengi nakuqeqesha Koluguquko Komhlaba. Bhiqaza, lonkele futhi uvuselele imininingwane yespace ngamadokhumenti e-cadastral alula nakhulu ajulile. Bhiqaza imininingwane yamadokhumenti amasha atshiwe ukuze uqinise ukuthi akukho nzoxa yespace ngaphambi kokuze ivunyiwe. Faka imininingwane, vuselela futhi lonkele imininingwane etembekile yespace ye-cadastral, okuhlanganisa ukufaka nokuvuselela imininingwane ehistoro. Cinga ngamathombo abalulekile amaphutha uma kutholakala ukuthi kunenzoxa bese uxazulula amaphutha ngendlela efanele. Sebenzisa imigomo yokubala isurvey yase-cadastral kanye namanye amathombo asemthethweni imininingwane ukuze usize ekuthuthukisweni kwenga yemininingwane yamagiba apolesi omhlaba. Skena yonke imininingwane yamadokhumenti e-cadastral uma ivunyiwe, ilungiswa, ivunyelwe noma ikhishiwe futhi wenze ukuhlolo kwethulwa. Skena imininingwane yamadokhumenti amasha e-cadastral. Phinda usskena yonke imininingwane e-cadastral evusiwe (elungisiwe, evunyelwe noma ekhishiwe). Xhumanisa imininingwane efakwe kumascan esithombe nendawo e-alpha numeric. Yenza izenzo zokusebenza futhi wenze ukuhlolo ukuthola ukuthi imininingwane eskeniwe iyahlanza futhi iqinisekile.

xh.title: Umsebenzi oPhakamileyo weeCadastral
xh.summary: Qamba ugcino kwaye ulondoloze i-data yecadastral, uqinisekise iinkcukacha zeqela lomhlaba usebenzisa isoftware ye-GIS kwi-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12 nesatifikethi seZizwe kwi-Geomatics okona isatifikethi soMsebenzi we-Survey (NQF Level 5). Ubuncinane kweminyaka e3 yamava emva kokuzakuzisa kwi-Geomatics kwimeko yokuqhelaniswa kwe-Geomatics / Cadastral survey. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi nge-Software ye-Geographical Information Systems nemiqondo yayo esisiseko. Ulwazi nge Standard Operating Procedures nendlela zokusebenza zika-Surveyor-General's Office. Ulwazi nge-Cadastral Surveys. Ikhono elinxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlalutya nokubhala iingxelo. Iingcali zokusebenzisana nabantu. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iprezentheshini kunye/nobume: Iimfihlo, unyaniseko, intlonipho nokuzithoba.
xh.duties: Qamba, ulondoloze uze uhle qamba i-data alpha numeric yamaxwebhu ecadastral alula nakwalawo angundosindo. Qamba iinkcukacha alpha namanani kwamaxwebhu amasha ecadastral ahamba phambili (alula anangundosindo) uze wenze ukujongwa okunokulinganiselwa kwephongo lenani kwaye uqinisekise idatha yamayala amatsha eqela lomhlaba. Hlela i-data base zecadastral survey ngokongeza okana ulungisa elunye nalomnye xwebhu elamkelekileyo (alula anangundosindo) ukuze ulondoloze indawo yegcinio le-alpha-numeric yekhompyutha. Qamba uze uqinisekise amaxwebhu ibali ecadastral alula anangundosindo. Joya ukulondoloza okunzima kwamaxwebhu ecadastral ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni. Yenza ukurhoxisa okana ukurhoxisa ngokupheleleyo kwamaxwebhu ecadastral kwisalathiso esemthethweni. Titsha, rhoxisa uze uqaphele amaxwebhu ecadastral anamagatya lomhlaba abhalisiweyo, iileysi okona izithunywa. Joya utshintsho olunzima kwamaxwebhu ecadastral awamkelekileyo nabhalisiweyo. Faka onke amaxwebhu amasha ecadastral awamkelekileyo kwindawo yegcino. Khupha uze unike amaxwebhu ecadastral. Phinda uwafake kwindawo yegcino amaxwebhu ecadastral abuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine amaxwebhu ecadastral esimo esilungileyo sokusebenzisa. Yenza ukujongwa lobuchwepheshe kwamaxwebhu ecadastral alula nakwalawo angundosindo. Jonga iindawo ezichaziweyo zamaxwebhu amasha ahamba phambili. Yenza ukujongwa kobuchwepheshe kwamadigrami alula anangundosindo nendlela ezisezantsi jikelele. Yenza ukujongwa kobuchwepheshe kwiinkcukacha zesurvey. Yenza ukujongwa kobuchwepheshe kumaplanga esiqhinga esilula anangundosindo. Hlela amaphepha okuqamba ngokongeza yonke iqela lomhlaba ecadastral elamkelekileyo. Phengela uze unike iinkcukacha ecadastral kubaxhasi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Khupha uze unike iinkcukacha ecadastral kubaxhasi. Nike iifoto ezisemzantsi, iifoto ezingcolileyo namapu avela kwi-National Geospatial Information (NGI) ngokwemigaqo enqweni ngokwemigaqo yesevisi. Yenza uphando olusisiseko kwiinkcukacha zesurvey yecadastral ezinxulumene namda weqela lomhlaba kubaxhasi naku-Land Reform. Qamba, ulondoloze uze uhle qamba i-data espacial kwamaxwebhu ecadastral alula anangundosindo. Qamba amaxwebhu amasha ahamba phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuba akukho nako ekuphela kommandla kwalo luphela ngaphambi kokuqinisekiswa. Yongeza idatha, hleza uze ulondoloze idatha equlethwe ngokuchanekileyo yecadastral spatial, kuquka ukongeza nokuhleza idatha yamaxesha edluleyo. Phengela iindawo ezinokubangela amaphutha xa kubonwa ukusilela ngaphakathi kosetyenziso uze ulungise amaphutha ngendlela echanekileyo. Sebenzisa iingcalu ezisemthethweni zokubala zesurvey ecadastral nabanye abo baprovida idatha ukuphucula iinkcukacha zomda weqela lomhlaba. Skena onke amaxwebhu ecadastral ngexesha lokwamkelwa, ulungiso, uqaphelelo okana ukurhoxiswa uze uhlole ubungakanani. Skena amaxwebhu amasha ecadastral awamkelekileyo. Phinda uskena onke amaxwebhu ecadastral ahleziweyo (okulungisiweyo, okuqaphelelwe okona okurhoxisiweyo). Qagqela iifoto eziskeniweyo ezigciniweyo kwi-data alpha numeric. Yenza imisebenzi uze uhlole ubungakanani ukuze uqinisekise ukuba i-data base yeeskeni zifana nezihobe zihliziwe.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk position in Cape Town at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, offering R237,453 per annum at Level 5.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate a computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Understanding of the work in registry. Job related skills. Planning and organisation. Computer literacy. communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Manage operations to achieve planned outcomes. Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence. Receive all mail. Sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Render an effective filing and record management service. Open and close files according to record classification system. Filing/storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Process documents for archiving an/disposal. Electronic scanning of files. Sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor. Keep records for archived documents.
jobs.enquiries: Mr T Mtintsilana at 071 302 1220
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post268@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males, and Coloured, Indian and White Females, and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form, (a nomination letter if required) and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. The Minister of Land Reform and Rural Development, in terms of section 4(3) and 4(4) of the Restitution of Land Rights Act No. 22 of 1994, hereby invites nominations from the general public for the appointment of a Chief Land Claims Commissioner for the Commission on Restitution of Land Rights. The person so nominated should meet the requirements for the position. Nominations must include a signed nomination letter and be accompanied by an updated CV and form Z83 completed by the nominated candidate. The appointment will be made in compliance with the Restitution of Land Rights Act 22 of 1994 read with the Public Service Regulations, 2016 MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Registerklerk
af.summary: Registerklerkpos in Cape Town by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, teen R237,453 per jaar op Vlak 5.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van registerpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Begrip van die werk in die register. Werksverwante vaardighede. Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur bedrywighede om beplande uitkomste te bereik. Verskaf registertoonbankdienste. Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgeleide pos/leêrs. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Versprei kenniggewings oor registervaardighede. Lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens. Maak en sluit lêers oop volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Lêer/berging, opsporing (elektronies/mondelings) en onttrekking van dokumente en lêers. Bedryf kantoormasjiene in verband met die registerfunksie. Verwerk dokumente vir argivering en/of wegdoening. Elektroniese skandering van lêers. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om gearchiveer te word en dien dit by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords van gearchiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Ummini we-Registry
zu.summary: Isikhundla sommini we-Registry eCape Town kumnyango i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, sinikeza i-R237,453 ngonyaka ezingeni 5.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ye-registry, izindlela zokwenza kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukufaka idatha, futhi usebenzise ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda ohlaka lomthetho oluphethe Imphakamthetho. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina nokukhipha imibhalo ngaphakathi kwezinkinga zokusebenza. Ukuqonda umsebenzi ophonyiwe ku-registry. Amandla okusebenza ahlobene nomsebenzi. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxhumana (ngokukhuluma nokubhala). Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi ukuzeufeze iziphumelelele ezicwelwe. Nikeza izinkonzo zesikhwama ku-registry. Yala kumakhilikithi. Phathela imibuzo yefoni naneminye ebonwayo. Thola ubhalise imali/mashu ezelwe ngentshe. Phathela ukumunyaziswa kokungenayo nentula. Thola yonke imali. Hlanganisa, bhalisa futhi ululula imali. Saza izaziso ngezinkinga ze-registry. Nikeza inkonzo egculisayo yokugcina nokuphatwa kwezikhulu bhalo. Vula futhi uvale imafayela ngesohlakomnywe bhalo sokugcina izigaba. Ukugcina/uKusuka, ukulandelela (ngokugqamisa/ngohle) nokukhipha izifundo namaphayela. Sebenzisa umshini wohhovela ohlobene nomsebenzi we-registry. Cabangisa imibhalo ngokulondoloza/ukulahla. Isikeni sangomagama samafayela. Hlanganisa futhi upakethe amafayela okulondoloza nokusakazwa. Hlela uhlu lwemibhalo okufanele ilondoloze futhi unikeze omphathi. Gcina izibhalo zamafayela alondoloziwe.

xh.title: Um-lawuli weRegistry
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli weRegistry eCape Town kwisebe leLand Reform and Rural Development, sibonelela ngoR237,453 ngonyaka kwinqanaba 5.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufunelekuba babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ye-registry, iinkqubo nakho nako ukubala i-data, nokuqhuba ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda ingqango yomthetho olawula inkonzo kaRulumende. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokulanda imibhalo ngokwemeko yokusebenza. Ukuqonda umsebenzi kwi-registry. Amaphuphu ahambelana nomsebenzi. Ulungelelwaniso kwaye ulungelelise. Ukuzazi ukusebenza ngakhompyutha. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Izihlobo zokwazi abantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphakathi kothimba.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo ukuze ufinyelele eziphumo ezicwangiweyo. Zibonelele iinkonzo ze-registry kwi-counter. Phendula kumaxhwebe. Phatha imibuzo yefowuni naye yamanye afumanekiyo. Yamkile ubhalise ngesandla iziqaqambilisa / iifayile eziletywe. Phatha unxibelelwano olungenayo noluphumayo. Yamke yonke imali. Hlela, ubhalise, thumela imali. Yahlule izaziso ngezinto ze-registry. Zibonelele ngonkonzo efanelekileyo yokugcina nokuLawula irekhodi. Vula, vala iifayile ngokwethuba lokuhlelwa kwamarekhodi. Ukuqhelanisa / ukugcina, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha / ngesandla) nokulanda amaxwebhu nemiqulu. Qhuba iimoto zofisini ezinxulumene nomsebenzi wakho we-registry. Phatha amaxwebhu ngonkonzo yokugcina / yokulahlwa. Isikena iifayile ngekhompyutha. Hlela, uqokele iifayile eziza kwindawo yokugcina kunye nokusasaza. Yila uluhlu lwamaxwebhu aza kugcinwa kwaye uzinike osomlawuli. Gcina amarekhodii emisebenzi egciniweyo.

jobs.title: Driver / Messenger
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: The Department of Land Reform and Rural Development seeks a driver and messenger to transport passengers and deliver documents in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 10 Certificate / Adult Basic Education and Training (ABET) qualification or related equivalent qualification and a valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of the city in which the function will be performed. Job related skills: Organising, Good communication (written and verbal), Interpersonal relations and Basic literacy. af.title: Bestuurder / Boodskapper
af.summary: Die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development soek 'n bestuurder en boodskapper om passasiers te vervoer en dokumente in Cape Town te besoorg.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Grade 10-sertifikaat / Adult Basic Education and Training (ABET)-kwalifikasie of verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van die stad waarin die funksie uitgevoer sal word. Werkverwante vaardighede: Organiseer, goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling), interpersoonlike verhoudings en basiese geletterdheid. 'n Betroubare en kreatiewe individu wat bereid is om onder druk en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur ligte en mediumvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items (pos, dokumente, kantoortoerusting) te besoorg. Versamel, versprei en beheer die beweging van dokumente. Doen roetineonderhoud aan die toegekende voertuig en rapporteer tydig foute. Doen daaglikse voor- en na-rit voertuiginspeksie om te verseker dat die voertuig altyd in die beste toestand is. Voltooi alle vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke met betrekking tot die voertuig en die goedere wat hanteer word. Onderhou akkurate en op datum skedulering van ritstate d.w.s. boekstaaf amptelike ritte, daaglikse kilometerstand. Versamel en besoeg dokumentasie en verwante items by die Departementele / Tak of enige ander komponent binne die Departementelike verwante eksterne partye. Verseker behoorlike en veilige beheer oor die beweging van dokumente. Bystand verleen in registerfunksies. Liaser inkomende korrespondensie en help om die lêer op te spoor. Fotokopieer en faks dokumente.

zu.title: Umshayeli / Umthunywa
zu.summary: I-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ifuna umshayeli kanye nomthunywa okuzobe ethwala abagibeli bese ethumela noma ehambisa amadokhumenti e-Cape Town.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingavamile: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 10 / isiqu se-Adult Basic Education and Training (ABET) noma isiqu esihlobene esilinganayo kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi idolobha lapho imisebenzi izobe yenziwa khona. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela, Ukuxhumana kahle (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo), Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu kanye nokufunda nokubhala okuyisisekelo. Indoda noma umuntu othembekile onesipiliyoni sobuciko ofuna ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi njengengxenye yeqembu.
zu.duties: Ukushayela izimoto ezikhulu kakhulu nakhulu ezincane ukuthwala abagibeli nokuhambisa ezinye izinto (imeyile, amadokhumenti, izisetshenziswa zohhovu). Qoqa abashayeli, yaba futhi ulawule ukunyakaza kwamadokhumenti. Yenza ukugcinwa okuvamile kwethrama kwimoto olyunyaziwe bese ubika lezo zinkinga ngokushesha. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwamoto ngemva kokushayela bese ehamba ibanga esikhundleni ngasinye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imoto ihlale lapha nxa ixhumile futhi. Qedela zeneziphi izitifiketi kanye nesigqibo esijwayelekile nobufakazi bokuhamba ngekhaya futhi yamaphofa okungenwa. Yenza uluhlu lokugcina uhlu lweziqeshana ezinguqikile kwamadokhumenti nemvume yekhaya. Qoqa bese uhambisa izincazelo nobuhlakani bokuhlangenwe nabo emnyangweni / esikhungweni ukwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nalawo mahhovisi angaphandle kwezinhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlolwa ngokulondolozwa nokuphephisa kwamaphasi nokuhamba kwabantu noma amadokhumenti esikhathini esidzingekile. Siza emsebenzini wokulondoloza amadokhumenti. Faka imibhalo engena bese usize ukuyilanda. Yenza amakhophi bese uhambisa amadokhumenti ngofax.

xh.title: Umshayeli / Mthunywa
xh.summary: Isebe leLand Reform and Rural Development lifuna umshayeli nomthunywa ukuthutha abagqithi nokuthumela amaxwebhu eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seGrade 10 / Isigqibo seAdult Basic Education and Training (ABET) okanye isigqibo esifanayo esinxulumeneyo nelaysensi yokuqhwesela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngasixeko lapho kuzakwenziwa khona umsebenzi. Amakhono anxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukuqamba, Unxibelelwano olululo (olubhalisiweyo noluthethwayo), Ubudlelwane nabantu nokuFunda nokubhala ngokusemthethweni. Umntu othemekayo noyilo ongakulungelelanga ukusebenza ngoxinzelelo njengetshudi yeqela.
xh.duties: Qhwesela izithuthi ezilula nangaphezile ukuthutha abagqithi nokuthumela ezinye izinto (iposi, amaxwebhu, izixhobo zofice). Qokelela, yahlula ulwandle wolwazi wamaxwebhu. Yenza ukunyamekela ngokwendalo kwisithuthi esinikiweyo kwaye uchaze iimposiso ngexeshaelifanelekileyo. Yenza kuqinisekiso ngemini yonke yaphambili nangemva yokuhamba kwesithuthi ukuze uqinisekise ukuba isithuthi sijolile kwaye simhle ngexesha lonke. Gqibazela zonke iirekhodi neelogbook ezifunekayo nezimisiweyo ngokwesisithuthi nangokwezinto eziphathwayo. Gcina ijadala elichanekileyo nelisezibukhweni lamabali ekubonakala kweentlobo ezahlukeneyo ezijelisa ukwenza umsebenzi wolawulo ukuba uchazwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qokelela kwaye uthumele amaxwebhu nezinto ezingezantsi kwindawo ebalulekileyo kunyaka wamashishini abhangi abanomdla nakwabanye bahlule abayilwa yiNkululeko kaRhulumente noHluvo lwemiSebenzi yoluntu ekuhlaleni. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluchanekileyo nolukhuselekileyo lwemvume yokuhamba kwamaxwebhu. Ncedisa kumisebenzi yokulawula iRegister efakiweyo. Faka iimemo ezifike kwaye uncede ukuzifumana ifayile ekulawulweni. Yenza ikopi kwaye uthumele ngeefax amaxwebhu.

af.title: Hoofhoftolk
af.summary: Hoofhoftolk benodig by die Limpopo Hooggeregshof in Thohoyandou, vereis 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolk en twee jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolk of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken beskik. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring as 'n Hoftolk waarvan een (1) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Taalvaardigheid: Engels en óf Tshivenda, Xitsonga, Sepedi. Kennis van Isi-Zulu/Setswana en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Batho Pele en die OCJ-beginsels, hofverrigtinge, kulturele diversiteit, kennis van beleide, voorskrifte en wetgewing en volledige beheer van die tale. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), luister, rekenaargeletterdheid (Ms Word, PowerPoint, Outlook en Internet, ens.), probleemoplossing, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, beplanning en organisering, mensevaardighede, intermediêre tik en kliëntediens-oriëntasie.
af.duties: Lewer tolkdiens in hoëprofielsake, tolk in komplekse sake, tolk in straf-, siviele- en Arbeidshof, tolk in klein eise hof, tolk in disiplinêre verhore, tolk in bemiddeling en arbitrasie, tolk in belydenis, tolk voorverrigtinge en konsultasies. Beheer, hou toesig en attendeer aan personeeladministratiewe aspekte van tolke, verskaf mentorskap en afrigting aan junior/senior tolke, bestuur prestasieooreenkomskontrakte, stel 'n skedule op vir vervanging van Hoftolke, beheer verlof van Hoftolke en dien Hofuurregisters in, dien kwartaalliks proefverslae in, monitor ondergeskiktes oor EHWP, vertaal Regsdokumente en uitstallings, bestudeer en analiseer die brondokumente, voer nodige navorsing uit en konsulteer, ontwikkel terminologie, oes terminologie, databasisontwikkeling, verskaf terme en hul onderskeie betekenisse in die glossariumregister, hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel, verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wiens pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesiggees ten opsigte van alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers. Verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker, hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor batestoewysing en -beheer.

af.title: Hoofhoftolk
af.summary: Hoofhoftolk benodig by die KwaZulu-Natal Hooggeregshof in Pietermaritzburg om tolkdiens in komplekse sake te lewer en junior tolke te onderrig en toesig te hou oor junior tolke.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolk of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se praktiese ervaring in Hof-tolk waarvan een (1) jaar op toesighoudende vlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Batho Pele en die OCJ-beginsels, Hofverrigtinge, Kulturele diversiteit, Kennis van Beleide, Voorskrifte en Wetgewing en Volle beheer van die taal. Bedrewe in kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, luister, interpersoonlik, kliëntediensoriëntasie, beplanning en organisering, probleemoplossing en vertroulikheid. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om onder druk te werk en die kuns van tolk.
af.duties: Lewer tolkdiens in hoëprofielsake, tolk in komplekse sake, tolk in straf-, siviele- en Arbeidshof. Tolk in Klein eise Hof, beheer en reël personeeladministratiewe aspekte van Tolke, verskaf afrigting en coaching aan junior Tolke, bestee prestasieooreenkomskontrakte, stel 'n skedule op vir vervanging van Hof-tolke, vertaal Regsdokumente en bewysstukke, bestudeer en analiseer die brondokumente, voer nodige navorsing uit en raadpleeg, Kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokumente, verkry buitelandse taaltolke en tydelike werknemers in ooreenstemming met PFMA en die tersaaklike beleid. Rapporteer statistieke wat gegenereer moet word en aan die trosbestuurder vir konsolidasie vir verdere aksie besorg moet word, magtig betalings van buitelandse en tydelike taaltolke, ontwikkel terminologie, oes terminologie en ontwikkel databasis, verskaf terme en hul onderskeie betekenisse in die glossariumregister, hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel en wys pligte toe en voer kwaliteitskontrole uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word.

zu.title: Isikhulumi Esikhulu Senkantolo
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isikhulumi Esikhulu Senkantolo e-KwaZulu-Natal High Court e-Pietermaritzburg ukuze sibe nezinsiza zokushumayela ezindabeni ezinzima kanye nokuphatha abashulumi abancane.
zu.requirements: Abafakelwayo kumele babe ne-National Diploma in Legal Interpreting noma isifundo esilingana ngengoqango lwe-NQF level six (6) esinamaphuzu angama-360 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka babe no-esibili (2) unyaka weminyaka yokuqashwa emsebenzini wokushumayela enkantolo, kanti kuleso sikhathi unyaka (1) kumele ube ngaphezulu kwesigaba sokulawula. Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile izoba ngaphezulu kokudingeka. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwe-Batho Pele kanye Nemigidingo ye-OCJ, izinkantolo, ukwahlukahlukana kwamasiko, ulwazi lwezinqumomo, ezemthetho kanye nokuqonda ngokugcwele ulimi. Ukukhona ngokukhuluma, ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukuzwa, kubantu, ukulungiselela, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nogwinya. Kanti futhi nokuba nalawa phawu: ikono lokusebenza ngokucindezelayo nobuciko bokushumayela.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngomsebenzi wokushumayela ezindabeni ezibalulekile, shumayela ezindabeni ezinzima, shumayela enkantolo yobugebengu, yesivila, kanye nase-Labour Court. Shumayela enkantolo yezikhalo ezincane, lawula futhi uphathe izindaba zokuphatha abashulumi, yifundise abashulumi abancane, lawula izivumelwano zemisebenzi, hlela isheduli yokushintshwa kwabashulumi enkantolo, humusha ukwaziswa kwemithetho, futhi ufunde ulwazi, kwenze ucwaningo oludingekayo, futhi ubuzanele, hlola, uhlehle, futhi ulungise okuhunyushiwe, thola abashulumi balimi besizwe abangaphandle namakhasimoni ngokuvumelana ne-PFMA nomqondiso ohambisanayo. Bika izibalo ezizonqunywa zigqitshwe kumlawuli wamagumbi asondweni ukuhlanganiswa, vuma ukukhokhelwa kwabashulumi balimi besizwe abangaphandle namakhasimoni, hlela izinkulumo, qoqa izinkulumo futhi akho isisekelo senani, hlinzeka ngegama naleso esihamba nalo, lawula futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi, kanti futhi wabel imisebenzi, futhi uqinise ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi obhekene nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Lingaphakathi Eliphezulu Lenkantolo
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSekela Lingaphakathi Eliphezulu Lenkantolo eKwaZulu-Natal High Court ePietermaritzburg ukunika iinkonzo zokuquka ngaphakathi eziqobo kumacala akhiqityiweyo nokulawla abaquki bathothotho.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafakeliswo babe nesidanga seNasionali Dipiloma ekuguqulelweni ngaphakathi kwamagunya okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF lesithandathu (6) namakhredithi angama-360 njengoko eqatshiwe yiSAQA. Kufuneka kube nokuhlolwa kokusebenza okubandakonyo kweminyaka emibini (2) ekuguqulelweni ngaphakathi kwamagunya apho kumele linye (1) leminyaka libe kwinqanaba lokulawula. Ilayisenesi yokuqhuba evakalayo iya kuba luncedo elongeziweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeBatho Pele nemiGaqo ye-OCJ, iinkqubo zenkantolo, indalo ehlukene, ulwazi lweMigaqo, iMigaqo eYilwayo, noMthetho wePalamente nokuziba ngokupheleleyo kolwimi. Ukuziba ekuthetheni, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, okuziva, phakathi kwabantu, ukuzibophelela kwinkonzo yamakhasi, ukuqamba nokuhlela, ukuxazulula iingxaki nasekugcineni iyimfihlo. Kakulandelwa le minqonqamela ilandelayo: Ukuba namakhono okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuxinzelelo lwemisebenzi yokuqamba ngaphakathi.
xh.duties: Kunike iinkonzo zokuqamba ngaphakathi ezingxamileyo ezibaluleayo, kuqanjwe ngaphakathi kwamagunya, aze kuqanjwe ngaphakathi kwamagunya ezenza ubuhlungu, zobe zikwishishi, nase nkantolo yabasebenzi. Aze kuqanjwe ngaphakathi kwenkantolo yeZiganeko eZincinci, ulawule azibuzele iimbono zolawulo lwabasebenzi abaqamba ngaphakathi, anikeze inkqubo yokulungisa abaquki bathothotho, alawule iinkqubo zemigaqo yokusebenza, akhule ishedyuli yokubalela koqamba ngaphakathi enkantolo, aguqulele amaxwebhu okusesigqikisini, afunde axova amaxwebhu asuka kumthombo, aze enze uphando olufunekayo aze achazele, akhangele, ahlele azalule amaxwebbu aguqiweyo, abuyelelele aba qambi belwimi olungelithiyo kunye nabathothotho ngokwemigaqo lePFMA nangoMthetho oluseleyo. Atyhile izibalo azibe ekudityanisweni zanikezelwe kumlawuli wengqungquthela kwindima yokudityanisa, avume ngenxa yokuhlawula aba qambi belwimi abangangelanga naseqabeni ngokutsha, axobe imigaqo yolwimi, aze axobe idathabhase, anikeze amagama nentsingiselo yawo kwatresi yeglosari, alawule aze aphuhambise basebenzi abaphantsi kwakhe anike umisebenzi aze achinge ulawulo kolusebenziso olunikwe ngamaphakathi.

jobs.title: Senior Court Interpreter

jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Senior Court Interpreter at the Eastern Cape High Court in Mthatha, requiring a National Diploma in Legal Interpreting and at least two years of court interpreting experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Legal Interpreting or equivalent qualification at NQF level six (6) with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ practical experience in Court Interpreting or Grade twelve (12) certificate with at least ten (10) years’ practical experience in Court Interpreting. Proficiency in English, isiXhosa Afrikaans, isiZulu or Sesotho. A valid driver’s license will serve as added advantage. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of relevant acts and regulations, knowledge of culture, knowledge of subject area, knowledge on how to translate and be able to keep to time frame, computer literacy (MS Office), effective communication skills (written and verbal), time management, good interpersonal relations skills, listening skills, customer service skills, problem solving skills, planning and organising skills, decision- making skills. analytical thinking, excellent English language, flexible, motivational, able to work under pressure, meticulous, self-driven and people centric.
jobs.duties: Render interpreting services: Interpret in Children’s Act matters, criminal proceedings, Civil proceedings, Domestic Violence Act matters, Older Persons Act matters, Family, Protection from Harassment Act matters, Labour, Maintenance Act matters, Child Justice matters, Inquests, and quasi-judicial matters, interpret in small claims Courts, interpret in disciplinary hearing, interpret in Conciliation and Arbitration, interpret in confession. Interpret in pre- trial proceedings and consultations, liaise with the supervisor for foreign language interpreters, interpret from source to target language during Court proceedings, pre-trial, consultation, quasi, judicial. interpret non-verbal gestures, dramatization and confessions, engage with the judiciary to confer on the readiness and/or performance of a particular interpreter in Court, render legal and quasi-judicial and language service: Render audible and clear interpreting from source to target language without embellishment or omissions while preserving the language, convey the correct language in accordance with language usage of the speaker, control the speaker and ensure that the citations are interpreted correctly, interpret non-verbal gestures dramatization and confessions, translate legal documents and exhibits: Study and analyse the source document, conduct the necessary research and consult with the relevant parties, ensure accurate cite translation documents, check, edit and revise the translated document, translate mechanically recorded audio material. Develop terminology and provide support in the reconstruction of records: Accumulate terminology and develop database, populate the terms and respective meaning in the glossary register, gather all trial documents, attend to mechanical recordings, compare notes of the Presiding Officer, State and Defence.

af.title: Senior Hof Tolk
af.summary: Senior Hof Tolk by die Eastern Cape High Court in Mthatha, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolk vereis en ten minste twee jaar se hof-tolkervaring.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolk of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak ses (6) met 360 krediete hê, soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in Hof-tolk of Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat met ten minste tien (10) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in Hof-tolk. Vaardigheid in Engels, isiXhosa Afrikaans, isiZulu of Sesotho. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal 'n voor-toetrede praktiese oefening onderneem as deel van die assesseringsmetode om die kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante wette en regulasies, kennis van kultuur, kennis van onderwerpsgebied, kennis oor hoe om te vertaal en in staat wees om die tydsraamwerk na te kom, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondeling), tydbestuur, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, luistervaardighede, kliëntediensvaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede. Analitiese denke, uitstekende Engelse taal, buigsaam, motiverend, in staat om onder druk te werk, noukeurig, selfgedrewe en mensegesentreerd.
af.duties: Lewer tolkdiens: Tolk in Children's Act-aangeleenthede, strafregtelike verrigtinge, siviele verrigtinge, Domestic Violence Act-aangeleenthede, Older Persons Act-aangeleenthede, Familie, Protection from Harassment Act-aangeleenthede, Arbeid, Maintenance Act-aangeleenthede, Child Justice-aangeleenthede, ondersoeke, en kwasi-geregtelike aangeleenthede, tolk in Kleinvorderingshowe, tolk in dissiplinêre verhore, tolk in Konsiliasie en Arbitrasie, tolk in belydenis. Tolk in verhoor-verrigtinge voor die proef en konsultasies, skakel met die toesighouer vir buitelandse taaltolke, tolk van brontaal na doeltaal gedurende Hof-verrigtinge, voor-verhoor, konsultasie, kwasi, geregtelik. Tolk nie-verbale gebare, dramatisering en belydenisse, tree in verbinding met die regbank om oor die gereedheid en/of prestasie van 'n spesifieke tolk in die Hof te beraad, lewer regs- en kwasi-geregtelike en taaldiens: Lewer hoorbare en duidelike tolking van brontaal na doeltaal sonder versiering of weglatings terwyl die taal behou word, dra die korrekte taal oor ooreenkomstig die taalgebruik van die spreker, beheer die spreker en verseker dat aanhalings korrek getolk word, tolk nie-verbale gebare dramatisering en belydenisse, vertaal regsdokumente en uitstaallings: Bestudeer en ontleed die brondokument, doen die nodige navorsing en raadpleeg die relevante partye, verseker akkurate vertaal-aanhalingdokumente, kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokument, vertaal meganies opgeneemde oudiomateriaal. Ontwikkel terminologie en verskaf ondersteuning by die rekonstruksie van rekords: Versamel terminologie en ontwikkel 'n databasis, vul die terme en onderskeie betekenis in die glossariumregister in, versamel alle verhoordokumente, hou toezig op meganiese opnames, vergelyk notas van die Voorsittende Beampte, Staat en Verdediging.

zu.title: Umtoliki Ophakeme Wenkantolo

Okungenani iminyaka emi (2) yohlangenwe nakho kwenzelwayo ekuTolulweni Kwabantu enkantolo noma isitifikedi sesigaba sesi-12 (12) sokugqila esinokuhlangenwe nakho okungenani kweminyaka eyishumi (10) kwenzelwayo ekuTolulweni enkantolo. Ukubakhona ulwazi oluhle ngesiNgisi, isiXhosa, isiBhunu, isiZulu noma isiSuthu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo izoba ngcoliswa ekutholeni isikhundla. Bonke abantu abathunywe ohlwini abazobe benza isivivinyo sendlela yokwenza izinto njengengxenye yendlela yokuhlola ukubeka ukufaneleka komuntu othunyiwe ngokusekelwe kumfuno wemisebenzi yalolu hlobo kanye namafuno jikelele alolu hlobo. Hhumusha ezinqabeni zocalulo lwangaphambi koxolo kanye nasemibonweni yokuqondana, xhumana nomphathi wemisebenzi yezilimi zangaphandle kubahumushi, hhumusha ulimi oluchazwe olutholakele luya kulimi oluthunyelwe enkantolo. Xhuma izinto ezingezona ezokhulunwayo, izibonakaliso, nemizwa yemithetho enkantolo, hhumusha izinkomba ezingezona ezokhulunwayo, imidanso nokuvuma, xhumana nabanikazi bomthetho ukubeka ukulungela noma ukusebenza komuntu othileyo ohumusha enkantolo, hhumusha ngesikhulu nangolunye ulimi kwaye unike ngenkonzo yezilimi zomthetho: Hhumusha ngokuzwakalayo nangokucacileyo ulimi oluchazwe luye kulimi oluthunyelwe ngaphandle kokongeza noma ukweqa ngelimi eligcinwa, dlulisa olimi oluchanekileyo ngokomthetho wokusebenzisa ulimi komkhulumi, lawula umkhulumi ukuze uqinisekiswe ukuthi izikhombisi zimxhumanise ngokwesiko, hhumusha izinkomba ezingezona ezokhulunwayo imidanso nokuvuma, humusha amadokhumenti ezomthetho kwaye ibe yinto ebonakalayo: Funda uze uhlaziye idokhumenti etholakalayo, wenze ucwaningo oludingekayo uze uxhumane nabantu abahlobene, qinisekisa ukuhumusha ngokufanele okuchaziwe, qinisekisa, hlela uphinde ulungise idokhumenti ehunyushiwe, humusha okulalelwe ngomshini. Yakha isihlukanisi magama anike ngenkxaso ekuqoqeni kabusha kwezarekodu: Qoqa izihlukanisi magama waze umxhumanise ohlelweni lwedatha, faka amagama esihlukanisi magama nemigca yabahumushi ebukwamagama, qoqa zonke izitifikedhi zocalulo, qaphela okulalelwe ngomshini, fananisa iinkcukacha zomlawuli, zombuso nokuzivikela.

xh.duties: Kunikezwa iinkonzo zokuhumusha: Ukuba kunjalo kwiMithetho yeBantwana, iinkqubo zezono, iinkqubo zeZivil, iMithetho yeNdlela yokuziphatha eNgcaleni, iMithetho yeBantu abadala, iSapho, iMithetho yeKhuselo ekuhlaselweni, iLabour, iMithetho yeNkonzo yokunyamekela, iNtshiso zeBantwana, iInquests, namacala asingathanga ngokutsha okusemthethweni, kuhumushwe kwiinkantolo zamangcala amancinci, kuhumushwe kwizingxoxo zokulalelwa kolahleko kwemisebenzi, kuhumushwe kwiNkqubo yokulungisa iziphithiphithi nokuPhakamisa isigqibo, kuhumushwe kwiGunya lokuvuma izono. Kuhumushwe kwiinkqubo ezenziwa phambi kokuqaliswa kombuso kunye nezigqibo ezidityaniswayo, kuxhumelane nomlawuli wabahumushi balwimi lwangaphandle, kuhumushwe lulwimi lokuqala lulwimi lokugqibela ngelixa kunjalo kwiNkantolo, phambi kokuqaliswa kolusu, kwiingxoxo ezidityaniswayo, kwicala elingaqhelekanga, elingokomthetho. Kuhumushwe izixhobo ezingezonto ezithe ngqo, ukudlaliswa kwezinto nokuvuma izono, kuthathelwane nxaxheba nomnyathi wokugqiba ukuze kuqwalaselwe ukulungele nokusebenza komhumushi othileyo enkantolo, kunikezwa inkonzo yomthetho, ecalo engaqhelekanga negunya lolwimi: Kunikezelwa okunye okusiva ngokucacileyo okuhumushiweyo kulwimi lokuqala lulwimi lokugqibela ngaphandle kwezinto ezongeziweyo okanye ezishiyiweyo ngelixa lugcinwa lulwimi. Kudluliselwe ulwimi olufanelekileyo ngokuvumelana nendlela yokuSetyenziswa kolwimi lomthethi, kulawulwe umthethi kuqinisekiswe ukuba okucaphuliweyo kuhumusheke kakuhle, kuhumushwe izixhobo ezingezonto ezithe ngqo okudlaliswayo nokuvuma izono, kuguqulwe amaxwebhu amathetho nokuboniswa: Kufundwe kanti kuqwalaselwe ixwebhu elikuqala, kwenziwe uphando olufunekayo kanti kuxhumelane nabantu abahambelana nalo, kuqinisekiswe ukuba amaxwebhu aguqulwe ngokuchanekileyo, kutsayiwe, kuhlelwe kanti kulungiswe ixwebhu eliguquliweyo, kuguqulwe okuluhlalutyiweyo ngesixhobo ekubhalwe ngako isandi. Kuphuhliswe iingamagama kunye nokunikela inkxaso ekwakhiweni kwemibhalo: Kuhlanzwe iingamagama kanti kuphuhliswe isiseko sedatha, kugcwaliswe amagama nentsingiselo yawo kweregista yohlu lwamagama, kuqokelelwe yonke imibhalo yecaleni, kutshatshwe ixhoba nokubhalwa kwesandi, kuthelekiswe iifayile zoMlawuli, eliKunye nokuQina.

jobs.title: Judge’s Secretary
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement. CENTRE             Supreme Court of Appeal: Bloemfontein
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and administrative support to a Judge at the Supreme Court of Appeal in Bloemfontein, typing judgments and managing correspondence.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade Twelve (12) Certificate. An LLB degree or a minimum of 20 modules completed towards an LLB, BA Law or BCom Law degree or related qualification at NQF level six (6) as recognised by SAQA (results must accompany the application). A minimum of two (2) years secretarial experience. A valid driver’s license. Secretarial experience in a legal/court environment will service as an added advantage. Shortlisted candidates will be required to pass a typing test. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of the Constitution of South Africa, relevant legislation, regulations and case lines. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), research capabilities, proficiency in English, communication (verbal and written), administration and organisational skills, interpersonal skills, customer service and typing skills along with the following attributes: Ability to meet strict deadlines and to work under pressure, attention to detail, confidentiality and time management.
jobs.duties: Provide general secretarial/administrative duties to the Judge. Typing (or formatting) of draft memoranda decisions, opinions or judgment entries written by, or assigned by the Judge. Manage and type correspondence, judgments and orders for the Judge (including dictaphone typing). Arrange and diarise appointments, meetings and official visits. Make travel and accommodation arrangements. Store, keep and safeguard all case files and update the case files with the order made by the Judge. Update files and documents and provide copies of documents to the Registrar. Perform digital recording of court proceedings on urgent cases after hours and ensure the integrity of such recordings. Accompany the Judge to Court. Manage the Judge’s vehicle, logbook and the driving thereof. Compile data and prepare reports and documents for the Judge as necessary including expense reports, financial disclosure statements and case management. Arrange refreshments for the Judge and his/her visitors and attend to their needs. Manage the Judge’s library and the updating of documentation. Execute legal research as directed by the judge and comply with all departmental prescripts, policies, procedures and guidelines.
jobs.enquiries: Technical related enquiries: Mr. V.Z.J Zwane Tel No: (051) 492 4623 HR related enquiries: Ms D.S.J Peters Tel No: (051) 492 4523
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/142/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals.

af.title: Regter se sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan 'n Regter by die Hooggeregshof van Appèl in Bloemfontein, tik vonnisse en bestee korrespondensie.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad Twaalf (12) Sertifikaat beskik. 'n LLB-graad of 'n minimum van 20 modules voltooi vir 'n LLB-, BA Regte- of BCom Regte-graad of verwante kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) soos deur SAQA erken (resultate moet die aansoek vergesel). 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar sekretariële ervaring. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Sekretariële ervaring in 'n regs-/hofomgewing sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kortlys-kandidate sal 'n tiktoets moet slaag. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Grondwet van Suid-Afrika, toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies en regspraak. Bedrewe in rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), navorsingsvermoë, vaardigheid in Engels, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede, kliëntediens en tikvaardighede tesame met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om streng sperdatums na te kom en onder druk te werk, aandag aan detail, vertroulikheid en tydbestuur.
af.duties: Verrig algemene sekretariële/administratiewe pligte vir die Regter. Tik (of formateer) konsept memorandum-beslissings, menings of vonnisinskrywings wat deur die Regter geskryf of deur die Regter toegeken is. Bestuur en tik korrespondensie, vonnisse en bevele vir die Regter (insluitend diktafoon-tikwerk). Reël en dagteken afsprake, vergaderings en amptelike besoeke. Maak reëlings vir reis en akkommodasie. Berg, hou en beskerm alle saaklêers en werk die saaklêers by met die bevel wat deur die Regter gegee is. Werk lêers en dokumente by en verskaf afskrifte van dokumente aan die Registrateur. Verrig digitale opname van hofverrigtinge oor dringende sake na ure en verseker die integriteit van sulke opnames. Vergesel die Regter na die Hof. Bestuur die Regter se voertuig, logboek en die bestuur daarvan. Stel data saam en berei verslae en dokumente vir die Regter voor soos nodig, insluitend uitgaweverslae, finansiële openbaarmakingsverklarings en saakbestuur. Reël verkwikkings vir die Regter en sy/haar besoekers en trek toe aan hul behoeftes. Bestuur die Regter se biblioteek en die bywerking van dokumentasie. Verrig regsnavorsing soos deur die regter aangewys en voldoen aan alle departementele voorskrifte, beleide, prosedures en riglyne.

zu.title: Isikhwama Sommeli Wamajaji
zu.summary: Nikela ngesikhashana nokusekela kolawulo kumajaji eNkantolo Ephakeme Yokwesula eBloemfontein, ukuthayipha izinqumo nokuphatha unxibelelwano.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGreidi Twelve (12). Idegree ye-LLB noma okungenani amazing angu-20 adlulile edegree ye-LLB, iBA Law noma iBCom Law noma izifundo ezihambisana nazo ezingeni le-NQF lesithupha (6) njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA (iziphumo kumele zihambise isicelo). Okungenani unyaka ababili (2) bokuhlangabezana njengesikhashana. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Okuhlangabezana khona njengesikhashana endaweni yomthetho/nenkantolo kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Abahlophe bazocelwa ukuba adlule uvivinyo lokuthayipha. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthethosisekelo waseSouth Africa, umthetho othintelayo, imithetho nemigomo nezinkomba zamacala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), amakhono okucwaninga, ukuba khona kolimi isiNgisi, unxibelelwano (okushiwo nokubhalwayo), ukulawula nokuhlela, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, inkonzo yamakhasimende nokuthayipha kanye nalezizinto ezilandelayo: Ikono lokuhamba ngesikhathi esibekiwe futhi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuthazo, ukuqaphela imininingwane, ukugcina imfihlo nokulawula isikhathi.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ejwayelekileyesikhashana/yalolawulo kumajaji. Ukuthayipha (noma ukulungisa isimo) samemo angu-0 esibhaliwe, izinqumo, izinkulumo noma okufakiwe ekuqushweni kwejaji. Phatha futhi uthayiphe unxibelelwano, izinqumo nemiyalo yomajaji (okuhlanganisa ukuthayipha ngedictaphone). Hlela ubuke ngosuku izabelo, izinkumonkhumo namakherekhedi ezikuqashi. Yenza izindleko ezohambe nabakhwestwa. Gcina, zigcine futhi uvikele zonke izinkomba zamacela ufake izinkomba zamacela nomyalo owenziwe umajaji. Buyela emuva izinkomba zamacela ongakahleliwayo futhi ukhiye ongakaze adlule uthayipha konke okuqushiwe emzimbeni wezinkomba zamajaji. Gcina amakhasimende abathengisiweyo afike ekhaya lodumo bese elungelelanisa nesikhathi sokubamba udumo. Qondana neJudge eNkantolo. Lawula imoto yejaji, incwadi yokushayela nokuyishayela. Hlanganisa idatha ulungise imibiko namadokhumenti ojaji njengoku diwa kanye nemibiko yokuhamba, izitatimende zobugcini bemali kanye nokulawula amacela. Hlela okuphuzwayo kumajaji nabakhamusi bakhe futhi uphendele ezidingweni zabo. Lawula ithebhu lesiyalakadeli lejaji nokuhlaziya kwamadokhumenti.enza ucwaningo ngokomthetho ngokumyalelwa yilo ampetha futhi uhambisane nazo zonke imiyalelo, izinqumo, inqubo nemihlahlandlela yomnyango.

xh.title: Mongameli woNomyalezo weJaji
xh.summary: Kubonelelwe ngoncedo lomsebenzi wolwazi lwamagama nololawulo kwiJaji eNkundla yamagosa eNqanaba eliphezulu yabaPhetheyo eBloemfontein, ukuchwetheza izigwebo nokulawula iindaba zolonwabo.
xh.requirements: Abagqithiselo kufuneka babe neSitifikedi seQela lesithoba (12). I-degree ye-LLB okanye ubuncinane kwimodyuli ezingama-20 eigqityiweyo kwicala le-LLB, i-BA Law okanye i-degree ye-BCom Law okanye ngesiphelo esinxulumene nayo kumqondo oyiNqanaba lesithandathu (6) njengokuvunywa yi-SAQA (iimpumlo kufuneka zihambisane nesicelo). Ubuncinane beminyaka emibini (2) yamava ngomsebenzi wokuba ngumongameli wolwazi lwamagama. Ilayisenesi yokushayela esebenzayo. Aba mva ngomsebenzi wolwazi lwamagama kwindawo yomthetho/inkundla baya kuba yingenelo. Abagqithiselo abakhethiweyo baya kufunwa kugqithise uvavanyo lokuchwetheza. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lweMithetho-siseko yaseMzantsi Afrika, umthetho oyonelisayo, iimigaqo nemithetho yamacala. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha (i-MS Office), amakhono okuphonononga, ukube kakuhle ngesiNgesi, ukunxibelelwana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), ukulawula nokuqamba izicwangciso, amakhono obuntu, ukukhonza abathengi nakumakhono okuchwetheza kunye neempawu ezilandelayo: Ukuba nakho ukutyhila iimigiba equkiweyo kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngexesha lokuxinzelelo, kuqatshelwe iinkcukacha, igcina iyimfihlo nokulawula isikhathi.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwe ngemisebenzi yonke yolwazi lwamagama/lolawulo kuJaji. Ukuchwetheza (okanye ukulungiselela ibhonti) izigwebo ezingekapheli, iimvakalelo okanye izalathiso zokugqiba ezibhalwe okanye eznikelwa nguJaji. Ukulawula nokuchwetheza iindaba zolonwabo, izigwebo nemyalelo kaJaji (kuquka ukuchwetheza ngomatshini wokurekoda mazwi). Ukucwangcisa nokubeka kwisiqulathada iingqibiziselo, iindibano nokutshaya iindlela ezisemthethweni. Ukwenza izicwangciso zokuhamba nendawo yokulala. Ukugcina, ukubeka nokhusela onke amafayile amacala, baze kuze kubuyekezwke ngomyalezo wakaJaji. Ukubuyekeza amafayile namaxwebhu ukunikeza iikopi zamaxwebhu kuMmeli woBumpetho. Ukwenza ukurekoda ngedijithali iinkqubo zenkundla kumacala apha ngaphaya kwawoamaxesha ajoviwyo kuqinisekiswe integriti yalowo msitho. Ukuhamba noJaji eNkundleni. Ukulawula isithuthi, incwadi yokuhamba kwaye asihambise. Ukuyila iidata, ukulungiselela iingxelo namaxwebhu kaJaji ngoko kufunekayo kuquka iingxelo ezimalini, iinkcukacha ezimalini ezivezwayo nolawulo lemacala. Ukulungiselela iziselo kuJaji nabakhenkethi bakhe ukubakhomkho iimfuno zabo. Ukulawula umthwalo weencwadi kaJaji nokubuyekeza uchazo. Ukwenzela uphando ngomthetho njengoko alayiswe yijaji kwaye athobele onke amagunya, iinkqubo, iingcebiso nemigaqo yesebe.

jobs.title: Administration Officer

af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Besigheidsadministrasie/ Publieke Administrasie of 'n Publieke Bestuur-kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (6) hê soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring insluitend internskap en leerderskap. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Bedrewe in Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik, rekenaarvaardigheid, probleemoplossing, analitiese vaardighede, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, beplanning en organisasievaardighede en toesigvaardighede.
af.duties: Registreer, organiseer, berg, vang en haal korrespondensie en data terug, werk registers en statistieke by, hanteer roetine-navrae, versprei dokumente/pakkette aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis, hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent, tik basiese briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis, hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande register van die komponent, magtig betalings, kwitansies en bevestig deposito's op die BAS-stelsel, verifieer transaksies op die BAS-stelsel, identifiseer verliese binne die kantoor en rapporteer aan die provinsiale kantoor d.w.s. vrugtelose en vermorsde uitgawes, ongemagtigde uitgawes en onreëlmatige uitgawes, stel uitgaweraporte en skenkingsregisters op, verseer behoorlike penaliserings op die transkripsiefakture, verseker gehalte van S&T-kwisings, selfoonkwisings, datakwisings, fakture (betalingstrome), betalingsregister, kwitansies en kwitansieregisters, verseer dat verskaffers op Logis gemagtig word, koppel dat goedere in registers en databasisse vasgelê word, ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers, werk die register van verskaffers by en verseer die onderhoud daarvan, verseer die implementering van Diensvoorwaardes, verseer die implementering van die werwing-, seleksie- en aanstellingsproses in die Hof, monitor die indiening van prestasie-ooreenkomste, jaarlikse assessering en midjaar-hersiening, stel opleidingsbehoeftes op, ondersteun die implementering van die opleidingsplan in die Hof, verseer algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op werknemers, verseer dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse zilandelwe, hlela imibalo yezinkokhelo, bhala imibhalo, gcina izinkokhelo ezakhelwe okungenwayo, ngokwesiko lokuphathwa kwezimali, lungiselela isikhwama samandla asethwe ukuvunyelwa imali esebenza kahle njengoba kudingekile, thumela futhi uqinisekise ngokumqondisa abantu abashukumisa kahle ekunakekelweni kwabo bakuqinisekisa ukuthi imali evunyelwe ukwenza lokho kuyabhalwa, qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezinikeze imali kumaphoyisa azokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ofanele, thumela kubantu abakhokha ngemali yokwenza imali emincane yezinsiza abazisebenzisayo bese benza ukuthi abantu abakhokha ngokusemthethweni kubhalwe ngokuphathwa kwemali ekhokhwayo, hlela kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezingangeniswa ngokusebenzisa amandla okubhalisa kumthetho wokuqinisekisa, thola isicelo sezidingo ezivela kubasebenzisi bokugcina, buyela kabusha bese uqinisekisa ukuthi kubhalwa imibhalo yabahlinzeki, qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezimo Zokusebenza, qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokubuyisa, ukukhetha kanye nokuqasha enkantolo, lawula ukubhaliswa kwezivumelwano sezenzo, ukuhlola unyaka nonyaka kanye nehlolo yasekhathi phakathi nenyanga, hlela izidingo zokufunda, sekele ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lokufunda enkantolo, qinisekisa ukuphathwa okujwayelekile kwabasebenzi, abela imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ikhwalithi emsebenzini owethulwe ngamaphoyisa, lawula iholo lomsebenzi, welule nokuphuma kule nxalenye, uvume imali ehlawulwayo, eyamkelwayo uze uqinisekise nazigciniwe kwindleba ye-BAS, qinisekisa iintengiso kwindleba ye-BAS, chonga ilahleko kwithemputshi uze uchaze ukubekwa kolahleko ngenxaso kumaxwebhu wemali, qinisekisa isimo samagama e-S&T, amagama eselfowuni, amagama oolwazi, iinkosi zentleko (iinqwelakude zentleko), igama lentleko, iinkosi zamkelo kunye namagama okubhalisa iinkosi zamkelo, qinisekisa ukuba abahlinzeki bavunyelwe kwi-Logis, qxhumanisa abahlinzeki naxabiso elichanekileyo nesenzo, qinisekisa iinkcukacha zabahlinzeki kwingxelo ye-CSD, qinisekisa okuqhotyoshelwayo okubekiweyo ngokuvumelana nolwazi oluqinileyo lwendalo nokuveliswa, qinisekisa ukuba izinto zibanjwa kumanani nasoBuchwepheshe bokubhalisa, wamkele izicelo zezinto kubasebenzisi bokusuka, hlaziya uze uqiniseke ukulondoloza igama leBahlinzeki, qinisekise ukusebenza kweemeko zeSebenza, qinisekise ukusebenza kwendlela yokuba nexabiso, ukukhetha nokumiselwa kwindlela eNkantolo, qwalasela ukungenisa kwezivumelwano ngokusebenza, ukulungelelana kweminyaka nokuphononwa kwaphakathi kweminyaka, yenza iimfuno zokulolonga, nceda ukuphumeza icebo lokulolonga eNkantolo, qinisekisa ulawulo olubanzi labasebenzi, wabelane nemisebenzi uze wenze ukuqwalasela ngokomgangatho kwimisebenzi ezelwe ngabasebenzi, lawula iholo labasebenzi, yale uze ukhokise abalawuli ngayo yonke imicimbi yomsebenzi, lawula ukusebenza, indlela nokukrwarha kwabasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi balolongwe baphuhliswe ukuba bakwazi ukuzisa umsebenzi womgangatho ofunwayo ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo, phuhlisa, yenze uze uqwalasele iindendla zomsebenzi nendlela zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuchanekileyo nangempumelelo, phendula imibuzo uze unikele nengcebiso nolwazi ngomisos womafa nokuwolula.

jobs.title: Accounting Clerk
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Division of The High Court: Makhanda
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Accounting clerk sought at the Eastern Cape High Court in Makhanda to handle witness travel bookings, S&T claims and finance payment batches, requiring Grade 12 and PFMA knowledge.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate. No experience required. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and sound understanding of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, BAS, PPPFA guidelines and other related prescripts. Skilled in computer literacy. (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook), accuracy, attention to detail, communication, administration and organisation skills. Along with the following attributes: ability to work under pressure independently, self-motivated and meet deadlines.

Filing, retrieve and safeguard finance payment batches, custodian of the petty cash and assigned a duty of paying ordinary witnesses, expert witnesses and psychologists. Process payments for service provides of Goods and services within the prescribed turnaround time.
