jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals.

af.title: Rekenmeleklerk
af.summary: Rekenmeleklerk gesoek by die Eastern Cape High Court in Makhanda om reisbesprekings vir getuies, S&T-eise en finansiele betalingsgroepe te hanteer, waarvoor Graad 12 en kennis van die PFMA vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en 'n deeglike begrip van die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, BAS, PPPFA-riglyne en ander verwante voorskrifte. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid. (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel en Outlook), akkuraatheid, aandag aan besonderhede, kommunikasie, administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onder druk onafhanklik te werk, selfgemotiveerd en om sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Berei VA26 voor om akkommodasie, motorhuur, pendeldiens en vlugte vir getuies sowel as tydelike amptenare te bespreek, ontvang S & T-eise, selfoon- en data-terugbetalingsiseise vir regters en amptenare sowel as tydelike amptenare. Liasseer, haal terug en bewaar finansiele betalingsgroepe, bewaarder van die klein kontant en toegewys die plig om gewone getuies, deskundige getuies en sielkundiges te betaal. Verwerk betalings vir diensverskaffers van Goedere en dienste binne die voorgeskrewe draaityd.

zu.title: Umkiqheli Wezimali
zu.summary: Kufunwa umkiqheli wezimali e-Eastern Cape High Court eMakhanda ukuphatha ukubhuka kwezokuhamba kwabofakazi, izimango ze-S&T namaphakethe ekukhokhelweni kwezimali, kudingeka i-Grade 12 nenolwazi nge-PFMA.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe nesatifikedi se-Grade 12. Akukho mphilo edingekayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda okuphelele nge-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, BAS, izindlela ze-PPPMA neminye imiyalo ehlobene nayo. Unolwazi ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel kanye ne-Outlook), ukuzelula, ukuqamba iphanga kwimininingwane, ukuxhumana, ukuphatha nokuhlela. Kanye nalezimpawu ezilandelayo: ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwesink esigxile, ukuzigqugquzela nokuhlukaniswa kwesikhathi.
zu.duties: Lungiselela i-VA26 ukubhuka izindlu, ukuqasha izimoto, isevisi yeshuthle kanye namabhangu afakazi kanye nabasebenzi abasheshe, thamatha izimango ze-S & T, izimango zofoni nedatha zabanikazi kanye nabasebenzi kanye nabasebenzi abasheshe. Faka kuyifayili, thola futh uvikele amaphakethe ekukhokhelweni kwezimali, mhlengi wemali encane futh uthunyelwe umsebenzi wokukhokha abofakazi abajwayelekile, abofakazi bachwepheshe kanye nabasabalalasandla. Hlela amakhokhelo abahlinzeka ngamaphakethe kwezimpahla nanye amasevisi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esihleliwe.

xh.title: Mmeli wokuBhala iiNani
xh.summary: Kufunwa mmeli wokubhala iinanı kw Eastern Cape High Court e Makhanda ukuzala ukubhukisha iindlela zohambo lolwanga, iimfuno ze S&T neebatch zentlalutshelo zemali, kufuneka ibe neloqondo le Grade 12 nolwazi ngentlalo yo-Phetha iimali zentlalutshelo (PFMA).
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12. Akukho mfundo yohambo edialweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi neqonda kakuhle ngentlalo yo-Phetha iimali zentlalutshelo (PFMA), iimviswano ye Treasury Regulations, BAS, iindlela zentlalo ze-PPPFA nolunye ulwazi oluhlobene nentlalutshelo. Ukuba nolwazi ekusetbenziseni ikompyutha. (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel nontlalutshelo ka Outlook), ukuchaneka, ukunakela iinkcukacha, unxibelelwano, ulawulo koluntu phakathi kwayo. Kwaye unobunye obuqu obungazisebenzayo: ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo ngokuzimela, ukuzimisela ngokwakho kwaye uhlangabezane namaxesha wokuvala.
xh.duties: Lungiselela i VA26 ukubhukisa iindawo zokuhlala, iintsimu zamakoloyi, iinkonzo zokuhamba ngeenkampani neenqwelo moya zezigqibi zetyala nakulabo abangabasebenzi bexesho, amkele iimfuno ze S & T, namafowuni nentlalo yokubuyisela imali abantu abanikwa ngeenkcukacha, iilali ezifunwa ngaba Judges nakulabo abangabasebenzi bexesho. Ukuhluza imibhalo, ukubuyisa nokhusela iibatchi zentlalutshelo zeemali, ukugcina imali encinci kwaye unikwe umsebenzi wokuhlawula abantu abangagqibekanga, izigqibi ezikumngcipheko nezigqibi ezibhetele abantu abafuna uncedo lokwengqina kwingqondo. Hlengahla iinkonzo ezenziwa ziinkampani ngeentsimu ezihlawula iinkonzo ngelixa elichaziweyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Human Resources Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Middle Management service).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Human Resources Management at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bloemfontein, offering R932,292 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Human Resource Management, Human Resource Training and Development, Public Management, Public Administration, Management Services, Labour Relations or related. A relevant functional experience in the Human Resources Management at a Junior managerial level (Assistant Director equivalent). Valid driver’s licence. Knowledge: Human Resource Management Policies. Human Resources Systems and Procedures. Performance Management. Project Management. Public Service Act, Regulations and Resolutions. Recruitment and Selection Strategies. Code of Remuneration. All Labour Legislations. Code of good conduct in the Public Service. Departmental Policies and Procedures. Batho Pele principles. Human Resource Management Practices and Systems. Skills: Management. Interpersonal. Communication (Verbal and Written). Computer literacy. Negotiation. Presentation. Report writing. People Management. Problem solving. Decision making skills. Working knowledge and experience of PERSAL.
jobs.duties: Manage the Human Resource support services and the implementation of all the Human Resource policies, procedures and relevant prescripts. Manage the effective implementation of recruitment and selection policy and procedures. Manage the effective implementation of Performance Management Policy. Manage the coordination of Human Resource Development interventions and the implementation of Human Resource Development Policies and Programs. Manage the administration of service benefits and leave of staff in the province. Manage the implementation of sound labour relations and matters of mutual interest. Advise line managers and employees on all HRM related matters. Manage subordinates. Plan and allocate work accordingly.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. T Zulu Tel No: (051) 408 7306
jobs.applications: for the position of Deputy Director: Human Resources Management must be emailed to: RecruitBLOEM26-32@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bloemfontein, teen R932,292 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejaar-tertiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Menslike Hulpbron-opleiding en -ontwikkeling, Openbare Bestuur, Openbare Administrasie, Bestuursdienste, Arbeidsverhoudinge of verwant. Relevante funksionele ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur op junior bestuursvlak (ekwivalent van Assistentdirekteur). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Beleide vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Menslike Hulpbronstelsels en -prosedures. Prestasiebestuur. Projekbestuur. Public Service Act, Regulasies en Resolusies. Werwerings- en keuringsstrategieë. Vergoedingskode. Alle arbeidswetgewing. Gedragskode vir goeie gedrag in die Openbare Diens. Departementele beleide en prosedures. Batho Pele-beginsels. Menslike Hulpbronbestuurpraktyke en -stelsels. Vaardighede: Bestuur. Interpersoonlik. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenvaardigheid. Onderhandeling. Voorlegging. Verslagskrywing. Mensebestuur. Probleemoplossing. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Werkende kennis en ervaring van PERSAL.
af.duties: Bestuur die Menslike Hulpbron-ondersteuningsdienste en die implementering van al die Menslike Hulpbron-beleide, prosedures en relevante voorskrifte. Bestuur die effektiewe implementering van die werwerings- en keuringsbeleid en -prosedures. Bestuur die effektiewe implementering van die Prestasiebestuursbeleid. Bestuur die koördinering van Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsintervensies en die implementering van Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsbeleide en -programme. zu.title: Isiphathamandla Esinesibili: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isiphathamandla Esinesibili: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi e Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e Bloemfontein,elinikeza iholo le R932,292 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Itholakala iziqu zesikole samabanga aphakeme eminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa kanye nentuthuko kwabasebenzi, ukuPhathwa KoMphakathi, ukuQashwa koMphakathi, Isevisi zoBuphathi, uBudlelwano Basebenzi noma okuhlobene nalokho. Ukwaziswa okufanele emsebenzini wokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi ezingeni lokuphatha elincane (esilingana nesikhundla sosizo). Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyelwe. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo zokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi. Amasistimu nezinqubo zokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Public Service Act, Izimiso kanye Nezinqumo. Izindlela zokuqasha nokuKhetha. IsiKhodi soMholo. Yonke Imithetho yoBudlelwano Basebenzi. IsiKhodi yokuziphatha okuhle koMphakathi. Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo ze-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Amasu kanye namasistimu okuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi. Amandla: Ukuphatha. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuxhumana (Ngomlomo kanye Nokubhaliwe). Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxoxisana ngokubonisana. Okwethulwa. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla okuthatha izinqumo. Ulwazi lokuqonda kanye nokuqeqeshwa kokuPHEPHEZELA.
zu.duties: Phatha isevisi yokweseka okuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi kanye nokuphatha zonke izinqubomgomo, izinqubo nezinqaso ezithintekayo zokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi. Phatha ngokusebenza kahle izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zokuqasha nokuKhetha. Phatha ngokusebenza kahle IsiNqubomgomo sokuPhathwa kokusebenza kahle. Phatha ukuHleliswa kolwazi oluVeza izinselele ezingeni le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure nokuphatha izinqubomgomo neziNqubo zokuqeqeshwa kanye nentuthuko kwabasebenzi. Phatha ukuPhathwa kwezinzuzo zesevisi kanye nenkululeko yabasebenzi esifundazweni. Phatha ukuphatha ubudlelwano basebenzi obuhle kanye nezindaba ezithinta bonke. Nikela izeluleko kubaphathi bemigqa kubasebenzi ngazo zonke izindaba eziphatheleneokuPhathwa Kwabasebenzi. Phatha labo abungasiwe. Cwangcisa futhi uqobe imisebenzi ngendlela efanele.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo Lwabasebenzi
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo Lwabasebenzi kwiSebe leziZakhiwo zoLuntu nezeNzululwazi eBloemfontein, linika umvuzo we-R932,292 ngonyaka.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Acquisition Management (SCM)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Manage procurement planning and acquisition processes as an Assistant Director in Supply Chain Management at the Cape Town Regional Office.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF Level 06) in Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ or in the relevant field. Relevant years of experience in Supply Chain Management environment with appropriate working experience at supervisory Level. A valid driver’s license. Computer skills in Microsoft Office Applications. Extensive knowledge and working experience in Public Sector procurement process, rules and regulations: PFMA, PPPFA, BBBEE, CIDB, Treasury Regulations Relevant and Supply Chain Management prescripts. Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills; Basic numeracy; Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills; Problem solving skills; Decision making skills; Statistical skills; Computer literacy; Problem solving skills; Presentation skills; Planning and organising skills; Ability to work independently and under pressure. Personal Attributes: Analytical thinking; Innovative; Creative; Resourceful; Ability to work under stressful situations; Ability to communicate at all levels; People orientated; Able to establish and maintain networks; Trustworthy; Assertive; Hard-working; Self- motivated; Ability to work independently. Must be prepared to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Manage the development of the Procurement Plan. Facilitate the approval of Procurement Plan. Communicate the Procurement Plan. Monitor that goods and services is rendered according to the Procurement Plan. Monitor the procurement of goods and services in line with the Procurement Plan. Advice on the performance of procurement in line with the plan. Manage the acquisition of goods and services. Provide and implement supply chain management policy, strategies and processes. Manage the acquisition of goods and service as per the transversal contract and participation contract. Provide and consolidate requests for invitation of quotation. Verify and advice on specifications for goods and services. Analyse the received quotation. Provide approval of received goods as per the specification. Serve in Bid Committees as a member. Monitor the implementation of guidelines for appointment of bid committees. Facilitate the appointment of Bid committee members. Manage logistical arrangements for Bid committee meetings and provide advisory support to Bid Committees. Provide secretariat function to the PBAC. Facilitate and monitor evaluation of bids and quotations. Develop and define processes for bids evaluation. Monitor adherence to advertised criteria in the evaluation process. Facilitate and verify captured information for all bids and quotations. Prepare an evaluation report- submission. Facilitate the clearance of the successful bidders. Customise and implement any changes on standard evaluation criteria. Implement and Oversee Risk and performance management strategies in the Supply Chain Management Unit. Identify and mitigate risks within the Unit. Manage all administrative matters, correspondence and complex enquiries are attended to promptly. Assist in the compiling of monthly SCM performance reports and verification of all monthly SCM reports. Ensure implementation and compliance of the Instruction Notes as issued by National Treasury as well as Departmental SCM Policy. Manage full compliance to all Demand Management, Acquisition Management and Contract Management prescripts, policies, practice notes and delegations of authority. Develop and maintain internal control measures for procurement. Ensure the effective management of Demand, Acquisition and Contract processes. Manage an appropriate response to internal and external auditors, other organs of state and Audit Intervention Plans. Monitor and liaise with CIDB about professionals’/ contractor’s information. Evaluate and monitor performance and appraisal of employees. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage discipline. Provide job description to subordinates. Manage division leave matters.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M Sozombile Tel No: (021) 402 2250
jobs.applications: for the position of Assistant Director: Acquisition Management (SCM) must be emailed to: RecruitCPT26-69@dpw.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlelwa kokuthenga kanye nezinqubo zokuthola njengoba Umqondisi Othunjwayo ekuPhatheni Kwendlela Yokuhlinzeka eCape Town Regional Office.
zu.requirements: Isifundo sezikhathi ezintathu esamuhla (NQF Level 06) kuSupply Chain Management/ Procurement/ noma kwelikhaya elihambisana nalolu. Unyaka weminyaka ophansi yokutholomfundo emkhakheni weSupply Chain Management ongemvume yokusebenza ezingeni lomphathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethsekile. Amakhono ekhompyutha kumisilo yohlelo lweMicrosoft Office Applications. Ulwazi olubanzi kanye nokuqondisisa kokusebenza inqubo, imithetho kanye nezilawuzi zokuthenga kuPublic Sector: PFMA, PPPFA, BBBEE, CIDB, Treasury Regulations kanye nemiyalo ephathelene neSupply Chain Management. Amakhona: Amakhono obulumko nobhalwe okuhle; Izibalo eziyisisekelo; Amakhono aphakeme okuxhumana nobutho; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo; Amakhono ezezibalo; Ukuqonda ukusebenza kwekhompyutha; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okubhukuda; Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele; Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa naphansi kokucindezela. Izici Zomuntu: Ukucabanga okuhlaziwayo; Okususwa okusha; Okubhaqwayo; Okuningi: Ikhono lokusebenza phansi kwezimo ezinobunzima; Ikhono lokuxhumana kuzo zonke izinkomba; Abantu abakhomba ngqo; Ikhono lokukhomba ukuxhumanisa futhi zigcine; Okuthenjwayo; Okuzethemba; Okusebenza kanzima; Okuzimisela ngokwakho; Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa. Kuyadingeka ukube ushukuniswe ukulungise isikhathi sokuqasha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zendawo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kweSu loKuthenga. Lize ukuvumelwa kweSuthu loKuthenga. Yazisa isuthu loKuthenga. Qaphela ukuthi impahla kanye nezevimpi zinikwa ngokuhambisana neSuthu loKuthenga. Qaphela ukuthenga impahla kanye nezinkonzo ngokuhambisana neSuthu loKuthenga. Lule ngokuphumelela kokuthenga ngokuhambisana nesuthu. Phatha okuthiwa impahla kanye nezinkonzo. Hlinzeka ngokuhambisana kwemibhalo yokuhlinzeka ngendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwamanye amaphi, amasu kanye nezinqubo. Phatha ukutholwa kwempahla kanye nezevimpi ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano esidlalwa kuye nangesivumelwano sokubamba iqhaza. Hlinzeka futhi uhlanganise izicelo zokumema izilinganiselo zentengo. Qinisekisa futhi lule ngezilinganiso zempahla kanye nezinkonzo. Hlaziya izilinganiselo ezitholakile. Hlinzeka ngokuvumela impahla ezitholakile ngokuhambisana nezilinganiso. Bamba iqhaza eNkomanini zeBid njengelungu. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kweziluleko zokuqashwa kwabaphathi beBibhobholo. Lize ukuqashwa kwamalungu eBid committee. Phatha izinhlela zezidingo zeBid committee meeting futhi unikeze isixhumanisi eNkomanini zeBibhobholo. Hlinzela ngomsebenzi wokuba ngumabhalane we-PBAC. Liza futhi ukuqaphela ukukalwa kwebhide kanye nezilinganiselo. Phakamisa futhi chaza izinqubo zokukalwa ibhide. Qaphela ukuhambisana nezinkomba ezibhalwe phansi ekukaleni. Liza futhi qinisekisa izinkomba ezibukiwe ezibhalwe phansi zazo zonke izibhidi kanye nesisindo. Hlela umbiko wokukalwa- okulethwayo. Lize ukucaciswa kwabaphumelelo bebhidi. Lungisa futhi sethu inqubo yezinkomba ezijwayelekile zokukalwa. Hlanganyela ngokuphelele futhi qaphela ukuphathwa kweRisk kanye nokuqhathaniswa kwemikwazo e-Supply Chain Management Unit. Hlola futhi ithwale izizi engowonke emkhakheni. Phata yonke imicabango, imibhalo ehlekisana futhi imibuzo ebanzi ihlangatswezwa ngasese. Siza ekubhalweni kwezibiko zomzinyi weSCM kanye nokuhlola konke izibiko zomzinyi weSCM. Qinisekisa ukusethwa kanye nokuhambisana kokuKhunjulwa kwemiyalo ethunyelwe yi-National Treasury nakuzo zonke izinhlelo zika-Supply Chain Management zendawo. Phatha ukuzinza okuphelele kuyo yonke imiyalo, Ukuphathwa Kokufuna nokuphathwa kwesivumelano, kanye nokuphathwa kwesivumelano, imibhalo, imiyalo yesithandaziso namandla okuhamba phambili. Phakamisa futhi gigcina izinkomba zangaphakathi zokulawula ngokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuphelele kwezinkinga zokuThola izinto, ukuthenga, kanye nokuQashwa kwezinkomba. Phendula ngokuhambisana ngokuphelele kubaphathi bongaphakathi nangaphandle, amanye amaphi aphathelene nenqubo kanye nama-Audit Intervention Plans. Qaphela futhi xhumana ne-CIDB ngemibhalo yezazi/ abathwesi bensimbi. Hlaziya futhi qaphela ukuqhathaniswa kanye nokwaziswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa isibalo nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Phakamisa futhi gidwisa ukuzimisela kwabasebenzi futhi ukhulise inqondo yokuphatha kwaziyo. Phatha inqubo yokuqothula. Nikeza umsebenzi ochazayo ohlangothini. Phatha izindaba zeholide zasendaweni.

jobs.title: Administration Officer: Demand Management (SCM)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Administration Officer needed in Cape Town to support demand management and procurement planning, requiring a relevant tertiary diploma and supply chain experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of three-year tertiary qualification (NQF level 06)/ National Diploma in Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/ Public Administration or related. Relevant years of experience in Supply Chain Management within Acquisition Management. Valid Driver’s Licence. Knowledge Of: Thorough knowledge and understanding of government procurement systems and relevant legislation; Supply chain management; Management of databases; PFMA; PPPFA; Supply Chain policies and procedures; Treasury Regulations and BBBEE Acts; Monitoring and evaluation theory and methodology; Monitoring and evaluation systems. Skills: Good verbal and written communication skills; Basic numeracy; Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills; Problem solving skills; Decision making skills; Statistical skills; Computer literacy; Problem solving skills; Presentation skills; Planning and organising skills; Ability to work independently and under pressure. Personal Attributes: Analytical thinking; Innovative; Creative; Resourceful; Ability to work under stressful situations; Ability to communicate at all levels; People orientated; Able to establish and maintain networks; Trustworthy; Assertive; Hard-working; Self-motivated; Ability to work independently. Must be prepared to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Provide admin support in the research and needs analysis for the Department. Provide guidance to End-Users/Project Managers on testing the markets. Lead the process of alignment of budgets with department objectives and Annual Performance Plans. Consolidation of Procurement Plans and report monthly to Head Office. Assist in the consultation with relevant stakeholders to determine challenges, opportunities and risks. Identify the frequency of needs and analyse the identified needs in line with the supply chain strategy and collect data commodity analysis and checking for alternatives. Provide support in the determination and development of procurement proposals for implementation based on the results of the research. Collect and collate information for the Department Annual Procurement Plan, collect information from the relevant units according to the prescribed template. Check and analyse the submitted information, confirm availability of budget. Consolidate the information into procurement plan. Provide support in the process of drafting specifications, advice whether specifications should contain special conditions. Assist in identifying and implementation of preference points system, track all movements of specification and terms of reference submission. Provide an appropriate response to internal and external stakeholders. Provide secretariat support to the relevant Bid Committees. Responsible for Demand, Acquisition and Contract Management. Ensure full compliance to all Acquisition, Demand Management and Contract Management prescripts, policies, practice notes and delegations of authority. Develop and maintain internal control measures for procurement. Ensure the effective management of Demand, Acquisition and Contract processes. Compile and consolidate the Demand Management Plan, Acquisitions Management and Contract Management reports. Coordinate input in the Demand Management Plan. Ensure that procurement is in line with the approved Demand Plan. Ensure effective utilisation of the CSD. Manage acquisition including BID administration. Assist in compilation of Terms of reference, Specifications and Bid Documents. Provide secretariat support to the BID committees and provide the administrative duties during the tender/bid briefing sessions. Provide assistance in the review of the scope of the Terms of Reference (TOR). Assist with the monitoring of validity period of closed tenders. Assist in the co-ordination and execution of the bidding process. Arrange and attend bid Evaluation committee meeting. af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Vraagbestuur (TOB)
af.summary: Administrasiebeampte benodig in Cape Town om vraagbestuur en verkrygingsbeplanning te ondersteun, wat 'n tersiêre diploma en ervaring in voorsieningskettingbestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum driejarige tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF level 06)/ Nasionale Diploma in Supply Chain Management/ Procurement/ Public Management/ Public Administration of verwant. Relevante jare ervaring in Supply Chain Management binne Acquisition Management. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van: Deeglike kennis en begrip van staatsverkrygingstelsels en relevante wetgewing; Supply chain management; Bestuur van databasisse; PFMA; PPPFA; Supply Chain-beleide en -prosedures; Treasury Regulations en BBBEE Acts; Monitering en evalueringsteorie en -metodologie; Moniterings- en evaluatingstelsels. Vaardighede: Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Basiese geletterdheid in syfers; Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Besluitnemingsvaardighede; Statistiese vaardighede; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Voorleggingsvaardighede; Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede; Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Persoonlike eienskappe: Analitiese denke; Innovatief; Skeppend; Hulpbronneffektief; Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer; Mensgerig; In staat om netwerke te vestig en te onderhou; Betroubaar; Selfversekerd; Ywerig; Selfgemotiveerd; Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Moet bereid wees om werkskedule aan te pas in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in die navorsing en behoeftesontleding vir die departement. Verskaf leiding aan Eindgebruikers/Projekbestuurders oor die toetsing van markte. Lei die proses van belyning van begrotings met departementele doelwitte en Annual Performance Plans. Konsolidasie van Procurement Plans en verslag maandeliks aan Head Office. Bystand verleen in die raadpleging met relevante belanghebbendes om uitdagings, geleenthede en risiko's te bepaal. Identifiseer die frekwensie van behoeftes en ontleed die geïdentifiseerde behoeftes in ooreenstemming met die voorsieningskettingstrategie en versamel data kommoditeitsontleding en soek na alternatiewe. Verskaf ondersteuning in die bepaling en ontwikkeling van verkrygingsvoorstelle vir implementering gebaseer op die resultate van die navorsing. Versamel en kollasioneer inligting vir die Department Annual Procurement Plan, versamel inligting van die relevante eenhede volgens die voorgeskrewe sjabloon. Kontroleer en ontleed die ingediende inligting, bevestig beskikbaarheid van begroting. Konsolideer die inligting in 'n verkrygingsplan. Verskaf ondersteuning in die proses van die opstel van spesifikasies, adviseer of spesifikasies spesiale voorwaardes moet bevat. Bystand verleen aan die identifisering en implementering van voorkeurpuntstelsel, volg alle bewegings van spesifikasie en terms of reference-indiening. Verskaf 'n toepaslike reaksie aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Verskaf sekretariaatondersteuning aan die relevante Bid Committees. Verantwoordelik vir Demand, Acquisition en Contract Management. Verseker volle nakoming aan alle Acquisition, Demand Management en Contract Management voorskrifte, beleide, praktysnotas en magtigings van gesag. Ontwikkel en onderhou interne beheermaatreëls vir verkryging. Verseker die effektiewe bestuur van Demand, Acquisition en Contract-prosesse. Stel op en konsolideer die Demand Management Plan, Acquisitions Management en Contract Management-verslae. Koördineer insette in die Demand Management Plan. Verseker dat verkryging in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde Demand Plan is. Verseker effektiewe benutting van die CSD. Bestuur verkryging insluitend BID-administrasie. Bystand verleen by die opstel van Terms of reference, Specifications en Bid Documents. Verskaf sekretariaatondersteuning aan die BID-komitees en verskaf die administratiewe pligte tydens die tender/bid-kortingsessies. Verskaf bystand in die hersiening van die omvang van die Terms of Reference (TOR). Bystand verleen met die monitering van geldigheidsperiode van geslote tenders. Bystand verleen in die koördinering en uitvoering van die bodproses. Reël en woon bid Evaluation committee-vergaderings by. Bestuur van die bid-prosesse en verseker effektiewe funksionering van alle Bid Committees. Bestuur en effektiewe benutting van Transversal Contracts en Participation contracts aan staatsorgane. Bestuur die proses van die bekom van kwotasies. Verse behoorlike dokumentbeheer en dokumentasie. Implementeer en hou toe sig op Risk and performance management strategieë in die Supply Chain Management Unit. Identifiseer en verminder risiko's binne die Unit. Verseker dat alle administratiewe aangeleenthede, korrespondensie en komplekse navrae onverwyld behartig word. Bystand verleen by die opstel van maandelikse SCM-prestasieverslae. Opstel/verifikasië van alle maandelikse SCM-verslae. Verseker implementering en nakoming van die Instruction Notes soos uitgereik deur National Treasury asook Departmental SCM Policy.

zu.title: Inqabheli Wezokuphathwa: Ukuphathwa Kwezidingo (SCM)
zu.summary: Ifuna inqabheli wezokuphathwa e-Cape Town ukuxhasa ukuphathwa kwezidingo nokuhlela uthole izinto ezidingekayo, kudinga idiploma yezemfundo ephezulu ehambisana nokuthi ube namava ekuphathweni kwensindiso.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwesidanga sezemfundo ephezulu seminyaka emithathu (NQF level 06)/ National Diploma ekuphathweni kwensindiso/ Ukuthola izinto ezidingekayo/ Ukuphathwa komphakathi/ Ukuphathwa Kwabalingwa Bombuso noma okuhlobene. Unyaka othile wamava ekuphathweni kwensindiso ngaphakathi kokuphathwa kokuthola izinto. Ilayiseni yokuqasha elisebenzayo. Ulwazi Ngakho: Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda izimiso zokuthenga zikahulumeni nomthetho ohambisana nalawo; Ukuphathwa kwensindiso; Ukuphathwa kwezibalo ezihlanganisiwe; PFMA; PPPFA; Izinqubomgomo nokuqondiswa kwensindiso; Imlawulo yesikwama senceku nemithetho ye-BBBEE; Inqubo nenkundla yokuqapha nokuhlola; Izimiso zokuqapha nokuhlola. Amakhono: Amakhono ahle okuxhumana okusho ukukhuluma nokubhala; Ukubala okuyisisekelo; Amakhono aphezulu okuxhumana nabantu nobuhlakani obuphakathi; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo; Amakhono ezibalo; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okubonisa; Amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba; Ikono lokusebenza nodwa naphansi kwenkcuva. Izici Zomuntu: Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; Okusha; Okudalayo; Onamandla okuziphethe; Ikono lokusebenza ezimeni ezinenkcuva; Ikono lokuxhumana kumazinga onke; Abantu abakhethekile; Ukukwazi ukwaksha futhi ulondoloze uhlalo; Othembekayo; Oqinile; Osebenza kanzima; Oziz激励; Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa. Kufanele ulungele ukuhlengahlengise isikhathi somsebenzi ngokwezidingo zehhovisi.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yokuphathwa kocwaningo nokuhlaziya izidingo kumnyango. Nikeza inkombandlela kubasebenzisi bokugcina/Abaphathi Baphrojekthi ngokuhlola imimakethe. Hola inqubo yokuqondanisa amabhajethi nemigomo yomnyango nokuhlela Ukusebenza Kwamnyaka wonke. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokuthenga futhi umbike nyanga zonke eNtshonalaho Khaya. Siza ekubonisweni nabalingane abahlobene ukuthola izinkinga, ithuba kanye namazinga. Chaza isilinganiso sezidingo futhi uhlaziye izidingo ezitholiwe ngokwezinqubomgomo zensindiso futhi uqoqe idatha yokuhlaziya izinto bese uhlola okunye okungenwa. Nikeza inkxaso ekwenzeni futhi ukuthuthukiseni izinketho zokuthenga ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokweziphumela zocwaningo. Qoqa futhi uqondanise ulwazi lekhawa leNyanga Yomnyango Yomnyango Yokuthenga, qoqa ulwazi kwamayunithi ahlobene ngokohlobo olumisiwe. Hlola futhi uhlaziye ulwazi olunikeziwe, qinisekisa ukutholakala kwebhajethi. Hlanganisa ulwazi ohlelweni lokuthenga. Siza kwenqubo yokuqamba izinqamuleli, welule ukuthi izinqamuleli kufanele zibe nezimo ezikhethekile. Siza ekuqapheni futhi ekusebenziseni izimiso zamaphuzu okukhethwa, landela konke ukunyakaza kwezinqamuleli nokuthunyelwa kwesixhumanisi sezinkomba. Nikeza impendulo ehambisana kubalingane bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikeza inkxaso yesekeli kumakomidi okukhethwa ahlobene. Uxanduva lokuphathwa kwezidingo, ukuthenga kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkomishi. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa okuphelele kwayo yonke inqubo yemiyalo yokuthenga, yokuphathwa kwezidingo nokuphathwa kwezinkomishi, izinqubomgomo, izaziso zokwenza kanye namandla okwabelwa.uthuthukise futhi ulondoloze izinyathelo zokulawula ngaphakathi kokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezidingo, ukuthenga futhi izinganiso zokuthengisa kwezinkomishi. Hlela futhi uhlanganise iPhulo Lokuphathwa Kwezidingo, imibiko yokuphathwa kokuthenga nokuphathwa kwezinkomishi. Hlanganisa okufakiwe ePhulweni Lokuphathwa Kwezidingo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga kuhambisana nePhulo Lokuthenga elamunywa. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwe-CSD. Phatha ukuthenga kuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwe-BID. Siza ekuhleleni kokuqamba izixhumanisi, Izinqamuleli kanye namadokhumenti e-BID. Nikeza inkxaso yesekeli kumakomidi e-BID futhi unikeze imisebenzi yokuphathwa phakathi kwezinkomba/amasessoni wokwaziswa ngephrojekthi. Siza ekuhlweni komkhawulo wezixhumanisi eziphathwa (TOR). Siza ekuqapheni isikhathi sokuqina sezinkomba ezivaliwe. Siza ekuhlanganiseni nokwenzeni inqubo yokuqasha. Hlela futhi ubambe ihhoho lokuhlola iqembu lokukhethwa. Ukuphathwa kwenqubo yokuqasha futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okuhle kwawo wonke amakomidi okukhethwa. Ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinkomishi eziqondene nezinkomishi zohlelo kumzimba kahulumeni. Phatha inqubo yokuthola izinkomba. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa okufanele kwamadokhumenti. Sebenzisa futhi uqaphele Izinqubomgomo zokuqapha nokusebenza ekuqaphweni kwensindiso. Chaza futhi unciphise izingozi ekuqapheni kwensindiso. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibuzo yokuphathwa, izincwadi ezihlobene futhi imibuzo eqakambekayo iphendulwa masinya. Siza ekuhleleni imibiko yamanyanga yezimo yokusebenza ye-SCM. Uhlela/kuqinisekiswa yonke imibiko yamanyanga ye-SCM. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa nokulandelwa kwesaziso esimisiwe sikazwelonke kanye nenqubomgomo ye-SCM Komnyango.

xh.title: IOfisa Kolawulo: ulawulo lwesicelo (SCM)
xh.summary: Kufuneka iOfisa Kolawulo eCape Town ukuxhasa ulawulo lwesicelo nokuqamba izicwangqiso zokuthenga, kudingwa idiploma yesimemo esifanelekileyo kunye namava ekulawulweni kwentambo yokuhambisa
xh.requirements: Isigqebhezulu sesimemo seemyaka emithathu (NQF level 06)/ National Diploma ekulawulweni kwentambo yokuhambisa/ ekuthengweni/ ekulawulweni koluntu/ kulawulo loluntu okanye into enjalo. Iimvo zomnyaka ezifanelekileyo zemava kulawulo lwentambo yokuhambisa ngaphakathi kolawulo lokufuna. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngokuqonda: Ulwazi oluqonde kakhulu nokuqonda iinkqubo zokuthenga kurhulumente nalo mthetho othe ngqo; ulawulo lwentambo yokuhambisa; ulawulo lweziseko zeenkcukacha; PFMA; PPPFA; iinkqubo namagama alawulo lwentambo yokuhambisa; iZikhululo zeMali kunye neMithetho ye-BBBEE; ingcamango nendlela yokulinganisela nokuqonda; iinkqubo zokulinganisela nokuqonda. Amakhono: Amakhono amabalawuli obomi athuthuze kakhulu; Isibalo esisisiseko; Amakhono aphakamileyo obudlelwane bobuntu nobudiplomasi; Amakhono okuxazula iingxaki; Amakhono okwenza izigqibo; Amakhono ezoBalo; Ukufunda nokubhala iakhompyutha; Amakhono okuyalela iingxaki; Amakhono okubonisa; Amakhono okucwangqisa nokuhlela; Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukucinga ngokwahlukana; Okutsha; Okuyilo; Onamandla; Ikhono lokusebenza kwiimeko ezinxilileyo; Ikhono lokunxibelelwana kuzo zonke iinqanaba; Abantu babhekisele kubo; Bakwazi ukwakha kwaye agcine uqhagamshelo; Othembekileyo; Oqinileyo; Oseregayo; Ozigqatsa ngokwakhe; Ikhono lokusebenza ngokwakhe. Kufuneka alungiselele ukulungelelanisa umaxheshe wamava ngokuvumelana nemfuno zofisi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwiphando nandlalatho yezidingo zeSebe. Nika isikhokelo kubasebenzisi bokugqibela/Baqambi iiprojekthi ekuvavanyeni iimarike. Yiba ngowokuqala kwinkqubo yomiselo oqondo nemigqibo yeSebe kunye neNdalo yokuQamba iNkqubo yeMinyaka yokuQamba. Dudela iNdalo yokuThenga uze uxele ngenyanga eNtloko uKqubo. Yiba ncedo kwingxoxo nabanomdla ukumisela iingxaki, ithuba kwaye nayingozi. Qinisekisa ukungaliphinda kwemfuno uze uhlalutye iimfuno ezifunyenwe ngokumisela nesu lokulawula intambo yokuhambisa uze uqokele iindatha njengalawulo lokwahlukanisa amagadi uze ujonge ezinye iindlela. Nika inkxaso ekumiseleni nasekuphuhlisweni kwezicwangqiso zokuthenga ezingenwa kusetyenziswa iziphumo zendalo. Qokelela uze udwelise ulwazi kwiNdalo yeSebe yoKuthenga yoMnyaka, qokelela ulwazi kumacandelo amangayo ngokwemveliso emisiweyo. Hlola uze uhlalutye ulwazi luthunyelwe, yaqinisekisa ukubakho kweMali. Duda ulwazi kwinkqubo yokuThenga. Nika inkxaso ekuqambeni iinkqubo, yenceba ukuba iinkqubo kufuneka zibe neemfuno ezizodwa. Nceda ekuboniseni nasekuzelelweni kwenkqubo yamaphawu okukhetha, landela yonke imiba yeinkqubo nemibuzo ekuhambiseni iinkqubo namagama ekuqambeni kwaye athunyelwe. Nika impendulo efanelekileyo kubanomdla bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lolulo kumakomiti afanelekileyo eBidi. Yiba yin tabatha iNkqubo yeMfuno, yokuzula uLawulo lweNtsatifiso. Qinisekisa ukuzithobela ngokupheleleyo kuzo zonke iNkqubo, uLawulo lweMfuno noLawulo lweNtsatifiso, iinkqubo, iindaba zomthetho kunye neendlela zokusebenza. Qamba uze ugcine iindlela zolawulo zangaphakathi zokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenzayo iNkqubo yeMfuno, ukuzula kwaye iNkqubo yentsatifiso. Hlela uze uduele iNdalo yoLawulo lweMfuno, ukuzula uLawulo lweNtsatifiso neNdaba yoLawulo lweNtsatifiso. Hlanganisa igalelo kwiNdalo yoLawulo lweMfuno. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuthenga kuyaqonda kwiNdalo yeMfuno evunyelweyo. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa iCSD. Lawula ukuzula kubandakanya ulawulo lweBidi. Nceda ekudweliseni kwamagama eNkqubo, iNkqubo uye namaxwebhu eBidi. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lolulo kwamakomiti weBidi uze unike izicwangqiso zolawulo ngelixa leziga zamaxesha abaxwayi. Nika inkxaso ekuhlolweni kommandla weenkqubo namagama. Nceda ekujoliseni ixesha elisebenzayo leetenda ezivaliweyo. Nceda ekuyilweni nasekuzeni iinkqubo zokuqamba. Hlela uze uzibandakanye kwindibano yeKomiti yoLawulo lweBidi. Lawulo lweenkqubo zeBidi uze uqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokusebenzayo kuzo zonke iKomiti zeBidi. ULawulo nokusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo iNkqubo zeTransversal kunye noLawulo lokuNgena kwiindlu karhulumente. Lawula inkqubo yokufuna izicelo. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluchanekileyo lwamaxwebhu namaxwebhu. Zulisa uze ulawule iNdaba yoxinzelelo nokuLawula imigaqo yemisebenzi ekuLawulweni kweNtambo yoKuhambisa. Bonisa uze unciphise iingozi ngaphakathi kweCandelo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imiba yolawulo, unxibelelwano nemibuzo ebithe ngcono inyathelwe ngokukhawuleza. Nceda ekudweliseni iindaba zeminyaka yemisebenzi yeSCM. UkuHlela/ukuQinisekisa yonke iNdaba yeminyaka yeSCM. Qinisekisa ukuzalisekiswa nokuzithobela kweNkqubo nokuzelelwa njengoko zikhutshwa yiNtlalo yaseLuntu uza nalaye nendlela yeNkqubo yeSCM yeSebe.

Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. Important: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Arbeidsverhoudingsbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte benodig vir arbeidsverhoudingsbestuur by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure-hoofkantoor in Pretoria.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende bestuur van dokumente; Ontvang, registreer en ken 'n verwysingsnommer toe aan ontvangse korrespondensie. Ondersoek roetine-voorleggings/verslae en maak notas en/of aanbevelings vir die bestuurder. Doen opvolg op verwysde korrespondensie/voorleggings. Stuur alle korrespondensie uit. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle dokumentasie in die kantoor in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en beleid. Verskaf insette, stel sameen en stel verslae op, bv. vorderingsverslae, maandelikse verslae en bestuursverslae. Versamel, analiseer en stel inligting wat deur die bestuurder versoek word, saam. Verseker dat reëreling vir reis goedgeskoord is. Bestuur die verlofregister en telefoonrekeninge vir die eenheid. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die bestuurder met betrekking tot vergaderings; ondersoek dokumente om vas te stel watter aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir vergaderings benodig word. Versamel en stel alle nodige dokumente vir die vergaderings saam. Neem notules/besluite op en kommunikeer dit na relevante rolspelers; doen opvolg op vordering gemaak. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings wanneer nodig. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van die rekords; Onderhou die Arbeidsverhoudings-register van ontvangse korrespondensie. Onderhou afskrifte van alle dokumente wat geproduseer is, voorafgaande aan versending. Onderhou 'n doeltreffende en goed gestruktureerde stelsel vir die indien van dokumente. Verseker klassifikasie van inligting, kantoor-aankoopbehoeftes en betaling van diensverskaffers.

zu.title: Inkantili Yozobo Izomgangatho: Ukuphathwa Kwezomgangatho Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkantili yozobo izomgangatho yokuphathwa kwezomgangatho zabasebenzi enkantini eliyinhloko le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Pretoria.
zu.duties: Nika ukuphathwa okuyimpumelelo kwemibhalo; Thola, bhalisa futhi nikeza inombolo yenkomba ephephandleni etholiwe. Hlola izinhlelo zokusebenza/izibiko ezijwayelekile futhi ube izinhlaka nokuhinde imibuzo. Landela bese Uphendula ephephandleni/izinhlelo ezithunyelwe. Thumela wonke amaphephandla. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusekela ezomgangathweni. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuphepha kwawo wonke amabhala enkantini ngokuhambisana nomthetho nezinqubomgomo ezifanele. Thola okufakiwe, qoqa futhi uhlele izibiko, njeng. izibiko zeqophelo, izibiko zanyanga zonke nezibiko zokuphatha. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uqoqele ulwazi oluceliweumphathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokuhamba zihleleke kahle. Phatha irejista yokushiya izikhathi namaseshini efoni yeqenjana. Nikeza usizo kumphathi mayelana namaphimbo, hlola imibhalo ukuze anqume izinyathelo/ulwazi/ezinye imibhalo edingekayo phambanaphimbo. Qoqa futhi uhlelelawonke imibhalo edingekayo phambilikwamaphimbo. Qopha izinqumo bese uyazindulisakubanomthelela, ulandelezelelentochenziwe. Hlela izinhlelo zokulogistics zamaphimbo ngenkudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuyimpumelelo nokusebenza kahle kwamarekhodi; Gcinairejista Yokuziphendulela phambilikwemibhaloyotholwa. Gcina izikopiezawonke amabhalo akhiqiziwe, ngaphambukokuza ukuthumela. Gcina izinhlelo zokugcina izincwadi ezisebenza kahle futhi ezakhiwekahle. Qinisekisa ukubhekiswa kolwazi, izidingo zokuthengwa kwempahla enkantini nokukhokhelwa kabanikezela besebenza.

xh.title: Ofisa Oluphatha Iinkqubo: Ulawulo Lwezabasebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneka ofisa oluphatha iinkqubo kulawulo lwabezabasebenzi kwiofisi enkulu yesebe le Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e Pretoria.
xh.duties: Nika ulawulo olusebenzayo lemibhalo. Thatha, bhalela kwirejista yonwabelele isalathiso kumabhalo afunyenweyo. Hlola iinkethiso zemihla ngemihla/iingxelo zenze amagqabantshintshi nengecebiselo lomlawuli. Landela umkhondo emabhalweni/inkethisweni ekuqhubiswa kwenye indawo. Thumela onke amabhalwana anelayela. Khothaza iinkonzo zolawulo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokhuseleko kwamabhalo wonke kofisini ngokwemithetho neenkqubo ezifaneleyo. Landa okuveliswa, qamba idibanise iingxelo ezinjengokuba ziiingxelo zentuthuko, iingxelo nyanga ngenyanga nedingxelo yolawulo. Qokelela, hlola uqamba ulwazi oluceliweyo ngumlawuli. Qinisekisa ukuba izicwangciso zohambo zihleliwe kakuhle. Lawula irejista yamalungu afikiweyo namanqaku efowuni yeqembu. Nikela inkxaso kumlawuli ngokumayelana namagqabantshintshi, hlola imibhalo ukuze umise izinyathelo/ulwazi/eminye imibhalo efunekayo kwamagqabantshintshi. Qokelela uqambe onke amabhalo afunekayo kwamagqabantshintshi. Bhala amaminithi/izigqibo azidlayazelele kubathathi inxaxheba abalungileyo, landele inkqubela entlei. Hlela izicwangciso zengqamano kwamagqabantshintshi xa kufunwa. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusemthethweni kwababali, gcina irejista yokulawulo lwabezabasebenzi yamabhalo afunyenweyo. Gcina ikopi yamabhalo onke aqambiweyo, phambi kokuthumela. Gcina inkqubo egcweleyo efakelweyo yokugcina imibhalo. Qinisekisa ukwahlulwahlula kolwazi, iimfuno zokuqeshwa kofisi nentlawulo yabaphathi beenkonzo.

jobs.title: Director: Business Intelligence, Economic Analysis and
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Director of Business Intelligence and Economic Analysis at the Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and 5 years' managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate and an advanced diploma or undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Economics / Econometrics / Business Analytics / or equivalent as recognised by SAQA. NQF level 8 in the same disciplines / Master’s degree will be an added advantage. Possess a minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience at a middle/senior managerial level within an economic research, model analysis and forecasting-related environment. Experience in managing a research unit, coordination of research work within an institution and among research stakeholders, gathering of research or intelligence to inform programme and policy design, hosting research events such as conferences/summits, creation of research partnerships with research institutions, development of a research agenda and management of a knowledge management hub. Knowledge of the Public Service Legislative Framework and Digital collaboration platforms, Econometrics / Econometrics. A compulsory pre-entry into the Senior Management Service Certificate from the National School of Government will be required before assumption of duty (https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme). Display competencies in Strategic Capability & Leadership, Financial Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, People Management and Empowerment, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Change Management, Service Delivery Innovation and Communication.
jobs.duties: Set and drive the Small Business Development Portfolio research agenda to support sector economic analysis, policy development, and strategic decision- making, including the identification of priority research areas and alignment with national and departmental objectives. Lead and oversee economic research, modelling, forecasting, and scenario analysis through the application of advanced econometric methodologies and digital tools, including assessing the impact of policy options and economic shocks on growth, development indices (statistical indicators), and MSME sustainability. Produce and deliver high-quality research and business intelligence outputs, including publications, policy briefs, and analytical insights on MSME performance and sector trends, to inform evidence-based decision-making. Coordinate and manage MSME- focused research initiatives and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders, including academia, industry, and research institutions, to strengthen the research ecosystem and leverage collaborative insights. Provide strategic advisory services to senior management and policymakers by integrating data-driven insights and research evidence into policy, strategy, programme design, and decision-making processes. Manage knowledge systems and ensure effective dissemination of research and sector information, including the development and maintenance of a central research repository, the use of digital platforms (e.g., dashboards, portals, automated reporting systems), and enabling data accessibility and interoperability across stakeholders, including a centralised access point for MSMEs. Manage the Directorate’s operations and its financial, human, and physical resources in compliance with applicable legislation, governance frameworks, and public sector regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Enquiries for this post should be directed to Mr. Maanda Ndou at 072 242 6245/Ms. Nthabiseng Mahlangu at 072 197 7511
jobs.applications: The Department of Small Business Development is committed to the pursuit of diversity and redress, and appointment will be in line with the DSBD EE Plan. Candidates must submit applications to recruitment4@dsbd.gov.za and quote the reference number for the abovementioned position on the subject line (email) when applying i.e., “REF NO: D – BIEA&E OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a recent comprehensive CV. Submission of copies of qualifications, Identity document, and any other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All non-SA citizens will be required to submit proof of permanent residence in South Africa when shortlisted. Personnel suitability checks will be done during the selection process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. In the pursuit of diversity and redress, appointments will be made in line with the DSBD EE Plan. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. The Department reserves the right not to fill or withdraw any advertised post. Note: a new application for employment (Z83) form is applicable from 01 January 2021. The new form can be downloaded online at http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Besigheidsintelligensie, Ekonomiese Analise en
af.summary: Direkteur van Besigheidsintelligensie en Ekonomiese Analise by die Department of Small Business Development in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en 5 jaar bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat en 'n gevorderde diploma of voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Ekonomie / Ekonometrie / Besigheidsanalise / of gelykwaardig soos deur SAQA erken. NQF vlak 8 in dieselfde dissiplines / 'n Meestersgraad sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Beskik oor 'n minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak binne 'n ekonomiese navorsing, modelanalise en voorspellingverwante omgewing. Ervaring in die bestuur van 'n navorsingseenheid, koördinering van navorsingswerk binne 'n instelling en onder navorsingsbelanghebbendes, die bymekaarmaak van navorsing of intelligensie om program- en beleidsontwerp in te lig, die aanbied van navorsingsgebeure soos konferensies/berade, die skep van navorsingsvennootskappe met navorsingsinstellings, die ontwikkeling van 'n navorsingsagenda en die bestuur van 'n kennisbestuurshub. Kennis van die Wetgewende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens en Digitale samewerkingsplatforms, Ekonometrie / Ekonometrie. 'n Verpligte voor-toetrede tot die Senior Management Service Sertifikaat van die National School of Government sal voor die aanvaarding van diens vereis word (https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme). Toon bevoegdhede in Strategiese Vermoe en Leierskap, Finansiële Bestuur, Probleemoplossing en Analise, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Veranderingsbestuur, Diensleweringinnoviasie en Kommunikasie.
af.duties: Stel en dryf die navorsingsagenda van die Small Business Development Portfolio om sektor-ekonomiese analise, beleidsontwikkeling en strategiese besluitneming te ondersteun, insluitend die identifisering van prioriteitnavorsingsareas en belyning met nasionale en departementele doelwitte. Lei en hou toezig oor ekonomiese navorsing, modellering, voorspelling en scenario-analise deur die toepassing van gevorderde ekonometriese metodes en digitale instrumente, insluitend die assessering van die impak van beleidopsies en ekonomiese skokke op groei, ontwikkelingsindekse (statistiese aanwysers) en MSME-duursaamheid. Produseer en lewer hoëgehalte-navorsings- en besigheidsintelligensie-uitkomste, insluitend publikasies, beleifsopsommings en analitiese insigte oor MSME-prestasie en sekortendense, om getuigskrifgebaseerde besluitneming te bevorder. Koördineer en bestuur MSME-gefokusseerde navorsingsinisiatiewe en vennootskappe met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend akademie, industrie en navorsingsinstellings, om die navorsingsekosisteem te versterk en samewerkende insigte te benut. Verskaf strategiese adviesdienste aan seniorbestuur en beleidmakers deur datagedrewe insigte en navorsingsbewyse in beleid, strategie, programontwerp en besluitnemingsprosesse te integreer. Bestuur kennistelsels en verseker effektiewe verspreiding van navorsings- en sektorinligting, insluitend die ontwikkeling en onderhoud van 'n sentrale navorsingsbewaarplek, die gebruik van digitale platforms (bv. dashboards, portale, outomatiese verslagdoeningstelsels) en die moontlik maak van data-toeganklikheid en interoperabiliteit tussen belanghebbendes, insluitend 'n gesentraliseerde toegangspunt vir MSMEs. Bestuur die Direktoraat se bedrywighede en sy finansiële, menslike en fisiese hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, bestuursraamwerke en openbare sektor regulatoriese vereistes.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukuhlakanipha Kwamabhizinisi, Ukuhlaziwa Kwezomnotho Nokuhlakanipha Kwebhizinisi
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokuhlakanipha Kwamabhizinisi Nakuhlaziwa Kwezomnotho eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 7 kanye namava eminyaka yonke yokuqashwa njengomenzipathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Esiphezulu nediploma ethuthukisiwe noma iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiqu (i-NQF level 7) kwezomnotho / I-Econometrics / Ukuhlaziwa Kwamabhizinisi / noma okulinganayo njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. I-NQF level 8 kulezi zifundo / I-degree ye-Master izoba yinzuzo ekungeziwe. Ukuze ube okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yamava ahambelanayo ezingeni lomenzipathi ophakathi/omkhulu endaweni ehlobene nocwaningo lwezomnotho, ukuhlaziwa kwemodeli nokubikezela. Amava okupatha iyunithi yocwaningo, ukuhlanganisa umsebenzi wocwaningo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo nakubaphathi bocwaningo, ukuqoqa ucwaningo noma ukuhlakanipxa ukuze kuqondise ukwakhiwa kuhlelo kanye nomthethosisekelo, ukubamba imicimbi yocwaningo njengesiqongqothi / izifundazwe, ukudala ubudlelwano bocwaningo nezikhungo zocwaningo, ukuthuthukisa lolu hlela locwaningo nokuphatha isikhungo sokuphatha ulwazi. Ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho Lomnyango Kahulumeni kanye namaphulatifomu wokusebenza ngokubambisana ngokwe-dijithali, I-Econometrics / I-Econometrics. Isitifikedi esiyisinyenzelo sokungena ku-Senior Management Service esivela kwi-National School of Government sizodingeka ngaphambi kokuthatha umsebenzi (https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme). Kuboniswe ukuzakhela amandla kokuqonda nokuhanisa kobuchwepheshe, Ukuphatha Izimali, Ukuxazulula Izinkinga Nakuhlaziya, Ukuphatha Abantu Nokubanika Amandla, Ukuqonda Ithuba Lemikhiqizo Kwaye Uqaphele Izingxoxo, Ukuphatha Iinguquko, Ukuthuthukiswa Kokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo Nakuxhumana.
zu.duties: Hlela futhiqhube phambili lolu hlela locwaningo lwe-Small Business Development Portfolio ukuze useke ukuhlaziwa kwezomnotho zesigaba, ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho kanye nokuqoka izinqumo ezicishe zibambe iqhaza, okuhlanganisa nokuqoqa izindawo zocwaningo eziphambili kanye nokuqondanisa nezinhloso zezwe kanye nezomnyango. Qhaza futhi ulawule ucwaningo lwezomnotho, ukumila, ukubikezela, kanye nokuhlaziwa kwezenzo ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezithuthukisiwe ze-econometric namathuluzi we-dijithali, okuhlanganisa nokuhlola imiphumela yamathuba yemithetho kanye nokushocka komnotho kumkhando, ekuthuthukisweni kwama-index (izinkomba ezenzwe nge-statistical), kanye nokuqina kwe-MSME. Kwakha futhi wethule imikhiqizo yocwaningo nokuhlakanipha kwamabhizinisi yomgalingandise, okuhlanganisa nokushicilelwa, izinqumo zemithetho, kanye nokuhlakanipxa ukuhlaziwa ngemikhiqizo yabantu ekusebenzeni kwabo ngendlela yesaba kanye nokuqonda okubonakalayo ukuze kuqonde ukwenza izinqumo. Hlanganisa futhi ulawule ukusingathwa kocwaningo oluhambisana ne-MSME kanye nokuqonda nemigangatho yabantu abaphakathi nakubaphandle, okuhlanganisa nendawo yezemfundo, imboni, nezikhungo zocwaningo, ukuze kusizakale ulwandle lolwazi futhi kusetshenziswe konke ukubonisana. Lethe izinkonzo zokuqondisa ngokobuchule ezingeni eliphezulu labaphathi kanye nabakhiqizi ngokuhlanganisa ukwaziswa okuyisidingo kanye nolwazi olwaziswa ngokuhlukanisa izinsiza ngokomthetho nangokwenqubo. Uphathe izinhlelo zolwazi futhi uqiniseke ukusakaza okusebenzayo kolwazi ngocwaningo nakwesigaba, okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukisa nokuqinisa indawo egcwele ngocwaningo ebalulekile, ukusetshenziswa kwamaphulatifomu we-dijithali (isb., amadashibhodi, amapothali, izinhlelo zokubika ezenza bodwa), kanye nokwenza ukuvuleka kolwazi kanye nokusebenza kokuqukethwe phakathi kwabahlengikazi, okuhlanganisa nesixazululo esilodwa samaswidiya amamayelana ne-MSME. Lawula imisebenzi ye-directorate kanye nezimali, abantu, kanye nezinsiza zomzimba ngokuvumelana nomthethosisekelo ohambisanayo, imigangatho yokuphatha, nezimfuneko zolawulo zesigaba sikahulumeni.

xh.title: Um lawuli: I-Business Intelligence, Economic Analysis and
xh.summary: Umlawuli we-Business Intelligence kunye no-Nohlalweyo oQhubekayo kwi-Department of Small Business Development ePretoria, efunayo isifundo se-NQF 7 kunye neminyaka emi-5 yamava obugcisa bobulawu.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate kunye ne-advanced diploma okanye isifundo se-undergraduate (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwi-Economics / Econometrics / Business Analytics / okanye esingulinganiselo njengoko ivunywa yi-SAQA. Inqanaba le-NQF 8 kule minyaka elifanayo / i-Master's degreeiya kuba yingozi elungileyo. Kufunke ube nomava ongaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 ekubeni msebenzi ohambelanayo kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphakathi/oluphezulu kwindawo enamanxulumene nophando olwezoqoqosho, uhlalutyo lwemodels, kunye nokubikeka okutsha kusasa. Amava ekubeni ngumlawuli wenkcumcha yophando, ulungelelwaniso komsebenzi wophando ngaphakathi kwesikhululo naphakathi kwabathathi-nxaxheba bophando, ukuqokelela uphando okanye ulwazi ukuze lunike isalathiso ekuyileni kwinkqubo kunye neyengcaciso. Ukubamba iimpakhamba zophando ezinjengeemvumelwano/ziqendu, udalwa lweehungu zophando kunye neziqendu zophando, kuphuhliswe kwindawo yophando kunye nokulawula indawo yolawulo lwolwazi. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Legislative Framework kunye namaplatifomu abumbeko we-Digital, i-Econometrics / Econometrics. Isatifikethi esinyanzelekileyo sokungena ngaphambili kwi-Senior Management Service esuka kwi-National School of Government siza kufuneka phambi kokuba kuqalise umsebenzi (https://thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme). Makubonakale ukuzinza ekubeni namandla kokuQonda-Strategic kunye noBukhosi, kuLawulo lweMali, ekuxazululeni iingxaki nasekuhlalutyeni, ekuLawuleni abaBantu nasekuBanikeni amandla, ekuQondisweni kwiKlayenti nasekuqwalaselweni iNtengiselwano, ekuLawuleni iThshintsho, ekuYileleni inkonzo eNtsha kunye noNxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Misela uze uphuhlisе indlela yophando ye-Small Business Development Portfolio ukuze uxhase uhlalutyo lwezoqoqosho lwesicawa, uphuhliso lwengcaciso, kunye nokuthatha izigqibo ezingamabala, kuquka ukuchonga iindawo zophando ezibalulekileyo nokuqamba ngokwemigqaqo yezizwe kunye nensele zesebe. Qhuba uze ulawule uphando lwezoqoqosho, ukwakhiwa kwemodels, ukubikezela, nokuhlalutya iimeko ngokusetyenziswa kweendlela ezithuthuzayo ze-econometric kunye nezixhobo ezahlukeneyo, kuquka ukuhlalutya impembelelo yokukhethwa kweengcaciso kunye neenguqu zezoqoqosho ekukhuleni, kumacandelo eziqondanayo (izalathiso ezibalulekileyo), nakwisimo sokuzinza kwe-MSME. Khupha uze unikeze iimveliso zophando olukumgangatho ophezulu kunye ne-business intelligence, kuquka iimpapasho, iingcaciso zengcaciso, nokuqonda okuhlalutyo ngemisebenzi ye-MSME nemitshila yesicawa, ukuze unike isalathiso ekuthatheni izigqibo ezingekho phezulu kodwa ezisekelwe kubungqina. Lungalelanisa uze ulawule iinkqubo zophando ezijolise kwi-MSME kunye neehungu nezinye iinqunube zangaphakathi nangaphandle, kuquka izikolo eziphakamileyo, amashishini, neenkcumcha zophando, ukuze undise ulwandle lwophando uze usebenzise ulwazi olubumba. Nikela ngenkonzo yokucebisa ngezicwangciso kubalawuli abaphezulu kunye nabalawuli beengcaciso ngokudibanisa ulwazi olusekelwe kumanani nobungqina bophando kwingcaciso, isicwangciso, ukuyilelwa kwenkqubo, nakwiinkqubo zokuthatha izigqibo. Lawula iinkqubo zolwazi uze uqiniseke ukusasazwa okusebenzayo kophando nolwazi ngemimandla yemvelaphi, kuquka uphuhliso nogcino lwendawo ebalulekileyo yophando, isetyenziswa kweplatifomu ze-digital (njengamadashboard, amaportal, iinkqabo ezizenzekelayo zokubika), nokwenza amanzi ukufikelela kumanani nokusasazwa kwawo phakathi kwabathathi-nxaxheba, kuquka nendawo ekufikelela kuyo konke ekuqanjwe ngamnye kwi-MSME. Lawula imisebenzi yeDirectorate nemicimbi yayo yemali, yabantu, nezixhobo ezingabonakaliyo ngokwemigqaqo yemithetho esetyenziswayo, iinkqubo zolawulo, nemiqathango yomgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lwesicawa.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Demand & Acquisition Management – (BID
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for demand and acquisition management in the Department of Small Business Development, requiring a bachelor's degree and three years' supply chain experience.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor’s Degree (NQF7) in Supply Chain Management / Procurement / Financial Accounting / Financial Management / Contract Management / Purchasing Management or equivalent/related as recognised by SAQA. A postgraduate degree in the above-mentioned will be an added advantage. 3 years related experience in supply chain management (demand and acquisition and bid administration) environment on supervisory level. Job- related knowledge: SCM legislation, policies and procedures, PFMA, Treasury Regulations and PPPFA, Demand and acquisition management processes, Bid administration and competitive bidding processes, Procurement planning, contract management and SCM compliance, Risk management, governance and internal controls. Job-related skills: Analytical and problem-solving skills, Communication and report-writing skills, Stakeholder management and negotiation, Leadership, planning and organisational skills, Computer literacy and proficiency in MS Office 365. Job competencies: Communication (verbal and written), Project Management, Financial Management, Client orientation and customer focus, Problem solving and analysis, Contract Management and Attention to detail. Additional: B/EB Driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Supervise employees to ensure an effective demand and acquisition management service and undertake all administrative functions required with regard to financial and HR administration. Coordinate (synergise), review, research, analyse and plan the procurement needs of the department. Coordinate review, collect and collate information for the annual procurement plan. Supervise and compile tender/quotation specifications as required. Develop, implement and maintain supplier database. Coordinate (synergise), review and execute the bidding process. Coordinate, review and compile the list of prospective providers for quotations and source quotations from the database according to the threshold values determined by the National Treasury. Communicate with stakeholders, Written: Draft general (basic to complex) correspondence such as response letters, emails, status reports, presentations, memos, and submissions, and verbal: Give detailed/comprehensive / in depth advice on procedural and technical related matters in respect of supply chain management (Demand and Acquisition and Bid Acquisition) policies and procedures to ensure compliance.
