af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur – (BID
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir vraag- en verwerwingsbestuur in die Department of Small Business Development, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en drie jaar se ervaring in voorsieningskettingbestuur vereis.
af.requirements: A Bachelor's Degree (NQF7) in Supply Chain Management / Procurement / Financial Accounting / Financial Management / Contract Management / Purchasing Management or equivalent/related as recognised by SAQA. A postgraduate degree in the above-mentioned will be an added advantage. 3 years related experience in supply chain management (demand and acquisition and bid administration) environment on supervisory level. Werkverwante kennis: SCM-wetgewing, beleide en prosedures, PFMA, Tesourieregulasies en PPPFA, vraag- en verwerwingsbestuursprosesse, bodadministrasie en mededingende bodprosesse, verkrygingsbeplanning, kontrakbestuur en SCM-nakoming, risikobestuur, bestuur en interne kontroles. Werkverwante vaardighede: Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede, belanghebbende-bestuur en onderhandeling, leierskap, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid en vaardigheid in MS Office 365. Werksbevoegdhede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur, kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus, probleemoplossing en analise, kontrakbestuur en aandag aan detail. Addisioneel: B/EB-bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur werknemers om 'n doeltreffende vraag- en verwerwingsbestuursdiens te verseker en onderneem alle administratiewe funksies wat ten opsigte van finansiële en HR-administrasie vereis word. Koördineer (sineriseer), hersien, doen navorsing, ontleed en beplan die verkrygingsbehoeftes van die departement. Koördineer hersiening, versamel en bondel inligting vir die jaarlikse verkrygingsplan. Bestuur en stel tender/kwotasiespesifikasies soos vereis op. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou die verskaffer-databasis. Koördineer (sineriseer), hersien en voer die bodproses uit. Koördineer, hersien en stel die lys van voornemende verskaffers vir kwotasies op en verkry kwotasies vanuit die databasis ooreenkomstig die drempelwaardes wat deur die National Treasury bepaal word. Kommunikeer met belanghebbendes, Skriftelik: Opstel van algemene (basiese tot ingewikkelde) korrespondensie soos antwoordbriewe, e-posse, statusverslae, aanbiedings, memorandums en voorleggings, en verbaal: Verskaf gedetailleerde/omvattende / diepgaande advies oor proseduruele en tegniese verwante aangeleenthede ten opsigte van voorsieningskettingbestuur (Vraag en Verwerwing en Bodverwerwing) beleide en prosedures om nakoming te verseker.

zu.title: Umndlaleli weSikhulu: Ukuphathwa Kwesidingo Nokuqoqwa – (BID
zu.summary: Umndlaleli wesikhulu sokuphathwa kwesidingo nokuqoqwa kuMnyango weNtuthuko yoezigxobo ezincane, ofuna iziqu ze-bachelor kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava yokuhlinzeka kwezinsiza.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor (NQF7) ekuPhathweni Kwesonto Samabhodwe Nokuthengisa / Ukuqoqwa / Izezimali Nokubhala / Ukuphathwa Kwezimali / Ukuphathwa Kwezinkontileka / Ukuphathwa Kokuthenga noma okulinganayo / ohlobene njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. I-postgraduate degree kuleyo ebuzwe ngenhla kuzoba yinzuzo ekwedlulele. 3 years related experience in supply chain management (demand and acquisition and bid administration) environment on supervisory level. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: umthetho we-SCM, izinqongo zomthetho neziyalezo, i-PFMA, Iziyalezo ze-Treasury ne-PPPFA, inqubo yophathwa lwesidingo nokuqoqwa, ukuphathwa kwabunikazi bamathenda nokuqashelwa kwamathenda amncintisana, ukuhlelwa kokuthenga, ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka nokuhambisana ne-SCM, ukuphathwa kengozi, ukubusa nokulawula ngaphakathi. Ukuziphatha komsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngokuthethwa nokubhalwa), Ukuphathwa Kwamaphrojekthi, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, ukuzinikela kwayisebenzelayo nokugxila kumthengi, Ukusombulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukuphathwa Kwezinkontileka nokunaka imininingwane. Okwengeziwe: Ilayisensi yokushayela B/EB.
zu.duties: Qaphela abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukukhonza okunempilo ekuphathweni kwesidingo nokuqoqwa wenze yonke imisebenzi eyadingekayo yomphathi ehlobene nokuphathwa kwezimali ne-HR. Hlanganisa (qondanisa), hlola, ucwaninge, hlaziya uphendule futhi uhlele izidingo zomnyango zokuthenga. Hlanganisa ukuhlola, qoqa uce imelelolwazi ngehlelo lokuthengisa ngonyaka. Qaphela bese uhlanganisa izinkomba zamathenda / izikhipho ezidingekayo. Bula, fakele ngempatha bese ulondoloza isisekelo seenjini ezibambe iqhaza. Hlanganisa (qondanisa), hlola bese uphumeza inqubo yokuthengisa ngamathenda. Hlanganisa, hlola bese uhlanganisa uhlu lwabanikazi abangaba khona ngezikhipho ubuye uzuze izikhipho ezisisekelini ngokwamagugu okulinganiswa akuqunywe yi-Treasury Kazwelonke. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli, Okubhaliwe: Bhala ukuxhumana okuvamile (okusukela esilulekeni esincane kuya kwesingconono) njengamagama okuphendula, ama-imeyili, imibiko yesimo, okuwethulo, okukhunjuzwayo, nezithumelo nokuthethwa: Yisulu elinemininingwane / elibi yidwala nangokujulile ngemayelana nezindaba ezinhlobene nokuqondiswa nobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni kwesonto samabhodwe (Ukuphathwa kwesidingo nokubamba iqhaza Bamathenda) izinqongo zomthetho neziyalezo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthobela imithetho.

Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono ohlalutyo nokusombulula iingxaki, Amakhono eNkathazo nokuBhala iiRipoti, ukuLawula abaNikeli bexesha nokuqhagamshelana, ukuQondisa, ukuCwangcisa nokuBumba iNkqubo, ukuQonda iKhompyutha nokuziphumezelela kwi-MS Office 365. Ukuziphumezelela kwomsebenzi: iNkathazo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), ukuLawula uMsebenzi, ukuLawula iMali, ukuQondisela kumXhasi nokugxila kumXhasi, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, ukuLawula iiNkontraxi nokuQwalasela iinkcukacha. Lungelelanisa (qondanisa), qwalasela, phando, hlalutya ucwangcise iimfuno zokuthenga zesebe. Lungelelanisa qwalasela, qokelele uze udibanise inkcazelo yocwangciso lokuthenga lonyaka. Qondisa uze udibe iinkcazelo ze-tender/iikhwoti ezifunekayo. Phuma, zenze uze ugcine isiseko seenkcukacha zabathengisi. Lungelelanisa (qondanisa), qwalasela uze uphumeze inkqubo yebid. Lungelelanisa, qwalasela uze udibe uluhlu lwabahlinzeki abanokuthumela iikhwoti uze ufune iikhwoti kwisiseko seenkcukacha ngokwamaxabiso amlinganiswo abekiweyo leNqanaba leSizwe leSikolo. Thetha nabahlinzeki abaxhasa ixesha, Ngokubhaliweyo: Bhala iNkcazelo yonke (esisisiseko ukuya kwingozi) enjengeempendulo zamanxibelelwano, i-imeyile, iiripoti zemo, ipezenteyishini, iimemo nokuNgeniswa, nangomlomo: Nika inkcazelo ecacileyo/eqondileyo / enzulu ngemiba yolawulo nangenkcukacha ngokwemithetho yamacebo okulawula iNtengiso (isicelo nokuThenga nokuThengisa ibid) amacebo nolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana.

Lola futhi uqinisekise ukugcinwa ngokulungile kanye nokukhuselwa kwamadokhonda ezimali. Lola futhi ulole ukutholwa nokuphathwa kwemali esandleni. Qinisekisa ukucutshungulwa ngokwesikhathi kwezinkokhelo zabathengisi kanye neholo loMnyango. Qinisekisa izinkokhelo zezimali ezibhalwe. Sula ama-akhawunti okumiswa. Lawula uze uqinisekise igqabi elifanele nolondolozo lwamaxwebhe abalo. Lawula uze ulawule ukuqokelelwa kolawulo lemali ngokuthe ngcembe. Qinisekisa ukucwangqiswa ngexesha elifanele kwentlawulo yabathengisi nokuqhutywa komvuzo wesebe. Lawula uze unike inkxaso yokugcina iisazisi. Qinisekisa ukucwangqiswa ngexesha elifanele kwentlawulo yabathengisi nakuqhutywa komvuzo wesebe. Qinisekisa iintengiselwano zemali ezithunyelwe. Susa i-akhawunti ezibambe. af.title: Administratiewe Assistent
af.summary: Administratiewe Assistente word in Pretoria benodig om lêerstelsels en dokumentvloei vir die Commission on Khoi-San matters te bestuur, met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n sekretariële sertifikaat as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n sertifikaat in Office Management/Secretarial Studies met ten minste een (1) jaar ervaring in kantoorbestuur en administrasie. 'n Post-Matric-kwalifikasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kernbevoegdhede: Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings). Eerlikheid en integriteit. Beplanning en organisering. Telefoonetiket. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Kantoorbestuur en administrasie, sekretariële funksies en algemene administrasie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende pligte uitvoer: Ontwikkel en bestuur 'n doeltreffende lêerstelsel en vloei van dokumente vir die Kommissie: Ontvang en versprei dokumente aan lede van die Kommissie oor Khoi-San-aangeleenthede. Resepteer dokumente in die toepaslike registers. Lêer en bestuur die dokumentasie van die Kommissie. Stel doeltreffende dokumentopsporingstelsels in werking. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan die Kommissie: Koördineer en berei dokumentasie vir die Kommissie se vergaderings/ werkswinkels/openbare verhore en uitreike voor. Stel agenda's, bywoningsregisters, notule en verslae op. Opstel memorandums en enige ander korrespondensies soos deur die Sekretariaat of Kommissie aangewys. Bestuur die dagboeke van die Kommissie, Bevorder doeltreffende dagboekkoördinering. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste: Reël logistiek en verwante aktiwiteite vir reis, vergaderings, werkswinkels, openbare verhore en konferensies. Bestuur die telefoon- en kommunikasiestelsels in die kantoor. Koop en bestel stasie en toerusting. Bestuur voorraad en toerusting binne die kantoor. Maak afskrifte, faks en e-pos dokumente soos vereis.

zu.title: Umncedisihlalo Omncane
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedisihlalo omncane ePretoria ukuphatha izinhlelo zokulondoloza amafayela nokuphakamiswa kwamadokhumenti eKhomishani yezindaba ezithinta amaKhoi-San, kudingwa ibhodi le-Grade 12 nesitifiketi sokuba ngummeli kahulumende.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye nesitifiketi ekuphathweni kohhovisi/ezifundweni zokuba ummeli kahulumende nobunye unyaka (1) owodwa wemvelo yokusebenza ekuphathweni kohhovisi nokolawulo. Ikhwalifayeshini ethathwa emva kwe-Matric izoba yinzuzo engezelelwe. Amakhono abalulekile: Ukuqondiswe kukhasimende nokuqwalasela abathengi. Ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqhathaniswa). Ukuqinisekiswa nokuzithiba. Ukwenza izinhlelo nokuhlela. Indlela yokuthinta abantu ngentengo. Ulwazi lwegciwane lekhompyutha. Amakhono okusebenza ngociko: Ukuphathwa kohhovisi nokolawulo, imisebenzi yokuba ngumunyameli kahulumende nokulawula ngokuvamile.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelelayo uzoba nesibopho sokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha ngempumelelo indlela yokulondoloza amafayela nokuphakamiswa kwamadokhumenti eKhomishani: Ukuthola nokusabalalisa amadokhumenti kubalulele khona ekubhekeni noma ekuvuleni icala elithinta amaKhoi-San. Ukubhalisa amadokhumenti kumarejista ahambisana nendima yawo. Ukulondoloza nokuphatha amaphepha eKhomishani. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezisebenza kahle zokuqapha amadokhumenti. Ukunikeza izinsiza zokuphathwa komsebenzi mayelana nokuba ngumunyameli kahulumende: Ukubhalisa nokulungiselela amadokhumenti okulethwa emihlanganweni/yimikhakha yomsebenzi/ezindleleni zokuzwa imibono yomphakathi nakulabo abasuki kunyakathe. Ukwenza isikhathi somhlangano, izinkomba zokubhalisa, amaminithi kanye nemibiko. Ukubhala imibhalo noma yikuphi okunye okuqhamuka ngokuhambisana nesiqondiso sikaNhlalo-oyedwa noma seKhomishani. Ukuphatha izinsuku zokwenza imisebenzi eKhomishani, ukugqugquzela ukubambisana okuhle kwezinsuku. Ukunikeza izinsiza zokuphathwa komsebenzi olawuziwe: Ukulungiselela izimpahla nezinye izinto ezihambisana nezinsuku, imihlangano, imikhakha yomsebenzi, ukuzwa imibono yomphakathi nasemihlanganweni yamakhonferensi. Ukuphatha izinsimbi zocingo nezinhlela zokuxhumana kohhovisi. Ukuthenga nokufuna amasese kanye nezinsimba ezidingekayo ohhovisi. Ukuphatha izimpahla kanye nezinsimba zohhovisi. Ukwenza amakhophi, ukuthumela ngefeksi noma nge-imeyili amadokhumenti njengoba kudingekile.

xh.title: Umncedisi Wezolawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumncedisi wezolawulo ePretoria ukulawula iinkqubo zogcino lwamafayile nokuhamba kwamaxwebhu kwi-Commission on Khoi-San matters, kufuneka abe ne-Grade 12 kunye nesatifikethi zabakhalipha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Grade 12 okanye isimiso esalinganayo esongezelelwe nesatifikethi kwi-Office Management/Secretarial Studies nobunyani ngaphezulu komnye (1) unyaka wamava wolawulo lofisi nolawulo. Isimiso esingaphezulu kwe-Matric sizakuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Amaphulu asemontweni: Ukwukhathalela abathengi nogqaliselo kubathengi. Unxibelelwano (elibhalwayo noluthethwayo). Inyanisekelo nobuzabalazo. Uculucululo nokuququzelela. Izikhelo zocingo. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha. Amaphulu obuchwephesha: Ulawulo lofisi nolawulo, imisebenzi yabakhalipha nolawulo jikelele.
xh.duties: Umthunywa ophumeleleyo uza kwenza le misebenzi ilandelayo: Ukuyila nokulawula inkqubo ephumeleleyo yogcino lwamafayile nokuhamba kwamaxwebhu kwi-Commission: Ukamkela kunye nokusasaza amaxwebhu kumalungu e-Commission on Khoi-San matters. Ukubhalisa amaxwebhu kumagama alungelelanisiweyo. Ukugcina nokulawula amaphepha e-Commission. Ukuseka iinkqubo ezisebenzayo zokulandela amaxwebhu. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zomcedisi kwi-Commission: Ukulungelelanisa nokulungiselela amaxwebhu okunxibelelwano/njinji zokuqeqesfa/veringulo zikawonke wonke kunye nezindaba zangaphandle eze-Commission. Ukudibanisa amagenda, amagama okubhalisa, amaminithi neengxelo. Ukubhala iimemo nanaxwebhu onke anikwa ngumceli-mangcolo okanye i-Commission. Ukulawula iidaresi eze-Commission, Ukukhuthaza ulungelelwaniso olusebenzayo lweedaresi. Ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zolawulo: Ukulungelelanisa amasentabisento kunye nemisebenzi edibaneyo yokuhamba, iintlanganiso, iindawo zokusebenzela, izindaba zikawonke wonke kunye namaqela. Ukulawula iinkqubo zocingo nontxibelelwano ofisini. Ukuthenga nokuyalela izixhobo zokubhala neempahla. Ukulawula izinto ezikhoyo namacebo ofisini. Ukwenza amakhophi, ukuthumela ngefeksi nakunxibelelwano lwamaxwebhu njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Data Capturer
jobs.salary_text: R201 093 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: The Department of Traditional Affairs seeks a data capturer in Pretoria with a Grade 12 certificate and at least one year of data capturing experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level 4 with at least one (1) year experience in data capturing and/or data management. Knowledge and experience in MS EXCEL and ACCESS. Ability to capture data and collect statistics. A post-Matric qualification will serve as an added advantage. Core competencies: Job knowledge. Interpersonal relations. Flexibility. Teamwork. Communication (verbal and written). Technical Competencies: Advanced computer literacy. Typing proficiency. Report writing. Planning and organising.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will perform the following duties: Capture data from available records into required formats e.g databases, tables, spreadsheet. Maintain data quality. Verify, query missing data and errors observed during data entry. Review and validate all data from the records. Ensure data backups. Update registers and statistics. Keep and maintain records and files. Ensure records and files are properly sorted and secured. Provide secretarial and administrative support to the Commission.
jobs.enquiries: Ms RS Mogaladi Tel No: (012) 065 3450
jobs.applications: Applications may be posted to: Directorate: Human Resource Management, Department of Traditional Affairs, Private Bag X22, Arcadia, 0083 or Hand deliver to: 509 Pretorius Street, Arcadia, 2nd Floor Pencardia 1 Building, Pretoria or email DTARecruit202622@cogta.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.notes: Youth and Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The successful candidate’s appointment will be subject to a security clearance process and the verification of educational qualification certificates. Applications must quote the relevant reference number and must be completed on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service department and signed when submitted. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. af.title: Datavasvanger
af.summary: Die Department of Traditional Affairs soek 'n datavasvanger in Pretoria met 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en ten minste een jaar se datavasvangervaring.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 4 met ten minste een (1) jaar ervaring in datavasvang en/of databestuur. Kennis en ervaring in MS EXCEL en ACCESS. Vermoë om data vas te vang en statistiek te versamel. 'n Post-Matric-kwalifikasie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kernbevoegdhede: Werkkennis. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Tegniese bevoegdhede: Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid. Tikvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende pligte uitvoer: Vang data uit beskikbare rekords vas in die vereiste formate, bv. databasisse, tabelle, sigblaaie. Handhaaf datakwaliteit. Verifieer, bevraagteken ontbrekende data en foute wat gedurende datavaslegging waargeneem word. Hersien en valideer alle data uit die rekords. Verseker databrugkopieë. Dateer registers en statistiek by. Hou en handhaaf rekords en lêers. Verseker dat rekords en lêers behoorlik gesorteer en beveilig is. Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Kommissie.

zu.title: Umqambi Wolwazi
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezwe Bezamasiko ufuna umqambi wolwazi ePretoria onegwadu le-Grade 12 nangezinjaqobo zonye unyaka wokuhlangenwe nakho ekubeni umqambi wolwazi.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezisingathweni se-NQF level 4 ezinamageza angu-(1) wonyaka wokuhlangenwe nakho ekubeni umqambi wolwazi nasekuphathweni kolwazi. Ulwazi nokuqashelwa ekusebenziseni i-MS EXCEL ne-MS ACCESS. Ikono lokwabiya ulwazi nokuqoqa izibalo. Isitifikedi esingemuva kwe-Matric sizobe siba yinzuzo ekwedlulelayo. Amandla abalulekile: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi. Izindinganiso zabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza ndawonye. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangesibhalwe). Amandla obuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisana khompyutha ngokuqhubekayo. Ukubhala ngokushesha ngobuchwepheshe. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo.
zu.duties: Lowo ophumelelayo uzobe enza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuqamba ulwazi osukwini olutholakalayo abe selukwatshwa kwizindlela ezidingekayo njengezokusingathwa kolwazi, izitafula, namaspredshithi. Ukugcina ikhwalithi yolwazi. Ukuqinisekisa, ukubuza ngolwazi olushodiwe namaphutha abonwayo ngesikhathi kufakwa ulwazi. Ukubuyeza futhi uqinisekise wonke ulwazi osukwini. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcina emuva kolwazi. Ukubuyeza izinkomba nezibalo. Ukugcina futhi uphathe amarekhodi namafayela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi namafayela acocekile ahlelwe kahle aphephile. Ukunika ukwesekwa ngokobonini kwezobhalo eKomishini.

xh.title: Umhliki wenkqobo zolwazi
xh.summary: Isebe lezoZezimvelo lifuna umhliki wenkqobo zolwazi e Pretoria ongesiqinisekiso se-Garde 12 anemo onyakeni ochokozeleyo kukuhlolwa kwenkqobo yolwazi.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-Garde 12 okanye isiqu esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 4 sinemo onyakeni ochokozeleyo (1) kokuhlolwa kwenkqobo yolwazi nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ulwazi noluvo lwe-MS EXCEL ne-ACCESS. Ulwazi lokuhlolwa kwenkqobo yolwazi nokuqokelela izibalo. Isiqu esingaphezu koMatric sizakubakho yinto encedisayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ubudlelwane nabaninziwa. Ukuhleluka. Umsebenzi wothimba. Unxibelelwano (olwemilomo nolwebhali). Ulwazi oluthe ngqo ngemisebenzi: Ulwazi oluphakamileyo lwekhompyutha. Ukuziphatha ekubhaleni. Ukwabhala iireport. Ucuqaplano nolungiselelwaniso.
xh.duties: Umama ogqibileyo uzakwenza le misebenzi ilandelayo: Ukuhlola inkqobo yolwazi ekuqokelelweni olukhoyo kwiindlela eziyimfuneko ezinjengedatabases, iitafile, spreadsheet. Ugcinzelela umgangatho wenkqobo yolwazi. Ukuqinisekisa ekubeni kubuzwe inkqobo yolwazi elahlekileyo neziphoso ezelelwe ngenkathi kungeniswa inkqobo yolwazi. Ukuqwalasela ukuqinisekisa zonke inkqobo yolwazi ezikuqokelelweni. Ukuyiqinisekisa i-data backups. Ukubhala iirejista nezibalo. Ugcinzelela ukuqokeleleka lwezinto aze azigcine. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ezihlwayiweyo zigcinwe zingathunyelwanga kwaye zikhuselekile. Ukuze ukhothekelele ngolondolozo ngolawulo oluqinileyo.

jobs.title: Messenger/driver

af.title: Bode/bestuurder
af.summary: Die Department of Traditional Affairs soek 'n bode en bestuurder in Pretoria met 'n Graad 10-sertifikaat, 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 10-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig (NQF level 3). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vyf (5) jaar se bestuurservaring. Algemene Bevoegdhede: Kommunikasie, vermoë om te lees en te skryf, goeie gesigskerpheid. Teamwerk. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Bedryf van toerusting. Fisiese ondersoek van voertuig en interpreter van instruksies vir behoorlike gebruik van alle kontroles vir veilige bedryf van voertuie. Interpret en volg van bedryfshandleidings, instandhoudingshandleidings en diensgrafieke.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende pligte verrig: Vervoer van werkspanne, dokumente, materiaal/toerusting. Op spoor en herstel van klein meganiese probleme aan die voertuig en stappe doen om dit te laat herstel (kontroleer vlak en toestand van olie, brandstof, bande en water). Ondersoek van die voertuie/toerusting en rapporteer van gebreke. Voltooi van voertuiglogboek, ritmagtiging vir die voertuig.

zu.title: Umthumeli/umshayeli wesithuthi
zu.summary: Umnyango we-Traditional Affairs ufuna umthumeli kanye nomshayeli wesithuthi e-Pretoria onegesi lethu le-Grade 10, ilayisensi yokushaya isithuthi evumelekile kanye namakhulu eminyaka emihlanu okushaya isithuthi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo se-Grade 10 noma esilinganayo (NQF level 3). Ilayisensi yokushaya isithuthi evumelekile. Emikhulu emihlanu (5) yeminyaka yokushaya isithuthi. Iziqu eziyisizinda: Ukuxhumana, ikhono lokufunda nokuqamba. Ukubona kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukusebenza njengaqoqo. Iziqu eziyisiko: Ukusebenzisa izinto zokusebenza. Ukuhlola ngokomzimba isithuthi bese kuhunyushwa imiyalo yokusetshenziswa kwansonzonzo zokulawula ngendlela ephephile yokusebenza kwezithuthi. Ukuhumusha bese kulandelwa izincwadi zokusebenza, izincwadi zokulungisa kanye namashadi ezenzo zokukhonza.
zu.duties: Ophumeleleyo uzokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuthutha amaqoqo abasebenzi, amafayela, izinto zokusebenza. Ukuthola bese kulungiswa izinkinga ezincane zezinylakathi ezithuthini bese kuthathwa izinyathelo zokulungiswa (ukuqola izinga nalesimo kawoyela, amafutha, amatayara namanzi). Ukuhlola izithuthi/izinto zokusebenza bese kukwebwa izono. Ukugcwalisa incwadi yokulandisa isithuthi, igunya lokuhamba ngesithuthi.

xh.title: Umthunywa/umqhubi
xh.summary: Isebe leZoBucala lifuna umthunywa nomqhubi ePretoria onesimalidati yesigaba se-10, ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo namashumi eminyaka emihlanu yamava okuqhuba.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sesigaba se-10 okanye esilinganayo (inqanaba le-NQF 3). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egqithisiweyo. Imihla emihlanu (5) yamava okuqhuba. Iakhono ezijulilezo: Unxibelelwano, ikhono lokufunda nokubhala Ukuze kukhangeleke kakuhle amehlo. Ukusebenza njengqela. Iakhono ezobuchwepheshe: Ukusebenzisa isixhobo. Ukuhlola ngokomzimba isithuthi nokutolika iimiyalelo ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwezonqulo zonke ukuze kuqhubwe ngokhuselekileyo izithuthi. Kutolikwe zilandele iincwadi zokuqhuba, iincwadi zokuhlengwa namashadi konkekonke.
xh.duties: Umphumlile ophumeleleyo uza kwenza lemisebenzi ilandelayo: Ukuthutha amaqela asebenzayo, amaxwebhu, izinto/izixhobo. Kufunyanwe kulungiswe iingxaki ezincinci zomzimba wezithuthi kuthathwe izigaba ezizezi zilungiswe (kuhlolwe inqanaba nolimo lwamafutha, iodini, amatayara namanzi). Kuhanjiselwe izithuthi/izixhobo kutyhilwe iingxaki. Qedwa incwadi yokugqitha isithuthi, igunya lokuhamba lesithuthi.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant: Recruitment and Selection
jobs.summary: Administrative assistant needed for recruitment and selection in Pretoria, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification in HR, public management or administration.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 6 in Human Resource Management / Human Resource Development/ Public Management / Administration / Industrial Psychology with no working experience. Knowledge and skills: Exposure to the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Exposure to the Recruitment and Selection policy and prescripts, Exposure to Human Resource Practices and Procedures, problem solving, project management, interpersonal relationship, policy analysis and development, computer literacy and co-ordination and organizing.

jobs.title: Director: Debt Issuance and Management
jobs.summary: Director role at National Treasury in Pretoria managing government debt issuance and borrowing strategy in domestic and international capital markets.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum Bachelor’s. degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Economics or Finance or Actuarial science or Commerce or Investment Management or International Economics pertaining to the money and capital markets. A minimum 5 years’ experience obtained at a middle or senior management level in financial markets operations. Knowledge and experience of different research methodologies. Knowledge and experience of market analyses related to information for utilisation in the broader business. Knowledge and experience of dealing with various foreign interest rate markets and currencies. Experience in qualitative and quantitative summarisation or analysis of domestic and foreign debt reports. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Finance borrowing requirement in domestic and international capital markets: Develop and implement a domestic and foreign borrowing strategy for the National Treasury. Initiate the issuing of government securities in the domestic and international capital markets. Implement benchmark bonds in the domestic and international capital markets. Determine the finance measures of government’s borrowing requirements in the domestic and international capital markets. Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and implement tools that will improve the investor base. Develop and implement an investor website to improve stakeholder engagement. Engage domestic and foreign investor stakeholders, through road shows and other mediums. Develop relationship with stakeholders like banks, domestic and foreign investors and engage lawyers on certain conditional requirements. Disclose listing requirements in domestic and offshore bond issuance: Assist with compiling the annual Initiate the annual filing process of the 18K form with foreign stakeholders like the U.S. Security Exchange Commission and Japan. Adhere to disclosure and listing requirements associated with domestic and offshore bond issuance. Engage stakeholders on general information in the sourcing and exchange of processing. Verify information for correctness and ensure their accuracy. Domestic and Foreign currency debt: Coordinate the debt portfolio in order to reduce the re-financing risk and cost. Initiate frequent market and portfolio analysis of qualitative and quantitative domestic and foreign currency debt information. Monitor domestic and international economic events and their impact on the South African economy and the debt portfolio. Analyse and advise on prudent debt management policies and recommend corrective debt strategies for implementation. Perform Research on markets volatility: Initiate research on capital markets pertaining to market volatility in the prudent management of debt. Perform research on local and international markets to stay abreast of developments impact on foreign debt management issues. Analyse and provide inputs to briefing notes and speeches.

Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. af.title: Direkteur: Skulduitreiking en Bestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos by National Treasury in Pretoria wat die uitreiking van regeringskuld en leningsstrategie in plaaslike en internasionale kapitaalmarkte bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis saam met 'n minimum Bachelorsgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 7) in Ekonomie of Finansies of Aktuariële wetenskap of Handel of Beleggingsbestuur of Internasionale Ekonomie wat op die geld- en kapitaalmarkte betrekking het. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of senior bestuursvlak in finansiële markbedrywighede. Kennis en ervaring van verskillende navorsingsmetodes. Kennis en ervaring van markontledings verwant aan inligting vir benutting in die breër besigheid. Kennis en ervaring van die hantering van verskeie buitelandse rentekoersmarkte en geldeenhede. Ervaring in kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe opsomming of ontleding van plaaslike en buitelandse skuldverslae. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos deur die National School of Government bekragtig, beskikbaar as 'n aanlynkursus op https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor die finalisering van 'n aanstelling.
af.duties: Finasieringsleningsbehoeftes in plaaslike en internasionale kapitaalmarkte: Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n plaaslike en buitelandse leningsstrategie vir die National Treasury. Stel die uitreiking van regeringssekuriteite in die plaaslike en internasionale kapitaalmarkte in werking. Implementeer maatstafobligasies in die plaaslike en internasionale kapitaalmarkte. Bepaal die finansiemates van die regering se leningsbehoeftes in die plaaslike en internasionale kapitaalmarkte. Belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid: Ontwikkel en implementeer gereedskap wat die beleggersbasis sal verbeter. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n beleggerswebwerf om belanghebbendesbetrokkenheid te verbeter. Betrek plaaslike en buitelandse beleggersbelanghebbendes deur padvertonings en ander mediums. Bou verhoudinge met belanghebbendes soos banke, plaaslike en buitelandse beleggers en betrokke prokureurs oor sekere voorwaardelike vereistes. Bekendmaak van koteeringsvereistes in plaaslike en buitelandse obligasie-uitreiking: Help met die opstel van die jaarlikse. Stel die jaarlikse indieningsproses van die 18K-vorm met buitelandse belanghebbendes soos die U.S. Security Exchange Commission en Japan in werking. Hou by die bekendmakings- en koteeringsvereistes wat met plaaslike en buitelandse obligasie-uitreiking gepaardgaan. Betrek belanghebbendes oor algemene inligting in die werwing en uitruil van verwerking. Verifieer inligting vir korrektheid en verseker die akkuraattheid daarvan. Plaaslike en buitelandse geldeenheidskuld: Koördineer die skuldportefeulje om die herfinansieringsrisiko en koste te verminder. Stel gereeld mark- en portefeulje-ontleding van kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe plaaslike en buitelandse geldeenheidskuldinligting in werking. Monitor plaaslike en internasionale ekonomiese gebeure en hul impak op die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomie en die skuldportefeulje. Ontleed en gee advies oor versigtige skuldbestuurbeleide en beveel korrigerende skuldstrategieë vir implementering aan. Doen navorsing oor markvolatiliteit: Stel navorsing oor kapitaalmarkte rakende markvolatiliteit in die versigtige bestuur van skuld in werking. Doen navorsing oor plaaslike en internasionale markte om tred te hou met ontwikkelings wat 'n impak het op buitelandse skuldbestuursaangeleenthede. Ontleed en verskaf insette tot voorligtingsnotas en toesprake.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukukhishwa Kwezikweletu Nokuphathwa Kwazo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi e-National Treasury e-Pretoria esibhekene nokuphathwa kokukhishwa kwezikweletu kahulumini nenqubomgomo yokuthatha izikweletu emakethe yamasheya angaphakathi nakwezangaphandle.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's degree okulingene (okulingana ne-NQF level 7) kwe-Economics noma i-Finance noma i-Actuarial science noma i-Commerce noma i-Investment Management noma i-International Economics mayelana namakethe yemali namasheya. Kudingeka kube nokuhlalisana eminye iminyaka engu-5 kokuthola isiphoqi esimaphakathi noma esiphezulu sokuphatha emisebenzini yamakethe yezimali. Ulwazi lokuhlangabezana nezindlela ezahlukene zocwaningo. Ulwazi lolwazi lokuhlaziya imakethe mayelana nolwaze oluzosetshenziswa kumanzuzu omphakathi omkhulu. Ulwazi lolwazi lokusingathwa kwamakethe ahlukene wezilinganiso zezinga lenani lezimali zasaphandle nemali yezizwe ezahlukene. Isiphoqi esibonakalayo sokufingqa ngezenhlalo nangabalo noma ukuhlaziya imibiko yezikweletu zasaphakathi nasaphandle. Ukuqedela ngemphumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kunconyiwe yi-National School of Government etholakala njengenkosi ye-inthanethi ku-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqitshwa kokumiswa komuntu esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Ukuthola izimali zezikweletu emakethe yamasheya angaphakathi nakwezangaphandle: Sunga futhi usebenzise inqubomgomo yokuthatha izikweletu zasaphakathi nasaphandle ye-National Treasury. Qala ukukhishwa kwamasheya kahulumini emakethe yamasheya angaphakathi nakwezangaphandle. Sebenzisa amabhomu ahlobene nesilinganiso emakethe yamasheya angaphakathi nakwezangaphandle. Hlola izindlela zezimali zezidingo zezikweletu kahulumini emakethe yamasheya angaphakathi nakwezangaphandle. Ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli: Sunga futhi usebenzise izinto ezingasiza ekwenzeni isisekelo sabatshali-wezimali sibe singcono. Sunga futhi usebenzise i-webhusayithi yabatshali-wezimali ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli abatshali-wezimali basesaphakathi nasaphandle, ngemikolo yokubonisa ngezinye izindlela. Sakha ubuhlobo nabahlanganyeli njengamabhange, abatshali-wezimali basesaphakathi nasaphandle buxe xhumane namabhangomthetho ezidingweni ezithile zezimo. Tudumala izidingo zokuqashwa ezikishweni izikweletu zamasheya angaphakathi nasaphandle: Siza ekuqoqweni kwaminyaka yonke. Qala inqubo yomnyaka yokufula ifomu le-18K kubahlanganyeli basaphandle njengabe-U.S. Security Exchange Commission ne-Japan. Zilandele izidingo zokutula nokuqashwa ezihlobene nokukhishwa kwamasheya angaphakathi nasaphandle. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli ngolwaze olujwayelekile ekutholeni nasekushintshanweni kolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lulunge futhi lube nelungelo. Izikweletu zemali yasesaphakathi nasaphandle: Hlanganisa isikhwama sezikweletu ngenhloso yokunciphisa ingozi yokuzikhetha kabusha nenzindleko. Qala ukuhlaziya njalo imakethe nesikhwama sezikweletu ngolwazi olubalekayo nolwezibalo sezikweletu zemali yasesaphakathi nasaphandle. Qaphela izehloko zezomnotho zasesaphakathi nakwezangaphandle kanye nomthelela wazo komnotho wase-South Africa nasesikhwameni sezikweletu. Hlaziya futhi uphulele ngezenqubomgomo ezihloniphekayo zokuphathwa kwezikweletu futhi uphakamise izindlela zokulungisa izikweletu ezizosetshenziswa. Yenza ucwaningo olumayelana nokuguquguquka kwamakethe: Qala ucwaningo ngamakethe yamasheya ngokugqamayo kokuguquguquka kwamakethe ekuphathweni okuhloniphekayo kwezikweletu. Yenza ucwaningo ngamakethe asakhaya nakwezangaphandle ukuze uhlale uyazi ngokuthuthuka okumayelana nomthelela ekuphathweni kwezikweletu zasaphandle. Hlaziya futhi nikeza izimilo ezibhaliwe ezikulumini nezinkulumo.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ukuqhutywa kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala noLawulo
xh.summary: Indima yomongameli kwi-National Treasury e-Pretoria ephatha ukuqhutywa kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala karhulumente nenkululeko yokuboleka kwimarike yezinto eziguquguqukayo zaselwandle nakumanqamlezo amakhulu e-ntla kuzo zombini iindawo zangaphakathi nezangaphandle.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho i-Grade 12 edityaniswe nendima ubuncinane i-Bachelor's. degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Economics okanye i-Finance okanye i-Actuarial science okanye i-Commerce okanye i-Investment Management okanye i-International Economics ezalathela ngemarike zemali nezempahla. Ubuncinane iminyaka emi-5 yamava enkiwe kwinqanaba lolawulo laphakathi okanye eliphezulu kumsebenzi wemarike yemali. Ulwazi namava ngamanyathelo ahlukeneyo ophando. Ulwazi namava ngokuhlalutywa kwemarike ahlobene nolwazi olusetyenziswayo kwishishini elibanzi. Ulwazi namava ngokusebenza kwemarike ahlukeneyo zamaxabiso enzala kwamanye amazwe nemali. Amavaokuqulunqa okanye ukuhlalutya ngokobungakanani nangokobungacishe iingxelo zetyala langaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuqhuba ngempumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoko ivunyiwe yi-National School of Government ekhona njengekhondo elikwi-intanethi kwi-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, phambi kokugqitywa kokumiswa komsebenzi.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuxhaswe iimfuno zokuboleka kwimarike yemali yasekhaya nangaphandle: Qamba futhi usebenzise inkqubo yokuboleka yasekhaya nangaphandle ye-National Treasury. Qalisa ukuqhutywa kolwazi oluchaziweyo kolawulo kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala karhulumente kwimarike yemali yasekhaya nangaphandle. Sebenzisa ii-benchmark bonds kwimarike yemali yasekhaya nangaphandle. Misela izigqibo zemali zeemfuno zokuboleka karhulumente kwimarike yemali yasekhaya nangaphandle. Ukuzibandakanya nabathathi nxaxheba: Qamba futhi usebenzise izixhobo eziza kusongela i-base yabatyali-mali. Qamba futhi usebenzise iwebhusayithi yabatyali-mali ukusongela ukuzibandakanya nabathathi nxaxheba. Zibandakanye nabathathi nxaxheba abatyali-mali basekhaya nangaphandle, ngokwenza imiboniso i-road shows nakwezinye iindlela. Sakhe ubudlelwane nabathathi nxaxheba njengamabhanka, abatyali-mali basekhaya nangaphandle kwaye uzibandakanye namagqwethi kwiimfuno ezithile zemigaqo. Tyhila iimfuno zokubhalisa kolwazi oluchaziweyo ukuthunyelwa kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala basekhaya nakumanqamlezo aselwandle: Nceda ukuqokelelwa kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala ngokunyaka qalisa inkqubo yokuqedwa kolwazi oluchaziweyo kwifomu le-18K nabathathi nxaxheba bangaphandle njenge-U.S. Security Exchange Commission ne-Japan. Zinikezelele kwezokutyhila nakuqwalaselo kolwazi oluchaziweyo amaxabiso amanqamlezoo kwimarike yemali yokutyhila iindaba nokubhalisa kolwazi oluchaziweyo ukuthunyelwa kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala basekhaya nakumanqamlezo aselwandle. Zibandakanye nabathathi nxaxheba ngolwazi olubanzi ekuqokelelweni nasekuhaniseni ulwazi. Qinisekisa ulwazi ngokuchanekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba lulwazi oluchanekileyo. Iinkcukacha kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala lemali yasekhaya nangaphandle: Hlela i-portfolio yetyala ukunciphisa ingozi yokubuyiswa kwemali nentlalo. Qalisa ukuhlalutya okuqhubekayo kwemarike ne-portfolio ngeenkcukacha ezibuzwa ngokobungakanani nangokobungacishe zezi ngenxa yemali yasekhaya nangaphandle. Lilindele iziganeko zezoqoqosho zasekhaya nakwezangaphandle kwaye umonakude kwiqoqosho laseMzantsi Afrika ne-portfolio yetyala. Hlalutya futhi uncede ngeenkcukacha kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana noLawulo lolwazi oluchaziweyo ngolawulo oluqondileyo futhi uze nice ngokulungiselelwa kwemigaqo yotyala esebenzayo. Yenza uphando ngokuguquguquka kwemarike: Qalisa uphando ngamandla okuguquguquka kwemarike kwimarike yezinto eziguquguqukayo ekuhenyuzweni kolwazi oluchaziweyo okuqondileyo. Yenza uphando ngemarike zasedolophini nasemazwe aphesheya ukuze uhlale ulungele ngokuguquguquka kwemarike kwingxaki yolawulo kolwazi oluchaziweyo mayelana netyala ezingaphandle. Hlalutya kwaye nikele ngeenkcukacha kolwazi othunyelweyo kwimemo nangamagama acingwa ngokukhawuleza nangokucamagusha.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Debt Issuance and Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director position at National Treasury in Pretoria, managing debt issuance and disclosure requirements for domestic and offshore bond programmes.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (NQF 6)/ B. Degree (NQF 7) in Economics/ Finance/ Statistics/ Investment Management/ Mathematical Sciences. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be at an Assistant director level or equivalent obtained in financial markets, with fixed income trading or financial research environment. Knowledge and experience in quantitative research methodologies. Knowledge and experience in market analysis related to information for utilisation in the broader business. Knowledge and experience in dealing with various foreign interest rate markets and currencies. Exposure to the money, banking and capital markets. Experience in qualitative and quantitative analysis of domestic and foreign capital markets.
jobs.duties: Disclose listing requirements in domestic and offshore bond issuance: Initiate the annual filing process of the 18K form with foreign stakeholders like the U.S. Security Exchange Commission and Japan. Adhere to disclosure and listing requirements associated with domestic and offshore bond issuance. Engage stakeholders on general information in the sourcing and exchange of processing. Verify information for correctness and ensure their accuracy. Management of domestic and foreign currency debt: Monitor the debt portfolio and implement strategies in order to reduce the re-financing risk and cos. Initiate frequent market and portfolio analysis of qualitative and quantitative domestic and foreign currency debt information. Monitor domestic and international economic events and their impact on the South African economy and the debt portfolio. Analyse and advise on prudent debt management policies and recommend corrective debt strategies for implementation. Perform research on markets volatility and conduct general market research: Initiate research on capital markets pertaining to market volatility in the prudent management of debt. Perform research on local and international markets to stay abreast of developments which may have an impact debt management issues. Analyse and provide inputs to briefing notes and speeches.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Skuldissueerbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteurpos by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat skuldissueerbestuur en openbaringsvereistes vir plaaslike en buitelandse effekteprogramme bestuur.

'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistentdirekteursvlak of ekwivalent moet wees, verkry in finansiële markte, met vaste-inkomste-handel of finansiële navorsingsomgewing. Kennis en ervaring in kwantitatiewe navorsingsmetodes. Kennis en ervaring in markontleding verbonde aan inligting vir benutting in die breër besigheid. Ervaring in kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe ontleding van plaaslike en buitelandse kapitaalmarkte.
af.duties: Openbaar lysteringsvereistes in plaaslike en buitelandse skuldissuering: Begin die jaarlike indieningsproses van die 18K-vorm by buitelandse belanghebbendes soos die U.S. Security Exchange Commission en Japan. Voldoen aan openbarings- en lysteringsvereistes wat verband hou met plaaslike en buitelandse skuldissuering. Betrek belanghebbendes oor algemene inligting by die bron en uitruiling van verwerking. Verifieer inligting vir korrektheid en verseker hul akkuraatheid. Bestuur van plaaslike en buitelandse geldeenheidskuld: Monitor die skuldportefeulje en implementeer strategieë om die herfinansieringsrisiko en koste te verminder. zu.title: Isikhulu Esikhulu Somsebenzi: Ukukhishwa Kolwelo Futhi Kuphatheke
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumlingisi ophethe esikhundleni sikabamba owayekhona e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, okuphatha ukukhishwa kolwelo nezidingo zokwaziswa izinhlelo zezibhondo zangaphakathi nangaphandle kwezilwandle.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe nekholiji yasekhaya le-Kholishi yase-Bhange lesi-Afrika elibiza ngokuthi 'Grade 12' kanti futhi kumele kube khona isitifiketi se-Diploma se-National Diploma (NQF 6) noma i-Digiri ye-B. Degree (NQF 7) kwezomnotho, ezimalini, kwezibalo, noma ekuqaleni kwezimali ezithengiswayo. Kumele ube nopilo onawo emsebenzini weminyaka engu-4 lapho iminyaka emi-2 kuyo ibe ngumuntu owayengumqondisi osiza noma ezinye izinhlobo ezifana nalena ekutholakala emmakethe zezimali, ezihweba ngomholo ongashintshi noma ucwaningo lwemali. Kube nolwazi futhi uphile uphila ekwenzeni ucwaningo ngokwezibalo. Ulwazi lomsebenzi ekuhloleni imakethe mayelana nemininingwane engasetshenziswa kubhizinisi libanzi. Ulwazi nomsebenzi wokusebenza namakethe ahlukene wenani lemali yamazwe aphesheya namasheke. Ubhekise emakethe yemali, kwezibhange, kanti futhi emakethe yamabhondo. Kube nolwazi ekwenzeni uhlolo lokuqonda ngokwezibalo nangokwezimfanelo kwamakethe amabhondo angaphakathi nawo aphesheya.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkomba yezidingo ngaphakathi kwamabhondo akhishwayo kuleyondawo angaphakathi nawo aphesheya: Qala inkqubo yonyaka yokungenisa idokhimenti yefomu le-18K kubantu abangaphandle njengabaqaphi be-U.S. Security Exchange Commission baseJapan. Hlala ulandela izindingo zokwaziswa nokubhaliswa ezihambisana nokukhishwa kwamabhondo kuleyondawo ngaphakathi nawaphesheya. Khuluma nabantu abahlukene mayelana nemininingwane engajwayelekile ekutholeni nasekushintshaneni imininingwane. Qinisekisa imininingwane ukuthi ilungile futhi iqinisekise ukuthi iyonaqopha. Uphathe imali yamabhondo aphakathi nawaphesheya: Luphe imali ehlezi kwindlu yamabhondo futhi usebenzise izindlela zokwehlisa inkinga yokuthi imali iphinde ibekwe kanti futhi namaphayiphayini athile. Qala uhlolojwalo njalo lwemakethe nendlu yamabhondo ngokwezibalo nangokwezimfanelo kwemali yamabhondo aphakathi nawaphesheya. Lilile izinkathi zomnotho zendawo nakwamanye amazwe futhi ubone ukuthi zithinta kanjani umnotho wezwe lase-Afrika kantsi nendlu yamabhondo. Hlola futhi unike izeluleko ngezinqubomgomo ezihlakaniphile zokuphatha amabhondo futhi uphakamise izindlela ezilungile zokwenza izinqumo ezingalungisayo ukuze zisetshenziswe. Yenza ucwaningo ngokuzamazama kwamakethe futhi wenze ucwaningo olujwayelekile lomsebenzi wemakethe: Qala ucwaningo kumakethe yamabhondo ngokuzamazama kwemakethe ekuphathweni okuhlakaniphile kwamabhondo. Yenza ucwaningo emakethe zendawo nakwamanye amazwe ukuze ugcine ukuthi uyazi okwenzekayo okungaba nomthelela ekuphathweni kwamabhondo. Hlola futhi unike imibono emibalabhalu efunekayo ekubhaliweyo kwezindaba.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukukhulula Izikoloko Nokuziphatha
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mongameli kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, siphatha ukukhulula izikoloko neemfuno zokuvelisa ulwazi kwinkqubo yezezo zomzohlwe zangaphakathi nangaphandle.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ube nesatifikethi se-Garde 12 kakunye ne-Diploma ye-National (NQF 6)/ I-Degree ye-B. (NQF 7) kwi-Economics/ Finance/ Statistics/ Investment Management/ Mathematical Sciences. Kufuneka ube nenkqubela yokuba ngaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-4, apho eminyaka emi-2 kufuneka ibe kumanqanaba kaMsizi womongameli okanye elinganayo efunyanwe kwimarike zemali, ngokurhangqwa kwe-fixed income trading okanye kwendawo yophando lwemali. Ulwazi namava okwenza uphando ngendlela ezibonisa inani. Ulwazi namava kwianalizi yemarike ehlobene nolwazi lokusetyenziswa kumshini wokuqonda ngokubanzi. Ulwazi namava ekuphatheni iimarike ezahlukeneyo zamaxabiso emali mfuneki yamanye amazwe nemali yamanye amazwe. Ukuvuleka kwiimarike zemali, zezenkxaso nazo ezinkulu. Amava kumanalizi ongakanani nangangakanani weemarike ezinkulu zangaphakathi nezakunye amazwe.
xh.duties: Ziveze iimfuno zokulinganisa ekukhululweni kwezikoloko zangaphakathi nangaphandle: Qalisa inqubo yonyaka lokugcwalisa ifomu le-18K kubathathi nxaxheba bakunye amazwe njenge-U.S. Security Exchange Commission naseJapan. Landela iimfuno zokuvelisa ulwazi nokulinganisa ezingqamanyelwe nokukhululwa kwezikoloko zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nxibelelanisa nabathathi nxaxheba malunga nolwazi olunjalo ekutholeni nasekutshintshweni kokuqhuba. Qinisekisa ulwazi lokuchanekileyo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuchanekile. Ukulawula izikoloko zemali yasekhaya nayamanye amazwe: Qwalasela ibhondo yezikoloko uze usebenzise iindlela ezinciphisa ingozi yokuqinisekisa kabusha iindleko. Qalisa kaningi qho qho i-analizi yemarike nangaphezulu kwesikoloko ngokomoya ongakanani nangangakanani lolwazi lwezikoloko zemali yasekhaya nayamanye amazwe. Qwalasela iziganeko ezimalunga nezoqoqosho zangaphakathi nakwamanye amazwe nomphumo wazo koqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika nakuluhlu lwezikoloko. Hlola uze unike iimceli zengqiqo malunga neenkqubo zokuziphatha izikoloko uze ucele iindlela zokulungisa iinkqubo zezikoloko ezingenwa. Yenza uphando ngokuguquguquka kwemarike uze wenze uphando olubanzi ngemarike: Qalisa uphando kumashishini aze aqhathanise ngokuqhathaniswa kwawo ngokwexabiso kwimarike yonke kwaye ufunde ngokuthi ahamba ngendlela ethile. Yenza uphando kumashishini ngamnye nakwezamazwe aphezulu ukuze ukwazi ukubuza imibuzo ngendlela engancedi ukuba ufumane iindlela ezinganceda ekulawulweni kwesiskeko sehlabathi. Hlola uze unike izimvo kulwazi oluncedisa ekuzuzeni iingcinga nentetho.

jobs.title: Government Information Technology Officer (GITO)
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), fully inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: The Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities seeks a Government IT Officer in Pretoria to drive ICT strategy and digital transformation at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate degree (NQF level 7) qualifications as recognised by SAQA in Information Technology / Computer Science / IT Engineering or related field. The following or other related Certificate will be an added advantage. CGEIT; CRISC/ CISM/ CISA; TOGAF; COBIT; ITIL; ISO 38500;31000;27000; and King IV. Certificate of successful completion of National School of Government’s SMS Pre-Entry programme prior appointment. Minimum of Five (5) years’ experience at (MMS) Middle / senior managerial level in Information Management. /Information Technology: Progressive leadership and management; Corporate Governance and Governance of ICT; Project Management; Supplier Management; Stakeholder Management; Apply prescripts and protocols, including ICT, in Public Administration and Written and verbal communication on an executive level. Knowledge of: IT governance framework; SITA Act; HR regularity framework in the Public Service; Skills: Strategic capability and leadership; Financial management; project and programme management; Change management; Knowledge management; Customer relations management; People management and empowerment; Negotiation and facilitation; Advanced verbal and written communication; Problem solving; Honesty and integrity. Personal Attributes. Analytical thinking; Innovative and creative; Ability to work under stressful situations; Solution oriented- ability to design ideas without a group; Highly motivated.
jobs.duties: ICT Strategy, Government and Digital Transformation: Drive the development of departmental technology standards, governance processes and performance metrics to ensure ICT delivers value to the department; Develop the ICT plan linked to the MTEF to prioritise ICT initiatives supporting the departmental strategic plan; Develop strategic IT plans that satisfy the current and ongoing needs of the organisation’s business strategy and current and future capabilities; Introduce innovative methods and approaches to digitalise the department services; Develop and monitor the implementation of ICT policies, processes and procedures to ensure compliance with DPSA/Government-wide ICT prescripts customised according to departmental requirements. ICT Solution Delivery (Build): Analysis, design, and development of ICT solutions; Interoperability and integration of ICT systems; Establish Secure ICT systems, services, and infrastructure; Testing and quality assurance of ICT solutions; Applications development. ICT Operations and Services Management (Run): Develop and define the IT Service Management policy to implement and manage the quality of ICT Services that meets business needs and serves as the ICT functional commitment to the departments; Develop the ICT operational plan to reflect how the department intends to implement the Start plan over the financial year; Manage the optimal functioning of ICT service management operations and end-user support; Manage ICT infrastructure, data centre and support services; Mange the provision of ICT Security Operations and Compliance; Oversee and direct day- to-day activities of the departmental ICT function, ensuring that systems, services, and infrastructure work reliably and securely in line with the ITSM policy. Manage, ICT contracts and service level agreements with service provider: Manage all ICT- related business risks, including security and cyber security. (mitigated and audited regularly); Enable the department to achieve its strategic mandate (current and future capabilities) and objectives by aligning business, and IT plans; Enable the department to achieve all ICT investments’ predetermined value and benefits; Manage financial, human resources, business plans, and reporting processes; Manage the departmental ICT assets; Optimise expenditure and eliminate duplication of ICT solutions and associated technologies; Manage Business Agreements (BA) and Services Level Agreements with SITA and/or other IT goods and Service Suppliers; Represent the interest of the relevant departments to the GITO Council.
