One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical skills that are generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, it is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of    this   position    and     the      candidature     of      persons      whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration. NB: preference will be given to African Female, Coloured Female, and Youth as well as Persons with Disabilities, as these groups are underrepresented in this post.

af.title: Regeringsinligtingstegnologiebeampte (GITO)
af.summary: Die Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities soek 'n Regerings-IT-beampte in Pretoria om ICT-strategie en digitale transformasie op SMS Vlak 13 te drywe.
af.requirements: Toepaslike graad (NQF vlak 7) kwalifikasies soos erken deur SAQA in Inligtingstegnologie / Rekenaarwetenskap / IT-ingenieurswese of verwante veld. Die volgende of ander verwante sertifikaat sal 'n voordeel wees. CGEIT; CRISC/ CISM/ CISA; TOGAF; COBIT; ITIL; ISO 38500;31000;27000; en King IV. Sertifikaat van suksesvolle voltooiing van die National School of Government se SMS voor-toelatingsprogram voor aanstelling. Minimum van Vyf (5) jaar ervaring op (MMS) middel-/senior bestuursvlak in Inligtingsbestuur. /Inligtingstegnologie: Progressiewe leierskap en bestuur; Korporatiewe bestuur en bestuur van ICT; Projektebestuur; Verskaffersbestuur; Belanghebbendesbestuur; Pas voorskrifte en protokolle toe, insluitend ICT, in Publieke Administrasie en geskrewe en verbale kommunikasie op uitvoerende vlak. Kennis van: IT-bestuursraamwerk; SITA-wet; HR-reguleringsraamwerk in die Publieke Diens; Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Finansiële bestuur; projek- en programbestuur; Veranderingsbestuur; Kennisbestuur; Kliëntverhoudingsbestuur; Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; Onderhandeling en fasilitering; Gevorderde verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie; Probleemoplossing; Eerlikheid en integriteit. Persoonlike eienskappe. Analitiese denke; Innoverend en kreatief; Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk; Oplossingsgerig- vermoë om idees sonder 'n groep te ontwerp; Hoë gemotiveerd.
af.duties: ICT-strategie, Regering en Digitale Transformasie: Dryf die ontwikkeling van departementale tegnologie-standaarde, bestuursprosesse en prestasie-aanwysers om te verseker dat ICT waarde aan die departement lewer; Ontwikkel die ICT-plan gekoppel aan die MTEF om ICT-inisiatiewe wat die departementale strategiese plan ondersteun te prioriteer; Ontwikkel strategiese IT-planne wat aan die huidige en deurlopende behoeftes van die organisasie se besigheidsstrategie en huidige en toekomstige vermoëns voldoen; Stel innoverende metodes en benaderings bekend om die departement se dienste te digitaliseer; Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van ICT-beleide, prosesse en prosedures om nakoming van DPSA/Regeringswye ICT-voorskrifte wat volgens departementale vereistes aangepas is, te verseker. ICT-oplossingslewering (Bou): Analise, ontwerp, en ontwikkeling van ICT-oplossings; Interoperabiliteit en integrasie van ICT-stelsels; Vestig veilige ICT-stelsels, dienste, en infrastruktuur; Toetsing en kwaliteitsversekering van ICT-oplossings; Toepassingsontwikkeling. ICT-bedryfs- en diensbestuur (Bestuur): Ontwikkel en definieer die IT-diensbestuursbeleid om die gehalte van ICT-dienste wat aan besigheidsbehoeftes voldoen te implementeer en bestuur, en wat dien as die ICT-funksionele verbintenis tot die departemente; Ontwikkel die departementale ICT-bedryfsplan om te weerspieël hoe die departement voornemens is om die Start-plan oor die finansiële jaar te implementeer; Bestuur die optimale funksionering van ICT-diensbestuursbedrywighede en eindgebruikersteun; Bestuur ICT-infrastruktuur, datasentrum en ondersteuningsdienste; Bestuur die verskaffing van ICT-sekerheidsbedrywighede en -nakoming; Hou toezig op en direkteer dag-tot-dag aktiwiteite van die departementale ICT-funksie, en verseker dat stelsels, dienste, en infrastruktuur betroubaar en veilig funksioneer in ooreenstemming met die ITSM-beleid. Bestuur, ICT-kontrakte en diensvlakooreenkomste met diensverskaffer: Bestuur alle ICT-verwante besigheidsrisiko's, insluitend sekuriteit en kubersekuriteit. (gemigreer en gereeld ouditeer); Stel die departement in staat om sy strategiese mandaat (huidige en toekomstige vermoëns) en doelwitte te bereik deur besigheids- en IT-planne in lyn te bring; Stel die departement in staat om alle voorafbepaalde waarde en voordele van ICT-investering te bereik; Bestuur finansiële, menslike hulpbronne, besigheidsplanne, en verslagdoeningsprosesse; Bestuur die departementale ICT-bates; Optimaliseer besteding en elimineer duplisering van ICT-oplossings en geassosieerde tegnologieë; Bestuur Besigheidooreenkomste (BA) en Diensvlakooreenkomste met SITA en/of ander IT-goedere en diensverskaffers; Verteenwoordig die belange van die relevante departemente by die GITO-raad.

zu.title: Ofisi Yezobuchwepheshe Ezenkululeko Kahulumeni (GITO)
zu.summary: I-Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities ifuna i-Government IT Officer ePretoria ukuze iqhube amasu e-ICT nenguqulo yamajengo abuciko ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele (NQF level 7) njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA kwi-Information Technology / Computer Science / IT Engineering noma omkhando ohlobene nalenhlekelele. Lokhu okulandelayo noma esinye isitifikedi esihlobene nalesi sizoba yinzuzo. CGEIT; CRISC/ CISM/ CISA; TOGAF; COBIT; ITIL; ISO 38500;31000;27000; kanye ne-King IV. Isitifikedi sesiphumelelo se-National School of Government's SMS Pre-Entry programme ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. U-Minimum of Five (5) years' experience e-(MMS) Middle / senior managerial level e-Information Management. /Information Technology: Ubunkosi nolawulo obuthuthukiswayo; uKuLawula Ibutho nokuLawula i-ICT; ukuLawulwa Kwezinhlelo; ukuLawula Abahanisi; ukuLawula Izinhlaka; Ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho nemibhalo yemiyalelo, okuhlanganisa i-ICT, kuKuLawulwa kwikulumende kanye Nokuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nangokwenyathelo esimnzwaneni weziqu ezingeni eliphezulu. Ulwazi mayelana: Nesakhiwo sokuLawula i-IT; i-SITA Act; isakhiwo sokulawula i-HR kuzeqanthi Kubhalwe Ngezenhlalo; Amakhono: Ukuba nesisindo ngenhloso nokuba ngumholi; ukuLawula Imali; ukuLawula izinhlelo nokuqalisa; ukuLawula izinguquko; ukuLawula Ulwazi; ukugcina ubuhlobo nabathengi; ukuLawula abantu nokuqinisekisa amandlana; ukuxhumana kanye nokuqhube imibono yokuhlangana; ukuxhumana ngokubhaliwe nokuthi ekhulunywe kakhuluma; ukuxazula izinkinga; ukuqiniseka ngokuzithoba nobusoqotho. Izici Zomuntu. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; ukuba nothando bokucinga ngendlela entsha; ikhono lokusebenza ezimeni ezinodluzula amandla; ukugxila ekuqondenisa izixazululo - ikhono lokubumba imibono ngaphandle kwegumbi; uzimotivha kakhulu.
zu.duties: Isu le-ICT, uHulumeni nenguqulo yamajengo abuciko: ukuQhuba ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga elinganiselwe lezobuchwepheshe lemunyango, izingaki zokuLawula kanye nezigaba kokusebenza ngamaphuzu ezinsimbi ukugqamisa ukuba i-ICT ilethe inzuzo emnyangweni; ukuthuthukisisa ihlelo le-ICT elicathulwe kwi-MTEF ukubeka phambili izinhlelo ze-ICT ezisekela ihlelo lobuholi bokuqamba ngenhloso bemnyango; ukuthuthukisisa amasu e-IT ahambisana nezidingo zanamuhla nezingajwayelekile zendlela yemino yokusebenza kanye nalamandlana wanamuhla ne- Yesikhathi esizayo; ukuletha izindlela namasu amasha ukwenza amasevisi omnyango abe ngamajengo abuciko; ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuhlolisisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo ze-ICT, izingaki neziqondiso ukugunyaza ukulandelwa kwezinqumo ze-DPSA/Government-wide ezi-ICT ezenziwe ngokwezidingo zomnyango. ukuNikela Ngesixazululi se-ICT (Ukakha): ukuHlaziya, ukwakula, nokukhulisa izixazululi ze-ICT; ukuxhumeka nokuhlanganisa izimiso ze-ICT; ukumiswa kwezimiso ze-ICT eziqhivethe, amasevisi, nempahla yezinsiza; ukuHlola futhi uqinise isisindo esihle samaxabiso ezixazululi ze-ICT; ukukhuliswa kwezinhlelo ezisebenza. ukuLawulwa kwe-ICT kwezimiso ze-ICT kanye NasekuLawulweni Amasevisi (UkuGijima): ukuthuthukisisa futhi uchaze isinqumomgomo wokuLawula Amasevisi e-IT ukuze asungule futhi alawule isisindo esihle samasevisi e-ICT ahambisana nezidingo zenhlanganelo futhi abe yisithembiso sokuLawula amasevisi kumnyango; ukuthuthukisisa uhlelo lokuqalise i-ICT olukhombisa indlela omnyango ehlose ngayo ukuthumela isu phambili kumnyaka wezimali; ukuLawula ukusebenza okuhle kakhulu kwezimiso ze-ICT zokuLawula amasevisi kanye nokusiza kakhulu abasebenzisi; ukuLawula impahla yezinsiza ye-ICT, isikhungo sedata yomnyango kanye namasevisi okusiza; ukuLawula nukunikela amasevisi okuLawula i-ICT nokulawulwa ngemithetho; ukuBuka futhi uqondise izinsuku zonke imisebenzi yemnyango ye-ICT, uqinisekisa ukuba izimiso, amasevisi, kanye nempahla yezinsiza zisebenza ngokuthembekile nokuqhivethe ngokuhambisana nesinqumomgomo we-ITSM. ukuLawula, izinkulumo-mvubomgomo ze-ICT kanye nezivumelwano zokuLawula izinga nabanikeli besevisi: ukuLawula yonke imirhuqo yokuhweba ehlobene ne-ICT, okuhlanganisa nokuqhivethe nokutshona kwe-ikhompyutha. (kuncishiswe futhi kuhlolwa njalo); ukunika umthombo isikhathi esigxile ukuze afinyelele esimweni nenhloso yakhe nenhloso yakhe (amandlana wanamuhla ne-yesikhathi esizayo) ngokuqondanisa ukuhweba, kanye namasu e-IT; ukuvumela umnyango ukuba afinyelele konke okulindelekile ukuthi kuzuzwe kulo konke okufakiwe kwe-ICT; ukuLawula imali, abantu abasebenzayo, amasu okuhweba, kanye nezingaki zokubika; ukuLawula impahla ye-ICT yomnyango; ukukhululeka ekusebenziseni imali nokukhipha konke okuphindwe kabi izixazululi ze-ICT kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhlotshaniswa nazo; ukuLawula izivumelwano zokuHweba (BA) nezivumelwano zokuLawula Amasevisi ne-SITA kanye/noma abanikezeli bamagama nesevisi yezinsiza ye-IT; ukumela izinhloso zemiyango ephathelene kwi-GITO Council.

xh.title: Isebe lokusebenza leenkonzo zeTekhnoloji yolwazi kahulumeni (GITO)
xh.summary: Isebe labo Basetyhini, abasebutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo lifuna iNkulumbuso ye-IT kahulumeni ePretoria ukuyikhokela inkqubo ye-ICT nenguquko yedijithali kwinqanaba le-SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo (NQF level 7) njengoko zivunywa yi-SAQA kwiTekhnoloji yolwazi / Isayensi yeKhompyutha / Injini ye-IT okwingonga elinxulumeneyo. Iifom zokuqinisekisa okanye enye efana nazo ziba ngumlondolozi. CGEIT; CRISC/ CISM/ CISA; TOGAF; COBIT; ITIL; ISO 38500;31000;27000; nakuKing IV. Isatifikethi esibonisa ukuphumelela kwinkqubo ye-SMS Pre-Entry ye-National School of Government ngaphambi kokuba umsebenzi. Okungaphantsi kweminye emihlanu (5) yeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba le-MMS eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo kwilawulo lolwazi. /iTekhnoloji yolwazi: Ukuba ngumkhokeli olawula ngokuphambili; ulawulo lwebhodi kunye nolawulo lwe-ICT; ulawulo lweprojekthi; ulawulo lomthengisi; ulawulo lwabathathi-nxaxheba; ukusebenzisa imimiselo nemithetho, kuquka i-ICT, kwiNtengiso yoluntu nokubhala nokuthetha ngomlomo ngangangokwinqanaba le-executive. Ulwazi lwakho: Inkqubo yolawulo lwe-IT; umthetho we-SITA; inkqubo yokulawula i-HR kundumo yoluntu; Amakhono: Amandla okuphakama ngokochongo nokuba ngumkhokeli; ulawulo lweemali; ulawulo lweenkqubo zeprojekthi; ukuguqula ulawulo; ulawulo lolwazi; ulawulo lokuziphathisa kunye nabathengi; ulawulo lweemali lweebhodo; ukulawula abantu kunye nokunika amandla; ukuxhomekeka kwemigaqo; nabaxumi ekubeni nentsika; ukubhala nokuvelisa iindlela ezintsha nangqondo; ukukwazi ukusebenza iindawo ezibangelwa inkinga; ukukhululeka ekubeni nolwazi nokuqonda ukusombulula iingxaki; ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Isu le-ICT, uluntu kunye nenguquko yedijithali: Khokela uphuhliso lwemilinganiselo yobuchwephheshe besebe, iinkqubo zolawulo kwaye ulinganise ukusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuba i-ICT inika ixabiso kwisebe; lungelelanisa isu le-ICT elidityaniswe kwi-MTEF ukuze kubekho izikhokelo ezibalulekileyo ze-ICT ezigqithisa isu sebe ukuya phambili; Zonke iinkqubo kunye namagqabantshiwe amakhulu afanele iimfuno, amathuba kunye nezinkqubo ezikhoyo ukuze igqibe iziphumo zeempumelelo ezibalulekileyo zoluntu; Ngokuphambili izikhuselo ezahlukeneyo namaxabiso azokubakho kwindalo evela kumagunya amakhulu ngokobuchwephetshe bokuziphilisa kwizindlu kwilizwe ngokwemigaqo yoluntu nengqukuquko yendalo esebenzayo kwihlabathi elinguwo mahluko kwibhalansi nangaphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ngokomthetho wenkqubo yamagunya ngemigaqo-nkqubo yekhompyutha; lungelelanisa ulawulo lwendalo yakho ebusa iprojekthi kubomi ngamaxesha onke ekusetyenziswa kwayo ngokubanzi.

jobs.title: Audit and Risk Committee Chairperson
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.salary_text: The appointment will be supported by the terms of reference and a contract. Remuneration will be paid in accordance with the Treasury Regulations 20.2.2.
jobs.summary: An Audit and Risk Committee Chairperson is sought by the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities to lead governance and financial oversight in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate, appropriate post graduate qualification (NQF level 8) as recognised by SAQA in Law, Accounting, Auditing, Risk Management, Business Management, Law, Public Administration or relevant qualifications; A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in serving on and/or chairing an Audit and Risk Committee, Board, Committee or similar governance/oversight structure; Membership of a recognised professional body such as the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA), Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA), Legal Practice Council (LPC), or an equivalent recognised professional body. A sound understanding of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and applicable public sector governance, audit, risk management and financial reporting frameworks; A sound understanding of the respective roles and responsibilities of the Accounting Officer, Executive Authority, Audit and Risk Committee, Internal Audit and Auditor-General of South Africa; Knowledge of the PFMA, Treasury Regulation and other public sector frameworks; Knowledge and understanding of financial statements, internal controls, risk management, internal and external audit, performance information and governance; Strong leadership, strategic thinking, analytical, communication and interpersonal skills; Independent, integrity, objectivity and professional judgement; Be able to devote sufficient time to the effective discharge of the responsibilities of the Chairperson.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will, amongst others: Provide effective leadership to the Audit and Risk Committee. Ensure that the Committee effectively discharges its responsibilities in accordance with its approved Charter and applicable legislation and prescripts. Facilitate effective oversight of financial reporting, performance information, risk management, internal controls and governance processes. Oversee Internal Audit function to ensure its effectiveness and independence. Facilitate the monitoring the implementation of recommendations arising from internal and external audit processes. Facilitate effective communication and engagement between the Committee, Executive Authority, Accounting Officer, management, Internal Audit and the Auditor-General of South Africa. Ensure that significant governance, risk, control, financial management and audit matters are appropriately considered and escalated. Report to the Executive Authority on the activities and effectiveness of the Audit and Risk Committee. Promote accountability, transparency, ethical conduct and good governance within the Department. Lead the annual assessment of the Audit and Risk Committee.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Vusumuzi Shongwe Tel No: (012) 359 0244 / 060 978 1749
jobs.applications: Applicants are urged to submit the applications via email to: ARCChairpersons@dwypd.gov.za. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Mr Vusumuzi Shongwe Tel No: (012) 359 0244 / 060 978 1749
jobs.notes: Interested candidates must submit: A comprehensive and updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) clearly outlining qualifications, professional experience, governance experience and previous Audit and Risk Committee/Board experience. A covering letter outlining their suitability for appointment as Chairperson of the Audit and Risk Committee. Copies of qualifications and identification. Contact details of at least three recent referees, where applicable. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non- RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to an interview, reference checks, qualification verification, and suitability checks including security vetting as such the appointment will be made subject to positive outcomes of the personal suitability checks. Correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Recommended applicant will be required to disclose, prior to appointment, any actual, potential or perceived conflicts of interest and any other circumstances that may compromise, or be perceived to compromise, their ability to independently and objectively perform the functions of Chairperson. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, It is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration. Preference will be given to Women and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Oudit- en Risikokomitee-voorsitter
af.summary: Die Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities soek 'n Oudit- en Risikokomitee-voorsitter om leierskap en finansiële toesig in Pretoria te behartig.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat, 'n toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 8) soos deur SAQA erken in Regte, Rekenkunde, Ouditering, Risikobestuur, Besigheidsbestuur, Regte, Openbare Administrasie of tersaaklike kwalifikasies; 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die diens op en/of die voorsit van 'n Oudit- en Risikokomitee, Raad, Komitee of soortgelyke bestuurs-/toesigstruktuur; Lidmaatskap van 'n erkende professionele liggaam soos die South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA), Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA), Legal Practice Council (LPC), of 'n equivalente erkende professionele liggaam. 'n Deeglike begrip van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en toepaslike openbare sektor-bestuurs-, oudit-, risikobestuur- en finansiële verslagdoeningsraamwerke; 'n Deeglike begrip van die onderskeie rolle en verantwoordelikhede van die Boekhoudingsbeampte, Uitvoerende Gesag, Oudit- en Risikokomitee, Interne Oudit en Auditor-General of South Africa; Kennis van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasie en ander openbare sektorraamwerke; Kennis en begrip van finansiële state, interne beheer, risikobestuur, interne en eksterne oudit, prestasie-inligting en bestuur; Sterk leierskaps-, strategiese dink-, analitiese, kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede; Onafhanklikheid, integriteit, objektiwiteit en professionele oordeel; In staat wees om voldoende tyd te wy aan die effektiewe nakoming van die verantwoordelikhede van die Voorsitter.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere die volgende doen: Effektiewe leierskap aan die Oudit- en Risikokomitee bied. Verseker dat die Komitee sy verantwoordelikhede effektief nakome ooreenkomstig sy goedgekeurde Handves en toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte. Effektiewe toesig oor finansiële verslagdoening, prestasie-inligting, risikobestuur, interne beheer en bestuursprosesse fasiliteer. Toesig hou oor die Interne Oudit-funksie om sy doeltreffendheid en onafhanklikheid te verseker. Die monitering van die implementering van aanbevelings voortspruitend uit interne en eksterne ouditprosesse fasiliteer. Effektiewe kommunikasie en betrokkenheid tussen die Komitee, Uitvoerende Gesag, Boekhoudingsbeampte, bestuur, Interne Oudit en die Auditor-General of South Africa fasiliteer. Verseker dat beduidende bestuurs-, risiko-, beheer-, finansiële bestuurs- en ouditkwessies behoorlik oorweeg en geeskalteer word. Aan die Uitvoerende Gesag rapporteer oor die aktiwiteite en doeltreffendheid van die Oudit- en Risikokomitee. Verantwoordelikheid, deursigtigheid, etiese gedrag en goeie bestuur binne die departement bevorder. Die jaarlikse assessering van die Oudit- en Risikokomitee lei.

zu.title: Usihlalo we-Komiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi
zu.summary: I-Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities ifuna uSihlalo we-Komiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi ukuba ahole ezindabeni zokuphathwa kwezindaba nokuhlola izimali e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Umfunyi kumele abe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12, iziqu ezifanele zangemva kwebanga (izinga le-NQF 8) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA kuMthetho, ukuBala izimali, ukuHlola izimali, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezohwebo, uMthetho, ukuPhathwa kwezinto Zomphakathi noma iziqu ezinhle; Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kokusebenza ekubambeleleni futhi noma ukubusa i-Komiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi, iBhodi, iKomiti noma isakhiwo esifanayo sokuphathwa kwezindaba/ukuqapha; Ukuba lilungu lomzimba ocbukekayo wabaprofeshinali njengoba yi-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA), i-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA), i-Legal Practice Council (LPC), noma omunye umzimba ocbukekayo ofanayo wabaprofeshinali. Ukuqonda okuhle kwe-PFMA, iMithetho yeTreasury nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezindaba zomphakathi ezisebenzayo, ukuhlola izimali, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nezinhlelo zokuvela ngemibiko yezimali; Ukuqonda okuhle kwemisebenzi nemithwalo yayo ehlobene ne-Accounting Officer, i-Executive Authority, iKomiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi, i-Internal Audit ne-Auditor-General of South Africa; Ulwazi nge-PFMA, iMithetho yeTreasury nakwezinye izinhlelo zomphakathi; Ulwazi nokuqonda izitatimende zezimali, izilawuli zangaphakathi, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuhlola izimali ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ulwazi ngemikhuba nokuphathwa kwezindaba; Amakhono amakhulu okukhokha, okucabanga ngokubukeka, ukuhlaziya, ukuxhumana nokuxhumana nabantu; Ukuzimela, ukuqotho, ukungathathi hlangothi nesinqumo seziprofeshinali; Ukuba nakho ukunikezela isikhathi esanele ekwenzeni ngempumelelo imisebenzi yeSihlalo.
zu.duties: Umfnuzi ophumelelayo uzobe, phakathi kwabanye: Unikeza ukukhokha okunamandla kuKomiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi. Aqiniseke ukuthi iKomiti yenza imisebenzi yayo ngempumelelo ngokweKhadi layo elivunyiwe nangokomthetho nemithetho ebuzwayo. Akusize ukulawula ngempumelelo ukuvela kwemibiko yezimali, ulwazi ngemikhuba, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, izilawuli zangaphakathi nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezindaba. Alawule umsebenzi we-Internal Audit ukuze aqiniseke ukusebenza kwawo nokuzimela kwawo. Akusize ukubheka ukuphunyushwa kwezinto eziphakamisiwe ezivela ezinqabeni zokuhlola izimali ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Akusize ukuxhumana nokubonisana ngempumelelo phakathi kweKomiti, i-Executive Authority, i-Accounting Officer, ukuphathwa, i-Internal Audit ne-Auditor-General of South Africa. Aqiniseke ukuthi izindaba ezinkulu zokuphathwa kwezindaba, izinkinga, izilawuli, ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuhlolwa kwamamembu aqashelwa futhi athunyelwe phezulu. Athumele umbiko ku-Executive Authority ngemisebenzi nokusebenza kweKomiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi. Akhuthaze ukubhekana phansi, ukusesinye, ukuziphatha kahle nokuphathwa kwezindaba kahle ngaphakathi kweMnyango. Ahole ukubheka komnyaka weKomiti Le-Audit Nomezinkathi.

xh.title: SihlaliweKomitiyoPhononongoNengozi
xh.summary: Kufunwa uSihlali weKomiti yoPhononongo nengozi ngasebe iDepartment of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities ukuba ezisebe kuPretoria ekulawuleni ulawulo nembono yamali.
xh.requirements: M kufunke abe nesatifikethi seGrade 12, nangophando olufanelekileyo lwesiqu (inqanaba 8 leNQF) njengokuhlutshwa yi-SAQA kwiZomthetho, ukuBala iimali, ukuBala iziphimo, ukuLawula iingozi, ukuLawula uShishino, iZomthetho, uLawulo loLuntu okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo; Abenokuqonda okungaphantsi kweminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ekukhonzeni nakwindima yokuba nguSihlali weKomiti yoPhononongo nengozi, leBhodi, Komiti okanye isakhiwo esifanayo solawulo/imbono; Lilungu lebhodi yamagcisa emfundo ethi yamkeleka njengoko South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (SAICA), Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIA SA), Legal Practice Council (LPC), okanye elinye igcisa elithi liramkeleka. Aqonde kakuhle i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations nezakhiwo zolawulo lwentlalo, uphononongo, ulawulo lweengozi nokuvela kwezemo zomthetho zephalantle; Aqonde kakuhle iindima nezibophelelo zoLawuli wezezimali, gunya eliphuma kulo, leKomiti yoPhononongo nengozi, uPhononongo langaphakathi neliyingenelo eliphezulu lamagcisa eSouth Africa; Azibe nolwazi nge-PFMA, iTreasury Regulation nezinye iinkqubo zolawulo zentlalo; Azibe nolwazi nokuqonda iimo zomthetho, izilawulo zangaphakathi, ulawulo lweengozi, uphononongo langaphakathi nangaphandle, iinkcukacha zemveliso nemigaqo yolawulo; Abe nentsiba yokuzisa, ukucinga ngokobuchule, luncedo, kukwazana nokuqonda nabantu; Azimele, abe nokuzipatha, azibe ngokwamaqondo aqeqweyo kwaye athathe iigqibo ngokwengqondo; Akwazi ukuzinika ixesha elifanelekileyo ekwenzeni umsebenzi kaSihlali.
xh.duties: Umntu ophumeleleyo, phakathi kwabanye, uya kuba: unceda ngokulawula ngokuchanekileyo leKomiti yoPhononongo nengozi. Qinisekisa ukuba iKomiti yenza imisebenzi yayo ngokwemigaqo yayo nangokomthetho nemigaqo ekhoyo. Yenza ukuba kubekho ulawulo oluchanekileyo kolwazi ngemali, iinkcukacha zedatha nengozo, ukulawula iingozi, izilawulo zangaphakathi nendlela yokusebenza komgaqo-siseko. Lilawule indima yoPhononongo langaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe isebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuba ngokusuka kwisiseko. Yenza kube lula ukulandela ukusebenza kwemiqulu ethethwe ngophononongo bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ukwazana okusebenzayo phakathi kweKomiti, gunya eliphuma kulo, uLawuli wezezimali, abaphathi, uPhononongo langaphakathi nalawo mabalana bamiGcisa weling. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezibalulekileyo zolawulo, iingozi, izilawulo, ulawulo lwemali nophononongo zihlolwa ngokufanelekileyo kwaye zithunyelwe phezulu. Athi umbiko ngoBulela bagcisa ukulunga nokunguyeImeko yeKomitiyo kaPhononongo neengSocks. Khuthaza isibophelelo, ukuchaza, ukuziphatha ngokomthetho ngokwemigaqo-siseko esebenzayo kwisebe. Yenza isihlavielo sokuhlolelwa ngamnye kwiKomitiyo kafaka nemPilo okuyenziwa.

jobs.title: Senior Education Psychologist Grade 1: Inclusive and
jobs.salary_text: R1 295 388 – R1 436 913 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the OSD)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Senior Education Psychologist Grade 1 at Eastern Cape Education Head Office in Zwelitsha, requiring HPCSA registration and a master's degree in educational or counselling psychology.
jobs.requirements: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a psychologist in a relevant registration category (Educational or Counselling), with a master’s degree in educational or counselling psychology. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience post-registration as an Independent Psychologist. Demonstrated personal attributes: integrity, professionalism, self-motivation, and the ability to function effectively within a team. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a high level of proficiency in English. Added advantage: Experience in both psychotherapy and psycho-educational support services. Experience in project management such as concessions and accommodation and psychosocial support services within an educational context. Knowledge and experience in the development, implementation, and management of data collection systems to inform psychological strategic interventions. Clear understanding of relevant policies and acts relevant to IE such as EWP 6, SIAS policy, and PAM. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: The Senior Psychologist will facilitate the strategic development and implementation of psychoeducational support services, within the context of inclusive education as per relevant policies such as WP6, SIAS, ext. within Full-Service Schools, Public Ordinary schools and Special Schools to meet international standards for specialized support services and inclusivity. Clear understanding of system transformation variables and processes required to establish and sustain an inclusive education system in order to provide support services. Utilize data-driven approaches to guide planning, monitoring, and decision-making within the inclusive education system, such as support and referral data systems. Oversight of resource allocation, budget frameworks, monitoring systems, and supervision processes to ensure effective psychosocial service delivery. The senior psychologist will lead the strategic planning, allocation, and management of budgets related to psychosocial support services. Oversee and monitor of the centralised budgets for Learning and Teaching Support Materials (LTSM) and assistive devices aligned to therapeutic and support needs of learners experiencing barriers to learning. Consideration of Personnel Administrative Measures (PAM) in the planning, allocation, and management of human resources within psychosocial and inclusive education support services. Management of psychologists, psychometrists and counsellors pertaining to project management, tools of trade, training and development and relevant policy development. Development of orientation and training material for psychosocial support services.

af.title: Senior Education Psychologist Grade 1: Inclusive and
af.summary: Senior Education Psychologist Grade 1 by Eastern Cape Education Head Office in Zwelitsha, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n meestersgraad in opvoedkundige of berederyingsielkunde vereis.
af.requirements: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as sielkundige in 'n tersaaklike registrasiekategorie (Opvoedkundig of Berederying), met 'n meestersgraad in opvoedkundige of beroepsielkunde. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring na registrasie as 'n Onafhanklike Sielkundige. Agetooide persoonlike eienskappe: integriteit, profesionaliteit, selfmotivering, en die vermoe om doeltreffend binne 'n span te funksioneer. Sterk kommunikasievaardighede, beide skriftelik en mondeling, met 'n hoë vlak van beheptheid in Engels. Bykomende voordeel: Ervaring in beide psigoterapie en psigo-opvoedkundige ondersteuningsdienste. Ervaring in projekbestuur soos konsessies en akkommodasie en psigososiale ondersteuningsdienste binne 'n opvoedkundige konteks. Kennis en ervaring in die ontwikkeling, implementering en bestuur van data-insamelingstelsels om sielkundige strategiese intervensies te ondersteun. Duidelike begrip van tersaaklike beleide en wetgewing relevant tot IE soos EWP 6, SIAS-beleid en PAM. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Die senior sielkundige sal die strategiese ontwikkeling en implementering van psigo-opvoedkundige ondersteuningsdienste fasiliteer, binne die konteks van inklusiewe opvoeding volgens relevante beleide soos WP6, SIAS, by wyse van Full-Service Schools, Public Ordinary schools en Special Schools om aan internasionale standaarde vir gespesialiseerde ondersteuningsdienste en inklusiwiteit te voldoen. Duidelike begrip van stelseltransformasie-veranderlikes en prosesse wat vereis word om 'n inklusiewe opvoedkundestelsel te vestig en in stand te hou ten einde ondersteuningsdienste te verskaf. Gebruik data-gedrewe benaderings om beplanning, monitering en besluitneming binne die inklusiewe opvoedkundestelsel te lei, soos ondersteunings- en verwysingsdatastelsels. Toesig oor hulpbron-toewysing, begrotingsraamwerke, moniteringstelsels en toesigprosesse om doeltreffende psigososiale dienslewering te verseker. Die senior sielkundige sal die strategiese beplanning, toewysing en bestuur van begrotings wat verband hou met psigososiale ondersteuningsdienste, lei. Toesig hou oor en monitering van die gesentraliseerde begrotings vir Learning and Teaching Support Materials (LTSM) en hulptoestelle wat ooreenstem met die terapeutiese en ondersteuningsbehoeftes van leerders wat hindernisse tot leer ervaar. Inagneming van Personnel Administrative Measures (PAM) by die beplanning, toewysing en bestuur van menslike hulpbronne binne psigososiale en inklusiewe opvoedkundige ondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur van sielkundiges, psiometriste en beraders rakende projekbestuur, werkinstrumente, opleiding en ontwikkeling en relevante beleidsontwikkeling. Ontwikkeling van oriëntasie- en opleidingsmateriaal vir psigososiale ondersteuningsdienste.

zu.title: Isikhulu Sezengqondo Esingenelelo Ezemfundo Elinga 1: Ebufakazini Nezokufaka phakathi
zu.summary: Isikhulu Sezengqondo Esingenelelo Ezemfundo Elinga 1 e-Head Office yoMnyango Wezemfundo wase-Eastern Cape e-Zwelitsha, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA nesiqu sokufunda esingangeniswa noma isiqu sokweluleka ngengqondo.
zu.requirements: Ukubhaliswa ku-Higher Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengcweti yengqondo ohlotsheni lokubhalisa oluhambisana (Ezemfundo noma Sokweluleka), ngesiqu sokufunda esingangeniswa noma sokweluleka ngengqondo. Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka eyithathu (3) yokuhlola ngemuva kokubhalisa njengengcweti yengqondo ekimele yodwa. Izimo zobuntu eziyisibonelo: ukuzipatha kahle, ukusebenza ngobungcweti, ukuzikhandla ngokwakho, nokuhlakanipha ekusebenzeni ngaphakathi kweqembu. Amakhono aphelele okuxoxa, kokubili okulobiwe noku khulunywayo, ngesimo esiphezulu sokukhuluma isiNgisi. Into eyongezelelayo: Uhambo lwezinhlelo zokweluleka ngengqondo kanye nesevisi yokusekela emfundeni. Uhambo lokuphatha imiklamo njengokunikwa izimalu nokuqatshelwa kanye nesevisi yokusekela ngokomoyenzelo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yemfundo. Ulwazi nolunzulu ekuthuthukisweni, ekuqedeni, nasekuphatheni amasistimu wokuqoqa ulwazi ukuze kwazi ukuthi kungenelelwa kanjani ngokobuchule bengqondo. Ukuqonda okucacile mayelana nemigomo nemithetho ebalulekile kwe-EWP 6, imigomo ye-SIAS, ne-PAM. Ilayisenisi yokushayela okusemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ingcweti yesikhulu yengqondo izokwazi ukuthuthukisa ngamandla nokuqedela inkambiso yokusekela ezemfundo ngokomoyenzelo, ngaphakathi kohlelo lwemfundo yokufaka phakathi ngokomthetho njengawe-WP6, SIAS, nokunye. ngaphakathi kwezikole Ezenza Konke, Izikole Zomphakathi eziyivamile kanye Nezikole Ezingenelelo ukuze zihambelane namazinga aphakeme emhlabeni jikelele ngesevisi yokusekela obuchulumaningi nangokulinganisa. Ukuqonda okucacile mayelana nezinto ezinguqula isistimu nemikhuba edingekayo ukuqondiswa kanye nokugcina uhlelo lwemfundo efaka phakathi ukwazi ukupha izinsiza zokusekela. Ukusetshenziswa kwendlela eholwa ngolwazi ukuqondisa ukuhlela, ukubuka, nokwenza izinqumo ohlelweni lwemfundo efaka phakathi, njengesistimu yedatha yokusekela nokuthumela. Ukulawula ukwabiwa kwemithombo, amasheke bhajethi, amasistimu okubuka, nemicimbo yokubuka ukuqinisekisa ukulethwa kwesevisi ephathe kahle ngokomoyenzelo. Ingcweti yesikhulu yengqondo izohola ukuhlela ngamandla, ukwabiwa, nokuphathwa kwebhajethi ephathelene nesevisi yokusekela ngokomoyenzelo. Ukubuka nokuqaphela ibhajethi egxilile yokufunda nokufundisa izinto zokusekela (LTSM) nezinsiza ezilawulayo eziqondene nezidingo zokwelapha nokusekela abafundi ababhekene nobunzima bokufunda. Ukuphathwa kwe-Personnel Administrative Measures (PAM) ekuhleleni, ukwabeni, nasekuphatheni abantu abakwimisebenzi ephathelene nesevisi yokusekela ngokomoyenzelo nangohlelo lwemfundo efaka phakathi. Ukuphathwa kwabangcweti bengqondo, abahloli be-engqondo, nabaluleki ngaphakathi kohlelo lokuphatha imiklamo, izinsiza zomsebenzi, ukuqeqesha ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemigumo ephathelene nalo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinto zokulekelela kumsebenzi wokusekela ngokomoyenzelo nokokuqeqesha.

xh.title: UmGcini weNzululwazi yoMfundo onqwenela inqanaba 1: Obandakayo noku
xh.summary: UmGcini weNzululwazi yoMfundo onqwenela inqanaba 1 kwiNtloko yoMphakamo weSebe lezemFundo eEastern Cape eZwelitsha, efuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kunye nedayiploma yesidanga se-master kwizululwazi yomfundo okanye yengcebiso ngokwengqondo.
xh.requirements: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomchwetya-psikholoji kwikategori efanelekileyo yokuBhalisa (ezemFundo okanye iNgcebiso ngokwengqondo), kunye nedayiploma yesidanga se-master kwizululwazi yomfundo okanye yengcebiso ngokwengqondo. Amava amabalule kathathu (3) emva kokubhalisa njengoMchwetya-psikhologi oZimeleyo. Iimpawu zobuqu ezezigqibo ezibonisiweyo: inyaniso, ubungcali, ukuzimisela ngokwakho, nendlela yokusebenza ngempumelelo kwisebe. Amakhono amandla wokunxibelelana, kokubili okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo, ngenqanaba eliphezulu lokuchaneka kolwimi esiNgesini. Iinzuzo ezongezelelweyo: Amava kokubini kokwelapha ngokwengqondo (psychotherapy) kunye nankonzo yoxhaso lomfundo ngokwengqondo. Amave kumanyathelo wprojekthi njengokuvunywa kwezinto ezikhethekileyo (concessions), nenzalo (accommodation), nakunconzo yoxhaso ngokwengqondo ngokwempilo yengqondo ngaphakathi kwimeko yomfundo. Ulwazi namava ekuphuhliseni, ekusebenziseni, nakulawulweni amacebo okuqokelela iingcombolo ukuncedisa ukungalathelwa komchwere-psikhologi kumanyathelo abalulekileyo. Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo iinkqubo namagatya abalulekileyo ku-IE njenge-EWP 6, iinkqubo ze-SIAS, kunye ne-PAM. Ilayisense yokushuka esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Umchwetya-psikhologi oMkhulu uya kubakhokela ngamanyathelo abalulekileyo ekuphuhliseni nasekusebenziseni izinkonzo zoxhaso lomfundo ngokwengqondo, ngaphakathi kwemigama yomfundo obandakayo njengoko kucetyiswe kuzigqibo ezinjenge-WP6, i-SIAS, ext. ngaphakathi kweziZikolo eziBonelela iNkonzo eYeNkele, iziZikolo eziQhelekileyo zoLuntu kunye neziZikolo eziZodwa ukuze zipumelele kwizinga namazwe ngamazwe kuzinkonzo zoxhaso ezizezekileyo nasesidlangalaleni. Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo iiguqo zomthetho yesimo kwinguqulelo nemicimbi efuneka kusekwa nokuQinisekisa inqubo yomfundo ebandakanyiwe ukuze kuqulunqwe izinkonzo zoxhaso. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezixhomekeke kwingcombolo ukukhokela iplani, ukulawula, nokuzinika isigqibo kwingqwelomfundo ebandakanyiweyo, njengedatha yoluxhaso nothumelo kumacebo. Ukugcina amehlo kovimba kwingingqi, ulwazi lobhajeti, amacebo okuLawula nolawulo kwimigangatho ukuyinika isiqiniseko sokubonelela ngokuphumelela izinkonzo ngokwempilo yengqondo. Umchwetya-psikhologi omkhulu uya kuba ngumkhokeli ekubeni kukhethwa izinto ezibalulekileyo, ukwaba nokuLawula iNgqi ngokuvunyelwa kwamaphulo ngokwemfundo. Ukugcina amehlo nokulandela iNgqi evunyiweyo ngumbutho ombithelela iziXhobo ziSiza ezoFundo nokuQeqesha (LTSM) kwaye nazo zibhetele kuzo kubonelelwa eziFundo nokuNika uluxhaso ngokwamandla oLuntu ngamandla imfundo igqibile ukuze kubonelelwe iziFundo ngokwamaxhoba oLuntu. Ukuthathela phezulu iNgqikitya yoLuntu kwimeko yokulungiselela, kovimba wamaphulo ngokwemfundo yomfundo obandakanyiweyo. Ukulawula abaGcini bengQondo, abaqhubi bengQondo, nabaLolesi ngokwemfundo ngokwephulo leProjekthi, iLiso leNtetho yolwazi, iLiso loBhedu kwilwazi nokuQamba ngokwentsimbi nobuLungisa bamapolisi. UkuQamba ngokwentsimbi yolwazi nokuQeqesha ngokwemfundo ngokwamaphulo okuNika uluxhaso ngokwengQondo.

jobs.title: Education Psychologist (GRADE 1) Lspid: Inclusive Education

jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Educational Psychologist sought by the Eastern Cape Department of Education to support inclusive education for learners with severe intellectual disability across designated schools.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of an appropriate qualification and be registered with the HPCSA as an Educational Psychologist. Current registration as an Educational Psychologist with the HPCSA is required, and proof of this registration must be provided. The incumbent must be able to promote inclusive education which includes promoting access to quality public funded education for learners with disability. They should have experience in working as part of a team and collaborating with stakeholders. They should be able to take initiatives, work under pressure and problem-solve if and when necessary. Experience in coordinating education and other support for learners with disabilities will be an added advantage. The incumbent will function as part of the District-based Support Team with the specific responsibility of providing transversal outreach services to care centres and special schools that include learners with severe to profound intellectual disability (LSPID). The job involves travelling and therefore a valid driver’s license is a requirement. The applicant must have advanced computer skills.
jobs.duties: As a member of the transversal team, the incumbent will collaborate with team members in the provision of support to designated schools and care centres on an itinerant basis. Support to be provided will include: Assessment of LSPID enrolled in the schools/ care centres; provision of relevant therapeutic intervention to learners and families; monitoring and reporting on these learners’ progress; training caregivers on the learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting caregivers’ implementation of the learning programme for LSPID; training and supporting teachers on the learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting on the implementation of the learning programme in designated schools and care centres; advocating for access to quality public funded education for LSPID and carrying out administrative functions related to the support provided and ensuring that placement . The Incumbent may also be required to provide support to other learners in the community as and when needed.

af.title: Opvoedingsielkundige (GRAAD 1) Lspid: Inklusive Onderwys
af.summary: Opvoedingsielkundige gesoek deur die Eastern Cape Department of Education om inklusive onderwys vir leerders met ernstige intellektuele gestremdheid oor aangewese skole te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie beskik en by die HPCSA as Opvoedingsielkundige geregistreer wees. Hondige registrasie as 'n Opvoedingsielkundige by die HPCSA word vereis, en bewys van hierdie registrasie moet verskaf word. Die amptenaar moet in staat wees om inklusive onderwys te bevorder, wat die bevordering van toegang tot gehalte openbaar gefinansierde onderwys vir leerders met gestremdheid behels. Hulle behoort ondervinding te hê in spanwerk en samewerking met belangegroepen. Hulle moet in staat wees om inisiatief te neem, onder druk te werk en probleme op te los wanneer nodig. Ondervinding in die koördinasie van onderwys en ander ondersteuning vir leerders met gestremdhede sal 'n voordeel wees. Die amptenaar sal funksioneer as deel van die Distrik-gebaseerde Ondersteuningspan met die spesifieke verantwoordelikheid om transversale uitreikdienste te verskaf aan sorgsentra en spesiale skole wat leerders met ernstige tot diep intellektuele gestremdheid (LSPID) insluit. Die werk behels reis en daarom is 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie 'n vereiste. Die aansoeker moet oor gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede beskik.

zu.title: Iseluleki sezesiko lemfundo (GRADE 1) Lspid: Inclusive Education
zu.summary: Eastern Cape Department of Education ifuna Iseluleki sezesiko lemfundo ukuxhasa imfundo ehlanganisayo yabafundi abanesici sokuhlakula okuphansi kakhulu kuzo zonke izikole ezibaluliwe.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nokuqaliselelana okufanele kanye nokuba bakhulelwe ku-HPCSA njengoba Iseluleki sezesiko lemfundo. Kudingwa ukuba ukhulelwe njengoba Iseluleki sezesiko lemfundo ku-HPCSA ngalesi sikhashana, futhi kufanele kunikwe ubufakazi bokukhulelwa. Umuntu ovela esikhundleni kufanele akwazi ukukhuthaza imfundo ehlanganisayo okuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela emfundeni enemigqa yomphakathi etholwa izimali zikahulumeni yabafundi abeswela isidlavini. Kufanele babe nolwazi lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu kanye nokusebenzisana nabanomzabo. Kufanele bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo, ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga uma futhi nxa kunesidingo. Ukuba nolwazi lokuhlanganisa imfundo kanye nenye inkuxaso yabafundi abeswela isidlavini kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Umuntu ovela esikhundleni uzosebenza njengengxenye ye-District-based Support Team nobume obukhethekile bokuhlinzeka ngamasevisi okunqunyula emaqandeni kuye kumasu okunakekelwa kanye nezikole ezikhethekile ezibandakanya abafundi abanesici sokuhlakula okuphansi kakhulu kuye kokujulile (LSPID). Lo msebenzi uhilela ukuhamba ngakho-ke ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile yisidingo. Umfaki isicelo kufanele abe namakhono aphakeme ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Njengengxenye yeqembu elihamba phakathi kweminye iminyango, umuntu ovela esikhundleni uzosebenzisana namalungu eqembu ekuhlinzekeni inkuxaso ezikoleni ezibaluliwe nasemasu okunakekelwa ngendlela yokuhamba-hamba. Inkuxaso ezohlinzekwa izohlanganisa: Ukulinganisa abafundi be-LSPID ababhalise esikoleni/nasemasu okunakekelwa; ukuhlinzeka ngokungenelela okuthile okuhlobene nokwelasho abafundi kanye nemindeni; ukubheka kanye nokubika ngakuqhubeka kolwazi kulabo bafundi; ukuqeqesha abanakekeli ngenqubo yokufunda yalaba bafundi be-LSPID; ukubheka futhi kubike ngokuqashwa kolwazi ngemindeni yokuphumeza inqubo yokufunda yalaba bafundi be-LSPID; ukuqeqesha futhi ukuxhasa othisha ngenqubo yokufunda yalabo bafundi be-LSPID; ukubheka kanye nokubika ngokuphumeza inqubo yokufunda ezikoleni ezibaluliwe nasemasu okunakekelwa; ukulwelwa nokuba nemfundo ebanzi etholwa izimali zomphakathi yabafundi abanesici sokuhlakula okuphansi kakhulu kuye kokujulile (LSPID) kanye nokwenza imisebenzi ephathelene nenkuxaso etholakalayo futhi uqinisekise ukubekwa esikhundleni. Umuntu ovela esikhundleni ngesikhathi esithile kungadingeka nokuba ahlinze ngenkuxaso kubanye abafundi emphakathini uma futhi nxa kunesidingo.

xh.title: Onotchwayo wePsychology yemfundo (GRADE 1) Lspid: Imfundo ehlanganiswayo
xh.summary: Isebe lemfundo le-Eastern Cape lifuna uOnotchwayo wePsychology yemfundo ukuze axhasa imfundo ehlanganiswayo kubafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo kumaziko emfundo abalawulwayo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nelayisensi efanelekileyo yemfundo kwaye babhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengoOnotchwayo bePsychology yemfundo. Kufuneka abe nabhaliso lwangoku njengoOnotchwayo wePsychology yemfundo kwi-HPCSA, kwaye kufuneka abe nobungqina bobhaliso lwakhe. Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka akwazi ukukhuthaza imfundo ehlanganiswayo equka ukukhuthaza ukufikelela kwabafundi abanobungozi bemindingo kumfundo woluntu ngemali kahulumende. Kufuneka abe namava okusebenza njengelinye iqela nakuthothathelana nabantu. Kufuneka akwazi ukuziba iqondo, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokusombulula iingxaki xa kuyimfuneko. Ukuba namava ekulungeniseni imfundo nezinye iindlela zexhaso kubafundi abanobungozi bemindingo kuya kuba lusizo. Umntu okhethiweyo uza kusebenza njengelungu leQela loXhaso laseKawonke konke ngempumelelo elinomsebenzi othile wokunika iinkonzo zoxhaso oluhamba hamba kumaziko onakekelo nakumaziko emfundo ekhetheke kakhulu aquka abafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo (LSPID). Lo msebenzi uquka ukuhamba ngakumbi ngoko ilayisensi yokushayela kufuneka ibekho. Isicelo somntu kufuneka abe noshicilelo lothungelwano olulula oluncedisa imfundo ekupheleni kwekhaya.
xh.duties: Njengelungu leqela elihamba phakathi kwamanye amaziko, umntu okhethiweyo uza kusebenzisana namalungu eqela ekunikeni uxhaso kumaziko emfundo ekhethiweyo namaziko onakekelo ngendlela yokuhamba-hamba. Uxhaso olunikelwayo luya kuquka; Ukuvavanya abafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo (LSPID) ababhaliswe kumaziko emfundo/ amaziko onakekelo; ukunikela iinkonzo zokwenza kube lula ubomi kwabafundi nolwabo; ukuphaphama nokubika ngemigaqo yalaba bafundi; ukuqeqesha abanakekeli ngohlelo lokufunda lwabafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo; ukuphaphama nokubika ngendlela abanakekeli abayisebenzisa ngayo uhlelo lokufunda lwabafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo; ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa ootitshala ngohlelo lokufunda lwabafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo; ukuphaphama nokubika ngokusetyenziswa koluhlelo lokufunda kumaziko emfundo ekhethiweyo nakumaziko onakekelo; ukukhusela ukufikelela kumfundo woluntu ngemali kahulumende kubafundi abanobungozi bemindingo ebulalayo nokwenza imisebenzi yolawulo enxulumene nexhaso elinikiweyo ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa komntu . Umntu okhethiweyo kunokwabakho isidingo sokuba axhase nabafundi abanye emphakathini njani njani xa kuyimfuneko.

jobs.title: Education Therapist Specialist - Speech and Language
jobs.centre: AE (Butterworth) Ref No: DOE03/08/2026 AW (Fort Beaufort) Ref No: DOE04/08/2026 Alfred Nzo West Ref No: DOE05/08/2026 JOE Gqabi Ref No: DOE06/08/2026
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Education therapist specialists in speech and language needed for multiple Eastern Cape districts to provide therapeutic services and capacity-building in schools.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Speech-Language Therapy that allows for registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Current registration as a Speech-Language Therapist with the HPCSA is required, and proof of this registration must be provided. Applicants should have at least 5 years of relevant experience as a Speech-Language Therapist following their community service. Experience as an Education Therapist will be considered an added advantage. A valid driver's license is required. Knowledge: Inclusive Education (IE) policies (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; Guidelines on the development of Full- service/Inclusive Schools; Guidelines on the development of Special Schools as Resource Centres; Care and Support for Teaching and Learning (CSTL); Integrated School Health Policy. Skills: Therapeutic assessment and techniques; multi-disciplinary teamwork; Preventative and developmental approach; Development of training programmes; Report writing; Analysis of data and trends; Therapeutic research methodology; Communication, consultation and facilitation skills; Computer literacy; Presentation skills and organising and planning.
jobs.duties: To provide therapeutic and educational services to Public Ordinary and Public Special Schools within the Education District. Implement therapeutic capacity- building programmes for early identification of interventions relating to barriers to learning. Train educators, parents and support staff in the early identification of learning barriers particularly barriers to accessing the curriculum.; Conduct assessments; provide short term curriculum interventions to learners experiencing barriers to learning. Provide specialized therapeutic support to strengthen District and School-based Support Teams (DBSTs/SBSTs). Collaborate as multi-disciplinary teams with DBST to support learners experiencing therapeutic barriers to learning. Provide therapeutic support advisory services to SBST. Provide direct therapeutic support services to learners when necessary. Monitor support programmes for learners with high level needs referred and not yet placed in Special Schools or High-Level Support Programmes. Conduct discipline specific research (Speech and Language) and gather information to identify trends and address these needs within the district. Participate in inter- and intra-sectoral networks and collaborations. Collaborate on therapeutic support matters with multi- disciplinary teams at the Special Schools / Resource Centres and Full-Service Schools / Inclusive Schools to include learners who experience curriculum barriers to learning. Provide/manage professional supervision of the therapists in Public Special Schools within the District. Monitor and support the process of assessment, reporting, referrals and placement of learners according to levels of need. Monitor and support the implementation of administration- and record-keeping processes. Ensure the compliance of Therapists in the special schools to the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) Continuous Professional Development (CPD) policy. Report on the implementation of therapeutic support intervention programmes for early identification of barriers to learning, therapeutic participation in and contributions to inter- and intra- sectoral networks, therapeutic interventions. Monitor and manage assistive devices.

af.title: Opvoedings-terapie-spesialis - Spraak en Taal
af.summary: Opvoedings-terapie-spesialiste in spraak en taal word vir veelvuldige Eastern Cape-distrikte benodig om terapeutiese dienste en kapasiteitsbou in skole te bied.
af.requirements: Bachelorsgraad in Spraak-Taalterapie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie as 'n Spraak-Taalterapeut by die HPCSA word vereis, en bewys van hierdie registrasie moet verskaf word. Aansoekers moet ten minste 5 jaar se relevante ervaring as 'n Spraak-Taalterapeut na hul gemeenskapsdiens hê. Ervaring as 'n Opvoedings-terapeut sal as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie word vereis. Kennis: Beleide vir Inklusiewe Onderwys (IO) (Witpapier 6); Beleid vir Sifting, Identifisering, Assesserende en Ondersteuning (SIAS); Riglyne oor die ontwikkeling van Volledige-diens/Inklusiewe Skole; Riglyne oor die ontwikkeling van Spesiale Skole as Hulpbronsentrums; Sorg en Ondersteuning vir Onderrig en Leer (CSTL); Geïntegreerde Skoolgesondheidsbeleid. Vaardighede: Terapeutiese assessering en tegnieke; Multisdissiplinêre spanwerk; Preventiewe en ontwikkelende benadering; Ontwikkeling van opleidingsprogramme; Verslagskrywing; Analise van data en tendense; Terapeutiese navorsingsmetodologie; Kommunikasie, konsultasie en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Aanbiedingsvaardighede en organisering en beplanning.
af.duties: Om terapeutiese en opvoedkundige dienste aan Publieke Gewone en Publieke Spesiale Skole binne die Onderwysdistrik te bied. Implementeer terapeutiese kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir vroeë identifisering van ingrypings wat verband hou met hindernisse vir leer. Train opvoeders, ouers en ondersteuningspersoneel in die vroeë identifisering van leerhindernisse, veral hindernisse vir toegang tot die kurrikulum.; Voer assesserings uit; verskaf korttermyn-kurrikulumingrypings aan leerders wat hindernisse vir leer ervaar. Verskaf gespesialiseerde terapeutiese ondersteuning om Distrik- en Skoolgebaseerde Ondersteuningspanne (DBST's/SBST's) te versterk. Werk as multisdissiplinêre spanne saam met DBST om leerders wat terapeutiese hindernisse vir leer ervaar te ondersteun. Verskaf terapeutiese ondersteuningsadviesdienste aan SBST. Verskaf direkte terapeutiese ondersteuningsdienste aan leerders wanneer nodig. Monitor ondersteuningsprogramme vir leerders met hoëvlakbehoeftes wat verwys is en nog nie in Spesiale Skole of Hoëvlak-Ondersteuningsprogramme geplaas is nie. Voer dissipline-spesifieke navorsing (Spraak en Taal) uit en versamel inligting om tendense te identifiseer en hierdie behoeftes binne die distrik aan te spreek. Neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerking. Werk saam oor terapeutiese ondersteuningsaangeleenthede met multisdissiplinêre spanne by die Spesiale Skole / Hulpbronsentrums en Volledige-diensskole / Inklusiewe Skole om leerders wat kurrikulumhindernisse vir leer ervaar in te sluit. Verskaf/bestuur professionele toesig van die terapeute in Publieke Spesiale Skole binne die Distrik. Monitor en ondersteun die proses van assessering, verslagdoening, verwysings en plasering van leerders volgens vlakke van behoefte. Monitor en ondersteun die implementering van administrasie- en rekordhoudingsprosesse. Verseker die nakoming van Terapeute in die spesiale skole aan die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) se Beleid vir Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD). Rapporteer oor die implementering van terapeutiese ondersteuningsingrypingsprogramme vir vroeë identifisering van hindernisse vir leer, terapeutiese deelname aan en bydraes tot inter- en intrasektorale netwerke, terapeutiese ingrypings. Monitor en bestuur hulptoestelle.

zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor ekuKhulumeni nokuPhathwa Kolimi evumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Kudingeka ukubhalisa ngokwesikhathi samanje njengomelaphi wezokukhuluma nolimi ku-HPCSA, futhi kufanele kuthunyelwe ubufakazi bokubhalisa. Abafakeli kufanele babe nokuhlangenwe nakho okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 okuhlobene nokuba ngumelaphi wezokukhuluma nolimi emva kwenkonzo yabo yomphakathi. Ukuhlangenwe nakho njengochwepheshe Wokwelapha Ezemfundo kuzobhekwa njengenzuzo eyongeziwe. Kudingeka ibhotheli lokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo zokufundisa ngokuhlangenwe nakho (Inclusive Education) (White Paper 6); inqubomgomo ye-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS); imihlahla yokuthuthukiswa kwezikole ezikwazi ukusebenza ngokugcwele/ezibandakanya bonke; imihlahla yokuthuthukiswa kwezikole ezikhethekile njengezikhungo zokusiza; Care and Support for Teaching and Learning (CSTL); Inqubomgomo ye-Integrated School Health. Amakhono: Ukuhlola ukwelapha nobuchwepheshe; ukusebenza njengeqembu lezinhlobonhlobo zabanini-msebenzi; indlela yokuvikela nokuthuthuka; ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha; ukubhala izikulumi; ukuhlaziya idatha nezinhlobo zezinto ezitholakalayo; indlela yokucwaninga ngokwelapha; amakhono okuxhumana, wokubonisana nokuqondisa; ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; amakhono okuyisa emcabangweni nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha nezemfundo ezikoleni Zomphakathi Ezijwayelekile nezikoleni Zomphakathi Ezikhethekile ngaphakathi kwesigaba semfundo. Ukuphetha izinhlelo zokwakha amandla okwelapha ukuze kuhlonze kusenesikhathi ukungenelela okubhekene nokuqhubeka ekufundeni. Ukuqeqesha othisha, abazali nabasekeli ekutholeni kusenesikhathi izinto ezingabambe ekufundeni ikakhulukazi ezingabambe ekufinyeleleni kwisifundo.; Ukuhlola; ukunikeza ukungenelela okwesikhashana kwisifundo kubafundi ababhekana nobunzima ekufundeni. Ukunikeza inkxaso yezokwelapha ezikhethekile ukuze kuqiniswe amaqembu Okusekela Esigabeni naseSikoleni (DBSTs/SBSTs). Ukusebenza ndawonye njengeqembu lezinhlobo-zinhlobo zabanini-msebenzi ne-DBST ukuze kusekelwe abafundi ababhekana nobunzima bokwelapha ekufundeni. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha zokulekelela i-SBST. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha ngqo abafundi noma lapho kudingeka. Ukuqapha izinhlelo zokusekela abafundi abanemidingo ephakeme abathunyelwe abangaqedi ukubekwa ezikoleni Ezikhethekile noma ezinhlelweni Zokusekela Ezingeni Eliphakeme. Ukwenza ucwaningo oluhlobene nesifundo (Ukukhuluma nolimi) futhi uqoqe ulwazi ukuze uhlone izinhlobo futhi uxaze le midingo ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Ukubambe iqhaza kumanethiwekhi nokusebenzisana phakathi naphakathi kwezinhundlu. Ukusebenzisana kwezokwelapha eqenjini lezinhlobo-zinhlobo zabanini-msebenzi kwezokusekela kwezokwelapha kuzo Zikole Ezikhethekile / Izikhungo Zokusiza nezikole Ezikwazi Ukusebenza Ngokugcwele / Ezibandakanya bonke ukufaka abafundi ababhekana nobunzima ekufinyeleleni kwisifundo. Ukunikeza/okuphatha ukulawula ngobuchwepheshe abathandazi ezikoleni Zomphakathi Ezikhethekile ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Ukuqapha futhi useke inqubo yokuhlolwa, ukubika, ukuthunyelwa kanye nokubekwa kubafundi ngokwemilingo yemidingo. Ukuqapha futhi useke ukuphethwa kwenqubo yokuqashwa kwezinto okuyisikhulu nokugcina amarekhodi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abathandazi ezikoleni ezikhethekile bayalandela inqubomgomo ye-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) ye-Continuous Professional Development (CPD). Ukubika ngenqubo yokuqalwa kwezinhlelo zokusekela ukungenelela ngokwelapha ukuze kuhlonze kusenesikhathi ubunzima bokufunda, ukubamba iqhaza ngokwelapha kanye neminikelo kumanethiwekhi phakathi naphakathi kwezinhundlu, ukungenelela ngokwelapha. Ukuqapha futhi aphathe izinto zokusiza.

xh.title: Isikhanga kunye nolu lwimi
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho iingcali ezisesikhundleni sobugcisa bobuchule ekunyulisweni kolwimi nokuThetha ukwaziswa kumazwe ngamagcisa olu limi namakhono okusebenza koluntu.
xh.requirements: Ifundo yakho yaphezulu eya kukuqinisekisa ukuba ulawulwa ziGqalaZemisebenzi kwiNkqubo evela kwiSouth African Council for Speech and Hearing Professionals (SACHP). Kufunke ufakwe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba uyayazi imithetho yokuThotha nokulawula izicwangqiso ngokubanzi nezigqeba-buhlungu ngokweemfuno zamagqala eNtlaza yolwimi lwaBasebenzi. Ukuba ngumntu oqinisekisa ukulawulwa kolwazi olufana neSACHP nokuzinza koluntu ukwaziswa kokuba lunako na ukuqonda nokwenza imisebenzi yakhe ngokwemisebenzi yakhe.

jobs.title: Education Therapist Specialist - Physiotherapist
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Specialist physiotherapist needed at Chris Hani West District Office to support inclusive education through assessments, therapy, and capacity-building.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Physiotherapy allowing for registration with the HPCSA. Valid, current registration with the HPCSA as a Physiotherapist (proof of registration required. A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience post-community service. Experience as an Education Therapist will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s license is essential for district-wide travel. Knowledge and Skills: Deep understanding of Inclusive Education policies, including White Paper 6, the SIAS policy, and guidelines for Full- service and Special Schools as Resource Centres. Familiarity with the Integrated School Health Policy and CSTL is required. Technical Competencies: Expertise in therapeutic assessments, preventative approaches, and developmental techniques. Ability to conduct discipline- specific research to identify and address district trends. Proficiency in report writing, data analysis, and computer literacy. Strong presentation, consultation, and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Train educators, parents, and staff in early identification of physical barriers to learning. Implement capacity-building programmes for School-based Support Teams (SBSTs). Conduct assessments and provide specialized, short-term curriculum interventions and direct therapeutic support where necessary. Work within a multi-disciplinary team alongside the District-based Support Team (DBST) to support learners with high-level needs. Manage professional supervision of therapists in Special Schools. Ensure all district therapists comply with HPCSA Continuous Professional Development (CPD) policies. Monitor and manage the distribution and use of assistive devices across the district. Gather data and report on the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions and inter-sectoral collaborations.

af.title: Onderwysterapeutspesialis - Fisioterapeut
af.summary: Spesialis-fisioterapeut word benodig by Chris Hani West Distrikkantoor om inklusiewe onderwys te ondersteun deur assesserings, terapie en kapasiteitsbou.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Baccalaureusgraad in Fisioterapie wat registrasie by die HPCSA moontlik maak. Geldige, huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Fisioterapeut (bewys van registrasie word vereis. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring na gemeenskapsdiens. Ervaring as 'n Onderwysterapeut sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie is noodsaaklik vir distrikwye reis. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande begrip van Inklusiewe Onderwysbeleid, insluitend Witboek 6, die SIAS-beleid, en riglyne vir Volledige diens- en Spesiale Skole as Hulpbronsentrums. Bekendheid met die Geïntegreerde Skoolgesondheidsbeleid en CSTL word vereis. Tegniese Bevoegdhede: Kundigheid in terapeutiese assesserings, preventiewe benaderings, en ontwikkelingstegnieke. Vermoë om dissiplinspesifieke navorsing te doen om distriktendense te identifiseer en aan te spreek. Vaardigheid in verslagskrywing, data-ontleding en rekenaargeletterdheid. Sterk aanbiedings-, konsultasie- en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Train opvoeders, ouers en personeel in die vroeë identifikasie van fisiese struikelblokke tot leer. Implementeer kapasiteitsbouprogramme vir Skoolgebaseerde Ondersteuningspanne (SBSTs). Doen assesserings en verskaf gespesialiseerde, korttermynkurrikulumintervensies en direkte terapeutiese ondersteuning waar nodig. Werk binne 'n multidissiplinêre span langs die Distrikgebaseerde Ondersteuningspan (DBST) om leerders met hoëvlakbehoeftes te ondersteun. Bestuur professionele toesig oor terapeute in Spesiale Skole. Verseker dat alle distrikterapeute voldoen aan HPCSA se Beleide vir Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD). Monitor en bestuur die verspreiding en gebruik van hulptoestelle regoor die distrik. Versamel data en rapporteer oor die doeltreffendheid van terapeutiese intervensies en intersektorale samewerking.

zu.title: Ithuluzi Elikhulumisa ngemfundo - Umsekileli wezomzimba
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsekileli wezomzimba ohlakaniphile eChris Hani West District Office ukuxhasa imfundo ehlanganayo ngokuspena ukutholwa kwezinkinga, ukwelapha, nokwakha amandla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu: I-Bachelor's Degree kwi-Physiotherapy evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA. Ukubhalisa okusebenzayo okwamanje ku-HPCSA njengomsekileli wezomzimba (kudingwa ibhuloho lokubhalisa. Ukuze ube nokuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka eyi-5 ngemuva kwenkonzo yomphakathi. Ukuhlangenwe nakho njengoTherapist yoMfundo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yomshayeli esemthethweni iyadingeka ukuhamba kulo lonke idolobha. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuqonda ngokujulile izinqubomgomo zokuFunda ngokuhlanganisa, kuhlanganise i-White Paper 6, inqubomgomo ye-SIAS, namacebo abo wonke asebenzayo naboMfundo Besebelwe njengezikhungo zezinsiza. Ukuzijwayeza nenqubomgomo ye-Integrated School Health kanye ne-CSTL kudingwa. Amandla obuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe ekuspeneni ukutholwa kokwelapha, izindlela zokuvikela, nobuchwepheshe bokuthuthuka. Ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo ngokweqoondo ukuthola futhi kubeke izinkambu zaselojiswini. Ukubhala izibalo, ukuhlaziya idatha, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okwethula, ukweluleka, nokuqamba okuqinile.
zu.duties: Qeqesha abagisi, abazali, nabasebenzi ekuboneni ngokushesha izithiyo ezibangelwa umzimba ekufundeni. Philisa izinhlelo zokwakha amandla kumatimu wokuNxusa esikoleni (SBSTs). Yenza ukuspena futhi unikeze izinxulumo ezingenele ngokusheshayo zohlelo lwezifundo kanye nenkxaso yokwelapha ngokuqondile lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza ngaphakathi kumatimu ohlanganiswe emakhemikhini onke akekwe noMnyango wokuNxusa (DBST) ukuxhasa abafundi abanemfunzamo ephezulu. Lawula ukugxinwa ngobuchwepheshe kwabathengi abalapha ezikoleni ezingavamile. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenza ukulapha emaphakela bayalalela ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo ze-HPCSA ngokuQhubekela Phambili ngobuchwepheshe (CPD). Bheka futhi ulawule ukwabiwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinto ongazisebenzisa kulo lonke idolobha. Qoqa idatha ubike ngokusebenza kwezindlela ezilaphayo nokuhlangana ngokwezingqungqulu ezahlukene.

jobs.title: Education Therapist Specialist - Occupational Therapist
jobs.centre: ANW (MT. Frere CMC) Ref No: DOE08/08/2026 SB (Humansdorp CMC) Ref No: DOE09/08/2026 ORTC (Lusikisiki CMC) Ref No: DOE10/08/2026
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Education Therapist Specialist (Occupational Therapist) posts based at multiple Eastern Cape community centres, offering an OSD salary of R664410 to R735930 per annum.
jobs.requirements: RVQ 13/14 qualification in Occupational Therapy recognised by SAQA. Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Occupational Therapist. Registration with the South African Council for Educators (SACE) will be an added advantage. Five-years of relevant experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Knowledgeable about a) National and Provincial Education legislation, policies and regulations (e.g. Health Professions Act, Screening Identification Assessment and Support policy (SIAS), South African Schools Act (SASA), Employment of Educators Act (EEA), White Paper 6 (Support for special needs learners), b) Analytic, diagnostic and assessment tools, c) Intervention methods, d) Child development, e) Therapeutic models and techniques, f) Understanding of group dynamics, g) Protocol and professional ethics.
jobs.duties: Assess the learner’s level of functioning to identify barriers to learning based on the Occupational Therapists’ scope of practice: Conduct screening for the learners; administer formal and informal assessments. Analyse and interpret information to make decisions regarding the need for therapeutic intervention, engage in multi-disciplinary team discussions and make recommendations and/or referrals. 2) Provide intervention (direct and indirect therapy) relating to barriers to learning: Provide direct and indirect Occupational Therapy services based on an Occupational Therapy plan to learners in public special schools and public ordinary schools; determine individualized and group Occupational Therapy; prescribe, issue, and maintain assistive devices; maintain records of Occupational Therapy, effective administration practices and report to supervisors as required. 3) Engage in therapeutic capacity-building programmes and skills sharing on related therapy issues/matters: Provide direct and indirect Occupational Therapy services based on an Occupational Therapy plan to learners in public special schools and public ordinary schools; Provide appropriate information regarding programmes offered by therapists to internal and external stakeholders (e.g., School Based Support Team, District Based Support Team, parents etc.). Promote awareness of the different therapy disciplines; participate in awareness campaigns of different disabilities; provide direct or indirect outreach services when required; engage in continuous professional developmental activities based on the relevant programmes offered in the school; supervise undergraduate Occupational Therapy students and therapy assistants as required. 4) Manage Therapy support materials and equipment: Request appropriate and adequate therapy support materials and equipment based on learner needs; safeguard therapy support materials and equipment; maintain records of therapy material, equipment and the issuing of assistive devices and report faults and maintenance needs of the materials and equipment; participate in inter and intra-sectoral networks and collaborations. 5. Participate in inter- and intra- sectoral networks and collaborations. Collaborate and interact with stakeholders (e.g., Department of Health, Department of Social Development, local government, and the broader Community). 6. Management and Administration: Manage effective administration practices of Occupational Therapy interventions; ensure compliance with the code of Ethics of the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA); practice sound interpersonal relations, engage actively in performance appraisals per requirement.
