af.summary: Onderwysterapeutspesialis (Arbeidsterapeut) poste gebaseer by verskeie Eastern Cape gemeenskapsentrums, wat 'n OSD-salaris van R664410 tot R735930 per jaar aanbied.
af.requirements: RVQ 13/14-kwalifikasie in Arbeidsterapie erken deur SAQA. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Arbeidsterapeut. Registrasie by die South African Council for Educators (SACE) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vyf jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Kennis van a) Nasionale en Provinciale Onderwyswetgewing, beleide en regulasies (bv. Health Professions Act, Screening Identification Assessment and Support policy (SIAS), South African Schools Act (SASA), Employment of Educators Act (EEA), White Paper 6 (Ondersteuning vir leerders met spesiale behoeftes), b) Analitiese, diagnostiese en assesseringsinstrumente, c) Ingrypingsmetodes, d) Kinderontwikkeling, e) Terapeutiese modelle en tegnieke, f) Begrip van groepsdinamika, g) Protokol en professionele etiek.
af.duties: Assesseer die leerder se vlak van funksionering om hindernisse vir leer te identifiseer op grond van die Arbeidsterapeute se omvang van praktyk: Voer sifting uit vir die leerders; administreer formele en informele assesserings. Analiseer en interpreteer inligting om besluite te neem oor die behoefte aan terapeutiese ingryping, neem deel aan multidissiplinêre teambesprekings en maak aanbevelings en/of verwysings. 2) Bied ingryping (direkte en indirekte terapie) aan wat verband hou met hindernisse vir leer: Bied direkte en indirekte Arbeidsterapie-dienste aan op grond van 'n Arbeidsterapie-plan aan leerders in openbare spesiale skole en openbare gewone skole; bepaal geïndividualiseerde en groep Arbeidsterapie; skryf voor, reik uit en onderhou hulptoestelle; hou rekords van Arbeidsterapie, effektiewe administratiewe praktyke en doen verslag aan toesighouers soos vereis. 3) Neem deel aan terapeutiese kapasiteitsbouprogramme en vaardigheidsdeling oor verwante terapiekwessies/aangeleenthede: Bied direkte en indirekte Arbeidsterapie-dienste aan op grond van 'n Arbeidsterapie-plan aan leerders in openbare spesiale skole en openbare gewone skole; Verskaf toepaslike inligting aangaande programme wat deur terapeute aangebied word aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes (bv. School Based Support Team, District Based Support Team, ouers ens.). Bevorder bewustheid van die verskillende terapie-dissiplines; neem deel aan bewustheidsveldtogte van verskillende gestremdhede; bied direkte of indirekte uitreikdienste aan wanneer vereis; neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite op grond van die tersaaklike programme by die skool aangebied; hou toesig oor voorgraadse Arbeidsterapie-studente en terapie-assistente soos vereis. 4) Bestuur Terapie-ondersteuningsmateriaal en toerusting: Verskaf toepaslike en voldoende terapie-ondersteuningsmateriaal en toerusting op grond van leerderbehoeftes; bewaar terapie-ondersteuningsmateriaal en toerusting; hou rekords van terapiemateriaal, toerusting en die uitreik van hulptoestelle en rapporteer foute en instandhoudingsbehoeftes van die materiaal en toerusting; neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerkings. 5. Neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerkings. Werk saam en wissel werking met belanghebbendes (bv. Department of Health, Department of Social Development, plaaslike regering, en die breër gemeenskap). 6. Bestuur en Administrasie: Bestuur effektiewe administratiewe praktyke van Arbeidsterapie-ingrypings; verseker nakoming van die kode van Etiek van die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA); beoefen gesonde interpersoonlike verhoudinge, neem aktief deel aan prestasie-evaluerings soos vereis.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezelapho Ezemfundo - Ugwethe Wokubulawa Kwesisindo
zu.summary: Izikhundla zochwepheshe bezelapho ezemfundo (Ugwethe Wokubulawa Kwesisindo) esekelwe emitholweni yomphakathi eminingana yakwa Eastern Cape, inikeza iholo le-OSD elingu R664410 kuya ku R735930 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-RVQ 13/14 kule Theraphy Yokubulawa Kwesisindo ezitholwe yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba ugwethe wokubulawa kwesisindo. Ukubhalisa ku-South African Council for Educators (SACE) kuzoba yinuzuzo. Uhlolisise eminyaka yisihlanu wenza umsebenzi ohambisanayo ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Unolwazi mayelana ne) Nemithetho, izinqubomgomo nemibandela yemfundo yezwe nakwishuro, b) Izithiwoz sokuhlola, ukuxilanga izifo nokuhlola, c) Izindlela zokungenelela, d) Intuthuko yengane, e) Izakhiwo kanye namakhono okwelapha, f) Ukuqonda ukuziphatha kweqembu, g) Imithetho yekhono nokuziphatha komsebenzi.
zu.duties: Hlola izinga lokusebenza kwesifundi ukuze kutholakale izithiwozokulinga ngokusekelwe kumkhakha wokusebenza kogwethe wokubulawa kwesisindo: Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezifundi; phatha ukuvivinywa okusemthethweni nongaqashwe mthetho. Hlaziya futhi uchaze ulwazi ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo mayelana nesidingo sokungenelela kokwelapha, thatha inxaxheba ezinkulumweni zeqembu elinamakhono ahlukene futhi wenze izincomo kanye/noma okokuqondisa. 2) Nikeza ukungenelela (ukwelapha ngokuqondile nangangaqondile) okuhlobene nezithiwozokulinga: Nikeza amasevisi okubulawa kwesisindo ngokuqondile nangangaqondile ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lokubulawa kwesisindo kubafundi kumaziko amabalomsiza namajikimjiki kubafundi; qamba izinhlelo zobuqwethe ngamunye nangamaqembu; kwelule, uphathisise, futhi agcine izinsiza eziluncedo; gcina amarekhodi okubulawa kwesisindo, izindlela zokuphatha ngempumelelo futhi umbike abaphathi njengoba kudingeka. 3) Thatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokwakha amandla okwelapha nokusabelana ngamakhono ekwelapha ezindabeni eziyizidingo ukuqonda; Nikeza amasevisi okubulawa kwesisindo ngokuqondile nangangaqondile ngokusekelwe ohlelweni lokubulawa kwesisindo kubafundi kumaziko amabalomsiza namajikimjiki abafundi; Nikeza ulwazi olufanele mayelana nezinhlelo ezinikelwe ogwethe kubashabiwe bengaphakathi nangaphandle (isb., Iqembu Lokwesekela Esikoleni, Iqembu Lokwesekela Esifundeni, abazali nokunye). Khuthaza ukuqonda mayelana namakhono okubulawa kwesisindo ahlukene; thatha inxaxheba emikhankasweni yokuqonda ukukhwayeka okuhlukene; nikeza izinsiza ezihlukene lapho kudingeka; thatha inxaxheba ezintshweni zokusethuka komsebenzi ngokusobayo ohlelweni olunikelwe esikoleni; lawula abafundi be-undergraduate abafunda ukubulawa kwesisindo kanye nabalawula abasizi bokuqwethe njengoba kudingeka. 4) Lawula amabhuloki wesekela abanikezwa ukusiza kanye nezinsiza: Cela izinsiza ezifanele kanti futhi ezinganele eziyisibonezelo sokuxhasa ukubulawa kwesisindo ezibhekene nezidingo zabafundi; gcina izinsiza zokubulawa kwesisindo; futhi zigcine amarekhodi okubulawa kwesisindo, amabhuloki ezeqe, kanye nokuqashiswa kwezinsiza futhi kube nezinsizekelo; bathathe inxaxheba kumanethiwekhi kanye nasezinhlanganisweni ezingaphakathi nangaphandle kwemingcele. 5. Thatha inxaxheba kumanethiwekhi nasezinhlanganisweni ezingaphakathi nangaphandle kwemingcele. Sebenzisana futhi uthintane labashabiwe (isb., Umnyango Wezempilo, Umnyango Wezentuthuko Yomphakathi, uhulumeni waseduze, nabaningi bomphakathi). 6. Ukuphatha nokulawula: Yenza izinqubo zokulawula ngempumelelo kokungenelela kokubulawa kwesisindo; qinisekis ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho we-HPCSA; zibe nobudlelwano obuhle kwezengqondo, thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimela kokuqashiswa kwangempumelelo njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Speshalisti yeTherapy yoMfundo - uNgcangcarelo we-Therapist
xh.summary: Izithuba zeSpeshalisti yeTherapy yoMfundo (uNgcangcarelo we-Therapist) eziqhelwa kwiizenzo zomthakathi ezininzi kwi-Eastern Cape, ezinika umvuzo we-OSD osuka kwi-R664410 ukuya kwi-R735930 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: I-RVQ 13/14 qualification kwakunye nokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoNgcangcarelo we-Therapy. Ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Council for Educators (SACE) kuya kuba yomelezo. Iminyaka emihlanu yamava ahambelana nokubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ulwazi ngqa) i-National and Provincial Education legislation, policies and regulations (e.g. Health Professions Act, Screening Identification Assessment and Support policy (SIAS), South African Schools Act (SASA), Employment of Educators Act (EEA), White Paper 6 (Support for special needs learners), b) Analytic, diagnostic and assessment tools, c) Intervention methods, d) Child development, e) Therapeutic models and techniques, f) Understanding of group dynamics, g) Protocol and professional ethics.
xh.duties: Hlola inqanaba lomsebenzi wesifundi ukuze athathe iindlela ezibambele kufundo ngokusekelwe kwicala lomsebenzi labaNgcangcarelo be-Therapy: Yenza uvavanya kubafundi; yenza uvavanya olusemthethweni nolungalwanga emthethweni. Hlalanisa uthathelwe ngokweenkcukacha ukuze wenze izigqibo malunga nesidingo sokungenelela ngokwezempilo, thabathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zethetha ngeqela elinezinto ezininzi zenze izindululo nokuthumela kwabanye. 2) Yenza inkonzo yokungenelela (yodwa nangenxa yodwa) ehambelana nezithintelo kufundo: Yenza iinkonzo ze-Occupational Therapy zobuqu nangaphandle ngokusekelwe kwindlela yokwenza i-Occupational Therapy kubafundi kumagumbi amanqanaba abantu abakhethe ukuba ngabakhethekileyo namagumbi amanqanaba abantu abaqhelekileyo; qamba i-Occupational Therapy yodwa noma eqeleni; yaleza, nikela, zigcine izixhobo ezincedayo; zigcine iirekhodi ze-Occupational Therapy, izinto zolawulo ezisebenzayo uzive ukuza kubaphathi njengoko kudingiwe. 3) Thabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezakhulula amandla ngokwezempilo ukuzidla ngolwazi malunga neendaba ezihambelana netherapy: Yenza iinkonzo ze-Occupational Therapy zobuqu nangaphandle ngokusekelwe kwindlela yokwenza i-Occupational Therapy kubafundi kumagumbi amanqanaba abantu abakhethe ukuba ngabakhethekileyo namagumbi amanqanaba abantu abaqhelekileyo; Nikela nolwazi olufanelekileyo malunga neenkqubo ezinikwa ngabanikabatherapy kubantu abangenaphakathi nangaphandle (umz., Iqela Lesiseko Lomthetho Lwesikolo, Iqela Lesiseko Lomthetho Wommandla, oogxiwelayedki bayo). Phakamisa ulwazi ngamagumbi ahlukeneyo etherapy; thabatha inxaxheba kumashishini okuphakamisa ulwazi ngokungabakho kwabantu ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo; nikeza iinkonzo zokufikelela ngokuthe ngqo nangaphandle xa kudingiwe; thabatha inxaxheba kumashishini okuphuhlisa ubuchule ngokuqhubekayo ngokusekelwe kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezibonelelwa kwisikolo; lawula abafundi bakhululekiweyo be-Occupational Therapy nabancedi be-therapy njengoko kudingiwe. 4) Lawulaphatha izinto ezixhasa i-Occupational Therapy nempahle: Cela izinto ezixhasa i-Occupational Therapy nempahle ezifanelekileyo naneleyo ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zabafundi; zikhusele izinto ezixhasa i-Occupational Therapy nempahle; gcina iirekhodi zempahle ye-therapy, empahlethi nokunikelwa kwezixhobo ezincedayo uze wenze ingxelo yeziphithiphithi neemfuno zokulungiswa kwale mipahle nempahlethi; thabatha inxaxheba kumanqwanqwa nengqungquthela phakathi kwaye ngaphakathi kumacandelo. 5. Thabatha inxaxheba kumanqwanqwa nengqungquthela phakathi kwaye ngaphakathi kwamanye amacandelo. Sebenzisana naye unxibelelane nalabo bantu abanomdla (umz., Isebe lezeMpilo, Isebe lezeNkcutha ngokweentlalo, urhulumente wengingasemzini, namakomkhulu omthakathi). 6. Ulawulo nokuLawulaphatha: Yenza izinto zolawulo ezisebenzayo zezenkozo ze-Occupational Therapy interventions; qinisekisa ukuzithembela ngokomthetho we-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA); zibe nomntla omhle kubantu, thabatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kukuqanjwa kwe[Ngxelo yokuSebenza] njengoko kudingiwe.

jobs.title: Chief Education Therapist – Speech and Language Therapist
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Chief Education Therapist (Speech and Language) based at Joe Gqabi District Office, providing itinerant therapeutic support to special and mainstream schools for learners with severe to profound needs.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognized qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Speech and Language Therapist. Current, valid registration with the HPCSA in Independent Practice. A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience post-registration with the HPCSA as a Speech and Language Therapist. Driver’s License: A valid driver’s license is mandatory as the role requires extensive travel within the District. Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for grant monitoring and data reporting. Knowledge and skills: In-depth knowledge of Inclusive Education policies (SIAS, White Paper 6). Expertise in Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) and its application for non-verbal learners with profound disabilities. Ability to take initiative, work under pressure, and apply innovative problem-solving in under-resourced care centre environments. Knowledge of safe positioning and modified textures is vital for their safety in care centres. Ability to understanding how sensory processing (e.g., tactile defensiveness or auditory hypersensitivity) impacts a learner's ability to communicate in a noisy care centre. Excellent communication skills.
jobs.duties: Transversal Outreach: Provide itinerant therapeutic support to designated Special Care Centres and Special Schools/Resource Centres for learners with LSPID/ Mainstream schools and High level of support Units catering for learners with severe to profound needs. Support the rollout of the Learning Programme for LSPID through screening, specialized assessment, and tailored communication intervention. Function as a key member of the District- based Support Team (DBST), collaborating with Psychologists, Occupational Therapists, Physiotherapists, and Special Needs Teachers. Train and mentor caregivers, parents, and school staff on the implementation of communication strategies and the Learning Programme. Promote the rights of learners with disabilities to quality, public-funded education in line with Education White Paper 6 and the SIAS Policy. Maintain accurate learner records, monitor progress, and compile comprehensive reports for the ECDOE and National Department of Basic Education (DBE).

af.title: Hoofopvoedingsterapeut – Spraak- en taalterapeut
af.summary: Hoofopvoedingsterapeut (Spraak en Taal) gebaseer by Joe Gqabi Distrikkantoor, wat reisende terapeutiese ondersteuning aan spesiale en hoofstroomskole vir leerders met ernstige tot diep behoeftes bied.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike erkende kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Spraak- en taalterapeut moontlik maak. Huidige, geldige registrasie by die HPCSA in Independent Practice. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Spraak- en taalterapeut. Bestuurderslisensie: 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie is verpligtend aangesien die rol uitgebreide reis binne die Distrik vereis. Gevorderde vaardigheid in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) vir toelaagmonitering en datarapportering. Kennis en vaardighede: Diepgaande kennis van Inclusive Education-beleide (SIAS, White Paper 6). Kundigheid in Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) en die toepassing daarvan vir nie-verbale leerders met diep gestremdhede. Vermoë om inisiatief te toon, onder druk te werk, en innoverende probleemoplossing toe te pas in omgewings met sorgsentra met beperkte hulpbronne. Kennis van veilige posisionering en aangepaste teksture is noodsaaglik vir hul veiligheid in sorgsentra. Vermoë om te verstaan hoe sensoriese verwerking (bv. tasiele verdediging of ouditiewe oorgevoeligheid) 'n leerder se vermoë om te kommunikeer in 'n rumoerige sorgsentrum beïnvloed. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Transversale uitreik: Verskaf reisende terapeutiese ondersteuning aan aangewese Special Care Centres en Special Schools/Resource Centres vir leerders met LSPID/ Mainstream-skole en High level of support Units wat leerders met ernstige tot diep behoeftes bedien. Ondersteun die implementering van die Learning Programme vir LSPID deur sifting, gespesialiseerde assessering, en op maat gemaakte kommunikasie-intervensie. Funksioneer as 'n sleutellid van die District-based Support Team (DBST), in samewerking met Psigoloë, Arbeidsterapeute, Fisioterapeute, en Spesiale behoeftes-onderwysers. Train en begelei versorgers, ouers, en skoolpersoneel oor die implementering van kommunikasie-strategieë en die Learning Programme. Bevorder die regte van leerders met gestremdhede tot gehalte, openbaar befondsde opvoeding in ooreenstemming met Education White Paper 6 en die SIAS-beleid. Onderhou akkurate leerderrekords, moniter vordering, en stel omvattende verslae op vir die ECDOE en National Department of Basic Education (DBE).

zu.title: UNobhala-Jikelele WokuThola Ukuze Kusize Ezemfundo – UTherapist Wokukhuluma Nolimi
zu.summary: UNobhala-Jikelele WokuThola Ukuze Kusize Ezemfundo (Ukulala Ulimi) osebenza eJoe Gqabi District Office, ethela ukwesekwa kokwelapha okuhamba njalo ezikoleni ezikhethekile nasezivamile kubafundi ababezidingongqongqo ezinzima kakhulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivunyiwe ezivumela ukubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenguTherapist Wokukhuluma Nolimi. Ukubhalisa okwamanje, okusemthethweni ku-HPCSA ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngokuzimela. Okungenani eminyaka 3 yokuhlaleka okufanelekile emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoTherapist Wokukhuluma Nolimi. Ilayisense yokushayela: Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni iyindlela ephoqelelekile njengoba le ndima idinga ukuhamba kakhulu ngaphakathi kwesiFunda. Ukubhana okuhlule kakhulu kwi-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) ukuze kuqashelwe imikhiqizo nokubika idatha. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile mayelana namapholisi eMfundo Ehlanganayo (SIAS, White Paper 6). Ukwazi kahle i-Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) nokusetshenziswa kwayo kubafundi abangakhulumi ababezinkinga ezinzima. Ukuthola isikhuthazo sabo, ukusebenza ngokucindezela nokusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuqaxumba izinkinga ezindaweni ezinganamithombo emikhaya yokunakekelwa. Ulwazi lokubeka ngokuphepha nokushintsha ukubonakala kokudla kubalulekile ukugcina ukuphepha kwabo emikhayeni yokunakekelwa. Ikhono lokuthi kuyindlela yokuxhumanisa ngokuzwa izwi kulawula izwi ekwaziseni inkathi, ukuzwa okwezwi, ukuzwa olunye ulwimi noma olunye uhlobo lokubhala lolimi. Ulwazi lokubeka abafundi ngokuphepha nokudla okulungisiwe kubalulekile ukugcina ukuphepha kwabo emikhayeni yokunakekelwa. Ikhono lokuzwa kahle ukuthi ukucutshungwa kwemisipha engaphansi kwesikhumba sibangela kanjani ukunqaba ukuthinta noma ukuzwa kakhulu kwezwi. Ukuxhumana kahle ngomlomo kubafundi ababezinkinga zokuzwa emakhaya aphila ngokukhululeka. Amakhono okuxhumana abhalwe kahle.
zu.duties: Ukuba khona ekuqondeni izindawo ezahlukene kubafundi ababenezinga eliphakeme elibiza ukuxhaswa ngokukhethekile. Ukuxhasa abayi-Learning Programme for LSPID ukuze baqonde ukuthi kuyenzakala kanjani lokhu okungaka emakhaya abakwezinsizakalo. Ukuba yilungu elibalulekile kuDistrict-based Support Team (DBST). Ukubeka abafundi emisebenzini yezandla ebalulekile ekubukeni imisipha yabo, ukubona imisipha ngaphansi kwesikhumba nokubamba imisipha, nokuthola ukuthi bayayikhuluma kanjani imisipha yabo nokuyixhawula imisipha. Ukuqeqesha abanakekeli kakhulu ekubukeni imisipha yakho ngokomzwelo ngokubona izimpawu eziyayikhuluma imisipha yakho yokuzwa nokuyixhawula.

xh.title: I-Nkulumbuso yabaThathi Ngunyondiso – uThathi Lwelizwi nolwemiLelo
xh.summary: I-Nkulumbuso yabaThathi Ngunyondiso (UkuThatha kwelizwi nolwemiLelo) egqithiswe kwi-Ofisi yeJoe Gqabi District, inika inkxaso yokuThatha ngunyondiso ehamba-hamba kwiikholeji ezizodwa nasezikolweni eziqhelekileyo kwabafundi abanamadinga abakhulu ukuya kubanzima kakhulu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esiqinisekisiweyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoThathi Lwelizwi nolwemiLelo. Ukubhalisa okusebenzayo, okusemthethweni kwi-HPCSA kwiNkqubo yokuSebenza yokuzimeleyo. Isiphiwo esingaphantsi kwe-3 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoThathi Lwelizwi nolwemiLelo. Ilayisensi yokushuka: Ilayisensi esemthethweni yokushuka iyimfuno njengoko le ndima idinga uhamba-hamba olubanzi ngaphakathi kwi-District. Ukuziqhelanisa ngokuqhubela phambili kwi-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) ukulawula iimali zoxhaso nokubika iingcombolo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngenkqubo yokuFunda ekwabandakanyweni (SIAS, White Paper 6). Ukuziqhelanisa ekunxulumeni nasekuSetyenzisweni kolwimi olunganganga olutsha (AAC) nakusetyenzisweni kwalo kwabafundi abangathethiyo abanokuQhwabela amakhondo abanzima. Ikhono lokuzithabaxa, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, nokusebenzisa izisombulu ezingqiqiyo eziyimveliso kwendawo ezingamntu namandla okunakekela. Ulwazi ngokubeka ngokhuseleko nokutshintsha isiphelo sasemilenzweni sibalulekile ngenxa yokhuseleko lwabo kwindawo zokunakekela. Ikhono lokuyiva ngendlela iinkqubo zamazwi ezenzakalayo (umzekelo, ukuzithethelela ngesandla okanye ukuzwela kakhulu ngendlela yamasundu) ezithintelwa ukuba kwakhona ukuthetha komfundi kwindawo yonqulo ethintayo. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana.
xh.duties: Intlatyo eYadluliselwa: Ukunika inkxaso yokuthatha ngunyondiso ehamba-hamba kwiindawo ezizodwa zokuNakekela nakwiZikolo ezizodwa/nakwiZiko lezeNkxalabo kubafundi abane-LSPID/nasezikolweni eziqhelekileyo naseMacandelo aPhakamileyo oXhaso abanakekela abafundi abanamadinga amakhulu ukuya kubanzima. Inkxaso ekurhwebeni kwenkqubo yokuFunda ye-LSPID ngokuhlola, ukuvavanywa ngobugcisa, nokungenelela ekunxulumaneni ngokwezifiso. Ukusebenza njengelungu elibalulekileyo leQela loXhaso laseKawonke-wonke (DBST), ukusebenzisana nabaNgcali bokuziphatha, abaThathi bokusebenza ngamandla emzimba, abaThathi bokuphulusa, noTitshala abaNeedayo ngokukodwa. Ukuzinklabela nokukhokela abanakekeli, abazali, nabasebenzi besikolo ngokuSetyenziswa kweenkqubo zolwimi nakwiNkqubo yokuFunda. Ukukhuthaza amalungelo abafundi abakhubekileyo ngafundo yamakhongo angabhalwa ngawo elungileyo ngokweliNgqungquthana lezeMfundo iWhite Paper 6 nakuMgaqo we-SIAS. Ukugcina irekhodi ecace gca esemthethweni yomfundi, ukulawula inkqubela, nokwenza iingxelo ezicwangcisiweyo ze-ECDOE neQumrhu leZiko lezeMfundo ezeKawonke-wonke (DBE).

jobs.title: Senior Education Specialist (LSPID): Education Social
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Senior Education Specialist providing itinerant education support to designated schools and care centres, requiring a professional teaching qualification, SACE registration and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a recognised 3- or 4-year qualification which includes a professional teacher qualification. They should be registered with the South African Council of Educators (SACE) as professional educator and have 5 years’ experience in the educational field. The incumbent must have in-depth knowledge and understanding of education legislation and policies. The incumbent must be able to promote inclusive education which includes promoting access to quality public funded education for learners with disability. They should have experience in working as part of a team and collaborating with stakeholders. They should be able to take initiatives, work under pressure and problem-solve if and when necessary. Experience in co- ordinating education and other support for learners with disabilities will be an added advantage. The incumbent will function as part of the District-based Support Team with the specific responsibility of providing transversal outreach services to care centres and special schools that include learners with severe to profound intellectual disability (LSPID). The job involves travelling and therefore a valid driver’s licence is a requirement. The applicant must have advanced computer skills.
jobs.duties: As a member of the transversal team, the incumbent will collaborate with team members in the provision of education support to designated schools and care centres on an itinerant basis. Support to be provided will include: Assessment of LSPID enrolled in the schools/ care centres; provision of relevant support to learners and families; monitoring and reporting on these learners’ progress; training caregivers on the learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting caregivers’ implementation of the learning programme for LSPID; training and supporting teachers on learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting on the implementation of the learning programme in designated schools and care centres; advocating for access to quality public funded education for LSPID and carrying out administrative functions related to the support provided including placement of out of school children in schools. The incumbent may also be required to provide support to other learners in the community as and when needed.

af.title: Senior Onderwyspesialis (LSPID): Onderwys Sosiaal
af.summary: Senior Onderwyspesialis wat reisende onderwyssteun aan aangewese skole en sorgsentra bied, wat 'n professionele onderwyskwalifikasie, SACE-registrasie en vyf jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n erkende 3- of 4-jarige kwalifikasie hê wat 'n professionele onderwyserkwalifikasie insluit. Hulle moet by die South African Council of Educators (SACE) as professionele opvoeder geregistreer wees en 5 jaar se ervaring in die onderwysveld hê. Die ampsdraer moet diep kennis en begrip van onderwyswetgewing en -beleid hê. Die ampsdraer moet inklusiewe onderwys kan bevorder wat die bevordering van toegang tot gehalte openbare befondsde onderwys vir leerders met gestremdhede insluit. Hulle moet ervaring hê in spanwerk en samewerking met belanghebbendes. Hulle moet in staat wees om inisiatief te toon, onder druk te werk en probleme op te los waar en wanneer nodig. Ervaring in die koördineering van onderwys- en ander steun vir leerders met gestremdhede sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Die ampsdraer sal as deel van die Distrik-gebaseerde Ondersteunspan funksioneer met die spesifieke verantwoordelikheid om dwarslopende uitreikdienste aan sorgsentra en spesiale skole wat leerders met ernstige tot diep intellektuele gestremdheid (LSPID) insluit, te bied. Die werk behels reis en daarom is 'n geldige bestuurslisensie 'n vereiste. Die aansoeker moet gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede hê.
af.duties: As lid van die dwarslopende span sal die ampsdraer met spanlede saamwerk in die verskaffing van onderwyssteun aan aangewese skole en sorgsentra op 'n reisende basis. Steun wat verskaf sal word, sluit in: Assessering van LSPID wat in die skole/sorgsentra ingeskryf is; verskaffing van tersaaklike steun aan leerders en gesinne; monitering en verslagdoening oor hierdie leerders se vordering; opleiding van versorgers oor die leerprogram vir LSPID; monitering en verslagdoening oor versorgers se implementering van die leerprogram vir LSPID; opleiding en ondersteuning van onderwysers oor die leerprogram vir LSPID; monitering en verslagdoening oor die implementering van die leerprogram in aangewese skole en sorgsentra; voorligting vir toegang tot gehalte openbare befondsde onderwys vir LSPID en die uitvoer van administratiewe funksies wat verband hou met die verskafte steun, insluitende die plasings van buite-skoolse kinders in skole. Die ampsdraer kan ook van tyd tot tyd vereis word om steun aan ander leerders in die gemeenskap te verskaf soos wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezemfundo Ophakeme (LSPID): Ezenhlalo Ezemfundo
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe Wezemfundo Ophakeme ohlinzeka ngokusekelwa kwemfundo okuyahamba-hamba ezikoleni ezikhethiwe nasemikhakheni yenakekelo, okudinga iziqu zokufundisa ngobungcweti, ukubhaliswa ku-SACE namava eminyakeni eyi-5.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nokuqashelwa iziqu ezaziwayo zeminyaka eyi-3 noma eyi-4 okuhlanganisa iziqu zobthisha ngobungcweti. Kufanele babhaliswe ku-South African Council of Educators (SACE) njengabachwepheshe bemfundo babe namava eminyakeni emihlanu enkundleni yemfundo. Umntwana osemsebenzini kufanele abe nolwazi olujulile nokuqonda ngemithetho kanye nenqubomgomo yemfundo. Umntwana osemsebenzini kufanele akwazi ukukhuthaza imfundo ehlanganisa yonke umuntu okuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela emfundweni ezingeni eliphezulu evikelwa kaholide ngumphakathi kubafundi abasikhondayo. Kufanele babe namva okusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu nokubambisana nabanye abahlanganyeli. Kufanele bakwazi ukuthatha iziqalo, basebenze ngaphansi kokucindezela basombule izinkinga uma kunesidingo noma nini. Amava ekuhlanganiseni ukusekelwa kwemfundo nokunye kubafundi abasikhondayo kuzoba yinzuzo evezwa. Umntwana osemsebenzini uzosebenza njengengxenye ye-District-based Support Team nenkinobho yokunikela ngokusekelwa okuyahamba-hamba emikhakheni yenakekelo nas ezikoleni ezikhethekile ezibakho abafundi abanesikhondayo esibukhali kuya esibukhali kakhulu (LSPID). Lo msebenzi udinga ukuhamba ngakho-ke ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile isidingo. Umfaki isicelo kufanele abe namakhono aphezulu ekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Njengelungu leqembu eliyahamba-hamba, umntwana osemsebenzini uzobambisana namalungu eqembu ekunikezeni ukusekelwa kwemfundo ezikoleni ezikhethiwe nasemikhakheni yenakekelo ngokusekelwa okuyahamba-hamba. Ukusekelwa okuzonikezwa kuzohlanganisa: Ukukalwa kwe-LSPID ababhaliwe ezikoleni/nasemikhakheni yenakekelo; ukunikela ngokusekelwa okuhambisana kubafundi kanye nemindeni; ukulalela nokubika ngokuqhubeka kwezinhlelo zabafundi bakaqedela; ukuqeqesha abanakekeli ngenqubo yokufunda ye-LSPID; ukulalela nokubika ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokufunda ye-LSPID ngabanakekeli; ukuqeqesha nokusekela othisha ngenqubo yokufunda ye-LSPID; ukulalela nokubika ngokuqashelwa kwenqubo yokufunda ezikoleni ezikhethiwe nasemikhakheni yenakekelo; ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela emfundweni ezingeni eliphezulu evikelwa kaholide ngumphakathi i-LSPID nokwenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa ehlobene nokusekelwa okunikiwe okuhlanganisa ukubeka izingane ezingekwikilasi ezikoleni. Umntwana osemsebenzini kungenzeka futhi acelwe ukusekela abanye abafundi emphakathini uma kunesidingo.

xh.title: Umcebisi wamaphakathi emfundo (LSPID): Imfundo yoLuntu
xh.summary: Umcebisi wamaphakathi emfundo onikeza inkxaso yemfundo ehamba-hambayo kwiikholeji ezikhethiweyo nakwiiziko ezingabomi, efun isebe lokufundisa ngobuchwepheshe, ukubhalisa kwiSACE kunye namava eminyaka emihlanu.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nelayisenshi esemthethweni yeminyaka engama-3 okanye eyi-4 equka isimamva sokuba nguthisha. Kufuneka babhaliswe kwiSouth African Council of Educators (SACE) njengabagqatswa bobuchwepheshe babe namava eminyaka emihlanu kwinkalo yemfundo. Umntu oza kugcinwa kulesi sithuba kufuneka abe nolwazi olunjingalulu nokuqonda iimithetho nolawulo lwemfundo. Umntu oza kugcinwa kulesi sithuba kufunelu akwazi ukukhuthaza imfundo ebandakanya abo bonke, equka ukukhuthaza ukufikelela kwimfundo ekhokelwa ngokusopolweni kubafundi abakhubazekileyo. Kufuneka babe namava ekusebenzeni njengengxenye yeqela baze basebenze ngokubambisana nabashicileli bomgaqo. Kufunelu bakwazi ukuthatha iingcebiso, ukusebenza ngoxinzelelo baze baxazulule iingxaki xa kuyimfuneko naxa kungekho. Awa ekulungelelanisa inkxaso yemfundo nakunye kubafundi abakhubazekileyo kuya kuba lusombululo olungakhalanga. Umntu oza kugcinwa kulesi sithuba uza kusebenza njengengxenye yeQela leNkxaso eliseziqu apho anoxanduva oluthile lokunika iinkxaso zokuphumela kwiindawo zoluntu kwiziko ezihlalam ikakhulu abafundi abanokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID). Lo msebenzi uquka ukuhamba ngoko ke ilayisenshi yokushayela esemthethweni sisiyikho. Umfaki kufunelu abe nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu obudlulileyo kwiikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Njengenxenye yeqela elihamba esidlangalaleni, umntu oza kugcinwa kulesi sithuba uza kusebenza ngokubambisana namalungu eqela ekukeni iinkxaso zemfundo kwiikholeji ezikhethiweyo nakwiiindawo zoluntu ngendlela ehamba-hambayo. Iinkxaso eziza kunikwa ziquka: ukuhlola abafundi abanokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID) abhalisiweyo kwiikholeji/ iindawo zoluntu; ukunika inkxako ebalulekileyo kubafundi nabazali; ukuqwalasela nokubika ngakuqhubeka kwebhaso labo; ukulungisa abanakekeli ngoludwe lokufunda iinkqubo zokufunda ngokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID); ukuqwalasela nokubika ngoludwe lokufunda olunika abanakekeli ngokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID); ukulungisa nokuxhasa ootisha beludwe lokufunda ngokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID); ukuqwalasela nokubika ngemisebenzi yoludwe lokufunda kwiikholeji ezikhethiweyo nakwezi ndawo zoluntu; ukukhusela ukufikelela kwimfundo ekhokelwa ngokusopolweni ngokukhubazeka ngamava amakhulu ekuchwepheshe (LSPID) nokwenza imisebenzi yolawulo enxulumene nenkxaso enikiweyo equka ukubeka abantwana abangesikwiiKholeji kwiikholeji. Umntu oza kugcinwa kulesi sithuba unokwafuna ukunikwa inkxako kubafundi abanye koluntu xakinixesha efuneka.

jobs.summary: Speech and language therapists are needed across seven Eastern Cape special schools to assess and support learners with communication difficulties.
jobs.requirements: Degree in Speech-Language Therapy: A recognized Bachelor's degree in Speech-Language Pathology/Therapy from an accredited institution. HPCSA Registration: Current and valid registration as a Speech-Language Therapist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) is mandatory. One Year of Relevant Experience: A minimum of one year of experience or relevant clinical experience as a Speech-Language Therapist. Knowledge of Inclusive Education (IE) policies (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; Special Schools as Resource Centres; and Integrated School Health Policy. Functionality of SBSTs and DBSTs. Inclusive Education (IE) policies (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; Special Schools as Resource Centres; and Integrated School Health Policy. Functionality of SBSTs and DBSTs. Therapeutic assessment and techniques; Multi-disciplinary teamwork; Preventative and developmental approach; Development of training programmes for the SBST; Report writing; Analysis of data and trends; Communication, consultation and facilitation skills; Computer literacy; Presentation skills and organising and planning.
jobs.duties: To conduct thorough assessments of learners' speech, language, and communication difficulties, including evaluation of speech sounds, language comprehension and expression, fluency, and voice in the special schools. To conduct outreach services to Full-Service and Public Ordinary Schools to extend therapeutic support. Administer formal and informal assessments and conduct screenings for learners to identify needs. Develop and implement individualized and group Speech-Language Therapy plans for learners in public special schools and public ordinary schools. Prescribe, issue, and maintain appropriate assistive devices to support communication. Provide relevant information about therapeutic programs to internal and external stakeholders, including School-Based Support Teams, District-Based Support Teams, and parents. Assist in the appropriate placement of learners within special schools based on their communication needs. Ensure strict compliance with the Code of Ethics of the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in all aspects of practice. Oversee effective administrative practices related to Speech and Language Therapy interventions. Analyse and interpret information to make decisions regarding the need for therapeutic intervention, engage in multi-disciplinary team discussions, and make recommendations and/or referrals.

af.title: Opvoedings Terapeut - Spraak en Taal
af.summary: Spraak- en taalterapeute word benodig in sewe Oos-Kaapse spesiale skole om leerders met kommunikasieprobleme te assesseer en te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Graad in Spraak-Taalterapie: 'n Erkende Baccalaureus-graad in Spraak-Taalpatologie/Terapie van 'n geakkrediteerde instelling. HPCSA-registrasie: 'n Huidige en geldige registrasie as 'n Spraak-Taalterapeut by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) is verpligtend. Een jaar van relevante ervaring: 'n Minimum van een jaar ervaring of relevante kliniese ervaring as 'n Spraak-Taalterapeut. Kennis van Inclusive Education (IE)-beleid (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS)-beleid; Spesiale Skole as Hulpbron-sentrums; en Integrated School Policy. Funksionaliteit van SBST's en DBST's. Inclusive Education (IE)-beleid (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS)-beleid; Spesiale Skole as Hulpbron-sentrums; en Integrated School Policy. Funksionaliteit van SBST's en DBST's. Terapeutiese assessering en tegnieke; Multidissiplinêre spanwerk; Preventiewe en ontwikkelingsbenadering; Ontwikkeling van opleidingsprogramme vir die SBST; Verslagdoening; Analise van data en tendense; Kommunikasie-, konsultasie- en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Aanbiedingsvaardighede en organisering en beplanning.
af.duties: Om deeglike assessering van leerders se spraak-, taal- en kommunikasieprobleme uit te voer, insluitend evaluering van spraakklanke, taalbegrip en -uitdrukking, vlotheid en stem in die spesiale skole. Om uitreikdienste aan Full-Service en Public Ordinary Schools te lewer om terapeutiese ondersteuning uit te brei. Formele en informele assessering toe te dien en siftings vir leerders uit te voer om behoeftes te identifiseer. Individuele en groep Spraak-Taalterapie-planne vir leerders in openbare spesiale skole en openbare gewone skole te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Toepaslike hulptoestelle voor te skryf, uit te reik en te onderhou om kommunikasie te ondersteun. Relevante inligting oor terapeutiese programme aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes te verskaf, insluitend School-Based Support Teams, District-Based Support Teams en ouers. Behulpsaam te wees met die toepaslike plasering van leerders binne spesiale skole op grond van hul kommunikasiebehoeftes. Streng nakoming van die Code of Ethics van die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in alle aspekte van die praktyk te verseker. Doeltreffende administratiewe praktyke wat verband hou met Spraak- en Taalterapie-ingrypings te oorsien. Inligting te analiseer en te interpreteer om besluite te neem oor die behoefte aan terapeutiese ingryping, deel te neem aan multidissiplinêre spanbesprekings, en aanbevelings en/of verwysings te doen.

zu.title: Umthibi Wezobuciko Wokwelapha - Ukukhuluma Nolimi
zu.summary: Kudingeka abathibi bokukhuluma nolimi kuzikole eziyisikhombisa e-Eastern Cape ezikoleni ezikhethekile ukuthi bahlole futhi basalule abafundi abanenkinga yokuxhumana.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ku-Speech-Language Therapy: I-Bachelor's degree evunyiweyo ku-Speech-Language Pathology/Therapy esikhungweni esigunyaziwe. Ukuqhashelwa kwe-HPCSA: Ukuqhashelwa kwamanje okusemthethweni njengoThibi Wokukhuluma nolimi ku-HPCSA okuthi yi-Health Professions Council of South Africa kuyadingeka. Unyaka Oyedwa Wobuhlebeke Obuhlobene: Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wobuhlebeke noma ubuhlebeke obuhlobene bokusebenza njengoThibi Wokukhuluma nolimi. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zokufunda okuhlanganisiwe (IE) (White Paper 6); inqubomgomo ye-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS); Izikole Ezikhethekile Njengezikhungo Zobulungisiwe; noku-Integrated School Health Policy. Ukusebenza kwe-SBSTs kanye ne-DBSTs. Izinqubomgomo zokufunda okuhlanganisiwe (IE) (White Paper 6); inqubomgomo ye-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS); Izikole Ezikhethekile Njengezikhungo Zobulungisiwe; noku-Integrated School Health Policy. Ukusebenza kwe-SBSTs kanye ne-DBSTs. Ukuhlolwa okuhlobene nokwelapha kanye nobuchule; Ukusebenza njengqembu elihlangene emisebenzini eyahlukene; Indlela yokuvikela nokuthuthukisa; Ukuthuthukisa amaphrogramu okuqeqesha i-SBST; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuhlaziya ulwazi nemigqa yezikhathi; Amakhono okuxhumana, ukubonisana nokukhwabanisa; Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okubonisa okanye ashada kanye nokuqamba futhi uhlele.
zu.duties: Ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwamathuba abafundi okukhuluma, ulimi, kanye nenkinga yokuxhumana, okuhlanganisa nokuhlolwa kwemisindo yokukhuluma, ukuqonda nokushiya ulimi, ukuzwakala kwezwi, noma ukuphazima kolimi ezikoleni ezikhethekile. Ukuze kuqhutshwe imisebenzi yokunyuka kwendawo kuma-Full-Service nama-Public Ordinary Schools ukuze kwandise ukusekelwa kokwelapha. Ukuphatha ukupenya nokubhala ukuze kuqashelwe izidingo zabafundi kanti futhi kuhlolwe kabanzi abafundi. Ukuze kwakhiwe futhi kwenziwe kusebenze izinhlelo ze-Speech-Language Therapy ngayodwa noma abantu abaningi abafundweni, kodwa labo abaseduze, abasezikoleni ezikhethekile kanti futhi nasemphakathini kanti kube khona futhi nasemphakathini wezinsizakalo kumbe futhi nasemphakathini wezinsizakalo kumbe wemisebenzi eyodwa. Ukuze kuqanjwe, kunikezwe, kanti futhi kugcinwe izinto ezifanele zokusebenza ukuxhumanisa. Ukuze kunikezwe incazelo ngamaphrogramu wokwelapha kubantu abangaphakathi noma abangaphandle, okuhlanganisa namaqembu okusekela okusekelwa ngaphandle, amaqembu okusekela okusekelwa ngaphandle, kanti futhi neqembu lokusekela, noma ngabe kungamaqembu okusekela angaphakathi noma angaphandle, kanti futhi abazali. Ukubasiza ekubekeni abafundi ngeziqu ezingafanele ezikoleni ezikhethekile, kanti futhi bakhonze ngokwesidingo sokuxhumana noma ngokwesidingo sabo sokusebenza okukhombisa. Ukugcina ukuthobela okukhulu ukuze kuhlonitshwe isiko le-Code of Ethics le-HPCSA kuzo zonke izinhlaka zokusebenza. Ukuze kubukezwe ukusebenza okuhle kwezomphatho okuhlobene nokubuyela ekhaya kokulawula kwesiHlathi ukukhuluma nokusebenzela olu limi lokukhuluma futhi kuhlolwe kanti futhi kuhlolwe, kodwa kanti futhi kuhlolwe ngokomthelela. Ukuze kuqoqwe futhi kuhumushwe ulwazi ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ngokwesidingo sokungena kolimi lokubuyiselwa ekhaya okukhuluma, kodwa kumele kukhulunywe ngokusobala kanti futhi sekuyisikhathi.

xh.title: Mngcotshombi weMfundo - Nkcubeko nolwimi
xh.summary: Abangcotshambi benkcubeko nolwimi bafunwa kumazwe asekhaya esixhephu ezikolweni ezingalunganga kwa Eastern Cape ukuba banqcobe baseke abafundi abanobunzima bokuziphatha nakuthetha.
xh.requirements: Degree in Speech-Language Therapy: Isidanga esivunyelweyo kwiSpeech-Language Pathology/Therapy esuka kwisikhululo esamkelweyo. HPCSA Registration: Ubulungiselelo obukhoyo nangoko bergqibekileyo njengomngcotshambi wankcubeko nolwemi kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) ngumfuno oqinisiweyo. One Year of Relevant Experience: Unyaka omnye wamava ngenxa yokuba ngumngcotshambi wankcubeko nolwimi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yeInclusive Education (IE) (White Paper 6); i-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; i-Special Schools as Resource Centres; kunye ne-Integrated School Health Policy. Ukusebenza kwe-SBSTs naba-DBSTs. Imigaqo ye-Inclusive Education (IE) (White Paper 6); i-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; i-Special Schools as Resource Centres; kunye ne-Integrated School Health Policy. Ukusebenza kwe-SBSTs naba-DBSTs. Uphononzo kunye neendlela zokwelapha; Ukusebenza njengesebe elinesidanga esininzi; Indlela yokuthintela naphucula; Upuhliso lweenkqubo zolungiselelo lwe-SBST; UKubhala iingxelo; Uhlalutyo lwamaxa nolwelo; Amava okuquzulunxwa, ukubonisana nokuqhankqalazela; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amava okubonisa nokuqukelela uphuhliso.
xh.duties: Ukuphonononga ngokucokileyo iinkcubeko nolwimi, kunye nobunzima bokuthetha kwabafundi, kuquka ukulinganisa iisandi zenkcubeko, ukuqonda nokubonakalisa ulwimi, ukuzityhola, nolwidlo: kwizikolo ezingalunganga: ukunika iinkonzo zokubaqondisa kwizikolo eziyelelane ntaaba eziqhelekileyo zoluntu ukwandisa inkxaso yokwelapha. Ukuphonononga ngokungatshayanga kwakwemigaqo nangokungagqibekanga, kwenze ukubonisa abafundi ukubona iimfuno zabo. Ukuphuhlisa kwaye sisebenzise iplani ngeenkcubeko nolwimi zabafundi ngabanye nabenze inkqubo kwizikolo ezingalunganga zoluntu ntaaba eziqhelekileyo zoluntu. Ukuyalela, ukunika, ukuze agcine izixhobo ezifanelekileyo zokunxibelelana ukukukhulisa ukuthetha. Ukunikela ngolwazi ngemikhulu yelwazi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle, kuquka i-School-Based Support Teams, i-District-Based Support Teams, ntaaba abazali. Ukunceda ukubeka abafundi kwindawo efanelekileyo kwizikolo ezingalunganga ngokwale mfuno yokuthetha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzityha kwemigaqo ye-Code of Ethics ye-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwakuzo zonke iindawo zokusetyenziswa. Ukuqonda nokulawula imisebenzi yolawulo ngenkqubo enkcula kunye nokwelapha ulwimi. Ukuhlalutya nokutolikisa ulwazi ukwenza izigqibo ngangamava ezifunwa kungenxa yokugqibelela ukwelapha, athabathe kwiinkqubo zesebe elinesidanga esininzi, aze ancomee okanye aqhube ekweni izalathiso.

jobs.title: Education Therapist – Speech-language and Audiologist
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Education therapist position at Greenwood Primary School in the Eastern Cape, requiring an RVQ 13/14 qualification and HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: RVQ 13/14 qualification in Speech Language Therapy and Audiology as recognised by SAQA. Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Speech Language Therapist and Audiologist. Registration with the South African Council for Educators (SACE). One-year relevant experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). A valid driver's license is required. Knowledge: Inclusive Education (IE) policies (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; Guidelines on the development of Full- service/Inclusive Schools; Guidelines on the development of Special Schools as Resource Centres; Care and Support for Teaching and Learning (CSTL); Integrated School Health Policy. Skills: Therapeutic assessment and techniques; multi-disciplinary teamwork; Preventative and developmental approach; Development of training programmes; Report writing; Analysis of data and trends.
jobs.duties: Assess the learner’s level of functioning to identify barriers to learning based on the Speech Language Therapy and Audiology’ scope of practice: Conduct speech-language and hearing screening for the learners; administer formal assessments. Analyse and interpret results for better decision making for therapeutic intervention, engage in multi-disciplinary team discussions and make recommendations and/or referrals: 2) Provide intervention (direct and indirect therapy) relating to barriers to learning: Provide direct and indirect services based on Speech-Language and Audiology plan to learners in public special schools and public ordinary schools; prescribe, issue and maintain assistive devices (e.g. Fm Systems and Communication Devices); maintain records of Speech-Language and Audiology services, effective administration practices and report to supervisors as required: 3) Engage in therapeutic capacity-building programmes and skills sharing on related therapy matters: Provide appropriate information regarding programmes offered by therapists to internal and external stakeholders (e.g. School Based Support Team, District Based. Support Team, parents etc.). Promote awareness of the different therapy disciplines; participate in awareness campaigns of different disabilities; provide direct or indirect outreach services when required; engage in continuous professional developmental activities based on the relevant programmes offered in the school; supervise undergraduate Audiology students as required. 4) Management of Speech Language Therapy and Audiology equipment and assistive devices: Request appropriate and adequate assistive devices and equipment based on learner needs; safeguard assistive devices and equipment; maintain records of material, equipment and the issuing of assistive devices and report faults and maintenance needs of the materials and equipment; participate in inter- and intra-sectoral networks and collaborations. 5) Participate in inter- and intra-sectoral networks and collaborations: Collaborate and interact with stakeholders (e.g., Department of Health, Department of Social Development, Non-Profit Organizations, Non- Governmental Organizations, local government, and the broader Community). Advocate for learners who experience barriers to learning; liaising with therapists from other special schools and sharing best practices and experiences; liaison with relevant professional boards and tertiary institutions; participate in extra-mural and co-curricular activities.

af.title: Opvoedkundige terapeut – Spraak-en-taal en Audioloog
af.summary: Opvoedkundige terapeutpos by Greenwood Primary School in die Eastern Cape, waar 'n RVQ 13/14-kwalifikasie en HPCSA-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: RVQ 13/14-kwalifikasie in Spraak-en-taalterapie en Audiologie soos erken deur SAQA. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Spraak-en-taalterapeut en Audioloog. Registrasie by die South African Council for Educators (SACE). Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie word vereis. Kennis: Beleide vir Inkluderende Onderwys (IO) (Witpapier 6); Beleid vir Sifting, Identifisering, Assessering en Ondersteuning (SIOO); Riglyne vir die ontwikkeling van Volledige diens/Inkluderende Skole; Riglyne vir die ontwikkeling van Spesiale Skole as Hulpbronsentrums; Sorg en Ondersteuning vir Onderrig en Leer (SOOL); Geïntegreerde Skoolgesondheidsbeleid. Vaardighede: Terapeutiese assessering en tegnieke; multidissiplinêre spanwerk; Voorkomende en ontwikkelingsgebonde benadering; Ontwikkeling van opleidingsprogramme; Verslagdoening; Analise van data en tendense.
af.duties: Assesseer die leerder se vlak van funksionering om hindernisse vir leer te identifiseer op grond van die Spraak-en-taalterapie en Audiologie se omvang van praktyk: Voer spraak-en-taal- en gehoorsifting vir die leerders uit; administreer formele assessering. Analiseer en interpreteer resultate vir beter besluitneming vir terapeutiese ingryping, neem deel aan multidissiplinêre spansbesprekings en maak aanbevelings en/of verwysings: 2) Verskaf ingryping (direkte en indirekte terapie) wat verband hou met hindernisse vir leer: Verskaf direkte en indirekte dienste op grond van die Spraak-en-taal en Audiologie-plan aan leerders in openbare spesiale skole en openbare gewone skole; voorskryf, reik uit en onderhou hulptoestelle (bv. FM-stelsels en Kommunikasietoestelle); handhaaf rekords van Spraak-en-taal en Audiologie-dienste, effektiewe administratiewe praktyke en doen soos vereis aan toesighouers verslag: 3) Neem deel aan terapeutiese kapasiteitsbouprogramme en vaardigheidsdeling oor verwante terapie-aangeleenthede: Verskaf toepaslike inligting oor programme wat deur terapeute aangebied word aan interne en externe belanghebbendes (bv. Skoolgebaseerde Ondersteuningspan, Distrikgebaseerde Ondersteuningspan, ouers ens.). Bevewig bewustheid van die verskillende terapiedissiplines; neem deel aan bewustheidsveldtogte oor verskillende gestremdhede; verskaf direkte of indirekte uitreikdienste wanneer vereis; neem deel aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite op grond van die relevante programme wat by die skool aangebied word; hou toesig oor voorgraadse Audiologie-studente soos vereis. 4) Bestuur van Spraak-en-taalterapie en Audiologie-toerusting en hulptoestelle: Versoek toepaslike en voldoende hulptoestelle en toerusting op grond van leerderbehoeftes; beveilig hulptoestelle en toerusting; handhaaf rekords van materiaal, toerusting en die uitreik van hulptoestelle en rapporteer foute en onderhoudsbehoeftes van die materiaal en toerusting; neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerking. 5) Neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerking: Werk saam en skakel met belanghebbendes (bv., Department of Health, Department of Social Development, Nonywinsorganisasies, Negeringsorganisasies, plaaslike regering, en die breë Gemeenskap). Pleit namens leerders wat hindernisse vir leer ervaar; skakel met terapeute van ander spesiale skole en deel beste praktyke en ervarings; skakeling met relevante professionele rade en tersiêre instellings; neem deel aan buitekurrikulêre en medekurrikulêre aktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umenesha Wezemfundo – Onjiniyela Wokukhuluma-Nolimi Nomcwetingi-wezwi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somenesha wezemfundo e-Greenwood Primary School e-Eastern Cape, sifuna izifundo ze-RVQ 13/14 nobumagama e-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-RVQ 13/14 ekwelapheni ukukhuluma-kolimi nokuva njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ubhalo e-HPCSA njengonjiniyela wokukhuluma-kolimi nomcwetingi-wezwi. Ubhalo e-South African Council for Educators (SACE). Unyaka oyedwa wemisebenzi ehambisana nale ndawo emva kokubhalisa e-HPCSA. Kudingeka iphethe ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Amapholisi Wezemfundo Ehlanganayo (White Paper 6); ipholisi lokuHlola, ukuQapha, ukuHlolisisa nokuNxumba (SIAS); imiholiso yokuthuthukiswa kwziKolo Ezigcwele/eziHlanganisayo; imiholiso yokuthuthukiswa kweziKolo Ezikhethekile njengezikhungo zokusekela; ukuNakekela nokuSekelela ukuFunda nokufundisa (CSTL); iPholisi lezeMpilo leSikolo esiHlanganiswe. Amandla: ukuHlolisisa nokwelapha ngezindlela ezithile; ukusebenza njengeqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eyahlukene; indlela yokuvikela futhi nokuthuthukisa; ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha; ukubhala imibiko; ukuHlolisisa idatha uthuthuke emikhakheni ehluken.
zu.duties: Hlolisisa izinga lokusebenza kwesifundi ukuze kutholakale izinselelo zokufunda ngokusekelwe emkhakheni wokwelapha ukukhuluma-kolimi nokuva: Yenza ukuhlolwa kokukhuluma-kolimi nokuva kubafundi; qasha ukuhlolwa okuyisimiso. Hlaziya futhi uchaze imiphumela ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo ezinhle ngokungenelela okokwelapha, thatha inxaxheba kumaxoxo eqembu elihlangene emikhakheni eyahlukene futhi unikeze izincomo nezinkomba: 2) Yenza okungenelela (ukwelapha ngokuqondile nangangokungekho) okuphathelene nizinselelo zokufunda: Nikeza amasevisi aqondile nangangokungekho ngohlelo lokuKhuluma-Kolimi nokuva kubafundi ezikolweni ezikhethekile ezenza isixazululo kwezombusazwe ezesidlangalaleni nasezinye izikolo ezesidlangalaleni; qamba, khishwe ulondoloze izinto zokusekela ezifana ne-FM Systems kanye neziNguxa zokuXhumana; gcina irekhodi yamasevisi okuKhuluma-Kolimi nokuva, izinqubo zokuphatha ngempumelelo futhi ubeke imibiko kubaphathi njengokuqashiwe: 3) Thatha inxaxhema ekuthuthukisweni kwamandla okukwelapha futhi wabelane ngamakhono ngendlela yokwelapha: Nikeza ulwazi olufanele ngemikhakha enikezwa onjiniyela bezokwelapha kubandakanya wonke abaholi bendawo yangaphakathi nangaphandle (isb. Iqembu elisekela isikolo ngaphakathi, Iqembu elisekela isifunda. Iqembu lokusekela, abazali njll.). Khuthaza ukuqondiswa ngemikhakha eyahlukene yokwelapha; thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kokuqonda ngaye imikhondo ehlukene yezinkhungo; thuthukisa ukunikezwa kwamasevisi ngokuphathelene nomphakathi uma kunesidingo; thatha inxaxhe ekuthuthukisweni kogqozi lomuntu ngomsebenzi ohambelana nale mikhakha etholakala esikolweni; qeqesha abafundi be-Audiology abangakafundela ngaphezulu njengokuqashiwe. 4) Ukuphathwa kolwangu lokukhuluma-kolimi kwe-Audiology kanye nezinto zokusekela: Cela izinto zokusekela nokulwangu olufanele olwanele ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zesifundi; zigcine izinto zokusekela nokulwangu; ulondoloze amarekhodi oyakho, ukulwangu nokunikwa kwezinto zokusekela uthule imikhondo yokuphuka nobuhle bokulungiswa bale mininingo nolwangu; 5) Thatha inxaxhebe ekuxhumeni nothakathelana emikhakheni ehlukene nasekuhlanganeni ngokunye: Xhumana uthintane nabo (isb., i-Department of Health, i-Department of Social Development, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi komphakathi eziqashayo abantu abangakayifundeli ngaphezulu, Izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kobulungiswa bomphakathi, urhulumeni wendawo, kanye nomPhakathi jikelele). Phakamisa izwi labafundi ababhekene nizinselelo zokufunda; xhumana nabaWelaphi kwezinye izikolo ezikhethekile ushintshe ngolwazi oluhle namava; xhumana namaphaneli ohlelo namasu njengabavezwe kule minhlalhla ekhona; hlanganyela kumakhono nezinkomba ekukhandweni izindaba ezehlukahlukene okuqhutshwa emkhakheni wokusebenza noma wokukhuluma abafundi abangakafundel ibanga elingaphezulu njengoba kuthandwa.

xh.title: Mongezi weMfundo – Onjiniyana wenkulumo-nolwimi nosolobo bokuziva
xh.summary: Isithuba somongezi weMfundo eGreenwood Primary School eEastern Cape, sifuna ifom ye-RVQ 13/14 nokuNGENISWA kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Ifom ye-RVQ 13/14 kwi-Speech Language Therapy and Audiology njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. UkuNGENISWA kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengonjiniyana wenkulumo-nolwimi nosolobo bokuziva. UkuNGENISWA kwi-South African Council for Educators (SACE). Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelanayo emva kokuNGENISWA kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ifayuni yokuqhuba ekgonyeliwe iyafuneka. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo zoMthetho ze-Inclusive Education (IE) (White Paper 6); uMthetho we-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS); iZikhokelo ekubakhiweni kwe-Full-service/Inclusive Schools; iZikhokelo ekubakhiweni kwe-Special Schools njenge-Resource Centres; uNakekelo nanoXhaso kuFundo noKufunda (CSTL); uMthetho we-Integrated School Health Policy. Amandla: Ukulinganisa kunye neendlela zokwelapha; ukusebenza njengqela elinamagatya amaninana; indlela yokuthintela nokuphuhlisa; ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo zolwazi oluqeqeshwayo; ukubhala iingxelo; ukuhlaziya idatha kunye neendaba ezisuka kuyo.
xh.duties: Linganisa inqanaba lomfundi lokusebenza ukuze kuqatshelwe iithirta ezinganika umfundi isithintatho ekufundeni ngokwesicwangciso sokwenza umsebenzi we-Speech Language Therapy and Audiology: Yenza ukuhlolwa kwenkulumo-nolwimi nokuva kubafundi; phatha iilinganiso ezisemthethweni. Hlaziya eliithuba ucacise iziphumo ukuze kuthathwe izigqibo ezilungileyo ekungeneleleni ngokwelapha, thata inxaxheba kwingxoxo yeqela elinamagatya amaninani uze wenze izindululo kwaye/okanye uqhube iingxelo: 2) Yenza ulwazi olujolise kubafundi ngokubakhuthaza kukufunda: Yenza iinkonzo ezisoloko ngqo nangamanyathelo aphanjwayo ukwakhelwe kuloo nkqubo ye-Speech-Language and Audiology yolwazi kubafundi kwi-special schools zikarhulumnte nakumaziko amabala aqhelekileyo karhulumnte; qamba, phathe ugqithiso kwaye ulondoloze izixhobo ezincedayo (umz. i-Fm Systems ne-Communication Devices); gcina iirekhodi zenkonzo ye-Speech-Language and Audiology, zisebenzise ngokufanelekileyo ngokomthetho zize kubikwe koogonyewu njengoko kufuneka: 3) Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokwakhiwa kwamandla ekwelapha kwaye wabelane ngeziqu ezahambelanayo nolwazi oluhambelanayo nolwelapho: Nikezela ngenkcazelo efanelekileyo malunga neenkqubo ezinqatshelwa ngabarhugi abangaphakathi nangaphandle (umz. i-School Based Support Team, i-District Based. Support Team, abazali njl.). Khuthaza ukuqonda ngezigaba ezahlukeneyo zokwelapha; thata inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuzibandakanya ekwaziseni ngemiba ahlukeneyo yokuvala isixhobo sabo somzimba; yenza iinkonzo ezisoloko ngqo nangamanyathelo aphanjwayo zokunyamezela abanye ukuba bafumane olunye ulwazi apha ekuhlaleni ukwakhelwe kuloo nkqubo etshungayo esikolo; qeqesha abafundi be-Audiology abangaphantsi kwesidanga njengoko kufuneka. 4) Lawulo kwezixhobo ze-Speech Language Therapy and Audiology: Celisa izixhobo ezifanelekileyo ezaneleyo ngokwemfuno yomfundi; zigcine izixhobo ezinceda abo bafunda ngokungayekiyo; gcina iinkcazelo ngezixhobo, zibe nerekhodi ukwazi ukuba ngubani ozele nantoni na ekhuselekileyo okanye ngobuganga bayo; thatha inxaxheba kwintsebenziswano phakathi kwamaphandle yangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokobuchwepheshe. 5) Thatha inxaxheba kumanethiwekhi unyeneelwano kwiintsebenziswano ezingaphakathi nangaphandle: Sebenzisana kwaye uqhagamshelane nabanegalelo kwezonyo kundwendwe olukhululekileyo (umz., i-Department of Health, i-Department of Social Development, i-Non-Profit Organizations, i-Non-Governmental Organizations, urhulumende wendawo, nentsapho yonke). Suka uthethelele ixesha eligqithiswayo elifanelekileyo ekuqhubeni iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo kwindalo ezahlukeneyo zomfundi; thatha inxaxheba ezinye iinkalo zodidi lokuqeqesha kwesixhobo somzimba ngokubanzi, ngokomthetho; qeqesha abafundi abangaphantsi kwesidanga be-Audiology njengoko kuyimfuneko.

jobs.summary: Occupational therapist needed at special schools in the Eastern Cape to assess learners, identify learning barriers, and provide therapeutic interventions.
jobs.requirements: Degree in Occupational Therapy: A recognized Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution. HPCSA Registration: Current and valid registration as an Occupational Therapist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) is mandatory. One Year of Relevant Experience: A minimum of one year of experience or relevant clinical experience as an Occupational Therapist. Knowledge: Inclusive Education (IE) policies (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS) policy; Special Schools as Resource Centres; and Integrated School Health Policy. Functionality of SBSTs and DBSTs. Skills: Therapeutic assessment and techniques; Multi-disciplinary teamwork; Preventative and developmental approach; Development of training programmes for the SBST; Report writing; Analysis of data and trends; Communication, consultation and facilitation skills; Computer literacy; Presentation skills and organising and planning.
jobs.duties: To assess the learner’s level of functioning; to identify barriers to learning based on the Occupational Therapy’ scope of practice. To conduct screening for the learners; administer formal and informal assessments. Analyse and interpret information to make decisions regarding the need for therapeutic intervention, engage in multi-disciplinary team discussions, and make recommendations and/or referrals. Provide direct and indirect Occupational Therapy services based on an Occupational Therapy plan to learners in public special schools and public ordinary schools; determine individualised and group Occupational Therapy Services. Prescribe, issue, and maintain assistive devices; maintain records of Occupational Therapy Services. Provide appropriate information regarding programmes offered by therapists to internal and external stakeholders (e.g. School Based Support Team, District Based Support Team, parents. Manage Therapy support materials and equipment. Manage effective administration practices of Occupational Therapy interventions; ensure compliance with the code of Ethics of the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). To assist in the placement of learners in the special schools. To conduct outreach services to other Full- Service and Public Ordinary Schools.

af.title: Onderwysterapeut - Arbeidsterapeut
af.summary: Arbeidsterapeut benodig by spesiale skole in die Eastern Cape om leerders te asseseer, leergrense te identifiseer en terapeutiese intervensies te bied.
af.requirements: Graad in Arbeidsterapie: 'n Erkende Baccalaureusgraad in Arbeidsterapie van 'n geakkrediteerde instansie. HPCSA-registrasie: Aktuele en geldige registrasie as 'n Arbeidsterapeut by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) is verpligtend. Een jaar van relevante ervaring: 'n Minimum van een jaar se ervaring of relevante kliniese ervaring as 'n Arbeidsterapeut. Kennis: Inclusive Education (IE)-beleid (White Paper 6); Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS)-beleid; Special Schools as Resource Centres; en Integrated School Health Policy. Funksionaliteit van SBSTs en DBSTs. Vaardighede: Terapeutiese assessering en tegnieke; Multidissiplinêre spanwerk; Voorkomende en ontwikkelingsbenadering; Ontwikkeling van opleidingsprogramme vir die SBST; Verslagdoening; Analise van data en tendense; Kommunikasie, konsultasie en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Aanbiedingsvaardighede en organisasie en beplanning.
af.duties: Om die vlak van funksionering van die leerder te asseseer; om leergrense te identifiseer op grond van die Arbeidsterapie se omvang van praktyk. Om sifting vir die leerders te doen; om formele en informele assessering toe te dien. Analiseer en interpreteer inligting om besluite te neem oor die behoefte aan terapeutiese intervensie, neem deel aan multidissiplinêre spanbesprekings, en maak aanbevelings en/of verwysings. Bied direkte en indirekte Arbeidsterapiedienste gebaseer op 'n Arbeidsterapieplan aan leerders in openbare spesiale skole en openbare gewone skole; bepaal geïndividualiseerde en groep Arbeidsterapiedienste. Skryf voor, reik uit en onderhou hulptoestelle; onderhou rekords van Arbeidsterapiedienste. Verskaf toepaslike inligting aangaande programme wat deur terapeute aangebied word aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes (bv. School Based Support Team, District Based Support Team, ouers. Bestuur terapie-ondersteuningsmateriale en -toerusting. Bestuur doeltreffende administrasiepraktyke van Arbeidsterapie-intervensies; verseker nakoming van die etiese kode van die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Om te help met die plasing van leerders in die spesiale skole. Om inloopdienste na ander Full-Service- en Public Ordinary-skole te bied.

zu.title: UTherapist Wezemfundo - UTherapist Womsebenzi
zu.summary: Kudingeka utherapist womsebenzi ezikoleni ezikhethekile e-Eastern Cape ukuze ahlasishe abafundi, abone izithihi zokufunda, futhi anikeze ukungenelela okwelaphayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ku-Occupational Therapy: I-Bachelor's Degree evunyelwe ku-Occupational Therapy esikhungweni esagunyaziwe. Ukuqashelwa kwe-HPCSA: Ukuqashelwa okwamanje nokuqinisekile njengoTherapist Womsebenzi ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kuyadingeka. Unyaka Oyedwa Wokuhlangenwe ngokubom kokuhlangenwe ngokubom okuhambisana nale ndima: Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wokuhlangenwe ngokubom noma ukuhlangenwe ngokubom ngokwesibhedlela njengoTherapist Womsebenzi. Ulwazi: Izinqongo zemigomo ye-Inclusive Education (IE) (White Paper 6); imigomo ye-Screening, Identification, Assessment and Support (SIAS); Izikole Ezikhethekile njengezikhungo zokusekelwa; kanye ne-Integrated School Health Policy. Ukusebenza kwe-SBSTs ne-DBSTs. Amakhono: Ukuhlola kokwelapha namatekhnikhi; Ukusebenza njengeqembu elinabangcweli abaningi; Indlela yokuvikela nokuthuthukisa; Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiklamo yokugcotshwa ye-SBST; Ukubhala imibiko; Ukuhlaziya idatha namaphethini; Amakhono okuxhumana, wokubuzisisa nakokuqondisa; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okwethula nokuhlela nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola izinga lokusebenza komfundi; ukuqaphela izithihi ekufundeni ngokusekelwe kwindawo yokusebenza ye-Occupational Therapy. Ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwabafundi; ukuphatha ukuhlolwa okuyimithetho nokuhlolwa okungeyimithetho. Hlaziya futhi umutshule ulwazi ukuze kuthathwe izinqumo mayelana nesidingo sokungenelela kokwelapha, ukuba yingxenye yezingxoxo zeqembu elinabangcweli abaningi, nokwenza izinkomba kanye/noma okokuthunyelwe. Nikela ngamasevisi e-Occupational Therapy aqondile nanganganisiwe okusekelwe ohlelweni le-Occupational Therapy kubafundi bezikoleni ezikhethekile zomphakathi nasezikoleni ezijwayelekile zomphakathi;inquma amasevisi e-Occupational Therapy aqondiswe komunye umuntu nakweqembu. Nxepha, ukhipha, futhi ulondoloze izixazululi zokusekelwa; gcina irekhodi lamasevisi e-Occupational Therapy. Nikela ngolwazi oluhambisana ngemiklamo etholwa utherapist kubahlombe bangaphakathi nangaphandle (isb. School Based Support Team, District Based Support Team, abazali. Phatha izinto zokusekelwa kokwelapha namalebhu. Phatha izinqubo zokuphatha okusebenzayo zokungenelela kokwelapha kwe-Occupational Therapy; qinisekisa ukuzithiba koshintsho lwekhodi ye-Code of Ethics ye-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ukusize ekubekweni kwabafundi ezikoleni ezikhethekile. Ukwenza amasevisi okwabelana namanye amasevisi nezikole Ezikhonza Ngokugcwele Noma Ezikoleni Ezijwayelekile Zomphakathi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho umthathi wokusebenza kumaziko amabala e-Eastern Cape ukuba abeke abafundi, achaze iithambeku zokufunda, anike unxibelelwano lokwelapha.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiTherapy yokusebenza: Isidanga sesiBakala kwiTherapy yokusebenza esivunyiweyo esivela kwisikhongozeli esinemvume. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelanayo: Iminyaka engu-1 yamava okanye amava ahambelanayo ezempilo njengomthathi wokusebenza. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo zemfundo ehlanganayo (IE) (IPhepha eliMhlophe eli-6); iNkqubo yokubeka, ukuchaza, ukubeka nokuxhasa (SIAS); Amaziko aba ngamathala encwadi kumaziko abalwa; naye iNkqubo yeMfundo yeZiko ehlangene. Amakhono: Ukubeka ngokwelapha neendlela; Ukusebenza njengelothu enguwo-wo-mxhantileka; Iindlela ezithintela nazo ziphuhlisa; Ukudalwa kweenkqubo zoluntu kwiSBST; Ukuqamba iingxelo; Ukupela isisombulu kumanani neendlela ezahlukeneyo; Amakhono okunxibelelwana, ukucela uluvo nokulungelelanisa; Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwekhompyutha; Amakhono okubonisa nokulungelelanisa neplani.
xh.duties: Ukubeka inqanaba lokusebenza komfundi; ukuchaza iithambeko kwizifundo ngesiseko somsebenzi weTherapy yokusebenza. Ukwenza iskrini kubafundi; ukubeka iindlela ezisesikweni nangaphandle. Ukupela nokutolika isisombulu ukuze kuthathwe izigqibo malunga neddokhumba yokuhlawulela, ukubamba ingxoxo ngokuhlangana kwelothu ebe ingowo-wo-mxhantileka, kananjalo ukwenza izindululo nokuba ngamathuba yokuthunyelwa kwenkxaso. Ukunikela iinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza ngokuqondileyo nangakho ngokusesikweni okusekelwe kuloyiso lweTherapy yokusebenza kubafundi kumaziko abalwa angabasetyhini nangawamadoda; ukugqiba iinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza ngamanye amaxhantileka. Ukumisela, ukupapasha, nokulondoloza izixhobo zokuncedakaliswa; ukugcina irekhodi lezinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza. Ukunika isisombulu ngokufanelekileyo malunga neenkqubo ezinikelwa ngabathathi kubahlombe bangaphakathi nangaphandle (umzekelo. Ithimba loNxhaso eliseKolinwini, Ithimba loNxhaso elisiNgingqi, abazali. Ukulawula izixhobo zokuxhasa iTherapy nezixhobo. Ukulawula ukusebenza okusemthethweni kwezinkonzo zeTherapy yokusebenza ngokuhlawulela; ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yoBuzingcweti yeKhomishoni yamaphrofeshi weMfundo eNingilimi eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA). Ukunceda ekubekeni abafundi kumaziko amabala. Ukwenza iinkonzo zokunika inkxaso kumanye amaziko aba yiNkonzo eValiweyo naba sisigqiki.

jobs.title: Education Therapist - Physiotherapist
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Physiotherapist sought for Parklands Special School in East London to assess learners' physical functioning and provide therapeutic interventions.

Current, valid registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Physiotherapist is mandatory. A minimum of one year of relevant clinical experience (post-community service). Legislative Knowledge: Inclusive Education policies (White Paper 6), SIAS Policy (Screening, Identification, Assessment, and Support, Integrated School Health Policy and the functionality of SBSTs and DBSTs. Core Skills: Paediatric therapeutic assessment and rehabilitation techniques, Collaborative multi- disciplinary teamwork, Report writing, data analysis, and trend identification, Advanced communication, facilitation, and computer literacy and Strong organizational planning and presentation skills.

af.title: Onderwysterapeut - Fisioterapeut
af.summary: Fisioterapeut gesoek vir Parklands Special School in East London om leerders se fisieke funksionering te assesseer en terapeutiese ingrywings te verskaf.
af.requirements: A recognized Bachelor’s Degree in Physiotherapy from an accredited institution. Current, valid registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Physiotherapist is mandatory. A minimum of one year of relevant clinical experience (post-community service). Legislative Knowledge: Inclusive Education policies (White Paper 6), SIAS Policy (Screening, Identification, Assessment, and Support, Integrated School Health Policy and the functionality of SBSTs and DBSTs. Core Skills: Paediatric therapeutic assessment and rehabilitation techniques, Collaborative multi- disciplinary teamwork, Report writing, data analysis, and trend identification, Advanced communication, facilitation, and computer literacy and Strong organizational planning and presentation skills.
af.duties: Assessment & Identification: Assess learners' physical functioning and mobility to identify barriers to learning within the Physiotherapy scope of practice, Conduct screenings and administer formal/informal physical assessments and Analyse data to determine the necessity of therapeutic intervention or referral. Therapeutic Intervention: Provide direct and indirect Physiotherapy services to learners in both Public Special Schools and Public Ordinary Schools, Develop and implement individualized and group physical therapy plans, and Focus on a preventative and developmental approach to support learner wellness. Assistive Devices and Resource Management: Prescribe, fit, and maintain assistive mobility devices (e.g., walkers, orthotics). Manage therapy equipment and support materials efficiently. Engage in multi-disciplinary team discussions to guide learner placement in special schools, Develop training programs for the School Based Support Team (SBST), and Conduct outreach services to Full-Service and Public Ordinary Schools. Maintain meticulous records of all therapeutic interventions and learner progress, Ensure all practices strictly comply with the HPCSA Code of Ethics, and Provide regular reports and feedback to internal and external stakeholders (DBST, parents, and educators).

zu.title: Umthandi Wemfundo - Umthandi Womzimba
zu.summary: Kufunwa umthandi womzimba kwa Parklands Special School e East London ukuze ahloliswe ukusebenza komzimba kwabafundi abaphila kahle futhi anikeze ukungenelela okwelapho.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor evunyiwe kwi-Physiotherapy evela esikhungweni esinemvume. Ukubhalisa okwamanje okusemthethweni ne Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomthandi womzimba kuyadingeka. Ubuncwane beminyaka eyodwa yohlolojio lweqiniso (ngemva kwenkonzo yomphakathi). Ulwazi lomthetho: Izinqubomgomo zemfundo ehlanganisayo (i-White Paper 6), inqubomgomo ye-SIAS (i-Screening, Identification, Assessment, and Support), i-Integrated School Health Policy kanye nokusebenza kwe-SBSTs ne-DBSTs. Izindlebe ezingusoqobo: Ukuhlola ukwelashwa kwe-Paediatric kanye namasu okuphulukisa, ukusebenza njengeqembu elihlangene elinamakhono ahlukene, ukubhala imibiko, ukuhlaziya idatha, kanye nokuhlonza amathrendi, ukuxhumana okuphakeme, ukuguqula, kanye nolwazi lwekhompuyutha kanye namakhono aqinile ohlelo lokuhlela nokubukusa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola kanye Nokuqhathanisa: Hlola ukusebenza komzimba kanye nokuqhabo kwabafundi ukuze kuhlonzeke izithiyo ekufundeni ngaphakathi kwesigaba somsebenzi se-Physiotherapy, wenze ukuhlola futhi unikeze ukuhlola okusemthethweni/okungekho emthethweni komzimba futhi uhlaziye idatha ukunquma isidingo sokungenelela okwelapho noma ukuthumela kwenye indawo. Ukungenelela Okwelapho: Nikeza izinsiza ze-Physiotherapy eziqondile nangezindlela ezingaqondanga kubafundi kumakholo we-Public Special Schools kanye namakholo we-Public Ordinary Schools, lungise futhi phatha amasu omzimba angabodwa nakweqembu, futhi gxila endleleni evikelayo nenyakazo ekuxhaseni impilo yabafundi. Amadivayisi Abasizo kanye Nokuphatha Izinsiza: Qamba, faka, futhi gcina amadivayisi aqhuba abasiza (isb, amawoka, ama-orthotics). Phatha izinsiza zokwelashwa kanye nezinto zokusekela ngempumelelo. Thatha inxaxheba kumixoxo yeqembu elinamakhono ahlukene ukuze kuqondwe ukubekwa kwabafundi emakholweni abakhulu, humusha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha i-School Based Support Team (SBST), futhi wenze izinsiza zokufinyelela kumakholo we-Full-Service kanye namakholo we-Public Ordinary Schools. Gcina ukurekhoda okucophelela kwayo yonke imisebenzi yokwelashwa kanye nentuthuko yomfundi, qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi ilandela ngokuqinile i-HPCSA Code of Ethics, futhi nikeza imibiko evamile kanye nempendulo kubahluleki bangaphakathi nangaphandle (i-DBST, abazali, kanye nothisha).

xh.title: Unyango lwezemfundo - Ngumsekibiophe lempilo yomzimba
xh.summary: Kufunwa umsekibiophe lempilo yomzimba kwiParklands Special School eEast London ukuba ahlole ukusebenza komzimba kwezinja zesikolo aze anike unyango oluthile.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelors esivunyiweyo kwiphysiotherapy esivela kwindawo egunyaziweyo. Ukubhalisa ngoku nangokusemthethweni kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomsekibiophe lempilo yomzimba kuyinyanzelo. Ubuncinane unyaka owodwa wamava ohlobo lweenkwelo (emva konkonzo loluntu). Ulwazi ngomthetho: Iinkqubo zemfundo ebandakanyayo (White Paper 6), iNkqubo yeSIAS (Screening, Identification, Assessment, and Support), iNkqubo yezeempilo ezahlukeneyo zesikolo nokusebenza kweSBSTs neDBSTs. Amandla angaphezulu: Iindlela zokuqonda iinkathazo ezilula kunye namava okuphinda ulungiswe, Ukusebenza ngokubambisana ngeqela elihlangene neelungu ezininzi, Ukubhala iingxelo, ukuhlalutya iingcombolo, nokuchonga iindlela ezibonakalayo, Unxibelelwano oluphuhlitiweyo, ukukhokela, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Namandla amakhulu eplani yokuhlela nokubonisa.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda nokuchonga: Hlola ukusebenza komzimba nokunyakaza kwabantu bafunda ukuchona okubambelela kokufunda kwisiphelo samandla sokwenza umsebenzi wokuhamba, Yenza iintlobo ezihlala phezulu zenkqubo uhlole ukunyakaza kwemiphunga emileyo nengamileyo uze uhlalutye iingcombolo ukugqiba ukuba kuyafuneka unyango okuthile okanye kufuneka kuthunyelwe kwenye indawo. Unyango oluthile: Nikezela iinkonzo zephysiotherapy ezengeziyo nezingezo kubafundi kumaziko abalulekileyo abahluliweyo kumaziko abalulekileyo abafunde kwoqobo, Phuhlisa uze usebenzise iplani yomzimba yomntu namanye amanye amakhulu, Uze ugqame kwindlela yokuthintela nokuphuhlisa ukukhusela ukhuseleko lomntu ofunda. Ii-dizesi zosizo lawo ulawulo lomthombo: Zagqiba, ugqoke, uze ulondoloze iinkqubo zosizo lokunyakaza (umzekelo walkers, orthotics). Lawula ngokuchanekileyo isixhobo sonyango nemithi yesixhobo esekelwa ngokukhululekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwizicengceleko zeqela elihlangene neelungu ezininzi ukukhokela ukubekwa komntu ofunda kwizikolo ezibalulekileyo, Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokuqeqesha kwiSchool Based Support Team (SBST), uze wenze iinkonzo zokufikelela kumaziko abakho konkonzo namaziko obuntu owqobo. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zonke iindlela zonyango nokuqhubela phambili komntu ofunda, Qinisekisa ukuzonkelela kuzo zonke iinkqubo ngokukhulu kwiHPCSA Code of Ethics, uze unikeze iingxelo ngeqondo ngesiqhelo kubantu abangenaphakathi nabaphandle (DBST, abazali, nabathisha).

jobs.centre: Tsolo Special School, Ref No: DOE25/08/2026 MT Fletcher Special School, Ref No: DOE26/08/2026 Khanyisa Cala Special School, Ref No: DOE27/08/2026 Vukuzenzele Special School, Ref No: DOE28/08/2026 Vukuhambe Special School, Ref No: DOE29/08/2026 ST.
