jobs.summary: School social workers needed at seven Eastern Cape special schools to support learners with special educational needs and their families.
jobs.requirements: A formal 4-year Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work. Current, valid registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). (Proof of payment for the current year is mandatory on or before the interview day). Previous experience in a school environment or working with children with disabilities is highly advantageous. A valid driver’s license. Deep understanding of the Children’s Act and the South African Schools Act. Strong interpersonal, report-writing, and crisis-management skills.
jobs.duties: To provide professional social work services to learners with special educational needs, their families, and the school community. The successful candidate will address social, emotional, and behavioural barriers to learning to facilitate the holistic development of the child within an inclusive or specialized environment. Psychosocial Support: Provide individual and group counselling to learners with diverse disabilities (physical, intellectual, or neurodivergent). Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work as part of the School- Based Support Team (SBST) alongside psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech therapists. Home-School Liaison: Conduct home visits and assessments to understand the learner’s social context and provide parent- guidance programs. Crisis Intervention: Manage cases of child abuse, neglect, and trauma in accordance with the Children’s Act. Advocacy and Placement: Assist with the screening, identification, and assessment (SIAS) process and facilitate referrals to external welfare organizations or medical facilities. Administration: Maintain comprehensive, confidential case files and draft statutory reports for the Department of Social Development or Children's Courts. Participate in inter- and intra-sectoral networks and collaborations. Collaborate and interact with stakeholders (e.g., Department of Health, Department of Social Development, Non-Profit Organizations, Non- Governmental Organizations, local government, and the broader Community). Advocate for learners who experience barriers to learning; liaising with Social Workers from other special schools and sharing best practices and experiences; liaison with relevant professional boards and tertiary institutions; participate in extra-mural and co-curricular activities. Management and Administration: Manage effective administration practices of Social Work interventions; ensure compliance with the code of Ethics of the SACSSP; practice sound interpersonal relations, engage actively in performance appraisals per requirement.

af.title: Skoolmaatskaplikewerker: Spesiale Skole
af.summary: Skoolmaatskaplikewerkers word by sewe Oos-Kaapse spesiale skole benodig om leerders met spesiale opvoedkundige behoeftes en hul gesinne te ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Formele 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Maatskaplike Werk. Huidige, geldige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Dienssprofessies (SACSSP). (Bewys van betaling vir die huidige jaar is verpligtend op of voor die onderhouddatum). Vorige ervaring in 'n skoolomgewing of werk met kinders met gestremdhede is hoogs voordelig. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Diepgaande kennis van die Kinderwet en die Suid-Afrikaanse Skoolwet. Sterk interpersoonlike, verslagskryf- en krisisbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Om professionele maatskaplikewerksdienste aan leerders met spesiale opvoedkundige behoeftes, hul gesinne en die skoolgemeenskap te verskaf. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal sosiale, emosionele en gedragsbarrieres vir leer aanspreek om die holistiese ontwikkeling van die kind binne 'n inklusiewe of gespesialiseerde omgewing te faciliteer. Psigososiale ondersteuning: Verskaf individuele en groepsberading aan leerders met uiteenlopende gestremdhede (fisies, intellektueel of neurodivergent). Multidissiplinêre samewerking: Werk as deel van die Skoolgebaseerde Ondersteuningspan (SBST) saam met sielkundiges, arbeidsterapeute en spraakterapeute. Tuis-skool skakeling: Voer tuisbesoeke en assesserings uit om die leerder se sosiale konteks te verstaan en ouerbegeidingsprogramme te verskaf. Krisisintervensie: Bestuur gevalle van kindermishandeling, verwaarlosing en trauma in ooreenstemming met die Kinderwet. Voorligting en plasings: Bystand verleen met die siftings-, identifiserings- en assesseringsproses (SIAS) en faciliteer verwysings na eksterne welsynsorganisasies of mediese fasiliteite. Administrasie: Onderhou omvattende, vertroulike gevallelêers en opstelle statutêre verslae vir die Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling of Kinderhowe. Neem deel aan inter- en intrasektorale netwerke en samewerkings. Werk saam en skakel met belanghebbendes (bv. Departement van Gesondheid, Departement van Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling, Nie-winsgewende Organisasies, Nie-regeringsorganisasies, plaaslike regering en die breër gemeenskap). Bespreek leerders wat barrieres tot leer ervaar; skakel met Maatskaplike Werkers van ander spesiale skole en deel beste praktyke en ervarings; skakel met relevante professionele rade en tersiêre instellings; neem deel aan ekstra-murale en ko-kurrikulêre aktiwiteite. Bestuur en Administrasie: Bestuur effektiewe administrasiepraktyke van Maatskaplike Werk-intervensies; verseker nakoming van die gedragskode van die SACSSP; beoefen gesonde interpersoonlike verhoudinge, neem aktief deel aan prestasie-evaluerings volgens vereiste.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezenhlalo Esikoleni: Izikole Ezikhethekile
zu.summary: Abasebenzi bezenhlalo basikoleni badingeka kumzikole eyisikhombisa ekhethekile e-Eastern Cape ukuxhasa abafundi abanemidingo ehalukile yemfundo kanye nemindeni yabo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree zeminyaka eyi-4 ngokusemthethweni ezenzweni zezenhlalo. Ukwabhalisa njengamanje ngesikhathi esiphathwe ngumthetho kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). (Ubufakazi bokukhokha konyaka okuthile buyadingeka ngosuku lokuqashwa noma ngaphambi kwawo). Uholo lwangaphambili endaweni yesikole noma ukusebenza izingane ezenza ubunikazi luyasetshenziswa kakhulu. Ilayisense yokushayela egunyaziwe. Ukuqonda okujulile kwi-Children's Act kanye ne-South African Schools Act. Amakhono amakhulu wokuhlobana nabantu, ukubhala imibiko, kanye nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsiza ezithile zokusebenza ngokwezenhlalo kubafundi abanemidingo yemfundo ekhethekile, emindeni yabo, kanye nendawo yesikole. Umgqeshi ophumelelayo uzobe esebenzisa izinselele ezenhlalo, ezingokomzwilibili, kanye nezokuziphatha ekufundeni ukwenza uthuthukiswa lwezingane ngokuphelele endaweni ehlanganisiwe noma ekhethekile. Ukuxhaswa Ngokwezenhlalo Nokomzwilibili: Ukunikeza ukwelulekwa ngabanye nangeqembu kubafundi abahlukumezekile (ngokomzimba, ngengqondo, noma ukungahambisani kwezenhlalo). Ukusebenzisana Namakhasimba Amaningi: Ukusebenza njengengxenye ye-School-Based Support Team (SBST) kanye namapholofesa wengqondo, abaphiliswa bokuqasha, kanye nabaqashi bokukhuluma. Uxhumano Lwasekhaya Nesikole: Ukwenza izivakashi zasekhaya kanye nehlolwa ukuze kuqonde isimo sezenhlalo somfundi futhi kuhlinzke ngezinhlelo zokuqondisa abazali. Ukuphathwa Kwezimo Eziphuthumayo: Ukuphatha amacala enkungubulo yabantwana, ukunganakwa, kanye nokuhlukunyezwa ngokuhambisana ne-Children's Act. Ukuxhasa Nokubekwa: Ukusiza inqubo yokuhlola, ukuhlukanisa, kanye nehlolo (SIAS) futhi wenze ukuthumelwa kumabumba ekucupha kolunye ukuze kuthuthelwe kumaziko angaphandle ezenhlalo noma ezokwelapha. Izokuphatha: Ukugcina amafayela amacala aqotho futhi abhale imibiko esemthethweni yoMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa KoXumo noma izinkantolo zabantwana. Ukuthatha inhlangothi kumaxhuxhu nokusebenzisana phakathi nangaphakathi kwezimigqa. Ukusebenzisana kanye nokuxhumana namabanjwa (isb, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa KoXumo, Amanyuvesi Angenzi Mphango, Amanyuvesi Angakahulumeki, kahulumeni wendawo, kanye nemiphakathi jikelele). Ukuxhasa abafundi ababhekana nezinselelo ekufundeni; ukuxhumana noBasebenzi Bezenhlalo kwezinye izikole ekhethekile kanye nukwabelana ngendlela ezingcono namava; ukuxhumana namabodwe abangochwepheshe abahlobene kanye namanyuvesi; ukuthatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi wanganoma yisiphi isikhathi ezesinye isikole futhi kweminye imisebenzi. Ukuphatha Kwezokuphatha: Ukuphatha izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuphatha izinyathelo zokungenelela kwezenzenzalo zezenhlalo; ukuqinisekisa ukuthobeka nemitsetzo ye-SACSSP yokuziphatha; ukuziphatha ngokuhlobene kahle nabantu, ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenza ukuhlola imisebenzi ngokufanele.

xh.title: Omsebenzi Wezentsocial Wasezikolweni: IziKolo eZizodwa
xh.summary: Kufunwa abasebenzi bentsocial basezikolweni kwiziKolo eZizodwa e-six sase Eastern Cape ukuxhasa abafundi abanaba imfuno yemfundo ezodwa nabo baphela basemakhayeni.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor sidanga samenyaka angethuba leminyaka emine kwi-Social Work. UkuBhalisa ngoku kusemthethweni kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). (Isibonakaliso sokuhlawula kwaleminyaka siyayimfunwa ngomhla ophelile nangaphambi kweenyanga zolwazi). Amava angaphambili kwindawo yasezikolweni okanye ukusebenza nabantwana abakhubazekileyo yinto ekhuthaza kakhulu. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. UkuQonda ngokujulile koMthetho wezaBantwana noMthetho weziKolo zase South Africa. Amakhono amakhulu okuhamba nabantu, okubhala iingxelo, nokulawula iimeko zobungoz.
xh.duties: Ukuze kubhiywele iinkonzo zobugcisa bezentsocial kubafundi abanaba imfuno yemfundo ezodwa, abo baphela basemakhayeni, nendawo yasezikolweni. OkuKhethwayo kuya kubhekana neenthintelo zentsocial, zomzwangedwa, nezimilo kumfundo ukuze kulawulwe ukuphila komntu ngokupheleleyo kwindawo ehleli ngokuzodwa okanye eqokelelwe ndawonye. Inkxaso yeNtloko nengqondo: Unika ingcebiso enye nengamaqela kubafundi abakhubazekileyo ngamagunya ahlukeneyo (komzimba, ngengqondo, okanye abanamathuba ngeengcinga). UkubumbaNgqonyela phakathi kwamagunya: Ukusebenza njengenxalenye yeQela leNkxaso eNzulwini iSikolweni (SBST) xa kunye nabanengqondo, abalawuli bokuSebenza ngengqondo, nabanengqondo bokuKhuluma. INxibelelwano phakathi koKhaya neSikolo: UkuQhuba iindwendwe zasekhaya nokuvavanya ukuze kuqondeke iindawo zentsocial zomfundi nokunika iinkqubo zokuKhokela abazali. UkuNgenela iMeko eNgamandla: UKulawula amacala obugxotho bantwana, ukungalungi, nolimaza ngokulandela uMthetho wezaBantwana. UkuBekela nokubeka: Ukuncedisa ngenkqubo yokuvavanya, ukuzichaza, nokuqhelanisa (SIAS) nokulawula ukuthunyelwa koomasebenzi bemfundo okanye iziko lokwamkcwathisa iinywaka. UkuLawula: UkuGcina amafayela amacala akhutshiweyo, aqulethweyo kwaye abhale iingxelo zomthetho ze-Department of Social Development okanye iNgwhatsho loBuntwana. UkuThatha inxaxheba kumanxibelelwano weminyanya phakathi koluntu kwaye uhambe nawo. UkuThi nkqo noThathe inxaxheba kubantu abanomdlandla (umz., i-Department of Health, i-Department of Social Development, amaQela angenamvuzo, amaQela angaphandle karhulumente, i-urhulumente webanga, nesiQhagamshelweo). UkuBeka amazwi abafundi abafumana iinthintelo kumfundo, kwaye unxibelelane naBantu baseBenzayo ngentsocial esikolweni esizodwa, kwaye wabelane ngezicwangqiso zokuQamba namava, kwaye unxibelelane namaQela obugcisa amathethweyo kwaye neziKolo zamabanga aphakamileyo, wathatha inxaxheba kumanyathelo abucala nokuGxeka ngokutshata kolwazi. UkuLawula nokuLawula: UKulawula amandla okuyilawula iinkqubo zentsocial ezilawulwayo, qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho omkhulu weSACSSP, zonwabise ukuziphatha ngokulunga kwesiBini ngaphakathi, kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kumlinganiselo wokusebenza ngokomthetho ngokwemfuno.

af.title: Klinieke Bestuurder
af.summary: Klinieke Bestuurder-pos by Nessie Knight Hospital in OR Tambo Distrik, Eastern Cape, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn en 'n minimum van 3 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing soos die National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act en verwante regulasies en beleide. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Dienslewering-innovasie, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en ontleding, Kommunikasie, Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste in die hele hospitaal ooreenkomstig die departementele standaarde, insluitend na ure soos gedelegeer. Neem deel en is verantwoordelik vir bystand om die hospitaal se kliniese dienste te lei en te bestuur. Onderhou akkurate gesondheidsrekords ooreenkomstig regs-etiese oorwegings. Lei en begelei personeel en gesondheidsverwante professionele persone in morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsbesprekings. Woon deurlopende mediese opleiding by en neem deel daaraan. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Verseker dat kostedoeltreffende dienslewering binne die onderskeie departement gehandhaaf word. Woon administratiewe aangeleenthede soos vereis by. Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, te rig, te koördineer en te bestuur deur met die sleutel- uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die regsregulatoriese raamwerk te werk. Om die hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig. Bepaal stelsel vir intradepartementele funksies in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleide en kommunikeer dit aan personeel. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel in die onderskeie afdelings. Verseker nakoming van National Core Standards-vereistes of enige ander regulatoriese en/of statutêre vereiste. Voer gereelde kliniese oudits uit en ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor aksieplanne. Ontwikkel, monitor en ontleed begroting en finansiële inligting en benut alle hulpbronne op 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende wyse. Pas effektiewe probleemidentifikasie- en oplossingsvaardighede toe as 'n metode van deurdagte besluitneming. Moet bereid wees om onder druk te werk en buitelik dienspligte na ure volgens die beleid vir verplasde oortyd te verrig. Stel mediese verslae op en lewer getuienis by verhore wanneer vereis. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling (PMDS) en voer kwartaalontledings van ondergeskiktes uit. Die ampsdraer moet ook bereid wees om voorgraadse en nagraadse junior dokters op te lei, te ontwikkel en te superviseer.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wezokwelapha e-Nessie Knight Hospital e-OR Tambo District, Eastern Cape, esidinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqaji bezokwelapha nokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho okungu-3 iminyaka ngenani elingaphansi khona.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengogqaji bezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengogqaji bezokwelapha. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-3 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele njengesikhulu sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengogqaji bezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene njengo-National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act kanye nemithethonqondo kanye namapholisi ahlobene nalokho. Ikhono: Ikamu lokuhlakanipha okusezingeni kanye noholo, ukuphatha izinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha inguqulo, ukuphatha abantu kanye nokusinakisisa, ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokunaka abathengi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinsiza zokwelapha esibhedlela sonke ngokuhambisana namazinga omnyango, kuhlanganise nangemva kohora njengoba kunikezwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwaye ube nesibopho sokusiza ekuhokeni nasekuphatheni izinsiza zokwelapha zesibhedlela. Ukugcina amarekhodi ezempilo anembile ngokuhambisana nokucatshangelwa komthetho kwezokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha futhi ohole abasebenzi kanye nabochwepheshe behlobene nezempilo ekubukeni ukugula nokufa. Ukuhamba kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ezimfundeni ezihlala ziqhubeka zokwelapha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emuhlebeni wokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuvikela ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinsiza okubiza kakhulu kugcinwe kumnyango ohlobene. Ukunaka izindaba zolawulo njengoba kudingeka. Ukuhlela, ukuqondisa kanye nokuhlanganisa futhi uphathe ukulethwa okusebenza kahle futhi ngempumelelo kwezinsiza zokwelapha kanye noxhaso lolawulo ngokusebenza njengesiqingathi esibalulekile sehlelo lolawulo esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwezimiso zomthetho. Ukumela isibhedlela ngamandla emihlanganweni yezifundazwe kanye nomphakathi. Ukumisa isimiso sezimiso zangaphakathi komnyango ngokuhambisana namapholisi esibhedlela futhi axhumelwe kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha futhi kuthuthukise abasebenzi esigabeni esihlobene. Ukuvikela ukuthi kuhambiswe nezidingo zamazinga akhona e-National Core Standards noma omunye noma owodwa isidingo somthetho noma esibekwe ngumthetho. Ukwenza ukuhlola okuvamile kokwelapha kwaye uhluze, ufake futhi ulawule ama-planu sesho. Ukuhlola, ukulawula kanye nokuuhlaziya ibhajethi kanye nolwazi lwemali futhi usebenzise wonke amas insiza ngendlela esebenzayo futhi ngempumelelo. Ukuziqhelanisa ekuboneni izinkinga ngekhono elisebenzayo nokuzixazulula njengendlela yokuthatha izinqumo ezinhle. Kumele abe wolungelo lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcina nangemva kohora njengoba kumthethonqondo woxesha olungeziwe. Ukuqamba imibiko yezokwelapha kwaye unike ulwazi ecaleni kwamacala, uma kuthiwa. Ukuphatha ukuqhutywa kwezinto kwaye ethuthukiswe kwaye enze okuhlwayo kwamakota nakubantu abangaphansi kwakhe. Owayo isikhundla kumele futhi alungelwe ukuqeqesha, aqhakambise futhi alawule abagqaji bezokwelapha abasha abangaphansi kwabafundi abangenamabachelor's degree nabaphothule i-degree.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wezokwelapha kwiNessie Knight Hospital kwiOR Tambo District, eEastern Cape, esifuna ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotela wempilo kunye nokuba nobugcisa obungaphezulu kweminyaka eli-3.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotela wempilo. Ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotela wempilo. Okona kube yiminyaka eli-3 ubugcisa obufanelekileyo njengomntu osebenzayo kwezempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengoDokotela wempilo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo echunyezelweyo efana noMthetho wezeMpilo yaseLizwe, uMthetho wezeMempilo yengqondo, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhovawunci (PFMA)), uMthetho woMphatho waSebe lweCandalo loluntu kunye nemigaqo-nkqubo edityaneyo namagqabantshintshi. Ikhono: Ikhono lokulawula nokuqaqambisa iindlela, uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweziTshintsho, uLawulo labaBasebenzi noMbuso wabo, iInkqubo zoKulethwa kweeNkonzo, uLawulo lweSpili, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuQwalasela, ukuThetha nokuThetha nabantu, uKujolisela kwiKhasava. Ilayisensi yokushuka ethengisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo zokwelapha kwisibhedlele sonke ngokwezinga lesebe, kuquka nangemva kwamaxesha ajalisweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwaye unoxanduva lokuncedisa ekukhuliseni nokuLawuleni iinkonzo zokwelapha zesibhedlele. Ukugcina iirekhodi zempilo ezichanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho yenkqubo yamalinge. Ukulolonga kwaye ukhokele abasebenzi nabanmpzeei abahlobene nezempilo ekuphononongweni kwezingcibecibe nokufa. Ukubakho kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwimfundo elulqongo yezokwelapha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula ukhwalithi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukuhanjiswa kwezinkonzo ezikulungele ixabiso kugcinwa kwesebe elithinteleleyo. Ukuba nzela kwezint zolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Ukwacinga, ukuqondisa, ukuqamba kwaye alawule ukuhanjiswa okusebenzayo nokuqinileyo kwezinkonzo zokwelapha kunye nokulawulela izinto zokulawulo ngokusebenza namanqanaba aphakamileyo ekulawula isibhedlele ngaphakathi kumonkqubo omtsha womthetho. Ukumela isibhedlele ngokugqibeleleyo kumabandla ommandla nakwikomonthi. Ukumisela inkqubo yemisebenzi yasekhaleni ngokomthetho wezibhedlele kwaye uxelele abasebenzi. Ukulolonga nokuqinisa abasebenzi kumacandelo ahambelanayo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuhambelana neemfuno zeNqanaba eziphakamileyo zamazwe nakwezinye iimfuno zomthetho nakwisigqeba. Ukuqhuba iingxoxo zokwelapha ngamaxesha aqhelekileyo kwaye aziphuve, aziphumeze kwaye alalele iinkqubo zokwenza izinto. Ukuphucula, ukulalela nokwahlula amaxabiso nemali yezimali kwaye usebenzise zonke izixhobo ngendlela esebenzayo nokuqinileyo. Ukuzilolonga ngokuchanekileyo ekubeni nokusombulula iingxaki njengendlela yokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo. Kufuneka alungele ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nakumaxwesha ajalisweyo njengoko kumthetho wehora yokusebenzaNgaphezu. Ukulungiselela iingxelo zokwelapha kwaye anike ubungqina ecaleni kwezityholo, xa kufuneka. Ukulawula ukuSebenza nokuqinisa (PMDS) kwaye enze iingxelo zexesha leminyaka yezikwi ezingezantsi. Lowo umnyaleza kufunanske alungele ukulolonga, aqhase kwaye alawule oodokotela abasaasebenzayo nabangapheli kwedigri.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wezeminyanga
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umlawuli Wezeminyanga ogcweleni le Dr Malizo Mpehle Hospital e OR Tambo District ukuphatha izinsizakalo zeminyanga kanye nokuba ihamba phambili kokuqashwa kwenosithela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezempilo. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezempilo. Ukwenzelwa okungu-3 iminyaka okuncane kokuhamba phambili njengomphathi weminyanga emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezempilo. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene njenge-National Health Act, i-Mental Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), i-Public Service Act nemithetho kanye nezinqumela ezihlobene. Ilayisensi yokushibha evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinsizakalo zeminyanga esibhedlela sonke ngokuvumelana nemilinganiselo komnyango, kuhlanganise nangemva kwezinsuku njengoba kunikelwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kanye nobuzwe ngokusiza ekuqondiseni nasekuphatheni izinsizakalo zeminyanga zesibhedlela. Ukugcina irekhodi lokuqinisekileyo lempilo ngokuvumelana nezinkumbulo zomthetho nezomzingozi. Ukuqeqesha kanyeokuqondisa izisebenzi nezinhlanganeni ezehlobene nempilo kulezo ngxoxo mayelana nezifo kanye nokuFA. Ukuya kwayokuba inxaxheba ekuqeqesheni okungapheleleko kweminyanga. Ukuba inxaxheba kumaphrojekhi okuphucula izinga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezibiza kakhulu ziyagcinwa ngokufanele kumnyango ohlobene. Ukuqashwa kwezindaba zolawulo njengoba kufuneka. Ukucwangcisa, ukuqondisa ukuqondanisa kwayokuphatha ukulethwa okusebenzayo kanye nokuqinisekileyo kwezinsizakalo zeminyanga kanye nokuqondisa ulawulo ngokusebenza nokuqondisa amakhulu ohamba phambili esibhedlela ngaphakathi komthetho. Ukumela isibhedlela ngokugqamile emimangweni wesifundazwe nalomphakathi. Ukucwangcisa inkundla yemisebenzi yangaphakathi komnyango ngokuvumelana nemithetho yesibhedlela kwayokudlulisa kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha kwayokukhulisa izisebenzi kumagatsha ahlobene. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo ze-National Core Standards noma nanoma yisiphi isidingo esimthethweni. Ukuqamba ukuhlola okuvamile kweminyanga kwayokuthuthukisa, ukuphatha kwayokubuka izinkqubo zenzo. Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuka kwayokuhlaziya ibhajethi kwayolwazi lwezimali kwayokusebenzisa onke amatholokuthi ngendlela esebenzayo kwayoqinisekileyo. Ukuzivumela okusebenzayo kokubona izinkinga kwayokuzixazulula njengendlela yokwenza izinqumo ezihle. Kufanele ukube ulungile ukusebenzisa ngokucindezelekile kwayokwenza imisebenzi yemva kwesikhathi njengoba kumthetho we-overtime. Ukuqamba umbiko weminyanga kwayokunikela ubufakazi ecaleni, uma kuceliwe. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kwayokuthuthukisa (PMDS) kwayokwenza ukubuka kwamakota abasebenzi abangaphansi. xh.title: Umphathi weZempilo
xh.summary: Kufunwa Umphathi weZempilo e Dr Malizo Mpehle Hospital kwindawo ye OR Tambo District ukulawula iinkonzo zempilo nokuba ngumongo kuwo asebenzayo isibhedlele.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengoGqirha. Ukubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengoGqirha. Okungenani iminyaka engu 3 yamava afanelekileyo njengomsebenzi wezonyanga emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengoGqirha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambelana nayo enjenge National Health Act, i Mental Health Act, i Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), i Public Service Act nakwisimiso nemigaqo ehambelana nayo. Iimfuno: Ikhumkaneko kunye nobuqhawe bokulawula, ulawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi, ulawulo lweMali, ulawulo loGuquko, ulawulo lwabantu nokuBa nakho, iNkonzo eNtsha yokunika, ulawulo lweNdalifa, ukuSombulula iingxaki neSixhobo sokuhlalutyi, unxibelelwano, ukuQwalasela umthengi nogqaliselo lwabathengi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweenkonzo zempilo kulo lonke isibhedlele ngokwemigaqo yesebe, kuquka nangemva leesixa ngokweswekiso. Thatha inxaxheba ube nawo amaxanduva ekuncedeni ekulawuleni nokulawula iinkonzo zempilo zesibhedlele. Gcina irekhodi yempilo eqondo nangokomthetho nengqikitho yokuziphatha. Qeqesha okokulundela abasebenzi neengcali ezidibana nezempilo ekuphononongeni ukugula nokufa. Thatha inxaxheba kwenzalo eqhubekayo yemfundo yonyango. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula ixabiso. Qinisekisa ukuba ukunikwa kweenkonzo ngexabiso elisebenzayo londolotwa kwesobe ngokwemfuno. Joyla iindaba zolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Cwangcisa, qondisa ulungelelanise ulawule ukunikwa ngokusebenza ngempumelelo nangexabiso lweenkonzo zempilo nolawulo ngenkxaso ngokusebenza nqamlezo kunye neqela eliphambili elilawulayo esibhedlele ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho nolawulo. Mela iNtloko yesiBhedlele ngamagunya kwiiyure zamaphondo nawoluntu. Zenza inkqubo yemisebenzi yangaphakathi kwesebe ngokwemigaqo yesibhedlele aze ayixelele abasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuvelisa abasebenzi kumacandelo ahambelana nayo. Qinisekisa ukuthelekiswa nemfuno yemigaqo yeNational Core Standards okanye nayiphi na enye imfuno ekulawulweni nangomthetho. Sakha, alawule aze ahlalutye imali yemali yolucwango lolwazi asebenzise onke amacebo ngendlela esebenzayo nangempumelelo. Sebenzisa amakhono okuchonga nokusombulula iingxaki ngokusebenza njengendlela yokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo. Makabe elungele ukusebenza ngocinezelo nakumasebenzi nangemva kweyure ngokwemigaqo yeture yexesha elidlulayo. Hlanganisela iingxelo zonyango uze ufake ubungqina kule zibhalo, xa kufuneka. Lawula iNkqubo yoMvuzo nokuQhuba iNkqubo yokuQaliswa kweNdalo (PMDS) uze wenze ukuphonononga kwi Koretha ngesikhathi ngemiba esezantsini. Lowo uwime kule sikhundla makabe elungele nokuqeqesha, ukuvelisa nokuqwalasela oogqirha abasha abafunda isidanga sangaphantsi nangaphezulu.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager
jobs.salary_text: R1 479 723 – R1 640 055 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD). Basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Clinical Manager sought for Zithulele Hospital in the Eastern Cape to lead and manage hospital clinical services in accordance with departmental standards.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a medical officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, Program and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Service Delivery Innovation, Knowledge Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, Communication, Client Orientation and Customer focus. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Management of clinical services in the entire hospital in accordance with the departmental standards, including after hours as delegated. Participate and accountable for assisting in leading and managing the hospital clinical services. Maintain accurate health records in accordance with legal ethical considerations. Train and guide staff and health associated professionals in morbidity and mortality reviews. Attend and participate in continuous medical education. Participate in quality improvement programs. Ensure that cost effective services delivery is maintained within the respective department. Attend to administrative matters as required. To plan, direct coordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of clinical and administration support services through working the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal regulatory framework. To present the Hospital Authoritatively at provincial and public forums. Determines system for intradepartmental functions in keeping with hospital policies and communicates it to staff. Training and development of staff in the relevant sections. Ensure compliance with National Core Standards requirements or any other regulatory and/or statutory requirement. Conduct regular clinical audits and develop, implement and monitor action plans. Develop, monitor and analyse budget and financial information and utilizes all resources in an effective and efficient manner. Practice effective problem identification and resolution skills as a method of sound decision making. Must be prepared to work under pressure and after hour duties as per commuted overtime policy. Compile medical reports and give evidence at trials, when required. Manage Performance and Development (PMDS) and perform quarterly reviews of subordinates. The incumbent must also be prepared to train, develop and supervise of undergraduate and post graduate junior doctors.
jobs.applications: Alternatively, applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Sobetwak@gmail.com
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short-listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). The department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Klinieke Bestuurder

af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste in die hele hospitaal in ooreenstemming met die departementele standaarde, insluitend na ure soos gedelegeer. Neem deel en is verantwoordelik vir bystand met die leiding en bestuur van die hospitaal se kliniese dienste. Handhaaf akkurate gesondheidsrekords in ooreenstemming met wettige etiese oorwegings. Trein en begelei personeel en gesondheidsverwante professionele personeel in morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings. Bywoon en neem deel aan deurlopende mediese opvoeding. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Verseker dat koste-effektiewe dienslewering binne die onderskeie departement gehandhaaf word. Tik aandag aan administratiewe sake soos vereis. Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe levering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, te rig, te koördineer en te bestuur deur saam te werk met die sleutel uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die wettige regulasieraamwerk. Om die Hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig. Bepaal stelsel vir intradepartementele funksies in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleide en kommunikeer dit aan personeel. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel in die relevante afdelings. Verseker nakoming van National Core Standards vereistes of enige ander regulatoriese en/of statutêre vereiste. Voer gereelde kliniese oudits uit en ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor aksieplanne. Ontwikkel, monitor en analiseer begroting en finansiële inligting en gebruik alle hulpbronne op 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe wyse. Beoefen effektiewe probleemidentifiserings- en oplossingsvaardighede as 'n metode van strategiese besluitneming. Moet bereid wees om onder druk en na ure dienste te werk volgens die berekende oortydbeleid. Stel mediese verslae op en getuig by verhore, wanneer vereis. Bestuur Prestasie en Ontwikkeling (PMDS) en voer kwartaallikse hersienings van ondergeskiktes uit. Die ampsdraer moet ook bereid wees om voorgraadse en nagraadse junior dokters op te lei, te ontwikkel en te superviseer.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa umphathi wezokwelapha wesibhedlela i-Zithulele Hospital e-Eastern Cape ukuze ahole aphathe futhi enze izinkonzo zezokwelapha zesibhedlela ngokuvumelana nezilinganiso zomnyango.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yohlelo olufanele njengonobhala wezokwelapha emva kokuqashelwa ku-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene njengalawo akuthiwa National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Act kanye nemithesho namapholisi ahlobene noku. Amakhono: Ikholo lokweluleka nokuhaqasha, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi namaphrograms, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa, ukutumba izinkonzo, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ukuqondiswa kiklayenti nogqoliswa kwamaklayenti. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zezokwelapha kuyo yonke isibhedlela ngokuvumelana nezilinganiso zomnyango, okubandakanya namahora emva kwesikhathi njengoba kunikeziwe. Ukubamba iqhaza nokubekezele ekusizeni ukuhola nokuphatha izinkonzo zezokwelapha zesibhedlela. Ukugcina imibhalo egculisayo enembile ngokuvumelana nanqondo zomthetho nezokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha futhi uhola abasebenzi nabanqidi bezempilo kumakuqubo okucwaninga ukugula kanye nokufa. Ukuhamba futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuqeqeshweni kwazo hlanye kwemfundo yezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza kwizinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuthola ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinkonzo okuyindlela yokugwema izinkali kugcinwa emnyangweni ohlobene. Ukunakwa izindaba ezinzuzwa njengoba kudingeka. Ukuhlela, ukuqondisa, ukuhomogenisa futhi uphathe ukulethwa okuyindlela nokuqinisekisiwe kwezinkonzo zezokwelapha kanye nezinkonzo zokwesekwa kwezobuphathi ngokusebenzana neqembu eliphambili lokuphatha elilawulayo esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho. Ukumela isibhedlela ngokusemthethweni kumaphoramu esifundazwe nasenkundla yomphakathi. Ukumisa inkqubo yemisebenzi yaphakathi komnyango ngokuhambisana namapholisi wesibhedlela bese eyixhumana kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi kumabangelo ahlobene. Ukuthola ukuthi kuhambiswa nezidingo zezilinganiso eziyisiseko ezingowezwekazi noma yikuphi na esinye isidingo somthetho. Ukwenza ukuhlola okuvamile kwezokwelapha bese ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa futhi ulawule izinhlelo zokwenza. Ukuthuthukisa, ukulawula futhi uhlaziye imali yesabelo nemininingwane yemali bese usebenzisa zonke izinsiza ngendlela ephumelelayo neqinisekile. Ukuzilolonga ikhono eliphumelelayo lokuhlonza nokuqeda izinkinga njengendlela yokwenza izinqumo ezinhle. Kufanele ukubekezele ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi kanye nemisebenzi yamahora ngemva kwesikhathi njengoba kulindewe ngumthetho we-overtime. Ukuqamba imibhalo yezokwelapha bese unikeza ubufakulu ezinkantolo, uma kudingwa. Ukuphatha ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa (PMDS) nokwenza ukuphonononga kwakho konke ukwamasonto amathathu ebasebenzini abangaphansi kwakho. Lowo othathiwe kulesi sikhundla kufanele futhi akubekezela ukuze aqeqeshe, athuthukise futhi alawule abadokotela abasha abafunda ngaphansi kwabanye noma abaphothule.

Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambelana nayo enjengomthetho weNational Health Act, iMental Health Act, iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iPublic Service Act namagqabantshintshi aneenkqubela ezenye nelu hlobo lwemithetho. Iakhono: Ikhono lokuhola nokuqamba iindlela ezintsha, Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi, Ulawulo lweemali, Ulawulo lenguquko, Ulawulo labantu nokuweekisa, Intsha kulawulo lweenkonzo, Ulawulo lolwazi, Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuqonda izinto ngokucokisileyo, Unxibelelwano, Ukuzinika kumthengi kwaye ugqalelele iimfuno zamthengi. Ilayisensi yokushuka edibeneyo.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweenkonzo ezimalunga nezempilo kwisibhedlele sonke ngokwemigangatho yesebe, kuquka nangemva kweeyure zomsebenzi njengoko kulunyulwe. Ukubamba iqhaza kwaye ube nawo uxanduva lokuncedisa ekukhuliseni nasekulawulweni lweenkonzo ezimalunga nezempilo zesibhedlele. Ukuze zigcinwe ngokuchanekileyo iirekhodi ezimalunga nezempilo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nesiko. Ukuzimela nokuqondisa abasebenzi namagosa ahlukene nezempilo kwimibiko yezigulo nokufa. Ukuza kubandakanyeka kwinkqubo yokufundela ngokuqhubekayo ngamaxesha onke ngokweenkonzo zezempilo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwiinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukwaneliseza iinkonzo ngexabiso elinguziro ngokwesebe ngalinye. Ukuqwalasela izinto ezimalunga nolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba iindlela, ukuhambelana nokulawula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngokweenkonzo ezimalunga nezempilo nolawulo ngokusebenzisa iqela eliphambilli lebalawuli besibhedlele ngaphakathi kwemithetho. Ukumela isibhedlele ngokusemthethweni kumabala amazwe nakowoluntu. Ukumisela iindlela ezimalunga nesebe ngokugqitha kumagqabantshintshi kwimigaqo yesibhedlele kwaye ixelwe kubasebenzi. Ukuzimela nokuphucula abasebenzi kumacandelo ahambelana nawo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuzinikela ngokwemigaqo ebalulekileyo yeli lizwe nasemthethweni nasemthethweni wesizwe. Ukuqhuba iingqwalasela ngamaxesha ngamaxesha ezempilo kwaye uqambe, uzebenzise kwaye ulandele iinkqubo zokwenza iinto ezintsha. Uqambe, ulandele kwaye uhlaluthe imali engeniswayo nolwazi ngemali kwaye uyisebenzise yonke into kwindlela echanekileyo. Ukuqonda iingxaki kwaye azixazule njengendlela yokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo. Kubekho lukhuni ukuze akwazi ukusebenza ngxemeshe kwaye azebenze nangemva kweyure ngokwemithetho. Ukuqamba iingxelo ezimalunga nezempilo kwaye anike ubungqina eengcaleni, xa kufunwa. Ukulawula ulawulo lomsebenzi nokuphucula izakhono (PMDS) kwaye aze anxaxhe abasebenzi basendlini ixesha ngalinye. Umntu okhetiweyo makabe lukhuni ekufundiseni, ekuphuculeni nakokuqondisa oogqirha abasha.

zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomqangi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomqangi wezokwelapha. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yokuhlolwa okufanele njengonobhala wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomqangi wezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene efana noMthetho Wezempilo Yezwe, uMthetho Wezempilo Yengqondo, uMthetho Wokuqaphela Imali Yomphakathi (PFMA), uMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi nemithetho ehalisayo kanye nezinqubomgomo. Amandla: Ikholwa nobuqhawe bokubheka phambili, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nezinhlela zomsebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla, ukwakheka kwemikhiqizo yesisekelo esisha, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxazulula inkinga nokuhlola, ukuxhumana, ukumiswa kwegxagxa klabhalise kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha efanele.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwezinkonzo zokwelapha esibhedlela sonke ngokuvumelana nemigomo yomnyango, okuhlanganise nangemva kwezihora njengokuqondiswa. Ukubamba iqhaza nokuphathwa kokusiza ekubhekeni phambili nokuqondweni kwezinkonzo zokwelapha zesibhedlela. Ukugcina irekhodi lokuqinisekile lezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nezinkomba zomthetho nezomthetho wokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha futhi uhola abasebenzi kanye nabanini zeziqu ezingene nezempilo ekuhloleni ukugula nokufa. Ukubandakanya nokubamba iqhaza kwemfundo ephilayo yezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza kwezinhlela zokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinkonzo okugcinayo kugcinwa ngaphakathi komnyango ohlobene. Ukubhekana nezindaba zomphathi njengokuqondiwe. Ukucabanga, ukuqondisa, ukuhlelela futhi aphathe ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokuqinisekile kwezinkonzo zokwelapha kanye nesevisi yolawulo ngokusebenza nochungechunge oluphambili lokuqondisa esibhedlela ngaphakathi kohlaka lomthetho. Ukumelela isibhedlela ngokugqamile emhlanganweni wesifundazwe nakomphakathi. Ukunquma uhlelo lokusebenza ngaphakathi komnyango ngokuvumelana nemigomo yesibhedlela bese uyixhumanisa nabasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi kumagatsha ahlobene. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo Zemigumo Yezwe noma yikuphi na okunye okudingwa ngumthetho. Ukuhlola njalo izokwelapha bese ukuthuthukisa, ukuphatha futhi ulawule izinhlela zomsebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlola futhi uhlaziye imali ebhalwe ngokwesabelo kanye nolwazi lwemali bese usebenzisa wonke amabhuloholo ngendlela efanele. Ukuzijwayeza ngamandla okuhlola inkinga nokuxazulula njengendlela yokwenza isinqo esihle. Ukuba ulungile ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegxabo kanye nemisebenzi yamahora angeyona yezihora njengokumiswe yisinqo sokusebenza ngaphezulu kwamahora. Ukuqamba imibalo yezokwelapha bese unika ubufakazi ecaleni, uma kudingwa. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kahle nokuthuthukiswa (PMDS) bese ukwenza okuhlwayo kwakho konke kwabangaphansi komakade. Umlondolozi kufanele futhi alungele ukuqeqesha, athathe inhlalo bese alawula ongayena kwezobudokotela abasha kanye nabo bhedeshu baphansi kwekolishi.

Amandla nokuziphatha: Ikhono lokuqonda iindlela ezisemthethweni nokuqaqamba izikhokelo, uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo loTshintsho, uLawulo bemi Benzi nokuBa matyhalyme, iNkcubeko ngenkululeko yokuZeza iNkonzo, uLawulo lolwazi, ukuzalisekisa iingxaki nokuHlola unxulumano, iNtetho, uQqamba lomThengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zamathengi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo zokwelapha kwisibhedlele sonke ngokwemilinganiselo yesebe, kuquka namava emva kweeyure njengoko kumiselwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwaye ungxululeke ekuncedeni ekukhuleni nasekulawulweni iinkonzo zokwelapha zesibhedlele. Ukugcina irekhodi yemiba ezempilweni ngokwemigaqo eqondene nemithetho nemicuko. Ukuqeqesha nokukhokela abasebenzi nabo bahlulwa kwimiba yempilo ekubhonweni kwemiba yokugula nokufa. Ukuhamba kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwiemfundo ephela yokuqeqesha ugqirha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ngexabiso elifanelekileyo kugcinwa kwicala ngalinye. Ukubhekana neemba zolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Ukucwangcisa, ukulawula ngqo nokulawula ukuhanjiswa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kweenkonzo zokwelapha nolawulo ngokusebenzana neqela eliphambili lokulawula kwisibhedlele ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomthetho. Ukumela isibhedlele ngokusesigxakeni kwiforum zephondo nakwawo onke amawonga. Ukumisela inkqubo yemisebenzi yangaphakathi kwesebe ngokweemigaqo zesibhedlele aze ayidlulisele kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuqhutywa kwaphambili abasebenzi kwindawo enxulumeneyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzalathiswa kwemfuno zamazinga aPhakathi eSizwe nanalo nawo nawuphi na owunye umthetho. Ukwenza iindlela zokuqinisekisa ukulungileyo kwemiba yezokwelapha rhoqo aze aqambe, aze azise kwangangoko kunokwenzeka ayenze aze alawule iinkqubo zenkqubo yokwenza. Ukuqamba, ukulawula nokuqhetywa kolwazi ngeemali zesibhedlele nokusebenzisa zonke iinkcelo ngenkqubo ephilayo neyempumelelo. Ukuziqhelanisa nokuqonda eNgxakini nokuSombulula iingxaki njengendlela yokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo. Kufuneka alungele ukusebenza nginqindi waze wasebenze nangemini emva kweyure njengoko kumiswe kwinkqubo yokusebenza ixesha elongezelelekileyo. Ukulungelelanisa iingxelo zokwelapha aze unike ubungqina ecaleni kwekhothi, njengoko kufuneka. Ukulawula ukwenza iNkqubo yoLawulo nokuziphatha (iPMDS) nokwenza iingqinisekiso zenyanga zihamba ngamakhusi o basebenziyo. Kufuneka umntu ogarhiweyo abe nalungelelwaniso lokuba aqeqesha, aphucule waye alawule ogqirha abatsha abafunde iinyanga ezincinci nabadlulileyo kodwa abagqithisayo.

zu.duties: Ukuphathele imisebenzi yamakliniki esibhedlela sonke ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zomnyango, kuhlanganise namahora emva kwesikhathi njengoko kunikwa imandla. Ukuhlose izindaba zolawulo njengoko kudingeka. Ukuhlela, ukuqondisa ukuhambisa nokuphatha ukulethwa okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo kwezinsiza zamakliniki nokusekelwa kolawulo ngokusebenzela iqembu eliphambili labaphathi besibhedlela ngaphakathi kohlelo lomthetho. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava afanelekileyo njengesigulane-mthatha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengeMedical Practitioner. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nayo efana neNational Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act nemiqathango namagqabantshintshi ahlobene nayo. Iikhompetensi: Isakhono seStrategic kunye nokuqhatha, ulawulo lweNkqubo noQeqesho loMsebenzi, uLawulo lwezeMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lwaBantu noMandlulo wabo, iziQqulubah bendlela yokunikela iinkonzo, uLawulo lweNzululwazi, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuQqamba iNgcakanada, ukuThetha nakuThethelana, uJolise kwiKhasi kunene nesaziso sabathengi. Ilayisensi yokuQhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: ULawulo lweekonzo zeempilo kwisibhedlele sonke ngokwemigaqo yesebe, kuquka nangemva kwemizila njengoko kumiselwe. UKuthatha inxaxheba kwaye ungxamise ekuncedeni ukuba kukhokelwe kwaye kulawulwe iinkonzo zeempilo zesibhedlele. UKugcina iirekhodi zeempilo ezichanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho neyokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha nokukhokela abasebenzi nabaqeqeshi-mpiIko ahlobene nayo kwiincoma ezimalunga nesigulo nokufa. UKuhleka nakuthathela urhulumente inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokulondolozela eluntwini kwinkqubo yeqhinga lokufunda. UKuthathela inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho. UKuqinisekisa ukuba ukunikela iinkonzo ezingabizi kuhle lugcino luyasikelelwa ngaphakathi kwesebe. UKujolisela kumaphulo olawulo njengoko kufuneka. UKucenga, ukuqondisa, ukulungelanisa nokulawula ukunikela okusebenzayo nasebenzayo iinkonzo zeempilo nenkxaso yolawulo ngokusebenza nqamlezethu yabaqhagamshelwa ekhowude ekhoyo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele ngaphakathi komthetho wemicimbi yokuLawula. UKumela isibhedlele ngokusemthethweni kwindawo zaseburhulumente nakwidini yasentshonalanga. UKuqamba iinkqubo yemisebenzi yangaphakathi kwesebe ngokwemigaqo yomthetho wesibhedlele kwaye iyaqikefela kubasebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuphucula abasebenzi kumacandelo ahlobene nayo. UKuqinisekisa ukuzalathana namagqabantshintshi eNational Core Standards okhoyi onke naqho amagqabantshintshi omthetho. UKwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwempiIko rhoqo kwaye aqhabe, ayise kwaye alawule iinkqubo zokwenza. UKuqamba, ulawula kwaye uhluke isithuba somanyano lwemali ekhwela kwaye asebenzise zonke iindawo zomanyano ngendlela ebalaseleyo nasebenzayo. UKuzilolonga ngokuchanekileyo ekuboneni nokuqambisa iingxaki njengendlela yokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo. Makabe elungele ukusebenza ngoxinzelelo nakumsebenzi wakutshanje njengoko kumiselwe yomthetho we overtime yokuhamba. UKuqamba iingxelo zeempilo kwaye anike iqhalo ecaleni kwengxaki xa kufuneka. UKulawula inkqubo yoManyano lokuSebenza nokuQeqeshwa (PMDS) kwaye enze ukukhangela kwamakomiti kwiNkokeli yamakomiti kwiNyanga yokuNgqungqumbela kunye neziqendu.

jobs.title: Clinical Manager
jobs.salary_text: R1 479 723 – R1 640 055 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD). basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Clinical Manager needed at Isilimela Hospital in OR Tambo District to manage clinical services in line with departmental standards.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a medical officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, Program and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Service Delivery Innovation, Knowledge Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, Communication, Client Orientation and Customer focus. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Management of clinical services in the entire hospital in accordance with the departmental standards, including after hours as delegated. Participate and accountable for assisting in leading and managing the hospital clinical services. Maintain accurate health records in accordance with legal ethical considerations. Train and guide staff and health associated professionals in morbidity and mortality reviews. Attend and participate in continuous medical education. Participate in quality improvement programs. Ensure that cost effective services delivery is maintained within the respective department. Attend to administrative matters as required. To plan, direct coordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of clinical and administration support services through working the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal regulatory framework. To present the Hospital Authoritatively at provincial and public forums. Determines system for intradepartmental functions in keeping with hospital policies and communicates it to staff. Training and development of staff in the relevant sections. Ensure compliance with National Core Standards requirements or any other regulatory and/or statutory requirement. Conduct regular clinical audits and develop, implement and monitor action plans. Develop, monitor and analyse budget and financial information and utilizes all resources in an effective and efficient manner. Practice effective problem identification and resolution skills as a method of sound decision making. Must be prepared to work under pressure and after hour duties as per commuted overtime policy. Compile medical reports and give evidence at trials, when required. Manage Performance and Development (PMDS) and perform quarterly reviews of subordinates. The incumbent must also be prepared to train, develop and supervise of undergraduate and post graduate junior doctors.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Z Nomphandana Tel No: (047) 564 2805/2/3.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted electronically via email to: Zukiswa.Nomphandana@echealth.gov.za

Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. af.title: Kliniese Bestuurder
af.summary: Kliniese Bestuurder benodig by Isilimela Hospitaal in OR Tambo Distrik om kliniese dienste in ooreenstemming met departementele standaarde te bestuur.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n mediese beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing soos die National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act en verwante regulasies en beleide. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en Projektbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Personeelbestuur en Bemagtiging, Diensleweringinnovasie, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en Analise, Kommunikasie, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste in die hele hospitaal in ooreenstemming met die departementele standaarde, insluitend na ure soos gedelegeer. Neem deel en is verantwoordelik vir hulp met die leiding en bestuur van die hospitaal se kliniese dienste. Onderhou akkurate gesondheidsrekords in ooreenstemming met wetlike etiese oorwegings. Lei en begelei personeel en gesondheidsverwante professionele persone in morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings. Woon deurlopende mediese opvoeding by en neem deel. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Verseker dat kostedoeltreffende dienslewering binne die onderskeie departement gehandhaaf word. Sitz administratiewe sake soos vereis. Om die doeltreffende en doeltreffende lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, te rig, te koördineer en te bestuur deur met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die wetlike regulatoriese raamwerk te werk. Om die Hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig. Bepaal stelsel vir intradepartementele funksies in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbeleide en kommunikeer dit aan personeel. Opleiding en ontwikkeling van personeel in die tersaaklike afdelings. Verseker nakoming van National Core Standards vereistes of enige ander regulatoriese en/of statutêre vereiste. Voer gereelde kliniese oudite uit en ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor aksieplanne. Ontwikkel, monitor en analiseer begroting en finansiële inligting en benut alle hulpbronne op 'n doeltreffende en doeltreffende wyse. Oefen effektiewe probleemidentifikasie en oplossingsvaardighede toe as 'n metode van deurdagte besluitneming. Moet bereid wees om onder druk en na-ure dienste te werk ooreenkomstig die omgereelde oortydbeleid. Stel mediese verslae op en getuig by verhore, wanneer vereis. Bestuur Prestasie en Ontwikkeling (PMDS) en voer kwartaallikse hersienings van ondergeskiktes uit. Die ampshouer moet ook bereid wees om voorgraadse en nagraadse junior dokters op te lei, te ontwikkel en te superviseer.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wezokwelapha e-Isilimela Hospital esifundeni i-OR Tambo District ukuphatha izinkonzo zokwelapha ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zomnyango.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha. Okungenani eminyakaengu-3 yokuhlola okufanelekileyo njengesikhulu sezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene njengengeNational Health Act, i-Mental Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), i-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho kanye nemigomo ehlobene. Izakhono: Ikhono lezokuqamba isu nokubusa, ukuphatha amaphrojekhi namaprogramu, ukuphatha imali, ukuphatha izinguquko, ukuphatha abantu nokuqusula, inovesheni yokuhanuliswa kwenkonzo, ukuphatha ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana, ukugxila kumthengi nokugxila kwindalela. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izinkonzo zokwelapha esibhedlela sonke ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso zomnyango, okuhlanganise nangemva kwezikhathi njengoba kunikelwe. Ukubambe iqhaza futhi ugxile ekusizeni ekukhuliseni nokuphatheni izinkonzo zokwelapha zesibhedlela. Ukugcina irekhodi lokunempilo eliqinisekisiwe ngokuvumelana nezinkinga zomthetho zokuziphatha. Ukuqeqesha nokuhola izisebenzi kanye nabahlinzeki bahlangene nezempilo ekubukeni ukugula nokufa. Ukuhamba nokubamba iqhaza ekugcineni kwezokufunda ezokwelapha. Ukubamba iqhaza kumaphrojekhi okuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinkonzo ezibiza kancane kugcinwa esigabeni somnyango ngasinye. Ukuhamba nezindaba zolawulo njengoba kudingekile. Ukucubungula, ukuqondisa ukuhlukanisa nokuphatha ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokwenza ngokushesha izinkonzo zokwelapha nokusekela olunye uhlelo lolawulo ngokusebenza nomthimba obalulekile wobuphathi obusebusikhundleni esibhedlela ngaphakathi kusandulela somthetho. Ukumela isibhedlela ngokugcizelela ezinkundleni zasifundza kanye nabezomphakathi. Ukumisa indlela yemisebenzi yangaphakathi komnyango ngokuvumelana nemigomo yesibhedlela kanye nokuyixhumanisa nezisebenzi. Ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa izisebenzi kwaba ngosayensi abahlobene. Ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nezidingo zezidinganiso ezibalulekile zezwe noma yisiphi esinye isidingo sezomthetho noma somthetho sasemthethweni. Ukwenza okuhlolwa okuvame kokwelapha futhi ukuthuthukisa, ukuphatha nokubuka izinhlelo zokwenza. Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuka kanye nokuhlaziya uhlelo lwemali imininingwane yemali kanye nezinsiza zonke ngendlela esebenzayo ngenkani. Ukuziphatha ngokuzithola futhi ukuxazulula izinkinga njengendlela yokwenza izinqumo ezinzima. Kumele azibophezele ukusebenza ngengcindezi futhi angemva kwezikhathi ngokuhamba nemigomo yesikhathi esidlulisekileyo. Ukuqamba imibiko yokwelapha futhi anike umbhalo ekuhloleni lwezocala uma kudingeka. Ukuphatha ukwenza nokuthuthukiswa (PMDS) futhi ukwenza ukubukwa kwamakota abangaphansi kwakhe. Umfundi kumele futhi azibophezele ukuqeqesha, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokulawula abayunivesithi abasha kanye nabayunivesithi abadala.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezobuchwepheshe Bekliniki
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umphathi wezobuchwepheshe bekliniki e Isilimela Hospital kwisebe le OR Tambo District ukulawula iinkonzo zekliniki ngokwemigowo yesebe.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezikuvumela ukuba ubhalise kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Ukubhalwa kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava afanelekileyo njengomongikazi emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengogqirha. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene njengoko kukwi National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA)), Public Service Act nemiqathango neyodwelo-Iindululo ecele kuyo. Ikhono: Ikhono lezorhwebo nolawulo, Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekhthi, Ulawulo lemali, Ulawulo lotshintsho, Ulawulo lwabantu nokuqukanisa, iNkonzo eNtsha yokuLwisa, Ulawulo lolwazi, Ukuxazula iingxaki noNlulamlulo, Unxibelelwano, Ukuqonda umthengi nogxininiso kubathengi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lweenkonzo zekliniki kwibhospithi yonke ngokwemigowo yesebe, kuqu kwaye nangemihla yamva emiselweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwaye unoxanduva lokuncedisa ekuzameni ukuyihola nokuwayulwa iinkonzo zekliniki zebhospithi. Ukugcina irekhodi yempilo ezichanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nezokuziphatha. Ukuyala kwaye ukhokele abasebenzi neengcali ezihlobene nezempilo kwimbonakaliso kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqonda nokuphawula ukwaluleko nokufa. Kuya kufuneka uhlale ukhona kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwimfundo ephihiliswayo yabagqirha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokuphucula ngobuchwepheshe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuhanjiswa iinkonzo ezingabizi ngokweqondo kwisebe ngalinye. Kuya kufuneka uchonge kumaphu athintela ulawulo njengoko kufunekayo. Ukucwangcisa, ukulawula ngqo nokucofa iinkonzo zekliniki ezichanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo, kuqu kwaye nakuwo nawo onke amaphu olawulo olusesikweni. Ukwamkela ngokusesikweni ibhospithi kumabhodi abalulekileyo urhwebo nakumabomvu. Ukumisela inkqubo yemisebenzi yangaphakathi kwele sebe ngokweyona ndlela ibhospithi ibeka ngayo iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye uzixelele abasebenzi. Ukulungiselela ukuqeqeshwa kolwazi nakubasebenzi ngokwemisebenzi abayenzayo ngokwemisebenzi nolwazi abayenzayo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuye kuqhutywe ngokweenkqubo eziphatha amagunya emandla akhoyo ngokomthetho. Ukwenza uphando ngokubala ngobuchwepheshe kwizinto ezahlulahlula iingxaki ezingenele ngakumbi kwinkqubo yokuqhelaniswa kwemisebenzi ngexesha lokubala. Ukwenza, ukulawula nokuchaza imali echithwayo nolwazi ngemali ukuze kusetyenziswe ngendlela efanelekileyo iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ukusebenzisa ukubala ngokwakho ngeendlela ezifanelekileyo ekuxazululeni iingxaki nangexesha lokwenza izigqibo ezisesikweni. Kuya kufuneka alungiselelwe ukusebenza ngamandla athile nokuba ngumsebenzi osuka kumava emihla yonke ngokweyona ndlela igqibele kuyo ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukubhala iingxelo zabagqirha ukuze anike umbiko othe qaqingana naxa kufunwa, kwaye anike ubungqina ngexesha lecala. Ukulawula ukuqhelaniswa kwemisebenzi nokuphucula ulwazi iinkqubo ezahlukene kubasebenzi abangaphantsi kwakhe. Kuya kufuneka aqhelise, aphucule ulwazi aze awayale abagqirha abasebenzela phantsi kwakhe.

jobs.summary: Clinical Manager position at Greenville Hospital in Alfred Nzo District, Eastern Cape, requiring HPCSA registration as a medical practitioner with at least three years experience.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly new Z83 Form (effective from 01 January 2021), a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, A relationship with reference. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Ilayisense yokuqeshisa esemthethweni.

Gcina irekhodi ezize ngokuchanekileyo zempilo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nemigaqo yokuziphatha. Latha kwaye ubeke isikhokelo abasebenzi nabanobspecialise kwezempilo ekugxilweni ekwandweni kwezifo nasekufeni. Zibandakanye kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwimfundo ephuhlisa iigqirha. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula ikhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuba ukubonelelwa iinkonzo ngexabiso elisebenzayo luyaqhubeka kwicala elo kulo isebe. Ngenxa yemiba yolawulo njengoko kufuneka. jobs.title: Clinical Manager
jobs.salary_text: R1 479 723 – R1 640 055 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD). Basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Clinical Manager sought at Maclear Hospital in the Joe Gqabi District, requiring HPCSA registration as a medical practitioner and at least three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. A minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as a medical officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Mental Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Competencies: Strategic capability and leadership, Program and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, People Management and Empowerment, Service Delivery Innovation, Knowledge Management, Problem Solving and Analysis, Communication, Client Orientation and Customer focus. A valid driver’s licence.

Maintain accurate health records in accordance with legal ethical considerations. Train and guide staff and health associated professionals in morbidity and mortality reviews. Attend and participate in continuous medical education. Participate in quality improvement programs. Ensure that cost effective services delivery is maintained within the respective department. Attend to administrative matters as required. To plan, direct coordinate and manage the efficient and effective delivery of clinical and administration support services through working the key executive management team at the hospital within the legal regulatory framework. To present the Hospital Authoritatively at provincial and public forums. As the Head of the hospital: To provide Strategic leadership to improve operational effectively within the health establishment to improve health outcomes. Strategic Planning: Prepare a strategic Plan for the Hospital to ensure it is in Line with the 10-point plan, national, provincial, regional and district plan. Finance Management: Maximize revenue through Collection of all income due to the hospital, ensure that Hospital is managed within the budget in line with the PFMA and Relevant guidelines. Ensure that adequate policies, systems and Procedures are in place to enable prudent management of financial resources. Planning of financial resources mobilization. Monitoring and evaluation and Asset and Risk management. Om die doeltreffende en effektiewe lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te beplan, te direkteer, te koördineer en te bestuur deur samenwerking met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal binne die regs- en regulatoriese raamwerk. Om die Hospitaal gesaghebbend te verteenwoordig by provinsiale en openbare forums. As die Hoof van die hospitaal: Om Strategiese leierskap te verskaf om operasionele doeltreffendheid binne die gesondheidsinstelling te verbeter ten einde gesondheidsuitkomste te verbeter. Monitering en evaluering en Bate- en Risikobestuur. zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umphathi Wezokwelapha e-Maclear Hospital esifundeni sase-Joe Gqabi, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengodokotela kanye nokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho okungenani kweminyaka emithathu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengodokotela. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-3 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele njengo-ofisiyezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwe-HPCSA njengodokotela. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nalolu hlobo njengengqikithi ye-National Health Act, i-Mental Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene nayo. Ikhono: Ikhono lezokuqamba izinhlelo kanye nobuholi, ukuqonda kwezohlelo nezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuqonda izimali, ukuqonda izinguquko, ukuqonda abantu kanye nokubakhulisa, ukukhulisa izinhlela zokuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo, ukuqonda ulwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda, ukuxhumana, ukuqonda ikhasimende kanye nokugxila kukhasimende. Ilayisensi yokushayela eyasebenzayo.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzi bezokwelapha ulwazi oluhlobene nezokwelapha njengoba kudingeka. Yenza ukunakekelwa okuqhubekayo kwabaguli ukuvumela ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa. Gcina amarekhodi ezempilo anembile ngokuvumelana nemigomo yomthetho nezokuziphatha. Hlola futhi uhola abasebenzi kanye nabangochwane bezokuziphilisa ekubukeni ukukhulelwa kanye nokufa. Thinta futhi ubambe iqhaza ekufundeleni kwamanye amakhono ezokwelapha. Bambe iqhaza kumuhle wokuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezibiza kakhulu kugcinwe kumnyango ohlobene nalowo. Phatha izindaba zentabalala njengoba kudingeka. Cwangisa, qondisa, hlela futhi phathe ukulethwa okusebenzayo kanye nokusebenza kahle kwabezokwelapha kanye nezinsizakalo zentabalala ngokusebenza eqenjini elibalulekile lemphathi yentabalala esibhedlela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho. Mele isibhedlela ngokugcwele emhlanganweni wesifundazwe kanye nomphakathi. Njengenhloko yesibhedlela: Nikeza ubuholi bezinhlelo ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sezempilo ukuthuthukisa iziphumo ezempilweni. Ukuhlela Izinhlelo: Lukethe uhlelo olucacile lwesibhedlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi luhambisana nenhlelo yamaphuzu ayi-10, yezwe, yesifundazwe, wesifunda kanye nenhlelo yommandla. Ukuqonda Izimali: Khulisa imali engenayo ngokuqoqa yonke imali efanayo nesibhedlela, qinisekisa ukuthi isibhedlela siphatshwa ngaphakathi kwesabelomali ngokuvumelana ne-PFMA kanye nemihakela ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinhlela, amasistimu kanye neziqondiso ezanele ukuvumela ukuqonda okuhlakaniphile kwemithombo yezimali. Ukuhlela ukwemithombo yezimali. Ukulandelwa kanye nokubuyekeza kanye nokuqonda i-Asset and Risk management. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwesiyalezulu sabasebenzi kanye namasiko ezenzo zezempilo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okusebenzayo kwabasebenzi ngekukhokhelwa kwezinzuzo zabasebenzi.

xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMpraktisi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMpraktisi Wezokwelapha. Okungenani iminyaka emi-3 yamava afanelekileyo njengomntu osebenza ngokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMpraktisi Wezokwelapha. Gcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo ezempilo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho neyokuziphatha. Qeqsha kwaye ulule abasebenzi nabochwepheshe abahambelana nezempilo kwimibongo yobuhlungu nokuswelwa kwempilo. Zibandakanye kwaye uthathe inxaxhema kwimfundo ephilayo ngokwelapha. Thatha inxaxhema kweenkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqhubekeka unikezelo lweenkonzo ezithengiswa ngexabiso elingeniso endaweni ngendaweni kwisebe ngalinye. Yonwabela iindaba zolawulo njengoko kufuneka. Cwangcisa, qhoboshela kwaye ulawule unikezelo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lweenkonzo zezempilo nezolawulo ngokusebenza kunye neqela eliphambili lolawulo esibhedlele ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomthetho. Mele isibhedlele ngokusesigxeni kwiindawo zephondo nakwizabathpublic. Njengentloko yesibhedlele: Nikeza inkokheli ezoluntu ukuphucula ukusebenza ngempumelelo kwisiseko sezempilo ukuze kuphuculwe iziphumo ezempilo. Ulawulo lweemali: Yanda imali engenayo ngokuqokelela yonke imali efanelekileyo kwisibhedlele, qinisekisa ukuba isibhedlele silawulwa ngaphakathi kwesabelo ngokuhambelana ne-PFMA nemigaqo ehambele nayo. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe, ukwakhiwa kwamasiko okusebenza ngemvelo ephezulu, ukwahlulela ngobungcweti, ukuxhumana. Ikakhulu ukwazi ukuphatha nokuhola, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nohlaziyo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhola iqembu, ubuhlakani, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuqaphela abathengi nokubakhulumela, ukuthumela imiyalezo, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukulungiselela nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, ukuphathwa koshintsho. Amafamu aphezulu okubhala imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe kanye namakhono okuxhumana ngobungcweti. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Ukuhambisana nomthetho: Yamukela ngokusesikhundleni ukumiswa okubhaliwe kuka-GMR 2.1 ukuba uqaphele ukugcinwa kwamajambe kanye nezidingo zokuphepha njengoba kucacisiwe emthethweni we-OHS nasemazingeni. Ukugcinwa kwamajambe & Ukuphathwa kwezezimali ezingenantengo: Lakaza, phatha, futhi uhlaziye izinhlelo zokugcinwa kobuchwepheshe ezivikela, zilungisa futhi ezibhekela phambili ukuze kwandise isikhathi sokusebenza kwamajambe kanye nezinsiza. Ukuhola abantu: Qapha abantu abangochwepheshe, phathe isisu abantu ngendlela eqotho, bhekisisa imikhuba yokuqashwa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono emsebenzi.

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging gesoek by Zithulele Hospital in die Eastern Cape om strategiese verpleegleierskap te verskaf, met 'n R425-kwalifikasie en nege jaar se verpleegervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie Diploma/Degree in Verpleging of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige Generies toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma in Verpleegbestuur/Administrasie. 'n Minimum van 9 jaar na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige, ten minste 4 jaar se toepaslike erkende ervaring moet op Bestuursvlak wees. Toon 'n gevorderde begrip en toepassing van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Kennis van PFMA, HR-bestuur. Kennis van Openbare Sektor Wetgewing en tersaaklike Voorskrif/Regulasie, Batho Pele-beginsels en Pasienteregtehandves. Sterk leierskap, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, doeltreffende probleemoplossing, bestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede is noodsaaklike vereistes. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om strategiese verpleegleierskap en rigting aan die verpleegdienste te bestuur en te verskaf. Beplan en monitor die doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid in ooreenstemming met die strategiese plan van die instelling en Departement. Koördineer en handhaaf gunstige/konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met Verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van professionele en etiese praktyk. Monitor en verseker dat verpleegsorg in ooreenstemming met die statutêre reg, beleide en prosedures wat die Verpleegprofessie, Arbeid en Gesondheidsorg regeer, beoefen word. Doeltreffende bestuur en benutting van Menslike en Materiële hulpbronne. Verseker doeltreffende implementering van PMDS. Monitor nakoming van Kwaliteitsversekering en Infeksiebeheer en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidstandaarde en Nasionale Kerntandaarde-nakoming. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe uitvoering van administrasiefunksies van die verpleegeenheid.

zu.title: Usomlilo wezoGqokezo NesiPhathimandla
zu.summary: Kudingeka uSomlilo wezoGqokezo NesiPhathimandla eZithulele Hospital eEastern Cape ukuze kunikezwe isiqondiso esiphezulu sobuholi bezogqokezo, kudingwa iziqu ze-R425 kanye namajemula ayisishiyagalolunye agoqokezo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisisekelo ze-R425 iDiploma/Degree ngoGqokezo noma iziqu ezingalinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqakezo Oqhelisayo Jikelele. I-diploma yesikhathi esingemuva kokuqedwa iziqu eNkundleni yolawulo weziGqokezo/Isebenziso. Ukuze ube neminyaka engu-9 ngemuva kokubhalisa njengoGqakezo Oqhelisayo, okungenani eminyakeni eyi-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele nesiqashelwe kumele ibe ezingeni Lokuqondisa. Kuboniswe ukuqonda okusembilini nokusetshenziswa kwezomthetho zezoGqokezo kanye namazwana omthetho nokuqondene kwezomthetho nezobuhlakani bokugqokeza. Ukuqonda i-PFMA, uLawulo Wabantu. Ukuqonda Izomthetho Zomkhakha Womphakathi kanye noMthetho/Umthethosisekelo othintekayo, izimiso ze-Batho Pele kanye neSazisi Ssamalungelo Abesiguli. Ubuhlakani obuqinile bokuhola, ubudlelwane obuhle obuqu, ukuxazulula izinkinga ngempumelelo, amakhono oluLawulo nokuthatha izinqumo. Amakhono okuxoxa abhalwe nokuqamba amagama abhalwe ayisidingo esibalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa nokunika isiqondiso esiphezulu sobuholi bezogqokezo kumasevisi ezoGqokezo. Ukuhlela futhi ukulawula izinhloso leyo yuniti ekhethekile ngokuvumelana nenqubo yokuhlela isikhungo kanye noMnyango. Ukuhlanganisa futhi ukugcina ubudlelwane obuhle obukhuthazayo nabagqokezi kanye nalabo abanye abahlotshaniswe nabo. Kuqiniseliswe ukuvumelana nokwenza okuhloniphekile nokuqondene. Ukulawula futhi kuqiniselwe ukuba ukunakekelwa kugqokezwa ngokuvumelana nomthetho, nemigomo nemithelela ebusa umsebenzi wezoGqokezo, Abasebenzi kanye Nezokunakekelwa Kwempilo. Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo Yabantu Nezinto. Kuqiniseliswe ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwe-PMDS. Ukulawula ukuvumelana Nezinsimbi Zokuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi Nokulawula Izifo Ezingatsakaliswa Kanti Futhi Nezinga Lezokuphila Kwezokuphathwa Nomkhuba Ohlelekile Kwezempilo Nezinga Lesizwe. Kuqiniselwe ukuphatha ngempumelelo nangempumelelo imisebenzi yolawulo leyonto YezoGqokezo.

xh.title: Mana njini osomakhulu wezoKhathalelo lwamaNesi
xh.summary: Kufuneki uMana njini osomakhulu wezoKhathalelo lwamaNesi eZithulele Hospital eEastern Cape ukunika intsimbi yabaphathi abanamava kakhulu ekukhokeleni abasesi, kufuneka unesiqinisekiso se-R425 kunye neminyaka elishwahla yamava okusesabeni.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esisisiseko se-R425 iDiploma/Isidanga kwizoKhathalelo lwamaNesi okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esivumela ubhaliso kwiSANC njengesiGqadhwa esiGeneral. IPostgraduate diploma kwiLawulo/loLawulo lwezoKhathalelo lwamaNesi. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-9 emva kokubhaliswa njengesiGqadhwa esiGeneral, ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-4 yamava afanelekileyo aqondekeleyo kufuneka abe kwiNqanaba loLawulo. Abonise ukuqonda okuvela phambili nokusebenzisa umGaqo-siseko wezoKhathalelo lwamaNesi nolunye ulwaziseko lwezomthetho nezokuziphatha kwizikhokelo zokusesa nasesibhedlele. Ulwazi ngePFMA, noLawulo lweHR. Ulwazi ngomGaqo-siseko kaWoLuntu nemiThetho nemiLaqo ehlobene nayo, ngeZimiso iBatho Pele neSaziso ngeLungelo labaGulayo. Ukwahlula kahle ekukhokeleni, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuxazulula iingxaki ngokusebenzayo, amava ekulawuleni nokuThatha iSigqibo. Ukubakho kwe mpawu zokuthetha nokubhala ngokusebenzayo zibaluleke kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula kunye nokunika isakhwezi sokukhokela abasesi nokuqhelanisa iinkonzo zeKhathalelo lwabaNesi. Ukuqamba ngemigangatho yolawulo lweziko elikhethekileyo ngokuvumelana neenkqubo ezibalulekileyo zesakhiwo nesebe. Uqhelanise ugcine ubuhlobo obuhle, obakho injongo phakathi kweKhathalelo lwabaNesi nabanabomnyanya. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imiGaqo yekhono nokuziphatha kwabasesi. Qwalasele uqinisekise ukuba ukukhathalela kugulwa kwenziwa ngokwemiThetho nemiLaqo elawula uMsebenzi weKhathalelo, iMisebenzi nesiBelele. Ukulawula ngokusebenzayo nokusebenzisa iZemba loMntu nemiPahla. Qinisekisa ukubakho kokusebenza okusebenzayo kwePMDS. Qwalasele ukuthobela iNqanaba loQinisekiso lweNani negaguqelo ngokulwa neGawulko nobuKhuseleko beNqanaba lokuSebenza ngokwemigaqo yeLizwe. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo kweekhondo zolawulo kwindawo yamasesi ashiwahla.
