jobs.centre: Buffalo City Metro Forensic Pathology Services (Ku Gompo)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 – R1 121 241 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) Grade 2: R1 188 255 – R1 278 089 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) Grade 3: R1 375 245 – R1 713 534 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 sought for forensic pathology services in East London to perform medico-legal post-mortem examinations and compile related documentation.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with HPCSA in respect to SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Ability to work independently to autopsies and crime scene investigation. Good practical knowledge of forensic pathology (theory and practice). Knowledge of the relevant legislations. The incumbent to the post is expected to participate in weekend and after-hours work. The incumbent may be required to undergo further training in the medico—legal investigation of un-natural death. Knowledge of applicable parts Of Occupational Health Act and Risk assessment process. Knowledge, Skills, Training and competencies: Ability to perform medico-legal post-mortem examinations and crime scene investigations. Ability to work in multi- disciplinary team setting. A certificate of competence as a forensic medical Officer or work experience in forensic pathology. Excellent communication skills, including computer literacy. Basic knowledge of forensic photography. Ability to make well-founded decisions and conclusions. Resilience and ability to work with fragmented and decomposed remains. Ability to make a positive contribution in a busy department. The incumbent is expected to partake in all the department's academic and training activities. Provision Of a Forensic Pathology Service at a district level as delegated. Produce reports of high quality. Satisfactory level of professional Court attendance. Maintain satisfactory clinical, professional and ethical standards related to Forensic Pathology Services. Attend to administrative matters as required.

Attendance of and examination of incident cases. Support to the Heads: Clinical Unit and Department, Medical Specialists and Safe Practices. Personal development and academic contributions: Assist with teaching and training of medical and forensic students, forensic pathology officers in medico-legal autopsies and related investigations.

af.title: Mediese Offisier Graad 1 -3
af.summary: Mediese Offisier Graad 1 tot 3 gesoek vir forensiese patologie-diensste in East London om medies-regsektiese lykskouings uit te voer en verwante dokumentasie op te stel.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Practitioner toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Medical Practitioner na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medical Practitioner ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Medical Practitioner na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medical Practitioner ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Medical Practitioner by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk aan lykskouings en misdaadtoneelondersoeke. Goeie praktiese kennis van forensiese patologie (teorie en praktyk). Kennis van die tersaaklike wetgewing. Van die ampsdraer word verwag om aan naweek- en na-kantoorure-werk deel te neem. Van die ampsdraer kan vereis word om verdere opleiding te ondergaan in die medies-regsektiese ondersoek van onnatuurlike sterftes. Kennis van toepaslike dele van die Occupational Health Act en risiko-assesseringsproses. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en bevoegdhede: Vermoë om medies-regsektiese lykskouings en misdaadtoneelondersoeke uit te voer. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinere spanomgewing te werk. 'n Sertifikaat van bevoegdheid as 'n forensiese mediese offisier of werkservaring in forensiese patologie. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese kennis van forensiese fotografie. Vermoë om goedgefundeerde besluite en gevolgtrekkings te maak. Veerkragtigheid en vermoë om met gefragmenteerde en ontbinde oorskot te werk. Vermoë om 'n positiewe bydrae in 'n besige departement te lewer. Van die ampsdraer word verwag om aan al die departement se akademiese en opleidingsaktiwiteite deel te neem. Verskaffing van 'n Forensiese Patologie-diens op distriksvlak soos gedelegeer. Lewer verslae van gehalte. Bevredigende vlak van professionele hofbywoning. Handhaaf bevredigende kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde wat verband hou met Forensiese Patologie-diensste. Baar aandag aan administratiewe sake soos vereis.
af.duties: Om medies-regsektiese lykskouings uit te voer, alle verwante ondersoeke en dokumentasie te voltooi, en lykskouingsverslae binne 'n 12-weke-omloopperiode af te handel. Stel en voltooi lykskouingsverslae en alle verwante medies-regsektiese dokumentasie akkuraat en betyds. Verskaf gevolgtrekkings van doodoorsake gebaseer op aanvullende ondersoekverslae, asook doeltreffende kundige getuienis in die hof wat verband hou met al bogenoemde outopsiegevalle, insluitend die formulering van forensiese tweede opinies soos versoek deur die Department of Justice. Bywoning en ondersoek van voorvalgevalle. Ondersteuning aan die Hoofde: Kliniese Eenheid en Departement, Mediese Spesialiste en Veilige Praktyke. Persoonlike ontwikkeling en akademiese bydraes: Bystand verleen met onderrig en opleiding van mediese en forensiese studente, forensiese patologie-offisiere in medies-regsektiese outopsies en verwante ondersoeke.

zu.title: I-ofisa Yezokwelapha Izinga 1 -3
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Ofisa Yezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 kumasevisi ezokuqashelwa kwemithambo yezomthetho e-East London ukuze yenze ukuhlolwa okungokomthetho kokufa okungalindelekile futhi ahluze amadokhumenti ahambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kunhlangano yezangqwashi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqeqeshwa njengodokotela Wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA maqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde eSouth Africa. Unyaka omunye wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqeqeshwa njengodokotela Wezokwelapha kunhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazanga emaqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde kwezinye izwe, ezingadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Izinga 2: Ubuncwane besipiliyoni seminyaka emi-5 njengodokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokuqeqeshwa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezokwelapha maqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde eSouth Africa. Ubuncwane besipiliyoni seminyaka emi-6 emva kokuqeqeshwa njengodokotela Wezokwelapha kunhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazanga emaqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde kwezinye izwe, ezingadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Izinga 3: Ubuncwane besipiliyoni seminyaka eyi-10 njengodokotela Wezokwelapha emva kokuqeqeshwa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezokwelapha maqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde eSouth Africa. Ubuncwane besipiliyoni seminyaka eyi-11 emva kokuqeqeshwa njengodokotela Wezokwelapha kunhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazanga emaqondana nezisebenzi ezifunde kwezinye izwe, ezingadingi ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eSouth Africa. Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa ekwenzeni ukuhlolwa okungokomthetho kokufa okungalindelekile nasekuphenweni indawo yobugebengu. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwesibonelo lwezomthetho wokuhlolwa kokufa okungalindelekile (inqubo kanye nokwenziwa). Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene. Umuntu othathiwe kulesi sikhundla kulindelwe ukuthi athathe inxaxheba emsebenzini wangempelasonto nangasemva kwamahora omsebenzi. Kungadingeka umuntu othathiwe afunde ngokugqithisayo ekuphenweni okungokomthetho kokufa okungalindelekile. Ulwazi ngamakhulu omthetho Wezempilo Ezomsebenzi kanye nenqubo yokuhlolwa ingozi. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ikhono lokwenza ukuhlolwa okungokomthetho kokufa okungalindelekile nokuphenya izigcawu zobugebengu. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini elinabokuwo wonke. Isitifiketi sobuqotho njengo-ofisa Wezomthetho wokuhlolwa kokufa okungalindelekile noma isipiliyoni somsebenzi ekwelapheni kwamathumba okufa okungalindelekile. Amakhono okuxhumakahle ehlanganisa nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olwanele ngesithombe sobugebengu. Ikhono lokwenza izinqumbo nezisiphetho ezinobumbo. Ukubekezelwa nokuqhamula ukusebenza namasinstimba ahlukanisiwe futhi ayohe. Ikhono lokufaka omumo ohle ekilasini ethe xaxa umnyango. Kulindelwe ukuthi lowo othathiwe uthathe inxaxheba kuzo zonke izinkqubo zemfundo zomnyango. Ukunikeza isevisi yokuhlolwa kwamathumba okufa okungalindelekile ezingeni lesifunda njengoba kuholelwe. Ukuhluza imibiko yekhwalithi ephezulu. Izinga elihambisana lokubukwa kwangasese enkantolo njengochwepheshe. Ukugcina izinga elihambisana lezokwelapha, ezangqwashi nezokuziphatha kumasevisi ezingokoqo. Ukuzeletha izindaba zokuphatha njengoba kudingeka.
zu.duties: Ukuwenza ukuhlolwa okungokomthetho kokufa okungalindelekile, ukuqedela konke okuhlobene nephulo nokuhlolwa kwamadokhumenti, futhi ukuqedela imibiko yokuhlolwa kokufa okungalindelekile phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-12. Ukuhluza futhi uqedela imibiko yokuhlolwa kokufa okungalindelekile nazo zonke izibhalo ezihlobene nokuhlolwa okungokomthetho ngokuchanekileyo nangesikhathi. Unike isisindo esiphothiwele ngokusuleleka kwesixhumanisi ngemibiko yephulo, kanye ubufakazi obusemthethweni enkantolo obuhlobene zonke izicalo ezingezansi, okuhlanganisa nokuqamba izinkulumo-mabonakude zesipiliyoni noma izibono ezimbili ezingokomthetho njengoba kudingwa ngumnyango Wezobulungiswa. Ukuhlatshwa nokuhlolwa kwezicala. Ukusekela ooboshi: Ikhono Lesibhedlela nomnyango, abachwepheshe Bezokwelapha kanye Nezenzo Ezivikelayo. Intuthuko yomuntu siqu kanye nezifundo ezihlobene: Ukusiza ekufundiseni nasekuqeqesheni abafundi Bezokwelapha nezomthetho, izikhulu zokuhlolwa kokufa okungalindelekile kwezokuhlolwa okungokomthetho nezinye izinhloli ezingokomthetho.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezonyango weNqanaba 1 -3
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe umsebenzi wezonyango weNqanaba 1 ukuya ku3 kwiinkonzo zobungcali bokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa kwindawo yokuhlola iindaba zamagunya apho baya kwenza iingxelo zokuvisisisa emthethweni ezimalunga nokufa nokubhalaamaxesha abo.
xh.requirements: Izembezo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyango. Ubhaliso kunabungcali benkqubo: Ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyango. Iimfuno zolwazi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nalunye ulwazi emva kobhalo njengompraktisi wezonyango kwi-HPCSA kumbasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Umnyaka omnye wolwazi oluhambelana nale ngxoxo emva kobhaliso njengompraktisi wezonyango kunabungcali bemithetho yangamandlela ebonwa kumasebenzi abafunde ngamandlela, abangekho funeko kubo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Ukuze ube nezinyanga ezisi-5 nangaphezulu wolwazi olufanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezonyango emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyango kumasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze ube nezinyanga eziyi-6 nangaphezulu wolwazi oluhambelana nalo emva kobhaliso njengompraktisi wezonyango kunabungcali bemithetho yangamandlela ebonwa kumasebenzi abafunde ngamandlela, abangekho funeko kubo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Inqanaba 3: Ukuze ube nezinyanga eziyi-10 nangaphezulu wolwazi olufanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezonyango emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyango kumasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze ube nezinyanga eziyi-11 nangaphezulu wolwazi oluhambelana nalo emva kobhaliso njengompraktisi wezonyango kunabungcali bemithetho yangamandlela ebonwa kumasebenzi abafunde ngamandlela, abangekho funeko kubo ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eNingizimu Afrika. Ikhono lokusebenza uzibophezele kwindawo yokubhala iingxelo ezimalunga nokutshona kwamathambo nasekujolweni iindawo zenyanga. Ulwazi olulungileyo lokusebenza mayela nolwazi lobungcali bokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa (ingcamango nokuqhuba). Ulwazi ngemithetho exhula mayela nalo. Umntu okhethiweyo kule ndawo uyathembele kumalunga nokubakho kumasebenzi angangeekiweyo namaxesha angaphaya kweyure zomsebenzi. Kungenzeka kufuneko ukuba umntu okhethiweyo aqhube ekufundeni ngakumbi ngokuphandwa kwemithetho ngemeko yokufa okungalindanga. Ulwazi ngezithintelo ezihambelana nomthetho wezeMpilo koBasebenzi nendlela yokulinganisa iingozi. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho nokuzipatha: Ikhono lokwenza iingxelo zokuvisisisa emthethweni ezimalunga nokufa nokuphanda iindawo zenyanga. Ikhono lokusebenza eqela elinamaphandle ahambelana nalo. Isatifikheysi sokwazi njengomsebenzi wezonyango webala imimandla ebandakanya ukufa okungalindanga okanye ulwazi lokusebenza kwinkonzo yobungcali bokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa. Amakhono amangaliswayo othethathethwano, kuquka nokuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ulwazi olusisiseko lwebala lemifanekiso exhula mayela nokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa. Ikhono lokwenza iigqibo neendawo ezikwazi ukuqinisekiswa. Inqindamvuzo nokuba nakhona ukusebenza ngeziqu ezingezantlanganisiweyo nangamazinyo ebele. Ikhono lokwenza igalelo elingcono kwisebe elixakekileyo. Umntu okhethiweyo uthathwa njengomntu oza kuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zonke zezifundo noqeqesho zesebe. Ukubonelelwa kwenkonzo yobungcali bokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa kwinqanaba lesithili njengoko kumiselwe. Ukwenza iingxelo ezikumgangatho ophezulu. Inqanaba elihambelana nesimemo sokuzisa iingxelo kwinkundla. Ukugcina inqanaba elifanelekileyo lezenzo ezikwizinga eliqinisekisiweyo, zobungcali nezomthetho ezingezantsu kweNkonzo yobungcali bokuhlola imimandla ebandakanya ukufa. Ukubhekana neendaba zolawulo njengoko kufuneka.
xh.duties: Ukwenza iingxelo zokuvisisisa emthethweni ezimalunga nokufa, ukugqiba zonke iingxoxo ezihambelana nendawo nokubhalaamaxesha, nokugqiba iingxelo zokuhlatshwa imithiyo yomzimba ngaphakathi kwethemu eneziveki eziyi-12. Ukubhala ukugqiba iingxelo zokuhlatshwa imithiyo yomzimba yaye zonke iingxelo ezimalunga nokufa ezikwizinga lenkqubo ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukubonelela ngengqumbo ngeendlela ezinkqubo zokuphanda ezingezantlanu, ekunika ulwazi olubukhali bokugqithisa inkundla ngokuhambelana nayo yonke imeko ezingezantlanu ezihlanganiswe ngaphezulu, ukubandakanya nokwenza iingxelo ezibuziwa ngumthetho wezonyango wesibini njengoko kucelwa nguManyathelo olawula urhulumente. Ukubakho nokuphanda iimeko zohlangothi. Ukuxhasa iiNkokeli: Icandelo lezonyango nesebe, oogqirha abangcali neenkqubo eziqinisekisiweyo. Intshukubo yomntu ngamnye nangaphezulu kwiinkalo ezingezantsu: Ukunceda ekufundiseni noqeqeshweni kwabafundi bezonyango nabalawuli bokuqonda iindawo zokufa, oogqirha bezona ezibala imimandla ebandakanya ukufa kwindawo ebalulekileyo yokuhlatshwa imithiyo yomzimba yaye iindawo ezingezantsu.

jobs.title: Medical Physicist Grade 1-3
jobs.centre: Buffalo City Metro, Frere Tertiary Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R844 128 – R935 049 per annum (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) Grade 2: R953 094 - R1 055 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) Grade 3: R1 087 263 - R1 221 843 per annum, (an all-inclusive package), (OSD) basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Medical Physicist needed at Frere Tertiary Hospital in Buffalo City to provide physics services across radiotherapy, nuclear medicine and diagnostic radiology.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Physicist. Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Physicist (Independent Practice). Current and active registration with HPCSA as a Medical Physicist Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Physicist. Grade 2: 8 years appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Physicist. Grade 3: 16 years appropriate after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Physicist. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Be a highly motivated and methodical individual who pays attention to detail with exceptional standards for accuracy. Capable of using initiative for problem solving, recognizing the need for action, considering possible risks and taking responsibility for results. Good communication, interpersonal relationships, research, development and teaching skills. Knowledge of statutory regulations regarding the medical use of ionizing radiation, particularly concerning diagnostic radiology. Potential to develop management skills. Skills pertaining to the scope of the profession of medical physicists. Understand the physics of radiotherapy, diagnostic X-ray and nuclear medicine equipment, computers and software; and have a thorough knowledge of diagnostic radiology physics.
jobs.duties: Routine Medical Physics service delivery activities in Radiotherapy, Nuclear Medicine and Diagnostic Radiology Assisting with departmental administration. Assistance with equipment tender preparation, evaluation and commissioning. Responsibility for the management of the dosimetry, quality assurance and radiation protection functions of Medical Physics in the Department of Diagnostic Radiology, with support to Radiation Oncology. External Coordination with other institutions in the province or national on Medical Physics activities. Attending and presenting at meetings, workshops and CPD activities. Operation, monitoring of maintenance, record keeping and care of all equipment and accessories. Design and implementation of new protocols. Teaching and training skills, radiation protection and handling, transporting and disposal of radioactive materials. Ability to solve radiotherapy physics problems. Performance of quality control procedures in radiotherapy. Provide medical physics support for radiation oncology treatment unit including Sound knowledge of radiotherapy dosimetry equipment, treatment planning acceptance testing, commissioning, calibration and quality assurance. Provide medical physics support in radiation oncology treatment planning. Participating in the implementation of new treatment techniques. Provide radiation protection services and ensure regulatory compliance for the institution.

zu.title: Umdedeli Wezokwelapha Izinga 1-3
zu.summary: Kudingeka umdedeli wezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Frere Tertiary Hospital e-Buffalo City ukuze ahlinze ngemisebenzi yezokulinganisa kumakhono okuchiza ngomsakazo, izifo ezingahlanzeki njengoba kusetshenziswa izinto eziphathwayo ezincane kakhulu, kanye nokuhlola ngemifanekiso ngomsakazo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomdedeli wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomdedeli wezokwelapha (Ukuzilolonga Ngokuzimele). Ukubhalisa okwamanje kanye nokusebenza ku-HPCSA njengomdedeli wezokwelapha Isipili sphandi: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomdedeli wezokwelapha. Izinga 2: Iminyaka engu-8 yokuhlakanipha ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomdedeli wezokwelapha. Izinga 3: Iminyaka engu-16 yokuhlakanipha ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomdedeli wezokwelapha. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuthazo futhi ugweme ukungahambisani nexesha. Ukuba ngumuntu oqinile ngokomoya futhi ohlakaniphile onqaka ukunakisiswa imininingwane ngokulinganisela okuphezulu. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ingqondo yakho ekuxazululweni izinkinga, ukuqaphela isidingo sokuwenza into,ukuqaphela izingozi ezingenzeka kanye nokuthatha inxaxheba kumvelaphano yemiphumela. Ukuba namakhono okuxoxa, okwakha izinkinga phakathi kwabantu, ukuphenya, ukuthuthuka kanye nokufundisa. Ulwazi ngemithetho esebenzela izinhlobo ezahlukene zezokwelapha ngomsakazo onobungozi, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuxilonga ngomifanekiso. Amathuba okuthuthuka ngekhono lezilawuli. Amakhono ahlobene nendawo egcina umsebenzi wawo wonke umdedeli wezokwelapha. Ukuqonda ukwelapha ngomoya onobungozi wokuchiza ngomoya wamatholide, amasevisi okuxilonga izifo ezingahlanzeki njengoba kusetshenziswa izinto eziphathwayo ezincane kakhulu futhi unolwazi oluphelele lokulinganisa imifanekiso.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi ephathwa ngokuhlola njalo yonke imihla ibaluleke kakhulu ukwelapha kwamaphoyinti njengomoya onobungozi wamatholide, izifo ezingahlanzeki njengoba kusetshenziswa izinto eziphathwayo ezincane kakhulu nokuxilonga imifanekiso ngomoya onobungozi wamatholide. Ukusiza ekuphathweni kwenhlangano emphakathini. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni, ekuhloleni futhi kungeniswe izinsiza ezintsha. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kokuqinisekiswa kokulinganiswa kwamatholide, ukwesekwa komthetho kanye nokuvikelwa komthetho wezokusebenza kwawo wonke amaphoyinti okulinganisa kwesibhedlela kwicandelo lokuxilonga imifanekiso, ngokwesekwa ukuqinisekiswa kwamatholide. Ukulungisa izinto ezingaphandle kanye namanye amasikhungo ezifundazweni noma esizweni ngemisebenzi yokulinga imiphumela yezokwelapha. Ukuya futhi ukwethula izinto ezibalulekile emihlanganweni, emikhubeni nasemisebenzini yokuthuthuka. Ukuphatha, ukuqapha, ukugcina amarekhodi, futhi uhlole konke ukulungiswa kwemishini namathuluzi. Ukulungisa futhi ufake izinhlela ezintsha. Amakhono okufundisa, ukuqeqesha, ukuvikelwa umthetho wezobungozi, ukuphathwa kwezinto, ukuthutha, nokulahla izinto ezinobungozi. Ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga eziphathwa kukuchiza ngomoya onobungozi wamatholide. Ukwenza imigomo yekhono lokuhlolwa ngokulinganisa kumaphoyinti okuchiza ngomoya onobungozi. Ukunika inkxaso yokulinganisa imiphumela yokuchiza ezinhlobonhlobo zokwelashwa amatholide okuhlanganisa ulwazi olwanelisayo ngezinsiza, ukugcinwa, ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlolwa, ukuqinisekiswa kwamatholide, okusetshenziswa ukuqinisekiswa kanye nokulungiswa. Ukunika inkxaso kwesibhedlela sokuhlela ukwelashwa amatholide. Ukubamba iqhaza ekungeniseni izindlela ezintsha zokwelashwa. Ukunikezwa ngezinsiza zokuvikelwa ezinhlobonhlobo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulandela imithetho yenhlangano.

xh.title: UmGcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo inqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo eFrere Tertiary Hospital eBuffalo City ukunika iinkonzo zefiziksi kwindawo yedeshi yefiziksi, yenyuso yamandla enzululwazi nedayagnostikhi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo (Ukuqhuba-ngokuzimele). Ukubhalisa kwangoku nokusebenzayo kwi-HPCSA njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo. Isipho: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntsetha ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoMgcini wezeFiziksi eZolimo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi komxinzelelo nokufezela iindlela zexesha eziyimfuneko. Ukuba ngumntu othanda ukusebenza kakhulu onamacandelo alo obonisayo nokubuka iinkcukacha ngeendlela eziphakamileyo zokuqinisekisa. Ukuba nokuba nekhono lokusebenzisa ingcinga ekuxineni iingxaki, ekuqondeni isidingo sokuqhatha. Sokuqwalasela iingozi ezinokubakho nokubamba inxaxheba kwemveliso. Iimpawu ezihle zokuthetha nonyana, ezokuxhumanisa kwabantu, ezokuphonononga, ezingqalasela nokuzisa isiphatho. Ulwazi ngomthetho-nkqubo kwimithetho ehlekisa kufuzo. Ikhono lokwenza iinkqubo ezitsha zendalo. Iimpawu ezihambisana nemigaqo yomsebenzi kwezamaphetha. Ikhono lokuyiqonda ifiziksi kwizixhobo zokuxhobha iindleko zamandla, i-fiziksi enyuseh kwaye nakwizixhobo zesazisawayi, iikhompyutha nesoftware.
xh.duties: Imisebenzi yamangsakho ezoFiziksi yaseZolimo ukunika iinkonzo ezingatyelelwanga kwindawo yolawulo lwee-Radiotherapy, Nuclear Medicine nedayagnostikhi. Uncedo ekusingathweni kwisebe. Uncedo kwisicelo sengqekembe, isiqendu esixutyiweyo nokuqwalaselwa kwezixhobo. Ukwakha iinkqubo zokulawula iinkonzo zokuqinisekisa i-fiziksi ekuxineni iingxaki, ulawulo lweekhwalithi kwindawo zokulungiselela amaza eedayagnostikhi, ulawulo lwee-Radiology. Ulwabiwo lweenkonzo namanye amaziko ephondo okanye kwelizwe lonke ekuxineni iinkonzo zoFiziksi yaseZolimo. Ukuzivakasha kwaye nokuvekela iingxaki kwindawo yokugcinwa kweenkonzo. Ukusebenza, ukulawula ukhuseleko, ukugcina amafa nokuqwalasela zonke izixhobo nendlela ezisebenza ngayo. Ukulungisa nokuzisebenzisa iindlela ezintsha ezisemthethweni. Iimpawu zokuyisa ulwazi kubasebenzi abatsha ekukhululekeni kwemisebenzi, ukusingatha, ukukhuthaza umtsalane kwindawo yokuhlohlozelwa kukho nokusingathwa kwemveliso yokudluliswa kolwazi. Ikhono lokuyeka iingxaki ze-Radiotherapy e-Fiziksi. Ukuphumeza iinkqubo zokulawula iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa amaza kwi-Radiotherapy. Ukuqinisekisa amaza amnyama kumxholo wokuxhobha ukhuseleko nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezikwiziko. Ukulungiselela iinkonzo zokukhusela abantu abangangeni kwii-Radiotherapy Treatment Planning. Ukuqwalasela amaza kubantu abangangeni kwindawo ezisetyenziswa ngamaza apha. Ukuba nekhono lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqinisekisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zomthetho ekuxineni iingxaki nakwintshukumo.

Probleemoplossing en ontleding, Besluitneming, Spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, Finansiële bestuur, Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë, Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardighede, Beplanning en organisering, Personeelbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste, Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteun in samewerking met Ingenieurs, Tegnoloë en geassosieerdes in veld-, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantoorbedrywighede. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasievereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer en verseker gehalteversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die relevante gesag. Hanteer veelvuldige projekte en multidissiplinêre konsultasie- en kontrakteerspanne. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese/ingenieursbedryfsplan. Verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering en instandhouding van databasisse, en bestuur, hou toesig oor en beheer tegniesverwante personeel en bates. Diagnoseer en los komplekse probleme op, Pas oplossing- en ontwerptegnieke toe, werkvloei (prosesse en prosedures, Effektiewe ontwikkeling en implementering van beleid, prosedures en strategieë rakende ingenieursbou-aangeleenthede. Navorsing en ontwikkeling, Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologie om prosedures te verbeter, Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter en om met relevante rade oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede te skakel.

zu.title: Ithekhinishani Yokulawula Injulalwazi Ezingeni a
zu.summary: Kudingeka ithekhinishani yokulawula injulalwazi e-Frere Tertiary Hospital e-Buffalo City ukuphatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe kanye nokuxhasa imisebenzi yenjulalwazi.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-National Diploma kwi-Electrical Engineering noma izifundo ezihambisana nalezo. Kweminyaka eyisithupha (6) yomsebenzi wamakhono emva kokuqulunqwa izifundo, kuyadingeka ukubhalisa ku-ECSA njengenthekhinishani yobuchwepheshe oyingcalwe,elayisense yokuqasha evumelekile. Ukusebenza kahle ekuphathweni kwenjulalwazi kubaluleke kakhulu. Ulwazi lokuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ezibhekene nenjulalwazi (PLC). Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukubonisana ngobuchwepheshe, umuntu othatha isinyathelo esiqhubayo, ongaguquki futhi oshintshashintsha ngokushintsha kwendawo yokusebenza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengomqabi, ukudala, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula, ukuxhumana, amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuphatha abantu. Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe, Phatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe kanye nokuxhasa kanye nama-Engineers, ama-Technologists kanye nabahlanganyeli emsebenzini ohlobene nendlu yokusebenzela khona, ehhovisi lobuchwepheshe nasemhlabeni. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezisemthethweni nangokubukeka. Hlola imanuals zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, okuzotshwa okujwayelekile kanye nendlela zokwenza ukuze kufakelwe inovishi entsha futhi kuqinisekiswe izinga lenqubo yezinto ezakhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinkomba bese kuvunyelwa/kwenziwa izinkomba zokuvunyelwa ngumlawuli ophathwayo. Phatha amaphrojekthi amaningi kanye namageqi amaningi okubonisana nokuqasha. Phatha imisebenzi yemibhalo nemicimbe ephathelene nayo. Nikeza okokufaka esweni inqubo yebhajeti. Hlanganisa futhi uthumele imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise okokufaka ohlelweni lomsebenzi wokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe/injulalwazi. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokugcinwa kwamasisekelo wemininingwane, futhi uphathe, ulawule futhi ulawule abantu abahlobene nobuchwepheshe kanye nezimpahla. Ukutholakala kanye nokuqondana nezinkinga ezinzima, Faka isixazululo nobuchwepheshe bokwakha, ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi (izinqubo nezindlela zokwenza), Ukuthuthukiswa okusebenzayo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinqumabungqashi, izindlela zokwenza kanye nezinqubomgomo ngamaphuzu okwakhiwa kwezokunjulalwazi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko, Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okuqhubekayo ukuze uhlale nge-inovishi entsha ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokwenza, Ucwaningo/izifundo zokulondolozwa ngobuchwepheshe bokwakhiwa be-inovishi ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono kanye nokuqhuba nomholi ophathelene nendaba e-ECSA ngemicimbe ephathelene nenjulalwazi.

xh.title: Unoncwadi wobenzi bokulawula ongqinqwana ka-a
xh.summary: Kufuneka unoncwadi wobenzi bokulawula eFrere Tertiary Hospital eBuffalo City ukulawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe nokuqinisekisa izicelo zobunjineli.
xh.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma in Electrical Engineering okanye nangomlinganiselo ofaneleyo. Zii- Six (6) years zeminyaka yamava obuchwepheshe emva kokufumana isidanga, Kuyimfuneko ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA njengononcwadi wobunjineli ogunyazisiweyo, Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukubonakaliswa ngokusebenza kakuhle ekulawulweni kobunjineli kuyimfuneko ekuyimfuneko. Ulawulo lweprojekthi, Ulwazi lokuyila ngobuchwepheshe nokuhlalutya. Uphando nophuhliso. Iinkqubo zobunjineli ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha (PLC). Ulwazi ngokuvumelana nomthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Iingxoxo zobuchwepheshe, umntu othatha isigqibo ongaguquguqukiyo oguquguqukayo nokuba uyakwazi ukuzivumelana nomxholo wokusebenza oshintshayo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, Ukwenza izigqibo, Ukusebenza njengodidi, ukuyila, Ulawulo lwezemali, Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula, Unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ucwangciso nolungiselelo, ulawulo labantu. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe, Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwepheshe noxhaso ngokubambisana nama-Engineers, aba-Technologists nabahlobo kummandla, kwindlu yokusebenzela nakwiofisi yobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kokhuseleko ngokwemigaqo nemithetho edityanisiweyo. Hlola iincwadi ezikhoyo zobuchwepheshe, iintsomiba ezisisiseko nemigaqo yokuzibandakanya nobuchwepheshe obutsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga kumanqaku obuchwepheshe ngakunye kunye neendlela ezichaziweyo, uvume/zenze izindululo eziza kuvunywa ngummanduleki olawulayo. Lawula iiprojekthi ezininzi namageqha amaninzi ocwangciso nemisebenzi yengxoxo nokusebenza. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo edityaniswe nayo. Nikezela isigqibo kwinkqubo yesixa semali. Qamba ngenxa yemfuneko uze unikeze iingxelo. Nikezela nangenxa ukuze zidityaniswe izigqibo kwinkqubo yokusebenza yobuchwepheshe/obunjineli. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliso, ukusebenza nokugcina iindatabhesi, ulawule ulawule ulawule abantu abadityaniswe nobuchwepheshe nempahla. Ukuxilonga nokuqonda iingxaki ezibucayi, Faka isisombululo nendlela yokuyila, ukusebenza (iinkqubo nemigaqo), Uphuhliso olusebenzayo nokusebenziswa kwemigaqo, iinkqubo namacebo obunjineli njengoko kukhathalelwa iindaba zobakhiwo bobunjineli. Uphando nophuhliso, Uphuhliso lwamava obugcisa obungapheliyo ukuze kubekho ulandelelwano nobuchwepheshe obutsha ukuze kuphuculwe naya kwimigaqo, Izifundo zophando/ngebali obutsha ngobuchwepheshe bobunjineli ukuze kuphuculwe amava ukuze kuthathwe inxaxheba kwimizuzulwana ngemiba edityaniswe nobunjineli.

jobs.reference_number: DHS01/09/2026 Project Management and Quality Assurance
jobs.title: Chief Construction Project Manager Production Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 108 per annum, all-inclusive package, OSD
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: Chief construction project manager needed in East London to oversee human settlements project initiation, feasibility and funding within the Amathole Region.
jobs.requirements: Matric/ National Senior Certificate/ NQF level 4, NQF level 7 in Built environment as recognised by SAQA with six (06) years’ experience as a registered Professional Construction Project Manager with SACPCMP. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager on appointment. Knowledge of Human Settlements policies and legislative frameworks. Built environment standards, CIDP regulations, financial and contract management, stakeholder and community engagement. Good communication skills, project management skills, presentation skills, report writing skills, negotiation, facilitation, analytical and critical thinking, conflict management. Ability to work in a team. Computer literate. Must possess a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Manage Project Initiation and Feasibility processes. Conduct project needs analysis through the review of municipal Integrated Development Plans, Spatial Development Frameworks, feasibility requirements and project costing. Compile and facilitate project funding requests and obtain the necessary approvals. Coordinate the appointment of Professional Service Providers (PSPs), including the development of procurement strategies, Terms of Reference, and liaison with Supply Chain Management processes. Facilitate project inception processes, including stakeholder engagement, contract finalisation, service level agreement, and commencement meetings. Monitor and evaluate feasibility study outputs, provide technical inputs, approve final reports, and facilitate related contractual payments. Manage Project Planning, Design and Procurement processes. Facilitate the procurement and appointment of professional service providers and contractors in accordance with Supply Chain Management requirements. Facilitate stakeholder engagement, contractual agreements and project inception processes. Oversee the preparation, review, approval, and regulatory compliance of project planning and design deliverables. Coordinate project implementation readiness, including National Home Builders Registration Council enrolment, payment administration and site handover processes. Manage project implementation stage. Coordinate stakeholder engagement, site handovers, and the establishment of Project Steering Committee (PSC) and Community Liaison Officers (CLO). Monitor and oversee the construction of services, housing units and rectification works to ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards and approved implementation plans. Conduct site visits, participate in technical meetings, monitor contractor performance, assess variation requests, and track project progress and cashflow projections. Prepare and present project progress reports and provide support to stakeholders, oversight bodies, and verification teams during project monitoring, evaluation, audit, and compliance processes. Manage project close-out stage. Analyse and validate expenditure against the value created. Verify that all documents, project deliverables are up to date and all issues are resolved. Liaise with the Project Management Unit for the presentation of the project close out file. Submit and present the project close out file to the Technical PACOM. Receive and file the approved project close out resolutions. Manage the allocated resources. Develop employee job descriptions. Develop Standard Operating Procedures. Manage performance of the employees. Manage sound employment relations. Manage employee conditions of service. Facilitate coaching, mentorship, training, and development of employees. Communication management. Attend to Internal Audit and Auditor General’s RFI’s. Asset management.
jobs.enquiries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli 071 606 5941/ Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842 : E-Recruitment, email: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za

The physical address is 31-33 Phillip Frame Road, Chiselhurst, East London.

af.title: Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder Produksie Graad a
af.summary: 'n Hoofkonstruksieprojekbestuurder word benodig in East London om inisiëring, haalbaarheid en befondsing van menslike nedersettingsprojekte binne die Amathole-streek te oorsien.
af.requirements: Matric/ Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/ NQF vlak 4, NQF vlak 7 in Bou-omgewing soos deur SAQA erken met ses (06) jaar se ervaring as 'n geregistreerde Professionele Konstruksie Projekbestuurder by SACPCMP. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksie Projekbestuurder by aanstelling. Kennis van Menslike Nedersettingsbeleide en wetgewende raamwerke. Bou-omgewingstandaarde, CIDP-regulasies, finansiële en kontrakbestuur, belanghebbendes en gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, voorleggingsvaardighede, verslagskrywingsvaardighede, onderhandeling, fasilitering, analitiese en kritiese denke, konflikbestuur. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Rekenaargeletterd. Moor 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê.
af.duties: Bestuur projeksinisiasie en haalbaarheidsprosesse. Voer projeksbehoerteanalise uit deur hersiening van munisipale Geïntegreerde Ontwikkelingsplanne, Ruimtelike Ontwikkelingsraamwerke, haalbaarheidsvereistes en projekskostebepaling. Stel projeksbefondsingsversoeke op en faciliteer dit, en verkry die nodige goedkeurings. Koördineer die aanstelling van Professionele Diensverskaffers (PSP's), insluitend die ontwikkeling van verkrygingsstrategieë, Terme van Verwysing, en skakeling met Voorsieningskettingbestuursprosesse. Fasiliteer projeksinisiasieprosesse, insluitend belanghebbendes se betrokkenheid, kontrakfinialisering, diensvlakooreenkoms, en aanvangsvergaderings. Monitor en evalueer haalbaarheidsstudie-uitkomste, verskaf tegniese insette, keur finale verslae goed, en faciliteer verwante kontraktuele betalings. Bestuur projeksbeplanning, ontwerp en verkrygingsprosesse. Fasiliteer die verkryging en aanstelling van professionele diensverskaffers en kontrakteurs in ooreenstemming met Voorsieningskettingbestuursvereistes. Fasiliteer belanghebbendes se betrokkenheid, kontraktuele ooreenkomste en projeksinisiasieprosesse. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding, hersiening, goedkeuring, en regulatoriese nakoming van projeksbeplanning en ontwerplewerings. Koördineer projeksimplementeringgereedheid, insluitend Nasionale Huishoubouers Registrasieraad-inskrywing, betalingsadministrasie en werfoorhandigingsprosesse. Bestuur die projeksimplementeringsfase. Koördineer betrokkenheid van belanghebbendes, werfoorhandigings, en die instelling van die Projekkeringskomitee (PSC) en Gemeenskapskakelbeamptes (CLO). Monitor en hou toesig oor die konstruksie van dienste, behuisingseenhede en regstellingswerk om nakoming van projekspesifikasies, gehaltstandaarde en goedgekeurde implementeringsplanne te verseker. Voer werfbesoeke uit, neem deel aan tegniese vergaderings, monitor kontrakteursprestasie, evalueer variasieversoeke, en volg projeks vordering en kontvloei-projeksies. Berei projeksvoortgangsverslae voor en bied dit aan, en verskaf ondersteuning aan belanghebbendes, toesigliggame en verifikasiespanne gedurende projeksonderhoud, -evaluering, -oudit en -nakomingsprosesse. Bestuur die projeksafsluitingsfase. Ontleed en valideer besteding teenoor die waarde geskep. Verifieer dat alle dokumente en projekslewerings op datum is en alle probleme opgelos is. Skakel met die Projeksbestuurs Eenheid vir die voorlegging van die projeksafsluitingslêer. Dien die projeksafsluitingslêer in en bied dit aan by die Tegniese PACOM. Ontvang en lê die goedgekeurde projeksafsluitingsresolusies weg. Bestuur die toegekende hulpbronne. Ontwikkel werknemers se werksbeskrywings. Ontwikkel Standaardbedrywingsprosedures. Bestuur die prestasie van die werknemers. Bestuur goeie diensverhoudinge. Bestuur werknemers se diensvoorwaardes. Fasiliteer afrigting, mentorskap, opleiding en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Kommunikasiebestuur. Hou hom/haar besig met Interne Oudit en die Oudit-generaal se RFI's. Batebestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkholi Wezinhlela Zokwakha Isikhundla Sokukhiqiza A
zu.summary: Kudingekaumphathi omkhulu wezinhlela zokwakha ezakhiweni eEast London ukuze abheke ukuqalwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, ukufaneleka nokuxhaswa ngemali endaweni yase-Amathole Region.
zu.requirements: Imatric/ Isitifiketi Samatrikulumu Seziqu Eziphezulu/ NQF level 4, NQF level 7 kumkhakha wemvelo eyakhiwe njengoba kuqashwa i-SAQA aneminyaka yohlu olungu-six (06) yeminyaka yesiphephelo njengomphathi ohlela izinhlela zokwakha oqashiwe njengongqangi e-SACPCMP. Ukubhalisa ngokuphothule kwe-SACPCMP njengomphathi ohlela izinhlela zokwakha ogqamile ngosuku lokwamukelwa emsebenzini. Ulwazi ngemikhakha kahulumo wokwakha izindlu nezimiso zomthetho. Izizinga zemvelo eyakhiwe, imithetho ye-CIDP, ukuphathwa kwezimali noma amakontradi, ukuxhumana nabathintekayo nomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, amakhono okuphatha izinhlela, amakhono okwethula, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ukuxoxisana, ukwenza kube lula, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nangokuqonda, nokuphatha izinkungo. Isikhathi sokusebenza elihle emqoka. Ilwazi lokusebenzana noma ukusebenza ngqo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yokuqalisa nokubheka ukufaneleka kwezinhlela. Yenza ukuhlaziywa kwezidingo zenkqondo ngezenzo zokuqoqa izinhlelo ezihlangeneyo zasemadolobheni, izimiso ezihlelwe zentuthuko, izidingo zokuthola imali neqolo lemali yepulani. Qoqa futhi wenze isicelo sokufuna imali yokuxhasa inqubo ukwenzela ukuthola izimvume ezidingekayo. Hlezele ukumisa abaphathi bezinkonzo ogqamile (PSPs), okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuthenga, amagama okubhekiswa kuwo, kanye nokuxhumana nokuqoqwa kwenkqubo yokuhlela ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Yenza kube lula ukuqalwa kwenkqondo yokwakha, okuhlanganisa nokuxhumana namaphanele, ukuqedwa kwamakontradi, isivumelwano saphakathi, namaphanele ukuqaliswa. Bheka futhi uhlole ukutholakala kokubheka isimo kwezinkomba zokwakha, nikeza izinkomba zobuchwepheshe, vumela imibiko yokugcina, futhi wenze kube lula ukukhokha okuhlobene nakho mayelana namakontradi. Phatha ukuhlelwa kwenkqondo, ukwakhiwa nokuthengwa kwemikhiqizo emiqoka kwezinsizakalo. Yenza kube lula ukuthenga nokugqoka abaphathi bezinkonzo nezinhlangano ezinamakhono ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuqoqwa kokuhlelwa kokulethwa kwemikhiqizo. Yenza kube lula ukuxhumana namaphanele, ukuvunywa kwezinkontiraki kanye nokuqaliswa kwezinhlelo. Bheka ukulungiselelwa nokwamukelwa kwezinhlelo zokuqoqa imibiko, ukuvumywa kanye nokuhambisana komthetho okuhleliwe namaphoyinti ezinhlelo nezinhlelo zokuqasha abahlinzi bamakhono. Lawula ukuqaliswa kwemikhiqizo yesikhathi, okuhlanganisa nokubhaliswa ekhapensi lesibhedlela, ukuphathwa kwezimali nezinkonzo ezisebenzayo. Phatha isigaba sokuphathwa kwezinhlela. Lawula ukwamukelwa kwabahleli bezindlu namaphanele, ukulethwa kwemikhiqizo yokwakhiwa endaweni, ukumiswa kwayo kanye nokwamukelwa kwekomidi elicwengile nelinkantolo lokulunga kwezindlu. Hlola nokugcina isibonakaliso, ukubhaliswa kwe-NHBRC, ukuphathwa kwezimali nezinkonzo ezisebenzayo. Lawula isikhathi sokuphathwa kwephulo. Lawula ukubamba izingxoxo namaphanele, ukuhlela indawo, kanye nokusekelwa ngokusebenza ngokomthetho nezinkinga eziphakamiswayo. Bheka ukutholakala kwemibiko yokuhlolwa kokuzithoba nokubikelela imiphumela yokuhlolwa ekugcineni kwesikhathi. Phatha isikhathi sokugcina inkqondo yokwakha. Hlaza futhi uvumele ukusebenza kwemali esebenzayo kanye nesenzo esibonakalisa ukwamukelwa okuphelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imibiko, imikhiqizo yephulo ihlaziwe futhi zonke izinkinga zixazululwe. Xhumana neNyuvesi yokuphathwa kwemisebenzi ukwenzela ukunika inkomba yesikhathi sokugcina inkqondo. Thumela futhi ukhombise inkomba yesikhathi sokugcina inkqondo kwi-Technical PACOM. Yamukele futhi ulondoloze izinqumo ezamukelekile zokugcina inkqondo. Phatha izinsiza ezabelwe. Hlela izincazelo zemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Hlela izinguqulo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza. Phatha ukusebenza kahle kwabasebenzi. Phatha ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza. Phatha izimo zokukhonza zabasebenzi. Yenza kube lulu ukweluleka, ukukhokha, ukuqeqesha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Phatha ukuxhumana okuyisimiso. Nzela izikhwapha ezokuhlola izindleko zangaphakathi nethonya kwezimali eziguqulayo. Phatha izimpahla.

xh.title: Umphathi weProjekthi yokuVakalisa iNqanaba leNkokeli
xh.summary: Kufuneka umphathi weprojekthi yovakaliso inqanaba leNkokeli e East London ukuze alawule ukuqaliswa kweeprojekthi zezicwangciso zabantu, ukuzinza kunye nemali yoluxhaso ngaphakathi kummandla i Amathole.
xh.requirements: I-Matric/ Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliphezulu seSizwe/ NQF level 4, NQF level 7 kummandla wokwakha njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA anomvu wo (06) weminyaka njengomphathi weprojekthi yovakaliso obhalisiweyo oyi-Professional kunye ne-SACPCMP. Ukuqatshelwa ngokuyimfuneko ne-SACPCMP njengomphathi weprojekthi yovakaliso oyi-Professional ngexa lenkomfa. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zezicwangciso zabantu nezakhe zomthetho. Izinga lommandla wokwakha, iimigaqo ye-CIDP, ulawulo lweemali nakontilaki, nokuqonda nabathathi-nxaxheba basesixekweni. Amakhono okunxibelelana amahle, amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi, amakhono okubonisa, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, uthethathethwano, ukulawula iingxoxo, ukucinga ngokuhlola nangokubuchophile, nokulawula iingxabano. Ikhono lokusebenza eqeni. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebeniza ikhompyutha. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo zokuQalisa iProjekthi nokulinganisa ukuzinza. Yenza uhlalutyo lweemfuno zeprojekthi ngokuphonononga iNkqubo yeSizwe yokuba yiNhlobo yenqanaba elinye yasezidolophini, iNkqubo zoPhuhliso lweNdalo, iimfuno zokulinganisa ukuzinza kunye neexabiso zeprojekthi. Hlanganisela ithWomngeni ukubakonwa ngeemfuno zemali setyhiswa kwaye uze ufumane izigqibo eziyimfuneko. Lungelelanise ukwenzwa kweziko loBazi ngezinkonzo oza kuqatsha (PSPs), kuquka ukuphuhliswa kweekqubo ezinxibelelayo zokuthenga, iigumbi zoBazi, nokuqondana neenkqubo zoLawulo loQoqosho lweNkqubo. Yenza kubakho iziqendu zokuqalisa iiprojekthi, kuquka ukuzibandakanya kwabathathi-nxaxheba, ukuqwalaselwa komgangatho wekontilaki, isivumelwano samakhondo enkonzo, namagqabantshosti okuqalisa. Lilindele uphando olungeniswayo ngenkqubo yokulinganisa, nikeze izinto eziphuma kuwo ngokobuchwepheshe, vumela iingxelo ezigqibele, zenze ukuba kubekho imali enokusetyhiswa kwizivumelwana ezinxulumene nayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuCwangcisa iProjekthi, ukuYila nokuThengisa. Yenza kubakho ukuThengisa nokuQatsha abazini bezoBazi nabaqambi bekontrakthi ngokwemfuneko yenkqubo yoLawulo loQoqosho lweNkqubo. Yenza ukubakho ubudlelwane nabathathi-nxaxheba, izivumelwana zeekontilaki, nokuqalisa iinkqubo zeprojekthi. Qwalasela ukuLungiselela, ukuPinda kuQwalaselo, ukuVuma nokuZibandakanya nokuLawula ngokomthetho izinto eziziKQALISO yaba zikwonakalise ngokulungelelanisa iinkqubo ezizakuqaliswa, ngokuhambelana nokuBhaliswa kweNkqubo yeKhomishane yoBukiwa bweZindlu zeSizwe, ulawulo lokuHlawula iinkonzo, nokuQwalaselwa kwenkqubo yokunikezwa iindawo zokwakha. Lawula inqanaba elithi leqela elenza inkqubo yokulawula iinkqubo kwaye abe bulele ngezinto ezenziwayo. Qwalasela iNkqubo yokuSebenza iinkqubo zokugqibela. Hlaziya iingxelo ezibhaliweyo, gqibezela izigqibo, nikezela ngokulungelelanisa ezenziweyo ngemali esetyhiwe, zama kungabikho iingxaki kwiinkcukacha eziguqukayo zokuqaliswa okanye okuphuhliweyo kwinkqubo yokugqibezela. Yenza uHlaziyo ngokunxibelelanisa nenzame kwezinsiza ezininzi zokulinganisela, kuqaliswe iinkqubo zokungenelela ngamakomiti, azenziwe inqanaba elisezantsi, ngokuNxibelelanisa iinkqubo zokuQwalasela iinkqubo nokugcina iinkcukacha eziguqukayo ngokuHamba, zibe nobunjalo obungakhalaziweyo nokuthi zibe zezobuchwepheshe ngokweNqanaba elithile, zibekiwe kwiNkqubo eQwalaselwa ngokuchanekileyo, kuqwalaselwe nalawulo oluza kubakho kwindalo yalo. Lawula izixhobo eziNikiwe. Pangalala iNdlela yokwenza iinkqubo, zibe yinkqubo. Lawula imisebenzi yeSizwe yendalo eqhutywa kwindawo ethileyo yokuNgqina ngemiba ngqo eqaliswayo eqaliswayo kwiNkqubo yokusebenza. Lawula iNkqubo yokuQala konke konke ukuze ivunywe njengenxaxheba eLungelelanisiweyo kwaye ivumelane nokuQwalasela izigqibo. Lungelelanisa izinsiza ezahluweneyo, ezahlukeneyo zokuNxibelelanisa, izinsiza eziphuma kuqeqesho eliya kwinxulumaniso elithile. Lawula ukusebenza koluntu kwakuthi, ukusebenza koluntu ngakumbi, kwinkqubo yokuqala nokugqibezela inkqubo yokuQhutywa zibe zezindalo nokuba yolwazi ngaphakathi kwakhona ngexa leqela elaziwa ngokuba ngamakomishi, namakomishi. Qwalasela kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuQhutywa, ngokuHamba, ngokuhamba kwexesha, ngakumbi ukulawula inkqubo ezibalulwa ngemiba eqwalaselwayo eqhutywa ngemiba yokugqibezela, eqhutywa ngokulinganisela elineNkqubo eqhutywa ngokwenkqubo eQhutywa ngakumbi kwiNqanaba yokuHlaziya kwinkqubo ezizeNkqubo eQhutywa ngokwenza iinkqubo ezenziwe ngokuchanekileyo ezenziwe ngokuchanekileyo ngaphezu kokuQhutywa ngokuchanekileyo kokubakho ngemali esetyhiweyo kwiNkqubo yokugcina ukusetyenziswa kolwazi oluhamba phambili ngokweNqanaba yokuNgeniswa yemiba ehamba ethandathu, ngemiba yendalo, ngokweNqanaba yendalo. Lawula iNkqubo yokugqibezela inkqubo. Hlaziya nokuQinisekisa imali esetyhiweyo ngokuchasene nexabiso elenziwe. Qinisekisa ukuba onke amaxwebhu, iziphene eziyimveliso zeprojekthi zilungile nakuqaliswa zize zonke iingxaki zisombululwe. Nxibelelanisa neYuniti yoLawulo loLwazi lokuHamba ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi lokuHamba oluya kusetyenziswa kwindalo. Zenzwe nokuNikwa ngolwazi olunxulumene nokuHamba oluya kusetyenziswa kolwazi ngokuhamba. Yakha iNkqubo yokuGcina amaxwebhu kwaye ulwazi. Lawula izinsiza ezinikiweyo. Yenza iinkcazelo zomsebenzi abasebenzi. Yenza iNkqubo eziQhutywa ngemigaqo. Lawula ukusebenza koluntu abasebenzi. Lawula uLuntu oluHamba oluQhutywa. Lawula imo yokuSebenza abasebenzi. Hlaziya ukusesika, ukubaluleka, ukugqibela, nokuQeqesha abasebenzi. Ulawulo lokuNxibelelana. Yenza nokuQwalasela koluntu ngokwenkqubo eQhutywa ngokwemiba ekhoyo. Ulawulo oluphathwayo ngokweNkqubo eQhutywa.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Risk Management and Integrity
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: Manage risk management frameworks, policies and strategies at the Eastern Cape Department of Human Settlements Head Office in East London.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Public Management/ Business Administration/ Public Administration/ Bachelor of Administration/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Accounting/ Financial Management/ BCom/ Economics as recognised by SAQA with 3 years’ experience at Assistant Director level in the field. Compulsory registration with Institute of Risk Management South Africa. Knowledge of Public Sector governance and legislation, risk management frameworks, internal control assurance systems, financial management and budgeting, ethics, integrity and anti-corruption frameworks, organisational and sector knowledge, information and data management. Good communication skills, project management skills, presentation skills, report writing skills, strategic planning, analytical and critical thinking, ethical judgement and integrity. Ability to work in a team. Effective and efficient management and monitoring of organisational budget and expenditure. Computer literate. Able to work under pressure and difficult deadlines. Must possess a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Manage the review of Risk Management Framework and Implementation plan. Obtain, analyse and identify gaps that are in the policy, strategy and charter. Circulate, analyse and identify gaps that are in the policy and strategy for comments from Top Management and Risk Management Committee members. Submit inputs of the Risk Management framework to the risk management committee for discussion. Forward the framework to the Head of Department for approval. Obtain Risk Strategy and operational plan. Identify risk management activities and calendar date. Recommend approval of the risk implementation plan to the Accounting Officer. Facilitate Risk Management Committee (RMC) meetings. Draft minutes for RMC meetings. Compile meeting packs seven days prior RMC meetings. Manage the annual risk assessment process and the maintenance of risk register. Issue a notification letter with dates to Senior Management Service. Provide support to programmes on the identification, evaluation and assessment of risks. Record all identified strategic/operational risk, controls and actions to improve management of risk. Monitor the implementation of risk plan. Record all actions taken on the risk control plan. Compile quarterly reports. Promote the risk awareness culture and risk appetite throughout the department. Arrange risk awareness sessions for the department. Facilitate the promotion of risk awareness programme to various stakeholders. Manage Business Continuity Plan (BCP) within the department. Facilitate the review and maintenance of the BCP and all other relevant documents. Facilitate appointment and functioning of BCP. Facilitate the implementation of BCP when disasters occur. Monitor and report on the implementation of BCP until the situation subside and operations come to normality. Coordinate the BCP task team. Report to the departmental Governance Committee. Monitor resources within the sub- directorate. Timeously develop job description. Manage performance of the directorate. Manage sound employment relations. Manage employee conditions of service. Facilitate coaching, mentorship, training, and development of sub-ordinates for effective and efficient service delivery. Establish, implement and maintain effective and efficient communication. Manage asset of the Directorate. Monitor the development and the implementation of the Directorate Standard Operating Procedures. Attend to Internal Audit, Auditor Generals RFIs, Audit Outcomes and Findings.
jobs.enquiries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941/ Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842 E-Recruitment, email: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za

To report any e-Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00- 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address. Hand-delivered, e-Mailed, Faxed, Posted applications will not be accepted. Where applicants are not able to submit their applications on the e-recruitment system, they must physically bring printed hard copies to Human Resources office at the Head Office, and they will be assisted to capture the hard copy application on the system. The physical address is 31-33 Phillip Frame Road, Chiselhurst, East London.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment.
