af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Risikobestuur en Integriteit
af.summary: Bestuur risikobestuursraamwerke, beleide en strategieë by die Eastern Cape Department of Human Settlements se hoofkantoor in East London.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Public Management/ Business Administration/ Public Administration/ Bachelor of Administration/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Accounting/ Financial Management/ BCom/ Economics soos deur SAQA erken, met 3 jaar se ervaring op Assistant Director-vlak in die veld. Verpligte registrasie by die Institute of Risk Management South Africa. Kennis van openbare-sektorbestuur en -wetgewing, risikobestuursraamwerke, interne beheerversekeringstelsels, finansiële bestuur en begroting, etiek, integriteit en antikorrupsieraamwerke, organisatoriese en sektorkennis, inligting- en databestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, strategiese beplanning, analitiese en kritiese denke, etiese oordeel en integriteit. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur en monitering van organisatoriese begroting en uitgawes. Rekenaarbedrywig. In staat om onder druk en moeilike sperdatums te werk. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Bestuur die hersiening van die risikobestuursraamwerk en implementeringsplan. Verkry, ontleed en identifiseer gapings wat in die beleid, strategie en handves voorkom. Sirkuleer, ontleed en identifiseer gapings wat in die beleid en strategie voorkom vir kommentaar van Topbestuur en lede van die Risikobestuurskomitee. Dien insette van die risikobestuursraamwerk by die risikobestuurskomitee in vir bespreking. Stuur die raamwerk na die Head of Department vir goedkeuring. Verkry risikostrategie en operasionele plan. Identifiseer risikobestuuraktiwiteite en kalenderdatum. Beveel goedkeuring van die risiko-implementeringsplan by die Accounting Officer aan. Fasiliteer Risikobestuurskomitee (RMC)-vergaderings. Skryf notule vir RMC-vergaderings. Stel vergaderingspakke sewe dae voor RMC-vergaderings saam. Bestuur die jaarlikse risiko-assesseringsproses en die instandhouding van die risikoregister. Stel 'n kennismakingsbrief met datums aan Senior Management Service uit. Verskaf ondersteuning aan programme oor die identifikasie, evaluering en assessering van risiko's. Record alle geïdentifiseerde strategiese/operasionele risiko's, kontroles en aksies om risikobestuur te verbeter. Monitor die implementering van die risikoplan. Record alle aksies wat op die risikobeheerplan onderneem is. Stel kwartaallikse verslae saam. Bevorder 'n risikobewustheidskultuur en risiko-aanvaarding regdeur die departement. Reël risikobewustheidsessies vir die departement. Fasiliteer die bevordering van die risikobewustheidsprogram aan verskeie belanghebbendes. Bestuur die Besigheidskontinuïteitsplan (BCP) binne die departement. Fasiliteer die hersiening en instandhouding van die BCP en alle ander relevante dokumente. Fasiliteer die aanstelling en funksionering van die BCP. Fasiliteer die implementering van die BCP wanneer rampe voorkom. Monitor en rapporteer oor die implementering van die BCP totdat die situasie bedaar en bedrywighede na normaliteit terugkeer. Koördineer die BCP-taakspan. Rapporteer aan die departementele Bestuurskomitee. Monitor hulpbronne binne die subdirektoraat. Ontwik tydig posbeskrywings. Bestuur prestasie van die direktoraat. Bestuur goeie diensverhoudinge. Bestuur diensvoorwaardes van werknemers. Fasiliteer afrigting, mentorskap, opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes vir doeltreffende en effektiewe dienslewering. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie. Bestuur bates van die Direktoraat. Monitor die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Direktoraat se Standard Operating Procedures. Skenk aandag aan Interne Oudit, Auditor Generals RFIs, Audit Outcomes and Findings.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuba nguMengameli: Ukuqashwa Komngcele Wengozi Nokuziphatha
zu.summary: Phatha ukwakheka kokuqashwa komngcele wengozi, izinqubo kanye nezindlela ezenziwa ngazo izinto eNdiweni lase Eastern Cape le Human Settlements Ehhovisi eliyinhloko e East London.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi ephakeme kazwelonke, iziqu ezingaphansi kwabaphakeme (NQF level 7) kwi Public Management/ Business Administration/ Public Administration/ Bachelor of Administration/ Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ Accounting/ Financial Management/ BCom/ Economics njengoba kuqashwe yi SAQA aneminyaka engu 3 yesisipho sokusebenza ezingeni likaMqashi oMncane enkundleni. Ukuqashwa okuyimfuneko ne Institute of Risk Management South Africa. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa komnyango kahulumeni nangemithetho, ukwakheka kokuqashwa komngcele wengozi, amasistimu woqiniseko lokuLawula ngaphakathi, ukuqashwa kwezimali kanye nokubhajetha, iziqiniso, ukuziphatha okuhle kanye nokuvikela ukukhwabanisa, ulwazi ngenhlangano nangesiqonga, ukuqashwa kolwazi kanye nedatha. Amandla okukhuluma kahle, amandla okuphatha izinhlelo, amandla okubamba iphathimthetho, amandla okubhala imibiko, ukweluleka ngokobuchule, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya kanye nokucabanga ngokuningiliza, ukwahlulela ngezindlela zokuziphatha kanye nokuziphatha okuhle. Amandla okusebenza eqenjini. Ukuqashwa nokulawula ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo ibhajethi yokuhamba kwenhlangano kanye nezimali ezichithwayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi kanye nasemikhawulweni yezinsuku ezingenzeki. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha ukubuyekeza ukwakheka kokuqashwa komngcele wengozi kanye neNqubo ezenziwayo. Thola, hlaziya futhi uchithe izikhala ezikhona kule nqubo, isu kanye nesibekelo. Sasaza, hlaziya futhi uchithe izikhala ezikhona kule nqubo kanye nesu ukuthola iziphakamiso kuBuhlakani bePhezulu kanye kwamalungu eKomidi Yokubaqashwa komngcele wengozi. Hambisa izinto ezifakwe kuqashwa komngcele wengozi kule Komidi Yokuqashwa komngcele wengozi ukuze kuxoxwe ngazo. Thumela le nqubo kuMkhulu we Nyuvesi weNdu ukuze ivunyelwe. Thola iSu Lokuqashwa komngcele wengozi kanye nendlela ezenziwayo. Chaza imisebenzi yokuqashwa komngcele wengozi kanye nasusuku lwamakhalenda. Siphakamisa ukuvunywa kwenqubo yokuqashwa komngcele wengozi kuMphathi Oqashwa ngemali. Whena izinkulumo zeKomidi Yokuqashwa komngcele wengozi (RMC). Bhala imizuzu yezinkulumo ze RMC. Qoqa iziphakamiso zezinkulumo ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa ngaphambi kwezinkulumo ze RMC. Phatha inqubo yonyaka yokuhlolwa komngcele wengozi kanye nokugcina isikweletu sengozi. Hambisa incwadi yesaziso yosuku kubakhethwa eNkonjini Ephakeme. Nikeza usizo ekubonakaliseni, ukulinganiseni nasekuhlolweni kwezengozi. Qopha zonke izengozi ezibonakalisiwe ezinguqinisekile/ezisebenzayo, izilawulo kanye nezinyathelo zokuphucula ukuqashwa komngcele wengozi. Qedela isu lokuqashwa komngcele wengozi. Qopha wonke amanyathelo athathiwe esini lokulawula komngcele wengozi. Qoqa imibiko yamakota. Khuthaza inkambiso yokwazisa ngezengozi kanye nokuthanda ukuthwala ingozi kuyo yonke indawo. Hlela izikhathi zokwazisa ngezengozi kwindawo. Siza ekukhuthazeni inqubo yokwazisa ngezengozi kubahlukanai balwazi. Phatha iNqubo Yokuqhubeka Kwezwe (BCP) kwindawo. Siza ekubukeni nakugcineni i BCP kanye wonye imibuzo ephathelene nalokho. Siza ukukhethwa kanye nokusebenza kwe BCP. Siza ekuqashweni i BCP ngesikhathi kubhukwa izinhlekeleli. Qedela kanti ubeke umbiko ekuqashweni i BCP kuze kube yilapho isimo sithuthuka kanti imisebenzi ibuyela endaweni yayo. Hlelanisa iqembu lemisebenzi i BCP. Beka umbiko eKomidini Yokulawula. Qedela amathambo ngaphakathi kwesiqephu sikaMqashi. Hlela inqubo ngokushesha ukubhala inqubo yomsebenzi. Phatha ukusebenza komsebenzi. Phatha ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle. Phatha izimo zomsebenzi zabasebenzi. Siza ekufundiseni, ekuqondeniseni, ekuqeqesheni, nakuthuthukiseni abasebenzi abangaphansi ukuze kube ukwaziswa okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Sika, phatha futhi gcina ukuxhumana okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Phatha izimpahla zoMqashi. Qedela ukuthuthukiswa nokuqashwa kweNqubo yokusebenza kaMqathi. Phathela ekuqashweni komngcele wengozi ngaphakathi, izicelo ze Auditor General, imiphumela kanye nalokutholakele.

xh.title: Isebe Leloqobo: iNqanaba lokuLawula iingozi nokuQinisekisa ukuzinikela
xh.summary: Lawula iinkqubo zokulawula iingozi, iindlela zokuqhuba nemigaqo eNdiweni leNtloko leSebe lezeZindlu eEastern Cape eEast London.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi seNqanaba leSekondari, isifundo se-NQF level 7 kwiQela leBhalwe ngqo kwiZiko kwilMimeko kaWumbatho, iRhulumente/ uLawulo lweShishini/ uLawulo lweRhulumente/ iBhalore yeZolawulo/ uLawulo leeNgozi/ uKuhlolwa ngaphakathi/ uKubala iimali/ uLawulo leeMali/ iBCom/ izoQoqosho njengoko kutyiwo yi-SAQA nge-3 yeminyaka yamava kwinqanaba loMcedisi kwindawo ekuchaziweyo. Ukubhalisa kwiNkundla yoLawulo leeNgozi eMzantsi Afrika kukhangelwa. Ulwazi ngokulawulwa kweQela loRhulumente nokuqinisekiswa kwemigaqo, iinkqubo zolawulo iingozi, iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ulawulo lwangaphakathi, ulawulo lweemali nokuqokelela imali, amanyathelo okuziphatha, ukuzinikela nokulwa nokungalunyeli, ulwazi loluntu nolwazi ngamabhunga, ulawulo lolwazi nemininingwane. Amandla okuncedxana ngokuthetha nabantu, amandla okulawula iiprojekthi, amandla okubonisa ngokusithetha, amandla okubhala iingxelo, iplani esisigqini, amandla okuhlalutya nokucinga ngokujongene nangokubuza, ukwahlulela ngokuziphatha okulungileyo nokuzinikela. Amandla okusebenza nqebe. Ukulawula nokujonga ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo imali nokuyltshwayo koluntu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okusebenza nginikezelo lokugqithisa nexesha elinzima. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokushayela.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuhlolwa kwenkqubo yoLawulo leeNgozi neNkqubo yokuYalelwa. Ukufumana, ukuhlalutya nokumfumanisa izikewu ezikumgaqo, injongo notchwepheshe. Ukusasaza, ukuhlalutya nokumfumanisa izikewu ezikumgaqo nasekujongeni nophando oluvela kuBaphathi abaPhezulu nabalungu beQela loLawulo leeNgozi. Ngenisa iingcamango zenkqubo yoLawulo leeNgozi kwiqela loLawulo leeNgozi ukuyizwa. Thumathisa inkqubo kumlawuli weSebe ukuyamkeleka. Fumana injongo yoLawulo iingozi neNkqubo yokuSebenza. Mfumanise izenzo zolawulo iingozi namhla kwiqhobosha. Fakela isiphakamiso sokwamkelwa kwenkqubo yokuyalelwa iingozi kumlawuli weTyalomali. Qhube iNkomfa yeQela loLawulo iingozi. Bhala iimizuzu yeenkomfa. Qokelela iinxalenye zenkomfa iintsuku ezisixhenxe phambi kweenkomfa. Lawula inkqubo yonyaka yokuhlolwa iingozi nokugcinwa kwegunya leengozi. Thumela ileta yokuqwalasela ngemihla kuSebe lokuLawula iinkonzo ezikumngangqo. Nikela ncedo kwiinkqubo ngokuchonga, ukuhlola nokwahlulela iingozi. Bhalo yonke ingozi ngokuzigqiba/iingozi ngokusebenza, ulawulo namanyathelo okuphucula ulawulo iingozi. Jonga ukuyalelwa kwenkqubo iingozi. Bhalo yonke amanyathelo athathiweyo kwinkqubo yokulawula iingozi. Qokelela iingxelo zethatu ngenyaka. Khuthaza inkcubeko yokwazisa ngeengozi nokufuna iingozi kulo lonke isebe. Hlela iinkqubo zokusasaza ulwazi ngeengozi ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo kwisebe. Qhubele phambili ukukhuthaza inkqubo yokusasaza ulwazi ngeengozi kubahlali-ntsapho abahlukeneyo. Lawula iNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini kwisebe. Qhube ukuvunjwa nokulondolozwa kweNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini nakuwo nawo na onke amanye amaxwebhu afanelekileyo. Qhube ukuqeshwa nokusebenza kweNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini. Qhube ukuyalelwa kweNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini xa kunokwenzeka iingozi. Jonga nokwenza iingxelo ngokuyalelwa kweNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini de kube sitsho sithi imeko iyaphola kwaye amashishino abuyela kwesiqhelo. Lawula iqela lemsebenzi weNkqubo yoQhagamshelo lweShishini. Yenza iingxelo kwiQela loLawulo koluntu. Jonga amacebo kwingqungquthela. Hlala ukhawuleza kwimisebenzi yokwenza inkqubo. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenza. Lawula ulwalamano lwebhasha lomsebenzi. Lawula iimeko zabasebenzi bemisebenzi yeshishini. Khuthaza iinkqubo zokuqeqesha, ukukhuthaza nokuphucula abangangezantsi kwisebe ukwenza ukuba inkonzo yanelise. Misela, yalela nolondoloze ulwalamano olusebenza kakuhle lomsebenzi nokuchanekileyo. Lawula izicwangciso kwisebe. Jonga inkqubo yokwenza nokuyalelwa kwiStandard Operating Procedures. Phendula iinkqubo zokuHlolwa ngaphakathi, iingxelo zeNkundla yeSikweri, iingxelo zokuHlolwa nokuHola.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 per annum, all-inclusive package, OSD
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: Construction Project Manager Grade A in Queenstown, requiring a built environment qualification and SACPCMP professional registration.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Higher Diploma (Built environment field) with a minimum of four (4) years’ and six months certified experience or a BTech (Built environment field) with a minimum of four (4) years’ certified managerial experience or Honours Degree in any Built Environment with a minimum of 3 years’ experience. Compulsory registration with the SACPCMP as a Professional Construction Project Manager on appointment. Knowledge of Human Settlements policies and legislative frameworks. Built environment standards, CIDP regulations, financial and contract management, stakeholder and community engagement. Good communication skills, project management skills, presentation skills, report writing skills, negotiation, facilitation, analytical and critical thinking, conflict management. Ability to work in a team. Computer literate. Must possess a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate the project initiation stage. Open the project file. Provide input during the development of the procurement strategy. Provide input in the development of the Terms of Reference (T.O.R). Prepare Professional Service Provider’s (PSP) payment certificate for the feasibility report. Co-ordinate the project planning and design stage. Organise meetings with the appointed PSP and district/local municipalities to communicate and agree on the requirements. Prepare the submission payment certificate for Supply Chain Management (SCM) returnable schedules. Provide input during the development of Service Level Agreement (SLA). Organise meetings with the professional services. Provide input during the first draft of planning and design deliverables. Prepare payment certificate to the PSP for Geotech, Environmental Impact Assessment, house plans and design reports. Submit project enrolment file to the Project Management Unit. Provide input during the development of the Procurement Strategy for contractors required. Provide inputs during the development of (TOR) and present to the Bid Specification Committee for approval. Organise meetings with the appointed contractors and district/local municipalities to communicate and agree on the requirements. Provide inputs during the development of the SLA. Liaise with PSP’s for the site handover. Coordinate the project implementation stage. Facilitate the construction of services. Facilitate the construction of housing units. Facilitate the rectification of housing units. Draft invitation letters for the introduction of stakeholders to municipalities. Liaise with the contractor in preparation for handing over of documents. Issue the copies of building drawings, milestone breakdown, PIPs and specifications to the Control Works Inspector. Liaise with Social Facilitation and Beneficiary Administration units for the establishment of Project Steering Committees and appointment of the Community Liaison Officer. Conduct progress and technical meetings. Conduct site visits to monitor progress on site. Verify value created on site, validate and process project claims. Make follow-ups with District support services on the payment claims. Submit copies of the payment stubs and payment reconciliation to the PSP and file. Prepare and submit quarterly contractor performance reports. Analyse and validate expenditure against the value created. Provide input during the preparation of variation orders. Prepare motivation for the issuing of non-performance notices. Prepare and present reports to various stakeholders. Provide support to the various stakeholders during project visits and verifications. Coordinate project Close-Out stage. Facilitate the submission of the close out report. Validate required documents in the project file. Source any outstanding required documents in the project file. Submit the project file to CCPM for project close out. File the approved project close out resolutions.
jobs.enquiries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941/ Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842 E-Recruitment, email: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applicants must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e-Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00- 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address. Hand-delivered, e-Mailed, Faxed, Posted applications will not be accepted. Where applicants are not able to submit their applications on the e-recruitment system, they must physically bring printed hard copies to Human Resources office at the Head Office, and they will be assisted to capture the hard copy application on the system. The physical address is 31-33 Phillip Frame Road, Chiselhurst, East London.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Konstruksie Projekbestuurder Graad a
af.summary: Konstruksie Projekbestuurder Graad A in Queenstown, wat 'n kwalifikasie in die geboude omgewing en professionele registrasie by die SACPCMP vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, Nasionale Hoër Diploma (Geboude omgewing-veld) met 'n minimum van vier (4) jaar en ses maande gesertifiseerde ervaring of 'n BTech (Geboude omgewing-veld) met 'n minimum van vier (4) jaar se gesertifiseerde bestuurservaring of 'n Honneursgraad in enige Geboude Omgewing met 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring. Verpligte registrasie by die SACPCMP as 'n Professionele Konstruksie Projekbestuurder by aanstelling. Kennis van Menslike Nedersettings-beleide en wetgewende raamwerke. Geboude omgewing-standaarde, CIDP-regulasies, finansiële en kontrakbestuur, belanghebbende en gemeenskapsbetrekkinge. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, voorleggingsvaardighede, verslagdoeningsvaardighede, onderhandeling, fasilitering, analitiese en kritiese denke, konflikbestuur. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Rekenaargeletterd. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Koördineer die projekinisiëringsfase. Open die projeklêer. Verskaf insette tydens die ontwikkeling van die verkrygingsstrategie. Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van die Terme van Verwysing (T.O.R). Berei die Professionele Diensverskaffer se (PSP) betalingsertifikaat vir die haalbaarheidsverslag voor. Koördineer die projekbeplanning- en ontwerpfase. Reël vergaderings met die aangestelde PSP en distriks/lokale munisipaliteite om vereistes te kommunikeer en ooreen te kom. Berei die voorleggingsbetalingsertifikaat vir Supply Chain Management (SCM) terugstuur-skedules voor. Verskaf insette tydens die ontwikkeling van die Diensvlakooreenkoms (SLA). Reël vergaderings met die professionele dienste. Verskaf insette tydens die eerste konsep van beplanning- en ontwerplewerings. Berei betalingsertifikaat aan die PSP vir Geotegnieke, Omgewingsimpak-assessering, huisplanne en ontwerpverslae voor. Dien projekinskrywingslêer by die Projekbestuureenheid in. Verskaf insette tydens die ontwikkeling van die Verkrygingsstrategie vir benodigde kontrakteurs. Verskaf insette tydens die ontwikkeling van (TOR) en bied dit aan die Biedspesifikasiekomitee vir goedkeuring voor. Reël vergaderings met die aangestelde kontrakteurs en distriks/lokale munisipaliteite om vereistes te kommunikeer en ooreen te kom. Verskaf insette tydens die ontwikkeling van die SLA. Skakel met PSP's vir die werfoorhandiging. Koördineer die projekimplementeringsfase. Fasiliteer die konstruksie van dienste. Fasiliteer die konstruksie van wooneenhede. Fasiliteer die regstelling van wooneenhede. Stel uitnodigingsbriewe op vir die bekendstelling van belanghebbendes aan munisipaliteite. Skakel met die kontrakteur ter voorbereiding vir die oorhandiging van dokumente. Verskaf afskrifte van geboutekeninge, mylpaal-afbreking, PIP's en spesifikasies aan die Kontrole Werkinspekteur. Skakel met Sosiale Fasilitering en Begunstigde Administrasie-eenhede vir die instelling van Projekstuurskomitees en aanstelling van die Gemeenskapskakelbeampte. Hou vordering- en tegniese vergaderings. Doen werfbesoeke om vordering op die werf te monitor. Verifieer waarde geskep op die werf, valideer en prosesseer projekaansprake. Doen opvolg met Distriksondersteuningsdienste oor die betaalaansprake. Dien afskrifte van die betaalstompies en betaalafstemming by die PSP in en lê dit weg. Berei en dien kwartaallikse kontrakteurprestasieverslae voor. Analiseer en valideer besteding teenoor die geskepte waarde. Verskaf insette tydens die voorbereiding van variasiebevele. Berei motivering voor vir die uitreik van nie-prestasiekennisgewings. Berei en bied verslae aan diverse belanghebbendes voor. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die diverse belanghebbendes tydens projekbesoeke en verifikasies. Koördineer projekafsluitingsfase. Fasiliteer die indiening van die afsluitingsverslag. Valideer vereiste dokumente in die projeklêer. Verkaf uitstaande vereiste dokumente in die projeklêer. Dien die projeklêer by CCPM vir projekafsluiting in. Lê die goedgekeurde projekafsluitingsresolusies weg.

zu.title: Umphathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Izinga A
zu.summary: Umphathi Wephrojekthi Yokwakha Izinga A eQueenstown, ofuna iziqu zendawo yakhiwe nokubhalisa njengongunjiniyela ku-SACPCMP.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samatanga Samabanga Aphakeme, I-Diploma Ephakeme Yezwe (Indawo yokwakha) okungenani eminyaka emine (4) nanezinyanga eziyisithupha ngokuhlolwa okugunyaziwe noma i-BTech (Indawo yokwakha) okungenani eminyaka emine (4) yamava okuphatha okuhlolwe noma i-Degree Honours kunoma yisiphi isigaba sokwakha okungenani eminyaka emi-3 yamava. Kuyadingeka ukubhalisa ku-SACPCMP njengesikhulu siphefumlelwe eNqumeni Yephrojekthi Yokwakha ngosuku lokwethweswa. Ulwazi ngemigomo Yezindlu nezinhlelo zomthetho. Izimiso zokwakha, imithetho ye-CIDP, ukuphathwa kwezimali namasheya, nokuqhathaniswa nabathintekayo nomphakathi. Amakhono okuxhumana aphezulu, amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono okubamba inkulumo, amakhono okubhala umbiko, ukuxoxisana, ukweluleka, ukuhlaziya nokucabanga ngokujulile, nokuphatha izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini. Kwatiyelwe ukusebenza ngakomakhwapha. Kufanele abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qondanisa isigaba sokuqala sephrojekthi. Vula ifayela lephrojekthi. Nikeza iminikelo ekuqaleni kwakhezelwa imikhuba yokuqoqa. Nikeza iminikelo ekuthuthukiseni Ithemba Lokuhlela (T.O.R). Lungiselela isitifiketi sokukhokha se-Provincial Service Provider (PSP) semibiko yokuphumelela. Qondanisa isigaba sokuqamba nokuhlela iphrojekthi. Hlela izinkundla nabakhethiweyo PSP kumaspala wesifunda/wasedolobheni ukuxhumana futhi baqale ngezidingo. Lungiselela isitifiketi sokukhokha isithakazelo ngokulondolozwa kokuqongela Supply Chain Management (SCM). Nikeza iminikelo ekuthuthukiseni Service Level Agreement (SLA). Hlela izinkundla ngezinkonzo zabaphathi. Nikeza iminikelo ekubhalweni okokuqala okuhleliwe. Lungiselela isitifiketi sokukhokha i-PSP mayelana namalabhwe ezwe, Ukuhlola Ukuthelekela nemvelo, izinhlela zendlu namalebula. Thumela ifayela lephrojekthi ekubhalisweni kumnyango wokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Nikeza iminikelo ekuthuthukiseni imikhuba yokuqoqa izinkontileka ezengeziwe. Nikeza iminikelo ekuthuthukiseni (TOR) nokuveza ku-Bid Committee ukuze ivunyelwe. Hlela izinkundla nabakhandi abakhethiweyo kumaspala wesifunda/wasedolobheni ukuxhumana futhi baqale ngezidingo. Nikeza iminikelo ekuthuthukiseni i-SLA. Xhumana ne-PSP mayelana nokunikezwa kwesiza. Qondanisa isigaba semisebenzi yakhiwa yezinto. Qondisa ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza. Qondisa ukwakhiwa kwezindlu. Qondisa ukulungiswa kwezindlu. Bhala izinhlamvuthi zokuqokoa izixwayi ukwazisa ngokusungulwa kwezinsiza kumaspala. Xhumana nosenkontilaka ukulungiselela ukugqitshwa kwamadokhumenti. Nikeza ngokugqanyisiwe ngokusaka imitapo, ukuhlukaniswa kwamagugu, ama-PIP nezinqikithi ku-Control Works Inspector. Xhumana namaphuzu e-Social Facilitation kanye Nezinhlangothi ze-Beneficiary Administration zokusungulwa kwamacomidi aphethe amaphrojekthi nokumiswa kwebhodi yokuxhumanisa nomphakathi. Yenza izinkundla zokubuka ukuba kuhamba kanjani neqhaza lobuchwepheshe. Yenza ukuvakashela iziza ukubona ukuba kuhamba kanjani emsebenzini. Qinisekisa ukuthi itholakala nini emsebenzini, qinisekisa futhi ufake izifiso eziphathelene nephrojekthi. Landela ngosizo luka District ngemali eceliwe ekhokhwa. Thumela izigqanyisi zokusayina izimali nokunganisa ezimali eceliwe PSP bese uzifaka. Bhala futhi uthumele amalebula ekuhamba kahle kwesenkontilaka ngenkathi unika izinhlangothi ezahlukene. Hlaziya futhi uqinisekise ukukhokhwa kwemali ngokutholakala kwamagugu. Hlela ukufakwa kwemibono yabantu ngokubaluleka kokuguqulwa kwayo. Hlela inkinga ethunyelwa izaziso zokungaphumeleli. Hlela bese usho amalebula ezinhlangano ezithile. Nikeza usizo kwabaxhasi bakuqoqa isibaphi ngelixa bevakashela iphrojekthi. Qondanisa isigaba sokugcina iphrojekthi. Qondisa ukuthumela ipepha elingene isigaba sokuqedwa kweprojekthi. Qinisekisa amadokhumenti adingekayo efayeleni lephrojekthi. Thola yonke imibhalo edingekayo efayeleni lephrojekthi. Thumela ifayela lephrojekthi ku-CCPM ukuze iphrojekthi iqede. Fakela izinqumo zokubuyiselwa kwephrojekthi eziyisinqumo.

xh.title: Umlawuli weNkqubo yoKwakhiwo lesiGaba a
xh.summary: Umlawuli weNkqubo yoKwakhiwo lesiGaba a eQueenstown, efuna isigaba sokufundela kwimeko yakho ekwakhiweyo nangokuqeshwa njengongcali kwiSACPCMP.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-National Higher Diploma (kwimeko yokwakha) namava abhalisiweyo angapheli kweminyaka emine (4) namaxa amathandathu okanye i-BTech (kwimeko yokwakha) nokuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi ababalayo iminyaka engapheli kwemine (4) okanye i-Honours Degree kuyo nayiphi na imeko ekwakhiweyo nolwazi olungapheli kweminyaka emithathu (3). Kuyakufuneka kubekho ukuqeshwa ngokuyimfuneko kwi-SACPCMP njengoMlawuli weNkqubo yoKwakhiwo ongocali ngexa lokwenziwa isithuba. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yasezindlwini nangendlela ezakhiweyo yomthetho. Izinga lemeko ekwakhiweyo, imigaqo ye-CIDP, ulawulo lwemali kunye noqwalaselo lwesivumelwano, nokuquuka abathintekayo kunye nomanyano lwabahlali. Amandla okunxibelelana ngelizwi elilungileyo, amandla okuqamba iinkqubo, amandla okubonisa, amandla okubhala iingxelo, nengxoxo, inkxaso, ukucoca-analitha nokucinga ngokujulileyo, kunye nolawulo lweenguquko. Amandla okusebenza eqileni. Ukuba nobugcisa bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka ube namalayisensi yokushayela asemthethweni.
xh.duties: Lawula isigaba sokuqalisa inkqubo yokwakha. Vula ifayile yenkqubo yokwakha. Nikela ingxelo ngelixa lokuphuhlisa inkqubo yokuqeshwa. Nikela ingxelo ngelixa lokuphuhlisa i-Terms of Reference (T.O.R). Lungiselela isatifikeyithi sokuhlawulela kumboneleli wesebe lezocali ngegxelo yenkqubo ekwakhiweyo. Lawula isigaba seplani nokuyilo lwenkqubo yokwakha. Lungiselela iindibano nelayisensi yokwakha eze kukhankanywa ngezikolo ezilawulayo/ekhaya konke ukunxibelelana nokuvumelana kumagqabantshintshi. Lungiselela isatifikethi sokuhlawulela i-Supply Chain Management (SCM) ngenkqubo yohlahlelo. Nikela ingxelo ngelixa lokuphuhlisa i-Service Level Agreement (SLA). Lungiselela iindibano ngeenkqubo zocali. Nikela ingxelo ngelixa lokuqala ukuyilo iziphumo zeplani. Lungiselela isatifikethi yokuhlawulela i-PSP nge-Geotech, Environmental Impact Assessment, iplani yezindlu negxelo yokuyila. Ngenisa ifayile yokuqeshwa enkqubo yoLawulo lweNgcali yokuLawula. Nikela ingxelo ngelixa lokuphuhliswa kwenkqubo yokuqeshwa kumakontraka afunekayo. Nikela ngegxelo ngelixa lokuphuhlisa (TOR) aze abuyisele kwi-Bid Specification Committee ukwamkelelwa. Lungiselela iindibano namakontraka aze kukhankanywe kunye namaphandle/asekhaya amacandelo oorhulumente banxibelelane baze bavume ngeemfuno. Nikela ngegxelo ngelixa lokuqeqesha i-SLA. Qhagamshelana nama-PSP malunga nokunikezwa i-site. Lawula isigaba senkqubo yokuqeshwa inkqubo yokuqhuba. Yiba nekxaso ekwakhiweni kweenkonzo. Yiba nekxaso ekwakhiweni kwamagumbi okuhlola ezi ngabom. Yiba nekxaso ekulungiseni amagumbi okuhlola. Bhala iileta zokumema ukwazisa abanxibelelanayo kuorhulumente. Qhagamshelana nomqeshi konjulwano loku-lungiselela ukunikwa koxwebhu. Nikela amakhophi ozobe zokwakha, ukuhlahlwa kwemigangatho, i-PIP nemigaqo ku-Control Works Inspector. Qhagamshelana nemicimbi yoLawulo ngokunxibelelana nezikwama kunye noLawulo lweqela elinceda ababhalisile ukuze kusekwe iKomiti yokuLawula iNgcali kwaye kuqatshwe iNkundla yomanyano IOfficer lungiselela inkqubo yokubeka iqhina phakathi kwabo, uluntu, namakontraka. Yenza iindibano ezingcali kwinkqubo yophuhliso. Yenza ukutyelela inkqubo yokwakha ukuze kuhlonywe inkqubo kwindawo yokwakha. Qinisekisa ixabiso elidalwe kwindawo yokwakha, qinisekisa aze alungise iindlela zenkqubo ezifuneka ngokumata. Landela inkxaso yemimandla ngokuhlawuleka kweenkqubo. Ngenisa amakhophi esatifikeyithi yokuhlawulela kwi-PSP aze abekwe kufayile. Lungiselela aze ungenise iingxelo zobugcisa bomqeshi kwikota. Hlaziya ukuze uqinisekise inkxaso malunga nexabiso elidalwe. Nikela ingxelo kwilungiselelo lokuqamba iindlela zokuguqula. Lungiselela isimemo malunga nokunika isaziso sokungasebenzi. Lungiselela aze ubonise iingxelo kumabanjulwano ahlukahlukeneyo. Nikela inkxaso kumabanjulwano ahlukahlukeneyo kwinkqubo yophononongo nokuqinisekisa. Lawula inkqubo yokuvala inkqubo yokwakha. Yiba nekxaso ekungeniseni inkqubo yokwakha kwindawo yokubeka iqhina. Qinisekisa ixwebhu elifunekayo kwifayile yenkqubo yokwakha. Zingela naxa ethile amaxwebhu afunekayo axhobileyo kwifayile yenkqubo yokwakha. Ngenisa ifayile yenkqubo yokwakha kwi-CCPM ukuze kuvalwe inkqubo yokwakha. Faka isigqibo sokuvalela inkqubo yokwakha kwifayile.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Audit
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Internal Audit at the Department of Human Settlements in East London, requiring a diploma or degree in auditing or accounting with three years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma (NQF level 6) B/ Degree (NQF level 7) in Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ BCom Accounting/ BCOMPT as recognised by SAQA with 3 years supervisory level experience in the field. Compulsory registration with the Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa. Knowledge of Public Sector governance and legislation. Knowledge of departmental policies and operational procedures, internal auditing principles, methodologies and practices, risk management principles and frameworks, financial management and accounting principles, performance information auditing and compliance auditing. Ability to analyse data. Good communication skills, project management skills, presentation skills, report writing skills, internal audit, analytical and critical thinking, investigation and evaluation. Ability to work in a team. Effective and efficient management and monitoring of organisational budget and expenditure. Computer literate. Must possess a valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the audit planning process. Identify Internal Audits planned to be conducted using the Internal Audit Plan. Request relevant Auditors for the relevant Audit assignments. Organise team briefing meetings. Create audit file on teammate. Conduct preliminary survey. Prepare memorandum for draft audit planning. Conduct pre-engagement meeting with clients. Guide and review Internal Auditors on preparation of systems descriptions, risk matrix and audit programme. Facilitate the execution of audit programme. Review the design of working paper. Monitor the day-to-day execution and completed working papers. Review exception standard report. Lead discussion of audit findings with Auditee. Supervise Internal Audit team on execution of the Audit programme. Facilitate the reporting phase of the audit. Prepare internal audit report. Present draft Internal Audit reports to the manager and attend relevant reviews. Organise closing meetings with Auditee. Communicate audit results of engagement. Review project file. Facilitate the monitoring of agreed action plans. Review and guide Internal Auditors on the implementation of agreed action plans. Update the Internal Audit Finding Register. Present draft Internal Audit reports to manager and attend relevant reviews. Draft a follow-up Internal Audit report. Communicate audit result with Auditee and Internal Audit Management. Manage resources within the directorate. Timeously develop job description. Manage performance of the directorate. Manage sound employment relations. Manage employee conditions of service. Facilitate coaching, mentorship, training, and development of sub-ordinates for effective and efficient service delivery. Establish, implement and maintain effective and efficient communication. Manage asset of the Directorate. Attend to Internal Audit, Auditor Generals RFIs, Audit Outcomes and Findings. Draft Audit Committee Chairperson Forum (ACCF) and Chief Audit Executive (CAE) reports. Update of quality assurance improvement programme.
jobs.enquiries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941/ Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842 E-Recruitment, email: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applicants must be submitted via the provincial e-recruitment system accessible at: https://ecprov.gov.za and/or at https://erecruitment.ecotp.gov.za. The Provincial e-Recruitment System is available 24/7 and closes at 23: 59 on the Closing Date. To report any e-Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00- 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address. Hand-delivered, e-Mailed, Faxed, Posted applications will not be accepted. Where applicants are not able to submit their applications on the e-recruitment system, they must physically bring printed hard copies to Human Resources office at the Head Office, and they will be assisted to capture the hard copy application on the system. The physical address is 31-33 Phillip Frame Road, Chiselhurst, East London.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Interne Oudit
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Interne Oudit by die Department of Human Settlements in East London, vereis 'n diploma of graad in oudit of rekenkunde met drie jaar se toesigervaring.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, National Diploma (NQF level 6) B/ Degree (NQF level 7) in Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ BCom Accounting/ BCOMPT soos deur SAQA erken met 3 jaar se toesigvlak-ervaring in die veld. Verpligte registrasie by die Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa. Kennis van openbare sektor se bestuur en wetgewing. Kennis van departementele beleide en operasionele prosedures, interne ouditbeginsels, -metodes en -praktyke, risikobestuurbeginsels en -raamwerke, finansiële bestuurs- en rekenkundige beginsels, prestasie-inligting-ouditering en nakomingsouditering. Vermoë om data te ontleed. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, verslagskrywingsvaardighede, interne oudit, analitiese en kritiese denke, ondersoek en evaluering. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur en monitering van organisatoriese begroting en uitgawes. Rekenaarvaardig. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die ouditbeplanningsproses. Identifiseer interne ouditte wat beplan is om uitgevoer te word deur middel van die Interne Ouditplan. Versoek tersaaklike ouditeure vir die tersaaklike oudittoewysings. Reël spaninligtingsvergaderings. Skep 'n ouditlêer op teammate. Voer 'n voorlopige opname uit. Berei 'n memorandum vir konsepouditbeplanning voor. Hou 'n vooraf-aangaan-vergadering met kliënte. Lei en hersien interne ouditeure oor die voorbereiding van stelselbeskrywings, risikomatriks en ouditprogram. Fasiliteer die uitvoering van die ouditprogram. Hersien die ontwerp van die werksdokument. Monitor die daaglikse uitvoering en voltooide werksdokumente. Hersen die uitsonderingsstandaardverslag. Lei die bespreking van ouditbevindings met die ouditee. Oorsien die interne ouditspan oor die uitvoering van die ouditprogram. Fasiliteer die rapporteringsfase van die oudit. Berei 'n interne ouditverslag voor. Bied konsep-interne ouditverslae aan die bestuurder voor en woon tersaaklike hersienings by. Reël afsluitvergaderings met die ouditee. Kommunikeer ouditresultate van die aangaan. Hersien die projeklêer. Fasiliteer die monitering van ooreengekome aksieplanne. Hersien en lei interne ouditeure oor die implementering van ooreengekome aksieplanne. Werk die Interne Ouditbevindingsregister by. Bied konsep-interne ouditverslae aan die bestuurder voor en woon tersaaklike hersienings by. Ontwerp 'n opvolg-interne ouditverslag. Kommunikeer ouditresultate met die ouditee en interne ouditbestuur. Bestuur hulpbronne binne die direktoraat. Ontwerp tydig posbeskrywings. Bestuur prestasie van die direktooraat. Bestuur goeie diensverhoudinge. Bestuur diensvoorwaardes van werknemers. Fasiliteer afrigting, mentorskap, opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes vir doeltreffende en effektiewe dienslewering. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie. Bestuur bates van die Direktoraat. Hou toesig oor interne oudit, Auditor Generals RFI's, Oudituitslae en -bevindings. Ontwerp Audit Committee Chairperson Forum (ACCF) en Chief Audit Executive (CAE) verslae. Werk die kwaliteitsversekeringsverbeteringsprogram by.

zu.title: Umkelo Ongezansi Ophethe I-Audit Yangaphakathi
zu.summary: Umkelo Ongezansi Ophethe I-audit Yangaphakathi e-Department of Human Settlements e-East London, edinga idiploma noma iziqu kwi-audit noma izibalo ezineminyaka emithathu yeziphalamvo sokuhlola abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-National Diploma (NQF level 6) B/ Degree (NQF level 7) ku-Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ BCom Accounting/ BCOMPT njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA eneminyaka engu-3 yamava ezingeni lokuhlola abasebenzi kule nsimu. Uku注册 okuyisiphothi ngo-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwe-Public Sector nomthetho. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zomnyango nezinqubo zokusebenza, izimiso zokuhlola ngaphakathi, izindlela nokwenza, izimiso zokulawula ingozi, izimiso zokulawula izimali nezibalo, ukuhlola ulwazi ngokusebenza kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhlola. Ikhono lokuhlaziya idatha. Amandla okuxhumana abalulekile, amandla okuphatha iphrojekthi, amandla okubonisa, amandla okubhala umbiko, i-audit yangaphakathi, ukucabanga kabanzi nangokuhlaziya, ukuphenya nokuhlola. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini. Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle kwezibalo ezimali zinhlangano nokuchitha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Kwenze inqubo yokuhlela i-audit. Khiqiza izi-audit ezihlelwe ukuba zenzwe kusetshenziswa i-Internal Audit Plan. Celise o-Auditors abafanele ukuba baye ezisebenzini ze-audit ezihambisana nawo. Hlela izinkomfa zokwazisa iqembu. Dala ifayela le-audit kwi-teammate. Yenza isibuyekuzo sasekuqaleni. Lungiselela imemorandhamo yohlelo lwe-audit oluyisicaphuno. Yenza inkomfa yasekuqaleni nomthengi. Qondisa futhi uhlole aba-auditor ngaphakathi ekulungiseleleni incazelo yamasistimu, i-risk matrix neprogramu ye-audit. Yenza inqubo yokuqalwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi yeprogramu ye-audit. Hlola ukwakheka kwamaphepha okusebenza. Qaphela ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke namaphepha okusebenza aquekile. Hlola umbiko ovamile wezimo ezingajwayelekile. Hola ingxoxo ngemiphumela ye-audit nodonke. Qondisa iqembu le-audit yangaphakathi ekwenzeni i-Audit programme. Yenza inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukuthi kubikwa nge-audit. Lungiselela umbiko we-audit yangaphakathi. Yethule imibiko ye-audit yangaphakathi eseyicaphuno kumphathi ubuye uye kokuhlola okuhambisana nawo. Hlela izinkomfa zokuvala nodonke. Yazisa imiphumela ye-audit yomsebenzi. Hlola ifayela lephrojekthi. Hola ukuqaphelwa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyenzekile. Hloza futhi uqondise aba-auditor ngaphakathi ekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlelo ezivunyelwe. Buyeza i-Internal Audit Finding Register. Yethula imibiko ye-audit yangaphakathi eseyicaphuno kumphathi ubuye ubambe kokuhlola okuhambisana nawo. Bhala umbiko wokuqhubeka we-audit yangaphakathi. Yazisa imiphumela ye-audit nodonke nangabaphathi be-audit yangaphakathi. Phatha izinsiza ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Hlela incazelo yomsebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele. Phatha ukusebenza kwesikhungo. Phatha ubuhlobo bokusebenza obuhle. Phatha izimo zokukhonza abasebenzi. Hola ukwelatshwa, ukulekelelwa, ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabangaphansi ukuba kwenzeke ukulethwa kwezinsiza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Saka, faka futhi gcine ukuxhumana okusebenzayo ngokusebenza kahye. Phatha izimpahla zesikhungo. Qaphela i-audit yangaphakathi, i-Auditor Generals RFIs, imiphumela nezithakazelo zoku-audit. Bhala imibiko ye-Audi Audit Committee Chairperson Forum (ACCF) kanye ne-Chief Audit Executive (CAE). Buyeza iphrogiyemu yokuthuthukiswa kokuhlolwa kwemigomo.

xh.title: Umncepheli womphathiswa: Ulwakuqwalaselo langaphakathi
xh.summary: Umncepheli womphathiswa: Ulwakuqwalaselo langaphakathi kwisebe leZicelo zabaHlali kwi-East London, lifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kukuqwalasela okanye akuqwalaselwa ngenyanga ezintathu zolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Senior seSizwe, iNational Diploma (NQF level 6) B/ Degree (NQF level 7) kwi-Risk Management/ Internal Auditing/ BCom Accounting/ BCOMPT njengoko kunyuliwe yi-SAQA namava eminyaka emi-3 kwinqanaba lolawulo kwindawo. Ukubhaliswa ngokuyimfuneko kwi-Institute of Internal Auditors South Africa. Ulwazi ngolawulo nemithetho yoluntu lwamazwe. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zemigaqo nendlela zokusebenza zesebe, iinkqubo zemigaqo, iindlela namaziko okuqwalasela ngaphakathi, iinkqubo zemigaqo nezakhiwo zolawulo lomngcipheko, imigaqo yolawulo lweemali nesibalo, ukuqwalasela ulwazi ngemigaqo yenzuzo nokuqwalasela ukuthobela. Ikhono lokuhlaluhla idatha. Amakhono abalulekileyo ekuqukenqa, amakhono olawulo lomsebenzi, amakhono abalisa, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, ulwakuqwalaselo langaphakathi, ukucinga ngokuhlaluhla nangokunzulu, uphononongo nokuqwalasela. Ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela. ULawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lonxibelelwano nolawulo lwemigangatho yemali yentlaluthe nemiselwa yemali. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Mafunekane nenkqubo yokuqhuba egunyazisiweyo.
xh.duties: Phatha inkinga yocwangciso lokuqwalasela. Chonga iindawo ezicwangciswe ukuba ziqwalaselwe ngokusebenzisa iCwangciso lokuQwalasela ngaphakathi. Cel abaqwalaseli abafanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokuqwalasela ofanelekileyo. Hlela iindibano zokwazisa iqela. Dala ifayile yokuchonga eqelweni. Yenza uphando lwangaphambili. Lungiselela imemorandam yocwangciso lokuchonga olungalunganga. Yenza indibano yangaphambili nabathengi. Qondisa kwaye uqwalasele abaQwalaseli ngaphakathi kwikulungiselelo lokuqamba iinkcazelo zesixubo, i-matrix yomngcipheko nenkqubo yokuqwalasela. Phatha inkqubo yokuqwalasela. Qwalasela ukuyila kweephepha zomsebenzi. Qwalasela isoqhaga somhlaka ekupheleni kwentsuku zonke ngeephepha zomsebenzi ezigqityiweyo. Qwalasela iingxelo ze-standard ezingalindelekanga. Qhatha iingxoxo ngeziphumo zokuqwalasela ngesiqwalaseli. Lawula iqela loQwalaselo ngaphakathi ekuphumeleleni nkwankqubo yokuqwalasela. Phatha i candelo levumba ngokuchonga. Lungiselela ingxelo yokuqwalasela ngaphakathi. Nika umbhali wengxelo ebala kwaye uhlole iindibano ezibalulekileyo. Hlela iindibano zokubetha apha ekugqibeleni neAuditee. Yazi iziphumo zokuqwalasela ndibano. Qwalasela ifayile lomsebenzi. Phatha ulawulo lweplani zemisebenzi emiselweyo. Qwalasela kwaye qondisa abaQwalaseli ngaphakathi ekuphumeleleni iinkqubo zemisebenzi emiselweyo. Hlaziya isicwangciso sokubhalisa iindawo zokuqwalasela ngaphakathi. Nikela iingxelo ebala kulawuli kwaye uze kwindibano ebalulekileyo yokuhlolela. Chonga iingxelo zokuqwalasela ngaphakathi. Yazi iziphumo zokuqwalasela ku-Auditee nakuLawulo loQwalaselo ngaphakathi. Lawula amacebo kwindawo yolawulo. Hlala ukuchaza inkinga phantse. Lawula inkqubo yomsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenzisana kubasebenzi. Lawula iimeko zabasebenzi. Phatha ukwazisa, ukukhokela, ukulungiselela nokuqhuba ngaphantsi abo kwizephi ukuze kube khona ulwazi olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo. Suka, seta kwaye ulugcine ulwazi loluntu. Lawula izinto zomsebenzi zodwela. Hlohla ingxelo ngokuqwalasela ngaphakathi, i-Auditor General's RFIs, iziphumo zokuqwalasela. Hlela amanqaku ebali leKomiti yeSihlalo, (ACCF) kwaye igqibe (CAE). Hlaziya iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ngoko kulungileyo kwexesha elide.

jobs.summary: Finance clerk providing clerical support for Human Settlements conditional grants, including payment capturing and compliance verification at the East London head office.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/NQF level 4 with accounting as a subject and no experience. Knowledge of Public Finance and Grants Frameworks, Human Settlements policy and legislative environment. Good communication skills, report writing, financial and analytical as well as the ability to work in a team.
jobs.duties: Provide clerical support in the management of Human Settlements Conditional Grants. Receive payments for capturing. Verify payments for compliance. Capture claims on Basic Accounting System. Submit project payments for authorisation. Provide clerical support in the compilation of Compliance Reports. Compile journals. Capture the journals on Basic Accounting System. Draw BAS expenditure reports. File journals after processing. Provide clerical support in the reconciliation of BAS and project payments. Receive payment stubs. Verify the correctness of amounts and banking details. Attach stubs and sort in numerical order. Reconcile BAS paid payments with Housing Subsidy System. Records management. Request for Electronic Bank Transfers (EBT) payment lists. Sort payments numerically. File the payments. Receive RFI’s and provide information to auditors, Internal and/or External stakeholders.

af.title: Finansieklerk Produksie
af.summary: Finansieklerk wat klerklike ondersteuning verskaf vir voorwaardelike toelaes van Human Settlements, insluitend die vaslegging van betalings en die verifikasie van nakoming by die hoofkantoor in East London.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate/NQF vlak 4 met rekenkunde as 'n vak en geen ervaring. Kennis van Openbare Finansies en Toelaesraamwerke, Human Settlements beleid en wetgewende omgewing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskrywing, finansiele en analitiese vermoëns asook die vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning in die bestuur van voorwaardelike toelaes van Human Settlements. Ontvang betalings vir vaslegging. Verifieer betalings vir nakoming. Lood eise op die Basic Accounting System. Dien projekbetalings vir magtiging in. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning by die opstel van Nakomingsverslae. Stel joernale op. Lood die joernale op die Basic Accounting System. Trek BAS-uitgaweverslae. Liasjoernale na verwerking. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning by die rekonsiliasie van BAS en projekbetalings. Ontvang betalingstrokies. Verifieer die korrektheid van bedrae en bankbesonderhede. Heg strokies vas en sorteer in numeriese volgorde. Rekonsilieer BAS-betaalde betalings met die Housing Subsidy System. Rekordbestuur. Versoeke vir Electronic Bank Transfers (EBT) betalingslyste. Sorteer betalings numeries. Lias die betalings. Ontvang RFI's en verskaf inligting aan ouditeurs, interne en/of eksterne belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Ikhelikandi Lezezimali Lokukhiqiza
zu.summary: Ikhelikandi lezezimali elinika inkxaso yabasebenzi bahlelo besikhulu somanyuzo kumazwe abantu abahlala ndawonye, okuhlanganisa ukubhala izimali ezikhokhwayo nokuhlolwa ukuziphatha ehhovisi eliyinhloko e-East London.
zu.requirements: Ibhodi yeminyaka yokugqoka isikole/Izinga le-NQF 4 ngaphakathi kwezifundo ezingezimali futhi kungekho ndaba yokusebenza. Ukukhalile ngokuqondene nemigomo yezimali kahulumeni kanye namagugu nemithetho yokuhlala ndawonye abantu, umthetho kanye nemithetho yokusingathwa kolwazi. Amakhono okukhuluma kahle, ukubhala imibiko, izinto eziyisibonisiwe ezingezimali kanye nokuqonda okungalawuleka kanye nethonyi lokusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yohlelo olubalulekile ekuphathweni kwamazwe abantu abahlala ndawonye abaphathwa ngaphansi kwemithetho. Thola izimali eziza kubhalwa. Hlola izimali ukuze zihambisane nemithetho. Bhala izifundo ezikhokhwayo kuhlelo lokubhala imali ekuqondile. Hambisa izimali zezinhlelo kumuntu onikezwe amandla. Nikeza inkxaso yohlelo emaqoqweni emibiko yesimiso semithetho. Qamba imibhalo yemali ehamba phambili. Bhala imibhalo yemali ehamba phambili kuhlelo lokubhala imali ekuqondile. Khishela imibiko yokuchithwa kwemali kuhlelo lokubhala imali ekuqondile. Faka iziqu imibhalo yemali ehamba phambili emva kokubhalwa. Nikeza inkxaso yohlelo ekuqondaniseni imali ephethwe yisimiso nokuhamba kwemali kwezinhlelo. Thola izimpawu zezimali ezikhokhwayo. Hlola ukuthi imali idinga ukuthi ibe yisihle kanye nemininingwane yasebhange. Namathisela izimpawu futhi uzibe ngokwenani. Qondanisa imali ekhokhiwe nge-BAS ngesimiso esiphathe izimali ezinikezwa abantu abafuna izindlu. Imigomo yokuqopha imininingwane. Celu amabhange abhalela ukuthumela imali (EBT) ohlwini. Hlola izimali ngokwenani. Faka izimali ezikhokhwayo. Thola izibuzo ezithunyelwe futhi unikeze ulwazi abahlobi bangaphakathi bese kuthi noma bangaphandle bathole ukwaziswa okuthunyelwe.

xh.title: Inkxaso yemali yokuvelisa
xh.summary: Inkxaso yemali ebonelela ngokuxhaswa okulolu lwemibhalo kumazwe abantu afana nemali emisho yeentlobo ezahlukeneyo kwiNgingqi yezeMiziyo, kuquka nokubhala iimali ezihlawulwayo kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuzithobela kolawulo kwindlu enkulu e-East London.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi samabanga aphezulu esizwe/NQF inqanaba 4 ene-accounting njengesihloko kwaye akukho noluvuyo. Ulwazi lwezeMali kaRhulumente nemimiselo yeMali emiweyo, iNgingqi yezeMiziyo nemigaqo yolawulo. Amakhono amnini ekunxibelelanani, ukubhala iingxelo, amakhono ezoqhakamshelwano nokuqhakamshelwa ngokuchanekileyo, kunye namandla okusebenza eqeleni.
xh.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yemali ekulawulweni kweMali emisho yeentlobo ezahlukeneyo ezeMiziyo zezeNtu. Yamkela iimali ezihlawulwayo zokubhala. Qinisekisa iimali ezihlawulwayo ukuzinika isiqiniseko sokuzithobela. Bhala iindleko kwisiChongo esiseSiseko seAccounts. Thumela iimali ezihlawulwayo zeeprojekthi ezindlebeni ukuze zivunywe. Nikeza inkxaso yemali ekuyileni iNgxelo eQinisekisa ulawulo. Qamba amajornali. Bhala amajornali kwisiChongo esiseSiseko seAccounts. Tyhila iingxelo zokuSebenzisa imali evela kwi-BAS. Faka amajornali emibhalweni emva kokugqitywa kwentsubo. Nikeza inkxaso yemali ekwenzeni uqeqesho olubuyela umva phakathi kwe-BAS neentlawulo zeprojekthi. Yamkela iipayisi ezihlawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo kwamaxabiso kunye neenkcukacha ze-akhawunti yebhanki. Namathisela iipayisi kwaye uzihlele ngokulandelelana kwamani. Yenza uqeqesho olubuyela umva phakathi kwamahlawulo e-BAS ahlawuliweyo nesiChongo seSubsidi yeNdlu. Lalwele ekuphathweni kwemibhalo. Celisa iindululo zemali ezihamba ngekhompyutha (EBT) kuluhlu lweentlawulo. Hlela iimali ngokulandelelana kwamani. Faka iimali emibhalweni. Yamkela i-RFI kwaye unikeze ulwazi kubagqatsi beendawo zokuqonda, abangaphakathi kwaye/noma abangaphandle abanomdla.

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Behuisingssubsidiestelsels
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig by die Department of Human Settlements se hoofkantoor in East London om skriftelike ondersteuning aan die Behuisingssubsidiestelsels-eenheid te verleen.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/NQF vlak 4 sonder werkervaring. Moet oor goeie kommunikasievaardighede (spraak en skrif), werkskennis, interpersoonlike verhoudings en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk beskik. Rekenaarvaardig en die vermoë tot beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Verleen algemene skriftelike ondersteuningsdienste aan die Human Settlements Subsidy Systems-eenheid. Neem korrespondensie en data op, organiseer dit, stoor dit, vang dit in en haal dit terug. Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostatiese kopieë en ontvang korrespondensie. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf toeleweringsketen-skriftelike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaardkantoorartikels. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf personeeladministrasie-skriftelike ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Vang besteding in die komponent in en werk dit by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaans- en reiselaime van amptenare en dien dit by bestuurder in vir goedkeuring.

zu.title: Inkantili Yopholulo: Izinhlelo Zesibonezelo Sezindlu
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkantili Yopholulo eNqobokazini Yezindlu Ezisetshenziswa Ngabantu e East London ukunikeza inkxaso yocwaningo ohlakeni lwezinhlelo Zesibonezelo Sezindlu.
zu.requirements: Izifundo eziphakeme zeSizwe/NQF level 4 ngaphandle kokulinganisela okuhle kokusebenza. Kudingeka kube nokuzwana okuhle ngokuvakalayo nokubhalayo, ulwazi lwomsebenzi, ubuhlobo bangabanye abantu kanye namandla okusebenza ohlakeni. Kudingeka kubaleke kahle okukhompyutheni kanye nemandla okuhlela futhi aqambe ngokulandelana.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yocwaningo evamile ohlakeni lwezinhlelo Zesibonezelo Sezindlu Ezisetshenziswa Ngabantu. Qophela, hlela, gcine, biza futhi ususe imibhalo kanye nezibalo. Bukela amabhalo nezibalo. Phendula imibuzo eqhelekile. Yenza amakhophi futhi wamukele imibhalo. Yabelana namadokhumenti/amasenthi ohlelo kubathintana abanengi njengoba kudingekwayo. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ohlelo lokuqophela ngaphakathi kwehlabathi kule ngxenye. Thayipha amagama namhlanje kanye namabhalo ngaphandle kwehlabathi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ihhovisi legunya lezindlu kanye nezinsiza zohlelo lwehlelo. Hlinzeka ngokusebenza kwamabhuloho ngesibonezelo kule ngxenye. Thinta ngaphakathi nangaphandle nalabo abahlangene ngokuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinkonzo. Thola izinkomba, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga amadokhumenti ohhovisi angavamanga. Lawula isitashi sehlabathi kule ngxenye. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ihhovisi lehlelo kule ngxenye. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amadokhumenti abasebenzi kule ngxenye. Gcina futhi ulondoloze amabhukho okuza nokuhamba kule ngxenye. Hlela ukuhamba kanye nendawo yokulala. Hlinzeka ngokusebenza ngokuhlelwa kwemali kule ngxenye. Qophela futhi ubukele imali ekhishiwe kule ngxenye. Hlola ukuzenzakalayo kwezimali zokuhamba zomuntu oqashiwe futhi uzinikeze ongqongqoshe ukuba azivume.

xh.title: Clerk ye-Administration: Iinkqubo ze-Housing Subsidy
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Clerk ye-Administration kwiNtloko ye-Office ye-Department of Human Settlements e-East London ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yoncwadi kwicandelo leenkqubo ze-Housing Subsidy.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate/NQF level 4 akukho nyaniso lolusebenzayo. Kufuneka ube namakhono amabalawulwimi (olwomlomo nolubhaliweyo), ulwazi ngomsebenzi, uqhathaniso labantu nobuchule bokusebenza eqela. Kufuneka ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nakho kukwazi ukucwangcisa nokulungelelanisa izinto.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yoncwadi ngokubanzi kwicandelo le-Human Settlements Subsidy Systems. Qamba, lungelelanisa, zigcine, uzibandakanye aze uze ulolule uncwadi nolwazi. Hlaziya iirejista namanani. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikhopi ezibhaliweyo waze wamkele oncwadi. Saziwa amaxwebhu/empahla kubahlali-beenkqubo abahlukeneyo njengoko kudingekiwa. Gcina ulungelelanise inkqubo yokugcina iifayile yelicandelo. Bhala iileta nokuba oncwadi olunye xa kudingeka. Gcina ulungelelanise iirejista yamaxwebhu angena aphuma kwelicandelo. Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yoncwadi ye-supply chain ngaphakathi kwelicandelo. Thetha nabahlali-beenkqubo bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayela nentengo yemihla noloncedo. Landa iintengo, gcwalisa iifomu zentengo yokuthenga izinto zeqhotyoshelo ezisemgangathweni. Lawula isitoko sezixhobo zeqhotyoshelo. Gcina ulungelelanise iirejista yempahla yelicandelo. Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yoncwadi yolawulo lwabantu ngaphakathi kwelicandelo. Gcina ulungelelanise iirekhodi zabantu kwelicandelo. Gcina ulungelelanise iirejista yokubakho kwelicandelo. Lungiselela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo lweemali kwelicandelo. Zibandakandise uhluze iindleko kwelicandelo. Hlola ukuchaneka kweesafiso zokuhamba nezokutya zabasebenzi uzithumele kumanejala ukuba zamkele.

To report any e-Recruitment System challenges send an email with your (i) ID Number, (ii) profile email address, (iii) details of your issue to: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za. Do not send any applications to this email address; should you do so, your applications/ CV will be regarded as lost and will not be considered. Technical support is limited to working hours: (08:00- 16:30 Mon-Thursday and 08:00-16:00 on Friday). Direct all enquiries to the specified enquiries person or email Address. Hand-delivered, e-Mailed, Faxed, Posted applications will not be accepted. Where applicants are not able to submit their applications on the e-recruitment system, they must physically bring printed hard copies to Human Resources office at the Head Office, and they will be assisted to capture the hard copy application on the system. The physical address is 31-33 Phillip Frame Road, Chiselhurst, East London.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: Z83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Administrasieklerk: Behuisingseiendomsbestuur
af.summary: Administrasieklerk word in Mthatha benodig om administratiewe ondersteuning te verleen, rekords te bestuur en roetine-navrae vir die Department of Human Settlements te hanteer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/NQF vlak 4 met geen werkervaring. Moet oor goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), werkkennis, interpersoonlike verhoudings en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk beskik. Rekenaarvaardig en die vermoë tot beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Verleen algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste (lynfunksie). Rekord, organiseer, berg, vang en onttrek korrespondensie en data. Werk registers en statistieke by. Hanteer roetine-navrae. Maak fotostaatkopieë en ontvang korrespondensie. Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis. Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent. Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis. Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent. Verskaf voorsieningsketting-administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes met betrekking tot die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaardkantooritems. Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie. Hou en onderhou die batesregister van die komponent. Verskaf personeeladministrasie-administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste binne die komponent. Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die komponent. Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die komponent. Reël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie-ondersteuningsdienste in die komponent. Vang en werk besteding in die komponent by. Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestaan- en reis ede van amptenare en dien by bestuurder vir goedkeuring in.

zu.title: Iklerka Yokuphathe: Ukuphathwa Kwakho Kwezindlu
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklerka yokuphathe eMthatha ukunikeza inkxaso yomsebenzi weklerka, ukuphatha amarekhodi nokuphatha imibuzo evamile kwiDepartment of Human Settlements.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate/ NQF level 4 ngaphandle kokuhlale kahle emsebenzini. Kumele ube nobuhlakani bokuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ulwazi ngomsebenzi, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu nendlela yokusebenza eqenjini. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngakwikhompyutha kanye nokuba nendlela yokucubungula nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngemisebenzi yamagunya ejwayelekile (Line function). Qophela, hlela, gcina, bhala futhi uthole ukuxhumana nemininingwane. Mukela futhi uvuse amarejista nokubalo. Phatha imibuzo evamile. Yenza amakhophi uthole futhi ukuxhumana okufakwayo. Sabela amadokhumenti/amasangciwo kubahlali abahlukene njengoba kudingekayo. Gcina futhi ukugcina uhlelo lokuclaulula ngaphakathi kwenhlokondlela. Bhala oonobhaxa nakho okunye ukuxhumana uma kudingeka. Gcina futhi ukugcina ukufakwa nokukhishwa kwamadokhumenti enhlokondlela. Nikeza ngamasevisi okusiza okunxulumene nenhlangano yokuhlinzeka ngaphakathi kwenhlokondlela. Xhumana nabahlali bangaphakathi nangaphandle kwenhlokondlela mayelana nokuthenga impahla namasevisi. Thola izinkomba, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga ukuthenga izinto zesikhungo eziqavile. Lawula isitoko sezinto zesikhungo. Gcina futhi ukugcina ukuphatheka kwempi futhi ukulawula amarekhodi abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlokondlela. Gcina futhi ukulawula amarekhodi abasebenzi enhlokondlela. Gcina futhi ukulawula irejista labantu ababekhona enhlokondlela. Hlela ukuhamba nendawo yokulala. Nikeza ngokwesekwa kokuphatheka kwemali enhlokondlela. Mukela futhi uvuse ukuchithwa kwemali enhlokondlela. Hlola ukulungile kokufuna kokuhamba nokudla kwabasebenzi uthumele kumaneja ukuze uvume.

xh.title: Clerk olulawula izinto: Ulawulo lweZakhiwo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kwindawo ye Mthatha, kusetyenziswa njengenkxaso yabasebenzi abalungiselela amanani. Kufuneka kubekho iNqanaba le 4 leNqaku leSizwe; le nto iyayaziwa njengeNqanaba leNqaku leSizwe. Le nto iyayaziwa njengenkxaso yabasebenzi. Umsebenzi wakhe kukubeka abantu ababhalwe kwindawo ababhalwa kuyo, ukubamba amanye amanani, nokuqwalasela iimfuno ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi eNqanaba le-4 le-NQF ngaphandle komsebenzi ozenzayo. Kufuneka uchume ngokubeka izinto ezibalwe ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Kufuneka uchume ngokubeka izinto ezahlukeneyo, uchume ngokubeka izinto ezahlukeneyo, uchume ngokubeka izinto ezahlukeneyo. Uchume ngokubeka izinto ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Ukuba inkxaso kubasebenzi abaninzi. Ukubeka, ukuhlela, ukugcina, ukubamba nokukhupha iindlela zokubhalisa nedatha. Ukulungisa izinto ezahlukeneyo nezibalwayo. Ukuphendula imibuzo edliwayo. Ukwenza amakhophi nokwamkela iindlela zokubhalisa. Ukusasaza amaxwebhu/izixhobo kubasebenzi ababaliweyo njengoko kufuneka. Ukugcina nokuqhakambisa inkqubo yokubeka amaxwebhu kwindawo ethile. Ukubhala iileta nezinye iindlela zokubhalisa xa kufuneka. Ukugcina nokuqhakambisa irejista yamaxwebhu angena naphuma kwindawo. Ukunikela ngenkxaso kwindawo ethile malunga nokuhlawulela izinto nezinye izixhobo. Ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngokuhlawulela izinto. Ukufumana ixabiso, ukugcwalisa iifomu zokuhlawulela izinto zendalo zoluntu. Ukulawula ukugcinwa kwamaxwebhu kohlobo. Ukugcina nokuqhakambisa irejista yezixhobo kwindawo ethile. Ukunikela ngenkxaso kwindawo ethile. Ukugcina nokuqhakambisa amaxwebhu abasebenzi. Ukugcina nokuqhakambisa irejista yokubakho kwindawo ethile. Ukulungisa ukunyuka kwindlela nokuhlala. Ukunikela ngenkxaso kwindawo ethile. Ukubamba nokuqhakambisa amaxabiso kwindawo ethile.

jobs.title: HR Clerk Production: HRP Information Systems and HRA
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: HR clerk at the Department of Human Settlements in East London administering recruitment and selection processes at salary level 5.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/NQF level 4 with no experience. Knowledge of government policies and prescripts, recruitment and selection process, conditions of service and employee benefits, personnel administration, electronic HR systems, records and document management and performance management. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Good interpersonal relationships and ability work in a team. Computer literate and time management.
jobs.duties: Administer the recruitment, selection and appointments. Receive and verify applications for compliance with advertisement requirements. Maintain and update recruitment master lists and vacancy tracking systems. Prepare documents and provide secretariat support for shortlisting and interview processes. Conduct reference checks, qualifications verifications and other screening activities. Prepare appointment and regret letters. Capture and process approved personnel transaction on PERSAL. Maintain accurate recruitment and appointment records. Administer conditions of service and employee benefits. Process salary structuring, allowances, pay progression and related benefits on PERSAL. Provide advice and guidance to employees on conditions of service and remuneration matters. Process housing, travel, acting and other approved employment benefits. Monitor compliance with applicable collective agreements, directives and policies governing conditions of service. Administer movements and service transactions. Administer transfers, relocations, secondments, promotions and other employee movements. Process appointments, terminations and service status changes on PERSAL. Verify the accuracy and completeness of supporting documentation for service transactions. Administer the implementation of approved employee movements and related personnel actions. Administer Human Resource information and records. Capture, update and maintain employee information on PERSAL. Prepare and submit HR documentation for record management and audit purposes. Maintain proper filing and safekeeping of all personnel records and transaction documents.
