af.title: HR Klerk Produksie: HRP Inligtingstelsels en HRA
af.summary: HR klerk by die Department of Human Settlements in East London wat werwerings- en seleksieprosesse op salarisvlak 5 administreer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/NQF vlak 4 sonder ervaring. Kennis van regeringsbeleid en voorskrifte, werwerings- en seleksieproses, diensvoorwaardes en werknemervoordele, personeeladministrasie, elektroniese HR stelsels, rekord- en dokumentbestuur en prestasiebestuur. Vermoë om vertroulike inligting met diskresie te hanteer. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Rekenaarvaardig en tydbestuur.
af.duties: Administreer die werwering, seleksie en aanstellings. Ontvang en verifieer aansoeke vir nakoming van advertensievereistes. Onderhou en werk werwingshooflyste en vakature-opvolgstelsels by. Berei dokumente voor en verskaf sekretariaatsondersteuning vir kortlyst- en onderhoudprosesse. Voer verwysingskontroles, kwalifikasieverifikasies en ander siftingsaktiwiteite uit. Berei aanstellings- en spytbriewe voor. Vang en verwerk goedgekeurde personeeltransaksies op PERSAL. Onderhou akkurate werwerings- en aanstellingsrekords. Administreer diensvoorwaardes en werknemervoordele. Verwerk salarisstrukturering, toelaes, salarisvordering en verwante voordele op PERSAL. Verskaf advies en leiding aan werknemers oor diensvoorwaardes en vergoedingsake. Verwerk behuising, reis, waarneming en ander goedgekeurde werknemersvoordele. Monitor nakoming van toepaslike kollektiewe ooreenkomste, direktiewe en beleid wat diensvoorwaardes reël. Administreer bewegings en dienstransaksies. Administreer oorplasings, herlokaliserings, tweedings, bevorderings en ander werknemersbewegings. Verwerk aanstellings, beëindigings en diensstatusveranderinge op PERSAL. Verifieer die akkuraatheid en volledigheid van ondersteunende dokumentasie vir dienstransaksies. Administreer die implementering van goedgekeurde werknemersbewegings en verwante personeelaksies. Administreer Menslike Hulpbronne-inligting en -rekords. Vang, werk en onderhou werknemersinligting op PERSAL. Berei en dien HR-dokumentasie vir rekordbestuur en ouditdoeleindes in. Onderhou behoorlike lêerwerk en veilige bewaring van alle personeelrekords en transaksiedokumente.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokulungisa Iminyuzo Yabasebenzi Ekukhiqizweni: Amasistimu Wolwazi We-HRP Ne-HRA
zu.summary: Umkhiqizi wokulungisa iminyuzo yabasebenzi e-Department of Human Settlements e-East London elawula inqubo yokubumba nabantu abakhethiwe nangemuva kokukhetwa esikhundleni seholo izinga 5.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatimu aphakeme ezikole/izinga le-NQF 4 ngaphandle kokutholakala komsebenzi. Ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo zikahulumbe nemiyalo yokusebenza, inqubo yokubumba nabantu abakhethiwe nangemuva kokukhetwa, izimo zokusebenza nezinzuzo zabasebenzi, ukulawulwa kwabasebenzi, amasistimu we-eHR, ukuphathwa kwemibhalo namadokhumenti kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Ikono lokuphatha imininingwane eyingimfihlo ngokuqapha okuhle. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu kanye nenkono yokusebenza njengosebenza ndawonye. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Lawula inqubo yokubumba abantu, abakhethiwe nangemuva kokukhetwa kanye nohlelo lokubeka abantu ezikhundleni. Thola futhi uqinisekise imibhalo yokufaka isicelo ukuthi ihambisana nezidingo ezibekiwe ezimemezweni. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze uhlu olukhulu lwabantu ababumbayo kanye nama-systems okulandela izikhundla ezize. Lungisa amadokhumenti futhi unikeze inkxaso eyisibonelo esimweni sokwenza uhlu lwabantu abafanelekile kanye nezinketho zokubuzwa imibuzo. Yenza ukuzivikela ngokubheka izinkomba, ukuqinisekisa izifundo kanye namanye amasevisi okuhlola. Lungisa imibhalo yokubeka abantu ezikhundleni kanye namagama ethweswe iziqu. Faka futhi uhlele izinqubo zokusebenza zabantu eziyivezi e-PERSAL. Gcina imibhalo eqinisekisiwe yokubumba abantu nokuqaswa. Lawula izimo zokusebenza kanye nezinzuzo zabasebenzi. Hlela izinkomba zokuqashwa kwezimali, izimali ezongezwayo, ukuthuthuka kokukhokha kwezimali nezinye izinzuzo eziyingqayizivele e-PERSAL. Nikeza izeluleko nokuqondisa abasebenzi ngemayelana nezimo zokusebenza nemibuzo yemali etholwa ngokusebenza. Hlela izinhlobonhlobo ezingezwa, izinhlobonhlobo ezikokela, ukusebenza ngendlela yesikhashana kanye nezinye izinzuzo zokusebenza eziyiveziwe. Bheka ukuthi kuhambisana yini nezivumelwano zomqulu, izinkomba nezinqubomgomo ezibeka izimo zokusebenza. Lawula izinqubo zokunyakaza kwabasebenzi kanye nezinye izinqubo zokusebenza. Lawula ukudluliswa kolwazi, ukushintshwa kolwazi, ukubekwa kwabanye ngokwesikhashana, ukukhushulwa kwezikhundla kanye nanjalo ukunyakaza kwabanye abasebenzi. Hlela ukubekwa ezikhundleni, ukusikiwa kwenqubo yokusebenza kanye nokushintshwa kwebanga lokusebenza e-PERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti okusekela asemthethweni futhi afanele ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zokusebenza. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kokunyakaziswa kwabasebenzi okuyiveziwe kanye nezinye izenzo ezihlobene nabasebenzi. Lawula imininingwane namadokhumenti e-Human Resource. Faka, buyekeza futhi ugcine imininingwane yabasebenzi e-PERSAL. Lungisa futhi uhambise imibhalo ye-HR ngenhloso yokugcina imibhalo nokwenza isibuyekezo. Gcina kahle ukulungiselelwa kwayo yonke imibhalo yabasebenzi namadokhumenti okusebenza.

xh.title: Umphononxi we-HR Okuveliswa: Iinkqubo zeLwazi ze-HRP ne-HRA
xh.summary: Umphononxi we-HR eSebeni lezeZolimo eEast London elilawula iinkqubo zokungena nokukhetha kumvuzo onqwenaba 5.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior National/NQF level 4 ngaphandle koluvo. Ulwazi ngeenkqazo zikarhulumente neziphako, inqubo yokungena nokukhetha, iimeko zoluleko neenzuzo zabasebenzi, ulawulo lwabasebenzi, iinkqubo ze-HR zeslabhalabhovu, ulawulo lwerekhodi namaxwebhu, nolawulo lokusebenza. Ikhono lokusingatha iinkcukacha ezimfihlo ngesazela sentlupheko. Iintlobano ezilumkileyo nabantu nekhono lokusebenza ngesigqeba. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha nolawulo lwexesha.
xh.duties: Lawula ukungena, ukukhetha nokumiswa kwabasebenzi. Yamkela ukuqinisekisa izicelo ngokuthi zihambelana noko kulindelwe kwisikwangaxa. Phatha uhlaziye uluhlu oluyinkosi lokungena kunye neenkqubo zokucofa iidawo. Lungela amaxwebhu unike inkxaso yesiklweditsi kwiinkqubo zokubeka kuluhlu olufutshane nokuqhweswa. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kweesalathiso, ukuqinisekiswa kwezifundo nanye imisebenzi yokucwangcisa. Lungela amagama okumiswa oonoxhala nokuzila. Faka uqalise iinkqubo zobuntu ezivunyelwe kwiPERSAL. Phatha izithuba ezichanekileyo zokungena nokuqeshwa. Lawula iimeko zoluleko neenzuzo zabasebenzi. Qhuba uqwalaselo lomvuzo, izibonelelo, inkqubela yokuhlawula nezinye izibonelelo ezinxulumeneyo kwiPERSAL. Nike izalathiso nokuqonda abasebenzi ngamayala avela kuqeqesho nemikhawulo yemisebenzi. Qhuba amaxwebhu okuhamba, okuhamba, okumiswe ixesha kunye nezinye izibonelelo ezivunyelwe. Qwalasela ukuthobela isivumelwano esithethwayo, iinkqazo neenkqazo ezilawula iimeko zoluleko. Lawula iintshukumo kunye neenkqubo zoluleko. Lawula ukudityaniswa, ukutshintsha iindawo, ukumiselwa kwezinye iindawo, ukukhethwa ngokusemthethweni ngenxa yokukhethwa ezikwelo elingentla, kunye nezinye iintshukumo zabasebenzi. Qhuba uqalise ukumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukususa kwindlela yokusebenza nokutshintsha isimo sabasebenzi kwiPERSAL. Qinisekisa ukuchanekileyo nokuzaliseka kwamaxwebhu okuqinisekisa ngokwemisebenzi ephathwayo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kweentshukumo zabasebenzi ezivunyelweyo ezikwimisebenzi elungileyo. Lawula ulwazi neerekhodi zoluleko lwabasebenzi. Phatha, hlaziya zigcine iinkcukacha zabasebenzi kwiPERSAL. Lungela unike amaxwebhu e-HR ngolawulo lweerekhodi ngenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukucothula. Gcina ukubeka kwemifayile yokhuseleko lwayo onke amaxwebhu abasebenzi kunye namaxwebhu eentshukumo.

Knowledge of filing systems, document classification, indexing and retrieval processes. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information. Computer literate and the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered files. af.title: HR-Registrateurklerk Produksie: HRP-inligtingstelsels
af.summary: Daar word gesoek na 'n HR-Registrateurklerk vir die Departement of Human Settlements se hoofkantoor in East London om registratuur-toonbankdienste te verskaf en korrespondensie te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/NQF-vlak 4 sonder enige ervaring. Kennis van registratuurbestuur, rekordbestuur en argiefpraktyke. Kennis van liasseringsisteme, dokumentklassifikasie, indeksering en onttrekkingsprosesse. Vermoe om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en sensitiewe inligting te hanteer. Rekenaarvaardig en die vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal.
af.duties: Verskaf registratuur-toonbankdienste. Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle HR-verwante korrespondensie. Sorteer, registreer en stuur korrespondensie uit. Lewer 'n doeltreffende lassering- en rekordbestuursdiens. Maak lêers oop en toe volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Liasseer/bewaar, spoor (elektronies/onder hand) op en onttrek dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bedien ouditeure en versoeke van interne/eksterne belanghebbendes om inligting. Prosesseer dokumente vir argivering en vernietiging. Skandeer lêers elektronies. Sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om te argiveer en stuur dit aan die toesighouer. Hou rekords van gearchiveerde dokumente.

zu.title: Umlobi Wesikhungo Sezokubhaliswa Kwe-HR Ekuqoqweni: Izinhlelo Zolwazi Le-HRP
zu.summary: Kufunwa umlobi wesikhungo sezokubhaliswa kwe-HR osebenzela Ekhaya Lenhliko Yezezolimo Nabahlali e-East London ukuze anikeze izinkonzo zecawu lezokubhaliswa alawule unxibelelwano.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samabanga Aphakemei Sezwe/ NQF level 4 ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ukwazi ngokuphathwa kwezokubhaliswa, okuphathwayo kokuqopha futhi kwenziwa izikhathi. Ukwazi mayelana nezinhlela zokulungiselela amafayela, ukuhlukaniswa kwemibhalo, ukuqoqa kanye nokuqoqa kwaye edle imigomo. Isidluliselo ngokuvumela imfihlo nokusizaemibalwelana bafakwayo. Ukwenza okusemthethweni kwaye udle ngokusinda kwamanani edlule koyile futhi ushiya ukudla okuyiphupha ekugcineni.
zu.duties: Ukunika izinkonzo zokuqamba amacawu ezokubhaliswa. Uphathe amakhasimedi. Ulungele imibuzo ngocingo noma kwenye indlela etholakalayo. Wakhamukele bese ubhalisa amafayela alandelwe isandla. Yonke imibhalo engena naphuma. Yamkele konke imibhalo ehlobene ne-HR. Yahlukanise, yibhalise bese uyithumela imibhalo. Unikeze inkonzo yokuqoqwa kwezinsiza kahle. Vula bese uvula amafayela ngokohlelo lokwaziswa kwemibhalo. Yifake/yigcine, ulandele (ngokuqhutywa ngokubhalwa/tyala yedle) bese uyithola imibhalo kanye namafayela. Qedela amakhadi okubhalisa kwaqo wonke amafayela. Yenzele abahloli, bantu bangaphakathi/aphandle isicelo sezokwaziswa. Thumela amafayela kwindawo yokulondolozwa kanye nokulahla. Thwebula amafayela ngesidluliselo. Hlukanisa bese uyibhokisele amafayela endaweni yokugcina nokusatshiswa. Hlela uhlu lwemibhalo okumele igcinwe uyithumele komphathi. Gcina imibhalo yamafayela angosizi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokubhalisa Kwe-HR Ekwenzeni: Iinkqubo Ze-HRP
xh.summary: Kufunekiwa umntu ongumsekeli wobhaliso lwe-HR kwiNtloko Yesebe LezeNdlu Zakuyo e-East London ukuze anikeze iinkonzo zesiko yobhaliso alawule unxibelelwano.
xh.requirements: National Senior Certificate/ NQF level 4 ngaphandle kokugqithela. Ulwazi ngolawulo lobhaliso, ulawulo lwerekotha namasiko obhaliso. Ulwazi lweendlela zokugcina amaphepha, ukwahlula amaxwebhu, ukwenza inkqubo yokukhangela nokubuyisela iirekotha. Ikhono lokugcina iyimfihlo kwaye uphathwe iinkcukacha ezibuhali. Ukubahluleleka ekusebenizeni ikhompyutha nere kiwano lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo lweze nangexesha elimisiweyo.
xh.duties: Nika amacandelo obhaliso iinkonzo. Yeba ngakumbi ngabakhixi-magumbi. Yiba ngokubhekisele ekuthetheni kubaninzi koluntu nabanye bafun umbuzo elifunyenwe. Yamkele kwaye ubhale iifayili eziletlwe ngesandla. Yiba ngokusingatha iindaba ezithi zikqamke kanye nezithi zihumbe. Yiba ngokuthenga yonke indada eliquka izinto ezidibana ne-HR. Yiba ngokucwangcisa, ubhale kwaye usasaze iindaba. Yiba ngokubonelela ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yokugcina amaphepha nerekotha. Vula kwaye uvale amaxwebhu ngokwemilinganiselo yokwahlula amaxwebhu. Yiba ngokucwangcisa/yokugcina amaphepha ulandele (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) kwaye ubuyisele amaxwebhu kwaye amaxesha amaninzi iifayili. Gqiba iikhadi ezichaza iindlela ezininzi iifayili. Yiba ngokwamkela iindaba ezivela kubagqibi-mali, kubantu bangaphakathi nabangaphandle iinkonzo ngokubathinta. Yiba ngokulungiselela amaxwebhu okuya enkqubo yokugcina ixesha elide nendlela yokuyohlala ngokugqibeleleyo. Skeni amaxwebhu ngekhompyutha. Yiba ngokucwangcisa kwaye uphake iifayili ezizakuwo hamba kwindawo zokugcina ixesha elide kwaye kwindawo ezizakuwo sasazwa. Yila uludwe lwamaxwebhu okuza kugcinwa ixesha elide kwaye uze kuwo nikwe ingcamango. Gcina iirekotha zamaxwebhu agciniweyo ixesha elide.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerk Production: Organisational Design
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk needed at the Department of Human Settlements Head Office in East London to provide clerical support, maintain records and draft routine correspondence.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, NQF level 4 with no experience. Knowledge of office administration procedures and record management, confidentiality and handling of official information. Good communication skills (written and verbal) and computer literate. Ability to work in a team and with collaborations, attention to detail, time management and customer care.
jobs.duties: Provide clerical support to the unit. Draft routine memoranda, letters, submissions and administrative reports. Maintain registers, filling systems and administrative records for the unit. Photocopy, scan, print and distribute documents as required. Follow up on outstanding documents and provide feedback to the supervisor. Render records and information management support services to the unit. Open, update and maintain physical and electronic files in line with records management requirements. Capture and update information relating to structures, job descriptions, job evaluation and service excellence activities. Maintain databases, spreadsheets and tracking tools for the unit. Retrieve records and provide information to officials when required. Ensure safekeeping and confidentiality of official records. Provide logistical and secretariat support. Arrange meetings, venues, attendance registers and related logistical requirements. Prepare and distribute agendas, meeting packs and supporting documents. Records minutes, decisions and action items during meetings when required. Follow up on action items and update tracking registers. Render support with the coordination of workshops, awareness sessions and stakeholder engagements. Provide general office, procurement and stakeholder support. Render support with requisitions, stationery requests and basic procurement administration. Receive and direct enquiries from internal and external stakeholders. Maintain office equipment usage records and report faults to the relevant unit. Render support in the circulation, signing and filing of job descriptions, plans, reports and submissions. Compile routine administrative updates for the supervisor.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk Produksie: Organisasionele Ontwerp
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by die Department of Human Settlements-hoofkantoor in East London om klerklike ondersteuning te bied, rekords te onderhou en roetine-korrespondensie op te stel.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, NQF-vlak 4 sonder ervaring. Kennis van kantooradministrasieprosedures en rekordbestuur, vertroulikheid en hantering van amptelike inligting. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling) en rekenaarvaardig. Vermoë om in 'n span en met samewerking te werk, aandag aan detail, tydbestuur en klienediens.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning aan die eenheid. Stel roetine-memoranda, briewe, voorleggings en administratiewe verslae op. Onderhou registers, lêerstelsels en administratiewe rekords vir die eenheid. Fotokopieer, skandeer, druk en versprei dokumente soos vereis. Volg uitstaande dokumente na en verskaf terugvoer aan die toesighouer. Lewer rekord- en inligtingsbestuurondersteuningsdienste aan die eenheid. Maak, werk enige bywerk en onderhou fisiese en elektroniese lêers in ooreenstemming met rekordbestuursvereistes. Vang inligting rakende strukture, werksbeskrywings, werks evaluering en diensuitnemendheidsaktiwiteite in en werk dit by. Onderhou databasisse, sigblaaie en nasporingsnutsmiddels vir die eenheid. Haal rekorde op en verskaf inligting aan amptenare wanneer vereis. Verseker veilige bewaring en vertroulikheid van amptelike rekords. Verskaf logistieke en sekretariaatondersteuning. Reël vergaderings, plekke, bywoningsregisters en verwante logistieke vereistes. Berei en versprei agenda's, vergaderingspakke en ondersteunende dokumente voor. Neem notule, besluite en aksiepunte tydens vergaderings op wanneer vereis. Volg aksiepunte na en werk nasporingsregisters by. Lewer ondersteuning met die koördinering van werkswinkels, bewustheidsessies en belanghebbendesbetrekkinge. Verskaf algemene kantoor-, verkrygings- en belanghebbendeondersteuning. Lewer ondersteuning met versoeke, stasiounerie-versoeke en basiese verkrygingsadministrasie. Ontvang en rig navrae van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Onderhou rekords van kantooruitrustinggebruik en rapporteer foute aan die betrokke eenheid. Lewer ondersteuning by die sirkulasie, ondertekening en lêering van werksbeskrywings, planne, verslae en voorleggings. Stel roetine-administratiewe opdaterings vir die toesighouer op.

zu.title: Inkantshela yolulo lokuqashelwa: Ukumiswa kwesakhiwo sehlangano
zu.summary: Kudingeka inkantshela yolulo eNqungeni eliphambili loMnyango weZezindlu e-East London ukunikeza inkxaso yolulo, ukugcina amarekhodi nokubhala okuvamile okuhlobene nokuxhumana.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior Certificate samazwe, izinga le-NQF 4 ngaphandle kokuhlelekile. Ulwazi lwenqubo yolulo lwezinhovela nokuphathwa kwamarekhodi, ukugcina imfihlo nokuphathwa kolwazi olusemthethweni. Amakhono wokuxhumana ahlelekile (okubhalwayo nokukhulwayo) nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isikhakula sokusebenza eqenjini nangokuxhumana, ukunaka imininingwane, ukuphatha isikhathi nokunakekelwa abathunjwa bezenkonzo.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yolulo eqenjini. Bhala okuvamile okuyimemorandam, amagama, izithakazelo nokubikwa kolulo. Gcina amabhuku okubhalisa, izinhlela zokuqondanisa amafayela namarekhodi yolulo eqenjini. Qamba amakhophi, sesa, shiceka futhi wabelange namadokhumenti njengoba kudingeka. Landela amadokhumenti angakaqedi futhi unikeze imbiko eqondene nokuqondiswa eqondene nomphathi. Nikeza inkxaso yamarekhodi nolwazi eqenjini. Vula, buyekeza futhi ugcine amafayela abhalayo ngesikhathi esibhalwayo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuphathwa kwamarekhodi. Faka futhi ubuyekeze ulwazi oluhlobene nezakhiwo, incazelo yemisebenzi, okulinganiswayo kwemisebenzi nemisebenzi yokusebenza kahle. Gcina izindawo zolwazi, amaspredishithi nezinto zokuqondanisa eqenjini. Khuphula amarekhodi futhi unikeze ulwazi kubasebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuphephile nokugcinwa kwemfihlo kwamarekhodi asemtshweni. Nikeza inkxaso yemisebenzi yokuhlelela futhi ube ngumabhalane. Hlela izinkomfa, izindawo, amabhuku okubhalisa ukubakho nezinye izidingo zokuhlelela. Lungisa futhi wabelange nangezinhlelo, amaphakethe enkomfa namadokhumenti anikela inkxaso. Bhala amaminithi, izinqumo nabezindaba ngesikhathi senkomfa uma kudingeka. Landela izehlakalo ezenzwayo futhi ubuyekeze amabhuku okubhalisa okuqondiswayo. Nikeza inkxaso ngokuhlelela izindawo zokusebenza, izikhathi zokwazisa nokuqondanisa nabahlanganyeli. Nikeza inkxaso yamahhovisi jikelele, yezokuthenga nokuqondanisa nabahlanganyeli. Nikeza inkxaso ngezidingo, izicelo zempahla yamahhovisi nolulo oluyisisekelo lokuthenga. Thola futhi uqondise imibuzo evela kubahlanganyeli bongaphakathi nangaphandle. Gcina amarekhodi okusetshenziswa ibhizi yamahhovisi futhi ukubike iziphazamiso eqenjini elihambisana. Nikeza inkxaso ekusasazweni, ukusayina nokugcinwa kwamafayela incazelo yemisebenzi, amaphulani, okubikiwe nezicelo. Hlela okubikiwayo okuvamile kolulo eqondene nomphathi.

xh.title: Monywenti Wolawulo: Ukuyila Kwequmrhu
xh.summary: Kufuneka umnywenti wolawulo kwiNtloko eNkulu koSebe lweZindlu zokuHlala eEast London ukunika inkxaso yolawulo, ukugcina iirekhodi nokubhala iindaba ezisetyenziswa ngokwesiqhelo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliPhakamili seNazwanga, iNQF level 4 ngaphandle koluhlu olunamava. Ulwazi lwezindlela zolawulo le-ofisi nolawulo lwerekhodi, ukugcinwa kweemfihlo nokuphathwa kolwazi olusemthethweni. Amakhono amabalulekileyo enxibelelwano (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo) nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza kwindiqo nakwiinkqubomphakamashishini, kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha, ulawulo lwexesha nokunakekelwa abathengi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwicandelo. Bhala imemo, iileta, iziphozo neengxelo zolawulo ezisetyenziswa ngokwesiqhelo. Gcina iiresijista, iinkqubo zokuGcinisha iifayili neerekhodi zolawulo zecandelo. Thatha ikopi, skiye, printe yahlule iifayili njengoko kufuneka. Landela iifayili ezingekayo unike amaxwebhu kumlawuli. Nikezela ngenkxaso yophatho lweerekhodi nolwazi kwicandelo. Vula, hlaziya uze ugcinwe iifayili ezibonakalayo nangekhompyutha ngokwemfuno yophatho lweerekhodi. Faka uhlaziye ulwazi malunga neendawo zolawulo, iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, ukulinganisa imisebenzi nemisebenzi yomethinto wokusebenza. Gcina iidatha ezijelwe, iispredshithi nezixhobo zokulandela icandelo. Khupha iirekhodi unike ulwazi kubasebenzi njengoko kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kolwazi olunemfihlo lweerekhodi ezisemthethweni. Nikezela ngenkxaso yabasebenzi beendawo zokubamba iintlanganiso. Cwangcisa iintlanganiso, iindawo, iiresijista zobukho nezinye iimfuno ezinxulumene nendawo. Lungisa yahlule iajenda, ipeketshi zentlanganiso namaxwebhu onke. Bhala iirekhodi zeentlanganiso, izigqibo nezenzo ezifuneka ngexesha leentlanganiso xa zifuneka. Landela izinto ezenzayo uhlaziye iiresijista zokulandela. Nikezela ngenkxaso kolawulo-kusebenzisana kweziqukunyambi, iinkqubo zokwazisa nendibano nabathintekayo. Nikezela ngenkxaso yelungiselelo le-ofisi, thengelo nentetho nabathintekayo. Nikezela ngenkxaso kwiziphozo, izicelo zesixhobo somsebenzi nolawulo olusisiseko lwethengelo. Yamkela uqondise imibuzo evela kubathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Gcina iirekhodi zokusetyenziswa kwemathini le-ofisi ichaze iziphetho kwicandelo elifanelekileyo. Phakama ngenkxaso kokuhamba, ukusayina nokugcina iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, iiplan, iingxelo neziphozo. Hlenga iingxelo zolawulo ezisetyenziswa ngokwesiqhelo kumlawuli.

af.title: Bestuurder/boodskapper: Werkomgewingsbestuur
af.summary: Bestuurder en boodskapper wat vervoerdienste aan die Department of Human Settlements in East London op salarisvlak 4 lewer.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 2 soos deur SAQA erken met geen ervaring nie. Geldige bestuurderslisensie met PDP. Kennis van padverkeerswette en -regulasies, regeringsvervoerbeleide en -prosedures, geografiese kennis, voertuigonderhoud en -veiligheid, dokumenthantering en rekordbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vertroulikheid en etiese gedrag. Fisieke fiksheid en waaksaamheid, kliëntediens en tydbestuur.
af.duties: Lewer vervoer- en bestuursdienste. Vervoer werknemers na verskeie bestemmings. Vervoer materiaal en toerusting. Pas padveiligheid en voorsorgmaatreëls toe. Vul logboeke en ritstelle in. Voer basiese voertuigkontroles uit en rapporteer foute. Verskaf vervoeradministratiewe dienste. Sluit daaglikse en weeklikse kilometerlesings af en fasiliteer die opneem van lesings. Voltooi voertuiglogboek en ritmagtigings. Konsolideer maandelikse voertuigopgawes. Laai en los goedere/toerusting. Dien ongevalverslae in. Onderhoud van motorvoertuie. Inspekteer motorvoertuie en rapporteer gebreke. Teken oproepe by Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) in vir motorvoertuigdiens, herstelwerk en onderhoud. Reinig en smeer masjinerietoerusting. Bespreek voertuie vir was en skoonmaak. Lewer klerklike steun/boodskapperpligte. Sorteer en rangskik korrespondensie. Versamel, versprei en sirkuleer korrespondensie. Reken en beheer korrespondensie. Fasiliteer dat ontvangers op die afleweringsboek/register teken. Veilige bewaring van logboeke, petrolkaarte en ritmagtigings. Lewer dokumente tussen hoofkantoor, susterdepartemente en instellings. Maak seker dat pakkies en lêers behoorlik verseël en geadresseer is. Handhaaf vertroulikheid van regeringsinligting. Voorkom skade, verlies of ongemagtigde toegang tydens vervoer.

zu.title: Isidayiva/umthumeli: Ukuphathwa Kwendawo Yokusebenza
zu.summary: Isidayiva kanye nomthumeli ohlinzeka ngamasosa okuthutha eNyuvesi Yokwakha Izindlu East London ngesikhundla lesiyinga 4.
zu.requirements: NQF level 2 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA ngaphandle kokuhlolwe. Ilayisensi yesidayiva esemthethweni ene-PDP. Ukwazi ngemithetho nemigomo yekhonthintha yezimoto, imithetho nemicimbi yohulumeni yokuthutha, ulwazi lwendawo, ukugcinwa nokuqinisekiswa kwezimoto, ukuphathwa kwamafayili nokuphathwa kwezarekhodi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana. Ukugcina imfihlo nokuziphatha ngendlela elungile. Ukuba nentamo ezinile futhi ukuba buhlaleke, ukukhonza abathundayo nokuphatha isikhathi.
zu.duties: Ukukhokulelwa kwemisebenzi yokuqasha ezindaweni ezahlukene kanye nokuthutha. Ukuthutha impahla kanye nempahla yokusebenza. Ukusebenzisa okuqaphela ukuthula kwewesi nokuthathela amagagasi. Ukugcwalisa emapuletshisi akuvandiwe. Ukwenzela ukubuyekezwa kwansuku zonke nangeviki ekuyofundwa khona futhi ukusekela ukubhalwa kwalo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo yezimoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaholayo bayasayina emapuletshini okulethwa. Ukwenza isibuki esiyingxenye sokuhlanganiswa kwamavolomu. Ukuthuthelwa nokuthuthelwa imiphahla/impahla. Ukudlulisa imibiko yezehlakalo. Ukukugcina izimoto. Ukubuyeka izimoto futhi ukumyikulela ukulimala. Ukungena kwamakholo e-Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) mayelana nokukhonza, ukulungiswa nokugcinwa kwezimoto. Ukushamba nezipho ezifaka izitobho ngezitshudisi. Ukusiza izimoto ukuthi zihlanjwe futhi zicotheke. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokwengeza umthunywa. Ukuhlela imibhiso yokuhlangana. Ukuyiqoqa, ukuyihambisa, ukuyisakazisa imibhiso. Ukubhala kanye nokulawula imibhiso. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abayamukelayo bayasayina kumapuletshini/wokulandelwa kwalethwa. Ukugcina imapuletshini, amakhadi etholakala imoto kanye namapuletshini wemibhalo yamavolomu. Ukuletha imibhiso phakathi kwehhovisi elikhulu, kwezinye izinsiza nezikhungo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphakethi namafayili abhokwe kahle futhi athunyelwe. Ukugcina ithimba lehholo. Ukwenza isibuki sokungakufiki futhi ukungatholakali kwetholakala kwemibhalo yohulumeni. Ukuthutha isikhathi nenzuzo, ukungatshali noma ukungatholi ukungangena okungalungile ngesikhathi sokuthutha.

xh.title: Umshayeli/umthunywa: Ulawulo lweNdawo yoMsebenzi
xh.summary: Umshayeli nomthunywa onika iinkonzo zothutho kwiSebe leZinto zoNtlalo e-East London kwinqanaba lesikere esingu-4 samaxabiso.
xh.requirements: Isikhongothi se-NQF level 2 njengoko sivunyelwe yi-SAQA ngaphandle kokulinganisela. Ileyibrari yomshayeli elungisele kwaye nePDP. Ukwaziswa ngemithetho yolawulo loothutho lwamatyala, iindlela nendlela zolawulo losapho lokarhulumente, ulwazi lweqondo labucala, ukugcinwa kwesithuthi nokhuseleko, ukuphathwa kwemibhalo nolawulo lweerekhodi. Izakhono ezilungile zokunxibelelana. Ukugcina imfihlo nokuzithatha. Ukomelela komzimba nokujongwa, iinkonzo zabakheni kunye nokulawula ixesha.
xh.duties: Nikeza iinkonzo zothutho nokushayela. Thutha abasebenzi kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Thutha izinto negalelo. Sebenzisa izithomiezo zokhuseleko loothutho lweendonga. Gqiba iindawo zogqabo lwamajelo kwaye ulungelelanise ugqabo. Wenza iqondo lokujonga iimoto kwaye uchaze iimposiso. Nikeza iinkonzo zolawulo lothutho. Vala izikelo zentsuku nosuku zeesikhathi ezikwabakali kwaye ulungelelanise ubhalo lwemikhondo. Gqiba ugqabo lwemoto kwaye wenza izigunyaziso zohambo. Qamba iindundo zenyanga zothutho. Thwala kwaye ukhulule izinto/igalelo. Thumela iindazimbuzo. Ukugcina iimoto. Jonga iimoto kwaye uchaze iintsiba. Faka iindleko kwi-Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) zokukonza, ukulungisa nokuqino iimoto. Cacaza kwaye usike amagciniwo emishini. Bhala iimoto zokuhlambwa nokucocwa. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo / imisebenzi yomthunywa. Hlela kwaye ulungelelanise imibhalo. Qokelela, yahlule kwaye uqhakamise imibhalo. Bhala kwaye ulawule imibhalo. Yenza ukuba abamkeli base imibhalo yohambiselwe / kwadi. Ukugcina ukhuseleko kwamakhobo othutho, amakhadi epetrol kunye nezigunyaziso zohambo. Thutha amaxesi phakathi kweofisi enkulu, iisebe ezelibazini kunye neendalo. Qinisekisa ukuba iipasile namahele abhalwe kakuhle kwaye aphathwe kakhulu. Gcina ixabiso lokwazisa kwelifikileyo. Thintela ukonakaliswa, ukulahleka okanye ukungena okungenasigunyaziso xa kuthuthwa.

zu.title: Umshayeli/isithumeli: Izenzo Zokwesekwa Izinhlaka
zu.summary: Umshayeli/isithumeli ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhamba nezokuphathwa kwezinhla zezenzo zenqubomgomo eNyuvesi yase East London, ofuna ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile ene-PDP.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 2 njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile ene-PDP. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqumo zokuqasha, imithetho nemiqondo kahulumeni yokuphathwa kwezinhla, ulwazi ngezindawo, ukugcinwa kwezinhla nokuphephela, ukuphathwa kwamafayili nokuphatwa kwemibhalo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana. Ukugcina imfihlo nokuziphatha ngokwesibindi. Ukunyakaza emzimbeni nokuqaphela, ukukhonza abathengi nokuphathwa kwesikhathi.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngohlelo lokuhamba nokushayela. Hayisha abasebenzi kwezindawo ezahlukene. Hamba nezinto kanye nempahla yemisebenzi. Sebenzisa izinto zokuphephela ngalendlela. Qedela izincwadi zohlelo lokushayela namaphepha okuhamba. Yenza ukuhlolwa okuyisisekelo kwezinhla bese ukhomba iziphazili. Hlinzeka ngezinhla zokuphathwa kwezinhla zenqubo. Vala ukufundwa kwamakhilomitha nsuku zonke nanye masonto bese ulungiselela ukubhalwa kwemibhalo. Qedela incwadi yezinhla zemoto nemiqumo yokuqasha. Hlanganisa imibalo yaminyaka yonke yezinhla zokushayela. Layisha bese ukhishwa impahla. Hambisa izibalo ezithola ubuhlungu noma imikhuba engalungile emgwazeni wokushayela. Ukugcinwa kwemoto. Hlola imoto bese ukhomba iziphili. Faka izibikelo noma amagama ocelwayo ku-Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) ngaphezulu kokuphila kwenqubo yokushayela. Hlola futhi udonswe noma uhlakazelwe ibhalansi lomshini noma isisetshenziswa. Faka izimoto ohlelweni lokuqashwa nokuqashelwa komsebenzi kubaluleke. Nikeza inkundla ngenkcazelo noma ukubika ngemisebenzi esuke yenziwe. Hlinzeka ngokusiza ezindlini zokushayela ngaphandle kokungasebenzi noma ukubhukuqeka kohlelo. Zimisela nokubheka imigudu yemisebenzi. Qoqa, yabelwa futhi uhambise imigudu yamaphepha. Phatha futhi ulawule imigudu yamaphepha. Qinisekisa ukuthi abatholi bayayisayina kwi-ncwadi noma ngemuva kokuyifaka ohlelweni. Gcina ngokuphephile izincwadi zokushayela, amakhadi kagesi bese nikela nemiqumo yokuhamba. Hambisa amafayili phakathi kwendawo enkulu, amanye amagatsha kahulumeni nasezinhlanganweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphakethe namafayili avaliwe futhi athunyelwe kahle. Gcina imfihlo yemibhalo kahulumeni. Thwala ukushoda noma ukubandakanywa okungalungile emgwazeni wemisebenzi.

xh.title: Umqhubi/umthunywa: Iinkonzo zoXhaso loLawulo
xh.summary: Umqhubi/umthunywa onikeza iinkonzo zothutho nolawulo kwiSebe leZindlu eziziMi ngase East London, lifuna ilayisenisi esemthethweni lokuqhuba ene-PDP.
xh.requirements: NQF level 2 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA ngaphandle kolwazilo. Ilayisenisi esemthethweni lokuqhuba ene-PDP. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo yethutho eNkundla, iinkqubomgomo nendlela zolawulo lokuthutho kurhulumente, ulwazi lwendawo, ukulondolozwa nokhuseleko kwezithuthi, ukuphathwa koxwebu nokulawula amarekhodi. Amakhono obunzulumzabalazo amahle. Iba ngasese nokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Ukuqinilekomzimba nokuzingca, ukukhonza abathengi nokulawula ixesha.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zothutho nokuqhuba. Thutha abasebenzi kumaphelo ahlukeneyo. Thutha izixhobo nemikhobongo. Faka ukhuseleko olusesikweni kunye nezithintelo kwishishini. Gqiba ii-logbooks namakhashe eendlela. Yenza ukutshekisha okusisiseko kwezithuthi uxele iimpazamo. Yonke iinkonzo zolawulo zothutho. Vala ukufunda amakhilomitha yonke imihla ngeveki uze ulawule ukubhalwa kokufunda. Gqiba ilogbook yesithuthi nangemvume yokuhamba. Misela ukubuyela kwamaviki izithuthi. Faka kwaye ukhuphe izinto/izixhobo. Nika iingxelo ezimalunga neengozi. Ukulondolozwa kwezithuthi. Hlola izithuthi uxele iimpazamo. Ngenisa amafowuni kwi-Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) ukwenzela ukukhonza, ukulungisa nokulondolozwa izithuthi. Cotha kwaye ulubhuze izixhobo. Faka izithuthi ukuya kuhlambeni nokucoshwa. Yiza iinkonzo zomsebenzi wofele/umthunywa. Hlela ngokulandelelana uxwebu. Qokelela, sasaza kwaye uzithungele uxwebu. Qamba uluhlu lwezixuku kwaye ulawule uxwebu. Qinisekisa ukuba abamkelayo basayina kwincwadi yokulethwa/irejista. Ukugcina ngokhuselekilekwamagama eelogbook, amakhadi epetroli nemvume yokuhamba. Thatha iinxatsheli phakathi kwehhovu elikhulu, amasebe afana nalo namaziko. Qinisekisa ukuba iiphakethi namanqaku alo avaliwe kakuhle kwaye athunyelwe. Gcina inkcakamba yolwazi kurhulumente. Thintela ukonakala, ukulahleka okanye ukungena okungenamvume ngelixa kuthuthwa.

jobs.title: Driver Messenger: Admin Support Services
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered. FOR ATTENTION : Or Queries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112 / Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 / Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842
jobs.summary: The Department of Human Settlements seeks a driver messenger in Gqeberha to provide transport, driving and administrative support services at salary level 4.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 2 as recognised by SAQA with no experience. Valid drivers’ licence with PDP. Knowledge of Road traffic laws and regulations, government transport policies and procedures, geographical knowledge, vehicle maintenance and safety, document handling and records management. Good communication skills. Confidentiality and ethical conduct. Physical fitness and alertness, customer service and time management.
jobs.duties: Render transport and driving services. Fairy employees to various destinations. Transport material and equipment. Apply road safety and precautionary measures. Complete logbooks and trip sheets. Conduct basic vehicle checks and report faults. Provide transport administrative services. Close daily and weekly kilometre readings and facilitate the recording of readings. Complete vehicle logbook and trip authorisations. Consolidate monthly vehicle returns. Load and offload goods/equipment. Submit accident reports. Maintenance of motor vehicles. Inspect motor vehicles and report defects. Login calls to Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) for motor vehicle service, repairs and maintenance. Clean and lubricate machinery equipment. Book vehicles for wash and cleaning. Render clerical support/messenger duties. Sort and arrange correspondence. Collect, distribute and circulate correspondence. Records and control correspondence. Facilitate that the recipients sign on the delivery book/register. Safekeeping of logbooks, petrol cards and trip authorisations. Deliver documents between head office, sister departments and institutions. Ascertain parcels and files are properly sealed and addressed. Maintain confidentiality of government information. Prevent damage, loss or unauthorised access during transportation.
jobs.enquiries: Contact Mr M. Kana at 071 606 8112/Mrs N. Mhlawuli at 071 606 5941 /Mr M. Sangqu at 071 606 7842 E-Recruitment enquiries: e-recruitment@ecdhs.gov.za

af.title: Bestuurder-Koerier: Administratiewe Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Die Department of Human Settlements soek 'n bestuurder-koerier in Gqeberha om vervoer-, bestuurs- en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste te verskaf op salarisvlak 4.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 2 soos deur SAQA erken met geen ervaring. Geldige bestuurderslisensie met PDP. Kennis van padverkeerswette en -regulasies, regeringsvervoerbeleid en -prosedures, geografiese kennis, voertuigonderhoud en -veiligheid, dokumenthantering en rekordbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vertroulikheid en etiese gedrag. Fisieke fiksheid en waaksaamheid, kliëntediens en tydbestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf vervoer- en bestuursdienste. Vervoer werknemers na verskeie bestemmings. Vervoer materiaal en toerusting. Pas padveiligheid en voorsorgmaatreëls toe. Voltooi logboeke en ritblaaie. Voer basiese voertuigkontroles uit en rapporteer foute. Verskaf vervoeradministratiewe dienste. Sluit daaglikse en weeklikse kilometerlesings af en fasiliteer die optekening van lesings. Voltooi voertuiglogboek en ritmagtigings. Konsolideer maandelikse voertuigopgawes. Laai en los goedere/toerusting. Dien ongeluksverslae in. Onderhoud van motorvoertuie. Inspekteer motorvoertuie en rapporteer gebreke. Log oproepe by Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) vir motorvoertuigdiens, herstelwerk en onderhoud. Maak en smeer masjinerietoerusting skoon. Bespreek voertuie vir was en skoonmaak. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning/koerierpligte. Sorteer en reël korrespondensie. Versamel, versprei en sirkuleer korrespondensie. Teken korrespondensie op en beheer dit. Fasiliteer dat die ontvangers op die afleweringsboek/register teken. Veilige bewaring van logboeke, petrolkaarte en ritmagtigings. Lewer dokumente tussen hoofkantoor, susterdepartemente en instellings. Maak seker dat pakkies en lêers behoorlik geseël en geadresseer is. Handhaaf vertroulikheid van regeringsinligting. Voorkom skade, verlies of ongemagtigde toegang gedurende vervoer.

zu.title: Isithumizi Somayili: Izenzelo Zokusekela Izindaba
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Komphakathi ufuna isithumizi somayili eGqeberha ukunikeza izinsiza zokuthutha, ukushayela kanye nokusekela izindabo ezingeni 4 leholo.
zu.requirements: Inqobo yesibili ye-NQF njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana namava. Ilayisensi ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni yomshayeli ePDP. Ukwazi ngemithetho nokuhleleka kwezimoto zesihwebi, izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuthutha zahulumathi, ulwazi lwesizinda, ukugcinwa kokuphepha kwezimoto, ukuphathwa kwamafayili nokulawulwa kwezimoto. Amandla okuxhumana kahle. Ukugcina imfihlo nokuziphatha ngokuya ngokuzotha. Ukuba nekhono elikhulu emzimbeni nokuba nokubuka kakhulu, ukukhonza abakhulumayisi nokulawula isikhathi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngamasevisi okuthutha nokuqhuba. Thutha abasebenzi kulezo zindawo ezingezinye. Thutha izinto zokwakha nemishini. Faka okuqaphele kwezimoto kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Qedela izincwadi zokuqamba kwezinhlela kanye namaphepha okuhamba. Yenza okuhlukene kokuhlola izimoto ubuncane bokuqonda, uphike izinkinga ezikuyo. Nikela ngamasevisi okuphathwa kwezindaba zezimoto. Vala ukufunda kwamakhilomitha nsuku zonke ngeviki, ulawule ukubhalwa kokufunda. Qedela incwadi yokubhalisa izimoto nemvume yokuhamba. Hlanganisa izinto evezwa ngezinyanga zokubuyela ngezimoto. Layisha futhi ukhulule izinto/imishini. Hambisa izigxilo zemikhuhla wemoto, Kwenze futhi uzivakashele imitshini wemoto, uxhume ukonakaliswa. Faka ukufakwa kwamafomu eNzuzo Zahulumathi Zokuphathwa Kwemoto (GFMS) mayelana nesevisi yemoto, izilungiselelo, nokulondolozwa. Hlanza futhi usikele imishini. Bhalisa imoto ukuze ihlanziwe kuhlanjwe. Nikela ngokusekela izindaba nangomsebenzi wesithumizi somayili. Phatha kabusha ngokulandelana izinsiza zokubhalisela nangokuthunyelwa kwemiyalo. Landa, sabelisa futhi usabalalise imiyalo. Ligcine futhi lilawule imiyalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi abathuli babhala ematshini wokubhalisa ukulandelana. Gcina ukuphepha kwesikhala kwalezi zinsizakalo, imadili yohhafu wehhafu izimoto nokuqinisekiswa kwezinsizakalo. Thumela imibhalo phakathi kwehhovisi eliyinhloko, emanyathelweni ahlobene nasezindaweni ezingaphansi kwawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaphakethe kanye namafayili avalwe ngokuphepha futhi athunyelwe kuleso sikhungo. Zigcine zinobumfihlo ezindabeni zehhulumathi. Thwala ukuvikela ukulimala, ukulahlekelwa noma ukungafinyeleliwa ngaphandle kwemvume ngesikhathi kuthuthwa.

xh.title: Umshayeli-ithumela: Iinkonzo ZoLawulo
xh.summary: Isebe leZiseko zokuHlaziya iiNdlu lufuna umshayeli-ithumela kwi-Gqeberha ukuze anike inkonzo yothutho, ukushayela nolawulo kwinzuzo yesabelo se-Administration enika umvuzo ongela mlinganiso.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba le-NQF 4 njengokuqatyiwa yi-SAQA ngencazelo efunwa kule siqendu. Layisensi yokushayela enesaziso se-PDP olusebenzayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemilinganiselo yeqela zokhwezo iintlandluzo kwezi ngoko, gqiba zonke iziphqqa ezinyanulwa kule siqendu. Iakhedi yokungathathi nxaxheba kwezopolitiko. Amakhob oka mfazwe. Iinkalo zakho eziquka: ukucela inkonzo kwamanye amanyunyu, ukuthumela nokuqokelelwa kwezinto, ukuhlolwa kwenkqubo, ukusebenzela ngokubanzi ngolu hlobo ibango. Isakhono sokubeka ngokweeneko ukuba ungenwa yinkqubo nangolu hlobo lweenkonzo. Isakhono esifanelekileyo sokusebenza.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yothutho nokushayela. Hamba nabasebenzi kumathafa amaninzi. Thutha izinto zokwenza umsebenzi. Zisebenzise izigqibo zokhuseleko olumgamaqondo kwaye uthathe iigalo. Gqiba iibhuku ezibhalwa imithamo namakhasi okuhamba. Hlola imoto ngemigaqo nize uxele ngayo. Nike inkonzo yolawulo lokutyhala. Vala iimilo yamakhilomitha yemihla ngemihla neyeeveki uncedise ukubhalwa kwabo. Gqiba ibhuku lemoto ngemithamo nemvume yokuhamba. Qhanga izibuko zemihla yamanyanga yokubuyela kwemoto. Layisha ukhuphe izinto zokwenza umsebenzi. Nika iiripothi zentshisho. Ukugcinwa kwemoto. Hlola imoto ungalathise okungalunganga. Thumela amagama kwi-Government Motor Financial Services (GFMS) ukuya kwenziwa imoto nokuqwalaselwa nokugcinwa. Coca ulungise ooncedo bezixhobo. Faka imoto ekuhambeni yokucoca. Yenza imisebenzi yobucwasekileyo. Hlela uphinde ulungise amagama. Qokelela ulwandise ulunge amagama. Bhala ulawule amagama. Qinisekisa ukuba abamkelayo basayina kwindlu yabamkelayo. Ukugcinwa kwebhuku lemoto, ikhadi lepetroli nemvume yokuhamba. Thumela amagama phakathi kwe-ofisi enkulu, amanye amasebe nemizi. Qinisekisa iziphoso namafayile aqhotywe kakuhle athunyelwe. Gcina imfihlo yolwulo. Thintela ukonakala, ukulahleka okanye ukungena ngenyani xa kuthuthwa.

Provide cleaning services to ablution facilities. Refill handwash liquid soap. Replace toilet papers, hand towels and refreshers. Empty and wash waste bins. Sweep and mop the floors. af.title: Skoonmaker: Admin Ondersteuningsdienste
af.summary: Skoonmakerpos in East London waar ABET Level 4 vereis word, met 'n aanbod van R144 024 per jaar op salarisvlak Level 02, met pligte wat kantoor Skoonmaak en afvalbestuur insluit.
af.requirements: ABET level 4 met geen ervaring. Kennis van skoonmaakmetodes en prosedures asook die veilige hantering van skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting, higiëne, afvalbestuur en sanitasiepraktyke. Vermoë om gesondheids- en veiligheidsgevare te identifiseer en te rapporteer. Tydbestuur en vermoë om instruksies akkuraat te volg.
af.duties: Verskaf skoonmaakdienste aan kantoorgange, kantore, hysers en raadsale. Stof af en was kantoor meubels. Veeg, skrop en was vloere. Stofsuig en sjampoeer vloere. Skoon maak mure, vensters en deure. Leeg en skoon maak asblikke. Versamel en verwyder afvalpapier. Verfris kantoorareas. Verskaf algemene kombuisskoonmaakdienste. Skoon maak wasbakke. Skoon maak kaste. Was en hou voorraad van kombuistoebehore. Veeg en mop die vloer. Leeg en skoon maak asblikke. Skoon maak eetgereedskap vir alle werknemers in die distrikantoor. Verskaf skoonmaakdienste aan ablusiegeriewe. Vul handwasvloeibare seep aan. Vervang toiletpapier, handdoeke en verfrissers. Leeg en was afvalasblikke. Veeg en mop die vloere. Onderhou skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting. Rapporteer gebreekte skoonmaakmasjiene en toerusting. Skoon maak masjiene (mikrogolfoonde, stofsuiers, yskaste, ens.) en toerusting na gebruik. Vra skoonmaakmateriaal aan. Veilige berging van die skoonmaakmateriaal.

zu.title: Inkosishi: Isevisi Yokwesekela Kolawulo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokugcoba e-East London esidinga ABET Level 4, sinikeza R144 024 ngonyaka eholo elingu-Level 02, nemisebenzi ehlanganza ukucocwa kwezinhlelo zolawulo nokuphathwa kwezingqambi.
zu.requirements: ABET level 4 ngaphandle kokuhlangenwe nakho. Ulwazi ngezindlela nezinqubo zokucisha kanye nokuphepha ekuphathweni kwezinto zokucisha nezisetshenziswa, ukuhlanzeka, ukuphathwa kwezingqambi nezindlela zokuhlanza. Ikono lokubona nokubika ingozi ezimalwe nempilo yomzimba nokuphepha. Ukulawula isikhathi kanye nenkokhelo yokulandela imiyalo ngokunembile.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi yokucisha emihosheniwezinhlelo zolawulo, amahhovisi, ama-elevator namakamelo abasekelayo. Susa uhwemsoka ugqoke izinto zobuhhovisi. Sula, ciza futhi ugxobe phansi. Sebenzisa i-vacuum futhi uhlamze phansi. Cosa izindonga, iwindi kanye namagugu. Qhakamisa futhi ucoce amabhokisi. Qoqa ususe amaphepha ezingqambi. Qabula izindawo zobuhhovisi. Nikela ngezinkonzo ezijwayelekile zokucisha kwendawo yokupheka. Cosa izibaseli. Cose izikhulumi. Geza futhi ulondoloze izingxenye zokupheka. Sula futhi uthathe phansi. Qhakamisa futhi ucoce amabhokisi. Cosaisetshenziswa zokudla zabo bonke abasebenzi kwihhovisi lesifunda. Nikela ngesevisi yokucisha izindawo zokuqubula. Gcwalisa isawula segesi sokugeza izandla. Buyisela amaphepha wendlunu, amathawula kanye nezimphehlula. Qhakamisa futhi ugeze amabhokisi ezingqambi. Sula futhi uthathe phansi. Gcina izinto zokucisha kanye nezisetshenziswa. Bika izinto zokucisha nezisetshenziswa ephukileyo. Coce izinsimbi (i-microwaves, i-vacuum cleaners, ama-fridges, njll.) nezisetshenziswa emva kokusetshenziswa. Cela izinto zokucisha. Ukulondolozwa okuphephile kwezinto zokucisha.

xh.title: Umcoci: Iinkonzo Zokuxhasa Lolunye Lusebe
xh.summary: Isithuba somcoci e East London esifuna i-ABET Level 4, sinika umvuzo ongemva kwonyaka ongu-R144 024 kwinqanaba lomvuzo ngu-Level 02, nomsebenzi oquka ukucoca iiofisi nokulawula imfucuza.
xh.requirements: I-ABET level 4 ngaphandle kolwazi. Ulwazi ngezindlela neenqobo zokucoca nokusingathwa ngokhuselekileko kwamashebe nempahla yokucooca, ukucooca, ukulawula imfucuza neenqobo zokuswela ithutyana. Ikhono lokubona nokubika iingozi zempilo yokhuseleko. Ukulawula ixesha nekhono lolandela imiyalelo ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokucoca iindonga zeeofisi, iiofisi, iilifti nakwigumbi lebandla. Sula kwaye uvakalelise ifanitsha yeofisi. Qhubha, coca kwaye uvakalelise amaphila. Qhuqa kwaye uhlanze amaphila. Coca iindonga, iifestile namacango. Zicime kwaye ucoce izikhongozeli. Qokelela kwaye ususe amaphepha amdaka. Vumsha iindawo zeofisi. Nika iinkonzo ezijikeleileyo zokucoca igumbi lokutya. Coca iisinki. Coca iikhabhathi. Geza kwaye ugcine isitokhwe sezixhobo zegumbi lokutya. Qhubha kwaye uthwele phantsi iphila. Zicime kwaye ucoce izikhongozeli. Coca izixhobo zokutya zabasebenzi bonke kwindawo yofisi yosapho. Nika iinkonzo zokucoca iindawo zokuhlanza. Gcwalisa isovusi esithweba izandla. Tshintsha amaphepha wetoilet, iithawuli ezihlawulayo izandla nezo kuvavaza. Zicime kwaye ugeze izikhongozeli zamadaka. Qhubha kwaye uthwele amaphila. Zigcine izingxobo zokucoca nempahla. Bika iingxobo zokucoca ezingatshintshiyo nemipahla. Coca iingxobo (iimicrowave, iivacuum cleaner, iifriji, njl) nempahla emva kokuzisebenzisa. Cela izingxobo zokucoca. Gcina ngokhuselekileyo izingxobo zokucoca.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technologist: Infrastructure
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technologist in Infrastructure needed in Bhisho, requiring a B Tech in Engineering, ECSA registration, and 6 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech), or a relevant qualification, with six (6) years’ post-qualification Engineering Technologist experience required. A valid driver's license. Compulsory registration with ECSA as an Engineering Technologist. Knowledge And Skills: Strategic capability and leadership, problem-solving and analysis, decision- making. Team leadership, Creativity, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer skills, People management, Planning and organizing, Conflict management, Negotiation skills, and Change management. Competencies: Programme and project management. Engineering, legal and operational compliance. Engineering operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Engineering and professional judgement.
jobs.duties: Engineering design and analysis effectiveness: Perform final review and approvals or audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory; co-ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology; pioneering of new engineering services and management methods. Maintain engineering operational effectiveness: Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources; set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability; monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct b or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Governance: Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources; compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements; provide technical consulting services for the operation on engineering-related matters to minimize possible engineering risks; manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives, e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Financial Management: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the engineering environment/services, manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organizational needs and objectives, manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects, facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles, allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. People Management: Manage the development, motivation and utilization of human resources for discipline to ensure a competent knowledge base for the continued success of engineering services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstegnoloog: Infrastruktuur
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstegnoloog in Infrastruktuur word in Bhisho benodig, met 'n vereiste vir 'n B Tech in Ingenieurswese, ECSA-registrasie en 6 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, Baccalaureus in Tegnologie in Ingenieurswese (B Tech), of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie, met ses (6) jaar se na-kwalifikasie Ingenieurstegnoloog-ervaring word vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n Ingenieurstegnoloog. Kennis en vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming. Spanleierskap, kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur, klienfokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede, en veranderingbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Program- en projektebestuur. Ingenieurswese, regtelike en operasionele nakoming. Ingenieursbedryfskommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Vaardighede vir die bestuur van mobiele toerusting. Ingenieursontwerp- en analisekennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Effektiwiteit van ingenieursontwerp en -analise: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of ouditeute op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie uit; koördineer ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker; baanbrekerswerk van nuwe ingenieursdienste en bestuurmetodes. Handhaaf ingenieursbedryfseffektiwiteit: Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudsstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne; stel ingenieursonderhoudstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisasie-doelwitte om optimale bedryfsbeskikbaarheid te verseker; monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens organisasie-doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te stuur of te herstuur vir die bereiking van organisasie-doelwitte. Bemagtiging: Rangskik, beheer, monitor en verslag oor alle hulpbronne; stel risikologboeke op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgoùitgesproke risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes; verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike ingenieursrisiko's te minimaliseer; bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe, bv. korttermyn-opdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Finansiële bestuur: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om aan die MTEF-doelwitte binne die ingenieursomgewing/dienste te voldoen, bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker, bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte, fasiliteer die opstel van innuvasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker, rangskik, beheer en monitor bestedings volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Mensebestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van ingenieursdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en optrede te neem om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Control Engineering Technologist: Isakhiwo
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Control Engineering Technologist ku-Infrastructure eBhisho, kudingwa i-B Tech ku-Engineering, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA, neminyaka eyi-6 yamava.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech), noma izifundo ezifanele, neminyaka eyisithupha (6) yamava kwesikhundla se-Engineering Technologist emva kokuthola izifundo. Ithikithi lokushayela elisebenzayo. Ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA njenge-Engineering Technologist okuyiphutha. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ikhono lokubhekana nezinhlobo nezinqubo kanye nekhono lokuhola, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuhola iqembu, Ukudala, Ukulawula imali, Ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, Ukuxhumana, Amakhono wekhompyutha, Ukulawula abantu, Ukulungelelanisa futhi uhlele, Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, Amakhono okuxoxisana, kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho. Ikhono: Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaprojekthi. Ukulandelana kolimi olomthetho kanye nokuhambisana nemisebenzi. Ukuxhumana kwemisebenzi yamakhono. Ulwazi kanye namakhono zokuqhuba inqubo. Amakhono nolwazi okulondolozwa. Amakhono okusebenzisa izinsiza ezihambahambayo. Ulwazi lokwakha nokuhlaziya. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukudala isiko eliphumelela kakhulu. Ukweluleka ngamakhono. Ukwahlulela ngokomsebenzi nangobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Ukusebenza kahle ekwakheni nokuqonda ukusebenza kwezinto: Yenza ukubuyekeza okugcwele futhi uvume noma uhlola izakhiwo ezisha zamakhono ngokwemigomo noma inqubo yokwakha; xhuma imizamo yokwakha nokuqoqoqoqa kwezindlela ezahlukene ukuze kuhlanganiswe kahle nobuchwepheshe obukhona; ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi emisha yamakhono nezindlela zokulawula. Ukugcina ukusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi yamakhono: Lawula ukuphumelelisa inqubo yokulondoloza ngokunikezwa kwezakhiwo, izinhlelo nemithombo ehlakaniphile; hlela imigomo, imihlahlandlela nemazinga okukhonza ngokohlelo lweqembu, ukunikezwa okulinganiselwe nezinhloso ukuze kuhlinzekwe isikhathi esiningi sokusebenza; buya ama-efficiencies okulondoloza ngokuhlelelwa ngokwezinhloso zeqembu ukuze kuqondwe noma kuqondwe kabusha imisebenzi yamakhono ukufeza izinhloso zeqembu. Ukulawula: Hlaba, lawula, bhala futhi uthole izinikezelo ngamathuluzi onke; qamba amafayela ezingozi ulawule izingozi ezinkulu ngokwemigomo okuzayo nangemithetho yenhlangano; nikeza imisebenzi yemibuzo ngobuchwepheshe ekusebenzeni kolimi, izinsiza namandla nangokwemithetho kwezinhlelo zokusebenza okubalulekile ukuze kuqatshelwe izindleko zayo, inzuzo nenani elifakiwe; hlelela futhi lawula izinto ezithile nangamanye, okungakwesikhashana noma ngokohlelo olulandelayo, ukulondolozwa nokwelula imikhiqizo yegatsha; setha imigomo yamaphoyinti kanye nobukhulu bomsebenzi, futhi ugxile kumaphoyinti abaluleke kakhulu emkhankasweni wokuqinisekisa ukusebenza okuhle kakhulu nemiklamo okutholakala ngayo; lawula futhi uphumeze izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi, njengemisebenzi emifushane nemithetho yohlelo lwezemisebenzi ekuqondene nokutholakala kolwazi nokwabelana ngakho phakathi kwezinhlelo, kwezinsizakalo namathuluzi aphethe izinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kolwazi: Yenza isigaba sokugcina ukusetshenziswa kolwazi nokukhethwa kolwazi phakathi kwesikhathi eside nokuhlakaniphile kwamathuluzi wokusebenza. Ukuphathwa kwezimali: Qinisekisa ukutholakala kolwazi oluningi futhi ulawule imali egciniwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwana nezinhloso ze-MTEF emkhakha/imisebenzi yonke leyo, lawula inkomba yamaphrojekthi omhlaba wangaphandle wonke lomtholampilo ukuze kuhlinzekwe ngemithombo ehlakaniphile ngemithombo egqamile namaphuzu abalulekile, lawula inani leminikelo yamaphrojekthi, izibhalo eziphathelene nezinkomba zenhlangano ukwazi ukusebenzisa ithuluzi lemininingwane, nangaphandle kwenkundla ethize esibekiwe futhi ehlakaniphile. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Lawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukwesekwa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi olubalulekile kakhulu emkhankasini wokuqinisekisa ukungena kolwazi oluhambisana nezinkinga ezihlukene namaphuzu abalulekile ngokuhlelo lomtholampilo ohlinzela abathintekayo nangemithetho yokuhlela nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukunika amandla nokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kolwazi ngokuhlela, ukulawula imigomo yokulinganiselwa komsebenzi, imigomo ekhona eyindlela yokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutholakala kwabasebenzi nokusetshenziswa kwabo kusebenza kanjani, ukuze kugcine ukusimama komtholampilo ohlinzelayo ohlelweni. Lawula indawo yezinyanga ezintathu eziphathelene nezinkomba eziyisihluthulelo zokusebenza kwezinyanga ezintathu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusebenza nokwamukela izindawo ezisha kuyasebenza futhi yilokhu okuhlehliswe izinkinga ezithile.

xh.title: Injiniya Yobuchwepheshe Elawulayo: Infrastruktura
xh.summary: Kufuneka injini yobuchwepheshe elawulayo kwi-Infrastruktura e-Bhisho, kwaye kufuneka ibe ne-B Tech kwi-Engineering, neregistration kwi-ECSA, kunye neminyaka eli-6 yamava.
xh.requirements: National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech), okanye isifikelelo esifanelekileyo, nangamava eminyaka emithandathu (6) emva kokufumana isifikelelo njengenjini yobuchwepheshe. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ubhaliso obuyiyo kwi-ECSA njengenjini yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi namakhono: Amandla okuqonda iindaba ngokubanzi nokukhokela, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, nokuthatha iigqibo. Ukukhokela iqela, ukudala izinto ngezimvo ezintsha, ukulawula imali, ukuzinika kumthengi nokuphendula, nokuqhathanisa, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulawula abantu, ukuceba nokuhlela, ukulawula iingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, nokuwohloka nokulawula utshintsho. Amandla: Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ukuthobela imithetho yokwenza njengenjini, emthethweni naseku sebenzeni. Unxibelelwano lokuqhuba phambili kwenkqubo yeenjini. Ulwazi namakhono emigangatho wenkqubo. Amakhono nolwazi oluhlelekileyo lokulondolozo. Amakhono okusebenzisa izixhobo ezingahambisiyo. Ulwazi lokuyila kwezobuchwepheshe nakuhlalutya. Uphando nophuhliso. Izicelo zokwenza njengeenjini ngekhompyutha. Ukuyila inkqubo ekwimo ephakamileyo yemveliso. Ingcebiso ngobuchwepheshe. Isigqibo sokuziphatha njengenjini nakho ngokobuchwepheshe.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuqatshelwe ukusebenza kokuyila nokuhlalutya: Yenza ukuphonononga okugqibeleleyo nokuvuma okanye ukuinganiso kwiimfuziselo ezintsha zezenjini ngokwemiqathango okanye inzululwazi yokuyila; lungiselela amandla okuyila nokuhlanganisa kuzo zonke iindawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa okungalulelekileyo ngeteknoloji yangoku; ukuba ngumdala kweenkonzo ezintsha zezenjini nendlela zokulawula. Gcina ukusebenza okusebenzayo kweenjini: Lawula ukuphumeza iindlela zokulondolozo ngokunika iimpawu ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo namathuba; cwangcisa amanqanaba okulondolozo seenjini, iingcebiso namakhondo ekonzo ngokwemigangatho yoshisho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufumaneka okuhle kokuqhuba phambili; qaphela iindlela ezilungele zokulondolozo ngokwemigangatho yoshisho ukuyalela okanye ukuyalela kwakhona iinkonzo zezenjini ukuze kufikelelwe kwimigangatho yoshisho. Urhwebo: Sabelo, lawula, qaphela nikikelela ngawo onke amathuba; qulunqa iifayile ezichaza iingxaki ziphithikeleyo kwaye ulawule iingxaki ezibalulekileyo ngokwemigaqo yamava ekulawuleni iingxaki nangokwemfuno yoshisho; nikeza iinkonzo zokukucebisa ngenkqubo yobuchwepheshe malunga neendaba ezinxulumene neenjini ukuze kuncitshiswe iingxaki ezinokubakho kwezenjini; lawula uphuhlise iinkqubo zokwabelana ngolwazi, umzekelo, ngenkqubo yesixa esifutshane sokumiselwa kwenkxaso nokuhambiswa kakhusele iinkonzo ezikunye nasekuhambeni kweenkonzo, ukuxhasa iinkqaba zophuhliso ngabanye, iimfuno zokuqhuba okusebenzayo neembali yokufumana iingeniso. Qaphela ngokuqhubekayo ukutshintshiselana nokukhuselwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ukugqibelela ukuqinisekiswa kokulawula ulwazi okusebenzayo ngokwemigangatho yesebe. Ukulawula imali: Qinisekisa ukufumaneka nokulawula iimali ukuze kufikelelwe kwimigangatho ye-MTEF kwindawo/ iinkonzo zeenjini, lawula ipotfoliyo yamaphulo ezoqhuba phambili kuwo wonke umsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa kwethuba elingcono ngokwemfuno yeshisho nangokwemigangatho, lawula ixabiso elenzelelweyo lokuhenganyelwa kumaphulo amacandelo anoxwebu, nkxaso yokulungiselela iingcebiso zophuhliso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza nokuhambelana nemigangatho yeshisho, sabela ngamathuba, lawula nokuqaphela ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwebalazwe ukuze kugqitywe ukulawula iindlela zokuqhuba phambili iimali. Ukulawula abantu: Lawula, nika isakhono sabantu nokubasebenzisa iindawo ezakhiweyo ezinolwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ngaphezulu kolwazi oluphakamileyo noluzinikeleyo kwezempumelelo zekonzo yezenjini ngokwemfuno nangokwemfuno yoshisho. af.title: Beheer-Argitektoniese Tegnoloog: Infrastruktuur
af.summary: Beheer-Argitektoniese Tegnoloog-pos in Bhisho wat R958,776 per jaar bied, waarvoor 'n B Tech in Argitektuur, SACAP-registrasie en ses jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat, Baccalaureus in Tegnologie in Argitektuur (B Tech) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie met ses (6) jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring as Argitektoniese Tegnoloog word vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Verpligte registrasie by SACAP as 'n Argitektoniese Tegnoloog. Bevoegdhede: Projekbestuur, probleemoplossing en -analise, besluitneming, spanleierskap, skepseluim, veranderingbestuur, finansiële bestuur, kursoriëntasie en -reaksie, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, en personeelbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur tegnologiese adviesdienste: Beplan tegniese ondersteuning aan argitekte en geassosieerde professionele persone in terreinopmetings, die opstel van gemeetde tekenings van bestaande geboue, die insamel van praktiese inligting rakende die voorgestelde projek, en die opstel van voorleggingstekeninge en -modelle van die ontwerp. Bestuur en lei die ontwerpproses, landskapontwerp en -voorlegging, en die opstel van werkstekeninge wat as wetlike opdrag aan die boukontrakteur sal dien om te verseker dat die gebou ooreenkomstig die werkstekeninge en ander wetlike dokumente gebou word. Verseist die nakoming en bevordering van veiligheidsstandaarde in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Los breedweg gedefinieerde tegnologiese uitdagings op deur die toepassing van bewese tegnieke en prosedures, en ontwikkel, onderhou en bestuur huidige tegnologieë. Monitering en evaluering van tegnologiese ontwerpe: Evalueer en monitor bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Verseist gehalteversekering van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en doen aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die relevante gesag, en identifiseer en optimeer tegniese oplossings deur argitektoniese beginsels toe te pas. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies: Verskaf insettes tot die begrotingsproses, stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis, verskaf en konsolideer insettes tot die tegnologiese/argitektoniese bedryfsplan, verseist die ontwikkeling, implementering en instandhouding van die databasis, en bestuur en hou toesig oor tegnologiese en verwante personeel en bates. Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures, Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor argitektoniese tegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter en skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Isitsha Sokulawula Ubuchwepheshe Besakhiwo: Izakhiwo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumlawuli wobuchwepheshe besakhiwo eBhisho esinikeza i-R958,776 ngonyaka, sifuna i-B Tech kwi-Architecture, ukubhaliswa kwi-SACAP kanye neminyaka emithandathu yohlalelwano.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology in Architecture (B Tech) noma izifundo ezifanele ezineminyaka emithandathu (6) yohlalelwano njengoba kunjalo emva kokuthola iziqu. Idrayiva elinesihlahla. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelekile ku-SACAP njengen technologist yezakhiwo. Ikhono: Ukuqondisa amaphrojekthi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nenhlalunjongo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuba busa iqembu, ukwakha okusha, ukuqondisa inguquko, ulawulo lwezimali, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula, ukuthintana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ucubungula kanye nokuhlela, kanye nolawulo labantu.
zu.duties: Ukulawula izinkonzo zokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe: Hlela ukwesekwa ngezobuchwepheshe kubasakhiwo kanye nabochwepheshe abahlobene ekwenzeni izivakashi zesiza, ekulungiseleleni izithombe ezingabalwa zezakhiwo ezikhona, ekutholeni ulwazi olusebenzayo mayelana nephrojekthi edingekayo, kanye nokuqamba izithombe zokuvezwa kanye namamodeli wakho. Lawula kanye nokuba yinhloko yendlela yokwakha umklamo, umklamo wesimo sendawo nosukele bokubonisa, kanye nokuqamba izithombe eziyisebenzisayo ngokomthetho kwakhiwe ukuthi isakhiwo sakhiwe ngokwezithombe eziyisebenzisayo namanye amadokhumenti angokomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthi amazinga okuphepha alandelwe futhi ashaywe phambili ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezisemtshakweni kanye nezomthetho. Xazulula izinselelo zobuchwepheshe ezenziwe umngcele obanzi ngokusetyenziswa kwamasu neqinisekisiwe, futhi thuthukisa, gcina, futhi lawula ubuchwepheshe obukhona. Ukubuka kanye Nokuhlaziya imiklamo yezobuchwepheshe: Hlaziya kanye nokubuka amanual obuchwepheshe, izithombe ezivamile, kanye nezenzo ezizobe ngokokuthi ubuchwepheshe obusha singafakwa kanjani. Qinisekisa izinga lemiklamo yezobuchwepheshe kanye nezinkomba kanye nokwenza izincomo ezingamukeleka uhulumeni obambisene nawo, futhi zibe nokuthola izixazululo zobuchwepheshe ezihamba phambili ngokuseta izimiso zokusakha. Lawula imisebenzi yokuphatha kanye neyohlelo: Faka iminikelo enkabeni yokuqamba ibhajethi, buza umbhalo futhi uthumele imibiko njengoba kudingeka, ukuphathwa kokwakha amanombolo, inhlalakahle yezobuchwepheshe ekugcineni ukulondolozwa kokuqanjwa ngokwesibonakaliso, ukuba nokuhlela nangendlela ekondla umthelela wokuxazulula, ukubuyekeza kanye nokuhlela kokuqashwa, ukuphatha nokulawula ukuphathwa komsebenzi ohilela okungabalandeli nabantu abadlule. Imfundo kanye nenhla: Ukulondoloza njalo ubuchwepheshe ukuze ube nolwazi ngobuchwepheshe bamanje namathuba amasha. Bheka imibhalo yocwaning lwakho mayelana nolimi ekuxazululweni kwenkinga ukuze ube nolwazi oludingekile.

xh.title: Itekoloji yakoZakhiwo Ebalulekileyo: Iinfrastraktha
xh.summary: Isithuba seTekoloji yakoZakhiwo Ebalulekileyo eBhisho esinika umvuzo we-R958,776 ngonyaka, sifuna i-B Tech kwiZakhiwo, ukubhalisa kwi-SACAP kunye neminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Certificate ye-National Senior, i-Bachelor of Technology kwiZakhiwo (B Tech) okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe (6) yamava okusebenza njengomele weTekoloji yakoZakhiwo emva kokuqesha isifundo. Ilayisenisi yokushuka etshoyo. Ukubhalisa kwi-SACAP njengomele weTekoloji yakoZakhiwo kuyaphoqelelwa. Ikhono: uLawulo lweProjekthi, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlola, ukuThatha iziGqibo, ukuKokela iQela, ukuQamba, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lweMali, ukuQwalasela abathengi nokusabela, ukuThetha, izikrini zeKhompyutha, ukuCwangcisa nokuHloma, kunye noLawulo abaPhethi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo zokululeka ngeznobuchwepheshe: Ukucwangcisa inkxaso yobugcokusithetha kubakhiwo kunye nabasebenza nabo ngokuhlola iindawo zokwakhiwa, ukulungisa imizobo elingenweyo yezakhiwo ezikhoyo, ukuqokelela ulwazi olubalulekileyo malunga neprojekthi eceliweyo, nokulungisa imizobo yokubonisa kunye namamodeli wodidi. Ukulawula nokukhokela inkqubo yokulungisa udidi, ukulungisa udidi lwendalo nokuvela, nokulungisa imizobo yokusebenza ekuya kuba ngumyalelo wesebe ngokomthetho kumakhi wezakhiwo ukuqinisekisa ukuba isakhiwo sakhiwa ngokweimizobo yokusebenza namaxwebhu amnye ngokomthetho. Kuqinisekiswe ukuzigcinana koluntu kunye nokukhuthaza iindlela zokhuseleko ngokweemfuno ngokomthetho kunye namagqabantshintshi. Ukusombulula iingxaki zobugcokusithetha ezichaziwe ngokubanzi ngokusetyenziswa kweendlela ezisetyenzisiweyo nezenziweyo, kwaye zacuthwa, zigcinwe, zilawulwe ezobugcokusithetha ezikhoyo. Ukuqwalasela nokubeka ubume beznobuchwepheshe ekuyilo: Ukuqwalasela nokubeka ubume bezincwadi ezinobugcokusithetha ezikhoyo, imizobo eqhelekileyo, nendenkqubo ukuze kufakwe ubugcokusithetha obutsha. Kuqinisekiswe ubunyulu bezakhiwo zobugcokusithetha ngeenkcazelo kwaye zenziwe izindululo zokuqinisekiswa ngumbeki ofanelekileyo, kwaye kuqatshelwe kwaye kulungelelwa izisombululo zobugcokusithethha ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zezakhiwo. Ukulawula imisebenzi yobaluleko nobunye: Kufakwe ulwazi kwindleko yokulinganisa imali, kuqulunqwe kwaye kunikelwe iingxelo njengoko kufuneka, kunikelwe kwaye kudityanisiwe ulwazi kwicwangciso lokusebenza ngokobugcokusithethha/obuzakhiwo, kuqinisekiswa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenza nokugcina idathabhesi, kwaye kulawulwe kwaye kugqutywa abasebenzi ngokobugcokusithethha nabongezelayo, nempahla. Uphononongo nokuphuhlisa: Ukuphuhliswa ngokungadingekiyo ukuze kugcinwe nobutsha ngokobugcokusithethha nendenkqubo, iifundo zophononongo/ulwazi ngebhuluku ngokobugcokusithethha bezakhiwo ukuza kulungelelanisa ulwazi ngokuchanileyo nokuxhumana namagqabantshintsi anegunya ngemiba engengqondo ngemiba ngamagqabantshintshi kumagunya ololobe ngokobugcokusithethha bezakhiwo.

zu.title: Inqambi Yobuchwepheshe Bekwakhiwo: Ukulethwa Kwezinsiza Ezisizekile ze
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNqambi Yobuchwepheshe Bekwakhiwo e Eastern Cape Department of Public Works ukuphatha izinsiza zokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe nokunikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe emisebenzini yezinsiza ezisizekile.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology in Architecture (B Tech) noma izifundo ezihambisanayo kanephezu kweminyaka emithathu (3) yokusebenza njengeNqambi Yobuchwepheshe Bekwakhiwo emva kokuthola izifundo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuqanjwa kabula ku-SACAP njengeNqambi Yobuchwepheshe Bekwakhiwo kuyinyanzele. Izindlela: Ukuphatha imisebenzi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukuba ngumholi weqembu, Ukwakha izinkumbulo, Ukuphatha inguquko, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula, Unxibelelwano, Amakhono ekhompyutha, Ukucubungula nokuhlela, kanye nokuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Phatha izinsiza zokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe: Hlela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubachwephheshe bokwakhiwo nabangane abaphathwe kuyo kwesiteshi sokuhlola, ukulungisa imidwayizo egqanyisiwe yezakhiwo ezikhona, ukuqoqa ulwazi olusebenzayo oluhlobene nomsebenzi ocumiwe, nokulungisa imidwayizo yokuhlonza namamodeli wokuhlela. Phatha futhi uhole inqubo yokuhlela, ukuhlela ibala nokuhlonza, nokulungisa imidwayizo yokusebenza ezoqobo yimiyalo emthethweni kumakhi ngesiteshi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isakhiwo sakhiwa ngokwesimidwayizo yokusebenza namanye amaxwebhu omthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthobeka nokukhuthaza izinga lokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nangemithetho. Xazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezichazwe kabanzi ngokusetyenziswa kwendlela ezisuke ezitholakele, futhi thuthukisa, gcina, futhi phatha ubuchwepheshe bamanje. Ukubuka nokuhlola izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe: Hlola futhi ulule imanuyali zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, imidwayizo eqavukile namaxwebhu okusebenza afake ubuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi yezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ngemiyalo futhi nikeza izindululo zokugunyazwa ngumlomo ohambisanayo futhi funa futhi ulungise izixazululo zobuchwepheshe ngokusetyenziswa kwezimiso zokwakhiwo. Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo eminye ehlobene nayo: Nikeza okufakwe esikhundleni ngenqubo yebhajethi, qamba futhi unikeze umbiko njengoba kudingeka, nikeza futhi uhlanganise okufakwe esikhundleni kwesu lokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe/ bokwakhiwo, qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, nokugcinwa kwesiphakamisi sedatha, futhi phathe futhi ulawule abantu bobuchwepheshe nemitshinakahle ehlobene nayo. Ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okungapheli ukuze ugqame nobuchwepheshe obusha nangendlela zokusebenza, Ucwaningo/izifundo zemibhalo ngobuchwepheshe bokwakhiwo ukuthuthukisa amakhono nokuunxibelelana nababukhulu/bamakhonza ahlobene nezindaba zokwakhiwo.

xh.title: Injinieri yobuchwepheshe yoYakhiwo: Ukulela iNfura
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNjinieri yobuchwepheshe yoYakhiwo kwi Eastern Cape Department of Public Works ukulawula iinkonzo zokucebisa ngobuchwepheshe nokunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumaprojekthi enzululwazi.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology in Architecture (B Tech) okanye izidanga ezifanelekene kunyaka wokuqala (3) emva kokufumana isidanga ngokuba yiNjinieri yobuchwepheshe yoYakhiwo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ubhaliso obuzima kwi-SACAP njengenjinieri yobuchwepheshe yoYakhiwo. Ikhono: uLawulo lweProjekthi, ukuSomba izixa nokwahlula-hlula, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuKokela iqela, ukuQamba, uLawulo lotshintsho, uLawulo lwemali, ukuqwalasela kwaye uphendule abaxhamli, uNxibelelwano, izikrini zekhompyutha, uCocelo lolwele, nokuLawula abantu.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zokucebisa ngobuchwepheshe: Cwangcisa inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubakhiwo neziphakamisi-zindwedwe kwisurvey esiçitsheni, ukulungisa imizobo elinganiswayo yezakhiwo ezikhoyo,okuqokelela ulwazi olusebenzayo olxhonywe kuprojekthi ephakamiswayo, nolol ezaqhuba imizobo yentshayvelo neendlela zoyilo. Lawula kwaye uzalise indlela yoyilo,uyilolwendalo neminononelo, kwaye uLungise imizobo yomsebenzi eza setyenziselwa njengemiyalelo yomthetho kumakhiwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba isakhiwo siyakhiwa ngokwe-mizobo yomsebenzi namaxwebhe amnye omthetho. Qinisekisa ukwamkelwa kukhuthazo lwemigaqo yokhuseleko ngokwemfuno yomthetho nangokwemigaqo. Sombisa iingxaki ezibhalwe ngokubanzi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezichasiweyo neenkqubo, kwaye uphucule,agcine, alawule iindlela zangoku zetheknoloji. Ukulawula nokuhlolwa kwezoyilo zobuchwepheshe: Hlola ulawule izalathiso zobuchwepheshe ezikhoyo, imizobo esemthethweni neenkqubo ukuze ufake theknoloji entsha. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi kumzobo wobuchwepheshe ngokomgangatho kwaye uze nicela izindululo kuvumelwe ngumlawuli ochwebileyo kwaye uchazé kulungise iindlela zobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zobakhiwo. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo nezinxulumene nayo: Nikeza igalelo kumaxwebhe obungcale, qamba kwaye ungenise iingxelo njengoko kudingeka, nikeze kwaye uqokelele iziqalelo kwicebiso lokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe/bakhiwo, qinisekisa uphuhliso, isetyenziswa nokugcinwa kobugcisa bolwazi,b kwaye ulawule kwaye ulawule abantu bomsebenzi weobuchwepheshe nakwindalo ezinxulumene nayo. Uphononongo nophuhliso: Uphuhliso olungaloyiyo ngobugcisa ukugcina usasazoobuchwepheshe, Uphononongo/ukufunda iingxelo ngobuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wokwakha ukuze uphucule ugqozi nokunxibelelana nemiqathango/nabavuni ngemiba ekuxhogwe kuyo ngobugcisa.
