jobs.summary: Engineering Technologist position in Bhisho within the Department of Public Works & Infrastructure, requiring a B Tech in Engineering, ECSA registration, and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate, Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech) or relevant qualification with three (3) years’ post-qualification Engineering Technologist experience required. A valid driver's license. Compulsory registration with ECSA as an Engineer Technologist. Knowledge and Skills: Strategic capability and leadership, problem-solving and analysis, decision- making. Team leadership, Creativity, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer skills, People management, Planning and organising, Conflict management, Negotiation skills, and Change management. Competencies: Programme and project management. Engineering, legal and operational compliance. Engineering operational communication. Process knowledge and skills. Maintenance skills and knowledge. Mobile equipment operating skills. Engineering design and analysis knowledge. Research and development. Computer-aided engineering applications. Creating high-performance culture. Technical consulting. Engineering and professional judgement.
jobs.duties: Engineering design and analysis effectiveness: Perform final review and approvals or audits on new engineering designs according to design principles or theory, Co-ordinate design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology, Pioneering of new engineering services and management methods. Maintain engineering operational effectiveness: Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels according to organisational objectives to ensure optimum operational availability, monitor maintenance efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct b or redirect engineering services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Governance: Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources; compile risk logs and manage significant risk according to sound risk management practice and organizational requirements; provide technical consulting services for the operation on engineering-related matters to minimize possible engineering risks; manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives, e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment. Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives. Financial Management: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the engineering environment/services, manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organizational needs and objectives, manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects, facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles, allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. People Management: Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure a competent knowledge base for the continued success of engineering services according to organisational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives.

af.title: Ingenieurtegnoloog: Infrastruktuur vir Onderwys
af.summary: Ingenieurtegnoloogpos in Bhisho binne die Department of Public Works & Infrastructure, waarvoor 'n B Tech in Ingenieurswese, ECSA-registrasie en drie jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate, 'n Bachelor of Technology in Engineering (B Tech) of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie met drie (3) jaar se post-kwalifikasie Ingenieurtegnoloog-ervaring word vereis. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n Ingenieurtegnoloog. Kennis en Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming. Spanleierskap, Kreatiwiteit, Finansiële bestuur, Kliëntgerigtheid en reaksievermoë, Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardighede, Mensebestuur, Beplanning en organisering, Konflikbestuur, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, en Veranderingsbestuur. Bevoegdhede: Program- en projekbestuur. Ingenieurswese, regtelike en operasionele nakoming. Ingenieursoperasionele kommunikasie. Proseskennis en -vaardighede. Onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis. Mobiele toerustingbedrywingsvaardighede. Ingenieursontwerp en -ontledingskennis. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Skep van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur. Tegniese konsultasie. Ingenieurs- en professionele oordeel.
af.duties: Ingenieursontwerp en -ontleding se doeltreffendheid: Voer finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudits op nuwe ingenieursontwerpe uit volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie; koördineer ontwerppogings en -integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker; baanbreek van nuwe ingenieursdienste en bestuurmetodes. Onderhou ingenieursoperasionele doeltreffendheid: Bestuur die uitvoering van die instandhoudingstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel ingenieursinstandhoudingstandaarde, -spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker; monitor instandhoudingdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te stuur of herstuur vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Goewerneering: Wijs toe, beheer, monitor en rapporteer oor alle hulpbronne; stel risikologboeke op en bestuur beduidende risiko volgens goeie risikobestuurpraktyk en organisatoriese vereistes; verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die operasie oor ingenieursverwante aangeleenthede om moontlike ingenieursrisiko's te verminder; bestuur en implementeer kennisdelingsinisiatiewe, bv. korttermynopdragte en uitleenings binne en oor operasies heen, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op belegging. Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker. Finansiële Bestuur: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om MTEF-doelwitte binne die ingenieursomgewing/-dienste te bereik; bestuur die operasionele kapitale projekportefeulje vir die operasie om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker; bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van die dissiplineverwante programme en projekte; fasiliteer die opstel van innovasievoorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker; wys toe, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Mensebestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om 'n bekwame kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van ingenieursdienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasie-areas deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik.

zu.title: Injiniya Yobuchwepheshe: Izakhiwo Zezemfundo
zu.summary: Isikhundla senjiniya yobuchwepheshe eBhisho ngaphakathi koMnyango WezokuSebenza Kahle Komphakathi & Izakhiwo, sifuna i-B Tech kwiNjiniya, ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA, kanye neminyaka emithathu yesisipiliyongo.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate, i-Bachelor of Technology kuEngineering (i-B Tech) noma iziqu ezifanele kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yesisipiliyongo sokuba ngunjiniya yobuchwepheshe ngemuva kokuqeda iziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukubhaliswa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniya yobuchwepheshe kuyinto ephoqelekile. Ulwazi nekhono: Ikhono lokubamba iqhaza nokuqondisa ngokubaluleka, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqondisa iqembu, ukudala, ukuphatha izimali, ukugxila kubathengi kanye nokuphendula, ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukuphatha abantu, ukwelula futhi uhlele, ukuphatha izinkinga ezibanga ingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana, kanye nokuphatha inguquko. Ikhono: Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye namaphrojekthi. Ukuhambisana kolwesiNjiniya, okusemthethweni kanye nokuqashwa. Ukuxhumana kwezokusebenza kweNjiniya. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubo. Amandla kanye nolwazi lokugcina. Amakhono okusebenzisa izinto ezihamba. Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuhlaziya iNjiniya. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokweluleka zamatshali obuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko elisebenza kahle kakhulu. Ukweluleka ngobuchwepheshe. Isinqumo sesiNjiniya kanye nesobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Ukusebenza kahle kokuqamba nokuhlaziya iNjiniya: Yenza ukubuyekeza okugqamile futhi uvume noma uhlola izinto ezintsha zokuqamba iNjiniya ngokwemigomo noma inqubo yokuqamba, hlanganisa imizamo yokuqamba kanye nokuhlanganisa kulo lonke izigaba ukuze kuqiniseke ukuhlanganiswa okuhamba kahle nobuchwepheshe bamanje, ukukhula izinto ezintsha kwezinsiza zesiNjiniya kanye nezindlela zokuphatha. Gcina ukusebenza kahle kwezokusebenza kweNjiniya: Phatha ukuphunyulwa kwenqubo yokugcina ngokunikezwa kwezakhiwo, izinhlelo kanye nezinsiza ezifanele. Hlela izinga lokugcina iNjiniya, izinkomba kanye namazinga enkonzo ngokwemigomo yenhlangano ukuze kuqiniseke ukutholakala okuhle kokusebenza, qaphela ukusebenza kahle kokugcina ngokwemigomo yenhlangano ukuze uqonde noma uqondise kabusha izinsiza zesiNjiniya ukuze kufikelelwe emigqweni yenhlangano. Ulawulo: Aba, lawula, qaphela futhi umbike ngazo zonke izinsiza; hlanganisa izinhlu zengozi uphathe ingozi enkulu ngokwenqubo yokuphatha ingozi ehle kanye nezidingo zenhlangano; nikeza izinsiza zokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe ukugqama kwezindaba eziphathelene neNjiniya ukuze kuncishwe ngamandla amathuba engozi yesiNjiniya; phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi, isib. ukwabelana kwemisebenzi emfushane kanye ne-secondments ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlela zentuthuko yomuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza kanye nenzuzo yokutshala. Qaphela ngokuqhubekayo ukushintshiselana kanye nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nabantu ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphatha ulwazi okusebenza kahle ngokwemigomo yomnyango. Ukuphatha Izimali: Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphatha imali ukuze kufikelelwe emigqweni ye-MTEF ngaphakathi kwesimo senkonzo yeNjiniya, phatha inqobo yephrojekthi yenkokhelo yokusebenza ye-portfolio yokugqama ukuze kuqiniseke ukubonelelwa okusebenza kahle ngokwezidingo nemigomo yenhlangano, phatha inani lokwengeza lezohwebo kumaphrojekthi kanye namaphrojekthi ahlobene nesigaba, xhumanisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezitifiketi zentsha ukuze kuqiniseke ukusemthethweni nokulandelwa kwemigomo yenhlangano, aba, lawula futhi qaphela ukuchithwa ngokwebhajethi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphatha kakhulu kwe-cash flow. Ukuphatha Abantu: Phatha intuthuko, ukukhuthaza nokusetshenziswa kolwazi lwabantu isigaba ukuze kuqiniseke isisekelo sethalo eliqotho sokuphila okuqhubekayo kwezinkonzo zesiNjiniya ngokwezidingo nemigomo yenhlangano. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza kwabankele ngokuvela kanye nokubuka amazinga okusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa iziphambeko ukuze kufikelelwe emigqweni yomnyango.

xh.title: Injiniya yezobuchwepheshe: Iinfrastrakhthi zeMfundo
xh.summary: Isithuba senjiniya yezobuchwepheshe eBhisho ngaphakathi kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi kaLuntu & Iinfrastrakhthi, esifuna i-B Tech kwiNjiniya, ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA, namashumi eminyaka emithathu zemfundo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSizwe sePhezulu, i-Bachelor of Technology kwiNjiniya (i-B Tech) okanye ngesimo esifanelekayo ngeeminyaka ezintathu (3) zemfundo yangemva kwezare lendodofothi yokuba ngunjiniya yezobuchepheshe. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ukubhalisa kwi-ECSA njengomntu ohlolelwe injiniya ngokumthetho. Ulwazi namakhono: Ikhono lokubumba ihambo nokuqhuba, ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukwenza iigqibo. Ukuqhuba iqela, ukudala, ulawulo lwezimali, ukugxila kubathengi nokuphendula, Unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ulawulo labantu, ukuceba nokuhlela, ulawulo lweingxaki, amakhono okuxoxisana, nolawulo lokutshintsha. Iikhono: Ulawulo lweenjongo neziprojekthi. Ukuthobela imithetho yezonjiniya, emthethweni nasekuqhubeni. Unxibelelwano olusemsebenzini wezonjiniya. Ulwazi namakhono wenkqubo. Amakhono nolwazi olwokugcina. Amakhono okusebenzisa izixhobo ezingahoyiyo. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuhlalutya izonjiniya. Uphononongo nentluko. Izicelo ezixhaswe yikhompyutha ezinguzonjiniya. Ukuyila inkqubo yemveliso ephezulu. Ukuba ngumceli-mangqa wamandla. Ukugqiba ngokwezonjiniya nangobungcali.
xh.duties: Ukusebenza kakuhle ekuyileni nokuhlalutya izonjiniya: Yenza ukuhlola okuphelayo kwaye uvume okanye ahlolye iziyilo ezintsha zezenjiniya ngokwemigaqo okanye ithiyori yokuyila, Qhobosela amandla okuyila nokuqhetjuba kwizifundo ukuqinisekisa ukuqhetjuba ngokufanelekileyo nentluko yangoku, Ukuphaphazela iinkonzo ezintsha ezinguzonjiniya neendlela zolawulo. Phatha ukusebenza kakuhle kwezonjiniya: Lawula ukuphethwa kwenkqubo yokugcina ngokubonelela iimbumbano, iinkqubo nezibonelelo ezifanelekileyo. Misela amagqabaza egcino lwezonjiniya, iinkcukacha namanqanaba konke ngokwemigqgibo yoluntu ukuqinisekisa ukufumaneka okusezantsi okugqibeleleyo, hlola ukusebenza kakuhle kokugcina ngokwemigqgibo yoluntu ukuqondisa okanye ukuqondisa kwakhona iinkonzo zezonjiniya ngenjongo yokufikelela imigqgibo yoluntu. Ulawulo:abela, lawula, hlola nevela ingxelo ngabo bonke abo banelwazi nemali; qamba iifayile ezingxakini ulawule iingxaki ezinkulu ngokwemigaqo yokulawula iingxaki ngokulunga nezidingo zenkqubo; bonezela iinkonzo zokuba ngumceli-mangqa wolwazi ngeendaba ezingezonjiniya ukuze unciphise iingxaki ezingezonjiniya ezinokubakho; lawula ukuqhuba iindawo zokwabelana ngolwazi, njengakunyaka omfutshane wokwabelana nokuqhwesela ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweenkonzo, ngenkxaso yamacebo okuzinza komntu ngamnye, iindingo zokuqhuba negagasi lemalini. Qhubekela ukuhlola ukutshintshelana kolwazi nokukhuselwa kolwazi phakathi kweendawo zokuqhuba nabantu ukuze kuqiniseqiswe ulawulo lolwazi olusebenzayo ngokwemigqgibo yesebe. Ulawulo lweZimali: Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kolawulo lwemali ukuze uhlangabezane nemigqgibo ye-MTEF ngaphakathi kwendalo/iinkonzo zezonjiniya, lawula uhlu lweeprojekthi zezimali zokuqhuba ngenjongo yokugqibelelya ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa ngokwemali ngokweenkxalo nemiQgqibo yoluntu, lawula ixabiso lezentlazo lenkqubo namaprojekthi ahlobene nezifundo, qhobosela ukuqhumbela iindimbambano ezintsha ukuze kuqiniseqiswe ukusebenza nokulandela imigaqo yoluntu, abela, lawula uhlola iindleko ngokwebhajethi ukuze kuqiniseqiswe ulawulo olusebenzayo lwekola yemali. Ulawulo lweSiqalelo: Lawula ukuphuhliswa, ukwaleka nokuqhwesa iimbovu zenkqubo yoluntu ngomntu ngamnye ukuze kuthathwe izigqibo zokulungisa iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kumagqabaza esbe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Labour Relations
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Labour Relations at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and three years' management experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF L6) or preferably a B Degree (NQF L7) as recognised by SAQA in BCom/Human Resource Management / Labour Relations / Labour Law / Industrial Psychology / BAdmin / Public Management, Industrial Relations / LLB (Law). A minimum of 3 years’ relevant Labour Relations related experience at Assistant Director / Junior Management level. In-depth knowledge of the following legislative prescripts: Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Disciplinary Code, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, 1994 as amended by Act 30 of 2007, PFMA, Industrial Policy and other related policies and procedures. Must further possess the following skills and attributes: Communication skills, Report Writing skills, Computer Literacy, Project Management, Financial management, Management and leadership skills, Planning and Organising. Willingness to work extra hours. Computer literacy with an emphasis on Excel and PowerPoint. An independent worker, meeting timeframes. Monitoring and managing compliance of the department with the Statutory Bodies. Must be in possession of a valid code 08 driving license. Knowledge & Skills: Sound understanding of Labour Laws. Employee and Employer Rights. Collective Bargaining and Trade Unions. Disciplinary Procedures. Grievance Handling. Dispute Resolution. Workplace Policies and Compliance. Misconduct, incapacity and poor performance matters, public sector employee relations policies and delegation. Communication Skills. Negotiation Skills. Conflict Resolution. Knowledge of Labour Laws. Problem Solving Skills. Emotional Intelligence. Investigation Skills. Policy Development and Interpretation. Organisational and Administrative Skills. Integrity and Ethics. Patience and Tolerance. Attention to Detail. Professionalism. Self- Discipline. Ability to work under pressure. Ability to chair meetings. Teamwork.
jobs.duties: Managing the development of labour relations policies and guidelines. Review and quality assure labour relations policies and procedures annually. Research best practices regarding labour relations policies and procedures. Develop and implement labour relations policies, procedures and strategies. Interpret and monitor compliance with applicable labour legislation and collective agreements. Provide strategic guidance on labour relations matters for management. Managing consultation and negotiation processes. Promoting sound employer-employee relations. Represent the department at conciliation or arbitration processes. Represent the department in the provincial and sector chamber. Providing advisory service to employees in respect of grievances and poor performance. Advising management on consultation strategies and processes. Managing the grievance procedure and dispute resolution processes. Coordinating the resolution of employee grievances in accordance with policies and procedures. Handle labour disputes and represent the department at forums. Monitor trends in disputes and recommend corrective actions. Empower managers and supervisors to understand their roles and responsibilities as well as the employee relations strategies. Providing technical support to line managers on the handling of grievance procedures. Monitor the utilisation of the grievance procedures and advise on possible solutions to resolve grievances. Investigating grievances and act as a mediator in resolving grievances. Representing the department in the Dispute Resolution Platforms. Managing provision of disciplinary processes. Engaging with trade unions, employees and management regarding misconduct and disciplinary matters. Providing guidance and technical support to management on handling of disciplinary codes and collective agreements. Conducting disciplinary investigations in conjunction with relevant managers regarding allegations. Review investigation reports and recommend appropriate actions. Oversee the provision of technical assistance during disciplinary investigations. Oversee that investigations are conducted fairly, objectively and in accordance with organisational procedures. Monitor progress of disciplinary cases to ensure timely resolution. Managing collective bargaining and stakeholder relations. Coordinate labour relations matters with organised labour and unions. Supporting departmental participation in collective bargaining processes. Maintaining effective relations with employee representatives and stakeholders. Representing the department in bargaining with council meetings and other labour forums. Leading the implementation of collective agreements and bargaining council resolutions. Promoting sound labour relations with organised labour, employee representatives and other stakeholders. Managing Administration Support. Giving input in the development of policies and operational plans. Attending and responding to audit matters. Compiling and submitting monthly and quarterly reports. Determining and verifying the authenticity of the evidence provided. Managing human and financial resources. Maintaining staff discipline.
jobs.enquiries: S. Mpafa – Head Office – (eQonce) Tel No: (043) 492 1405 e- Recruitment Technical Enquiries – recruitment@ecsrac.gov.za

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Arbeidsbetrekkinge
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Arbeidsbetrekkinge by die Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad vereis, asook drie jaar se bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF L6) of by voorkeur 'n B-graad (NQF L7) soos deur SAQA erken in BCom/Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Arbeidsbetrekkinge / Arbeidsreg / Bedryfsielkunde / BAdmin / Openbare Bestuur, Bedryfsbetrekkinge / LLB (Regte). 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se relevante ervaring in arbeidsbetrekkinge op Assistentdirekteur / Juniorbestuursvlak. Diep kennis van die volgende wetlike voorskrifte: Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Dissiplinêre Kode, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, 1994 soos gewysig deur Act 30 of 2007, PFMA, Nywerheidsbeleid en ander verwante beleide en prosedures. Moet verder oor die volgende vaardighede en eienskappe beskik: Kommunikasievaardighede, Verslagdoeningsvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede, Beplanning en Organisering. Bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk. Rekenaarvaardigheid met die klem op Excel en PowerPoint. 'n Onafhanklike werker wat tydraamonderskep. Monitering en bestuur van die departement se nakoming van die Statutêre Liggame. Moet in besit wees van 'n geldige kode 08 bestuurslisensie. Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike begrip van Arbeidswette. Werknemer- en Werkgewersregte. Kollektiewe Bedinging en Vakbonde. Dissiplinêre Prosedures. Hantering van Griewe. Skikking van Geskille. Werksplekbeleide en Nakoming. Wangedrag, onvermoë en swak prestasie-aangeleenthede, openbare-sektor werknemersbetrekkingbeleid en delegasie. Kommunikasievaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Konflikoplossing. Kennis van Arbeidswette. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Emosionele Intelligensie. Ondersoekvaardighede. Beleidsontwikkeling en -interpretasie. Organisasie- en Administratiewe Vaardighede. Integriteit en Etiek. Geduld en Verdraagsaamheid. Aandag aan Detail. Professionaliteit. Selfdissipline. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë om vergaderings voor te sit. Spanwerk.
af.duties: Bestuur van die ontwikkeling van arbeidsbetrekkingbeleid en -riglyne. Hersien en gehaltewaarborg jaarliks van arbeidsbetrekkingbeleid en -prosedures. Ondersoek van beste praktyke ten opsigte van arbeidsbetrekkingbeleid en -prosedures. Ontwikkel en implementeer van arbeidsbetrekkingbeleid, -prosedures en -strategieë. Interpreteer en monitor nakoming van toepaslike arbeidswetgewing en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Verskaf strategiese leiding oor arbeidsbetrekkingaangeleenthede vir bestuur. Bestuur van konsultasie- en onderhandelingsprosesse. Bevorder van goeie werkgewer-werknemerbetrekkinge. Verteenwoordig die departement by skikkings- of arbitrasieprosesse. Verteenwoordig die departement in die provinsiale en sektorale kamer. Verskaf van adviesdienste aan werknemers ten opsigte van griewe en swak prestasie. Adviseer bestuur oor konsultasie-strategieë en -prosesse. Bestuur van die grieweprosedure en geskillopgewingsprosesse. Koördineer die oplossing van werknemersgriewe in ooreenstemming met beleid en prosedures. Hantering van arbeidsgeskille en verteenwoordiging van die departement by forums. Monitor tendense in geskille en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls aan. Bemagtig bestuurders en toesighouers om hul rolle en verantwoordelikhede sowel as die werknemersbetrekkingstrategieë te verstaan. Verskaf van tegniese ondersteuning aan lynbestuurders oor die hantering van grieweprosedures. Monitor die benutting van die grieweprosedures en adviseer oor moontlike oplossings om griewe op te los. Ondersoek van griewe en optree as bemiddelaar in die oplossing van griewe. Verteenwoordiging van die departement in die Geskillopgewingsplatforms. Bestuur van die verskaffing van dissiplinêre prosesse. Raadpleeg met vakbonde, werknemers en bestuur ten opsigte van wangedrag en dissiplinêre aangeleenthede. Verskaf van leiding en tegniese ondersteuning aan bestuur oor die hantering van dissiplinêre kodes en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Voer dissiplinêre ondersoeke in samewerking met relevante bestuurders ten opsigte van bewerings uit. Hersien ondersoekverslae en beveel toepaslike maatreëls aan. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van tegniese bystand tydens dissiplinêre ondersoeke. Hou toesig daarop dat ondersoeke billik, objektief en in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese prosedures uitgevoer word. Monitor vordering van dissiplinêre sake om tydige oplossing te verseker. Bestuur van kollektiewe bedinging en belanghebbenderelaties. Koördineer arbeidsbetrekkingaangeleenthede met georganiseerde arbeid en vakbonde. Ondersteun departementele deelname aan kollektiewe bedingingsprosesse. Onderhou effektiewe betrekkinge met werknemerverteenwoordigers en belanghebbendes. Verteenwoordiging van die departement in bedingingsraadvergaderings en ander arbeidsforums. Lei die implementering van kollektiewe ooreenkomste en bedingingsraadsbesluite. Bevorder van goeie arbeidsbetrekkinge met georganiseerde arbeid, werknemerverteenwoordigers en ander belanghebbendes. Bestuur van Administratiewe Ondersteuning. Verskaf insette in die ontwikkeling van beleid en operasionele planne. Bywoon van en reageer op ouditaangeleenthede. Samestel en indien van maandelikse en kwartaalverslae. Bepaal en verifieer die egtheid van die verskafde bewyse. Bestuur van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne. Onderhou werknemersdissipline.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu: Izinqukaba zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu sezinqukaba zabasebenzi e-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture eQonce, esifuna idiploma noma iziqu ezifanele kanye neminyaka emithathu yohlelo lokusebenza.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF L6) noma ngokuthandwa i-B Degree (NQF L7) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA kwi-BCom/Human Resource Management / Labour Relations / Labour Law / Industrial Psychology / BAdmin / Public Management, Industrial Relations / LLB (Law). Uhlu oluncane lweminyaka engu-3 yohlelo oluhlobene nezinqukaba zabasebenzi ezingeni lika-Assistant Director / Junior Management. Ulwazi olujulile lwemithetho elandelayo: Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Disciplinary Code, Public Service Regulations, Public Service Act, 1994 njengokulungiswa yi-Act 30 of 2007, PFMA, Industrial Policy kanye nezinye izinqubo nezinhlelo ezihlobene nalokhu. Kufanele futhi abe neziqu kanye nezici ezilandelayo: Amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okubhala imibiko, ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, amakhono obuholo nokubusa, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora angaphezulu. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ngokugqamisa kwi-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Umsebenzi ozimele, ohlangabezana nesikhathi. Ukugcina futhi kuphathe ukuthi umnyango uhambisana neziqu zenhlangano. Kufanele abe namalayisensi okushayela ebhalisekile ethi code 08. Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ukuqonda kahle ngoMthetho weLabour. Amalungelo abasebenzi nethi melawulo. Ukuhlangana ngokubili nokubambisana nama-Trade Union. Izinqubo zesisisho. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Izinqubo ze-Wood Policies nokuhambisana. Izindaba zokwenza okungalungile, ukungakwazi nokusebenza kabi, izinqubo zamaphoyinti abasebenzi bomonchakali kanye nokuqwashisa. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Ukuxazulula izinkulumo zombango. Ulwazi loMthetho weLabour. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlakaniphile. Amakhono okuphenya. Ukuthuthukiswa nokuhumusha inqubo. Amakhono obubungaqotho. Ukuzethemba nokuziphatha. Ukubekezela nokubekezelela. Ukunakeniswa iminikelo. Ukuziphatha ngokuzenzela. Isithunzi. Ukuzithiba. Ukusebenza ngaphezulu. Amakhono okuhlola izinkomfa. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo nezinkomba ezinqkaba zabasebenzi. Ukubuyekeza futhi kuqinisekiswe izinqubo nezinhlelo zenqkaba zabasebenzi zonyaka ngamunye. Ukuphenya izinqubo ezinhle ezihlobene nezinquba zabasebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ufake izinquba zabasebenzi, izinqubo kanye nezinhlelo. Ukuhumusha futhi ulawule ukuthi kuhlangatshezwa yini nomthetho weLabour kanye nokuqoqwa kwabasebenzi. Ukunika inkombandlela ezindabeni zenqkaba zabasebenzi ekuphathweni. Ukuphatha inqubo yokuxoxisana nokuxoxa. Ukukhuthaza izinqaba ezinhle phakathi kwethimela nabasebenzi. Ukumela umnyaku ezinqabeni zokuqondisa noma ekuguquleni izinkinga. Ukumela umnyaku esikhwameni sezohlu kanye nesigaba. Ukunikela ngesibawulo kubasebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinkinga nokusebenza kabi. Ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa ngemikhuba yokuxoxa kanye nezinkomfa. Ukuphatha inqubo yokusombulula izinkinga. Ukubambisana ekuxazululeni izinkinga zabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinqubo nezinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kwemibhalo ye-Labour futhi umyaleze umnyaku. Ukugcina ukuthi kuhamba kanjani imibhalo yezinkinga futhi ukubuyekezele okungenzeka ukuxazulula. Ukukhuthaza abaphathi futhi abalawuli bazuqonde izindima kanye nemithwalo yabo kanye nemigomo yamaphoyinti. Ukunikela ngesebenzelo ngokocwaticwingxindi kubaphathi beNqaba ngokuphathwa kweNqubo yeSisisho. Ukubeka ngokusetshenziswa kweNqubo yeSisisho futhi unike izinkomba ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Ukuphenya izinhluphele futhi usebenze njengomxhumanisi ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Ukumela umnyaku kumabonakaliso eNkinga eziXazululwa. Ukuphathwa kwenkomba yokuvekela izinkomfa. Ukuxhumana nama-Trade Union, abasebenzi kanye nabaphathi ngokuhambisana nokungenza okungalungile kanye nezindaba zesisisho. Ukunika inkombandlela kanye nesebenzelo ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zesisisho kanye nokuxhumana. Ukwenza ukuphenya ngokuhambisana nasekuthuthukisweni kwezinsimba zabasebenzi. Ukubuyekeza imibiko yokuphenya futhi ukuthumela izinyathelo ezifanele. Ukuphathwa kwesebenzelo ngesikhathi sokuphenya ngemikhuba. Ukugcina amapuzu kuthathwe ngokulunga, ngokungazibi futhi ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zenqaba. Ukugcina ukuqhubeka kwamacala okungenwa kusesigabeni. Ukuphathwa kokuxoxa ngokuvunyelana nabahlele kanye nemibhangqwano. Ukuxhuma izindaba zokuthintana nabahlele kanye nama-Trade Union. Ukusekela ukubambe iqhaza kwenkatha yokuxoxisana nabahleli. Ukugcina izinhlelo ezinhle kubamele abasebenzi kanye nabahlele. Ukumela umnyaku ezinkomfakwenini zokuqashwa nasezinye izinkundla zenkqkaba. Ukukhokula ukusetshenziswa kokuqoqwa kwemibhangqwano kanye nezinqumbulu zemibhangqwano. Ukukhuthaza inqkaba ezinhle abahleleli, abamele abasebenzi kanye nabahleli. Ukuphathwa kokusekela umsebenzi. Ukunikela ngemininigelo ekuthuthukisweni izinhlelo kanye nezinhlela zokusebenza. Ukubhukuda kanye nokuphendula ezindabeni i-Audit. Ukuqamba futhi ukuthumela imibiko yamnyanga kanye nehlanzi. Ukuthola futhi uqinisekise ukuthi iqiniso elifakwe ngokukhanyayo. Ukuphathwa kwamathuva kanye nezimali. Ukugcina inqondo esebenzini.

xh.title: Isekela iqumrhu: Iindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini
xh.summary: Isekela iqumrhu leendaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini kwisebe lezemidlalo, iindalo, nezobugcisa nentsokoloko kwiphondo leMpuma Koloni eQonce, lifuna idiploma okanye idigrive ehambelana nayo kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ohlolokuhle lolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSekolo samabanga aphakamileyo sesebe lezemfundo sibandakanya iDiploma yaseMzantsi Afrika (NQF L6) okanye ngokukhethwayo iDigrive yeB (NQF L7) evunyiwe yiSAQA kwiBCom/Indlela yoLawulo lweZemvelo / Iindaba zoBudlelwane basesebenzini / umThetho weNdlela zoBusebenzini / iNdlela yokuQonda ingqondo yeNtsolompilo / iBAdmin / uLawulo lukaZwelonke, Iindaba zeNgqiqo zoNyango / iLLB (uMthetho). Iqondo elingentla kwamava emyaka emithathu exelwe ngakumbi kweendaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini kwinqanaba likaSekela uMlawuli / uLawulo oluBuncwane. Ulwazi olunjingalwazi lemithetho elandelayo: uMthetho weNdaba zoBudlelwane basesebenzini, uMthetho weMigaqo eBhalwe ngokusesikweni yoBusebenzini, uMthetho woLingano lwaBasebenzisi, iKhowudi yoNgcinezelo, iMigaqo yeNkonzo kaZwelonke, uMthetho weNkonzo kaZwelonke ka-1994njengoko ulungiswe ngumthetho wama-30 ka-2007, iPFMA, iNqunqamvume yona kwamashishino neminye imigaqo noluqwalaselo ehambelana nayo. Makabe nakho nokulandela kakhulu iimfuno nempawu zilandelayo: amandla okunxibelelana, amandla okubhala iingxelo, ulwazi olusezikrunyweni ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, uLawulo lweProjekhthi, uLawulo lweMali, amandla oLawulo nokuQonda abanye, uCwangciso nokuhlela. Qgelaqgelisa ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Ulwazi lwesikrini lokusebenza ngokugqamisa iExcel nePowerPoint. Umsebenzi ozingelayo, ogqiba kwiyure ezicetyiswayo. Ukuphonononga nokuqwalasela ukuzigcina emthethweni kwesebe kwiBumba zoMthetho. Makabe nakho ilayisense yokuqhuba ye-code 08. ULwazi namandla: Ukuqonda okuphantse kolwazi ngomthetho weendaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini. Amalungelo oQashiyo nabaQashi. Iindlela zokuNxibelelana ngokusemthethweni namashishini abasebenzi. Inkqubo yokuNxibelelana ngokusemthethweni. Ukuphathwa kweNgxelo. Indlela yokuzalisa iingxaki. Ukwenziwa kokuMiselwa kweendaba. Iindlela nokuQwalasela iNgcamango. Ukutshatiswa kwemisebenzi nokubonakala kabi ngomsebenzi, noko kuvakalayo nalokungavakalanga ngokubakho kwexesha elibi, imigaqo yesikhululo seenkonzo ekwikomkhulu elinye iqela karhulumente namagunya. Amandla eNkxibelelano. Amandla eNjingalwazi. Iindlela zokuQwalasela iingxaki. Amandla eQand'ingxaki. Ukuzinikela ngokomnqweno. Amandla eSenzakaliso. Amandla eNkqubo yokuQamba iMigaqo nokuyiqonda. Iziphinqa ngokulawula iqumrhu. Ukukhanya ngokomthetho nezindaba ezimalunga nobuqhetshama nokuzithiba. Inqwenelelo nokunyamezela. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Iinzame ezingangenwa kukuzenzisela. Amadlelwane ngokubakho komngeni otyhila iNgqungquthela. Ukusebenza ngokomanyano.
xh.duties: UkuLawula ukuyila kwezigaqo nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zolawulo lwezindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini. Ukuqwalasela onke unyaka nokugqiba iinkqubo ngokugqitha amaxabiso wezindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini. Ukuphonononga izimvo ngokomthetho ngokwemigaqo yendlela yokwenza izindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini. Ukuyila nokusebenzisa iinkqubo, imigaqo nokuqwalasela iindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini. Ukuqondisisa nokuphonononga isigqibo ngomthetho olu hambelana noyilo ngemigaqo yamatyala. Ukubonelela ngokuqondisisa ngokomthetho ngokulawula izindaba zobudlelwane basesebenzini ekuqwalaselweni. Ukulawula ukuzolisa kwenkqubo yokubonisana nokutshatisa ngokomthetho. Ukukhusaza ukulawula ukhuseleko kwayo kunye nokudibanisa abaqashiyo. Ukumela isigqibo kwinselelo yokumiselwa kwenkcazelo yeNkqubo yokuqwalasela iingxabano. Ukumela isigqibo kwibunga lephondo. Ukubonelela ngamava obulumko abo kunye nokuqwalasela imigaqo yokubakho kwexesha elibi kunye nokwenza iingxelo ngokungakhangelwa kwexesha elingcono. Ukuqwalasela ukubakho kokungavakalanga nokusebenzisa iNkqubo yokuzisa izindaba ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo yokuzisa izindaba ezihlangabezana namava abo. Ukubakha nokubakha kweendaba ezininzi ezingaziswa kwinkqubo yokuzisa iingxaki kwaye asebenze njengomlamli ekuzisweni iingxaki.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R 584 370 per annum (Level 09), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management at the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Gqeberha, requiring a diploma or degree and three years' HR experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate Plus National Diploma (NQF L6) or preferably a B Degree (NQF L7) as recognised by SAQA in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management /Public Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Industrial Psychology. Minimum of three (3) years’ functional experience as Senior Personnel Practitioner Level (7/8) in Human Resource Management. Extensive knowledge of the PERSAL and Pension Case Management systems. Human Resource Management Methodology, Principles and Strategies. COIDA, DPSA Directives, Customer Service principles (Batho Pele Principles). Budgeting and Financial Management, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury regulations, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Minimum information security standard (MISS), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Skills: Coaching and Mentoring, Conflict Management, Critical and Innovative Thinking, Inspire Commitment, People Management, Performance and oversight, Performance/ Project Management, Quality Assurance, Risk Management. Ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid (Code 8) driving license is required.
jobs.duties: Facilitate and monitor Human Resource Management and Personnel Conduct: attend and convene Human Resource meetings. Coordinate recruitment, selection and appointment process. Develop and implement recruitment and selection plans in line with approved workforce plans. Champion the advertising, screening, shortlisting, interviewing, and appointments of employees. Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, policies, and recruitment procedures. Provide support to the selection committees during recruitment and selection processes and technical support on recruitment matters. Monitor vacancy rates and recruitment turnaround times. Prepare recruitment reports and maintain accurate recruitment records. Promote employment equity and transformation objectives during recruitment processes. Administer conditions of service. Manage the implementation and administration of employee conditions of service. Understanding of GEPF and Pension Case Management system. Ensure accurate administration of appointments, transfers, promotions, terminations, leave and leave gratuity management, overtime, housing allowance, long-service recognition, and other employee benefits. Provide guidance on human resource policies and applicable legislation. Monitor compliance with service conditions and resolve employee enquiries. Ensure accurate personnel records and HR information management. Liaise with payroll and other stakeholders to resolve personnel administration matters. Coordinate performance management and development services. Provide guidance and training to managers and employees on performance management processes. Monitor compliance with performance planning, reviews, assessments, and development plans. Identify training and development needs based on performance outcomes. Ensure proper record keeping and reporting on performance management activities. Facilitate and monitor Human Resource Development and EPMDS. Monitor the development of Workplace Skills Plan. Monitor development of performance contracts. Conduct quarterly reviews and Validation of Reviews and Assessment. Coordinate the administration of PMDS, Monitor and facilitate Training & Capacitation of employees. Coordinate labour relations services, Facilitate the implementation of labour relations policies and procedures. Give advice to management on labour legislation and collective agreements. Execute disciplinary, grievance and incapacity processes. Promote sound employer-employee relations and conflict resolution. Monitor implementation of labour relations decisions and maintain confidential records. Coordinate wellness programmes services. Plan and implement employee health and wellness programmes (EHWP). Develop and implement wellness initiatives addressing physical, emotional, financial, and psychosocial wellbeing. Organise awareness campaigns on health, wellness, and work-life balance. Facilitate counselling referrals and employee support services. Monitor employee participation and evaluate programme effectiveness. Promote a healthy, safe, and productive work environment. Management of all administration processes. Give input in the development of policies and operational plans. Develop and interpret reporting templates. Determine and verify the authenticity of the evidence provided. Attend and respond to audit matters. Supervise human resources. Maintain staff discipline.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N. Dyalvane– Nelson Mandela District Tel No: (041) 492 1230/1232 e- Recruitment Technical Enquiries – recruitment@ecsrac.gov.za

If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Gqeberha, wat 'n diploma of graad vereis asook drie jaar se ondervinding in menslike hulpbronbestuur.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus Nasionale Diploma (NQF L6) of by voorkeur 'n B-graad (NQF L7) soos deur SAQA erken in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Personeelbestuur / Publieke Administrasie / Publieke Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur / Nywerheidsielkunde. Minimum van drie (3) jaar se funksionele ondervinding as Senior Personnel Practitioner Vlak (7/8) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Uitgebreide kennis van die PERSAL- en Pension Case Management-stelsels. Menslike Hulpbronbestuur Metodologie, Beginsels en Strategieë. COIDA, DPSA Riglyne, Kliëntediensbeginsels (Batho Pele-beginsels). Begroting en Finansiële Bestuur, Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic Condition of Employment Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National Treasury-regulasies, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), Minimum information security standard (MISS), Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Vaardighede: Afgerigtheid en Mentorskap, Konflikbestuur, Kritiese en Innoverende Denke, Toewyding Inspireer, Mensebestuur, Prestasie en Toesig, Prestasie/Projekbestuur, Kwaliteitsversekering, Risikobestuur. Vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige (Kode 8) bestuurslisensie word vereis.
af.duties: Fassiliteer en monitor Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Personeelgedrag: bywoon en byeenroep van Menslike Hulpbron-vergaderings. Koördineer werwing, seleksie en aanstellingsprosesse. Ontwikkel en implementeer werwing- en seleksieplanne in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde werksmagplanne. Beyker die adverteer, sif, kortlys, onderhoudvoering en aanstellings van werknemers. Verseker nakoming van relevante wetgewing, beleide en wertingsprosedures. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die seleksiekomitees tydens werwing- en seleksieprosesse en tegniese ondersteuning oor wertingsake. Monitor vakansiesyfers en werting-omkeertye. Berei wertingsverslae voor en hou akkurate wertingsrekords aan. Bevorder indiensnemingsgelykheid en transformasiedoelwitte tydens wertingsprosesse. Administreer diensvoorwaardes. Bestuur die implementering en administrasie van werknemers se diensvoorwaardes. Begrip van GEPF en Pension Case Management-stelsel. Verseker akkurate administrasie van aanstellings, oorplasing, bevorderings, beëindigings, verlof en verlofgratifikasiebestuur, oortyd, behuisingsallowansie, langdienserkenning en ander werknemersvoordele. Verskaf leiding oor menslike hulpbronbeleid en toepaslike wetgewing. Monitor nakoming van diensvoorwaardes en los werknemersnavrae op. Verseker akkurate personeelrekords en HR-inligtingsbestuur. Skakel met loonstaat en ander belanghebbendes om personeeladministrasie-aangeleenthede op te los. Koördineer prestasiebestuur en ontwikkelingsdienste. Verskaf leiding en opleiding aan bestuurders en werknemers oor prestasiebestuurprosesse. Monitor nakoming van prestasiebeplanning, hersienings, assesserings en ontwikkelingsplanne. Identifiseer opleidings- en ontwikkelingsbehoeftes gebaseer op prestasie-uitkomste. Verseker behoorlike rekordhouding en verslagdoening oor prestasiebestuuraktiwiteite. Fassiliteer en monitor Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling en EPMDS. Monitor die ontwikkeling van Workplace Skills Plan. Monitor ontwikkeling van prestasiekontrakte. Voer kwartaal-hersienings en validering van hersienings en assesserings uit. Koördineer die administrasie van PMDS, Monitor en fassiliteer Opleiding en Bemagtiging van werknemers. Koördineer arbeidsverhoudingsdienste, Fassiliteer die implementering van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid en -prosedures. Verskaf advies aan bestuur oor arbeidswetgewing en kollektiewe ooreenkomste. Voer dissiplinêre, klagte en onvermoënsprosesse uit. Bevorder goeie werkgewer-werknemer-verhoudinge en konflikbeslegting. Monitor implementering van arbeidsverhoudingsbesluite en hou vertrouelike rekords aan. Koördineer welsynsprogramdienste. Beplan en implementeer werknemergesondheids- en welsynsprogramme (EHWP). Ontwikkel en implementeer welsynsinitiatiewe wat fisieke, emosionele, finansiële en psigososiale welsyn aanspreek. Reël bewusmakingsveldtogte oor gesondheid, welsyn en werk-lewe balans. Fassiliteer berading-verwysings en werknemersondersteuningsdienste. Monitor werknemerdeelname en evalueer programdoeltreffendheid. Bevorder 'n gesonde, veilige en produktiewe werksomgewing. Bestuur van alle administrasieprosesse. Verskaf insette by die ontwikkeling van beleid en operasionele planne. Ontwikkel en interpreteer verslagdoeningsjablone. Bepaal en verifieer die egtheid van die verskafde bewyse. Bywoon en reageer op ouditaangeleenthede. Fassiliteer menslike hulpbronne. Handhaaf personeeldissipline.

zu.title: Umncedisi weNduna: ekuPhathweni kwabaBantu
zu.summary: Umncedisi weNduna: ekuPhathweni kwabaBantu eMnyangweni weMidlalo, iNdelo, uBugcisa nenHlalo eGqeberha, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu kanye namava eminyaka emithathu kokuqashwa kwabantu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seNational Senior Certificate + i-National Diploma (NQF L6) noma ngokuthandwayo i-B Degree (NQF L7) evunywe i-SAQA kwi-Human Resource Management / Personnel Management /Public Administration / Public Management / Business Management / Industrial Psychology. Ubuncane beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okusebenza njengo-Senior Personnel Practitioner Level (7/8) kwi-Human Resource Management. ulwazi olubanzi ngezinhlelo ze-PERSAL ne-Pension Case Management. i-Human Resource Management Methodology, Principles and Strategies. i-COIDA, i-DPSA Directives, imigomo yoku Phakamisa iNkosi (i-Batho Pele Principles). uBajethi nokuPhathwa kweMali, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Basic Condition of Employment Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho ye-National Treasury, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act, i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA), i-Minimum information security standard (MISS), i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Amakhono: uKwelisa nokuQondisa, ukuLawulwa kwezingxabano, ukuCabanga okujuqu kanye nokuQamba, ukuQinisekisa ukuzinikela, ukuPhathwa kwaBantu, ukuQashwa kanye nokuQapha, ukuPhathwa kokuQashwa/ amaPhrojekthi, ukuQinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuLawulwa kwezingozi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva nokuzimele. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code 8) esemthethweni iyadingeka.
zu.duties: uKwazi ukulawula kanye nokuqapha ukuPhathwa kwaBantu nokuZiphatha kwaBasebenzi: ukuya kubuye uhlele imihlangano ye-Human Resource. ukuHlanganisa inqubo yokubiza abantu, ukukhetha kanye nokuqasha. ukuHlela kanye nokuphothula izinhlelo zokubiza abantu nokukhetha ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zokuqasha ezamukelekile. ukuQedela ukuthumela imibiko yokubiza, ukuhlola, ukuhweba ngohlu lokuqasha ngokufushane, ukuxoxa, nokuqesha basebenzi. ukuQinisekiswa kokuziphatha ngokwemithetho ephathelene, imigomo, kanye nenqubo yokubiza abantu. ukuNika inkxaso amakomidi okukhetha ngesikhathi kwenqubo yokubiza nokukhetha nokulawula okusemgangathweni ezindabeni zokubiza abantu. ukuQapha amazinga okungalashwa kanye nesikhathi sokuqasha abantu. ukuLungiselela imibiko yokubiza kanye nokugcina irekhodi ehlelwe kahle. ukuKhuthaza ukulingana kokuqashwa kanye namagagu okuguqula ngesikhathi senqubo yokubisa abantu. ukuLawulwa kwezimo zokusebenza. ukuPhatha ukuphothula kanye nokuphatha izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi. ukuQonda i-GEPF nenhlelo ye-Pension Case Management. ukuQinisekisa ukulawulwa okuhle kokuxoshwa kwendlu, ukudluliselwa, ukukhushulelwa, ukupheliswa kweziqu, ukushiya kanye nokuphathwa kwekhomishini yoku shiya, amahora okusebenza ngaphezulu, inkokhelo yendlu, ukuqatshelwa okuhle ngokwenza isikhathi eside, kanye ezinye izinzuzo zabasebenzi. ukuNika isiqondiso ngemigomo yoluntu nangemithetho elandelayo. ukuQapha ukuziphatha ngokwemigomo nangokwezimo zokuqashwa kanye nokuqxaxa imibuzo yonke yomuntu oqashiwe. ukuQinisekisa irekhodi ehle kakhulu yoluntu kanye nokulawulwa kolwazi lwe-HR. ukuXoxa nalabo abaphathe i-payroll nalabo abanye abahluzekile ukuxazula imiba yokuphathwa koluntu. ukuHlelanganisa amaphlanji ezenza kahle kakhulu. ukuQonda izinhlelo zokuqapha nokuphathwa kwezinkomba eziyisikhuthazo. ukuHlelanganisa imisebenzi yokulawula imigomo nokuqamba iplani yokusebenza.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNgqalashe: uLawulo lweNk zasobunini
xh.summary: Umncedisi weNgqalashe: uLawulo lweNk zasobunini kwiSebe leMzobi, iNdlalo, iBuhoro nesesiko kwiGqeberha, lifuna idiploma okanye idigri kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwisebe leHR.
xh.requirements: Isatifiketi seNqanaba seSizwe Plus iDiploma yeSizwe (NQF L6) okanye ngokuthandwayo iDigri yeB (NQF L7) njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA kuLawulo lweNk zasobunini / uLawulo lwabantu / uLawulo lweLuntu lwoLuntu / uLawulo lweLuntu / uLawulo lweShishini / iNyanisiso yeNdalo. Ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okusebenza njengompraktishani oMncedi weNqanaba (7/8) kuLawulo lweNk zasobunini. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nePERSAL nesePension Case Management systems. Indlela, iimigaqo kunye namacebo oLawulo lweNk zasobunini. ICOIDA, iimiyalelo zeDPSA, iimigaqo yeNkonzo kubathengi (iimigaqo yeBatho Pele). uQwalaselo lweMali kunye noLawulo lweMali, uMthetho weNhlangano yeNdalo, uMthetho weQabiso lweNkqubo, uMthetho weMigaqo esiYintsingiselo yoLuntu, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA), iimigaqo zeNational Treasury, uMthetho woPhakamiso lokuFikelela kwelwazi, uMthetho weeNkonzo zoLawulo (PAJA), iNqanaba elingaphantsi loKhuseleko lolwazi (MISS), uMthetho woKhuselo lweLwazi ngabucala (POPIA) Amandla: uQeqesho kunye neNkxaso, uLawulo lweNgxabano, ukuCinga okuBalulekileyo nokuQamba iinto ezintsha, uKuthembisa isithembiso, uLawulo lwabantu, ukuQwalasela nokuBukeka, uLawulo lweNkqubo/ lweProjekthi, uQinisekiso lweMgangatho, uLawulo lengozi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo lodwa. Ifuna ilayisenesi yokushayela evakalayo (iKhowudi 8).
xh.duties: uKunceda kwaye ulawule uLawulo lweNk zasobunini nokuziphatha kwabantu: ukubakhona kwaye ubize iindibano zeNk zasobunini. uKulungelelanisa inkqubo yokubumba, ukukhetha nokwamkela. uKuqamba nokusebenzisa iicandelo zokubumba nokuKhetha ngokwale ndlela egunyaziweyo yamacingo abasebenzi. uKukhuthaza ukwenziwa kokutsha, ukuhlaziwa, ukubeka kuluhlu, iintervyu, nokuQinisekisa abasebenzi. uQinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwemigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokubumba ezifaneleyo. uKunikela ngenkxaso kumakomiti okukhetha ngelixa wenza inkqubo yokubumba nokuKhetha ngenkxaso yobugcisa kwimiba yokubumba. uKuhlola amanqanaba okulahleko nakuqhubeka kwexesha lokubumba. uKulungiselela iingxelo zokubumba kwaye ugcine irekhodi echanekileyo yokubumba. uKukhuthaza ukulingana kokwamkelwa kwaye nemiqondo yokuGuqula ngelixa wenza inkqubo yokubumba. uLawulo lwemigaqo yenkonzo. uKulawula ukusebenzisa nokuLawula imigaqo yenkonzo yabasebenzi. ukuQonda iGEPF nesePension Case Management system. uQinisekisa uLawulo oluchanekileyo lokwamkelwa, ukuDluliselwa, ukuPhakamiswa, ukuPheliswa, ukuLawulwa kweNkonzo nemivuzo yayo, iiyure ezongezelelweyo, imvuzo yendlu, ukuQatshelwa kweenkonko ezinde, nezinye izibonezelo zabasebenzi. uKunikela nomqondiso ngemigaqo yenk zasobunini nengqongqo ezifaneleyo. uKuhlola ukwamkelwa kwemigaqo yenkonzo kwaye uxazule imibuzo yabasebenzi. uQinisekisa ukuba irekhodi yabantu yamkelekile kwaye ulawulo lwelwazi leHR lulungile. ukuXhumana nomlawuli wemivuzo nabanjiniyeni abangenako ukuXazula imiba yolawulo lwabantu. uKulungelelanisa iinkonzo zoLawulo lweNkqubo nokuPhuhliswa. uKunikela nomqondiso nokuQeqesha abaphathi nabasebenzi ngokwenkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo. uKuhlola ukwamkelwa kwecandelo loLawulo, ukuHlola, ukuQwalasela, nokuQamba iiCandelo. uKuqaphela iimfuno zoQeqesho nokuPhuhliswa ngokwemveliso yeNkqubo. uQinisekisa ukugcina irekhodi ngokufanelekileyo nokuChaza ngenkqubo yoLawulo lweNkqubo. uKunceda kwaye uHlole uPhuhliswa lweNk zasobunini kunye neEPMDS. uKuhlola uPhuhliswa lweCandelo leNkqubo yeseKhumsha. uKuhlola uPhuhliswa kweziQinisekiso zeNkqubo. uKwenza ukuHlola kwamakota nokuQinisekisa ukuHlola nokuQwalasela. uKulungelelanisa uLawulo lwePMDS, ukuHlola kwaye uQeqeshe kwaye uNcedise abasebenzi. uKulungelelanisa iinkonzo zodidi lwenhlangano, uKukhuthaza ukusebenzisa imigaqo yodidi lwabaSebenzi. uNceda abaphathi ngomthetho odidi lwabaSebenzi noma singqinisiso. uKwenza iinkqubo zodidi lwezohlwayo, izikhalazo nobunakho. uKukhuthaza ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kqhayiya nabaSebenzi nokuXazula iingxabano. uKuhlola ukuSebenzisa jobs.title: Assistant Director: Skills Development
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R584 370 per annum (Level 09), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Coordinate workplace skills plans, training reports and skills gap analysis at the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture Head Office in Qonce.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF L6) or preferably a B Degree (NQF L7) in Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development/ Public Administration/ Public Management qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Skills Development and Training coordination, of which three (3) years should be at a supervisory level (SL 7 / 8). Skills Development Facilitator certificate and Train the Trainer certificate will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Good interpretation and knowledge of the National Skills Development Strategy, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levy Act, Public Service Regulations, knowledge of the compulsory training programmes in the Public Service and training on various programme, knowledge of PERSAL system, planning, coordination, organising, analytical and people management skills, sound verbal and written Communication skills, presentation skills, high sense of responsibility and accountability, interpersonal, time management skills, attention to details, experience in managing long term training programmes (Learnership, Internship, Workplace Integrated Learning), experience in developing and submitting Workplace Skills Plan and various SETA’s reports, project management skills and ability to coordinate, manage and closeup training and development projects, computer literacy in the Microsoft package i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ability to work under pressure and independently and or as part of a team. A valid (Code 8) driving license.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the development and submission of the workplace skills plan (WSP) and annual training report (ATR). Conduct skills gap analysis and training assessment across the organization. Align skills development plans with strategic objectives and workforce plans. Facilitate consolidation of inputs from business units to inform training priorities. Administer integration of skills development initiatives into departmental plans and budgets. Monitor progress against planned training interventions and recommend adjustments where necessary. Manage and implement skills development initiatives. Coordinate artisans’ development programs. Coordinate the implementation of training and development programmes. Develop and maintain the annual training schedule. Facilitate logistics for training interventions. Engage with internal stakeholders and external accredited training providers. Administer nomination and enrolment of employees for training. Monitor and track training delivery against the approved plan. Maintain accurate training records and documents. Coordinate and facilitate comprehensive Induction Programmes. Develop and maintain induction programme schedule. Coordinate logistics and resources for induction sessions. Facilitate delivery of induction session. Engage with internal stakeholders. Track attendance and completion of induction programmes. Evaluate and improve induction effectiveness. Coordinate career path development programmes. Promote the development of leadership and succession programmes targeting emerging leaders, middle management and high potential staff. Promote a culture of continuous learning and promotional growth. Facilitate mentorship relationships. Conduct coaching sessions. Monitor progress and provide feedback. Management of administration support. Give input on the development of policies and operational plans. Attend and respond to audit matters. Compile and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Determine and verify the authenticity of the evidence provided. Supervise human resources. Maintain staff discipline.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vaardigheidsontwikkeling
af.summary: Koördineer werkplek-vaardigheidsplanne, opleidingsverslae en vaardigheidsgapatkering by die Departement van Sport, Rekreasie, Kuns en Kultuur se Hoofkantoor in Qonce.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF L6) of by voorkeur 'n B-graad (NQF L7) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/ Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling/ Opleiding en Ontwikkeling/ Openbare Administrasie/ Openbare Bestuur-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Vaardigheidsontwikkeling en Opleidingskoördinasie, waarvan drie (3) jaar op toesigvlak (SL 7 / 8) moet wees. 'n Vaardigheidsontwikkelingsfasilitateur-sertifikaat en 'n Train the Trainer-sertifikaat sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie interpretasie en kennis van die Nasionale Vaardigheidsontwikkelingstrategie, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levy Act, Openbare Diensregulasies, kennis van die verpligte opleidingsprogramme in die Openbare Diens en opleiding oor verskeie programme, kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel, beplanning, koördinasie, organisering, analitiese en mensbestuursvaardighede, goeie mondelingse en skriftelike Kommunikasievaardighede, voorleggingsvaardighede, hoë sin van verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid, interpersoonlike, tydbestuursvaardighede, aandag aan besonderhede, ervaring in die bestuur van langtermyn opleidingsprogramme (Learnership, Internship, Workplace Integrated Learning), ervaring in die ontwikkeling en indiening van Werkplek-vaardigheidsplan en verskeie SETA-verslae, projekbestuursvaardighede en vermoë om opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprojekte te koördineer, bestuur en afsluit, rekenaarvaardigheid in die Microsoft-pakket d.w.s. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik en of as deel van 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige (Kode 8) bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer die ontwikkeling en indiening van die werkplek-vaardigheidsplan (WSP) en die jaarlikse opleidingsverslag (ATR). Voer vaardigheidsgapatkering en opleidingsassessering dwarsoor die organisasie uit. Lijn vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplanne met strategiese doelwitte en werksmagplanne in alignment. Fasiliteer die konsolidasie van bydraes van besigheidseenhede om opleidingsprioriteite te inlig. Administreer die integrasie van vaardigheidsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe in departementele planne en begrotings. Monitor vordering teenoor beplande opleidingsintervensies en beveel waar nodig aanpassings aan. Bestuur en implementeer vaardigheidsontwikkelingsinisiatiewe. Koördineer ambagsmanne se ontwikkelingsprogramme. Koördineer die implementering van opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprogramme. Ontwikkel en onderhou die jaarlikse opleidingskedule. Fasiliteer logistiek vir opleidingsintervensies. Skakel met interne belanghebbendes en eksterne geakkrediteerde opleidingsverskaffers. Administreer nominasie en inskrywing van werknemers vir opleiding. Monitor en volg opleidingslewering teenoor die goedgekeurde plan. Onderhou akkurate opleidingsrekords en dokumente. Koördineer en fasiliteer omvattende inlywingsprogramme. Ontwikkel en onderhou inlywingsprogramkedule. Koördineer logistiek en hulpbronne vir inlywingsessies. Fasiliteer aflewering van inlywingsessie. Skakel met interne belanghebbendes. Volg bywoning en voltooiing van inlywingsprogramme. Evalueer en verbeter inlywing se doeltreffendheid. Koördineer loopbaanpad-ontwikkelingsprogramme. Bevorder die ontwikkeling van leierskaps- en opvolgingsprogramme wat gemik is op naaste leiende leiers, middelbestuur en hoëpotensiaalpersoneel. Bevorder 'n kultuur van deurlopende leer en bevorderlike groei. Fasiliteer mentorskapsverhoudings. Voer afrigtingsessies uit. Monitor vordering en verskaf terugvoer. Bestuur van administratiewe ondersteuning. Verskaf insette oor die ontwikkeling van beleide en operasionele planne. Bywoon en reageer op ouditsake. Stel en dien maandelikse en kwartaalverslae in. Bepaal en verifieer die egtheid van die verskafde bewyse. Toesig oor menslike hulpbronne. Onderhou personeeldissipline.

zu.title: Umcedisi Weqhaza: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwekhono
zu.summary: Qondanisa amaphulani ekhono emsebenzini, imibiko yeseluleko kanye nenhlolokhono yokuhlukanisa amakhono emnyangweni wezemidlalo, ukuzilibazisa, izinkomishi nobuciko nenzuko enkabeni eQonce.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi sePhakeme leSizwe kanye neDiploma yeSizwe (NQF L6) noma ngaphezu kwalokho idigri ye-B (NQF L7) ekuphatweni kweBantu / ekuthuthukisweni kweBantu / ekuloleni nasekuThuthukisweni / ekuphatweni kwezezulu / ekuphatweni komphakathi njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwazisa okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) ngokuhlangenwe nakho ekuthuthukisweni kwekhono nasekuqondaniseni ukulolwa, lapho kuleyo minyaka emithathu (3) kumele ibe ngazinga ebuselayi (SL 7 / 8). Isitifiketi seSikhulu sokuthuthukiswa kwekhono nesithifiketi sokulola abaloli sizobe yindlela engeza inzuzo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ukuhumusha okuhle nolwazi ngokuQondiswa kokuthuthukiswa kwekhono leSizwe, uMthetho wokuPhatha kwezimali Komphakathi, uMthetho wokuThuthukiswa kwekhono, uMthetho weNkxwabo yokuThuthukiswa kwekhono, imiThetho yoMphakathi, ukwazi ngezenzo zokulola ezingaphezu kwezinyunwana kwinkonzo yoMphakathi nokulola izinhlelo ezahlukene, ukwazi ngesistimu ye-PERSAL, ukucubungula, ukuqondanisa, ukuhlela, ukuhlola kanye nakhono okuphathwa abantu, amakhono okuxoxa ngomlomo nokubhala angemva kwesikhathi, amakhono okubonakalisa, indaba ephakeme yobudlelwano neyokubophezela, amakhono aphakathi nabantu, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukunakela imininingwane, okuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatweni izinhlelo zokulola zesikhathi eside (ukufundela umsebenzi, ukuphatwa kweziqu, ukufunda okuhlangene nemisebenzi), okuhlangenwe nakho ekwakheni nokuthumela iPhulani lekhono laseMsebenzini nemibiko ehlukene ye-SETA, amakhono okuphatha iphulo nendawo yokuqondanisa, ukuphatha nokuphuma kwamaphulo okulola nokuThuthukiswa, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kusikelo phakathi kwe-Microsoft i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwegcino nokuzimela noma njengengxenye yeqembu. Ilayisense esemthethweni (Code 8) yokushayela.
zu.duties: Qondanisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuthunyelwa kophulani wekhono laseMsebenzini (WSP) nembiko yonyaka wokulola (ATR). Yenza isilinganiso sokuhlukanisa amakhono kanye nokuhlolwa kokulola kulo lonke isikhungo. Qondanisa amaphulani ekhono nenhloso ezinhle kanye namaphulani abasebenzi. Qondisa ukuhlanganiswa kokuvela kumayunithi ukuze kuthuthukise izinto eziphambili zokulola. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwekhono kumaphulani kanye nakuqoqosho lomnyango. Qapha inqubo yokulola okuhleliwe futhi wenze izincomo lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwekhono. Qondanisa izinhlela zokuthuthukiswa kubalulekile. Qondanisa ukusebenziswa kwezinhlela zokulola kanye noKuthuthukiswa. Thuthukisa futhi ugcine isikhathi sokulola sonyaka. Lungiselela izinsiza zokulola ezingene. Zibandakanye nalabo abaphakathi kanye nalaba abaphandle abagunyaziwe ukulola. Phatha ukubekwa kanye nokubhalwa kwabasebenzi ukulola. Qapha futhi ulandele ukulethwa kokulola ngokuhambisana nalephulani esemthethweni. Gcina imibiko yokulola eqinisekile nemiqulu. Qondanisa futhi wenze izinhlela zokungenisa ezingene. Thuthukisa futhi ugcine isikhathi sehlelo lokungenisa. Qondanisa izinsiza nezimpahla zeziqendu zokungenisa. Yenza iziqu zokungenisa ezintsha. Zibandakanye nalabo abaphakathi. Landela ukubakhona nokuqedwa kwezinhlela zokungenisa. Hlola futhi uthuthukise ukusebenza kwesikhathi sokungenisa. Qondanisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwindlela yokuphila komsebenzi. Khuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwekhono lekhono nokulandelana kwabaphathi abasha, abaphathi abaphakathi kanye nabasebenzi abanamandla. Khuthaza isiko sokufunda ngokuqhubekayo nokuthuthukiswa. Qondisa izindlela zokumela. Yenza iziqendu zokulolwa. Qapha inqubo futhi unikeze umbiko. Ukuphatha ukwesekwa. Nikeza umbiko ekuthuthukisweni kwemithetho kanye namaphulani okusebenza. Khona futhi uphendle izindaba zokuhlola. Hlela futhi uthume imibiko yenyanga nenyanga noma yenyanga ezintathu. Qondise futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izibonakaliso ezinikiwe ziyiqiniso. Qondise abantu abasebenzayo. Gcina ukuqina kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Iyurekhtha Etyhila: Iphuhliso leZakhono
xh.summary: Lungiselela iiplani zezakhono zendawo yomsebenzi, iingxelo zolweliso kunye nolaneko lweqhagamshelwano phakathi kweNtaba kaXorda kwisiKongo sikaRhulumente wezeMidlalo, iMidlalo Yokuzonwabisa, iBuguqa kunye nAmaSiko eQonce.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi ePhakamileyo seNzululwazi ngenqanaba lesi-6 leNqanaba lemfundo ePhakamileyo (NQF L6) okanye ngokukhethwayo idhigri yeB (NQF L7) ekulawulweni koBasebenzi / ePhuhliseni iBunini / ekuQeqeshweni nasekuPhuhliseni / ekuLawulweni koLuntu / ekulawulweni kawonke wonke njengoko kumiselwe yiSAQA. Amava amabalwa amathathu (3) eminyaka ekulungeleliseni iPhuhliso lezakhono nokuQeqeshwa, apho amathathu (3) kuma-ela mava kufuneka abengabagcini abaqatha abalawula abanye (SL 7 / 8). Isatifikethi sokuba ngumthunywa wePhuhliso lezakhono nesatifikethi soQeqesho lwabaQeqeshi kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nakhono: Iingcinga ezilungileyo nolwazi ngokuLungelelanisa iNqubomgomo yePhuhliso lezakhono yoLuntu, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, uMthetho wePhuhliso lezakhono, uMthetho weNkqubo yentsubo yePhuhliso lezakhono, iMimiselo yoLuntu lwesebe, ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokuQeqeshwa ekuqatyiweyo kuLuntu olukarhulumente nakwiinkqubo zokuQeqeshwa ezahlukeneyo, ulwazi ngenkqubo yePERSAL, uNgcineliselelo, ulungiselelo lomsebenzi ngokubakanya, iNkcukacha ezilungileyo zolwazi, namakhono oLulawulo lwabantu, amakhono olwazi olubaliweyo naselwahlweni, amakhono okubonisa, inxaxheba ephakamileyo yoxanduva noshishino, amakhono okubakanya, amakhono oLulawulo lwexesha, ukubalulela iNkcukacha, amava ekulawulweni kweenkqubo zokuQeqeshwa ezinde kakhulu (iNgqungquthela yoQeqesho, iNgqungquthela yokuzilolonga, iNkqubo yokuQeqeshwa eHlangeneyo), amava ekuphuhliseni ngenkqubo nakuqeqeshweni lwezakhono bendawo yomsebenzi kunye nokuXhaswa kwaye kuqulunqwe iNgxelo yeZakhono zendawo yomsebenzi kunye namaxesha amaninzi eengxelo zeSETA, amakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi nokuLungelelisa, ukulawula nokuQwalasela iProjekthi zeQeqesho nokuQeqesha iQeqesho, ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha kwindawo yeMicrosoft, i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuzimele ngaphezulu okanye njengenxalenye yetim. ILayisensi yokushayela (iKhowudi 8) esemthethweni.
xh.duties: lungiselelisa ukuphuhlisa nokungenisa iNkqubo yokulungelelanisa izakhono zendawo yomsebenzi (WSP) nangexesha leminyaka iNgxelo yoQeqesho (ATR). Qamba ulwazi lwesikhundi kunye nokuqwalasela uQeqesho kulo lonke uLuntu. Lungelelanisa iplani zokuPhuhlisa izakhono ngokwakho ngemigqo nemiqulu ekujoliswe kuyo. Yiza nokuqulunqa iingcebiso ezivela kwizinto zoluntu ezahlukeneyo ezingakumbi kwindawo yokuQeqeshwa. Lawula iNkqubo yokudibanisa izakhono nokuQeqeshwa kwiinkqubo zesebe nemigqango yolwazi. Qwalasela inqanaba leNkqubo yeQeqesho eceliweyo kwaye ucele ukuba kwenziwe utshintsho apho kufuneka khona. Lawula kwaye usebenzise iNkqubo zokuPhuhlisa izakhono. Lungiselelisa ukuphuhliswa kobugcisa. Lungiselelisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yeQeqesho nokuPhuhlisa. Phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze igqathi lemihla yonke yeNkqubo yeQeqesho. Lungelelanisa izinto ezikwiNkqubo yeQeqesho. Thethathetha nabantu abangaphakathi nabaxhasiweyo bokuQeqeshwa. Lawula igama lobasebenzi nokuBhalisa kwindawo yeQeqesho. Qwalasela kwaye ulandele ukulethwa kweQeqesho ngakwemigqo evunyiweyo. Gcina iNkcukacha ezilungileyo zemibhalo yeQeqesho. Lungiselelisa kwaye wenze iNkqubo yeQeqesho iThube. Phuhlisa kwaye ulondoloze igqathi leNkqubo yoThubo. Lungiselelisa izinto ezifunekayo nakumadelwa ngoThubo. Yiza nokuQeqeswa kwabaThubo. Thethathetha nabantu abangaphakathi. Landela ukubakho nokugqiba kweNkqubo yoThubo. Qwalasela kwaye uphucule ukuSebenza koThubo. Lungiselelisa iNkqubo zoBomi beNkqubo. Phuhlisa inkqubo yemikhosi yolawulo nokuThatha indawo ethunjelwe kubaphathi abasezantsi, abaphathi kwindawo elingana nephakathi, nasekwindawo kubasebenzi abanamandla. Phuhlisa inkambiso yakuQeqeshwa ngokokuqhuba nokukhula ngokwemigaqo. Yiza nobudlelwane bokumuncu. Qeqesha inkqubo yokumuncu. Qwalasela inkqabakaxa kwaye unikeze izimvo. Lawulo lwenkxaso yolawulo. Nikezela iingcebiso ngokuphuhliswa kweemigaqo nemiqulu. Zibandakanye kwaye uphendule iMibandela yoQeqesho. Qulunqa kwaye uzinike iNgxelo yonyaka. Qamba kwaye uqinisekise ukuzinza kolwazi olunikiweyo. Qeqesha abasebenzi. Gcina izigqibo sabo basebenzi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Training & Capacity
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R584 370 per annum (Level 09), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Training and Capacity at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, coordinating employee training programmes and development policies.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF L6) or preferably a B Degree (NQF L7) in Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development/ Public Administration/ Public Management qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Skills Development and Training coordination, of which three (3) years should be at a supervisory level (SL 7 / 8). Skills Development Facilitator certificate and Train the Trainer certificate will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Good interpretation and knowledge of the National Skills Development Strategy, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levies Act, Public Service Regulations, knowledge of the compulsory training programmes in the Public Service and training on various programs, knowledge of PERSAL system, planning, coordination, organising, analytical and people management skills, sound verbal and written Communication skills, presentation skills, high sense of responsibility and accountability, interpersonal, time management skills, attention to details, experience in managing long term training programmes (Learnership, Internship, Workplace Integrated Learning), experience in developing and submitting Workplace Skills Plan and various SETA’s reports, project management skills and ability to coordinate, manage and closeup training and development projects, computer literacy in the Microsoft package i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ability to work under pressure and independently and or as part of a team. A valid(Code 8) driving license.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and facilitate training programmes for employees. Manage the development, review the training & development policies, frameworks and guidelines. Monitor consolidation of the departmental training needs. Verify alignment with departmental priorities and skills plans. Develop and maintain annual training schedules. Liaise and engage with training providers. Oversee training sessions to ensure quality and adherence to agreed standards. Align human resource development training programs with strategic objectives. Maintain training records and reporting. Facilitate and lead skills audits. Develop a detailed skills audit plan and implementation approach aligned with departmental objectives. Develop, standardize tools and methodologies as per Public Service-Skills Audit Methodology Framework. Engage and consult stakeholders on various HRD matters that needs to be consulted. Analyse and interpret skills audit results. Develop skills audit reports and recommendations. Monitor the implementation of recommendations. Administer the implementation of the bursary scheme policy. Draft bursary advert and submit it to Superior for further processing. Coordinate bursary application processes and submit it to bursary committee for selection. Communicate outcomes with recipients and educational institutions. Monitor bursary contracts. Coordinate payment and financial administration. Monitor academic performance and compliance. Maintain records and compile reports. Implement, monitor and evaluate the Internship and Learnership Programme. Coordinate the screening, recruitment and placement of interns. Supervise the administration of internship contracts. Facilitate the training of mentors for the learnership programme support. Monitor alignment of Learnerships Programmes to SETA, Quality Council for Trades & Occupations and departmental requirements. Monitor, evaluate and report on the progress of the Learnership programmes including coordination of learner-facilitator and learner- mentor contact sessions. Liaise with relevant stakeholders regarding the administration and successful delivery of Learnership Programmes. Management of administration support.
