af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Opleiding & Kapasiteit
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Opleiding en Kapasiteit by die Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce, wat werknemers-opleidingsprogramme en ontwikkelingsbeleid koördineer.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n National Diploma (NQF L6) of by voorkeur 'n B Degree (NQF L7) in Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development/ Public Administration/ Public Management-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Skills Development en Training-koördinasie, waarvan drie (3) jaar op toesigvlak (SL 7 / 8) moet wees. 'n Skills Development Facilitator-sertifikaat en Train the Trainer-sertifikaat sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie interpretasie en kennis van die National Skills Development Strategy, Public Finance Management Act, Skills Development Act, Skills Development Levies Act, Public Service Regulations, kennis van die verpligte opleidingsprogramme in die Public Service en opleiding in verskeie programme, kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel, beplanning, koördinasie, organisasie, analitiese en mensebestuursvaardighede, goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, 'n hoë sin van verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, tydbestuursvaardighede, aandag aan besonderhede, ervaring in die bestuur van langtermyn-opleidingsprogramme (Learnership, Internship, Workplace Integrated Learning), ervaring in die ontwikkeling en indiening van Workplace Skills Plan en verskeie SETA's-verslae, projektebestuursvaardighede en vermoë om opleidings- en ontwikkelingsprojekte te koördineer, bestuur en af te handel, rekenaarvaardigheid in die Microsoft-pakket d.w.s. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik en/of as deel van 'n span te werk. 'n Geldige (Code 8) bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer en fasiliteer opleidingsprogramme vir werknemers. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersien die opleidings- en ontwikkelingsbeleid, raamwerke en riglyne. Monitor konsolidasie van die departementele opleidingsbehoeftes. Verifieer belyning met departementele prioriteite en vaardigheidsplanne. Ontwikkel en handhaaf jaarlikse opleidingskedules. Skakel en raadpleeg met opleidingsverskaffers. Hou toesig oor opleidingsessies om gehalte en nakoming van ooreengekome standaarde te verseker. Belyn menslikehulpbronontwikkeling-opleidingsprogramme met strategiese doelwitte. Handhaaf opleidingsrekords en verslagdoening. Fasiliteer en lei vaardigheidsoudits. Ontwikkel 'n gedetailleerde vaardigheidsouditplan en implementeringsbenadering wat met departementele doelwitte belyn is. Ontwikkel en standaardiseer gereedskap en metodes volgens die Public Service-Skills Audit Methodology Framework. Raadpleeg en skakel met belanghebbendes oor verskeie HRD-aangeleenthede wat geraadpleeg moet word. Analiseer en interpreteer vaardigheidsouditresultate. Ontwikkel vaardigheidsouditverslae en aanbevelings. Monitor die implementering van aanbevelings. Administreer die implementering van die studiebeurskema-beleid. Opstel 'n studiebeursadvertensie en dien dit by 'n meerdere in vir verdere verwerking. Koördineer studiebeursaansoekprosesse en dien dit by die studiebeurskomitee in vir keuring. Kommunikeer uitslae met ontvangers en opvoedkundige instansies. Monitor studiebeurskontrakte. Koördineer betaling en finansiële administrasie. Monitor akademiese prestasie en nakoming. Handhaaf rekords en stel verslae op. Implementeer, monitor en evalueer die Internship- en Learnership-program. Koördineer die sifting, werwing en plasing van interns. Hou toesig oor die administrasie van internship-kontrakte. Fasiliteer die opleiding van mentors vir die ondersteuning van die learnership-program. Monitor belyning van Learnership-programme met SETA, Quality Council for Trades & Occupations en departementele vereistes. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor die vordering van die Learnership-programme insluitend koördinering van leerder-fasiliteerder- en leerder-mentor-kontaksessies. Skakel met relevante belanghebbendes aangaande die administrasie en suksesvolle aflewering van Learnership-programme. Bestuur van administratiewe ondersteuning. Fasiliteer die HRM-ouditproses en verseker tydige indiening van inligting wat deur ouditeurs versoek word. Lewer insette oor die ontwikkeling van beleid en operasionele planne. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op. Bestuur finansiële en menslike hulpbronne. Handhaaf werknemersdissipline.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wezikhulu: Uqeqesho Namandla
zu.summary: Umsekeli Wezikhulu Wokuqeqesha Namandla e-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture eQonce, ohlelwayo izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi kanye namapholisi okuthuthukisa.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF L6) noma ngaphezu kwalokho i-B Degree (NQF L7) ku-Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development/ Public Administration/ Public Management njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwesaba eminyakeni emithathu (3) uwuhlobo lomsebenzi e-Skills Development nasekuqeqeshweni okuhlelwayo, lapho eminyakeni emithathu (3) kufanele ibe ezingeni lokubhekwa (SL 7 / 8). Isitifikedi se-Skills Development Facilitator nesi-Train the Trainer sizoba yinzuzo ethile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuhuquza kahle nokwazi i-National Skills Development Strategy, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Skills Development Act, i-Skills Development Levies Act, i-Public Service Regulations, ulwazi lwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezingenisa iso e-Public Service kanye nokuqeqesha kwezinhlelo ezahlukene, ulwazi lwesistimu ye-PERSAL, ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, ukuhlelela, ukwahlulela nokuphatha abantu, amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala kahle, amakhono okubhala, inzondo enkulu yomthwalo wemfanelo nosiko, amakhono omuntu nabantu, amakhono okuphatha isikhathi, ukuqaphela izinhlaka, ulwazi lokuphathe izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezinde isikhathi (Learnership, Internship, Workplace Integrated Learning), ulwazi lokuthuthukisa nokunikeza i-Workplace Skills Plan kanye namabhule we-SETA ahlukene, amakhono okuphatha iphrojekthi nendlela yokuhlanganisa, okuphatha nokuvaleka kwezinhlelo zokuqeqesha, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ithuluzi lekhompyutha kwindlela ye-Microsoft okuyi-Word, Excel, PowerPoint, indlela yokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkcindezi nokuzimele noma njengengxenye yeqembu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code 8).
zu.duties: Hlela futhi uholele izinhlelo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa kwamapholisi okuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa, izakhiwo ezinhle kanye nezinhla ezibekwayo. Qaphela ukuhlanganiswa kwezidingo zokuqeqesha komnyango. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinhloso eziphambili zomnyango namapholisi amakhono. Thuthukisa futhi ulondoloze izikhathi zokuqeqesha zonyaka. Xhumana nonezinxibelelwa zokuqeqesha. Bheka izikhathi zokuqeqesha ukuze uqinisekise izinga elihle nokulandela izimo ezivunyiwe. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zokuthuthukisa amandla abantu nezinhloso eziyisigqugu. Gcina amafayela okuqeqesha kanye nokubika. Hola futhi uholele ukuhlolwa kwamakhono. Thuthukisa icebo elibhalwe ngokuningiliziwe lokuhlolwa kwamakhono nendlela yokuphumelelisa elihambisana nezinhloso zomnyango. Thuthukisa, hlela amathuluzi nezindlela njengakwesakhiwo se-Public Service-Skills Audit Methodology Framework. Xhumana futhi ubonisane namaphathi abathintekayo ngemithwalo ye-HRD ehlukene edinga ukuboniswana. Cwaninga futhi uhuquze imiphumela yokuhlola amakhono. Thuthukisa amabhule wokuhlola amakhono kanye nezinkomba. Qaphela ukuphumeleliswa kwezinkomba. Phatha ukuphumeleliswa kwesipolisi sesikolashi. Bhala isikhangiso sesikolashi futhi sinikeze umphakeli ukugqitywa. Hlela inqubo yokufaka izicelo zesikolashi futhi zithunyelwe ekomidi yesikolashi ukukhethwa. Yazisa abamukelayo nemikhakha yemfundo ngemiphumela. Qaphela izinkontileka zesikolashi. Hlela ukukhokhelwa nokuphatha izimali. Qaphela ukuziphatha emfundweni nokulandela izimo. Gcina amafayela futhi uhlole amabhule. Phumelelisa, qaphela futhi uhlole inqubo ye-Internship ne-Learnership. Hlela ukuhlola, ukubumba nokubeka abaqeqeshi. Bhekisa inqubo yezinkontileka zokuqeqesha. Hola ukuqeqesha abagaduzi ukweseka inqubo ye-learnership. Qaphela ukuhambisana kwezinhlelo ze-Learnerships ne-SETA, i-Quality Council for Trades & Occupations nezidingo zomnyango. Qaphela, hlole futhi ubele ngokuqhubeka kwamapholisi we-Learnership kanye nohlelo lokuxhumana phakathi komfundi, noqhwebu kanye nothisi bafundisi. Xhumana namaphathi abathintekayo ngokuphatha nokuphumelelisa okuphumelelekile kwamapholisi we-Learnership. Ukuphathwa k wesekelo. Hola inqubo yokuhlolwa i-HRM futhi uqinisekise ukunikwa kolwazi abalwayo basesikhathini. Nikeza okokufaka ekuthuthukiseni amapholisi namapholisi okusebenza. Hlela amabhule nyanga zonke nasemakwindi. Phatha izimali namandla abantu. Gcina iziyalo zabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQondo: Uqeqesho Namandla
xh.summary: Umncedisi weQondo woQeqesho nAmandla kwisebe lezeMidlalo, iNtlalo, iZobugcisa nENkcubeko eQonce, elungisa iinkqubo zoqeqesho labasebenzi kwaye nenzimasimisi yaphuhliso.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate ngaphezulu kwe-National Diploma (NQF L6) okanye ngokukhethwayo i-B Degree (NQF L7) kwi-SHuman Resource Management/ Human Resource Development/ Training and Development/ Public Administration/ Public Management njengoko ivunywe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kokulungisa uPhuhliso lwamakhono noQeqesho, apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lomphathi (SL 7 / 8). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (Code 8).
xh.duties: Lungisa futhi uqeqeshe iinkqubo zokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi. Lawula uphuhliso, ukuhlola iingcamango zolwazi nokuphuhlisa, iindlela nemiqathango. Qaphela ukuqokelelwa kwezifiso zoqeqesho zesebe. Qinisekisa ulungelelwano ngokubaluleka kwezinto ezibalulekileyo zesebe neenkqubo zamakhono. Yila ulondoloze iinkqubo zoqeqesho ziminyaka yonke. Qhagamshela uncedise nabahanisi boqeqesho. Qhatha iiseshoni zoqeqesho ukuze uqinisekishe ubumfuziselo nokulandela iinkqubo ezivunywe ngokomthetho. Lungisa iinkqubo zophuhliso kolwazi lobunyulu kwiinjongo ezibalulekileyo. Gcina iirekhodi zeqeqesho neembiko. Qhuba uqhube ukuhlalutya kwamakhano. Yila icebo lokuhlalutya amakhano enza indlela yokuyisebenzisa ngokulungelelana nokuqonda kwesebe. Yila, umgangatho wamathuluzi nezindlela njengoko kumiswe kwi-Public Service-Skills Audit Methodology Framework. Qhagamshela uncedise nabanomdla kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ze-HRD ezifuna ukuxoxwa. Hlalutya ukuze uqonde iziphumo zokuhlalutya amakhano. Yiza neembiko neengcamango ngokuhlalutya amakhono. Qaphela ukusebenziswa kweengcamango. Lawula ukusebenziswa kwenkqubo yothango. Yila isikhangiso sothango singeniswe kuMkhulu ukuze qhubekele phambili. Xoba inkqubo yokuqesha ithango ungenise kubahluli-sigqibo. Yazi iziphumo kubamkeli naseziko lemfundo. Qaphela iinkqubo zethango. Lungisa intlawulo nokulawula imali. Qaphela ukusebenza kwemfundo nokuvumelana nemithetho. Gcina iirekhodi zenze iimbiko. Sebenzisa, qaphela uze uhlalutye iNkqubo yobuNqkwankqkwenzi nabaQeqeshwa. Lawula ukuhlola, ukuqesha nokubeka abanqkwankqkwenzi. Qhatha ukulawula iinkqubo zenkonzo yabafundi-baqeqeshi. Qhube uqeqesho lobakhokeli-ziqeqesho ukuyisekela iNkqubo yabaQeqeshwa. Qaphela ukulungelelana kweNkqubo yabaQeqeshwa neSETA, iQuality Council for Trades & Occupations nezifiso zesebe. Qaphela, hlalutya uze wenze umbiko ngokuqhubela phambili kweenkqubo zabaQeqeshwa kuquka nokulungisa iiseshoni zoqhagamshelwano phakathi kwabaqeqeshi nabakhokeli-ziqeqesho. Qhagamshela nababanomdwa ngokulawula nokuza ngokuphumelela kweNkqubo yabaQeqeshwa. Lawula inkxaso yolawulo. Qhatha inkqubo yokuhlola i-HRM qinisekise ukungeniswa kolwazi emva kwesoxhuzula ngokunesikhathi. Nikezela ingcamango ekuyileni iingcamango neenkqubo ezisebenzayo. Xoba iimbiko yenyanga nethatu-nyanga. Lawula imali noluntu. Gcina inyameko yabasebenzi.

Manage daily employee performance and ensure timely Performance Assessments of all subordinates.

'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n Supply Chain management-omgewing, veral in verkryging/inkoop op 'n toesighoudende vlak (SL 7 / 8). 'n Goeie begrip van die Public Service Supply Chain Management Framework, PFMA en Treasury Regulations, PPPFA, SCM/Acquisition Management. Goeie kennis van finansiële stelsels (LOGIS en BAS). Tegniese bekwaamheid in SCM en Acquisition Management, deeglike analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede, leierskaps- en toesighoudingsvaardighede, strategiese bestuur, konflikbestuur, finansiële bestuur, mensbestuursvaardighede. Uitstekend in administratiewe, koördinerings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Asook rekenaarvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige kode 08-bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Monitor die implementering van vraag- en verkrygingsprosesse: Koördineer die uitnodiging, evaluering en adjudikasie van kwotasies. Ondersoek die beskikbaarheid van die benodigde bron in die mark. Evalueer die behoeftes van die eindgebruikers. Stel 'n Demand Management Plan en Procurement Plan op. Bevorder en verseker nakoming van die Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (BBBEE) en die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 2000 (Act 5 of 2000) (PPPFA) in die Departement. Verseker dat optimale verskaffingstrategieë en -tegnieke gebruik word. Skep en onderhou 'n databasis van verskaffers wanneer kwotasies verkry word. Koördineer en fasiliteer Procurement Committee Meetings Demand and Acquisition Management, insluitend die oorsig van die sekretariaatfunksie van Bid Committees, d.w.s. Bid Specification Committee, Bid Evaluation Committee en Bid Adjudication Committee. Onderhoud van 'n opgedateerde bate-register: Verseker dat alle bates in die bate-register aangeteken word. Verseker dat nuwe verkrygings in die bate-register aangeteken word. Rekonsilieer die bate-register met BAS. Verseker dat batrekonsiliasie deur middel van fisiese verifikasie kwartaalliks uitgevoer word. Doeltreffende bestuur van bates: Verseker dat bates gemerk en van strepieskodes voorsien word. Bestuur die beweging van bates en die ondertekening van oordragvorms. Hersien batebeskrywing. Bestuur van beskikking: Bepleit die beskikking van bates aan NGO's vir distrikte. Verseker dat alle bates wat vir beskikking geïdentifiseer is, van strepieskodes voorsien en korrek gelys word. Verseder behoorlike bewaring van alle bates wat beskik gestel is. Konsolideer die bate-register vir alle distrikte. Verseker bestuur, onderhoud en veilige bewaring van bates. Uitvoering van logistieke bestuur: Verseker dat voorraadtelling kwartaalliks gedoen word. Produseer 'n statusverslag oor die bevindings van voorraadopname. Monitering van die bestelling, ontvangs en berging van skryfbehoeftes en drukverbruiksgoedere. Implementering van beleide om die risiko van verliese te minimiseer: Verseker dat alle voorraaditems aangemeld en opgevolg word. Verseker dat alle amptenare bewus is van die verliesbeheerbeleide. Bestuur die toegewysde hulpbronne van die Subdirektoraat in ooreenstemming met wetgewende en departementele beleidsriglyne en voldoen aan korporatiewe bestuurs- en beplanningsimperatiewe: Handhaf hoë standaarde deur te verseker dat die span/afdeling uitstekende werk lewer ten opsigte van gehalte/hoeveelheid en tydigheid. Delegeer funksies aan personeel op grond van individuele potensiaal, verskaf die nodige leiding en ondersteuning en bied personeel voldoende opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Verseker tydige ontwikkeling van posbeskrywing en implementering van Work Plans en Personal Development Plans (PDP's) vir alle werknemers in die Subdirektoraat. Bestuur daaglikse werknemerprestasie en verseer tydige Performance Assessments van alle ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umueluleli: Ukuphathwa Kwensohwebu (UKUTHOLWA
zu.summary: Umueluleli wekuphathwa kwensohwebu (ukutholwa) eNtshonalanga Kapa ehovisi elikhulu leNyundo yeZemidlalo, Ulwazi, Ubuciko Namasiko eQonce, edinga idiploma noma iziqu kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava okubusa kokuphathwa kwensohwebu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu saseNingizimu Afrika, plus a National Diploma (NQF L6) or preferably a B Degree (NQF L7) as recognized by SAQA) in Supply Chain Management / Procurement Management / Logistics Management / Purchasing Management // Financial Management / Accounting. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nantathu (3) yamava enkimeni yokuphathwa kwensohwebu, ikakhulukazi ekutholeni/ukuthengiseni emazingeni okubusa (SL 7 / 8). Ukuqonda kahle isakhiwo sokuphathwa kwensohwebu kwensevisi kahulumeni, i-PFMA kanye nemithetho yobuhle, i-PPPFA, ukuphathwa kwe-SCM/okokuthola. ULwazi oluhle mayelana namasistimu ezimalini (LOGIS and BAS). Ukusebenzisana okuhle ngobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni kwe-SCM kanye nokuthola, amakhono okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nokubhala imibiko, amakhono okubusa nokuhola, ukuphathwa kokuqamba, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezimali, amakhono okuphatha abantu. Ukuba ngcono ekuphathweni, ukuhintela kanye namakhono ohlelo. Kanye namakhono ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ikono elokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi ngokuzimele. Ilayisensi yokushayela ekwaziyo ukuqashwa ibhalwe ngu-08.
zu.duties: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokufuna nokuthola. Hlela ukumemwa, ukuhlola kanye nokuphetha izikweletu. Phenya ukutholakala kwemithombo edingekayo esikweletini. Hlola izidingo zabasebenzisi bokugcina. Hlanganisa ihlelo lokuphathwa kokufuna kanye neHlelo lokuthengisa. Khuthaza futhi qinisekisa ukuthobela i-Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (BBBEE) kanye ne-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, 2000 (Act 5 of 2000) (PPPFA) eNyundweni. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwamasu amahle kanye namakhono okuthola. Landa futhi ugqamise iziqu abathengisi xa kuthathwa izikweletu. Hlela futhi yenza izinkomishini zokuthengisa ukuze kubekho ukuhlanganiswa nokutholwa phakathi kokuphathwa, okuhlanganisa nokubuka umsebenzi wezokwaziswa wekomidi le-Bid Committee, njengenge-Bid Specification Committee, i-Bid Evaluation Committee kanye ne-Bid Adjudication Committee. Ukuphathwa kohlu lamathebhu okubhalwa phansi: qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imathebhu ibhalwe ohlwini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukutholwa okusha kubhalwe ohlwini. Hambisanisa ohlu lwamathebhu ne-BAS. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhambisanisa kwamathebhu ngokuhlolwa ngesandla kwenziwa njalo ngesigaba. Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwamathebhu: qinisekisa ukuthi amathebhu abhalwe futhi abe namakhodi. Phatha ukunyuka kwamathebhu kanye nokusayina bamafomu okudluliswa. Phinda ubhale incazelo yamathebhu. Ukuphathwa kokulahla: khuthaza ukulahla kwamathebhu kumasinga. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amathebhu aboniswe kokulahla anamakhodi futhi abhalwe ngendlela efanayo. Qinisekisa ukulondoloza kahle onke amathebhu alahiwe. Hlanganisa ohlu lwamathebhu. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukulondoloza kanye nokugcina imathebhu. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemikhiizo: qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqashwa kolwelwesi kwenziwa njalo ngesigaba. Khipha imibiko yezimo ngeziphumo zokuqashwa kolwelwesi. Qapha ukuthunyelwa, ukwamukelwa nokugcinwa kwezimpahla. Ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ukuze kuncishwe ubungozi bokulahlekelwa: qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto ezithunyelwayo zibikwa futhi kwenziwe ulandelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazazi izinqubomgomo zokulawula ukulahleka. Phatha abantu ababelwe isikhundla ngokuvumelana nemithetho kanye nokuqondiswa kwemithetho. Gcina amazinga aphezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu / isigaba sikhupha umsebenzi omuhle ngokobuningi nobuhle kanye nesikhathi. Yabel imisebenzi kubasebenzi ngokwamandla abo, nikeza ukwesekwa okudingekayo futhi nikeze abasebenzi amathuba okolunye ukulungiselelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubhalwa izincazelo zemisebenzi kanye nokusebenzisa ama-Work Plans kanye nama-PDP. Phatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke kanye nohlola imisebenzi yansuku zonke ngempumelelo.

xh.title: Umqeqeshi Omncinci: Ulawulo Lwenkoliso Yentsengahla (UKUTHENGWA
xh.summary: Umqeqeshi Omncinci woLawulo Lwenkoliso Yentsengahla (ukuthengwa) eKomitshi ZeQhinga loQeto, EMDLALO, Ulutyonjuluxo, Ubuciko nEnkcubeko kwiiOfisi eZinkulu eQonce, kufuneka idiploma okanye idigrinya kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava okulawula iSCM.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior seNazwemba, kananjalo iDiploma yeNarha (NQF L6) okanye ngokukhethwa kakhulu iDigrinya yeB (NQF L7) njengokuvunywa yiSAQA) kuLawulo Lwenkoliso Yentsengahla / Ulawulo Lokuthenga / Ulawulo Lwemigaqo yokuthengisa / Ulawulo Lokuthenga // Ulawulo Lweemali / IsiNdwamathandabuzo. Iminyaka elit (3) yamava kwimeko yoLawulo Lwenkoliso Yentsengahla, ngakumbi ekuthengeni/nakuthenga kwinqanaba lokulawula (SL 7 / 8). Ukuqonda okulungileyo koMgaqo-Nkathwa woLawulo Lwenkoliso Yentsengahla wokuLuntu, iPFMA nemiGaqo yeTreasury, iPPPFA, ulawulo lweSCM/nakuthenga. Ulwazi oluhle lweenkqubo zemali (LOGIS naseBAS). Ukuziphatha kakuhle kwiSCM nakulawulo lokuthenga, amakhono obuhlalantyi nokuombana iingxaki, amakhono othetho nokubhala iingxelo, amakhono okukhokela nokuqhuba, ulawulo olubhekisa phambili, ulawulo lweengxabano, ulawulo lweemali, amakhono okulawula abantu. Ukugqiba kakuhle kwamakhono oqobo, uququzelelo nokuququzelela. Kananjalo nakhono ekompyutheni. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuzimela. Ilayisenesi yokusha ethathlonkqo 08.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuSETYENZiswa kweenkqubo zokuVELISA nokuTHENGA: Qququzelela ukumema, ukuqokelela izimvo nokunqumama iziqinisekiso zentengiso. Phanda ukufumaneka kwemvelaphi efunekayo kwisikhokelo. Linganisa iimfuno zabapheli bokuqhubela phambili. Lungelelanisa iCandelo loQeto lokuLinganisa iimfuno nokuThenga. Phakamisa uqinisekise ukuthobela umThetho woNyuselwa lwaBAntu abaMnyama oLusazo (BBBEE) nakuMthetho oQhelisayo woQheliso loQeto, 2000 (uMthetho 5 ka 2000) (iPPPFA) kwiiSebe. Qinisekisa ukuba ezona nkqubo zokunyusa izixhobo ziyasetyenziswa. Misela zigqibe ulwazi oluzinze ngokwabathengisi xa kufunyanwa iziqinisekiso. Qququzelela ukuqhuba iNqanaba laBandla loQeto ukuLinganisa uQeto nakuThengwa kubandakanya ukulawula inkqubo yeseKretari yamaKomiti eBethu i.e. iKomiti leSicwangciso seQiniso, iKomiti loQokelelo lwaMaqiniso naseKomiti lokuNqumama. Ukugcina olu tshaolwayo lwempahla: Qinisekisa ukuba yonke impahla igqitywe kolutshaolwayo. Qinisekisa impahla ezintsha zithengiweyo zigqitywe kolushaolwayo. Qwalasela izitsha ezingqalelelanayo ezingqamana zibe nesiBAS. Qinisekisa ukuba ukungqalelelana kwempahla ngokwenza isiqinisekiso sempilo senziwa ngenkathi ngamnye. Ulawulo oluSeziko lwempahla: Qinisekisa ukuba impahla ipawuliwe kwaye inamakhodi ezinti. Lawula iintsukwano zempahla nokusayina iifomu zokusuka kuye kuya kuye. Phengulula inkcazelo yempahla. Ulawulo lokulahla: Ukukhokela phambili ukulahla impahla kumacandelo ahamba iCirha kumacandelo. Qinisekisa zonke izixhobo ezikhethiweyo ezizakulahlwa zinamakhodi ezinti azicatshulwe kakuhle. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwempahla egqityiweyo. Lungelelanisa isitsha seempahla kumacandelo onke. Qinisekisa ulawulo, ukugcina nokugcina kakuhle impahla. Ulawulo lweMigaqo yokuthengisa: Qinisekisa ukuba ukubala impahla kwenziwa ngenkathi ngamnye. Velisa iingxelo ngemeko esisiphelithi sokubala impahla. Qwalasela ukuyalela, ukwamkela nokugcina izixhobo zokubhala nokupeyinta. UkuSetyenziswa koomGaqo lokunciphisa ingozi zokulahleka: Qinisekisa ukuba yonke impahla ibikwa kwaye kusenziwa ulandelelwano. Qinisekisa ukuba wonke amaphethi azazi ngomGaqo wokuLawula iLahleko. Lawula izibonelelo ezabeliweyo esiCandelo ngesiqondo soMthetho nemiGaqo yesebe kwaye uthobele iinkqubo zoLawulo kunye neenkqubo zeQhinga. Gcina iimigangatho ephezulu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba iqela / icandela lida imisebenzi emangalisayo ngokobungakanani / ngobuninzi nangexesha. Yabelisa imisebenzi abasebenzi ngokomahlulela weqabane lwoMntu wonke, ibe nika isikhokelo nasekuxhasweni ngokufunekayo, wanika abasebenzi ithuba lokuzimfunda nokuPhephakala. Qinisekisa ukuba isicwangciso somsebenzi sithywe sibe sikhona ixesha kwaye uSetyenziswe iindlela zeQhinga zoQeto lweSebe naseQhelisweni lweNkqubo yoPhephakala lweQabane (i-PDP’s) kubo bonke abasebenzi esiCandelo. Lawula imisebenzi yamangapha ngemini kwaye uQinisekise ukuQokelelwa kweNkanuko yamahlulela ngexesha kubo bonke abo abapantsi.

jobs.title: State Accountant: General Payments
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07) (An all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed at the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce to process general payments and financial administration at salary level 7.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or B. Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Financial Accounting/ Cost and Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit qualification with at least 1 to 2 years’ experience within the public sector expenditure management field. Knowledge of financial systems (LOGIS and BAS). Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Legislations/ policies/ prescripts, and procedures. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations, understanding of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Financial Regulations Knowledge of Batho Pele principles. Computer literacy (specializing in Advanced EXCEL and PowerPoint Presentation). Good communication and Report writing skills. Sound organisational skills. People management. Customer / client orientated approach and ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid driving licence (Code 8) is required.
jobs.duties: Render financial administration. Process and verify general payment transactions accurately and within prescribed timeframes. Ensure all payment requests are supported by valid documentation and approved in accordance with delegated authority. Capture, review, and authorize payment transactions on the applicable financial management systems. Monitor payment batches to ensure timely settlement of supplier invoices and other financial obligations. Render authorization of electronic transactions for transfers and creditors payments. Verification of captured payment details. Render quality assurance of payments. Facilitate and solve payments queries on time. Facilitate payment of supplier bank rejections. Monitor adherence to internal controls. Authorization of all creditor’s payments manually. Ensure compliance with payment documents. Manual authorization and monitor of transfers. Facilitate the authenticity for transfer payments to Public Entities and institutions. Authorization of all transfer payments manually. Facilitate confirmation for receipt of fund transferred by different Institutions and Public Entities. Compile register of transfers monthly and quarterly submit for disclosure in the Interim/ Annual financial statements. Facilitate reconciliation of transfers to budget for In Year Monitoring. Ensure that we disclose correct information on transfers for quarterly Interim Financial Statement and Annual Financial Statement. Compilation of accruals and payables reports. Request reports from system controller. Facilitate compilation of accruals and payables reports. Verification of payments age analysis of the Accruals and payables. Verification, analysing and reconciliation of accruals and payables. Consolidation of accruals and payables monthly. Presentation of accruals and payables reports in the In- Year-Monitoring meetings. Ensure that accurate information is disclosed on accruals and payables for quarterly Interim Financial Statement and Annual Financial Statements.
jobs.enquiries: M. Cezula – Head Office – (eQonce) Tel No: (043) 492 1400 e- Recruitment Technical Enquiries – recruitment@ecsrac.gov.za
jobs.notes: Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Applications must be submitted on a duly completed New Z83 form (effective from 01 January 2021), e-Recruitment System automatically generates Z83 immediately you press apply and generate Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents upon application but must submit a fully completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae. NB: 83 in the e-recruitment system is currently not signable; so, applicants who submitted applications via the e-recruitment system will not be disqualified for an unsigned Z83 instead will be requested to sign on/or before the interview day. View the list of the positions you applied for on “My Job Applications” and do note that the system Z83 does not reflect work experience and qualifications, however, every detail of your information does reflect to the Recruitment team. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, and other relevant documents (like a copy of Permanent Resident Permit for Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit Holders to HR on or before the interview date. Failure to submit all the required documents will disqualify the application. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Selected candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record check, qualification/ study verification and previous employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic Managerial Competency Assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of Competency-based Assessment. Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/ knowledge test. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of twelve 12/24 months. It is the objective to address the Employment Equity Affirmative Action Measures in line with the Employment Equity Plan and to achieve equitable representation across race and gender. The EE targets of the recruiting Department will be adhered to although the applications are welcome from all racial groups. The Recruiting Department reserves the right to amend/ review/ withdraw the advertised posts if by so doing, the best interest of the department will be well served. (Females and People with Disabilities are also requested to apply and indicate such in their applications). Misrepresentation in the application documents will result in automatic disqualification and disciplinary action in the event the candidate has already been appointed. SMS pre-entry certificate (Nyukela) must be submitted prior appointment. Full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme Note: Due to austerity measures, the Department will not carry any related costs (transport, accommodation, and meals) for candidates attending pre-selection assessment/s and interviews. af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Algemene Betalings
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce om algemene betalings en finansiële administrasie te verrig op salarisvlak 7.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n National Diploma (NQF Level 6) of B. Degree (NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Financial Accounting/ Cost and Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit kwalifikasie met ten minste 1 to 2 jaar se ervaring binne die openbare sektor se bestuursveld vir uitgawes. Kennis van finansiële stelsels (LOGIS and BAS). Kennis van Public Service Regulations, Legislations/ policies/ prescripts, en prosedures. Kennis van Treasury Regulations, begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van Financial Regulations en Batho Pele-beginsels. Rekenaargeletterdheid (met spesialisasie in Advanced EXCEL en PowerPoint Presentation). Goeie kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Deeglike organisatoriese vaardighede. Mensebestuur. Kliëngerigte benadering en vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Code 8) word vereis.
af.duties: Lewer finansiële administrasie. Verwerk en verifieer algemene betalingstransaksies akkuraat en binne voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke. Verseker dat alle betalingsversoeke deur geldige dokumentasie ondersteun word en ooreenkomstig gedelegeerde gesag goedgekeur word. Vang, hersien en magtig betalingstransaksies op die toepaslike finansiële bestuurstelsels. Monitor betaalbare groepe om tydlike vereffening van verskaffersfakture en ander finansiële verpligtinge te verseker. Lewer magtiging van elektroniese transaksies vir oorplasing en krediteurbetalings. Verifikasie van ingevangde betalingsbesonderhede. Lewer gehaltversekering van betalings. Fasiliteer en los betalingsnavrae betyds op. Fasiliteer betaling van verskaffersbankverwerping. Monitor nakoming van interne kontroles. Magtig alle krediteurbetalings handmatig. Verseker nakoming van betalingsdokumente. Handmatige magtiging en monitor van oorplasing. Fasiliteer die egtheid vir oorplaasbetalings aan Public Entities en instellings. Magtig alle oorplaasbetalings handmatig. Fasiliteer bevestiging van ontvangs van fondse oorgeplaas deur verskillende instellings en Public Entities. Stel maandelikse en kwartaallikse register van oorplasing op en dien dit in vir openbaarmaking in die Interim/ Annual financial statements. Fasiliteer rekonsiliasie van oorplasing tot begroting vir In Year Monitoring. Verseker dat ons korrekte inligting oor oorplasing openbaar maak vir kwartaallikse Interim Financial Statement en Annual Financial Statement. Opstel van reeds-verskuldig en skuldverslae. Versoek verslae van die stelselbeheerder. Fasiliteer opstel van reeds-verskuldig en skuldverslae. Verifikasie van betalings ouderdomsanalise van die reeds-verskuldig en skuld. Verifikasie, ontleding en rekonsiliasie van reeds-verskuldig en skuld. Konsolidering van reeds-verskuldig en skuld maandeliks. Voorlegging van reeds-verskuldig en skuldverslae in die In- Year-Monitoring vergaderings. Verseker dat akkurate inligting oor reeds-verskuldig en skuld openbaar word vir kwartaallikse Interim Financial Statement en Annual Financial Statements.

zu.title: Isidlali Sezimali Sembuso: Izinkokhelo Ezijwayelekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isidlali Sezimali Sembuso eDepartment of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture eQonce ukuphatha izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ngesabelo somsebenzi seholo izinga 7.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samatikuletse Sezwe kanye nesiKholeji Sezwe (NQF Level 6) noma i-Digri ye-B (NQF level 7 njengokuthiwa yi-SAQA) kwi-Financial Accounting/ Cost and Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit ngenani elinganani iminyaka engu-1 kuya koku-2 yamava ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokuphathwa kwezimali komphakathi wembuso. Ulwazi mayelana namasistimu ezimali (LOGIS kanye ne-BAS). Ulwazi mayelana Nemithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi, umthetho/ izinqubomgomo/ imibhalo, kanye nendlela yokuqhuba izinto. Ulwazi mayelana Nemithetho Yezigqeba, ukuqonda uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi (PFMA). Ulwazi Lomthetho Wemali Kuhulumenze; Ulwazi ngemigomo yeBatho Pele. Ukubhalisele ngabakompyutha (izinhlangothi ekusebenzeni Advanced EXCEL PowerPoint Presentation). Amakhono asemthethweni ekubhala nokuxoxa. Amakhono asemthethweni ohlelweni. Ukuphatha abantu. Nikela ngokuhlolwa kwemali ezingeni eliphezulu kwezinkokhelo. Wenze futhi uxazulule izinkinga ezingekho emthethweni ngokushesha. Wenze ukuthi izimali ezihluleka ukuthunyelwa kubhange zibuyele kubanikazi bazo. Hlola ukuthi kugcinwe imithetho eseduze. Vumela zonke izinkokhelo zenziwe ngaphandle komsingathi kubakhamuzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemibhalo ngezinkokhelo. Vumela ngokuthintana nokuhlolwa kwezimali ezohudeniwe. Wenze ukuthi kubekho ukuqinisekiswa kwemali ethunyelwe emnyangweni. Vumela ngemibhalo yokwenza izimali ezikhamuzi. Wenze ngokuthi kubekho ukuqinisekiswa ngemibhalo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi ngemali ethunyelwe kubayini bakhaya emphakathini. Vumela ukubhaliswa kwemali ethunyelwe emnyangweni emnyameni. Bekela imibhalo ethunyelwe emnyangweni njalo ngenyanga futhi ngesikhathi ngokusobala. Wenze ukuthi kubekho ukubuyela emuva kwemali ethunyelwe kubudget ngesikhathi kubukwa iminikelo yamanye amabutho. Hlola imali ethunyelwe emnyangweni nangale ndlela efanayo. Kuhlolwa kubalwa kwenani leminyaka yamanye amabutho. Kwenze imibhalo yokuhlolwa kwamanye amabutho ngokweminyaka. Kuhlolwa ukubalwa kwemali ethunyelwe emnyangweni. Hlola imali ethunyelwe emnyangweni ngokweminyaka. Kubekwa emnyangweni imibhalo yamanye amabutho. Nikela ngokubekwa kwesikhundla ngokweminyaka. Kubekwa emnyangweni imibhalo yezinkokhelo ezijwayelekile. Kubukwa imibhalo ngesikhathi semihlangano yeminyaka yonke.

xh.title: Isabaluli sehlabathi: Iintlawulo eziNgumzekelo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa isabaluli sehlabathi kwiSebe leMzobo, uLungelelaniso, uBuciko nenSiko eQonce ukujolisa iintlawulo ezijolike ngokubanzi kunye nokulawulwa kweemali eQonce inqanaba 7.

Ulwazi ngamajelo eemali (LOGIS kunye neBAS). Ulwazi ngeNgqungquthela zezeNkonzo zeLuntu, eMthethweni/ iNgqina/ imigaqo, kunye neendlela ezilandelelwayo. Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yeQhawa lezeMali, ukuqonda uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zeLuntu (PFMA). Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yezeMali nokunika amandla amava ngoMgaqo weBatho Pele. Ukufaka, ukuphonononga, nokuvuma iintengiselwano zentlawulo kwijelo lokulawula iimali. Ukujonga iinhlobo zentlawulo ukuze qinisekiswa ukubhaliswa kwexesha lokuhlawula iinvoices zabanikezeli kunye nezinye iinkqubela zemali. Ubekho kuvunywa kweentengiselwano ze-elektroniki kumatshintsho kunye nentlawulo zababenzi-mali. Ukuqinisekisa iinkcukacha zentlawulo ezingeniswe. jobs.title: State Accountant: Cash & Revenue Management
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: State Accountant role in cash and revenue management at the Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, requiring a diploma or degree in accounting with public sector finance experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or B. Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit qualifications with at least 1 to 2 years’ experience within the public sector expenditure management field and payment of employee benefits. Public sector finances experience in budgeting and revenue management will be added advantage. Knowledge of financial systems (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS) and be able to interpret NERF and Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Legislations / policies / prescripts, and procedures. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations and Division of Revenue Act (DORA), understanding of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Appropriation Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Financial Regulations Knowledge of Batho Pele principles. Computer literacy specializing in Advanced EXCEL and PowerPoint Presentation. Good communication and report writing skills. Sound organisational skills. People management. Customer / client orientated approach and ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid driving licence (Code 8) is required.
jobs.duties: Ensure Collection and Deposit of Revenue. Receive and account for all revenue collected by the department. Verify the accuracy and completeness of revenue collection documentation. Ensure that all revenue is deposited into the relevant bank account within prescribed timeframes. Capture and record revenue transactions on the relevant financial management systems. Monitor outstanding revenue and follow up on unpaid amounts. Ensure compliance with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and departmental policies relating to revenue collection. Maintain proper records and support documentation for all revenue transactions. Identify and classify departmental revenue sources in accordance with applicable legislation. Monitor revenue trends and analyse revenue generated from various sources. Verify that all revenue received is correctly allocated to the appropriate revenue codes. Assist in identifying opportunities to improve revenue collection processes. Compile reports on revenue generated from different revenue streams. Ensure accurate recording and reporting of departmental revenue. Render cash flow Management. Monitor daily cash balances and cash movements. Prepare cash flow forecasts and projections. Monitor cash availability to ensure operational requirements are met. Compile periodic cash flow reports for management. Liaise with relevant stakeholders regarding cash flow requirements. Identify potential cash flow risks and recommend corrective measures. Ensure effective management of cash resources in accordance with Treasury guidelines Render Cash Reconciliation. Perform daily, weekly and monthly cash reconciliations. Reconcile bank statements with departmental financial records. Investigate and resolve cash and banking discrepancies. Reconcile suspense accounts and outstanding transactions. Maintain complete reconciliation records and audit trails. Prepare reconciliation reports for management review. Assist with internal and external audit requests relating to cash and revenue transactions.

zu.summary: Indima yesiphathimanzi sesifunda ekuphathweni kwezimali ezingenalutho nezimali ezizongiwe e-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, efunwa idiploma noma idigri ebhalweni izimali nokuba namava emzimweni wemali woqobo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seNational Senior Certificate kanye neNational Diploma (NQF Level 6) noma iB. Degree (NQF level 7 njengoba kukhonjwa yi-SAQA) kwe-Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit nezitifiketi okungenani unemava eminyaka engu-1 kuya koku-2 ngaphakathi kwenkambu yokuphathwa kwezimali ezixhafuniwe emqubenikazi kwendlu yokukhokha izinzuzo zabasebenzi. Izinto ezingezela emqubweni wezimali ezizongiwe kule ndima: ukuba namava ekwenzeni imali yesabelo kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ezizongiwe. Ukwazi mayelana namasistimu emali (LOGIS, PERSAL kanye ne-BAS) nokuba ngeke ukwazi ukuhumusha i-NERF kanye ne-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Ulwazi mayelana neziluleko zomphakathi, izimali / izinqubomgomo / imibhalo nendlela ezindle zokwenza. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuncika imali ophethwe ngumnyanga nakuwo wonke umnyango (DORA), nokuzikhalimela komthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali kahulumeni (PFMA) nomthetho wesabelo. Umthetho olikhetho ngokuthenga izinto (PPPFA), nokwazi imithetho yezimali kanye nokuqonda imigomo ka-Batho Pele. Ubuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa ikhompyutha okukhulu eku-EXCEL nakunokuSethula izinto eshibhile. Amandla okuxoxa nokuqinisekwa okuhle nokuqhuba ngocwaningo. Amuva kumchamo walapha khaya. Ukuphathwa izinkulumo. Indlela ekuxakwe abantu abathengayo nokuba ngeke uphatheke kahle ezindabeni ezinkulu zikagesi esigabeni sezinkundla. Isikhwama sokugibela ngesitifiketi (Code 8) sidingwa.

xh.title: IsiNgqungqutha sikaRhulumente: Ulawulo lemali esebenzayo nenyuzo
xh.summary: Indima yesiNgqungqutha sikaRhulumente kulawulo lemali esebenzayo nenyuzo kwisebe lezeMizobo, ukuZonwabisa, uBuchule, namasiko eMpuma Koloni, elifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwesigqeba samabalengwe kunye namava emali yalawulo lolawulo karhulumente.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSekondari seSizwe negqithwe kweyoN Diploma yaseZantsi (NQF Level 6) okanye iB. Degree (NQF level 7 njengokuqatyiweyo yiSAQA) kwi-Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit ngeemfuno zamava abangaphezulu kwey1 ukuya kwiy2 emmandini wolawulo wokuhlawulelwa kolawulo karhulumente nentlawulo yenzala zabasebenzi. Amava emali yolawulo karhulumente kwicala lokwakha ijohwe nolawulo lwenyuzo kuya kuba lusizo ngakumbi. Ulwazi ngamajohwe emali (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS) nokuba nakho ukuqonda i-NERF ne-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kwabasebenzi basarhulumente, eMithethweni / iinkqubo / imiyalelo, nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi ngeenjongono zeTreasury kunye ne-Division of Revenue Act (DORA), ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) nokuSebenzisa koMthetho. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), iinjongono zeMali Ulwazi lwemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha olugqithise kwi-Advanced EXCEL nakwiPowerPoint Presentation. Amandla amabalengwe abalulekileyo sokuthetha nokubhaliweyo kwemiva. Amandla abalulekileyo ecaleni lokuhlelwa. Ulawulo lwabantu. Indlela yejonga abathengi / abaxhasi kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo nodwa. Kufuneka ibe nelayisense yokushayela (Code 8).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuQokelela nokubeka iNyuzo. Thatha kwaye ulawule lonke inyuzo ezoqokelelwa yisebe. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka nokuzaliseka kolwazi malunga noqokelelo lwenyuzo. Qinisekisa ukuba lonke inyuzo ibekwa kwi-akhawunti yasebhengi ezikwicalaelifanelekileyo ngaphakathi kwexesha elicediweyo. Faka kwaye urekhode iintengiso zenyuzo kwizijambo ezikwicalaelifanelekileyo zolawulo lwemali. Phatha inyuzo engahlawulelwanga kwaye ulandele imali engahlawulelwanga. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kumthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iinjongono zeTreasury nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo zesebe ezithatha inyuzo. Gcina ulwazi oluchanekileyo naxhaso lolwazi lwazo zonke iintengiso zenyuzo. Phawula kwaye uhlaziye iindawo zenyuzo zesebe ngokomthetho osebenzayo. Hlola ukuya phambili kwemali kwaye uhlaziye imali ezuzwa kwindawo ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba lonke inyuzo ethathiweyo inikwa ikhowudi yenyingiselo elungileyo. Nceda ukukhetha iindawo ezinokuphucula iindlela zoqokelelo lwenyuzo. Hlela imiva malunga nenyuzo ethi iholelwe kwimithombo eyahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa nokuriportswa okuchanekileyo kwemali yesebe. Zinikele kwiNtengiso yoLawulo lwemali. Hlola imali yemihla ngemihla kwaye uhlole ukuhamba kwemali. Loki iimboniselo nemiqondiso yemali. Hlola ukubakhona kwemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe imfuno yokusebenza. Hlela iimiva zeemarike zemali ngokwendlela ekuhambela abaphathi. Thathelana abantu abakwicala elifanelekileyo malunga neemfuno zokuqhuba imali. Phawula ubungozi obungabakho kumarike kwaye ucele indlela zokulungisa. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo kwemali ngokwemiqondiso yeTreasury Zinikeze kuLawulo lokuqwalaselwa kwemali. Yenza ukuqwalaselwa kwemali ngemihla, ngeveki ngenyanga. Qwalasela iinkhunga zebhengi nerekhowudi yemali yesebe. Phanda kwaye ulungise ukungahambelani kwemali nebhengi. Qwalasela i-akhawunti ze-suspense nentengiso ezingahlawulelwanga. Gcina ulwazi oluqulunqwe ngokuzinikela kwemali nokubakho kolwazi lokusetyenziswa. Lenza iimiva zokuqwalaselwa abaphathi. Nceda ngemibuzo yangaphakathi nangaphandle ephathiswe kuntengiso zemali nenyuzo.

jobs.title: State Accountant: TAX Reconciliation
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: State Accountant needed at the Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce to render tax reconciliation services, requiring a diploma or degree in accounting or finance with one to two years of public sector experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF Level 6) or B. Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit qualifications with at least 1 to 2 years’ experience within the public sector expenditure management field and payment of employee benefits. Public sector finances experience in budgeting and revenue management will be added advantage. Knowledge of financial systems (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS). Knowledge of Tax Administration Act, Public Service Regulations, Legislations / policies / prescripts, and procedures. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations and the Public Finance Management Act and Financial Regulations. Knowledge of Batho Pele principles. Computer literacy specializing in Advanced EXCEL and PowerPoint Presentation. Good communication and report writing skills. Sound organisational skills. People management. Customer / client orientated approach and ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid driving licence (Code 8) will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Render Tax Rebates Services. Receive, assess and process tax rebate applications in accordance with relevant legislation, policies and procedures. Verify the completeness and -accuracy of supporting documentation submitted by taxpayers and stakeholders. Validate taxpayer information against financial and tax records. Capture, update and maintain tax rebate information on the relevant financial management systems. Calculate and process approved tax rebates accurately and within prescribed turnaround times. Prepare payment schedules for approved tax rebates. Resolve tax rebate-related queries from taxpayers and internal stakeholders. Liaise with relevant internal and external stakeholders regarding outstanding information and tax rebate matters. Perform Tax Reconciliation. Reconcile tax rebate accounts and identify discrepancies. Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences promptly. Match payments, refunds and adjustments with supporting documentation. Reconcile general ledger accounts relating to tax rebates. Ensure that reconciliations are completed within prescribed timeframes. Maintain complete reconciliation records and audit trails. Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the supervisor. Financial Administration and Reporting. Compile monthly, quarterly and annual reconciliation reports. Prepare management information on tax rebate transactions. Monitor outstanding tax rebate claims and recommend corrective actions. Maintain accurate financial records in accordance with record management policies. Assist with audit requests by providing supporting documentation and explanations. Promote Stakeholder and Customer Service. Provide professional advice and guidance to taxpayers and stakeholders regarding tax rebate procedures. Respond to enquiries within prescribed service standards. Build and maintain productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Participate in awareness sessions and provide support on tax rebate processes.
jobs.enquiries: M. Cezula – Head Office (eQonce) Tel No: (043) 492 1400 e- Recruitment Technical Enquiries – recruitment@ecsrac.gov.za

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Belastingverrekening
af.summary: Staatsrekenmeester benodig by die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture in Qonce vir die lewer van belastingverrekeningsdienste, wat 'n diploma of graad in rekenmeesterskap of finansies vereis met een tot twee jaar se openbare-sektor-ervaring.
af.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus 'n National Diploma (NQF Level 6) of B. Degree (NQF level 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit kwalifikasies met ten minste 1 tot 2 jaar se ervaring binne die openbare-sektor bestedingsbestuursveld en betaling van werknemervoordele. Openbare-sektor finansies ervaring in begroting en inkomste bestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van finansiële stelsels (LOGIS, PERSAL en BAS). Kennis van Tax Administration Act, Public Service Regulations, wetgewing / beleide / voorskrifte en prosedures. Kennis van Treasury Regulations en die Public Finance Management Act en Financial Regulations. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Rekenaarvaardigheid wat spesialiseer in Gevorderde EXCEL en PowerPoint-voorlegging. Goeie kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede. Soliede organisatoriese vaardighede. Mensebestuur. Kliënt-georiënteerde benadering en vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Code 8) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Lewer Belastingterugbetalingdienste. Ontvang, beoordeel en verwerk belastingterugbetaling-aansoeke in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, beleide en prosedures. Verifieer die volledigheid en -akkuraatheid van ondersteunende dokumentasie wat deur belastingbetalers en belanghebbendes ingedien is. Valideer belastingbetalers se inligting teen finansiële en belastingrekords. Vang, werk by en onderhou belastingterugbetaling-inligting op die toepaslike finansiële bestuurstelsels. Bereken en verprobe goedgekeurde belastingterugbetings akkuraat en binne voorgeskrewe omkeertye. Berei betaling skedules voor vir goedgekeurde belastingterugbetings. Los belastingterugbetting-verwante navrae van belastingbetalers en interne belanghebbendes op. Skakel met toepaslike interne en eksterne belanghebbendes rakens uitstaande inligting en belastingterugbetting-aangeleenthede. Voer Belastingverrekening uit. Verreken belastingterugbetting-rekenings en identifiseer afwykings. Ondersoek en los verrekeningsverskille onmiddellik op. Pas betalings, terugbetalings en aanpassings by ondersteunende dokumentasie. Verreken grootboekrekenings wat op belastingterugbetings betrekking het. Verseker dat verrekenings binne voorgeskrewe tydperke voltooi word. Onderhou volledige verrekeningsrekords en oudit-spore. Eskaleer onopgeloste afwykings na die toesighouer. Finansiële Administrasie en Verslagdoening. Stel maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verrekeningsverslae op. Berei bestuursinligting oor belastingterugbetting-transaksies voor. Monitor uitstaande belastingterugbetting-eise en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls aan. Onderhou akkurate finansiële rekords in ooreenstemming met rekordbestuursbeleide. Bied hulp met ouditversoeke deur ondersteunende dokumentasie en verduidelikings te verskaf. Bevorder Belanghebbende- en Kliëntediens. Verskaf professionele advies en leiding aan belastingbetalers en belanghebbendes rakende belastingterugbetting-prosedures. Reageer op navrae binne voorgeskrewe diensstandaarde. Bou en onderhou produktiewe werksverhoudinge met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan bewusmakingsessies en verskaf ondersteuning oor belastingterugbetting-prosesse.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezimali Zombuso: Ukuqathanisa Kwezintela
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Wezimali Zombuso eNyuvesi yezemidlalo, konzimfundo, nobuciko namasiko eQonce ukuze kunikezwe izinkonzo zokuqathanisa izintela, kudingwa idiploma noma iziqu ezigabeni ezibhalwa ngemali noma ezimali unyaka owodwa kuya kwababili bokuqashwa komphakathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatasa sabafundi bezikhathi eziphakeme kanye neDiploma Yezizwe (NQF Level 6) noma I.B. Degree (NQF level 7 njengoba kuqashwa yiSAQA) kwezimali / ukuqashwa kwezimali kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali / iziqu zokuhlola ngaphakathi ngenani elinganiselwa kweminyaka engu-1 kuya kweyi-2 yokuqashwa kumphakathi endaweni yokuphathwa kwemali kanye nokuqashwa kwezimali zabasebenzi. Ukuqashwa ezimalini zikamphakathi endaweni yokwenza umgxogxo kanye nokuphathwa kwemali kungaba yinzuzo. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zezimali (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS). Ulwazi ngomthetho wezintela, imithetho yomphakathi, izinqubo nemigomo nemithetho. Ulwazi ngezeMali ezilawulwa kanye noMthetho wokuPhathwa kwezMali zikaHulumeni kanye neMithetho yezimali. Ulwazi nemiGOMO yeBatho Pele. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha esibhekiswa ku-Advanced EXCEL kanye ne-PowerPoint Presentation. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono amahle okuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Indlela yokuqondiswa kabathengi nankwethole ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezima nokuzenzela. Ilayisensi yokuqasha (Code 8) ingaba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Niketa izinkonzo zokubuyiselwa izintela. Thola, hlola futhi ucubungula izicelo zokubuyiselwa izintela ngokuvumelana nomthetho ohambisanayo, imigomo nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukuphela nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo yesekelo ethunyelwe ngabahlawuli bezintela kanye namaqembu. Qinisekisa ulwazi ngabahlawuli bezintela ngokumelana namarekhodi ezimali nezintela. Faka, buyekeza futhi ulondoloze ulwazi ngezintela emuhle wokuqathanisa kwezimali. Bala futhi ucubungula izintela ezivunyiwe ngokunembile futhi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekelwe. Lungelela izinhlela zokuqasha ngezintela ezivunyiwe. Susa imibuzo ehlobene nezintela evela kubahlawuli nangakaphakathi. Xhumana namaqembu ahlukene angaphakathi nakaphandle ngenkcazelo ngolwazi olusale nangezintela. Yenza ukuqathanisa izintela. Qathanisa ama-akhawunti wezintela futhi uthole okungahambisani. Phenya futhi ususe okungahambisani ngokushesha. Linganisa izinkokhelo, imbuyiselo kanye noshintsho nemibhalo yesekelo. Qathanisa ama-akhawunti ehhovisi elijwayelekile ahlobene ngezintela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqathanisa kuqedwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekelwe. Londoloza imibhalo yokuqathaniza egcwele futhi ukuqhubela ukuhola. Dlulisa okungahambisani okungaxazululki kumlawuli. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokubika. Hlanganisa imibiko yokuqathanisa yenyanga, kwesigaba kanye nenyaga. Lungelela ulwazi loluqondiswa ngamatholakha wezintela. Qapha izinto ezingahlolwa zezintela futhi uncome isinxaxa besexwayiso. Londoloza amarekhodi ezimali anembile ngokuvumelana nemigomo yokulondoloza amarekhodi. Siza ngemibuzo yokuqathanisa ngokunikeza imibhalo yesekelo kanye nokuqondisa. Khuthaza amaQembu kanye nesevisi yabathengi. Nikeza iseluleko esibukhali kanye nekhanda kubahlawuli nangamaqembu ngendlela yezintela. Phendula imibuzo ngaphakathi kwemigomo yesevisi. Akha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano bomsebenzi obuhle namaqembu angaphakathi nakaphandle. Thatha inxaxheba kumasethingi wokwazisa futhi unikeze isikusestentuma ngamatholakha wezintela.

xh.title: iNkokheli yeemali zikarhulumente: Uyilo lweMali yeThaxes
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNkokheli yeemali zikarhulumente kwisebe leMzobo, iNkunzi, iBuguqa bobugcisa n'eNkcubeko eQonce ukunika iinkonzo zokuyila kwakhona iimali zethaxes, kufuneka idiploma okanye idigri ebhalweni lemal okanye ezemali inyanga ezilishumi nambini ukuya kowamashumi amabini emisebenzi yakawonke-wonke.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sikaQondo samabanga aPhezulu kwesizwe ngokwayo kanjalo neDiploma yaseMzantsi Afrika (NQF Level 6) okanye iB. Degree (NQF level 7 njengoko kugunyaziswe yiSAQA) kwi-Accounting/Cost & Management Accounting/Financial Management/Internal Audit nembali yemisebenzi emizekelweni yamashumi amabini ukuya kwamathathu kwisoqobo somsebenzi wokulawula iindleko zikarhulumente nentlawulo yemivuzo yabasebenzi. Iphuhliso lemali karhulumente kwihlelo lokubhalisa nentlawulo yentswela-banewonga kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi ngamajelo eemali ombane (LOGIS, PERSAL, BAS). Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Tax Administration Act, iNqondo yeMithetho yesebenza ngokusakuzelwe, imithetho/iimgagangqatho/iindlela zamanqaku nemigaqo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngemiqathango yeTreasury Regulations naku-Public Finance Management Act kwaye yimiqathango yezemali. Ulwazi ngeemfundiso zeBatho Pele. Isikolo ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha esinomzimba oqinileyo ochonge i-EXCEL, esidala esiya kwelixa eliphezulu kwaye kubekho nazipho na ezinokuchazwa. Isakhono sokubeka ngokukhululekana, sokuzoba iimpawu ezingangenisa nto, sokubeka ngokulungelelanisa. Ukulawula abantu. Ulungiselelo lokuqonda abathengi/abaxhasi nako ukwazi ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo nokuzimela. Ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code 8) kuya kuba ngusizo oluqhinga.
xh.duties: Nikezela ngeenkonzo ze-Tax Rebates. Thatha, hlola kwaye ulungise iinkonzo ezijoliswe kubantu abazithumelayo ukuba bazichaze ukuya kwimigangatho engaqambanga yomthetho, iindlela nemigaqo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ubungakanani nokungabi namathafa phakathi kwamaphepha obungqina angeniswa ngabahlawuleli bethaxes nabo banceda kubantu abakhusela iintsapho. Qinisekisa ulwazi ngabantu abahlawula iithaxes ngokubhekisa kwemali nakwiirekhodi zethaxes. Faka, hlaziya kwaye ugcine ukugcina ulwazi ngenkonzo ethile kwinkqubo yeemali esemthethweni phantsi kwemigaqo yayo egqitha kwiqhinga kubantu abazinikelayo. Balule kwaye ulungise iinkonzo ezamkelekileyo ngokuchanekileyo nangaphantsi kwesixa sokuphela koxinzelelo kwelixa elichaziweyo. Lungiselela ukwahlula-hlula iinkonzo zentlawulo ngokuchanekileyo nokuba zilandele imithetho yexesha. Sombulula iinkathazo ezihlobene neenkonzo ezinikiweyo kubantu abanikezwa ngayo iinkonzo zokumisela imirhumo ngexesha nangaphandle kweziphaluka. Thethathetha ngeengxamiselelo ezingagqibekanga, zibe ngokomthetho nezinye iingcali ngendlela ekuhlakaniphileyo, ukuze kubekho amathuba amaninzi okuba kubemva nangexesha lokumisela ukubakho koluntu oluzisezantsi. Ukwenza uyilo lweemali ezifunekayo. Hlalumba zonke iingxaki ezithiwe kuye kungenwa imirhumo yemali. Yongeza nokulungisa iingxaki ezifunyaniswe kwinkqubo ekuyo. Hlalumba iinkqubo ezibambe ngokuchanekileyo ukuya kwinkqubo egqityiweyo yemirhumo yemali. Gcina iindlela zokuyila ulwazi lwasemahlathini nakwelinye igumbi. Qinisekisa ukuba inkonzo iphumelela ngokwemigaqo egqithiweyo yokungena kuxinzelelo. Yiba nexesha lokuzisezela kwiindawo ezimila kwindalo eqondo ngokubanzi ukuya kuloo midlalo ibekelwe ukuba igcine lonto ngokufanelekileyo. Gcina ulwazi oluyimvelaphi yegatja lokusebenza nolugqithisiweyo, lude ngokumalunga nolwazi oluqotho. Hlola kwaye wenze isicongo-mxhama ngaloo nto ikhoyo ngolu hlobo. Thetha nabantu abangenwa yimfuneko yonke kwaye abanceda ekubeni kwenzeke oko kunokubakho uluntu oluvela kubantu abanikela ngemali kwinkqubo eqondo esuka kwiinkalo ezifanayo phakathi kwexesha elininzi. Lungiselela nokulungisa amanqaku eemali ezahlukeneyo anokusetyenziswa ngelixa lokuqonda nokusebenzisa iNqondo yoluntu. Bonezela ngexesha indlela yokwenza iindaba ezenziwayo. Sebenzela iindaba ezahlukileyo zentsini ngokuzimela phakathi kobulumko.

jobs.summary: State Accountant needed for Budget Planning at OR Tambo District, Eastern Cape, requiring a diploma or degree in accounting or finance with 1 to 2 years of public sector experience.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate plus a National Diploma (NQF level 6) or B. Degree (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit qualifications with at least 1 to 2 years’ experience within the public sector expenditure management field and payment of employee benefits. Public sector finances experience in budgeting and revenue management will be added advantage. Knowledge of financial systems (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS) and be able to interpret NERF and Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Legislations / policies / prescripts, and procedures. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations and Division of Revenue Act (DORA), understanding of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Appropriation Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Financial Regulations Knowledge of Batho Pele principles. Computer literacy (specializing in Advanced EXCEL and PowerPoint Presentation. Good communication and report writing skills. Sound organisational skills. People management. Customer / client orientated approach and ability to work under pressure and independently. A valid driving licence (Code 8) is required.
jobs.duties: Monitor the Implementation of expenditure patterns of the department. Prepare expenditure report documents as per responsibility codes of the programmes. Identify misallocations of funds. Facilitate loading and capturing of budget on the system. Collection of inputs from programs for budget in line with the operational plans. Preparation of final balancing of budget for each following financial year. Facilitate submission of budget database from the programs. Facilitate consolidation of operational budget. Guide and assist programmes on budget utilization. Facilitate logistical arrangements for the workshops. Minute taking for workshops. Facilitate implementation of virements. Receive and check availability of funds in budget proposals. Check and maintain commitment registers. Forward commitment registers to relevant programmes.

af.title: Staatsekstant: Begrotingsbeplanning
af.summary: Staatsekantoorwerker benodig vir Begrotingsbeplanning by OR Tambo Distrik, Eastern Cape, wat 'n diploma of graad in rekenkunde of finansies vereis met 1 tot 2 jaar se openbare sektor ervaring.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) of B. Degree (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Rekenkunde/ Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde/ Finansiële Bestuur/ Interne Oudit-kwalifikasies met ten minste 1 tot 2 jaar se ervaring binne die openbare sektor se bestuursveld vir uitgawes en betaling van werknemervoordele. Openbare sektor finansiële ervaring in begroting en inkomste-bestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van finansiële stelsels (LOGIS, PERSAL en BAS) en wees in staat om NERF en Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA) te interpreteer. Kennis van Public Service Regulations, Wetgewing/ beleide/ voorskrifte, en prosedures. Kennis van Treasury Regulations en Division of Revenue Act (DORA), begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Appropriation Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Finansiële Regulasies Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Rekenaargeletterdheid (spesialiseer in Gevorderde EXCEL en PowerPoint-aanbieding. Goeie kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede. Soliede organisatoriese vaardighede. Mensebestuur. Kliënt-georiënteerde benadering en vermoë om onder druk en onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Code 8) word vereis.
af.duties: Monitor die implementering van uitgawepatrone van die departement. Berei uitgaweverslagdokumente voor volgens verantwoordelikheidskodes van die programme. Identifiseer verkeerde toewysings van fondse. Fasiliteer die laai en vaslegging van begroting op die stelsel. Insameling van insette van programme vir begroting in ooreenstemming met die operasionele planne. Voorbereiding van finale balansering van begroting vir elke daaropvolgende finansiële jaar. Fasiliteer indiening van begrotingsdatabasis van die programme. Fasiliteer konsolidasie van operasionele begroting. Lei en help programme met begrotingsbenutting. Fasiliteer logistieke reëlings vir die werkswinkels. Notulaas neem vir werkswinkels. Fasiliteer implementering van oordragte. Ontvang en kontroleer beskikbaarheid van fondse in begrotingsvoorstelle. Kontroleer en onderhou verbintenisregisters. Stuur verbintenisregisters na tersaaklike programme.

Verskaf ondersteuning in die implementering van doeltreffende finansiële bestuur en interne beheer maatreëls binne die departement. zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Ssezimali Sezwe sokulawula ngaphakathi nangemisebenzi ye-pre-audit ngaphakathi kwe-Eastern Cape Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture, esidinga idiploma noma iziqu kwezobuciko bokubala ngolwazi lwesikhungo sezimoto zitholakala emmango.

Ulwazi ngemisimulo yezimali (LOGIS, PERSAL kanye ne-BAS) kanye nakho ukuthi ukwazi ukuhumusha i-NERF kanye ne-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Nikeza inkxaso ekuletheni imisimulo ekusetshenzisweni yokulawula izimali ngempumelelo kanye nezinyathelo zokuLawula Ngaphakathi ngaphakathi komnyango. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa okufanele kanye nokugcinwa kwezimoto zezimali. Yenza ukuqathaniswa lapho kudingeka khona futhi uhlanganise imibiko yamasonto nezinyanga. Xhumana nabahlinzeki abahlobene ukukhulisa iziphephelo, ukulungisa nokuxazulula izobuciko bokulawula abatholakele nezinto ezitholakele ekuhlotsheni.

zu.title: Isikhulu sezimali sikahulumende: Eziphathwa kwezimali ezixhafunwayo
zu.summary: Isikhulu sezimali sikahulumende eziphathwa kwezimali ezixhafunwayo kuMnyango weMidlalo, iNguquko, ubuBhaqwe nemiCimbi yoBuciko kwa-East London, sifuna idiploma noma iziqu kwi-akhawunti noma ezimali ezinolwazi lomsebenzi womphakathi.
zu.requirements: National Senior Certificate kanye ne-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) noma i-B. Degree (NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwe yi-SAQA) kwi-Accounting/ Cost & Management Accounting/ Financial Management/ Internal Audit kanye nolwazi lweminye engu-1 kuya kwa-2 emkhakheni wezimali ezixhafunwayo womphakathi noshintsho lwemikomisho yabasebenzi. Lolwazi kwezimali zomphakathi ekwelweni nezimali ezifakwayo luzobe lusizo. Ukwazi izinhlelo zezimali (LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS) nokukwazi ukuhumusha i-NERF kanye ne-Standard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Ukwazi Izinhlelo zomphakathi, iziMiso/ inqubomgomo/ imiyalo nezindlela zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukwazi Izimiso zeNgqikithi yezimali kanye ne-Division of Revenue Act (DORA), ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye ne-Appropriation Act. I-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Izimiso zezimali nokwazi imigomo yamaphrinsiphi ka-Batho Pele. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokukhethekilewa kwi-Advanced EXCEL kanye ne-PowerPoint Presentation. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokubhala izibali. Amakhono ahlelekile okuhlelela. Ukuqondisa abantu. Indlela yokugxila kthelathelithi kanye nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkuthazo nokuzimele. Ifuna ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code 8).
zu.duties: Nika futhi usebenzise izinsiza zokushintsha imali. Qedelela ukuthola ama-inivhoisi kwi-Supply Chain Management bese ukhomba ukulinganiswa okungalungile kwabasebenzi kwi-isisele kanye nale-Logis System. Qinisekisa ukuthi okunamathiselwe kuqinisile kokubili i-isisele kanye nama-Logis Systems. Xhumana ne-internal audit nakubantu bangaphandle. Faka imali kwi-Logis System. Qedelela ngaphambili ukushintshwa kwemali kwi-Logis kwa-Isisele. Thumela imali edluliselwe kwa-internal control ukuze kusolwe ukuqiniswa nokubukeka kokuqinisekiswa kwamafa kuma-Logis systems. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa okulungile kwamafa bese uwathumela kwa-internal control ukuphathwa ngokuphepha. Hlela izibali zansoni zonke nezinyanga zonke. Ukusebenzisa izinhlobo zokuchithwa kwemali komnyango. Lungiselela amafa ezibali ngokwezikhozo ezingxenyeni zohlelo. Khomba ulondoloze futhi uthumele kumphathi ukulinganiselwa okungalungile kwemali.

xh.title: IsiGqisha sikaRhulumende: Ulawulo lokuTsala-Mali
xh.summary: IsiGqisha sikaRhulumende kwiLawulo lokuTsala-Mali kwiSebe leMzobo, iNzuzo, iBhalo nenHlalo nakoNtshato eEast London, lifuna idiploma okanye igqetho kubuchwephetshe be-akhawunti okanye nezimali ngoluhlu lweqela elisebenzayo kwiqela labantu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliPhakamile seSizwe kwege idiploma yeSizwe (iNQF Level 6) okanye igqetho leB. (iNQF level 7 njengakamkelwa yiSAQA) kwi-Akhawunti/ I-Akhawunti yokuTshela nokuLawula/ uLawulo lweMali/ iindawo zokuPondayo ezingaphakathi noluhlu lobomi obungazifunanga kwiRiphabhuliki yomsebenzi wokuLawula imali eceliweyo namahlawuliso abasebenzi. Uluhlu lobomi obungazifunanga kwiRiphabhuliki yemali kwisiqulatho semali nolawulo lentsalelo kuya kuba lusisibonelelo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zemali (LOGIS, PERSAL, BAS) nokuba nakho ukuqondisisa iNERF neStandard Chart of Accounts (SCoA). Ulwazi ngeMgqetho weNkonzo kaRhulumende, iMigqetho/ iingqikithi/ amaphepha asekelweyo neenkqubo. Ulwazi ngeMigqetho yeNgqikithi yeMali naseMthetho woLawulo lweNsalelo (DORA), ukuqondisisa koMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumende (PFMA) noMthetho wokuQhutywa kweMali. UMthetho weNgqikithi yokuThenga ngokukhethwa (PPPFA), Ulwazi ngeNgqikithi yeMali malunga nemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokubhekisele kwi-Advanced EXCEL nakwiNkcazelo ngePowerPoint. Ikhono elilungeleleyo lokuncokolisa nokubhala iingxelo. Iikhono ezilungeleleneyo zoluhlu lomsebenzi. ULawulo lwabantu. Indlela ezelwe iinxalenye/ iklayenti nakhono lokusebenza ngoxinzelelo nokuzimeleyo. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba (Code 8) elisebenzayo iyafuneka.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokuhlawula uze uyisebenzise. Yenza okulula ukwamkela iinvoyisi evela kuLawulo lweNkqubo yoLawulo lokuNikela uze uqonde ekuhlelweni okungalunganga kwiinkqubo zokuzinika ezingalunganga kwi-Logis System. Qinisekisa ukuzinika okungalunganga kokuqinisekiswa kweephepha ezikwazi ezingazange zenziwe kwaye azilunganga kumasebe amakhulu kwi-Logis Systems. Qhagamshelana nolawulo lwangaphakathi nalabo basebenza ngaphandle. Tsala imali eceliweyo kwi-Logis System. Tsala ngaphambili imali eceliweyo kwi-Logis nase-Isisele. Thumela imali eceliweyo kwindawo yolawulo ngaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe nokuzinika okungalunganga kwamaxwebhu akwi-Logis systems. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa okulungileyo kwamaxwebhu uze ayinike indawo yolawulo ngaphakathi ukuze zigcinwe zikhuselekile. Hlela iingxelo ezivezwa ngeveki nangeyenyanga. Zisebenzise iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuTsala-mali kwisebe. Lungiselela iingxelo zokuTsala-mali ngokwamaxwebhu ngokwemigca yomsebenzi yeemisebenzi. Qonda uqonde uze unike umlawuli wakho izinto ezingeniswe kwindawo ezingelulo yemali.

zu.title: Umthungi wezincwadi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabathungi wezincwadi emitolobeni kahulumeni kuzinga ezintathu e-Eastern Cape, kudinga idiploma noma iziqu kwi-Library and Information Science ngeminyaka eyi-1 kuye kwayi-2 yohlelo.

Amakhono amahle ekhompyutha, ukuhlela, ukuxhumana, nokuqamba imibiko; ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu nezimo eziphakathi kwabo. Ulwazi oluhle ngabahlanganyeli. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela (Code 8).

Ukuphatha, ukwamukela kokubuyisa izinto ezingemitolo ezivela kofisi lesifunda. Ukunakela izidingo zabasebenzisi. Ukubhaliswa kwezibalo zenyanga zokusetshenziswa nokubhala imibiko. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuqoqweni kohlelo lokusebenza. Ukuphatha impahla nezinsiza zendawo yokufunda. Ukulawula ukubuyiswa kwemali minyaka yonke. Ukumisa kanye nokugcina izakhiwo zendawo yokufunda. Ukuphatha isevisi kuma-mini-lib. Okwelawulo abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umntu osebenzela mtlari wemibhalo

xh.requirements: National Senior Certificate eyongezelelwa National Diploma (NQF Level 6) okanye Bibl. Degree / B Tech (NQF Level 7) njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA kwiLibrary and Information Science / Studies okanye Bachelor of Information Sciences nokuba uninzi lonyaka wamava omsebenzi ongaphela kwaka-1 ukuya kuka-2 kwinkalo yeLibrary and Information Service. Ulwazi ngomthetho, iinkqubela, namagunya oluntu. Ulwazi olusetyenziswa ngenkqubo nendlela zolwazi ngemibhalo nolwazi noluqondo Iimpilo ezilungileyo zekhompyutha, zolungelelwaniso, zoxhumo, nolwazi lokubhala iingxelo, kunye nokuba namakhosi alungileyo kumanyano woluntu. Ulwazi olulungileyo malunga namaphakathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code 8) esemthethweni.

Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni kohlelo loshishino. Ukulawulwa koluhlu lweemali zomthobo wemibhalo Ukusetyenziswa kolungiselelo lonyaka lwemali. Ukuqulunqa nokugcina iinkqubo zomthobo wemibhalo. af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by Bayworld Museum in Gqeberha vir die hanteer van ontvangs, berging en verspreiding van goedere, wat 'n diploma in voorsieningsketting of openbare bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat plus 'n Diploma (NQF Level 6) of 'n Graad (NQF Level 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration/Inventory Management/Stores/Logistics Management. Blootstelling op die gebied sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van registerpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf, sal ook 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van berging- en onttrekkingsprocedures binne die werksomgewing. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Aanvaarbare verslagskryfvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om maksimum vlak van vertroulikheid te verseker. 'n Geldige (Code 8) bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Fasiliteer ontvangs van goedere en dienste. Ontvang, kontroleer en rekord die goedere en fakture wat van die verskaffer ontvang is. Vergelyk ontvangs van goedere met die versoekvorme. Onderteken by ontvangs van goedere. Rekordeer die goedere wat ontvang is. Hou goedere op die regte en veilige plek. Fasiliteer die berging, uitreiking en verspreiding van voorraad-items/voorraad. Plaas goedere in die korrekte opbergplek. Werk opbergkaarte en itemrekords by. Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die museum. Help met die administrasie van die Museum se vloot.
