Kontroleer die geldigheid van die faktuur (stempel, handtekening en bankbesonderhede). Ontvang en lê voorleggings op die stelsel vas. Rekordeer uitgaande voorleggings. Stuur die voorleggings na betalings. Voorraadbeheer en voorraadopname.

zu.title: Clerk we-Admin
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-clerk ye-admin e-Bayworld Museum e-Gqeberha ukuphatha ukwamukelwa kwempahla, ukuhlakaniphwa nokusatshalaliswa, kudinga idiploma kwi-supply chain noma kwi-public management.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate kanye ne-Diploma (NQF Level 6) noma i-Degree (NQF Level 7) ekuqashelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management/ Public Management/ Public Administration/Inventory Management/Stores/Logistics Management. Ukuba nolwazi ohlwini lomsebenzi kuzoba yinzuzo eble. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistry, izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi kanye nokukwazi ukungenisa idatha, futhi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzoba yinzuzo eble. Ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda umthetho ohlola isevisi kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngemigomo yokuqasha nokuthola kabusha impahla ngokwesimo sendawo yokusebenza. Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Amakhono asemthethweni okubhala imibiko. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isimo sokugcina ulwoluqobo. I-(Code 8) driving license evuma ukushayela izimoto izoholela ekubeni ukwazi ukulawula uhlelo lokushayela.
zu.duties: Pheph ukwamukelwa kwempahla kanye namasevisi. Qaphela futhi ubhale impahla kanye ne-invoice efinance evela kumsizi. Thath'inkomba kwindlela yokuqasha nokubeka impahla noma ukuthumela esikhundleni esihle. Phath'inkomba yokuqasha. Bhala impahla etholwe. Gcina impahla endaweni ekuqiniswe ukuthi ihlanzekile. Pheph ukulondolozwa, ukusatshalaliswa nokunikwa izimoto. Thum'inkomba yokuqashwa kwempahla ohlelweni lwemibhalo yomsebenzi. Pheph uhlelo lokubhala amakadi nokuqapha impahla egcinwe ngokwemibhalo yolwazi. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lemithombo yocwaningo lwe-museum. Phath'inkomba yokuhlela uhlelo lwamasholashi e-museum. Thintana nabasebenzela kwendawo ethile ukuthola impahla ekwamukelwe. Siza ekutheni kwenzeke ukubhaliswa kwamaphepha okufaka izimpahla kubasebenzela abaningini. Phetha ukubhalwa nokungeniswa kolwazi kusikhala sezimali kubasebenzela abaningini. Hambisa izimpahla ohlelweni lokuhamba kwesikhathi sokufika kwabo. Qapha ukuvumeleka kwe-invoice (isigcino, ukuzifikiswa nokungahambisani kwemali). Yenza isibonisiwe ngokungamisela emandleni okukhetha ukuthi inikwe igunya elikusikhathi. Faka isabelo sokuthi inikwa izwe labantu. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezenzo luhamba ngohlelo. Xhuma ngohlelo i-Finance section. Yenza ukuhlola imithombo yamaphoyisa. Qinisekisa imiyalelo yezinto ezibhalwayo nezinkomba ezenzwa i-museum.

xh.title: Mntathu wezinto
xh.summary: Kufunekho mntathu wezinto kwi-Bayworld Museum e-Gqeberha ukuphatha ukwamkelwa kwempahla, indalo nokuhambisana, ngenani yesidanga kwindlela yokuhamba kwempahla okanye ulawulo loluntu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sokuQesha iNazionale kwaye iNqanaba le-6 le-NQF okanye iNgqondo (Nqanaba lama-7 le-NQF) njengoko kuyaziswa yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management/ iPublic Management/ iPublic Administration/ iInventory Management/ iStores/ iLogistics Management. Ulwazi kule ndawo kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistri, iindlela zayo kwanekhono lokungena kwi-data, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nako kuya kuba lusizo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda kolawu lomthetho olawula iNkonzo kaZwelonke. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokugcina nokubuyisela impahla ngokwendawo yokusebenza. Ilungile ukunxibelelana ngokubhala nangokuthetha. Ikakhulu ukubhala iingxelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokugcina ixabiso eliphezulu lokugcina imfihlo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela (iKhowudi 8) esemthethweni iya kuba lusizo.
xh.duties: Yenza kubenjalo ukwamkelwa kwezinto kunye nenkonzo. Amkela, hlola uze ubhale izinto nefakthure ezwamkela kumthengisi. Qamantsha izinto eziwamkelayo ngefomu zesicelo. Sign isignitsha kwamkelwa kwempahla. Bhala izinto eziwamkeliwe. Gcina izinto kwendawo elungileyo ekhuselekileyo. Yenza kubenjalo indalo, ukupapashwa nokuhambisana kwezinto/impahla. Faka izinto kwigumbi elilungileyo. Hlaziya amakhadi egumbi kunye nerekhedi yezinto. Gcina uze ulawule irekhedi yemfuneko yemnyuziyam. Ncedisa kwiNtengiso yamaje eMnyuziyam. Nxibelelana nomsebenzisi wokugqibela ukuba aze athathe izinto eziwamkelwe. Papasha uze ulawule ukusayina kwesatifikethi samkelo sezinto somsebenzisi wokugqibela. Yenza kubenjalo ukungenisa nokuvelisa amaxesho okuhlawulela. Qamantsha uze uhlole ifakthure ngokomyalelo nangokwezinto eziwamkelwe. Hlola ukusemthethweni kwefakthure (isitempe, isayini kunye neenkcukacha zebhanki). Amkela uze ungenise isicelo kwinkqubo. Bhala isicelo esiphumayo. Thumela isicelo kuhlawulo. Lawula isitokhwe nokubala izinto.

jobs.title: General Assistant: Logistics Services
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R144 024 – R 169 656 per annum (Level 02), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: General Assistant for Logistics Services in Amathole District requiring ABET Level 4 or Grade 10 and a Code 8 driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Abet Level 4 or grade 10. National Senior Certificate will be an added advantage. No experience required. Exposure to the environment will be an added advantage. Prepared to work after hours. Knowledge: Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Interpersonal relations and communication skills. A valid (Code 8) driving license.

Ensure prompt delivery of documents to provincial office, other departments and safe keeping of information/documents whilst in transit. Photocopying of documents. Collection of delivery items/ correspondence to various offices in the district. Ferry officials to departmental events, i.e., workshops and meetings. Collect and deliver mail to registry office. Paste notices in the district notice boards. Assist in any general assistant’s duties as and when required to do so. Provide cleaning services of offices, boardroom, and walkways. Keep and maintain cleaning materials and equipment. Prepare venue for functions and meetings. Prepare tea during meetings. Assist during functions.

af.title: Algemene Assistent: Logistieke Dienste
af.summary: Algemene Assistent vir Logistieke Dienste in Amathole Distrik wat ABET Level 4 of Graad 10 en 'n Code 8 bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Abet Level 4 of grade 10. National Senior Certificate sal 'n voordeel wees. Geen ervaring vereis. Blootstelling aan die omgewing sal 'n voordeel wees. Bereid om buite werksure te werk. Kennis: Basiese kennis van werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Interpersoonlike verhoudings en kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige (Code 8) bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die ontvangs, laai en aflaai van goedere in die distrik. Bystand verleen met voorraadopname en verifikasie van bates. Sorg vir tydige aflewering van dokumente aan provinsiale kantoor, ander departemente en veilige bewaring van inligting/dokumente terwyl dit in transito is. Fotokopiëring van dokumente. Versameling van afleweringsartikels/korrespondensie na verskeie kantore in die distrik. Amptenare vervoer na departementele geleenthede, d.w.s. werkswinkels en vergaderings. Pos versamel en aflewer by registerkantoor. Kennisgewings op distrikskennisgewingborde plak. Bystand verleen met enige algemene assistent se pligte soos en wanneer vereis. Skoonmaakdienste vir kantore, raadsaal en gangpad verskaf. Skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting hou en in stand hou. Lokaal vir funksies en vergaderings voorberei. Tydens vergaderings tee voorberei. Bystand verleen tydens funksies.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Ohlelekile: Isevisi Yezohwebo
zu.summary: Umsebenzi Ohlelekile weze-Isevisi Yezohwebo kwi-District yase-Amathole ofuna i-ABET Level 4 noma i-Grade 10 nephasi lokushayela le-Code 8.
zu.requirements: I-Abet Level 4 noma i-grade 10. I-National Senior Certificate izoba ngothile. Akukho mkhuleko odingekile. Ukuvezwa emhlabeni kuzoba ngothile. Ukuze ulunge ukusebenza emahoreni angemuva. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nemigomo yomsebenzi ngokwesimo sokusebenza. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu namakhono okuxhumana. Iphasiwidi (Code 8) lokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Siza ekutholeni, ukufakelweni, nokukhipheni izimpahla kwi-district. Siza ekubaleni izitoko kokuqinisekisa izimpahla. Qinisekisa ukulethwa ngokushesha kwamafa esiweni sifundvo, eminye iminyango nokugcina ngokuphephile ulwazi/amafa ngenkathi kuhamba. Ukukopisha amafa. Landa izinto ezithunyelwayo/ukuxhumana ezinye izikhungo kwi-district. Hamba nabaluleki emicimbini yomnyango, okungukuthi, izinkundla namahlangano. Landa futhi ulethe iposi esiweni sesirejistri. Namathisela izaziso kubhodikazi bezaziso kwi-district. Siza kunoma yimiphi imisebenzi yomsebenzi ohlelekile njalo nangasinye isikhathi uma kudingeka. Nikeza amasevisi okuhlamba izikhungo, igumbi lezinkundla, kanye nezindlela zokuqhuba. Gcina futhi ulondoloze izinto nezisetshenziswa zokuhlamba. Lungiselela indawo yemicimbo namahlangano. Lungiselela itiye ngesikhathi samahlangano. Siza ngesikhathi somicimbo.

xh.title: Umncedi jikelele: Iinkonzo zoQhweshe
xh.summary: Umncedi jikelele wasekuQhwesheni kummandla wase Amathole District ofuna i-ABET Level 4 okanye u-Grade 10 nelayisensi yokuqhwesha eyi-Code 8.
xh.requirements: I-Abet Level 4 okanye i-grade 10. Isatifikethi se-National Senior Certificate siza kuba lusonelo. Akukho nqeqesho lwemfundo efunekayo. Ukuqonda indalo siza kuba lusonelo. Kulungele ukusebenza emva kweyure zemiselo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusetyenziswayo lwendlela yokwenza umsebenzi ngokwemo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu namakhono ekunxibelelwani. Ilayisensi evakalayo (Code 8) yokuqhwesha.
xh.duties: Nceda ekwamkelweni, ekufakeni, nasekukhupheni impahla kummandla. Nceda kokuthathwa kwesitokhwe nasekuqinisekiseni izinto. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zolwazi zisikelwa ngokukhawuleza kwindlu yophangano yephondo, kumasebe amanye nokugcinwa kwexabiso lelwazi/izixhobo zolwazi xa kusetyenziswa. Ukwenza izixhobo zolwazi iikopi. Ukuqokelela izinto zokuhanjiswa/negazethi kumaziko ahlukeneyo kummandla. Khusela abaphathi kwimizamo yesebe, oko kukuthi, kumaziko oqeqesho nakuqunyelweni. Qokelela uze uhanise iposi kwindlu yokuqikelela iindlela. Natshela izaziso kumabhoodi ezaziso kummandla. Nceda kulo naliphi na umsebenzi womncedi jikelele njengoko naxa kufuneka. Nikeza iinkonzo zokucotha kumaziko, kwindlu yokudibana, naseendleleni zokuhanjiswa. Gcina uze ulondoloze izinto zokucotha neempahla. Lungiselela indawo yemisebenzi nokuqunyela. Lungiselela iti ngexa lokuqunyela. Nceda ngexa lokuqhutywa kwezinto.

af.title: Biblioteekassistent
af.summary: Biblioteekassistentposte by nege Eastern Cape-distriksbiblioteke, wat 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat vereis, op salarisvlak 4 met pligte wat sirkulasie, rangskikking en naslaanvrae insluit.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat met relevante ervaring of Diploma/B. Graad (NQF-vlak 6/7) soos deur SAQA erken in Biblioteek- en Inligtingkunde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Goede beheer van ten minste twee (2) amptelike tale sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van biblioteekstelsels en tersaaklike regeringsvoorskrifte. Blootstelling op die gebied sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike vaardighede. 'n Geldige (Kode 8) bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Voer alle sirkulasiepligte in die biblioteek uit. Sluit aan by en help met die hernuwing van biblioteeklidmaatskap. Rangskikking van alle biblioteekleesmateriaal. Hanteer naslaanvrae deur gebruikers. Onderhou goeie openbare betrekkinge met belanghebbendes. Vergesel bibliotekaris by vergaderings wanneer nodig. Stel statistieke van die biblioteek op. Help met die reël van en/of betrokke wees by bewustheidsprogramme (Voorligting en Bemarking). Help met die vorming/vestiging van 'n biblioteekstruktuur & boekklubs. Verantwoordelik vir oriëntasie en kinderprogramme. Help met die bestuur van biblioteekskenkings en ander programme in die biblioteek insluitend IT- en minibibliotheekdienste. Hierdie poste is vir persone met gestremdhede voorbehou.

zu.title: Umncedi WezMitadi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomncedi wezemitadi kuzo zonke izimitadi sezifunda eziyisishiyagalombili ze-Eastern Cape, ezidinga i-National Senior Certificate, ezingeni 4 leholo nemisebenzi ehlanganisa ukugeza izinto, ukubeka izinto ezifundiwe kanye nemibuzo mayelana nalokho okufakiwe esitadini.
zu.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate. I-National Senior Certificate enamava ahambisanayo noma i-Diploma/B. Degree (NQF level 6/7) evunyiwe ngu-SAQA kwi-Library & Information Science kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ukuqonda kahle okungenani izilimi ezimbili (2) zomthetho kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo zemitadi nemithetho kahulumeni ehambisanayo. Isipili sindo kule nsimu kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (Code 8) kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu.
zu.duties: Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokuqhuba imisebenzi esitudiyweni. Ujoyine futhi usize ekubuyisweni kwangasese kobuhlalo besitudiyo. Ukubeka bonke abafundi bezinto ezifundiwe esitudiyweni. Phendula imibuzo ngesitadi ethiwe abasebenzisi. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nomphakathi nabantu abahlobene nayo. Hamba nomtaphezelwa wemibhalo emihlanganweni uma kudingeka. Qamba izibalo zesitudiyo. Sise ekulungeniseni kanye noma ukuba yingxenye kwezinhlelo zokwazisa (Ukuxhasa kanye nokuMaketha). Sise ekwakheni/ukusekelweni kwenhlelo yesitudiyo kanye namaklabhu ezincwadi. Uxanduva lokuhlola futhi uphathe izinhlelo zezingane. Sise ekuphathweni kweminikelo yesitudiyo, kanye nezinye izinhlelo esitudiyweni okuhlanganisa i-ICT kanye namasevisi e-mini-lib. Lezi zikhundla zigqokiselwe abantu abakhubazekile.

xh.summary: Izithuba zomncedi wethala leencwadi kumathala eencwadi amalunga nawo olunye kumazwe angamawathathu angaphakathi Eastern Cape, afuna isiQinisekiso seNqanaba leZiko, kwinqanaba 4 lomvuzo nemisebenzi equka ukusasaza, ukubeka iincwadi kwithala ngemibuzo yosalathiso.
xh.requirements: IsiQinisekiso seNqanaba leZiko. IsiQinisekiso seNqanaba leZiko esinamava ahambelanayo okanye iDiploma/iGqaka leZidanga (NQF level 6/7) njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA kwiNzululwazi nolwazi loMthetho weThala leencwadi kuya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi oluhle kolunye (2) ulwimi olusesiqu lwelizweiya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi ngamathala eencwadi nemigcaqo kahulumeni ehambelanayo. Inkcubeko kundawo iya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalise entetho nokubhala. Ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code 8) esemthethweni iya kuba ngumonde olongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Kwenza yonle imisebenzi yokusasaza kuthala leencwadi. Ukuzinikela kwaye uncede ekuhlaziyeni ilungelo lolilungo lethala leencwadi. Ukubeka yonke iincwadi ezifundwayo kuthala. Ukuphendula imibuzo yosalathiso eza kubasebenzisi. Ukugcina ubudlelwane obuhle namaphakathi abanomdla. Ukuhamba nelibrharia kwimibhangqela xa kuyimfuneko. Ukuqokelela izibalo zethala leencwadi. Ukuncedisa ekulungiseni okanye ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinjongo zokuvakalayo (Ukuqinisekiswa kuze kuqashelwe). Ukuncedisa ekuveliseni/ekusekweni isakhiwo Sethala leencwadi namaklabhu encwadi. Ukuzimela ngokuqaliswa kwabantu abasha namaziko abantwana. Ukuncedisa ekulawuleni iimalana nethala leencwadi, nakwezinye iinkqubo zethala leencwadi kuquka iICT namaziko amancinci. Ezi zithuba zizihlolelwe abantu abakhubazekileyo.

af.summary: Handwerkmanpos by die Eastern Cape Museum, verantwoordelik vir gebouonderhoud, sleutelbestuur en noodsituasies.
af.requirements: Graad 8-sertifikaat / ABET level 4 of NQF level – 3 met geen ervaring. Moet kan skryf en lees. Goie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Selfgemotiveerd. Die volgende sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien: Die uitvoer van algemene assistentpligte, blootstelling in die veld sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees en 'n geldige (Code 8) bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bewaak alle hoof- en reservesleutels wat aan die instelling behoort. Bystand verleen aan alle defekte in die gebou. Bystand verleen by noodsituasies soos hysbreekdowns; geboue ontruimings ens. Voer 'n voorraadopname uit van areas van verantwoordelikheid soos sleutels, kantooruitrusting ens. Verseker dat alle toerusting van sluitfasiliteite voorsien word. Inbind van departementele omvangryke dokumente.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wokuqasha izinto nokuqapha izakhiwo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi wokuqasha izinto nokuqapha izakhiwo e-Eastern Cape Museum, onenziwa ngokulondolozwa kwezakhiwo, uphatha amakhiye, kanye nemicimbi ephuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 8 / i-ABET level 4 noma i-NQF leve1 – 3 ngaphandle kokuhlonze okufunyenwe. Kumele ukwazi ukubhala nokufunda. Amakhono amuhle wokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono amuhle okuxoxa nokubhala. Ukuzimotivisha. Okulandelayo kuzoba yinzuzo: Ukwenza imisebenzi eyisilongondwane, ukuba nolwazi ensimini kuzoba yinzuzo kanye nelayisense lokushayela (Code 8) elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Londoloza onke amakhiye amakhulu naba-yasindawo abhekele isikhungo. Qaphela wonke amaphutha ezakhiweni. Siza kumicimbi ephuthumayo njengokuhluleka kwelift; ukushiywa kwesakhiwo njll. Yenza ukubala kwezinto ezindaweni zobuncwabi njengamakhiye, izinto zohhovisi njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto zinamakhiye abo. Ukuhlanganisa imadokhumenti enkulu yomnyango.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wezandla
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wezandla e-Eastern Cape Museum, ejonge ngokuhlala kwakho komaketha, ulawulo lweqhosha, kunye neimeko ezingathi zenzeka ngokukhawuleza.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGraji 8 / i-ABET level 4 okanye i-NQF leve1 – 3 ngaphandle kwolwazi. Kufuneka ukwazi ukubhala noku funda. Iakhobho ezintsonzothi zomntu nomntu. Iakhobho ezintsonzothi zethetha noku bhala. Zivele ngokwakhe. xh.duties: Zigcine ngokukhuselekileyo onke amaqhosha aphambili namagejoza ebelonging kwisebe. Yelela onke amashwa kunye neemposiso ezakhiweni. Ndiza ngeemeko ezibuthathaka njengokuba kuhluleke i-elevator; kushiyekef izakhiwo njl njl. Yenza isifundo sazo onke amaqhosha. Voke. Yenza isifundo sezinto ezikwisikhululo. Tshintsha isixhobo esibizwa ngokuba 'lock'. Qwalasela ukuba zonke izixhobo zinikwa iinkonzo ezilocking. Xhoma izixhobo eziyimfihlo ezisesikweni.

jobs.title: Groundsman
jobs.department: Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture
jobs.salary_text: R144 024 – R169 656 per annum (Level 02), (an all-inclusive remuneration)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026. Applications received after closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture seeks a groundsman to maintain the grounds and gardens at Bayworld Museum in the Eastern Cape.
jobs.requirements: Grade 8 certificate / ABET level 4 or NQF leve1 – 3 with no experience. The following will be an added advantage: experience in gardening, grounds maintenance or general assistant duties & exposure in the field. Must be able to read and write. Good interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated.
jobs.duties: Maintain lawns, flowerbeds, trees and pathways around the museum. Water plants, remove weeds, prune shrubs and trees, mow grass, and sweep outdoor areas. Relocate plants and trees, remove garden refuse, and assist with care and pest control of the cycad collection. Clean paved surfaces using high- pressure equipment. Keep signage, benches, bins, storerooms, and public spaces neat and presentable. Care for gardening tools and equipment; detect and report malfunctioning tools or maintenance issues such as leaks or broken lights. Assist with moving and setting up exhibition materials, showcases, furniture, and display cases. Help with the construction, assembly, and maintenance of museum displays and exhibition structures under supervision. Provide cleaning services in exhibition rooms, workshops, and storage areas. Set up chairs, tables, and equipment for school visits, talks, and community events. Assist with venue preparation and clean-up before and after functions. Support caretakers and cleaners as required. Perform any other duties related to grounds and facility upkeep or general assistant work as assigned by the supervisor.

af.title: Grondwerker
af.summary: Die Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture soek 'n grondwerker om die gronde en tuine by Bayworld Museum in die Eastern Cape te onderhou.
af.requirements: Grade 8-sertifikaat / ABET level 4 of NQF level 1 – 3 sonder enige ervaring. Die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: ervaring in tuinmaak, grondonderhoud of algemene assistentpligte en blootstelling in die veld. Moet kan lees en skryf. Goeie interpersoonlike, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Selfgemotiveerd.
af.duties: Onderhou grasperke, blombeddings, bome en voetpad rondom die museum. Besproei plante, verwyder onkruid, snoei struike en bome, maai gras en vee buite areas skoon. Herplaas plante en bome, verwyder tuinafval en help met die versorging en plaagbeheer van die broodboom-versameling. Maak geplaveide oppervlakke skoon met behulp van hoëdruktoerusting. Hou naamborde, banke, asblikke, stoorkamers en openbare ruimtes netjies en presentabel. Versorg tuinmaakgereedskap en toerusting; ontdek en rapporteer wanfungerende gereedskap of onderhoudsprobleme soos lekke of gebreekte ligte. Help met die verskuif en opstel van uitstallingsmateriaal, vertoonkaste, meubels en vertoonkas. Help met die bou, montering en onderhoud van museumuitstallings en uitstallingsstrukture onder toesig. Verskaf skoonmaakdienste in uitstallingsale, werkswinkels en stoorareas. Stel stoele, tafels en toerusting op vir skoolbesoeke, praatjies en gemeenskapsgeleenthede. Help met voorbereiding en skoonmaak van die perseel voor en na funksies. Ondersteun oppassers en skoonmakers soos benodig. Voer enige ander pligte verbonde aan grond- en fasiliteitonderhoud of algemene assistentwerk uit soos deur die toesighouer opgedra.

zu.title: Umogululi wemisebenzi yaphandle
zu.summary: I-Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts and Culture ifuna umogululi wemisebenzi yaphandle okugcina indawo yaphandle namagadi e-Bayworld Museum Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 8 / i-ABET level 4 noma i-NQF leve1 – 3 ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Okokulandelayo kuzoba nomusa ohlukile: ukuhlolwa emagadeni, ukugcinwa kwendawo yaphandle noma imisebenzi yosizo evamile & ukuvuleleka emkhakheni. Kumele ukwazi ukufunda nokuqamba. Amakhono ahle wokuzwana nabantu, okuthunyelwe ngomlomo nokuqamba. Ukwazijabulisa.
zu.duties: Gcina insimu, amabhuloshi ezimbali, izihlahla noma izindlela ezingommbetha imnyuziyamu. Amanza izitshalo, susa udoti ezindlebeni, qhaqha izihlahla ezincane noma ezinkulu, qhwaba insimu, futhi qhaqha izindawo ezingaphandle. Hambisa izitshalo noma izihlahla, susa udoti lwesimo, futhi usize ekugcineni nasekulawuleni izinambuzane zohlu lwamacash. Cwasha izindawo ezibhentshe ngesisetshenzwa esinamandla amakhulu. Gcina izibonakaliso, amasodo, iziqu, izindlu zokulondolozwa, futhi zigcine zihle noma zibukeka kahle. Gcina izinsimbi zokugcinwa kwesimo; phawula futhi wenze umbiko wokusuke kwenzeke izinsimbi noma izinkinga ezifana nokugqamala noma izibani ephukile. Siza ekushaniseni ukulungiselela izibonakaliso zommbetha, iziqu, noma izinkomba. Siza ngokwakha, ukuhlanganisa, kanye nokugcina izibonakaliso zommbetha noma izakhiwo zezinkomba ebusoswayeni. Hlinzeka ngokucwasha izindawo zokubukela, izindlu zokusebenza, kanye nezindawo zokulondolozwa. Lungelelanisa amasodo, amatafule, noma izinsimba zokuvakasha kwamaskolo, inkulumo, noma zemikhakha. Siza ekulungiseleleni nasekuhlanzweni izikhungo ngaphambi nangemva kwezinkomba. Siza abagcini nabacwashi njengoba kudingeka. Yenza noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi ongaphandle kwalowo okhombiswa umbusi.

xh.title: Umgcini wemihlaba
xh.summary: Isebe loMzila, iMpumaliko, uBugcisa n'eNtetho lifuna umgcini wemihlaba ukuba agcine umhlaba neendawo ezihlatshelelwyo eBayworld Museum eEastern Cape.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi yebanga leGrade 8 / ABET level 4 okanye NQF leve1 – 3 ngaphandle kokulinganisela. Oku kulandelayo kuya kuba lusizo: amava ekulimeni, ukugcinwa kwemihlaba okanye imisebenzi yomncedisi jikelele nokuvezwa kwendawo. Kufuneka ukuba akwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Amakhono amahle aphilisanayo, okuthetha nokubhala. Uzigqatseloyo.
xh.duties: Gcina amasimi amabalwa, iilamuni zeentyatyambo, amathambo neendwendwela ezikumngcipheko wemnyuziyam. Khupha izityalo, susa tshe ithontsi, qhwala iincomo namathambo, sitsha inqwala, kwaye cofa iindawo zangaphandle. Tshintsha izityalo namathambo, susa inkqubela yolimo, kwaye ncedise ekunakekelweni nolawulweni lwezilwanyana ezitshayizayo kwibala leecyad. Coca iindawo ezidweliswe ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezinobovu obunamandla. Gcina iimpawu, iibhenji, iziqwenga-zezipha, iindawo zokugcina, nendawo zomphakathi zicoce zibonakale kakuhle. Qhelisa izixhobo zokulima; fumana ukuze uchaze izixhobo ezingasebenziyo okanye iingxaki zokugcina ezinjengokujonga okanye izikhanyezo ezingasebenziyo. Ncedisa ekushyutsheni nasekulungiseni izinto zokubonakalisa, iikheysi zokubonisa, ifanitsha, nendwendwela zokubonisa. Nceda ngokwakhiwa, ukuhlanganiswa, nakugciniwa kwezinto ezibonakaliswa kwimnyuziyam nemiqathango yokubonakalisa ngaphantsi kolawulo. Nikezela ngenkonzo yokucofa kwiigumbi zokubonakalisa, iindawo zokusebenzela, nendawo zokugcina. Lungiselela iisihlalo, iitafile, nezixhobo iindwendwela zesikolo, iinkcukacha, nemicimbo yomphakathi. Ncedisa ekulungiseleleni nasekucozeni indawo ngaphambi nangemva kwemicimbo. Xhasa abanakekeli nabanocadi njengoko kufuneka. Yenza nayiphi na enye imisebenzi enxulumene nokugcinwa kwemihlaba neendawo okanye umsebenzi jikelele womncedisi njengoko axialiwe ngumlawuli.

af.summary: Skoonmakerpos by Bayworld Museum in die Eastern Cape wat Graad 8 of ABET Level 4 vereis, met skoonmaakervaring 'n bykomende voordeel.
af.requirements: Graad 8-sertifikaat of ABET level 4 of NQF leve1 - 3 sonder ervaring. Een (1) jaar ervaring as 'n skoonmaker sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Selfgemotiveerd. Blootstelling op die gebied sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaffing van skoonmaakdienste. Skoonmaak van kantore, gange, hyserkuile en raadsale deur: Afstof en was van kantoorameublement. Vee, skrop en was van vloere. Stofsuig en sjampoe van vloere. Skoonmaak van mure, vensters en deure. Ledig en skoonmaak van vullisblikke. Versamel en verwyder van papiervullis. Verfris die kantoorareas. Skoonmaak van algemene kombuise deur: Skoonmaak van blikke. Was en voorraad hou van kombuisgereedskap. Skoonmaak van rusruimtes deur: Byvul van handwasvloeibare seep. Vervang toilettoilet, handhanddoeke en verfrisders. Ledig en was van vullisblikke. Hou en onderhou skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting. Rapporteer gebreekte skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting. Skoonmaak van masjiene (mikrogolfoonde, stofsuiers ens.) en toerusting na gebruik

zu.title: Ukuhlanzwa
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuhihlanza esikhungweni semnyuziyamu i-Bayworld e-Eastern Cape esidinga i-Grade 8 noma i-ABET Level 4, okuhlaziya njengensengo eyongezelelweyo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 8 noma i-ABET level 4 noma i-NQF leve1 - 3 ngaphandle kokuhlaziya. Unyaka (1) wokuhlaziya njengomhihiya uzakuba nsengo eyongezelelweyo. Amakhono amnandi ahlobene nabantu. Amakhono amnandi okuthetha. Zimotivahirwe ngokwakho. Intshona ehlobene nendawo izakuba nsengo eyongezelelweyo.
zu.duties: Ukunikezelwa kwezinkonzo zokuhlaziya. Ukuhlaziya amahholo, iindholorho, iilevetha, namagumbi okubhalisana ngolu hlobo: Ukwenza umthwalo wamafenitsha ehholo. Ukuthathela phantsi, ukucoca, nokuthumba iindonga. Ukuvacuum nokushampoo iindonga. Ukuhlaziya iindonga, iifestre, namacango. Ukuzala nokuhlaziya iibhini zthina. Ukuthatha nokususa amaphepha athathwayo. Ukuvusa amahholo. Ukuhlaziya iikhichinthi ngolu hlobo: Ukuhlaziya iibhini. Ukuhlamba nokugcina isitokhwe sezixhobo zekhichinthi. Ukuhlaziya iindonga zokuphumla ngolu hlobo: Ukuzalisela usiba oluthengiswa izandla. Ukutshintsha amaphepha ethoyilethi, amathawuli ezandla, nezinto zokuvuselela. Ukuzala nokuhlamba iibhini zthina. Ukugcina nokulungisa izinto nezixhobo zokuhlaziya. Ukuxela ngezinto nezixhobo zokuhlaziya eziqhawukiweyo. Ukuhlaziya iimasina (iimakroweyifu, abavacuumi, njl) nezixhobo emva kokusebenzisa

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Isithuba somcoci kwiBayworld Museum eEastern Cape esifuna iGrade 8 okanye iABET Level 4, nolwazi lokucoca luya kuba yinlawulo engezelayo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 8 okanye iABET level 4 okanye iNQF level 1 - 3 ngaphandle kolwazi. Unyaka omnye (1) wolwazi njengomcoci uya kuba yinlawulo engezelayo. Amakhono amabal asebenzisanwe nabantu. Amakhono amabal okunxibelelana ngokuthetha. Ukuzinikela ngokuzenzela. Ukuba nolwazi kule ndawo kuya kuba yinlawulo engezelayo.
xh.duties: Ukuhlinzekwa kweenkonzo zokucoca. Ukucoca iiofisi, iindorho, iilevatha, namagumbi ngok: Ukwenza idasti nokufaka i-wax kofudulelo lweofisi. Ukucoca ngokubumba, ukurhamba, nokufaka i-wax kumaza. Ukusebenzisa i-vacuum nokushampo amaza. Ukucoca iindonga, iifestile, neenyuzi. Ukushenxa kwaye kucocwe iibhini ezityhonjwayo. Ukuqokelela nokususa amaphepha amatyila. Ukuvuza iindawo zeofisi. Ukucoca iikhitshi jikelele ngok: Ukucoca iibhini. Ukuhlamba kwaye kugcinwe isitokhwe sezixhobo zekhitshi. Ukucoca iindawo zokuhlambela ngok: Ukuzalisela kwakhona isephu yokuza isandla. Ukutshintshela amaphepha e toilet, amatowel okuza isandla, nezinto zokuvuza. Ukushenxa kwaye kuhambe iibhini zetyila. Ukugcina kwaye kuphathwe kakuhle izinto nezixhobo zokucoca. Ukubika ngezinto nezixhobo zokucoca ezinqamlezileyo. Ukucoca iimachine (i-microwave, ii-vacuum cleaner njl) nezixhobo emva kokuzisebenzisa.

jobs.title: Intern: Cultural Affairs (ARTS & Culture)
jobs.summary: Internship in Cultural Affairs supporting arts and culture project monitoring, event coordination and report compilation in Maletswai, Eastern Cape.
jobs.requirements: National Senior Certificate/Matric Certificate/Grade 12 with a three-year degree/National Diploma (NQF 6) as recognized by SAQA in Arts and Culture Studies// Arts Management/ Fine Arts/ Performing Arts. Bachelor of Arts /Social Science majoring in one of the following or related fields Music, Dance & Drama, Visual Arts, Film. majoring in one other following or related fields: Langue, Music, Dance, Speech & drama, Visual Arts, Film or any relevant field of study. Previous experience in arts administration, event planning, or related fields. Knowledge of arts and culture structures and funding institutions. Strong interest in arts, culture, and community engagement. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Creativity and willingness to contribute ideas. Be a South African citizen. Must have no criminal record. Applicants must be unemployed and never participated in an internship programme previously.
jobs.duties: Assist in the development of concept documents. Assist in the development of budget and Implementation of Operational Plan. Assist with Monitoring of Arts and Culture funded Projects. Compile project reports. Assist with planning and coordination of arts and culture events, exhibitions or festivals. Compile monthly reports for the section. Implement outreach programmes. Assist with procurement in the section. Assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, drafting correspondence, maintaining database, organize meeting and minutes taking. Engage with artists, performers, and community partners as needed.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. L Putter Tel No: (040) 608 4200 For e-Recruitment Enquiries, Email: erecruitment@ecdoe.gov.za
jobs.notes: The Department of Sport, Recreation, Arts & Culture is offering an internship programme. The programme will be for a non-renewable period of 24 months. Unemployed Graduates are invited to apply and be in possession of the National Diploma / Degree as indicated in the requirements below. Applicants who previously underwent or are currently on an internship programme will not be considered. The objective of the Internship program within the public service, is to address the problem of youth unemployment, especially tertiary (university and Technikon) graduates by providing them with work experience opportunities in the public service. As per the Directive issued by DPSA on the employment of persons to developmental programmes in the public service: Internship, Learnership, Apprenticeship, Graduate recruitment schemes and related programmes, this Internship programme is specifically aimed at the following: Interns need to be graduates and unemployed. Interns need to be within their specific demographic area. The internship should not exceed a period of 24 months, meaning candidates cannot enter an internship program more than once. During the tenure of the contract, the youth will receive continuous learning and development interventions to improve their skills through on-the-job training initiatives for optimal performance and to equip them for future employment. OTHER POST

af.title: Intern: Kulturele Sake (Kuns & Kultuur)
af.summary: Internskap in Kulturele Sake wat die monitering van kuns- en kultuurprojekte, gebeurteniskoördinering en die opstel van verslae in Maletswai, Eastern Cape, ondersteun.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/Matrieksertifikaat/Graad 12 met 'n driejarige graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) soos deur SAQA erken in Kuns- en Kultuurstudies// Kunsbestuur/ Beeldende Kuns/ Uitvoerende Kuns. Baccalaureus Artium/Sosiale Wetenskappe met as hoofvak een van die volgende of verwante velde: Musiek, Dans & Drama, Visuele Kuns, Film. met as hoofvak een van die volgende of verwante velde: Taal, Musiek, Dans, Spraak & drama, Visuele Kuns, Film of enige relevante studieveld. Vorige ervaring in kunsadministrasie, gebeurtenisbeplanning of verwante velde. Kennis van kuns- en kultuurstrukture en befondsingsinstansies. Sterk belangstelling in kuns, kultuur en gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid. Uitstekende skriftelike en verbale kommunikasievaardighede. Organisasievaardighede en aandag aan detail. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Kreatiwiteit en bereidwilligheid om idees by te dra. Wees 'n Suid-Afrikaanse burger. Mag geen strafregister hê nie. Aansoekers moet werkloos wees en voorheen nie aan 'n internskapprogramma deelgeneem het nie.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van konsepdokumente. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van begroting en die implementering van die Operasionele Plan. Bystand verleen met die monitering van befondsde Kuns- en Kultuurprojekte. Stel projekverslae op. Bystand verleen met beplanning en koördinering van kuns- en kultuurgebeurtenisse, uitstallings of feeste. Stel maandlikse verslae vir die afdeling op. Implementeer uitreikprogramme. Bystand verleen met verkryging in die afdeling. Bystand verleen met administratiewe take soos skedulering, opstel van korrespondensie, onderhoud van databasis, reël van vergaderings en neem van notules. Skakel soos nodig met kunstenaars, kunstenaars en gemeenskapsvennote.

zu.title: Umntwana osiza emsebenzini: Izindaba Zamasiko (IZIBHEBO & Inhlalo)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosizo kulezi Zincwadi Zamasiko sokusekela ukulawula imiklamo yezibhebho nenhlonipho yamasiko, ukuhlanganisa izinkundla kanye neqoqo lemibhalo yemibiko kumasikhundla iMaletswai, Eastern Cape.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatikuletsheni SaseNingizimu Afrika/Isitifikedi seMatric/Isigaba se-12 esinodigri yeminyaka emithathu/Isitifikedi seNationally Diploma (NQF 6) esamukelekwa yi-SAQA kwezifundo ze-Arts and Culture Studies// Arts Management/ Fine Arts/ Performing Arts. I-Bachelor of Arts/ISayensi Yomphakathi ngesigaba esikhulu kunyinye yalaba noma kumaphuza ahlobene i-Music, Dance & Drama, Visual Arts, Film. ngesigaba esikhulu komunye walaba noma kumaphuza ahlobene: Langue, Music, Dance, Speech & drama, Visual Arts, Film noma nayiphi indawo enembile yezifundo. Isipiliyoni esedlule ekuphatweni kwezibhebho, ekwelweni izinkundla, noma kumaphuza ahlobene. Ulwazi ngemiba yezibhebho nenhlonipho yamasiko nemikhakha exhaswa ngemali. Isikhuthazo esikhulu kuzibhebho, emasikweni, nasekuxhumeni nomphakathi. Amakhono aphumelelayo okubhala nokuthetha. Amakhono okuhlela izinto nokunaka imininingwane. Isakhono sokusebenza wedwa nakuhlangene nabanye. Ubuciko nesithakazelo sokuletha imibono. Ukuba ngumakade asuka eNingizimu Afrika. Kufanele ungenadohleko noma owayengeyenalwesolo. Abafakwa bamephondo kufanele bengenamsebenzi futhi bengazange bathathe inxaxheba esandulela leso esandulela ekusizeni emsebenzini.
zu.duties: Siza ekubunjweni kwemibhalo yemiklamo. Siza ekubunjweni kwesabelo malu kanye nokuphumeleliseni isu sokwenzwayo. Siza ukulawula imiklamo ye-Arts and Culture exhaswa ngemali. Hlanganisa imibiko yemiklamo. Siza ekwelweni nokuqoqweni kwezinkundla ze-Arts and Culture, imibhalo noma imimongamiso. Hlanganisa imibiko yenyanga ngayonyanga yesigaba. Pumelelisa imiklamo yokwaziswa komphakathi. Siza ngokuthenga izimpahla kulesigaba. Siza emsebenzini wolawulo njengokulunga isikhathi, ukubhala imibhalo yokuxhumana, ukulondolozwa kwesiphakamiso, ukuhlanganisa izingqungquthela nokubhala izinkumbulo. Zibandakanye nabakhiyiwe, nabadlali, nabahlanganyelo bomphakathi njengoba kudingeka.

Isatifikedi seNqanaba lesi-6 leSizwe kwisifundo esibuyekeziweyo ukuba singunobumba ekulawuleni amaphupha kunye noBugcisa esihloniphekileyo esinamagunya asebenzayo emisebenzi ejolise ekulawuleni amaphupha nokuziqhelanisa neengqondo ezahlukeneyo ezenza umsebenzi osisigxina ekubeni kwabo ikhaya labo basebenza ngokutsha kumgangatho osisigxina efanelekileyo kwindawo ebaluleke kakhulu ikakhulu ngokutsha kwezinto ezingundoqo kwiNdzamiswano yakuqeqesha. Isatifikedi seNqanaba lesi-6 leSizwe esinamagunya ahambelana nokuqonda konke na okutsha kwindawo ekulawulwa amaphupha nobugcisa esinamagunya ahambelana nokuqonda konke na okutsha kwindawo ekujoliswe kuyo abantu abanamagunya ahambelana nale ndawo. Nceda nokuba nendima ekulawulweni kwamaphupha nobugcisa afake imali yomsebenzi. Qokelela amaphepha echaza imisebenzi. Nceda nokuba nendima kumsebenzi wolawulo njengokumisela iinkqubo, ukubhala iincwadi, ukugcina ulwazi malunga nabantu, ukuqamba ukutsha kwemihlangano nokubhala iincwadi ezichaza iingxoxo ezithintelwe kumhlangano. Yiba nongxoxo nabadosiwe, nabadlali nabalinganisi bemisebenzi yorhambo nangabashareki bentsapho njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE)
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport
jobs.centre: Free State Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport: Head Office (Bloemfontein)
jobs.salary_text: Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE) sitting (including preparation): The Members will be paid sitting allowances per sitting of the PRE. The Members will be paid an allowance per ad-hoc meeting as determined by the MEC. The Members will be paid subsistence and travelling allowances when attending PRE activities and meetings. The Members will be appointed in terms of the National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023.
jobs.summary: The Free State Department of Community Safety seeks members for the Provincial Regulatory Entity to adjudicate and advise on public transport applications.
jobs.requirements: Candidates must have at least ten (10) years’ relevant experience in both the Public and Private Sector and any postgraduate degree or equivalent qualification in Finance, Transport Logistics or Transport Economics or Transport Management (Specialisation in Public Transport). Knowledge of the National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023. Technical knowledge of the prescripts, regulations, and frameworks governing the Department's mandate and the National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023. Competencies: Strong leadership, analytical thinking, good communication skills, ability to inspire confidence and maintain a balanced view, ability to maintain independence and objectivity, facilitation skills, courage to stimulate discussions and ask relevant questions, willingness to dedicate time to serve the interest of the public, encourage openness and transparency, professional approach, high level of integrity, independent judgement, knowledge of the public sector risk and control, and ability to offer new perspective, ability to promote effective working relationships. Be persons of integrity, independence and sound judgement.
jobs.duties: As an Advisory Committee/entity to the Accounting Officer and MEC as required in terms of the requirements of the National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023, the Provincial Regulatory Entity will: Adjudicate, oversee, advise and decide on the applications received regarding public transport operating licenses (renewals, transfers and amendments). Advise on issues relating to the public transport services in the province, thus ensuring compliance with the operating license conditions. Monitor and regulate public transport operations and route management within the Free State province. Assist in ensuring the transformation of the public transport sector, particularly in the taxi industry and the implementation of public policies and strategies relating to the National Land Transport Amendment Act. Advise when there are disputes in the transport sector and ensure that they are resolved. Improve efficiency in the Operator License Administration System (OLAS) and reduce backlogs of pending taxi applications. Improve service delivery on its core mandate of ensuring road safety, regulated public transport and an integrated transport system and network. Provision of sustainable community safety through its monitoring and assessment activities of all public transport modes within the Free State. Ensuring that the demands of public transport motor vehicles for required services in terms of the NLTA is compliant within the province are met efficiently, economically and effectively.
jobs.enquiries: Acting Deputy Director: Transport Registrar: Mr T.K.Z Ntai- Contact number: 0820599707
jobs.applications: Applications, quoting the relevant reference number, should be hand-delivered or emailed as follows: No 45 Charlotte Maxeke Street, Perm Building, Bloemfontein. Applications that are hand-delivered must be brought to the Perm Building where they must be placed in the appropriately marked box on the Security Ground floor. Applications may also be e-mailed for the attention of Mr T.K.Z Ntai (PRE@freetrans.gov.za). Contact details of Mr T.K.Z Ntai (082) 059 9707 FOR ATTENTION : Mr T.K.Z Ntai (Acting Deputy Director: Transport Registrar)
jobs.notes: The Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE) is an independent regulatory body responsible for considering and adjudicating applications for operating licenses and performing regulatory functions assigned in terms of the National Land Transport Amendment Act, No. 23 of 2023. The Member of the Executive Council (MEC) calls for the appointment of Two (2) candidates to serve as members of the Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE) Committee of the Department of Community Safety, Roads and Transport (CSRT). The Member of the Executive Council (MEC) for Community Safety, Roads and Transport in the Free State Province further invites suitably qualified, experienced and competent persons for appointment as Members of the Free State Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE) in terms of the National Land Transport Amendment Act, No. 23 of 2023. A person may not be appointed if he or she has been convicted of an offence involving fraud, corruption or dishonesty, has been declared insolvent and has not been rehabilitated, has been removed from an office of trust, has a direct financial interest in any public transport operation that may create a conflict of interest, and is unable to perform the functions of the office independently and impartially. Applications must be accompanied by a comprehensive curriculum vitae accurately detailing the qualifications, certified copies of academic qualifications, professional membership (if applicable), relevant experience and the identity document. Applicants are required not to use the Z83 application form when they apply. Applicants must clearly indicate the reference number in the covering letter of the application. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department. Documents such as qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Qualification certificates must not be copies of certified copies. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are emailed or hand-delivered timeously. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short course/s certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Dual citizenship holders must provide the Police Clearance certificate from their country of origin when shortlisted. All non-SA Citizens will be required to submit a copy of proof of South African permanent residence when shortlisted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel/verification suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please consider your application as unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointments. Applicants who do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. The Department does not accept applications via fax. OTHER POST

af.title: Provinciale Reguleringsentiteit (PRE)
af.summary: Die Free State Department of Community Safety soek lede vir die Provinciale Reguleringsentiteit om openbare vervoertoepassings te beoordeel en advies daaroor te lewer.
af.requirements: Kandidate moet oor ten minste tien (10) jaar se relevante ervaring in beide die openbare en privaatsektor beskik asook 'n nagraadse graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Finansies, Vervoerlogistiek of Vervoerekonomie of Vervoerbestuur (Spesialisasie in Openbare Vervoer). Kennis van die National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023. Tegniese kennis van die voorskrifte, regulasies en raamwerke wat die mandaat van die departement en die National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023 reël. Bevoegdhede: Sterk leierskap, analitiese denke, goeie kommunikasievaardighede, vermoë om vertroue in te boesem en 'n gebalanseerde siening te handhaaf, vermoë om onafhanklikheid en objektiwiteit te handhaaf, fasilitasievaardighede, moed om bespreking te stimuleer en tersaaklike vrae te stel, bereidwilligheid om tyd te wy aan die diens van die publieke belang, openheid en deursigtigheid aanmoedig, professionele benadering, hoë vlak van integriteit, onafhanklike oordeel, kennis van openbare sektor risiko en beheer, en vermoë om 'n nuwe perspektief te bied, vermoë om effektiewe werksverhoudinge te bevorder. Wees persone van integriteit, onafhanklikheid en goeie oordeel.
af.duties: As 'n Adviserende Komitee/entiteit vir die Rekenaaramptenaar en MEC soos vereis ingevolge die vereistes van die National Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023, sal die Provinciale Reguleringsentiteit: Beslis, toesig hou, adviseer en besluite neem oor die toepassings wat ontvang is ten opsigte van openbare vervoerbedryfslisensies (vernuwings, oordragte en wysigings). Adviseer oor kwessies wat verband hou met die openbare vervoerdienste in die provinsie, om sodoende nakoming van die bedryfslisensievoorwaardes te verseker. Monitor en reguleer openbare vervoerbedrywighede en roetebestuur binne die Free State provinsie. Bystand verleen om die transformasie van die openbare vervoersektor te verseker, veral in die taxybedryf en die implementering van openbare beleide en strategieë wat verband hou met die National Land Transport Amendment Act. Adviseer wanneer daar geskille in die vervoersektor is en verseker dat hul opgelos word. Doeltreffendheid in die Operator License Administration System (OLAS) verbeter en agterstande van hangende taxy-toepassings verminder. Dienslewering verbeter op sy kernmandaat om padveiligheid, gereguleerde openbare vervoer en 'n geïntegreerde vervoerstelsel en -netwerk te verseker. Verskaffing van volhoubare gemeenskapsveiligheid deur sy monitering en assesseringsaktiwiteite van alle openbare vervoerwyses binne die Free State. Verseker dat die aanvrae van openbare vervoermotorkoeruie vir vereiste dienste ingevolge die NLTA doeltreffend, ekonomies en effektief nagekom word binne die provinsie.

zu.title: Isikhungo Sokulawula Esifundazweni (PRE)
zu.summary: UMnyango weZokuphepha Kwezomphakathi waKwaZulu-Natal ufuna amalunga aso esikhungweni sokulawula esifundazweni ukuze athathe izinqumo futhi anikeze izeluleko mayelana nezicelo zokuhamba komphakathi.
zu.requirements: Abaphumeleliwo kumele babe namava okungenani amashumi ayishumi (10) okuhambisana nendawo yomsebenzi kokubili emkhakheni womphakathi nowangasese nakunoma yiphi iphuzu lamaphuzu noma izifundo ezingalinganiselwa kwezomnotho, ukuphathwa kwezohamba noma ibizo lezohamba noma ukuphathwa kwezohamba (ukugqamisa kwezokuhamba komphakathi). Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuqediswa kwezohamba zezwe i-Act No 23 of 2023. Ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe mayelana nemiyalo yomthetho, izimiso, namaphakethe a lawula umsebenzi womnyango kanye noMthetho wokuqediswa kwezohamba zezwe i-Act No 23 of 2023. Izakhono: Ubuhlakani bokuhola abantu, ukucabanga ngezinhlangothi zonke, amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ikhono lokwakha ukweseka nokugcina umbono olinganiselayo, ikhono lokulondoloza ukuzimela nokubuka izinto ngendlela ezingathathi hlangothi, amakhono okukhuthaza ingxoxo, isibindi sokubangela izinkulumo futhi ubuze imibuzo ehambisana nendaba, ukuzithoba ngokuhlinzeka isikhathi ngokwenzela izinto ezihambisana nezinkomishi zobantu ukuthuthukisa ukuvuleka nokungabihlangothi, ukuphathwa ngendlela eqotho, izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kahle, izinqumo eziyingcosana yomuntu, ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezingozi kwezomphakathi, nokulawula, futhi ikhono lokuletha umbono omusha, ikhono lokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza. Kumele kube ngabantu abakhulelekile, abazimele futhi abanamazwela aqotho.
zu.duties: Njengoba komkhulu wezokweluleka/isikhungo kunoNobhalo wezimali no-MEC njengoba kudingwa ngemithethonqubo yeNational Land Transport Amendment Act No 23 of 2023, isikhungo esifundazweni sokulawula sizothi: Thatha izinqumo, qaphela, nikeza izeluleko futhi qumba ngezicelo ezitholiwe ngohambo lwamalayisense okusebenza ohambweni lwabantu olomphakathi (ukubuyekeza, ukudlulisa, kanye nokushintsha). Nikeza izeluleko ngezinkomba ezihlobene nezinsiza zezokuhamba zomphakathi esifundazweni, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela izimo zamalayisense okusebenza. Qaphela futhi ulawule izinhlelo zezokuhamba komphakathi kanye nokuphathwa kwamaselula esifundeni iKwaZulu-Natal. Siza ekwenza kube nenzuko ukushintsha komkhakha wezokuhamba komphakathi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezitha futhi ekusebenzeni kwezinqubomgombe ezomphakathi namasu ahlobene noMthetho wokuqediswa kwezohamba zezwe. Nikela izeluleko kuba khona izinkingi emkhakheni wezokuhamba futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ziphathwa kahle ngokuphumelela. Hlube ukusebenza kahle kohlelo lokuphathwa kwamalayisense abasebenzayo (OLAS) futhi unciphise isibopho sezicelo ezinqamule zemitha. Thuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza ngesabelo sendalo sa kona esiyisisekelo sokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezindlela, ukulawulwa kwezokuhamba komphakathi kanye nezohamba ezihlangene nemibhobho. Hlinzeka ngokuphepha kwezomphakathi okuzinzile ngokusebenza kwayo kokubuka nokuhlaziya zonke izinhlobo zezokuhamba zomphakathi esifundeni iKwaZulu-Natal. Qinisekisa ukuthi izidingo zezimoto zezokuhamba zomphakathi ngezinsiza ezingadingwa ngokomthetho i-NLTA zihambisana yonke imikhakha esifundazweni kutholakale ngokuphumelela, kwezomnotho futhi ngempumelelo.

xh.title: Isebe leLawulo loMmandla (PRE)
xh.summary: Isebe loKhuseleko lweZindlu e Free State lifuna amalungu kuSebe leLawulo loMmandla ukuze alahlule nale ngcekezo kumagama esikhululo sabantu.
xh.requirements: Abafaki-macala kufuneka babe nenkululeko yeminyaka elishumi (10) egqithisileyo esikwalini kwindawo yangasese naseyabucala bagqithwe kuyo nakuphi na izidanga eziphezulu okanye isidanga esilingana neso kwimali, ukurhweba ngokuthunyelwa kwebhodi okanye kumzinbiso wokuthutha izinto okanye kulawulo lokuthutha izinto (ukuzinza ekuthuthweni kwabantu). Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLungiso lweZwe loKuthutha iziXhobo unani 23 ka 2023. Ulwazi lobugcisa ngeemithetho, iimiso, namakhephu ahola ilizwe le-Department kunye noMthetho woLungiso lweZwe loKuthutha iziXhobo unani 23 ka 2023. Iimpawu: Inqeqho eqinisekileyo, okuqamba iingcinga, amandla okunxibelelana amagama, amandla okunika ithemba nokugcina imbonakalo equlekileyo, amandla okuzimela nokungabikhethi, amandla okuncedisa, isibindi sokubakha iingxoxo nokubuza imibuzo ephathwe ngayo, inkathalo yokuzinikela ixesha ukukhonza izinto zabantu, ukhuthazo lokuvuleka nangabunye, indlela esemthethweni, inqanaba eliphezulu lokuzithoba, isigqibo ezimeleyo, ulwazi lwengcinezelo nokulawula kwindawo yangasese, kunye namandla okunikela ingqiqo entsha, amandla okukhuthaza ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obuhle. Kufuneka babe ngabantu abathembekayo, abazimeleyo, abanesigqibo esilungileyo.
xh.duties: NjengokoBume obuNika isiGqibo kuMntu oPhethe iimali nakwi-MEC njengoko kufuneka ngokweemfuno zoMthetho woLungiso lweZwe loKuthutha iziXhobo unani 23 ka 2023, iSebe leLawulo loMmandla liza ku: Lahlula, luhlalele ngaphezulu, linike ingcebiso aligqibe ngamagama afunyenwe malunga namalayisense okusebenza okwaziwa ngokuba yi-public transport operating licenses (ukuzaliswa kwentlandlwane, ukudluliswa, nokulungiswa). Linike ingcebiso kumacala axhelene nesebe lemphakamo esikwazi ngokuba yi-public transport kule ndawo, ngokwenza isigqibo sokuzaliseka kwemimiselo yamalayisense wokusebenza. Lilole ilize lale izinto eziliqondo kwakho, lize lilawule ukuthutha iziXhobo nokulawula iindlela e Free State. Lincedise ngokwenza isigqibo sokutsha kwendawo yalo yonke i-public transport, ikakhulu kumlinganiselo wamatheksi, nakuphuhlisweni koMthetho wezeLuntu namacebo axhelene noMthetho woLungiso lweZwe loKuthutha iziXhobo. Linike ingcebiso xa kunokubakho izimbalwa ngokubana ukuthutha izinto, ukuze sigqitywe. Phucula isiseko seNkqubo yoLawulo lwaMalelayisense wokuSebenza (OLAS)uncede litsale imva isahlukelo samagama ebekiweyo amatheksi. Phucula ukuphuhliswa kweenkonzo kwinkamiso yaso ezingqongqo, ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko lwezithutha, ukulawulwa kwabantu, nendlela ebandakanyeneyo yokuthutha iziXhobo nethumbo eliya kuyo. Ukunika ukhuseleko ngokungapheliyo kumaphakathi ngokulola nokulinganisa okwenziwa ngayo zonke iindlela zokuthuthwa kwabantu e Free State. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zezithutha zomzila ezenziwa zibe ukhuseleko ngokweziga ezi-Funwa yi-NLTA ngokukululekileyo kwindawo, zithathwa ngokulula nangexabiso eliphantsi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed in Bloemfontein to lead provincial eCares system support, performance management and user adoption for the Free State Department of Education.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a SAQA-recognised three-year post- matric qualification (NQF Level 7) in Education (B.Ed. / PGCE) or a SAQA- recognised three-year post-matric qualification (NQF Level 7) in Information Systems / ICT / Computer Science / Data or related field. 5 years Management Experience. 6-7 Years’ relevant experience in Systems administration and user support; User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and training facilitation. Data reporting and system usage monitoring. Knowledge of: Cloud-based system operations; Provincial EMIS environment and/or ECD system landscape. Strong analytical, data manipulation and reporting skills (Excel advanced level). Ability to coordinate multi-level stakeholders (national, provincial, district). Problem- solving ability, attention to detail, and customer service orientation. Ability to work independently and travel extensively. A valid driver’s license is essential. EMIS experience will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for Provincial eCares System Use & Performance management. Lead provincial support for system usage, performance and adoption; Monitor user compliance with system functionality and data workflows; Advocate system utilisation for decision-making. User Support & Access Management; Manage 1st line helpdesk support for PED users; Manage user access, roles and permissions; Escalate issues promptly to national and service providers. User Training & Capacity Building- Conduct ongoing training on: New releases; Functional improvements; Reporting and dashboards. Support districts and circuits to drive usage. Testing & Implementation-Lead provincial testing of system releases and updates; Develop test plans, record UAT outcomes, submit feedback to developers; Validate system enhancements prior to deployment. Systems Maintenance Support- Work with DBE and vendors (e.g. Mezzanine/Vodacom) to ensure continuity; Identify and resolve technical issues affecting provincial users. Reporting & Master Data Management-Maintain alignment between eCares and EMIS Masterlists; Validate EMIS number allocation in eCares; Support provincial reporting needs and accuracy. Stakeholder Collaboration-Work closely with PED ECD and EMIS Directorates; National EMIS and ECD teams social partners such as Ilifa Labantwana and the Bana Pele Initiative. The candidate will report to the provincial EMIS head and work closely with the ECD Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Randall Pienaar, Acting Director IT and Information systems at 079 503
jobs.applications: For All Posts: https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted using the link provided in the advertisement. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit a detailed Curriculum Vitae (only). Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the day of the interview. Successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks, qualification and employment verification including social media profiles). Appointment is subject to positive results of the security clearance process. The successful candidate will be required to sign an annual performance agreement and, where applicable, annually disclose his/her financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Applicants, who do not comply with the requirements outlined above, will not be considered. People with disabilities, women and youth are encouraged to apply. In line with the Directive on Human Resource Management for Public Servants Professionalisation: Volume 1, all shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POST

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur word in Bloemfontein benodig om provinsiale eCares-stelselondersteuning, prestasiebestuur en gebruikeracceptansie vir die Free State Department of Education te lei.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n deur SAQA erkende driejaar-post-matrikkwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) in Opvoedkunde (B.Ed. / PGCE) of 'n deur SAQA erkende driejaar-post-matrikkwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) in Inligtingstelsels / IK / Rekenaarwetenskap / Data of 'n verwante veld hê. 5 years Management Experience. 6-7 Years' relevant experience in Systems administration and user support; User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and training facilitation. Data reporting and system usage monitoring. Knowledge of: Cloud-based system operations; Provincial EMIS environment and/or ECD system landscape. Strong analytical, data manipulation and reporting skills (Excel advanced level). Ability to coordinate multi-level stakeholders (national, provincial, district). Problem- solving ability, attention to detail, and customer service orientation. Ability to work independently and travel extensively. A valid driver's license is essential. EMIS experience will be an added advantage.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir Provinsiale eCares-stelselgebruik en prestasiebestuur. Lei provinsiale ondersteuning vir stelselgebruik, prestasie en acceptansie; Monitor gebruiker nakoming met stelselfunksionaliteit en data werksvloeie; Beywer stelselbenutting vir besluitneming. Gebruikerondersteuning en toegangsbestuur; Bestuur 1st line helpdeskondersteuning vir PED-gebruikers; Bestuur gebruiker toegang, rolle en toestemming; Eskaleer probleme onmiddellik na nasionale en diensverskaffers. Gebruikeropleiding en kapasiteitsbou- Voer deurlopende opleiding oor: Nuut vrygesteltes; Funksionele verbeteringe; Verslagdoening en paneelborde. Ondersteun distrikte en kringe om gebruik aan te moedig. Toetsing en implementering-Lei provinsiale toetsing van stelselvrystellings en opdaterings; Ontwikkel toetsplanne, registreer UAT-uitkomste, dien terugvoer by ontwikkelaars in; Bekragtig stelselverbeteringe voor ontplooiing. Stelselonderhoudsondersteuning- Werk saam met DBE en verskaffers (bv. Mezzanine/Vodacom) om kontinuïteit te verseker; Identifiseer en los tegniese probleme wat provinsiale gebruikers raak, op. Verslagdoening en master-databestuur- Handhaaf belyning tussen eCares en EMIS Masterlyste; Bekragtig EMIS-nommertoekenning in eCares; Ondersteun provinsiale verslagdoeningsbehoeftes en akkuraatheid. Belanghebbendesamewerking-Werk nou saam met PED ECD- en EMIS-Direktorate; Nasionale EMIS- en ECD-spanne sosiale vennote soos Ilifa Labantwana en die Bana Pele Initiative. Die kandidaat sal aan die provinsiale EMIS-hoof rapporteer en nou saam met die ECD-Direktoraat werk.

zu.title: UmQondisi Ohlanganyele
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMqondisi Ohlanganyele eBloemfontein ukuba aholise ukusekelwa kwesistimu yephrovinsi ye-eCares, ukuphathwa kokusebenza nokamukeleka komsebenzisi kuMnyango wezemfundo weFree State.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi sethuba leziqu leminyaka emithathu emva kwesikole (NQF Level 7) esithunyiwe yi-SAQA kwezemfundo (B.Ed. / PGCE) noma isitifiketi sethuba leziqu leminyaka emithathu emva kwesikole (NQF Level 7) esithunyiwe yi-SAQA kwezinhlelo zolwazi / ICT / Isayensi Yezikhompyutha / Izinhlangothi noma indawo ehlobene lana. 5 years Isipiliyoni Sokuphatha. 6-7 Years' isipiliyoni esihambisana nalokho ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo kanti nokusekelwa komsebenzisi; Ukuhlolwa Kokwamukeleka Komsebenzisi (UAT) kanti nokuqondisa ukulolonga. Ukubika kwemininingwane kanti nokubuka ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu. Ulwazi ngokuhlobene nokuthi: Izindlela zokusebenza zesistimu esebenzisa i-Cloud; Isimo se-EMIS sephrovinsi kanti noma imifanekiso yesistimu ye-ECD. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya, ukulungisa imininingwane kanti nokubika (Excel advanced level). Ikhono lokubumba abahlanganyeli abaningi abasezingeni elihlukene (kazwelonke, ephrovinsi, esifundazwe). Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuqaphela imininingwane, nokugxila ekukhonzeni abakhulumisi. Ikhono lokusebenza wedwa kanti nokuhamba kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela ngokusemthethweni iyadingeka. Isipiliyono se-EMIS kuzoba ngunozuzo.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethiwe uzobe nesibopho sokusetshenziswa kweNkqubo ye-eCares yephrovinsi kanti nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Ukuba ihamba phambili ekusekelweni kwephrovinsi ekusetshenzisweni kwesistimu, ukusebenza nokwamukelwa; Ukugcina ukuzithoba komsebenzisi ngokusebenza kwesistimu kanti nangokuhamba kwemininingwane; Ukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu ekuthatheni izinqumo. Ukusekelwa Komsebenzisi Nokuphathwa Kokungena; Ukuphatha ukusekelwa kwedeski losizo abasebenzisi abangaphakathi be-PED; Ukuphatha ukungena komsebenzisi, amaphuzu namalungelo; Ukushintsha izinkinga ngokushesha kwabakazwelonke kanti nasezinkampanini ezisebenzayo. Ukuqondisa Ukulolonga Nokwakha Ukuzakhona Komsebenzisi- Qhuba ukulolonga okuqhubekayo ngokuthi: Okukhishwe okusha; Izinto ezenziwe zibe namandla; Ukuhlabela izincomo namaphedi. Ukusekelwa amasifundazwe namajikelezo ukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa. Ukuhlolwa Nokuzikweseka- Hamba phambili ekuhlolweni kwephrovinsi kwezinto ezikhishwayo futhi zibuyekezwe; Bole izinhlelo zokuhol, gqamisa imiphumela ye-UAT, faka iziphakemazwe ezithunyelwa kubakhi; Qinisekisa ukwandiswa kwesistimu ngaphambi kokuba kusetshenziswe. Ukusekelwa kokuNgcinwa kweNkqubo- Sebenzisana ne-DBE namadayi (ex. Mezzanine/Vodacom) ukubona ukuthi kuqhubeke; Bona uphinde uxazulule izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezithinta abasebenzisi bephrovinsi. Ukubika kanti nokuphathwa kokuGuqulela Imininingwane eNingi- Gcina ukuhambisana phakathi kwe-eCares nezinhlu ezingavwana ze-EMIS; Qinisekisa ukwabiwa kwenamba ye-EMIS kwe-eCares; Sekela izidingo zokubika zephrovinsi kanti nalokunembile. Ukuxhumana Kwabahlanganyeli-Sebenza eduze nezinhlangamnyama ezingavwana ze-PED ECD kanti ne-EMIS; Amateyimu kazwelonke we-EMIS ne-ECD ahlanganyelana njengalawo nge-Ilifa Labantwana kanti nalohambo lwe-Bana Pele Initiative. Umuntu okhethiwe uzobe ebika kumphathi we-EMIS wesifundazwe futhi alosebenza eduze nenhlangamnyama ye-ECD.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSekela Mongameli eBloemfontein ukuze alulele inkxaso yenkqubo yaseCares yephondo, ulawulo lwesiphumelele nokuamkelwa kumsebenzisi kwisebe lezemfundo lazo Zwe Lase Free State.
xh.requirements: Kumgangathi wemifuno abagqithiswa kufuneka babe nophawu olusetyenziswa yi-SAQA lwesigqeba seminyaka emithathu lokugqitha ibakala (NQF Level 7) kwimfundo (B.Ed. / PGCE) okanye uphawu olusetyenziswa yi-SAQA lwesigqeba seminyaka emithathu lokugqitha ibakala (NQF Level 7) kwindlela yolwazi / ICT / isayensi yekhompyutha / Iingcombolo okanye indawo engummiselwa. 5 years Management Experience. 6-7 Years’ relevant experience in Systems administration and user support; User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and training facilitation. Iingxelo zedata nokuqaphela ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo. Ulwazi nge: Ukusebenza kwenkqubo esekwe kwi-cloud; Imo ye-EMIS yephondo nakho nokuba yimozulu yenkqubo ye-ECD. Amandla alokucoca ulwazi, ukulawula idata nokwenza iingxelo (Excel advanced level). Amandla okuhambelanisa nabathinti abanamakhulu ahlukeneyo (kwelizwe, kwiphondo, kwisithili). Amandla okuxazulula iingxaki, kuqatshelwe iinkcukacha, kwaye ubhekisele kakhulu kwinkonzo yabathengi. Amandla okusebenza wedwa nakuhamba kakhulu. Ilayiseni yomqhubi esemthethweni iyimfuno. Ulwazi kwi-EMIS kuya kuba ngaphezulu.
xh.duties: Umama ophumeleleyo uya kuba nawe mandla okulawula ukusetyenziswa kweNkqubo yaseCares yephondo nokulawula isiphumezele. Ukulawula inkxazo yephondo mayela nokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo, isiphumezele nokuamkelwa; Ukuqaphela ukuthobela kwabasebenzisi ngokwemisebenzi yenkqubo nokuqhubekeka kwedata; Ukukhusela ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ekuwenzeni izigqibo. Inkxaso kumsebenzisi & Ulawulo loFikelelo; Ulawula inkxazo yedeski yosizo yokuqala yabasebenzisi basePED; Ulawula ukufikelela komsebenzisi, iindima namagunya; Ukuphakamisa iingxaku ngokukhawuleza kwelizwe nakubahanjisi benkonzo. Uqeqesho & Ukwakha Amandla; Ukuqeqesha ngokuya qho nge: Iintlobo ezintsha; Iziphuculo ezisebenzayo; Iingxelo namapaneli eengxelo. Inkxazo kwisithili nakumjikelo wokuqhubela phambili ukusetyenziswa. Uvavvo & Ukusebenzisa-Ukulawula uvavvo lwephondo lweentlobo zenkqubo nezihlaziyo; Ukwakha iindlela zovavvo, uqophe iziphumo ze-UAT, uze unike ulwazi kubaphuculi benkqubo; Uqinisekise iziphuculo zienkqubo phambi kokuzisebenzisa. Inkxazo yokuGcina Inkqubo-Sebenzana ne-DBE nabanikezeli (umz. Mezzanine/Vodacom) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuya phambili; Qaphela uze uxazule iingxaki ezithinta abasebenzisi baphondo. Iingxelo & Ulawulo lweData eNkulu-Gcina ulungelelwaniso phakathi kwe-eCares nakuluhlu olukhulu lwe-EMIS; Qinisekisa ulwabiwo lwenani le-EMIS kwi-eCares; Inkxazo kwimfuno yengxelo yephondo nokuqiniseka. Ubumfihlo-Ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo phakathi kwabasebenzi be-PED ECD nabo EMIS; Iqela le-EMIS lelizwe kunye namaqela e-ECD ahamba naye abanjengaye Ilifa Labantwana kunye nenhloso iBana Pele Initiative. Umama uya kuxela intloko yephondo ye-EMIS aze asebenze ngokuchanekileyo noqeqesho be-ECD.

jobs.title: Registry Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.summary: Registry Clerk providing counter services, mail handling and correspondence management at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent (NQF 4) qualification. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide registry counter services. Attend to clients. Handle telephonic and other enquiries received. Receive and register hand delivered mail/files. Handle incoming and out coming correspondence. Receive all mail. Sort, register and dispatch mail. Distribute notices on registry issues. Render an effective filling and record management service. Opening and close files according to record classification system. Filling/storage, tracing (electronically/manually) and retrieval of documents and files. Complete index cards for all filles. Operate office machines in relation to the registry function. Open and maintain franking machine register. Frank post, record money and update register on a daily basis. Undertake spot checks on post to ensure no private post is included. Lock post in postbag for messengers to deliver to Post Office. Open and maintain remittance register. Record all valuable articles as prescribed in the remittance register. Hand delivers and signs over remittances to finance. Send wrong remittances back to sender via registered post and record reference number in register. Keep daily record of amount of letters franked. Process documents for archiving and/disposal Electronics scanning of files sort and package files for archives and distribution. Compile list of documents to be archived and submit to the supervisor. Keep records for archived document.
jobs.enquiries: e-recruitmentfsdpwi01@fswork.gov.za
jobs.applications: To apply visit: (https://systems.fshealth.gov.za/e-Recruitment/Login)

af.title: Registersklerk
af.summary: Registersklerk wat toonbankdienste, poshantering en korrespondensiebestuur by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Bloemfontein verrig.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardige (NQF 4) kwalifikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf registertoonbankdienste. Bedien kliënte. Hanteer telefoon- en ander navrae wat ontvang word. Ontvang en registreer met die hand afgelewerde pos/lêers. Hanteer inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Ontvang alle pos. Sorteer, registreer en stuur pos uit. Versprei kennisgewens oor registervaardighede. Lewer 'n doeltreffende invul- en rekordbestuursdiens. Open en sluit lêers volgens die rekordklassifikasiestelsel. Invul/berging, opsporing (elektronies/handmatig) en terugkry van dokumente en lêers. Voltooi indekskaarte vir alle lêers. Bedryf kantoormasjiene in verband met die registerfunksie. Open en handhaaf die frankmasjienregister. Frank pos, tekengeld en werk die register daagliks by. Onderneem steekproewe op pos om te verseker dat geen private pos ingesluit is nie. Sluit pos in pos sak toe vir boodskappers om na die Poskantoor te af te lewer. Open en handhaaf die oorboordregister. Teken alle waardevolle artikels soos voorgeskryf in die oorboordregister. Handhaaf en tekens oor oorboord aan finansies. Stuur verkeerde oorboorde terug na die sender via geregistreerde pos en teken die verwysingsnommer in die register. Hou 'n daaglikse rekord van die hoeveelheid briewe gefrank is. Proseseer dokumente vir argivering en/of vernietiging. Elektroniese skandering van lêers, sorteer en verpak lêers vir argiewe en verspreiding. Stel 'n lys op van dokumente om te argiveer en dien dit by die toesighouer in. Hou rekords van argiefdokumente.

zu.title: Umlobi we-Registry
zu.summary: Umlobi we-Registry ohlinzeka ngesevisi yasekhawuntani, ukuphathwa kweposi nokuphathwa kwezincwadi e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-Grade 12 noma ezifanayo (NQF 4). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yasekhawuntani ye-registry. Phatha abakhasimende. Phatha imibuzo ebonwa ngocingo nakunye oyitholayo. Yamukela ubhalise iposi/amafayela alethwe ngesandla. Phatha izincwadi ezitholakala nokuqhamuka. Yamukela yonke iposi. Hlukanisa, ubhalise uphose iposi. Sazisa izindaba mayelana nezindaba ze-registry. Hlinzeka ngesevisi egculisayo yokugcina nokuphathwa kwezinkumbulo. Vula uvala amafayela ngokwesistimu yokuhlelwa kwezinkumbulo. Ukugcina/ukulondoloza, ukulandela (ngekhompyutha/ngesandla) nokukhipha amadokhumenti namafayela. Qedela amakhadi ashunqayo wonke amafayela. Sebenzisa imishini yehhovisi mayelana nomsebenzi we-registry. Vula ulondoloze irekhodi lekhadi le-franking machine. Phosa iposi, qamba imali ubuyekeze irekhodi nsuku zonke. Yenza ukuhlola okungazelelwe iposi ukuzeqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho iposi yangasese ehlanganisiwe. Khiya iposi esikhwameni seposi abathunywa ukuyilethela e-Post Office. Vula ulondoloza irekhodi lemali ethunyelwe. Qamba zonke izinto ezibalulekile njengoba kuhlotshiswe kurekhodi lemali ethunyelwe. Yize ngesandla usayine ukudlulisela imali ethunyelwe kwezimali. Thumela emuva imali ethunyelwe ngokungalungile kumthumeli ngeposi ebhalisiwe ubhale inombolo yenkomba kurekhodi. Gcina irekhodi lansuku zonke lenani yamagama aphoshiwe. Qhubeka amadokhumenti okugcina esikhombini kanye/nokulahla ukuskena kwamafayela ngekhompyutha ahlole abeke amafayela esikhombini nasokusatshalaliswa. Hlola uhlu lwamadokhumenti okugcina esikhombini umenze ahambiswe kumlawuli omkhulu. Gcina izinkumbulo zamadokhumenti okugcinwe esikhombini.

xh.title: Umhlawuli weRejista
xh.summary: Umhlawuli weRejista onikeza iinkonzo zesikrwele, ukuphathwa kweposi nokulawula uqhagamshelwano kwisebe leZoMisebenzi ziKawonke neziNkcukacha eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Isimanga se-12 okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo (NQF 4). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zesikrwelezejista. Phatha abaxhasi. Jongana nemibuzo engexelelwayo naye yenye efunyanwayo. Amkela uze ubhale iposti/iiFayili ezilethwe ngesandla. Phatha uqhagamshelwano olungenayo noluphumayo. Amkela yonke iposti. Hlela, bhaleze uthumele iposti. Yahlula izaziso ngemiba yerejista. Nikeza inkonzo esebenzayo yokugcina kunye nokulawula irekhodi. Vula uze uvalle iiFayili ngokwesimiso sokwahlulwa kweerekhodi. Ukugcina/ukulondolozwa, ukukhangela (ngekhompyutha/nangesandla) nokukhupha amaxwebhu ngeeFayili. Gqiba amakhadhi enkcazelo yazo zonke iifayili. Sebenzisa iimashini zofisi ezinxulumene nomsebenzi werejista. Vula ulondoloze irekhodi yemashini yokupayina. Payina iposti, bhale imali uze uhlaze irekhodi ngemihla yonke. Zenza ukuphonononga okungalindelekanga kweposti ukuqinisekisa ukuba akukho positi yangasese enjikanyelweyo. Tshixa iposti esikhwameni seposi abathunywa bayo ukuyithumela ePost Office. Vula ulondoloze irekhodi yemali ethunyelwayo. Bhale zonke izinto ezixabisekileyo njengoko kumiselwe kwirekhodi yemali ethunyelwayo. Zithwale ngesandla uze uzityhalele imali ethunyelwayo kumawabo mali. Thumela emva imali ethunyelwayo engekalungileyo kumthumeli ngeposi ebhalwe ngokusesikweni uze ubhale inani lesalathiso kwirekhodi. Gcina irekhodi yemihla ngemihla yomthamo wamagama apayinwe. Hlela amaxwebhu okugcina/ukutshatyalaliswa ukuskena kwekhompyutha kwamafayili ahluze uze uphakethe iifayili zegcino kunye nokusabalalisa. Hlela uluhlu lwamaxwebhu okugcina uze uwuthumele kumahlakani. Gcina iirekhodi zamaxwebhu agciniweyo.

Sort mail, files, documents and parcels. Ensure that items to collect are sealed and addressed. Collect mail, files, documents and parcels form addressor. Do routine maintenance on the allocated vehicle and report defects timely. Complete all the required and prescribed records and log books with regard to the vehicle and the goods handled.
