af.title: Boodskapper /bestuurder
af.summary: Bestuurder en boodskapper benodig in Bloemfontein om pos, pakkies en dokumente vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in te samel, te versprei en te sorteer.
af.requirements: NQF3 (Grade10). Vermoë om te lees en te skryf. Geldige bestuurderslisensie 7-12 maande se relevante ervaring. Kennis van (prosedures en praktyke aangaande boodskapperdienste)
af.duties: Om boodskapperdienste te lewer, korrespondensie in die register te sorteer en te reël. Versamel, versprei en sirkuleer korrespondensie (pos, pakkies, dokumente en lêers). Sorteer pos, lêers, dokumente en pakkies. Verseker dat items wat ingesamel moet word, verseël en geadresseer is. Versamel pos, lêers, dokumente en pakkies by die adresseerder. Lewer pos, lêers, dokumente en pakkies aan adresseerde. Om bestuurdersdienste te lewer. Bestuur ligte en medium motorvoertuie om passasiers te vervoer en ander items (pos en dokumente) te besorg. Doen roetineonderhoud aan die toegewysde voertuig en rapporteer tydig defekte. Vul alle vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke met betrekking tot die voertuig en die goedere wat hanteer is, in.

zu.title: Umthumeli / Umshayeli
zu.summary: Kudingeka umshayeli nomthumeli eBloemfontein ukuthi baqoqe, bahambise futhi bahlele imeyili, amaphakethe namadokhumenta kuDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure.
zu.requirements: NQF3 (Grade10). . Ikhalenda lokushayela elivumelekile. Uzobo oluyisikhathi esingU 7-12 ezinyanga ezinhle imisebenzi ehlobene nalokho. Ulwazi ngemigomo nendlela yokusebenza ngokwenkonzo yomthumeli
zu.duties: Ukunikeza inkonzo yokuthumela, hlela futhi uhlele ukuxhumana kwemibhalo kwirejistri. . Hlela imeyili, amafayela, amadokhumenti namaphakethe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezizosutholwa zivaliwe futhi zinikwe ikheli. . . Ukunikeza inkonzo yokushayela. . Yenza ukunakekelwa okuvamile kwesithuthi esinikiwe futhi wenze umbiko ngemikhondo ngokushesha. Qedela zonke iziqopho nezincwadi ezidingekile nesezimiswe mayelana ngesithuthi nezinto ephathwayo.

xh.title: Umthunywa /umqhubi
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umqhubi nomthunywa eBloemfontein ukuba aqokele, abe ahlule iposi, amaphakethe namaxwebhu kwisebe leDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure.
xh.requirements: I-NQF3 (Grade10). Ulwazi lokufunda nokubhala. I-License yokushaya othweni egunyazisiweyo; Iinyanga ezili-7-12 zemvelaphi efanelekileyo. Ulwazi ngale ndlela (neenkqubo ngokwentlalo komthunywa).
xh.duties: Ukuze anike iinkonzo zomthunywa, ahlele alungise uxwebhu kwindawo egcinwa kuyo imibhalo. Aqokele, abe asasaze axwebhu (iposi, amaphakethe, amaxwebhu namafayile). Ahlele iposi, amafayile, amaxwebhu namaphakethe. Aqiniseke ukuba izinto eziqokelelwayo zivaliwe zibe zigqitywe. Aqokele iposi, amafayile, amaxwebhu namaphakethe kumntu othumelayo. Aze athume iposi, amafayile, amaxwebhu namaphakethe kubafundi. Ukunika iinkonzo zokushaya othweni. Ashaye izithuthi ezincinci nezithengathelyo ezithathwa ngamandla amancinci ukuba ahambise abagqibi abakhoyo athwele nezinye izinto (iposi namaxwebhu). Enze ukhuseleko olujwayelekelo kwisithuthi esinikiweyo axele ngemiba ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Agqibe zonke iirekhodi namabuki alawulo afunekayo kwaye abekiweyo ngokwesithuthi nangokwezinto ezithathwa ngaye.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Administrative Support and Co-ordination
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive salary package), (This all- inclusive flexible remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the Government’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion, which may be structured in terms of the rules for the structuring of the flexible portion and which may include a 13th cheque, motor car allowance, housing allowance and medical aid assistance).
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Administrative Support and Co-ordination in the Department of Treasury, Bloemfontein, requiring a diploma or degree with three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Diploma or Degree (NQF level 6) qualification in Public Administration/Business Administration or equivalent qualification. A minimum of three (3) years’ relevant experience in an administration/support environment below middle management (Assistant Director) / middle management level. Broad knowledge and understanding of the functional areas covered by the executive authority’s portfolio. Proven management competencies. Working knowledge of the political and parliamentary processes in South Africa. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage the administrative and coordination activities within the office of the executive authority, including but not limited to, developing, implementing and maintaining systems to monitor and manage the flow of documents to, from and within the office of the executive authority, managing the procurement and maintenance of equipment and administering the budget in the office of the executive authority, managing logistical support, developing and maintaining a filing system and managing the registry for the office of the executive authority. Liaise with internal and external role-players with regard to matters relating to the portfolio of the executive authority. Render an executive council support service to the executive authority. Supervise employees.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. A M J Hattingh: recruitment@treasury.fs.gov.za
jobs.applications: applications for the Department of Free State Provincial Treasury to be submitted via: Online-link to https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
jobs.notes: Effective from 1 April 2026, the Free State Provincial Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za ), which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e- Recruitment with no success and the Free State Provincial Treasury Information Technology Sub-directorate was unable to assist. The Department will not be responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. The applicant’s profile on the e-Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Applicants should upload their curriculum vitae (CV), qualification(s) and other related document(s) as one (1) document attachment on the e-Recruitment system. (Please ensure that document is in PDF format & maximum size 3MB). The Curriculum Vitae should be specific regarding previous positions occupied and the start date and end date of the position(s) should be indicated. Accompanying relevant documentation required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, Driver’s license, ID, etc., such documents need not be certified at point of application, however, certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on, or before the day of the interview following an invitation from the Department to attend an interview, and such qualification(s) and other related document(s) should be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are submitted online timeously. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short courses certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The highest relevant qualification should be captured/listed as the first qualification on the e- recruitment profile. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Communication will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial assets check, qualification verification and reference checks). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations and/or record. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments on the advertised post(s). All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on: recruitment@treasury.fs.gov.za (no applications, strictly for enquiries purposes). Free State Provincial Treasury is compliant with the requirements of POPIA. OTHER POST

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Administratiewe Ondersteuning en Koördinering
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Administratiewe Ondersteuning en Koördinering in die Department of Treasury, Bloemfontein, wat 'n diploma of graad met drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Gesikte Diploma of Degree (NQF level 6) kwalifikasie in Public Administration/Business Administration of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe/ondersteuningsomgewing onder middelbestuur (Assistant Director) / middelbestuurvlak. Breë kennis en begrip van die funksionele gebiede wat deur die uitvoerende gesag se portefeulje gedek word. Bewese bestuursbevoegdhede. Werkende kennis van die politieke en parlementêre prosesse in Suid-Afrika. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die administratiewe en koördineringsaktiwiteite binne die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag, insluitend maar nie beperk tot nie, die ontwikkeling, implementering en onderhoud van stelsels om die vloei van dokumente na, van en binne die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag te monitor en te bestuur, die bestuur van die verkryging en onderhoud van toerusting en die toediening van die begroting in die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag, die bestuur van logistieke ondersteuning, die ontwikkeling en onderhoud van 'n lêerstelsel en die bestuur van die register vir die kantoor van die uitvoerende gesag. Skakel met interne en eksterne rolspelers met betrekking tot aangeleenthede rakende die portefeulje van die uitvoerende gesag. Lewer 'n uitvoerende raadsondersteuningsdiens aan die uitvoerende gesag. Hou toesig oor werknemers.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokumanebenzi: Ukusekela Kolawulo Nokuhlanganisa
zu.summary: Isikhundla Sokumanebenzi Sokusekela Kolawulo Nokuhlanganisa kumnyango weTreasury, eBloemfontein, esidinga idiploma noma iziqu ezineminyaka emithathu yolwazi oluhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile zeDiploma noma i-Degree (NQF level 6) ku-Public Administration/Business Administration noma iziqu ezingabuye zifanele. Ubufakazi obuncane beminyaka emithathu (3) bolwazi oluhambisanayo endaweni yolawulo/ukusekela ngaphansi kwesigaba somphathi osemkhakheni ophakathi (Assistant Director) / ezingeni lomphathi osemkhakheni ophakathi. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuzuva kumakhono amakhulu abekwe phansi kwamandla enkomikela kahulumeni. Amakhono obuphathi abufakazelwa ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ulwazi lokusebenza mayelana nezinkambiso zezepolitiki nalezinsipho eNingizimu Afrika. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo nokuhlanganisa kahle-nkahle kundlu yamandla enkomikela kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa kepha okungeyona okukhawulwe kuso, ukuthuthukisa, ukuyisebenzisa nokugcina izinhlelo zokuqapha nokuphatha ukugeleza kwamadokhumenti okuya, okuvela nokuhamba kahle-nkahle endlini yamandla enkomikela kahulumeni, ukuphatha ukuthengwa nokugcinwa kwemishini nokuphatha imali ehlelwe kakhulu endlini yamandla enkomikela kahulumeni, ukuphatha ukusekelwa ngokohlelo, ukuthuthukisa nokugcina isiphakeli samafayela nokuphatha uburejista bendlu yamandla enkomikela kahulumeni. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngokulawula izindaba ezihlobene nomkhakha wamandla enkomikela kahulumeni. Nika insiza yokusekela ibhodi elawulayo enkomikeli kahulumeni. Qaphela abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathiswa woBunkonzo: Inkxaso yoBuphangaliso kunye noQeqesho-lwemisebenzi
xh.summary: Umphathiswa woBunkonzo weNkxaso yoBuphangaliso kunye noQeqesho-lwemisebenzi kwisebe le Treasury, eBloemfontein, efuna idiploma okanye izidanga kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo zediploma okanye sidanga (NQF level 6) kwiNtengiso yoLuntu/YoBuphangaliso beShishini okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) ubuncinane Yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yobuphangaliso/inkxaso engaphantsi komphathi wolawulo lwesiqakaqa (Assistant Director) / kwinqanaba lolawulo lwesiqakaqa. ULwazi olubanzi kunye nokuqonda iindawo zomsebenzi ezikhuselwe kwindima yagunyazwe ngowona ulawulo. Amakhono obukhosi aboniswe ngokoqobo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lweenkqubo zezopolitiko kunye zepalamende eSouth Africa. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni.

Qhathanisa nabaphathi-bomsebenzi abangaphakathi kunye nabangaphandle malunga neendaba ezithinta indima yegunyazwe ngowona ulawulo. Nikela ngenkonzo yonkxaso kolawulo lwesigqeba kubagunyazwe ngowona ulawulo. Qondise abasebenzi.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie word benodig by Leratong-hospitaal in Gauteng vir kliniese bestuur en toesig oor personeel.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie moontlik maak. Geen ervaring word vereis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginek. nie. Kennis van tersaaklike pasiëntsorgriglyne en gereguleerde norme en standaarde (Nasionale kernstandaarde). Kennis van jaarlikse prestasieplan-doelwitte en prioriteite in verhouding tot programme, bv. pasiëntervaring van sorgprogramme om kliniese dienste te verbeter. Goeie kommunikasie- en spanbouvaardighede. Menslike hulpbronbeleide en arbeidsverhoudinge, bestuur van personeelverlof, onderrigvaardighede en demonstrasievaardighede, vermoë om 'n spanlid in 'n leidende rol te wees, kennis van prosuringsprosedures en voorsieningskettingbeginsels, kennis van finansiële regulasies, d.w.s. bestuur van skenkings.
af.duties: Algehele kliniese bestuur van die Verloskunde- en Ginekologie-eenheid. Toesig oor mediese beamptes, intern dokters, kliniese medewerkers, studente, registrateurs en ander kliniese personeel. Bestuur van pasiënte in buitepasiënteafdelings en funksionering in 'n multidissiplinêre span. Wees deel van die hospitale se kliniese bestuurspan, Distriks Gesondheidsdiens in die hospitaal. Rapporteer aan die Hoof van Kliniese eenheid en die Kliniese Bestuurder van Leratong-streeks hospitaal. Bestuur, ontwikkel, hou toesig oor en implementeer verloskundige behandelingsprotokolle, riglyne vir effektiewe bestuur van Verloskunde- en Ginek-pasiënte. Lei en opvoed junior dokters met direkte en indirekte toesig om mediese personeel in staat te stel om pasiëntbehandeling doeltreffend en effektief uit te voer. Verbeter pasiënt-/kliëntesorg deur implementering van toepaslike evalueringsmetodes, instrumente, protokolle en prosedures. Help die hospitaal om die besigheidsmodel aan te spreek met die oog op 'n streek moedersfasiliteit, verminder verwysings en bestuur pasiënte effektief, bestuur en hou toesig oor Verloskunde- en Ginekologie-preventie en verbeterde benaderings, bestuur ICU- en hoësorgpasiënte met 'n multidissiplinêre benadering wat interne medisyne behels. Verbeter pasiëntrekordhouding, verhoog toeganklikheid van Kliniese Dienste, betrokke by kliniese oudit, verbeter data-insameling onder dokters en verpleegsters. Verseker nakoming van die Nasionale Kernstandaarde/ ideale hospitaal Raamwerk. Verseker nakoming van die gedragskode en Openbare Diens Wet, Regulasies, en PFMA. Help met die effektiewe bestuur van interne en eksterne belanghebbende klagtes en konflik, binne die eenheid. Permanente verblyf of Suid-Afrikaanse burgerskap is noodsaaklik. Dra by tot die akademiese aktiwiteite van die Hospitaal. Om woonkwartier-oortydpligte te verrig.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics and Gynaecology odingeka e-Leratong Hospital e-Gauteng ekuphathweni kwezokwelapha nasekuqondiseni abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha ku-Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Akukho mkhawulo wamava emsebenzini odingekayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha ku-Obstetric and Gynae. Ulwazi ngemihlahlandlela ekunakekelweni kwabagula nemigomo namazinga abekwe ngumthetho (National core standards). Ulwazi ngemigidingo nemigidingo yeplani yokusebenza kwonyaka mayelana namaphrogramu isb. amaphrogramu okunakekelwa kwabagula ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zokwelapha. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana nokwakha iqembu. Izinqubomgomo zabasebenzi nezokuhlobana nomsebenzi, ukuphathwa kokuphumula kwabasebenzi, amakhono okufundisa nokukhombisa, ikhono lokuba yilungu leqembu esikhundleni sobuholi, ulwazi lwenqubo yokuthenga nemigomo yohwebo olunyathelisiwe, ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali okungukuthi, ukuphathwa kwezipho.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwonke kokwelapha kwesigaba se-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ukuqondisa abahlinziri, ochwepheshe abafundela ukwelapha, abahlotshanisi bezokwelapha, abafundi, ababhalisi kanye nabanye abasebenzi bokwelapha. Ukuphatha abagula emagumbini okuhlola nendlela yokusebenza eqenjini elinemingalo eyahlukene. Ukuba yingxenye yeqembu eliphetha izinsizakalo zokwelapha esibhedlela, le-District Health Service esibhedlela. Kubika kuHhola wesigaba sezokwelapha nakuMphathi Wezokwelapha e-Leratong Regional Hospital. Uphatha,uthuthukise, aqonde futhi asebenzise imithetho yokwelapha ye-obstetric, imihlahlandlela yokuqondisa ngokuphumelelayo abagula be-Obstetric and Gynae. Ufundisa futhi afundise ochwepheshe abasha ngokuqondisa ngokuqondile nangokungaqondisi ukuze anike amandla abasebenzi bokwelapha ukuthi baphathe abagula ngokuphumelelayo nangokusebenza kahle. Ukuthuthukisa inakekelo yomgula/mthengi ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezifanele, amathuluzi, imithetho mayelana nezenzo & izinqubo. Usiza isibhedlela ekuphathweni kwendlela yokusebenza ehamba ibheke esikhungweni samaningi amaningi wesifunda, ukunciphisa izindleko zokuthumela abagula kwenye indawo nangokubaphatha ngokuphumelelayo, ukuphatha nokuqondisa izindlela zokuvikela nokuthuthukisa i-Obstetrics and Gynaecology, ukuphatha abagula abasesimweni esibucayi (ICU) nalabo abanakekelwa ngokukhethekile ngendlela ehlanganisa amagatsha ahlukene okwelapha ehlanganyela nemithi yangaphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa ukugcina amarekhodi abagula, ukwenza lula ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo Zokwelapha, ukubandakanyeka ekuhlolweni izinsizakalo zokwelapha, ukuthuthukisa ukuqoqa imininingwane phakathi kochwepheshe bolwelapha nabanakezeli. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-National Core Standards/ ideal hospital Framework. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nekhowudi yokuziphatha nenoMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, Imithetho, ne-PFMA. Usiza ekuphathweni izikhalo zabadluli abangaphakathi nabangaphandle & izinkinga ngokuphumelelayo, ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Ukuba nesikhundla sokuhlala njalo noma ukuba ngumakade we-South African kuyimfuneko. Yiba negalelo emisebenzini yezifundo yesibhedlela. Ukwenza imisebenzi yamasikhathi amaningi ehlukanisiwe.

xh.title: Isebe Lemveliso sezophilo
xh.summary: Kufuneka Isebe Lemveliso sezophilo kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology esibhedlele i-Leratong Hospital e-Gauteng ukulawula izigulo nokumathunywa abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesebe lemveliso sezophilo kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Akukho mfundo yamava ifunekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesebe lemveliso sezophilo kwi-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokunyamekela izigubo nemigangatho elawulayo (i-National core standards). Ulwazi ngamaphupha okusebenza kwangonyaka nangokubaluleka kweenkqubo ezinjengenkqubo yokunyamekela izigulo ukuphucula iinkonzo zobugcisa. Iindlela eziluncedo zokunxibelelwana nokwakha iqela. Iinkqachamthetho zabantu noqhinga lokubakho kwaba basebenzi, ukulawula iholo labasebenzi, amakhono o mfundisi namakhono okubonisa, ikhono lokuba lilungu leqela elibalulekileyo, ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuthenga namagunya onxibelelwano wemithombo yamalizo, ulwazi ngomthetho wezimali ngokomzekelo ukulawula iimaliso.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ngokubanzi izigulo kwisebe le-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ukumathunywa abadokotala abaqeqeshiweyo, abadokotala abangangenwa mfuno, abanxulumene nesebe lemveliso, abafundi, ababhalisi kunye nabanye abasebenzi bezigulo. Ukulawula izigulo kumasebe ezigulo ezigqibelelayo nokusebenza eqeleni elinguwo lo-manyano lwamasebe. Ukuba yinxalenye yeqelo elilawula izigulo zesibhedlele, i-District Health Service kwesibhedlele. Iingxelo zika kwentloko yesebe lezigulo kunye nomlawuli wezigulo we-Leratong Regional Hospital. Ukulawula, ukuphucula, ukumathunywa nokusebenzisa amagunya onyamekelo lwe-obstetric, imigaqo yokulawula ngokusebenza kakuhle izigulo ze-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ukufundisa nokuphucula abadokotala abasebancinci ngokumathunywa ngokuthe ngqo nakungekho ngqo ukuze ncedise abasebenzi bokugqithisa ukuba baphathe izigulo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuphucula ukunyamekela izigulo nabathengi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqwalasela, izixhobo, imigaqo name ngokuqhuba. Ukunceda isibhedlele ekujameni imodelo yeshishino ukuya kwisibhedlele sabazali sendawo, ukunciphisa iingxelo zokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yokunyamekela ngokusebenza kakuhle, ukulawula nokumathunywa iindlela eziziphucula ngokuthintela i-Obstetrics and Gynaecology, ukulawula abaguli be-ICU nabanakekelo lwaphezulu ngendlela equka amasebe amaninzi njengamayeza angaphakathi. Ukuphucula ukugcina iirekhodi zabaguli, ukwenza lula ukufikelela kwinzinkonzo ezilula, ukubandakanyeka kwisibhedlele ekugxekweni kwenkqubo yonyamekelo, ukuphucula ukuqokelela iingxelo phakathi kwabadokotala nokhathalelo lwesibhedlele. Aqinisekise ukuzilandela i-National Core Standards/ ideal hospital Framework. Aqinisekise ukuzilandela ikhodi yokuziphatha nomthetho wesebe likawonke-wonke, oLilawulo, ne-PFMA. Ukunceda ekulawuleni iingxelo ngokusuleleka nokungavani kwabahlali bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ukuhlala ngonaphakade okanye ukuba ngumZantsi Afrika ngumthetho obalulekileyo. Ukuncedisa iziNkqubo zeZibo zesibhedlele. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokusebenza ngaphezulu kwamavesi.

zu.requirements: Izindingo ezifanele ze-MBcHB/MBBcH ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela wezokwelapha. ULwazi Namakhono: I-CTOP Act 92 of 1996 kanye nezindingo ezithinta umthetho nezokwelapha, Amakhono okuxhumana kahle kanye nokweluleka. Ukuba nakho ukwenza ukuphelisa ukukhulelwa kwesikhathi esisemthethweni. Amakhono okusebenzisa i-sonar eysisekelo ye-Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Ulwazi lwezokuqondiswa kokunakekelwa kwegula kanye namaphuzu kanye nezindingo ezilawuliwe (National core standards,) ulwazi lwezinjongo kanye nezinto eziphambili ohlelweni lwemisebenzi yonyaka ngokuhlobene namaphrojekthi izib. amaphrojekthi okunakekelwa kwegula ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinkonzo zokwelapha).
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ngokubanzi ngokwelapha iyunithi ye-CTOP, ukuvikela ukukhulelwa kanye nezinto zabesifazane. Ukugada abayishi bokwelapha, abahlotshanisi bezokwelapha, abafundi, kanye nabanye abasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuphatha abagula eziyunithi ze-CTOP, emnyangweni we-Obstetrics & Gynaecology futhi asebenze eqenjini elihlukene emikhakheni. Ukuba yingxenye yeqembu lokuqondisa izokwelapha esibhedlela, iqembu lokuqondisa inkonzo yezempilo yesifunda kanye nokusekela ababhalisi ekubekweni ohlelweni nakulawulweni kwenkonzo yezokwelapha esibhedlela. Ukuphatha abagula ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Ukuthuthukisa inakekelwa kwegula kanye nembuki zinkomba ngokufeza izindlela zokuqondisa ezifanele, amathuluzi, amaphrothokholi kanye Nemigomo. Ukuphatha iganga lezinto zabesifazane kanye namaganga okunakekelwa abesifazane abakhulelwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela yokunakekelwa kwegula, ukusebenza nomkomidi wokuphepha kwezigameko zegula ukuze kwenzike ukuhlaziya okuphelele kokuvimbela kanye ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuthuthukisa ukugcinwa kwezinkomba zabagula; ukwenza ukutholakala kolwizo lwezokwelapha, ukuba ngxenye ekuhloleni izokwelapha. Ukuthuthukisa ukuqoqa idatha phakathi kwabaphathi kanye nokusesimweni emnyangweni we-O&G. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela izindingo ze-National Core Standards/Ideal hospital Framework. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela ikhodi yokuziphatha kanye nomthetho wenkonzo yomphakathi, Izimiso, kanye ne-PFMA. Ukusiza ekuphathweni kokuphikisana kanye nezikhalazo zabahlomuli abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuphumelelayo, ngaphakathi kweyunithi. Ukuba nesikhundla esisigxilile noma ukuba ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukufaka isandla emisebenzini yezemfundo yesibhedlela. Ukwenza imisebenzi yothuli lwexeshana elongiwe.

xh.title: Isebe Lolawulo Lwezempilo
xh.summary: Kufuneka gqithiswa isithuba sokuba ngumlawuli wezempilo eLeratong Hospital ukulawula icandelo le-CTOP, lokuzivikisa ukukhulelwa neliqela lezifo zabantu besifazane, nakuphina ukumela abasebenzi bezempilo.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ze-MBcHB/MBBcH ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha. Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoMlawuli weZempilo Ozimeleyo, noluhlobo lokusebenza zendela kwiqela lokukhethwa kokuqeshwa kolwandiso lokukhulelwa (CTOP), ezobugqirha bokubeletha nabezifo zabantu besifazane (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) nasekuzivikiseni ukukhulelwa. Ulwazi nekhono: UMthetho we-CTOP 92 ka-1996 nemiba yomthetho nezempilo; amakhono amahle encokolwano nokuqeqesha. Kubakho khono lokwenza ukupheliswa kolwandiso lokukhulelwa kule nyanga yesibini. Amakhono obugqirha bedophu emabhaleni wesifo sokubeletha nalo bagqirha bezifo zabantu besifazane. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezimayelana nokunakekelwa kwesisiguli nemilinganiselo yomthetho nezigqibo (National core standards); ulwazi ngamagqibo aphuhliswa ngemisebenzi yonyaka nezinto eziphambili kwinkqubo yemisebenzi, njengeenkqubo ezibona ngokunakelwa kwesisiguli eziphucula iinkonzo ezingqondweni.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ngokubanzi nangengqondo izempilo kwicandelo le-CTOP, lokuzivikisa ukukhulelwa nelamagqirha bezifo zabantu besifazane. Ukuphatha iresidenţi yamagqirha, abahlobo bezempilo, abafundi nabo bonke abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukulawula abasiguli kwicandelo le-CTOP, esebelekazi elalela ukubeletha nezifo zabantu besifazane kwaye asebenze ngendlela eqela elikho bulawa. Ukuba yinxalenye yeqela elilawula izempilo esibhedlele, iqela elilawula iinkonzo zeMpilo yakuwo onke amazwe, kwaye axhase ulawulo ekuyilweni nakulawulweni kolawulo lwezempilo esibhedlele. Ukulawula abasiguli ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokukhawuleza. Ukuphucula ukunakekelwa kwesisiguli/nmvelisi ngokusebenzisa iindlela, izixhobo, iinkqubo namagqibo alungele ukupima ulawulo. Ukulawula i-ward yamagqirha bezifo zabantu besifazane neward yezifo zokubeletha ukuphucula iziphumo zonakekelo lwesisiguli; ukusebenza nomaqela abalawula ukhuseleko lwesisiguli ukwenza isahluko ngokupheleleyo ngeendlela ezithintela iziphazamiso kwaye ziphucula ukusombulula. Ukuphucula ukugcinwa kweekhadi zamasiswa kwesisiguli; ukwandisa ukufikelelwa kolawulo lwezempilo; ukubandakanyeka kwisikolo sokupima ulawulo lwezempilo. Ukuphucula ukugcinwa kwemigaqo kubagqirha nabaninimesi kwisebe le-Obstetrics & Gynaecology. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana neNqanaba Eliqiqiweyelo Lemizila/Isakhulo esibhedlele esahlulo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho wokuziphatha nomthetho wesebe lolawulo, iimiso kunye ne-PFMA. Ukuncedakalawulo ukuphatha ukungalungi kweenkokheli zabangaphakathi nabangaphandle nemi served ngendlela esebenzayo, kule candelo. Ukuba ngummi azele okanye ukuba ngumZulu ngokuzalwa. Ukwenza okanye ukubhalisa iinkqubo zeyunivesithi kwisibhedlele. Ukwenza imisebenzi ngenkathi ethize ngemva yexesha elisezidlangalaleni.

jobs.title: Academic Head of Department - Mental Health Nursing
jobs.salary_text: PND 3: R741 783 – R871 860 per annum, (plus benefits)
jobs.summary: Lead and manage the Mental Health Nursing academic department at Bonalesedi Campus, coordinating education, training and clinical learning for student nurses.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 certificate or equivalent. A Basic qualification accredited with the South Africa Nursing Council in terms of Government Notice R.425 (i.e. diploma/degree) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse and Psychiatric Nursing. Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Nursing Education. A Post Basic or Postgraduate qualification in Psychiatric Nursing or Mental Health Nursing. Master’s degree in nursing/public health. Assessor and Moderator registered with SANC. Current registration with SANC. A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing, at least five (5) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing Education after obtaining the one (1) year post-basic qualification in Nursing Education. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in the appropriate speciality. Computer literacy. Valid driver's licence. Skills and knowledge: knowledge of procedures and processes related to post basic programmes, knowledge of relevant Acts and Legislation, Code of ethics and Professional Practice of South African Nursing Council. Knowledge in Human Resource and Finance matters. Sound communication and leadership skills. Good communication, problem-solving, supervisory, report writing and presentation skills. Ability to work in a team and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and manage the provision of education and training to student nurses. Manage clinical learning exposure to learners between Campus and clinical areas. Develop and ensure implementation of quality assurance programmes. Orientate, supervise, and appraise staff members in the academic department. Participate in the presentation of academic programmes theory and clinical practice. Supervise the marking and moderation of the theoretical and practical examinations. Provide academic support to students. Develop, review, and evaluate the curriculum of academic programmes. Perform research relevant to nursing education. Collaborate with other stakeholders and build a sound relationship within the Department. Serve as chairperson/member on applicable academic/management committees. Participate in the management of the College. Oversee the supervision of students.

af.title: Akademiese Hoof van Departement - Geestesgesondheidsverpleegkunde
af.summary: Lei en bestuur die akademiese departement vir Geestesgesondheidsverpleegkunde by Bonalesedi-sentrum, en koördineer opvoeding, opleiding en kliniese leer vir studenteverpleegkundiges.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. 'n Basiese kwalifikasie geakrediteer by die South Africa Nursing Council ingevolge Government Notice R.425 (d.w.s. diploma/graad) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde toelaat. Baccalaureusgraad/Diploma in Verpleegkunde-opvoeding. 'n Postbasiese of Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde of Geestesgesondheidsverpleegkunde. Meestersgraad in verpleegkunde/volksgesondheid. Assessor en Moderateur geregistreer by SANC. Huidige registrasie by SANC. 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenning ondervinding in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, waarvan ten minste vyf (5) jaar van bogenoemde periode toepaslike/erkenning ondervinding in Verpleegkunde-opvoeding moet wees na verkryging van die een (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-opvoeding. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar ondervinding in die toepaslike spesialiteit. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede en kennis: kennis van prosedures en prosesse verbonde aan postbasiese programme, kennis van toepaslike Wette en Wetgewing, Kode van etiek en Professionele Praktyk van die South African Nursing Council. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbron- en Finansiële aangeleenthede. Goeie kommunikasie- en leierskapsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie-, probleemoplossings-, toesighoudende, verslagdoenings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur die verskaffing van opvoeding en opleiding aan studenteverpleegkundiges. Bestuur kliniese blootstelling aan leerders tussen die sentrum en kliniese areas. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van gehalteversekeringsprogramme. Oriënteer, superviseer en beoordeel personeellede in die akademiese departement. Neem deel aan die aanbieding van akademiese programme se teorie en kliniese praktyk. Superviseer die nasien en moderasie van die teoretiese en praktiese eksamens. Verskaf akademiese ondersteuning aan studente. Ontwikkel, hersien en evalueer die kurrikulum van akademiese programme. Voer navorsing uit wat relevant is tot verpleegkunde-opvoeding. Werk saam met ander belanghebbendes en bou 'n gesonde verhouding binne die Departement op. Dien as voorsitter/lid op toepaslike akademiese/bestuurskomitees. Neem deel aan die bestuur van die Kollege. Hou toesig oor die supervisie van studente.

zu.summary: Hola uphathe umnyango wezemfundo wokunakekelwa kwezempilo engqondweni eBonalesedi Campus, ulungiselele imfundo, ukuqeqesha nokufunda kwezokwelapha abafundi bokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seMatric/Grade12 noma esilingana naso. Isiqu esisisiseko esemtholwe ngemuva kweSouth Africa Nursing Council ngokombhalo weGovernment Notice R.425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri) noma isiqu esilingana nesiqu esivumela ukubhalisa kuSANC njengosiHlengikazi Sezwe kanye noHlengikazi Bezengqondo. I-Bachelor's Degree/Diploma kumfundo wezokuhlenga. Isiqu se-Post Basic noma se-Postgraduate ekunakekelweni kwezengqondo noma ekunakekelweni kwezempilo engqondweni. Isiqu se-Master's degree kwezokuhlenga/ezempilo ezidlule. Umhloli kanye noMhlolisisi ababhaliswe kuSANC. Ukubhalisa okwamanje kuSANC. Okungenani eminyaka eyi-9 yohlebelebe oluhambisana/oluhloniphwayo kwezokuhlenga ngemuva kokubhalisa njengosiHlengikazi Sezwe kuSANC ekunakekelweni Okujwayelekile; okungenani eminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kule minyaka edlulwe kumele ibe yohlebelebe oluhambisana/oluhloniphwayo kumfundo wezokuhlenga ngemuva kokuthola isiqu snyakeni (1) se-post-basic kumfundo wezokuhlenga. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yohlebelebe ekhethekile. Ukuzazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayiseni yemoto evumelekile. Amakhono nolwazi: ulwazi ngeqhubo nezinqubo ezihlobene nezinhlela ze-post basic, ulwazi ngemiThetho ehlobene nayo, neKhowudi yobuHlengikazi kanye neNqubo YeSiseko seSouth African Nursing Council. Ulwazi kwezabantu kanye nezomnotho. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokuholaho. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuqondisa, okubhala imibiko nokuhamba phambili. Isakhono sokusebenza eqenjini naphansi kwenkundla.
zu.duties: Lungiselela uphathe ukunikeza imfundo nokuqeqesha abafundi bakhwelwa. Phatha ukudlula kolwazi kwezokwelapha phakathi kwesikhungo nezindawo zokwelapha. Beseze uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuqinisekisa ukuphuma kahle. Sebenzisana nothisha beqenjana, ulawule, usesde abasebenzi kumnyango wezemfundo. Ngena enkombeni yezinhlela ze-academic zithiyori kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezokwelapha. Lawula uphawulwe nokuqashwa kokubuyekeza okuthiyori nakokusetshenziswa. Nikeza usizo lwezemfundo kubafundi. Beseze, ubuyekeze, uhlole isikhathi sezinhlela ze-academic. Yenza ucwaningo oluhlobene nemfundo yokuhlenga. Sebenzisana nabanomzamo bese ukha imibusano ezingculaza kumnyango. Sebenzisa njengosihlalo/ilungu ekhomidi ezihlukahlukene ze-academic/ezokuphatha. Ngena ekuqondisweni koMnyango. Bukela ukuqondiswa kwabafundi.
