af.duties: Verskaf opvoeding en opleiding aan geesteshuisvestiging-studentverpleegkundiges, koördineer kliniese leerblootstelling tussen kampus en kliniese fasiliteite. Ondersteun visie en missie en beveld die beeld van die kampus en kollege. Implementeer assesseringsstrategieë om student se bevoegdhede te bepaal. Oefen beheer oor studente uit. Beplan en implementeer akademiese program. Pas 'n verskeidenheid onderrig- en leerstrategieë toe om vereiste uitkomste te bereik. Vergesel studente in kliniese areas. Bestuur studentdatabasis. Inisieer en/of neem deel aan verpleegkundenavorsing en gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid. Neem deel aan voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling in verpleegkunde-opvoeding en eie praktykveld.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Pnd1/ Pnd2- Ukwengamela Esezempilweni Yengqondo
zu.summary: Onjiniyela ekuKengameleni Esezempilweni Yengqondo eGauteng College of Nursing, Bonalesedi Campus, odinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nesifundo sokufundisa abanesi.
zu.requirements: PND 1: Isitifikedi se-Matric/Grade 12 noma esilinganayo. I-Diploma/Degree kuNursing (R.425) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoNesiwePhezulu, nakuPsychiatric Nursing. Isifundo se-Diploma/degree eNursing Education esibhaliswe ku-SANC. Isifundo se-Post Basic noma se-Postgraduate kuPsychiatric Nursing noma eMental Health Nursing. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC. I-Master's degree enursing/public health (Abafake izicelo abasesigabini sokuhlaziya idatha ocwaningweni banganakwa, nalabo abanayo i-Master's degree enursing kodwa benesifundo se-Degree eNursing eNQF L8 bangafaka izicelo). Ukuze ube nokuhlala okungaphansi kweminyaka engu-4 ngokulinganayo/nokuhlonzekwayo njengoNesiwePhezulu. (kuncishiswe unyaka oyedwa wokuhlala kubafakiwe ababekwe ngaphandle kwePublic Service emva kokuhambisa izidingo zokubhaliswa). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukubhaliswa njengo-Assessor no-Moderator. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha/isitifikedi kwi-MS Office, namakhono okuxoxa kahle, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubhala umbiko nokwethula. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nangaphansi komfutho. PND 2: Isitifikedi se-Matric/Grade 12 noma esilinganayo. I-Diploma/Degree kuNursing (R.425) noma isifudo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoNesiwePhezulu, nakuPsychiatric. Isifundo se-Diploma/degree eNursing Education esibhaliswe ku-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC. Isifundo se-Post Basic noma se-Postgraduate kuPsychiatric Nursing noma eMental Health Nursing. I-Master's degree enursing/public health (Abafake izicelo abasesigabini sokuhlaziya idatha ocwaningweni banganakwa, nalabo abangena i-Master's degree enursing kodwa benesifundo se-Degree eNursing eNQF L8 bangafaka izicelo). Ukuze ube nokuhlala okungaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 ngokulinganayo/nokuhlonzekwayo enursing emva kokubhalisa njengoNesiwePhezulu ku-SANC, okungenani iminyaka engu-10 esikhathini esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube yohlu lokuhlala ngokulinganayo/nokuhlonzekwayo emfundweni yabanesi. (kuncishiswe unyaka oyedwa wokuhlala kubafakiwe ababekwe ngaphandle kwePublic Service emva kokuhambisa izidingo zokubhaliswa). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukubhaliswa njengo-Assessor no-Moderator. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office namakhono okuxoxa kahle, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okubhala umbiko nokwethula. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nangaphansi komfutho.
zu.duties: Nikeza imfundo nokuqeqesha abafundi abanesi bezempilo yengqondo, hlelahlele ukwaziswa okufundiswa emtholampilo phakathi kwe-campus nabezinye izikhungo ezitholakala emtholampilo. Sekela inqubo nethembayo futhi umuse isithombe se-campus nekholishi. Qalisa izindlela zokuqondisa ukulinganisa ukuthola ukuthi umfundi uyazi nokwazi yini. Lawula abafundi. Cwaza uze usebenzise uhlelo Iwemfundo ephakeme. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokufundisa nokufunda ukuze ufinyelele imigomo edingekayo. Hambela abafandi ezindaweni ezitholakala emtholampilo. Phatha idatha yabafundi. Qala futhi/ noma uthathe inxaxheba ocwaningweni lwezinsizi nasekuqondiseni inxulumene nomphakathi. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni ngomsebenzi wezinsizi emfundweni yabanesi nasemkhakheni wakho wokusebenza.

xh.title: Onyathi Pnd1/ Pnd2- Ukunyanga iimeko zengqondo
xh.summary: Onyathi ekunyungeni iimeko zengqondo e Gauteng College of Nursing, Bonalesedi Campus, efuno ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nokuqatshelwa isidanga sokufundisa abanegadi.
xh.requirements: PND 1: Isatifikethi se-Matric/Grade 12 okanye esilinganayo. Isidanga/Digri ekunyungeni (R.425) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengongenengqondo eQeshengiweyo, kunye nokunyunga iimeko zengqondo. Isidanga/digri ekufundiseni abanegadi esibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. Isidanga se-Post Basic okanye se-Postgraduate ekunyungeni iimeko zengqondo okanye ekunyungiweyo iimeko zengqondo. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-SANC. Isidanga se-Master's ekunyungiweyo/impilo yomphakathi (Abaqwayeyi abakwindawo yokwahlula idatha yokuphandwa banganconywa, nabo abangenaso isidanga se-Master's ekunyugiweyo kodwa benesidanga kokuNyunga kwindawo ye-NQF L8 bangathi sebenze). Amava abungenzi angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-4 afanelekileyo/evakalayo njengongenengqondo eQeshengiweyo. (kutyotywe umnyaka o-1 wamava abaqwayeyi abakhethiweyo ngaphandle koKonzo kaWogqolo emva kokuzalisekisa iimfuno zokubhalisa). Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukubhalisa njengomahluleli noMlawuli. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha/isatifikethi kwi-MS Office nakhono lokunxibelelana elilungileyo, ukuxazula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo nakhono lokubonakalisa. Ikhono lokusebenza eqebeni nangaphantsi koxinzelelo. PND 2: Isatifikethi se-Matric/Grade 12 okanye esilinganayo. Isidanga/Digri ekunyungeni (R.425) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengongenengqondo eQeshengiweyo, kunye nokunyunga iimeko zengqondo. Isidanga/digri ekufundiseni abanegadi esibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-SANC. Isidanga se-Post Basic okanye se-Postgraduate ekunyugeni iimeko zengqondo okanye ekunyugiweyo iimeko zengqondo. Isidanga se-Master's ekunyugiweyo/impilo yomphakathi (Abaqwayeyi abakwindawo yokwahlula idatha yokuphandwa banganconywa, nabo abangenaso isidanga se-Master's ekunyugiweyo kodwa benesidanga kokuNyunga kwindawo ye-NQF L8 bangathi sebenze). Amava abungenzi angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 afanelekileyo/evakalayo ekunyugenyo emva kokubhaliswa njengongenengqondo eQeshengiweyo kwi-SANC, ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 yexesha elikhankanywe ngasentlu kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/evakalayo kwimfundo yegadi. (kutyotywe umnyaka o-1 wamava kumqwayeyi oqokwe ngaphandle koKonzo kaWogqolo emva kokuzalisekisa iimfuno zokubhalisa). Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukubhalisa njengomahluleli noMlawuli. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office nakhono lokunxibelelana elilungileyo, ukuxazula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo nakhono lokubonakalisa. Ikhono lokusebenza eqebeni nangaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Nika imfundo nokuqeqesha abaFundi bagadi kwezempilo zengqondo, qamba ekuso ngokufundiswa okusesixekeni phakathi kwekhorasi nasezikhululo zesesixekeni. Xhasa iimbono nenjongo zeLali zeLali zekhorasi neLali zeLali zekholeji. Phatha iindlela zokuqamba ukugqiba ukukwazi kweFundi. Lawula abaFundi. Cwangcisa nokuqhuba inkqubo yemfundo. Sebenzisa iindlela ezininzi zokufundisa nokufunda ukugqiba iziphumo ezifunekayo. Xhathisa abaFundi kwizinto ezingoomlingo. Lawula idathabhasi yabaFundi. Qala noko wazi / nokuzibandakanya kuphando lokunyunga nolonwabulo loluntu. Zibandakanye ekuphuhliseni ukhuseleko lobuchwepheshe ekufundiseni abanegadi nakwindawo yakho yokusebenza.

jobs.title: Lecturer Pnd1/pnd2 Diploma in Nursing
jobs.salary_text: PND1: R495 423 - R571 161 per annum, (plus benefits) PND2: R607 350 - R785 568 per annum, (plus benefits)
jobs.summary: Lecturer position in nursing education at Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, responsible for planning, coordinating and implementing nursing programmes with theoretical and clinical instruction.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification. Basic qualifications accredited with South African Nursing Council (SANC) in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e., Diploma/Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Registered Nurse and Midwife. Degree in Nursing which includes midwifery as a qualification. Diploma/Degree in Nursing Education registered with SANC as nurse educator. Master’s degree in nursing will be an added advantage. Applicant must be registered with South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professional Nurse and Midwife. PND1: Minimum of four (4) years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience after registration as a Registered Nurse and Midwife. PND2: Minimum of four (4) years of appropriate and recognizable nursing experience after registration as a Registered Nurse and Midwife and ten (10) years of appropriate and recognizable experience in nursing education after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification in Nursing Education. Knowledge and ability to apply South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, Nursing Standards, Scope of Practice and all relevant regulations. Must be computer literate. Sound communication, supervisory, report writing and presentation skills. Ability to work in a team and under pressure. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: planning, coordination and implementation of nursing programmes; provide theoretical and clinical instructions, and conduct evaluations of Nursing programmes; clinical accompaniment, supervision and implementation of assessment strategies to determine student competencies; exercise control over students; provide students’ guidance and support towards attainment of minimum course requirements as set by SANC. Support the mission of the College by serving in Committees, attending, and participating in meetings and College/Campus activities. Promote the image of the College; participate in research relevant to Nursing Education. Develop, review, and evaluate curriculum. Engage in own Continuous Professional Development (CPD) related to own area of practice and to Nursing Education. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.enquiries: Dr. H.R Letlape Tel No: (011) 983 3007
jobs.applications: All applications must be submitted online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience if any) and a fully completed signed Z83 (81/971431) application form are required. A new Z83 (81/971431) application form with effect 01 January 2021 can be obtainable from https://www.dpsa.gov.za. In compliance with DPSA Circular 19 of 2022 certifying documents/qualifications will only be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the interview process (Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents). Please make sure that the correct reference number is reflected on the Z83 application form. Employment history must reflect the complete calendar date (e.g., 01 April 2017) on the C.V. State all your competencies, training, and knowledge in your CV. Contactable employment references must be line managers and inclusive of email addresses and telephone numbers. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The successful candidate will be subjected to Pre-employment Medical Surveillance conducted by the Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner (OHNP). Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Provincial Government of Gauteng is committed to the achievement and maintenance of diversity in employment, especially of race, gender, and disability. It is a legislative requirement that all newly appointed staff members are subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (PSC)- Verification, upon appointment within the Department. This verification process entails reference checks that should be an immediate current supervisor, Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks). Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment for the advertised post. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity targets will be taken into consideration during the selection process. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. A person may only qualify for an appointment in the SMS if they have successfully completed an SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) and obtained a certificate for Nyukela.

af.title: Lektor PND1/PND2 Diploma in Nursing
af.summary: Lektorpos in verpleegkunde-onderrig by Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, verantwoordelik vir die beplanning, koördinering en implementering van verpleegkunde-programme met teoretiese en kliniese onderrig.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Basies kwalifikasies geakkrediteer met South African Nursing Council (SANC) ingevolge Government Notice R425 (d.w.s. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die SANC as 'n Registered Nurse and Midwife toelaat. Degree in Nursing wat verloskunde as 'n kwalifikasie insluit. Diploma/Degree in Nursing Education geregistreer met SANC as nurse educator. 'n Meestergraad in verpleegkunde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Aansoeker moet by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professional Nurse and Midwife geregistreer wees. PND1: Minimum van vier (4) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n Registered Nurse and Midwife. PND2: Minimum van vier (4) jaar toepaslike en erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n Registered Nurse and Midwife en tien (10) jaar toepaslike en erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde-onderrig na behaling van die eenjaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Nursing Education. Kennis en vermoë om die South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, Nursing Standards, Scope of Practice en alle relevante regulasies toe te pas. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Sterk kommunikasie-, toesig-, verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span en onder druk te werk. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal, onder andere, vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: beplanning, koördinering en implementering van verpleegkunde-programme; verskaf teoretiese en kliniese onderrig, en voer evaluerings van verpleegkunde-programme uit; kliniese begeleiding, toesig en implementering van assesseringstrategieë om studentekompetensies te bepaal; oefen beheer oor studente uit; verskaf studente leiding en ondersteuning tot die bereiking van minimum kursusvereistes soos deur SANC vasgestel. Ondersteun die sending van die College deur in Komitees te dien, byeenkomste by te woon en deel te neem aan vergaderings en College/Campus-aktiwiteite. Bevorder die beeld van die College; neem deel aan navorsing relevant tot Nursing Education. Ontwikkel, hersien en evalueer kurrikulum. Raak betrokke by eie Continuous Professional Development (CPD) verwant aan eie praktykgebied en tot Nursing Education. Alle kortelys-kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsassesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassessering (etiese gedrag) wees.

zu.title: Umfundisi Pnd1/pnd2 I-Diploma ekuQeqeshweni kwezokunakekela abaguli
zu.summary: Isikhundla somfundisi ekuqeqeshweni kwezokunakekela abaguli e-Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, ubhekene nokuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha izinhlela zokunakekela abaguli nokuqeqesha ngokuningiliziwe kokubili ngokomqondo nangokwesibonakaliso.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Izifundo eziyisisekelo ezivunyiwe yi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) ngokwesaziso kahuluminti i-R425 (okungukuthi, i-Diploma/I-Degree ekuNakekelweni kwezokunakekela abaguli) noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesikhululeki esibhalisiwe kanye nomemezeli wokubeletha. I-Degree eNakekelweni kwezokunakekela abaguli efaka phakathi ukubeletha njengesifundo. I-Diploma/I-Degree ekuQeqeshweni kwezokunakekela abaguli ebhaliswe kwi-SANC njengomqeqeshi wezokunakekela abaguli. I-Master's degree ekuNakekelweni kwezokunakekela abaguli izoba yinzuzo. Umfaki isicelo kumele abhaliswe ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesikhululeki esisebenzelayo nangomemezeli wokubeletha. PND1: Okuncane ngeminyaka emine (4) yokuhlangabezela ezokunakekela abaguli ehambisana nokuqashelwa emva kokuqinisekiswa njengesikhululeki esibhalisiwe nangomemezeli wokubeletha. PND2: Okuncane ngeminyaka emine (4) yokuhlangabezela ezokunakekela abaguli ehambisana nokuqashelwa emva kokuqinisekiswa njengesikhululeki esibhalisiwe nangomemezeli wokubeletha kanye neminyaka yeshumi (10) yohlu lwezokunakekela abaguli ehambisana nokuqashelwa emva kokuthola isifundo esingemva kwesinye esisekelo se-Nursing Education. Ulwazi namosho wokusebenzisa i-South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, amazinga ezokunakekela abaguli, indawo yokusebenza kanye nazo zonke izimiso ezihambisana nalokhu. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana, okulawula, okubhala imibiko nokubonisa kahle. Ikhono lokusebenza ohlwini kanye nangaphansi kwengcindezi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Umfaki isicelo opumelelayo uzobe ubhekene nokunye okunye, nomsebenzi olandelayo ohleliwe: ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha izinhlela zokunakekela abaguli; ukunikeza ukuqeqeshwa ngokomqondo nangesibonakaliso, nokwenza ukuhlola izinhlela zokuNakekela abaguli; ukuhlala nabafundi ezikhungweni zesibonakaliso, ukubakluleka nokuphatha izindlela zokuhlola ukuze kutholwe ukuthi abafundi bakwazi yini; ukulawula abafundi; ukunikeza abafundi inkombandlela nokuxhasa ekutholeni izidingo ezingezansi zesifundo njengoba kuhlelwe yi-SANC. Ukuxhasa inhloso yeKolishi ngokuba yilungu kumaKomidi, ukuhamba, nokubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni nasezimweni zeKolishi/i-Campus. Ukuthuthisa isithombe seKolishi; ukubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni oluhlobene ne-Nursing Education. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlola kabusha, futhi uhlola isifundo. Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo okuhlobene nendawo yakho yokusebenza nangaku-Nursing Education. Bonke abafaki izicelo ababekiwe ohlwini, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazothatha ukuvivinywa okubili ngaphambi kokuqeqeshwa. Okukodwa kuzoba yisivivinyo sokuqeqesha ngesandla ukuze kutholwe ukuthi umuntu uyafaneleka yini ngokusekelwe kwezidingo zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kubheke izimilo (ukuziphatha ngokomthetho).

xh.title: Onjiniyane yokufundisa Pnd1/pnd2 Diploma kwiNursing
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumfundisi kwimfundo yenursing eChris Hani Baragwanath Campus, siprofileyo kwicebo lokulunga, ukuqhangelana nokuphumeza iinkqubo zenursing enokufundisa ngokubhalayo nakwezempilo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. Iimfuno ezisisiseko ezivunyiweyo kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) ngokwesiTyhuluso seRhuqo uLuntu iR425 (okt., iDiploma/Isidanga kwiNursing) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo nomhlinzisi. Isidanga kwiNursing esiquka ubuhlinzisi njengesifanekiso. iDiploma/Isidanga kwimFundo yenursing ebalwe kwiSANC njengomfundisi-mongikazi. Isidanga sebomu kwiNursing siya kuba luncwadi olongezelelweyo. Umfundi makabe bhalisile kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi opongiziweyo nomhlinzisi. iPND1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emine (4) yamava obuchule/ovakalwa emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo nomhlinzisi. iPND2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emine (4) yamava obuchule novakalwa emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi obhalisiweyo nomhlinzisi neminyaka elishumi (10) yamava obuchule ovakalwayo kwimfundo yenursing emva kokuze isifanekiso sobonyaka obunye bokumva emva kwesisiseko kwimFundo yeNursing. Ulwazi nokuwusebenzisa iKhowudi yeNgqondo yeSouth African Nursing Council, iindidi zeSimo sokusebenza, ummandla wokuSebenza nayo yonke imigaqo enomdla. Makazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amava okunyaniseka okuthetha, okulawula, okubhala iingxelo nokuvelisa iingxelo. Ikelo lokusebenza kwiqela nangaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Umzuzuzana opumelelayo uya kuba nexanduba lokwenza, phakathi kwezinye, ezi ndima ezithile zilandelayo: icebo, ukuqhangelana nokuphumeza iinkqubo zenursing; ukunika inkathazo ngokubhaliweyo nakwezempilo, nokwenza ipononqo lweenkqubo zeNursing; ukuhamba nabafundi kwizibonelelo zempilo, ulawulo nokuphumeza iindlela zohlolo ukumisela ukuguquguquka kwabafundi; ukwenza ulawulo kubafundi; ukunika abafundi ukukhokela nokuXhasa ukufikelela ekufezweni kweemfuno zesifundo ezincinane njengoko kumiswe yiSANC. Ukuxhasa iNjongo yeKholeji ngokuba ngamalungu kwiKomiti, ukuza, nokuthatha inxaxheba kwiintlanganiso nasezinyangweni zeKholeji neseCampus. Ukukhuthaza umfanekiso weKholeji; ukuthatha inxaxheba kuphononqo lwenziwa kuMfundo weNursing. Ukuyila, ukupononqoda, nokuHlola iculum. Ukuqhela kolwazi kwesiTanga obuqhubela phambili (CPD) exhamene nendawo yakhe yokusebenza nakuMfundo weNursing. Onke abagqithiswa ababhalisiweyo, kuquka ne-SMS, baya kwenza iindibaniselwamava ezimbini phambi kokungena. Enye iya kuba yenkqubo yokuzama ukumisela ukulungelelana komfundi ngokusekelwe kwemfuno ezingatshathanga ngocwetywa nengachanekanga yendima yendima eyesithobiyo ngenye imele uphononqo lokuzama ukulingana (ukuziphatha ngokungcolileyo).

jobs.title: Lecturer Pnd1/pnd2 Diploma in Advanced Midwifery
jobs.salary_text: PND1: R495 423 - R571 161 per annum, (plus benefits) PND2: R607 350 - R785 568 per annum, (plus benefits)
jobs.summary: Lecturer in Advanced Midwifery at Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, requiring SANC-registered nursing qualifications and degrees in nursing education and administration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification. Basic qualifications accredited with South African Nursing Council (SANC) in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma/Degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Registered Nurse and Midwife. Degree in Nursing Education registered with the SANC. Degree in Nursing Administration registered with the SANC. Post basic qualification in Midwifery and Neonatal nursing science registered with the SANC and master’s degree will be an added advantage. Current SANC annual practice certificate. PND1: minimum of five (5) years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience in Clinical Midwifery after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing and Midwifery. PND2: minimum of five (5) years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience in Clinical Midwifery after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing and Midwifery and ten (10) years of appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing education. Knowledge and application of the South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, Nursing Standards, Scope of Practice and all relevant regulations. Must be computer literate. Sound communication, supervisory, report writing and presentation skills. Ability to work in a team and under pressure. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: planning, coordination and implementation of training programmes; provide theoretical and clinical instructions, and conduct evaluations of Midwifery Nursing Science academic programmes; clinical accompaniment, supervision and implementation of assessment strategies to determine student’s competencies; exercise control over students; provide student guidance and support towards attainment of minimum course requirements as set by SANC; support the mission of the College by serving in Committees, attending and participating in meetings and College activities. Promote the image of the College; participate in research relevant to Nursing Education. Develop, review and evaluate curriculum, and engage in own continuous Professional development (CPD) related to own area of practice and to Nursing Education.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. T. I Sithole Tel No: (011) 983 3010
jobs.applications: All applications must be submitted online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience if any) and a fully completed signed Z83 (81/971431) application form are required. A new Z83 (81/971431) application form with effect 01 January 2021 can be obtainable from https://www.dpsa.gov.za. In compliance with DPSA Circular 19 of 2022 certifying documents/qualifications will only be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the interview process (Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant documents). Please make sure that the correct reference number is reflected on the Z83 application form. Employment history must reflect the complete calendar date (e.g., 01 April 2017) on the C.V. State all your competencies, training, and knowledge in your CV. Contactable employment references must be line managers and inclusive of email address and telephone numbers. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The successful candidate will be subjected to Pre-employment Medical Surveillance conducted by the Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner (OHNP). Incomplete applications or applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Provincial Government of Gauteng is committed to the achievement and maintenance of diversity in employment, especially of race, gender, and disability. It is a legislative requirement that all newly appointed staff members are subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (PSC)- Verification, upon appointment within the Department. This verification process entails reference checks that should be an immediate current supervisor, Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks). Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment for the advertised post. The Department is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity targets will be taken into consideration during the selection process. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. A person may only qualify for an appointment in the SMS if they have successfully completed an SMS pre-entry programme (Nyukela) and obtained a certificate for Nyukela.

af.title: Lektor Pnd1/pnd2 Diploma in Gevorderde Vroedvroukunde
af.summary: Lektor in Gevorderde Vroedvroukunde by Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, wat SANC-geregistreerde verpleegkwalifikasies en grade in verpleegonderrig en -administrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate of ekwivalente kwalifikasie. Basiese kwalifikasies by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) geakkrediteer ingevolge Government Notice R425 (d.w.s. Diploma/Degree in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Registered Nurse and Midwife toelaat. Degree in Nursing Education by die SANC geregistreer. Degree in Nursing Administration by die SANC geregistreer. Post basiese kwalifikasie in Midwifery and Neonatal nursing science by die SANC geregistreer en 'n meestergraad sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Huidige SANC-jaarlikse praktisysertifikaat. PND1: minimum van vyf (5) jaar toepaslike/erkennde verpleegervaring in Kliniese Vroedvroukunde na registrasie as Professional Nurse by SANC in Algemene verpleegkunde en Vroedvroukunde. PND2: minimum van vyf (5) jaar toepaslike/erkennde verpleegervaring in Kliniese Vroedvroukunde na registrasie as Professional Nurse by SANC in Algemene verpleegkunde en Vroedvroukunde en tien (10) jaar toepaslike/erkennde ervaring in verpleegonderrig. Kennis en toepassing van die South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, Nursing Standards, Scope of Practice en alle tersaaklike regulasies. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Klank kommunikasie-, toesig-, verslagskryf- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span en onder druk te werk. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir, onder andere, die volgende spesifieke take: beplanning, koördinering en implementering van opleidingsprogramme; verskaf teoretiese en kliniese instruksies, en voer evaluerings van Midwifery Nursing Science-akademiese programme uit; kliniese begeleiding, toesig en implementering van assesseringsstrategieë om studente se bevoegdhede te bepaal; oefen beheer uit oor studente; verskaf studentebegeleiding en -ondersteuning ter bereiking van minimumkursusvereistes soos deur SANC vasgestel; ondersteun die sending van die Kollege deur in Komitees te dien, byeenkomste by te woon en deel te neem aan Kollege-aktiwiteide. Bevorder die beeld van die Kollege; neem deel aan navorsing relevant tot Verpleegonderrig. Ontwikkel, hersien en evalueer kurrikulum, en raak betrokke by eie deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling (CPD) verwant aan eie praktykarea en aan Verpleegonderrig.

zu.title: Onjiniyela Pnd1/pnd2 iDiploma ku-Advanced Midwifery
zu.summary: Onjiniyela ku-Advanced Midwifery e-Chris Hani Baragwanath Campus, ofuna iziqu zokunyanga ezibhalisiwe ku-SANC kanye namadigri emfundo yokunyanga nolawulo.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate noma iziqu ezingaphele kwayo. Iziqu eziyisisekelo ezamukelekile ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) ngokuya kwe-Government Notice R425 (okt. i-Diploma/Degree yokunyanga) noma iziqu ezingaphele kwayo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengenesi ebhalisiwe kanye nomlamuli wokubeletha. i-Degree emfundo yokunyanga ebhalisiwe ku-SANC. i-Degree kulawulo lokunyanga ebhalisiwe ku-SANC. Iziqu ze-post basic ku-Midwifery kanye nesayensi yokunyanga kwabanjwayo ebhalisiwe ku-SANC kanye ne-master's degree kuzoba ngumnikelo. Isitifiketi samanje se-SANC annual practice. PND1: okungenani eminyaka emihlanu (5) yohlu oluqondile/oluhloniphwayo lokuqashwa kokunyanga ezimeni zokubeletha emva kokubhalisa njengenesi yobungcweti ne-SANC ekunyangeni okujwayelekile nasekubetheleleni. PND2: okungenani eminyaka emihlanu (5) yohlu oluqondile/oluhloniphwayo lokuqashwa kokunyanga ezimeni zokubeletha emva kokubhalisa njengenesi yobungcweti ne-SANC ekunyangeni okujwayelekile nasekubetheleleni kanye neminyaka elishumi (10) yohlu oluqondile/oluhloniphwayo emfundo yokunyanga. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa i-South African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, ama-Nursing Standards, i-Scope of Practice kanye nezinye izimiso ezihambisana nawo. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuytha. Amakhono ohlezi komuntu oyedwa wokuxhumana, okuqondisa, ukubhala imibiko kanye nokwethula. Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini nangaphansi kwenkuthazo. ilayisenisi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Umqashi ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokwenza, phakathi kwamanye, imisebenzi elandelayo: ukucubungula, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha; ukunikeza iziyalezo ezingokomqondo nezokwesobho, kanye nokwenza ukuhlola kwamaprogramu akademi ayeNzululwazi Yokunyanga Yokubeletha; ukuhambisana ngokwesobho, ukuqondisa nokuphatha izindlela zokuqondisa ukuthola izakhono zenfundo; ukulawula abafundi; ukunikeza abafundi ukwesekwa nekhuthazo ukuthi bafeze izidingo ezingezansi zesifundo njengoba kumiswe i-SANC; ukusekela umgomo weKolishi ngokuba yilungu kwi-Committees, ukuhamba kwaye uthathe inxaxheba emihlanganweni nasemsebenzini weKolishi. Ukuthuthisa isithombe seKolishi; ukuthatha inxaxheba ocwaningweni ohlobene nemfundo yokunyanga. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlola kabusha nokuhola izifundo, kanye nokuzithuthukisa ngokuqhubekayo (CPD) okuhlobene nendawo yakho yokusebenza nakuMfundo Yokunyanga.

xh.title: Onjiniyela Pnd1/pnd2 I-Diploma kwisiNga esiyaPhambili sokubeleka
xh.summary: Onjiniyela kwisiNga esiyaPhambili sokubeleka eChris Hani Baragwanath Campus, efuna iimfuno zobugorha bokunyanga ezibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC kunye nezidanga kwemfundo kunye nolawulo lokunyanga.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. Iimfuno ezisisiseko ezigunyaziswe kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) ngokwesiSaziso sikarhulumente R425 (okt I-Diploma/Isidanga ekunyangenii) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengenkosi yeNtlalontle kunye noMbeleki. Isidanga kwimfundo yokunyanga esibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. Isidanga kulawulo lokunyanga esibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. Isifanekiso se-post-basic kwisiNga sokubeleka kunye nolwazi lwe-Neonatal nursing science esibhalisiweyo kwi-SANC nesisidanga se-masteriya siza kuba lusenzo olongezelelweyo. Isatifikethi yonyaka sesiko sokutitshala se-SANC. PND1: inyanga ezintlanu (5) nje ngaphezulu zeminyaka yamava amafanelekileyo/azibalekayo ekunyangeni okubandakanya isiNga sokubeleka emva kokubhalisa njengenkosi yeNtlalontle ezingunyuliweyo kwi-SANC kwisiNga iJoliso kunye nokubeleka. PND2: inyanga ezintlanu (5) nje ngaphezulu zeminyaka yamava amafanelekileyo/azibalekayo ekunyangeni okubandakanya isiNga sokubeleka emva kokubhalisa njengenkosi yeNtlalontle ezingunyuliweyo kwi-SANC kwisiNga iJoliso kunye nokubeleka kunye neminyaka elishumi (10) yamava amafanelekileyo/azibalekayo kwimfundo yokunyanga. Ulwazi nokusetyenziswa kweSouth African Nursing Council Code of Ethics, iimfuno zobugorha bokunyanga, Scope of Practice nazo zonke iimithetho ezifanelekileyo. Kufuneka ukuba nokwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhomaba elihle, elilawulayo, lokubhala iingxelo kunye namakhono abonakalisa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza eqeleni kwaye ungzantsi koxinzelelo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Umogqwa ofunyanwe isiphithiphithi uza kuba nenkathalo, phakathi kwezinye, ngemisebenzi elandelayo ethile: ukuqamba, ulungelelanisa nokuphumeza iinkqubo zolungiselelo; ukunika iingcebiso ezitheoritical kunye nezoClinic, nokwenza iziqendu zeinkqubo zezifundo ezingabasebenzi bamabakala aphakamileyo ebelekisa isiNga sokubeleka; ukulandelana kweClinic, ukulawula nokuphumeza iindlela zokuhlola ukugunyaziswa kwamava abafundi; ukulawula abafundi; ukunika abafundi isalathiso nenkxaso ngenjongo yokufikelela kumlinganiselo omncinci weemfuno zekhosi njengoko sethwa yi-SANC; ukuxhasa injongo yeKholej ngokukhonza kwiKomiti, nokuza kwabakhona ukuzihlanganisa kwiindibana kwaye bathathe inxaxheba kumanyano neentshukumo zeKholej. Ukukhuthaza isithombe seKholej; ukuthatha inxaxheba kuphando oluthe ngqo kwimfundo yokunyanga. Ukuphuhza, ukuphinda uhlole nokuqwalasela isifundo, kwaye uzibandakanye kolwazi lwakho lokuqhubela phambili ngobugorha obuhamba phambili (CPD) elithe ngqo kwicandelo lakho lomsebenzi nakuMfundo yokunyanga.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Contract Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Contract Management at the Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg, overseeing contract administration, SCM processes, and supplier relationships.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Administration or equivalent in a related field. Minimum of 3 - 5 years’ relevant experience at Assistant Director level in contract management / SCM environment. Possession of a valid driver’s License. People management and leadership skills. Attention to detail. Communication skills. Problem solving skills. Analytical skills. Time Management skills. Ability to perform under pressure. Strategic leadership and policy development experience. Advanced knowledge of PFMA, Treasury Regulations, and SCM frameworks. Project management and stakeholder engagement skills. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage, analyse and determine actions to ensure proper contract administration. Evaluate applications for variations, amendments and cancelations and develop proposals for approval. Maintain proper relationship with suppliers within the code of ethics to ensure delivery of goods/services. Manage the coordination, review and monitoring of contract compliance. Identify and implement a risk management plan for the directorate. Drive SAP Automation and Effective System Management for Contract Administration. Lead the implementation, optimisation and automation of SAP processes within Contract Management. Oversee integration of contract management processes with SAP to improve data integrity, compliance and audit readiness. Monitor system-generated reports to track contract performance, commitments and expenditure. Ensure adherence to system controls, governance frameworks and audit requirements within SAP. Management of Sub- Directorate resources and personnel. Allocate duties and do quality control of the work delivered. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning. Address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Alinah Mogaswa at 072 313 8052
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Employment Equity targets apply: preference will be given to suitably qualified African males, Indian males, Coloured males and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). Youth candidates are encouraged to apply. Requirement of applications: No late applications will be considered. No faxed or emailed applications will be accepted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za and it should be accompanied by a new Z83 and a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) only. Certified copies of qualifications, Identity and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. For all SMS positions, the successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government and possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate is required prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov. za/training course/sms pre-entry-programme/. Following the interview and exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic management competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency- based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic management and development for SMS posts. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Kontrakbestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Kontrakbestuur by die Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg, wat toezicht hou oor kontrakadministrasie, SCM-prosesse en verskafferverhoudings.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) soos erken deur SAQA in Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Administration of gelykstaande in 'n verwante veld. Minimum van 3 - 5 jaar se relevante ervaring op Assistant Director-vlak in kontrakbestuur / SCM-omgewing. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Mensebestuur en leierskapsvaardighede. Aandag aan detail. Kommunikasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te presteer. Strategiese leierskap en beleidontwikkelingservaring. Gevorderde kennis van PFMA, Treasury Regulations en SCM-raamwerke. Projekbestuur en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Bestuur, ontleed en bepaal aksies om behoorlike kontrakadministrasie te verseker. Evalueer aansoeke om variasies, wysigings en kansellasies en ontwikkel voorstelle vir goedkeuring. Handhaaf 'n behoorlike verhouding met verskaffers binne die etiese kode om lewering van goedere/dienste te verseker. Bestuur die koördinering, hersiening en monitering van kontraknakoming. Identifiseer en implementeer 'n risikobestuursplan vir die direktoraat. Dryf SAP-automatisering en effektiewe stelselbestuur vir kontrakadministrasie. Lei die implementering, optimalisering en outomatisering van SAP-prosesse binne kontrakbestuur. Hou toezig op die integrasie van kontrakbestuursprosesse met SAP om data-integriteit, nakoming en ouditgereedheid te verbeter. Monitor stelselgegenereerde verslae om kontrakprestasie, verbintenisse en uitgawes na te volg. Verseker nakoming van stelselbeheermaatreëls, bestuursraamwerke en ouditvereistes binne SAP. Bestuur van subdirektoraat-hulpbronne en personeel. Wijs pligte toe en doen gehaltebeheer van die gelewerde werk. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker. Hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bateslokkering en -beheer.

zu.title: Usomlungukani: Ukuphathwa Kwezinkontileka
zu.summary: Usomlungukani Wokuphathwa Kwezinkontileka e-Department of Human Settlements e-Johannesburg, obheke ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka, inqubo ye-SCM, nobudlelwano nabahlinzeki.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesondlela se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Administration noma okulingana nakho emkhakheni ohlobene. Okungenani unyaka abangu-3 - 5 wobuhlobo bezempilo ezingeni le-Assistant Director ekuphathweni kwezinkontileka / emgwqweni we-SCM. Ukuba nephasipoti evumelekile yokushayela. Amakhono okuphatha abantu nokuhola. Ukunakisisa imininingwane. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela. Isipiliyoni sokuhola ngokobuhlakani nokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo. Ulwazi olwehluleka lwe-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, nezakhiwo ze-SCM. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Phatha, hlaziya futhi unrume izenzo ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okulungile kwezinkontileka. Hlola izicelo zokushintshwa, ukulungiswa nokukhansela bese uthuthukisa iziphakamiso zokuqinisekiswa. Gcina ubudlelwano olulungile nabahlinzeki ngaphakathi komthetho wokuziphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwezimpahla/isevisi. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhlolwa nokulandwa kokuhambisana nezinkontileka. Chaza futhi usebenzise icebo lokuphatha imikhuba yomnyango we-directorate. Qhuba i-SAP Automation kanye Nokuphathwa KweSistimu Okusebenzayo kokuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Holisa ukusetshenziswa, ukukhuliswa nokuzenzakalela kwezinqubo ze-SAP ngaphakathi Kokuphathwa Kwezinkontileka. Bheka ukuhlanganiswa kwezinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkontileka ne-SAP ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwethembeka kwemininingwane, ukuhambisana nokulungelelwa ukuhlolwa. Landela imibiko evela esistimini ukuze ulandele ukusebenza kwezinkontileka, izibopho nokuchithwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nokulawulwa kwezinhlelo zomthetho, izakhiwo zokubusa nezidingo zokuqinisekiswa ngaphakathi kwe-SAP. Ukuphatha abantu nezinsiza ze-Sub-Directorate. Hlaba imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ikhwalithi komsebenzi othunyelwe. Thuthukisa, sethenze futhi ulandele izinhlelo nezinqubo zokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okusebenzayo nokuqinile. Phendula imibuzo futhi unikeze izeluleko nokuqondisa ngokuqokwa nokulawulwa kwempahla.

xh.title: iPhini leDirektha: uLawulo LweKontraki
xh.summary: iPhini leDirekhta loLawulo LweKontraki kwisebe leZicwangciso zoHlalo eJohannesburg, lulawula ukuqhotyoshelwa kweekontraki, iinkqubo zeSCM, namakhosi abahanjisi.
xh.requirements: iMatric ngakumbi nesiqinisekiso se-undergraduate (inqanaba le-NQF 7) njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA kwiSupply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Administration okanye okulinganayo kwendawo enxulumeneyo. Okungqingqwa iyiminyaka engama- 3 - 5 yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba leAssistant Director kulawulo lwekontraki / kwindawo yeSCM. Ukuba nalayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amakhono obulawa nabantu nokuba nogunyaziso. Ukuqwalasela iinkcukacha. Amakhono othethathethwano. Amakhono oxazululo ziingxaki. Amakhono ohlalutyo. Amakhono oluLawulo lwesixa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kokucinezela. Amande ogunyaziso ngokwezicwangciso namava ekunjulalweni kweenkqubo zentlalo. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo ngePFMA, iTreasury Regulations, kunye neenkqubo zeSCM. Amakhono oluLawulo lweprojekthi nokuzibandakanya namajoni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Lawula, hlalutya uze umise izinyanzelo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulawulo lwekontraki ngokuchanekileyo. Qwalasela izicelo zolwangu, okutsha okufakwe nokurhoxiswa ze uphuhlise iingcamango eziza kuvunywa. Gcina ubudlelwane obuchanekileyo nabahanjisi ngaphakathi kobungcali bokuziphatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwezinto/iinkonzo. Lawula uqhelaniso, ukuqwalasela nokumila ukuthobela iinkqubo zeSCM. Ze uze unikeze isicwangciso soLawulo loyingo ekwiso ngokulawulwa kwemisebenzi. Qhuba ngokuzenzekelayo i-SAP kwaye ulawule iNkqubo Esebenzayo yoLawulo LweKontraki. Dibanisa inkqubo yokuzenzekela ukusetyenziswa ibuncinane kwezinkqubo zika-SAP ngaphakathi koLawulo LweKontraki. Qwalasela udibaniso lweenkqubo zolawulo lwekontraki ngesi-SAP ukuphucula ukuchaneka khwama yeemfihlo zolwazi, ukuhambelana nokulungelelwaniso kokuqwalaselwa. Landa iingxelo ezenziwa yinkqubo ukulandela iimpumelelo zekontraki, izithembiso kunye nokuhola. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana kolawulo lweenkqubo, iinkqubo zokulawula iinkqubo zentlalo kunye neemfuno zokuqwalaselwa ngaphakathi kweSAP. Ulawulo lwemithombo namabakha awo- Sub-Directorate. Yaba imisebenzi uze wenze ulawulo lokugcwala kolwazi yezinto ezilungelelanisiweyo. Puhlisa, zisebenzise uze ulande iinkqubo kunye neendlela zokusebenza ukuze kubekho ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngokulinga ngokukhanya. Phendula imibuzo uze unike izalathiso kunye nengcebiso ngenkqubo yokwaba izinto nolawulo lwazo.

A minimum of 3–5-year experience at Assistant Director level within SCM environment. The candidate should have knowledge of all the Public Service prescripts applicable to the role as well as the Department’s mandate. Knowledge of performance management frameworks applicable in the Public Service and proven strategies in performance improvement. Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership, People Management and empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Problem solving and analysis, Client orientation and customer focus, Service Delivery Innovation, Honesty and Integrity. Personal Attributes: Good written and verbal communication. Self-motivated. Work well under pressure. Good Interpersonal skills. Supportive and knowing how to draw the best energy out of the team. Reliable and Responsible. Positive attitude.
jobs.duties: Manage the functional operation of Demand and Acquisition Management. Manage, design and develop demand and acquisition management policies processes and procedures. Compile procurement plan and obtain approval. Setting up the Bid Evaluation, Bid Adjudication and Bid Specification Committees and render SCM advisory services to the relevant committees. Oversee the appointment of bid committee members. Compile tender/quotation specifications as required. Oversee the bidding process. Manage compilation of bid documents and advertisements. Manage publishing of bid documents. Manage the receipt (closing and opening) of bid documents. Processing of bid documents. Monitor the database of approved suppliers. Oversee the coordination, compilation and submission of information for audit purposes. Compile reports and oversee the reporting on the execution of the procurement plan and other related supply chain management administrative reports. Report on the execution of the procurement plan and other supply chain management administrative related activities. Management of sub- directorate. Establish, implement, and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the unit and report on progress as required. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Plan and allocate work.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur vraag- en verwrywingsbedrywighede, ontwikkel SCM-beleide, stel verkrywingsplanne op en hou toesig oor biekomitees vir die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: A Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management. 'n Minimum van 3–5-jaar ervaring op Assistentdirekteurvlak binne SCM-omgewing. Kennis van prestasiebestuursraamwerke wat in die Openbare Diens van toepassing is en bewese strategieë in prestasieverbetering. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projektebestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingsbestuur. Selfgemotiveerd. Werk goed onder druk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Ondersteunend en weet hoe om die beste energie uit die span te haal. Betroubaar en verantwoordelik. Positiewe houding.
af.duties: Bestuur die funksionele werking van Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur. Bestuur, ontwerp en ontwikkel vraag- en verwrywingsbestuursbeleidsprosesse en -prosedures. Hou toesig oor die aanstelling van biekomiteelede. Stel tender/kwotasiespesifikasies soos benodig op. Hou toesig oor die biewerksproses. Bestuur die opstel van biedokumente en advertensies. Bestuur die publisering van biedokumente. Bestuur die ontvangs (sluiting en opening) van biedokumente. Verwerking van biedokumente. Monitor die databasis van goedgekeurde verskaffers. Hou toesig oor die koördinering, opstel en indiening van inligting vir ouditdoeleindes. Stel verslae op en hou toesig oor die verslagdoening oor die uitvoering van die verkrywingsplan en ander verwante verskakelingskettingbestuursadministratiewe verslae. Rapporteer oor die uitvoering van die verkrywingsplan en ander verwante administratiewe aktiwiteite van verskakelingskettingbestuur. Bestuur van subdirektoraat. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie-reëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die eenheid en rapporteer oor vordering soos benodig. Stel alle benodigde administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Beplan en wys werk toe.

zu.title: Induna Yomnyango: Ukuphatha Isicelo Nokuthola Izinsiza
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yesicelo nokuthola izinsiza, hlola izinqubomgomo ze-SCM, hlela izinhlelo zokuthenga, futhi qapha amakomidi okubhida kuGauteng Department of Human Settlements eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesiqu se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esiqashelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management. Okungenani 3–5 iminyaka yeminyaka yamava esikhundleni se-Assistant Director emkhakheni we-SCM. Umfunwa kufanele abe nolwazi ngawo wonke umthetho osemthethweni wesebe lezamasebe abantu ochazayo ongawasebenzisa kulesi sikhundla kanye naleso somnyango. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokuphatha ukusebenza ezisebenza emkhakheni wesebe lezamasebe abantu kanye nendlela evezwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ikhono: Ikhono lokuhola kanye nokuqondisa, ukuphatha abantu nokunika amandla, ukuphatha amaphrojekhi kanye namaphrojekhi, ukuphatha imali kanye nokuphatha ushintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuphucula inkonzo abayifunayo, ukunqoba ukuphucula ukulethwa kwenkonzo, ukwethembeka nokuba nokuzethemba. Iphrofayela yomuntu: Ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Ukuzikhandla ngokwakho. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi kokucindezelwa. Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu. Ukusekela kanye nokwati ukuthi ungathola kanjani amandla angcono eqenjini. Ukuzethemba kanye nokubeka indywaba. Ukuba nokuzethemba okuhle.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusebenza kokuphatha Isicelo nokuthola Izinsiza. Phatha, diza futhi uthuthukise izinqubomgomo, izinqubo namagunya okuphatha isicelo nokuthola izinsiza. Hlela isu lokuthenga uthole ukugunyazwa. Misela i-Bid Evaluation, i-Bid Adjudication kanye nama-Bid Specification Committees futhi unikeze izeluleko ze-SCM emakomidini ahambisanayo. Qapha ukumiswa kwamalungu ekomidi lokubhida. Hlela izidingo zokuthenga noma izilinganiso ngokwezidingo. Qapha inqubo yokubhida. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwamadokhumenti okubhida kanye nezikhangiso. Phatha ukushicilelwa kwamadokhumenti okubhida. Phatha ukwamukelwa (okuvalayo nokuvula) kwamadokhumenti okubhida. Cuba amadokhumenti okubhida. Qapha isisekelo sedatha yabathengisi abagunyaziwe. Qapha ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhlanganiswa nokuthunyelwa kwolwazi ngenhloso yokuhlola. Hlela umbiko futhi uqaphele ukubika ngokuqhubekayo kwesu lokuthenga kanye namanye omabiko okuphatha inqubo yokuthengisa. Bika ngokuqhubekayo kwesu lokuthenga kanye nalokunye okuhlobene nokuphathwa kwenqubo yokuthengisa. Phatha isigaba esingaphansi. Saka, sebenzisa, futhi gcina izinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo futhi ezisebenzayo. uthuthukise futhi uphathe isu sokusebenza sesigaba bese ubika ngokuqhubekaya ngokwezidingo. Hlela bese uthumela wonke omabiko okuphatha inqubo abadingekayo. Hlela futhi wabelwe umsebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamzi: Ulawulo Lwemfuno Noluthenga
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yemfuno noluthenga, cula iinkqubo ze-SCM, qulunthe iinkqubo zoluthenga, ulawule iikomiti ezithengisayo kwisebe leGauteng Department of Human Settlements eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric kunye nesidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) esimrwewe ngu-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management. Amava amabalwa eminyaka engama-3–5 kwinqanaba lase-Assistant Director kwindawo ye-SCM. Umthunywa kufuneka abe nolwazi ngawo onke amagazethi aseZikweni kaWonke wonke abafanelekayo kule ndima njenjalo nengxowa yomsebenzi yesebe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zolawulo lwentsingiselo ezisebenza kuZikweni kaWonke wonke nezicwangciso eziphakamileyo ekuphuculeni intsingiselo. Ikhono: Ikhono lokubakuba namagama nobuntu bokuba ngumgqatswa, ulawulo lwabantu nokuwabusayo, ulawulo lweenkqubo namagephu, ulawulo lwemali nolawulo lokutshintsha. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki nokuwahlola, ukujolisa kwabathengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zabo, intsingiselo yokuziphumeza kwindawo yokwenza imisebenzi, inene nokuqina. Iimpawu zobuwo: Ukuzithandela kakuhle ngokubhala nangokuthetha. Ukuqina ngokuzinikela. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono elihle lokuchasana nabantu. Ukuxhasa nendlela yokukhupha amandla anhle eqela. Ethembekile nethathwa ngokubakum nto eyinye. Imo yokuziphatha eqinisekile.
xh.duties: Lawula imisebenzi yokusebenza kolawulo lwemfuno noluthenga. Lawula, lula iinkqubo kunye nezicwangciso zolawulo lwemfuno noluthenga. Qulunthe isicwangciso soluthenga ulifumane isigunyaziso. Misela iikomiti zokuqwalasela izithengi, iikomiti zokuqhaqha izithengi nungezi zokuqulunthisa iimfuno zeentengi zeze nkqubo ze-SCM kunye nendlela yokuthengisa kwamakomidi afanelekileyo. Lawula ukumiselwa kweelungu zekomiti yezentengi. Qulunthe iinkcukacha zeentengi/namacebiso njengoko kufuneka. Lawula inkqubo yokuthengisa. Lawula ukuquluntha koxinzelelo lwamaphepha eentengi nokuza kwaziswa. Lawula ukushicilelwa koxinzelelo lwamaphepha eentengi. Lawula ukufumana (okuvala nokuvula) oxinzelelo lwamaphepha eentengi. Ukuqhubekeka kolawulo lwamaphepha eentengi. Qwalasela idatabase yabathengisi abavunyiweyo. Lawula ukuhambelanisa, ukuquluntha nokunika iinkcukacha ngeemfuno zokuhlolwa. Quluntha iingxelo ulawule ukwenza iingxelo ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yoluthenga ngezinye iingxelo ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lwesicwangciso somnqonyama. Yenza iingxelo ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yoluthenga nangeminye imisebenzi ehambelana nolawulo lwesicwangciso somnqonyama. Ulawulo lweqeli elingaphantsi. Misela, ukuze iphumeze kwaye igcine iindlela ezisebenzayo nezichanekileyo zoxhumano. Cula ulawule isicwangciso sokusebenza seqeli uziveze ngokuqhubela phambili njengoko kufuneka. Quluntha unike yonke iingxelo ezifunekayo zolawulo. Cwangcisa usule ngomsebenzi.

af.requirements: 'n Matriek plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Vervoerbestuur/Logistieke Bestuur of enige relevante kwalifikasie. Beplanning, organisering en uitvoering; kennisbestuur; strategiese bestuur en die vermoë om konflik te bestuur. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projektebestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntgerigtheid en klijentfokus, dienslewering innovasie, eerlikheid en integriteit. Persoonlike eienskappe: Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. af.duties: Bestuur, ontwikkel, hersien en handhaaf vervoerbeleid en prosedures. Bestuur vervoerkontrakte vir die departement. Skakel met motorhandelaars en verkopers rakende GG en gesubsidieerde voertuie en bestuur die instandhouding van staatsbesit voertuie. Fasiliteer die goedkeuring van regeringsvoertuie vir diens of herstelwerk. Monitor die padwaardigheid van die regeringsmotors. Organiseer en skeduleer vlootvoertuig-instandhouding. Ondersoek voorlopig die misbruik van voertuie en verskaf tegniese assessering van voertuie wat aandag vereis. Stel beheermaatreëls in om voertuigmisbruik en bedrog te bekamp. Reageer op korrespondensie ten opsigte van oudits wat uitgevoer is. Bestuur van die besigheidsseenheid. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Beplan en wys werk toe.

zu.title: Ongomane Weziqu: Izokuhamba Izimoto
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOngomane Weziqu: Izokuhamba Izimoto eJohannesburg esidinga iziqu zikaNQF level 7 nokuthi ube namafuthi eminyaka engu-3-5 ebangeni likaNceda-Ongomane kokuhamba kwezimoto noma ukulawula ukuthunyelwa kwezimpahla.

Ukuze ube nokuhlangabezana okuncane kweminyaka engu-3-5 kokuhlangabezana okufanele ebangeni likaNceda-Ongomane ngaphakathi kwesimo sokuthunyelwa kwezimpahla noma kokuhamba kwezimoto. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Kufanele ukuthi umgqatsi abe nokwazi zonke imiyalo yesebenzi kahulumeni esebenza kulesi sikhundla kanye nemigomo yomnyango. Ukwazi i-Public Financial Management Act; i-Treasury Regulations; inkqubo ye-BAS; izinkqubo ze-SAP ne-PERSAL kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokuthunyelwa kwezimpahla. Ukuhlela, ukulungisa, kanye nokwenza; ukuphathwa kolwazi; ukuphathwa okuhlelekile kanye nenhlokolo yokuphatha ingxabano. Amakhono: Ikhono lekuholo okuhlelekile nokuqondisa, ukuphatha abantu nokuvasa, ukuphatha izinhlelo namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha izimali nokuqondisa izinguquko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukuqonda iklayenti nokuqonda umthengi, intuthuko yokuhaniselwa kwezinsizakalo, ukuqotho nokuqotha ngokwanelisekile. Izinto zobuqu: Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala kahle. Ukuziphatha. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwesisindo. Amakhono abantu ohlelo. Amakhono okuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza kanye nokugcina imigomo kanye nendlela yokuhamba izimoto. Ukuphatha izinkulumo-mvubu zokuhamba izimoto zomnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzisi bokuhamba izimoto bomnyango balandela imiyalo emile. Ukuphatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphatha isiqhenga. Nikeza umbiko wokusetshenziswa kwe-fuel nyanga zonke, umbiko we-logbook kanye nombiko wezinhlelo zokusebenzisa. Ukubhalisa kumihlangano ye-Provincial Transport Forum kanye nomhlangano we-Transport Committee. Ukulawula ukukhokhelwa kwamaphepha okungenele. Ukulwa noku setshenziswa kabi kwemoto zombuso; ukuphatha imali yokuhamba izimoto kanye nezehlo eziphatwa izimoto. Ukuvumela amafomu okugunyazwa uhambo. Xoxisana nabathengisi bemoto kanye nabathengi ngemoto ze-GG nezimoto ezibhadalelwa kanye nokugcina ukulungiswa kwemoto zombuso. Kwesula ukuvunyelwa kwemoto kahulumenu ukuba zilungiswe noma zihlolwe. Hlola ukuthi imoto zikahulumeni zifanelekile ukuzihamba endleleni. Hlela futhi ulungele ukulungiswa kwemoto zesiqhenga. Yenza uphenyo lokuqala ngokusetshenziswa kabi kwemoto futhi uhlinze nokuqashwa kobuchwepheshe emoto ezifuna ukunakwa. Hlela izinyathelo zokulawula ukulwa noku setshenziswa kabi kwemoto nokukhwabanisa. Phendla okubhaliwe ngokuqondene nokuhlolwa okwenziwe. Ukuphatha ibanga lezokuhweba. Lungele futhi uhambise wonke amabiko okuphatha abalulekile. Hlela futhi wabelwe umsebenzi.
