Ubuncinci bamava afanelekileyo eminyaka yama-3-5 kunqanaba lomncedi kaMongqongqo ngaphakathi kwendawo yemisebenzi yokuhamba okanye yokuthutha. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela eyasebenzayo. Umthweswekunye kufuneka abe nolwazi ngazo zonke iimiselo zeNkonzo zoLuntu ezisebenza kulo nakuMthetho wesebe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu; Iimigaqo yoLwazi lwamahlulelo; Inkqubo ye-BAS; iinkqubo ze-SAP ne-PERSAL nokulawula iinkqubo zokuhamba. Uqhelaniso, ukuhlela nokuphumeza; ulawulo lolwazi; ulawulo olubhekisa phambili nakhono lokulawula ingxaki. Ikhono: Ikhono lokubhekisa phambili noBukhosi bukaBaviwe, uLawulo babantu nokubakhulisa, uLawulo lweNkqubo namaPhulo, uLawulo lweMali noLawulo loTshintsho. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzihlola, ukujolisa kumthengi nokugxila kumakhosi, iNnovation ekunikezeleni inkonzo, uQqhayiso nokuzithembisa. Iimpawu zobuntu: Amakhono amabalwe asebenzayo kunye nokuthetha. Ukuzilawula. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhono amabalwe okusebenzisana nabantu. Amakhono okuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Ukulawula, ukuphucula, ukuphonononga nokugcina iinkqubo zokuthutha nemigaqo. Ukulawula iinkonzo zokuthutha zesebe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba abasebenzisi bokuthutha basebe bayilandela imiyalelo eqhelekileyo. Ukulawula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo zolawulo lwamafutha. Ukunika ingxelo yenyanga zonke ngesetyenziswa sempahla, ingxelo yencwadi yokugqiba kunye nengxelo yezicelo. Ukubakho kwiindibano zeProvincial Transport Forum nakuNdibano woBumpathi boKuthutha. Ulungelelwaniso lweentlawulo zamacwecede okuhamayo. Ukulwa nokusetyenziswa ngendlela engafanelekayo iimoto zesizwe; ukulawula ingxowomali yokuthutha iingxelo zeonke into ethintwayo yemoto esebenzayo. Ukuvumela amafomu okugunyazisa uhambo. Ukusebenzisana nabanithi beemoto nabanikabi ngee-GG nezithuthi ezixhaswa ngurhulumente nokulawula ukugcinwa kweemoto zikarhulumente. Ukwenza lula ukuvunywa kweemoto zikarhulumente ukuba zilungwe okanye zilungiswe. Ukuqonda ukuba iimoto zikarhulumente zifanelekile ukuzibeka emgwaqeni. Ukuhlela nokulunda ukugcinwa iimoto esebenzayo. Ukwenza uphononongo lokuqala malunga nokuhlukunyezwa iimoto nokunika isiqondo esingcali kwiimoto ezifuna kuqwalaselwa. Ukuseka iindlela zolawulo ukulwa nokuhlukunyezwa iimoto nokurhweba ngendlela ecekayo. Ukuphendula iincwadi malunga nokuphononongwa kweenkonzo. Ulawulo lwesixhobo somrhumo. Ukudibanisa nokunika zonke iingxelo zolawulo efunekayo. Ukuhlela nokwaba umsebenzi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Payment Administration
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for payment administration in the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, requiring an NQF 6/7 finance qualification and 3-5 years relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 6/7) as recognised by SAQA in Accounting/Auditing/Financial Management or similar. The incumbent should have 3-5 years relevant experience at Assistant Director level, or equivalent in accounting/auditing/financial management or similar. Proven experience in payment processing, verification, reconciliation, and authorisation, preferably within a grant funding environment. Proven experience in managing high-volume payment transactions and dealing with a highly pressurised environment and working under pressure. Possession of a valid driver’s licence. Skills & Competencies: The incumbent should have knowledge and understanding of Human Settlements legislations, National housing code Division of Revenue Act, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Housing Subsidy System (HSS), of the BAS (Basic Accounting System) and SAP. Budgeting skills, Financial Management Skills, Problem solving and analysis; Decision making, Team leadership, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness; Planning and organising; Conflict management and Negotiation skills.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic and operational leadership in the management of payment administration systems, policies, procedures, and controls. Oversee the accurate capturing, verification, processing, and authorisation of payments within the Housing Subsidy System (HSS) or relevant payment platforms. Ensure compliance with payment administration prescripts, supporting documentation requirements, and approval protocols. Manage and oversee payment adjustments, reversals, and rejections in accordance with prescribed regulations and procedures. Investigate and resolve complex payment-related queries, including long-outstanding and disputed payments. Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of payment data and transactions. Oversee the development, submission, and implementation of system change control requests (e.g. OSCARS) related to payment administration. Ensure the compilation and submission of daily, weekly, and monthly financial and non- financial management reports. Identify and manage financial, operational, and compliance risks related to payment administration. Identify systemic risks, control weaknesses, and process inefficiencies within claims administration and implement corrective measures. Ensure effective monitoring and mitigation of financial, operational, and compliance risks. Manage the sub- business unit, including staff performance management, discipline, capacity development, and effective communication. Develop, implement, and monitor the operational plan of the unit and report on progress as required. Foster a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, and high performance within the unit.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Miyelani Tshabalala at 063 691 4046
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Employment Equity targets apply: preference will be given to suitably qualified African males, Indian males, Coloured males and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). Youth candidates are encouraged to apply Requirement of applications: No late applications will be considered. No faxed or emailed applications will be accepted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za and it should be accompanied by a new Z83 and a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) only. Certified copies of qualifications, Identity and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. For all SMS positions, the successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government and possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate is required prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov. za/training course/sms pre-entry-programme/. Following the interview and exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic management competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency- based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic management and development for SMS posts. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Betalingsadministrasie
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir betalingsadministrasie in die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, wat 'n NQF 6/7 finansiele kwalifikasie en 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van Matriek plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 6/7) soos deur SAQA erken in Rekeningkunde/Oudit/Finansiele Bestuur of soortgelyk. Die amp draer moet 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring op Assistentdirekteur vlak hê, of ekwivalent in rekeningkunde/oudit/finansiele bestuur of soortgelyk. Bewese ervaring in betalingsverwerking, verifikasie, afstemming, en magtiging, verkieslik binne 'n toelaagfondsomgewing. Bewese ervaring in die bestuur van hoë volume betalingstransaksies en die hantering van 'n hoogs druk omgewing en werk onder druk. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Die amp draer moet kennis en begrip hê van Menslike Nedersettings wetgewing, Nasionale behuisingskode Division of Revenue Act, Public Finance Management Act, Tesourie Regulasies, Housing Subsidy System (HSS), van die BAS (Basic Accounting System) en SAP. Begrotingsvaardighede, Finansiele Bestuursvaardighede, Probleemoplossing en analise; Besluitneming, Spanleierskap, Finansiele bestuur, Klienterigting en reaksievernuf; Beplanning en organisering; Konflikbestuur en Onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese en operasionele leierskap in die bestuur van betalingsadministrasie stelsels, beleide, prosedures, en kontroles. Hou toesig oor die akkurate vaslegging, verifikasie, verwerking, en magtiging van betalings binne die Housing Subsidy System (HSS) of relevante betalingsplatforms. Verseker nakoming van betalingsadministrasie voorskrifte, ondersteunende dokumentasie vereistes, en goedkeuringsprotokolle. Bestuur en hou toesig oor betalingsaanpassings, terugwerkings, en afwysings in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe regulasies en prosedures. Ondersoek en los komplekse betalingsverwante navrae op, insluitend lank uitstaande en betwiste betalings. Verseker die integriteit, akkuraatheid, en tydigheid van betalingsdata en transaksies. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, indiening, en implementering van stelselveranderingsbeheerversoeke (bv. OSCARS) wat verband hou met betalingsadministrasie. Verseker die opstel en indiening van daaglikse, weeklikse, en maandelikse finansiële en nie-finansiële bestuursverslae. Identifiseer en bestuur finansiële, operasionele, en nakomingsrisiko's wat verband hou met betalingsadministrasie. Identifiseer stelselmatige risiko's, beheerswakheid, en prosesdoeltreffendheid binne eisadministrasie en implementeer korrektiewe maatreëls. Verseker effektiewe monitering en matiging van finansiële, operasionele, en nakomingsrisiko's. Bestuur die sub-besigheids eenheid, insluitend personeelprestasiebestuur, dissipline, kapasiteitsontwikkeling, en effektiewe kommunikasie. Ontwikkel, implementeer, en monitor die operasionele plan van die eenheid en verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Bevorder 'n kultuur van aanspreeklikheid, etiese gedrag, en hoë prestasie binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Ongqongqoshe Ophethe: Ukuphathwa Kwezinkokhelo
zu.summary: Ongqongqoshe Ophethe ukuphathwa kwezinkokhelo e Gauteng Department of Human Settlements, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF 6/7 kwezezimali nokuthi abe namava afanele eminyakeni engu-3-5.
zu.requirements: Okungafanele kungansi ngaphansi kwamaphuzu e-Matric kanye neziqu ezingaphansi kwesiquqiwana (NQF level 6/7) ezithathwa njengezivunywe yi-SAQA kwi-Accounting/Auditing/Financial Management noma okufanayo. Lowo othathwa esikhundleni kufanele abe namava afanele eminyakeni engu-3-5 ezingeni lika-Assistant Director, noma okulinganayo kwi-accounting/auditing/financial management noma okufanayo. Kufanele abe namava abonakalayo ekucubunguleni izinkokhelo, ekuqinisekiseni, ekubambisweni kwezinto, nakemvumeni, ngokukhethekileko endaweni yokunikwa imali yosizo. Kufanele abe namava abonakalayo ekuphathweni kwenani elikhulu lezinkokhelo nokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezela okuphezulu. Kufanele abe nesilayizenisi sokushayela esivunyelwe. Amakhono & Ikhono: Lowo othathwa esikhundleni kufanele abe nokwazi nokuqonda umthetho wezobulungisi kwe-Human Settlements, i-National housing code, i-Division of Revenue Act, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Housing Subsidy System (HSS), i-BAS (Basic Accounting System) kanye ne-SAP. Amakhono okubhalela isabelomali, Amakhono okuphathwa kwezezimali, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukuphatha iqembu, Ukuphathwa kwezezimali, Ukuqaphela umthengi nokusebenza ngokumakahela; Ukuhlela nokuhlelabantu; Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga namakhono okuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkuleleko ebalulekile nenhleleleko ekuphathweni kamasistimu wokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo, izinqubo, izinhlelo, nokulawula. Qaphela ukugcinwa ngokunembile, ukuqinisekiswa, ukucubungulwa, nemvume yezinkokhelo ngaphakathi kwe-Housing Subsidy System (HSS) noma kumasistimu okukhokha ahambisanayo. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela imiyalo yokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo, izidingo zokushicilelwa kwamadokhumenti asekelwayo, nezinqubo zokuvuma. Phatha uphinde uqaphele ukulungiswa kwezinkokhelo, ukubuyiselwa emuva, nokwenqatshwa ngokuvumelana nemithetho elandelayo nalezinqubo. Phenya uphende uxazulule imibuzo eminengi ehlobene nezinkokhelo, okuhlanganisa izinkokhelo ezibekwe isikhathi eside kakhulu nazo ezipikiswanayo. Qinisekisa ukuzinembile, ukunemba, nokuqashelwa kwesikhathi kwedatha kanye nezinkokhelo. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa, ukuthunyelwa, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezicelo zokushintsha ukulawula amasistimu (njenge-OSCARS) eziphathene nokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo. Qinisekisa ukuqoqwa nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko yezindleko nengezona ezibalwa imali yansuku zonke, yamasonto, kanyenyanga. Chonga uphinde uphatse izinkinga eziphathene nezimali, ezenhleleleko, nokuzilandela umthetho ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinkokhelo. Chonga izinkinga zamasistimu, ukungabi namandla kokulawula, nokungaloleki kwezinqubo ngaphakathi kokuphathwa kwezicalo uphende usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa. Qinisekisa ukubhekwa okusebenzayo nokunciphiswa kwezinkinga eziphathene nezimali, ezenhleleleko, nokuzilandela umthetho. Phatha ingxenye yenhlangano, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi, isiyalo, ukuthuthukiswa ikhono, nokuaxhumana okusebenzayo. Thuthukisa, phumeza, uphinde uqaphele ihlelo lokusebenza lenhlangano uphende umbike ngokuba khona njengoba kudingekile. Khulisa injongo yokuziphendulela, ukuziphatha ngokuzingelayo, nokusebenza ngamandla aphakeme ngaphakathi kwenhlangano.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo LokuHlawula
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wolawulo lokuhlawula kwiSebe leZoZindlu iGauteng, lifuna izifundo ze-mali ze-NQF 6/7 kunye namava afanelekileyo eminyaka engama-3-5.
xh.requirements: Isiganga esingaphantsi kwesiNgesi kunye nesidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 6/7) esamkelwe yi-SAQA kwi-Accounting/Auditing/Financial Management okwa kufana nalo. Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka abenamava afanelekileyo eminyaka engama-3-5 kwinqanaba lomCedile weNcedo, okwa kulingana nalo kwi-accounting/auditing/financial management okwa kufana nalo. Amava abonwayo ekucwangciseni, kuqinisekiseni, ekubambiseleni, nasekuvumeleni kokuHlawula, ngokukhethwa kwindawo yokunikwa ngeemali zoxhaso. Amava abonwayo ekulawuleni iintengiswano ezininzi zokuHlawula nokusingatha indawo enengxaki enkulu kunye nokusebenza phantsi kwengxaki. Ukuba nelayisensi yokuqhuba eseyiseko. Ikhono & Amakhono: Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka abanolwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho yeZoZindlu, i-National housing code Division of Revenue Act, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Housing Subsidy System (HSS), i-BAS (Basic Accounting System) kunye ne-SAP. Ikhono lokucwangcisa iNgeno, iKhono loLawulo lweMali, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda; ukwenza izigqibo, ukukhulisa iqela, ulawulo lweMali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuphendula; ucwangciso nokuqamba; ulawulo lweempixano nokuNxibelelwana.
xh.duties: Nika inkokheli engumgameli nesebenzayo ekulawuleni iindlela, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, nolawulo lokuhlawula. Qinisekisa ukubumba okuchanekileyo, ukuqinisekisa, ukuqhuba phambili, nokuvuma ukuhlawula ngaphakathi kwi-Housing Subsidy System (HSS) okwezinye iindlela zokuHlawula. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela imithetho yolawulo lokuHlawula, iimfuno zoxhaso loxwebhu, nemiqathango yokuvuma. Lawula uqinisekise ukulungiswa, ukubuyela umva, nokwalwa kokuHlawula ngokwemiqathango elandelayo nemigaqo. Phanda uzisombulule iingxaki ezinzima ezidityaniswe nokuHlawula, kuquka ezibekade kudlule kakhulu nezityekiswayo. Qinisekisa ukuzinza, ukuqinisekisa, nexesha elichanekileyo lwedatha nokuHlawula. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa, ukungeniswa, nokusebenza kwezicelo zolawulo lolutshintsho lwenkqubo (umz. i-OSCARS) ezidityaniswe nolawulo lokuHlawula. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa nokungeniswa kwemibiko yemali nengengeyoyo yemihla ngemihla, yenyanga, kunye nenyanga. Qamba ulawule imingxaki yemali, yokusebenza, nokuZilandela ezidityaniswe nolawulo lokuHlawula. Qonda imingxaki yenkqubo, ubuthathaka bolawulo, nangcono kwezindlela ezisebenzayo ekulawuleni iindlela ze-claims uze usebenzise izithintelo ezilungisayo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nokunciphisa imingxaki yemali, yokusebenza, nokuZilandela. Lawula iyonke iqela lenkampani, kuquka ulawulo lokuSebenza kwabasebenzi, isithintelo, ukusinywa kwamakhono, nokuNxibelelwana okusebenzayo. Cwangcisa, usebenzise, ulawule ucwangciso lokusebenza loludidi uphinde uchaze inkqubela njengoko kufuneka. Khuthaza inkqubo yobuxanduva, indlela yokuziphatha ngokuziphatha, nokusebenza kakuhle kakhulu ngaphakathi kweqela.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Income & Expenditure Control
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role at the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements overseeing income and expenditure control, grant claims verification, and financial administration.
jobs.requirements: A Matric plus a National Diploma/ Degree in Finance/Cost & Management Accounting / B Com Accounting or any relevant qualification at NQF Level 6/7 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years relevant experience at Admin Officer level within financial administration or management accounting environment. Possession of a valid driver’s license. The candidate should have knowledge of Public Financial Management Act, Knowledge of Treasury Regulations, Knowledge of Division of Revenue Act; BAS & SAP System. Planning, organising and execution; knowledge management; strategic management and ability to manage conflict. Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership, People Management and empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Problem solving and analysis, Client orientation and customer focus, Service Delivery Innovation, Honesty and Integrity. Personal Attributes: Good written and verbal communication skills. Self-management. Work well under pressure. Good Interpersonal skills. Negotiation skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor and implement the verification of grant claims and invoices relating to operational / Goods and Services. Monitor if the Financial Authorization form is signed by relevant official and check if the name of the entity on the FA it corresponds with the invoice attached. Monitor whether the contact, claim form, HSS for, claim progress payment and document check list are attached. Monitor if the total amount on the FA, HSS form and claim. Facilitate the payment of claims and invoices Ensure that all the documents are attached as per procurements regulations, quotation regulations, quotation, invoices, appointment letter and delivery note. Monitor invoices on SAP for validity of the following: Tax Clearance Certificate, Vendor number, invoice amount and bank account. Capture correct invoices on SAP in line with correct budget allocations . Attend to suppliers’ queries and payment related queries from internal and external stakeholders. Facilitate the scanning of claims from the E-Gov using SAP for payment purpose. Pass a correcting journal on SAP for all misallocations identified through verification process. Ensure the vendor number and vendor name, SAP account number, reference number, gross and net amount corresponds with the details on the invoice. Compile and update exception report on payments paid within 15 and 30 days on a weekly, monthly and quarterly basis and submit to the Senior State Accountant for review. Monitor expenditure report for discrepancies for overspending and submit to the Senior State Accountant for review and inputs from budget holders. Supervision of staff. Maintenance of discipline. Management of performance and development. Ensure establishment, implementation and maintenance of efficient and effective communication arrangements. Plan and allocate work. Prepare meeting packages and perform secretariat functions during the meetings and presentations.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Inkomste- en Uitgawebeheer
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-pos by die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements wat toesig hou oor inkomste- en uitgawebeheer, verifikasie van toelaag-eise en finansiële administrasie.
af.requirements: A Matric plus 'n Nasionale Diploma/ Graad in Finansies/Kosteberekening en Bestuursrekeningkunde / B Com Accounting of enige relevante kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 6/7 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring op Admin Officer-vlak binne 'n finansiële administrasie- of bestuursrekeningkunde-omgewing. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die kandidaat moet kennis hê van die Public Financial Management Act, kennis van Treasury Regulations, kennis van die Division of Revenue Act; BAS & SAP-stelsel. Beplanning, organisering en uitvoering; kennisbestuur; strategiese bestuur en die vermoë om konflik te bestuur. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise, kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus, diensleweringinnovasie, eerlikheid en integriteit. Persoonlike eienskappe: Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Selfbestuur. Werk goed onder druk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Onderhandelingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor en implementeer die verifikasie van toelaag-eise en fakture met betrekking tot operasionele / Goedere en Dienste. Monitor of die Financial Authorization-vorm deur die relevante beampte onderteken is en kontroleer of die naam van die entiteit op die FA ooreenstem met die aangehegte faktuur. Monitor of die kontrak, eisvorm, HSS-vorm, eisvoortgangsbetaling en dokumentkontrolelys aangeheg is. Monitor of die totale bedrag op die FA, HSS-vorm en eis. Fasiliteer die betaling van eise en fakture. Verseker dat alle dokumente aangeheg is volgens bekomstenisregulasies, kwotasie-regulasies, kwotasie, fakture, aanstellingsbrief en afleweringnota. Monitor fakture op SAP vir geldigheid van die volgende: Tax Clearance Certificate, Vendor number, faktuurbedrag en bankrekening. Voer korrekte fakture op SAP in ooreenkomstig korrekte begrotingstoekenningar. Hanteer verskaffers se navrae en betalingsverwante navrae van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Fasiliteer die skandering van eise vanaf die E-Gov deur SAP vir betalingsdoeleindes. Boek 'n korrigerende joernaal op SAP vir alle wan toekenninge wat deur die verifikasieproses geïdentifiseer is. Verseker dat die vendor number en verskaffernaam, SAP-rekeningnommer, verwysingsnommer, bruto en netto bedrag ooreenstem met die besonderhede op die faktuur. Stel op en dateer die uitsonderingsverslag oor betalings binne 15 en 30 dae op 'n weeklikse, maandelikse en kwartaallikse basis en dien dit by die Senior State Accountant in vir hersiening. Monitor uitgaweverslag vir afwykings vir oorbesteding en dien dit by die Senior State Accountant in vir hersiening en insetsels van begrotingshouers. Toesig oor personeel. Onderhoud van dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Verseker die instelling, implementering en onderhoud van doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Beplan en allokeer werk. Berei vergaderpakette voor en verrig sekretariaatfunksies tydens vergaderings en aanbiedings.

zu.title: Onqumula Wezinsiza: Ukulawula Inzuzo Nentela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnqumula Wezinsiza eGauteng Department of Human Settlements esibhekele ukulawula inzuzo nentela, ukuqinisekisa izimangalo zemali yenikelo, kanye nobuqhwaba bezimali.
zu.requirements: Isithasisi samatikidi se-Matric kanye ne-National Diploma/ Degree kwi-Finance/Cost & Management Accounting / B Com Accounting noma noma yikuphi okufanele kwesigaba se-NQF Level 6/7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ubulula eminyakeni engu-3-5 yeminhlelo yamava ohlelweni lwe-Admin Officer level ngaphakathi kwendawo yobuqhwaba bezimali noma ohlelweni lokubala komphathi. Kuba nesikwiidi sokushaya esivunyelwe. Kufanele umuntu abe nolwazi mayelana ne-Public Financial Management Act, ulwazi nge-Treasury Regulations, ulwazi nge-Division of Revenue Act; BAS & SAP System. Ukucubungula, ukuhlela kanye nokuphumeza; ukulawula ulwazi; ukulawula ngobuchule kanye nendlela yokuphatha phansi koni. Amakhono: Ikghono lokubukeka phambili nokuholwa, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa, ukuphatha amaprogramu namaphrojekthi, ukuphatha imali nokuphatha izinguquko. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuahlukanisa, ukuqondiswa kumthengi nogqozi lomthengi, ukuthuthukisa inkonzo, ukwethembeka nokubaqinile. Izakhiwo zobuntu: Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma. Ukuzilawula. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwegcindezi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi ufeke izimangalo zemali yenikelo namabhilidi ahlobene nokusebenza / Izimpahla kanye Nezinsiza. Qapha ukuthi ifomu Lokugunyazwa Kwezimali lisayiniwe yisikhulu esifanele futhi uhlole ukuthi igama lenhlangano ku-FFA sihambisana nombilidi oshuthezelwe. Qapha ukuthi koni, ifomu lesimangalo, ifomu le-HSS, inkokhelo yeqiniso lesimangalo kanye nohlu lokuhlolwa kwamadokhumenti ashuthezelwe. Qapha inani eliphelele ku-FA, ifomu le-HSS nesimangalo. Phatha inkokhelo yezimangalo namabhilidi. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti ashuthezelwe njengokuhlelwa kwemithetho yokuthenga, imithetho yamacashelo, igama elinikezwe, amabhilidi, incwadi yokumiswa kanye nenkomba yokulethwa. Qapha amabhilidi ku-SAP ukuze uqinisekise okulandelayo: Isitifikedi Sokuhlanza Intela, inombolo yomdayisi, inani lembilidi kanye naku-akhawunti yebhange. Faka amabhilidi ahlakaniphile ku-SAP ngokuhambisana nokwabiwa kwesabelo esihlanakaniphile. Phendula imibuzo yabakhiyiza kanye nemibuzo ehlobene nenkokhelo evela kubaphathi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha ukuskena kwezimangalo kusuka ku-E-Gov kusebenzisa i-SAP ngenjongo yokukhokha. Dlulisa i-journal yekilashe ku-SAP yonke imikhuba engahambisani etholakale ngenqubo yokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi inombolo yomdayisi negama lakhe, inombolo ye-akhawunti ye-SAP, inombolo yokugcina, inani eliphelele nelingaxhunyiwe kahle nemininingwane ebhilidini. Hlela futhi uvuselele umbiko wokuhluka ngemikhokho ekhokhiwe ngaphakathi kwamahanga angu-15 nangu-30 ngesonto, inyanga nangesikhathi senyanga yonke futhi uwufake kuka-Senior State Accountant ukuze uqashelwe. Qapha umbiko wentela ngokweqile ngenkukhu yemali eqede isabelo futhi uwufake kuka-Senior State Accountant ukuze uqashelwe futhi athole imininingwane kubanikoholo. Ukuphatha abasebenzi. Ukugcina isithunzi. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kanye nentuthuko. Qinisekisa ukumiswa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqiniswa kobuhle bokuxhumana. Hlela futhi wabelwe umsebenzi. Hlela imibhalo yomhlangano futhi wenze umsebenzi wesibili ngesikhathi somhlangano kanye nezethulo.

xh.title: Umphathi ongcwatileyo: Ulawulo Lwentsengo Nemali Etsusekayo
xh.summary: Indima yomphathi ongcwatileyo kwisebe le-Gauteng Department of Human Settlements elibhekisele kulawulo lwentsengo nemali etsusekayo, ukuqinisekisa amagama ezibonelelo, kunye nolawulo lwezimali.
xh.requirements: I-Matric enye ne-National Diploma/ Degree kwi-Finance/Cost & Management Accounting / B Com Accounting okanye naliphi na igqeba elinjalo kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 6/7 njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka yamava engu-3-5 ngokubanzi kwinqanaba le-Admin Officer kwindawo yolawulo lwezimali okanye kwelohlelo lokubala izindleko. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela. Umsebenzi kufuneka abe nolwazi nge-Public Financial Management Act, ulwazi nge-Treasury Regulations, ulwazi nge-Division of Revenue Act; BAS & SAP System. Ukuqamba, ukulungiselela nokuphumeza; ulawulo lolwazi; ulawulo oluhle njengeqela nendlela yokulawula iminceli. Iimpawu zekhono: Ikhono lokuba nomongo ohleliweyo nokuba nogunya, ulawuloabantu nokuqinisekisa amandla, ulawulohlelo, ulawulo lwemali nokuguqula imisebenzi. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya, ukujolisa kwabathengi, iimbono ezintsha ekulekeleleni, ukuqiniseka nokuzithembisa. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ikhono elihle lokubhala nokuqhathanisa ngemilo. Ukuqonda ngokuzilawula. Ukusebenza kakuhle nangantsixeko. Ikhono elihle lokuhambelana nabantu. Ikhono lokuxoxisana.
xh.duties: Qaphela uze usebenzise ukuqinisekisa amagama ezibonelelo namafomu etyala ahlobene nemisebenzi / Iimpahla kunye namacebo ashukumisayo. Qaphela ukuba ifomu le-Financial Authorization litityiniwe ngumsebenzi ochukumileyo uze ululeke ukuba igama lenkundla kwi-FA luhambelana nefomu etyala elitshiwhiweyo. Qaphela ukuba idilesi, ifomu legama, ifomu le-HSS, inkqubela yentlawulo yegama neluhlu lwezifundo zokuhlola zifakelwe. Qaphela ukubona imali yonke kwifomu le-FA, ifomu le-HSS negama. Khokelela intlawulo yamagama namafomu etyala. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imifanekiso ifakelwe njengoko kuchazwe kumthetho wokuthenga, kumthetho wamanqaku, amanqaku, amafomu etyala, ileta yokwamkelwa nokubuyisa ukutsha. Qaphela amafomu etyala kwi-SAP ukuqinisekisa ukuthembeka kwala: Isatifikethi esula irhwetyo, inamba yomthengi, inamba yemali yefomu etyala narekhodi lebhanki. Thumela ngokuchanekileyo amafomu etyala kwi-SAP ngokuhambelana nezigqeba ezichanekileyo zebhajeti. Phendula imibuzo yabahlinzeki nemibuzo ehlobene nentlawulo evela kubantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Khokelela ukuskaniwa kwamagama kwi-E-Gov kusetyenziswa i-SAP ngenjongo yentlawulo. Hamba ngomhlathi wokulungisa kwi-SAP kuzo zonke izinto ezingachanekileyo ezifunyanwe ngokuqhuba ukuhlola. Qinisekisa ukuba inamba yomthengi negama, inamba yekhonte kwi-SAP, inamba yokubhekisa, imali yonke nenani eptshehlayo ahambelana nezinto ezikwifomu etyala. Hlanganisa uze uhlaziye ingxelo ngeentlawulo ezihlawulwe kwimali yemihla eli-15 neli-30 ngeveki, inyanga kunye nethyhedyana uze uyithumle kumQhathwa weSizwe oMkhulu ukuze ayijonge. Qaphela ingxelo yemali echithekiyo ukuzimela okudlula kumda uze uyithumle kumQhathwa weSizwe oMkhulu ukuze ajonge anike izimvo kubantu abaphethe izigqeba. Ukwengamela abasebenzi. Ukugcina urhulumente. Ulawulo lokuqhuba nokukhula. Qinisekisa ukuqatshwa, ukusetyenziswa nokugcinwa kolwakhwe lokunxibelelwana oluyimveli. Cwangcisa ukwabelana komsebenzi. Lungiselela amaqeku abakhiwo kwaye wenze imisebenzi yobhedeshile kwicawa kunye nemiboniso.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Contract Management
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Contract Management in Johannesburg, requiring a degree and 3 to 5 years of experience in contract management or SCM.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus Degree in Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Management or equivalent in a related field. Minimum of 3- 5 years’ Admin Officer level experience in Contract Management/ SCM environment. Possession of a valid driver’s License. People management and leadership skills. Attention to detail. Communication skills. Problem solving skills. Analytical skills. Time Management skills. Ability to perform under pressure. Knowledge, understanding and application of relevant applicable acts, Treasury Regulations and Instruction Notes in relation to SCM. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate experience in a contract management or equivalent role in a procurement environment. Good working knowledge of contract management processes and techniques including the implementation of the contract life cycle. High level of interpersonal skills, including the ability to liaise effectively with a range of stakeholders to resolve queries. Ensure compliant contract administrative activities daily. Maintain performance records for reporting and governance purposes. Analyse the evaluation reports and develop a tool for reporting on non-compliant service providers. Monitor contract performance and compliance with the contract stipulations, contract management plan, risk management plan and organisational policies and procedures. Administer variations to the contracts. Effectively manage disputes in the contract management environment. Draft and maintain a Comprehensive Contract Register as prescribed. Monitor the implementation of contract management policy and standard operating procedures. Ensure safe keeping and accessibility of all contract documentation. Prepare monthly, quarterly and ad hoc contract management reports. Provide inputs into accruals, commitments, and audit reporting requirements. Ensure alignment with SAP or relevant systems for contract tracking. Allocate and monitor work to ensure timely execution of contract management functions. Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and service delivery excellence. Supervise staff.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Miyelani Tshabalala at 063 691 4046
jobs.applications: Please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Employment Equity targets apply: preference will be given to suitably qualified African males, Indian males, Coloured males and Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). Youth candidates are encouraged to apply Requirement of applications: No late applications will be considered. No faxed or emailed applications will be accepted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications should be submitted strictly online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za and it should be accompanied by a new Z83 and a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) only. Certified copies of qualifications, Identity and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Correspondence will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you have not been contacted within 3 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. For all SMS positions, the successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government and possession of the SMS Pre-Entry Certificate is required prior to appointment. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov. za/training course/sms pre-entry-programme/. Following the interview and exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic management competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency- based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic management and development for SMS posts. The Department reserves the right not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kontrakbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Kontrakbestuur in Johannesburg, wat 'n graad en 3 tot 5 jaar se ervaring in kontrakbestuur of SCM vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek plus 'n Graad in Voorsieningsketting / Logistiek / Aankope / Openbare Bestuur of gelykwaardig in 'n verwante veld. Minimum van 3- 5 jaar se ervaring as Administratiewe Beampte-vlak in 'n Kontrakbestuur-/ SCM-omgewing. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Mensebestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Aandag aan detail. Kommunikasievaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te presteer. Kennis, begrip en toepassing van toepaslike wetgewing, Tesourie-regulasies en Instruksienotas in verband met SCM. Rekenvaardigheid.
af.duties: Toon ervaring in 'n kontrakbestuurs- of gelykwaardige rol in 'n verkrygingsomgewing. Goeie werkende kennis van kontrakbestuursprosesse en -tegnieke, insluitend die implementering van die kontraklewensiklus. Hoë vlak van interpersoonlike vaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om doeltreffend met 'n verskeidenheid belanghebbendes te skakel om navrae op te los. Verseker daagliks nakoming van kontrakadministratiewe aktiwiteite. Handhaaf prestasierekords vir verslagdoenings- en beheerdoeleindes. Analiseer die evalueringsverslae en ontwikkel 'n instrument vir verslagdoening oor nie-nakomende diensverskaffers. Monitor kontrakprestasie en nakoming van die kontrakbepalings, kontrakbestuursplan, risikobestuursplan en organisatoriese beleide en prosedures. Administreer wysigings aan die kontrakte. Bestuur geskille doeltreffend in die kontrakbestuursomgewing. Opstel en handhaaf 'n Omvattende Kontrakregister soos voorgeskryf. Monitor die implementering van kontrakbestuursbeleid en standaardbedryfsprosedures. Verseker veilige bewaring en toeganklikheid van alle kontrakdokumentasie. Berei maandelikse, kwartaallikse en ad hoc-kontrakbestuursverslae voor. Verskaf insette in agterstande, verbintenis- en oudit-verslagdoeningsvereistes. Verseker belyning met SAP of toepaslike stelsels vir kontrakopvolging. Wi werk toe en monitor dit om tydige uitvoering van kontrakbestuursfunksies te verseker. Bevorder 'n kultuur van verantwoordelikheid, spanwerk en uitnemende dienslewering. Hou toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Umsekeli Weqhaza: Ukuphathwa Kwamakontrathi
zu.summary: Umsekeli Weqhaza Wokuphathwa Kwamakontrathi eJohannesburg, ofuna idigri nobunye iminyaka engu-3 kuya ku-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphathweni kwamakontrathi noma kwi-SCM.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikhi yamabanga aphezulu (Matric) ene-Digri kwi-Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Management noma okulinganayo kwesigaba esihlobene. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho ezingeni lika-Admin Officer ekuphathweni kwamakontrathi/nasimondweni se-SCM. Ukuba nodawuni wesimoto esebenzayo. Amakhono okuphatha abantu nokuba ngumholi. Ukuqaphela iminikelo. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa umthetho ohambisana nawo, Izindlela ze-Treasury kanye nezaziso eziyisihluthulelo ezihlobene ne-SCM. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Fakisa izinkomba zohlangenwe nakho ekuphathweni kwamakontrathi noma esikhundleni esilinganayo esimondweni sokuthenga. Ulwazi oluhle lokuqonda izinqubo namakhono okuphatha amakontrathi okuhlanganisa nokuphatha umjikelezo wempilo yamakontrathi. Izinga eliphezulu lamakhono okuxhumana nothile, okuhlanganisa ikhono lokuxhumana kahle namalungu abahlukene abahlobene nenhlangano ukuxazulula izibuzo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yokuphatha amakontrathi ihambisana nemithetho nsuku zonke. Gcina irekhodi lenkulo yezinto zokusebenza ukuze kusetshenziselwe ukubika nokuphatha kwenhlangano. Hlaziya imibiko yokuqashwa kwenze ithuluzi lokubika ngabahlinzeki abangahambisani nemithetho. Qapha inkulo yamakontrathi nokuhambisana nemigomo yamakontrathi, ihlelo lokuphatha amakontrathi, ihlelo lokuphatha ingozi kanye nemigomo kanye nezinqubo zenhlangano. Phatha izinguquko ezweni amakontrathi. Phatha ngempumelelo iziphikishano esimondweni sokuphatha amakontrathi. Hlola futhi ugcine i-Contract Register eliphelele njengoba kumiselwe. Qapha ukuphathwa komgomo wokuphatha amakontrathi kanye nezinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuphepha kanye nokufinyeleleka kwawo wonke amadokhumenti amakontrathi. Lungiselela imibiko yokuqashwa kwamakontrathi yenyanga, yenhlanganisela kanye naleyo yokuphela. Nikeza izinto ezibhalwayo mayelana nokwanda kwezimali, izibopho, kanye nezidingo zokubika ukubukeza. Qinisekisa ukuvumelanisa ne-SAP noma amasistimu ahlobene ekulandeleni amakontrathi. Hlola futhi qapha umsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelelisa ngokwesikhathi imisebenzi yokuphatha amakontrathi. Khuthaza injongo yokubhekana phansi, ukusebenza njengesiqhaza kanye nempumelelo ekulethweni izinsiza. Qapha abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi ongumingqi: Ulawulo Lweenkonzo
xh.summary: Umphathi ongumingqi wokuLawula iinkonzo eJohannesburg, ofuna isidanga kunye neminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwi-5 yamava kulawulo lweenkonzo okanye kwi-SCM.
xh.requirements: Isidanga samabakala siphusunye kwisiNkulu saseSikolweni sidityaniswe nesidanga kwi-Supply Chain / Logistics / Purchasing / Public Management okanye esilinganayo kwindawo ehlobene nayo. Iminyaka engama-3 ukuya ku-5 yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi wolawulo kwimeko yokulawula iinkonzo/ SCM. Ukuba nesiqinisekiso sokushayela esivunyelwe. Amakhono obulawuli babantu nokuqhatha. Ukunakela iinkcukacha. Amakhono enxibelelwano. Amakhono ox ukusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono okuhlola nokuhlalutywa. Amakhono olawulo lexesha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa imithetho ehlobene nayoo, iMigaqo yeQelele kunye neNkcazelo yeziLayishiso ngokubalene ne-SCM. Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Bonisa amava kwinkonzo yokulawula iinkonzo okanye enye enjalo kwimeko yokuthenga. Ulwazi olululo ngokusebenza ngokwemiqathango yokulawula iinkonzo nekuchaza iindlela zokwenza oku kuquka ukusebenzisa ibhalo yexesha lonke lenkonzo. Amakhono aphakamileyo onxibelelwano namathandathu, kuquka nakhono lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo nomntu onguluhlu lweentsapho zokusingatha okanye zokuqinisekisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqinisekisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusombulula iimibuzo. Qinisekisa ukwenza izenzo ezilawulayo zolawulo lweenkonzo qobo. Zigcine iirekhodi zokusebenza ngomgaqo-nkqubo weempawu zokubika nangamagunya lokwenza izinto. Hlola iingxelo zokuhlola uze udalwe isixhobo sokubika ngabakhiqizi abangahambelaniyo nemigaqo. Lilisele inkonzo yokulawula iinkonzo nokuhambelana nemigaqo yekontrakti, indlela yokulawula inkonzo, indlela yokulawula iingozi, iinkqubo zolawulo nemigaqo yenkokhelo. Lawula iinguqu ezingeniswa kwiiNkonzo. Yonke iingxabano kwindawo yokulawula iinkonzo zicwangciswe ngokufanelekileyo. Bhala uze ulondoloze uBhalo olubanzi lweenkonzo njengoko kumiselwe. Lilisele ukusebenziswa kwengqungquthela yolawulo lweenkonzo nemigaqo esemthethweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kakuhle nokuphonononga kolwazi olupheleleyo ngeenkonzo. Lungiselela iingxelo zenyanga zonke, zethatu kunye nezongezelelweyo zolawulo lweenkonzo. Nikela ngegalelo kwi-accruals, naziinkitshobo, nemfuno yokuqinisekisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubika. Qinisekisa ukuthelekiswa neSAP okanye iinkqubo ezifaneleyo zokuqhuba iinkonzo. Qamba ulawulo lolawulo lweenkonzo uze ulilisele ukusetyenziswa kweenkonzo. Khuthaza inkqubo yokuziphendulela, ukusebenza njengomanyano, nokusebenza ngokugqithisileyo. Qhuba abasebenzi ngokulawula iinkonzo ngokwezigqibo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Demand and Acquisition Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, (plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: Manage demand and acquisition functions including procurement planning, policy development and bid committee facilitation for the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements.

A minimum of 3 - 5 years’ relevant experience within Supply Chain Management environment at Admin Officer level. The candidate should have knowledge of all the Public Service prescripts applicable to the role as well as the Department’s mandate. Knowledge of performance management frameworks applicable in the Public Service and proven strategies in performance improvement. Competencies: Strategic capability and Leadership, People Management and empowerment, Programme and Project Management, Financial Management and Change Management. Problem solving and analysis, Client orientation and customer focus, Service Delivery Innovation, Honesty and Integrity. Personal Attributes: Good written and verbal communication skills. Self-motivated. Work well under pressure. Good Interpersonal skills. Supportive and knowing how to draw the best energy out of the team. Reliable and Responsible. Positive attitude.

Compile the procurement plan. Facilitate the execution of the procurement plan. Setting up the Bid Evaluation, Bid Adjudication and Bid Specification Committees and render a secretariat service to the relevant committees including the bid adjudication committee. Oversee the appointment of bid committee members. Compilation of bid documents and advertisements. Facilitate publishing of bid documents. Receipt (closing and opening) of bid documents. Ensure safekeeping and access to SCM records. Compile reports on the execution of the procurement plan and other related supply chain management administrative reports. Develop and manage the operational plan of the unit and report on progress as required. Develop, implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Plan and allocate work.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vraag- en Verwerwingbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur vraag- en verwerwingfunksies, insluitend verkrygingsbeplanning, beleidsontwikkeling en fasilitering van biekomitees vir die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements.
af.requirements: 'n Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie, Graad/Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6/7) soos deur SAQA erken in Supply Chain Management. 'n Minimum van 3 - 5 jaar se relevante ervaring binne 'n Supply Chain Management-omgewing op Admin Officer-vlak. Die kandidaat moet kennis hê van alle Openbare Diens-voorskrifte wat op die rol van toepassing is, asook die departement se mandaat. Kennis van prestasiebestuursraamwerke van toepassing in die Openbare Diens en bewese strategieë vir prestasieverbetering. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, kliëntgerigtheid en klienstant, diensleweringsinnovasie, eerlikheid en integriteit. Persoonlike eienskappe: Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Selfgemotiveerd. Werk goed onder druk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Ondersteunend en weet hoe om die beste energie uit die span te haal. Betroubaar en verantwoordelik. Positiewe houding.
af.duties: Voer die funksionele werking van Vraag- en Verwerwingbestuur uit. Ontwerp en ontwikkel vraag- en verwerwingbestuursbeleid prosesse en prosedures. Stel die verkrygingsplan op. Fasiliteer die uitvoering van die verkrygingsplan. Stel die Bie-evaluerings-, Bie-berekenings- en Bie-spesifikasiekomitees op en lewer 'n sekretariatsdiens aan die betrokke komitees, insluitend die bie-berekeningskomitee. Hou toesig oor die aanstelling van biekomiteelede. Opstel van biedokumente en advertensies. Fasiliteer publikasie van biedokumente. Ontvang (sluiting en opening) van biedokumente. Verseker veilige bewaring en toegang tot SCM-rekords. Stel verslae op oor die uitvoering van die verkrygingsplan en ander verwante supply chain management-administratiewe verslae. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die eenheid en doen soos vereist verslag oor vordering. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Beplan en allokeer werk.

zu.title: Umcedisi Weqonga: Ukuqashwa nokuphathwa kokutholwayo
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yokuqashwa nokuphathwa kokutholwayo okuhlanganisa ukuhlela kokuthengwayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo nokuqondisa amakomidi ohlelo lwemisebenzi lukahulumende waseGauteng Department of Human Settlements.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye nesidanga sokungena esikoleni esiphakeme, i-Degree/National Diploma (NQF level 6/7) njengoba kuhlonzwa u-SAQA kwi-Supply Chain Management. Okungenani izinyanga eziyi-3 - 5 zeminyaka yohluvo oluhambisana nomkhakha we-Supply Chain Management ezingeni labaMlawuli. Kufanele ukuthi ophakanyiwe anolwazi lwawo wonke amagunya womphakatha asemthethweni asebenza kulesi sikhundla kanye nemitsa yaleLo mnyango. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokuqondiswa kokusebenza ezisebenzayo kuPhakade loMphakatha kanye nezindlela ezivezwe ukuthuthukiswa kokusebenza. Izindlela: Ikono lokubusa nokuhola, ukuqondisa abantu nokubabusisa, ukuqondisa amaprojekhi, ukuqondisa izimali kanye noGuqulo lokuqondisa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuqondiswa kubathengi, ukuqashelwa kwesevisi, ukuqashelwa kwamakhasimodi, ukuthuthukiswa kokuhanjiswa kwesevisi, ukuqinisekiswa nokuba namandla. Izimpawu zomuntu: Amakhono okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Ukuqondisa kabuso. Ukusebenza kahle ngaphansi komfutho. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukusekela kanye nokuqonda ukuthi ungathatha kanjani amandla amaningi eqenjini. Ukuthembeka kanye nokuqonda izibopho. Bakube ukuba nomumo ohamba kahle.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kokutholwayo nokutholwayo kokuthengwayo. Hlela bese uthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye nezindlela zokuphathwa kokutholwayo nokuthengwayo. Hlela inqubo yokuthengwayo. Qondisa ukwenziwa kwenqubo yokuthengwayo. Misela amaKomidiokuQamba, aBhalisikanye namaKomidiokuQondisa bese unikeza isevisi yasekela amakomidi ahambisana nalawo okubaliza kuhlanganise nekhomidi lokuhlaziya imigqomo. Qaphela ukumiswa kwamalungu amakomidi emigqomo. Ukubhala imibhalo yemigqomo kanye nokukhangisa. Qondisa ukushicilelwa kwemibhalo yemigqomo. Ukuthola (ukuvala nokuqamba) imibhalo yemigqomo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokuqondiswa kolwazi mayelana namafayela e-SCM. Hlela imibhalo mayelana nokuqashwa kwenqubo yokuthengwayo kanye nemibhalo esesikhundleni semphathi ye-Supply Chain Management. Hlela bese uphatha inqubo yokusebenza kwesigaba bese ubika ngentuthuko njengoba kudingwa. Hlela, faka esikhundleni bese ulondoloza izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukulawulwa okulungile komsebenzi. Hlela bese uthumela yonke imibhalo ephathelene nokuqondiswa. Cima bese uqondisa umsebenzi.

xh.title: uMqogi ongene entlango: uLawulo lofuno nokuZuulwa
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yofuno nokuZuulwa kuquza nokuCwangcisa ukuthenga, uPhuculo lweNkqubo nokukhokelela kwamakomiti enxaxheba iSebe leGauteng Department of Human Settlements.
xh.requirements: iMatric kunye nelayisensi ezingeni elingezantsi, iDangwe/iNqanaba leSizwe (NQF level 6/7) njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA kwiLawulo leNkqubo yoQoqosho. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi3 - 5 yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yoLawulo leNkqubo yoQoqosho kwinqanaba loGunyi Wolawulo. Umama kufuneka abe nolwazi ngawo onke amagazethi eNkonzo kaZizwe agqithiselwa kulesi sithuba kwakunye nethonya leSebe. Ulwazi ngamakhowuda alawulo ukuphumeza imisebenzi asebenzayo kwiNkonzo kaZizwe nolwazi oluchanekileyo ekuphuculeni ukusebenza. Ikhono elikho: Ikhono lokulawula nokuBa buNtununtusu, uLawulo lwabantu nokuNika amandla, uLawulo lweNkqubo namaprojekthi, uLawulo lweMali nokuTshintsha uLawulo. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuPhengulula, ukujolisa kumxhasi nokuJolisa kumthengi, uTshintsho lweNkonzo eyiswa, uQaqambileyo nokuZinikela. Iimpawu zobuNtu: Ikhono elilula kolwimi nobuNgosi. UkuZigqatsela. Ukusebenza kakuhle phantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono elilula kwabathintana nabo. UkuNxaxheba nokuBanga ukuphuma kwamandla amnandi eqela. UTHembekile nokuNxiba uxanduva. IMoya oNtle.
xh.duties: Zenza imisebenzi esemqoka yoLawulo loFuno nokuZuulwa. Zila kwaye zandise iindlela, iinkqubo namacebo alawulo lofuno nokuZuulwa. Hlaziya icebo lokuthenga. Sikhokela ukuphumeza icebo lokuthenga. Misela amaKomiti woQeqesho loNxaxheba, uNqumlo lweNxaxheba nokuQulunqwa kweNxaxheba kwaye unikeze inkonzo yobungaziki kwikomiti ezinzayo kuquka nekomiti yonqamlezo wenxaxheba. Qaphela ukumiswa kwamalungu amakomiti enxaxheba. Ukuqulunqwa kwamaxwebhu enxaxheba nokuQuquzelela. Sikhokela ukushicilelwa kwamaxwebhu enxaxheba. Ukufumana (ukuvala nokuVula) amaxwebhu enxaxheba. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa nokuFikelela kumagama eSCM. Hlaziya iingxelo ngokuphumeza icebo lokuthenga nakuwo owamanye amaxwebhu olawulo olunxulumene nolawulo lweNkqubo yoQoqosho. Yila kwaye ulawule icebo lokusebenza leYunithi kwaye uchaze inkqubela njengoko kufuneka. Yila, phumeza kwaye zigcine iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olululo lwemisebenzi. Hlaziya kwaye unikeze yonke iingxelo zolawulo ezifunekayo. Cwangcisa kwaye wabelane ngomsebenzi.

jobs.summary: GISc Technologist sought by the Gauteng Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg to conduct spatial data collection, analysis and database design.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus three (3) to four (4) years GIS degree or related bachelor’s degree coupled with 3 years post Technologist experience. Compulsory registration with PLATO. Possession of a valid driver’s licence. Strong GIS skills with two or more GIS packages (e.g. ESRI). Ability to use science and Technology effectively and critically. Knowledge of legal compliance. Problem solving and analysis. Conflict management. Decision making. Financial management. Team leadership. Conflict management.
jobs.duties: Conduct all GISc technical functions. Collect and capture of data from various formats and sources. Design and implement a spatial database to store the required datasets. Data manipulation and analysis including quality assurance. Creation and maintenance of spatial data topology and attributes, format manipulation. Apply geo-referencing, datum and projection transformations. Providing technical support relating to software and data usage to geographic information system (GISc) users. Design, develop and create geo-databases, maps and other related project. Promote and participate in stakeholder relations. Maintain GISc unit effectiveness. Develop Geographical Information Science (GISc) spatial information tools within organization process. Provide access to Spatial Information and Geographic Information Services to all clients in the Department. Train end users on skills regarding to GISc at all times. Ensure interoperability between systems to maximize efficiency. Publish data into a web based GISc system to provide Geographical Information through the internet. Facilitate GISc implementation. Undertake system audit. Undertake requirements analysis. Undertake cost benefit analysis. Develop process model and workflows diagram. Implement GIS standards. Draft Terms of Reference for GIS projects. Conduct research on new GIS technologies. Research, investigate and advice on new GIS technologies. Advise on research viability and feasibility. Recommend and compile appropriate plan to respond to the research problem. Develop new methods/technologies for solving spatial data problems. Research and implement new GIS standards. Governance. Allocate, control, monitor and report on all resources. Manage and implement knowledge sharing initiatives e.g. short-term assignments and secondments within and across operations, in support of individual development plans, operational requirements and return on investment; and Continuously monitor the exchange and protection of information between operations and individuals to ensure effective knowledge management according to departmental objectives.

af.title: Gisc Tegnolog Produk sie Graad a
af.summary: GISc Tegnolog gesoek deur die Gauteng Department of Human Settlements in Johannesburg om ruimtelike dataversameling, ontleding en databasisontwerp uit te voer.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus drie (3) tot vier (4) jaar GIS-graad of verwante baccalaureusgraad gekoppel aan 3 jaar na-Tegnoloog-ervaring. Verpligte registrasie by PLATO. Besit van 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Sterk GIS-vaardighede met twee of meer GIS-pakette (bv. ESRI). Vermoë om wetenskap en tegnologie doeltreffend en krities te gebruik. Kennis van regsnavolging. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Konflikbestuur. Besluitneming. Finansiële bestuur. Spanleierskap. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Voer alle GISc tegniese funksies uit. Versamel en vang data uit verskeie formate en bronne. Ontwerp en implementeer 'n ruimtelike databasis om die vereiste datastelle te stoor. Datamanipulasie en ontleding insluitend kwaliteitsversekering. Skepping en onderhoud van ruimtelike datatopologie en -eienskappe, formaatmanipulasie. Pas geoverwysing, datum- en projeksietransformasies toe. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning rakende sagteware en datagebruik aan geografiese inligtingstelsel (GISc) gebruikers. Ontwerp, ontwikkel en skep geodatabasisse, kaarte en ander verwante projekte. Bevorder en neem deel aan belanghebbenderelaties. Handhaaf GISc-eenheid se doeltreffendheid. Ontwikkel Geografiese Inligtingswetenskap (GISc) ruimtelike inligtingshulpmiddels binne organisasieprosesse. Verskaf toegang tot ruimtelike inligting en geografiese inligtingsdienste aan alle kliënte in die Departement. Lei eindgebruikers te alle tye in vaardighede rakende GISc. Verseker interoperabiliteit tussen stelsels om doeltreffendheid te maksimeer. Publiseer data in 'n webgebaseerde GISc-stelsel om geografiese inligting via die internet te verskaf. Fasiliteer GISc-implementering. Onderneem stelseloudit. Onderneem vereiste-ontleding. Onderneem koste-batenontleding. Ontwikkel prosesmodelle en werksvloeidiagramme. Implementeer GIS-standaarde. Opstel Terme van Verwysing vir GIS-projekte. Voer navorsing oor nuwe GIS-tegnologieë uit. Navors, ondersoek en gee advies oor nuwe GIS-tegnologieë. Gee advies oor navorsingslewensvatbaarheid en -haalbaarheid. Beveel aan en stel 'n toepaslike plan op om op die navorsingsprobleem te reageer. Ontwikkel nuwe metodes/tegnologieë vir die oplossing van ruimtelike dataprobleme. Navors en implementeer nuwe GIS-standaarde. Bewarding. Allokeer, beheer, monitor en rapporteer oor alle hulpbronne. Bestuur en implementeer kennisdeling-inisiatiewe bv. korttermynopdragte en tweedeings binne en dwarsoor operasies, ter ondersteuning van individuele ontwikkelingsplanne, operasionele vereistes en opbrengs op investering; en Monitor voortdurend die uitruil en beskerming van inligting tussen operasies en individue om effektiewe kennisbestuur volgens departementele doelwitte te verseker.

zu.title: Isikhundla sokuba nguchwepheshe we-GISc ezingeni a
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe we-GISc ufunwa umnyango i-Gauteng Department of Human Settlements e-Johannesburg ukuze aqoqe idatha yesikhala, ahalazele futhi adizayne idathabheyisi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nedigri ye-GIS yeminyaka eyithathu (3) kuya kneyine (4) noma ibhalori degri ehlobene kanye neminyaka engu-3 yamava emumva kokuba nguchwepheshe. Ukuqinisekiswa ukubhaliswa ku-PLATO kuyisinyezo. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono aphezulu e-GIS anamaphakheji amabili noma ngaphezulu we-GIS (isb. i-ESRI). Ikono lokusebenzisa isayensi nobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzayo nangokubuka kabusha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhalaza. Ukuphathwa kwezixabano. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukukhokhela iqembu. Ukuphathwa kwezixabano.
zu.duties: Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ye-GISc. Ukuqoqa nokubamaba idatha kumafomethi namithombo ahlukene. Ukudizayne futhi usebenzise idathabheyisi yesikhala ukugcina ama-datasets adingekayo. Ukushintshwa kweyidatha nokuhalaza kuhlanganise ukuqinisekiswa kwikhwalithi. Ukudala futhi ukugcina itopoloji nezincazelo zedatha yesikhala, ukushintsha ifomethi. Ukusebenzisa ukushintshwa kwe-geo-referencing, datum neprojekshon. Ukunika inkundla yobuchwepheshe mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwesoftware nedatha kubasebenzisi besistimu yolwazi lwezwe (i-GISc). Ukudizayne, ukuthuthukisa futhi kudale ama-geo-databases, izimeshi namanye amaphrojekthi ahlobene. Ukukhuthaza futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba ebuhlotsheni bendawo. Ukugcina ukusebenza kahle kweyunithi ye-GISc. Ukuthuthukisa amathuluzi yolwazi lwe-GISc lwesikhala phakathi kwenqubo yenhlangano. Ukunikeza isabelo kolwazi lwesikhala nezinkonzo zolwazi lwezwe kubo bonke abathengi kumnyango. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi bomphezulu ngamakhono mayelana ne-GISc nsuku zonke. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana phakathi kwezistimu ukuze kusize isebenze kahle. Ukushicilela idatha kusistimu ye-GISc eseku-inthanethi ukuze kunikezwe ulwazi lwezwe nge-inthanethi. Ukwenza kubenjalo ukusetshenziswa kwe-GISc. Ukwenza okuhlwayo kwezistimu. Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kwezidingo. Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kwenzuzo yezindleko. Ukuthuthukisa imodeli yenqubo nedayigrama yemisebenzi. Ukusebenzisa amazinga e-GIS. Ukulumba amagama okulungiselela amaphrojekthi e-GIS. Ukwenza ucwaningo ngobuchwepheshe obusha be-GIS. Ukuhlola, uphenye futhi unikeze izeluleko ngobuchwepheshe obusha be-GIS. Ukunikeza izeluleko ngokuphila nokwenzeka kocwaningo. Ukuphakamisa futhi uhlanganise uhlelo olufanele lokuphendula inkinga yocwaningo. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela/ubuchwepheshe obusha bokuxazulula izinkinga zedatha yesikhala. Ukuhlola futhi usebenzise amazinga amasha e-GIS. Ukuphathwa. Ukwabelana, ukulawula, ukulanda imibiko kwaye wenze umbhalo wazo zonke izinsiza. Ukuphatha futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokwabelana ngolwazi isb. ukwabelana ngemisebenzi yesikhashana nokuthunyelwa phakathi nakwezinye izindlela zokusebenza, ukuze kusekele izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu ngamunye, izidingo zokusebenza nenzuzo yokutshala imali; futhi qhubeka ukulanda ukushintshiselana nokuvikelwa kolwazi phakathi kokusebenza nabantu ngamunye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwolwazi okusebenzayo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Gisc Technologist Producti on Grade a
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-GISc Technologist ngaphakathi kwisebe le-Gauteng Department of Human Settlements e-Johannesburg ukuze kwenziwe ukuqokelelwa kwedata esithubeni, ukuhlola nokuyila idatabase.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 kwaye kufuneka kubekho degree ye-GIS eminyaka imithathu (3) ukuya kwenye (4) okanye elinye elingana nayo ibhalor degree ixhotyiwe neminyaka emi-3 yamava ngemuva kokuba ngumntu olindeleyo kwimisebenzi yobuchwepheshe. Kuyinyanzelo ukubhalisa kwi-PLATO. Kufuneka ube nelayisensi yokushayela egqithisiweyo. Kubancediswa kakhulu ekusebenzeni nge-GIS ngeziqendu ezimbini nangaphezulu ze-GIS (umz. ESRI). Ikhono lokusebenzisa isayensi nobuchwephesha ngokuchanekileyo nangokugqithiseleyo. Ulwazi ngokuzithintela ngokomthetho. Ukuxomba iingxaki nokuhlola. Umlawulo weengxabano. Ukwenza izigqibo. Umlawulo wezimali. Ukulawula iqela. Umlawulo weengxabano.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba yonke imisebeni yobuchwepheshe ye-GISc. Ukuqokelela nokubumba idata ezakwalathini nasezithangelweni ezahlukeneyo. Ukuyila nokusebenzisa idatabase yezithuba ukuze igcine iidata efunekayo. Ukuzoba idata nokuhlola kuquka uqinisekiso lomgangatho. Ukudalwa nokugcinwa kwezithuba zedata kunye neempawu, nokuzoba izakwalathini. Ukusebenzisa i-geo-referencing, idatum kunye nokuguqula iiprojekshini. Ukunika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe malunga nokusetyenziswa kwe-software nakwidata kubasebenzisi benkqubo yolwazi lobuzwe (GISc). Ukuyila, ukuphucula nokudala ama-geo-database, iimepho nezinye iiprojekthi ezinxulumene nayo. Ukukhuthaza nokuthatha inxaxheba kwimibanqelana nabahlalutyi. Ukugcina isiseko se-GISc sisebenze ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuphucula izixhobo zonke lwazi lwesayensi yonikezelo lolwazi lobuzwe (GISc) ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yentlangano. Ukunika inzondo kulwazi lwesithuba kunye neenkonzo zonikezelo lolwazi lobuzwe kubo bonke abaxumi kwisebe. Ukulatasa abasebenzisi bokugqibela ngamakhono awayo ngemisebenzi ye-GISc naninina. Ukuqinisekisa ulwhaniso phakathi kweenkqubo ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukushicilela idata kwingx систем ye-GISc esekwe kwi-web ukuze kunikezelwe ulwazi lwesithuba ngenxanye ye-intanethi. Ukukhokeza ukusebenziswa kwe-GISc. Ukuqhuba uvavanyo lwenkqubo. Ukuqhuba uhlalutyo lweemfuno. Ukuqhuba uhlalutyo lenzuzo-xabiso. Ukuyila imodel yenkqubo yomsebenzi i-workflows diagram. Ukusebenzisa iimeko ze-GIS. Ukubhala i-Terms of Reference zeeprojekthi ze-GIS. Ukwenza uphando ngobuchwepheshe obutsha be-GIS. Ukuphanda, ukuphonononga kunye nokucelisa ngobuchwepheshe obutsha be-GIS. Ukubuza ngokubaluleka nokwenzeka kolwazi ngokophando. jobs.summary: Director needed to lead the implementation of the Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan and KZN Regional Airport Strategy.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree in Urban or Regional Planning / Transport Economics / Economic Development / Economics / Policy Development / Engineering (Civil, infrastructure), or Transport Logistics at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA. Postgraduate qualifications (highly advantageous) - Master’s Degree in Urban Planning, Economic Development, Economics, Business Administration/ Business Management. A minimum of five years of experience at a Middle/Senior Managerial level in the Transport and/or Aviation Sector. Completion of Nyukela Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) upon appointment; A valid driver’s licence. Skills, Training, and Competencies: The successful candidate must demonstrate in- depth knowledge and understanding of Aerotropolis theory, including how airports become economic growth engines that link logistics, commerce, planning, and community development. Advanced knowledge of Aerotropolis and airport city development strategy, global value chains, Aerotropolis connectivity, business development, and investment attraction around airports. Knowledge of Urban planning and spatial development, including land-use planning, master planning frameworks, and sustainability principles. Economic development principles, including job creation strategies, investment attraction, economic modelling, and regional competitiveness. Public-private partnerships (PPP) and infrastructure financing, including how government and private investors align funding and risk. Transport logistics and connectivity planning with intermodal transport (air, road, rail) and logistics infrastructure. Policy, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Strong Knowledge of the KZN Integrated Aerotropolis Strategy, Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan, KZN Regional Airport Strategy; basic understanding of the South African Civil Aviation Authority Regulations (SACAA), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO); Knowledge and understanding of the regulatory framework for the Public Service, e.g., the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, the Public Service Act, the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, the Public Service Regulations, the Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA), the Occupational Health and Safety Act, and the Labour Relations Act, Skills Development Act, Service Delivery Frameworks, policies, and strategies relevant to Aerotropolis development (e.g. National Airports Development Plan, Bilateral Agreements). Skills: Strategic leadership and management Skills. Strategic capability and leadership, problem-solving, and analysis; financial & budgetary management, administration, people management, risk management, corporate planning, decision-making; Creative, analytical & innovative thinking, Computer literacy, good report-writing, negotiation, verbal and written communication, research, basic driving, presentation, project management, and ability to communicate at all levels, including Provincial Departments, Senior Management, and Private Sector Organizations.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be required to: Oversee and provide strategic leadership for the Implementation of the Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan and the Integrated Aerotropolis Strategy Oversee and provide strategic leadership for the Implementation of the KZN Regional Airport Strategy Oversee and provide strategic leadership for advancing knowledge and skills in the field of Aerotropolis and Aviation Industry Technical and economic support and source of information in the development of Aerotropolis Supervise the Aerotropolis Development Administration, Risk Management and Budgeting processes and manage human resources.
