Kennis van Stedelike beplanning en ruimtelike ontwikkeling, insluitend grondebruikbeplanning, meesterbeplanningsraamwerke, en volhoubare beginsels. Ekonomiese ontwikkelingsbeginsels, insluitend werkskeppingstrategieë, beleggingsaantrekkings, ekonomiese modellering, en streeksmededingendheid. Publiek-private vennootskappe (PPP) en infrastruktuurfinansiering, insluitend hoe die regering en private beleggers befondsing en risiko belyn. Vervoerlogistiek en konnektiwiteitsbeplanning met intermodale vervoer (lug, pad, spoor) en logistieke infrastruktuur. Beleids-, regulerings- en bestuursraamwerke. Sterk Kennis van die KZN Geïntegreerde Aerotropolis-strategie, Durban Aerotropolis-meesterplan, KZN Streekslughaavenstrategie; basiese begrip van die South African Civil Aviation Authority Regulations (SACAA), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO); Kennis en begrip van die reguleringsraamwerk vir die Openbare Diens, bv. die Grondwet van die Republic of South Africa, die Public Service Act, die PFMA, Treasury Regulations, die Public Service Regulations, die Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA), die Occupational Health and Safety Act, en die Labour Relations Act, Skills Development Act, Diensleweringsraamwerke, beleide, en strategieë wat relevant is tot Aerotropolis-ontwikkeling (bv. National Airports Development Plan, Bilaterale Ooreenkomste). Vaardighede: Strategiese leierskap en bestuursvaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, probleemoplossing, en analise; finansiële en begrotingsbestuur, administrasie, personeelbestuur, risikobestuur, korporatiewe beplanning, besluitneming; Kreatiewe, analitiese en innoverende denke, rekenaarvaardigheid, goeie verslagskryf, onderhandeling, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, navorsing, basiese bestuursvaardigheid, aanbieding, projekbestuur, en vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, insluitend Provinciale Departemente, Seniorbestuur, en Privaatsektororganisasies.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om: Strategiese leierskap te verskaf en toesig te hou oor die implementering van die Durban Aerotropolis-meesterplan en die Geïntegreerde Aerotropolis-strategie. Strategiese leierskap te verskaf en toesig te hou oor die implementering van die KZN Streekslughaavenstrategie. Strategiese leierskap te verskaf en toesig te hou oor die bevordering van kennis en vaardighede op die gebied van Aerotropolis en die Lugvaartbedryf. Tegniese en ekonomiese ondersteuning en ’n bron van inligting te wees in die ontwikkeling van Aerotropolis. Om toesig te hou oor die Aerotropolis-ontwikkelingsadministrasie, risikobestuur- en begrotingsprosesse en om menslike hulpbronne te bestuur.

zu.title: Umongameli: Inhlokodolobha yase-Aerotropolis
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongameli okhokmise ukuphunyulwa kwe-Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan kanye nesu le-KZN Regional Airport Strategy.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor’s Degree ezifanelelekile ku-Urban noma i-Regional Planning / Transport Economics / Economic Development / Economics / Policy Development / Engineering (Civil, infrastructure), noma i-Transport Logistics kuleli izinga NQF Level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu zesiqu phezulu (ezibusisiwe kakhulu) - i-Master’s Degree ku-Urban Planning, Economic Development, Economics, Business Administration/ Business Management. Ukube kusekhondli unyaka wesikhathi eminyakeni eyishlanu ohlelweni oluphakathi noma oluphezulu lolawulo kumkhakha wezokuthutha kanye/noma wezokundiza. Ukuqedwa kwe-Nyukela Certificate ukungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) ngemuva kokwethweswa ibhayili; Ibhayili esemthethweni yokushayela. Amakhono, uqeqesho, namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Kumele ofakwe esikhundleni abonise ulwazi oluqinile nokuqonda incazelo ye-Aerotropolis, okubandakanya ukuthi izikhungo zokundiba zingangamuhle wamandla wokukhula kwezomnotho ahlanganisa ukulawula izimpahla, ukuhweba, ukuhlela, nentuthuko yomphakathi. Ulwazi oluthuthukile wesu le-Aerotropolis nentuthuko yedolobha lesikhungo sokundiza, amaketsha emfanelo emhlabeni jikelele, ukuxhumana kwe-Aerotropolis, intuthuko yebhizinisi, nokukhumba izimali mboleko ezinkundleni zokundiza. Ulwazi lokuheha idolobha nentuthuko yesikhala, okubandakanya ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwomhlaba, amakhalwe okuqamba uhlelo, nezinhlobo zokuqinisekisa ukubekezela. Izimiso zentuthuko yezomnotho, okubandakanya izu zokudala amathuba omsebenzi, ukukhumba izimali mboleko, ukubheka izibalo yezomnotho, nokuncintisana kwezifundazwe. Ubufelana phakathi kwabango kanye nabatshali bezimali abasesihlabathini (PPP) kanye nezimali zokusungura izinfrafstructure, okubandakanya ukuthi umbuso nabatshali bezimali bangesihlabathi bahlanganisela kanjani imali kanye nobungozi. Ukuhlela ukulawula izimpahla nokuxhumana ngohlelo lokuhamba ngezindlela ezahlukene (ndiza, udoti, gwela) nokuqamba izinkundla zokulawula izimpahla. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo, izimiso zolawula, kanye namakhalwe wobuso. Ulwazi oluqinile ngesu le-KZN Integrated Aerotropolis Strategy, Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan, KZN Regional Airport Strategy; ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemithethonqondo ye-South African Civil Aviation Authority Regulations (SACAA), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO); Ulwazi nokuqonda ingozi yomthethonqondo wesevisi yomphakathi, ngok., uMthethosisekelo weRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, i-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Treasury, Izimiso ze-Sevisi Yomphakathi, uMthetho Wezimo Eziyisisekelo Zokusebenza (BCEA), uMthetho Wokuphila Kuhle Nokusku ephephile kwabasebenzi, noluMthetho Wezohlobano Lwabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezokuphuhlisa Amakhono, Amakhalwe Wokuletha Inkonzo, izinqubomgomo, nezimiso ezihlobene nentuthuko ye-Aerotropolis (ngok. Isu Lokusungura Izinkundla Zokundiza Zikazwelonke, Izivumelwano Esibili). Amakhono: Ubuhlakani bokuba ngumholi nokuqamba izinhlelo zokuphatha. Isiphothi esikhulu nobuhlakani bokuba ngumholi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokuqoqwa kwemininingwane; ukulawula imali kanye nokuqamba izinkomba zemali, ukuphatha, ukuphatha abantu, ukulawula ubungozi, ukuqamba kwezigaba somndeni obhaliwe, ukwenza izinqumo; Ukucabanga okuyimfihlo, okuhlwayo nokuqamba, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubika ngokubhala amagama, ukuxoxisana, ukuthetha nokubhala, ukuphenya, ukushayela, ukubukusa, ukuphatha amaphulo, nethonya lokuxhumana ngamazinga onke, okubandakanya oMnyango Wezifundazwe, Abaphathi Abaphezulu, kanye Nezinhlangano zeMakethe Yangesihlabathi.
zu.duties: Ofakwe esikhundleni kuzodingeka: Ukugcina iliso futhi anikele ubuhlakani bokuba ngumholi ohlangothi lolu kuSiphakamiso Sokuphunyulwa kweDurban Aerotropolis Master Plan kanye nohlelo oluphakeme I-Aerotropolis Integrated Strategy Ukugcina iliso futhi anikele ubuhlakani bokuba ngumholi ohlelweni lokuphunyulwa kweKZN Regional Airport Strategy Ukugcina iliso futhi anikele ubuhlakani bokuba ngumholi ekuphusheni phambili ulwazi namakhono olwandle lwe-Aerotropolis kanye nobuchwepheshe bezohwebo lokundiza Ukusekela ngobuchwepheshe kanye nangokomnotho nokuthola imininingo ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Aerotropolis Ukugcina iliso Ukulawulwa kweNtuthuko ye-Aerotropolis, Ukulawulwa kobungozi, kanye nemikhuba Yokwakha Isabelo kanye nokuphatha abantu.

xh.title: Umlawuli: Ukuphuhliswa kwe-Aerotropolis
xh.summary: Kufuneka igosa elidlulileleyo ukuqhubelela phambisi ukuqatshulwa koLungelelwaniso oluPhambili lwe-Durban Aerotropolis nendlela yoBuntu beKZN Regional Airport.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor ezifanelekileyo kwi-Urban okanye i-Regional Planning / Transport Economics / Economic Development / Economics / Policy Development / Engineering (Civil, infrastructure), okanye i-Transport Logistics kwinqanaba le-NQF Level 7 njengoko kubulwe yi-SAQA. Iziqumba zemfundo ezingaphezu kwesidanga (ezibaluleke kakhulu) - i-Master’s Degree kwi-Urban Planning, Economic Development, Economics, Business Administration/ Business Management. Uhambo olungaphantsi kolwazi olunqamlezile iindawo ezintlanu kumgangatho woBhaliso oPhakathi okanye ophezulu kumsebenzi wezemithuthlana kunye namaza. Ukuqwalasela kwe-Nyukela Certificate ukungena kwi-SMS (Senior Management Service) xa kuthunyelwa; ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Amakhono, uQeqesho, kunye namabala obuchule: Umphenyondi ophumeleleyo kufuneka abonise ulwazi olulula kunye nokuqonda inqanaba le-Aerotropolis, kuquka nokuba iindiza ziba njani izikrweqe ezikhuthaza ukukhula kwamathanga ezinxulumanisa ukuthunyelwa kweempahla, urhwebo, ulungelelwaniso, nokuphuhliswa koluntu. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo ngohambo lwe-Aerotropolis nendlela yokuphuhliswa kolawulo lwedolophu yendiza, amachapha amanani emhlabhi jikelele, unxibelelwano lwe-Aerotropolis, ukuphuhliswa kobucala, nokutsalelwa kweentshi ezikwindiza eziseduze. Ulwazi ngokulungiselelwa kolawulo lwedolophu nokuphuhliswa kweendawo, kuquka nokuqwalasela indalo, iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso oluphambili, nendlela ezakhiwa ngayo iziseko ezigcina imo yendalo. Iintsika-zisoloko zokuphuhliswa kobuzo, kuquka namanyathelo okudala iindawo zomsebenzi, ukutsalela iintsukuthi, ukulinganisa imiba yamathanga, kunye nokuba gcinwa phantsi kolwandle lwe-Aerotropolis. Ukubamba ihlangano lukawonke-wonke nezinye iintshishamano (PPP) nezimali zolwakhiwo, kuquka nendlela urhulumente kunye neentsukuthi ezingowabucala ezidibanisa ngayo umceli-mali nengozi. Ukulungiselelwa kolwazi lwemithuthlana nolonxibelelwano ngeendlela ezahlukene ezithuthlana (ngomoya, ngendlela, ngesitimela) nolwakhiwo lwalomthuthuthumbo. Iinkqubo zolawulo-lwesilawuli, nezobulungiseleli. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo nge-KZN Integrated Aerotropolis Strategy, i-Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan, i-KZN Regional Airport Strategy; ulwazi okulingeneyo malunga ne-South African Civil Aviation Authority Regulations (SACAA), i-International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO); Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zobunkokeli eziphatha iinkonzo zikarhulumente, umz.; uMgaqo-siseko weRiphabhlikhi yoMzantsi Afrika, uMthetho weKonzo zoRhulumente, i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Public Service Regulations, uMthetho weMimoya yeMisebenzi eFundayo (BCEA), uMthetho woKhathalelo lokhuseleko koluntu nakwemisebenzi, kunye noMthetho weNxulumano ngamasebenzi, uMthetho woQeqesho, iinkqubo zoKunikela iinkonzo, iinkqubo zomthetho neendaba, kunye namacebiso afanelelekileyo ekuphuhlisweni kwe-Aerotropolis (umz. i-National Airports Development Plan, i-Bilateral Agreements). Amakhono: Ukulawula nobunkokeli bokuzimisela nokubeka ihlathi. Ikhono lobunkokeli bokuzimisela, ukusombulula iingxaki, nokuqwalasela; ukulawula kwezimali ne-seseti, ulawulo, ukulawula abantu, ukulawula iingozi, ulungelelwaniso lwentshishamano yokwenza iigqwembe; Ukucinga okudalayo, okuhlalutyo nokutsha, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuxoxwa, unxibelelwano ngelolu nangokubhaliweyo, uphando, ukuqhuba okusesiseko, ukubonakalisa, ulawulo lweenjongo, nakhono lokunxibelelana nakuzo zonke iindidi, kuquka kumasebe awoMmandla, kuBunkokeli oPhezulu, nakumashishini eBucala.
xh.duties: Umntu ophumeleleyo uya kufuneka: Aqwalasele abele uBunkokeli obuzimisela ukuphuhliswa kwe-Durban Aerotropolis Master Plan nokuQatshulwa kwe-Integrated Aerotropolis Strategy. Aqwalasele abele uBunkokeli obuzimisela ekuphuhlisweni kwe-KZN Regional Airport Strategy. Aqwalasele abele uBunkokeli obuzimisela ekuphuhlisweni kolwazi namakhono kwindawo ye-Aerotropolis kunye noshishino lweemithuthlana. Anikezela ngokuluncedo ngamava nobuchule bakokwamathanga nakulwazi ekuphuhlisweni kwe-Aerotropolis. Alawule imiba yokulawula ukuphuhliswa kwe-Aerotropolis, uLawulo lweengozi, iNkqubo yeseti, alawule nabelana abantu.

jobs.title: Director: Communications & Marketing Services
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive salary package to be structured under the rules of SMS)
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Director of Communications and Marketing Services at the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations or Journalism at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA. A Postgraduate Degree in Communication and extensive experience will serve as an added advantage A minimum of five years relevant experience at Middle / Senior Managerial level in a Communications, Marketing, Public Relations or Journalism environment Completion of Nyukela Certificate for entry into the SMS (Senior Management Service) before appointment A valid driver’s licence. Skills, Training, And Competencies: The successful candidate must have advanced knowledge of Government communication systems and frameworks, including GCIS guidelines, Media relations, marketing, branding, and public relations principles, Strategic communication and reputation management, Crisis communication and media response management, and Policy development and strategic planning processes. Knowledge of the Electronic Communications Act, Broadcasting Act, Independent Communications Authority of South Africa Act, functioning of National, Provincial and Local Government, structure and functioning of the Department, Parliamentary protocol processes, linkages with government clusters, Media and Marketing industry, cross-cultural knowledge, client relations, Public Outreach. Demonstrable understanding of media technology, creative and graphic design, and broadcast technology. •Conceptualization and presentation of cutting-edge communication and marketing proposals. Demonstrate knowledge of effective communication strategies between the public sector and media. Working knowledge of electronic media such as computers, photography and video. Knowledge of formulation, interpretation and application of government policies aimed at effective delivery. Knowledge of the National Development Plan (NDP) and Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS). Knowledge and understanding of the Public Service regulatory framework, e.g., Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, Service Delivery Frameworks (Batho Pele Principles). Skills: Strategic leadership and management, Communication skills (verbal and written), Presentation and public speaking skills, Media engagement and negotiation skills, Analytical thinking and problem-solving, Research and information analysis, Stakeholder management and networking, Interpersonal relations and diplomacy, Financial and project management, Report writing and presentation skills, Conflict management and decision- making, Planning, organizing, and time management, Computer literacy and digital communication skills, Content development and editing skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, Excellent leadership skills, Ability to interpret and apply policy, Presentation skills, Negotiation skills, Assertiveness skills, Coaching and mentoring skills, good planning and organizational skills, Well-developed analytical and research Skills. The successful candidate must demonstrate integrity and ethical conduct with a strong commitment to ethical principles and professional standards.
jobs.duties: Manage Internal and External Communications. Manage Marketing and Communication Campaigns. Manage Stakeholder and Community Liaison. Ensure the development and implementation of policies. Ensure effective management of the resources of the office of the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr BS Ntuli at 060 569 2315

jobs.notes: Preferred: Females and People with Disabilities who meet the requirements OTHER POST Directions to candidates note to applicants: All information submitted will be treated as confidential. af.title: Direkteur: Kommunikasie- en Bemarkingsdienste
af.summary: Direkteur van Kommunikasie- en Bemarkingsdienste by die KwaZulu-Natal Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs in Pietermaritzburg.
af.requirements: ’n Geskikte Baccalaureusgraad in Kommunikasie, Bemarking, Publieke Verhoudinge of Joernalistiek op NQF-vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken. ’n Nagraadse graad in Kommunikasie en uitgebreide ervaring sal as ’n bykomende voordeel dien. ’n Minimum van vyf jaar se relevante ervaring op middel- / seniorbestuursvlak in ’n Kommunikasie-, Bemarking-, Publieke Verhoudinge- of Joernalistiek-omgewing. Voltooiing van Nyukela-sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die SMS (Senior Management Service) voor aanstelling. ’n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet oor gevorderde kennis van regeringskommunikasiestelsels en -raamwerke beskik, insluitend GCIS-riglyne, mediaverhoudinge, bemarking, handelsmerkvoering en beginsels van publieke verhoudinge, strategiese kommunikasie en reputasiebestuur, krisiskommunikasie en mediereaksiemanagement, en beleidsontwikkeling en strategiese beplanningsprosesse. Kennis van die Electronic Communications Act, Broadcasting Act, Independent Communications Authority of South Africa Act, die funksionering van Nasionale, Provinsiale en Plaaslike Regering, die struktuur en funksionering van die departement, parlementêre protokolprosesse, skakels met regeringscluster, Media and Marketing-industrie, interkulturele kennis, kliëntverhoudinge, Publieke Voorligting. Aantoonbare begrip van mediategnologie, kreatiewe en grafiese ontwerp, en uitsaaitegnologie. •Konseptualisering en voorlegging van vooruitstrewende kommunikasie- en bemarkingsvoorstelle. Toon kennis van effektiewe kommunikasiestrategieë tussen die publieke sektor en die media. Werkskennis van elektroniese media soos rekenaars, fotografie en video. Kennis van formulering, interpretasie en toepassing van regeringsbeleid gemik op effektiewe lewering. Kennis van die National Development Plan (NDP) en Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS). Kennis en begrip van die regulasieraamwerk van die Openbare Diens, bv. die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, Service Delivery Frameworks (Batho Pele-beginsels). Vaardighede: Strategiese leierskap en bestuur, Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik), Voorleggings- en openbare spraakvaardighede, Mediabetrokking en onderhandelingsvaardighede, Analitiese denke en probleemoplossing, Navorsing en inligtingsanalise, Belanghebbendebestuur en netwerking, Interpersoonlike verhoudinge en diplomasie, Finansiële en projekbestuur, Verslagskrywing en voorleggingsvaardighede, Konflikbestuur en besluitneming, Beplanning, organisering en tydbestuur, Rekenaarvaardigheid en digitale kommunikasievaardighede, Inhoudontwikkeling en redigeervaardighede. Uitstekende kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede, Uitstekende leierskapsvaardighede, Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas, Voorleggingsvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Selfassertiewe vaardighede, Afrigtings- en mentorskapsvaardighede, goeie beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede, Ontwikkelde analitiese en navorsingsvaardighede. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet integriteit en etiese gedrag toon met ’n sterk toewyding aan etiese beginsels en professionele standaarde.
af.duties: Bestuur interne en eksterne kommunikasie. Bestuur bemarkings- en kommunikasieveldtogte. Bestuur belanghebbende- en gemeenskapskakeling. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleid. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van die hulpbronne van die kantoor van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umluleki: Izinsiza Zokuxhumana Nokuthengisa
zu.summary: Umluleki Wezinsiza Zokuxhumana Nokuthengisa eKwaZulu-Natal Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs ePietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's ezenzelayo kuzokuxhumana, Ukuthengisa, Ubufuzo Bokuziphatha Komphakathi noma Ubuqili bokubhala eNQF level 7 njengoba kunikwe isiqinisekiso yi-SAQA. I-degree yasekhono eliphezulu (Postgraduate Degree) kuzokuxhumana kanye namava amakhulu kuzoba yinzuzo edidiyelwe. Umkhathi weminyaka emihlanu ngenani yamava ahambisana nezinyunyana ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu kwezokuxhumana, ukuthengisa, ubufuzo bokuziphatha komphakathi noma ubuqili bokubhala. Ukugcotshwa kweNyukela Certificate yokungena ku-SMS (Senior Management Service) ngaphambi kokwamukelwa. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Amakhono, uqeqesho, Namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Kumele lowome afunde ngokwazi okuphakeme kwamasistimu namakhekheba okuxhumana kahulumeni, okuhlanganisa namalayisense e-GCIS, ubudlelwano nezindaba, ukuthengisa, ukwakha igama, kanye nemigomo yobufuzo bokuziphatha komphakathi, ukuxhumana ngokuhlela nokuphathwa kwesithombe, ukuxhumana ngesimo esibucayi nokuphathwa kokuphendula izindaba, kanye nentuthuko yemigomo kanye namaqhingasu ahleliwe. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Electronic Communications Act, Broadcasting Act, Independent Communications Authority of South Africa Act, ukusebenza kahulumeni weNarazwe, Wonkephakathi noKhaya, isakhiwo nokusebenza kwaleyo Department, inqubo yokuziphatha kwi-Parliament, izinhlonze ezinhlobonhlobo zezinkundla kahulumeni, intsha yezindaba kanye nendima yokuthengisa, ulwazi lwamasiko ahlukene, ubudlelwano nabathengi, ukufinyelela komphakathi. Ukuqonda okubonakalayo mayelana netheknoloji yezindaba, ukwakhiwa kombhalo kanye noyilo lwesithombe kanye netheknoloji yokusakaza. •Ukucabanga ngokujulile kanye nesithangami esiguquguqayo sezinhlelo zokuxhumana nokuthengisa. Ukukhombisa ulwazi lwezindlela ezisebenzayo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhundla zomphakathi kanye nezindaba. Ulwazi lwezindaba zensekelo yamakhompyutha efana nokudweba ngekhamera nokusebenzisa amavidiyo. Ulwazi ngokwakheka, ukuhumusha kanye nokusebenzisa imigomo kahulumeni ehlose ukuletha izinsiza. Ulwazi mayelana ne-National Development Plan (NDP) ne-Provincial Growth and Development Strategy (PGDS). Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngesikokelo esibusayo somphakathi, isb, I- Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Act, amakhekheba okuletha izinsiza (Isimiso sika-Batho Pele). Amakhono: Ukubusa kongqongqoshe kanye nokuphatha, amakhono okuxhumana (okubukhaya nokubhalwayo), ikhono lokwethula kanye nokuwukhuluma phambi komphakathi, amakhono okubamba iqhaza ezindabeni kanye nokuxoxisana, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya kanye nokuqonda izinkinga, ukucwaninga kanye nokuhlaziya ulwazi, ukuphatha iziphephandaba kanye nokuxhumanisa, ubudlelwano nabantu kanye nesiqu somuntu, ukuphatha izimali kanye namaphrojekthi, ukubhala umbiko kanye namakhono okuyethula, ukuphatha izingxabano kanye nokwenza izinqumo, ukuhlela, ukuhlela kabusha kanye nokuphatha isikhathi, ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha kanye namakhono okuxhumana kwezinsizakusebenza, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuqeqesha ulwazi. Amakhono okuxhumana kanye nobudlelwano nabantu aphezulu kakhulu, amakhono abukhulu okubusa, ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa imigomo, amakhono okubukhulu amakhono okubukhulu, amakhono okuxoxa, amakhono abukhulu amakhono okubukhulu, amakhono okuqeqesha kanye nokwelisa, amakhono ahleliwe kuhle kakhulu kwenqubo yokuhlela kanye noyilo, ulwazi lwekhono lokuhlaziya nokucwaninga. Umele umuntu okhethiwe abonakalise ukuzethemba nokuziphatha ngesivumelwano esiphezulu ngemigomo yokuziphatha kanye namazinga obungcweti.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuxhumana kwangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphatha amakhempeni okuthengisa nokuxhumana. Ukuphatha iziphephandaba kanye nendima yokuxhumanisa nomphakathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemigomo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zebhuloro yale- Directorate.

xh.title: Umongameli: Iinkonzo Zokunxibelelanayo NenzenguYelo
xh.summary: Umongameli Weenkonzo Zokunxibelelanayo NenzenguYelo Kwisebe leKwaZulu-Natal leNtshukumbiso yokuQatshwa kwezEzo-nqayisiba, lezoKhenketho nabaKwangoko ilwaLwazi ePietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuQala esifanelekileyo kwiNzuluYelo kwiNtshukumbiso yokuQatshwa kwezEzo-nqayisiba, iNzenguYelo, uBudlelwane nabaQhathwa okanye uBundo kumqondo onqamle ixesha wonke phantsi kweNqanaba le-7 njengoko bonwa yi-SAQA. Isidanga sokuQhubela phambili kwiNtshukumbiso yokuQatshwa kwezEzo-nqayisiba namava amakhulu kuya kuba lusizo oluNgaphezulu. Iminyaka emithathu yamava abangaphambili kwisebe ngokwemigaqo esemqoka yesiNgesi kunye namava amakhulu kuBuntu, urhulumente, kubalo norhwebo.Ukuqeda iSifikezo saseNyukela kwaye uNikelo ngaphakathi kwiSebe lokuLawula urhulumente phambi kokuba ugqitywe kumsebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ngokusemthethweni.Amaziko, uQeqesho, Namava: Umntu oqeqeshiweyo kufuneka abe nolwazi oluchasene norhulumente ngokulawulwa nokuqatshwa kwezexesha ezithileyo nokuqonda imigaqo ekhoyo ngokwemigaqo yesiNgesi ngaphezulu ekujoliswe kuso kwindawo apho kukhoyo khona urhulumente, kubandakanya i-GCIS, namava nokuqonda imigaqo yokunxibelelana nabaQhathwa, uBuntu nobuNgcali bomntu wonke, kunye nezikhokelo ezichazwe ngokomthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqatshwa kolwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwiNkundla, iNtommbi yaseAfrika yakuQatshwa kolwazi, iNtommbi yakuLawula urhulumente nakulo lonke urhulumente ngokusetyenziswa kwesixokelelwanakonxibelelwano ngokusemthethweni, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluqondene norhulumente. Ukungqina nokubonakalisa konke okutshiwoyo, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lweenkcukacha ezingcali zedijethi elungeleleneyo nezimemo ngokwemigaqo yokuLawula urhulumente nokuba ngumnikazi weeNkcukacha ezahlukeneyo ezisebenza njengesakhelo soRhrhulumente kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzayo ekuqatshweni kolwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluqondene norhulumente. jobs.title: Environmental Officer - Environmental Empowerment
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs
jobs.centre: Umgungundlovu, Harry Gwala and Ethekwini Districts
jobs.closing_date_text: 23 October 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Environmental Officer promoting environmental awareness and education programmes across multiple KwaZulu-Natal districts, requiring a bachelor's degree in environmental management or related field.
jobs.requirements: The ideal candidate must have: An appropriate Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Management, Environmental Science, Natural Science, or Geography at NQF7 as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of one (1) year of relevant experience as an Environmental Management intern, or a demonstration of affinity or passion for environmental education, awareness, and capacity building, will serve as an added advantage. A valid driver’s license. Skills, Training, And Competencies: The successful candidate must have practical knowledge of Environmental Legislation (NEMA), including an understanding of the objectives and provisions of the National Environmental Management Act, 1998, and associated legislation. Knowledge of Project Management, Facilitation of workshops, and Information Management protocols. Knowledge and understanding of the Republic of South Africa Constitution, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Labour Relations Act, Community Development, Public Participation, Community Outreach, Project Management principles, Millennium Development Goals, National Youth Development Agency Act, Youth Development Policy, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Service Delivery Framework, National Development Plan, Provincial Growth and Development Plan, National Environmental Education policy. Skills: Organizational planning skills; analytical thinking; project management; computer literacy; report writing; research skills; presentation skills; decision-making; people management; strategic planning skills; Conflict management; interpersonal relations; problem-solving; communication skills (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be required to: Promote and implement environmental awareness programs implement environmental education programs to assist with the implementation of environmental education into formal education structures (such as schools, SETAs, AET, Higher Education, etc). Identify and implement environmental capacity building programs for the general public and stakeholders through physical interaction and/or web conferencing Develop and implement community-based natural resource management and environmental action projects for sustainable development Perform administrative support and internal cooperation.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. S Ngcobo at 082 312 6597
jobs.applications: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e- Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address: kznjobs@kznedtea.gov.za Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS), where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) List At www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs.” Please note that applicants should only use one of the following methods when applying for a post: Either through the online e-recruitment system, emailing the Z83 and CV directly to the relevant department, or submitting a hardcopy application as directed. Applications may alternatively be forwarded to the Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs, Private Bag X9152, Pietermaritzburg, 3200, or hand-delivered to the Ground Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street, Pietermaritzburg, 3201, in the vacancy box provided for the attention of Ms Nondumiso Buthelezi / Mr Sipho Zangwa.
jobs.notes: All the appointments will be made in accordance with the employment equity targets of the department, which are African male, coloured male, Indian male and people with disabilities who meet the requirements are encouraged to apply. successful candidates must note that they will have to serve in the districts where they are placed for a minimum of five (05) years before any transfers within the department can be considered. Directions to candidates note to applicants: All information submitted will be treated as confidential. The Department reserves the right to withhold the filling of the abovementioned posts at any time before an appointment. All applications must be submitted on the new Application for Employment form (Z83), which became effective from the 1st of January 2021, obtainable from any Public Service Department or can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za- vacancies. The form must be completed in full, and the application form should be initiated, signed, and dated. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by an updated, detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Shortlisted candidates must submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources. Should an applicant have a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applications submitted electronically will be taken as a final application and may not be amended or supplemented in any way after the closing date indicated in the advertisement. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates will be required to undergo a competency test/technical exercise. Candidates are discouraged from sending their applications through registered mail, as the Department will not take responsibility for the non-collection of those applications. The appointment is subject to a positive outcome obtained from the State Security Agency to the following checks (security clearance, qualification, citizenship, and previous employment verifications). The Department will conduct reference checks with the HR of the current and or /previous employer(s) apart from the referees listed. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Before the appointment for SMS positions, the appointee will be required to produce a Pre-entry certificate for the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, a public service-specific training program applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS. The course is offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for Entry, and the full details can         be        obtained        by       following        the       link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/smspre-entryprogramme. Regrettably, due to excessive budget cuts, the Department is not in a position to meet any travel and subsistence costs relating to recruitment processes. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte - Omgewingsbemagtiging
af.summary: Omgewingsbeampte wat omgewingsbewustheid en opvoedingsprogramme oor veelvuldige KwaZulu-Natal distrikte bevorder, met 'n baccalaureusgraad in omgewingsbestuur of 'n verwante veld as vereiste.
af.requirements: Die ideale kandidaat moet hê: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad in Omgewingsbestuur, Omgewingswetenskap, Natuurwetenskap, of Geografie op NQF7 soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar se relevante ervaring as 'n Omgewingsbestuurintern, of 'n demonstrasie van affiniteit of passie vir omgewingsopvoeding, bewustheid en kapasiteitsbou, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet praktiese kennis van Omgewingswetgewing (NEMA) hê, insluitend 'n begrip van die doelstellings en bepalings van die National Environmental Management Act, 1998, en geassosieerde wetgewing. Kennis van Projekbestuur, Fasilitering van werkswinkels, en Inligtingsbestuursprotokolle. Kennis en begrip van die Republic of South Africa Constitution, National Environmental Management Act, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Labour Relations Act, Gemeenskapsontwikkeling, Openbare Deelname, Gemeenskapsuitreik, Projekbestuursbeginsels, Millennium Development Goals, National Youth Development Agency Act, Jeugontwikkelingsbeleid, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Dienslewering-raamwerk, National Development Plan, Provincial Growth and Development Plan, Nasionale Omgewingsopvoedingsbeleid. Vaardighede: Organisatoriese beplingsvaardighede; analitiese denke; projekbestuur; rekenaargeletterdheid; verslagskrywing; navorsingsvaardighede; aanbiedingsvaardighede; besluitneming; mensebestuur; strategiese beplingsvaardighede; konflikbestuur; interpersoonlike verhoudings; probleemoplossing; kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik).
af.duties: Die ampsdraer sal vereis word om: Omgewingsbewustheidsprogramme te bevorder en implementeer omgewingsopvoedingsprogramme te implementeer om te help met die implementering van omgewingsopvoeding in formele opvoedingsstrukture (soos skole, SETAs, AET, Hoër Onderwys, ens). Omgewingskapasiteitsbouprogramme vir die algemene publiek en belanghebbendes te identifiseer en implementeer deur fisiese interaksie en/of webkonferensie Gemeenskapsgebaseerde natuurlike hulpbronbestuur- en omgewingsaksieprojekte vir volhoubare ontwikkeling te ontwikkel en implementeer Administratiewe ondersteuning en interne samewerking te verrig.

zu.title: Inkulu Yemvelo - Ukunikeza Amandla Ngemvelo
zu.summary: Inkulu Yemvelo ethuthukisa ukwaziswa ngemvelo namaphrograma emfundo kulo lonke iqhaza lamakhaza amaningana eKwaZulu-Natal, edinga iziqu ze-bachelor kwizindlela zokuphathwa kwemvelo noma inkundla ehlobene.
zu.requirements: Omeluleki kufanele abe nalokhu: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree ezifanelekile kwi-Environmental Management, i-Environmental Science, i-Natural Science, noma i-Geography ezingeni le-NQF7 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. U kube nokuthakazelwa emsebenzini onguzuzisa: okungenani unyaka owodwa (1) wemfundo ngekhaya egameni leminyaka yokuqala, noma ukuzikhetha kwakho ukuze uthakazele ukukhonza nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi, kungakwandisa ukusebenza kwezwe ngemfundo ngaphandle kwengxoxo, ngokuthumela imilayezo ebyalwe, umuntu uthole ukuzivocavoca eqhamuke ngokuthumela imfundo ehlezi okungenzeka kwayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezimoto ezisebenzayo. Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa, Namakhono: Ophumelelayo kufanele abe nolwazi lwemisebenzi ngomthetho We-Environmental Legislation (NEMA), okuhlanganisa ukuqonda izinhloso nezinhlinzeko ZoMthetho WeNational Environmental Management Act, 1998, nomthetho ohambisana nawo. Ulwazi lokuqonda: Ulwazi lokuqeqesha abanye ekwaziseni imisebenzi, ukulungiselela emisebenzini, kanye namaphrotokholi okuqondisa imininingo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Republic of South Africa Constitution, i-National Environmental Management Act, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Labour Relations Act, ukuqeqeshwa kwezindawo zokuhlala, ukuthatha inhlomulo kwabezomphakathi, ukufinyelela emphakathini, izimiso zokuqondisa imisebenzi, i-Millennium Development Goals, i-National Youth Development Agency Act, i-Youth Development Policy, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act, i-Service Delivery Framework, i-National Development Plan, i-Provincial Growth and Development Plan, kanye nenqubomgomo yezwe yokufunda imvelo. Amakhono: Amakhono okulungiselela isikhungo; ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; ukuphatha imisebenzi; ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; ukubhala imibiko; ukwenza ucwaningo; amakhono okuthula inkulumo; ukwenza izinqumo; ukuphatha abantu; amakhono okulungiselela ngokusobala; ukuphatha izinkinga; ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu; ukuxazula izinkinga; amakhono okuxhumana (ngokuthetha nokubhala).
zu.duties: Lowo othathwe kulesi sikhundla uzodingwa: Ukuthuthukisa futhi asuse imiqondo yemvelo. Ukuthuthukisa imfundo yemvelo, futhi ayisebenzise ukuze inikeze lusizo ekwazisweni komthetho wezemvelo otholakala ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zemfundo (njengezikole, i-SETAs, i-AET, izikhungo eziphakeme zemfundo, njll). Ukubona futhi athuthukise izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amandla emphakathini wemvelo abekwe kulo lonke izintambo, azenzele umphakathi nabadlali bemisebenzi, anikeze ngokusebenzisana emkhaya noma ngokuxhumana ngocwaningo. Ukuthuthukisa futhi enze izinhlela zikawonke-wonke zokulawula imithombo yokwakha kwezindawo ezingekho ngaphansi komhlaba nemisebenzi yokuthuthukisa imvelo kwezinhlelo ezibhekiswe ekwakhiweni okuholelayo. Ukubonekela ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezimbalwa zokulawula imisebenzi yabakhokhelwayo.

xh.title: Mntamabalawuli wezeNdalo - Ukunika amandla kwendalo
xh.summary: Mntamabalawuli wezeNdalo othuthisa oluqondo lwendalo nemisebenzi yemfundo kumazinga aphithizelayo ku KwaZulu-Natal, efunwa inqanaba eliphezulu lemfundo kwintshayelelo yemilawulo yendalo okanye indawo efana naleyo.
xh.requirements: Umzobi ofanelekileyo kufuneka abene: inqanaba eliphezulu lemfundo kwintshayelelo yoLawulo lweNdalo, iNzululwazi lweNdalo, iNzululwazi yendalo, okanye iGeografi kwinqanaba le NQF7 njengokuqatigwa yi SAQA. Ubuncinci bomnye (1) unyaka wamava ahambelanayo njengomfundi oxuba oLawulo lweNdalo, okanye ukubonisa ukuthanda okanye inkunzi yemfundo yendalo, oluqondo, nokwakha amandla, kuya kuba ngumonde ongezuzo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amandla, uQeqesho, naBaphili: Umzobi opumeleleyo kufuneka abenolwazi lokusebenza ngokomthetho weNdalo (NEMA), kuquka ukuqonda iinjongo kunye neemigangatho yoMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo weSizwe, 1998, nomthetho ohambelanayo. Ulwazi lokuLawula imisebenzi,okuqhutywa kwezindibaniselwa, kunye nemigaqo yoLawulo lweNkcukacha. Ulwazi ukuqonda uMgaqo-siseko woRiphabhlikhi woMzantsi Afrika, uMthetho woLawulo lweNdalo weSizwe, uMthetho weeNkonzo zaBantu, Iimigaqo yeNkonzo zaBantu, uMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zaBantu, uMthetho weeMiba zoBusebenzi, uPhuhliso lweQela, uThatho-nxaxheba koBantu, ukuNxibelela nabahlali, iinkqubo zoLawulo imisebenzi, iinjongo zoPhuhliso lweNyaka, uMthetho weSebe leNkcubeko yoPhuhliso loButyi-bo elinye, iNqba-mthetho yoPhuhliso loButhi-bo, uMthetho woKhuthaza uFikelelo kwiNkcukacha, iSakhiwo soKwaziwa kweeNkonzo, uCwangciso lwePhuhliso loBukhosi, uCwangciso loPhuhliso noNyuso lwePhondo, iNqba-mthetho yemfundo yendalo yesizwe. Amandla: Amandla okucwangcisa iqela; ukucinga ngokwahlulahlula; ukulawula imisebenzi; ukwazi ukusebenza ngekhompyutha; ukubhala iingxelo; amandla okuphanda; amandla okubonisa; ukuthatha izigqibo; ukulawula abantu; amandla okucwangcisa ngokwezicwangciso; ukulawula iingxoxo eluthhayini; iindibaniselwano phakathi kwabantu; ukuxazulula iingxaki; amandla axulumana (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo).
xh.duties: Umntu oqeshiweyo uya kufunwa: Athuthise anyanze iinkqubo zoluqondo lwendalo anyanze iinkqubo zemfundo yendalo ukunceda ekunyanzweni kwemfundo yendalo kumagumbi emfundo aqeqeshiyo (njengamabanga, SETAs, AET, Imfundo ePhezulu, nokunye). Abuze anyanze iinkqubo zokwakha amandla zendalo kubantu jikelele kunye nabanomdla ngokusebenzisana ngokomzimba okanye ngokudibana nge-web. Aqhube anyanze imisebenzi yokulawula izixhobo zendalo ngokommandiqela kunye nemisebenzi yenzo yendalo yophuhliso olusiNgqengile. Anike inkxaso yolawulo olungekwalulo langaphakathi nokubambisana.

jobs.reference_number: G52/2026 Cluster: Strategic Health Programmes Job Purpose Strategy and System Development: To analyse national policy imperatives and other baseline information regarding the management of the various programmes with a view to determining department policy gaps and developing an integrated policy framework inclusive of treatment protocols and guidelines
jobs.title: Director: Hast Programmes Implementation & MMC, HIV
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive SMS salary package)
jobs.summary: Director position to lead HIV, AIDS, STIs and TB programme implementation and policy development at KwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate (Grade 12). Plus, an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) in Clinical Health Sciences. Plus, Registration with Health Professions Council. Plus, 5 years of experience at a middle / senior managerial level. Plus Extensive (5 – 10 years) experience in HIV, AIDS, TB, STIs. Plus, Valid Driver’s License. Plus, Computer literacy. Additional Requirements: Project management certification or equivalent qualification. Plus, Financial management certification/qualification/accreditation. Plus, Post graduate qualification (Certificate, diploma or degree) in Public Health. Competencies: Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Competencies: Knowledge: The incumbent of this post will report to the Director: Strategic Health Programmes. The ideal candidate must: Extensive clinical knowledge and experience regarding the management of the HAST diseases within the health service context. Knowledge and skills in HIV and STI Prevention, Treatment, Management, Care and Support programme. Extensive knowledge and skills regarding integrated policy development in a highly complex environment. Extensive knowledge of best practices and the ability to customise such practices to suit local needs. Specialised knowledge and skills related to the clinical management of TB and HIV collaboration and STI. The ability to identify the determinants of the disease falling outside the functional domain of the department and to effectively empower the Principals to leverage corrective action by relevant institutions. Extensive Project Management skills. Training, facilitation, mentorship, and coordination skills. Proper Financial and Resource Management. Negotiation and Problem-solving skills. Data analytical, sharing and use skills. Basic research skills and or ability to formulate research questions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Based on the identified “gaps” develop integrated health policies inclusive of treatment protocols, referral arrangements, quality assurance, norms, standards and monitoring arrangements to enable Institutions to effectively and efficiently manage the prevalence of HIV, AIDS, STIs and TB through the primary health care approach. Through the co-opting of specialists from all relevant health care disciplines, ensure that prescribed clinical protocols will promote a holistic and integrated approach in the management of HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, STI, PrEP and Comprehensive condom program. Programme/ Project Management: Based on relevant disease profiles, facilitate processes for the resourcing and allocation of external resources Institutions. To oversee and manage the policy development inclusive of processes to secure/manage specialized resources (both internal and external). Interact with internal stakeholders (more specifically the General Managers responsible for operational implementation) to facilitate the effective and efficient implementation of intervention strategies and policy within the area of operation. Ensure that activities of the Unit are well coordinated and integrated with the objectives of other components of the Cluster. Technical Advice and Support: Provide technical advice to the Principals on policy matters and develop innovative policy solutions related to the area of operation. Represent the Department in technical for a (both national and provincial) responsible for the development of a comprehensive response to HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, STI, PrEP and Comprehensive condom program. Provide technical advice to the Department on strategy and policy matters and policy solutions related to the area of operation. Provide technical input during national policy design phases with the development of well-defined departmental mandates, enabling the Principals to effectively and efficiently participate in the operations of the National and Provincial Health Councils. Monitoring and Evaluation: Monitoring and evaluate the overall performance of the policy component with a view to identify implementation berries created by strategy and policy imperatives and where appropriate coordinates and manage processes to unblock the identified berries. Monitor and evaluate the delivery of programmes throughout the province and ensure that strategic goals and objectives are being. Monitor efficient distribution and use of resources allocated to the Unit and Programme delivery.

Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply for the post. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants with foreign qualifications are requested to have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for quoting the relevant reference number. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. NB: For the Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS, any individual may register for the course and complete such in anticipation of wishing to apply for an SMS post in future. However, prior to an appointment being made to any SMS post, the appointee to such a post must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s prior to the date of the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.

af.title: Direkteur: Implementering van HAST-programme & MMC, HIV
af.summary: Direkteurspos om die implementering van HIV-, VIGS-, SOI- en TB-programme en beleidsontwikkeling by KwaZulu-Natal Health Hoofkantoor te lei.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat (Graad 12). Plus, 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 7) in Kliniese Gesondheidswetenskappe. Plus, Registrasie by die Gesondheidsprofessieraad. Plus, 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Plus Uitgebreide (5 – 10 jaar) ervaring in HIV, VIGS, TB, SOI's. Plus, Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Plus, Rekenaarvaardigheid. Addisionele Vereistes: Sertifikaat in projekbestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Plus, Sertifikaat/kwalifikasie/akreditering in finansiële bestuur. Plus, Nagraadse kwalifikasie (Sertifikaat, diploma of graad) in Openbare Gesondheid. Bevoegdhede: Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Bevoegdhede: Kennis: Die beampte van hierdie pos sal rapporteer aan die Direkteur: Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme. Die ideale kandidaat moet: Uitgebreide kliniese kennis en ervaring rakende die bestuur van die HAST-siektes binne die gesondheidsdienskonteks. Kennis en vaardighede in HIV- en SOI-voorkoming, behandeling, bestuur, sorg en ondersteuningsprogramme. Uitgebreide kennis en vaardighede rakende geïntegreerde beleidsontwikkeling in 'n hoogs komplekse omgewing. Uitgebreide kennis van beste praktyke en die vermoë om sodanige praktyke aan te pas om aan plaaslike behoeftes te voldoen. Gespesialiseerde kennis en vaardighede wat verband hou met die kliniese bestuur van TB- en HIV-samewerking en SOI. Die vermoë om die determinante van die siekte wat buite die funksionele domein van die departement val, te identifiseer en die Principalse doeltreffend te bemagtig om regstellende aksie deur relevante instellings te bewerkstellig. Uitgebreide projekbestuursvaardighede. Opleidings-, fasiliterings-, mentorskaps- en koördineringsvaardighede. Behoorlike finansiële en hulpbronbestuur. Onderhandelings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Data-ontledings-, delings- en gebruiksvaardighede. Basiese navorsingsvaardighede en/of vermoë om navorsingsvrae te formuleer. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Gebaseer op die geïdentifiseerde "gapings", ontwikkel geïntegreerde gesondheidsbeleid insluitend behandelingsprotokolle, verwysingsreëlings, kwaliteitsversekering, norme, standaarde en moniteringsreëlings om Instellings in staat te stel om die voorkoms van HIV, VIGS, SOI's en TB doeltreffend en doeltreffend deur die primêre gesondheidsorgbenadering te bestuur. Deur die koöpteer van spesialiste uit alle relevante gesondheidsorgdissiplines, verseker dat voorgeskrewe kliniese protokolle 'n holistiese en geïntegreerde benadering in die bestuur van HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, SOI, PrEP en Omvattende kondoomprogram sal bevorder. Program-/Projekbestuur: Gebaseer op relevante siekteprofiele, fasiliteer prosesse vir die bemagtiging en toekenning van eksterne hulpbronne aan Instellings. Om die beleidsontwikkeling te oorsien en te bestuur, insluitend prosesse om gespesialiseerde hulpbronne (sowel intern as extern) te bekom/te bestuur. Interakteer met interne belanghebbendes (meer spesifiek die Algemene Bestuurders wat vir operasionele implementering verantwoordelik is) om die doeltreffende en doeltreffende implementering van ingrypingsstrategieë en beleid binne die area van werking te fasiliteer. Verseker dat aktiwiteite van die Eenheid goed gekoördineer en geïntegreer is met die doelwitte van ander komponente van die Cluster. Tegniese Advies en Ondersteuning: Verskaf tegniese advies aan die Principals oor beleidsake en ontwikkel innoverende beleidsoplossings wat verband hou met die area van werking. Verteenwoordig die Departement in tegniese forums (sowel nasionaal as provinsiaal) wat verantwoordelik is vir die ontwikkeling van 'n omvattende respons op HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, SOI, PrEP en Omvattende kondoomprogram. Verskaf tegniese advies aan die Departement oor strategie- en beleidsake en beleidsoplossings wat verband hou met die area van werking. Verskaf tegniese insette gedurende nasionale beleidsontwerpfases met die ontwikkeling van goed gedefinieerde departementele mandate, wat die Principals in staat stel om doeltreffend en doeltreffend aan die operasies van die Nasionale en Provinciale Gesondheidsrade deel te neem. Monitering en Evaluering: Monitor en evalueer die algehele prestasie van die beleidskomponent met die oog daarop om implementeringshindernisse wat deur strategie- en beleidsimperatiewe geskep is, te identifiseer en waar toepaslik prosesse te koördineer en te bestuur om die geïdentifiseerde hindernisse te ontsluit. Monitor en evalueer die aflewering van programme regdeur die provinsie en verseker dat strategiese doelwitte en doelwitte bereik word. Monitor doeltreffende verspreiding en gebruik van hulpbronne wat aan die Eenheid en Programaflewering toegewys is.

zu.title: Umcondzisi: Ukuphunyulwa Kwezinhlelo Ze-Hast Ne-MMC, I-HIV
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikamongcondzisi sokukhokumz inhlelo ze-HIV, AIDS, STIs kanye ne-TB kanye nentuthuko yemigomo eKwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatrikhu (I-Grade 12). Futhi, iziqu zesiqu esingaphansi kwe-NQF Level 7 kwi-Clinical Health Sciences. Futhi, ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council. Futhi, iminyaka eyi-5 yomcumo ezingeni eliphakathi / eliphezulu lokuphatha. Futhi, umcumo omude (iminyaka eyi-5 – 10) kwi-HIV, AIDS, TB, STIs. Futhi, i-Driver's License evumelekile. Futhi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izidingo Ezengeziwe: Isitifiketi sokuphathwa kwezinhlela noma iziqu ezingulinganisana neso. Futhi, isitifiketi/iziqu/ukungemukelwa kokuphatha izimali. Futhi, iziqu zobudlule (isitifiketi, idiploma noma idigri) ku-Public Health. Ikhono: Ulwazi, Ama-skil, Ukuqeqeshwa nama-Skil Adingekayo: Amandla: Ulwazi: Lowo ogcwala lesi sikhundla uzobika kumongcondzisi: I-Strategic Health Programmes. Ifekethi kumele: Ulwazi olulula kanye nomcumo ngokuphathwa kwezifo ze-HAST ngaphakathi kwezimo sevezi yempilo. Ulwazi nama-skil kwi-HIV kanye nokuvinjelwa, ukwelashwa, ukuphathwa, ukunakekelwa kanye nokwesekwa kwe-STI. Ulwazi olulula nama-skil mayelana nentuthuko yemigomo ehlanganisiwe esimeni esidabukisayo kakhudlwana. Ulwazi olulula ngendlela ezingcono kakhudlwana kanye namandla okuzilinganisela ezidingweni zendawoko. Ulwazi obhekele kanye nama-skil ahlobene nokuphathwa kwesifo se-TB kanye nokusebenzisana ne-HIV kanye ne-STI. Amandla okubona okubangele isifo okungaphandle kobulungu bezenzo bale mnyango kanye nokuqeqesha i-Principals ukuba bakwazi ukwenza isenzo esilungisayo ngezikhungo ezihambisana nalokho. Amandla omkhulu wokuphatha izinhlelo. Amandla okuqeqesha, ukweseka, ukukholeka kanye nokuheha. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nezinsiza ngendlela efanele. Amandla okuxoxa kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amandla okuhlaziya, ukwabelana nokusebenzisa idatha. Amandla omkhulu wocwaningo noma amandla okubumba imibuzo yocwaningo. Amakhono obukhulu okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Ngokususwa ezimeni ezitholakaliyo, hlela imigomo yempilo ehlanganisiwe ehlanganisa amaphrothokholo okwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuqondisa, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, imigango, izinga kanye nokuheha izinhlelo ukunika amandla izikhungo ukuba ziphathe amanani we-HIV, AIDS, STIs kanye ne-TB ngendlela yokuqala yonakekela impilo. Ngokubamba izikhungo kubuchwepheshe bezempilo onke, qiniseka ukuthi amaphrothokholo okwelashwa ayokukhuthaza indlela ehehayo nehlanganisiwe ekuphathweni kwe-HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, STI, PrEP kanye nenhhlelo yamakhondom ahlangeneyo. Ukuphathwa Kwenhhlelo/Project: Ngokususwa kumaphrofayela wezifo, yenza izinqubo zezinsiza kanye nokwabelwa kwezinsiza zangaphandle izikhungo. Ukubukela kanye nokuphatha intuthuko yemigomo ehlanganisa izinqubo zokuqasha/okuphatha izinsiza ezikhetheke (ngaphakathi nangaphandle). Xoxa nabambisana ngaphakathi (ikakhuluki i-General Managers abaphathwe ukuphunyulwa) ukweseka ukuphunyulwa okusebenzayo kahle kwezinhlela zokungenelela kanye nemigomo ngaphakathi kwenkundla yokusebenza. Qiniseka ukuthi izinkalo ze-Unit zihleliwe zihlanganiswe nezinhloso zamacandu amnye we-Cluster. Izeluleko Lobuchwepheshe Kwayo Isekela: Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe kwi-Principals ezindabeni zemigomo kanye nentuthuko yezixazululi zemigimo ezintsha ezingenele ndawo yokusebenza. Mela i-Department kumaphorum obuchwepheshe (kuzwelonke kanye nasifundazwe) abaphathwe ukuthuthukisa impendulo ehehayo ye-HIV, HTS, PMTCT, ART, MMC, HTA, STI, PrEP kanye nenhhlelo yamakhondom ahlangeneyo. Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe ku-Department kwe-strategy kanye nezindaba zemigomo kanye nezixazululi zemigomo ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza. Nikeza okufakwe obuchwepheshe esigabeni senhhlelo yemigomo yezwe kanye nentuthuko yemigomo emisiwe ka-Department, inikeza amandla i-Principals ukuba thume kahle kumhlangano we-National and Provincial Health Councils. Ukuheha Kwayo Ukuhlola: Heha kanyeokuheha ukuphunyulwa kwe-candu lemigomo nangekujwayela ukuthola izinkalany ezingavimbwa umgomo nesu kanti lapho kufanele khona heha kanye nokuheha izinqubo zokuqedela izinkalayi ezingavunyelwe. Heha kwayehlola ukulethwa kwezinhlela kulo lonke isifundazwe kwaye qinisekisa ukuba izinhloso kwe-strategy kwaye ezinhloso ziyaphunyulwa. Hlola ukulethwa okusebenzayo nokususwa kwezinsiza ezinikezwe i-Unit kwaye kulethwa kwezinhlelo.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ze-HAST ne-MMC, i-HIV
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli sokukhokela ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ze-HIV, i-AIDS, i-STI, ne-TB nentlutho yemigaqo eKwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Matric (Grade 12). Kananjalo, isiqu esingaphantsi kweziqu (NQF Level 7) kwi-Clinical Health Sciences. Kananjalo, uBhaliso kwi-Health Professions Council. Kananjalo, eminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo. Kananjalo amava amaninzi (eminyaka engama-5 – 10) kwi-HIV, i-AIDS, i-TB, i-STI. Kananjalo, ilayisenisi esemthethweni yomqhubi. Kananjalo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimfuno Ezongezelelweyo: Isatifikethi sokulawula iiprojekthi okanye isiqu esilingana neso. Kananjalo, isatifikethi/isiqu/ukuqinisekiswa kolawulo lwezimali. Kananjalo, isiqu esiphezulu (Isatifikethi, idiploma okanye idigri) kwi-Public Health. Ikhono: Ulwazi, Ikhono, uQeqesho neKhono Efunekayo: Ikhono: Ulwazi: Umntu oza kuba kulesi sithuba uya kuxela kumlawuli we-Strategic Health Programmes. Umphathi oqondileyo kufuneka: Alwazi namava amaninzi ngolawulo lwezifo ze-HAST ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yezempilo. Alwazi nakhono ekuthinteleni, ekunyuseni, ekulawuleni, ekunakekelweni nasekuxhaseni iinkqubo ze-HIV ne-STI. Alwazi nakhono amaninzi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kolwazi olutsha ekuphuhliseni imigaqo kwindawo enzima kakhulu. Alwazi amaninzi ngendlela ezilonakalayo kakhulu nako kuwanakho ukuzilungiselela ukuba zihambelane neemfuno zendawo. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo nakhono malunga nokulawula ngokwezifo i-TB kwaye kubekho udibano nolawulo kwi-HIV ne-STI. Ukuba nakho ukuchonga izinto ezenza isifo ezingaphandle kommandla wesebe nokuwanika amandla abaphathi ukuba bathathe inyathelo lokulungisa kwiintshishwangcss ezingathintelayo. Ikhono amaninzi lokulawula iiprojekthi. Ikhono loqeqesho, lokukhuthaza, lokuba ngumzekeli, nolungiselelani. Ulawulo olulungileyo lwezimali ngezixhobo. Ikhano lokuclawulisana nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokuhlalutya, lokwabelana nolokusebenzisa iingcombolo. Ikhonlo elisisiseko lokuphanda okanye ukuba nakho ukubakho imibuzo yophando. Ikhono elibalaseleyo lokuthetha nokubhala.
xh.duties: Kuxhome ekubonakaleni kweendawo ezikrwele, kuphuhliswe imigaqo ezibhanga yezempilo engaquka iinkqubo zokunyanga, izicwangciso zokuqhubela ngaphambili, uqinisekiso lomgangatho, imigaqo yomlinganiselo nemigaqo yokuqwalasela ukuvumela iZiko ukuba lilawule ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo ukusasazeka kwe-HIV, i-AIDS, i-STI, ne-TB ngeyindlela yokunyanga ngokusisiseko. Ngokubutha iingcali kuzo zonke iindawo zolwazi lwezempilo, kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinkqubo zokunyanga eziqhelwe ziya kuthinta indlela egqithiselayo nongqupheyo ekulawuleni i-HIV, i-HTS, iPMTCT, i-ART, i-MMC, i-HTA, i-STI, i-PrEP nenoNkqubo yecondom equlunqwe kakuhle. Ulawulo lwenkqubo/Iprojekthi: Ngokusekwe kumapo wezifo, kuncedwa iinkqubo zokufumanisa nokuqhuba izixhobo ezingaphandle kweZiko. Ukugcina nolawula uphuhliso lomgaqo kuquka iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa/ukulawula izixhobo ezingcali (ezangaphakathi nangaphandle). Kundibana nabathintekayo bangaphakathi (ikakhulu abaphathi abanjwe ngqo bokuphunyezwa kwezicwangciso) ukunceda ukuphunyezwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwezicwangciso zokungena nomgaqo ngaphakathi kwendawo yomsebenzi. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba imisebenzi yeQela ihlelwe kakuhle idibane namagqabo kwezinye izixhobo zeQela. Icebiso lobuchwephesha nokuNxaxhelelwa: Kunikwa icebiso lobuchwephesha kubaphathi ngemigaqo kuphuhlise izisombululo ezintsha zemigaqo ezihlobene nendawo yomsebenzi. Kumelwe imele iSebe kumaziko obuchwephesha (kuzwelonke nakwingingqi) ephathe ukuphuhlisa impendulo egqithiselayo kwi-HIV, i-HTS, iPMTCT, i-ART, i-MMC, i-HTA, i-STI, i-PrEP nenoNkqubo yecondom equlunqwe kakuhle. Kunikwa icebiso lobuchwephesha kuSebe ngenkqubo nemigaqo nabisombululo bemigaqo ezihlobene nendawo yomsebenzi. Kuthathwa inxaxheba ngexesha lokuqulunqa imigaqo yezwelonke ngokuphuhlisa i Sithethi seSebe esicacileyo, ukunikela amandla abaphathi ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo kumsebenzi weNational and Provincial Health Councils. Ukulandela noKuhlola: Kulandelwa kuqwalaselwe inkqubo yomgaqo ngokupheleleyo ngenjongo yokuchonga iinditha zokuqwalasela ezenziwa yinkqubo nabo bagqibela imigaqo kwaye apho kufuneka khona kuhlelwa kulawulwe iinkqubo zokususa iinditha ezibonwe. Kulandela kuqwalaselwa ukunikwa kweenkqubo kulo lonke ummandla kuqinisekiswa ukuba amagqibo nangamagqabangabangcus e ndyaniswayo ayaphunyezwawa. Kulandela ukusatyalwa ngempumelelo ukusasazwa nolusekelo lwezixhobo ezinikelwa kwiQela nakunikwa kweenkqubo.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Surgery
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 899 182 per annum The all-inclusive remuneration package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules. Other Benefits: 22% of basic salary – Rural Allowance & Commuted Overtime (conditions apply)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Surgery sought for Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, offering graded salaries from R1.4m to R1.9m per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: No Experience required. Grade 2: Minimum of 5 years relevant experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Surgery. Grade 3: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Surgery. Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. MBChB degree & FCS / Surgery. An appropriate qualification that allows registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Surgery. Current HPCSA Registration card 2026/2027. Registrars who have completed their training may also apply on condition that their appointment will be subject to them submitting documentary evidence of registration with HPCSA as a Specialist in Emergency Medicine. Registrars who have completed their training may also apply on condition that their appointment will be subject to them submitting documentary evidence of registration with HPCSA as a Specialist in Surgery. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Clinical knowledge, competency and skills in department of Surgery. Sound knowledge of health care system medical ethics. Good communication skills, leadership and decision-making qualities. Relevant teaching experience (clinical and operative) necessary for junior medical officers / interns training. Must have interests in research. Successful candidate will be obliged to perform an outreach programme under the guidance of the Head of Department. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service Legislation, regulations and Policies. Good team building and problem solver. Excellent human, communication and leadership skills. Awareness of cross-cultural differences. Concern for excellence.
jobs.duties: Provide specialist services in designated area of responsibility within accepted guidelines and protocols. Provide appropriate level of care, referral pathways, seamless and integrative service delivery system. Supervision and training of junior staff at clinical and operative level. Facilitation of academic meetings. Must be able to provide an afterhours / emergency service as unit requirements. Review and implementation of district health service protocols. Statistiese analise om relevante joernaalpublikasies te kan produseer. Om gereelde interdissiplinêre vergaderings by te woon. Om 'n uitreikprogram na ander hospitale binne die distrik te fasiliteer.
