Nikela izinga elifanele lenakekelo, izindlela zokuqondisa, kanye nenkqubo yokunikela insiza ephambene njalo ehlanganisiwe. Siza owayini bekhikhili ekwakheni amandla emitholamtholampilo futhi nikela insiza yesandulela kugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zezokwelapha. Yenza ukuphenya okuhlobene nesimo, ukubuyekezwa kokugula nokufa, kwakhe imigqugquzela yezokwelapha, amaphrotokholi, imibiko yenyanga ngamunye, ulawule ukokuqondisa okungalungile kulezo zinsiza. Ukuba ngomphathi osondelene namahlelo okuqhubeka nemfundo yezokwelapha zonke izikhungo zezempilo zesifunda i-Ugu. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abafundi abangakwethweswa isidiploma nabalowo eqede izifundo ze-Emergency Medicine. Thatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuPhucula Ikhwalithi emnyangweni. Thatha inxaxheba ezinkqubweni zokuqaphela okuhlobene nezokwelapha emnyangweni. Yiba nomdabelelo ekufundiseni abafundi bezokwelapha, abasebenza ngasezinkondhilihle, abahlezi bengabhalisi nabashintshi bezokwelapha. Siza ekugcineni uhlelo lokufundisa i-DipPEC kanye nesiFundiswa. Gcina amazinga okwelapha, abocwebhe kanye namagunya ahlobene nezokwelapha eziphuthumayo.

xh.title: Iqhawe lezonyanga: IYesi Yakonzululo
xh.summary: Kufunwa Iqhawe lezonyanga kuYesi Yakonzululo le Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, nemvuzo oqwalaselwa ngokwamava nokubhalwa kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mava afunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Amava angu-5 ubuncinane ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokuqaliswa kubhalwe kwi-HPCSA njengeQhawe lezonyanga kuYesi Yakonzululo. Inqanaba 3: Amava angu-10 ubuncinane ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokuqaliswa kubhalwe kwi-HPCSA njengeQhawe lezonyanga kuYesi Yakonzululo. Grade 12 / Matric okuTulingana. Isidanga se-MBChB & i-FCEM(SA). Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengeQhawe lezonyanga kuYesi Yakonzululo. Isatifikethi sobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengeQhawe lezonyanga kuYesi Yakonzululo. Ikhadi le-HPCSA lonyaka wokuqinisekisa 2026/2027. Aboqeqeshe abaqedile isikhathi sabo sokuzilolonga banokuthi bafake isicelo ngolu nyanzeliso lokuba ukwakelwa kwabo kuya kuxhomekeka ekubeni bazinike ixatsho lengxelo yemibhalo engqinisela ubhaliso lwabo kwi-HPCSA njengoNjineli yesiNganga kwesiNgingqi soKukhawuleza. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuZinza okuFunekayo: Ulwazi lokunyanga, ukuzinza namakhono kuYesi Yakonzululo. Ulwazi olusemandleni ngobugcisa bokunyanga. Aakhoni obuntu oluqinileyo bokunxibelelana, ukuzala nokuthatha izigqibo. Ukukwazi ukuvakalcela ukhuseleko ekuqwalaselweni nasekuzamaniseni iingxaki eziqhelekileyo zonyango nezezionto ezingcolileyo. Ukukwazi ukulawula iqela lezagqoki zonyango ekuqwalaselweni kokunyanga ngokukhawuleza abagulayo. Ulwazi ngokuMgaqo-nkqubo wezeMpilo nezeNkonzo kaRhulumente wangoku, imigaqo nemimiselo. Inkathalo ngenzululwazi.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngeenkonzo zobugqatsa kummandla wemisebenzi ogqithisiweyo ngaphakathi kwemiqathango nemigaqo esemthethweni. Kwenze, aze achaze akhuphe iingxelo ngeenkqubo nangemisebenzi yolophando ngaphakathi kwendalo egqithisiweyo. Kubonelele ngolinganiso elifanelekileyo lezonyango, iind zonka zokufakela kwindalo efanayo, inkqubo yokuhanjiswa kweenkonzo ezingabandakanyiyo iziphene. Kuncede uNdwebu weCandelo leBugqirha ngokwakha amandla ezibhedlele zesithili naku Bonelelo lweenkonzo zokunyamezela ngokugxila ekuphuculeni iinkonzo zonyango. Kuqhube ukuqwalaselwa kweenkonzo, ukuphonononga ukugula nokufa, aze azeke imigaqo yonyango nemigaqo yomsebenzi, iingxelo zethatu, alawule iindlela ezingafanelekanga zokuthumela abaguli kwindalo egqithisiweyo. Kubandakanyeko olusebenzayo kumacandelo oqeqesho lonyango oluchithiweyo aze wanelise isiq endo sonke sezobuchwepheshe zeMpilo zesithili sase Ugu. Kuthathe inxaxheba ekufundiseni iYesi Yokukhawuleza kumalunga abafundi abangangenanga kwaye abangenile kwizinzingo ezilandela izidanga. Kuthathe inxaxheba kwiNkqubo yoPhuculo lomgangatho kwisebe. Kuthathe inxaxheba kumanyathelo oqwalaselwa imisebenzi yonyango ngaphakathi kwesebe. Ke ngokuba ngumcebisi wokufundisa abafundi bezonyango, abasebenzi abangengawona ogqirha, ogqirha bezamaxesha, aboqeqesha nezigqibo zonyango. Kuncede ekugcinweni kwe DipPEC neNkqubo yoQeqesho lwaBaqeqeshi. Kugcine iinkqubo ezidibeneyo ngokunyanga, ngomsebenzi nangezobugqirha ezidibene noYesi Yokukhawuleza.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing (LEVEL 1 & 2 Hospitals)
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 – R1 201 302 per annum, (all-inclusive packages), consist of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of applicable rules. Other Benefits: In-Hospitable Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing post at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a nursing qualification and nine years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 Diploma / Degree in Nursing or equivalent qualification allowing registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Current South African Nursing Council (SANC) registration (2026).9 years’ appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration, with at least 4 years at Primary Health Care (PHC) management level. Diploma/Degree in Nursing Administration/Health Service Management will be an added advantage. Computer literacy and a valid driver’s licence. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of Primary Health Care policies, legislation, guidelines, norms and standards. Knowledge of nursing care processes, procedures, clinical governance and quality assurance. Knowledge of human resource management, financial management and supply chain management processes. Knowledge of District Health System planning, monitoring and evaluation. Knowledge of PHC programmes, including HIV/AIDS, Sexually Transmitted Infections and Tuberculosis (HAST), communicable and non-communicable diseases, and maternal, neonatal and child health. Good leadership, management, coordination and supervisory skills. Good communication, report-writing, conflict-management and problem- solving skills. Ability to manage human, financial and material resources effectively. Ability to analyse and interpret health information and use data to improve service delivery. Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team and engage with internal and external stakeholders. Computer skills, including the ability to use relevant Microsoft Office applications. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and direction to Primary Health Care nursing services. Coordinate, supervise and monitor quality and efficient patient-care services. Monitor implementation of the District Health Plan, PHC indicators, norms, standards and targets, and initiate corrective action where required. Coordinate planning, monitoring and evaluation of PHC service delivery within the sub-district. Ensure compliance with Office of Health Standards Compliance (OHSC), Ideal Health Facility, clinical governance and nursing standards. Manage human, financial and material resources effectively, including budget monitoring and audit compliance. Manage staff performance, development, discipline and grievances. Ensure effective infection prevention and control and quality-improvement programmes. Monitor key PHC programmes, including HIV, AIDS, Sexually Transmitted Infections and Tuberculosis (HAST), communicable and non-communicable diseases, and maternal, neonatal and child health. Promote health education, health promotion and disease prevention. Strengthen multidisciplinary, outreach and stakeholder relationships. Use health information and monitoring and evaluation findings to improve service delivery and patient outcomes. Support service-delivery innovations towards Universal Health Coverage/National Health Insurance (NHI). Perform any other duties delegated by the relevant authority.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Gbcte Khawula Tel No: (031) 907 8506
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging (VLAK 1 & 2 Hospitale)
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging-pos by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie en nege jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425 Diploma / Graad in Verpleging of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met Verloskunde toelaat. Huidige Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC) registrasie (2026). 9 jaar se toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie, met ten minste 4 jaar op Primêre Gesondheidsorg (PHC) bestuursvlak. Diploma/Graad in Verpleegadministrasie/Gesondheidsdiensbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van Primêre Gesondheidsorgbeleide, wetgewing, riglyne, norms en standaarde. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse, prosedures, kliniese bestuurstelsel en gehalteversekering. Kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuur, finansiële bestuur en toevoerkettingbestuursprosesse. Kennis van Distriksgesondheidstelselbeplanning, monitering en evaluering. Kennis van PHC-programme, insluitend MIV/VIGS, Seksueel Oordraagbare Infeksies en Tuberkulose (HAST), oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes, en moederlike, neonatale en kindergesondheid. Goeie leierskap-, bestuurs-, koördinerings- en toesigvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie-, verslagskrywing-, konflikbestuur- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur. Vermoë om gesondheidsinligting te analiseer en te interpreteer en data te gebruik om dienslewering te verbeter. Vermoë om doeltreffend binne 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk en met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes in te skakel. Rekenaarvaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om toepaslike Microsoft Office-toepassings te gebruik. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting aan Primêre Gesondheidsorg-verpleegdienste. Koördineer, hou toesig oor en monitor gehalte en doeltreffende pasiëntsorgdienste. Monitor implementering van die Distriksgesondheidsplan, PHC-aanwysers, norms, standaarde en teikens, en inisieer regstellende optrede waar nodig. Koördineer beplanning, monitering en evaluering van PHC-dienslewering binne die subdistrik. Verseig nakoming van Kantoor vir Gesondheidsstandaarde Nakoming (OHSC), Ideale Gesondheidsfasiliteit, kliniese bestuurstelsel en verpleegstandaarde. Bestuur menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne doeltreffend, insluitend begrotingsmonitering en ouditnakoming. Bestuur werknemersprestasie, ontwikkeling, dissipline en griewe. Verseker doeltreffende infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Monitor sleutel-PHC-programme, insluitend MIV, VIGS, Seksueel Oordraagbare Infeksies en Tuberkulose (HAST), oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes, en moederlike, neonatale en kindergesondheid. Bevorder gesondheidsopvoeding, gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming. Versterk multidissiplinêre, uitreik- en belanghebbenderelationships. Gebruik gesondheidsinligting en moniterings- en evalueringsbevindings om dienslewering en pasiëntuitkomste te verbeter. Ondersteun dienslewering-innovasies na Universele Gesondheidsdekking/Nasionale Gesondheidsversekering (NHI). Voer enige ander pligte uit wat deur die relevante owerheid gedelegeer word.

zu.title: iNumerator Manager Wezokwelapha (IZIBHINGO LEVEL 1 & 2)
zu.summary: Isikhundla seNumerator Manager Wezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esidinga iziqu zokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha namashumi ayisishiyagalolunye eminyaka yohlolojiziwe.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / i-Degree evela kwisisekelo i-R425 eNakekelweni Lwezokwelapha noma iziqu ezimiswe khona okuvumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengesiGuliwe eNakekelweni Lwezokwelapha ezinamakhono okubelethisa. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026).9 years’ appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration, with at least 4 years at Primary Health Care (PHC) management level. I-Diploma / i-Degree kuNikelo Lokuphatha Ezokwelapha / eNakekelweni LezempiIomthombo Yezempilo Izoomva. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokwelapha, inqobo yezokuhlelekwa nokwamukeleka kwesimo sokusebenza, ezokubusa nokugunyazwa kwekhwalithi. Ulwazi lolawulo lwabantu, ulawulo lwezimali nezinqubo zokuqinisekisa i-supply chain. Ulwazi lokuhlela ukubheka nokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kohlelo LwezeMpiIomthombo Yezempilo EsiNgangingqangi. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo ze-PHC, okuhlanganisa i-HIV/AIDS, izifo eziphathwa ngocansi namafu (HAST), izifo eziphathwayo nezingekeziphathwayo, nezempilo yomama, zezinsana namantombazana. Amakhono ahle ekubuseni, ekulawuleni, ekuhlanganiseni nakokuqapha. Amakhono ahle ekuxhumeni, ekubhaleni imibiko, ekuphatheni izinkinga nasekuqondiseni abasebenzi. Ulwazi lokulawula izinsiza zabantu, ezezimali nezempahla ngokusebenziseka kwesikhathi. Ulwazi lokuhlaziya nokuqonda imininingwane yezempilo futhi uyisebenzise ukuphucula ukuphathwa kwamasevisi. Ukuba namakhono okusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwethimba elihlangene namakhono ahlukene nokuxhumana nabanikazi bendawo yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Amakhono okusebenza namakhompyutha, ahlanganise namakhono okusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-Microsoft Office. Isimo sezimoto esikhona nokusebenza ngaphantsi koxanduva futhi uhlole ukugcwaliseka kwamadethedi.
zu.duties: Nika inqongo eqondile yokubusa mayelana nenhlelo yokunakekelwa kwamaphathi entonzama eNakekelweni Lwezokwelapha EsiNgangingqangi. Hlanganisa, qapha futhi ulawule ukusebenza kahle kweNakekelo LwesiGuliwe. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo LwezeMpiIomthombo Yezempilo EsiNgangingqangi, izinkomba ze-PHC, amaphuzu wobuqotho, iziteshadi futhi uqale izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Hlanganisa ukubheka nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwamasevisi e-PHC endaweni engaphakathi kwesifunda. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuqinisekisa Izinga Lezokwelapha (OHSC), ezokusimama kahle kwesibhedlela, inqobo yezokwelapha namaphuzu obuqotho abantu. Lawula abantu, imali nezinsiza ngokusebenziseka kwesikhathi, okuhlanganise ukubheka imali yokusebenza nokulandwa kwe-odithi. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwabo, isimo sobuqotho nezinkinga. Qinisekisa ukuthinteka kwezifo nokulawulwa kwemizila futhi uhlelokusebenza kahle mayelana nemithelela yekhwalithi. Qapha izinhlelo eziyisihlaka ze-PHC, okuhlanganisa i-HIV, i-AIDS, izifo eziphathwa ngocansi namafu (HAST), izifo eziphathwayo nezingekeziphathwayo, nezempilo yomama, zezinsana namantombazana. Khuthaza imfundo yezempilo, ukwandiswa kwezempilo nokuvikwa kwezifo. Qinisekisa izinhlelo ezihlukene namahlelo aphathwa ngaphandle kwezempilo. Sebenzisa imininingwane yezempilo, ukubheka nokuhlaziya ukuphucula ukusebenza kwamasevisi futhi ukuphucula isimo somuntu ophathwayo. Usekela izinhlelo ezintsha zokwenza izinto ezingafani ngokuphathwa kwamasevisi futhi uhlele izinhlelo eziholela ekwethembeni okusekwe ekuthuthukisweni kwezempilo. Zenze noma yimuphi umsebenzi onikelwe yisikhulu esihlelekile.

xh.title: Manejala oMncinci weZesiko LokuQonda (Izibhedlele zesiNqanaba 1 & 2)
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaManejala oMncinci weZesiko LokuQonda esibhedlele i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esifuna isifundo sokugqibela kumdlalo wezempilo kwaye sifuna iminyaka elishoba yamava.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / i-Degree eNtsimbi ye-R425 kwiZesiko LokuQonda okanye isifundo esifanayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqithi weZesiko LokuQonda ongumdali wabantwana. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) (2026). Iminyaka elishoba (9) yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo kumdlalo wezempilo emva kokuqhutywa kwisebe lempilo, enoko ubuncinane beminyaka eline (4) kwinqanaba lolawulo lwe-Primary Health Care (PHC). I-Diploma / i-Degree eNtsimbi kolawulo lweZesiko LokuQonda / lolawulo lweNkonzo yeMpilo iya kuba lusanda olunye. Ulwazi mayela nekhompyutha nelayisensi yokushuma ephefumlelwayo. Ulwazi, Ikhono, uQeqesho kwiNkqubo eFunekayo: Ulwazi ngeenqongo zomthetho ngeempilo eziphantsi kolawulo, inkqubo yomthetho, izalathiso, imigaqo nemilinganiselo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zonakekelo lwezempilo, iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo, uLawulo lweNtlanganiso yamava nezizathu, nokuqinisekisa isimo esiphantsi kwesigqibo. Ulwazi nolawulo lweempahla zabantu, ulawulo lweemali nolawulo lwenkqubo yokuHambisa iimpahla. Ulwazi ngeCandelo lokuHlola iNkqubo yeMida yonke yokuQamba iNdlela ekujoliswe kuyo, nokulinganisela imigaqo yokuQamba iNdlela nokuqonda ubomi. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ze-PHC, kuquka i-HIV/AIDS, izifo ezihamba ngokwesondo (STI) kwaye isifo seentshwa (TB) (HAST), izifo ezithathwayo nangazithathwayo, nempilo yomama, isana nephunga elingakazalwa. Iikhono ezilungileyo elalisa, ulawulo, ukuqamba izigqibo nokulawula abasebenzi. Iikhono ezilungileyo lonxibelelwano, ukubhala iingxelo, ukulawula iingxabano kwaye ukusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokulawula iimpahla, iimali nezinto ngempumelelo. Ikhono lokuhlola nokutolika iinkcukacha ngezempilo kwaye usebenzise iinkcukacha ngezempilo ukuphucula iinkonzo ezinikezelwa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kuluntu olunamasandi amaninzi kwaye uxhume namashishini angaphakathi nangaphandle. Iikhono zekhompyutha, kuquka khono lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zomsebenzi weMicrosoft Office. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwegxalaba kwaye ugqibe kwaye agqibe umhla wokuqeda isixhobo.
xh.duties: Nika inkokheli nakuqonda ngokuzalisekisa iinkonzo zokuvulwa iindlela ezintsha ezisisiseko zempilo yoluntu. Qamba, lawula kwaye ulawule ukwenza izigqibo ngokugqibeleleyo nangokulula zonakekelo zabaguli. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwendlela yokuhamba kwesixeko esingaphakathi, izalathiso ze-PHC, imilinganiselo yokuQamba iNdlela nokuqinisekisa uluntu oluziinkqubo ezihlakaniphileyo, kwaye uqale izigqibo ezilungisa iingxaki apho kufuneka khona. Qamba indlela ekujoliswe kuyo, ukwenza isigqibo ngokuthanda nokwamkela iinkonzo eziphantsi kwesizwe. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kweNkqubo eMithethweni yeZempilo ngokugqibeleleyo nokuqinisekisa iziko lezempilo, uluntu olungumphakathi kwaye alawulwe ngokwemethetho ezezonyango. Lawula ngokulula, iimali nezinto eziluncedo ngempumelelo, kuquka ukuqwalasela ingqikithi yamashumi zamali kwaye ulandele umthetho wokuhlolwa. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenza koluntu, ukuphuhlisa, ukuziphatha iinkqubo ezibiwayo nokwenza iingxaki ngokugqibeleleyo. Qinisekisa isilumkiso sokuthintela kwaye kulawulwe ulwemi kwaye iinkqubo zokuphucula ukwenza izigqibo ngokugqibeleleyo. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezisisiseko ze-PHC, kuquka i-HIV, i-AIDS, izifo ezihamba ngokwesondo (STI) kwaye isifo seentshwa (TB) (HAST), izifo ezithathwayo nangazithathwayo, nempilo yomama, isana nephunga elingakazalwa. Phucula ulwazi ngemfundo yezempilo, ukuphucula ulwazi ngemfundo nokuthintela izifo. Phucula uluntu olunamasandi amaninzi, olusebenza ngaphandle kwesizwe namashishini abantu. Sebenzisa iinkcukacha ngezempilo kwaye uqwalasele ukwenza isigqibo ngokuthanda nokwamkela ukuphucula iinkonzo ezinikezelwa kubomi babaguli. Nceda ngenkqubo ezintsha ezikulungele ukunika inkonzo ngokubakhusela amaphulo obulumko obe ngowonke loMzobo weZempilo eSigqibele / iNkqubo yeNhlayo ngokufikelela kwezoNkqubo eZikawonke wonke uMthetho weNtlalo yamaNde (NHI). Zenze nabayiphi na imisebenzi enikezelwa yiNkululeko eNkulu ekufuneka yenziwe.

jobs.title: Medical Officers Grade 1, 2 OR 3
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 – R1 121 241 per annum, All-inclusive packaged consist of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rule, plus Commuted Overtime, Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Medical Officers Grade 1, 2 or 3 sought for Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring HPCSA registration and MBCHB qualification.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualification plus registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. No experience required after completion of Community Service. Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent. An appropriate tertiary qualification (MBCHB) plus Registration certificate with HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Current registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner after completion of community Services 2025/2026. Persons in possession of a foreign qualification must attach an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The employment equity target for this post is an African Male. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Good knowledge of Anaesthetic procedures and latest protocols. Knowledge and appropriate use of anaesthetic equipment Experience and ability to deal with a wide variety of Anaesthetic cases. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team setting. Good interpersonal and supervisory skills. Provide training and guidance to members of the multi-disciplinary team. Ability to diagnose and manage common anaesthetic problems including emergencies. Sound moral values based on integrity, trust and judgement. Sound knowledge of the relevant legislative mandates, policies and prescripts governing the medical profession and public health in South Africa. At least 6 months’ experience in Anaesthetics would be a recommendation. The Diploma in Anaesthesia (DA) from the College of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA) or progress toward primary exams (FCA PART 1) will be an added advantage. Other valid additional certificates such as BLS, ACLS, and ATLS will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Provide safe, high quality clinical care for patients during pre-operative assessments, intra-operative regional and general anaesthesia administration and post- operative care including pain management. Manage emergency resuscitations, urgent medical stabilisation and intensive care needs. Ability to identify the need for and refer appropriately. Work with other clinical care units. Ability to manage patients in a holistic manner. Give medical judicial evidence. Maintain medical records. Provide training to the members of the multidisciplinary team in theatre. Participate in continued professional development and teaching programmes. Participate in departmental audits and all other quality improvement initiatives. Knowledge of the clinical governance framework and the legislated norms and standards. The successful applicant will be required to perform after hour duties.
jobs.enquiries: Dr S Reddy: HCU-Anaesthetics Tel No: (031) 530 1502

af.title: Mediese Beamptes Vlak 1, 2 OF 3
af.summary: Mediese Beamptes Vlak 1, 2 of 3 gesoek vir Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, met HPCSA-registrasie en MBCHB-kwalifikasie as vereiste.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasie plus registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Practicus. Geen ervaring vereist na voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdiens. Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 of gelykwaardig. 'n Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie (MBCHB) plus Registrasiesertifikaat by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practicus. Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Practicus na voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdienste 2025/2026. Persone wat oor 'n buitelandse kwalifikasie beskik, moet 'n evaluasiesertifikaat van die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) heg. Die indiensnemingsgelykheidsteiken vir hierdie pos is 'n Afrika-man. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Goeie kennis van narkotiese prosedures en die nuutste protokolle. Kennis en toepaslike gebruik van narkotiese toerusting. Ervaring en vermoë om 'n wye verskeidenheid narkotiese gevalle te hanteer. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre spanomgewing te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike en toesighoudende vaardighede. Verskaf opleiding en leiding aan lede van die multidissiplinêre span. Vermoë om algemene narkotiese probleme, insluitend noodgevalle, te diagnoseer en te bestuur. Gesonde morele waardes gebaseer op integriteit, vertroue en oordeel. Deeglike kennis van die tersaaklike wetgewende mandate, beleide en voorskrifte wat die mediese professie en openbare gesondheidsorg in South Africa regeer. Ten minste 6 maande se ervaring in narkose sal 'n aanbeveling wees. Die Diploma in Anaesthesia (DA) van die College of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA) of vordering na primêre eksamens (FCA PART 1) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ander geldige bykomende sertifikate soos BLS, ACLS en ATLS sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Verskaf veilige, hoë gehalte kliniese sorg vir pasiënte tydens pre-operatiewe assesserings, intra-operatiewe streeks- en algemene narkose-toediening en post-operatiewe sorg insluitend pynbestuur. Bestuur noodreanimasies, dringende mediese stabilisering en intensiewe sorgbehoeftes. Vermoë om die behoefte te identifiseer en toepaslik te verwys. Werk saam met ander kliniese sorgeenhede. Vermoë om pasiënte op 'n holistiese manier te bestuur. Lewer mediese regsgetuienis. Onderhou mediese rekords. Verskaf opleiding aan lede van die multidissiplinêre span in die teater. Neem deel aan voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling en onderrigprogramme. Neem deel aan departementele oudite en alle ander gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Kennis van die kliniese bestuursraamwerk en die gewette norms en standaarde. Die suksesvolle aansoeker sal verplig wees om buite-ure pligte te verrig.

zu.title: Odagokiwe Bezokwelapha izinga 1, 2 Noma 3
zu.summary: Odagokiwe Bezokwelapha izinga 1, 2 noma 3 bafunwa eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kudingeka ukubhaliswa kuHPCSA nesidanga seMBCHB.
zu.requirements: Isidanga esifanele kanye nokubhaliswa kuHPCSA njengodokotela. Akukho mbiko oludingeka ngemva kokuphothula Isevisi Yomphakathi. Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu / Izinga 12 noma esingangaso. Isidanga esifanele samakolishi (MBCHB) kanye Nesitifiketi Sokubhalisa kuHPCSA njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa njengamanje kuHPCSA njengodokotela ngemva kokuphothula Isevisi Yomphakathi 2025/2026. Labo abanamasidanga avela kwamanye amazwe kufanele bafake isitifiketi sokuhlola esivela kuSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Inhloso yokulingana kokuqashwa kulesi sikhundla yindoda yesi-Afrika. Ulwazi, Amafundo, Ukuqeqeshwa Nakho Konke Okudingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngezenzo zokwelapha ngokukhanya izindunu kanye nemithetho yamajeje okuhora. Ulwazi kanye nokusetshenziswa okufanele kolwembu olusetshenziswa ekukhanyeni izindunu. Isipiliwhi nakho ukubhekana nezinhlobo ezahlukene zeziguli ezidinga ukwelapha ngokukhanya izindunu. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini elihlangene iziqu ezahlukene. Amafundo ahle abantu nokuhlakanipha ekubukeni abanye. Ukunika ukuqeqeshwa nokuqondisa amalungu eqenjini elihlangene iziqu ezahlukene. Ikhono lokuthola ukuthi kuyini futhi ulungele ukulungisa izinkinga ezivamile ezibangelwa ukukhanywa izindunu kuhlanganise izimo eziphuthumayo. Imigomo yobuhlakani obuhle esekelwe ngukuzithoba, ukwesekwa nokuhluleka. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho, amapholisi nemiyalo ebusa umsebenzi wezokwelapha kanye nempilo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliwhi okungenani sezinyanga eziyisithupha ekukhanyweni kwaba yiso kuzoba inhlahlambiso. Isitifiketi iDiploma in Anaesthesia (DA) esivela kuCollege of Medicine of South Africa (CMSA) noma inqubo yokuya ezivivinyweni zokuqala (FCA PART 1) kuzoba yinhlahlambiso. Eminye imitfihla yolwazi efana neBLS, ACLS, kanye neATLS kuzoba yinhlahlambiso.
zu.duties: Ukunika ukunakekelwa okuphephile nentle kwezokwelapha iziguli ngesikhathi sekubuka ngaphambi kokusebenza, ukusetshenziswa kotho olukhanyayo ngaleso sikhathi kanye nalo jikelele futhi kunakekelwa ngemva kokusebenza kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kobuhlungu. Ukubhekana nokubuyiswa komtholampilo ngokushesha, ukuzinza okuphuthumayo kwezokwelapha kanye nezidingo zokunakekelwa kwesibhedlela esibucayi. Ikhono lokubona ukuthi yini okudingekayo futhi ukuthumela endaweni efanele. Ukusebenza namanye amayunithi okunakekelwa. Ikhono lokunakekela iziguli ngendlela ebona yonke into. Ukunikela ngobufakazi bezokwelapha emthethweni. Ukugcina amarekhodi ezokwelapha. Ukunika ukuqeqeshwa amalungu eqenjini elihlangene iziqu ezahlukene esibhedlela. Ukuthatha inhlalo ekuthuthukiseni ulwazi lomsebenzi kuhlanganise nemihqhalaliba yokufundisa. Ukuthatha inhlalo kuhlolojweni lwesibhedlelo nakho konke okunye okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga. Ulwazi ngohlaka lokulawula izinto ezisenzayo kanye nemithetho okhona kanye namazinga ebuso. Umuntu ophumelele kuzodingeka akwenze imisebenzi emahoreni aseleyo.

xh.title: Oogesa beSebe lezoKuhlinza inqanaba 1, 2 OKanye 3
xh.summary: Kufunwa aboGosa beSebe lezoKuhlinza inqanaba 1, 2 okanye 3 kwiDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka abe nokuBhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nesidanga se-MBCHB.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo ngokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGosa wezoKwelapha. Akukho nako lokulinganiswa kufuneka emva kokuQeda iNkonzo yoBomi bentlalo. Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo / uBhalo ka-12 okanye esilinganayo. Isidanga esifanelekileyo seyunivesithi (MBCHB) kanye nesatifikethi sobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengoGosa wezoKwelapha. UkuBhaliswa ngoku njengoGosa wezoKwelapha eKhomishoni yabaProfeshoni bezoKutya yaseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) emva kokuQedwa kwenkonzo yomphakatha 2025/2026. Abo banamazwi esidanga angamanye amazwe kufuneka bathe ngesatifikethi sokuLinganisa esivela kuBureau lokuLinganisa iSidanga saseMzantsi Afrika (SAQA). Injongo yoLingano lokuSebenza kule sivakalishi kukuba yeyomTu owesilisa umYentsi. ulwimi, amakhono, uQeqesho namandla aFunekayo: ulwimi oluLungileyo malunga neNkqubo zokuBethelela neMichubo yamva nje. ulwimi nokuSebenzisa ngendlela eFanelekileyo iSixhobo sokuNika isibetho. uQeqesho nako lokusebenza ngeenkcuba ezahlukeneyo zokuBethelela. ukuLingana nokusebenza kwicandelo elinabasebenzi abavela kumacandelo ahlukeneyo. amakhono amahle obudlelwane nabantu kunye nokulawula. ukunikela uQeqesho nokuQondisa amalungu equndeni elinamacandelo ahlukeneyo. ukuLingana nokuQonda ukuze alawule iingxaki ezixhaphakileyo zokuNika isibetho kuquka nabo盒子da Iindlela zokuLinda ukuba kusinakaliswe kakhulu. amaNxaxheba amahle oBomi obuNokuzipatha, kuqondwe ngokwethembeka, ukuthembana nokugqiba. ulwimi oluNtsundu ngemiThetho, iinkqubo neNkqubo eLawula inkqubo yokuSebenza eyiNtshona nokuBenza komPhakatha eMzantsi Afrika. ukuQeqeshwa okungenayo iinyanga ezi-6 kwinkqubo yokuNika isibetho kuya kubakho ngenxa yokuba ngumVuzo weNyani. iSidanga sokuBethelela esivela eKholejini yoGosa weMphiliso yaseMzantsi Afrika (CMSA) okanye ukuQeqeshelwa kumanqaku esiPreliminary (FCA PART 1) kuya kuba luncedo. ezinye iSatifikethi ezizeUvimba ezinjenge-BLS, ACLS, ne-ATLS ziya kuba luncedo.
xh.duties: ukunika inkonzo eKhuselekileyo, ezingowonaMava yokuLungisa iGazi, eLawulwa ngaphambili, kuqhubekile ngokubethelela isiHlobo esithile nesidumbu, nakwinkqubo yokulondoloza emuva kokuhlinzwa, kuquka nokulawula intlungu. ukuLawula iQingqo leSimo esiphuthumayo, ukuzinza okuKhawulezayo nokuLingana neemfuno zokuLungiswa eKwindlu yoNxibelelwano lwamahlathi. amandla okubona imfuneko yokuba kusiHluthiwe kwaye kuQhagamshelwe kulawulo. ukuSebenza kwamanye oonxibelelwano beSebe lezoGosa. amandla okusebenza ngokubandakanya iindlela ezininzi. ukunika ulwazi olusemthethweni olubhadla imiba yonke. ukulondoloza iirekhedi. ukunika uQeqesho kwicandelo elinamathwathwa kwindlu yoGosa. ukuThatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yophuhliso ngokuQeqeshwa, kubandakanya nezinye iinkqubo. ukuNgenisa amandla okuLawulwa kukabaphathwa nokupuhla iNkqubo yokuQhatha nokugcina iMigaqo yaseBucala ePuswavu. uLwazi ngolwandle lweNyani I-Clinical governance neMigaqo aze athi alawule amava wokuGqibela.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (NAASFARM Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R821 454 per annum. Other benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Inhospitable Allowance: 8% and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing position at Naasfarm Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring extensive nursing experience and a Primary Health Care qualification.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience after obtaining the one-year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ or National Certificate plus basic R425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Current registration with SANC (2026) as Professional Nurse and Primary Health Care and a minimum of 9 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required For The Post: Knowledge of Nursing care processes and procedures, Nursing Acts, Health Act, Nurses Pledge, Patient’s-Right charter, Batho Pele principles etc. Nursing statutes and relevant legal framework. Knowledge and understanding of legislative framework governing the public services. Knowledge of HR, Finance, Skills development, Labour Relations, Public Service. PHC Guidelines and other prescripts. Conflict, change and people management. Disciplinary code and procedure, Grievance Procedure, Human Resource Policies, Hospital generic and specific policies. Leadership, organisational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework, supervisory and communication skills. Good report writing and facilitation skills, good verbal and communication skills. Team building and cross-cultural awareness. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Sound knowledge of the National Core standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Sound knowledge of health programme run at the PHC level. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Computer skills in basic programmes.
jobs.duties: Facilitate provision of comprehensive package of service at PHC level including priority programme and Quality Improvement Programmes. Develop Clinic Operational Plan, monitor the implementation and submit progress reports. Participate in the implementation of the nursing plan (Clinical practice/quality patient care). Participate in clinical audits in the facility and ensure implementation of the quality improvement plans supported by strong work ethics. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (Quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff/housing keeping staff and give guidance. Ensure continuity of patient care on all levels e.g. work book, handover and rounds. Ensure effective utilisation of human resources, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Render health services in the community by implementing Community Oriented Primary Care. Supervise and ensure the provision of an efficient patient care through adequate nursing care at the clinic. Ensure Batho Pele principles, National Core standards and ideal Clinic priorities are implemented. Provide safe therapeutic environment that allows for the practice of safe nursing care as laid down by nursing act and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Compile monthly, quarterly statistics and other reports. Provide strategic leadership in delivery of integration DHS based on relevant policy imperatives. Reduce burden of diseases by implementing the integrated multi stakeholder HEALTH promotion well-being strategy (IMHPWS) fully in your subdistrict and implementation of health programmes and service package within the subdistrict. Ensure effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources- HRM, HRD, Budget, Transport, Equipment etc. within the subdistrict. Monitor and evaluate the PHC activities. Management of Records, Data performance information within the subdistrict.

Email Address: DannhauserCHC.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za or www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs FOR ATTENTION : Mrs DBP Buthelezi

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (NAASFARM Kliniek)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde-pos by Naasfarm Kliniek in KwaZulu-Natal, wat uitgebreide verpleegervaring en 'n Primêre Gesondheidsorg-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar gepaste/erkenning ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet gepaste/erkenning ervaring wees na verkryging van die een jaar se post basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Standaard 10/ of Nasionale Sertifikaat plus basiese R425 kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleegkunde of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Post basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Helende Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg geakrediteer by die SANC. Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026) as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg en 'n minimum van 9 jaar gepaste/erkenning ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis vir die Pos: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, Verpleegwetwette, Gesondheidswet, Verpleegkundige se Eed, Pasiënteregte-handves, Batho Pele-beginsels ens. Verpleegwetgewing en relevante regskader. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat openbare dienste regeer. Kennis van HR, Finansies, Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Openbare Diens. PHC-riglyne en ander voorskrifte. Konflik-, verandering- en mensebestuur. Dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, Grieweprosedure, Menslike Hulpbronbeleide, hospitaal se generiese en spesifieke beleide. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk, toesig- en Kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie verslagskryf- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, goeie mondelinge en kommunikasievaardighede. Spanbou en kruiskulturele bewustheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandelings-, konflikhanterings- en beradingsvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van die Nasionale Kerstandaarde (OHSC) en Data-bestuur. Deeglike kennis van gesondheidsprogramme wat op PHC-vlak uitgevoer word. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die voorsiening van 'n omvattende dienspakket op PHC-vlak insluitend prioriteitsprogramme en Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme. Ontwikkel kliniekbedryfsplan, monitor die implementering en dien vorderingverslae in. Neem deel aan die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasiëntesorg). Neem deel aan kliniese oudite in die fasiliteit en verseker implementering van die kwaliteitsverbeteringsplanne ondersteun deur sterk werksetiek. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging (Kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig van alle verpleegpersoneel/huishoudelike personeel en gee leiding. Verseker kontinuïteit van pasiëntesorg op alle vlakke bv. werkboek, oorhandiging en rondes. Verseker effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Lewer gesondheidsdienste in die gemeenskap deur Gemeenskapsgeoriënteerde Primêre Sorg te implementeer. Oorsien en verseker die voorsiening van doeltreffende pasiëntesorg deur voldoende verpleegsorg by die kliniek. Verseker dat Batho Pele-beginsels, Nasionale Kerstandaarde en ideale kliniekprioriteite geïmplementeer word. Verskaf 'n veilige terapeutiese omgewing wat die beoefening van veilige verpleegsorg soos neergelê deur verpleegwet en die Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet toelaat. Stel maandelikse, kwartaalstatistiek en ander verslae op. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in leweringsintegrasie van DHS gebaseer op relevante beleidsimperatiewe. Verminder las van siektes deur die geïntegreerde multisakehouer HEALTH bevordering welweesheidsstrategie (IMHPWS) ten volle in u subdistrik te implementeer en implementering van gesondheidsprogramme en dienspakket binne die subdistrik. Verseker effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne- HRM, HRD, Begroting, Vervoer, Toerusting ens. binne die subdistrik. Monitor en evalueer die PHC-aktiwiteite. Bestuur van Rekords, Dataprestasie-inligting binne die subdistrik.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokunakekela Abagulayo (Ikhilinikhi ye-NAASFARM)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wemisebenzi yokunakekela abagulayo eNaasfarm Clinic eKwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ulwazi oluningi ekunakekelweni kwezempilo nokuqeqeshwa kokunakekela izempilo ezingunaphakade.
zu.requirements: Umkhathi weminyaka engu-9 yeminyaka yokuqashwa okufanele/okubonakalayo ekunakekelweni kwezempilo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoNesiwezikhundla ephathekayo neSANC ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kufanele kube yisoqoqosolwazi/ulwazi olubonakalayo ngemva kokuthola iziqu zesikhathi sonyaka ngemva kokuqeqeshwa okusesikhundleni kokunakekela izimpilo ezingunaphakade. Igrade 12(Isitifiketi Samuntu Omdala), i-Standard 10/noma iNational Certificate kanye noqeqesho oluyisiseko lwe-R425 okungukuthi iziqu/idiploma ekunakekelweni noma iziqu ezingamalungana neziqu ezivumela ukubhalisa kuSANC njengoNesiwezikhundla ephathekayo. Iqeqesho elifanele nesikhathi esingengu-1 eminyaka ezinkomonkomo zokwelapha ekunakekelweni izimpilo ezingunaphakade esemthethweni neSANC. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kuSANC (2026) njengoNesiwezikhundla ephathekayo kanye nokunakekela izempilo ezingunaphakade kanye nomkhathi weminyaka engu-9 yeminyaka yokuqashwa okufanele/okubonakalayo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoNesiwezikhundla ephathekayo ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye Nobufakazi Obudingekayo Kulesi Sikhundla: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nemicimbe yokunakekela, izindaba eziphathelene nezempilo, uMthetho Wezempilo, isifungo sabanesi, umthethosisekelo zamalungelo eguli, imigomo yeBatho Pele njll. Imithetho yezesibhakabhaka nemithetho ehlobene nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthethosisekelo ophatha izinsiza zomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-HR, izimali, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, izintambo zomsebenzi, isevisi yomphakathi. Imihlahlandlela ye-PHC kwezinye izinkomba. Ukuphatha izinkinga, ushintsho kanye nabantu. Ikhodi nendlela yokugwema izinkinga ezithile, inqubo yokuphathwa kwezinkinga zomsebenzi, imigomo yokuphathwa kwemithombo yolwazi, imigomo egeywe ngakho nengasekhayeni. Amandla okubusa, ohlelo, okwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi komkhawulo webhange lomphakathi nemigomo yenhlangano, amandla okuhlola nokuxhumana. Ukubhala okuhle imibiko kanye namandla okusiza, amandla okukhuluma nokuxhumana. Ukwakha iqhaza nelwazi ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwamasiko. Amakhono obuntu obuningi okuhlanganisa ukuxhumana nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nokweluleka. Ulwazi olujulile ngezibalo ezisemqoka (OHSC) nokuphathwa kweminingwane. Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo lwezempilo olwenziwa ezingeni le-PHC. Ukuqonda ngezenqubo kanye nemigomo mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ulwazi ngemali kanye nohlelo ngemithombo oyiphethe. Amakhono ekhompyutha kulezo zinhlelo eziyisiseko.
zu.duties: Inceda ekunikezeni umkhwama ohlanganisiwe wesevisi ezingeni le-PHC okuhlanganisa ohlelo oluphambili namahlelo okuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Beka uhlelo lokusebenza oluwumyalelo wekhilinikhi, hlola ukuqashwa kwalo futhi uhambise imibiko yokuqhubeka. Hlanganyela ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokunakekela izempilo (ukwenza okusebenzayo ukunakekela iguli). Hlanganyela ekuhloleni izempilo ezikhundleni zokwenza futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi okusekelwa umkhuba omuhle wokusebenza. Sebenzisa izibalo, imikhuba, izinkomba kanye namagugu okuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yamakhibhodi nokunakekelwa. Yenza isibonelo sokunakekela kanye nesevisi yezempilo ngokomyelelo wemithetho nemithetho ephathelene nokunakekela kanye nesevisi yezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle obusebenzayo bokunakekelwa kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli. Nikeza okuqondile nangokungaqondile ukugada bonke abesimisebenzi/abahlezi kanye nokubanika inkombandlela. Qinisekisa ukuqhubeleka phambili kokunakekelwa kwegazi kumakhono onke isb. incwadi yomsebenzi, ukuphathwa kwesevisi kanye nokuzula. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwemithombo yolwazi, izinto eziyingqayizivele nongakwazi ngendlela ehle. Nikela ngesevisi yezempilo emphakatheni ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokunakekelwa izempilo lomphakathi olumaphepha. Gada futhi uqinisekise ukunikezwa kwezinhlelo zokunakekelwa abagulayo ezibalulekile ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okwanele efasiliteni. Qinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yeBatho Pele, izibalo eziyisiseko nendawo ephathekayo ziyasetshenziswa. Nikeza indawo ekulungele ukwelashwa evumela ukwenza isibonelo sokunakekelwa okuphephile njengoba kucatshangelwe umthetho wezempilo kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Nokuvikeleka. Qamba izibalo zanyanga zonke, kanye namanye imibiko. Nikeza ukuphatha okubalulekile ekunikeni amandla ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza ezisekwe emigomweni ebalulekile. Cindezela isithwathwa sezifo ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokuqashwa kwemithombo eminingi yokukhuthaza impilo (IMHPWS) ngaphezu kweyakho kanye nokusebenza kwezinhlelo zokunakekelwa izimpilo ngokugcwele kuleyo ndawo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle, okuphephile kokusetshenziswa kwemithobo ekiwe - i-HRM, i-HRD, izibalo, ukuthutha, izinsimbi njll. kuleyo ndawo. Hlola futhi uhlole imisebenzi ye-PHC. Ukuphathwa kwebhange lemibhalo yegazi, imininingwane yokwenza imisebenzi kuleyo ndawo.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokhathalelo Lwezempilo (Iikliniki ze-NAASFARM)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wemisebenzi yokhathalelo lwezempilo kwikliniki yase-Naasfarm e-KwaZulu-Natal, esifuna uluvo olubanzi lokhathalelo lwezempilo nokuqulunqeswa kwokuqulunqeswa ekuqaleni kokhathalelo lwezempilo.
xh.requirements: Okunguzantsi konyaka ongama-9 oluvuyo/olubonakalayo kwikhathalelo lwezempilo emva kokuqulunqeswa njengogqirha wezempilo e-SANC kwikhathalelo lwezempilo jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka engama-5 yexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ibe loluvo olufanelekileyo/olubonakalayo emva kokufumana iqulunqeswa leNyanga enye emva kwesiseko sekhondo ekuqaleni kokhathalelo lwezempilo. Ireyiti 12(Isatifikethi esPhezulu), i-Standard 10/okanye iNational Certificate ehlathiweyo nesiseko se-R425 iqulunqeswa i.e. IDigri/IDiploma ekhathalelweni lezempilo okanye iqulunqeswa elingana nokuqulunqeswa nge-SANC njengogqirha wezempilo. Iqulunqeswa ngemva kwesiseko nobude bonyaka ongoyinye ekhathalelweni lokuphulukisa ekuqaleni kokhathalelo lwezempilo eliqinisekiswe yi-SANC. Ukuqulunqeswa kwangoku nge-SANC (2026) njengogqirha wezempilo naseKuqaleni kweKhathalelo leZempilo nayo okungenani iminyaka engama-9 yamava afanelekileyo/abonakalayo emva kokuqulunqeswa njengogqirha wezempilo kwikhathalelo lezempilo jikelele. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namaQinisekiso aFunekayo kulo Msebenzi: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokhathalelo lwezempilo neendlela zokwenza umsebenzi, iMithetho yokhathalelo lwezempilo, iMithetho yeZempilo, Isifungo seGqirha, iMtetho-mlilo Wokhathalelo Lwesityhulu, iimpiniselo zeNkqubo zeBatho Pele njl. Istatsha zokhathalelo lwezempilo nesiseko somthetho esihambelana nazo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwesiseko somthetho esilawula iinkonzo zoluntu. Ulwazi ngabasebenzi, ezeemali, uqeqesho lwamakhono, iindaba zoluntu ezingalawulekiyo, ezoLuntu. iindlela ze-PHC nemithetho eminye. Ukulawula iingxabano, iinguquko nabantu. Ikhowudi nendlela yokwenza isohlwayo, iNdlela yokubakwayo iingxaki zeKhaladi, iMigaqo yeMisebenzi yabaBasebenzi, iMigaqo ekhethekileyo neseqobo yeZibhedlele. Amandla okukhokela, uqeqesho lwezintlanganiso, ukuthatha izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kogqitho lomgaqo-nkqubo weluntu nehlelo lolawulo, amakhono okuyalela nakwawokunxibelelana. Amandla amahle ekubhala iingxelo nokuqhankqalaza, amakhono amahle okuthetha nakunxibelelana. Ukwakha iqela nokuqonda ngamasiko ahlukene. Amakhono onxibelelwano nomntu kunye nokuqashelwa komntu wonke, ukuthengiselana, ukulawula iingxabano namakhono okuqamba iindlela. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngezilinganiso ezikowo zesizwe (OHSC) nokulawula iDatha. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngeenkqubo ezimalini nezempilo ezenziwa kwinqanaba le-PHC. Ukuqonda iinkqubo nemigaqo mayelana nokhathalelo lwezempilo. Ulwazi lweemali nomgaqo-simali mayelana nezibonelelo ezikulawulo. Amakhono ekhompyutha kumanqanqesikqubo aqhelekileyo.
xh.duties: Yalela ukunikwa kweqhinga elibanzi lezenkonzo kwinqanaba le-PHC kuquka iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo nokuPucuka kweNkqubo yokuPucuka. Phucuka iNqulunqo yokusebenza leKliniki, qwalasela ukusebenza kwayo uze ungenise iingxelo zentswalo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokwenza iphuculo lomsebenzi wokhathalelo lwezempilo (Ukusebenza ngokwezempilo/Ukhathalelo olungcolileyo lwesigulane). Thatha inxaxheba kwiindingcingo zezempilo kwisikhululo uze uqinisekise ukwenziwa kwezicwangciso zokuphucula umgangatho zixhaswa ngokuzimisela okuqinileyo kwinkqubo. Yenza izilinganiso, iindlela zokwenza, iindlela zokuqamba nemiqondiso yakhondo ekhathalelweni lwezempilo ekhethwe (Umgangatho wekondo). Yenza ukhathalelo lwezempilo nakwempiro ngokwemithetho nokuqamba okuhambelana nokhathalelo lwezempilo nempilo. Londoloza ukusebenza kwelakuniyo nentlangano kwakhathalelo lwezempilo. Nikeza ukuyalela okuthe ngqo nakungenanjalo kowonke umsebenzi wokhathalelo lwezempilo/abasebenzi bokugcina indlu uze unikeze isikhokelo. Qinisekisa ukusuka komntu oqhubekayo phantsi kweemviwo ezingatshitsho njengokuxelelwa komsebenzi, ukudlulisa komsebenzi nokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwabanikazi bomsebenzi, izinto ezibonakalayo nemizi ezingaqondanga ngokusebenza kakuhle. Yenza iinkonzo ezempilo kwilali ngokuqamba iNkqubo yeQhinga eliQalayo leZempilo. Yala uze uqinisekise ukunikwa kokuqhuba kakhulu komntu okhathalelwa kakuhle ngokhathalelo olwaneleyo lwezempilo kwikliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemigaqo yeBatho Pele, izilinganiso ezikowo zesizwe neenkqubo ezizelekileyo zekliniki. Nikeza indalo elula yokwakha ekuvumela ukusetyenziswa kolondolozo lwekhondo njengoko kumisiwe ngumthetho wekhondo noMthetho woKhathalelo Lwemiba ngokukhathalela. Qamba iingxelo zenyanga, ngenyanga ezintathu nezinye iingxelo. Nikeza ukukhokela ukuzinza ekunikeni iinkonzo zokudityaniswa zeDHS ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo. Phucuka umthwalo wezifo ngokuqamba iNkqubo yokuPhucula imPilo ngokubomi equlunqwe ngokubakheyo (IMHPWS) ngaphezu kweNqanaba kwaye uqambe iinkqubo ezempilo neqhinga lezenkonzo ngaphakathi kweNqanaba. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo, kakuhle nokugcina izibonelelo ezabelwe- iHRM, iHRD, iNgcazimali, ukuHamba, iziXhobo njl. ngaphakathi kweNqanaba. Qwalasela uze ulinge izicwangciso ze-PHC. Ulawulo lweziQendu, iNkcazolo yeNkonzo yokuQhuba ngaphakathi kweNqanaba.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing (NIGHT Duty)
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R846 282 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque/service bonus, medical aid: optional homeowners allowance subject to meeting prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: Night duty assistant nursing manager position at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital requiring a nursing diploma, SANC registration and at least 8 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate or equivalent. Degree/Diploma in General Nursing Science, Midwifery and Psychiatry – Current South African Nursing Council receipt - licence to practice (2026/2027). A minimum of 8 years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. - At least three (3) years of the period above must be a supervisory experience. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge and insight in Nursing processes, procedures and other relevant Public Service Acts, legislations - Knowledge of Health Care Service delivery. Knowledge of basic/standard management principles of nursing approach. Knowledge of Human Resources Management, Staff Training and Development and Financial Management. Sound knowledge of disciplinary processes and grievance procedures. - Good communication skills (written and verbal) and problem solving skills. Ability to function well within a team. Supervisory and analytical thinking skills. Ability to formulate patient care related policies.
jobs.duties: Ensure adequate coverage and supervision of staff in all units to allow provision of quality patient care in an efficient and cost effective manner. Facilitate and strengthen implementation of health care services delivery policies, procedures, clinical guidelines, and protocols, plans, and strategies aimed achieving service excellence. Promote implementation of Batho Pele principles, rights charter and acceptance professional/clinical-ethical standards within the applicable legal framework. Participate and ensure implementation of norms and standards, National Health Priorities & quality improvement initiatives including national priority program plans. Ensure a safe environment for both patients and staff at night. Ensure the effective staff development takes place and monitor performance thereof. Demonstrate effective communication with staff, patients, colleagues, clinicians and other stakeholders including report writing and presentation. Ensure effective& efficient management and utilization of resources including staff, material, financial etc. Exercise control of discipline, grievance and labour relations in terms of laid down policies and procedures. Deal with labour relation issues in terms of legislative and procedural guides. Prompt submission of patient safety incidents, complaints reports with quality improvement plans. Ensure that quality is monitoring in various programs e.g. IPC, .resuscitation, Health and safety. ENQUIRES : Ms SC Nduli: Deputy Director: Nursing Management Tel No: (031) 530 1416
jobs.applications: Directives To Candidates: Applications to be hand delivered to 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) KwaMashu or Emailed To: pixley.recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za or Couriered To: 310 Bhejane Street (Hospital Gate Number 2) KwaMashu, 4360 FOR ATTENTION : Deputy Director: HRM
jobs.notes: The following documents must be submitted, Application for employment form (Z83), which is obtainable at any Government Department or form website- www.kznhealth.gov.za. Originally signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of current/previous work experience endorsed and stamped by Human Resource Department & other required documents. Applications must be submitted on or before the closing date. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 e.g. DPKISMH 10/2026. NB: Failure to comply with the above instruction will disqualify applicants. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Please note that due to the number of applications anticipated, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within two months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from NIA to the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications and verification from the company Intellectual Property (CIPC). The Department reserves the right not to fill the post (s). This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleging (NAGDiens)
af.summary: Nagdiens-assistentbestuurder-verpleegpos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital wat 'n verpleegdiploma, SANC-registrasie en ten minste 8 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardig. Baccalaureusgraad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Vrouensiekte en Psigiatrie – Huidige Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad-kwitsensie - lisensie om te praktiseer (2026/2027). 'n Minimum van 8 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring na registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. - Ten minste drie (3) jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toesigervaring wees. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis en insig in verpleegprosesse, prosedures en ander relevante Staatsdiens-wette, wetgewing - Kennis van Gesondheidsorgdienslewering. Kennis van basiese/standaard bestuursbeginsels van verpleegbenadering. Kennis van Menslike Hulpbronne-bestuur, Personeelsopleiding en -ontwikkeling en Finansiële Bestuur. Deeglike kennis van dissiplinêre prosesse en klagteprosedures. - Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling) en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om goed binne 'n span te funksioneer. Toesig- en analitiese denkvaardighede. Vermoë om pasiëntsorg-verwante beleide te formuleer.
af.duties: Verseker voldoende dekking en toesig oor personeel in alle eenhede om voorsiening van gehalte pasiëntsorg op 'n doeltreffende en koste-effektiewe wyse moontlik te maak. Fasiliteer en versterk implementering van gesondheidsorgdienslewering se beleide, prosedures, kliniese riglyne en protokolle, planne en strategieë wat op die bereiking van diensuitnemendheid gemik is. Bevorder implementering van Batho Pele-beginsels, regtehandves en aanvaarding van professionele/klinies-etiese standaarde binne die toepaslike regskader. Neem deel en verseker implementering van norme en standaarde, Nasionale Gesondheidsprioriteite en gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe insluitend nasionale prioriteitsprogramplanne. Verseker 'n veilige omgewing vir beide pasiënte en personeel snags. Verseker dat doeltreffende personeelsontwikkeling plaasvind en monitor prestasie daarvan. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met personeel, pasiënte, kollegas, klinici en ander belanghebbendes insluitend verslagskrywing en voorleggings. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur en benutting van hulpbronne insluitend personeel, materiaal, finansies ens. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, klagtes en arbeidsbetrekkinge ingevolge neergelegde beleide en prosedures. Hanteer arbeidsbetrekking-kwessies ingevolge wetgewende en prosedurale riglyne. Vinnige indiening van pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, klagteverslae met gehalteverbeteringsplanne. Verseker dat gehalte gemonitor word in verskeie programme bv. IPC, resussitasie, Gesondheid en veiligheid. NAVRAE : Me SC Nduli: Adjunkdirekteur: Verpleegbestuur Tel No: (031) 530 1416

zu.title: Umphathi Ohambisana Nosekelo Wezokwelapha (UMSEBENZI WASEBUSUKU)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohambisana nosekelo wezokwelapha wasebusuku eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital esidinga idiploma yezokunyanga, ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nobuncwane beminyaka engu-8 yamava.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo. IDigri/Idiploma kwi-Nursing Science jikelele, i-Midwifery ne-Psychiatry – Iresethi yamanje ye-South African Nursing Council - ilayisensi yokusebenza (2026/2027). Ubuncwane beminyaka engu-8 yamava ahambelana nawo/abonakalayo emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengoGqithuzi Professional. - Okungenani eminyaka mitatu (3) kwesikhathi esingenhla kufanele ibe yamava okuhlola. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nobukhulu obudingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda kumaprozesi wezokunyanga, izinqubo nezinye izi-Acti zesevisi yomphakathi, umthetho - Ulwazi ngokuhlinzwa kwezempilo. Ulwazi lwemigomo yokuphathwa ejwayelekile yesimo sokunyanga. Ulwazi lokuphatwa Kwabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kanye nokuphatwa kwezimali. Ulwazi olulungile ngezenzo zesisulu kanye nokuqhubwa kwezindaba zezikhalazo. - Amakhono ohlelo lokuxhumana (okuqoshiwe nokuthiwa ngomlomo) kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Isikhathi sokusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwethimba. Amakhono okuhlola kanye nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Isikhathi sokwakha izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwesiguli.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukumbozwa okwanele kanye nokuhlola abasebenzi kuzo yonke iziyuniti ukuvumela ukunikelwa kokunakekelwa kwesigili koluhle kanye nendlela ekashadi nelemithwalo embalwa. Letsha futhi uqinise ukuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo zokuhanzwa kwezempilo, izinqubo, izinkomba zokwelapha, namaphrothokholo, izinhlelo, kanye namasu okufeza ukuphumelela kwenkonzo. Khuthaza ukuphathwa kokuqhuba kwemigomo ye-Batho Pele, umqulu walabo abathintwayo kanye nokwamukela izinga lezokunyanga/ze-Mathuzi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi somthetho esiphathwayo. Thatha inhlalo futhi uthi qinise ukuphathwa kwezindinganiso, Izinto ebalulekile ezinhlelekile ze-National Health & imizamo yokuthuthukiswa kobuhle okuhlanganisa izinhlela zemibhalo yezinto ebalulekile zakwazwe. Qinisekisa insimu ephephela abo bobabili iziguli nabasebenzi ebusuku. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kwenzeke ngobuhlule futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwawo. Khombisa ukuxhumana okuhlakile futhi ngeziqu naba basebenzi, iziguli, onganezakho, obayiziDokotela kanye nabanye abahlobene nakho kuhlanganise ukubhala nokuphatwa imibiko. Qinisekisa ukuphatwa ngobuhlule futhi ngemithwalo embalwa kanye nokuphathwa kwemithwalo ehlanganisi abantu, izingxenye, izimali njll. Lawula izenzo zesisulu, izindikia zabasebenzi kanye nokuqhubana ngendlela efanayo nemigumo neyenzikhathi ebiyindlela. Khuluma nokuqubula ngendlela ngendlela ngomthetho kanye nezinkomba ezibekiweyo. Ukulethisa ngokushesha izindikia zokupela komuntu, ukuphatwa kwemibilo ngohlelo kanye nokuthuthukiswa koluhle. Qinisekisa ukuba ukwengqolowa kuhlaliseka lula lula ezindzawini zonke ezenjalo. UMBUZO: Nkosazana SC Nduli: I-Deputy Director: Ukulawula kwe-Nursing Tel No: (031) 530 1416

xh.title: Usomlawuli oncedisayo weNursing (UMSEBENSI WASEBUSUKU)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi oncedisayo weNursing womsebenzi wasebusuku kwi-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital esifuna idiploma yenursing, ukubhalisa kwi-SANC kunye nobani inqanaba elinganga iminyaka 8 yamava.
xh.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate okanye efanayo. IDegree/IDiploma kwiNzululwazi yeNursing Jikelele, ukuNceda ukubeletha kunye nePsychiatry – Iresiphi yamanje yeSouth African Nursing Council - ilayiseni yokwenza umsebenzi (2026/2027). Ubuncinane iminyaka 8 yamava afanelekileyo/aqatshelwayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengeNesi yoBuchule. - Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) kwelixesha elingentla kufuneka ibe ngamava okulawula. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho noNako obufunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zeNursing, iinkqubo kunye nezinye iMithetho yeNkonzo yoLuntu, imithetho - Ulwazi ngokubonelela ngeenkonzo zezeMpilo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yesiseko/yeseminganiselo yokulawula indlela yenursing. Ulwazi loLawulo lweZabantu, uQeqesho noPhuhliso lwabasebenzi kunye noLawulo lweMali. Ulwazi oluqinileyo malunga neenkqubo zokuziphatha kunye neenkqubo zongquzulwano. - Amandla amabalwe wokunxibelelwana (okubhaliweyo nesethethwayo) namandla okusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okusebenza kakuhle ngaphakathi kweqela. Amandla okulawula nokucinga ngokuhlola. Amandla okubumba iinkqubo ezinxulumene nokukhathaleka kwesiguli.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukugqibelela ngokwaneleyo nokulawula abasebenzi kuzo zonke iindawo ukuvumela ukubonelela ngokukhathaleka kwesiguli ngokulinganeyo nangendlela engabizi kakhulu. Yenza kube lula kwaye uqinise ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zokubonelela ngeenkonzo zezeMpilo, iinkqubo, imigaqo yokwelapha, kunye nemigaqo, iiplani, kunye nezicwangciso ezijolise ekufikeleleni kulwabiwo lweenkonzo olugqithisileyo. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa kweemigaqo yeBatho Pele, umbhalo wamalungelo nokwamkelwa kwezinga eliphezulu lezomsebenzi/lezokwelapha ngokuziphatha ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho esifanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kwezinga kunye neemigangatho, iingxaki eziphambili zeMpilo yeSizwe & iziganeko zokuphucula izinga kubandakanya iiplani zenkqubo yezinto eziphambili zesizwe. Qinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo yabaguli nabasebenzi ebusuku. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqhubeka ukuphuculwa kwabasebenzi ngokusebenzayo kwaye ulolwe ukusebenza kwabo. Bonakalisa ukunxibelelwana ngokusebenzayo nabasebenzi, abaguli, babakho, oogqirha kunye nabanye abathintekayo kubandakanya ukubhala iingxelo nokuyibonisa. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo nangengxwala amathuba kubandakanya abasebenzi, izinto, imali njl njl. Lawula ukuziphatha, iingxaki zongquzulwano nobudlelwane bolusebenzi ngokwemigaqo neenkqubo ezibekiweyo. Phatha iindaba zolusebenzo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho nengqondo yeenkqubo. Thumela ngokukhawuleza iingxelo zeziganeko zokhuseleko lwesiguli, iingxelo zezikhalazo ezikunye neeplani zokuphucula izinga. Qinisekisa ukuba kusenziwa umonito wekwalithi kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo njengomzekelo, IPC, .ukuvusa kwakhona, uKhuseleko noMpilo. jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing: Grade 1 (GENERAL Stream)
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 – R644 613 per annum. Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional), In- hospital Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 in the general stream at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, requiring a basic nursing qualification, SANC registration and seven years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/ Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery) that allows registration with the ‘South African Nursing Council’ (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Certificates of Registration with the SANC (General Nursing and Midwifery) Current registration with the SANC (2026) A minimum of seven (7) years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Computer literacy will be an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Possess communication skills for dealing with patients, supervisors and other members of the multidisciplinary team including the writing of reports when required. Good human relations displaying a concern for patients, promoting and Advocating proper treatment and care including a willingness and awareness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele) Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and practices. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Ability to plan and organise own work, time and that of support personnel to Ensure proper nursing care in the unit.
jobs.duties: Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good nursing care that is cost effective, equitable and efficient in Medical Outpatient Department (MOPD) services. Perform a quality comprehensive clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined legislative framework and national Core Standards and Office of Health Standard Compliance. Perform duties within the ambits of legal framework as required. Ensure compliance to professional and ethical practice. Work effectively and amicably at a supervisory level with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Perform duties as delegated by the supervisor and relief duties of the assistant nurse manager’s office as required. Ensures implementation of programs relevant to the area of speciality. Serves in quality improvement, IPC and Health and Safety committees NB: Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging: Graad 1 (ALGEMENE Stroom)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging Graad 1 in die algemene stroom by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, SANC-registrasie en sewe jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/ Graad in Algemene Verpleging en Vroedkunde) wat registrasie by die 'South African Nursing Council' (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Sertifikate van Registrasie by die SANC (Algemene Verpleging en Vroedkunde). Huidige registrasie by die SANC (2026). 'n Minimum van sewe (7) jaar toepaslike/ erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis, Vaardighede Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Beskik oor kommunikasievaardighede vir die hantering van pasiënte, toesighouers en ander lede van die multidissiplinêre span, insluitend die skryf van verslae wanneer vereis. Goeie menslike verhoudinge wat besorgdheid vir pasiënte toon, behoorlike behandeling en sorg bevorder en ondersteun, insluitend 'n bereidwilligheid en bewustheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho Pele). Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en Finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter. Vermoë om eie werk, tyd en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die eenheid te verseker.
af.duties: Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker wat kostedoeltreffend, billik en doeltreffend is in Mediese Buitepasiënt Departement (MOPD)-dienste. Voer 'n gehalte omvattende kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die wetgewende raamwerk en nasionale Kernstandaarde en die Office of Health Standard Compliance. Voer pligte uit binne die grense van die wetlike raamwerk soos vereis. Verseker nakoming aan professionele en etiese praktyk. Werk doeltreffend en vriendelik op 'n toesighoudende vlak met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Voer pligte uit soos deur die toesighouer gedelegeer en bystandspligte van die kantoor van die assistent-verpleegbestuurder soos vereis. Verseker implementering van programme relevant tot die area van spesialiteit. Dien in gehalteverbetering, IPC en Gesondheid en Veiligheid komitees. NB: Moet bereid wees om skof te werk soos toegeken; sluit nagskof, naweke en Openbare Vakansiedae in.

zu.title: Umenenja Wokusebenza Wezokwelapha: Izinga 1 (General Stream)
zu.summary: Umenenja Wokusebenza Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 ohlelweni olujwayelekile e Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, ofuna iziqu ezisisekelo zokwelapha, ukubhaliswa ku SANC nokuthatha isiponso seminyaka eyisikhombisa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze Basic R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma/ Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi ‘South African Nursing Council’ (SANC) njengoNesikela Wezokwelapha. Amatifikhethi okubhaliswa ku SANC (General Nursing and Midwifery) Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku SANC (2026) Okuncane isiponso seminyaka eyisikhombisa (7) esifanele/ esibonakalayo ekuqashweni kwesifo ngemva kokuvala njengoNesikela Wezokwelapha ku SANC ku General Nursing. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuzobe yinconyadi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho Nemandla Abadingekayo: Khombisa ukuqonda okujulile ngemithetho yokwelapha kanye nokuqondisa ngokomthetho nangokomahlakela mayelana nokwelapha. Ukukhuluma kahle ongakuqondisa ngakakhulu nabanesiguli, abaphathi kanye namalungu amanye eqembu elihlangene kahle, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Ukuhlobana kahle nabantu kubonise ukukhathaleka ngabanesiguli, ukugqugquzela futhi asike izinkambiso zokwelapha nokuqondakalisa njengengxenye yokulondolozwa, okuhlanganisa ukuzimisela nokuqonda ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nezinhlayiya zabanesiguli (Batho Pele) Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqumo ze HR kanye nangoMthetho Wezezimali kanye nokuqondakalisa. Khombisa ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha njengesekelo ekwenzeni ukuba izinkonzo zibuye zinhle. Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi uhlele umsebenzi, isikhathi kanye nesikhathi sabancedisi ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukwelapha okufanele ekhaya/eward.
