zu.duties: Sebenza njengengxenye eqenjini elihlangene kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswelwe ukwelapha okuhle okubiza kancane, okulinganayo futhi okusebenza kahle ezenzakalweni ze Medical Outpatient Department (MOPD). Yenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha ochwepheshile futhi ohleliwe ngokomthetho wokusebenza nangokuhamba kwesikhathi ngokwezidingo zendawo yawo wonke umuntu ngokomthetho. Sebenza ngokomthetho njengoba kudingwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa imithetho nokuqondakalisa ngokomsebenzi ohlelekile. Sebenza kahle futhi ngemfanelo kumkhakha wolawula nabantu abanomqondo ongafani, isiko, isibala noma inkolo ehlukene. Yenza imisebenzi ohleliwe ngumphathi kanye nemisebenzi yesikhundla kasiphandla senceku yesikhundla njengoba kudingwa. Yenza uhlelo olubangelwe isizinda sokuhlukana nendawo ekuyo. Hlala kumakomidi okuthuthukisa izinga, i IPC kanye nezoMpilo NokuPhepha NB: Kudingeka ukubekezela ukusebenza ngokuhlelwa ngokwesikhathi; bahlanganisa ukusebenza ebusuku, ngeSonto nasemiholide yomphakathi.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuSebenza koQhatho: Inqanaba 1 (IsiQhagamshelo Jikelele)
xh.summary: Umphathi wokuSebenza koQhatho inqanaba 1 kwingxoxo jikelele ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, efuna isatifikeshi esisisiseko soqhatho, uwoyilo lokuzibhalisa kwi-SANC kunye neminyaka yamava elishumi elinesixhenye (7).
xh.requirements: Isatifikeshi esisisiseko se-R425 (okt. idiploma/ inqunabamfundo kuQhatho jikelele nokuBeletha) esivumela uwoyilo lokubhalisa kwi-'South African Nursing Council' (SANC) njengoGqathazi oPhambili. Iyatifikethi zokubhalisa kwi-SANC (kuQhatho jikelele nokuBeletha). Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwi-SANC (2026). Ukuza ngezantsi kweminyaka elishumi elinesixhenye (7) yamava afanelekileyo/ aqaphakayo kwinto yokuqhaqha emva kokubhalisa njengoGqathazi oPhambili kwi-SANC kuQhatho jikelele. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kuya kuba luncedo elonge. Ulwazi, Amakhono uQeqesho kunye namandla afunekayo: Ukubonisa ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ngomthetho weqhatho kunye nemisebenzi yomthetho namaxanduva aqotho ekwazayo yoqhatho. Ukuba nakhono lonxibelelwano ekuphatheni abagulayo, oziphatha kunye namalungu amanye eqela elixubeneyo elinobunye bamabala, kuquka nokubhala iiripoti xa kufuneka. Unxibelelwano oluhle nabantu olubonisa ukukhathaleka ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa unyango nokunyamekela okufanelekileyo, kuquka nesithembiso nokuziphoqa ngokusabela kwimfuno, iimfuno nethemba labagulayo (Batho Pele). Ukubonisa ukuqonda okusesiseko seenqobo zoqoqosho kunye nemigaqo yokusebenza kwezamafa. Ukubonise ukwazi okusesiseko ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha njengesixhobo sokuxhasa ukuphucula iinkonzo ezisiwa kubantu. Ukuba nakhono okucwangcisa nokumisela umsebenzi wakhe, isixa sexesha kunye nalawo abasebenzisa abaxhasi ukuze uqiniseke ukunyamekela ngokufanelekileyo koqhatho kwisebe.
xh.duties: Ukusebenza njengesinxenye seqela elixubeneyo elinobunye bamabala ukuze uqiniseke ukunyamekela kakuhle koqhatho okugcinwa iindleko, okulinganayo nokuqhutywa kakuhle kwiinkonzo ze-Medical Outpatient Department (MOPD). Ukwenza umsebenzi ophantsi woluhlu loqeqesho ngokubanzi ngokwemigaqo yakwisakhono kunye namazinga oqhatho njengoko kumiswe ngumthetho okwayo kunye namaNational Core Standards kwaye noMphathiswa woMiso woLungelelwaniso lweMpilo. Ukwenza imisebenzi ngaphakathi kweendlela zamagama asemthethweni njengoko kufunwa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela umsebenzi ongcali kwaye ogcwalise ixanduva. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngokwamathandabuzo kwinqanaba labo abaphathi kwabantu abahlukene ngokwengqondo, ngesiko, ngebe iintsalelo okanye inkolo. Ukwenza imisebenzi njengoko iphakamiswe ngumphathi nomsebenzi wokuncedisa uphepho lomphathi onyango onekhondo xa kufuneka. Kuqinisekiswa ukusebenza kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nendawo ekhethekileyo. Ukukhonza kwiinkqubo zokuphucula ukhululo, i-IPC kunye namagqabaza iNkokeli zoMiso woKhuseleko lweMpilo QAPHELA: Kumadingidwe ukulungiselela ukusebenza isikhathi njengoko limisiwe; kuquka ukusebenza ebusuku, ngeeniksi zomvulo nangamaholide eLungelo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager- Night Duty
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 per annum. Plus 12% Rural Allowance Other Benefits 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Operational manager for night duty at Port Shepstone Regional Hospital requiring a nursing degree, midwifery qualification and seven years of clinical experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Health Service Management. Certificate in computer Course. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwife / Accoucher and Health Service Manager. A minimum of 7 years clinical experience in nursing after and Midwife in a hospital environment as General Nurse in a hospital environment. Current SANC receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Leadership, management, planning, organizing and co-ordination skills. Knowledge of relevant Acts, prescripts, policies and procedures governing health care service delivery. Clinical competencies and policy formulation. Sound knowledge of nursing care delivery approaches and scope of practice in the areas under their control. Sound knowledge of priority programs, clinical guidelines, protocols, policies and procedures. Good communication, interpersonal, negotiation, decision-making, problem-solving, conflict management, counselling, teaching, mentorship and supervisory skills. Basic financial management skills. Knowledge of Code of Conduct, Labour Relations and related policies.
jobs.duties: Diagnose and manage obstetric emergencies in the absence of a doctor (i.e.) Eclampsia APH etc. Identify high risk clients during ante-partum and post- partum periods, manage them or refer them accordingly to hospital policy. Develop vision and mission and objectives for obstetric unit. Develop, implement and review obstetric policies / SOP. Conduct Perinatal Mortality reviews or meetings. Know SANC rules and regulations pertaining to obstetrics. Develop and implement in-service education and quality improvement programs for the obstetrics department. Act as an advocate for clients utilizing Batho Pele principles. Form part of the multi-disciplinary team. Participate and lead in all obstetrics programs, i.e. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, and RHC – reproductive health. Identify training needs for the staff. Practice participative management by assisting with relief duties of the supervisor. Maintain and monitor stock and supplies. Attend meetings held in the institution / outside. Provide leadership and ensure the provision of optimal, holistic specialized O&G nursing units within set standards and professional / legal framework. Plan, organise, coordinate, monitor nursing activities and disaster management in the domain to ensure quality patient care. Monitor and promote Infection Prevention and Control Practices, patient safety and quality improvement initiatives. Ensure effective management and utilization of human, financial, and material resources. Monitor financial resources with emphases on cost containment and keeping of all records within financial policies regarding procurement and the policy regarding revenue generation. Supervise and support nursing personnel, ensure adherence to protocols, policies and standard of care. Ensure that the unit complies with OHSC and IHRM Standards. Monitor implementation of clinical governance programmes and quality assurance standards. Evaluate staff on work performance, and implement employer assistance plan. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure efficient, cost-effective and equitable service delivery. Coordinate and facilitate orientation, in-service training mentoring and continuous professional development of staff. Compile and submit reports, statistics and other information required. Participate in research activities and promote evidence-based nursing practice. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Champion and monitor the implementation of CPD program as per SANC CPD Framework.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applicants are encouraged to utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha WAYA WAYA or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit proof of qualifications) FOR ATTENTION Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder- Nagdiens
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder vir nagdiens by Port Shepstone Regional Hospital wat 'n verpleegkunde-graad, 'n vroedvroukwalifikasie en sewe jaar se kliniese ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of Ekwivalent. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vroedvroukunde Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. Sertifikaat in rekenaarkursus. Huidige registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vroedvrou / Accoucher en Gesondheidsdiensbestuurder. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar kliniese ervaring in verpleging na en as Vroedvrou in 'n hospitaalomgewing as Algemene Verpleegkundige in 'n hospitaalomgewing. Huidige SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Leierskap, bestuur, beplanning, organisasie en koördinasievaardighede. Kennis van tersaaklike Wette, voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures wat gesondheidsorgdienslewering beheer. Kliniese bevoegdhede en beleidsformulering. Deeglike kennis van verpleegsorgleweringbenaderings en omvang van praktyk in die areas onder hul beheer. Deeglike kennis van prioriteitsprogramme, kliniese riglyne, protokolle, beleide en prosedures. Goeie kommunikasie, interpersoonlike, onderhandeling, besluitneming, probleemoplossing, konflikbestuur, berading, onderrig, mentorskap en toesighoudende vaardighede. Basiese finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Kennis van Gedragskode, Arbeidsverhoudinge en verwante beleide.
af.duties: Diagnoseer en bestuur verloskundige noodgevalle in die afwesigheid van 'n dokter (d.w.s.) Eklampsie APH ens. Identifiseer hoërisiko-kliënte gedurende ante-partum en post-partum periodes, bestuur hulle of verwys hulle ooreenkomstig hospitaalbeleid. Ontwikkel visie en missie en doelwitte vir verloskundige eenheid. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien verloskundige beleide / SOP. Voer perinatale sterfte-oorsigte of vergaderings uit. Ken SANC-reëls en regulasies met betrekking tot verloskunde. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diensopleiding en gehaltsverbeteringsprogramme vir die verloskunde-afdeling. Tree as 'n voorpleiter vir kliënte op volgens Batho Pele-beginsels. Vorm deel van die multidissiplinêre span. Neem deel en lei in alle verloskunde-programme, d.w.s. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, en RHC – reproduktiewe gesondheid. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes van die personeel. Beoefen deelnemende bestuur deur te help met vermeeingspligte van die toesighouer. Onderhou en monitor voorraad en voorrade. Woong byeenkomste wat in die instelling / buite gehou word. Verskaf leierskap en verseker die voorsiening van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde V&G-verpleegeenhede binne vasgestelde standaarde en professionele / regskader. Beplan, organiseer, koördineer, monitor verpleegaktiwiteite en rampbestuur in die domein om gehalte-pasiëntorg te verseker. Monitor en bevorder Infeksievoorkoming en Beheerpraktyke, pasiëntveiligheid en gehaltsverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Verseker effektiewe bestuur en benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiaalhulpbronne. Monitor finansiële hulpbronne met klem op kostebeperking en byhou van alle rekords binne finansiële beleide rakende verkryging en die beleid rakende inkomstegegenereing. Toesig hou en ondersteun verpleegpersoneel, verseker nakoming van protokolle, beleide en standaard van sorg. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan OHSC- en IHRM-standaarde. Monitor implementering van kliniese bestuursprogramme en gehaltsversekeringsstandaarde. Evalueer personeel op werkprestasie, en implementeer werknemersondersteuningsplan. Werk saam met multidissiplinêre spanne om doeltreffende, koste-effektiewe en billike dienslewering te verseker. Koördineer en fasiliteer oriëntering, in-diensopleiding mentorskap en deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling van personeel. Stel op en dien verslae, statistieke en ander vereiste inligting in. Neem deel aan navorsingsaktiwiteite en bevorder getuienisgebaseerde verpleegpraktyk. Onderhou professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Kampioen en monitor die implementering van VDO-program volgens SANC VDO-raamwerk.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wemisebenzi- Umsebenzi Wabusuku
zu.summary: Umlawuli wemisebenzi wabusuku e-Port Shepstone Regional Hospital ofuna iziqu zokunyanga, iziqu zobulelesi kanye namashumi ayisikhombisa eminyaka yemfundo yokuqamba ukwelashwa.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Diploma / Degree e-Nursing Science jikelele. I-Diploma / Degree e-Midwifery Nursing Science. I-Diploma / Degree e-Health Service Management. Isitifiketi sekosi yekhompyutha. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-SANC njengesinasesi jikelele, umbelethisi / umsizi wezokuvelisa kanye nomphathi wezinkonzo ezempilo. Okungenani iminyaka eyisi-7 yemfundo yokuqamba ukwelashwa kunokunyanga noma kuba umbelethisi esibhedlela njengesinasesi jikelele. Iresithi yamanje ye-SANC yango-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ubungqondabele, ulawulo, ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa namakhono okuhlanganisa. Ulwazi ngemithetho ephathelene nayo, imiyalo, izinqubomgomo kanye nemikhuba ephatha ukulethwa kwenkonzo yezempilo. Amakhono okuqamba ukwelashwa kanye nokwakheka kwezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi olujulile ngezindlela zokuletha ukunyathelwa kwezokunyanga kanye nevimbandela yokusebenza ezindaweni ezikulawulweni. Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo olubalulekile, iziqondiso zokuqamba ukwelashwa, imithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nemikhuba. Amakhono okuxhumana ohlelo, wobuntu, okuxoxisana, okuthathwa kwezinqumo, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuphathwa kwezixuku, okweluleka, okufundisa, okumemela nokuba ngumcondisi. Amakhono amsoco okulawula izimali. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wokuziphatha, Ubudlelwano Bokuqashwa kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nawo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola kanye nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo zokubelethisa engekho udokotela (okusho ukuthi) i-Eclampsia APH njll. Ukuqaphela abathathi mkhathi abasureshi okuphezulu ngesikhathi sobukhathi bayaphakathi kanye nasemuva kokubeletha, kubaphathe noma baxhunywe ngokomthetho wesibhedlela. Ukuthuthukisa umbono kanye nomgomo kanye nokuqonda ibandla lokubelethisa. Ukuthuthukisa, ukuphumeza kanye nokubuyekeza izinqubomgomo zokubelethisa / i-SOP. Ukuqhatha izinkathi zokubuyezela ukufa kwabantwana abayisanda noma izingqungquthela. Ukwazi imithetho kanye nemiyalo ye-SANC ephathelene nokubelethisa. Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokuphuhuzela imfundo yaphakade kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga ebandleni lokubelethisa. Ukubamba iqhaza njengosomki wabakhwetha basebenzisa izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ukuba yingxenye yeqembu lapho abasebenzi behlukene khona. Ukubamba iqhaza nokuba ngumholi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokubelethisa, okusho ukuthi i-PPIP, i-PMTCT, i-BBI, i-MBFI, ne-RHC – ukuzala kokuziphilisa. Ukutholakala izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ukusebenzisa ulawulo ngokubamba iqhaza ngokweseka imisebenzi yokuphatha umqashi. Ukugcina kanye nokulawula izinto kanye nokulethwayo. Ukuhamba izingqungquthela ezibanjwa esikhungweni / ngaphandle. Ukunika ubuholo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulethwa kokunakekelwa okuphumelelisayo, okubandakanya konke kokunakekelwa okusesikhundleni kwezinyanga ze-O&G ngaphakathi kokuqondiswa okuhleliwe kanye nosizo ochwepheshe / omthetho. Ukuhlela, ukuhlanganisa, ukubambisana, ukulawula imisebenzi yokunyanga kanye nolawulo lwaba kuleso sikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle komuntu ugule. Ukulawula kanye nokukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwentsholongwazi kanye namaphuzu okulawula, ukuphaphama kwesiguli kanye nokuqaliswa kokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphatha okuphumelelisayo kanye nokusebenzisa abantu, izimali, kanye nezinsiza. Ukulawula izimali ngokugqamisa ukuhlaliswa kwindleko kanye nokugcina yonke imibhalo ngaphakathi kwezinqubomgomo zezimali mayelana nokuthenga kanye nenqubomgomo mayelana nokukhiqiza imali. Ukulawula kanye nokusekela basebenzi bokunyanga, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemiyalo, izinqubomgomo kanye neninga lenkondlo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ibandla lihambisana namazinga e-OHSC kanye ne-IHRM. Ukulawula ukuphuhuzela ulawulo lokuqamba ukwelashwa kanye namazinga okuqinisekisa izinga. Ukuhlola abasebenzi ngokusebenza kwabo, kanye nokuphuhuzela isu sesinqume sabaqashi. Ukusebenzisana namakilabhu awohlukenego ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo okuphumelelisayo, okugcina izindleko kanye nokulingana. Ukuqondisa kanye nokwenza lula ukuqondisa abasha basebenzi, ukuqeqesha abasemgwaqeni kanye nokuqeqesha ngokungqandavu kanye nokuthuthukiswa kobungcweti ngaphandle kwesikhathi somsebenzi. Ukuqamba kanye nokuthumela imibiko, izibalo kanye nanolunye ulwazi oludingekayo. Ukubamba iqhaza kumasebenzi ocwaningo kanye nokukhuthaza ukunyathelwa kolwazi mayelana nokunyanga. Ukugcina ukukhula kolwazi, imigomo yokuziphatha kanye nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuqhuba kanye nokulawula ukuphuhuzela kwesinhlelo se-CPD njengakumgomo we-CPD we-SANC.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi- Umsebenzi Wasebusuku
xh.summary: Umphathi wemisebenzi wasebusuku e Port Shepstone Regional Hospital ofuna isidanga sokhunjulwana, isigqibo sokunyanga ababelekisi neminyaka elishumi esixheni yolwazi lwangaphakathi.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 / Imatrik okanye eNdinganiselayo. IDiploma / Isidanga kwiSayensi yokhunjulwana jikelele. IDiploma / Isidanga kwiSayensi yokhunjulwana lokunyanga ababelekisi. IDiploma / Isidanga ekuLawulweni kweenkonzo eziNgcono ezeMpilo. Isatifikethi kwikholeji yekhompyutha. Ubulungu okuqinisekisiweyo kwi SANC njengogqiwo lokhunjulwana jikelele, onyathi / onyathi naye kwaye ungunyathi wokulawula iinkonzo ezintle ezeMpilo. Iminyaka engu-7 ubuncinane yolwazi lwangaphakathi lokhunjulwana emva kokuba ngumnyathi nakummi wezibedlele njengogqiwo lokhunjulwana jikelele kwindawo yesibedlele. Iresiti yangoku ye SANC ka-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuSebenza okuFunekayo: Amakhono obukhosi, okulawula, okucwangcisa, okuqamba nokuqhagamshelana. Ulwazi ngeMithetho, ngemiThetho, ngeents policies nezendlela ezilawula ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ezintle ezeMpilo. Ukusebenza kakuhle ngokweliso kwaye ukwenziwa kwezinqobo. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngeendlela zokunikezela ngakhunjulwana nangomda wolwazi olulawulwa ngumntu. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo, iimveliso zangaphakathi, iinkqubo, iints policies nangendlela. Amakhono obuqhagamshelano, okuxhumana nabantu, okuxoxisana, okuthatha izigqibo, okusombulula iingxaki, okulawula ingxabano, okwelisa, okufundisa, okukhokela nokulawula. Amakhono angaphantsi okulawula imali. Ulwazi ngeKhowudi yokuziphatha, uBudlelwane boBasebenzi ngeents policies ezinxulumene nayo.
xh.duties: Kuxilongoze kwaye ulawule iimeko ezibuthathaka zokubeleka kwingxaxe yodokhola (umz.) iEclampsia, iAPH, njalo. Zichonge abathengi ababuthathaka ngexesha lokubeleka nangemva kokubeleka, balawule okanye babathumele ngokomthetho wesibedlele. Yakhe umbono, injongo nemiqondiso yeyunithi yokubeleka. Yakhe, usebenzise kwaye uqwalasele iints policies zokubeleka / iSOP. Qhuba iinqobo okuba zithintele ukufa okwenzeka ngexesha lokubeleka okanye iindibano. Yazi iimithetho nengqikhitha ze SANC ezithinta okubeleka. Yakhe kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zemfundo yangaphakathi nongphuculo loluhlu loluhlu lokubeleka. Yiba ngumthethi wabathengi usebenzisa iimvisiswano zeBatho Pele. Yiba yinxalenye yeqela elihlangene, elinguwo. Thatha inxaxheba kwaye udale zonke iinkqubo zokubeleka, umz. iPPIP, iPMTCT, iBBI, iMBFI, neRHC – impilo yokuqhamsha. Chonga iimfuno zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Zisebenzise ulawulo oluthatha inxaxheba ngokuncedisa kumsebenzi wokukhulula ogqibo. Gcina kwaye ulawule izitokhwa nezinto eziyimfuneko. Zikhondo eendibanweni ezenziwa kwisikhungo / ngaphandle. Nika ubukhosi kwaye uqinisekise ukunikezelwa ngokugqibeleleyo, nangokupheleleyo kweeyunithi ezitsalwe kakhulu zeO&G ngaphakathi kwezingqikithi ezimiswe ngokuchanekileyo nangokomthetho / ngokomthetho. Cwangcisa, hlela, qhagamshela, lilise imisebenzi yokhunjulwana nolawulo lweziganeko kwidomain ukuze uqinisekisela ukunakekelwa okuhle koguli. Lilisa kwaye ukhulule ukusebenzisa iindlela zoKuthintela nokuLawula Ukutyalwa, ukhuseleko koguli nongphuculo loluhlu. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokusebenzisa abantu, imali, nezinto. Lilisa imali ngokugqamisa ukuhlala ngemibi yemali kwaye ugcine zonke iirekhodi ngaphakathi kweents policies ezimali malunga nokuqesha nents policy malunga nokwenza imali. Lawule kwaye uxhase abasebenzi bakho, qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo, iints policies nangoomgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba yunithi ihambelana nezigqibo zeOHSC neIHRM. Lilisa ukusebenziswa kweenkqubo zobukhosi bengcali kwaye ukhusele iingqineliso. Qwalasela abasebenzi ngokusebenza, kwaye usebenzise icebo lokuncedisa ogqatshu. Sebenzisana namaqela ahlangene ukuze uqinisekise ukuba inkonzo inikwa ngenkqubo, ngesixa esifanelekileyo ngokweimali yaye ngokulinganayo. Qhagamshelana kwaye ukhokele inkqubo yokuzisa, ukuqeqesha abasebenzi, ukukhokelela nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo ngokwemveliso ngokwemveliso. Yakhe kwaye unike iingxelo, izibalo nolwazi olunye olufunekayo. Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yokuphonononga kwaye ukhuthaze ukhunjulwano olusekelwe kwimveliso. Gcina ukukhula ngokwemveliso, iingqinisekiso ngokuziphatha nokuziphucula. Yiba ngumkhokeli kwaye ulilise ukusebenziswa kwenkqubo yeCPD ngokweSikhokelo seCPD seSANC.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1/2 – Specialty Stream
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R571 161 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R741 783 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional), In- hospital Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1/2) specialising in advanced midwifery at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, providing antenatal, labour and obstetric emergency care.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Degree/Diploma) in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a “Professional Nurse” with Midwifery A post-basic qualification in Advanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing Science with a duration of at least one year, accredited with the SANC. Certificates of Registration with the SANC (General Nursing and Midwifery) Current registration with the SANC (2026) Experience Grade 1: a minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Experience Grade 2: a minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the specific specialty, i.e. Advanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing, after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge of nursing legislation, policies, guidelines and professional/ethical practices. Knowledge and skills in the management of normal and high-risk pregnancy, labour, delivery and the postnatal period. Ability to identify and manage obstetric emergencies within the scope of practice. Good communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Basic computer literacy. Ability to plan, organise and provide quality nursing and midwifery care. Knowledge of Batho Pele principles and Infection Prevention and Control practices.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic and specialised nursing and midwifery care in the Admission, Antenatal and Labour Ward. Provide antenatal care and monitor patients during labour and delivery. Identify and manage obstetric emergencies and complications within the scope of practice. Effective utilisation of human, financial and material resources. Participate in training, research, quality assurance and clinical audits. Maintain accurate patient records and promote adherence to nursing and midwifery standards. Provide support to nursing services and work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Attend meetings, workshops and training programmes as assigned by the supervisor. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift leader on both day and night when necessary. NB: Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1/2 – Spesialiteitsstroom
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Graad 1/2) wat spesialiseer in gevorderde vroedvrouskunde by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, wat voorgeboortelike, kraam- en verloskundige nood-sorg verskaf.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Graad/Diploma) in verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n "Professionele Verpleegkundige" met Vroedvrouskunde toelaat. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie in Advanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing Science met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC. Sertifikate van Registrasie by die SANC (Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroedvrouskunde). Huidige registrasie by die SANC (2026). Ervaring Graad 1: 'n minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ervaring Graad 2: 'n minimum van 14 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit, d.w.s. Advanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing, wees na verkryging van die eenjarige post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis van verpleegkundige wetgewing, beleide, riglyne en professionele/etiese praktyke. Kennis en vaardighede in die bestuur van normale en hoë-risiko swangerskap, kraam, bevalling en die postnatale tydperk. Vermoe om verloskundige noodgevalle binne die omvang van praktyk te identifiseer en te bestuur. Goeie kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoe om effektief in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoe om gehalte-verpleegkunde- en vroedvrouskundesorg te beplan, organiseer en verskaf. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels en Infeksievoorkoming en -beheerpraktyke.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese en gespesialiseerde verpleegkunde- en vroedvrouskundesorg in die Toelatings-, Voorgeboortelike- en Kraamsaal. Verskaf voorgeboortelike sorg en monitor pasiënte tydens kraam en bevalling. Identifiseer en bestuur verloskundige noodgevalle en komplikasies binne die omvang van praktyk. Effektiewe benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne. Neem deel aan opleiding, navorsing, gehalteversekering en kliniese oudits. Onderhou akkurate pasiëntrekords en bevord nakoming van verpleegkunde- en vroedvrouskundestandaarde. Verskaf ondersteuning aan verpleegkundige dienste en werk effektief as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Onderhou professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Bywoon vergaderings, werkswinkels en opleidingsprogramme soos deur die toesighouer toegewys. Bystand verleen met verpligte pligte van die toesighouer en optree as skifleier op beide dag en nag wanneer nodig. NB: Moet bereid wees om skof te werk soos toegewys; sluit nagskof, naweke en openbare vakansiedae in.

zu.title: Umongikazi Othwebule 1/2 – Isimiso Sokuchwepheshe
zu.summary: Umongikazi Othwebule (Izinga 1/2) ohlose ukuchwepheshe ekuqakwendeni okuthuthukile e-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, ethi inikeze ukunakekelwa kwasemuqamweni, ngesikhathi sokubeletha kanye nokunakekelwa kwezimpilo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okungukuthi IDigri/IDiploma) ekuqakashisweni noma iziqu ezingalinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi osebenza ekuqakwendeni Isiqu sokwengcoliswa ekuqakwendeni okuthuthukile nasezulalweni zokubeletha nobungongozi bezalo esikhathini esinganani unyaka oyedwa, esagunyazwe yi-SANC. Izitifikedi zokubhalisa kwi-SANC (Ukuqakashisa okujwayelekile nokuqakwenda) Ukubhalisa okwamanje kwi-SANC (2026) Okuhlolwayo Izinga 1: okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-4 yohlelo olufanele/olwaziwayo ekuqakashisweni emva kokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi kwi-SANC ekuqakashisweni okujwayelekile. Okuhlolwayo Izinga 2: okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-14 yohlelo olufanele/olwaziwayo ekuqakashisweni emva kokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi kwi-SANC ekuqakashisweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesikhathi esikhunjulwe ngaphezulu kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanele/eso sasiyaziwa esikhundleni esithize, okungukuthi ekuqakwendeni okuthuthukile nasekuqakwendeni kokubeletha, emva kokuthola isiqu sokwengcoliswa sayunyaka owodwa esikhundleni esithize. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezokuqashwa, izinqubo, izixwayiso, namasu ahlomula ngokuchwepheshe/okuzipatha. Ulwazi namakhono ekuqashweni nokuphathweni kwesikhathi esijwayelekile nesesingo sokubeletha, ukubeletha, ukuletha kanye nesikhathi ngemva kokubeletha. Ikhono lokukhomba futhi kulawulwe izimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okuxhumana nawabantu nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo eqenjini elihlangene. Ukuqwala izisekelo ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokuhlela, ukubumba futhi kunikeze ukunakekelwa okuphezulu kokuqakwenda nokugula. Ulwazi ngezimiso ze-Batho Pele namasu okuvikela nokuqonda ukutheleleka.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuphezulu okuphelele nokuchwepheshe kokuqakwenda nokubeletha kwabaguli e-Wardi yokungena, kwabasabelethe kanye nase-Wardi yokubeletha. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabasabelethe futhi kuhloliswe abaguli ngesikhathi bokubeletha nasekuletheni. Ukukhomba futhi kulawulwe izimo eziphuthumayo nokubeletha okubangezwa yizinkinga ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza. Ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwemithombo yabantu, ezimali nezinto. Ukubamba iqhaza ekugxilweni, ekuphenyeni, ekuqinisekiseni izinga kanye nokuhlolweni kwezokwelapha. Ukugcina irekhodi echanekileyo labaguli futhi kuthuthukise ukulandela izinga lokuqakwenda nokubeletha. Ukunikeza inkxaso ezinkonzweni zokuqakwenda futhi kusebenze ngempumelelo njengesigxabo seqembu elihlangene. Ukugcina ukukhula ngokuchwepheshe, izinga lokuzipatha nokuzikhethela. Ukuhlanganyela emihlanganweni, emiklweni wokuqeqesha namuhla ongumyalezo osukunyathiwe nguMphathi. Ukusiza kwimisebenzi yokushintsisa komphathi futhi abe ngumholi weshifti emini nasebusuku uma kunesidingo. NB: Kumele uzibophezele ukusebenza ishifti ngokwemaphasi-nyawo efakwe; kufaka phakathi ishifti ebusuku, ngemibosama nezinsuku eziyihlobo eZimiso.

xh.title: Umhloli wezozo weGqadi 1/2 – Umthamo woBuchule
xh.summary: Umhloli wezozo (iGqadi 1/2) ogqithayo kumkhakha wokuvelisa abantwana kwiSibhedlele sokuKhumbula iNkosi uMshiyeni, ethula inkonzo yokhathalelo phambi kokuzalwa, nokuzalwa, kunye nenkonzo yezigangatho ezibuthathaka kumkhakha wokuvelisa abantwana.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esisisiseko seR425 (okt. iDegree/Diploma) kwezonyongo okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo“Professional Nurse” noMvelisi wabantwana. Isidanga esingaphezulu kweAdvanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing Science esithatha ubuncinane unyaka omnye, esamkelwe yiSANC. Iifom zokuBhalisa kwiSANC (iGeneral Nursing and Midwifery). UkuBhalisa okuseleyo kwiSANC (2026). Okuhlangabezana nayo iGqadi 1: ubuncinane iminyaka emi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/akuqatshelwayo kwezonyongo emva kokubhalisa njengoProfessional Nurse kwiSANC kwiiGeneral Nursing. Okuhlangabezana nayo iGqadi 2: ubuncinane iminyaka elishumi nane (14) yamava afanelekileyo/akuqatshelwayo kwezonyongo emva kokubhalisa njengoProfessional Nurse kwiSANC kwiiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane iminyaka elishumi leyo minyaka elutshuniweyo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/akuqatshelwayo kumthamo othileyo wobuchule, oko kukuthi iAdvanced Midwifery and Obstetrical Nursing, emva kokufumana isidanga esingaphezulu kwesiya unyaka somthamo othileyo owufundayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezonyongo, iinkqubo zamagqabantshintshi, iinkqubo ezilolongwayo namaziko obuchule. Ulwazi namakhono ekulawuleni ukukhulelwa okusesitweni nakokingoziyo, ukubeletha, ukuzalwa nethembo lokuzalwa. Ikhono lokubona nokulawula iimeko ezibuthathaka kumkhakha wokuvelisa abantwana ngaphakathi kommandla womsebenzi. Amakhono amabalallweyo, obudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu bokuncedisana nokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokusebenzayo kwiqela elinabasebenzi abavela kumabala amaninzi. Ukuzoba ngesikrini esisisiseko. Ikhono lokucwangcisa, ukuqamba izinto nokuvelisa ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngokukhathalela abasempilweni abakhulelweyo nabazalwayo.
xh.duties: Inkonzo ngenkqubo yokulawula abasempilweni abakhulelweyo ebeqela kwangaphambili nakuqesha imisebenzi yezigangathwa ezikummandla wamagqabantshintshi angafanelekanga amaxesha amaninzi namava okufumana ulwazi othileyo nokuzala abantwana. Yonke imisebenzi ekufuneka yenziwe kwimeko yokuba lisefuniwe ukuba kubekho ukuzala nokuhamba komsebenzi wakho ngokupheleleyo nangokuchanekileyo. Ukubeka iingxaki ezinobungozi kwindlela ekukhuliswa ngayo inkonzo ngomsebenzi wakho nokuzibandakanya ekusebenzeni koluntu nokuziphatha kakuhle kwaye ulindele iingxaki zokuzala ukusuka kubantu abafuna ukukhulisa abantwana ngokukhawuleza. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo izixhobo zomuntu, ezimali nezinto. Ukubandakanywa ekufundeni, kuphandweni, kwinkqubo yomgangatho wezonyongo nakwiinkqubo zokuhlahlelwa ngamava abantu abanawo ekubeni bakhulelwe. Ukulondoloza amanqaku obumpilo obuchanekileyo bomntu ovelisa usana nokukhuthaza ukulandwa kwemigangatho yezonyongo evelisa abantwana. Ukukhuthaza inkonzo yokukhathalela abantu abantu abakhulelweyo ekubeni bakhulele abantwana basebenze ngokufanelekileyo njengesinye isigaba seqela elinamasebe amaninzi. Ukuphuhlisa ulwazi lwakho lobuchule, ukuziphatha ngokwekhusi kwaye uzilolonge ukuba ngumntu ozikhuselayo. Ukuya kwiiNdibano zamagqabantshintshi, iinkqubo zokuzifundisa nemisebenzi efunwa ngumlawuli wakho. Ukuncedisa nomlawuli wakho ekubeni kwakho namaxesha onke ekulawuleni iNdibano nentsasa kwaye usebenze njengesikhokelo kwiiNdibano zentsasa, kubandakanya ubusuku namaphondo emini.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1/2 – Specialty Stream
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R571 161 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R741 783 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional), In- hospital Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed for operating theatre specialty stream at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, providing holistic specialised nursing care.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification(i.e. Degree/Diploma)in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council(SANC) as a “Professional Nurse” with Midwifery A post basic qualification in ‘Operating Theatre Nursing Science’, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC Certificates of Registration with the SANC (General Nursing and Midwifery) Current registration with the SANC (2026) Experience Grade 1: a minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Experience Grade 2: a minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience in the specific specialty (i.e. Operating Theatre Nursing Science’) after obtaining the 1- year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Possess communication skills for dealing with patients, supervisors and other members of the multidisciplinary team, including the writing of reports when required. Good human relations, displaying a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care, including a willingness and awareness to respond to patients' needs, requirements and expectations (Batho Pele). Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Ability to plan and organise own work, time and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care in the unit. Demonstrate knowledge of peri-operative nursing care and practices.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic specialised nursing care with set standards and within a professional/legal framework in the Operating Theatre. Effective utilisation of resources. Participation in training and research. Provision of support to nursing services and multidisciplinary theatre teams. Maintain professional growth, ethical standards and self-development. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care, including awareness and willingness to respond to patient needs, requirements and expectations. Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure good nursing care that is cost-effective, equitable and efficient. Attend meetings, workshops and training programmes as assigned by the supervisor. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift leader on both day and night when necessary. NB: Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1/2 – Spesialiteitsstroom
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige benodig vir operasiesale-spesialiteitsstroom by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg bied.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. Graad/Diploma) in verpleging of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n "Professionele Verpleegkundige" met Verloskunde toelaat. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie in 'Operating Theatre Nursing Science', met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC. Sertifikate van registrasie by die SANC (Algemene Verpleging en Verloskunde). Huidige registrasie by die SANC (2026). Ervaring Graad 1: 'n minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ervaring Graad 2: 'n minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit (d.i. 'Operating Theatre Nursing Science') wees na behaling van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die ter sake spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardigheidsopleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wetlike en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Besit kommunikasievaardighede vir omgang met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander lede van die multidissiplinêre span, insluitend die skryf van verslae wanneer vereis. Goeie menslike verhoudinge, om besorgdheid vir pasiënte te toon, behoorlike behandeling en sorg te bevorder en te ondersteun, insluitend 'n bereidwilligheid en bewustheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer (Batho Pele). Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsinstrument om dienslewering te verbeter. Vermoë om eie werk en tyd en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die eenheid te verseker. Toon kennis van peri-operatiewe verpleegsorg en praktyke.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg met vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele/wettige raamwerk in die Operasiesale. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne. Deelname aan opleiding en navorsing. Verskaffing van ondersteuning aan verpleegdienste en multidissiplinêre teaterspanne. Handhaaf professionele groei, etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en ondersteun behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiëntbehoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker wat koste-effektief, billik en doeltreffend is. Bywoon van vergaderings, werkswinkels en opleidingsprogramme soos deur die toesighouer toegewys. Bystand met waarnemingspligte van die toesighouer en optree as 'n skifteleier gedurende beide dag en nag wanneer nodig. NB: Moet bereid wees om skigte te werk soos toegewys; sluit nagskigte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae in.

zu.title: Umongikazi Ochwepheshe Izinga 1/2 – Isiqhagamsheli Sokusebenza Kwesinye Isikhathi
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongikazi ochwepheshe ohlinzeka ngokusethelwe kwesinye isikhathi esithiyetha kukho Izinkampani Zokuhlinza ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, okuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuzo kwamakhono okuhlinzeka okukhethekile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okungukuthi I-Degree/I-Diploma) ekunakekeleni noma izifundo ezingokulinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council(SANC) njengoba 'Umongikazi Ochwepheshe' ne-Midwifery. Isiqu se-post basic ekusebenzeni kwesayensi yokuhlinza, ngesikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka oyi-1, esamkelwe yi-SANC. Amatifikheyeti okubhalisa kwi-SANC (General Nursing ne-Midwifery). Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-SANC (2026). I-Experience Izinga 1: okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yamava okulingene/okuqashelwa ekunakekeleni ngemva kokubhalisa njengoba Umongikazi Ochwepheshe kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. I-Experience Izinga 2: okungenani eminyakeni engu-14 yamava okulingene/okuqashelwa ekunakekeleni ngemva kokubhalisa njengoba Umongikazi Ochwepheshe kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yesikhathi esikhushiwe ngenhla kumele kube amava okulingene/okuqashelwa kuleso sinqamulelo (okungukuthi 'Isayensi Yokuhlinza') emva kokuthola isiqu se-post-basic senyanga oyi-1 kuleso sinqamulelo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Kabonise ukuqonda okujulile komthetho wezokunakekela kanye nemithetho ehlobene nakho kanye nokuziphatha ngokomthetho nokuzethemba ekunakekelweni. Abambe amakhono okuxhumana nabagula, abaphathi namalungu amanye eqembu elinamakhono amanengi, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Kubuhle bakhe obuhle bokuxhumana nabantu, abonise ukukhathalela abagula, ukukhuthaza nokwesekela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, okuhlanganisa nokuzimisela nokuqonda ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nezithembiso zabagula (Batho Pele). Abonise ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwemithetho yezomsebenzi neyezimali kanye nezindlela zokuyenze. Abonise ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngesisekelo njengesithsa sokukhuliseka kokuhlinzeka. Akwazi ukucubungula nokuqamba umsebenzi wakhe, isikhathi naleso sabasekelayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwamakhono okuhlinza. Abonise ulwazi ngokunakekelwa kanye nezindlela zokunakekelwa ngaphambi kokuhlinza kanye nakuhlinzwa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuhle kakhulu okuzo kwamakhono okuhlinzeka okukhethekile okuhambisana namazinga asethiwe futhi ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho/ochwepheshe kwizinkampani zokuhlinza. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwamasosiza. Ukuthatha inhlavo ekulolongweni nasekucwaningweni. Ukuhlinzeka ngokweseka amasevisi okunakekelwa namateyimbe ezeqembu elinamakhono amanengi kwizinkampani zokuhlinza. Ukwagcina ukukhula komsebenzi, amazinga okuziphatha okufanele kanye nokuzakuzijwayeza. Abonise ukukhathalela abagula, ukukhuthaza nokwesekela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele, okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokuzimisela ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nezithembiso zabagula. Abasebenze njengolunywe lwegumbu elinamakhono amanengi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle okungalizi, okulinganayo futhi okusebenzayo. Ahvott imihlangano, izinkundla zokusebenza namaphulo ukuqeqesha njengoba emthunywa ngumphathi. Asize ngemisebenzi yokuphumula komphathi futhi abe ngumholi wesikhundla ekuseni nasbusuku uma kudingeka. NB: Kumele azibambelele ukusebenza isikhundla njengoba kuhleliwe; okuhlanganisa nokusebenza ebusuku, ngezikhiphama nasemicimbeni yomphakathi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGqithisayo Inqanaba 1/2 – Umthetho weQela leNgcumbi
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongikazi ogqithisayo kumthetho weqela lengcumbi kwiNdawo yoGqitho iNkosi Mshiyeni eKwaZulu-Natal, ukunika unyango lwezempilo olubanzi noluchanekileyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zegunya leR425 (okt. iNqanaba lesiFundo/ i Diplomatic) kuzoongikazi okanye isixa esiyantlanjwa kweso siguqo esivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo"Mongikazi oGqithisayo" nepaleni ezelwe iMbeleko. Isigqibo sokuqala ngemva kwegunya eliyintloko kwi'Ssayensi yoNyango lweNdawo yoGqitho', ngexesha elingathi nyaka omnye, elamkelwe yi-SANC. IZatifikesi zokuBhalisa kwi-SANC (iNyango eliQhelekileyo nePaleni eZelwe). Ukubhalisa ngoku kwi-SANC (2026). Iminyaka yamava inqanaba 1: inqanaba elincitshiywe lonyaka mmine ulungileyo/ovakalayo woLwazi kuyo yononke iminyaka emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqithisayo kwi-SANC kwiNyango eliQhelekileyo. Iminyaka yamava inqanaba 2: inqanaba elincitshiywe lonyaka ali-14 ulungileyo/ovakalayo woLwazi kuyo yononke iminyaka emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqithisayo kwi-SANC kwiNyango eliQhelekileyo. Ubuyeke iminyaka eli-10 kule minyaka eshiwo ngentla kufuneka ibe ngamava amalungileyo/avakalayo kwelo qela elithe ngqo (okt.'iSayensi yoNyango lweNdawo yoGqitho') emva kokuFumana isigqibo sokuqala ngemva kwegunya eliyintloko kwelo qela elithe ngqo. ULwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namabala aFunekayo: Kubonise uQonde elingene ngokucamileyo ngomthetho wezongikazi namathetho alawula izongikazi echanekileyo nayoyikelelo okwenziwa ngayo. Anamandla okuthetha athintela abelwe iimbeba, oorhogoboyi nakwabcinywe kweli qela, kubandakanya nobhalo iingxelo xa kuyimfuneko. Abunzi obubaxa kubantu, abonise intshiseko kumiguli, aqhubezeze kwaye axhase unyango oluthe ngqo neLungelo, kubandakanya ukuzinikela nokuQonda xa kuphendula iimfuno zabaguli, iimfuno neminqweno (Batho Pele). Kubonise uQonde osisiseko ngamathetho eBe zomzimba nezemali. Kubonise ulwazi olusisiseko lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha njengesixhobo sokuncedisa ukomeleza ukubonelelwa ngokwempepho. Abakho namandla okucwangcisa ukuze alungise umsebenzi wakhe, isixa samaxesha nesikaBaxhasi ukuqinisekisa unyango oluthe ngqo kwicandelo. Kubonise ulwazi ngonyango lwangaphambi nangemva kokusingatha kwindawo yokuQhawula.
xh.duties: Ukunika unyango oluthe ngqo olubanzi lwezongikazi ngokwemigaqo emiselweyo kunye nendlela ethethwa ngumthetho okwenziwa kuyo iNdwendwe yoGqitho. Ukusebenzisa isibonelelo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuQeqesho nokuPanda. Ukwomeleza imisebenzi yezongikazi kunye namawela amaxeshi eNdwendwe yoGqitho. Ukuze agcina ukukhula kwakhe ngokoMthetho neNqanaba eliQhelekileyo lokuZithuthisa. Abonise intshiseko kumiguli, aqhubezezeze kwaye axhase unyango oluthe ngqo nolungileyo, kubandakanya ukuQonda nokuzinikela okuthe ngqo xa kuphendula iimfuno zabaguli iimfuno noko bakulindeleyo. Ukusebenza njengenxaxheba yomxhasi weqela ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho unyango oluthe ngqo iindleko zisezantsi ngokulingana nokukhawuleza. Ukubakho kwiindibano amawele eziQeqesho nazinkqubo zoQeqesho anikiwe nguMphathi. Ukunceda kumsebenzi wokuQeqesha koMphathi kwaye abe ngumphathi wamayela emini ebusuku xa kuyimfuneko. Okuqaphelekileyo: kufuneka azilungiselele ukusebenza kumashishini ngokwabelwa, kubandakanya ukusebenza ebusuku, iCawa nemihla yamaSikhosi yoLuntu.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1/2 – Specialty Stream
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R571 161 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R741 783 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional), In- hospital Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Critical Care specialty) sought at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal. Requires SANC registration and post-basic Critical Care qualification.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Degree/Diploma) in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a “Professional Nurse” with Midwifery A post basic qualification in ‘Critical Care Nursing Science’, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC Certificates of Registration with the SANC (General Nursing and Midwifery) Current registration with the SANC (2026) Experience Grade 1: a minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Experience Grade 2: a minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience in the specific specialty (i.e. Critical Care Nursing Science) after obtaining the 1- year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Demonstrate knowledge and skills in the provision of specialised critical care nursing. Possess good communication and interpersonal skills when dealing with patients, relatives, supervisors and members of the multidisciplinary team. Demonstrate knowledge of Infection Prevention and Control and Occupational Health and Safety practices. Demonstrate basic understanding of HR and financial policies and practices. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Ability to plan, organise and coordinate nursing care in the Intensive Care Unit. Ability to train, supervise and support junior staff and student nurses. Ability to identify and manage critically ill patients and respond appropriately to emergencies. Ability to promote quality patient care, ethics and professionalism.
jobs.duties: Render optimal, holistic specialised nursing care to patients as a member of the multidisciplinary team. Train and supervise junior staff and student nurses. Maintain accreditation standards by ensuring compliance with National Norms and Standards. Co-ordinate clinical activities of the unit. Participate in the formulation, analysis, implementation and monitoring of unit objectives, policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with Infection Prevention and Control and Occupational Health and Safety policies. Strengthen ethics and professionalism. Provide a safe and therapeutic environment for patients, staff and the public. Advocate for quality patient care. Participate in staff development through the EPMDS system and other work-related programmes and training. Ensure that equipment and machinery are available and functional at all times. Report challenges and deficiencies within the unit. Attend meetings, workshops and training programmes as assigned by the supervisor. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift leader on both day and night when necessary. NB: Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1/2 – Spesialiteitsstroom
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige (Kritiese Sorg-spesialiteit) gesoek by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal. Vereis SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritiese Sorg.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Graad/Diploma) in verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met Verloskundigheid moontlik maak. 'n Na-basiese kwalifikasie in 'Critical Care Nursing Science' met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC. Sertifikate van registrasie by die SANC (Algemene Verpleegkunde en Verloskundigheid). Huidige registrasie by die SANC (2026). Ervaring Vlak 1: 'n minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ervaring Vlak 2: 'n minimum van 14 jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkende ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit (d.w.s. Critical Care Nursing Science) wees na verowering van die 1-jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewer en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Toon kennis en vaardighede in die verskaffing van gespesialiseerde kritiese-sorg-verpleging. Besit goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede wanneer daar met pasiënte, familielede, toesighouers en lede van die multidissiplinêre span gepraat word. Toon kennis van Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-praktyke. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon basiese rekenaarvaardigheid as 'n ondersteuningsnutsmiddel om dienslewering te verbeter. Vermoë om verpleegsorg in die Intensiewesorgeenheid te beplan, te organiseer en te koördineer. Vermoë om junior personeel en studenteverpleegkundiges op te lei, toe te sien en te ondersteun. Vermoë om kritiek siek pasiënte te identifiseer en te bestuur en toepaslik op noodgevalle te reageer. Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg, etiek en professionaliteit te bevorder.
af.duties: Lewer optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg aan pasiënte as 'n lid van die multidissiplinêre span. Lei junior personeel en studenteverpleegkundiges op en hou toesig oor hulle. Handhaaf akkreditasiestandaarde deur te verseker dat daar aan Nasionale Norme en Standaarde voldoen word. Koördineer kliniese aktiwiteite van die eenheid. Neem deel aan die formulering, ontleding, implementering en monitering van eenheidsdoelwitte, beleide en prosedures. Verseker voldoening aan Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-beleide. Versterk etiek en professionaliteit. Verskaf 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing vir pasiënte, personeel en die publiek. Pleitbesorg vir gehalte pasiëntsorg. Neem deel aan personeelontwikkeling deur die EPMDS-stelsel en ander werksverwante programme en opleiding. Verseker dat toerusting en masjinerie te alle tye beskikbaar en funksioneel is. Rapporteer uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Woon vergaderings, werkswinkels en opleidingsprogramme by soos deur die toesighouer opgedra. Bystand verleen met die pligte van die toesighouer en as 'n skiftleier optree beide bedags en snags wanneer nodig. NB: Moet bereid wees om skifte te werk soos toegeken; insluitend nagskof, naweke en Openbare Vakansiedae.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Othwebule izinga 1/2 – Isiqhaza Esikhethekile
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi othwebule (isiqhaza sokunakekelwa okuyingozi) e-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal. Kudingeka abhalise ku-SANC futhi anemvume yemfundo yesikhundla esiphezulu sokunakekelwa okuyingozi.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ebalulekile ze-R425 (okungukuthi IDigri/IDiploma) ekunakekelweni noma izindingo ezingefani ezenza ukuba abhaliswe kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengengomhlengikazi onemvume yokubeleka Isindingo semfundo yesikhundla esiphezulu sokunakekelwa okuyingozi esithatha ubuncwane unyaka oyedwa esamukelwe yi-SANC Amasitifiketi okubhalisa ku-SANC (ukunakekelwa okujwayelekile nokubeleka) Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-SANC (2026) Okuhlolwayo izinga 1: okungenani eminyakeni eyi-4 yohlelolwazi oluhambisana/ oluvelele ekunakekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi othwebule e-SANC ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okuhlolwayo izinga 2: okungenani eminyakeni eyi-14 yohlelolwazi oluhambisana/olvelele ekunakekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi othwebule e-SANC ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube uhlelolwazi oluhambisana/ oluvelele esiqhazeni esikhethekile (okungukuthi izayensi yokunakekelwa okuyingozi) emva kokuthola isindingo semfundo yesikhundla esiphezulu esithatha unyaka oyedwa kuleso siqhaza. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nezinkombo eziyidingeka: Kufanele abonise ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho ekunakekelweni kanye namaphethini omtetho nezokuziphatha ekunakekelweni. Kufanele abonise ulwazi namakhono ekunikezeni ukunakekelwa okuyingozi okukhethekile. Kufanele abe namakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu nokusebenza nabanye uma ekubhekene namagula, osihlalo, abaphathi kanye nalabo abaningi eqenjini elihlangene. Kufanele abonise ulwazi ngokuvikela nokulawula izifo kanye namaphethini aphilayo kwezempilo nokuphepha esebenzini. Kufanele abonise ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngemigomo yezemiholo nezimali kanye nendlela yokuziphatha. Kufanele abonise ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha njengesithusa ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukukwazi ukucubungula, ukuhlela futhi ahlophise ukunakekelwa kukawomhlengikazi eNcwajini yokunakekelwa okuyingozi. Ukukwazi ukuqeqesha, ukulawula futhi axhase abasebenzi abancane nabafundi bokuqeqeshwa ekunakekelweni. Ukukwazi ukuhlola kuphinde aphathe abagula abakhulu bese esabela ngendlela efanele ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukukwazi ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa okuhle kwamagula, izokuziphatha nobugcwe.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa okukhethekile okulungele futhi okubandakanya konke kwabagula njengelungu leqembu elihlangene. Qeqesha futhi ulawule abasebenzi abancane nabafundi bokuqeqeshwa ekunakekelweni. Gcina amazinga okuvunywa ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezindlela ezingezansi ezingezansi. Hlanganisa izinhlelo zempilo zesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni, ekuhloleni, ekusebenziseni nasekuhloleni izinhloso, imigomo kanye namaphethini esikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemigomo yokuvikela nokulawula izifo kanye nezempilo nokuphepha esebenzini. Qedisa izokuziphatha nobugcwe. Nikela ngendawo ephephile enesiphithiphithi sokwelapha kwabagula, abasebenzi nalomphakathi. Zama ngokwegagasi ukunakekelwa okuhle kwamagula. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi ngesistimu ye-EPMDS kanye nezinye izinhlelo nekuqeqeshweni okuhlobene nomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amaseshibhise namathuluzi atholakala futhi asebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi. Sengiphathe izinselelo nezinkomba ezingekho emthethweni esikhungweni. Hlanganyela kumahlangano, kumhlangano wezokusebenza nakuhlelo lokuqeqesha njengoba kuqashiweumphathi. Siza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha komphathi futhi ube ngumholi weshifthi ngosuku nangesikhathi sobusuku uma kudingeka. NB: Kumele alungele ukusebenza ngokushaywa kweshifthi njengoba kuqedwa; kubandakanya ishifthi yobusuku, amasonto neziholide zikahulumeni.

xh.title: Inqodi Yomongikela wesigaba 1/2 – Uluhlu Lwemisebenzi Eqeqeshelwa yiNtsebenzo
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMongikeli oyiNqodi (onemisebenzi eqeqeshelwa yiNtsebenzo yokunyanga abagulayo abasesichengeni) ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal. Kufuna ukubhalisa kwi-SANC kunye nemfuno yesixa sokuqeqeshwa emva kwesidanga sokubhalisa kwisoLuhlu lokuNtshona iNtshona lwezoQeqesho (post-basic Critical Care qualification).
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingundoqo ze-R425 (oko kukuthi iNqondo/Isixa Sokuqeqesho) ekunyuseni imithetho yesiGqwiya ngokulinganayo nesinokuvumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengaka "Mongikeli oyiNqodi" nowongezelelo lokuBa leSiselo. Imfuno yesixa sokuqeqeshwa esilandelayo emva kokuqala kwesiXhashu (post basic qualification) kwi 'Critical Care Nursing Science', ngexesha elinganayo neminyaka elinganiselwe kwesinye (1) unyaka, esamkelwe yi-SANC. Iifom ezibhalwe ngazo kwi-SANC (iNqondo yeQeqesho kwesiGqwiya nokuBa leSiselo). Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwi-SANC (2026). Iminyaka yemisebenzi eQela 1: kufuneka kube nengona nje kakhulu kweminyaka emi-4 (4) yangaphambili ngokulinganayo/ okubonakalayo kwemisebenzi yokunyusa imithetho yesiGqwiya emva kokubhalisela njengakaMongikeli oyiNqodi kwi-SANC kwisiGqwiya. Iminyaka yemisebenzi eQela 2: kufuneka kube nengona nje kakhulu kweminyaka eli-14 (14) yangaphambili ngokulinganayo/ okubonakalayo kwemisebenzi yokunyusa imithetho yesiGqwiya emva kokubhalisela njengakaMongikeli oyiNqodi kwi-SANC kwisiGqwiya. Kufuneka kube nengona nje iminyaka eliqhosha (10) kwisekhethi ebalulekileyo kwiNtsebenzo ethile esemthethweni wezoQeqesho (eko kukuthi yi 'Critical Care Nursing Science') emva kokuqeqeshwa kwisekondari yesinye (1) unyaka kwesoLuhlu lokunikezela iNtsebenzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono aQeqeshwayo nawo amalungiselelo aluncedo ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngokulinganayo nangokulinganiselwa kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona: Kubonisa ukuba uyaqonda ngokubanzi ngemithetho nesigqibo ngemithetho yokunyusa imithetho kwakunye nemithelela ekunikezeleni ngokwemigaqo ngokusesikweni nangokusesikweni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kubonisa ulwazi nakhono ekunikezeleni ngemisebenzi yokunyusa imithetho eqeqeswe ukuba ithathe indawo ekhawulezileyo kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kubakhona ukuba namakhono amaninzi okuthethathethana nabantu nabaphathiswa ngokusesikweni kumngeni wakho nomngeni wakho abaqeqeshi nabaphathiswa ekunikezeleni ngenxaxheba yokunyusa imithetho ngokusesikweni. Kubonisa ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuthintela nokulawula iNtshona nokuNakekela iMisebenzi yokuQinisekisa ukuKhuseleka nokukhusela ukuKhuseleka komSebenzi ekunikezeleni ngemigaqo yokuNtshona. Kubonisa ukuba uqonda ngokusesikweni imithetho yokusebenza ekunikezeleni ngenxaxheba ekunikezeleni ngokusesikweni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kubonisa ukuba uqonda ngokusesikweni imithetho yokuNtshona yekhompyutha njengesixhobo esinceda ekunikezeleni ngokusesikweni. Ukuba nakho ukulungisa, ukulungelelanisa nokuhamba ngokusesikweni ukunika isikhokelo kwiNtshona yokuNtshona yokunyusa imithetho eqeqeswe ukuba ithathe indawo ekhawulezileyo. Ukuba nakho ukuqeqesha, ukulawula nokukhusaba oonozibalo abangekho kwelixa elidibana nakuqeqeshwa emisebenzini yolwazi olunxulumene neNtshona yokuNtshona yamakhono ekuqeqesheni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Ukuba nakho ukubona nokuba namakhono okuqamba iingcinga zokunyusa imithetho ngokusesikweni nokusabela ngokusesikweni kumngeni wakho nokusabela ngokusesikweni kumngeni wakho. Ukuba nakho ukuthuthuzela ngokusesikweni ukunyusa imithetho ngokusesikweni yokubonelela ngokusesikweni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona.
xh.duties: Kubonelela ngesixa esingcono kakhulu, ngokubanzi ekunikezeleni ngemisebenzi eqeqeswe ukuba ithathe indawo ekhawulezileyo yokunyusa imithetho ngokusesikweni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona njengelungu lommandla. Kuba namakhono okuqeqesha nokulawula oonozibalo abangekho kwelixa elidibana nakuqeqeshwa kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kugcine iMigangatho yokuQeqeshwa ngokusemthethweni ngokugqibela ukuba ngokusesikweni kumthetho ogqithiswe ngowona wonke. Kubonelela ngenxaxheba kumanzi oqeqeshwa kwaye alungelelanise ukunika isikhokelo kwiNtshona yokuNtshona. Kuba namakhono okusebenza ngokomthetho kwiNtshona yokuNtshona yokusebenza ngokomthetho, iNtshona yokuNtshona yokuqeqeshwa nokuqeqeshwa kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kubonisa ukuba ngokusesikweni ugqibe ukuba ngokusesikweni kumathango okunikezela ngokusesikweni eNtshona, okusesikweni nokunikezelwa ngokusesikweni ngomntu wonke. Kuba namakhono okunika isikhokelo esinokubakho kwaye sibe nakho ukuqeqesha abantu abanomsebenzi kwaye babe nakho ukusebenza ngokusesikweni ekunikezeleni ngokusesikweni. Kuba namakhono okuqeqesha nokusebenza ngokusesikweni kwesoLuhlu lokuNtshona. Kuba namakhono okuqeqesha abantu abanomsebenzi kwaye abe nakho ukusebenza ngokusesikweni. Kubonelela ngenxaxheba ekuqeqeshweni ngokusesikweni ngokusebenzisa i-EPMDS nokuba ngokwesinye isixhobo esinceda ekunikezeleni ngokusesikweni. Kubonelela ngenxaxheba ekunikezeleni ngokusesikweni. Kubonelela ngenxaxheba kumanzi oqeqeshwa kwaye alungelelanise ukunika isikhokelo. Kubonelela ngenxaxheba kwiNtshona yokuNtshona yokusebenza ngokomthetho ngokusesikweni.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- Specialty
jobs.salary_text: R495 423 per annum, Plus 12% Rural Allowance. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed at Port Shepstone Regional Hospital to provide neonatal and child health care in the paediatrics ward.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or equivalent. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. 1 year post basic qualification in Child Health Nursing Science. A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a general nurse. Registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwife and Child Health Nurse. SANC receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Leadership, organizational, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the Public Sector and institutional policy framework. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal framework. Ability to formulate patients care related policies, vision, mission and objective of the component. Communication and interpersonal skills including Public Relations, Negotiating, Coaching. Conflict handling and counselling skills. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care, computer skills in basic programmes. Knowledge of MNCWH programmes. Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge /skills). Good communications and interpersonal skills, planning and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Implement neonatal and child health care programmes. Develop and implement quality assurance policies & operational plans. Implement standards, practice and indication for Neonatal and Child Health Care. Participate in child PPIP meetings. Manage effective utilization of all resources in the unit. Develop and implement strategies for Infection Control and Prevention for the unit. Exercise control over discipline and labour relations issues. Develop / establish and maintain constructive working relationship with nursing and other stake holders. Ensure that the unit complies with Regulated Norms and Standards. Support the Mother Baby Friendly initiative. Support and mentor student nurses. Identify high risk, manage or refer them according to hospital policy. Develop vision and mission and objectives for neonates and paediatrics. Develop, implement and review neonatal and paediatric policies/SOP. Attend meetings held in the institution/outside. Participate in the implementation of SANC CPD Framework.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applicants Are Encouraged To Utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Copies should be submitted by shortlisted candidates only) FOR ATTENTION Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (Ethical Conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC).
