Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige benodig by Port Shepstone Regionale Hospitaal om neonatale- en kindgesondheidsorg in die pediatriese saal te bied.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matrik of gelykwaardig. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vroedvrouenskap Verpleegkunde. 1 jaar post-grundwetlike kwalifikasie in Kindgesondheid Verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike of erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n algemene verpleegkundige. Registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vroedvrou en Kindgesondheid Verpleegkundige. SANC kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings-, toesighoudende en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en institutionele beleidsraamwerk. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerk. Vermoë om pasientësorg-verwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent te formuleer. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare Betrekkinge, Onderhandeling, Afrigting. Konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. Kennis van MNCWH programme. Bereidheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke, Openbare Vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis / vaardighede). Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Implementeer neonatale- en kindgesondheidsorg programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer gehalteversekeringsbeleide en operasionele planne. Implementeer standaarde, praktyk en aanduidings vir Neonatale en Kindgesondheidsorg. Neem deel aan kind PPIP vergaderings. Bestuur effektiewe benutting van alle hulpbronne in die eenheid. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë vir Infeksiebeheer en -voorkoming vir die eenheid. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline en arbeidsverhoudingsake. Ontwikkel / vestig en handhaaf konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan Gereguleerde Norme en Standaarde. Ondersteun die Moeder-baba-vriendelike inisiatief. Ondersteun en mentor studentverpleegkundiges. Identifiseer hoë risiko, bestuur of verwys hulle volgens hospitaalbeleid. Ontwikkel visie en missie en doelwitte vir neonate en pediatrie. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien neonatale en pediatriese beleide/SOP. Woon vergaderings by wat in die instelling/buite gehou word. Neem deel aan die implementering van SANC CPD Raamwerk.

zu.title: Umongameli Wokunakekela Abagulayo- Ekhono Elikhethekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongameli wokunakekela abagulayo esibhedlela i-Port Shepstone Regional Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kwezinsana nezinsizwa esibhedlela sezinsizwa.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Diploma / Degree kwe-Nursing Science Jikelele. I-Diploma / Degree kwe-Midwifery Nursing Science. Isifikiminya sokuqala semvula yesiqu ekhethekile ekuNakekelweni Kwezempilo Kwezinsizwa. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yemvelo noma ekuqashwa kwezemisebenzi yokunakekela abagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomongameli jikelele. Ukubhaliswa ne-SANC njengomongameli jikelele, i-Midwife kanye noNakekeli Wezempilo Wezinsizwa. Isitifiketi se-SANC sonyaka ka-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nama-Competencies Adingekayo: Abugqili bokukhokuma, ukuhlelela, ukwenza izinqumo, okokuhlola kanye nokuqonda okubalulekile emikhakheni kahulumeni nasekuhambisweni nemigomo yesikhungo. Ulwazi lwezindlela nezinqubo zokunakekelwa abagulayo, izixhumanisi zencazelo yamakhosi ezinye imigiqigaba yomthetho. Ikhono lokubumba imigimo ehlobene nokuNakekelwa Kwezempilo, isibhaxo, umnyako kanye nangokuhlose kwalezo nyanga. Amakhono okuxhumana nokusebenza ngomoya wokuxhumana kwezandla abantu, kufaka phakathi ukuHlelokwasabhizinisi Kawonkewonke, ukuXoxisana, ukuQeqesha. Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga nokuweluleka abagulayo. Ulwazi lwemali kanye nokubhukele imizobo ekhokhelwa kulo msebenzi wokwenza into ethize mayelana nemithombo engaphansi kobulungu. Ukuqonda izinqubo imigiqigaba ehlobene nokuNakekelwa abagulayo, amakhono ekhompyutha ngezinkqubo ezingasingesi. Ulwazi lwezinhlelwe ze-MNCWH. UkuNakela ukuSebenza ngokushintshwa, amashifu emini nasabusuku, amangebuhlungu, izikhathi zeholide. Amakhono e-Competencies (ulwazi / amakhono). Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ayeNanini oKubili, nokuhlela ezinhlelweni zakho umsebenzi wakho.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzisa izinhlelwa zencazelo zikaBantu abakhuluphele ebandla. Bhekisisa nokusebenzisa imigiqigaba yokuHlolwa kweNdlela ezokwenza ubuchule obuhle ekusebenzeni. Hlela izinsizakalo, ukukhangisisa okunye ukutholwa okuhambisana nezeMinyaka nokuHlolwa kwamabalele abakhuluphele. Hlangana imihlangano yePPIP yezinsizwa. Lawula ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinto onke eMnyankeni. Bumba ukusebenzisa okukhulu kwemiThetho yokuvimba ngaphandle kokuhlinzwa yonke iMnyama oNyakathwana. Hlola ukuthi noma yikuphi ukwenza okungalungile okungase kubambe khona emGqigomeni wakho. Bumba / wakha ugqozi lokuSebenza ngemisebenzi kaKhothe ukwamukela izinhlelo zokuhlelela ezinhle ebandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi umThetho kanye nezigaba emiZabalweni ezokwenza kuhambisana nawo. Sekele iMother Baby Friendly ngenhlayo. Sekele ukuQeqesha abafundi beNesi. Khipha okungavamile ngemvelo nokusebenzela emiThethweni noma yikuphi ukubuyekela ngesibhedlela. Bhekisisa, okukhulu, ihlanhla noma yisiphi isikhathi esihle sokuHlelela nokugqiba imigomo yezinsana kwezinsizwa. Bumba, sebenzisa futhi uHlolwe imigiqigaba yezinsana nezinsizwa iNesi/yeSOP. Hlanganyela imihlangano ebanjwa esikhungweni / ngaphandle. Hlanganyela ekuHleleleni iSANC CPD Framework.

xh.title: Unesesemtholwangqondo weMisebenzi eBalulekileyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kube ngumongikazi ogunyaziweyo kwindawo yase Port Shepstone Regional Hospital ukunikeza inkathazo lonxweme kwakhona nolunyango lweempilo zomntwana kwigumbi labantwana abagulayo.
xh.requirements: IGrade 12 / Matric okanye okulingana nayo. IDiploma / Degree kwiSayensi yoNqeqesho lokuQhatha. IDiploma / Degree kwiSayensi yoNqeqesho lokuNceda abantu abayimithamo. I-1 year post basic qualification kwisiFundiso soNyango lweMpiIko zomntwana. Okungenani i-4 years inkqubela phambili kwize ngokuvumileyo noma ezivunyelweyo kwinkqubo yokunyanga emva kokuqanjwa ngokwesigqeba soGqirha. Ukubhaliswa kwinkqubo SANC njengomongikazi oQhatha, oNceda abantu abayimithamo kunye noNyango lweMpilo yomntwana. Isitfuxo se-SANC samhlophe ka-2026. Ulwazi, Amafupha, uQeqesho nokuQonda okufunekayo: Ukulawula, ukuHlola, ukwenzisa iSigqibo, nokuQondisa, kunye nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kweMida yoHlaziyo lweZwitter, kwinkqubo yakwaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yonyango nekqubululo, imithetho yonyango kwaye nolunye uhlobo lweMithetho. Ukuba nokwazi ukwenza iMithetho yolawulo oluthe lwakho, eyakusetyenziswa ngumntu othe ngale ndlela kuphela. Amafupha okunxibelelana namanye aze afake kuQuquzelelwano nokuQeqesha abanye. Ulwazi olubalulekileyo lokuLawula imali eFakwayo ngokusemthethweni iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo, iinkqubo zokuQonda kwiinkqubo zaManqanaba. Ukuba namandla okuNika amanye isakhono sokuba bachaze iNkqubo yabo nokuba nasiphi na isakhono sezigqibo, nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo ezisisiseko zeKhompyutha. Ulwazi ngamafupha eMncwele namanyathelo. Ukuzithanda ukuSebenza iinkqubo ezize ngokukhawuleza, eMini nakusuku, naseIwekendini, naseKwindlela eNkulu zokuGubela. Ukuzimisela ukuSebenza ulwazi lwemisebenzi /amafupha okusebenza. Amafupha okuNxibelelana namanye namandla okuQonda, ukuCwangcisa nokwenzisa inkqubo yokusebenza.
xh.duties: Ukusetyenziswa kolunyango lweNthetho yenkolo yakho neMpiIko yomntwana nasekwenzeni iinkqubo ezintsha. Ukuqonda nokuSebenza ngokuQinisekisa iMithetho yekhwalithi neZigqibo. Ukusetyenziswa koMgangatho nokwenza okusemthethweni kolunyango lweNthetho yenkolo yakho neMpiIko yomntwana. Ukuzibandakanya kwiinkqubo zokuGqiba iMithetho. UkuLawula ngokufanelekileyo nokuSebenzisa ngokusemthethweni amandla eNyanga. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa ulwazi nokuQinisekisa iNkqubo yokulwa nokutshona izifo ezibalekayo nasekuyini ukutshona izifo ezibalekayo. UkuLawula ngokusemthethweni nokuyini iMithetho yeNyanga kwinkqubo yokusebenza ngokweMithetho. Ukuqonda okutsha /okuhle njengesikhokelo sokusebenza ngokwakho nokuQondisa ulwazi olufunekayo ukuze usinike naye okunye ukuSebenzisa iNkqubo. UkuQinisekisa ukuba iNkqubo ihambelana neMithetho neMigaqo. UkuNceda ekuQaleni iNkqubo yokulunga noMama. UkuNceda nokuQeqesha abaFundileyo abafundi abaQeqeshwa iMithetho. Ukuqonda iMilingo nokuLawula okuthe lwakho okuQondene noMthetho weSibhedlele. Ukuqonda okutsha nokuSebenzisa iMithetho nokuyini ukugqiba iMithetho neenkqubo zokuHamba kwiMithetho yakho. Ukuqonda, ukuSebenzisa nokubuyekeza iNkqubo yamafupha kaMntwana kunye nokuHamba kweMithetho kaMntwana nokuHamba kweNkqubo kwiNkqubo. UkuXhoma ukuya kwindawo yokubhiyozela iNkqubo kwindawo /nangaphandle. UkuXhoma ekusebenziseni iNkqubo yokuQeqesha eNtsha kwinkqubo SANC CPD.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- Speciality
jobs.salary_text: R495 423 per annum, Plus 12% Rural Allowance. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialised in obstetrics and gynaecology sought for Port Shepstone Regional Hospital to manage obstetric emergencies and high-risk maternity cases.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or Matric certificate. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Advanced Midwifery Nursing Science. A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Registration with SANC as General Nurse, midwife and Advanced Midwife. SANC Receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Leadership, organizational, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the Public Sector and institutional policy framework. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal framework. Ability to formulate patients care related policies, vision, mission and objective of the component. Communication and interpersonal skills including Public Relations, Negotiating, Coaching. Conflict handling and counselling skills. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining nursing care, computer skills in basic programmes. Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge /skills). Good communications and interpersonal skills, planning and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Diagnose and manage obstetric emergencies in the absence of a doctor, i.e., Eclampsia APH, etc. Identify high risk clients during ante-partum and post- partum periods, manage them or refer them according to hospital policy. Develop vision and mission and objectives for obstetric unit. Develop, implement and review obstetric policies / SOP. Conduct Perinatal Mortality reviews or meetings. Know SANC rules and regulations pertaining to obstetrics. Develop and implement in-service education and quality improvement programs for the obstetrics dept. Act as an advocate for clients utilizing Batho Pele principles. Form part of the multi-disciplinary team. Take part in all obstetrics programs, i.e. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, and RHC – reproductive health. Identify training needs for the staff. Practice participative management by assisting with relief duties of the supervisor. Maintain and monitor stock and supplies. Attend meetings held in the institution/outside.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applicants are encouraged to utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit proof of qualifications) FOR ATTENTION Mr. Z.M Zulu

All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige met spesialisering in verloskunde en ginekologie gesoek vir Port Shepstone Regional Hospital om verloskundige noodgevalle en hoërisiko-materniteitsgevalle te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of Matrik-sertifikaat. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Verloskunde Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Gevorderde Verloskunde Verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, vroedvrou en Gevorderde Vroedvrou. SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming, toesighoudende en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerk. Vermoë om pasiëntesorgverwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent op te stel. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare Betrekkinge, Onderhandeling, Afrigting. Konflikhantering en beredderingsvaardighede. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke, Openbare Vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis / vaardighede). Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Diagnoseer en bestuur verloskundige noodgevalle in die afwesigheid van 'n dokter, d.w.s. Eklampsie APH, ens. Identifiseer hoërisiko-kliënte gedurende ante-partum en post-partum periodes, bestuur hulle of verwys hulle volgens hospitaalbeleid. Ontwikkel visie en missie en doelwitte vir verloskundige eenheid. Ontwikkel, implementeer en hersien verloskundige beleide / SOP. Voer perinatale sterftesherusiensies of vergaderings uit. Ken SANC-reëls en regulasies rakende verloskunde. Ontwikkel en implementeer in-diensopleiding en gehaltsverbeteringsprogramme vir die verloskunde-dept. Tree op as 'n voorpleiter vir kliënte deur Batho Pele-beginsels te gebruik. Maak deel uit van die multidissiplinêre span. Neem deel aan alle verloskundige programme, d.w.s. PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, en RHC – reproduktiewe gesondheid. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes vir die personeel. Beoefen deelnemende bestuur deur te help met verpligtingspligte van die toesighouer. Onderhou en monitor voorraad en voorrade. Woon vergaderings by wat in die instelling/buite gehou word.

zu.title: Umongikazi Wezisebenzi - Isikhundla Esikhethekile
zu.summary: Kufunwa umongikazi wezisebenzi oghqozekile kwezokuqaliswa kwezalo kanye nezifo zabesifazane ozobe esebenza esibhedlela sasePort Shepstone Regional Hospital ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ezokubelethisa kanye namacala abesifazane abanesengo eliphezulu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12 noma iMatric. I Diploma / I Degree kwezuMongikazi Jikelele. I Diploma / I Degree kwezuMongikaziokuqaliswa kwezalo. I Diploma / I Degree kweMfundo ePhakeme yoMongikaziokuqaliswa kwezalo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yemfundo eqondile / ekuqashwayo kumongikazi ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoMongikazi Wezisebenzi kuSANC eNsesabungikazi Jikelele. Ukubhaliswa kuSANC njengoMongikazi Jikelele, umongikazi wokubelethisa noMongikazi wokubelethisa ophakeme. Isipheshana seSANC sonyaka ka-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaKhono aFuniwayo: Ubungqoshi, ukuhlelela, ukuthatha izinqumo, abalawuli kanye namandla okuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomKhakawabantu kanye nolwandle lwezinqumo zesikhungo. Ulwazi lwezinqubo namagugu okunakekelwa kokuba ngumongikazi, izomiso zomongikazi kolunye ulwandle oluhambisana nomthetho. Ikono lokwakha izinqumomabhekulwa ahlobene nokunakekelwa, i-vision, i-mission, negagasi lesigaba. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa i-Public Relations, ukuxoxisana, ukuqeqesha. Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga nokuweluleka. Ulwazi lwezimali nezabelomali ahlobene nemithombo ephathiwe. Ukuqonda izinqubo nezinqumo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kokuba ngumongikazi, amakhono ekhompyutha ezinhlelweni eziyisiseko. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza oshinthweni, ekuseni nasebusuku, nangamasonto, nangesikhathi sezikhathi ezithile zabantu. Amakhono (ulwazi /amakhono). Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, ukuhlela nokuhlelela.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola kuphinde uphathe izimo eziphuthumayo zokubelethisa ekungabikho kodokotela, okuyi, i-Eclampsia APH, nokunye. Ukuqaphela amaklayenti abanesongo eliphezulu esikhathini sangaphambi kokubeletha nangemuva kokubeletha, abaphathe noma abathumele ngokwezinqumo zesibhedlela. Ukuthola i-vision, i-mission, namagagasi eyunithi yokuqaliswa kwezalo. Ukuyakha, ukuyisebenzisa kuphinde uhlole izinqumo / i-SOP zokuqaliswa kwezalo. Ukwenza ukubuyekeza noma izinkulumo ezengezelwe zobhubhane lwabantu abancane. Ukuqonda izilinganiso nomthetho we-SANC ohlobene nokuqaliswa kwezalo. Ukuyakha futhi ukuyisebenzisa uQeqesho lwasemsebenzini namaphrokhremu okuthuthukiswa izinga ukuyunithi yokuqaliswa kwezalo. Ukuba ngommeli wamaklayenti usebenzisa izimiso zika-Batho Pele. Ukuba ingxenye yeqembu elinezigaba eziningi. Ukuthatha inxaxheva kuzo zonke izinhlela zokuqaliswa kwezalo, okuyi i-PPIP, i-PMTCT, i-BBI, i-MBFI, ne-RHC – impilo yokuqaliswa. Ukuqaphela izidingo zokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ukwenza ukuphathwa ngokubambe iqhaza ngokulekelela emisebenzini yesikhundla somlawuli. Ukugcina kuphade isitoko nezimpahla. Ukuba izinkulumo ezenziwa esikhungweni / ngaphandle.

xh.title: Inkosikazi yeNzululwazi yezeMProfu- Ikhondo
xh.summary: Kufunwa inkosikazi yemprofu egqithiswe kumkhwa wokuvela kwabantu nangokuqunjelwa kwesisu ukuba isebenze kwisibhedlele sase Port Shepstone Regional Hospital ukulawula iimeko eziphuthumayo zokuvela kwabantu namacala amabali ayingozi ebudeni bokuletha.
xh.requirements: Isatifiketi seGraji 12 okanye iMatric. Idiploma / I-degree kwiSayensi yeNesi jikelele. Idiploma / I-degree kwiSayensi yeNesi yokukhulisa abantu abangethwe. Idiploma / I-degree kwiSayensi yeNesi ePhakamileyo yokukhulisa abantu abangethwe. Amava afanelekileyo / aqaqambiswayo angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-4 enikuni nasemsebenzini wokuba yinesi emva kokubhalisa njengenkosikazi yemprofu kwi-SANC kuNesi jikelele. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoNesi jikelele, onesisi wokuqalisa, noNesi oPhakamileyo wokuqalisa. Isipho nesi sikaSANC saka-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namAbility aFunekayo:akhono abukhosi, abulela, okwengqondo ekwenzeni isigqibo, okulawula nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yangaphakathi kwiNgingqi kaRhulumente nendlela yamagigaba esikhungo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi nendlela yenzatho yokunyanga, ngemithetho yamakhadi yokukhulisa nangolunye ulwilo olusemelwe ngumthetho. Amandla okwenza iincomiso ezimalana nokunyanga isiguli, iphupha, umisiso namagaba ayingcali yendawo. Amandla okuthetha nabantu nokuziphatha kakuhle kwabanye, kuquka uMaqondo obuntu, ukuNxibelelana, ukuQeqesha. Amandla okusingatha iingxabano nokwelusa. Ulwazi ngemali nangemali yesabelo kumthombo ongaphantsi kolawulo. Ukuqonda iindlela namagigaba amayithi nangokunyanga, amakhono ekhompyutha kwinkqubo esisiseko. Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ngesithuba, emini ebusuku, ngaphezu kwemini, nangamaholide eRhulumente. Iimfuno (ulwazi /amakhono). Amakhono mahle okuthetha nabantu nokuziphatha kakuhle kwabanye, amakhono okuceba nokulawula.
xh.duties: Qapha unyange iimeko eziphuthumayo zokuvela kwabantu xa kungekho dokhota, umz. i-Eclampsia APH, njl. Phawula abaxhasi ababuthathaka ngemini yakuqala nangemini yokuqalisa, bawalawule okanye babathumele ngokomthetho wesibhedlele. Yakha iphupha, umisiso nangamagaba oyingcali wendawo yokuvela kwabantu. Yakhe, usebenzise uphinde uqwalasele iincomiso ezimalana nokunyanga abantu abavelayo / iSOP. Qhuba iingxoxo okanye iindibano zokuphinda ubuke imifu emfutshane yabantu abangethwe. Yazi imigaqo nemitetho kaSANC emalana nabantu abavelayo. Yakhe usebenzise inkqubo yemfundo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo nokuphucula umgangatho kwiziko labantu abavelayo. Zive njengomgcazeki kubaxhasi usebenzisa iimfundiso zikaBatho Pele. Ubambe inxaxheba eqenjini elinamakhondo amaninzi. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo zokuvela kwabantu, umz. i-PPIP, PMTCT, BBI, MBFI, nake-RHC –impilo yokuzala. Phawula iimfuno zeqeqesho zabasebenzi. Zisebenzisa ulawulo olunxibelelanayo ngokuncedisa kumsebenzi wokungenisa isikhundla somlawuli. Gcina ulawule imithi nakwiliso. Zivele kwiindibano ezenziwa esikhungweni/nangaphandle.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- Specialty

jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialising in orthopaedics at Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, requiring SANC registration and four years post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or Matric certificate. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing science. Diploma / Degree in Advanced Midwifery Nursing science. 1 year post basic qualification in orthopaedic nursing science. A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse. Registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwife and Orthopaedic Nurse. SANC Receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills Training And Competencies Required: Leadership, organizational, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the Public Sector and institutional policy framework. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining nursing care, computer skills in basic programmes. Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge /skills). Good communications and interpersonal skills, planning and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Executive professional nurses’ duties and functions with proficiency in support of the strategic operational plan of the Institution. Render an optimal holistic specialized nursing care to patients as member of the Multidisciplinary team. Display concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care and willingness to respond to patient’s needs. Advocate for quality care of patients utilizing Batho Pele principles. Maintain accurate and complete patient records. Do meaningful rounds and monitor client satisfaction by communicating with patients and relatives. Assist the Operational manager with overall management and necessary support for the effective functioning of the unit. Train and supervise junior staff and student nurses. Participate in ethics and professionalism activities. Participate in the formulation, analysis, implementation and monitoring of unit objectives, policies, and procedures. Ensure effective and efficient management of resources and availability of essential equipment. Maintain accreditation standards by ensuring compliance with Regulated Norms and Standards and Ideal hospital programmes. Ensure the unit complies with Infection Prevention and Control as well as Occupational Health and Safety policies. Participate in staff development using EPMDS System and other work-related programmes and training.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in ortopedie by Port Shepstone Streeks-hospitaal, vereis SANC-registrasie en vier jaar ervaring na registrasie.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of Matriek-sertifikaat. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vroedvrouenskap-verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskap-verpleegkunde. 1 jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in ortopediese verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vroedvrou en Ortopediese Verpleegkundige. SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming, toesighoudende en probleemoplossende vermoëns binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke. Vermoë om pasiëntsorgverwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent te formuleer. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare Betrekkinge, onderhandeling, afrigting. Konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke, Openbare Vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis / vaardighede). Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Voer professionele verpleegkundiges se pligte en funksies uit met bedrevenheid ter ondersteuning van die strategiese operasionele plan van die Instelling. Lewer optimale holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg aan pasiënte as lid van die Multidissiplinêre span. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder en beyker vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg en toon bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes te reageer. Beyker vir gehalte-sorg van pasiënte deur gebruik van Batho Pele-beginsels. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Doen betekenisvolle rondtes en monitor kliëntetevredenheid deur met pasiënte en familielede te kommunikeer. Help die Operasionele bestuurder met algehele bestuur en noodsaaklike ondersteuning vir die effektiewe funksionering van die eenheid. Lei en hou toesig oor junior personeel en studenteverpleegkundiges. Neem deel aan etiek en professionaliteitsaktiwiteite. Neem deel aan die formulering, analise, implementering en monitering van eenheidsdoelwitte, beleide en prosedures. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne en beskikbaarheid van noodsaaklike toerusting. Onderhou akkreditasiestandaarde deur versekening met Gereguleerde Norme en Standaarde en Ideale hospitaal-programme. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan Infeksiepreventie en -beheer asook Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid-beleide. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling deur gebruik van die EPMDS-stelsel en ander werkverwante programme en opleiding.

zu.title: Usesi-Ikhosi Elingcali- Ochwepheshe
zu.summary: Usesi-Ikhosi Elingcali ochwepheshile kubuchwepheshe bezempilo bamathambo ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nanomuhla weminyaka emine wokuhamba esikhundleni ngemuva kokuqashwa.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma i-Matric. I-Diploma / i-Degree kusayensi yokuhlinzwa jikelele. I-Diploma / i-Degree kusayensi yokubeletha. I-Diploma / i-Degree kusayensi yokubeletha ephakeme. I-1 year yesiqu seminyaka eyodwa ngemuva kokuqeda ihlelo elisisekelo kusayensi yokuhlinzwa amathambo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele / esihlonishwayo ekuhlinzeni ngemuva kokuqashwa njengosesi-Ikhosi Elingcali. Ukuqashwa ku-SANC njengosesi-Ikhosi Jikelele, oBelethisi nesesesi-Ikhosi Lawo Mathambo. I-SANC Receipt ka-2026. Uluvo, Amakhono Okolotshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ukuba ngumholi, ukuhleleka, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukulawula nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yomkhakha kahulumeni nesakhiwo sezinqumela zemithetho yesikhungo. Ulwazi lwenqubo nezinyathelo zokunakekelwa kweziguli, izimoto zokuhlinza kanye nomnyele othize. Ukukwazi ukwakha izinqumela ezithintela inakekelwa lesiguli, isibono, umnqwenyo nezinjongo lesigaba. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa Ubudlelwane Bomphakathi, Ukuxoxisana, nokwengamela. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nokweluleka. Ulwazi lwezimali nemali yesabelo mayelana namaphakethe okulawulwa. Ukuqonda izinqubo nezinqumela ezihlobene nenakekelwa, amakhono ekhompyutha kumuhla wokuqala. Ukuzeza ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha kwamahora, emini nasebusuku, nangamasonto, ngosuku lweholide loluntu. Amaphuzu anele (uluvo / amakhono). Amakhono ahlelekile okuxhumana nabantu, ukuhlela nokuhleleka.
zu.duties: Ukuze izinkulu zomsebenzi nokusebenza kwabasesi-Ikhosi Elingcali ngekhono ekusekeleni ihlelo eliyisimo sokusebenza leSikhungo. Ukunika inakekelwa elikhulu eliqoqoqo lokuhlinza okuchwepheshile kubantu njengelungu leqembu elinezigaba eziningi. Ukubonisa ukukhathalela iziguli, ukukhuthaza nokugqugquzela ukwelashwa okufanele nokuzikhethela ukuphendula izidingo zesiguli. Ukugqugquzela inakekelwa elilinganisela iziguli ngokusebenzisa izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ukugcina amarekhodi aphelele ahlelekile wesiguli. Ukwenza okuhamba okunentsingiselo futhi uqaphele intokozo yamakhasimende ngokuthintana neziguli kanye nabantu bahlobene. Ukusiza umphathi we-Operational ngokuqondakonke ekuphatheni nasekunikezeni okudingekayo ukubasebenza kahle ikhava. Ukulolonga nokulawula abasebenzi abasha kanye nabafundi basesi-Ikhosi. Ukuthatha inhlangothi kumasekhelwe nobuchwepheshe. Ukuthatha inhlangothi ekwakhiweni, ukuhlaziya, ukusebenzisa kokuqaphekwa kwezinjongo zekhava, izinqumela, nezinqubo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezibalo ngempumelelo nokutholakala kwemisho ebalulekile. Ukugcina izinga le-accreditation ngokuqinisekisa ukuvumelana ne-Regulated Norms and Standards kanye namahlelo we-Ideal hospital. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhava ivumelana ne-Infection Prevention and Control nayo yonke imithetho ye-Occupational Health and Safety. Ukuthatha inhlangothi ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa i-EPMDS System kanye namanye amahlelo ahlobene nomsebenzi nokulolonga.

xh.title: Umongikazi weGazi elisezantsi- iSplyane
xh.summary: Umongikazi ogqithiswe kwindawo yolunyango lweemithambo yomzimba esibhedlele sasePort Shepstone Regional, efuneka ibhaliso kwiSANC kunye neminye emi-4 yamava emva kwebhaliso.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi yeGrade 12 okuye ibe yiMatric. IDiploma / iDegree kwizazinzulu zoQeqesho lweMongikazi jikelele. IDiploma / iDegree kwizazinzulu zoQeqesho lweMongikazi ababelekisi. IDiploma / iDegree kwizazinzulu zoQeqesho lweMongikazi ababelekisi abaphezulu. Inqanaba le-1 lefaneleko emva kwekusebenza ngemigaqo yolunyango lweemithambo yomzimba. Iminyaka engu-4 yamava afanelekileyo / aqondakalayo kusebenza njengomongikazi emva kwebhaliso njengomongikazi weGazi elisezantsi. Ibhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi weNyanga, umongikazi oRhodisayo nomongikazi weMithambo yomzimba. Iresiti yeSANC ka-2026. ulwazi, amakhono oQeqesho namakhono afunekayo: Ulawulo, ukuqamba iinkqubo, ukuthabatha iigqibo, ulawulo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yeNgingqi yoLuntu kunye nendlela yokusebenza kolwakhiwo lweziko. Ulwazi ngamanyathelo namagqabolisa eNxholo lokunyanga ngumongikazi, izigaba zomthetho zolunyango lwamathuba oluncedo. Ulwazi ngokubumba iinkqabolisa ezithintela usito lomngeni ekuqwalaselweni, iimbono, inkqubo yentsapho namagqabolisa oqeqesho lwamathuba ekuqwalaselweni lwabantu abadlula ngaselwandle ikakhulu ukwenza amagqabolisa kwindlela zokubeka iilwimi, iindidi ezahlukeneyo namava abantu ngokuphathelele kuseto lweNgingqi. Amakhono okuzalathisa nokuzithandabuzela eziquka iindaba ngokubakho, iingxaki, ulwazi olutsha oluvela kakhulu. ukuzalathisa noMathamba emisebenzi, ukuzalathisa noMbane ongazange ngokulinganiselwa, kwakunye nemisebenzi yokuzalathisa ukudlula ngokuthengisa ukuba abantu bakho apho ababandakanywa kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilawulwa kubantu abanokuphathwa kwizinto ezahlukeneyo zokuphila. Ulwazi lweemali kunye nemali exhomekeke kwindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilawulwa ngaphantsi kolawulo. Ukuqonda iindlela namagqabolisa ezithintela usito lomngeni ngomongikazi, amakhono ekhompyutha kumanqanaba abakho. Ukuzinikela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha, imini ebusuku nemini kwaye, iintsuku zokuphumla, iintsuku zokuhlola ezingazange ngokubakho ezilawulwa ngokubakho. Amakhono (ulwazi / amakhono). Ulwazi oluhle lokuzalathisa nokuzithandabuzela kubantu, ulwazi lokuqamba amagqabolisa wokuqamba amagqabolisa.
xh.duties: Ukuze kugqitywe imisebenzi yamakhosi abantu abanye ngokwemigaqo yolawulo oluvela kwindawo ekuqwalaselweni ekuqwalaselwa ngokusesikweni ngemigaqo yolawulo lweSiko. Unikezela iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilawulwa ngokusesikweni kubantu abagulayo njengamalungu eqela labantu abanamava amaninzi ekubakho kwezigulana. Ukubonisa ukukhathalela iingxaki zamagqabolisa abagulayo kwaye ukhuthaze ukuba atshate ngokukhuthaza kumava abagulayo abanokuphathwa kwiindidi ezahlukeneyo. Ukuthatha iintjongo zobugcisa bokulungiselela ukukhuthaza imigaqo yolawulo oluvela kubantu baseRharhabe. Ukuze kugqitywe iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilinganiselwa kubantu abagulayo kwaye kugqitywe ukuvakaliswa kwindlela ezahlukeneyo ekuqwalaselweni kwindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ukuze kwenziwe amagqabolisa kwaye kuqwalaselwe ukwaneliseka kwegosa kunye neentsapho zentsapho kwaye kugqitywe kumava. Unceda umphathi weNkonzo ngokulawula ngokupheleleyo ngenkxaso efunekayo ukuba kubakho ukusebenza ngokusesikweni. Uqeqesha kwaye ulawule abantu abangakagqithi kwizixhobo zangaphantsi zolawulo. Ukuzinikela kumava ngeziganeko ezahlukeneyo ezilawula ukubakho kwabagulayo kwaye ukhuthaze ukwenza. Umngeni wokusebenza ngokusesikweni ukuze kugqitywe imisebenzi yamava namagqabolisa wokuqamba amagqabolisa ekuqwalaselweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho imisebenzi yokusebenza ngokusesikweni kunye nokwaneliseka kolawulo loyilo lweemoto ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza. Ukugcina amagqabolisa amaninzi ngokupheleleyo ngokuthi kugqitywe amagqabolisa angazange ngokusesikweni nangokusesikweni. Ukuze kugqitywe imisebenzi yamagqabolisa amaninzi kubantu abangakwazi ukusebenza ngokusesikweni kwindawo ekuqwalaselweni kwindlela ezahlukeneyo ezilawulwa ngokusesikweni. Ukuze kugqitywe imisebenzi yamagqabolisa amaninzi ngokusesikweni ngokusebenza ngokusesikweni kwamava nokuqeqeshwa kolunyango kwindlela ezahlukeneyo.

'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige. SANC Kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander tersaaklike regskader. Vermoë om pasiëntsorg-verwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent te formuleer. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Publieke Betrekkinge, Onderhandeling, Afrigting. Konflikhantering en beradingvaardighede. af.duties: Bystaan in beplanning / organisering en monitering van doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënt en publiek. Voltooi pasiëntverwante data en neem deel aan navorsing. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Bystaan met verligtingspligte van toesig en tree op as junior skifleier op beide dag- en nagshift. Neem deel aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Skakel met professionele verpleegkundige in beheer in chirurgiese hoësorg / niereenheid. Toedeling van personeel binne die direktoraat op rotasie-basis. Verpleeg 'n kritiek sieke pasiënt wat geventileer word, op oxlog en op deurlopende monitering. Verpleeg alle tipes pasiënte ongeag diagnoses volgens siekteprofiel binne die direktoraat. Verpleeg 'n traumapasiënt vir noukeurige monitering. Neem die leiding in herlewing van kritieke pasiënte. Wees goed ingelig oor arbeidsverhoudingsprosedures. Implementering van Nasionale Kernstandaard en ontwikkeling van gehalteverbeteringsplanne en -projekte om gehaltesorg te verbeter.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ozinga Eliphezulu - Okukhethekile
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ozinga eliphezulu oseletheni lezimo eziphuthumayo ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, edinga izifundo ze-post-basic eziseletheni lezimo eziphuthumayo kanye namafa eminyaka emine wokuhlanganyela.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma i-Matric. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwi-General Nursing Science. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwi-Midwifery Nursing Science. Unyaka we-1 we-post basic qualification ku-Emergency and Trauma Nursing Science / Critical Care. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yamafa afanele / okwaziwayo ekunonyakeni emva kokuqashwa njengoProfessional Nurse. Isitifiketi se-SANC sonyaka we-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqetshwa Nezindima Ezidingekayo: Amandu okuhola, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, ukulawula nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi komkhawulo we-Public Sector kanye nomthetho wesikhungo. Ulwazi ngezinqubo nezindlela zokunakekela, kanye nomthetho wezokunyaza namanye omthetho ohlobene. Ikhono lokwenza izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nokunakekelwa kweguli, kanye nekhono lokubhala ubuhle bezikhungo, umgomo kanye nokuhlosiswa komkhakha. Amakhono okuxoxa nokusebenza nabantu kuhlanganise nezenzakalwano zomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, nokuhlela. Amakhono okuphathisa ingxabano yomphakathi nokuhola. Ulwazi ngezimal kanye nemali yesabelomali ezithinta izinsiza ezilawulwa. Ukuqonda izindlela zokuziphatha nemigomo yesikhungo. Ukuthanda ukusebenza ngokushintshana, emini nasembusuku, ngempelasonto, nasezinsukini zeholide zomphakathi. Izindima (ulwazi / amakhono). Amakhono okuxoxa okuhle nokusebenza nabanye, ukuhlela nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Usize ekuhleleni / ukwenzeni kanye nokubukeleni amahloso esigaba esikhethekile. Nikeza indawo ephephile, ephilisayo kubasebenzi, kwiguli nakumphakathi. Nikeza okusemoyeni ekuphathweni konke ukunakekelwa basebenzi bokunyaza kanye nokubanika isiqondiso ukuze kuqhubeke ukunakekelwa kwegazi kuzo zonke izinga. Bonisa ukuxoxa okusebenzayo neziguli kanye nomndeni kukhanda oluningi, kanye namanye amakhuluaphansi angaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Siza ekwabelweni / ukushintshweni kohlu lwasemini nasembusuku kanye nezokungenisa okumayelana neholide. Siza ekugcineni amarekhodi kanye nokunikeza imininingwane ngokuqeqetshwa kanye nomsebenzi. Siza ekuhloleni abasebenzi nge-EPMDS kanye nokwenza i-EAP. Siza ekuthombiseni, ekufakeni esikhundleni nasokubukeleni konke ukunakekelwa basebenzi bokunyaza. Qedela imininingwane ephathelene neziguli kanye nokubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okukhethekile njengoba kuhlelwa umkhawulo wokusebenza kanye namazinga abizwa ngokuthi i-relevant speciality. Siza ekuphathweni kwezobanba ze-supervision kanye nokuba yilunga elincane le-shift-leader emini nasembusiku. Bamba iqhaza kuzo zonke izinkonzo yesigaba esikhethekile, okunjengokwakha iqembu. Uphathe ngempumelelo nangokusebenza konke izinsiza. Xoxisana nomhlengikazi ophethe i-surgical high care / renal unit. Abele abasebenzi ngokujikeleza ngaphakathi kwedirectorate. Nakela iguli esigulile kakhulu edinga umoya owengeziwe, e-oxlog kanye nokuhlola okuqhubekayo. Nakela zonke izinhlobo zeziguli kungakhathaliseki ukugula ngaphakathi kwedirectorate. Nakela iguli yesimo esibi ngokuhlola okuseduze. Yiba yilunga elihola ekuvusweni kweziguli eziyingozi. Ukwazi kahle izindlela zokuphathwa komsebenzi. Ukwenza i-National Core Standards kanye nokuthuthukisa amaqaphu akhuthaza ubuhle bensebenzo.

xh.title: Umongikazi weNgcali - iNkundla eBalulekileyo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umongikazi weNgcali kwicala lezithuba ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, kufuneka ane-degree yasemva kwesixhobo sokugqibelela kwizithuba kwaye anamashumi amaninana iminyaka yokuhlala.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye iMatric. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwiNzululwazi yoNongikazi jikelele. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwINzululwazi yoNongikazi bokuBaLumkisi. Ifumaneka iminyaka elishumi emva kwesixhobo sokugqibelela kwINzululwazi yoNongikazi bezithuba nezeNgcolo / eZalathiso eziBalulekileyo. Amava angaphantsi kwamashumi amaninana amthetho okumelana nokuqatshelwa kwakhe emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi weNgcali. Isalathiso seSANC ka-2026. ulwazi, amakhono aQeqeshiweyo nemisebenzi efunekayo: ukuziphatha ngokwalo, ukulungelelanisa, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemigingqo yongaLuleko kaWonke-wonke nendlela yokusebenza kwesebe. ulwazi ngeendlela nemigaqo yokunikelwa kokunongikaza, imithetho yokunongikazi nolunye ulwizo ngokomthetho oluhambelana nayo. Ikhono lokuyila iingqinisiso ezimalana nokunikelwa kokongileyo, iimbono, injongo nokugqiba kwale ndawo. amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu kuquka uManyano lwentlalo, ukuXoxa, ukuQeqesha. amakhono okusingatha iingxabano nokuqeqesha ngokomoya. ulwazi lweemali nemali yokulinganisa ngokwemithombo ebalulekileyo phantsi kolawulo. ukuqonda iinkqubo neengqinisiso ezimalana nokunongikaza, amakhono ekhompyutha kumaxwebhu amabini. uku_readya ukusebenza kumashishini, eemini nasebusuku, ngeekwezidi, ngemihla yamagosa. ukuzinza (ulwazi/amakhono). amakhono amakhulu okunxibelelana nabantu nokuqamba, iplani nokulungelelanisa amakhono.
xh.duties: Nceda kukwazi ukuqamba / ukulungelelanisa nokujonga iinjongo zale ndawo ebalulekileyo. Nikezela indawo ekhuselekileyo, ethambekayo kubasebenzi, kumagula kwakunye nentlalo. Nikezela ukulawula ngqo nangakudidi abo bonke abaNongikazi kwaye ubanike ixesha lokulawula ukuqinisekisa ukwenzeka kokunikelwa kokongileyo kwazo zonke iindidi. Bonisa ukunxibelelana kakuhle nomgula nentsapho kunye neqela elisebenza ngokubanzi - elibandakanya amasebe, nezinye iindawo ezingaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Nceda nokuqamba uluhlu / uluhlu lokutshintsha, iindlela zokusebenza emini nasebusuku kwaye ufake iziphakamiso zokuphumla. Nceda ekugcineni iirekhodi nokuqhinga ulwazi ngezibalo ngeendlela zokuqeqesha nendlela yokusebenza. Nceda kwiziqla ze-EPMDS zokuqwalasela abasebenzi ukuya kuzisebenzisa i-EAP. Nceda ngenkuliso, ukulungelelana nokujonga abo bonke abaNongikazi. Qeda idatha ngeemeko yomgula ngokuchanekileyo yaye uphathe kwiinkqubo zophando. Khuthaza ukunikelwa kokunongikaza okubalulekileyo njengoko kuqatshelwa lisiko elithile. Nceda ngemisebenzi yokuzithoba ngakunye nokuba ngumntu oqhuba ishishini lokusuka emini nasebusuku. Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yale ndawo ebalulekileyo ngokubanzi, oko kukuthi ukwakha iqela. ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusebenza kahle ngokwemithobo yonke. Qhagamshelana nomongikazi weNgcali olinganiswe kwiziko lezibi / ukukhululeka kweempompo. Nceda ukuba uqhathe abasebenzi ngaphakathi kommandla ngendlela yokujikeleza. Nceda ukongamela umgula oyingozi osindwa kwiimpahla zokuphefumla eziya kuvela isiphelo, kumafutha igama elithi 'oxlog' nakulo lonke ucopho lokukhanya. Nceda ukongamela yonke indlela yomgula ngokwemeko yokuqwalaselwa ngokungakhathali ukubhaqabhaka kwesiBhedlele. Nceda ukongamela umgula weNgcolo ngesimo yokukhanya. Nceda ukuba uyintloko ekubuyiseni umphakamo wamagula ayingozi. Nceda ukuqonda iinkqubo zolwandle lolwahlulo. Nceda ukusebenzisa iNqanaba eliBalulekile leSizwe nokuphuhlisa iiplani zemisebenzi yokuphucula ukhoyo negciwe elifana nokuphucula ukhoyo lokunikelwa.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- Specialty
jobs.salary_text: R495 423 per annum, Plus 12% Rural Allowance. Other Benefits 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Seek a Professional Nurse for Critical Care at Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, providing specialised nursing care and supervision.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or Matric certificate. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing science. 1 year post basic qualification in Critical Care / Emergency and Trauma Nursing Science. A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse. SANC Receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Leadership, organizational, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the Public Sector and institutional policy framework. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal framework. Ability to formulate patients care related policies, vision, mission and objective of the component. Communication and interpersonal skills including Public Relations, Negotiating, Coaching. Conflict handling and counselling skills. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining nursing care, computer skills in basic programmes. Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge /skills). Good communications and interpersonal skills, planning and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the specialized unit. Provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and public. Provide comprehensive quality nursing care. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all Nursing Staff / Housekeeping staff and to give them guidance and ensure continuity of patient care. Demonstrate effective communication patient and families with the multi – disciplinary team, other department within the hospital. Assist with allocation /change list, day and night duty rosters and inputs for leave. Assist in record keeping and provide statistical information on training and staffing. To assist in EPMDS evaluation of staff and implement EAP. Assist in orientation, induction and monitoring of all nursing staff. To complete patient related data and partake in research. Promote quality specialized nursing care as directed by scope of practice and standards determined by the relevant speciality. To assist with relief duties of supervision and act as junior shift- leader on both day and night shift. To partake in overall specialized unit functions, i.e. team building. Effective and efficient management of all resources. Liaise with professional nurse in charge in surgical high care / renal unit. Allocation of staff within the directorate on rotational basis. To ensure critically ill patients regardless of diagnoses according to disease profile within the directorate. To nurse a ventilated paediatric / high care patient in ICU for close monitoring. Maintain professional growth / ethical standard and self- development. Participate in the implementation of SANC CPD Framework.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applicants are encouraged to utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit proof of qualifications) FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Spesialiteit
af.summary: Soek 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige vir Kritieke Sorg by Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, wat gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg en toesig verskaf.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of Matrik-sertifikaat. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vroedkunde Verpleegkunde. 1 jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in Kritieke Sorg / Nood- en Trauma-verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige. SANC Kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming-, toesig- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerk. Vermoë om pasiëntsorgverwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent te formuleer. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare Betrekkinge, Onderhandeling, Afrigting. Konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verpleegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke, Openbare Vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis / vaardighede). Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met beplanning/organisasie en monitering van doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en publiek. Verskaf omvattende gehalte verpleegsorg. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig van alle Verpleegpersoneel / Huishoudelike personeel en gee hulle leiding en verseker kontinuïteit van pasiëntversorging. Demonstreer effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte en families met die multi-dissiplinêre span, ander departemente binne die hospitaal. Bystand verleen met toedeling / veranderinglys, dag- en nagdiensroosters en insetsels vir verlof. Bystand verleen met rekordhouding en verskaf statistiese inligting oor opleiding en bemanning. Bystand verleen met EPMDS-evaluering van personeel en implementeer EAP. Bystand verleen met oriëntering, inducting en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Voltooi pasiëntverwante data en neem deel aan navorsing. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Bystand verleen met verligtingspligte van toesig en tree op as junior skifleier op beide dag- en nagshift. Neem deel aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Skakel met professionele verpleegkundige in beheer in chirurgiese hoësorg / nier-eenheid. Toedeling van personeel binne die direktoraat op rotasie-basis. Verseker kritiek siek pasiënte ongeag diagnoses volgens siekteprofiel binne die direktoraat. Verpleeg 'n geventileerde pediatrese / hoësorg pasiënt in ICU vir noukeurige monitering. Onderhou professionele groei / etiese standaard en selfontwikkeling. Neem deel aan die implementering van die SANC CPD-raamwerk.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ochwepheshe- Obhekene Nebunjululu
zu.summary: Sifuna Umhlengikazi Ochube njengochwepheshe okwelingozi ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwamayunithi ekhokhelwa khona isikhathi esingazelelwe nokuqapha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 noma iMatric. Diploma / I-Degree kusayensi yokunakekelwa kwamayunithi jikelele. Diploma / I-Degree kusayensi yokunakekelwa kwabesifazane abakhulelwe. 1 unyaka wemfuno yesisekelo ekukhetheleweni kwesayensi yokunakekelwa okungaba yingozi / Ngokungozi nokuLimala. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yokuthola okufanelekile / ekhunjulwa ekunakekelweni kwamayunithi emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ochube njengochwepheshe. Isiphutha seSANC sonyaka we-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono okuqeqesha Nokwazi okudingekayo: Amakhono okuba ngumholi, wokuhlela abantu, wokwenza izinqumo, wokuphatha abanye nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi komkhawulo Wezinkundla Zomphakathi nezinqubo zephakethe lesikhungo. Ulwazi ngezinqobo nangokuhambiswa kwamaphrosesi nokunakekelwa kwamayunithi, ngomthetho wokunakekelwa kwamayunithi nanjengomthetho olusetshenziswayo. Ikhono lokuhlela izinqubo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwagula, i-vision, i-mission, negumbi ngokuthi iyiphi inqubo. Amakhono okuxhumana nobantu ngokusemthethweni kahulumendi okubandakanya namakhono okuxhumana nomphakathi, okuxazulula izingxabano, nokuphatha iqembu elilodwa. Amakhono okubhekana nokuqhushumbiswa kwengxabano nokweluleka abantu. Ulwazi olumayelana nezimali nokwazi ukusebenzisa imali ongayiphethe, nangemithombo yokusebenza engaphansi kolawulo. Ukuqonda izinqobo nezinqubo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwamayunithi, kanye namakhono wokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza esikhathini esihlukene, okubandakanya ukusebenza emini nasebusuku, amapharolakhi amaphelanga kanye namaholide omphakathi. (ulwazi / amakhono) okuncikene emthethweni okubandakanya amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu, amakhono wokuhlela. ukubhalisa, ukuxazulula, nokuxhasa. Amakhono okubheka iqembu elilodwa nokuqondanisa, kanye nokuhlela nokuhlela abantu ngokomthetho ophathwayo.
zu.duties: Siza ekuhlebeni / ekubheni iqhaza ekulawuleni imigomo yomnyango olinganiswayo. Nikeza isimo esizuzisayo ukubhukuda kubasebenzi, kubagule nasesiphethweni somphakathi. Nikeza ngokunakekelwa okugcwele nokuqinisekisa amaphoyinti aphezulu. Qapha futhi uhlole bonke osoMhlengikazi / abasebenzi abangangeniswa ezinyaweni nabanikethe isiqondiso, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeleka kokwelashwa kwesiguli. Bonakalisa isikhulumi esimbulalisele kakhulu esimbulalisele emndenini wesiguli kanye neqembu elazi ngokusebenza kahle, kanye namanye amaqembu angaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Siza ekwabelweni / ekushintsheni uhlu lomsebenzi, okuhlela ukusebenza kwemini nasebusuku kanye nokushicilelwa ukwesula. Siza ekugcineni amarekhodi ekushicilelwa imininingwana kwezibalo kokuqeqesha nokulawula. Siza kokuqeqesha abaqashiwe ngokusemthethweni kanye nokuthumela osomkhulu bayo ukuhlola ukuthi abasebenzi basebenza kahle kwezobuchwepheshe nokusebenzisa inkundla eqondene nokusebenza ngokuziphatha. Siza ekuletheni abasebenzi abasha, ekufakweni nasekuqapheni osomhlanganyelo jikelele. Qedela imininingwana ehlobene namagula asebenza ngokucophelela ekusebenziseni nokuthola ulwazi oluphelele. Siza ekuphusheni iqembu elilodwa nangokulinganisela inani labantu ukuba bafunde, bahlale futhi bakhulule ekuphusheni iqembu elilodwa. Siza ekunakekelweni kokubeka abasebenzi kwindawo yokusebenza, njengabahleli beminyakazo yokuqeqesha osomhlanganyelo. Siza ekugcineni isikhathi sokusebenza mayelana nokuqeqesha nokwamukela inqubo yokusebenza evela ku-EPMDS kubasebenzi, kanye nokusebenzisa i-EAP. Siza ekuletheni, ekufakweni nasekuqapheni bonke osomhlanganyelo. Qedela imininingwana yamagula asebenza ngokucophelela ekusebenziseni nokuthola ulwazi oluphelele. Qedela imininingwana yamagula asebenza ngokucophelela ekusebenziseni nokusebenza ekucwaningeni. Siza ekuthumeleni osomhlanganyelo eqhaza kabanzi ekusebenziseni, njengabahleli beminyakazo yokuqeqesha osomhlanganyelo. Siza ekugcineni isikhathi sokusebenza mayelana nokuqeqesha nokwamukela inqubo yokusebenza evela ku-EPMDS kubasebenzi, kanye nokusebenzisa i-EAP.

xh.title: Umhlengikazi Wezisebenzo- Isikhundla Esithile
xh.summary: Kunyanzelwa umhlengikazi wezisebenzo eNkundleni Yokunakekelwa Kwezimo Ezibuthathaka ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital, ukunikeza inakekelo lokhetho nokulawula.
xh.requirements:
Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye iMatric. I Diploma / Degree kwizifundo zokunakekela jikelele. I Diploma / Degree kwizifundo zokunakekela abanini buzalo. Iminyaka eli-1 yangemva kokufumana isifundo se-basic kwisikhundla esithile kwi Critical Care / Emergency and Trauma Nursing Science. Okona kciny amava afanelekileyo anamava angaphezulu kweminyaka emi-4 ekuqalekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi wezisebenzo. Isiphatho se SANC sika-2026. Ulwazi, ukuqeqeshwa kwekhono namakhono afunekayo: Ubukhosi bezikhokela, ukulungelelanisa, ukuthabatha iigqibo, ukulawula noku-sombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida koLawulo lwikomitye kunye nolawulo lweziko. Ulwazi ngamaxesha okunakekelwa nendlela zokwenza izinto nakuqondaniswa kwamanye amaxeshha elungisa zonke izifundo zokunakekela kwaye ngezinye iinkqubo ezithintekileyo zomthetho. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokunakekela, ukubhala iimbono, i-mission, i-objectives ngokwakha amacebo oku-hamba phambili. Ulwazi ngokuzibandakanya nabathengi bakhona, aqhagamshelwano nobuntu obuqhotsa iimpilo. Ukuba namakhono oxulumano nofikelelo koluntu nakunxibelelwano nemizuzu yokwamkela iingcebiso. Ukusingatha iingxabano nokunika ingcebiso abantu. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi kweemali izibonelelo ezibalulekileyo phantsi kolawulo. Ukuvakalelwa kwamacandelo amaninzi avela isigqibo, kwaye ulwazi kwakhona ngokusebenzisa i software ikhompyutha nokusetyenziswa koluntu nakulawulo oluqhutywa sisiph esaziwa ngokuba yi- IT. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza kumashifi, imini nasebusuku, iintsuku zolonwabo, nakuwo onke amaholide. Ikhono njengolwazi. Ukuyazi ukuvakalelwa kwezazimali abanini basebenza, umthwalo wokulungelelanisa iindaba ezilula nabantu.

*Ulwazi ngokunakekela iinkqubo namaqcango amathathu entsapho yamakhaya kunye nokubeka ngasese iinkcukacha nempilo kwi-card yakho yamandla. Ulwazi lokubeka iimpilo nabanye abantu kwindalo ukwakha isakhono sokwenza ucwangciso. Nokugcina ulwazi lokuhamba kwamaxesha.
xh.duties: Uncedise ekulungelelaniseni / ukuqokelela kwaye ulandelele iinjongo zale candelo ekhethwe kuko. Zizeleze indawo yokunyanga abasebenzi, abagula noluntu. Nikeza inakekelo yonke ihle lobuntunzabantu. Yonke inkqubo ethintelwe abasebenzi ekulawulweni lwamakhaya, kwakunye nokuba ngumsindo kwakho, ukubakho nabani na ukulawula, ukubanika iNdlela ekulungelelanisa iinkqubo nokunceda kumasebe abo abavela kumaziko. Yonke imisebenzi ephezulu yokuyalela abantu iya kubakho gca into iya kuhlala isakuba nokuba ngu mzekelisi iya kumisela abo abangangeni kumakhaya endlela yokunakekelwa abantu batyiwa ngayo. Ukubonisa ukusebenza njengesandla ngasinye esiya kwikhomityhala, abagulayo, abasebenzi bentsapho, nakwabanye amasebe angaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Uncedise ngegalelo ekwabelweni / ugqitho, nokwenzela usuku nakunye / ukulungelelanisa abantu basebenza phakathi kwentsasa / imini. Uncedise kugcino IIREK and ukunikela ngesikwere ngemiselo ecacileyo ukunakekelwa emsebenzini kwaye igqibe ekuzonakaliseni ukuba akukho mntu ofanele ukusetyenziswa ekubeni isibonakaliso ngasinye ukunakekelwa kwiliso esemthethweni naku-balwa. Uncedise abantu basebenza nenguqulelo kubakho amasebe ukunakekelwa kwemisebenzi yalo kusetyenziswa imisebenzi yokulungelelanisa nokuyalela okanye nokunakekelwa kwemisebenzi iphathwe ngabasebenzi ukunakekelwa kwemisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwabasebenzi abanokubakho kukwaziswa. Phakamisa inqanaba eliphezulu ngokunakekelwa nokuqonda nangenye indlela kubakho amakhono aphakathi kokunakekelwa komsebenzi ngokunyuka kwakho kunye namakhono afunekayo ngokunakekelwa komsebenzi ngokunyuka kwakho kunye namakhono. Uncedise kwimisebenzi yokuzinza kwindalo yakho ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ekunakekelweni kwabagula phakathi kwemithetho. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ekusebenzeni ngokulandela imigaqo yesixeko kwaye usetyenziso. Uncedise kwindlela yokuyalela ukuba ngumntu ongumlawuli ophezulu wokuqonda nangenye indlela kubakho amakhono ekunakekelweni kwabagula phakathi kwemithetho nokunyuka. Makabe ngumzali ongumntu ongumyalezo kulawulo oluhle kakuhle ekunakekelweni ngokusebenzisa izitshixo. Ungagqibi kwimizamo yakho yokusebenza ekuphakamiseni ulwazi nakulwazi ekulawulweni kwentsasa. Sebenzisana nomphathi wezisebenzo ezisebenza ekunakekelweni kwindalo yokuzilolonga. Yonke imisebenzi ekunakekelweni mayibe ngamanye amaxeshha alungelelaniswa ngokwemigaqo yoluntu. Ukunakekelwa kwabagula abangenamkhondo okanye abanokubakho kwimiba ngokomthetho ngokulandela imigaqo yoluntu. Ukuqinisekisa ngokuphatha abagula abakhange ukubakho kwesibhedlele nangaphandle koko ngokulawula ngokomthetho nokunakekelwa kwemisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwindalo yokunakekelwa kwabantu ngokwemithetho yoluntu. Ukugcina ukukhula ngokwezisebenzo / ngokomthetho nokuziphucula. Uncede ekusebenzeni ngemigaqo yoluntu.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- Speciality
jobs.salary_text: R495 423 per annum, Plus 12% Rural Allowance. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialising in perioperative care sought for Port Shepstone Regional Hospital operating theatre, requiring SANC registration and at least four years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or Matric certificate. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing science. Diploma / Degree in Perioperative Nursing Science. Registration with SANC as General Nurse, Midwifery and perioperative Nursing Science. A minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. SANC Receipt for 2026. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Leadership, organizational, decision making, supervisory and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the Public Sector and institutional policy framework. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes and other relevant legal framework. Ability to formulate patients care related policies, vision, mission and objective of the component. Communication and interpersonal skills including Public Relations, Negotiating, Coaching. Conflict handling and counselling skills. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining nursing care, computer skills in basic programmes. Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge /skills). Good communications and interpersonal skills, planning and organizational skills.
jobs.duties: Executive professional nurses’ duties and functions with proficiency in support of the strategic objectives and operational plan of the Institution. Render an optimal holistic specialized nursing care to patients as member of the Multidisciplinary team. Display concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care and willingness to respond to patient’s needs. Advocate for quality care of patients utilizing Batho Pele principles. Maintain accurate and complete patient records. Do meaningful rounds and monitor client satisfaction by communicating with patients and relatives. Assist the Operational manager with overall management and necessary support for the effective functioning of the unit. Train and supervise junior staff and student nurses. Participate in ethics and professionalism activities. Participate in the formulation, analysis, implementation and monitoring of unit objectives, policies, and procedures. Ensure effective and efficient management of resources and availability of essential equipment. Maintain accreditation standards by ensuring compliance with Regulated Norms and Standards and Ideal hospital programmes. Ensure the unit complies with Infection Prevention and Control as well as Occupational Health and Safety policies. Participate in staff development using EPMDS System and other work-related programmes and training.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. Applicants are encouraged to utilise courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit proof of qualifications) FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige - Spesialiteit
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in peri-operatiewe sorg gesoek vir Port Shepstone Streekhospitaal se teater, wat SANC-registrasie en ten minste vier jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of Matrik-sertifikaat. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vrugbaregeneeskunde-verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Peri-operatiewe Verpleegkunde. Registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige, Vrugbaregeneeskunde en Peri-operatiewe Verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. SANC-kwitansie vir 2026. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings-, toesighoudende en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Kennis van verplegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegwetgewing en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke. Vermoë om pasiëntsorgverwante beleide, visie, missie en doelwitte van die komponent te formuleer. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare Betrekkinge, Onderhandeling, Afrigting. Konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide met betrekking tot verplegsorg, rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme. Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, dag- en nagdiens, naweke, Openbare Vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis / vaardighede). Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede.
af.duties: Voer professionele verpleegkundiges se pligte en funksies uit met bekwaamheid ter ondersteuning van die strategiese doelwitte en operasionele plan van die Instansie. Lewer optimale holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg aan pasiënte as lid van die Multidissiplinêre span. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder en beyker behoorlike behandeling en sorg en toon bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes te reageer. Beyker vir gehalte-sorg van pasiënte deur gebruik van Batho Pele-beginsels. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords. Doen betekenisvolle rondtes en monitor kliëntetevredenheid deur met pasiënte en familie te kommunikeer. help die Operasionele bestuurder met algehele bestuur en nodige ondersteuning vir die effektiewe funksionering van die eenheid. Leiding en opleiding van junior personeel en studenteverpleegkundiges. Neem deel aan etiek en professionaliteitsaktiwiteite. Neem deel aan die formulering, analise, implementering en monitering van eenheidsdoelwitte, beleide en prosedures. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne en beskikbaarheid van noodsaaklike toerusting. Handhaaf akkreditasiestandaarde deur te verseker dat daar voldoen word aan Gereguleerde Norme en Standaarde en Ideale hospitaalprogramme. Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer asook Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-beleide. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling deur gebruik van EPMDS-stelsel en ander werkverwante programme en opleiding.

zu.title: Unesi Ochwepheshe- Ikhondo Elikhethekile
zu.summary: Unesi ochwepheshe ohlala kuvela kwikhondo lokunakekelwa kwabasbezelayo efunekayo esibhedlela sesifunda sasePort Shepstone esikhungweni sokuhlinza, okudinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nokuhlangenwe khona okungungenwa lapha ngaphezulu kweminyaka emine.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12 noma i-Matric. I-Diploma / I-Digri kusayensi yokuNeselwa Jikelele. I-Diploma / I-Digri kusayensi yokuNeselwa kokubelethiswa. I-Diploma / I-Digri kusayensi yokuNeselwa kwabasbezelayo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengenesi Jikelele, okubelethiswa kanye nesayensi yokuNeselwa kwabasbezelayo. Okungenwa okuncane eminyakeni emi-4 okufanelekile / okubonakalayo ekuneseni ngemuva kokubhalisa njengenesi Ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ekuNeselweni Jikelele. Isipikhi se-SANC sonyaka ka-2026. Ulwazi, Amakhono ukuqeqeshwa kanye namandla afunekayo: Ubuchule bokuhola, ukuhlelela, ukuthatha izinqumo, okulinze kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yaseMkhandlwini kahulumeni kanye nendlela yemithelela yesikhungo. Ulwazi ngemikhakha namalungu okunakekelwa kwabesifo, kanye nemiqulu yokuNeselwa namanye ohlelo lomthetho oluhambisana nawo. Ikhono lokwakheke imithetho ehlobene nenakekelwa kwabesifo, umbono, umnqoba, kanye nenjongo yenxenye. Amakhono okuthuthumlana nabantu kanye nokuhlangana ngokomzwango okuhlanganisa ukusebenza neZithombe zahulumeni, ukuzeza, nokuqeqesha. Amakhono okuphatha izingxabano kanye noxhaso ngokomzwango. Ulwazi ngemali kanye nohwebo ngemithombo ohlobene nokuphathwa kwawo. Ukuqonda imikhuba namalungiselelo ahlobene nenakekelwa kwabesifo, amakhono ekhompyutha ohlelweni oluyisisekelo. Ukuzethemba ukusebenza emushumayeleni, ikusini nasebusuku, ngeSonto, nasemiholide kahulumeni. Amakhono (ulwazi / amakhono). Amakhono amahle okuthuthumlana nabantu, ukuhlela, kanye nohlelo lolusebenzo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yamanesi ochwepheshe ngokuphelele ekwesekeni injongo yokuhlongakwamandla nohlelo lokusebenza lwesikhungo. Ukunikela inakekelwa ngokukhethwa ngokuphelele kubesifo njengelungu leqembu elixubene ngamakhono. Ukubonisa ukukhathazeka ngabesifo, ukugqugquzela nokuphakamisa ukwelashwa okufanele kanye nokuzinika ukuphendula izidingo zabesifo. Ukuphakamisa inakekelwa kakhulu kwabesifo ngokusebenzisa imigomo ka-Batho Pele. Ukugcina imibhalo ephelele yabesifo. Ukwenza ukuhamba okunomqondo kokuqeqesha kanye nokubheka ukuthokoza amakhasimende ngokuthuthumlana nabesifo kanye nendondo. Ukusiza umphathi wenqubo ngokuphathwa jikelele kanye noxhaso olufunekayo ukuze inxenye isebenze ngokusebenza kahle. Ukuqeqesha kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha kanye namanesi abafundi. Ukungena kumnyakazo wenhlalo yokuziphatha kwamakhono. Ukungena ekwakheni, ukuhlaziya, ukusebenzisa, kanye nokubheka injongo yenxenye, imithetho, namalungu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenza kahle kwemithombo kanye nokutholakala kwezinto ezinguzile. Ukugcina izinga eliphumelelayo nge-Regulated Norms and Standards kanye nohlelo lwe-Ideal hospital. Ukuthi inxenye ihambisane nokuvikelwa kokutheleleka kanye nokulawula kanye nemithetho ye-Occupational Health and Safety. Ukungena ekuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi ngokusebenzisa ohlelo lwe-EPMDS kanye namanye ohlelo lokusebenza ahlobene nomsebenzi kanye nokuqeqeshwa.

xh.title: Isikhululeko sokuxhapha- iNkundla
xh.summary: Kufunwa ugqirha ongumsebenzi wentengiso ogqithisela kunkqubo yokuNakelwa ePort Shepstone Regional Hospital kuyo nakwindlu yokushiywa kwezilumkiso, kufuneka abhaliswe kwiSANC abe nenyanga ungenaphi wamava onke amane.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seQela lesi-12 okanye iMatric. Isidiploma / Isidali ngeNzululwazi yokuNika. Isidiploma / Isidali ngeNzululwazi yokuNika iMidwifery. Isidiploma / Isidali ngeNzululwazi yokuNika iPerioperative. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqirha jikelele, iMidwifery nokuNika iPerioperative. Ukhetho lonyaka ungenaphi wamava afanelekileyo / aqwalaselwa kusenziwa lokunika emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha jikelele kwiSANC kwiNzululwazi yokuNika jikelele. IReceipt yeSANC ka2026. Ulwazi, amakhono oQeqesho namakhono aFunekayo: Isakhono sokuzala, ukuqamba, ukwenza izigqibo, ukulawula nokuqhuba iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida kwisebe loLuntu kunye neNkqubo yentsika. Ulwazi ngendlela nokusetyenziswa kolwazi lokunika, izigqibo zabongikazi nolunye ulwazi oluxelweyo olunentsingiselo. Isakhono sokubhala iinkqubo ezinxulumene nokuNakelwa kwabagulayo, iNdima, iNkqubo kunye negqibo elo. Isakhono sokunxibelelana nabathile nabantu kuquka iNtlangano yoLuntu, iNtshutshiso, uQeqesho. Isakhono sokuQwalasela iingxabano kunye nokuQeqesha. Ulwazi lemali nobhajeti olunxulumene imithombo efunekayo elawulwayo. Ukuqonda iindlela neenkqubo ezinxulumene nokuNakelwa kwabongikazi, amakhono ekhompyutha kwizikqeko ezingundoqo. Ukulungelelwaniso ukusebenza ishaphu, imini ebusuku nasekuseni, iintsuku zokuphumla, iMini zeLuntu. Amakhono (ulwazi / amakhono). Isakhono sokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu, ukuyila nokuhlela amakhono.
xh.duties: Ukuze uphumeze imisebenzi nemisebenzi yabongikazi bachwayo ngesiphiwo ngenkxaso yamaphupha aqhelanayo neplani yokuqhuba yeNtsika. Nikela ngokunakekela okupheleleyo okusemgangathweni kukhupho kwabagulayo njengelungu leqela elisebenza ngamaphandle amaninzi. Bonisa ukwakhathalela abagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela unyango nokunakekelwa okufanelekileyo nokulungelelwaniso ukuphendula iimfuno zabagulayo. Khathaza ukunakekelwa koluhlobo oluphezulu kubagulayo kusetyenziswa iinkqubo zeBatho Pele. Gcina irekhodi echanekileyo neyepheleleyo yabagulayo. Yenza iindwendwe ezinentsingiselo uze ulawule ukwaneliseka kumaxheshi ngokuthetha nabagulayo nabezinja. Ncedisa umphathi weQhinga ngolawulo lwalo lonke ngenkxaso efunekayo ukwenzela ukusebenza kweyuniti ngokusebenza kakuhle. Qeqisha uze ulawule abasebenzi ababancinane nabo bafunda ubugqirha. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zobugqirha bokuziphatha. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhenkeni, kuqondaniseni, ekusebenziseni nasekuqwalaselweni kwamaphupha eeyunithi, iinkqubo kunye neendlela. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusebenzayo lwemithombo yokunakekelwa nokubakho kwemishini ebalulekileyo. Gcina amanqanaba aqinisekisiweyo kuqinisekisa ukuvumelana neNkqubo eLawulayo ngokumnganga nangamaphulo ehospodali. Qinisekisa ukuba iyunithi ihambelana nokuThintela ukutshatyalaliswa nokuLawula ukugula ngokubangelwa kukho ngasemva, kunye neenkqubo zoKhuseleko lweNdalo ekuSebenzeni. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi kusetyenziswa inkqubo yeEPMDS kunye nazi zinye iinkqubo ezinxulumene nomsebenzi nokuqeqeshwa.

jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 – R472 359 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 – R550 389 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 – R683 808 per annum
jobs.summary: Speech Therapist position at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, offering roles across three grades with salaries ranging from R413,121 to R683,808 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: No experience required after registration as Speech Therapist. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration as Speech Therapist. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration as Speech Therapist. Other Benefits:13thCheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Housing Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements. Sound knowledge of paediatric dysphagia assessments and management. Comprehensive caregiver training, patient education and related concerns. Perform outreach services as needed, conduct group work/ therapy and or block therapy as identified. Confidentiality and ethical multidisciplinary approach to treatment of patients. Conduct home and school visits and other community visits as needed. Administrative work related to patient care: report- writing, statistics. Meeting, case conference, legal reports as needed e.g. disability grants, medico legal work and insurance. Quality improvement plan initiatives: clinical guidelines, teaching and training, audits (core standards, infection control, ideal hospital, etc.) Effective communication with all stakeholders (Patients. NGOs, caregivers etc.) Ensure professional development in line with patient care profile. Support the supervisor in all projects and transformative efforts
