af.title: Spraakterapeut Vlak 1, 2 OF 3
af.summary: Spraakterapeutpos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat poste oor drie vlakke bied met salarisse wat wissel van R413,121 tot R683,808 per jaar.
af.requirements: Vlak 1: Geen ondervinding vereis na registrasie as Spraakterapeut nie. Vlak 2: Minimum van 10 jaar relevante ondervinding na registrasie as Spraakterapeut. Vlak 3: Minimum van 20 jaar relevante ondervinding na registrasie as Spraakterapeut. Ander Voordele:13deCheque, Mediese Aid (Opsioneel), Behuisingsuitkering: Werknemer moet voorgeskrewe vereistes nakom. Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus 'n Nasionale Diploma/Graad in Spraakterapie plus Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Spraakterapeut plus Sertifikaat van diens wat deur die HR-departement van vorige en huidige werkgewer goedgekeur is, sal slegs vir gekorte lysde kandidate vereis word. Suksesvolle kandidaat sal 'n minimum van een jaar in-diens moet deurbring. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Spraakterapie pediatrise en algemene diagnostiese, terapeutiese prosedures. Kennis van departementele administratiewe take. Kennis van etiese kode en omvang van praktyk. Vermoë om probleme op te los en analitiese prosesse op pasiëntsorg toe te pas. Toesighoudervaardighede vir junior personeel en studente. Ongegoedgekeurde geldige Kode B-bestuurslisensie (Kode 08) en Bedrewe in IsiZulu.
af.duties: Verskaffing van doeltreffende en omvattende assessering en behandeling vir pediatriese en algemene spraakterapie aan dienste aan alle pasiënte. Deeglike kennis van pediatriese disfagie-assesserings en bestuur. Omvattende versorgeropleiding, pasiëntopvoeding en verwante bekommernisse. Voer uitreikdienste soos benodig uit, voer groepwerk/terapie en/of blokterapie soos geïdentifiseer uit. Konfidensialiteit en etiese multidissiplinêre benadering tot behandeling van pasiënte. Voer tuis- en skoolbesoeke en ander gemeenskapsbesoeke soos benodig uit. Administratiewe werk verwant aan pasiëntsorg: verslaggewing, statistieke. Vergaderings, gevallekonferensie, regsverslae soos benodig bv. gestremdheidstoelaes, medies-juridiese werk en versekering. Kwaliteitsverbeteringsplan-inisiatiewe: kliniese riglyne, onderrig en opleiding, oudits (kernstandaarde, infeksiebeheer, ideale hospital, ens.) Doeltreffende kommunikasie met alle belanghebbendes (Pasiënte. NRO's, versorgers ens.) Verseker professionele ontwikkeling in ooreenstemming met pasiëntsorgprofiel. Ondersteun die toesighouer in alle projekte en transformeringspogings.

zu.title: Umenzi Wocingo Lokwelapha NgesiKhulumi Izinga 1, 2 Noma 3
zu.summary: Isikhundla somenzi wocingo lokwelapha ngesikhulumi esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, sithula izikhundla kuzo zozinga ezintathu ngeholo eliyisuka ku-R413,121 kuya ku-R683,808 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Akukho ngqondo yomsebenzi edingekile emva kokuqoshwa njengomenzi wocingo lokwelapha ngesikhulumi. Izinga 2: Kudingeka okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yomsebenzi ofanele emva kokuqoshwa njengomenzi wocingo lokwelapha ngesikhulumi. Izinga 3: Kudingeka okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yomsebenzi ofanele emva kokuqoshwa njengomenzi wocingo lokwelapha ngesikhulumi. Ezinye izinzuzo: Isheke lamasenti angu-13, usizo lwezokwelapha (ngokukhethwa), inert yokuhlolwa kwezindlu: Umsebenzi kumele ahambisane nezidingo ezishiwo. Isitifikedi samatikhethe / Izinga le-12 kanye ne-Diploma/I-Digri yezizwe ekwelapheni ngesikhulumi kanye nokubhaliswa kwamanje ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomenzi wocingo lokwelapha ngesikhulumi kanye nesitifikedi sokusebenza esigunyazwe abomnyango we-HR kubasebenzi abadlule nabakhona sizodingeka kuphela kubaphakeme abakhethiwe. Ophumelele uzodingeka ashiwe okungenani unyaka owodwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi, Amandla, ukuqeqesha nokuqonda okudingekayo: Ukusebenza kolwazi lwezokuhlola nokwelapha abantwana nakuwo wonke amazinga. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yocalulo yomnyango, ulwazi ngokuhlonipha imithetho yesiko nomkhawulo wokusebenza. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokusebenzisa inqubo yokuhlaziya ekunakekelweni kwesiguli. Amandla okuhlola abasebenzi abasha nabafundi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba evakalwe ngokungashiyi isiKhodi B (isiKhodi 08) nokuba ngowokuqonda isiZulu.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukuhlola nokwelapha okusebenza futhi okubanzi kokukhuluma ngesikhulumi kwabantwana nakuwo wonke amaphrofayela kuyo yonke iziguli. Ulwazi olunjengolwandle lokuhlola ukugwathwa kwesisikhashana ngokukhuluma phansi kwabantwana nokuphathwa kwalo. Ukuqeqesha okubanzi kwababanakezeli, ukuqeqesha iziguli nokuhlobene nezinkinga. Ukwenza izinsiza zokukhuluma ngokwesidingo, ukwenza imisebenzi yeqembu / ukwelapha noma ukwelapha ngamabhulokhi njengoba kuhlonzwe. Ukugcina imfihlo futhi ukusebenzisa indlela ekokela ukukhethwa kwemikhakha eminingi ekwelapheni iziguli. Ukuqashwa kwezikhungo zasekhaya nasemfundweni nakwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi ngokwesidingo. Imisebenzi yocalulo ehlobene nanakekelo kwesiguli: ukubhala imibiko, izibalo. Ukuhlangana, inkomphi yamacala, imibiko yezomthetho ngokwesidingo isb. izibonelelo zokukhulelwa, umsebenzi wezomthetho wezokwelapha kanye nesiqiniseko. Amaphulo izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga: iziqondiso zezokwelapha, ukufundisa nokuqeqesha, ukuhlolwa (izindinganiso eziphakathi, ukulawula ukutheleleka, isibhedlela esihle, njl). Ukuxhumana okusebenza nabo bonke abanikela ngomsebenzi (Iziguli. Izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi komphakathi, abanakezeli, njl.) Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ngokuhambisana nophrofayela wokunakekela iziguli. Ukusekela omlawuli kuyo yonke imiklamo namaphulo okuguqula

xh.title: Umtheraphisti Wethetha ngokubakwayo Inqanaba le-1, 2 OKUNYE i-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somtheraphisti wethetha ngokubakwayo eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sinikeza iindima kuzona zonke iinqanaba ezintathu zinomvuzo osuka kwiR413,121 ukuya kwiR683,808 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba le-1: Akukho mafa wamava afunekayo emva kokuqatshelwa njengomtheraphisti wethetha ngokubakwayo. Inqanaba le-2: Iimfuno ezincinci zemimandla yamava emi-10 emva kokuqatshelwa njengomtheraphisti wethetha ngokubakwayo. Inqanaba le-3: Iimfuno ezincinci zemimandla yamava emi-20 emva kokuqatshelwa njengomtheraphisti wethetha ngokubakwayo. Ezinye izibonelelo:Iqhosha le-13, INcedo Yezempilo (Ngokukhethwayo), Iindleko zendlu: Umsebenzisi kufuneka adibanise nemfuno echanekileyo. ISetifikathi Ephakamileyo / Inqanaba le-12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe / I-degree kwiSpeech Therapy kunye noQatshelwa lwangoku kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomtheraphisti wethetha ngokubakwayo kunye neSetifikathi yenkonzo esemvumelweni ngurhwebo lweHR ukususela kubakho base ngaphambili nabangoku kuya kufuneka kuphela kubagqibiwe kumgca o finyuviweyo. Umphumeleli kuya kufuneka achithe isithuba esingaphantsi komnyaka unyaka wesevisi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namandla ekuqaleni: Ithetha ngokubakwayo yabantwana ekuqaphelelweni iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokunyanga. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo kwisebe, Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuziphatha nangommandla wokusebenza. Ulwazi lokusombulula iingxaki nokusetyenziswa kolwazi oluthe ngqo kwikhathalelo labagulwa. Amakhono okulawula abasebenzi ababambi nzimeni kunye nabafundi. Ilayisensi esemthethweni engekavunywa yeKhowudi B (Khowudi 08) kunye nolwazi kwiZulu.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngokuqaphelelwa nokunyanga ngokupheleleyo nangokubanzi kubantwana nakutshetha ngokubakwayo ngokubanzi iinkonzo kubo bonke abagulwa. Ulwazi olululo ngokuqaphelelwa kulawulo kubantwana abasela nzima. Uqeqesho olupheleleyo labanini bashikiweyo, imfundo yomgulwa nemiqala ehlotshanayo. Ukwenza iinkonzo eziphumile njengoko kuyimfuno, ukwenza umsebenzi weqela inyango okanye unyango lweqela njengoko kubonwe. Iimfihlelo nendlela yokuziphatha ngeqela elahlukeneyo kwinyango labagulwa. Ukwenza iindwendwe ezikhaya nasesikolweni nasezinye iindwendwe koluntu njengoko kuyimfuno. Umsebenzi wolawulo ongomgulwa: ukubhala iingxelo, izibalo. Iintlanganiso, ingxoxo yetyala, iingxelo zomthetho njengoko kuyimfuno. umzekelo imali yamalungelo okukhutshwa iinkonzo ezincinene, umsebenzi wezomthetho kwezempilo inshurensi. Inyameko lo phuculo lolungiselelo: iindlela zolawulo ngokweklinikhi, ukufundisa nokuqeqesha, iindlela zokuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho esemgqweni ngokwezinye iindlela ngokubanzi, ukutshiswa kolwazi, isibhedlele esifunekayo, njl.njl.) Ukuxhumana kakuhle nabo bonke abanemibaqamba (abagulwa. Ii-NGO, abanini bashikiweyo njl.njl.) Qinisekisa uphuculo lomsebenzi ngokwembonakaliso yomgulwa wenkonzo. Xhasa umphathi kuyo yonke imibhangqo nemizamo yokutshintsha.

jobs.title: Health and Safety Officer
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum, (Level 08). 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Health and Safety Officer at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a degree or diploma in Environmental Health or Safety Management with 3-5 years of safety experience.
jobs.requirements: Degree / National Diploma in Environmental Health or Safety Management. Minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in Safety. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies required: Knowledge of relevant legislations pertaining to Occupational Health and Safety. Identification, control, elimination and monitoring of hazards. Health education and administration of the services. Knowledge of computer literacy. Accident investigation. Disaster management.
jobs.duties: Identification of potential situation that could lead to injury/disability/death of staff member/visitor. Proper damage or loss, internal disaster, medico-legal claim and reporting thereof to the Occupational health and safety manager. Ensuring the delegate management and administrative functions are carried out timely and correctly in order for health and safety to function in the institution. Assisting in development and compilation of manuals, policies and protocol that will be included in the rolling out of the health and safety training, orientation and induction programmes. Participate in safety audits for the institution in compliance with the occupational health and safety Act,85 of 1993. Assisting the occupational health and safety manager in ensuring that buildings, construction, plants, and machinery meet and maintain compliance certificates that are regulated by the occupational health and safety Act, 85 of 1993 and its regulation. Organise and record the Disaster drills. Ensure that all employees and service providers within the hospital complies with the required safety protocols. Ensure that people, patients, staff and the building are safe and Hospital is legally compliant, OHSD, norms and standards, DOH requirements, conduct workplace inspections, PPE management, ergonomics and staff safety. Liaise with occupational Health team on T.B, Hep B radiation monitoring etc. Ensure fire safety and emergency preparedness. Ensure Infection Control and patient safety support, i.e heater qudity, ventilation, waste management, contractor safety. Conduct training and awareness on Health and Safety. Implement monitoring and quality improvement. ENQURIE : Mr. T.D Ndaba Tel No: (034) 328 8014
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office no:3, Madadeni Hospital, f0001, section 6, Madadeni, 2951 or emailed to: sibongiseni.kheswa@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. MAD 01/2016. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview.

af.title: Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n graad of diploma in Omgewingsgesondheid of Veiligheidsbestuur vereis met 3-5 jaar se veiligheidservaring.
af.requirements: Graad / Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsgesondheid of Veiligheidsbestuur. Minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Veiligheid. Vereiste kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Kennis van relevante wetgewing met betrekking tot ArbeidsGesondheid en Veiligheid. Identifikasie, beheer, eliminasie en monitering van gevare. Gesondheidsvoorligting en administrasie van die dienste. Kennis van rekenaarvaardigheid. Ongelukondersoek. Rampbestuur.
af.duties: Identifikasie van potensiële situasies wat tot besering/verstommendheid/dood van 'n staflid/besoeker kan lei. Behoorlike skade of verlies, interne rampe, medies-regtelike eise en rapportering daarvan aan die arbeids gesondheids- en veiligheidsbestuurder. Verseker dat afgevaardigde bestuurs- en administratiewe funksies tydig en korrek uitgevoer word sodat gesondheid en veiligheid in die instelling kan funksioneer. Bystand verleen by die ontwikkeling en opstel van handleidings, beleide en protokolle wat ingesluit sal word by die uitrol van die gesondheids- en veiligheidsopleiding, oriëntering en inlywingsprogramme. Neem deel aan veiligheidsoudits vir die instelling in ooreenstemming met die Wet op ArbeidsGesondheid en Veiligheid, 85 van 1993. Bystand verleen aan die arbeids gesondheids- en veiligheidsbestuurder om te verseker dat geboue, konstruksies, aanlegte en masjinerie aan die nakomingsertifikate voldoen en dit behou wat gereguleer word deur die Wet op ArbeidsGesondheid en Veiligheid, 85 van 1993 en sy regulasies. Reël en rekord die rampoefeninge. Verseker dat alle werknemers en diensverskaffers binne die hospitaal aan die vereiste veiligheidsprotokolle voldoen. Verseker dat mense, pasiënte, staf en die gebou veilig is en die Hospitaal regmatig voldoen, OHSD, norme en standaarde, DOH-vereistes, werkplekbesigtings uitvoer, PPE-bestuur, ergonomie en stafveiligheid. Skakel met die ArbeidsGesondheidspan oor T.B, Hep B-stralingsmonitering ens. Verseker brandveiligheid en noodgereedheid. Verseker Infeksiebeheer en pasiëntveiligheidsondersteuning, d.w.s. verwarming, ventilasie, afvalbestuur, kontrakteurveiligheid. Voer opleiding en bewusmaking oor Gesondheid en Veiligheid uit. Implementeer monitering en gehalteverbetering. NAVRAE : Mnr. T.D Ndaba Tel No: (034) 328 8014

zu.title: Inkosi Yezempilo Nokuphepha
zu.summary: Inkosi Yezempilo Nokuphepha e-Madadeni Provincial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, edinga iziqu noma i-diploma ezimeni ye-Environmental Health noma i-Safety Management ngeminyaka eyi-3-5 yokuqeqeshwa kokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu / i-National Diploma kwi-Environmental Health noma i-Safety Management. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3-5 yokuqeqeshwa Kokuphepha. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene ne-Occupational Health and Safety. Ukuqapha, ukulawula, ukususa nokubheka izingozi. Iminyakazo yezempilo nolawulwe kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ukuphenya izehlakalo ezinhleke. Ukuphathwa kwezehlakalo ezinkulu.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha izimo ezingase zibangele ukulimala / ukukhwesha / ukufa komsebenzi noma wesivakashi. Ukwazisa ngokulimala noma ukulahlekelwa, isehlakalo sangaphakathi, izikhalazo zezomthetho ezibhekene nezokwelapha nokuzidlulisa kumphathi wezempilo nokuphepha kokusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yolawulo nobuqu obunikelwe abanye yenziwa ngasikhathi nangendlela elungile ukuze izempilo nokuphepha kusebenze esikhungweni. Ukusiza ekwakheni nasekuhlanganiseni imibhalo, izinqubomgomo namaphrotokholi ezozoba ingxenye yokuhlolwa kwemfundo, yokumukelwa nokuhlolwa kwezempilo nokuphepha. Ukubamba iqhaza kokuqapha kokuphepha esikhungweni ngokuvumelana ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 85 of 1993. Ukusiza umphathi wezempilo nokuphepha ekugcineni ukuthi izakhiwo, ukwakhiwa, izitshalo, namashini ahlangabezana futhi agcine amafomula wokuvumelana abalawulwa yi-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 85 of 1993 nemithetho yalo. Ukuhlela futhi uqaphe imiyalo yezehlakalo ezinkulu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi nabanikezeli besevisi emgubasweni bayalandela amaphrotokholi okuphepha adingekayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu, abagulayo, abasebenzi nesakhiwo buphepha futhi isibhedlela sivumelana nomthetho, i-OHSD, izindinganiso nezitandards, izidingo ze-DOH, ukwenza okuhlolywa ezindaweni zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwe-PPE, ergonomics nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ukuxhumana nenkundla ye-Occupational Health ngokwe-T.B, i-Hep B, ukubheka ukusakazeka kwemisakazo nokunye. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kumililo nokulungele ukwesabela ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kokutheleleka nokusekela ukuphepha kwesiguli, okuyilawu lokushisa, ukuhambisa umoya, ukuphathwa kwenkunkuma, nokuphepha kwabakhiqizi. Ukwenza imfundo nokwazisa ngezempilo Nokuphepha. Ukuphatha ukubheka nokuthuthukisa izinga. IMIBUZO: Mr. T.D Ndaba Tel No: (034) 328 8014

xh.title: Umnikazi weZezempilo Nokhuseleko
xh.summary: Isithuba somnikazi weZezempilo Nokhuseleko e Madadeni Provincial Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal, sifuna idigree okanye iDiploma yesiQonga kwiZezempilo zeNdalo okanye uLawulo loKhuseleko, elineminyaka elithoba yamava ngokhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Idigree / iDiploma yesiQonga kwiZezempilo zeNdalo okanye uLawulo loKhuseleko. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-5 yamava kuKhuseleko. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi ngemithetho ehambisana nezeMisebenzi yeMpilo noKhuseleko. Ukuqaphela, ukulawula, ukucima nokuhlola iingozi. Imfundo ngempilo nokulawula iinkonzo. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Uphenyo lwehondo. ULawulo leeNdawo ezibangelwa ziBungozi.
xh.duties: Ukuqaphela izimo ezinokubangela ukulimala/ukuphila ngokuchazekileyo/ukufa komsebenzi/omnye umntu othe waya esibhedlele. Ukubika ngokulahleka okuchanekileyo okanye ilahleko, isigwegwengana sangaphakathi, isigqibo sezomthetho-esempilweni nokusibika kumlawuli wezempilo nokhuseleko wengcali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukulawula ababekiweyo nemisebenzi yolawulo iyenziwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangendlela efanelekileyo ukuze impilo nokhuselelo kusebenze kwindalo. Ukuncedisa ekwenzeni nasekuqokeleleni iimannuals, iinkqubo namacebo okuza kubandakanywa ekusasazweni kofundo, okumiselo lokuqala nokuqalelwa ezisebenzweni kwezempilo nokhuseleko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqaphelo lwezendlu ngokhuseleko ukulandelwa komthetho weMisebenzi yeMpilo noKhuseleko, 85 ka 1993. Ukuncedisa umlawuli wempilo nokhuseleko wengcali ukuqinisekisa ukuba iindlu ezingamagumbi, ezoakhiwayo, izityalo namashini diyalwe zigqibo ngokwemithetho kwaye zigqibe ukulandelwa kwemithetho yeMisebenzi yeMpilo noKhuseleko, 85 ka 1993 nemithetho yayo. Ukuhlela nokugcina ukuzilolonga iindawo ezibangelwa ziBungozi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi nabanye abahlinzeki abakule ndawo yosizi bayazithobela iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokhuseleko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu, abagulayo, abasebenzi nendlu ezingamagumbi bakhuselekile kwaye isibhedlele sithobela imithetho, OHSD, imigaqo nemilinganiselo, iimfuno ze DOH, ukuhlola indawo yomsebenzi, uLawulo lwePPE, ergonomics nokuKhuseleka kwabasebenzi. Ukuqhagamshelana neqela leMisebenzi yempilo ngesifo soMkhuhlane iBengo (TB), isifo senhepa (Hep B), ukulawulwa kokutshonga njengokwenzekayo. Ukuqinisekisa uKhuseleko mlilo nokuLungela iimeko ezibangelwa ziBungozi. Ukuqinisekisa uLawulo lweNdlu ngenkcitha kwaye inkxaso yokhuseleko lomntu ofuna unyango, ngoko kukhuseleko lomlilo, ukuphefumula, uLawulo lweNdalo, ngenkcitha. Ukwenza uQeqesho nokuvakalaysa ngeZempilo nokuKhuseleko. Ukuzisebenzisa ukuqaphela nokuphucula umgangatho. IMIBUZO : Mnuz. T.D Ndaba Tel No: (034) 328 8014

jobs.title: Facility Information Officer
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Manage health information systems and coordinate data collection at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, requiring an IT or related diploma or degree.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12. National Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field. The following will be an added advantage: Appropriate experience in data management and health information systems, including the District Health Information System (DHIS) and Routine Health Information Systems. Training and/or previous experience in TIER.Net and/or EDRWeb data capturing and reporting. Certificate in MS Office or demonstrated proficiency in the MS Office package. A valid driver's license. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of health information systems and data-management principles. Ability to collect, capture, validate, analyse and report health information. Presentation skills - The ability to compile meaningful presentation and/ or graphical presentation of statistics and to compare strategic objectives with reported results Strong communication, interpersonal and supervisory skills Sound organizing, planning and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Ability to work under pressure and to meet tight reporting deadlines. Understand regional/district health systems (incl. Health and Management Information Systems) Sound public health knowledge Proficient Computer skills working with full Microsoft Office Package. Ability to operate office equipment e.g. photocopiers, fax machine etc. High level of accuracy and capturing skills Technical knowledge in the information Technology Environment.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinating and managing the collection of quality data and the maintenance of the Institutional Health and Management Information at the facility Collecting, capturing, validating, analyzing and interpreting facility data Ensuring the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of information submitted through the relevant health information systems. Monitoring facility performance indicators against targets. Preparing statistical tables, graphs and presentations. Feeding back information through both summary and comprehensive reports Maintaining information and data-management records. Conduct data audits, data-quality assessments and monitoring visits. Ensure data and information integrity to accurately represent the state of service delivery in the facility. Supervising and training staff. Putting mechanisms in place to improve the quality of information received. Co-ordinate and facilitate the development of information management and Data flow plan Convene data information Management committee meetings. Actively participate in the facility performance review activities. Continuously verify and validate data to ensure quality and good decision-making.

af.title: Fasiliteite-inligtingbeampte
af.summary: Bestuur gesondheidsinligtingstelsels en koördineer dataversameling by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, wat 'n IT- of verwante diploma of graad vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12. Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Inligtingstegnologie, Bestuursinligtingstelsels, Statistiek, Rekenaarwetenskap of 'n verwante veld. Die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: Toepaslike ervaring in databestuur en gesondheidsinligtingstelsels, insluitend die District Health Information System (DHIS) en Routine Health Information Systems. Opleiding en/of vorige ervaring in TIER.Net en/of EDRWeb datavaslegging en verslagdoening. Sertifikaat in MS Office of getoonde vaardigheid in die MS Office-pakket. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van gesondheidsinligtingstelsels en databestuursbeginsels. Vermoë om gesondheidsinligting in te samel, vas te lê, te valideer, te analiseer en daaroor te rapporteer. Aanbiedingsvaardighede - Die vermoë om betekenisvolle aanbiedings en/of grafiese aanbiedings van statistieke op te stel en strategiese doelwitte met gerapporteerde resultate te vergelyk. Sterk kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike en toesigvaardighede. Deklike organiserings-, beplannings- en analitiese vaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en streng verslagdoenings sperdatums na te kom. Begrip van streeks/distrik-gesondheidstelsels (insl. Gesondheids- en Bestuursinligtingstelsels) Deklike openbare gesondheidskennis. Vaardige rekenaarvaardighede met die volledige Microsoft Office-pakket. Vermoë om kantoortoerusting te bedien, bv. fotostaatmasjiene, faksmasjien ens. Hoë vlak van akkuraatheid en vasleggingsvaardighede. Tegniese kennis in die Inligtingstegnologie-omgewing.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur die insameling van kwaliteitsdata en die instandhouding van die Instellings se Gesondheids- en Bestuursinligting by die fasiliteit. Versamel, lê vas, valideer, analiseer en interpreteer fasiliteitsdata. Verseker die akkuraatheid, volledigheid en tydigheid van inligting wat deur die betrokke gesondheidsinligtingstelsels ingedien word. Monitor datakwaliteit en identifiseer diskrepansies vir korreksie. Stel maandelikse, kwartaal- en jaarlikse statistiese verslae op. Verskaf inligting aan hospitaalbestuur vir beplanning, monitering en evaluering. Verskaf advies aan saalbestuurders en hoofde van departemente met betrekking tot gesondheidsinligting- en databestuurstelsels en verwante behoeftes, bv. voltooiing van gestandaardiseerde vorms en gebruik van hospitaalregisters en Databestuursbeleid-verwante kwessies. Monitor fasiliteitsprestasie-aanwysers teen teikens. Berei statistiese tabelle, grafieke en aanbiedings voor. Voer inligting terug deur beide opsommings- en omvattende verslae. Onderhou inligting- en databestuursrekords. Voer dataoudite, datakwaliteitsassessering en moniteringsbesoeke uit. Verskaf leiding aan personeel oor data-insameling, verslagdoening en inligtingsbestuursprosedures. Enige ander pligte verrig wat deur die toesighouer of hospitaalbestuur gedelegeer word. Onderhou en verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan alle Routine Health Information Systems. Koördineer die insameling van roetine- en nie-roetine data, insluitend opnames. Verseker data- en inligtingsintegriteit om die toestand van dienslewering by die fasiliteit akkuraat voor te stel. Toesig hou our en oplei personeel. Skep meganismes om die kwaliteit van inligting wat ontvang word, te verbeter. Koördineer en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n inligtingsbestuurs- en Data-vloeiplan. Reël data-inligtingsbestuurskomiteevergaderings. Neem aktief deel aan die fasiliteitsprestasie-hersieningsaktiwiteite. Verifieer en valideer data deurlopend om kwaliteit en goeie besluitneming te verseker.

zu.title: Umphathi Wolwazi Lwezikhashana
zu.summary: Phatha izinhlela zolwazi lwezempilo futhi uhlelanise ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane e Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, kudingeka idiploma noma iziqu kwe-IT noma esimaheleni esihlobene.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / i-Grade 12. Idiploma Yezwe noma Iziqu kwi-Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science noma esimaheleni esihlobene. Okulandelayo kuzoba yinzuzo: Okuhlobene nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatweni kwemininingwane nakwezinhlela zolwazi lwezempilo, kuhlanganise i-District Health Information System (DHIS) nezinhlela zolwazi lwezempilo ezenzeka nsuku zonke. Ukuqeqeshwa kanye/noma okuhlangenwe nakho ngaphambilini ekuthathweni kwemininingwane kwe-TIER.Net kanye/noma EDRWeb ekubikweni. Isitifikedi kwi-MS Office noma ukubonisa ukugqugquzelela kwephakheji ye-MS Office. Ilayisenisi yokuqasha evumelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono Aqeqeshiwe Nezindinganiso Ezingadingekayo: Ulwazi ngolwazi lwezempilo kanye nemigomo yokuphatha imininingwane. Ikono lokuthola, lokuthatha, lokugqamisa, lokuhlaziya kanye nokubika ulwazi lwezempilo. Amakhono okwethula - ikono lokulunga okunemininingwane okuthakazelisayo futhi/noma okubonakalayo ngokwezibalo nokuthi kuholiswe izinjongo eziyisigaba nezibiko eziyisimo. Amakhono okuthumela imiyalezo aqinile, okuhlobene nabantu nokuqasha abanye. Amakhono aqinisekile okuhlela, okucwangisa nokuhlaziya. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimele futhi njengengxenye yeqembu elinabanye abantu abanamakhono ahlukene. Ikono lokusebenza ngokucindezelekile nokuhlangabezana nezikhathi ezinqamule ezibikwayo. Ukuqonda izinhlela zezempilo zesifunda/omasipala (kuhlanganise Izinhleba Lolwazi Lwezempilo Nolwazi Lolawulo). Ulwazi oluzinze ngasese ngolwazi lwezempilo. Amakhono okusebenza ngabakhiqizwa ngokuthuthukile okusebenza ngephakheji ephelele ye-Microsoft Office. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinto zendawo yokusebenza njengamafotokophiya, ifeksi njj. Izinga eliphezulu lokuba nefayimbo nokuthatha imininingwane. Ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe kwindawo Yezobuchwepheshe Lwazi.
zu.duties: Ukuhlelanisa nokuphatha ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane emihle nokugcinwa Kwolwazi Lwezempilo Nolwazi Lolawulo Lwesikhungo. Ukuthatha, ukuyigqamisa, ukuqinisekisa, ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha imininingwane yesikhungo. Ukuqinisekisa ukunemba, ukuphela kanye nokuqedwa ngokushesha kolwazi olunikezwa ngokuhamba kwezinhlela zolwazi lwezempilo ezihlobene. Ukubheka ikhwalithi yemininingwane futhi kubone iziphambano ukuze zilungiswe. Ukulenga izibiko eziyizinamba ezenzelwe izinyanga, masontwe nonyaka zonyaka. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi abaphathi besibhedlela ukuze bacwaningisise, babheke futhi bahlukanise. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kubaphathi bamagumbi kanye noBaphathi bezeminyango mayelana nolwazi lwempilo kanye nezinhlela zokuphatha imininingwane kanye nezidingo ezihlobene njengokuqedwa kwamafomu ajwayelekile nokusetshenziswa kwezibiko zesibhedlela kanye nezinto eziyisinqumo ezihlobene namapholisi Okuphatha Imininingwane. Ukubheka izinkomba zentengo zesikhungo phezu kwanqubomgomo. Ukuqasha izinkomba, izinkulumo zemifanekiso nezibiko. Ukuphendula ngolwazi ngokusebenzisa izibiko ezimfushane futhi eziyisifanekisongqangi. Ukugcina izibiko zolwazi kanye nozulwazi okuphathwayo. Ukwenza ukuhlola imininingwane, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi kanye nokubheka ukuqedwa. Ukuhola izikhulu ngendlela yokuyiqoqa imininingwane, ukubika kanye noqolwazi lolawulo. Ukwenza noma yikuphi okunye okwabelwe umbonisi noma izibhedlela ngokomthetho wokuhola. Ukugcina kanye nokusekela obala buchwepheshe wonke amasistemu Olwazi Lwezempilo. Ukuqoqa imininingwane evamile neyengeziwe ekuqoqweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane igqamile ngokusimama futhi ihlakaniphile. Ukuqasha kanye nokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kolwazi lolawulo futhi uhlele imigqa yonke. Ukuqoqela kanye nokugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo yolwazi nokuqondisa imiyalezo yemininingwane. Ubuhlakani bokusebenza ngendlela eqinisekisiwe.

xh.title: Isikhokeli Bolwazi besiSiseko
xh.summary: Phatha iinkqubo zolwazi ngempilo uze ulungelelanise ukuqokelelwa kwedata kwi Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, kufuneka ube nediploma okanye idigri kwi-IT okanye kwelinye ibala elinxulumene nalo.
xh.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12. National Diploma okanye Degree kwi-Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science okanye kwelinye ibala elinxulumene nalo. Oku kulandelayo kuya kuba luncedo olongezelelweyo: Amava afanelekileyo ekulawulweni kwedata naseenkqubweni zolwazi ngempilo, kuquka i-District Health Information System (DHIS) kunye ne-Routine Health Information Systems. Uqeqesho kwaye/okanye amava angaphambili ekubambeni kwedata nokubika kwi-TIER.Net kunye/okanye i-EDRWeb. Isatifikethi kwi-MS Office okanye ubuchwepheshe obubonisiweyo kwipakethe ye-MS Office. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi, uQeqesho lweAkhoni namava aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolwazi ngempilo kunye nemigaqo yokulawula idata. Amandla okuqokelela, ukubamba, ukuqinisekisa, ukuhlalutya nokubika ulwazi ngempilo. Amakhono okubonisa - Amandla okwenza iintonobano ezinentsingiselo nokuba/okanye ukubonisa ngemizobo izibalo kunye nokuthelekisa iinjongo ezicwangcisweyo nemiphumala exeliweyo. Amakhono amanqanqamathu okunxibelelwana nabantu nakulawula Amakhono amanqanqamathu okuhlela, ukucwangcisa nokwahlulaahlula. Amandla okusebenza kodwa nakunjengengxenye yeqela elinamagatya amaninzi. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kunye nokuhlangabezana nemigaqo eqinileyo yexesha lokubika. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zempilo zommandla/isithili (kuquka iinkqubo zeNkcukacha ngoZoBomi noLawulo). Ulwazi olunamandla malunga nempilo yomntu wonke Amakhono ekhompyutha ezisebenza ngePakethe epheleleyo yeMicrosoft Office. Amandla okusebenza izixhobo zikawonke-wonke ezinje ngefotokhopi, imatshini yefaxi njl.njl. Iqondo eliphezulu lokuchaneka nokubamba amakhono. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe kwimeko yobuchwepheshe bolwazi.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa nokulawula ukuqokelelwa kwedata elungileyo nolondolozo lweNkcukacha zoLawulo noMphilo zeSiseko kwisiseko. Ukuqokelela, ukubamba, ukuqinisekisa, ukuhlalutya nokutolika idatha yesiseko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuchaneka, ukugqithiswa ngokwaneleyo nokuhamba kwexesha kolwazi olunikezayo ngeenkqubo zolwazi ngempilo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqwalasela umgangatho wedata nokuqaphela iingxaki ezifuna ukulungiswa. Ukuqokelela iiripoti zeziqengqheko ezingenyanga, kwikota, nonyaka. Ukubonelela ulwazi kulawulo lesibhedlele malunga noqwalaselo, ukulandelela nokubuyela ngemva. Ukunika izindaba abaphathi beewardi neentloko zemisebenzi malunga nolwazi ngempilo ngeenkqubo zokulawula idata nezidingo ezinxulumene nazo njengokugqibezela amafomu agqithisweyo nokusetyenziswa kwamaswidi esibhedlele neendaba ezinxulumene nenqaku lokulawula idata. Ukuqwalasela izalathisi zomsebenzi zesiseko ngokuchasene neenjongo. Ukulungisa iitafile, iigrafi kunye neentonobano zeziqengqheko. Ukuphindela ngemva ulwazi ngokubika ngokudityaniswa ngokubanzi nangokweenkcukacha. Ukugcina ulwazi neerekhodi zokulawula idata. Ukuqhuba ukuvavanya idata, iimvavanyo zomgangatho wedata kunye nokutyelela ukuqwalasela. Ukunika inkqubo abasebenzi ngeendlela zokuqokelela idata, ukubika nokuLawula ulwazi. Ukuqhuba nayiphi na eminye imisebenzi enikiwe ngumphathi okanye ulawulo lesibhedlele. Ukulondoloza kunye nokunikela inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kuzo zonke iinkqubo zoMphilo ngeNkcukacha ezenza umgaqo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuqokelelwa kwedata eqhelekileyo nengaqhelekanga kuquka iintlobo zophando. Ukuqinisekisa ubuso bedata nolwazi ukuze bubonise ngokuchaneka ubume bokunikwa kweenkonzo kwisiseko. Ukulawula nokuyala abasebenzi. Ukuzisa iindlela eziza kuphucula umgangatho wolwazi olufunyenweyo. Ukulungelelanisa nokwenza lula ukuphuhliswa kokuLawulwa kolwazi necandelo lokuSebenza idata. Ukubiza iindiba zebhunga lokuLawulwa kolwazi lwedata. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo kwiindaba zokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwisiseko. Ukuqhubeka nokuhlala uqinisekisa idata ukuze kuqinisekiswe umgangatho nokwenza izigqibo ezilungileyo.

af.summary: Superviseer pasientadministrasiepersoneel by ST Chads CHC in KwaZulu-Natal, wat Graad 12 en drie tot vyf jaar se ervaring in pasientadministrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Standaard 10/ Graad 12. 3-5 jaar se ervaring in pasientadministrasie-komponent. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis. Bumuse, setha futhi ulondoloze amaphulo okuqashwa kwababumbe nokuphathwa kwabagulayo kule CHC/Ichibhiyela ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga elihle. Siza ngokusula kwemibenzo kanye nomkhondo wemibuzo ehlobene negulayo /izibalo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemibiko ukusekela imigudu yembiko yezimali eqinisekisiwe nesikhathini. Qapha futhi ulawule ukugcinwa okuhle kohlaka lwabagulayo namagugu abagulayo. Bumuse, setha futhi uqaphele izinyathelo ezn klanyele ukuba zikwesekisa ukusula kwemali. Qinisekisa ukulungiswa nokuhumusha imibiko yezimali/izibuyekezo nkamwaka futhi wenze isiphetho senyanga /nyanga inyaka. Bumuse, setha, qapha futhi ubuyekeze imigudu yezinhlelo ezindayo. Thatha inxaxheba kwingxoxo yokuletha izinkonzo. Bumuse, setha futhi uqaphele izinyathelo ezibophiwe ukunciphisa isikhathi sokulinda. Hlela inkuliso nokwesekwa. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuyiqiniso, okusebenza kahle nokuqashwa kwezibalo eziyisabelo kulunga lokuphathwa, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Clerk wezolawulo: Umphathi: Ukulawula abagulayo
xh.summary: Lawula abasebenzi bolawulo abagulayo kwi-ST Chads CHC eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka igrade 12 nephakamilo lokwaziswa kweminyaka emithathu ukuya kwelinthan kulo lawulo abagulayo.
xh.requirements: Standard 10/ Grade 12. 3-5 years’ experience in patient administration component. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo. Ulwazi olubanzi namava ekusebenzeni ngeenkqubo zolawulo lwabagulayo. Ulwazi oluzolileyo malunga ne-Public Finance Management Act, imiyalelo yeTreasury, i-UPFS nokuphatha imali. Amanqanaba okulawula nokuba ngumgqatswa. Amanqanaba okuqamba, iplani nokusombulula iingxaki. Amanqanaba okusebenzisana nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemeko yekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukusebenza komsebenzi uze wakhe iingxelo. Lawula abasebenzi uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwe-EPMDS. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-UPFS ngokwenza isiqondo esichanekileyo somgulayo. Phepha zendlela zokusebenza ezintsha ukuze kuxhaswe inkqubo yokulawula abagulayo. Yenza izibalo ezinxulumene nabagulayo uze wakhe iingxelo eziya kwabaphathi. Lawula ukuhlokwabeziswa koxwebhu lwabagulayo. Qinisekisa iindlela ezithi zikhuphe imali engenayo. Yenza iingxelo zimali ngenyanga. Yenza iindlela ezithi zinciphise iingxaki. Lawula abasebenzi uze wachaze iindlela ezichanekileyo zokwenza umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yesebe ngokusebenzisa izixhobo esinazo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1–3 – General Stream
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 – R391 515 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 – R478 116 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 – R635 704 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply), 13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional), In- hospital Area Allowance (8% of basic salary)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1-3, General Stream) sought at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to deliver and supervise quality nursing care.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/ Degree in General Nursing and Midwifery) that allows registration with the ‘South African Nursing Council’ (SANC) as a Professional Nurse and Midwife. Current registration with the SANC (2026) Experience Grade 1: None Experience Grade 2: a minimum of 10 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Experience Grade 3: a minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks. Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act. Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure, etc. Good communication skills; Report writing skills Knowledge Management; Planning & Organizing; Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan and quality patient care. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing care. Practise nursing and healthcare in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and healthcare. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise resources efficiently and effectively. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift leader on day and night duty when necessary. Provide appropriate nursing care to patients in the Admission, Antenatal and Labour Ward. Promote and advocate proper treatment and care, responding to patients' needs, requirements and expectations. Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure nursing care that is cost-effective, equitable and efficient. NB: Must be prepared to work shift as per allocation; includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1–3 – Algemene Stroom
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Vlak 1-3, Algemene Stroom) gesoek by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om gehalte-verpleegsorg te lewer en toe te sien.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/ Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroegkunde) wat registrasie by die ‘South African Nursing Council’ (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vroedvrou toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die SANC (2026) Ervaring Vlak 1: Geen Ervaring Vlak 2: 'n minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ervaring Vlak 3: 'n minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/ erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde Kennis, Vaardighede Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute, en ander relevante regsraamwerke. Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act. Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels, Public Service Regulations, Labour Act, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure, ens. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede; Verslagdoeningsvaardighede Kennisbestuur; Beplanning & Organisasie; Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf leiding en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan en gehalte pasiëntsorg. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalte-verpleegsorg. Beoefen verpleegkunde en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleegkunde en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkunde en ander belanghebbendes. Benut hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Bystand verleen met aflospligte van die toesighouer en optree as skiftleier op dag- en nagdiens wanneer nodig. Verskaf toepaslike verpleegsorg aan pasiënte in die Toelatings-, Antenatale en Kraamsaal. Bevorder en beyker behoorlike behandeling en sorg, deur te reageer op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om verpleegsorg te verseker wat koste-effektief, billik en doeltreffend is. NB: Moet bereid wees om skift te werk soos toegewys; sluit nag-skift, naweke en Openbare Vakansiedae in.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohleziwe Izinga 1–3 – Umqhazo Jikelele
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ohleziwe (Izinga 1-3, Umqhazo Jikelele) e-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital KwaZulu-Natal ukunikeza futhi abukele ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okunesikhathi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ze-R425 eziyisisekelo (okungukuthi i-Diploma/ Degree ekunakekelweni kwamaso nobeletho) ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-'South African Nursing Council' (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe nombelethisi. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-SANC (2026) Okuhleziwe Izinga 1: Akukho Okuhleziwe Izinga 2: okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yohlelo olufanele/ olushiywa isikhumbuzo ekunakekelweni kwamaso ngemva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe ku-SANC ekunakekelweni kwamaso jikelele. Okuhleziwe Izinga 3: okungenani eminyaka engu-20 yohlelo olufanele/ olushiywa isikhumbuzo ekunakekelweni kwamaso ngemva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohleziwe ku-SANC ekunakekelweni kwamaso jikelele. Ulwazi, Amandla Okusebenza Isikole Namandla Okwenza Izinto Ahlelekile: Ulwazi mayelana nezigaba nezinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwamaso, izimo zokuba ngumhlengikazi, kanye namanye amasiko okusebenza asemthethweni. I-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health & Safety Act. I-Patient Rights Charter, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Act, i-Disciplinary Code and Procedure, i-Grievance Procedure, njll. Amandla okuxhumana oluhle; Amandla okubhala izibalo Ulwazi Lokuphatha Ukuhlela Nokuhlela; Ulwazi Lokusebenzisa Ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ukusebenza kwenhlelo yokunakekela nokunakekelwa kwesiguli okuhle. Sebenziza izinga, izindlela zokusebenza, izindlela nezinkomba zokunakekelwa kwamaso okuhle. Yenza isikhundla sokunakekela nokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemithetho ephathelene nokunakekelwa nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Githelela ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nabahlengikazi kanye nabanye abahleli bamandla. Sebenzisa imininingwane ngokusebenza futhi ngokunyakaziswa. Siza ngesikhundla sokuqedela komqondisi futhi ube ngumholi wesikhathi ngemini nasebusuku uma kudingeka. Nikeza ukunakekelwa kwamaso okufanele kubaguli e-Admission, Antenatal kanye ne-Labour Ward. Khuthaza futhi ugcine ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okuhle, uphendula izidingo, izidingo nenkululeko yabaguli. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okubiza kakhulu, okulingana futhi okusebenza. NB: Kumele ube buthaka ukusebenza isikhathi ngokwe-alkeshini; kuhlanganise isikhathi sobusuku, amasonto nokuhamba kwezikhathi Zomphakathi.

xh.title: Umongikazi ozingeliweyo Wesiqendo 1–3 – Isiqendu Jikelele
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMongikazi ozingeliweyo (Isiqendo 1-3, Isiqendu Jikelele) kwiPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunikeza nokuqonda ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okulungileyo.
xh.requirements: Izeluleko eZisisiseko R425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma/IDigri kwiZ nursing eZizelelo neMbelo) evumela uku.bhaliswa kwi‘South African Nursing Council’ (SANC) njengoMongikazi ozingeliweyo noMbelosi. Uku.bhaliswa kwangoku kwi SANC (2026) Iimfihlo zesiqendo 1: Akukho Iimfihlo zesiqendo 2: amava amabaliso ayi-10 emsebenzini oqondileyo/owaziwayo kwinakekelwa emva koku.bhaliswa njengoMongikazi ozingeliweyo kwi SANC kwiNursing eZizelelo. Iimfihlo zesiqendo 3: amava amabaliso ayi-20 emsebenzini oqondileyo/owaziwayo kwinakekelwa emva koku.bhaliswa njengoMongikazi ozingeliweyo kwi SANC kwiNursing eZizelelo Ulwazi, Amandlaokuqamba, uQeqesho namaQaqamba afunekayo: Ulwazi ngamachacha okunakekelwa kwezempilo nemigaqo, izikqeli zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, nezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezithintekayo. Isikqelo seNursing, isikqelo soBomi beZempilo, isikqelo sokuQonda ukuQhubeka kuKhuseleko kwiNdawo yoMsebenzi. Isatifikedi samalungelo eSiguli, iinkqubo zoBatho-Pele, iNgqungquthela yoMthetho woMphulu Wonke, umThetho woBasebenzi, umThetho woQeqesho nomThetho wokuSika umSebenzi, iNkqubo yokuZingela iingxaki, njl. Amandla okuthetha alungileyo; Amandla okubhala iingxelo; Ulwazi lolwazi; uCwangciso oluHleliweyo; ukuba buqukwa kweKhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nikezela ngokuqonda nokuqondisa ukuqaliswa kweplani yokunakekelwa nokunakekelwa kweziguli ezilungileyo. Qalisa iinkqubo, amachacha, iinkalanyo nemalungiselelo emisebenzini yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Qeqesha umsebenzi wezempilo nakunakekelwa ngokuthobela imithetho nemiqathango ephathelene nayo. Gcina ulungelelwaniso olukhuselekileyo phakathi kwabasebenzi bakaMongikazi nabanye abanomdla. Sebenzisa izixhobo ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo. Nceda ekuphateni imisebenzi yokhuseleko komqondisi wakho ube ngumphathi wesikhundla kusuku nasebusuku xa kuyimfuneko. Nikela ngokunakekelwa okuqondileyo kweziguli kwindawo yoKwamkelwa, kweNdalo yoMbelo nakwiWadi yoMbelo. Phakamisa nokuxhasa unyango nokunakekelwa olulungileyo, uphendule iimfuno, iinkqubo nolindelo lwabasempilweni. Sebenza njengesicitha sethu esiphathelene neziguli ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okugxininiswa, okulingana nangempumelelo. NB: Kufuneka uzilolomh ukusebenza esikhundleni ngokwabiwo; kuquka isikhundla sobusuku, iintsuku zibe ngapantsulu kweekhaya.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse- General (GRADE1)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum, Plus 12% Rural Allowance. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional) and Housing Allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Seeking a Grade 1 Professional Nurse for Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, requiring registration with SANC as a General Nurse and Midwife.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 / Matric or Equivalent. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing Science. Diploma / Degree in Midwifery Nursing Science. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse and Midwife / Accoucher. Current SANC receipt for 2026. Grade 1: No Experience Required. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Demonstrate an understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Perform a clinical nursing practice in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by relevant health facility. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors, other clinicians including report writing when required. Work effectively, co-operatively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations.
jobs.duties: To execute duties and functions with proficiency within prescripts of applicable legislation. Provision of quality patient care in a cost-effective and efficient manner. Implementation of policies and procedures, clinical guidelines and protocols and all other legislative requirements for the nursing professions. To participate in implementation of Quality Improvement Programmes, Infection Prevention and Control and occupational health and safety. Uphold Batho Pele Principles and Patients’ Rights Charter. Provide a safe, therapeutic environment as laid down by the Nursing Act. Maintain accurate and complete patient records according to legal requirements. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relation issues. Manage and supervise effective utilization of all resources e.g. Human, financial, material etc. Assist in orientation, induction and mentoring of all nursing staff. Assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as a shift-leader on both day and night shifts when necessary.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. M.C Maqutu Tel No: (039) 688 6117
jobs.applications: Applications should be posted / hand delivered to: The Human Resource Manager, Port Shepstone Hospital, Private Bag X5706, Port Shepstone, 4240. NB: Applicants are encouraged to utilise Courier Services/ S’thesha Waya Waya or e-mail to PSRH.Recruitment@kznhealth.gov.za (Copies should be submitted by shortlisted candidates only) FOR ATTENTION : Mr. Z.M Zulu
jobs.notes: Detailed application for employment (Z83) and Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies – Must not be submitted when applying for employment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Due to financial constraints, S&T claims will not be paid to candidates who attended interviews. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks: security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige- Algemeen (VLAK1)
af.summary: Soek 'n Vlak 1 Professionele Verpleegkundige vir Port Shepstone Streeks Hospitaal, wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vroueverpleegkundige vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 / Matriek of Ekwivalent. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Diploma / Graad in Vroueverpleegkunde. Huidige registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige en Vroueverpleegkundige / Accoucher. Huidige SANC kwitansie vir 2026. Vlak 1: Geen Ervaring Vereis. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdhede Vereis: Toon begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers, ander klinici insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk effektief, saamwerkbaar en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdiensverskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon bekommernis vir pasiënte deur behoorlike behandeling en sorg te bevorder en te beywer insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om aan pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te voldoen.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer binne die voorskrifte van toepaslike wetgewing. Verskaffing van gehalte-pasiëntesorg op 'n koste-effektiewe en doeltreffende wyse. Implementering van beleide en prosedures, kliniese riglyne en protokolle en alle ander wetlike vereistes vir die verpleegprofessies. Om deel te neem aan die implementering van Gehalteverbeteringsprogramme, Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Handhaaf Batho Pele-beginsels en die Verklaring van Pasiënteregte. Verskaf 'n veilige, terapeutiese omgewing soos uiteengesit deur die Verpleegwet. Handhaaf akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords volgens wetlike vereistes. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en arbeidsverhoudingsake. Bestuur en hou toezig op doeltreffende benutting van alle hulpbronne bv. Menslike, finansiële, materiële ens. Bystand verleen by oriëntering, indoksing en mentorskap van alle verpleegpersoneel. Bystand verleen met tydelike pligte van die toesighouer en as skofleier optree op beide dag- en nagskofte wanneer nodig.

zu.title: Unulesi Weziqu - Jikelele (IZINGA 1)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Unulesi Wezinga 1 we-Port Shepstone Regional Hospital, okudingeka abhalise kwi-SANC njengonulesi jikelele kanye nombelethisi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 / I-Matric noma okulinganayo. I-Diploma / I-Degree ekuSayensi KokuNulela OkuJikelele. I-Diploma / I-Degree ekuSayensi KokuNulela OkuBelethayo. Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwi-SANC njengonulesi jikelele nombelethisi / umbelethisi. Iresidi yamanje ye-SANC ye-2026. Izinqa 1: Akukho mva oludingekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Aphelele Adingekayo: Bonisa ukuqonda komthetho wokunulela kanye nokusebenza ngokomthetho nangokomculo okuhlobene nokunulela. Yenza umsebenzi wokunulela ngokwezempilo ngokuvumelana nomkhawulo wokusebenza futhi ngokwezindinganiso zokunulela njengokuqumiwe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Bonisa ukuthumayela okuphumelelayo neziguli, abaphathi, abanye ochwepheshebezempilo okubandakanya ukubhala umbiko lapho kudingeka. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisene ngokuhle kwabantu abehlukene ngengqondo, ngenhlalo, ngebala noma ngenkolo. Yakha futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho nalawo abasizi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwabasizi okufanele. Khombisa ukukhathalela iziguli ngokuthuthukisa futhi ukukhuthaza ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okufanele okubandakanya ukuqonda futhi ukuzimisela ukuphendula izidingo, izifiso nokulindele kweziguli.
zu.duties: Ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokuphelele ngaphakathi kokushiwo komthetho osebenzayo. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwemigwqo okukhulu nendlela ezele ngokuhlehla futhi ekhiqizayo. Ukuqaliswa kwezinqubomgomo nezinqubo, izeluleki zezokwelapha namaphulothokholo kanye namanye omunye umthetho odingekayo emsebenzini wokunulela. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuqalisweni kwezinhlelo zokuThuthukisa Ikhwalithi, Ukuvinjelwa Kwentifo nokuLawula kanye nezempilo nokuphila kwabasebenzi. Gcina izimiso ze-Batho Pele noMthethosisekelo Wezamalungelo Amaguli. Nikeza isikhundla esivikelayo, esiphilisa njengokuqashiwe nguMthetho WokuNulela. Gcina ukubhalwa kweziguli okuyiqiniso futhi okuphelele ngokuvumelana nezidingo zomthetho. Lawula isifundo, izikhalazo kanye nezinkinga zohlelo lokusebenza. Lawula futhi qapha ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwawo wonke amatholwano isb. Abantu, ezezimali, izinto njll. Siza ekulekeleleni, ekungeniseni nasekulekeleleni bonke abasebenzi bokunulela. Siza ngemisebenzi yesikhundla sokubuyisela komphathi futhi usebenze njengengqalasizinda yesibopho ngosuku ngokupheleleyo ekuqhubeni ngokwemithetho edingekayo.

xh.title: Umongikazi weNgcali- Jikelele (Inqanaba1)
xh.summary: Kukho isithuba somongikazi weNgcali weNqanaba 1 kwiPort Shepstone Regional Hospital, kufuneka abhaliswe kwiSANC njengongikazi weJikelele nesibelekisi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo samabakala sagrade 12 / Isidanga seMatric okuNgathathwa njengokoKulinganayo. Isidiploma / Isidanga kwisiXhobo sikaGqithiso lokonga iNgesiNgcali eJikelele. Isidiploma / Isidanga kwisiXhobo sikaGqithiso lokonga ikuBeleka. UkuBhalisa kwiSANC okuQhubekayo njengoNgikazi weJikelele nesibelekisi / oMthatha abekezayo. Iresiti yeSANC yonyaka ka-2026. Inqanaba 1: Akukho mvaMaAhalo mfuno. ULwazi, amaQhinga, ukuQeqeswa namakhono aFunekayo: Bonisa ukuQonda ngemithethonqumamo yokonga kwaye nawo onke amanye eza mayelana nemithetho nomahlulelo okoWalo kweMisebenzi yokonga. Yenza imisebenzi yokonga emangesi ngokwemiGangatho yemisebenzi efanelekile nokuQatshelwa esiTyhini. Bonisa ukuNcumama okuSebenzayo nezigulana, oLawulo, oNyanga abanye, kuquka nokuBhala iingxelo xa kumiFuneko. Sebenza ngokuSebenzela ngokuchanekileyo, ukuBambisana ngomanyano ngokwexabiso ngokobuBom, iNkcubeko, isipi okuHamba nobuKholo. KuKwazi ukuCwangcisa iMisebenzi yakhe nokuYilwa kwabasekeli aBambelelayo qho nokuQinisekisa ukuNakekelwa. Bonisa ukuKhathaleka iNgcwecwe yezigulana, ukuKhuthaza nokuziMela ngokwemiSebenzi yokunakekelwa ngokuchanekileyo, kuquka ukuQonda nokulungiselela ukuPhendula iimFuneko, iimFuneko namathemba aseSigulaneni.
xh.duties: UkuZala imiSebenzi namaLungiselelo ngokuQqhayisa kwimiThethonqumamo neemFanelo ezifanelekileyo. UkuNika iNgcwecwe yoBomi iNgcwecwe yamaphupha okuBheja ngokweMali neSebenzela. UkuziMisa iimThetho neziNgqinisiso, iziNxulumaniso ezisengiNxwaledwini nokuQinisekisa imiThetho yokuYilela nakukho wonke emiNqamlezweni kumisebenzi yakuZingca ngokusebenza kwemiThetho yakuQinisekisa iNgcwecwe yoBomi iSikhululeko iGula. UkuthathaNxaxhele kokuZingca kwiNkqubo yokumila iGatya, iNkqubo yeNkqubo yeNkqubo iNqamlezwe yokuziVikela ngokulimala nokuQinisekiswa kwemisebenzi. Ukugcina iNkqubo ngokuSebenza ngokugqibeleleyo neSazela esiZizo. UkuQinisekisa iNgcwecwe yoQeqeswa ngokweSazela esiZizo ngokomsebenzi wemithetho. Ukulawula iNgcwecwe kwezindaba zokuGqibelela izindaba eziNgqamlezweni neziQinisekisa zonke iNkqubo. UkuLawula iMisebenzi neNkqubo yokwamkele aboBomi nokuZihambisa zonke iNkqubo ezisebenzayo. Ukubonelela ngeSikhululeko esisebenzayo kwabashana abashiyiweyo aBaSukanga ngokusebenza kwakhona kwiiNkcitha ezisebenzela iNtuthuko kubuLungisa ukuNgcwecwe iNgcalweyo ukuba baBambelele ngokusebenza kwabo bonke aboBomi nokuQeqesha abasebenzi bokonga. Ukubonelela ngeNkqubo yokusiVakalisa kwabuDengebasebenzi nokuQeqesha iiNqamlezwe zabashana bokonga bobo bonke oBomi bokonga nokuQinisekisa iNqanaba lokubakho iNtshukumo.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Assistant (POST Basic)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R275 340 – R310 422 per annum Grade 2: R318 666 – R337 083 per annum Grade 3: R343 761 – R390 396 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) position at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, involving dispensing medicines and controlling pharmaceutical stock under pharmacist supervision.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) or equivalent. Registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Current registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Experience Grade 1: None. Experience Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years' appropriate/recognisable experience as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) after registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Experience Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years' appropriate/recognisable experience as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) after registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Knowledge, Skills Training And Competencies Required: Knowledge of the Pharmacy Act and Good Pharmacy Practice. Knowledge of pharmaceutical legislation and policies. Understanding of medicine supply management. Knowledge of stock control systems. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy. Ability to work independently and under pressure. Planning and organisational skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Problem-solving and report-writing skills.
jobs.duties: Assist in the provision of an efficient pharmaceutical service under the supervision of a pharmacist. Dispense medicines according to approved Standard Operating Procedures and within the scope of practice of a Pharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Receive, store, issue and control pharmaceutical stock. Monitor stock levels and assist with stock ordering and stock rotation. Perform stock counts and assist with inventory management. Pack and distribute medicines to wards, clinics and departments. Maintain accurate pharmaceutical records and documentation. Ensure compliance with Good Pharmacy Practice and pharmaceutical legislation. Participate in quality improvement programmes and medicine management initiatives. Maintain cleanliness and organisation of the pharmacy and storage areas. Provide medicine information to healthcare professionals and patients within the scope of practice. Perform any other duties delegated by the Pharmacy Manager or supervising pharmacist.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Mhlongo Tel No: (031) 907 8169
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Apotekassistent (POST Basic)
af.summary: Apotekassistent (Post Basic)-pos by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat behels die uitreik van medisyne en die beheer van farmaseutiese voorraad onder toezig van 'n apteker.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) of ekwivalent. Registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic). Huidige registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Ervaring Graad 1: Geen. Ervaring Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring as 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic) na registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic). Ervaring Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring as 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic) na registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van die Pharmacy Act en Good Pharmacy Practice. Kennis van farmaseutiese wetgewing en beleide. Begrip van medisynevoorsieningsbestuur. Kennis van voorraadbeheerstelsels. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Probleemoplossing en verslagskryfvaardighede.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die lewer van 'n doeltreffende farmaseutiese diens onder die toezig van 'n apteker. Medisyne uitreik volgens goedgekeurde Standard Operating Procedures en binne die werksomvang van 'n Apotekassistent (Post Basic). Farmaseutiese voorraad ontvang, stoor, uitreik en beheer. Voorraadvlakke monitor en help met voorraadbestelling en voorraadrotasie. Voorraadtellings uitvoer en help met voorraadbestuur. Medisyne inpak en versprei na saale, klinieke en departemente. Akkurate farmaseutiese rekords en dokumentasie byhou. Verseker nakoming van Good Pharmacy Practice en farmaseutiese wetgewing. Deelneem aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme en medisynebestuursinisiatiewe. Skoonheid en organisasie van die apteek en stoorareas handhaaf. Medisyne-inligting verskaf aan gesondheidsorgprofessionele persone en pasiënte binne die werksomvang. Enige ander pligte uitvoer wat deur die apteekbestuurder of toezighoudende apteker gedelegeer word.

zu.title: Umncedisi wePhalmacist (POST Basic)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic) esibhedlela i-Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, okuhlanganisa ukuphepha imishanguzo nokulawula isitoko sezamakhemikhali ngaphansi kokuhlola komphathi wephalmasi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) noma okufanayo. Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic). Ukubhalisa kwamanje kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Isiphephelo se-Grade 1: Akukho. Isiphephelo se-Grade 2: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-5 yesiphephelo esifanele/esiyaziwayo njengomncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic) emva kokubhalisa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic). Isiphephelo se-Grade 3: Okungenani eminyaka eyi-13 yesiphephelo esifanele/esiyaziwayo njengomncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic) emva kokubhalisa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic). Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho Nemikhuba Edingekayo: Ulwazi nge-Pharmacy Act kanye ne-Good Pharmacy Practice. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi ezamakhemikhali. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kwenikezelo lemishanguzo. Ulwazi ngamasistimu wokulawula isitoko. Amakhono ohlakaniphi okukhuluma kahle nokuhambisana nabanye. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nangaphansi kwegcinzezi. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Ikhono lokugcina imfihlo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Nsiza ekunikezeni inkonzo yamakhemikhali ephumelelayo ngaphansi kokuhlola komphathi wephalmasi. Phetha imishanguzo ngokweziqondiso ezamukelekile ze-Standard Operating Procedures futhi ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza somncedisi wePhalmacist (Post Basic). Thola, gcina, nikeza ulwazi futhi ulawule isitoko sezamakhemikhali. Landa amazinga esitoko futhi usize ngoku-oda isitoko nokujikelezwa kwesitoko. Yenza ukubala kwesitoko futhi usize ngokulawulwa kokuqoqwa kwempahla. Hlanganisa futhi usabalisele imishanguzo kumawadi, amakliniki kanye namakomidi. Gcina imibiko yamakhemikhali enemibhalo eqinisekile. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-Good Pharmacy Practice kanye nemithetho yamakhemikhali. Thatha inxaxheba kwizinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga kanye nokuqala izinhlela zokulawula imishanguzo. Gcina ukuhlanzeka nokuhlelwa kwephalmasi kanye nezindawo zokugcina. Nikeza ulwazi ngemishanguzo ochukunyiswa abangamagunya ezempilo kanye neziguli ngaphakathi kwesibopho sokusebenza. Yenza nanoma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi onikezwe nguPhathi wokuqoqwa kwamakhemikhali noma umphathi wephalmasi ongumhloli.

xh.title: Umncedisi weThambo (POST Basic)
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi wethambo (Post Basic) kwisebe le Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, elicela nokuba selifake iimthambo kwaye lilawule isiko lemithambo ngaphantsi kolawulo lomthambo.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) okanye okulinganayo. Ukuqatshelwa ngokusemthethweni kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wethambo (Post Basic). Ukuqatshelwa kwangoku ngokusemthethweni kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC). Experience Grade 1: Akukho nanye. Experience Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo/awaqatshelwayo njengomncedisi wethambo (Post Basic) emva kokuqatshelwa kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wethambo (Post Basic). Experience Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-13 yamava afanelekileyo/awaqatshelwayo njengomncedisi wethambo (Post Basic) emva kokuqatshelwa kwiSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengomncedisi wethambo (Post Basic). Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi ngomthetho wePharmacy Act kwiNkonzo yeThambo eNzulu. Ulwazi ngomthetho namagunya elundlu ngemithambo. Ukuqonda ukulawula ukubonelelwa kwemithambo. Ulwazi ngamancedo okulawula iziko. Amakhono olwazimagama abalulekileyo nephakathi kwabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngodwa nangaphezulu komthwalo. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuqamba izinto. Ukuba nakho ukugcina imfihlelo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokubala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuboneleleni ngenkonzo yemithambo ngokusemthethweni ngaphantsi kolawulo lomthambo. Faka imithambo ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni yokusebenza esamkelekileyo nangaphakathi kwesithuba somncedisi wethambo (Post Basic). Yamkela, gcina, khupha ulawule isiko lemithambo. Qwalasela amanqanaba esiko uphedule nokuodisha isiko nokujikelezisa isiko. Yima iindlela ezili-10 ezisezantsi kakhulu zamava aqatshelwayo ekuqeqeshweni kolwazi lwakho olubalulekileyo lwekhompyutha. Gcina imithambo ngokuchanekileyo nemibhalo eqatshelwe ngokusemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo yeNkonzo yeThambo eNzulu nomthetho wepharmasi. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yophuculo lwekhwalithi nakwindalo yokulawula imithambo. Gcina ukococeka nokuhlelwa kwekhompyutha nendawo yokugcina imithambo. Nikezela ngolwazi ngemithambo kubasebenzi bezempilo nabaguliyo ngaphakathi kwesithuba somsebenzi. Yeyiphi na eminye imisebenzi enikelwe ngumlawuli wePharmacy okanye umthambo olawulayo.

jobs.title: Artisan Production: Plumber
jobs.salary_text: R253 341 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (optional), Homeowner Allowance (subject to meeting prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Plumber needed at ST Chads CHC in KwaZulu-Natal to handle installation, repairs and maintenance of plumbing systems, geysers and ablution facilities.
jobs.requirements: Standard 10/ Grade 12 certificate. Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in terms of section 13(9)(2)(h) of the Manpower Act of 1981 as amended. Valid Driver’s License. A minimum of 0-2 years’ experience as a Plumber in an appropriate field. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required. Knowledge of Occupational Health and Safety and safety standards. Knowledge of basic maintenance and repair of broken pipes. Knowledge of safety systems of work. Ability to work independently. Ability to work under pressure. Good communication skills (both verbal and written). Knowledge of Batho Pele principles.
jobs.duties: Installation, repairs and maintenance of high pressure and low-pressure geysers. Installation and repairs to toilets, urinals and other ablutions facilities such as shower and baths etc. installation and repairs to water and sewerage reticulation system. Clear blocked drains, gutters, down pipes, wastewater lines and branch lines. Take and record water supply readings daily. Maintenance on fire hose main supply, fire hose and fire hydrants. Daily reporting of faults, job progress and daily completion of job progress and daily completion of job card/ time sheets as per auditor’s instruction. Be prepared to visit primary health care clinics to perform maintenance duties when required. Installation of gutters and down pipes and galvanized pipes. Compile and submit reports, provide input on the compilation of technical reports. Deputize Artisan Foreman when required to do so. Form part of multi-disciplinary team doing rounds in the CHC and clinics and necessary steps to fix all identified shortfalls. Be prepared to work overtime and standby duties. To take necessary steps to fix all identified shortfalls. To take responsibility for in-house training and advancement of subordinates. To perform standby duties and after hours call outs. To supervise handyman and assist other tradesman aid when requested to do so by maintenance supervisor. Preference will be given to African Male
