af.title: Ambagsman Produksie: Loodgieter
af.summary: Loodgieter benodig by ST Chads CHC in KwaZulu-Natal om installasie, herstelwerk en onderhoud van loodgietersisteme, warmwatergeysers en sanitêre fasiliteite te behartig.
af.requirements: Standaard 10/ Graad 12-sertifikaat. Toepaslike AmbagsToetssertifikaat ingevolge artikel 13(9)(2)(h) van die Mannekragwet van 1981 soos gewysig. Geldige bestuurslisensie. 'n Minimum van 0-2 jaar se ervaring as 'n Loodgieter in 'n toepaslike veld. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis. Kennis van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid en veiligheidsstandaarde. Kennis van basiese onderhoud en herstel van gebreekte pype. Kennis van veiligheidsisteme van werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels.
af.duties: Installasie, herstelwerk en onderhoud van hoëdruk- en laedrukgeysers. Installasie en herstelwerk aan toilette, urinale en ander sanitêre fasiliteite soos stortbad en baddens ens. installasie en herstelwerk aan water- en rioolretikulasiesisteem. Maak verstopte dreine, dakghote, afvoerpype, afwaterlyne en sylyne skoon. Neem en registreer daagliks watertoevoerlesings. Onderhoud aan brand slang hoof toevoer, brandslange en brandkraane. Daaglikse verslagdoening van foute, werkvoortgang en daaglikse voltooiing van werkvoortgang en daaglikse voltooiing van werkkaart/ tydstrokke volgens ouditeur se instruksie. Wees bereid om primêre gesondheidsorgklinieke te besoek om onderhoudspligte te verrig wanneer vereis. Installasie van dakghote en afvoerpype en gegalvaniseerde pype. Stel verslae op en dien dit in, verskaf insette oor die opstel van tegniese verslae. Tree op as plaasvervanger vir Ambagsman Voorman wanneer vereis. Maak deel uit van 'n multidissiplinêre span wat rondtes doen in die CHC en klinieke en neem nodige stappe om alle geïdentifiseerde tekortkominge reg te stel. Wees bereid om oortyd en wagdienspligte te werk. Om nodige stappe te neem om alle geïdentifiseerde tekortkominge reg te stel. Om verantwoordelikheid te neem vir interne opleiding en bevordering van ondergeskiktes. Om wagdienspligte en oproepe buite werksure te verrig. Om toesig te hou oor handwerksman en ander ambagsmanne by te staan wanneer versoek deur die onderhoudstoesiener. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan Afrika Manlik

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wokukhiqiza Ogwini: UNumbe
zu.summary: Kudingeka unumbe e-ST Chads CHC e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuphatha ukufakwa, ukulungiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwemiyalelo yonumbe, amageyisa nezikhungo zokuhlambela.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Standard 10/ Grade 12. Isitifikedi esifanele sokuhlola ubuchwepheshe ngokusho kwesigaba 13(9)(2)(h) seManpower Act of 1981 njengoba silungisiwe. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Uhlangothi olungaphansi kweminyaka engu-0-2 yamava njengoNumbe enkundleni efanele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye Nezindlela eziyisidingo. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety namazinga okuphepha. Ulwazi ngokugcinwa okuyisisekelo nokulungiswa kwamaphayipi aphukile. Ulwazi ngezinhlela zokuphepha ezinkundleni zokusebenza. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimela. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana ( kokuhamba nemibhalo). Ulwazi ngemigomo ye-Batho Pele.
zu.duties: Ukufaka, ukulungisa kanye nokugcina amageyisa aphezulu naphansi koxinzelelo. Ukufakwa nokulungiswa kwezindlu zangasese, amayunithi nezinye izikhungo zokuhlambela njengeshawa namabhedi njll. ukufakwa nokulungiswa kwemiyalelo yokusabalalisa amanzi kanye namadluliselo okungcolile. Ukusula amaphayipi a-valiwe, izingcozhi, amaphayipi ehla, imigqa yamanzi ashukile kanye namaphayipi ehlethu. Ukuthatha kanye nokurekhoda izifundo zokunikezwa kwamanzi nsuku zonke. Ukugcinwa kwenhlanganisela yokunikezwa kwe-hose yomlilo, i-hose yomlilo namahayidhrenthi. Ukubika nsuku zonke ngemikhondo engavikelekile, inqubo yomsebenzi kanye nokugcwaliswa nsuku zonke kwesikhathi somsebenzi njengoba kuyiswe ngumlandisi. Ukube ukulungele ukuvakashela amakliniki okunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo ukuze wenze imisebenzi yokugcina lapho kudingeka. Ukufakwa kwezingcozhi namaphayipi ehla namaphayipi abethwe ngegolovu. Ukuqamba kanye nokuhumusha imibiko, nokunikeza iminikelo ekwakheni imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukumela i-Artisan Foreman lapho kudingeka. Ukuba ingxenye yeqembu elihlukene emisebenzi lapho kuhamba e-CHC nakumakliniki kanye nokuqatha izinyathelo zokulungisa yonke imikhondo ebonakele. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi kanye nemisebenzi yokulindile. Ukuthatha izinyathelo ezingezile ukulungisa yonke imikhondo ebonakele. Ukuthatha icala lokulungiselela ukuqeqeshe endlini nokuqhubela phambili abangaphansi. Ukwenz imisebenzi yokulindile kanye nemibiko yemisebenzi ngemuva kwezikhathi. Ukugada isandla somsebenzi kanye nosenza kwezinye izandla zezobuchwepheshe lapho kucelwa ukuba wenze kanjalo ngomphathi wokugcina. Izintandokazi zizonikezwa osweni besilisa from African Male

xh.title: Umsebenzi wobugcisa bokwenziwa: Umboli wezitya
xh.summary: Kufuneka umboli wezitya kwi-ST Chads CHC eKwaZulu-Natal ukuba alothe ukufakela, ukulungisa nokugcina iindlela ezisetyenziswa kumboli wezitya, amageyiza neendawo zokuqhubeka.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Standard 10/ Grade 12. Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo sovavanyo lobugcisa ngokwecandelo 13(9)(2)(h) loMthetho weManpower ka-1981 njengoko lugqityiwe. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Eminyaka yamava angu-0-2 njengomboli wezitya kwilizu elifanelekileyo. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo. Ulwazi nge-Occupational Health and Safety nemigaqo yokhuseleko. Ulwazi ngokugcina ngokuyisekelo nokulungisa izitya ezephukileyo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokhuseleko ezisebenzayo. Amandla okusebenza ngodwa. Amandla okusebenza ngexesha lokuxinzelela. Amakhono amabalulwazi (omlomo nolubhaliweyo). Ulwazi ngeemigaqo iBatho Pele.
xh.duties: Ukufakela, ukulungisa nokugcina amageyiza aphezulu namanqanaba asezantsi. Ukufakela nokulungisa iindawo zokuhamba, amaxa kunye nezinye iindawo zokuqhubeka ezinjengokugeziswa nokuhlambwa njl. Ukufakela nokulungisa iindlela zokusasaza amanzi namayime ezinkcqawa. Ukupehla iindawo ezivaliweyo, iintsiba ezisendlini, iindweba eziyela phantsi, iindweba zamanzi ashukumayo namashumi. Ukuqamba kwaye urekhode izifundo zamani njemihla ngemihla. Ukugcina isixhobo sokuzisa amanzi esitya somlilo, isitya somlilo namanzi okuzima umlilo. Ukubika ngemiba, intshukubabo yomsebenzi nokuqwalasela njemihla ngemihla ipepa lomsebenzi/ amaphepha exesha ngokwesiluleko somqangi. Kubekhona ukuhlola iikliniki zempilo yoyilo aze azenze imisebenzi yokugcina xa kufuneka. Ukufakela iintsiba ezisendlini, iindweba eziyela phantsi kwaye alungise iintsiba eziganiswe. Ukuqamba kwaye athumela iinkcukacha, anike ingxelo ekwenziweni kweekhadi lezobugcisa. Ukuba ngumphathi weArtisan Foreman xa kufunwa. Ukuba ngumnye wethim elingenamagatya elenza amajingi kwi-CHC nakwiikliniki aze athathe iinyathelo zokulungisa zonke iingenelo ezifunyenweyo. Ukuba ulungele ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha nakuwo wonke umsebenzi wokulinda. Ukuthatha iinyathelo ezifunekayo ukulungisa zonke iingenelo ezifunyenweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqeqesho lwangaphakathi nokuqhubela phambili abaphansi bakho. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokulinda kwaye ubizeke emva kweeyure zomsebenzi. Ukusebenzisa abathengisi kwaye ancede nabanye abalungi xa kucelwa ngumlawuli wokugcina. Nqayaniselo kuya kunikwa kumntu omtsha wesilumkini

jobs.title: Staff Nurse
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 – R256 671.per annum Grade 2: R272 778 – R306 294.per annum Grade 3: R319 071 – R391 515 per annum Other Benefits: Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply), 13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional)
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse position at Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, providing basic nursing care to patients with salaries ranging across three grade levels.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Certificate. Enrolled Nurse Certificate. Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 as a Staff Nurse. Experience Grade 1: None. Experience Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Staff Nurse. Experience Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Staff Nurse. Knowledge, Skills Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of Public Service policies, Acts, Regulations, Code of Conduct, Labour Relations Act, Batho Pele principles and Patients' Rights Charter. Knowledge of SANC rules and regulations. Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures. Good communication, writing and interpersonal skills. Ability to function effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Basic computer literacy. Ability to provide basic nursing care within the scope of practice. Ability to observe, identify and report changes in patients' conditions. Ability to maintain accurate nursing records and reports.
jobs.duties: Provide basic nursing care to patients in accordance with the scope of practice. Assist Professional Nurses with patient care and nursing procedures. Maintain patient hygiene, comfort, dignity and safety. Observe and report changes in patients' conditions to the Professional Nurse. Assist with admission, transfer and discharge of patients. Maintain accurate patient records and reports. Ensure compliance with Infection Prevention and Control and Occupational Health and Safety practices. Assist with the effective utilisation resources. Participate in patient and staff education as directed. Work as part of a multidisciplinary team to ensure quality patient care. Maintain professional growth and comply with ethical standards and the relevant Code of Conduct. NB: Must be prepared to work shifts as per allocation; this includes night shift, weekends and Public Holidays. The successful candidate may be required to rotate to or be deployed to other nursing components within the institution as and when operationally required.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs R.M Abboo Tel No: (031) 907 8518
jobs.applications: Applications to be forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager OR Hand deliver to A-Block 1st Floor white applications box. Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital Private Bag X07, Mobeni, 4060. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to: Mxolisi.Mlambo@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line. Emailed applications should please be sent as one attachment. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M.F Mlambo
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: Applicants must submit a fully completed, initialled and signed Z83 form and a detailed CV only. All fields of Sections A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Due to the limited space on the Z83, applicants may indicate “refer to CV” or “see attached” in Sections E, F and G. However, the question relating to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part F must be answered, and the declaration must be completed and signed. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified supporting documents and a Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources. Only the new Z83 Application for Employment form, effective from 01 January 2021, will be accepted. The form is available from any Government Department or from the KZN Department of Health or DPSA websites. The reference number and position applied for must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Due to the anticipated high number of applications, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates. If you are not contacted within two months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. African males and persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply. No subsistence and travel (S&T) payments will be made to candidates attending interviews. Applicants with foreign qualifications must have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and provide proof of the evaluation where required. Failure to comply may result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post(s). Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in disqualification. (This Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to promoting representivity at all levels and across all occupational categories.)

af.title: Verpleegster
af.summary: Verpleegsterpos by Prince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal wat basiese verpleegsorg aan pasiënte verskaf met salarisse wat oor drie graadvlakke strek.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifikaat. Ingeskrewe verpleegstersertifikaat. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 as 'n Verpleegster. Ervaring Graad 1: Geen. Ervaring Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegster. Ervaring Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by die SANC as Verpleegster. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van Openbare Diensbeleide, Wette, Regulasies, Gedragskode, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Batho Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasiënteregte. Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures. Goeie kommunikasie-, skryf- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om basiese verpleegsorg binne die omvang van praktyk te verskaf. Vermoë om veranderinge in pasiënte se toestand waar te neem, te identifiseer en te rapporteer. Vermoë om akkurate verpleegrekords en verslae te hou.
af.duties: Verskaf basiese verpleegsorg aan pasiënte in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk. Bied professionele verpleegsters bystand met pasiëntversorging en verpleegprosedures. Handhaaf pasiënthigiëne, gemak, waardigheid en veiligheid. Neem veranderinge in pasiënte se toestand waar en rapporteer dit aan die professionele verpleegster. Bied bystand met toelating, oorplasing en ontslag van pasiënte. Hou akkurate pasiëntrekords en verslae. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer en Beroepsgezondheid- en Veiligheidspraktyke. Bied bystand met die doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne. Neem deel aan pasiënt- en personeelsopleiding soos aangewys. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om gehalte-pasiëntsorg te verseker. Handhaaf professionele groei en voldoen aan etiese standaarde en die toepaslike Gedragskode. NB: Moet bereid wees om skofte soos toegeken te werk; dit sluit nagskof, naweke en Openbare Vakansiedae in. Die suksesvolle kandidaat kan vereis word om na ander verpleegkomponente binne die instansie te roteer of ontplooi te word soos when operasioneel vereis.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi oBhalisiwe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somhlengikazi oBhalisiwe ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, okunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesisekelo kwabagulabo ngeholo elihamba kalula kuzikhathi ezintathu zezigaba.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 12. Isitifikedi somhlengikazi oBhalisiwe. Ubhalo lwamanje neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 njengomhlengikazi oBhalisiwe. Isipiliyoni seGrade 1: Akukho. Isipiliyoni seGrade 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yisipiliyoni esifanelekile/esibonakalayo ekunakekelweni kwabagulabo ngemva kokuqeqeshwa neSANC njengomhlengikazi oBhalisiwe. Isipiliyoni seGrade 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yisipiliyoni esifanelekile/esibonakalayo ekunakekelweni kwabagulabo ngemva kokuqeqeshwa neSANC njengomhlengikazi oBhalisiwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngemigango yomphakathi, Ama-Act, Izimiso, Ikhodi Yokuziphatha, iLabour Relations Act, izimiso zikaBatho Pele nesitifikedi samalungelo abagulayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezimiso zeSANC. Ulwazi ngenqubo nezinyathelo zokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Amakhono okuxhumana, okubhala nokuhlobana nabantu kahle. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene. Ulwazi olusisekelo lwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesisekelo kwabagulabo ngaphakathi kwesibalo sokusebenza. Ikhono lokubuka, ukuqaphela nokubika izinguquko ezimeni zabagulayo. Ikhono lokugcina ukuphela okufanelekile kobuhlengi namabhiko. Ulwazi olusisekelo lwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesisekelo kwabagulabo ngaphakathi kwesibalo sokusebenza. Ikhono lokubuka, ukuqaphela nokubika izinguquko ezimeni zabagulayo. Ikhono lokugcina ukuphela okufanelekile kobuhlengi namabhiko.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa kwesisekelo kwabagulabo ngokwelana nesibalo sokusebenza. Siza oMhlengikazi oQeqeshiwe ngokunakekelwa kwabagulabo nzenqubo zokunakekelwa. Gcina ukuhlanzeka, ukuzola, isithunzi nokuphepha kwabagulayo. Buka futhi ubike izinguquko ezimeni zabagulayo kuMhlengikazi oQeqeshiwe. Siza ngokungenisa, ukudlulisela nokukhipha abagulayo. Gcina ukuphela okufanelekile kobuhlengi namabhiko. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izinto ezivikela ukuthelelelana, ukuLawula kanye namaziko okuLawula Ukuphepha komsebenzi. Siza ekusebenziseni izibalo ngokusebenza kahle. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abagulayo nabasebenzi njengakuqondisiwe. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangene ukuze uqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo okuhle. Gcina ukukhula komsebenzi futhi uthobele amazinga okuziphatha nesiko Yokuziphatha ehlobene. NB: Kufanele ulungele ukusebenza amashifthi njengoba kunikeziwe; lokhu kuhlanganisa amashifthi ebusuku, amasonto nezinsuku Zomphakathi Ezingevanga Ukuze. Umphakathi ophumelelayo kungadingeka ashintshele noma axoshwe kwezinye izigaba zokuhlenga phakathi kwesikhungo ngesikhathi nangokwesidingo sokusebenza. The successful candidate may be required to rotate to or be deployed to other nursing components within the institution as and when operationally required.

xh.title: uNesi oZinikeleyo
xh.summary: Isithuba sabaNesi kwiPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sinika abagulawo ukunakekelwa okusesiqukwenga ngemivuzo egqithiswayo kumaqanaba amathathu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seKhosi le-12. Isatifikethi soNesi wobhaliswe kwiNdlu yoBunasi yaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) ka-2026 njengoNesi osebenzayo. Isipilinge seeNqanaba 1: Akukho. Isipilinge seeNqanaba 2: I-10 iminyaka ngentlandlolo yemisebenzi egqithisweyo/uqaphelo oluchongiweyo kwinkonzo yokunakekela abagulawo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoNesi osebenzayo. Isipilinge seeNqanaba 3: I-20 iminyaka ngentlandlolo yemisebenzi egqithisweyo/uqaphelo oluchongiweyo kwinkonzo yokunakekela abagulawo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoNesi osebenzayo. Ulwazi, amakhono ukuqeqeshwa namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi malunga namagqabantshintshi, iMithetho, iMgqabunye, iKhodi yaBhalo, uMthetho waBakhe abasebenza, iintsingiselo zeBatho Pele, noMgaqo-siseko weNkululeko yabaGulawo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemithetho ye-SANC. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi nemigaqo yokunakekela abagulawo. Amakhono obuqhagamshelwano, abhaliweyo nabantu. Isakhono sokuze sisebenze kakuhle njengesiqukwenga seqela elinabasebenzi abaninzi. Ulwazi lokuqeqesha elisezantsi ngesikompyutha. Isakhono sokuze sinike ukunakekelwa kwesiNgesi ngommandu wakho wokuzilolonga. Isakhono sokuqaphela, ukuze ukhuphe iintshaba kwaye uxelo ngokuguquka kwesimo somzimba kabagulawo. Isakhono sokuze sigcine umbhalo ongachazwanga wemisebenzi yonakekelo lwezazimali abanayo.
xh.duties: Nika abagulawo ukunakekelwa okusesiqukwenga ngokwahlulelana nommandu wokusebenza. Yanceda oNesi abaziwayo ekunakekelweni kwabagulawo nakumisebenzi ehlobene nokunakeka abagulawo. Phatha ukuhlanzeka, inkonzo, isithundithunzi nokuze kubakho ukhuseleko komgulayo. Qaphela wayeze uxelele uNesi oziwayo ngapandle nasemigqabunyeni kubeko kwesimo sabagulawo. Yanceda ekungeniseni, ekudlulisweni nasekuphumiseni abagulawo. Phatha umbhalo ongachazwanga wabagulawo nemiqulu esemthethweni. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana nemithetho yokuthintela ukungcola nokuyilawula, kunye namashebe-jikelelo woMsebenzi wokuQinisekisa ukuHleleka namashebe-jikelelo. Yanceda ekusebenziseni amandla emisebenzi ngokufanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abagulawo nabasebenzi njengoko kumiselwe. Sebenza njengomnye wabasebenzi abavela kumacandla amaninzi ukuze uzele isincedo esinemveliso. Phatha ukukhula ngobugcisa bobunasi uze uhambelane nemilinganiselo yamagama amaninzi naye wonke umthetho woBuzisa. Isalathiso: Kufuneka ulungele ukuhlala usenza imisebenzi yesikhephu njengoko omtshato noko amandla kakhulu; apha kubandwa ukwenza imisebenzi yasesikhephini, iintsuku zeveki nangozi zabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ovunywe kule ndawo anokudluliselwa kwenye indawo onakwa nayo ngokomsebenzi wakho nangemini xa kubakho isidingo ngokusebenza.

af.title: Dienste-kantoorbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur 'n maatskaplike dienste-kantoor wat welsyns- en gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdienste lewer, wat 'n graad in Maatskaplike Werk, SACSSP-registrasie, 'n bestuurderslisensie en drie jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Maatskaplike Werk. Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. Slegs gekortlysde kandidate sal bewys van huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Profession as 'n Maatskaplike Werker voorlê. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF Vlak 7) in Maatskaplike Werk. Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Kennis: Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Navorsingsmetodologie, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Werknemersprestasiebestuurs- en -ontwikkelingstelsel, Kundige vaardighede om strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit te daag, Kundige kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewing interaksie het ten einde sosiale welsyn te bevorder, Die begrip en vermoë om komplekse maatskaplikewerkdienste te verskaf ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar is en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie, Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe te assisteer en te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter, nood te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik in gevalle waar kundige kennis vereis word. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie, Taal, Interpersoonlike verhoudinge, Rekenvaardigheid, Navorsing, Probleemoplossing, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Konflikbestuur, Tydbestuur, Gevorderde welsynsberading, Analitiese denke, Voorlegging, Finansiële bestuur, Syfervaardigheid, Bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens van die hoogste, mees gevorderde en gespesialiseerde aard binne (a) gedefinieerde gebied(e) van spesialisering rakende die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur die relevante programme in vennootskap met belanghebbendes. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme en ingrypings om 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens te lewer deur die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe benutting van finansiële hulpbronne. Bestuur 'n maatskaplikewerkseenheid om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe maatskaplikewerkdiens gelewer word deur die doeltreffende en effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne; Hou tredy met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die maatskaplikewerkveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat maatskaplikewerknavorsing en -ontwikkeling onderneem word. Voer en/of verseker dat al die administratiewe funksies wat in die eenheid vereis word, uitgevoer word

af.summary: Maatskaplikewerkbestuurder-pos in KwaZulu-Natal wat toesig hou oor gespesialiseerde sosiale welsynsdienste vir kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe, wat 'n graad en 10 jaar se ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: Kwalifikasies: Baccalaureusgraad (NQF-vlak 7) in Maatskaplike Werk. Registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Professions as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. Slegs gekose kandidate sal bewys van huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Services Profession as 'n Maatskaplike Werker voorlê. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se ondervinding in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as 'n Maatskaplike Werker by SACSSP. Kennis: Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Navorsingsmetodologie, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Employee Performance Management and Development System, Kundige vaardighede om strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting te bevraagteken, Kundige kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewing skakel om sosiale welstand te bevorder, Die begrip en vermoë om komplekse maatskaplikewerkdienste te verskaf ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie, Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan en te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en hul probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter, nood en lyding te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne effektief te gebruik in gevalle waarkundige kennis vereis word. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie, Taal, Interpersoonlike verhoudings, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Navorsing, Probleemoplossing, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Konflikbestuur, Tydbestuur, Gevorderde welsynsberading, Analitiese denke, Voorlegging, Finansiële bestuur, Syfervaardigheid, Bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens van die hoogste, mees gevorderde en gespesialiseerde aard binne 'n gedefinieerde area(s) van spesialisering ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike programme in vennootskap met belanghebbendes. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling en beplanning van programme en intervensies om 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens te lewer deur middel van die doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe benutting van finansiële hulpbronne. Bestuur 'n maatskaplikewerkeenheid om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe maatskaplikewerkdiens gelewer word deur middel van die doeltreffende en effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplikewerkveld om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat maatskaplikewerknavorsing en -ontwikkeling onderneem word. Voer en/of verseker dat al die administratiewe funksies wat in die eenheid vereis word, uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Abaphathi BezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi: Iminyuzo Yomphakathi Yezinsizakalo Eziyingqayizivele
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMphathi WezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi KwaZulu-Natal, okubheke iminyuzo yezinsizakalo eziyingqayizivele zabantu nabomphakathi abasengozini, esidinga iziqu neminyuzu yeminyaka yeyikhono eli-10.
zu.requirements: Iziqu: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (NQF Level 7) kwi-Social Work. Ukuqoshwa ku-South African Council for Social Services Professions njengo-Social Worker. Abantu abangabhaliswe kuphela ohlwini abazohwethekela iziqiniseko zokuqoshwa kwamanje ku-South African Council for Social Services Profession njengo-Social Worker. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Okungenani iminyaka eyikhathi yeminyuzu eyi-10 kwi-Social Work emva kokuqoshwa njengo-Social Worker ku-SACSSP. Ulwazi: I-Constitution yase-Republic of South Africa, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Research Methodology, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations, i-Employee Performance Management and Development System, iziqhobo esiyingqayizivele zokuphikisana nemithombo eyinhloko yokuswela, ukungalingani, ukucindezelwa, ukubandlulula nokukhethekisa, ulwazi esiyingqayizivele nokukuqonda ukuziphatha kwezinja kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi, nokuqeqesheka ukungenelela kumaphuzu lapho abantu bahlangana khona nemvelo yabo ukuze kukhuliswe impilo entle yomphakathi, ukuqonda nengakwazi ukunikeza iminyuzo yomphakathi eyinkimbinkimbi yezinsizakalo eziya ekuvikeleni abantu abasengozini, abasengcupheni futhi abangeke bakwazi ukuqwayisa. Ikhono namandla okusiza futhi sikhulise abantu, izindlu, amaqembu, izinhlangano namaphakathi ukuphucisa ukusebenza kwabo komphakathi namandla abo okuxazulula izinkinga, bavimbe baphulule nobuhlungu futhi basebenzise izinsiza ngempumelelo ezimeni lapho kudingeka khona ulwazi esiyingqayizivele. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana, Ulimi, Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ocwaningo, Ukuxazulula Izinkinga, Ukuloba izibiko esiyingqayizivele, Ukuphatha izinkinga, Ukuphatha isikhathi, Uweluleko esiyingqayizivele, Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, Okwethulo, Ukuphatha izimali, Ukubala, Ukushayela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenzinsizakalo yomphakathi yesimo esiyingqayizivele, esiphezulu kakhulu futhi esiyingqayizivele ngaphakathi kwendawo ethize yeminyuzo ngokuphathelene nokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa abantu, amaqembu, izindlu namaphakathi abasengozini ngezinhlelo ezihlukene zibandakanye abantu. Qedelela ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlelwa kwezinhlelo nezindlela zokunikeza iminyuzo yomphakathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zezimali ngokusebenza kalula, ngokugcina imali futhi ngempumelelo. Phatha iqembu lomsebenzi wabaphathi bokuze iminyuzo yomphakathi inikezwe ngenxa yokusetshenziswa okulula, ngempumelelo kwemithombo yabantu. Gcina ulwazi lwamanzi ngotshintsho olusha kule minyuzo ukuze kube khona impumelelo ekunikeleni ngezinsizakalo. Hlela futhi qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa kwenzeke. Zenze noma qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yabaphathi emnyango iyenziwe.

xh.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wothuto Lwabantu: Iinkonzo Zolonwabo Lweentsapho
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguMphathi Womsebenzi Wothuto Lwabantu KwaZulu-Natal ngokuqonda iinkonzo ezibhekisa kwindo ethile zolonwabo lweentsapho kubantu nabaphila ngaphantsi kweenkxalabo namaphakathi, kufuneka ube nelayisensi kunye neminyaka eli-10 yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zolwazi: I-Degree ye-Bachelor (NQF Level 7) kumsebenzi wothuto lwabantu. Ukuqatyelwa kwi-South African Council for Social Services Professions njengomsebenzi wothuto lwabantu. Kuphela abagqatswa abakhethiweyo baya kuthumela ubungqina bokuba bakhona kuqatyiwe njeng ngokwedolo kwi-SACSSP. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava kumsebenzi wothuto lwabantu emva kokuqatyelwa njengomsebenzi wothuto lwabantu kwi-SACSSP. Ulwazi: Urhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika, umthetho wontengiso wosa lawulo, iimfuno zomthetho wosa lawulo, iMithetho yamagunya antengiso, indlela yophando, umthetho wolawulo wemali kaRhulumente, iMithetho yamagunya eqhelisayo kolawulo lweqhalo, indlela ekulawulwa ngayo inkqubo yokuhola nokugqgisa abasebenzi, amandla okuphazamisa imiba ezisuka kwingingqi, engaqhelekanga, kwaye nangesiqendu, ukungathandabuzi nokungabi naso isazima, ulwazi olunamandla nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu nendlela abasebenza ngayo ekuhlangenwe naso kwindalo, kwaye ukwazi ukusekela eendaweni abantu abaqhathanwa khona nobume babo ukuze kube kukhuseleko kwabantu, ulwazi lokuba nakho nokusekela imisebenzi yothuto ekwiingxaki enkulu ngokukhusela abantu abasemngciphekweni, kwaye abangenako ukuqeqeshwa kwakho, namandla okusekela nokunika amandla abantu, iintsapho, amaqela, oorhulumente namaphakathi ukwazi ukusebenza kakuhle, nokwazi ukusombulula iingxaki, noku thintela nokuphelisa iingozi, nokusebenzisa imithetho yokulawula ngokufanelekileyo kuyo nayiphi na imeko ekfuneka kukhona ulwazi oluphakamileyo ngayo. Amandla okusebenza: Unxibelelwano, Ulwimi, Unxibelelwano nabantu, Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamatyala, Uphononongo, Ukuqhuba iingxaki, Ukwabhala iingxelo eziphakamileyo, Ukulawula iingxabano, Ukusebenzisa ixesha ngokwemigaqo, ukweluleka iintsapho ezingenamntla, Ukucinga ngokuchanekileyo, iNkcazelo, ukulawula imali, ukubala, ukuqhuba.
xh.duties: Yonike iinkonzo zomsebenzi wothuto lwabantu ezisezizingeni eliphezulu, elithuthuzelayo nelichanekileyo kummandla ochaziweyo kwimisebenzi yokhathalo, ixhaso, ukhuselo nophuhliso koluntu olusemngciphekweni, namaqela, iintsapho namaphakathi ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo ngokuthengiselana nabanini nzala. Phuhlisa ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi nemisebenzi yothuto ngokusebenzisa imali ngokukhawuleza, ngokugcina imali nangokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yothuto ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinkonzo zothuto zihamba ngokukhawuleza nangokuchanekileyo ngokusebenzisa abantu abangagcina futhi bahlale bezama. Hlala ufuna ulwazi olutsha kumsebenzi wothuto ukuze ulusebenzise ekuphuculeni iinkonzo. Cwangcisa ngokweenkqubo ezingenamntla wazi ukuba kuphando lokuba kwenziwe imisebenzi yothuto. Yenza okanye uqiniseke ukuba imisebenzi yophatho efuneka kule nkqubo yenziwe ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Auxiliary Services
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Auxiliary Services in KwaZulu-Natal. Manage records, information management, facilities, logistics and digital transformation at Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Qualifications: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Public Management, Public Administration, Business / Operations Management, Facilities Management and Logistics Management. A minimum of 3 years' experience at junior management level managing multiple operational support functions including auxiliary services, facilities/operations, logistics, fleet and transport, records and information, public-sector administration and/or government operational support services. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge: Public Sector Governance and Financial Management (the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, POPIA, PAIA, Occupational Health and Safety Act, government policies, budgeting and expenditure management), Records and Information Management (National Records Services & Achieves Act, Electronic records management, Information governance and compliance, Digital transformation practices, record security, Fleet, Facilities and rental management (fleet/transport, office / rental, cleaning and hygiene, telecommunications, and support services), Contract, Risk and Service Provider management, Operational performance and business improvement., Document Management, Employee Performance Management and Development System. Skills: Strategic and operations management, Financial, contract and risk management, Analytical, problem solving and performance management, Leadership, communication and stakeholder management, Digital, change and service delivery management, Computer literacy and Project management.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of records and information management services; Develop and implement records and information Classification System in line with the Provisions of National Records Services & Archives Act; Implement systematic disposal programme for Departmental records; Manage digital transformation in records and information management; Manage the provision of the office and auxiliary services; Manage the provision of fleet management; Develop policies and strategies aimed at improving service delivery; Manage Resources of the Sub- Directorate.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Hulpdienste

'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op juniorbestuursvlak vir die bestuur van veelvuldige operasionele ondersteuningsfunksies, insluitend hulpdienste, fasiliteite/bedrywe, logistiek, vloot en vervoer, rekords en inligting, openbare-sektoradministrasie en/of regeringsbedryfsondersteuningsdienste. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van rekord- en inligtingsbestuursdienste; Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n rekord- en inligtingsklassifikasiestelsel in ooreenstemming met die bepalings van die National Records Services & Archives Act; Implementeer 'n stelselmatige beskikkingsprogram vir departementale rekords; Bestuur digitale transformasie in rekord- en inligtingsbestuur; Bestuur die verskaffing van kantoor- en hulpdienste; Bestuur die verskaffing van vlootbestuur; Ontwikkel beleide en strategieë wat gemik is op die verbetering van dienslewering; Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Subdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umqondisi Ohle wayo: Izinsizakusebenza Ezesekelayo
zu.summary: Umqondisi Ohle wayo: Izinsizakusebenza Ezesekelayo e KwaZulu-Natal. Phatha amarekhodi, abalokudweba ulwazi, izinsiza, amalogistics kanye nokushintsha kwe-digital ehhovisi eliyinhloko.

Idrayiva elifanele. Ulwazi: Ukuphathwa kolawulo kanye nezimali kuhlangothi lomphakathi (i-Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, POPIA, PAIA, Occupational Health and Safety Act, izinqubomgomo zohulumeni, ukubhajetha kanye nokuphatha ukuchithwa kwemali), Ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi nolwazi (National Records Services & Achieves Act, ukuphathwa kwamarekhodi e-elekthronikhi, ukuhlonza ukuphathwa kolwazi kanye nokuhambelana nomthetho, izindlela zoshintsho lwedijithali, ukuvikeleka kwamarekhodi, Fleet, Facilities and rental management (ama-fleet/ukuthutha, ihhovisi / ukurenta, ukuhlanzwa kokuzeke, namathilakazi, nokusekelwa kwemisebenzi), Ukuphathwa kwe-contract, ubungozi kanye nabahlinzeki bezinsiza, ukusebenza kahle kwezokusebenza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi., Ukuphathwa kwamadokhumenti, Employee Performance Management and Development System. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kohlangothi oluhlelekile kanye nezokusebenza, ezimali, kwe-contract kanye nokuphathwa kwebungozi, okuhlukaniswa, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza, obuholo, ukuxhumana kanye nokuphatha abahlanganyeli, okwedijithali, ukushintsha kanye nokuphathwa kohlinzeko lolwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuphatha amaphrojekhi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuhlinzekwa kwamarekhodi kanye nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yolwazi; Lungiselela futhi usebenzise Isistimu Yokuhlukanisa Amarekhodi Nolwazi ngokuhambelana nezinhlinzeko ze-National Records Services & Archives Act; Sebenzisa uhlelo lokuqothula ngokuhlelekile amarekhodi omnyango; Phatha ukushintshwa kwedijithali ekuphathweni kwamarekhodi nolwazi; Phatha ukuhlinzekwa kwehhovisi nezinsizakusebenza ezesekelayo; Phatha ukuhlinzekwa kokuphathwa kwa-fleet; Hlela izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela ezihlose ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka; Phatha izinsiza zesigaba esingaphansi kuka-directorate.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Iinkonzo Zesondlo

Ilayisensi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. xh.duties: Phatha ukunikela iinkonzo zolawulo lwamarekhodi nolwazi; Pumba kwaye usebenzise iNkqubo yoqoqosho-mali kwamarekhodi nolwazi ngokwemigaqo yeNkonzo yeRekhodi eZizwe & uMthetho we-Archives; Sebenzisa inkqubo yokuuphunga amarekhodi esebe ngokwendlela echongiweyo; Phatha uguqulo olwdijithali kwikxaso yamarekhodi nolwazi; Phatha ukunikela iinkonzo kuhofisi eNkulu kwaye zenze iinkonzo zesondlo; Phatha ukunikela inkonzo yolawulo lweefleet; Pumba iinkqubo negama lisetrategiya ukuze kuphuculwe iinkonzo ezikawonke-wonke; Lawula amacebo oMmandla weSub- Directorate.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Financial Management at the Limpopo Department of Social Development, offering R932292 per annum at Level 11.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF level 6 in Financial Management or equivalent qualification in the relevant field or area as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (05) years of proven experience of which 3 years must be at Junior / Assistant Director level. A valid motor vehicle driver’s licence (with the exception of persons with disabilities). Core And Process Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership, Programme and Project Management, Change Management, Financial Management, People Management and Empowerment, Knowledge Management, Problem solving and analysis. Client orientation and customer focus. Knowledge And Skills: Understanding of Public Service Regulations, Acts, policies and procedures. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of NGO financial governance, funding cycles, and donor requirements. Department of Social Development (DSD) financial policies and procedures. Financial reporting standards (GRAP/IFRS). Financial analysis, reporting, and interpretation. Budgeting and expenditure control. Auditing and compliance verification. Capacity building and training facilitation for NGOs. Report writing and presentation. Use of accounting and financial systems/software (e.g., Excel, BAS) Stakeholder engagement and communication. Problem-solving and decision-making. Good understanding of BAS, PERSAL and LOGIS financial systems.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of Supply Chain Management. Manage demand and acquisition, Purchasing and inventory management. manage and coordinate asset management services. Manage transportation Services. Manage the provision of financial planning and budgeting. Manage the provision of Financial Accounting Services. Manage physical facility Maintenance and Repairs. Manage audit processes.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Finansiële Bestuur by die Limpopo Department of Social Development, teen R932292 per jaar op Vlak 11.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 in Finansiële Bestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die relevante veld of area soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van vyf (05) jaar se bewese ervaring waarvan 3 jaar op Junior-/Assistentdirekteurvlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir motorvoertuie (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kern- en prosesbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en projekbestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntgerigtheid en kliestensfokus. Kennis en vaardighede: Begrip van Openbare Diensregulasies, Wette, beleide en prosedures. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van NGO-finansiële beheer, befondsingsiklusse, en skenker vereistes. Department of Social Development (DSD) finansiële beleide en prosedures. Finansiële verslagdoeningsstandaarde (GRAP/IFRS). Verslagskrywing en voorlegging. Gebruik van rekenkundige en finansiële stelsels/sagteware (bv. Excel, BAS). Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en kommunikasie. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Goeie begrip van BAS, PERSAL en LOGIS finansiële stelsels.

Bestuur die verskaffing van finansiële beplanning en begroting. Bestuur die verskaffing van Finansiële Rekenkundige Dienste. Bestuur fisiese fasiliteitsonderhoud en herstelwerk. Bestuur ouditprosesse.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Onozimele Wokuphathwa Kwezimali eLimpopo Department of Social Development, enikeza R932292 ngonyaka kwi-Level 11.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesiqinisekiso esifanele esingeni le-NQF level 6 ekuphathweni kwezimali noma isiqinisekiso esilinganayo ensimini noma indaweni ehlotshaniswa njengokuthi sihlonzwe yi-SAQA. Ukwazisa okungenani iminyaka eyishanu (05) yohluvo oluyisibonakaliso lapho kufuneka kubonakale eminyakeni eyi-3 kube kulelozinga likaJunior / Assistant Director. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ikhono eliyingqikithi nalesokuqhuba: Ikhono lokubuka phambili kanye noholo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kokushintsha, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokusinakuzisebenzela, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqoqagula. Ukwakheka ngomthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi. Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ukuqonda imithetho, izenzo, izinqubomgomo kanye namasu omphakathi. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi (PFMA) kanye nemithetho yeTreasury. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezimali kuma-NGO, amasiko okuxhaswa, kanye nezidingo zabanikazi boxhaso. Izinqubomgomo kanye namasu okuphathwa kwezimali aDepartment of Social Development (DSD). Amasizu okubika ngezimali (GRAP/IFRS). Ukuhlaziya, ukubika, kanye nokuhumusha izimali. Ukwenza umthethoshelelo kanye nokuqapha ukuchithwa kwemali. Ukuhlola kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana. Ukwakha amandla kanye nokukhuthaza ukudlulisela ulwazi kuma-NGO. Ukubika kanye nezibonakaliso. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo kanye namabhanti ezimali (isb., Excel, BAS) Ukuxhumana namaphathi abanomdla kanye nokuxhumana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukuqonda kahle izinhlelo zamanje zemali i-BAS, PERSAL kanye ne-LOGIS.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kokuphathwa kweSonto Lokuhlinzeka. Phatha isidingo kanye nokuqoqa, ukuthenga kanye nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. phatha futhi uhlobo ngamunye izinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwempahla. Phatha izinsizakalo zokuthutha. Phatha ukunikezwa kokuhlela izimali nokwenza umthethoshelelo. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokubala izimali. Phatha ukugcinwa kanye nokulungiswa kwezinto eziyizakhiwo. Phatha inqubo yokuholwa.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: HOI: Sekutupu OLD AGE Home
af.summary: Bestuur en administreer Sekutupu Old Age Home in Capricorn District, hou toesig oor personeel, begrotings en implementering van die Older Persons Amendment Act.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk soos deur SAQA erken. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. 'n Kwalifikasie in Public Management/ Public Administration sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van vyf (05) jaar se bewese ervaring waarvan 3 jaar op Junior/ Assistent-direkteurvlak moet wees. Geldige motorvoertuigbestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kern- en Prosesbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en Projekbestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Personeelbestuur en bemagtiging, Kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en ontleding, Kliëntgerigtheid en kobraandag. Kennis en Vaardighede: Diepgaande begrip van die Older Persons Act en DSD-beleide, Norme & Standaarde vir residensiële fasiliteite. Relevante maatskaplike welsynsdienste-ervaring, bestuursvaardighede en gespesialiseerde kennis van maatskaplike welsynswetgewing. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, PSA, PSR, Arbeidsverhoudingsraamwerk ens. Kennis van Maatskaplike Werk, Verpleegkunde en residensiële sorgbestuursvoorskrifte. Begrip van pasiëntveiligheid, holistiese sorgmodelle en psigososiale ondersteuningsbeginsels. Kennis van SCM, finansiële bestuur, HR-administrasie en fasiliteitsbedrywighede. Begrip van risikobestuur, gehalteversekering, monitering en evalueringsmetodologieë. Vermoë om multidissiplinêre spanne te koördineer en geïntegreerde dienslewering te fasiliteer. Operasionele beplanning en leierskapsvaardighede. Beleidsinterpretasie en implementeringsvaardighede. Finansiële en Supply Chain-bestuursvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Onderhandelings- en belanghebbende-bestuursvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Implementeer die Older Persons Amendment Act 1 van 2025. Algemene en algehele bestuur en administrasie van die Gespesialiseerde Welsynsfasiliteit. Ervare leier om beleide te implementeer, personeel toes te hou en begrotings, bates en infrastruktuur in ooreenstemming met Tesourie-regulasies te bestuur. Verskaf strategiese rigting, strategiese bestuur, dienslewering en finansiële toesig vir die instelling. Versterk nakoming vir sorgfasiliteit ten opsigte van verpligtinge vir die aanmelding van misbruik en verwante mandate op die register vir misbruik van ouer persone. Monitor nakoming van Norme en Standaarde vir Ouer Persone. Bestuur en fasiliteer ontspannings-, sosiale en welstandsprogramme wat aktiewe veroudering en lewenskwaliteit bevorder. Bestuur en fasiliteer sorgdienste. Verse behoorlike rekordbestuur en lêerstelsels. Bestuur fasiliteitsondersteuning en hulpdienste. Monitor professionele nakoming van personeel.

zu.title: Sekela-Mqondisi: HOI: Sekutupu OLD AGE Home
zu.summary: Phatha nolawula i-Sekutupu Old Age Home e-Capricorn District, ngokuqapha abasebenzi, amabhajethi, nokusebenzisa i-Older Persons Amendment Act.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor of Social Work njengokuqinisekiswa yi-SAQA. Ukwabhaliswa okwamanje ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Isifundo se-Public Management/ Public Administration kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (05) yesipiliyoni esibonisiwe, okuyilapho iminyaka eyi-3 kumele ibe ezingeni le-Junior / Assistant Director. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abanokukhubazeka). Amakhono Okuyisisekelo Nokuqhuba Izinqubo: Ikhono Lokwenza Izinhlelo Nokuhola, ukuPhatha Amaphulo Namaphrojekthi, ukuPhatha Izinguquko, ukuPhatha Imali, ukuPhatha Abantu NokuNika Amandla, ukuPhatha Ulwazi, ukuXazulula Izinkinga NokuHlaziya, ukujwayelela iklayenti nokugxila kumthengi. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukuqonda okujulile ngo-Older Persons Act kanye Nemigomo ye-DSD, ama-Norms & Standards wezikhungo zokuhlala. Isipiliyoni esihlobene namasevisi enhlalakahle, amakhono okuphatha, nolwazi olukhethekile ngomthetho wenhlalakahle Ulwazi ngemithetho yenkonzo kahulumeni, i-PFMA, imithetho ye-Treasury, i-PSA, i-PSR, uHlelo Lobudlelwano BoMsebenzi njll. Ulwazi ngemiyalo ye-Social Work, ukuNakekela, nokuphatha ukunakekelwa ezindaweni zokuhlala. Ukuqonda ngokuphepha kwesiguli, izindlela zokunakekela ngokuphelele, kanye nemigomo yesekelo ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo. Ulwazi nge-SCM, ukuphatha imali, ukuphathwa kwe-HR, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zesikhungo. Ukuqonda ngokuphatha izingozi, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi, kanye nezindlela zokuqapha nokuhlola. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa amaqembu asuka emagatsheni ahlukene futhi lusize ekuletheni inkonzo ehlangene. Amakhono okuhlela izinhlelo zokusebenza nokuholisa. Amakhono okutolika nokusebenzisa imigomo. Amakhono okuphatha imali ne-Supply Chain. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono okuxoxisana nokuphatha abahlanganyeli. Amakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Sebenzisa i-Older Persons Amendment Act 1 of 2025. Ukuphatha nokulawula okubanzi konke isikhungo senhlalakahle esikhethekile. Umholi onamava ekusebenziseni imigomo, ekuqapheni abasebenzi nasekuphatheni amabhajethi, izimpahla, nezakhiwo ngokuvumelana nemithetho ye-Treasury. Nikeza isiqondiso sezinhlelo, ukuphatha okuhleliwe, ukuletha inkonzo, kanye nokuqapha kwezimali kwesikhungo. Qinisa ukuvumelana kwesikhungo sokunakekela ngokwemithetho yokubika ukuhlukunyezwa nemiyalo ehlobene nerekhodi lokuhlukunyezwa kwabadala. Qapha ukuvumelana nama-Norms and Standards for Older Persons. Phatha futhi usize ezinhlelweni zokuzilibazisa, zenhlalo, nezesiphile ezeza ukuguga okusebenzayo kanye nekhwalithi yempilo. Phatha futhi usize ezinkonzweni zokunakekela. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okulungile kwemibhalo kanye nezinhlelo zokugcina amafayela. Phatha ukwesekwa kwezikhungo namasevisi okwesekela. Qapha ukuvumelana ngobungcweti babasebenzi.

xh.title: Umongameli oNgenzantsi: HOI: Sekutupu OLD AGE Home
xh.summary: Phatha ulawule iSekutupu Old Age Home kwiCapricorn District, ukhangele abasebenzi, amabhajeti, nokuqhuba uMthetho wokuLungiswa wabantu abaMdala.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 kunye ne-Bachelor of Social Work njengokuvunywa yiSAQA. Ukubhalisa kwangoku neSouth African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Isidanga kwi-Public Management/ Public Administration siza kuba luncedo elongezelelweyo. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (05) yamava aqinisekisiweyo apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba leJunior / Assistant Director. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba imoto elisebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abanokhubekelo). Amakhono aPhakathi neNqubo: Ikhono leNqubomgomo noBunkokeli, uLawulo lweNkqubo neePhojekthi, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwaBantu nokubanika amandla, uLawulo loLwazi, ukuSolula iingxaki nokuQwalasela, ukukhathalela abathengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zabo. ULwazi neeKhono: Ukuqonda okunzulu koMthetho wabantu abaMdala neeMigaqo zeDSD, iMilinganiselo namaZinga amaZiko okuHlala. Amava ahambelanayo kwiinkonzo zentlalontle, amakhono olawulo, nolwazi oluchaziweyo ngomthetho wentlalontle. ULwazi ngemithetho yeNkonzo kaRhulumente, iPFMA, imigaqo yeTreasury, iPSA, iPSR, iNkqubo yoBudelwano beBasebenzi njl. ULwazi ngeSocial Work, uNyango, nemigaqo yoLawulo lweZiko loNakekelo. Ukuqonda ukhuseleko lwabaGulukuda, iindlela zonakekelo ezibanzi, nemigaqo yokuxhasa ngokomoya nangokwentlalontle. ULwazi ngeSCM, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweHR, nokuQhuba iZiko. Ukuqonda uLawulo loMngcipheko, uQinisekiso lweMigangatho, neendlela zokuJonga nokuQwalasela. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa amaqela abasebenzi basezithuba ezahlukeneyo nokuqhuba ukulethwa kwenkonzo edityanisiweyo. Amakhono oCwangciso lokuQhuba noBunkokeli. Amakhono okuQonda nokuQhuba iMigaqo. Amakhono oLawulo lweMali neSupply Chain. Amakhono okuQwalasela. Amakhono okuNcokola noLawulo lweeBathintekayo. Amakhono okuBhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Qhuba uMthetho wokuLungiswa wabantu abaMdala 1 of 2025. Ulawulo jikelele nolubanzi lweZiko leNtlalontle elukhethekileyo. Inkokeli enamava yokuqhuba iimigaqo, ukhangele abasebenzi, ilawule amabhajeti, impahla, nolwakhiwo ngokweemigaqo zeTreasury. Nika isalathiso seNqubomgomo, ulawulo lweNqubomgomo, ukulethwa kweNkonzo, nokuJonga iMali kwesiZiko. Qinisekisa ukuzalisekiswa kwemimiselo kwiziko lonakekelo ngokwemfuneko yokuxela ukuphathwa kakubi nemiyalelo edibene nayo ebhalweni lokuphathwa kakubi kwabantu abadala. Jonga ukuzalisekiswa kweMilinganiselo namaZinga kwabaMdala. Lawula uze ulawule iinkqubo zokuzonwabisa, zentlalontle, nokuphila kakuhle ezikhuthaza ukuguga ngokusebenzayo nezinga lobomi. Lawula uze ulawule iinkonzo zonakekelo. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lweerekhodi neenkqubo zokugcina iifayile. Lawula inkxaso yeZiko neenkonzo ezincedisayo. Jonga ukuzalisekiswa kwemigaqo yobuchwepheshe yabasebenzi.

af.duties: Voer mediese saakassessering uit. Koördineer en fasiliteer die verwysingsproses vir die verkryging van mediese menings. Help met die monitering en ondersteuning van die adjudikasieproses. zu.title: Isikhundla sikapsaykoloshi izinga 1
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikapsaykoloshi izinga 1 eSeshego Treatment Centre eLimpopo, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengokapsaykoloshi wekhilinikhi nelaysensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesiqinisekiso esifanele esingu-NQF 7 kwe-Social Science (isiqinisekiso esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengokapsaykoloshi wekhilinikhi. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengokapsaykoloshi. Ilaysensi yokushayela imoto esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ikhono lezobuholi nesokuqamba izinhlelo, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlela namaphrojekthi, Ukuphathwa izehlakalo, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokunika amandla, Ukuphathwa kolwazi, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukuqondiswa kwabathengi nogxile kumakheli. Ulwazi lwamakhono: Ulwazi lwezokwelapha ngekhilinikhi ekuhloleni, ekuxilimeni nasekunyathelweni ukuphila kwakho konke. Isakhiwo sezomthetho nesikolo lokusebenza. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo nemithetho yomnyango. Ukwelapha ngemithetho yesayensi. Ukuqonda umphakathi ongabaningi, amasiko, indawo kanye nezinto eziphathelene nezomnotho ezithinta impilo yengqondo. Ikono lokusebenza ohlwini lwabanjiniyeni abaningi bokuhlangenwe ndaba. Amakhono okuhlela kahle nokuphatha isikhathi. Ukuxhumana kolimi okuhle nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuzwela izinkomba zobulili, izinhlanga, izinkalo, izinkulumo zobulili nobunkhubazeka.
zu.duties: Linganisa izicala zezokwelapha. Hlanganisa futhi wenze kubelula inqubo yokuthumela abantu ukuthola izinhloliyo zezokwelapha. Siza ekubukeleni nasekusekeleni inqubo yokuhlulela. Hlela imibiko. Xhuma nabahlinzeki bezokwelapha kanye nezempilo. Ukubamba iqhaza lezokwelapha ngekhilinikhi emahoreni angemuva kwerosteri yokubizwa. Ukuphatha isistimu yokulawula ulwazi lokuqashwa kwabantwana nabasha.

xh.title: Igama lesikhundla: Umnyathi weNgcwele level 1.
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaganga weNgcwele level 1 kwindlu yokunyangwa yabantwana eLimpopo, sifuna umbhalo we-HPCSA njengoganga weKliniki nelayisensi yokushusha kwindlela yamakhithi abantu ethengisa ukubhalwa kwishishini lezeMiganga eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengoganga weKliniki. Kukho iNqanaba lesi-7 kwizifundo zezenzululwazi seemihla ngemihla.
xh.requirements: Kwindlela yesi-12 ukongeza nesesundo esifanelekileyo kwindleba yamazinga e-7 kumaziko ezeSayensi ezenzelwe abantu (isesundo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwishishini lamaNda ezeMiganga yaseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomganga wezoKliniki. Ubhaliso lukhoyo kwi-HPCSA njengomganga weengqondo. Ilayisenisi yokushusha kwindlela yamakhithi abantu (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Iikhompethensi ezizezakwindimbamba eziyiikhongo esi ezenziwayo: Ikhono lokulawula inkqubo nakwikhotho, ukulawula iinkqubo nezinxaxheba ezenziwayo, ukulawula utshintsho, ukulawula izimali, ukulawula abantu nokwakha isabelo, ukulawula iimvulo, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqhathanisa ucando luzikhethileyo, ukunakekela iintsebenziswa nokuqwalasela abathengi. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi lwezoKliniki ngezigulo zeengqondo ekuxhasweni kwempilo yomntu, ekuxhasweni komganga weengqondo nakunyango kwalo onke amanqanaba obomi. Iindlela ezomthetho nezomculo zomsebenzi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo neengcinga zothisha. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeNgcwele yoMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda okubanzi ngomphakathi, ngezithethe, ngezoqoqoselwazi nangemiba yomphakathi echanekileyo. Ikhono lokuba ngumntu ogqamileyo ekubeni nabakho. Ikhono eluhlaza lokubeka izinto kwindlela yamakhithi abantu.
xh.duties: Yenza ixhaso lemiganga yezempilo. Langelelisa kwaye ulawule inkqubo yokuthumela nokuze kufumane izimvo zemiganga yezempilo. Ncedisa ekubhenkeni nasekuxhaseni inkqubo yoxheliso-mganga. Lungiseela iingxelo. Xhasana nabaganga nezisebenzi ezingqamweni lempilo yabantu. Uluvo lokwenza izinkqubo zempilo emva kweyure zasebekhaya kwishejuli yokubiza. Ulawulo lweenkqabo zolawulo lwelwazi loliso lwabantwana nolutsha.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Development Manager Grade 1
jobs.summary: Assistant Community Development Manager role at the Sekhukhune District Office requiring an NQF 6 qualification and eight years of community development experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF 6 in Development Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography or equivalent qualification in the relevant field or area as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of eight (08) years’ appropriate experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. A valid motor vehicle driver’s licence (with the exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and understanding of individual and group behaviour, its inter-relations within community structures, dynamics of the community and current legislation to enable interventions. Knowledge of community development principles. The ability and competence to manage community development structures and projects. The ability to influence individuals and groups to participate in self- empowerment ventures. The ability to undertake complex research. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills. Computer literacy. Written and verbal communication skills. Financial management. Presentation skills. Project management. Supervision skills. Policy formulation and implementation. Knowledge of the Public Service Management Framework, e.g. PFMA, Labour Relations Act, etc.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated development interventions in partnership with other relevant stakeholders through efficient, effective and economical utilisation of resources by the service delivery area(s). Coordinate and manage community development service delivery area(s) to ensure that an efficient and effective community development service is delivered through the proper utilization of human, financial and physical resources. Keep up to date with new developments in the community development and management fields to enhance service delivery. Plan and ensure that research on community development is undertaken including the facilitation of complex community development research.

af.title: Assistent Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbestuurder Graad 1
af.summary: Assistent Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbestuurder-rol by die Sekhukhune Distrikskantoor wat 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie en agt jaar se gemeenskapsontwikkelingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF 6 in Development Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie in die relevante veld of area soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van agt (08) jaar se toepaslike ervaring in Community Development na verkryging van die vereiste kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van individuele en groepsgedrag, die interverhoudings daarvan binne gemeenskapsstrukture, dinamika van die gemeenskap en huidige wetgewing om ingrypings moontlik te maak. Kennis van gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeginsels. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture en -projekte te bestuur. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem. Die vermoë om komplekse navorsing te onderneem. Probleemoplossings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuur. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Projektbestuur. Toesighoudingsvaardighede. Beleidsformulering en -implementering. Kennis van die Openbare Diensbestuursraamwerk, bv. PFMA, Labour Relations Act, ens.
af.duties: Koördineer die identifisering, facilitering en implementering van geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsingrypings in samewerking met ander relevante belanghebbendes deur doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne deur die diensleweringarea(s). Koördineer en bestuur gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiensleweringarea(s) om te verseker dat 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe gemeenskapsontwikkelingsdiens gelewer word deur die behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelings- en bestuursvelde om dienslewering te verbeter. Beplan en verseker dat navorsing oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling onderneem word, insluitend die facilitering van komplekse gemeenskapsontwikkelingsnavorsing.

zu.title: Umncedisi Womphathi Wokuthuthukisa Umphakathi Grade 1
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedisi womphathi wokuthuthukisa umphakathi eSekhukhune District Office esidinga iziqu ze-NQF 6 kanye nesipiliyoni seminyaka eyisishiyagalomboli sokuthuthukisa umphakathi.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 kanye neziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF 6 kwi-Development Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography noma iziqu ezilinganayo enkundleni noma indaweni ehlobene njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okuncane iminyaka eyisishiyagalomboli (08) yesipiliyoni esifanele sokuthuthukisa umphakathi emva kokuthola iziqu ezidingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethembekile (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha komuntu ngamunye nakweqembu, ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, amandla okushintsha emphakathini nomthetho wamanje ukwenzela ukungenelela. Ulwazi lwezimiso zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ikhono nokukwazi ukuphatha izakhiwo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi namaphrojekthi. Ikhono lokukhuthaza abantu ngamunye namaqembu ukuba bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zokuzivuselela. Ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo olunzima. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuxazulula iziphixano. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma. Ukuphatha imali. Amakhono okwethula. Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amakhono okulawula. Ukubunjwa nokusetshenziswa kwamapholisi. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Management Framework, njengesibonelo i-PFMA, i-Labour Relations Act, njll.
zu.duties: Hlela ndawonye ukuqashwa, ukukhuthazwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokungenelela zokuthuthukisa okuhlangene ngokubambisana nabanye abahlanganyeli abahlobene ngokusebenzisa ngempumelelo, ngokusebenza kahle nangokonga izinsiza zendawo yokufulathela isevisi. Hlela ndawonye futhi uphathe izindawo zokufulathela isevisi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isevisi yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ethembekile nesebenzayo inikezwa ngokusebenzisa ngendlela efanele izinsiza zabantu, ezezimali nezesimo sendawo. Gcina usazi ngemikhakha yokuthuthukisa umphakathi nokuqapha ukuthuthuka okusha ukuze kuphuculwe ukulethwa kwisevisi. Cwangcisa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kwenziwa ucwaningo lokuthuthukisa umphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza ucwaningo olunzima lokuthuthukisa umphakathi.

xh.title: Umphathi woNtsunduwo lwePhakathi weNqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguMphathi woNtsunduwo lwePhakathi kwiOfisi yesiKolo seSekhukhune District efuna ifanelekile kwi-NQF 6 namava eminyaka yeyi-8 kwintsunduwo lomphakathi.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 kunye nefanelekileyo kwi-NQF 6 kwiDevelopment Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography okanye isidanga esilinganayo kwicala okumgangathweni elithintelayo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isiqingatha seminyaka eyisi-8 (08) yamava afanelekileyo kwintsunduwo lomphakathi emva kokufumana isidanga esifunekayo. Ilayisenesi yomqhubi wesithuthu esisebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha komntu kunye neqela, ukwamanyelana kwabo ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, iinkqubo zomphakathi namagazethi wangoku ukwazi ukwenza ukungenelela. Ulwazi ngeemvisiswano zentsunduwo lomphakathi. Ikhono lokulawula iindonga zentsunduwo lomphakathi kunye namaphulo. Ikhono lokukhokela abantu namaqela ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwizinto ezinika amandla. Ikhono lokwenza uphando oluyinkimbinkimbi. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokulungisa iingxabano. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okubhala nokuThetha. Ukulawula iimali. Amakhono okubonisa. Ukulawula amaphulo. Amakhono okulawula abasebenzi. Ukwenza nokuphumeza iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngeSiseko soLawulo lweNkonzo kaRhulumente, nkq. PFMA, umthetho wezibiniphatho, njl.
xh.duties: Lungisa ukuqonda, ukulawula nokuphumeza iindlela zentsunduwo eziyinyaniso kunye nabalawuli abanye ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ngendlela echanekileyo nangokusebenza kwicala lezenkonzo. Lawula izikwere lezenkonzo zentsunduwo lomphakathi kuqinisekiswa ukuba iinkonzo zilawulwa kakuhle ngokusebenzisa abantu, iimali nezixhobo. Gcina ulwazi olutsha kwintsunduwo lomphakathi nakuLawulo ukuphucula iinkonzo. Cwangcisa uqinisekise ukuba uphando lwentsunduwo lomphakathi luwenziwa kuquka nolawulo lophando oluyinkimbinkimbi lwentsunduwo lomphakathi.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Stelselbeheer
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig by Hoofkantoor van Sosiale Ontwikkeling in Polokwane om sekuriteitsbeheer en toegangsregte in finansiële transversale stelsels te oorsien.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 in Finansiële Bestuur / Rekeningkunde / Oudit / Koste / Bestuursrekeningkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike veld of area soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring op toesighoudende vlak. Geldige motorbestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansiesbestuur (PFMA). Kennis van Openbare Diensregulasies, Beleide en prosedures. Kennis van transversale stelsels spesifiek verbonde aan stelselbeheer. Leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Finansiële verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker behoorlike sekuriteitsbeheer in alle finansiële stelsels (Transversale stelsels). Implementeer en handhaaf skeiding van pligte in die finansiële stelsels. Hersiening van gebruikers se toegangsregte. Verskaf hulplinkfasiliteite aan alle gebruikers van finansiële stelsels. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van prosedurehandleidings of standaard bedryfsprosedures (SOP's). Onderhou departementele standaard rekeningskema en sekuriteitsprofiel. Monitor die koppelvlak en transversale stelsel op banke, LOGIS, PERSAL en BAS. Laai af en berei verslag oor betalings binne 30 dae vanuit Vulindlela voor. Fasiliteer afsluiting van boeke en monitor verrekening van hangende rekenings. Verseker behoorlike finansiële verslagdoening van die departement. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse finansiële state van die departement.

zu.title: Umphathi Wesikhundla: Ukulawula Kwezimiso
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wesikhundla eSocial Development Head Office ePolokwane ukuba aqaphele izilawulo zokuvikela namalungelo okungena kumasestemu ezimali ahambahambayo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi esifanele esisingathini se-NQF level 6 kwi-Financial Management / Accounting / Auditing / Cost / Management Accounting noma isitifiketi esilinganayo enkimeni noma endaweni ehlotshaniswe nalokhu njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ukwaziswa okuncane kweminyaka engu-3 kokuhlangabezana kwemisebenzi ezingeni lokuba ngumlawuli. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi Nekhono: Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Regulations, Izinqobo nezinqubo. Ulwazi lwamasestemu ahambahambayo ngokukhethekile okuhlobene nokulawula isistimu. Amakhono obuholo nokuphathwa. Amakhono okubika ngemali. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawula okufanele kwokuvikela kuzo zonke izimiso zemali (Transversal systems). Faka endaweni futhi wenze ukuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi kumasestemu ezimali. Ukuphonononga amalungelo okungena komsebenzisi. Nikeza izinto zokwesiza wedeski kubo bonke abasebenzisi bamasestemu ezimali. Lakaza futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezincwadi zezinqobo nezinqubo noma izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile (SOP's). Gcina ishedi le-akhawunti ezingeni elijwayelekile lomnyango nephayela lokuvikela. Qaphela isistimu yokuxhumana nokuqhathaniswa emabhange, LOGIS, PERSAL and BAS. Layisha futhi ulungiselele umbiko wokukhokha kungakapheli amasuku angu-30 otholakala ku-Vulindlela. Khokhela ukuvaleka kwezincwadi futhi uqaphele ukusula kwe-akhawunti zokwedlulisa. Qinisekisa ukubika okufanele ngenkulu yemali komnyango. Siza ekulungiseleleni inkulumo yemali yonyaka kamnyango.

xh.title: Umncedisi woLawulo weNkqubo
xh.summary: Kufuneka uM lawuli ongumncedisi kwi-Head Office ka Social Development ePolokwane ukulawula ulawulo lokhuseleko kunye namalungelo okufikelela kwiinkqubo zemali eziqhelekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ngakunye nesidanga esifanelekileyo kumanqanaba e-NQF angama-6 kuLawulo lweMali / i-Akhawunti / ukuPhonononga / iXabiso / uLawulo lweAkhawunti okanye isidanga esilinganayo kwelinye igunya elichanekileyo njengoko kuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka eyi-3 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo kwinqanaba lokuqondisa. Ileyisensi yokuqhuba edibeneyo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente (PFMA). Ulwazi ngamagunya, iinkqubo nemigaqo yoMsebenzi woLuntu. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo eziqhelekileyo ngokukodwa ezidityaniswa nolawulo lwenkqubo. Amakhono okuququmbela & uLawulo. Amakhono okubika ngeMali. Amakhono oNxibelelwano. Amakhono oLawulo lweNxaxheba. Amakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi. Amakhono okuziba iingxaki.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungelelenyo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zemali (Iinkqubo eziqhelekileyo). Zisebenzise kwaye uqinisekise uhlulahlulo lwemisebenzi kwiinkqubo zemali. Ukuphonononga amalungelo okufikelela komsebenzisi. Bonezela izinto zesixhobo somncedisi kubo bonke abasebenzisi benkqubo yemali. Yila kwaye uqinisekise ukusebenziswa kwamanual amaqheleza okwenza imisebenzi okanye amaqheleza okusebenza aqhelekileyo (SOP's). Gcina ireyikhodi yamanye amaxephula esebe kunye nophawu lokhuseleko. Qaphela umdibaniso wamananye amakhredithi kunye nenkqubo ebandakanya iibhanki, i-LOGIS, i-PERSAL kunye ne-BAS. Thatha kwaye ulungiselele ingxelo yokuhlawulela kumhla wokuvala iintsuku ezingama-30 esuka kwi-Vulindlela. Qhubeza ukuvalwa kweencwadi kwaye uqaphele ukucoca i-akhawunti ezingazange zicwetshwe. Qinisekisa ukubika ngemali olulungelelenyo kwesebe. Nceda kulungiselelo lwenyanga yonyaka lwenkcazelo yemali yesebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Supply Chain Compliance
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Supply Chain Compliance at the Department of Social Development in Polokwane, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and 3 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF level 6 in Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Purchasing Management or equivalent qualification in the relevant field or area as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3 years relevant experience at Supervisory /Junior Management level. Valid motor vehicle driver’s license (with the exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Policies and procedures. Knowledge of Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Leadership & Management skills. Financial reporting skills. Communications skills. Conflict management skills. Project Management skills. Problem solving skills.
jobs.duties: Provide capacity building to supply chain management. Identify capacity gaps through monitoring of policy implementation. Provide capacity building to Supply Chain Management Practitioners. Provide capacity building to Bid Specification, Evaluation and Adjudication committees. Provide capacity building to departmental end users. Facilitate provision of accredited Supply Chain Management courses. Provide support to institutions bid committee structures and Supply Chain Management officials. Management of departmental contracts. Provide regular status/ progress reports to management highlighting trends, problems, risks, deviation, delays and make appropriate recommendations for contract management improvement. Facilitate appointments and provide capacity building for project managers. Manage and provide advice to project managers in reporting on the performance of contracted service providers. Manage financial, administrative Implement and comply with relevant polies. Manage systems and procedures. Manage the budget planning and spending processes according to relevant frameworks. Manage the performance and development of staff. Compile and submit quarterly and annual reports.
