af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Voorsieningsketennakoming
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Voorsieningsketennakoming by die Department of Social Development in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en 3 jaar toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF level 6 in Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Purchasing Management of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike veld of area soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar tersaaklike ervaring op Toesig-/Juniorbestuursvlak. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir motorvoertuie (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Kennis van Public Service Regulations, beleide en prosedures. Kennis van Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Finansiële verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Konflikbestuursvaardighede. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf kapasiteitsbouing aan voorsieningsketenbestuur. Identifiseer kapasiteitsgapinge deur monitering van beleidsimplementering. Verskaf kapasiteitsbouing aan Supply Chain Management-praktisyns. Verskaf kapasiteitsbouing aan bodspesifikasiemaak-, evaluerings- en beslissingskomitees. Verskaf kapasiteitsbouing aan departementele eindgebruikers. Fasiliteer die verskaffing van geakkrediteerde Supply Chain Management-kursusse. Verskaf ondersteuning aan instellings se bodkomiteestrukture en Supply Chain Management-amptenare. Bestuur van departementele kontrakte. Verskaf gereelde status-/vorderingsverslae aan bestuur wat tendense, probleme, risiko's, afwykings, vertraagings uitlig en toepaslike aanbevelings doen vir verbetering van kontrakbestuur. Fasiliteer aanstellings en verskaf kapasiteitsbouing vir projekbestuurders. Bestuur en verskaf advies aan projekbestuurders oor verslagdoening rakende die prestasie van gekontrakteerde diensverskaffers. Bestuur finansiële, administratiewe implementering en voldoen aan tersaaklike beleide. Bestuur stelsels en prosedures. Bestuur die begrotingsbeplanning en bestedingsprosesse volgens tersaaklike raamwerke. Bestuur die prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel. Stel kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae op en dien dit in.

zu.title: Umuntu Ohola Isikhundla: Ukuhambelana Kwenkonzo Yokuhlinzeka
zu.summary: Umuntu ohola isikhundla sokuqinisekisa ukuhambelana kwenkonzo yokuhlinzeka e-Department of Social Development e-Polokwane, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 6 nokuba neminyaka eyi-3 yokuhola isiphephelo sabantu.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesiqu esifanele esingu-NQF level 6 kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Purchasing Management noma isiqu esilinganayo enkundeni noma indawo ehlobene njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwazisa ukuba ube neminyaka eyi-3 yokuhola isiphephelo sabantu / ezingeni lobuholi bejunior. Ilayisensi yokushayela emotokalo esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ulwazi ngo-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulations, izinqubomgomo nezindlela. Ulwazi ngo-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Izikhono zobuholi nolawulo. Izikhono zokubika ngemali. Izikhono zokuthintana. Izikhono zokuphatha izinkinga. Izikhono zokulawula amaphrojekthi. Izikhono zokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokwakha ikhono lenkonzo yokuhlinzeka. Hlola izikhala ekwakheni ikhono ngokuqaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Hlinzeka ngokwakha ikhono kubasebenzi benkonzo yokuhlinzeka. Hlinzeka ngokwakha ikhono emakomidi okubeka izinkomba, okuhlola nokwesula izinkomba. Hlinzeka ngokwakha ikhono kubasebenzisi bangekugcineni bomnyango. Qedelela ukunikezwa kwamakilasi asemthethweni enkonzo yokuhlinzeka. Nikeza ngokweseka izakhiwo zekomidi lesikhungo nezikhulu zenkonzo yokuhlinzeka. Lawula izinkontileka zomnyango. Nikeza ngemibiko evamile yohamu / inqubo kubaphathi ukuze kuboniswe izinto ezihamba kahle, izinkinga, izingozi, ukwehluka, izeshe ezidonsa kanti futhi unikeze izinkomba ezifanelekile zokuthuthukiswa kokulawulwa kwezinkontileka. Qedelela izabelo futhi uhole ekwakheni ikhono labaphathi bamaphrojekthi. Lawula futhi unikezezelane nomabaphathi bamaphrojekthi ekubikeni ngomumo wabenzi besevisi abanesinkontileka. Lawula izimali, izinto zolawulo. Sebenzisa futhi uzinikeze ngokuhambelana nezinqubomgomo ezihlobene. Lawula izinhlelo nezindlela. Lawula inqubo yokuhlela nokusebenzisa imali yokulinganisela ngokuhambelana nezakhiwo ezihlobene. Lawula ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Hlanganisa futhi uhlele imibiko yesikhashana nenyanga zonke.

xh.title: Umphathi woMncedi: Ulwazi lokuZalathisa ngoKwemiaMthetho yeNkokhelo
xh.summary: Umphathi woMncedi woLwazi lokuZalathisa ngoKwemiaMthetho yeNkokhelo kwiSebe leNtshukubo yoPhu lwaNtswelangcwalu kwaPolokwane, lifuna izifundo kwinQanaba le-NQF level 6 kunye namava eminyaka yama-3 yokulawula abantu.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ngakunye nefomali esemthethweni kwi-NQF level 6 kwilandlela loKulawula uNtsenga nokuthunyelwa kweempahla / ye-Logistics / yokulawula ukuthenga okanye isifundo esilinganayo kwindawo ekhudlayo njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emi-3 ubuncinane yamava abalulekileyo kwinQanaba lokulawula / lokulawula iPhondo eNqanaba elincinci. Ilayiseni yokushayela imoto esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi nokuSebenzisa: Ulwazi ngeMthetho yoLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente (i-PFMA). Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoLawulo lwaKwiziko loRhulumente, iNkqubo nemiThetho yokuSebenza. Ulwazi ngeMthetho yoQqofo lweNkqubo yokuKhetha kuRhulumente i-PPPFA. Ukulawula kunye nokuba namava okulawula abantu. Amava okubika ngemali. Amava okuthetha nabantu. Amava okulawula iingxabano. Amava okulawula iiprojekthi. Amava okuzalisa iingxaki.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngamava kolawulo lwentsengo nokuthunyelwa kweempahla. Ukubona indawo esele ngamava ngokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwenkqubo. Ukubonelela ngamava kuBaqhubi boLwazi loLawulo lweMithetho yokuthengisa nokuthenga iimpahla. Ukubonelela ngamava kwiKomiti eQamba iMigaqo, eLinganisa nakaQhatha imigqaqo. Ukubonelela ngamava kwabaphela abasebenzisa iNkqubo. Ukukhuthaza ukubonelela kolwazi lweNkqubo eMthethweni yokuthengisa nokuthenga iimpahla. Ukuxhasa iinkqubo zeKomiti ekhetha iBidders namaPhathi beNkqubo yokuthengisa nokuthenga iimpahla. Ukulawula iKontrakti ze-Departments. Ukubika rhoqo ngomgangatho / inkqubo kubaphathi ndawonye nokuqaphela okuqhuba phambili, iingxaki, iingozi, ukungahambi kwenkqubo nokuBiza iNgcebiso ngeKontrakti yokuphucula inkqubo yokulawula. Ukwenza iNkomishani yokuba ngamaPhathi beProjekthi ndawonye nokubonelela ngamava abo. Ukulawula ndawonye nokubonelela ngamava kuBaphathi beProjekthi ngokubika ngemisebenzi yabaThengisa iinkonzo. Ukulawula iMali, iNkqubo yokuCima kwaye uQhagamshelane neNkqubo eMthethweni. Ukulawula iNkqubo namacebo. Ukulawula iNkqubo yokucinga malunga noLawulo lweMali ngakunye nokusebenzisa iMali ngokwemigaqo ephilayo. Ukulawula ukuphucula nokusebenza kwabasebenzi ndawonye nokuQamba iNkqubo yokubika ngamava eQhosini. Ukucima nokubika iNkqubo yokuQwalasela ibali rhoqo ngamava eQhosini.

jobs.title: Community Development Supervisor Grade 1
jobs.summary: Supervise community development structures, projects and practitioners in Elias Motsoaledi, Limpopo, requiring Grade 12, an NQF 6 qualification and seven years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF 6 in Development Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography or equivalent qualification in the relevant field or area as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of seven (07) years’ appropriate experience in Community Development after obtaining the required qualification. Valid motor vehicle driver’s licence (with the exception of persons with disabilities) Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge and understanding of individual and group behaviour, inter relations within community structures, dynamics of the community and current legislation to enable interventions. The ability and competence to manage community development structures and projects. The ability to influence individuals and groups to participate in their own self-empowerment ventures. Research and report writing skills. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills. Computer literacy. Financial management. Presentation skills. Project management. People Management. Knowledge of the Public Service Management Framework, e.g. PFMA, Labour Relations Act, etc.
jobs.duties: Manage community development structures and projects. Supervise the identification, facilitation and implementation of integrated community development interventions in partnership with the community and other relevant stakeholders. Supervise and support community development practitioners to ensure that there is communication and coordination with all the relevant role players, internal and external. Perform administrative support on community development and related activities. Keep up to date with the new developments in the community development field to enhance service delivery.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezinhlelo Zokuthuthukisa Umphakathi Isigaba 1

zu.requirements: Ibanga le-Grade 12 kanye nethuluzi elifanele le-NQF 6 kwi-Development Studies / Diaconiology / Social Sciences / Community Development / Sociology / Population Studies / Demography noma iziqu ezingajwayelekile kuleyo ndawo noma inkundla njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okungeyona into engaphansi kweminyaka eyisikhombisa (07) yamava afanele kokuqashwa komunyango wokuthuthukisa umphakathi emva kokuthola iziqu ezidingekayo. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha komuntu ngamunye nekwalaba labantu, ubudlelwano phakathi kwezakhiwo zomphakathi, okuphilayo komphakathi nomthetho wamanje ukuze kunikezwe izinxibelelwano. Ikhono namandla okuphatha izakhiwo namaphrojekthi okuthuthukisa umphakathi. Ikhono lokunika amandla abantu ngamunye namaqembu ukuthi bathathe inxaxheba kumashisho okuzikhulisa. Amakhono okucwaninga nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nengxabano. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Amakhono okwenza okumetshula. Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Management Framework, njengoba PFMA, Labour Relations Act, njl.
zu.duties: Phatha izakhiwo namaphrojekthi zokuthuthukisa umphakathi. Qapha ukuqashwa, ukweluleka nokusetshenziswa kwezinxibelelwano ezihlangene zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ngokubambisana nomphakathi nabanyeabanikazi benhlangano abafanele. Qapha futhi usekele izisebenzi zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunokuxhumana nokuhlelwa kuyo yonke imicimbi ephathwayo, ephakathi nangaphandle. Yenza ukusekelwa okuphathwayo kokuthuthukisa umphakathi nemicimbi ehlobene nawo. Gcina ulwazi olusha ngezinto ezisha kule ndawo yokuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuze kuphuculwe ukulethwa kwenkonzo.

jobs.summary: Senior IT Technician sought at the Department of Social Development in Polokwane to provide technical support, maintain network infrastructure and troubleshoot hardware and software.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF 6 in Computer Science / Information Technology or equivalent qualification in the field or area as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 2-3 years’ relevant experience. Valid motor vehicle driver’s licence (with the exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge And Skills: Good knowledge of Microsoft Windows desktop and server environments, including Microsoft 365. Knowledge of network infrastructure: LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, routing, switching and Wi-Fi. Knowledge of Active Directory, user account administration and Group Policy. Hardware and software installation, configuration and troubleshooting skills. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and IT service management. Strong problem- solving, analytical, communication and customer-service skills. Ability to work independently and effectively within a team. Strong diagnostic troubleshooting, excellent communication, and collaboration skills are required.

Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot servers, desktops, laptops, printers and peripheral devices. Support and maintain network infrastructure, including switches, routers, Wi-Fi, and structured cabling. Administer user accounts, permissions and access on Active Directory and Microsoft 365 tenant. Support and monitor ICT systems, servers, endpoint protection and backup solutions. Conduct routine system maintenance and apply approved updates and patches. Assist with the implementation of ICT projects, infrastructure upgrades, and departmental initiatives. Monitor LAN performance and availability, troubleshoot network issues, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime and ensure optimal network performance. Perform data backups and system disaster recovery. Implement and enforce network security controls, including VLAN configuration, access control lists, and segmentation to protect departmental data and resources.

af.title: Senior Inligtingstegnologetegnikus
af.summary: Senior IT-tegnikus gesoek by die Department of Social Development in Polokwane om tegniese ondersteuning te verskaf, netwerkinfrastruktuur te onderhou en hardeware en sagteware te ontfout.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF 6 in Rekenaarwetenskap / Inligtingstegnologie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die veld of area soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 2-3 jaar se relevante ervaring. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir motorvoertuig (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en vaardighede: Goeie kennis van Microsoft Windows-desktop en bedieneromgewings, insluitend Microsoft 365. Kennis van netwerkinfrastruktuur: LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, roetering, skakeling en Wi-Fi. Kennis van Active Directory, gebruikersrekeningadministrasie en Groepsbeleid. Hardeware- en sagteware-installasie, konfigurasie en ontfoutingsvaardighede. Kennis van kuberveiligheidbeste praktyke en IT-diensbestuur. Sterk probleemoplossing, analitiese, kommunikasie- en kliëntediensvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en doeltreffend binne 'n span te werk. Sterk diagnostiese ontfouting, uitstekende kommunikasie en samewerkingsvaardighede word vereis.
af.duties: Verskaf daaglikse tegniese ondersteuning aan eindgebruikers oor hardeware-, sagteware- en netwerkverwante voorvalle. Installeer, konfigureer, onderhou en ontfout bedieners, lessenaars, skootrekenaars, drukkers en randapparatuur. Ondersteun en onderhou netwerkinfrastruktuur, insluitend skakelaars, roeters, Wi-Fi en gestruktureerde kabelwerk. Administreer gebruikersrekeninge, toestemmings en toegang op Active Directory en Microsoft 365-tenant. Ondersteun en monitor ICT-stelsels, bedieners, eindpuntbeskerming en rugsteunoplossings. Voer roetine-stelselonderhoud uit en pas goedgekeurde opdaterings en pleisters toe. Bystand verleen met die implementering van ICT-projekte, infrastruktuur-opgraderings en departementele inisiatiewe. Monitor LAN-prestasie en beskikbaarheid, ontfout netwerkprobleme en implementeer regstellende maatreëls om onbedroegtyd te verminder en optimale netwerkprestasie te verseker. Voer datarugsteune en stelselrampherstel uit. Implementeer en handhaaf netwerksekuriteitskontroles, insluitend VLAN-konfigurasie, toegangskontrollyste en segmentering om departementele data en hulpbronne te beskerm.

zu.title: Umlobi Ophakeme Wobuchwepheshe Bolwazi
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umlobi Ophakeme We-IT e-Department of Social Development e-Polokwane ukunikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe, ukugcina inzakwoxumumaniso kanye nesinxulumisi sezinsiza nokulungisa izinkinga zehadwe kanye nesofthiwe.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesifundo esifanele esingasinga le-6 se-NQF kwi-Computer Science / Information Technology noma isifundo esilingana kuleyo ndawo noma imikhakha njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani okuhlolwayo okungu-2-3 eminyakeni. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngemidudu yedeskithophu kanye namaseva kwe-Microsoft Windows, okuhlanganisa i-Microsoft 365. Ulwazi ngenzulwa yoxhumano: i-LAN/WAN, i-TCP/IP, ukubhuka umzila, ukushintsha kanye ne-Wi-Fi. Ulwazi nge-Active Directory, ukuphathwa kwama-akhawunti abasebenzisi kanye ne-Group Policy. Izikhono zokufaka, ukumisa, nokulungisa izinkinga zehadwe kanye nesofthiwe. Ulwazi ngemigomo ehle yokuvikeleka kwamakhompyutha kanye nokuphatwa kwenkonzo ye-IT. Izikhono ezinamandla zokuxazulula izinkinga, zokuqhathanisa, zokuxhumana kanye nzenkonzo zabathengi. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimele nangempumelelo eqenjini. Zidingwa izikhono ezinamandla zokuxazulula izinkinga ngokuhlola, zokuxhumana ezinhle, kanye nokusebenza ndawonye.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe yansuku zonke kubasebenzisi ngehhadwe, isofthiwe, kanye nemithefana yokuxhumano. Faka, misa, gcina futhi ulungise izinkinga zamaseva, amadeskithophu, amalaptopu, abaphrinti kanye nezinsiza ezingezona eziyisisekelo. Sekela futhi ugcine inzakwoxhumano, okuhlanganisa okushintshwayo, ababhiyo bamazila, i-Wi-Fi, kanye nokuhlinzeka kabusha ngamakhebhu. Phatha ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, izimvume kanye nongenelelo kwi-Active Directory kanye naku-Microsoft 365 tenant. Sekela futhi ulawule izimiso ze-ICT, amaseva, ukuvikelwa kwezinqamuleli kanye nezixazululo zokulondolozwa. Yenza ukugcinwa kwemiso okuyisisekelo futhi usebenzise izibuyekezo kanye nezilungiso ezivunyiwe. Siza ekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlelo ze-ICT, ukuthuthukiswa kwenzakwoxhumano, kanye nezinhloso zomnyango. Lawula ukusebenza nokutholakala kwe-LAN, lungisa izinkinga zokuxhumano, futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ukunciphisa isikhathi esingasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okuhle kwezokuxhumano. Yenza ukulondolozwa kwemininingwane kanye nokuqeda kwezimiso ngesikhathi kwezinhlekelelo. Setha futhi ugoqe izilawulo zokuphepha kwezokuxhumano, okuhlanganisa ukumiswa kwe-VLAN, uhlu lokulawula ukungena, kanye nokuqoqa ukuze uvikele imininingwane nezinsiza zomnyango.

Amandla okusombulula iingxaki, okuhlola, okunxibelelana nokukonza abathengi. Amandla okusebenza kodwa nendlela echanekileyo kwind iqela. Kufuneka ubekho amakhono amabalisa okusombulula iingxaki ngokuchanekileyo, okunxibelelana kakuhle, nokusebenzisana.

Faka, misa, gcina kwaye usombulule iingxaki kwiiseva, iidesktop, iilaptops, iiprinta kwaye nasezixhobo ezingezizo ezingundoqo. Nceda kwaye ugcine ulwakhiwo lwenethiwekhi, kuquka ukutshintsha, ukuyeka umzila, i-Wi-Fi, kunye nokuqhelanisa iikhebho. Nceda kwaye ulinde iinkqubo ze-ICT, iiseva, ukhuselwa kwi-endpoint kunye nezisombululo zokwenza ikopi. Yenza izigqibo zokusetyenziswa kwemihla ngemihla kweenkqubo kwaye usebenzise izihlaziyo ezivunyiweyo kunye namaphesha. Nceda nokusebenzisa iiprojekthi ze-ICT, uhlaziyo lolwakhiwo, kunye nemiqathango yesebe. Linda inkqubo ye-LAN yemigaqo kwaye ujule iingxaki zenethiwekhi, kwaye usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa ukunciphisa ithuba lokungasasebenzi kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo kwenethiwekhi. Yenza iikopi zedatha nokuphinda ubuyise inkqubo kwimeko yohlangothi. af.title: Maatskaplike Werker Graad 1
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker benodig om berading, assessering en ondersteuningsdienste te bied aan kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe in die Mopani-distrik. Registrasie by SACSSP word vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Baccalaureus-graad in Maatskaplike Werk soos deur SAQA erken. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Geldige motorvoertuigbestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede).Kennis en vaardighede: Assessering vaardighede, evalueringsmetodes en -prosesse; Raamwerk vir die toesig van maatskaplike werkers; Maatskaplike werk-wetgewing; Maatskaplike werk-teorie en ingrypings; Inligting en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings) vaardighede; Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid; Organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede; Projekbeplanningsvaardighede; Psigososiale ingryping vaardighede; Verslagdoening; Voorlegging en fasiliteringsvaardighede; diagnostiese en analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede; Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntefokusvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag, die sosiale stelsel en vaardighede om in te gryp op 'n punt waar mense met hul omgewinginterakteer ten einde hul welsyn te bevorder. Kennis van program- en projekbestuursvaardighede. Inligtings- en kennisbestuursvaardighede. Menslike bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kommunikasie en koördinasievaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer maatskaplike werkdienste met betrekking tot die sorg, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe. Bied individuele en groepberading. Voer gevorderde en gespesialiseerde assessering uit wat gemik is daarop om toestande te identifiseer en relevante ingryping te regverdig. Implementeer die aanbevelings oor die toepaslike ingryping wat vereis word om in die behoeftes te voorsien en verskaf deurlopende ondersteuning. Skep en handhaaf rekords van maatskaplike werk-ingrypings, prosesse en uitkomste. Onderneem maatskaplike werk-navorsing en -ontwikkeling, dra by tot en help met die ontwikkeling van beleide. Voer alle administratiewe funksies uit wat vir die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezomphakathi Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wezomphakathi ukuthi ahnikeze ngcebiso, ukuhlola, kanye nesevisi yokusekela abantu abasengozini, imindeni, kanye namaphakathi e-Mopani District. Kudingeka abhalise ku-SACSSP.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 kanye nend degree eyi-Bachelor ku-Social Work njengoba eqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile).Ulwazi Namasikhathi: Amakhono okuhlola, izindlela nezinqubo zokuqinisekisa; Isikhokelo Sokugada abasebenzi bezomphakathi; Umthetho we-Social Work; Incazelo nokungenelela kwe-Social Work; Ukuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi; Iphrothokholi kanye nethekhi yomsebenzi; Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe kanye nokukhulunwa); Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono ohlelo lokuhlela nokuhlela amaphulo; Amakhono okuhlela amaphulo; Amakhono okungenelela ngokomqondo; Ukubhala imibiko; Amakhono okubamba iqhaza nokuthuthukisa; amakhono okuhlola, ukuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga; Amakhono okuqondiswa kuklayenti nogxilile kumthengi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuziphatha komuntu, uhlelo lomphakathi namakhono okungenelela lapho abantu bexhumana nomhlaba wabo ukuze bakhusuze impilo yabo. Ulwazi ngamakhono okuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphulo. Amakhono okuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi. Amakhono okukhululeka abantu. Amakhono wokuxhumana nokucoordinateda.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi yomsebenzi wezomphakathi ngokuqhathaniswa nokunakekelwa, ukuvikelwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni namaphakathi. Nikeza ngengcebiso yomuntu ngamunye kanye namaqembu. Qhuba ukutholwa okuthuthukisiwe okugxile ekuqoqeni izimo futhi ulenze izimo zokungenelela. Thumela izincomo ezengeziwe zokungenelela okufunekayo ukuze kuhlangatshelwe izidingo futhi kunikezwe inkxaso ethize. Qamba futhi ulondoloze umbhalo wokungenelela, izinqubo nemiphumela. Yenza ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi wezomphakathi, wengeze futhi usize ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo. Yenza wonke umsebenzi wezokuphathwa ophelele.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokuncedisa Wabantu Bokuqela inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka kugqithiswe umsebenzi wokuncedisa abantu ukuze kubekho ingcebiso, iqondo lokulinganisa kunye namacebo okuxhasa abantu abasemngciphekweni, imindeni nakumazwe amabini apha Mopani District. Kufuneka ubhaliswe kwi-SACSSP.
xh.requirements: I-Grede 12 kunye nesidanga se-Bachelor's kwimiSebenzi YokuNcedisa abantu njengoko kbonwa yi-SAQA. Ubhaliso lwangoku kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP]. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba igazi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Ulwazi Namakhono: Amakhono okulinganisa, iindlela neenkqubo zokuqwalasela; Inqqaku loLawulo lomSebenzi wokuNcedisa abantu; IMithetho yokuLawula umSebenzi wokuNcedisa abantu; Iminikelo nokuqonda ngeNkqubo nokusebenzisa ukuncedisa abantu; Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kolwazi; Imithetho yolwazi nemithetho yobugcisa; Amakhono ebhalwe nokuwetha ebuzayo; Ukuziqhelisa ekwenzi amacebo; Ukuyila amaphulo; Amakhono okulinganisa iziganeko zobuchule; Amaxwebhu okubhala; Amakhono okubonisa nakwemisebenzi yosasazo; Amakhono okubona izifo, ukuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki; Amakhono okusinika isikhokelo kuluntu nokuziphatha kumthengi. Ukuziqhelisa ekwenzeni imisebenzi ngekhompyutha. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngendlela abantu abakwenza ngayo imisebenzi yabo, iindlela ezifana neenkqubo zoluntu nokuba nakho ukuncedisa abantu kwelixa elithile apho bathetha nento ezibavela ndawonye ukuze bakhuseleke. Ulwazi ngokulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngeendlela zokulawula iinkqubo zamaphulo. Amakhono okubakhuthaza abantu. Amakhono okuthetha nokuqoqisa imisebenzi.
xh.duties: Kufuneka kwenziwe imisebenzi yokuncedisa abantu enxulumene nokukhathalela, ukhuselo nophuhliso labo abasemngciphekweni abangabantu, iqela, imindeni nentlango. Kufuneka kubekho ingcebiso abayibuzayo nokuthi ixabisa imindeni. Kufuneka kuqwalaselwe ngokuzenzekela kakuhle iziganeko ukuze kubonwe imeko yalowo bani nokuzobe kubekho iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuzezelwa. Kufuneke kusettyenziswe inkqubo efanekiswe ngokwemfuno yabantu ngokulawula iingxaki ezinkosi kunye nokuxhasa. Kufunekwe ukuba kubhaliwe izinto zenziwe ngezixa elongezelelweyo, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nemiphumela yemisebenzi yokuncedisa abantu. Kufunekwe ukuba lungelelwano lolwazi ngokuphandwa ngokwemisebenzi yokuncedisa abantu, kwaye incedisane nokuqonda ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngokomthetho wemisebenzi yonke ekufunekayo yalonto oyenzayo.

af.title: Hoofregistratureklerk: Personeeldossier
af.summary: Bestuur personeelsregistratuur en rekordbestuursdienste by die Department of Social Development-hoofkantoor in Polokwane.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike erkende NQF-vlak 4 (Graad 12) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasies soos deur SAQA erken. Kwalifikasies/sertifikaat in Rekords en Argiewe sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar se ondervinding in Personeelsrekords/Registratuur. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van registratuurpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van berging, onttrekking, argivering en vernietigingsprosedures ingevolge die Wetgewende Raamwerk wat rekords regeer. Kennis van die Best Practice Model vir personeelsrekords.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf personeelsregistratuur-toonbankdienste. Bestuur die hantering van inkomende en uitgaande korrespondensie. Bestuur en lewer 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuursdiens. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne/personeel.

zu.title: Umphathi Womkhando Oveya: Irekodi Yabasebenzi
zu.summary: Qaphisani ngemisebenzi yomkhando kanye nezinsizakalo zokuphathwa kwarekhodi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Social Development ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele ezivunyiwe ezingeni le-NQF level 4 (Grade 12) noma iziqu ezingalingana njengoko zivotwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu/Isitifikedi kuma-Records and Archives kuyoba yinzuzoengeziwe. Okungenani umfutho weminyaka engu-3-5 wemisebenzi kuma-Personnel Records/Registry. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto. (ngaphandle kwezimpimizi ezinesikhalazo). Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomkhando, izinqubo kanye nokuqonda ukuyifaka idatha, futhi usebenzise ikhomphyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kanye neqondo ngesakhiwo somthetho esibusiswa ku-Public Service. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa, ukukhiphwa, ukugcinwa kubuhlotshisi kanye nezinqubo zokulahleka ngesakhiwo somthetho esibusa amarekhodi. Ulwazi nge-Best Practice Model ngamarekhodi abasebenzi.
zu.duties: Qaphisani futhi ninike izinsizakolo zomkhando wesikhashana. Qaphisani ukuphathwa kwezincwadi ezingenayo neziphumayo. Qaphisani futhi nibe nesibopho ngokugqamwa okusebenzayo kanye nensizeni yokuphathwa kwarekhodi. Qaphisani ukusebenza kanye nokusebenzisa izinsimbi zehhovisi ukuthi zihambisane nensiza yomkhando wabasebenzi. Qaphisani ukulungiselelwa kwezincwadi zokugcinwa ubuhlotshisi noma/ukulahleka. Qaphisani imithombo yezinsiza zabantu/abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umntu Ophethe Isebe Lefayile: Irekhodi Labasebenzi
xh.summary: Phatha iinkonzo zolawulo lwefayile namarekhodi abasebenzi kwintloko yesebe leDepartment of Social Development ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivunywe njengoNQF level 4 (Grade 12) okanye izifundo ezingqamile njengoko zivunywa yiSAQA. Izifundo/Izatifikedi kwiRecords and Archives ziba luncedo. Amava amabalwa angu3-5 kwimisebenzi yePersonnel Records/Registry. Ilayisenisi yokushayela emotokile esemthethweni. (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi Nobugcisa: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yefayile, iinkqubo kunye nokuqonda ukugcina ulwazi, nokusebenza ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo kaWonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokugcina, ukubuyela kwamaxoki, ukugcina iifayile zembali nokuwasula ngokomthetho oLawula irekhodi. Ulwazi ngeBest Practice Model ekurekhodweni labasebenzi.
xh.duties: Phatha kwaye unikeze iinkonzo zedesha yefayile yabasebenzi. Phatha ukuphathwa kweekhondivesi ezingenayo n ezithimelayo. Phatha kwaye unikeze inkonzo ephumelelayo yokugcina iifayile nolawulo lwerekhodi. Phatha ukuqhutywa kwaye uqhube iimashini zofice malunga nomsebenzi wefayile yabasebenzi. Phatha ukuqhelaniswa kwamaxatshwebyiweyo bokugcina iifayile n okwasula. Phatha abantu abasebenzayo/abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Provisioning Administrative Officer: Demand & Acquisition
jobs.summary: Provisioning administrative officer handling demand and acquisition at the Mopani District Office, requiring an NQF 6 qualification and SCM experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification at NQF 6 in Financial Management / SCM / Procurement Management / Logistics or equivalent qualification in the relevant field or area as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 1-2 years experience in Supply Chain Management. Valid motor vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge And Skills: Knowledge of the Supply Chain Management framework, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Treasury Regulation, Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE) and other relevant prescripts.
jobs.duties: Provide regular status/progress reports to management highlighting trends, problems, risks, deviations, delays and make appropriate recommendations for improvement. Determine possible future need for service by conducting a gap analysis. Manage and maintain the database of all suppliers. Ensure quality reporting on sourcing of goods and services. Consolidate procurement plan based on inputs from various units. Capacity building to all users on new procedures or systems implemented for the purpose of needs and market analysis. Assist with the development of acquisition plan or strategy. Purchase goods and services that meet users’ requirements. Ensure that contractual obligations are met to administer the flow of orders as well as ensuring that all orders are invoiced. Receive and process requisition. Ensure that the Service Level Agreements are met. Monitor and make Quality Assurance of the incoming and outgoing requisition. Ensure that requisitions are in line with the BEE as well as the South African Vendor Market.

af.title: Voorsieningsadministratiewe beampte: Vraag en Verkryging
af.summary: Voorsieningsadministratiewe beampte wat vraag en verkryging by die Mopani Distrikkantoor hanteer, met 'n NQF 6-kwalifikasie en SCM-ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF 6 in Finansiële Bestuur / SCM / Inkoopsbestuur / Logistiek of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die toepaslike veld of area soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 1-2 jaar ervaring in Toeskettingbestuur. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir 'n motorvoertuig (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van die Toeskettingbestuur-raamwerk, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), Treasury Regulation, Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE) en ander relevante voorskrifte.
af.duties: Verskaf gereelde status-/vorderingsverslae aan bestuur wat tendense, probleme, risiko's, afwykings en vertragings uitlig en maak toepaslike aanbevelings vir verbetering. Bepaal moontlike toekomstige behoefte aan diens deur 'n gaping-ontleding uit te voer. Bestuur en onderhou die databasis van alle verskaffers. Verseker gehalte-verslagdoening oor die broning van goedere en dienste. Konsolideer die inkoopplan op grond van insette van verskeie eenhede. Kapasiteitsbouing aan alle gebruikers oor nuwe prosedures of stelsels wat geïmplementeer is vir die doel van behoefte- en markontleding. Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling van 'n verkrygingsplan of -strategie. Koop goedere en dienste wat aan gebruikers se vereistes voldoen. Verseker dat kontraktuele verpligtinge nagekom word om die vloei van bestellings te administreer asook om te verseker dat alle bestellings gefaktureer word. Ontvang en prosesseer requsisies. Verseker dat die Diensvlakooreenkomste nagekom word. Monitor en doen Kwaliteitsversekering van inkomende en uitgaande requsisies. zu.summary: Inkulu yophatho emlawulo ephatha isidingo nokuthola eMopani District Office, idinga izifundo ezinga le-NQF 6 namava e-SCM.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele okulingana ne-NQF 6 ku-Financial Management / SCM / Procurement Management / Logistics noma isiqu esilinganayo endaweni noma inkambu ehlobene esesabhalwe yi-SAQA. Amava okungenani unyaka o-1-2 e-Supply Chain Management. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba imoto esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abasikhohlwe ukuba khona). Ulwazi Nemakhono: Ulwazi ngohlelo lwe-Supply Chain Management, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA), i-Treasury Regulation, i-Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE) neminye imithetho ephathelene nalokhu.
zu.duties: Nikeza imibiko evamile yesimo/phambili kubaphathi ethwasa izimo, izinkinga, amathuba, ukwehluka, ukubambezela futhi unikeze izindikimba ezifanele zokuthuthukisa. Hlola isidingo esingenzeka esikhathini esizayo ngokwenza ukuhloliswa kobulemi. Phatha futhi ulondoloze idathabheyisi yabo bonke abahlinzeki. Qinisekisa ukubika ikhwalithi kokutholwa kwezimpahla nezinkonzo. Hlanganisa uhlelo lokuthenga ngokusekelwe kumasukathi avela kumayunithi ahlukene. Ukwakhiwa amakhono kubo bonke abasebenzisi ngemithetho entsha noma izinhlelo ezisetshenziswe ngenhloso yokuhlola isidingo nokuhlola imarike. Siza ngokuqhakambisa uhlelo noma isu lokuthola. Thenga izimpahla nezinkonzo ezhuzisa izidingo zabasebenzisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izibopho zesivumelwano seziqaliswe ukuze kuphathe ukugeleza kwezimiyalelo kanye nokuthi wonke amamyalelo axoshwe ngesikweleti. Yamukla futhi ucubungule isicelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izivumelwano zezizinga zesevisi zihambiswe. Landa futhi wenze ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi kumasukashi anosuki. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasukashi ahambisana ne-BEE kanye ne-South African Vendor Market.

xh.title: Ofisa Wopelo Lwemisebenzi Elohlukeneyo: Isicelo & Ulwazi lokuthenga
xh.summary: Ofisa wolawulo wokubonelela ophatha isicelo nolwazi lokuthenga kwiOfisi yoMmandla we-Mopani, ofuna ngokwesimemo samabanga esithi NQF 6 nolwazi lomsebenzi kwi-SCM.
xh.requirements: Qaba ngu Grade 12 ongakwazi ukuzonke isiqu esifanelekile esingango NQF 6 kwiluntu Lokulawula Imali / SCM / Ulawulo Lokuthenga / Ukuphathwa kolwazi lokuthenga okanye isiqu esilinganayo kwelinye igunya elifanelekile njengoko kugcinwe yi-SAQA. Zingaphi kwiminyaka eling 1-2 ubudala obudlulileyo ngolwazi Iwi-Ukwenza Ulwazi Lokuthenga. Ifayile yokushayela inethanga ekhoyo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukuba ulwazi Iwakithatha ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi Iokuthenga, umthetho wokulawulwa kwimali yoluntu (PFMA), umthetho wolulwazi loathenga ngokugqwesa (PPPFA), urhocyzo Iolwabiwo-mali, umthetho wokubonelela amatyala malunga noluntu Iwabantu abamnyama abangenanto yokungathanga (B-BBEE) nakwezinye ipeo ezikwizinga.
xh.duties: Ungaze unike iingxelo zoluvo Iokwanda Iwenzele nengqeqesho ebonelela ngokuqhubela phambili kwioluntu Iwehlabathi noluvo Iokuthi kuqhuba kolwazi Ioluthengwayo kwiimeko zokuthengisa Iolulawulo uluntu Iukudlula Iolwazi Iokuthengisa Iolulawulo kolwazi Iokulawula amanani.

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyn Vlak 1
af.summary: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingspraktisyns word in verskeie Limpopo-distrikte benodig om geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies met belanghebbendes te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF 6 of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Ontwikkelingstudies / Diakoniologie / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Gemeenskapsontwikkeling / Sosiologie / Bevolkingstudies / Demografie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike veld of gebied soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk, vaardighede, houdings en waardes van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van menslike gedrag, sosiale stelsels en tersaaklike wetgewing. Die vermoë en bevoegdheid om gemeenskapsontwikkelingsstrukture te koördineer. Die vermoë om individue en groepe te beïnvloed om aan selfbemagtigingsondernemings deel te neem. Begrip van sosiale dinamika van gemeenskappe. Kennis en begrip van basiese finansiële bestuur. Aanbiedingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede. Projektbestuur.
af.duties: Identifiseer en fasiliteer die implementering van geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in samewerking met die gemeenskap en ander tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Werk saam en skakel met tersaaklike rolspelers en belanghebbendes om vennootskappe te vestig om die volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker. Ondersteun gemeenskappe en verrig administratiewe ondersteuning oor gemeenskapsontwikkeling en verwante aktiwiteite. Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die gemeenskapsontwikkelingsveld om dienslewering te verbeter.

zu.title: Umuntu osethenjweyo Ophatha Inhuthuko Yamiphakathi Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Abantu osethenjweyo abaphatha inhuthuko yamiphakathi bafunwa emasin' amanengi a Limpopo ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zenhuthuko yamiphakathi eziyinhlanganisela nabahlall kanye nabalawuli.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nelayisense yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nobukhoni bokusebenza nhuthuko yamiphakathi, amakhono, izinkalo nezigaba zamiphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, izinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nemiqulu ephathelene. Ikhono nobukhoni bokuhlanganisa izakhiwo zenhuthuko yamiphakathi. Ikhono lokuthinta abantu bukhulu nabakhu kokuziphakamisa. Ukuqonda izinguquko zemiphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali. Amakhono okubukhombisa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxoxa ngomlomo nangombhalo. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono ocwaningwayo. Ukuphatwa kwephrojekthi.
zu.duties: Bona futhi khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zenhuthuko yamiphakathi eziyinhlanganisela ngokubambisana nomphakathi kanye nabalawuli abahle. Hlanganyela futhi uxhumane nabahlanganyeli abaphathelene ukwakha ubudlelwano ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zenhuthuko ziphila isikhathi eside emphakathini. Sekele imiphakathi futhi unikeze inkxaso yolawu kwezinhlelo zenhuthuko yamiphakathi nakwezinye izindaba. Zinake izinto ezisha ohlelweni lwenhuthuko yamiphakathi ukuze kuthuthuke isisekelo sezinsiza.

xh.title: Umpracthisa woPhuhliso lweMiphakama inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka abapracthisa boPhuhliso lweMiphakama kummandla ongapheliyo weLimpopo ukwenzela ukucocwa kwezinyanzelo zoPhuhliso oluhlangenwe lwa lo mmandla kunye nabathathi nxaxheba.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ube neGrade 12 kanye nesidanga esifanelekileyo kwi-NQF 6 okanye isidanga esilinganayo kumzila woPhuhliso / kaDiakonoloji / wezeSayensi zeZentlalo / woPhuhliso loMphakama / kaSosiyoloji / woPhando lweZahlulo / kwiDemografi okanye isidanga esilinganayo kwimbono ekufaneleyo njengokuqatyiweyi yi-SAQA. Ifayidini yokuqhubaimoto (ngaphandle kwabo bamele bathwale ugonyazelo). Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi woPhuhliso oluhlangenwe lwa loMphakama, ngamakhono, imimoya kunye nendlela ababukho ngayo amaphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuziphatha kwabantu, izendlela zentlalo kunye nemithetho echanekileyo. Ikhono namandla okuhlanganisa iindalo ezithintela ekuphuhlisweni komphakama. Ikhono lokunika amandla aba ngabanye kunye neqela ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kumaprojekthi aziphuhlisa. Ukuqonda ngamandla antlalo amaphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngolawulo lweemali elisisiseko. Amanyathelo okubonisa ekubeni ukwazi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amanyathelo okubonisa ekubeni ukwazi. Amanyathelo okubonisa ngomlomo. Amanyathelo okukhuthaza ekubeni ukwazi. Amanyathelo okucinga. Ulawulo lwamaprojekthi.
xh.duties: Ziva aze acocwe ukusetyenziswa kwezinyanzelo zoPhuhliso oluhlangenwe lwa loMphakama ngokubambisana nomMphakama kunye nabanye abathathi nxaxheba abakade bakhoyo. Zoba baphathisane nitshintsane nemidlali echanekileyo nabathathi nxaxheba bokuzisa iindibano ezibumba abathathi-nxaxheba ukuqinisekisa ukuba okusenziwa kuphuhlisa komphakama kokunye kusahlala kunjalo ngokuhamba kwexesha. Nceda amaphakathi wenze oovimba ezinkonzo ezingekho mdla kuPhuhliso lomMphakama. Ziqwalaselwe iindaba ezintsha ezikwinkalo yoPhuhliso lomMphakama ukwandisa ukusebenza ngenkonzo.

jobs.summary: Legal Administration Officer at the Department of Social Development Head Office in Polokwane, requiring an LLB degree and five years of relevant legal experience.

A minimum of 5 years’ experience after obtaining the degree. Valid motor vehicle driver’s license (with the exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge And Skills: Sound knowledge of South African legal system and applicable legislation relevant to social development. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Legal drafting and interpretation skills. Strong administrative and organizational skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). af.title: Regstaatsadministrasiebeampte
af.summary: Regstaatsadministrasiebeampte by die Department of Social Development Hoofkantoor in Polokwane, wat 'n LLB-graad en vyf jaar se tersaaklike regsonderwindening vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Regte (LLB) of 'n gelykwaardige tersaaklike kwalifikasie in die verwante veld of gebied soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring na die behaling van die graad. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel en toepaslike wetgewing wat op sosiale ontwikkeling betrekking het. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Regsopstel- en interpretasievaardighede. Sterk administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Analitiese vaardighede. Geskilbeslegting. Regsnavorsering. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Beleidsontleding- en interpretasievaardighede.
af.duties: Stel wetlike dokumente op, redigeer en/of hersien dit, insluitend kontrakte, memorandummen, menings en korrespondensie. Verskaf regsondersteuning by die interpretasie en toepassing van tersaaklike wetgewing, insluitend die Grondwet, die Children's Act, die Older Persons Act en die Social Assistance Act. Help met die voorbereiding van regsmenings en advies vir departementele eenhede. Bestuur en onderhou regsgevalldossiers en -rekords. Help met die hantering van litigasiesake wat die Department in samewerking met die Staatshprokureur se kantoor betrek. zu.title: Inkulu Yabaphathi Bezomthetho
zu.summary: Inkulu Yabaphathi Bezomthetho eDepartment of Social Development Head Office ePolokwane, edinga iziqu ze-LLB kanye neminyaka emihlanu yomsebenzi ohambisana nomthetho.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye neziqu ze-Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB) noma iziqu ezingevana ezihambisana nendawo edingekayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani unyaka lobudala obungu-5 beminyaka yomsebenzi emva kokuthola iziqu. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba imoto esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubeke). Ulwazi Nezikhono: Ulwazi oluzo ngomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika nomthetho ohambisana nentuthuko yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngomthetho i-Public Finance Management Act. Izikhono zokubhala nokuhumusha izixhumanisi zomthetho. Izikhono ezinzima zokuphatha futhi zokuhlela. Ukuxhumana okuhle ngemibhalo nangomlomo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nangaphansi kwegcobo. Izikhono zokuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izingxabano. Ucwaningo lomthetho. Izikhono zokuphatha imiklamo. Izikhono zokuhlaziya nokuhumusha izinqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Bhala, hlela futhi/noma ubuke izixhumanisi zomthetho kubandakanya izinkontileka, okumbhalo-ndikho, imibono, kanye nokubhalelana. Nikeza ngokwesekwa komthetho ekuhumusheni nokusebenzisa umthetho ohambisana nawo, kubandakanya i-Constitution, i-Children's Act, i-Older Persons Act, kanye ne-Social Assistance Act. Siza ekulungiseni imibono kanye neluleko lomthetho emayunithi womnyango. Phatha futhi ulondoloze othafa bemicimbo yomthetho kanye namarekhodi. Sisa ekuphathweni kwezindaba zemikhaliphudo ehilelekile umnyango ngokuxhumana nekhonkco le-State Attorney. Seke izindaba zezinhlalo zomsebenzi kanye nezinkundla zolaka-olawu ngokulungisa imibhalo futhi usise ngokuhambisana nemigomo yomthetho. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenziweni komthetho nasekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo ezithinta umnyango. Yenza ucwaningo lomthetho ukuze useke imisebenzi ye-Legal Services Directorate. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana ne-PAIA, i-POPIA, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezibekiwe. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso zomthetho kanye neluleko ngaphakathi komnyango.

xh.title: Iofisa oluphathwayo ngomthetho
xh.summary: Iofisa oluphathwayo ngomthetho kwiNkundla eNkulu yeSebe lezeNzululwazi ePolokwane,elifuna izidanga ze-LLB namashumi amanu amahlanu eminyaka yamava ahambelana nomthetho.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zebanga lesi-12 kunye neNgqangqulu kwizifundo zoMthetho (LLB) okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esihambelana nendawo ethintekileyo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 emva kokufumana isidanga. Ilayisensi yomqhubi wemoto esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olulungileyo ngendlela yomthetho eNingizimu Afrika nakumthetho ohambelana nophuhliso lwentlalo. Ulwazi ngeMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Amakhono okubhala nokutolika imithetho. Amakhono amandla omlawulo nokuqhelanisa izinto. Unxibelelwano olubhalwayo nolwenziwa ngomlomo olumangalisayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook). Isakhono sokusebenza kodwa nangantsindiselo. Amakhono ohlalutyo. Ukuxazulula iingxabano. Uphando ngomthetho. Amakhono olawulo lweenkqubo. Amakhono ohlalutyo nokutolika iinkqubo.
xh.duties: Bhala, lungisa okanye phefa kwamaxwebhu omthetho kuquka iinkqubo, iimemorandam, iimvumbo, kunye nencwadana. Nikeza inkxaso yomthetho ekutolikweni nokusetyenziswa kwemithetho ehambelana nendawo, kuquka uMgaqo-siseko, uMthetho woBantwana, uMthetho woBantu abadala, nakuMthetho woNcedo loNtlalo. Ndiza ekulungiselelweni kweemvumbo kunye nengcebiso ngomthetho kumagumbi esebe. Lawula zigcine iifayile zamacala kunye neerekhodi. Ndiza ekuphathweni kwezindaba zamacala ezithinta iSebe kwindibano nendawo yoMmeli woMbuso. Xhasa amacala obudlelwane basesikweni namava esigqibo ngokulungiselela uxwebhu nangondisa ngokuhambelana nendlela echanekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zophuhliso komthetho namapholisi aphuma kwindawo ezithinta isebe. Yenza uphando ngomthetho ukuxhasa imisebenzi yeNkundla yeSebe loMthetho. Qinisekisa ukuhambelana ne-PAIA, i-POPIA, nakunye nolawulo olumiselweyo. Lilindele ukuphunyezelwa kokuqatshwe ngomthetho nangengcebiso ngaphakathi kwesebe.

jobs.title: Social Auxiliary Worker Grade 1
jobs.centre: Capricorn District: Botlokwa One Stop Centre
jobs.summary: Social auxiliary worker needed at Botlokwa One Stop Centre in Limpopo to support social workers in providing care and protection to vulnerable individuals and communities.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognized NQF level 4 (Grade 12) or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA and Social Auxiliary Certificate. Current registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social auxiliary worker. Knowledge And Skills: Demonstrate basic understanding of the South African social welfare context, the policy and practice of development social welfare services also the role of social auxiliary worker within this context. Define and demonstrate understanding of the purpose of social auxiliary work also with the role and functions of a social auxiliary worker in relation to a social worker within South African context. Consistently reflect the values and principles contained in the Bill of Rights, and social work profession’s Code of Ethics in service delivery as a social auxiliary worker. Demonstrate a basic understanding of the South African judicial system, the legislations governing and impacting on social auxiliary work and social work. Demonstrate a basic understanding of human behaviour, relationship system and social issues. Implement appropriate social auxiliary work methods and techniques to address the social needs of client system. Use appropriate resources in service delivery to client systems. Work effectively with social workers and members of multi-sectoral teams in social service delivery. Work effectively as a social auxiliary worker to address the special needs and problems experienced by at least 3 of the priority focus groups in the social welfare. Keep precise records and compile accurate reports on social needs and social auxiliary work activities and file them appropriately. Provide an efficient research and administrative support services to the social worker. Demonstrate basic knowledge of financial matters related to social auxiliary work. Demonstrate self-awareness regarding personal capacities, attitudes skills and willingness to develop them further under the supervision of a social worker.
jobs.duties: Provide assistance and support to social workers with the rendering of a social work service with regard to the care, support, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, groups, families and communities through the relevant departmental programmes. Assist social workers to attend to any other matters that could result in, or stem from, social instability in any form. Keep abreast with new developments in the social work and social services field. Perform administrative support functions in support of social workers as required of the job.

af.summary: Sosiale hulpwerker benodig by Botlokwa One Stop Centre in Limpopo om sosiale werkers te ondersteun in die verskaffing van sorg en beskerming aan kwesbare individue en gemeenskappe.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte erkende NQF vlak 4 (Graad 12) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, asook 'n Sosiale Hulpsertifikaat. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as sosiale hulpwerker. Kennis en vaardighede: Toon basiese begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse maatskaplike welsynkonteks, die beleid en praktyk van ontwikkelingsmaatskaplike welsynsdienste asook die rol van die sosiale hulpwerker binne hierdie konteks. Definieer en toon begrip van die doel van maatskaplike hulpwerk asook die rol en funksies van 'n sosiale hulpwerker in verhouding tot 'n sosiale werker binne die Suid-Afrikaanse konteks. Weerspieël deurlopend die waardes en beginsels vervat in die Bill of Rights en die sosiale werkberoep se Kode van Etiek in dienslewering as 'n sosiale hulpwerker. Toon 'n basiese begrip van die Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel, die wetgewing wat maatskaplike hulpwerk en maatskaplike werk beheer en daarop inwerk. Toon 'n basiese begrip van menslike gedrag, die verwantskapsisteem en maatskaplike kwessies. Implementeer toepaslike metodes en tegnieke vir maatskaplike hulpwerk om die maatskaplike behoeftes van die kliëntstelsel aan te spreek. Gebruik toepaslike hulpbronne in dienslewering aan kliëntstelsels. Werk doeltreffend saam met sosiale werkers en lede van multisektorale spanne in maatskaplike dienslewering. Werk doeltreffend as 'n sosiale hulpwerker om die spesiale behoeftes en probleme wat deur ten minste 3 van die prioriteitsfokusgroepe in die maatskaplike welsyn ervaar word, aan te spreek. Hou noukeurige rekords en stel akkurate verslae oor maatskaplike behoeftes en maatskaplike hulpwerkaktiwiteite op en lê dit behoorlik weg. Verskaf doeltreffende navorsings- en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die sosiale werker. Toon basiese kennis van finansiële aangeleenthede wat verband hou met maatskaplike hulpwerk. Toon selfbewustheid rakende persoonlike vermoëns, gesindhede en vaardighede, en die bereidwilligheid om hulle onder toesig van 'n sosiale werker verder te ontwikkel.
af.duties: Verskaf bystand en ondersteuning aan sosiale werkers met die lewer van 'n maatskaplike werkdienste met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne en gemeenskappe deur middel van die tersaaklike departementele programme. Bied hulp aan sosiale werkers om enige ander aangeleenthede by te woon wat tot, of voortspruit uit, maatskaplike onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei. Hou tredes met nuwe ontwikkelinge in die veld van maatskaplike werk en maatskaplike dienste. Voer administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies uit ter ondersteuning van sosiale werkers soos deur die pos vereis.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womtholampelo Oncedwayo Izinga 1
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo e Botlokwa One Stop Centre e Limpopo ukuxhasa abasebenzi bomtholampelo ekunikeni inakekelo nokuvikela abantu abasengozini kanye nemiphakathi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezitholakalayo ezingeni le-NQF level 4 (Grade 12) noma iziqu ezilinganayo njengoba ziyaziwa yi-SAQA kanye ne-Social Auxiliary Certificate. Ukuqinisekiswa okumanje ne-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo. Ulwazi Nekhono: Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomongo wemithombo yezomphilo emphakathini eNingizimu Afrika, inqubomgomo nokwenzakalo kwezinkonzo zomtholampelo zentuthuko kanye nendima yomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo kule mongo. Chaza futhi ukhombise ukuqonda ngomgomo womsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo kanye nendima nemisebenzi yomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo ebudlokweni nomsebenzi womtholampelo eNingizimu Afrika. Qhubeka ubonise amagugu nezimiso eziqukatwe kuBill of Rights, kanye ne-Code of Ethics yomsebenzi womtholampelo ekunikezeni inkonzo njengomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngosimithi wezabenkantolo eNingizimu Afrika, umthetho ohlawula nowonena kumsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo kanye nomsebenzi womtholampelo. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngokuziphatha kwabantu, isimiso sobuqhawe kanye nezinkinga zomphakathi. Setsha izindlela namakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo ukuze awaphathise izidingo zomphakathi zesimiso somthengi. Sebenzisa izinsiza ezifanelekile ekunikezeni inkonzo kumimango yabathengi. Sebenza ngempumelelo nabasebenzi bomtholampelo kanye namalungu eqenjji leminyakhi yamanye amaphiko ekunikezeni inkonzo yomphakathi. Sebenza ngempumelelo njengomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo ukuphatha izidingo ezikhethekile nezinkinga ezibhekwa okungenani ngamagumbi ama-3 okugxila okubalulekile emtholampelweni womphakathi. Gcina amarekhodu achazile futhi uhloze imibiko eqondile ngemfuneko yomphakathi kanye nemisebenzi yomtholampelo oncedwayo futhi uyifake endaweni efanele. Nikeza ngenkonzo yokuphenya nokuphatha okusebenzayo kumsebenzi womtholampelo. Khombisa ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemayelana nezimali nokuhlobene nomsebenzi womtholampelo oncedwayo. Khombisa ukuzazi ngamandla komuntu siqu, izinkalo namakhono kanye nokulungele ukuthi wazibekelela ngaphezulu ngaphansi kokuqondiswa komsebenzi womtholampelo.
zu.duties: Nikeza ngenkophe futhi uxhase abasebenzi bomtholampelo ekunikeni inkonzo yomtholampelo ngokunakekela, ukuxhasa, ukuvikela nentuthuko yabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni namaphakathi kusetshenziswa izinhlelo zomnyango ezihambisanayo. Siza abasebenzi bomtholampelo ukuba banakele eminye imibandwana ezingadala noma evela kungazinzi komphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo. Gcina ulwazi ngentuthuko ezinkundleni zomtholampelo kanye nezinkonzo zomphakathi. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha ukuze uxhase abasebenzi bomtholampelo njengoko kudingeka umsebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Womncedi Wentlalo Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umsebenzi womncedi wentlalo kwiZiko Lenkonzo Enye saseBotlokwa esiphuma kwisebe kwiLimpopo ukuxhasa abasebenzi bentlalo ekunikezeleni nokuqinisekisa inkonzo kubantu abaswatileyo nakumaphakambili.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezivunywe njengeNqanaba le-4 (Nqanaba 12) okanye iziqu ezilinganayo njengoko zivunywe yi-SAQA kunye neSatiﬁikate Yomncedi Wentlalo. Ukuqatshelwa okwangoku kuSouth African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo. Ulwazi Namakhono: Bonisa ukuqonda okusisiseko ngomthetho wemiba yentlalo yaseMzantsi Afrika, iinkqubela phambili kunye nemisebenzi yeenkonzo zentlalo ekuphuhliseni kwaye nendima yomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo kule meko. Chaza kwaye ubonise ukuqonda ngemGqoqo nomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo kwaye nendima kunye nemitsho yomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo enxulumene nomsebenzi wentlalo kumGqoqo waseMzantsi Afrika. Phinda ubonise amaxabiso namagunya aqukethe uMthetho Wamalungelo, kunye neKhowudi yeZigqiyo zomsebenzi wentlalo ekunikezeleni inkonzo njengomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo. Bonisa ukuqonda okusisiseko ngowona mtshato wamagunya eMzantsi Afrika, imithetho elawula nethintela kumsebenzi womncedi wentlalo kunye nomsebenzi wentlalo. Bonisa ukuqonda okusisiseko ngokuziphatha kwabantu, inkqubo yamathuba phakathi kwamakhaya kunye neenkqubo zentlalo. Sebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo namakhono wokuqalisa izicwangciso ukusombulula iimfuno zentlalo zomntu othingswayo. Sebenzisa amathuba afanelekileyo ekunikezeleni inkonzo kubathathi nkxaso kumntu othingswayo. Sebenza ngokusebenziseleyo nabasebenzi bentlalo kunye namalungu amaqela avela kumakhaya amaninzi ekunikezeleni inkonzo yentlalo. Sebenza ngokusebenziseleyo njengomsebenzi womncedi wentlalo ukusombulula iimfuno ezizodwa neengxaki ezihola ubomi babantu basebenzayo kwelungelo elingeniso lwa-3 kweqela eliphuhliswayo kule ndawo. Gcina imibalo ecacileyo yemisebenzi yakho yakudlula kwaye uphendule iimviwo ezibalulekileyo ngemfuno yomsebenzi wentlalo ekunikezelwa nkxaso kumntu othingswayo. Zeza ngenkxaso ecacileyo nolwazi ngemisebenzi entsha kumsebenzi wentlalo kunye nendawo yeenkonzo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuncedisa kwindawo yokulawula ukuze ixhase abasebenzi bentlalo njengoko kufunwa ngumsebenzi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso namathuba kubasebenzi bentlalo ekunikezeleni inkonzo yentlalo ngokunikela inkxaso, ukhuselo nokuphuhliswa koluntu kubantu abaswatileyo, amaqela, amakhaya nomaphakambili ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zesebe. Nceda abasebenzi bentlalo ukuba bakwazi ukujongana nasiphi na isigaba esinokubakho, okanye esingavela kwingxaki yentlalo nganoma ithiphi na indlela. Zise ngokulandela iziphuhliso ezintsha kumsebenzi wentlalo nasekuhambeni kwamaxa ethu kundwendwe lwabantu. Yenza imisebenzi yokuncedisa kwindawo yokulawula ukuze ixhase abasebenzi bentlalo njengoko kufunwa sisithuba.

af.title: Kind- en Jeugsorgwerker
af.summary: Kind- en jeugsorgwerkers gesoek vir fasiliteite in Polokwane en Thohoyandou, wat NQF level 4 en SACSSP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike erkende NQF level 4 (Grade 12) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, en Basiese kwalifikasie in Kindersorg. Huidige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP] as hulpkind- en jeugsorgwerker. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk (Children's Act, Child Care Act, Child Justice Act) wat die Secure Care Centers regeer. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, vermoë om druk te hanteer. Eerlikheid en vertroulikheid, kliëntesorgvaardighede.
af.duties: Ontvang kinders en jeug by die sorgfasiliteit na opname. Verskaf oriëntasie vir die kind by die sentrum. Verskaf sorg en ontwikkeling van kinders en jeug waar hul behoeftes beskerm word. Verseker dat kinders/jeug mediese dienste ontvang. Fasiliteer onafhanklike leef- en ontspanningsprogramme. Reël gesinsbesoeke en kontakte. Begelei kinders na eksterne dienste. Bied hulp met die implementering van ontwikkelings- en terapieprogramme. Voer administratiewe pligte uit.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokunakekelwa Kwabantwana Nabantu Abasha
zu.summary: Kufunwa abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha izikhungini ePolokwane naseThohoyandou, kudingeka ibe khona i-NQF level 4 nokubhaliswa kwi-SACSSP.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezaziwayo ze-NQF level 4 (Grade 12) noma iziqu ezingamuva njengoba zibonwa yi-SAQA kanye neziqu eziyisisekelo ezokunakekelwa kwabantwana. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP] njengomsebenzi ongemva ohlotshanwe nokunakekelwa kwabantwana nabantu abasha. Ulwazi Nobuhlakani: Ulwazi nokuqonda ingqungquthela yomthetho (Children’s Act, Child Care Act, Child Justice Act) ohlola izikhungo ze-Secure Care Centers. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle, Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, Ikhono lokubekezela ingcindezi. Ukwethembeka nokugcina imfihlo, amakhono okunakekelwa kabathengi.
zu.duties: Yamukela abantwana nabantu abasha esikhungweni sokunakekelwa ngemva kokwamukelwa. Nikeza umqondo wesikhungla umntwana. Nikeza inakekelo nokuthuthukisa abantwana nabantu abasha lapho izidingo zabo zivikelwa khona. Qinisekisa ukuthi abantwana/abantu abasha bathola izinsizakalo zezokwelapha. Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphila ngokuzimela kanye nezokuzilibazisa. Hlela izivakashi zomndeni nokuxhumana. Hambisa abantwana kwezinye izinsizakalo. Siza ekusebenziseni izinhlela zokuthuthukiswa kanye nezokwelapha. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokukhulisa Abantwana Nabantu Abadala
xh.summary: Kufunwa abasebenzi bokukhulisa abantwana nabantu abadala kumaziko ePolokwane naseThohoyandou, kufuneka inqanaba leNQF 4 neregistesho kwiSACSSP.
xh.requirements: Isifikelelo esifanelekileyo esivunyiweyo esininqanaba leNQF 4 (Grade 12) okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko sivunywa yiSAQA nokuqaliswa kokhondo kokukhulisa abantwana. Ukurejista kwangoku kwiSouth African Council for Social Service Professions [SACSSP] njengomsebenzi oncedisayo wokukhulisa abantwana nabantu abadala. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kohlakamthetho (Children’s Act, Child Care Act, Child Justice Act) olawula iindawo zokhondo olukhuselweyo. Amakhono amabalini okunxibelelwana, amaqhelo alungileyo oqhagamshelwano nabantu, ikhono lokubhekana nengcinezelo. Uqotho nokugcina iyimfihlo, amakhono okukhathalela abathengi.
xh.duties: Amkela abantwana nabantu abadala kwiziko lokhondo emva kokwamkelwa. Mnika umntwana isikhokelo malunga nendawo. Zinike ukhondo nentluko yabantwana nabantu abadala apho iimfuno zabo zikhuselwa khona. Qinisekisa ukuba abantwana/bantu abadala bafumana iinkonzo zonyango. Khokela iinkqubo zobomi obuzimeleyo nezokuzonwabisa. Lungisa iindwendwe zosapho nokunxibelelana.qhagamshela. Qhuba abantwana kwiinkonzo ezangaphandle. Ncedisa ekusebenzeni kweekqubo zentluko nongonyezo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo.

af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn (2026) (Independent Practice). zu.title: Izikhundla Zomhlekithiwe Zokwelapha Isikhundla 3
zu.summary: Izikhundla Zomhlekithiwe Zokwelapha Isikhundla 3 emitholampa emihlanu Kwisifunda sase-Ehlanzeni, kudingeka ibhakholari we-MBChB nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Ibhakholari ye-MBChB (izifundo) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha e-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuzijwayeza okuzimele). Isivumelwano esivumelekile sokusebenza sizodingeka kubantu abangebona abaNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi kahle ngokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuqondiswa kabanzi kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye namava endaweni ebalulekile yezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi akhatholayo wezempi lo nokwaziswa Komnyango kahulumeni. Amanye amava Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology kanye ne-ENT azoba yinconelo. Amakhono okweluleka, ukuthatha incazelo yomlando, ukuhlola, ukuqinisekisa ngokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kwesimo sezokwelapha. Isikhundla 3: Amava ambalwa eminyakeni eyishumi (10) emuva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha (Ukuzijwayeza okuzimele). Amava ahambisanayo eminyakeni eyishumi nanye (11) emuva kokubhaliswa kuleligidi elihloniphekwe lezokwelapha laphandle kanye noma i-HPCSA njengomunyazi wezokwelapha (Ukuzijwayeza okuzimele) kubasebenzi abathola izifundo ezingaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ukwazi kahle ngokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bezokwelapha. Ukuqondiswa kabanzi kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye namava endaweni ebalulekile yezokwelapha. Ulwazi lwangokwelapha oluhle, amakhono nakhono kumagatsha jikelele ezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokulawulwa njengilungu elisebenzayo leqembu. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana, ukuba ngumholi, okuhlobene nabantu, kanye nokuqondisa. Ikhono lokuphatha iziguli zonike, ngokuzifisela, ngobuleme kanye nokuqhathaniswa lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngamapholisi ezempilo akhatholayo, umthetho, izinhlelo kanye nezinto ebalulekile endaweni leyo. Ikhono lokufundisa,ukuqondisa abasebenzi abasha kumnyango. Iimpawu Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ekuhambeleni, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nakhono lokuakha kanye nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqeda imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngokusebenza kahle, ukusekela amabhuda kanye nemigomo yesikhungo ehambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kweziguli. Ukuzithathela isibopho sokuphathwa kwesiguli esingenele endaweni yenani 2/3 yesevisi. Ukusiza ekulungiseni kanye nokusebenzisa imibhalo namaphrothokholi. Ukuba yingxenye yezinhlelo zokufunda kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza ukubuyeza ngokwelapha kwesimilo kwenhlelo ekuthuthukiseni ngqo umsebenzi. Ukunika inkhaselo ebalulekile ekuqondiseni isibhedlela ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lenkonzo kanye nenkonzo yesiguli.

xh.title: Mganga Wobunqununu Inqanaba 3
xh.summary: Izithuba zikaMganga Wobunqununu Inqanaba 3 kumazibolwe amahlanu kwisebe le-Ehlanzeni District, efuna isidanga se-MBChB nokuqatshelwa kwi-HPCSA njengomprho wamazwe oluntu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBChB (isigqibo-sifundo) esivumela ukuqatshelwa kwi-HPCSA njengomprho wamazwe oluntu kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomprho wamazwe oluntu (2026) (Inkqubo yoqeqesho oluzimeleyo). Ipermiti yomsebenzi esemthethweni iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyo eMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngokuziphatha komthetho wezempilo. Ulawulo olunamacandelo amaninzi nokusebenza njeng iqela nobesipilo kumazwe apho weza kuzo obunqununu. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemithetho yamanqanaba aleyo yamva nyo yezempilo nokuKwinkonzo kaZwelonke. Amava angaphezulu kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology ne-ENT phantse kuba sisinduli. Amandla okuvela ngoncedo lwesiphakamiso, ukuthabatha imbali yomntu, ukuhlola, ukuvavanya ngokomthetho wamazwe oluntu nolawulo lokwazima. Inqanaba 3: Amava afunekayo amveni afikelela kwiminyaka elishumi (10) emva kokuqatshelwa kwi-HPCSA njengomprho wamazwe oluntu (Inkqubo yoqeqesho oluzimeleyo). Amava afunekayo amveni afikelela kwiminyaka elineshumi elinesinye (11) afanelekileyo emva kokuqatshelwa kumbutho wamazwe aphayo ohlonelwayo noko okanye i-HPCSA njengomprho wamazwe uluntu (Inkqubo yoqeqesho oluzimeleyo) kubasebenzi abavela kumazwe aphayo. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho nemisebenzi efunekayo: Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngokuziphatha komthetho wezempilo. Ulawulo olunamacandelo amaninji nokusebenza njeng iqela nobesipilo kulowo mazwe obunqunulu. Ulwazi lukliniki oluzinzileyo, amandla namakhono kumazwe akliniki jikelele. Amandla okusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengomsebenzi othembekileyo kwelungu leqela. Isiphatho esinzima, amandla okuzisa, ukuziphatha koluntu, nokuqonza nokulawula abantu. Amandla okuzimela ekulawulen abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzinikezel, ngenoxandulelo nokuba nombono xa kufuneka. Ulwazi lwezithintelo zamava nobucenga bamanqanaba alelayo kunwe nomthetho, iinkqubo nokuqwalasela phantsi kummandla. Amandla okufundisa, ukuyala abasebenzi abasezantsi kwisebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nengxubevexube, ukusebenza kwelundu lelali, uqina ngokwakho nokuakha nokuqhlekisisa ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuphunyeze amaxanduva nemisebenzi ngamandla, ukuze uxhase iinjongo neenjongo ebehlelo, ezingqamana nezinga lengxaki yomguli. Ukamathela iyourweather yoxanduva kulawulo labaguli abangenwe kufaslilith yekliniki yekliniki (level 2/3). Ukuncedisa kulungiselelo nokubeka kuphathe imibhalo nemithetho yokwenza. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokufunda nokuqeqesha. Ukuncedisa ngokutshintsha izinto kwinkqubo yovavanyo lwekliniki aze athabathe inxaxheba kuzinto ezintsha kwenkqubo yakho yoxanduva. Ukunika inkxaso ekulawuleni iibolwe ukwenzela ukuba linga elihle lokunyanzelwa kovakatshelwe lulawulo lwezempilo kusalelwe lilodwa.

zu.requirements: Ibachelore yeMBChB (iziqu) evumela ukugqamiswa neHPCSA njengodokotela wezempilo eHPCSA njengodokotela wezempila (2026) ngokuzimele ekwenzeni imisebenzi. Isivumelwano esisebenzayo sokusebenza sizodingwa kubantu abangewona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithethonkqubo yokuziphatha kwezempilo. Ukuphatwa kwezinto kabanzi nokusebenza njengosebenza ngamunye kanye nokuhamba phambili ngokuhlangenwe ngalo kwesikhundla esithile sezempilo. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi ajeke njalo ezempilo kanye nosebenza kahle zikahulumeni. Okunye ukuhamba phambili kungaba ukwaziswa ngesikhundla sokuqaliswa kokubeletha, ukwelapha izifundo ezithinta izilonda ezingangenwa ithemba, ukweluleza imitha kanye nokulawula ezigabeni ezingezwa futhi kungenwa futhi kubangele imisebenzi kungenzeka kwamukelwe. Amakhono ngokwelula, ukuthatha umlando wogulisayo, ukuvivinya, ukulinganisa ngokwezempilo, kanye nokuphathwa kwesimo sezempilo. Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhamba phambili emva kokuqaliswa ukuba lilunga leHPCSA njengodokotela wezempilo ngokuzimele ekwenzeni imisebenzi. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yokuhamba phambili emva kokuqaliswa kwelunga lekhanseli elisekwe emazwe ngaphandle noma / nangeHPCSA njengodokotela wezempilo ngokuzimele ekwenzeni imisebenzi kubasebenzi abathole iziqu emazweni aphesheya. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namakhono ayingqongqo azelelwe ukuthi adingekile: Ulwazi oluhle ngemithethonkqubo yokuziphatha kwezempilo. Ukuphatwa kabanzi nokusebenza njengosebenza ngamunye kanye nokuhamba phambili ngokuhlangenwe ngalo kwesikhundla esithile sezempilo. Ulwazi, ikakhono namakhono ayingqongqo ngokwezempilo kahle kahle. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokuhlolwa njengosebenza osebenza kahle eqenjini. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana, ukuphatha, nokuziphatha okuhle, namakhono okuhlola. Ikhono lokuphatha abagulisayo ngokuzimele, ngokuzifake emsebenzini ngokuziphatha okuhle, kanye nokubakholelana lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngamapholisi ezempilo, umthetho, izinhlelo, kanye nezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu ngaphakathi kwesikhundla. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukukhombisa abasebenzi abasesigabeni esingaphansi ngaphakathi kwesikhundla. Izici zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela engcindezini, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba, kanye nakhono lokwakha kanye nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nezimiso ngokuziphatha kahle, ukuze usize ngezinhloso nezimigomo zesikhungo ezihambisana nemingizo yokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukuzethemba ngokuphatha abagulisayo abangenwe esikhundleni esingu 2/3 sokuphathwa kwesevisi. Ukusiza ekulungiseleni nasekusebenziseni iminigizo namaphrotokholo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwezinhlelo ezimali nokuqeqeshwa. Ukusiza ngokuhlola izimpilo ngokuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni njalo ngokwemisebenzi. Ukunika isikhundla ekuphathweni kwesibhedlela ngokugcina imigizo nokuqinisekiswa kokunakekelwa kwesiguli nesevisi.

xh.title: I Ofisi Yezempilo Inqanaba 3
xh.summary: Izikhundla ze Ofisi Yezempilo Inqanaba 3 kwiZibedlele zaseWitbank naseKwaMhlanga eMpumalanga, ezifuna iziqu zeMBChB nokuqatshelwa kwiHPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zeMBChB (isifundo) ezivumela ukuqatshelwa kwiHPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo koBulungu beNgqungquthela beeNkonzo Zobuchwepheshe beZempilo eNingizimu Afrika (HPCSA) njengompraktisi wezempilo (2026) (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Ipermithi esebenzayo yomsebenzi izakufuneka kubantu abangeyo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi olululu ngokuziphatha kwamazinga obudokotela. Ukulawula kwabanganingi babantu kwaye basebenze njengorhwebo kunye namava kwelona candelo lezempilo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nakwezindulumiso zamanqanaba ezeeNkonzo zeZempilo nakwiZiko loLawulo kuqhubekayo. Amava angaphezulu kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology naku-ENT azakuthathwa njengesandi. Amakhono ngokupathwa nokubuzwa imibuzo, ukuthathwa kwembali, ukuvavanywa, ukulinganiswa kokwelwa kukho ukunyanga. Inqanaba 3: Amava amabalwe angaphantsi kwekhulu (10) iminyaka emva kokuqatshelwa kwiHPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Amava amabalwe angaphantsi kokulishumi nananye (11) iminyaka ephathelene nayo emva kokuqatshelwa kwikomiti yamanye amazwe eyaziwayo yokugqiba ngobuchwepheshe beempilo kwaye / noma iHPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele) kubasebenzi abagqibiwe kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuqondene okuFunekayo: Ulwazi olululu ngokuziphatha kwamazinga obudokotela. Ukulawula kwabanganingi babantu kwaye basebenze njengorhwebo kunye namava kwelona candelo lezempilo. Ulwazi lwamava okululu, ukuziphatha ngekhono namakhono kwemimandla evela kumaxhathso. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amakhono amahle okunyaniseka, abakhokeli, abantu kunye nokulawula. Ikhono lokunyanga abagulayo ngokuzimele ngokuzinikela, ngexanduva nokuthetha xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngamagunya ezempilo, izimiso, iinkqubo nezinto ebalulekileyo ngaphakathi kommandla. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukukhokela abasebenzi abasebutsha ngaphakathi kwesebe. Iimpawu zokuNzula: Ukuqhayisa inzondo, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, ukuzethemba nokuqondene namakhono omoya wokwakha ukulondolooza ubuhlobo obulunjalo.
xh.duties: Ukuze kusetyenziswe imisebenzi namagqabi ngokuchanekileyo, ukuxhasa iinjongo nezinto ezikujoliswe kuzo eSikhungo ezahambelana namazinga okunyanga iguli. Ukugqiba uxanduva lokulawula abaguli abangenisiwe kwifasilithi yesixa sephakathi inqanaba 2/3. Ukunceda ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahambelana neemigangatho yolawulo. Ukuthath inkxaxheba kweenkqubo ezifundwayo nokuqeqesho. Ukunceda ngokuphathwa kwamava ezempilo ukuthath inkxaxheba ngokusebenza kolwazi kwinkqubo ehamba phambili. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuba kugqitywe isixa esisebenzayo samazinga okunyanya iguli nesekonzo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 3
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 3 sought at Ermelo Hospital in Mpumalanga, requiring MBChB registration with HPCSA.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree (qualification) that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Additional experience in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology and ENT will serve as recommendation. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). A minimum of eleven (11) years relevant experience after registration with a recognised foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice) for foreign qualified employees. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge, competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work under supervision as an efficient team member. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and supervisory skills. Ability to manage patients independently, diligently, responsibility and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.
jobs.duties: To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the Institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services is maintained.
