af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 3
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 3 gesoek by Ermelo Hospital in Mpumalanga, wat MBChB-registrasie by HPCSA vereis.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practisy toelaat n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Practisy (2026) (Onafhanklike Praktyk). 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diensregulasies en -beleid. Bykomende ervaring in Verloskunde & Ginekologie, Neurochirurgie, Narkose, Urologie en KNO sal as aanbeveling dien. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Practisy (Onafhanklike Praktyk). 'n Minimum van elf (11) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessieraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practisy (Onafhanklike Praktyk) vir buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesigvaardighede. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig, verantwoordelik te bestuur en in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat in ooreenstemming is met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakketfasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning aan hospitaalbestuur verleen sodat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: I_Ofisi Yezokwelapha Izinga 3
zu.summary: Kufunwa I_Ofisi Yezokwelapha Izinga 3 esibhedlela i-Ermelo Hospital e-Mpumalanga, kudingeka ubhaliswe nge-MBChB ku-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB (isiqu) evumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomqambi Wezokwelapha Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomqambi Wezokwelapha (2026) (Independent Practice). Isivume sokusebenza esivunyiwe sizodingwa kubantu abangewona abakwaNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda okuhle ngezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye nolwazi ohlelweni lwezokwelapha ohlobene nalo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqubomgomo zamanje Yezempilo NezeSebenzo SikaZwe. Ulwazi olwengeziwe kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology kanye ne-ENT luzoba ukungeza okuhle. Amakhono mayelana nokubonisana, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukuhlola kwezokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kwezokwelapha. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yolwazi emva kokuqeqeshwa ku-HPCSA njengoMqambi Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yolwazi oluhlobene emva kokubhalisa kwi-phumo eliyisikhulu labo bokwelapha basemapulazini ne-HPCSA njengoMqambi Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe basemapulazini. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Abhekwayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye nolwazi ohlelweni lwezokwelapha ohlobene nalo. Ulwazi oluhle lwezokwelapha, amandla namakhono kumkhakha jikelele wezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengilungu elisebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana, ukubusa, phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuqondisa. Ikhono lokuphatha abaguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzigqatsa, ngobekiwe futhi uxhume uma kunesidingo. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zamanje zezempilo, umthetho, izinhlelo futhi okubalulekile ohlelweni. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuhola kanye nabasebenzi abasha kulesi sikhungo. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela engcindebini, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu, ukuzethemba kanye nethemba lokwakha kanye nokuqhuba ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngekhono, ukusekela amagugu kanye namabalengenhloso yesikhungo ahambisana namazinga enakekelwa abaguli. Ukubekezelela ukuphathwa kwabaguli abangeniswe ohlelweni lokuqeqesha izinga 2/3. Ukusiza ekuhlelweni nasekuqeqeshweni kokuqondisa neziphethandi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwezinhlela zemfundo nokusebenza ngesikhathi eside. Ukusiza ngekhodi yokuhlola amandla okusebenza kokubonisana ngokusuka ngesikhathi ekuthuthukisen ulwazi ngobungcweti. Ukusekela ukuphathwa kwesibhedlela ngokusiza ekugcineni amazinga okunakekelwa abaguli kanye namasevisizi.

xh.title: Isebe SoGqitha Wezempilo Inqanaba 3
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuthintelwe isithuba sokuba nguGqitha Wezempilo Inqanaba 3 eErmelo Hospital eMpumalanga, kwaye kufuneka ube neregistration ye-MBChB ne-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB (iqudration) ekuvumela ukuba ubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengoGqitha Wezempila kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqitha Wezempilo (2026) (Independent Practice). I-permit yomsebenzi egqithisayo kuya kufuneka kubekho abantu abangebangamazwe aseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngemigaqo yomsebenzi wezempilo. Ulawulo lweekomity ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengodidi kwaye unamava kwicala lemigangatho yezempilo elibandakanyekayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemigaqo-nkqubo yamagqabantshathi aje nje wezempilo kwakunye nalawo koluntu. Amaxesha amangaphezu kwemigaqo kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology kunye ne-ENT kuya kubakho nxaxheba njengesiphakamiso. Amakhono ekubonisana, ukuthatha imbali, ukupholisa, ukulinganisa ngamagqabantshati nokulawula kwamagqabantshati. Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka elishumi (10) yamava engentla emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqitha Wezempilo (Independent Practice). Iminyaka elishumi elinye (11) yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-recognised foreign health profession council kwaye / okanye kwi-HPCSA njengoGqitha Wezempilo (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abagqithiswe kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngemigaqo yomsebenzi wezempilo. Ulawulo lweekomity ezahlukeneyo nokusebenza njengodidi kwaye unamava kwicala lemigangatho yezempilo elibandakanyekayo. Ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngamagqabantshati, ukuzinza nokusebenza kumacandelo ajikeleze ekwamagqabantshati. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengomzoba osebenza kakuhle kwikomityi. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana, ukuyalela, nokusebenza nabantu, kwaye namakhono okulawula. Ikhono lokulawula abaguli ngokuzimeleyo, ngokuchanekileyo, ngoxanduva kwaye ukuxhasana xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo, imithetho, iinkquba namaphandulo angokuwezo kwelinye igumbi elihambelanayo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuyalela kwaye oomabasebenzi abasha baso esebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukuze amandla okumelana nengxaki, ukusebenza phakathi kwekomityi, ukuzigqitha nokuzithembisa nokwakha kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuphumeze imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngekhono, ukuxhasa iinjongo neenjongo zeSiseko ezahambelana nemigangatho yokhathalelo lwamaguli. Ukubambelela ngokuzimisela kuxanduva lokulawula abaguli abangenwe kwisiseko se-level 2/3 package of service facility. Ukuncedisa kulungiselelo nokuphumeza iindlela zimaphakathi namagqabantshati aye aphakathi. Ukubandakanyeka kwiinkqubo zokufunda nezakwiqeqesho. Ukunceda nokwenza ukuhlolwa kwamagqabantshati ukubandakanyeka ngokuchanekileyo ekuphuhliseni ekuphuculweni ngokuchanekileyo. Ukunikela inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuyakuba ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokwemigangatho yokhathalelo lwamaguli nokuze kugcinwe izabelo.

Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. zu.title: Umongameli Wezokwelapha Izinga 2

zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB (isiqu) evumela ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomunyenti Wezokwelapha e Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomunyenti Wezokwelapha (2026) (Independent Practice). I-permit yomsebenzi evamile izodingwa kubantu abangewona abaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngokuziphatha kwamazwe ezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengeqembu nokuhlangenwe nakho enkambeni yezokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqubomgomo zaman ezempilweni nezokuletha umphakathi. Okuhlangenwe nakho okwengeziwe kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology ne-ENT kuzoba yincoma. Amakhono ohlelwini lokuqashwa kwezimo, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisela ngokwesilabela kwezokwelapha nokuphathwa kwezokwelapha. Izinga 2: Okuncane iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlangenwe nakho emuva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengoMunyenti Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Okuncane iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisanayo emuva kokubhaliswa necounsellu yesizwe sezokwelapha yamanye amazwe eliqinisekisiwe futhi noma i-HPCSA njengoMunyenti Wezokwelapha (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abakwezinye izwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha nokuKwazi okudingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngokuziphatha kwamazwe ezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengeqembu nokuhlangenwe nakho enkambeni yezokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ulwazi oluhle, ukukwazi namakhano kakhono ezilungu ezijwayelekile zezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengelungu leqembu elisebenza kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, okukhokha, okwabantu, nokuqapha. Ikhono lokuphatha abaguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzifunela, ngesibopho nokubandakanyeka ngesikhathi esifanele. Ulwazi ngabezempilo, imithetho, izinhlelo izinhlelo nezinhloso zaman ngaphakathi kwale ndawo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuhola abasebenzi abasa kulelo ngingqi. Izimpawu Zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nokucindezeleka, ukusebenza endlini yeqembu, inkolo ezulu kumzimba namandla, kanye nokuakha, and ukugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngekhono, ukwesekela imigomo nokuqondisa iNtwantsha ngokuhambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukubamba isibopho sokuphathwa kwabaguli abangenwe esikhungweni selevel 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokuqalisweni kwemibhalo nezenzo. Ukuhlanganyela kumahlelo ayo yonke imikhakha yokufunda nokuzivocavoca. Ukusiza ukulola kakhwelo kobuqhawe nokubamba iqhaza kumahlela abekeze ayoqhubeka nakho. Ukunikeza isicebo sikahulumudi wokuphathwa kwezempilo ngokusebenza okukahle kanye nasekugcineni amazinga okunakekelwa nobuyekezeko.

xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBChB (izifundo) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo ogqithiswe kwiBhunga lezoGqirha ezoNtsholobo waseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezempilo (2026) (uKuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Amakhono malunga neenkoliso, ukuthabatha imbali, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganiswa kwezokliniki nolawulo lwezokliniki. Inqanaba le-2: Uluhlu lonyaka omthandathu (6) wolwazi emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo (uKuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Uluhlu lonyaka omthandathu (6) wolwazi oluhambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kwabhedlele abakwayiyo nokupelelayo kwiBhunga lezamagqirha eliqatshiweyo nokuba yiso i-HPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo (uKuzilolonga ngokuzimele) kumsebenzi abaqeqeshiwe ngaphandle. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namaphulo afunekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngezemigaqo yezogqirha. Ulawulo olungcamngi kwaye ukusebenza njengorhumbo nolwazi kwicandelo lezogqirha ngokuhambelanayo. Ulwazi oluhle lwezokliniki, amaphulo namakhono kumagunya ajikeleze ezokliniki. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana, ukuba ngumongameli, nokuhamba kakuhle nabantu, namakhono okulawula. Ikhono lokuzilawula zigulane ngokuzimele, ngokuzimisela, ngoxanduva nokuthatha inxaxheba xa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo yangoku, izithetho, iinkqubo nezinto ezibalulekileyo ngaphakathi kule ngingqi. Ikhono lokufundisa, nokukhokela osebenza kwisebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nengxaki, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, ukuzigqatsa nokwakha uqhagamshelo oluhle.
xh.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuqonda iinjongo neenjongo zeSikhululo ezihambelana namazinga okunyamezela igulane. Ukubamboxanduva lokulawula iigulane ezamkelwe kwifasiliti yenqanaba le-2/3 yesebe lenkonzo. Ukunceda ekulungeniseni nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemigaqo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zezemfundo nokuqeqesho. Ukunceda ngokuphonononga izokliniki ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekuqhubekeni nokuphuhliswa kwamakhono obuchule. Ukunikela inkxaso kulawulo lesibedlele ukuze kugcinwe izinga elisebenzayo lonyamezelo lwegulane nezeenkonz.

zu.requirements: IDigri ye-MBChB (izifundo) evumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoMphilisi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengoMphilisi Wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuzilolonga Okuzimele). NB: Onogqela Bezempilo abashiwayo kumele bakwazi ukusebenza amashifti. I-permit yomsebenzi esemthethweni izodingwa abangesiwo abakwa-South Africa. Ukwazi kuhle ngezimilo zokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwababekephele imitholampilo nokusebenza njengeqembu nanokuhlangenwe ngokuhlola enkatheni yezokwelapha ehlobene naleyo. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana, ukubusa, okwemiphakathi, nokubeka abantu eqenjini. Ikhono lokuphatha abagula bodwa, ngokuzithoba, ngomthwalo wemfanelo futhi kubayekezelwe lapho kudingeka khona. Ukwazi ngemigomo yezempilo, umthetho, amaphrojekhi nepharetha ezinhlelweni zanjulo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuhola abasebenzi abasha umnyankamo ngaphakathi kwesoMnyango. Izimilo Zenkathi Ezinengqondo: Ukumelana nenkinga, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nethemba lokwakha futhi zigcine ubuhle ubudlelwano.

Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemiqathango yayebe yamaphulo ezeNtlalo nokuSebenza koluntu ekujoliswe kulo. Amakhono ekubonisana, ukuthatha imbali, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa kokliniki nokulawula iinkqubo zokliniki. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nqanaba lolwazi luya kufuneka emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengSpraktikhala yezonyango (Ulwenziwo oluZimeleyo). Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-1 yolwazi olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwiBhodi yamaphulo ezoNyango yaseMzantsi Afrika njengSpraktikhala yezonyango (Ulwenziwo oluZimeleyo) kuba basebenzi abavela ngaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono aFuweyo: Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yobugcisa bezonyango. Ulawulo lwamaxesha amaninzi nentsebenzisano eqelekethe kwaye nolwazi kwinqanaba lezonyango elifanelekileyo. Ulwazi olululo lokliniki, amakhono nokuziqhelanisa kwizikhulu ezinemvuzo oqhelekileyo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amakhono obuqu obukhulu bukhulu bokuziphatha, abukhokeli, abantu abangenamdla, kwaye nokulawula. Ikhono lokuzilawula iiguli ngokuzimeleyo, ngesigqibo, ngobuzwe nokubandakanyeka xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yamaphulo oluntu yemithetho, iinkqubo nokuqwalaselwa okukhulu kule nkqubo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukukhokela abasebenzi abasebantwaneni kwisebe. Iimpawu zobuziphatha: Ukumelana nokuqhathwa, ukusebenza eqeleni, ukuzethemba nokwakha ukwakha unobumba oluhle.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokugqibeleleyo, ukuxhasa iinjongo nemiqathango ezenjwa ngumsindisana weMvuzo oqhelekileyo wezonyango. Ukuvakalelwa ukuziphendulela ngokulawula iiguli ezikwidlelo 2/3 ekwinkqubo yekliniki. Ukuncedisa ukuqwalaselwa nokusebenziswa kwemigaqo nemigaqo yokuqwalaselwa eqela. Ukubandakanyeka kwezifundo nokusebenza. Ulwazi olubukhali ngendlela ezonyango. Ikhono lokubhekana nemizekelo yonke yezigulo ezikhulu. Ulwazi ngendlela yobugcisa bezonyango. Ukuncedisa ngokuqwalaselwa kwamaphulo amakhulu ukubandakanyeka ngokusebenzayo ukungatshuki kwesaziso soBugcisa. Ukunikela inkxaso kulawulo lwesibhedlele ukuba ukhuseleko olukhulu lwemvuzo oqhelekileyo wezonyango lusebenza ngokwemigaqo ekuqwalaselwa iinkonzo ezikho.

zu.title: I-ofisa Lezokwelapha Izinga 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Ofisa Lezokwelapha Izinga 1 esibhedlela i-Witbank nasemagumbini okwelapha ahlobene esifundeni i-Nkangala, edinga i-MBChB nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: I-digri ye-MBChB (iziqu) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodziyazi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengodziyazi wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuzilolonga okuzimele). OKUBALULEKILE: I-Ofisa Lezokwelapha eliyishiwe kumele lakwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha. Abasebenzi abangesi abakwaNingizimu Afrika bazodinga isivume sokusebenza esivumelekile. ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuqondisa abantu bezinhlaahlukile kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu nanomhlalaphi kolimi oluhambisano lwezokwelapha. ukuqonda imithetho nemigomo yezempilo kanye nenkonzo yomphakathi okwamanje. Amakhono ohlelo lokweluleka, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa ngokwezokwelapha. Izinga 1: Akukho nomhlalaphi odingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengodziyazi wezokwelapha (Ukuzilolonga okuzimele). Ubumniningwane bonyaka oyi-1 bomhlalaphi ohambisana nalokhu ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-Foreign Health Professions evunyelwe kanye noma kwi-HPCSA njengodziyazi wezokwelapha (Ukuzilolonga okuzimele) kubasebenzi abafunde kulezinye izwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuqondisa abantu bezinhlaahlukile kanye nokusebenza njengeqembu nanomhlalaphi wolimi oluhambisano lwezokwelapha. ukuqonda okuhle ngokwezokwelapha, amandla namakhano kulawo wonke amagumbi ezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengolungu leqembu elisebenza kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana okuhle, okuholayo, phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuhlola. Ikhono lokuphatha abaguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzinakekela, ngobuhlakani futhi abanye bazibandanye lapho kudingeka khona. ukuqonda imigomo yezempilo okwamanje, umthetho, amaphrograma kanye nezinto eziyinhlopenhliko kulelo lungakuwo. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqondisa abasebenzi abasesibhakabhakeni ngaphakathi kwomnyango. Iziphawu Zenkathi: Ukwamukla inkinga, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwomnyango, ukuzethemba kanye nolunye lokwakha futhi sigcine ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuze yenze imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuze ixhase amagagu nezinjongo zesikhungo ezihambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukube yibamba inkinga ngokuphathwa kwabaguli abangenwe kumgumbi okuyizinga 2/3 lesevisi. ukusiza ekulungiseleleni kanye nokuphunyulisweni kwemihlahlandlela kanye nemithetho. ukubambe iqhaza emaphrogrameni ezifundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa. ukuqonda okuhle ngokwezokwelapha ngokuphatelene nenkinga yezokwelapha. Ikhono lokubhekana nazo zonke izinkathi eziphuthumayo. ukuqonda ngokuziphatha okuhle kwezokwelapha. ukusiza ukubuyeza ngokwezokwelapha kanye nokubamba iqhaza ngokuphumelelayo ukuphunyuka ngokomhlalaphi. ukunikeza ukusekela kuhlelo lesibhedlela ekuqondeni ukuthi amaninga okunakekelwa kwesiguli namasevisi zihlale zisezinga elihle sigcinwe.

xh.title: Isebe lemibuzo yezempilo inqanaba le-1
xh.summary: Izithuba zesebe lemibuzo yezempilo inqanaba le-1 eWitbank Hospital nakwiikliniki ezinxulumene kusithili seNkangala, kufuneka kubekho iziqu ze-MBChB kunye nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isifikelelo) ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo (2026) (Ukuzimela ekusebenzeni). QAPHANI: Isebe lemibuzo yezempilo eliyinyanga kufuneka libe nakho ukusebenza ngokutshintshwana kwishedyuli. Ipermithi yesebenzo evunyiwe iza kufuneka kubantu abangeyo baseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olululo ngokuziphatha kwamagazethi ezempilo. Ukuqhuba kwemimandla emininzi nokusebenza ngesiqupe kunye nolwazi kwelona candi limibuzo yezempilo liluthintelweyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye namacebo amanje wezempilo kunye nesebe lazo zikonzo zikawonke-wonke. Amakhono kwinkqubo yokuphendula imibuzo, ukuthatha imbali, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganisa ngokwempilo nokulawula ngokwempilo. Inqanaba le-1: Akukho lwazi lufunekayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo (Ukuzimela ekusebenzeni). Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-1 yolwazi oluhambelana nendima emva kokubhalisa kunye neBhunga lwezeMpilo eLawulayo laseMzantsi Khaya okanye i-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo (Ukuzimela ekusebenzeni) koqeqesho lwabasebenzi bengaphandle. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho kunye namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi olululo ngokuziphatha kwamagazethi ezempilo. Ukuqhuba kwemimandla emininzi nokusebenza ngesiqupe kunye nolwazi kwelona candi limibuzo yezempilo liluthintelweyo. Ulwazi olululo ngempilo, amakhono nokuziphatha kwemimandla yempilo ngokubanzi. Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amakhono obuqhawe bokunxibelelana, ukuzoba iqhawe, unxibelelwano lwabantu, kunye nokulawula. Ikhono lokuzilawula iiguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzinikela, ngokwenza ngokwakho nakunjalo ngokubambisana xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngamacebo, umthetho, iinkqubo kunye neencomo ezibalulekileyo zamanje ngaphakathi kweli candi. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukulunga nokukhokela abasebenzi abasebunzimeni ngaphakathi kwesebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nengxwabo, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesiqhanga, ithemba lokuzenza nokwakha nokugcina ubudlelwane obulungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuphumeza imisebenzi kwaye nenjongo ngobuchule, ukuxhasa iinjongo neemigqaliselo zeNkupela ezihambelana namazinga okunikelwa iiguli. Ukwamkela urhoqo lokulawula iiguli ezingenisiwekwisiseko selevel 2/3 sephakheji yesebenzo. Ukunceda kulungiselelo nokuphumeza iinkqubo zokukhokela namaphrothokholi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zophando zezifundo zomzimba nokuzimela nokuziphatha kwamagazethi ezempilo. Ulwazi olululo ngempilo mayela nemibuzo yezempilo. Ikhono lokubhekana nayo yonke imiba yezempilo ephuthumayo. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha okulungileyo kwamagazethi ezempilo. Ukunceda nokwenza iingxelo ezilandelelayo ngokunxibelelana nakulawulo lwesibhedlele ukuba kugcinwe isimo esisebenzayo samazinga okunikelwa iiguli kunye neenkonzo.

Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur sodat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: Ofisa Wezokwelapha Grade 1
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Ofisa Wezokwelapha Grade 1 zitholakala emisebenzini yesifunda sase Gert Sibande District e-Ermelo, idinga idigri ye-MBChB nobhalo lwamanje ku-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Idigri ye-MBChB (isifundo) evumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoMpraktisa Wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengoMpraktisa Wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuzimela). QAPHELA: Ofisa Wezokwelapha oqokwe kumele akwazi ukusebenza amashifu. Ivume yokusebenza esemthethweni izodingwa kubantu abangebona oNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi okuqinile ngezimiso zokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinkambu eziningi nokusebenza njengqembu kanye nolwazi enkambini yezokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ukwazi ngemithetho nangezinqubomgomo zamanje yezeMphilo nazoMsebenzi Womphakathi. Amakhono okubonisana, ukuqoqa umlando wokwelapha, ukuhlola, ukubuyekezwa ngokwesibhedlela nokuphathwa ngokwesibhedlela. Grade 1: Alukho ulwazi oludingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoMpraktisa Wezokwelapha (Ukuzimela). Okungenani unyaka we-1 wolwazi oluhambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa eqenjini elihloniphekile lezamaphrofesheni zezempilo zamanye amazwe kanye/noma ku-HPCSA njengoMpraktisa Wezokwelapha (Ukuzimela) kubasebenzi abaqeqeshwe kwamanye amazwe. Ukwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha namandla Okwenza Adingekayo: Ukwazi okuqinile ngezimiso zokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinkambu eziningi nokusebenza njengqembu kanye nolwazi enkambini yezokwelapha ehambisanayo. Ukwazi okuqinile lokwelapha ngokwesibhedlela, amandla namakhono emikhakheni yezokwelapha jikelele. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengilungu elisebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, ukuhola, okuhlobene nabantu, nokulawula. Ikhono lokuphatha abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzimisela, ngomzwangedwa nokuxhumana uma kudingeka. Ukwazi ngezenqubomgomo zezempilo zamanje, umthetho, izinhlelo kanye nezinto ezibalulekile emkhakheni. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqondisa kanye nokuphatha abasebenzi abasha emnyangweni. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ngaphansi koxinzelelo, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nekhono lokwakha nokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nezinkomba ngobuchule, ukuze useke izinhloso nezinjongo zeSikhungo eziyahambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukwamukela ithwalo lokuphatha abaguli abamukelwe esikhungweni esinika insiza yamazinga 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nokuqaliseni izinqondiso neziqubo. Ukubambe iqhaza kwezinhlelo zezifundo nokuqeqesha. Ukwazi okuqinile lokwelapha ngokwesibhedlela mayelana nemithi. Ikhono lokubhekana nazo zonke izimo eziphuthumayo zezokwelapha. Ukwazi ngesenzo sokwelapha esihambisana nezimiso zokuziphatha. Ukusiza ekubuyelekeni kwemisebenzi yezokwelapha nokubambe iqhaza ngokuzimisela ekuthuthukisweni kobungcweti ngokuphazima kweso. Ukunikeza inkxaso okuphathweni kwesibhedlela ukuze kugcinwe amazinga aphumelelayo okunakekelwa kwabaguli kanye nezinsiza.

xh.title: Isebe lokwelapha inqanaba lesi-1
xh.summary: Izithuba zesebe lokwelapha inqanaba lesi-1 zitholakala kumaziko oMmandla we-Gert Sibande e-Ermelo, kufuneka kubekho izidanga ze-MBChB nokubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBChB (isigaba sezifundo) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomPractitioner wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengomPractitioner wezokwelapha (2026) (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). OKUQAPHELWEYO: Isebe lokwelapha elikhethiweyo makakwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweshifi. I-permit yomsebenzi esebenzayo iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyiwo abaseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngezemigaqo yezokwelapha. Ulawulo lwamabala amaninani nolusebenzisana koluhlobo nolunamava kwelinye ibala lezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngezendlela zangoku eziyimigaqo nezithintelo zezeMpilo nezeSebenza zoLuntu. Ikhono ekubeni kubekho iindibano, ukuthabatha imbali, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganisa ngokwelapha nolawulo ngokwelapha. Inqanaba lesi-1: Akukho mava efunekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomPractitioner wezokwelapha (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele). Ubuncinane bemava yonyaka we-1 elihambelana nokubhaliswa kwi-Foreign Health Professions ekuqatyiweyo kwaye/noma kwi-HPCSA njengomPractitioner wezokwelapha (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimele) kubasebenzi bakhuphiweko kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Ikhono, uQeqesho namaNgcibilikho aFunekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngezemigaqo yezokwelapha. Ulawulo lwamabala amaninani nolusebenzisana kuluhlobo nolunamava kwelinye ibala lezokwelapha. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwelapha, ukuzinza ngekhono namakhono kwimimandla yonke yezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengelungu elisebenzayo leqela. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana, bokulawula, bokuziphatha kunye nabanye, nabolawulo. Ikhono lokulawula abagula ngokuzimele, ngokuzinikela, ngokubathathela uxanduva nokuqabisa xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngeemigaqo, iindlela zimithetho, iinkqubo nangokubaluleka kwangoku kwimpilo yoxanduva. Ikhono lokufundisa, lokukhokela abasebenzi abancinane kwisebe. Iimpawu zoKuziphatha: Ukuqwemelela inxaxheba, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, ukuzithemba nokuwakha ugcinisisa ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba imisebenzi nemitsebenzi ngokuchanekileyo, ukuze uxhase iinjongo nemiNjongo yeSikhungo ehangene neemigangatho yokuqonywa kwabagula. Ukubamathatha uxanduva lolawulo lwabaguli abangenwe kwifasiliti yeqela lesebenza lesi-2/3. Ukuncedisa kulungiselelo nokusebenzisa iindlela nemigaqo yokuqhuba. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kweenkqubo zezifundo nokuqeqeshwa. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwelapha mayela ngezithi. Ikhono lokubhekana nayo yonke imeko yezokwelapha ephuthumayo. Ulwazi ngokuzilolonga ngokweemigaqo yezokwelapha. Ukuncedisa ngokuqamba izikhuselo ngokwelapha ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekuphuhliseni ngokuchanakeka. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lwesibhedlele ngakumbi ekugcineni imigangatho echanekileyo yokuqonywa kwabagula nesebenzo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (PN-B3): PHC
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing position at Diepdale Clinic in Mpumalanga, requiring a Professional Nurse qualification with post-basic training to manage primary healthcare services.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification plus Basic qualification accredited with the South African Nursing Council in Terms of Government Notice 425, (i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse (2026) plus a post basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice No R212 in Primary Health Care. A minimum of nine (09) years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with South African Nursing Council (SANC) in General Nursing. At least five (05) years of period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable in the specific specialty after obtaining the one (01) year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Nursing Science. A post basic qualification in Nursing Administration/Health service management. Experience and knowledge of the District Health System. Demonstrate an in- depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how these impact on service delivery. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and finance and practices. Knowledge of relevant legal framework such as Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. Problem Solving, planning and Organizing Skills. Expected to work under pressure and on night duty. Leadership. Supervisory, problem-solving, conflict resolution, inter-personal and communication and communication skills. Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of legislation and related ethical nursing practices and how this impact on service delivery. Computer literacy will be an added advantage (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage and provide PHC facility supervisory in line with the PHC Supervision Guideline. Ensure clinical nursing practice by the nursing team in the facility in accordance with the scope and practice and nursing standard as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standard in accordance with the PHC delivery package. Ensure the implementation on National Core Norms and Standards including Six Priority Areas. Advocate for patients through ensuring adherence to Batho Pele Principles. Coordinate community involvement and participation. Manage and monitor effective use and maintenance of assets and infrastructure of the facility. Monitor information management and documentation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Mr. Mxolisi Maseko Tel No: (013) 766 3351, Mr. Samson Nyoni Tel No: (013) 766 3087, Ms. Samukelisiwe Mgwenya Tel No: (013) 766 3540 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (PN-B3): PHC
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging-pos by Diepdale Kliniek in Mpumalanga, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkwalifikasie met na-basiese opleiding vereis om primere gesondheidsorgdienste te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer met die South African Nursing Council ingevolge Government Notice 425, (d.w.s. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) wat registrasie met die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) toelaat plus 'n na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer met die SANC ingevolge Government Notice No R212 in Primary Health Care. 'n Minimum van nege (09) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste vyf (05) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslik/erkenbaar wees in die spesifieke spesialiteit na verwerwing van die een (01) jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in Primary Health Care Nursing Science. 'n Na-basiese kwalifikasie in Nursing Administration/Health service management. Ervaring en kennis van die District Health System. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regmatige en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit dienslewering beïnvloed. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR en finansies en praktyke. Kennis van die tersaaklike regskader soos Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operasionele Bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossings-, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Daar word verwag om onder druk en nagdiens te werk. Leierskap. Toesighoudende, probleemoplossings-, konflikhanterings-, interpersoonlike en kommunikasie- en kommunikasievaardighede. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van wetgewing en verwante etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit dienslewering beïnvloed. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n byvoeglike voordeel wees (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf PHC-fasiliteits toesig in ooreenstemming met die PHC Supervision Guideline. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan in die fasiliteit in ooreenstemming met die omvang en praktyk en verpleegstandaard soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaard in ooreenstemming met die PHC afleweringspakket. Verseker die implementering van National Core Norms and Standards insluitend Six Priority Areas. Pleitbesorg vir pasiënte deur versekerde nakoming van Batho Pele Principles. Koördineer gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en -deelname. Bestuur en monitor effektiewe gebruik en instandhouding van bates en infrastruktuur van die fasiliteit. Monitor inligtingsbestuur en dokumentasie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokusebenza Wokuhloliswa Kwabesifazane (PN-B3): PHC
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokusebenza wokuhloliswa kwabesifazane e-Diepdale Clinic e-Mpumalanga, esidinga isiqu somhlolisi wabesifazane ongabezifundo zasemva kwesisekelo ukuze aphathe izinkonzo zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo.
zu.requirements: Izigidimbu Senior Certificate / Grade 12 noma isiqu esilinganayo kanye nesiqu sesisisekelo esamukelwe yi-South African Nursing Council ngokomtshumayelo kahulumeni 425, (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree ekukuhloleni kwabesifazane) esivumela ukubhaliswa ne-SANC njengomhlolisi wabesifazane (2026) kanye nesiqu sokuhlola kwabesifazane ngemva kwesisekelo, esithatha isikhathi esingasenani esinye unyaka, esamukelwe yi-SANC ngokomtshumayelo kahulumeni u-No R212 ekunakekeleni kwezempilo okuyisisekelo. Ubude obungeqile beminyaka elishumi neshiyagalombili (09) yiminyaka yokuhlolisisa kwabesifazane emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlolisi wabesifazane ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC) ekukuhloleni kwabesifazane jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka elihlanu (05) yomkhathi okushiwo ngaphezulu kumele ibe yohlelo/ehlukumezwayo ohlotshaneni oluthize emva kokuqeda isiqu esithatha unyaka olulodwa (01) sokuhlola kwabesifazane ngemva kwesisisekelo kumzobu wokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo. Isiqu sokuhlola kwabesifazane ngemva kwesisekelo ekuqondweni kwezabesifazane/ekuphathweni kwezinkonzo zempilo. Okuhlangenwe nakho nolwazi mayelana ne-District Health System. Khombisa ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho wokuhlola kwabesifazane nemikhakha kahulumeni ebandakanya amasiko amahle nemithetho ehlobene nokuhlola kwabesifazane nokuthi le mikhakha ithinta kanjani ukulethwa kwezinkonzo. Khombisa ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwe-HR nezimali nokuqhuba kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi mayelana negunya elihambisana nomthetho njengesibonelo i-Nursing Act, i-Health Occupational and Safety Act, i-Patients Right Charter, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, Amakhono e-Operational Management. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukwelula ukucubungula nokuhlela. Kulindeleke ukuba usebenze ngengcindezi nasebusuku. Ubuholi. Amakhono okuqondisa, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuxazulula ukungahambelani, okuxhumana nabantu nokuqhweba. Khombisa ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho nemikhakha yamasiko amahle ekuhloleni kwabesifazane nokuthi lokhu kuthinta kanjani ukulethwa kwezinkonzo. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngekhompyutha kuzoba yinhla sovuzwayo (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Ukwazi ukusebenza ngekhompyutha.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlinzeke nokuqondisa isikhungo se-PHC ngokohlelo lokuqondisa i-PHC. Qinisekisa ukuzilolonga kokuhlola kwabesifazane iqembu lokuhlola kwabesifazane esikhungweni ngokwesigaba nosiko lokuzilolonga nokuhlolwa ngokwemigomo noma izindlela ezihlongozwe yisikhungo sempilo esihlobene. Khuthaza inani elihle lokuhlola kwabesifazane njengoba kuqondiswa isigaba somhlolisi ohlelokufunda kanye nezinhlobonhlobo eziyimigomo ngokohlelo lokuhanjiswa kwe-PHC. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-National Core Norms and Standards okuhlanganisa izindawo eziphambili eziyisithupha. Zikhankasela iziguli ngokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezimiso ze-Batho Pele. Qondise ubandakanywa komphakathi nengxaxheba. Phathe futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa okuyindlela kanye nokuqashwa kwempahla nezingqikithi zesikhungo. Qapha ukuphathwa kolwazi namafayela.

xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wemisebenzi yoqhatho kwi-Diepdale Clinic e-Mpumalanga, sifuna isigqibo soqhatho lwabaphathi ngemfundo eyiyo after-basic ukuze alawule iinkonzo ze-primary healthcare.

Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kolwazi Iqela Iqela laMazwe Adwelene Mhlabanzi nowokusebenza kakhulu Iindawo Zehlabathi eziyisixhenxe. Tsala amandla ngokukhulisa amandla eBatho Pele. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Verkrygingsbestuur
af.summary: Koördineer en implementeer voorsieningsketting-verkrygingsbestuursraamwerke en bodprosesse by die Department of Health in Mbombela.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Finance, Accounting Management, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Public Management / Administration as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years relevant experience in supply chain management, acquisition Management, Financial Management at supervisory / management (Level 7/8). Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Revenue Management policies, National Health Act, and relevant departmental prescripts. Knowledge of BAS, PEIS and other relevant systems. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint). Valid driver's licence.
af.duties: To coordinate, review, undertake and implement the supply chain acquisition management framework and policies through the execution of the bidding process, compilation of a list of service providers, according to the prescribed procurement methodologies. Coordinate (synergise) review and execute the bidding process. Coordinate, review and compile the list of prospective provider for quotations. Coordinate review and source quotations from database according to the thresh values determined by the National Treasury. Supervise employees to ensure an effective acquisition management service and undertake all administrative functions required with regard to financial and HR administration.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatikithetho / I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma / I-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Finance, Accounting Management, Financial Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Public Management / Administration njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) engajwayelekile yokuhlola ukuphathwa kohlangothi lokuthengisa, ukuphathwa kokutholwa, Financial Management ezingeni lomqondisi / ukuphathwa (Level 7/8). Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-Treasury Regulations, izinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwemaliyo, i-National Health Act, nezimiso zomnyango ezihlobene lokhu. Ulwazi lwe-BAS, PEIS nakwezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene lokhu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-Microsoft Office (Excel, Word kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqondanisa, ukubuyekeza, ukwenza kanye nokufaka amasokhwezi okuphathwa kokutholwa kwezinsiza nezinqubomgomo ngokwenza inqubo yokuqasha, ukwelulepha uhlu lwabanikezeli besebenza, ngokwezindlela zokuthenga ezibekiwe. Qondanisa (umunganise) ubuyekeze futhi usebenzise inqubo yokuqasha. Qondanisa, ubuyekeze futhi uhlanganise uhlu lwabanikezeli abangaba khona ezinkomba zentengo. Qondanisa ubuyekeze futhi uthole izinkomba zentengo esikhungweni se-data ngokwezinto ezinikelwe yi-National Treasury. Qaphise abasebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke isisebenzi esiphezulu sokuphathwa kokutholwa futhi wenze yonke imisebenzi yentengo edingekayo mayelana nokuqashwa kwezimali ne-HR.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphezulu / Grade 12 ngeDiploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwezeMali, Ulawulo lwezeAccounting, Ulawulo lwezeMali, ukuBiza kunye noLawulo lwezeAccounting, uLawulo lwaZomongo / uLawulo kunye nokuvunywa nguSAQA. OkungeLeanani kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ahambelanayo kulawulo lwentatho yezinto, ulawulo lokwamkela, ulawulo lwezimali kwinqanaba lokuqonda / lolawulo (Level 7/8). Ulwazi malunga nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations, iinqobo zincwadi zoLawulo lweNgeniso, iNational Health Act, kunye nezinqamlezincwadi zesebe ezihambelanayo. Ulwazi lweBAS, iPEIS kunye namanye amaqhagamshelo ahambelanayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Office (Excel, Word and PowerPoint). Ilayisensi yokuqamba ehambile.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba, ukuphonononga, ukwenza kunye nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lokwamkela kwentatho yezinto kunye neenqobo zincwadi ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokubiza, uluhlu lwabahlinzeki benkonzo, ngokweendlela ezibekiweyo zokuthenga. Ukuqamba (ukuhlanganisa) ukuphonononga nokusebenzisa inqubo yokubiza. Ukuqamba, ukuphonononga nokululuhla uluhlu lwabahlinzeki abayimfuno ngeento eziceliweyo. Ukuqamba ukuphonononga nokuzisa iinto eziceliweyo kwisiseko sedatha ngokomlinganiselo we-thresh oqhelweyo yiNational Treasury. Ukuqonda abasebenzi ukuqinisekisa inkonzo elungileyo yolawulo lokwamkela nokwenza zonke iinkqubo zolawulo ezifunekayo ngokuphathelele ulawulo lwezimali nolwe-HR.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Risk Performance and Contract
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Mpumalanga seeks a Senior State Accountant to manage risk performance and contracts at the Provincial Office in Mbombela.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus six (6) years relevant experience in Supply Chain Management field or Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management, Public Management / Management Accounting. At least three (3) years’ experience in the post of Chief Administration Clerk / Administrative Officer / State Accountant at (Level 7). A qualification related to Treasury and competence for Finance officials will be an added advantage. Preparedness to security clearance and disclosure of financial interest. A valid driver’s licence (with exception of people with disabilities). Knowledge, Competencies and Skills: Supervisory skills, good planning and organized skills. Good interpersonal relations and good communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to work under pressure and preparedness to work overtime, when required. Skills in Microsoft Word and Excel.
jobs.duties: Maintain a database of al concluded contracts. Administering contracts effectively in accordance with policy, procedures and compliant with applicable legislative requirement. Maintain contract register in a format provided by Provincial Treasury. Interacting with the Project Managers about the signing of contracts and service level agreements for all contracts entered by the Department. Ensuring that all contracts are accurately recorded on the contract Register and regularly update of the contract register. Reviewing contracts on the contract register to ensure their validity. Co-coordinating and control the application of the procedures in respect of the supplier performance monitoring and contract management. Preparing reports on non-performing / poor performing companies and recommends the appropriate actions to be taken to remedy the situation. Supervising activities of the personnel to ensure that work performed meets acceptable standards and is completed within agreed upon timelines.

af.title: Senior Staatsrekenmeester: Risiko-prestasie en Kontrak
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Mpumalanga soek 'n Senior Staatsrekenmeester om risiko-prestasie en kontrakte by die Provinsiale Kantoor in Mbombela te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus ses (6) jaar relevante ervaring in die Supply Chain Management-veld of Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management, Public Management / Management Accounting. Ten minste drie (3) jaar ervaring in die pos van Chief Administration Clerk / Administrative Officer / State Accountant op (Level 7). 'n Kwalifikasie verwant aan Tesourie en bevoegdheid vir finansie-amptenare sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bereidwilligheid tot veiligheidsklarering en openbaarmaking van finansiële belange. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis, Bevoegdhede en Vaardighede: Toesigvaardighede, goeie beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge en goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om onder druk te werk en bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer dit vereis word. Vaardighede in Microsoft Word en Excel.
af.duties: Onderhou 'n databasis van alle afgehandelde kontrakte. Administreer kontrakte doeltreffend in ooreenstemming met beleid, prosedures en in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewende vereistes. Onderhou kontrakregister in 'n formaat wat deur Provinsiale Tesourie voorsien word. Skakel met die Projekbestuurders oor die ondertekening van kontrakte en diensvlakooreenkomste vir alle kontrakte wat deur die departement aangegaan is. Verseker dat alle kontrakte akkuraat op die kontrakregister aangeteken word en die kontrakregister gereeld opdateer. Hersien kontrakte op die kontrakregister om hul geldigheid te verseker. Koördineer en beheer die toepassing van die prosedures ten opsigte van verskafferprestasiemonitering en kontrakbestuur. Berei verslae voor oor nie-presterende / swak presterende maatskappye en beveel die toepaslike stappe aan om die situasie reg te stel. Houdig toe op die aktiwiteite van die personeel om te verseker dat die werk wat verrig word aan aanvaarbare standaarde voldoen en binne die ooreengekome tydlyne voltooi word.

zu.title: ISiphesihle State Accountant: Ukusebenza Kwengozi Nomehlwele
zu.summary: Umnyango Wezempi lo in Mpumalanga ufuna i-Senior State Accountant ukuphatha ukusebenza kwengozi nomehlwele eProvincial Office in Mbombela.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kanye neminyaka eyisithupha (6) yezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambisana ne-Supply Chain Management noma i-Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management, Public Management / Management Accounting. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava esikhundleni se-Chief Administration Clerk / Administrative Officer / State Accountant e-(Level 7). I-qualification ephathene ne-Treasury nokuziphendulela kwezimali kuzoba ngumvuzo ongeziwe. Ukuzikhethela ukuba kuhlolwe ngokuphepha nokwembula izinkomba zamashefa. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi, amandla namakhono: Amakhono okulawula abantu, ukucubungula kahle nokuhlela kahle. Ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu kanye namakhono okuxhumana kahle (okubhaliwe nokuvezwa ngomlomo). Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kweinkululeko futhi ukuzikhethela ukusebenza ngemva kwesikhathi, uma kudingek. Amakhono e-Microsoft Word kanye ne-Excel.
zu.duties: Gcina idathabheji yazo zonke izivumelwane ezifeqiwe. Ukuphatha izivumelwane ngempumelelo ngokwesimiso, izinqubo nokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho ezibhekisisiwe. Gcina isibali sezivumelwane kulesifo esinikiwe i-Provincial Treasury. Ukuxhumana ne-Project Managers ngokusayinwa kwezivumelwane nezinkomba zezimo zenkonzo yazo zonke izivumelwane ezingena kumnyango. Ukuthembisa ukuba izivumelwane zonke zibhalwe ngokunembile kwi-Contract Register kanye nokwenza kube khona ukuvuselelwa okuvamile kwesibali sezivumelwane. Buka izivumelwane kwisibali sezivumelwane ukuze uqiniseke ukusebenza kwemithetho yazo. Ukulungiselela nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezinqobo ngesikhathi sokulalela amaphuzu omnikazi nomehlwele wesevisi. Hlela imibiko ngezinkampani ezingenzi / ezingasebenzi kahle futhi incoma izenzo ezifanele zokwenziwa ukulungisa isimo. Ukulawula izenzo zomhloli ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi umsebenzi owenziwe uhambisana namaphuzu amukelekile futhi uphela ngeziyalo ezingeniswe.

xh.title: UmGcina-imali woMmaba ohamba phambili: Ukusebenza kweengozi neeNkontile
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eMpumalanga lifuna uMgcina-imali woMmaba ohamba phambili ukuphatha ukusebenza kweengozi neenkontile kwiOfisi yePhondo eMbombela.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seHigh School / Ibanga lesi-12 kwaye unamashumi amathandathu (6) eminyaka yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yoLawulo lweSisindiko okanye iDiploma / iZemfundo (iNqanaba leNQF 6/7) kuLawulo lweSisindiko / uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwaMasipala / uLawulo lokuGcina iMali. Ubuncinane amathathu (3) eminyaka yamava kwisithuba somLawuli weNgangelelo / iNkonzululi yeNgangelelo / uMgcina-imali woMmaba kwiNqanaba (7). Isifundo esinxulumene neSikolo sokuGcina iMali nangaphezulu kokwazi koMphathi weMali kuya kuba lusizo. Ukulungelelaniswa nokuhlolwa kwezokhuseleko nokuvela kolwazi mayelana nenzala yemali. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekile). Ulwazi, amandla nokugcina: Amakhono okulawula, ukucwangcisa kakuhle nokuhlela kakuhle. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu nakhono lokuTHINTANA oluHLE (elibhaliweyo noluthethwayo). Amandla okusebenza phantsi komthwalo nokulungelelana ukusebenza ngenxa yexesha, xa kufuneka. Amakhono kwiMicrosoft Word neExcel.
xh.duties: Ukugcina isiseko se-data seenkontile zonke ezigqityiweyo. UkuLawula iinkontile ngokusebenzayo ngokweMigaqo, iinkqubo nokuthi zihambelane neemfuno zomthetho ezifaneleyo. Ukugcina irejista yeenkontile kwindlela ebonelelwa yiSikolo sokuGcina iMali sePhondo. Ukuqhagamshelana nebaQamba amaPojekthi ngokusayina iinkontile neendibano zanqanaba lenkonzo ngeenkontile zonke ezinikiweyo yiSebe. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkontile zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo kwiRejista yeNkontile nokuzihlaziya rhoqo kule rejista yeenkontile. Ukuphonononga iinkontile kule rejista yeenkontile ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwazo. Ukuququzelela nokulawula ukusebenzisa iinkqubo mayelana nokuqwalasela ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki nokuLawula iinkontile. Ukulungisa iingxelo ngamakampani angasebenziyo / aseyonzayo kwaye aze achaze izinyathelo ezifanelekileyo eziza kuthathwa ukulungisa imeko. UkuLawula imisebenzi yabasebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi oenziweyo uhambelana namazinga afanelekileyo ugqitywa ngaphakathi kwexesha elivunyelweyo.

jobs.summary: Provisioning administrative officer supervising demand, acquisition and logistical services at the Mpumalanga Provincial Office, requiring Grade 12 with three years of supply chain experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification plus three (3) years relevant experience in Supply Chain Management or Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Finance / Logistics / Procurement / Supply Chain Management / Financial / Accounting Management as recognised by SAQA. Knowledge and experience of provisioning administration, main focus in the following areas: LOGIS, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury Regulations and general knowledge of Basic accounting system (BAS). Computer literacy. Sound interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal). Good management and supervisory skills. Ability to work independently and tight deadlines. Valid driver’s licence will be an added advantage.

Supervise and control the work of sub-ordinate (including training) in the supply chain management unit. Deal with more advanced and complicated matters pertaining to provisioning administration. Manage all aspects of orders such as quotations, purchase and processing of requisitions, authorization of procurement advice and guidance to all clients, chief user clerks and responsibility managers. Ensure compliance with departmental and Treasury Regulations. Evaluate and test compliance of all purchasing transactions. Manage all open orders. Deal with Human resources matters such as leave and perform development system of quarterly evaluation reports. Adhere to regulations and legislation pertaining supply chain management unit. Facilitate and administer requisitions for good and services. Implement internal procurement policies, regulations systems and procedures. Maintain procurement and provisioning systems and processes. Administer payment processes. Knowledge of BAS and LOGIS financial systems. Ability to work under pressure. Supervision of the subordinates. Attend and respond to audit queries.

af.title: Voorseeningsadministratiewe beampte: Logistieke Bestuur
af.summary: Voorseeningsadministratiewe beampte wat voorsiening, verkryging en logistieke dienste by die Mpumalanga Provinsiale Kantoor toesien, met 'n vereiste van Graad 12 en drie jaar se ervaring in die voorsieningsketting.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Graad 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus drie (3) jaar relevante ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur of Diploma / Graad (NQF Vlak 6/7) in Finansies / Logistiek / Procurement / Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Finansiële / Rekeningkunde Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis en ervaring van voorseeningsadministrasie, met hoofklem op die volgende areas: LOGIS, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie Regulasies en algemene kennis van Basic accounting system (BAS). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goed ontwikkelde interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Goie bestuurs- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en styf deadlines na te kom. Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor en voorsiening en verkrygingsdienste lewer. Toesig hou oor en logistieke dienste verrig. Toesig hou oor en beheer die werk van ondergeskiktes (insluitend opleiding) in die voorsieningskettingbestuureenheid. Hanter meer gevorderde en ingewikkelde aangeleenthede rakende voorseeningsadministrasie. Bestuur alle aspekte van bestellings soos kwotasies, aankoop en verwerking van versoekskrifte, magtiging van verkrygingsadvies en -leiding aan alle kliënte, hoofgebruikersklerke en verantwoordelikheidsbestuurders. Verseker nakoming van departementele en Tesourie Regulasies. Evalueer en toets nakoming van alle aankooptransaksies. Bestuur alle oop bestellings. Hanter Menslike hulpbronne aangeleenthede soos verlof en voer die ontwikkelingstelsel van kwartaal evaluasieverslae uit. Hou aan regulasies en wetgewing rakende die voorsieningskettingbestuureenheid. Fasiliteer en administer versoekskrifte vir goedere en dienste. Implementeer interne verkrygingsbeleid, regulasies stelsels en prosedures. Onderhou verkrygings- en voorseeningstelsels en -prosesse. Administer betalingsprosesse. Kennis van BAS en LOGIS finansiële stelsels. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Toesig oor die ondergeskiktes. Bywoon en reageer op ouditnavrae.

zu.title: Inkulu Kazokuphathwa Kwezinsizakalo: Ukuphathwa Kwezohwebo
zu.summary: Inkulu kazokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo ebeke izimo zokufuna, ukuthola kanye nezinsizakulo zokuhanjiswa kwempahla eSikhundleni Sezifundazwe saseMpumalanga, edinga ibanga lesi-12 neminyaka emithathu yohlelolwemisebenzi wezinxephe ezihamba phambili.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatikolomo ephakeme / ibanga lesi-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yohlelolwemisebenzi oluhambisana nokuphathwa kwezinxephe ezihamba phambili noma izifundo zeDiploma / I-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwezezimali / wokuhanjiswa kwempahla / kokuthenga / ukuphathwa kwezinxephe ezihamba phambili / ukuphathwa kwezezimali / ekubhalwen kwemali njengoba kubonwa uSAQA. Ukwazi futhi unolwazi ekuphathweni kwezinsizakolo, kugxilwe kakhulu kule minyakulu elandelayo: i-LOGIS, Umthethosivivinywa Wokuthenga Ngokuthandwa (PPPFA), umthetho wokuphathwa kwemali kahulumeni (PFMA) kanye nemithetho yokuphathwa kwesikweletu, kanye nolwazi jikelele mayelana nesistimu esiyisisekelo yekubhalwa kwemali (BAS). Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha. Ukuba nobuhlakani bokuxhumana nabantu nokucommunicate (okulotshiwe nokuvela kolimi). Amakhono amahle okuphatha nokubeka isiboniso abasebenzini. Ikhono lokusebenza ngodwa nokuhlalela izikhathi ezibekiwe. Ilayisensi yokuqasha izimoto evuma ukuthi ihole impahla ibe yindlela ekungenisa inzuzo.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uhlinze ngezinsizakolo zokufuna nokuthenga. Qapha futhi wenze izinsizakolo zokuhanjiswa kwempahla. Qapha futhi ulawule imisebenzi yabalawuli (okubandakanya ukugadula) kwiyunithi yokuphathwa kwezinxephe ezihamba phambili. Uphathise izinto ezinkulu futhi ezinobudlelwano obubucayi mayelana nenyulo lokusebenzisa. Phatha zonke izindlela zemiyalelo efana nokuthenga okuqala ngosuku, ukuthenga nokuqhuba imibuzo yezidingo, imvumela yokubala kwemali nokuyala bonke abathengi, ababhalisi bokusebenza kwezinhloko kanye nabaphathi beboptobedlulo. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho yomnyango kanye Nemithetho Yokuphathwa Isikweletu. Hlola futhi ukuhlola ukuthobela kwemithetho yonke imisebenzi yokuthenga. Phatha yonke imiyalelo evulekile. Phathisana nezindaba zezinsizakolo zomuntunjengezinkulo futhi ukwenze isistimu yentuthuko yokwenza umbiko wokuqashwa kwesikhathi ngasinye. Landela imithetho nalemigomo ephathelene neyunithi yokuphathwa kwezinxephe ezihamba phambili. Phatha futhi wenze imibuzo yezidingo kwezimpahla kanye nezinsizakolo. Faka esikhathini imigomo, imithetho, izistimu kanye nenqubo yokuthenga yangaphakathi. Gcina izistimu kanye nenqubo yokuthenga kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakolo. Phatha inqubo yokukhokha. Ulwazi mayelana nezistimu zemali i-BAS kanye ne-LOGIS. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenhlekisa. Ukubeka isibonisa abalawuli. Hlala uphendula imibuzo ngokuhlola imibhalo.

xh.title: Iofisa loLawulo lokuNika izinto: uLawulo loHambiso
xh.summary: Iofisa lolawulo lokunika izinto oluphatha izicelo, okuthengwa nezinkonzo zohambiso kwiOfisi yaseMpumalanga yePhondo, kufuneka ubengumntu oneMatriki/igreydi 12 eneminyaka emithathu yamava kwinkqubo yohambiso.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior / igreydi 12 okanye isifundo esilinganayo kunye neminyaka mithathu (3) yamava ahambelanayo kuLawulo loHambiso okanye iDiploma / iDigrizi (NQF Level 6/7) kwezeMali / loHambiso /okuThengwa / uLawulo loHambiso / uLawulo lwezeMali / oBhaliso njengoko iqatshelwa yiSAQA. Ulwazi namava okusingqongweni kolawulo lokunika izinto, intshayelelo ingqalelo enkulu kwezindawo zilandelayo: LOGIS, iPreferential Procurement Policy Framework (PPPFA), iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) namaxwebhu eTreasury kunye nolwazi jikelele lenkqubo yeBasic accounting system (BAS). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amaphepha amabalwo okuchazwa nabantu nokunxibelelana (okubhalisiweyo nokuthethwayo). Amaphiko alungileyo oluLawulo nokulawula. Amandla okusebenza uzimele nangexeshana elinzima. Ilayiseni yokushayela esebenzayo iya kuba ngaphezulu kwezinye.
xh.duties: Phatha kwaye unike izinkonzo zezicelo nokuTHENGWA. Phatha kwaye wenze izinkonzo zohambiso. Phatha ulawule umsebenzi babo baphansi kwaye (kuquka uqeqesho) kwiyunithi yolawulo lohambiso. Jongana nemiba ethuthukeleyo nentsindileyo ehlobene nolawulo lokunika izinto. Lawula onke amanqanaba eodolo anjengekota, uthengiso nokucutshungula izicelo, igunya leluleko lokuthenga kubo bonke abathengi, ababhalisi basebenzi abakhulu nabaphathi abanenxaxheba. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kwemiGaqo yesebe neyaseTreasury. Linganisela uhlule ukuzithoba kuzo zonke iinkqubo zokuThenga. Lawula onke amaodolo avulekileyo. Jongana nemiba yabalimi abanjengoluhlaso kwaye wenze inkqubo yophuhliso yokwenza iire포to zohlolo nyaka zithathwa ngoqondo. Gxila kumthetho nemigaqo ehlobene neyunithi yolawulo loHambiso. Qedela uphehle izicelo kumaxhulu namathuba. Misela ngaphakathi iinkqubo, imigaqo, iinkqubo neendlela zokuThenga. Yenza iinkqubo namaxhulu oluLawulo lokuthenga nokunika izinto. Lawula iinkqubo zokuhlawula. ULwazi lweBAS neLOGIS kwezamatheminshi. Amandla okusebenza ngocango. UkuPhatha abo baphansi kwaye. Khubeka kwaye uphendule imibuzo yolawulo.

jobs.title: Senior State LAW Adviser: Legal Advisory Services (OSD)
jobs.salary_text: R1 242 915 per annum (LP9 - OSD), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The successful candidate will be required to enter into a Performance Agreement with the Principal State Law Adviser.
jobs.summary: Senior State Law Adviser providing legal opinions and drafting provincial legislation for the Mpumalanga Provincial Government in Mbombela.
jobs.requirements: An LLB degree or a recognized 4-year legal qualification equivalent to NQF 8. Admission as an Advocate or Attorney. At least eight (8) years’ appropriate post qualification litigation/advisory experience. A postgraduate qualification will be an advantage; Knowledge of particular aspects of the Law; Knowledge and understanding of Constitutional Law, Human Rights and the Constitution of South Africa, practical experience in drafting of Bills; Knowledge of specifically the Public Service Act, Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Skills and competences: Legal Research and drafting; Dispute resolution; Analytical thinking; Communication skills (written and verbal); Presentation and facilitation skills; Financial management skills; Computer literacy; Strategic planning capabilities and Leadership skills. Ability to work as part of a team, individual and to function effectively under pressure. Essential skills will include the following: Drafting of Provincial legislation, legal opinions and interpretation of legislation. Strategic capability and leadership, financial management, change management, knowledge management, People management and empowerment, programme and project management, service delivery innovations, communication, client orientation and customer focus, problem solving and analysis.
jobs.duties: Provision of legal advice and furnishing of oral and written legal opinions and assistance to the Mpumalanga Provincial Government. Being responsible for the drafting of Provincial legislation and on a continuous basis, for the rationalization of Provincial laws, including old order legislation. Draft employment contracts, service level agreements, memoranda, letters and any other documents with a legal bearing. Formulate and scrutinize Provincial legislation, including subordinate legislation, i.e. Proclamations, Notices, Regulations, etc . Certify internal documents. Making inputs concerning policy formulation and implementation and preparing comments on draft Bills and policies of National Departments. Management of risks as identified in respect of the Legal Advisory Services Unit.
jobs.enquiries: should be directed to the Deputy Director: Internal HRM & D: Ms. SS Monareng: Tel No: (013) 766 2004.
jobs.applications: Should only be submitted online through the link: erecruitment.mpg.gov.za on the new Z83 form and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications. If no correspondence is received within two months of the closing date, applicants must accept that their applications have been unsuccessful.
jobs.notes: The Office of the Premier is an equal opportunity employer. It is our intention to promote respresentativity in respect of race, gender and disability through the filling of these positions and that the candidature of persons, whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representativeness, will receive preference. The minimum entry requirement for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts is a Pre-entry Certificate that is obtainable through a course named Certificate for entry into SMS submitted prior to appointment, and the full     details    can     be     sourced    by     following     the     link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. (SMS Pre-entry Certificate submitted prior appointment) All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The recommended candidates for Senior Management Level (SMS) and Middle Management Level (MMS) posts shall be subjected to a competency assessment. All appointments are subject to security clearance, security vetting, employment reference checks, qualification verification and signing of performance agreements. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Staatsregswenadviseur: Regsadviesdienste (OSD)
af.summary: Senior Staatsregswenadviseur wat regsmenings verskaf en provinsiale wetgewing opstel vir die Mpumalanga Provinciale Regering in Mbombela.
af.requirements: n LLB-graad of 'n erkende 4-jarige regskwalifikasie gelykstaande aan NQF 8. Toelating as 'n Advokaat of Prokureur. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie litigasie-/advieservaring. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n voordeel wees; Kennis van spesifieke aspekte van die Reg; Kennis en begrip van Grondwetlike Reg, Menseregte en die Grondwet van Suid-Afrika, praktiese ervaring in die opstel van Wetsontwerpe; Kennis van spesifiek die Openbare Dienswet, Openbare Finanziesbeheerwet en Tesourie-regulasies. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Regsondersoek en opstel; Skikkingoplossing; Analitiese denke; Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings); Voorlegging en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Finansiële bestuursvaardighede; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Strategiese beplningsvermoëns en leierskapsvaardighede. Vermoë om as deel van 'n span te werk, individueel en om effektief onder druk te funksioneer. Essensiële vaardighede sal die volgende insluit: Opstel van provinsiale wetgewing, regsmenings en interpretasie van wetgewing. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, program- en projekbestuur, diensleweringinnovasies, kommunikasie, kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus, probleemoplossing en analise.
af.duties: Verskaffing van regsadvies en die verskaf van mondelinge en skriftelike regsmenings en bystand aan die Mpumalanga Provinciale Regering. Verantwoordelik vir die opstel van provinsiale wetgewing en op 'n deurlopende basis, vir die rasionalisering van provinsiale wette, insluitend ou-orde-wetgewing. Opstel van dienskontrakte, diensvlakooreenkomste, memoranda, briewe en enige ander dokumente met 'n regsimplikasie. Formuleer en ondersoek provinsiale wetgewing, insluitend ondergeskikte wetgewing, d.w.s. Proklamasies, Kennisgewings, Regulasies, ens. Sertifiseer interne dokumente. Lewer insette rakende beleidsformulering en -implementering en berei kommentaar op konsepwetsontwerpe en beleide van Nasionale Departemente voor. Bestuur van risiko's soos geïdentifiseer ten opsigte van die Regsadviesdienste-eenheid.

zu.title: Umeluleki Wezomthetho Ohleziwe Ohlelwe Kangangamakhulu: Iinsiza Zokweluleka Ngomthetho (OSD)
zu.summary: Umeluleki Wezomthetho Ohleziwe Ohlelwe Kangangamakhulu obika imibono yomthetho futhi ebhalwa umthetho wesifundazwe wohulumeni wesifundazwe wakwaMpumalanga eMbombela.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-LLB noma isiqu somthetho sezinhle zonyaka ezilandelanayo esivunyelwe esilingana ne-NQF 8. Ukuvunyelwa njengoMmeli noma njengommeli. Okungenani uyisikhombisa (8) iminyaka yohlelo lokusebenza okufanele ngemva kokuthola isiqu ekulwelweni ithulusi/ukweluleka. Isiqu sesikhathi samva kuzoba yithuba elihle; Ulwazi ngemiqondo ethize yomthetho; Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho wesizinda, Amalungelo abantu kanye nomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, ulwazi lokusebenza ekubhalweni komthetho; Ulwazi olukhethekile ngoMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi kanye Nemithetho yesigodlo. Amakhono nokuzakhela: Ukuphenya ngomthetho nokubhala; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya; Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo); Amakhono okuyisa imibono nokusiza ukuthi kutholakale isixazululo; Amakhono okuphatha imali; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuthuthukile; Ikhono lokucabanga ngokusuka kude kanye namakhono eba ngumholi. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu, ngabanye nokusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphansi koxhaxha. Amakhono abalulekile azofaka okulandelayo: Ukubhala komthetho wesifundazwe, imibono yomthetho nokuchazwa komthetho. Ikhono lokuhola nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kolwazi, ukuphathwa abantu nokunika amandla, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi, izinto ezintsha zokulethwa kwenkonzo, ukuxhumana, ukugxila kukhasimende nokugxila kumthengi, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuqhathanisa.
zu.duties: Ukunika izeluleko zomthetho kanye nokuletha imibono yomthetho yokukhuluma nokubhaliwa kanye nensiza kuHulumeni wakwaMpumalanga wesifundazwe. Ukuba nomthwalo wokubhala umthetho wesifundazwe futhi ngokuqhubekayo, ukuze kuqatshwe kabusha umthetho wesifundazwe, okuhlanganisa nomthetho wegazi lasemandulo. Ukubhala izivumelwano zokusebenza, izivumelwano zanoma yisiphi isabelo, imibhalo, incwadi nanoma yimiphi eminye imibhalo enesigaxa somthetho. Ukuhlela futhi ukuhlola umthetho wesifundazwe, okuhlanganisa nomthetho ongaphansi kwawo, okungaba nguMthetho, Izaziso, Izimiso, njll. Ukugunyaza imibhalo yangaphakathi. Ukuletha imibono ngokuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo kanye nokuhlola izikombiso ngokuhlelwa kwemithetho kanye nezinhlaka zamaphoyisa kazwelonke. Ukuphatha izingozi ezibonakalayo ngokuphathelene neNyongo Yezinsiza Zokweluleka Ngomthetho.

xh.title: Umcebisi Ophakamileyo WoMthetho WesiLawa: Iinkonzo Zokuncedwa ngoMthetho (OSD)
xh.summary: Umcebisi Ophakamileyo WoMthetho WesiLawa onika izimvozo zomthetho ebhala ngayo iimthetho karhulumente yephondo kwakulawulo lwephondo likaMpumalanga eMbombela.
xh.requirements: Inqaphelo le-LLB okanye inqaphelo elidumileyo leminyaka emine (4) elilingana ne-NQF 8. Ukwamkelwa njengengceli okanye ummeli. Ubuncinane beminyaka yamashumi asixhenxe (8) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokufumana inqaphelo ekulemele/ukuncedzeni ngomthetho. Isatifikethi sokugqiba izifundo emva kwe-degree siza kuba ngumda oluncedo; Ulwazi ngezinto ezithile zomthetho; Ulwazi nokuqonda koMthetho womgaqo-siseko, amaQabanelo oLuntu nomgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika, amava okwenza izebhile emzimbeni ezenza iMithetho; Ulwazi ngakumbi ngoMthetho woBulungu, uMthetho woLawulo loMvuzo woRhulumente noMthetho wokuLawula uGcino. Amakhono namandla: Uphando ngomthetho nobhaliweyo; Isisombululo sezimpixano; Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya; Amakhono okunxibelelwana (abhalwayo nethethwayo); Amakhono okubonisa nokuqhuba; Amakhono olawulo lemali; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Amakhono okucwangcisa ngokwenza istratigi nokuqhatha; Isakhono sokusebenza njengesiqhthi sehlabathi, ngamnye nokusebenza kakuhle phantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhona abalulekileyo aya kuquka oku kulandelayo: Ukubhala ngemithetho karhulumente yephondo, izimvozo ngomthetho nentshayo yomthetho. Isakhono esistratigi nokuqhatha, ulawulo lwezimali, ulawulo loshintsho, ulawulo lolwazi, ulawulo lwabantu nokuqiniswa, ulawulo lwenkqubo namaphulo, izinto ezintsha ekuletkeni iinkonzo, ulwazi nakunxibelelwano, uqwalaselo kwabathengi nokuqwalasela abathengi, ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngendlela yolwazi ngomthetho nokunika izimvozo ngomthetho ezithethwayo nezibhalwayo nencedo kulawulo lwephondo likaMpumalanga. Ukuba noxanduva lokubhala iimthetho karhulumente yephondo nasekuhlala njalo, ukwenzela ukulawula iimthetho yephondo, kuquka iimthetho yoluhlu oludala. Ukubhala iinkqubo zomsebenzi, izivumelwano zanqanaba lekonzo, amamoridsa, iileta nayo nan na amanye amaxwebhu anesimo somthetho. Ukwenza nokuqwalasela iimthetho karhulumente yephondo, kuquka iimthetho ezincinane, i.e. Iproklamathsi, Izaziso, Iimthetho, njl. Ukugqinisa amaxwebhu angaphakathi. Ukwenza izinto ezithethwa ngayo ngenkqubo yokuyilwa nokwenziwa kolwazi ngomthetho nokuqulunqa izimvozo kwimithetho ekuqulunqeni nangenkqubo kumasebe oRhulumente wezwelonke. Ulawulo lweengozi ezifunyanisiweyo ngenkqubo yeNkonzo zoNcedo ngoMthetho.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Strategic Management and Planning
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The successful candidate will be required to enter into a Performance Agreement with the Director: Strategic Management and Planning.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Strategic Management and Planning at the Office of the Premier in Mbombela, requiring a relevant undergraduate qualification and three years of junior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA-recognised undergraduate in Public Administration / Public Affairs / Public Management / Monitoring and Evaluation or relevant qualification (NQF Level 07). A minimum (3) years of functional work experience and should be at junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Knowledge of strategic management and service delivery improvement frameworks. Understanding of project management and financial management. In-depth knowledge and understanding of: Legislation governing planning and reporting. Data Collection. Analysis and report writing. Research methodology. Strategic Planning Processes. Ability to develop and apply policies. Sound organising, planning and excellent communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and long hours. Essential skills will include the following: Knowledge and Understanding of DPME Revised Framework, Project Management, Legislative Mandates, Treasury Regulation and Public Service Act. Competent skills in Computer Literacy, People Management, Planning and Organising, Report Writing and Minute Taking, Decision- making, Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving, and Communication and Presentation.
jobs.duties: Facilitate and coordinate operational and strategic planning processes. Facilitate the development of a Strategic Plan, Provincial Program of Action and Annual Performance Plan. Coordinate the development of the departmental Annual Operational Plan. Develop, review and coordinate the implementation of departmental Information and Knowledge Management strategies, policies, frameworks, standard operating procedures and implementation plans. Coordinate and support Knowledge Management maturity assessments, compliance assessments, evidence collection, remedial action plans and reporting to oversight structures. Align Information and Knowledge Management initiatives with government priorities, departmental strategic plans, annual performance plans, operational plans. Develop compliance matrix. Develop reporting templates as per the approved plans. Prepare Knowledge Management performance information for monthly, quarterly and annual reporting.
