af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Strategiese Bestuur en Beplanning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Strategiese Bestuur en Beplanning by die Kantoor van die Premier in Mbombela, wat 'n toepaslike voorgraadse kwalifikasie en drie jaar se junior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Public Administration / Public Affairs / Public Management / Monitoring and Evaluation of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie (NQF Level 07). 'n Minimum van (3) jaar se funksionele werkservaring en moet op junior bestuursvlak wees (Assistant Director-vlak of gelykwaardig). Kennis van strategiese bestuur en diensleweringverbeteringsraamwerke. Begrip van projekbestuur en finansiële bestuur. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van: Wetgewing wat beplanning en verslagdoening reël. Dataversameling. Analise en verslagskrywing. Navorsingsmetodologie. Strategiese beplanningsprosesse. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas. Gesonde organisasie-, beplannings- en uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk en lang ure te werk. Essensiële vaardighede sal die volgende insluit: Kennis en begrip van DPME Revised Framework, Project Management, Legislative Mandates, Treasury Regulation en Public Service Act. Bevoegde vaardighede in Computer Literacy, People Management, Planning and Organising, Report Writing and Minute Taking, Decision-making, Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving, en Communication and Presentation.
af.duties: Fasiliteer en koördineer operasionele en strategiese beplanningsprosesse. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n Strategic Plan, Provincial Program of Action en Annual Performance Plan. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van die departementele Annual Operational Plan. Ontwikkel, hersien en koördineer die implementering van departementele Information and Knowledge Management-strategieë, beleide, raamwerke, standaardbedryfsprosedures en implementeringsplanne. Koördineer en ondersteun Knowledge Management-volwassenheid assessments, voldoeningsassessering, bewysversameling, remediese aksieplanne en verslagdoening aan toesigstrukture. Belyn Information and Knowledge Management-inisiatiewe met regeringsprioriteite, departementele strategiese planne, jaarlikse prestasieplanne, operasionele planne. Ontwikkel 'n voldoeningsmatriks. Ontwikkel verslagsjablone volgens die goedgekeurde planne. Berei Knowledge Management-prestasie-inligting voor vir maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslagdoening.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaNobhala Phansi: Ephathwa Nokuqondiswa Kohlelo Nokuhlela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNobhala Phansi sePhathwa Nokuqondiswa Kohlelo Nokuhlela eOffice of the Premier eMbombela, sidinga izifundo ezifanele zesiqu esingaphansi kokuqeqeshwa kanye namaviki amathathu wemisebenzi yokuba ngumqondisi osheshise.
zu.requirements: I-undergraduate evunyiwe ngu-SAQA kwi-Public Administration / Public Affairs / Public Management / Monitoring and Evaluation noma izifundo ezifanele (NQF Level 07). Okuncane eminyakeni (3) yemisebenzi futhi kufanele kube izinga lomqondisi osheshise (izinga lomsizi womqondisi noma okulinganayo). Ukwazi ukuphathwa ngokuqondiswa nokuqhubekeka kokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokuphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi oluqinile nokuqonda: Umthetho olawula ukuhlela nokubika. Ukuqoqa idatha. Ukuhlaziya nokubika. Indlela yocwaningo. Inqubo yokuhlela ngokuqondiswa. Ikono lokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ikono elihle lokuhlela, ukulungisa nokuxhumana okuphezulu. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva nangamasikhathi amade. Amakhono abalulekile afaka okulandelayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokuHlelwa kabusha kwesakhiwo se-DPME, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, imithetho elawulayo, imithetho yeTreasury kanye ne-Public Service Act. Ukubekezela ekubhaleni ngokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, ukuphatha abantu, ukuhlela nokulungisa, ukubika nokubhala imizuzu, ukwenza izinqumo, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokuxhumana nokwethula.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi uhlanganise inqubo yokuqondiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqondiswa kanye nezoqhumbana. Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kweStrategic Plan, iProvincial Program of Action kanye neAnnual Performance Plan. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Annual Operational Plan yomnyango. Thuthukisa, hlaziya futhi uhlanganise ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi lomnyango, izinqubomgomo, izakhiwo, izingqikithi zokuqondisa eziyisisekelo futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Hlanganisa futhi usekela ukulinganiswa kokuvuthwa kokuphathwa kolwazi, ukulinganiswa kokuhambisana nemithetho, ukuqoqa izibonakaliso, izinhlelo zokuqhubisa ukulungiswa nokubikela izakhiwo eziqondisayo. Hlanganisela izinhlela zokuphathwa kolwazi nezinkomba zombuso, izinhlelo zokuqondiswa komnyango, izinhlelo zomsebenzi wamashumi nanhlanu, izinhlelo zokuqhubekeka zansuku zonke. Thuthukisa imatriksi yokuhambisana. Thuthukisa amathempleyithi okubika njengoba kuhleliwe ezinhlelweni ezivunyiwe. Lukethe ulwazi lokuqhubekeka kokuphathwa kolwazi ngokubika ngenyanga zonyaka, ngesikhathi esiyisigamu unyaka kanye nonyaka wonke.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukulawula ngoBuchule nokuCwangcisa
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wokuLawula ngoBuchule nokuCwangcisa eKantoro kaMongameli eMbombela, efunayo izifundo ezifanelekile zesiqu esingaphantsi kweziqu ezinesiqinisekiso se-SAQA kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava abasebenzi abangabaphathi abancinci.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekile esinamandla esiphawulwe yi-SAQA kwi-Public Administration / Public Affairs / Public Management / Monitoring and Evaluation okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 07). Uqobo (3) eminyaka yamava okusebenza kwaye kufuneka abe kwinqanaba lobaphathi abancinci (inqanaba lase-Assistant Director okanye elingana nalo). Ulwazi ngolawulo ngobuchule nakwiikhowudi zokuphucula ukunikezwa kweenkonzo. Ukuqonda ukulawula amaprojekthi kunye nokulawula iimali. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda: oMthetho olawula ucwangciso neengxelo. Ukuqokelela iData. Ukuhlalutya nokubhala iingxelo. Indlela yokuqonda uphando. Iinkqubo zoCwangciso ngobuchule. Amandla okuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Amandla aphakamileyo okuquka, ukuqamba iindlela ezintsha kwaye athetha kakuhle. Amandla okusebenza phantsi kwexesha elinzima nangamaxa amade. Amandla abalulekileyo aza kuqulatha oku kulandelayo: Ulwazi nokuQonda kwi-DPME Revised Framework, ukuLawula amaProjekthi, oMthetho oLawulayo, i-Treasury Regulation kunye noMthetho woBumnini woRhulumente. Amandla obuchule ekuSebenziseni iKhompyutha, ukuLawula abaBantu, ukuCwangcisa nokuQuka, ukuBhala iingxelo nokuThatha iiMiniti,okuThatha iziGqibo, ukuCinga ngeNdlela eNzulu nokuSomba iingxaki, nokuThetha nokubonisa okubalulekileyo.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambili kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo zocwangciso lokusebenza nolobuchule. Qhubela phambili ukuphuhliswa kwe-Sstrategic Plan, Provincial Program of Action ne-Annual Performance Plan. Lungelelanisa ukuphuhliswa kwe-dpartmental Annual Operational Plan. Phuhlisa, phinda uhloliswe kwaye ulungelelanise ukusebenziswa kweekhumenti zesebe zokuLawula ulwazi nolwazi, iinkqubo, iikhowudi, iinkqubo zokusebenza ezisesikweni neendawo zicwangcisiweyo zokusebenzisa. Lungelelanise kwaye uxhase ukulinganiswa ngobuchule kokuLawula ulwazi, iingxelo zokuvumelana, ukuqokelela imiqondo, iiplani zenzo zokulungisa nokuvela kumajelo olawulayo. Linganisa izigqibo zokuLawula ulwazi nolwazi nezigqibo zorhulumente, iiplani zesebe zobuchule, iiplani zemveliso yonyaka, iiplani zokusebenza. Phuhlisa imatriksi yobume bomthetho. Phuhlisa iitemplate zengxelo njengoko beplanwewe kwaye zivunyiwe. Lungiselela i-data yemveliso yokuLawula ulwazi yexesha lenyanga, kodwa ngenyanga nangonyaka.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Risk Management–business Continuity
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (an all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Risk Management and Business Continuity at the Office of the Premier in Mbombela, requiring a degree and experience in business continuity management.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in risk management, or a related field. Professional certifications in business continuity management. Minimum of (3) years of experience in business continuity management and 5 years in related field. Strong knowledge of business continuity management principles, methodologies, and best practices. Knowledge of BCM standards and frameworks such as ISO 22301 or NIST SP 800-34. Project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines. Familiarity with business continuity management software, tools and technologies. and Experience in conducting risk assessments and business impact analyses. Essential skills will include the following: Risk management. Ethics management. Business Continuity Management. Interpersonal relations. Strategic capability and leadership. Financial management. Change management. Report writing and presentation. Knowledge management. People management and empowerment. Programme and project management. Service delivery innovations. Client orientation and customer focus. Problem solving and analysis. Communications. The successful candidate will be required to enter into a Performance Agreement with the Director: Risk Management.
jobs.duties: Develop and maintain business continuity program. Manage the entity-wide business continuity strategies and response arrangements. Provide technical advice to management to carry out business impact analysis and prepare business continuity plans. Manage the design, build, test and monitor the implantation of capacity BC planning. Liaise with ICT to ensure integration on business continuity plans to the disaster recovery. Develop central source of information and conduct awareness workshop.
jobs.enquiries: should be directed to the Deputy Director: Internal HRM & D: Ms. SS Monareng Tel No: (013) 766 2004.
jobs.applications: Should only be submitted online through the link: erecruitment.mpg.gov.za on the new Z83 form and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications. If no correspondence is received within two months of the closing date, applicants must accept that their applications have been unsuccessful.
jobs.notes: The Office of the Premier is an equal opportunity employer. It is our intention to promote respresentativity in respect of race, gender and disability through the filling of these positions and that the candidature of persons, whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representativeness, will receive preference. The minimum entry requirement for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts is a Pre-entry Certificate that is obtainable through a course named Certificate for entry into SMS submitted prior to appointment, and the full     details    can     be     sourced    by     following     the     link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. (SMS Pre-entry Certificate submitted prior appointment) All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The recommended candidates for Senior Management Level (SMS) and Middle Management Level (MMS) posts shall be subjected to a competency assessment. All appointments are subject to security clearance, security vetting, employment reference checks, qualification verification and signing of performance agreements. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Risikobestuur–Besigheidskontinuïteit
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Risikobestuur en Besigheidskontinuïteit by die Kantoor van die Premier in Mbombela, wat 'n graad en ervaring in besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Bachelorsgraad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in risikobestuur of 'n verwante veld. Professionele sertifiserings in besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur. Minimum van (3) jaar se ervaring in besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur en 5 jaar in 'n verwante veld. Sterk kennis van besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuursbeginsels, -metodes en -best practices. Kennis van BCM-standaarde en -raamwerke soos ISO 22301 of NIST SP 800-34. Projekbestuursvaardighede, met die vermoë om veelvuldige projekte gelyktydig te bestuur en streng sperdatums te haal. Vertroudheid met besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuursagteware, -nutsgoed en -tegnologieë. En ervaring in die uitvoer van risiko-assesserings en besigheidsimpakontledings. Essensiële vaardighede sal die volgende insluit: Risikobestuur. Etiekbestuur. Besigheidskontinuïteitsbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Verslagskrywing en aanbieding. Kennisbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Diensleweringinnovasies. Kliëntoriëntasie en klantfokus. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Kommunikasie. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om 'n Prestasieooreenkoms met die Direkteur: Risikobestuur te sluit.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en handhaaf besigheidskontinuïteitsprogram. Bestuur die entiteitbreë besigheidskontinuïteitsstrategieë en reëlings vir reaksie. Verskaf tegniese advies aan bestuur om besigheidsimpakontleding uit te voer en besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne voor te berei. Bestuur die ontwerp, bou, toetsing en monitering van die implementering van kapasiteits-BC-beplanning. Skakel met ICT om integrasie van besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne met rampsherstel te verseker. Ontwikkel 'n sentrale bron van inligting en hou bewustheidswerkswinkels.

zu.title: Isikhundla Somongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi–Ukuqhubeka Kwebhizinisi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somongameli sokuphathwa kwezingozi nokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi ehhovisi likaMongameli eMbombela, sidinga idigri namava ekuphathweni kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor's degree noma izifundo ezingalingana ekuphathweni kwezingozi, noma enkundleni ehlobene. Izingaqiniso zobungcweti ekuphathweni kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Okungenani (3) iminyaka yamava ekuphathweni kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi neminyaka engu-5 enkundleni ehlobene. Ulwazi olunamandla ngemigomo, izindlela, nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu zokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Ulwazi ngemizingwa nezakhiwo ze-BCM njenge-ISO 22301 noma i-NIST SP 800-34. Amakhono okuphatha imiklamo, nokuthi ukwazi ukuphatha imiklamo eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa futhi uhlangabezane namadethuleli asheshisayo. Ukuzwana nesofthiwe, amathuluzi, nobuchwepheshe bokuphathwa kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Namava ekwenzeni ukuhlola kwezingozi nokuhlola impacto yebhizinisi. Amakhono abalulekile azofaka okulandelayo: Ukuphathwa kwezingozi. Ukuphathwa kobuene. Ukuphathwa kokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ikhasimende nokuqonda abathengi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlola. Unxibelelwano. Umphakathi opumelelayo uzocelwa ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokusebenza noMongameli: Ukuphathwa Kwezingozi.
zu.duties: Yakha futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Phatha izindlela zokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi kuyo yonpi imikhakha kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula. Nikela ngeluleko lobuchwepheshe ekuphathweni ukwenza ukuhlola impacto yebhizinisi futhi ulungise izinhlelo zokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Phatha ukwakheka, ukwakhiwa, ukuvivinywa nokugcinwa kokutholakala kwe-BB planning. Xhumana ne-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqhubeka kwebhizinisi ekubuyisweni ngemva kwezinkinga. Yakha umthombo ophakathi kolwazi futhi ubambe iworkshop yokwazisa.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukulawula Imingozi–Ukuqhubeka Koluntu benkampani
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli wokuLawula imingozi nokuphila koluntu benkampani eKwindla kwaMongameli eMbombela, kufunekwe isidanga namava ekulawulweni kokuqhubeka koluntu benkampani.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ekulawulweni kwezingozi, okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Iifikitifati zobungcali ekulawulweni kokuqhubeka koluntu benkampani. Ukuba nokungaphezulu kwe-(3) iminyaka yamava ekulawulweni kokuqhubeka koluntu benkampani kunye neminyaka emi-5 kwelinye indawo enxulumene nayo. Ulwazi olunamandya ngamagama oMthetho ekulawulweni kokuqhubeka koluntu benkampani, iindlela, kunye nendlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngemigangatho nendawo zokusebenza ze-BCM ezinjengokuba yi-ISO 22301 okanye i-NIST SP 800-34. Amakhono oLawulo lweenjongo, anamandla okulawula iiprojekthi ezininzi ngaxeshanye kwaye uhlangabezane nexesha elifunekwayo ngokukhawuleza. Ukuqonda ngamakhaladi wokuqhubeka koluntu benkampani kakhulu, izixhobo kunye nobuchwepheshe. Kwaye uNamava ekwenzeni isiphelo sokulinganisela iingozi nokuqonda imiphumo koluntu benkampani. Amakhono abalulekileyo aya kuquka oku kulandelayo: Ukulawula iingozi. Ukulawula inkqubo yokuziphatha. Ukulawula ikuqhubeka koluntu benkampani. Izimbo zomanyano. Ulawulo lokuqonda iindlela zolawulo. Ukulawula iimali. Ulawulo olutsha. Ukubhala iireport nezizezizo. Ulwazi ngolawulo. Ulawulo nabantu nokuqinisekisa. Ulawulo lweenkqubo neenjongo. Iindlela ezitsha zokuvelisa inkonzo. Ukuqondisa umthengi kwaye ugqalisise umthengi. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokucokisekileyo. Unxibelelwano. Umntu ophumeleleyo uya kufuneka asayine isivumelwano soLawulo noMongameli: Ukulawula iingozi.
xh.duties: Yakha kwaye ulondoloze inkqubo yoLawulo oluqhubekayo. Lawula izicwangciso zokuLawula oluqhubekayo kwintsellahleko yonke kunye neendlela zokuqhathanisa imiba. Yazeke ulwazi oluqonde kumanabala aLawulayo ukuze balawule imiphumo koluntu benkampani kwaye alungiselele iNkqubo yoLawulo oluqhubekayo. Lawula uyilo, ukuyakha, ukuvavanya kwaye ulawule ukuqutywa kwebala elilungele ukulungiselela ukusilela. Qhagamshelana nabasebenzi be-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudityaniswa kweenkqubo zokuLawula oluqhubekayo kwindlela yokubuyisela iingxaki ekubekweni komsebenzi. Yakha indawo ekuyo kungatholwa ulwazi olubalulekileyo kwaye uqale iindaba zokuvakalayo.

jobs.title: Persal Controller: Financial Management
jobs.summary: Persal Controller needed in Mbombela to maintain PERSAL user profiles, facilitate training and oversee RACEF reporting, requiring a financial degree and PERSAL experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Accounting/Financial Management (NQF Level 6) or Financial related Field. Minimum of 3 years’ experience working in financial systems. Computer literacy. The candidate must have passed the PERSAL Controllers Course and extensive knowledge of the functionality and capabilities of the PERSAL System. Knowledge of Public Financial Management Act. Basic Accounting System (BAS) and other financial systems (LOGIS, PERSAL, etc.) Financial reporting. Treasury regulations. Essential skills will include the following: Planning and Organising Skills. Communication. Conflict management. Motivation skills. Report writing. Logical and analytical thinking. Peoples Management skills. Interpersonal Skills. Decision-making. Problem solving skills. Minutes taking.
jobs.duties: Register and maintain PERSAL user profile. Register PERSAL user and revisers, ensure orientation and maintain profile through selective allocation of functions. Facilitate the training of PERSAL users in the Department. Signing of monthly RACEF reports and examining of daily RACEF Report. Reset revoked users and restore their access to the salary system when authorised. Develop, review and maintain policy ,procedures and best practices pertaining to PERSAL user and system management. Represent the Department on the provincial PERSAL forum. Regularly monitor the audit- and control reports available on PERSAL.
jobs.enquiries: should be directed to the Deputy Director: Internal HRM & D: Ms. SS Monareng Tel No: (013) 766 2004.
jobs.applications: Should only be submitted online through the link: erecruitment.mpg.gov.za on the new Z83 form and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications. If no correspondence is received within two months of the closing date, applicants must accept that their applications have been unsuccessful.

It is our intention to promote respresentativity in respect of race, gender and disability through the filling of these positions and that the candidature of persons, whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representativeness, will receive preference. The minimum entry requirement for Senior Management Services (SMS) posts is a Pre-entry Certificate that is obtainable through a course named Certificate for entry into SMS submitted prior to appointment, and the full     details    can     be     sourced    by     following     the     link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. (SMS Pre-entry Certificate submitted prior appointment) All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The recommended candidates for Senior Management Level (SMS) and Middle Management Level (MMS) posts shall be subjected to a competency assessment. All appointments are subject to security clearance, security vetting, employment reference checks, qualification verification and signing of performance agreements. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Persal-beheerder: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Persal-beheerder benodig in Mbombela om PERSAL-gebruikersprofiele in stand te hou, opleiding te fasiliteer en RACEF-verslagdoening te toesien, met 'n finansiële graad en PERSAL-ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Rekenkunde/Finansiële Bestuur (NQF Level 6) of 'n finansiële verwante veld. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in finansiële stelsels. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Die kandidaat moet die PERSAL Controllers Course geslaag het en uitgebreide kennis hê van die funksionaliteit en vermoëns van die PERSAL-stelsel. Kennis van die Public Financial Management Act. Basiese Rekenkundige Stelsel (BAS) en ander finansiële stelsels (LOGIS, PERSAL, ens.). Finansiële verslagdoening. Tesourie-regulasies. Essensiële vaardighede sluit die volgende in: Beplanning en organisasievaardighede. Kommunikasie. Konflikbestuur. Motiveringsvaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Logiese en analitiese denke. Mensebestuursvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Besluitneming. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Notule neem.
af.duties: Registreer en onderhou PERSAL-gebruikersprofiel. Registreer PERSAL-gebruikers en hersieners, verseker oriëntasie en onderhou profiel deur selektiewe toekenning van funksies. Fasiliteer die opleiding van PERSAL-gebruikers in die Department. Ondertekening van maandelikse RACEF-verslae en ondersoek van daaglikse RACEF-verslag. Herstel herroep gebruikers en herstel hul toegang tot die salarisstelsel wanneer gemagtig. Ontwikkel, hersien en onderhou beleid, prosedures en beste praktyke met betrekking tot PERSAL-gebruiker en stelselbestuur. Verteenwoordig die Department op die provinsiale PERSAL-forum. Monitor gereeld die oudit- en beheerverslae wat op PERSAL beskikbaar is.

zu.title: Isilawuli se-Persal: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka isilawuli se-Persal e-Mbombela ukugcina iphrofayili yabasebenzisi be-PERSAL, ukuqeqesha abantu kanye nokulawula ukubika kwe-RACEF, kutholwe iziqu zezimali namava e-PERSAL.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyi-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma ezifanelekileyo kwi-Accounting/Financial Management (NQF Level 6) noma enkingeni enezimali. Okungenani eminyaka engu-3 yamava kokusebenza kumasistemu wezimali. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kumele umkhankaso adlule koqeqesho lokuba nguPERSAL Controllers futhi abe nolwazi olubanzi ngemisebenzi namandla kwasistimu ye-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Financial Management Act. I-Basic Accounting System (BAS) nabanye amasistemu wezimali (LOGIS, PERSAL, njll.) Ukubika ngezimali. Iminyakazo ye-Treasury. Ikhono ezingaba yimayelana nalezi: Ikhono lokuhlela futhi uhle. Ukuxhumana. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ikhono lokukhuthaza. Ukubhaliwe kwemibiko. Ukucabanga okulandelayo nangokuhlaziya. Ikhono lokuphatha abantu. Ikhono lokuziphathela nabanye. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuthatha iminithi.
zu.duties: Bhalisa futhi ugcube iphrofayili yabasebenzisi be-PERSAL. Bhalisa abasebenzisi be-PERSAL nabalungisi bawo, qinisekisa ukuzinikela futhi ugcube iphrofayili ngokucophelela ukwabelwa kwemisebenzi. Qeqesha abasebenzisi be-PERSAL kumnyango. Ukusayina imibiko yamnye yonke ye-RACEF nokuhlola imibiko yansuku zonke ye-RACEF. Seta kabusha abasebenzisi abakhishiwe baphinde bafinyelele kumasistimu weholo uma bevunyelwe. Phepha, hlaziya futhi ugcube inqubomgomo, izehlulelo kanye nemikhuba emihle ehlobene nasekupilweni kwabasebenzisi be-PERSAL kanye nokuphathwa kwasistimu. Mele umnyango kwiforum ye-PERSAL esifundazweni. Itholakala njalo ukulandela imibiko yokuhlola nokulawula etholakala ku-PERSAL.

xh.title: Umlawuli we-Persal: Ulawulo Lweemali
xh.summary: Kufuneka omlawuli we-Persal eMbombela ukuze agcine iiprofayili zabasebenzisi be-PERSAL, aqhube imfundo elungelelanisa kwaye alawule ingxelo ye-RACEF, efuna isidanga kweemali nendalo ye-PERSAL.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekile se-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma kwi-Accounting/Financial Management (NQF Level 6) okanye ndawo enxulumene neemali. Isipho esingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-3 sokusebenza kwezindlela zemali. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. af.title: Uitreikspanleiers (WBPHCOT-program)
af.summary: Lei en bestuur WBPHCOT-uitreikspanne in die Frances Baard-distrik om gemeenskapsgesondheid te verbeter deur voorkoming, vroeë identifisering, verwysing en opvolg.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen, Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenning ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike/erkenning ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde.
af.duties: Om die WBPHCOT te lei en te bestuur om gedefinieerde bevolkingsdekking en meetbare verbeterings in gemeenskapsgesondheid te bereik deur voorkoming, vroeë identifisering, verwysing, koppeling en opvolg. Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasientversorging). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met ander gesondheidsfasiliteite en versterk gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. Doelwitte: Kontinuïteit van gesondheidsorgdienste aan individue en huishoudings. Verskaf bestuur, toesig en leierskap vir die WBPHOT. Monitering en verslagdoening van die WBPHOT. Lei en verskaf kundige ondersteuning aan die WBPHOT. Bystand verleen met die bereiking van teikens soos deur gesondheidsfasiliteite geïdentifiseer. Fasiliteer gemeenskapsmobilisering en skep bewustheid oor gesondheidsiektes deur bewustheidsveldtogte en mobiliseer rondom gemeenskapsbehoeftes. Rede en rapporteer alle aktiwiteite volgens verslagdoeningsinstrumente Aansoeke vir Frances Baard.

zu.title: Abaholi Bemiqulu Yokusakhela (I-Nhlangano ye-WBPHCOT)
zu.summary: Hola uphathe imiqulu yokuqhuba phambili ye-WBPHCOT esifundeni i-Frances Baard ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomphakathi ngokuvikela, ukubona ngokusheshisa izinkinga, ukukhombisa abantu kwezokwelapha nokulandela abagulayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezenziwa ngaphansi kwe-R425 (okukhulunywa ngayo njenge-diploma/iziqu kwezokuNesiingane) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengesiNesi esiphumelelayo. Ukwesekwa ngokubhalisa ku-SANC njengesiNesi esikhulile. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isiphevi: I-G Grade 1: Akukho, i-Grade 2: Okungezele emuva kokubhalisa njengesiNesi esikhulile ku-SANC kwe-Nesiingane zeZizonke, kufanele kube nokungenzwa okuncike entweni ekuqashwayo/eyaziwayo emsebenzini we-Nesiingane iminyaka engu-10 noma ngaphezulu, i-Grade 3: Okungezele emuva kokubhalisa njengesiNesi esikhulile ku-SANC kwe-Nesiingane zeZizonke, kufanele kube nokungenzwa okuncike entweni ekuqashwayo/eyaziwayo emsebenzini we-Nesiingane iminyaka engu-20 noma ngaphezulu.
zu.duties: Ukuhola uphathe i-WBPHCOT ukuze kugcinwe isibalo sabantu abafinyelelwa kanye nokuthuthuka okungabonwa empilweni yomphakathi ngokuvikela, ukubona kusheshise izinkinga, ukukhombisa kwezokwelapha, ukuhambisana nokulandela abagulayo. Nikeza isiqondiso nolawulo ekwenzeni iphulo lezokuNesiingane (umsebenzi wezempilo/ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwesiguli). Phakamisa amazinga, imikhuba, imigomo nemibalavu yokwenza amaNesiingane kahle (ikhwalithi yomsebenzi). Sebenzisa umsebenzi we-Nesiingane nempilo ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemibalavu ehlobene nokuNesiingane nempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bezisebenzayo namanye amafasiliti ezempilo, ukuqinisa amaphuzu ezinsiza zomphakathi. Imigomo: Ukungaphazamisi kokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabantu abodwa namakhaya. Nikeza ulawulo, ukugadleka nolawulo lokuhola olubhekele i-WBPHOT. Ukugadleka nokubika nge-WBPHOT. Ukukhombisela nokweseka ngolwazi i-WBPHOT. Siza ekufeizeni imigomo ebonwe ngamafasiliti ezempilo. Siza ukushukumisa umphakathi futhi udale ukwaziswa ngemikhuhlane ezinhlelweni zokwazisa uphakathe futhi ushukumise ngemidingo yomphakathi. Ukubhala nokubika yonke imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwamathuluzi okubika. Izicelo zika-Frances Baard.

xh.title: Abaphathi Beqela Lothutho (Inkqubo ye-WBPHCOT)
xh.summary: UKuba bathathe ihlazo balawule amaqela othutho e-WBPHCOT kwisiFunda saseFrances Baard ukuphucula impilo yomphakathi ngokuqonda nge ngoko, ukuqonda kusengowudlula ibungo, ukuthumela kwezinye iindawo zempilo nokuqokelela iinkcukacha emva kokuthumela.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingundoqo ezikwi-R425 (okt. idiploma/izidanga kwizibalo zokunyangwa) okanye izifundo ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqitha wezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqitha wezempilo. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba. Isipiliwo: Inqanaba lesi-1: Akukho, Inqanaba lesi-2: Isipiliwo esingezantsi kweminyaka eli-10 okanye isipiliwo esibonakalayo ekunyangweni emva kokubhaliswa njengogqitha wezempilo kwi-SANC kwizibalo eziqhelekileyo, Inqanaba lesi-3: Isipiliwo esingezantsi kweminyaka eli-20 okanye isipiliwo esibonakalayo ekunyangweni emva kokubhaliswa njengogqitha wezempilo kwi-SANC kwizibalo eziqhelekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuba uthathe ihlazo ulawule i-WBPHCOT ukufeza ukugqithiswa kubemi ngokuchanekileyo nokuvela ngokulinganisekayo ekuphuculeni impilo yomphakathi ngokuqonda nge ngoko, ukuqonda kusengowudlula ibungo, ukuthumela kwezinye iindawo zempilo, ukuqhagamshelana nokuqokelela iinkcukacha emva kokuthumela. Ukunika iNdlela kulawulo ekusebenziseni iplani yokunyangwa (iziqu zokwenzayo/ukhathalelo lomthwali wezempilo). Ukusebenzisa iziqondiso, izinto ezenziwayo, iinkalo nemiqondo yokulinganisa ukhathalelo oluhle (isimo sokusebenza). Ukusebenzisa ukunyangwa n ukhathalelo lo mpele ngokwemigaqo nemithetho evelayo ekunyangweni nas kikhathalelo lo mpele. Ukugcina ulwalamano olusebenzayo nezinye iindawo zempilo, ukwande izixokelelwano zokwabelana komphakathi. Iinjongo: Ukugqithisa iindawo zokhathalelo lo mpele kumntu no kwintsapho. Ukuba nika ulawulo, lolawulo nokuqhatha ukulawuleka kwi-WBPHOT. Ukuqwalasela nokubika nge-WBPHOT. Isikhokelo ngenkxaso abatyholwa kwi-WBPHOT. Ukuncedisa ekufezeni iinjongo ezithathiweyo zindawo zokhathalelo lo mpele. Ukwenza ukuba umphakathi uqhagamshelane, wandise ulwazi ngezifo zokhathalelo lo mpele ngokwenza amaqela othutho nokuqhagamshela ngemfuneko yomphakathi. Ukubhala nokubika ngazo zonke izinto ezenziwayo njengoko kumiselwe ziiqwenga zokubika Iimfuno zokufaka isicelo kwi-Frances Baard.

af.duties: Om die WBPHCOT te lei en te bestuur sodat gedefinieerde bevolkingsdekking en meetbare verbeterings in gemeenskapsgesondheid bereik word deur voorkoming, vroeë identifikasie, verwysing, koppeling en opvolg. Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasientversorging). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir kwaliteitsverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleging en gesondheidsorg van toepassing is. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met ander gesondheidsfasiliteite en versterk gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. Doelwitte: Kontinuïteit van gesondheidsorgdienste aan individue en huishoudings. Verskaf bestuur, toesig en toesighoudende leierskap vir die WBPHOT. Monitering en verslagdoening van die WBPHOT. Voorligting en kundige ondersteuning aan die WBPHOT. Bystand met die bereiking van teikens soos deur gesondheidsfasiliteite geïdentifiseer. Fasiliteer gemeenskapsmobilisering en skep bewustheid van gesondheidsiektes deur bewustheidsveldtogte en mobiliseer rondom gemeenskapsbehoeftes. Opname en verslagdoening van alle aktiwiteite volgens verslagdoeningsinstrumente. Aansoeke vir Zwelentlanga Fatman Mgcawu

zu.title: Abaholi Beqembu Lokuthuthukisa Impilo Yamaphandle (IHubo lwe-WBPHCOT)
zu.summary: Hola uphathe iqembu lokuthuthukisa impilo yamaphandle le-WBPHCOT esifundeni sase-Namakwa ukuze kululiswe impilo yomphakathi ngokuthiwa kweziguli, ukubona kusenesikhathi, ukuqondiswa kanye nokulandelwa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingundoqo ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezibhalise njengesibhedlela) noma iziqu ezingokulingana ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengesesuli Esezemithi Yokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengesesuli Esezemithi Yokwelapha. Ilayiseni yokuqhuba. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Alikho, Izinga 2: Ugcino oluncane lweminyaka engu-10 lesipiliyoni esifanele/esiye saphawulwa kusemthethweni yokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengesesuli Esezemithi Yokwelapha ku-SANC ngokwemithi yokwelapha jikelele, Izinga 3: Ugcino oluncane lweminyaka engu-20 lesipiliyoni esifanele/esiye saphawulwa kusemthethweni yokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengesesuli Esezemithi Yokwelapha ku-SANC ngokwemithi yokwelapha jikelele.
zu.duties: Ukuhola uphathe i-WBPHCOT ukuze kufinyelelwe ekuqokweni abantu abadingisiwe nasezimpucukweni ezibonakalayo ezimpilweni zabomphakathi ngokuthiwa kwezigula, ukubona kusenesikhathi, ukuqondiswa, ukuhlanganiswa kanye nokulandelwa. Nikela isiqondiso nolawulo ekuphethweni kabuhle kwenkqubo yokwelapha (izenzakalo zokwelapha/ukunakekelwa kwesiguli okuhle phakathi kwemithetho nemisimelo ehlobene nokwelapha nakunakekelwa kwezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza namanye amasibhedlela ezesempilo, ukuqinisa izinsiza ezisezingeni lomphakathi. Imigomo: Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza eziya phambili zezempilo kubantu nasemakhaya. Nikeza ulawulo, ukulawula nokuqondisa ukubusa i-WBPHOT. Ukugcina futhi kubike ngokuziphathe kwaye ngokwenziwa kwazo zonke izenzo ngokwamathuluzi okubika. Kubike ngokuziphathe nokuvela kwemisebenzi yonke yokwelapha kwabobaphakathi nokuqondisa imibutho yomphakathi ngesidingo sabo. Kubike futhi kugcine imisebenzi yonke nangokwamathuluzi okubika. Izibhalo zokusebenzela i-Zwelentlanga Fatman Mgcawu

xh.summary: Qonda elula iqela le-WBPHCOT kwisebe lase-Namakwa District ukuphucula impilo yomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuziphatha kwangaphambili, ukuthumela kubuchwepheshe nokulandela.
xh.requirements: Iyafuneka isemgangathweni seR425 (okt in-diploma/in-digri yokunyuka ngamagama) okanye esinokulingana nayo okuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha weProfesional. xh.duties: Ukuqonda elula kwaye ulawule i-WBPHCOT ukufikelela kwikhaver yabantu ebalulweyo nakuphuculo olubonakalayo kwimpilo yomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuziphatha kwangaphambili, ukuthumela kubuchwepheshe, ukuqhagamshelana nokulandela. Nika isalathiso nokuqaphela ukuphumeza icebo lokunyuka (inkqubo yamagqirha/ikhwalithi yokunyuka kwamagqirha). Yenza ukuzincedisa komphakathi ukuze udale ingqiqo ngezigulo zempilo ngeenkampazo zokwazisa ukuze uzincedise ngemfuno yomphakathi. Ukuqaphela nokubika ngazo zonke izenzo njengokubalulwe kwiinkqubo zokubika. Izicelo zeZwelentlanga Fatman Mgcawu

Recording and Reporting all activities as per reporting tools Applications for John Taolo Gaetsewe District

af.duties: Om die WBPHCOT te lei en te bestuur om gedefinieerde bevolkingsdekking en meetbare verbeterings in gemeenskapsgesondheid deur voorkoming, vroeë identifikasie, verwysing, koppeling en opvolg te bereik. zu.title: Abaholi Beqembu LoKuhamba Emakhaya (Ohlelo lwe-WBPHCOT)
zu.summary: Hola uphathwe ohlelo lwe-WBPHCOT esifundeni i-John Taolo Gaetsewe, ubukele ukuhamba emakhaya nasezikweni ngokwezempilo, ukuvikela, ukuqondisa kubahlengikizi kumnyango ofanele nokuphatha uhlelo lokuhlengwa kwabantu emakhaya.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhejethi yokulingana ne-R425 (okunamathiselwe iziqu/digri ekuhlengweni kwabantu) noma ezinye iziqu ezingalingana nalesi ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengesisulu somhlengikizi. Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengesisulu somhlengikizi. Ilayisense yokushayela. Isiphepho: Izinga 1: Akukho, Izinga 2: Ukwaziswa okungenaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-10 kokusebenza okufanelekile/okuqashwa ekuhlengweni kwabantu emva kokubhaliswa njengesisulu somhlengikizi ku-SANC ekuhlengweni kwesiZulu, Izinga 3: Ukwaziswa okungenaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-20 kokusebenza okufanelekile/okuqashwa ekuhlengweni kwabantu emva kokubhaliswa njengesisulu somhlengikizi ku-SANC ekuhlengweni kwesiZulu.
zu.duties: Ukuhola uphatha i-WBPHCOT ukuze kufinyelelwe esibhekeni esihlongwe ndawonye sabantu nasithekelweni esibonwa ngemilinganiselo ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi ngokuvikela, ukuhlola ngokushesha, ukuqondisa kubahlengikizi, ukuxhumanisa kanye nokulandela. Nikela isiqondiso nokuqaphela ukuphathwa kohlelo lokuhlengwa kwabantu (izenzakalo ekuhloleni/ukunakekelwa kwemilinganiselo kwesiguli). Phatha imilinganiselo, izindlela, imigomo nemibhalo ebalulekile yomlinganiselo wokuhlonza (umlinganiso wenzakalo). Hlengaabantu uphathe izempilo ngokwemithetho nemikhawulo ephathelene nokuhlengwa kwabantu nezempilo. Zagcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza namanye amakiliniki, uqinise ukutholakala kokuqashwa emphakathini. Iminyuzo: Ukubekezela ngokutholakala kokuqashwa ngemithombo yezempilo kubantu nasemakhaya. Nikela ngokuphatha, ukuqapha kanye nokuholwa ngokubuka i-WBPHOT. Ukuqapha nokubika ngohlelo i-WBPHOT. Nikela ngokuqondisa kanye nokusekela ngokwazi i-WBPHOT. Siza ekwenzeke izikhwama njengoba zingabonakala ngemithombo yezempilo. Qondisa ukuvusa abantu ngokuzibandakanya udaba iqhutshwe imicimbi yokwaziswa kanye nokuqoka izidingo zabantu emakhaya. Ukubhala nokubika ngokukhanya ngendlela ezobuzwa ngazo ngemibhalo. Izicelo zaKhasi le-John Taolo Gaetsewe esifundeni i-John Taolo Gaetsewe.

xh.title: Abaphathi Beqela Lokuqhubela Phambili (Inkqubo ye-WBPHCOT)
xh.summary: Qonda uphondo loyili kwaye ulawule inkqubo ye-WBPHCOT kwisiqhingi sika John Taolo Gaetsewe, ulawule ukusasazwa kwempilo yomphakathi, ukuthintela, ukuthumela kubachongi nokuphunyezwa kwenkqubo yokuhlola.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziyimfuno ze-R425 (okt. idiploma/izidanga ezingamabanga aphakamileyo kwakhetho yokunyanga) okt izifundo ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha oqeqesha ukunyanga. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha oqeqesha ukunyanga. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Iimfuno zokugqibelela: Isigaba 1: Akukho nanye, Isigaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yokugqibelela ngokufaneleyo/eqondakalayo kwinjongo yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha oqeqesha ukunyanga kwi-SANC kwikhondo eliPhakathi, Isigaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yokugqibelela ngokufaneleyo/eqondakalayo kwinjongo yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha oqeqesha ukunyanga kwi-SANC kwikhondo eliPhakathi.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda uphondo loyili nokulawula i-WBPHCOT ukuze kufikelelwe kwizinhlaka ezichaziweyo zobomi bemiphakathi nasezibingelelweni ezibonakalayo ezisezimpilweni zomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuzisa ubuchule kusenesikhathi, ukuthumela kubachongi, ukudibanisa nokuqhubela phambili. Nikeza isalathiso nophondo lokuphumeza inkqubo yokunyanga (izididi zokusingatha/ikhwalithi yokusingatha abagulayo). Phumeza iimfuno, izididi, iinkcazelo nemigangatho yekhwalithi yemisebenzi yokunyanga (ikhwalithi yomsebenzi). Yenza umsebenzi wokunyanga nephulo lempilo ngokwemithetho nemigangatho edibana nomsebenzi wokunyanga nephulo lempilo. Gcina ubudlelwane obulungileyo obusebenzayo nezinye izindlu zemiphakathi, ukuqinisa iinkonzo zomphakathi. Iinjongo: Ukukhululeka kwezonkonzo zempilo kubantu nabakhaya. Nikeza uphando, ulawulo nolawulo lokusingatha i-WBPHOT. Ukulawula nokubika nge-WBPHOT. Isikhokelo nencoko yomfanekiso kunye ne-WBPHOT. Siza ekufezeleni iinjongo njengoba kubonwa ngamaphulo empilo. Yenza ukubakheyshwa komphakathi ududu lwamagama ngamaphulo ophando nokududuza ngemfuno yomphakathi. Ukugcina nokubika zonke izididi ngokwemithetho yokuqamba.

zu.title: Abaholi Bemisebenzi Yokuthuthukisa Impilo Yomphakathi (Ohlelweni lwe-WBPHCOT)
zu.summary: Hola uphatha ohlelweni lwe-WBPHCOT esifundeni sama-Namakwa ukuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi ngokuvikela, ukutholwa kwanqamu, ukuthumela kogqirha nokulandelela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu kulesimo yokwelapha) noma iziqu ezingalingana ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengongunciwe ongumuntu ochwepheshe. Ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengongunciwe ongumuntu ochwepheshe. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho, Izinga 2: Uppingo ocansi oneminyaka engu-10 isipiliyoni esifanele/esaziwayo kulawo kukwamukela isimo sokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa njengongunciwe ongumuntu ochwepheshe ku-SANC eNqamlezweni Yokwelapha Okuvamile, Izinga 3: Uppingo ocansi oneminyaka engu-20 isipiliyoni esifanele/esaziwayo kulawo kukwamukela isimo sokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa njengongunciwe ongumuntu ochwepheshe ku-SANC eNqamlezweni Yokwelapha Okuvamile.
zu.duties: Ukuhola uphatha i-WBPHCOT ukufeza ukumbovana okuchaziwe koluhlu labantu nentuthuko ephathwayo empiloni yomphakathi ngokuvikela, ukutholwa kwanqamu, ukuthumela kogqirha, ukuhlonza nokulandelela. Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqondisa ukuqashwa kwenqubo yokunakekela (umkhiqizo wangasese/ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa komuntu ofundayo). Qamba izidingo, izindlela, izigaba nezinkomba zeKHUBALI ekunakekelweni okungumsebenzi ochwepheshe (ikhwalithi yomsebenzi). Yenza isimo sokwelapha nokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemiHlahIvo ephathelene nokunakekela nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Sigcine ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nezinye izindawo zezempilo, ukuqinisa izinkonzo eziphakathi komphakathi. IminIbegzO: Ukuqhubeka kwezinkonzo zezempilo kubantu nasemakhaya. Nikeza uphatha, ukuqondisa nobuholi bokubuka i-WBPHOT. Uloloba nokubika ngokuthi i-WBPHOT isebenza kanjani. Iseluleko nesixhaso esichwepheshe ku-WBPHOT. Siza ekufezeni izinhloso ezitholwe yizindawo zezempilo. Qhubeka wemukela ukuzibandakanya komphakathi futhi wakhe ukuzwana ngezifo zezempilo ngokuhlolwa komphakathi futhi wemukela izidingo zomphakathi. Ukubhala nokubika ngemisebenzi yonke ngokuhambisana nezithako zokubika kumagugu okuwlela ukuphendula.

xh.title: Iintloko zeQela loVakwalwazi (Inkqubo yeWBPHCOT)
xh.summary: Qhoboshela kunye nokulawula inkqubo yeWBPHCOT kwisiQithi saseNamakwa ukuze kuphuculwe impilo yomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuqonda kwangaphambili, ukuthumela kubaprofeshinali abafanelekileyo kunye nokulandela.
xh.requirements: Iyure yobungcali yeR425 (okt idiploma/idinga ezifundweni zokuhlolwa kwagula) okt isiqinisekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukuqwalaselwa kwiSANC njengogqirha ohlolwayo. Ukuqwalaselwa kwiSANC njengogqirha ohlolwayo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba. Uqeqesho: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntetho, Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-10 yamava afanelekileyo /amava aqaqambiswayo ekuhlolweni kwagula emva kokuqwalaselwa njengogqirha ohlolwayo kwiSANC ekuhlolweni kwagula ngokubanzi, Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-20 yamava afanelekileyo /amava aqaqambiswayo ekuhlolweni kwagula emva kokuqwalaselwa njengogqirha ohlolwayo kwiSANC ekuhlolweni kwagula ngokubanzi.
xh.duties: Ukuqhoboshela kunye nokulawula iWBPHCOT ukuze kufikelelwe kwimigiqatho echaziweyo yabemi kunye neziphuculo ezisenganyelweni kwimpilo yomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuqonda kwangaphambili, ukuthumela kubaprofeshinali abafanelekileyo, ukudibanisa nokulandela. Nika iindlela kunye nokuqaliswa kolawulo ekuphumezeleweni kwendlela yokuhlolwa kwagula (umzilo oqheliswayo /inkonzo yemgangatho ephezulu yomguli). Zisebenzise iimfunononke, iindlela, iingqgobela kunye nezalathiso zokuhlolwa kwagula kwizinga eliphezulu (umgangatho womzilo). Yenza ukuhlolwa kwagula kunye nenkonzo yempilo ngokuvumelana namagazethi kunye nemigaqo ehambelana nokuhlolwa kwagula nenkonzo yempilo. GCina ubudlelwane obulungileyo bokusebenza nezinye izikhulu zempilo, ukuqinisa iinkonzo ezisekelwe kumphakathi. Iinjongo: Ukungapheli kweenkonzo zempilo kumzimba nabantu. Nika ulawulo, ukuqaliswa kolawulo kunye nokuba nkokheli bokugcina iliso kwiWBPHOT. Ukulandela kunye nokuchaza ngayo iWBPHOT. Ukukhokela kunye nenkxaso yamava aqinileyo kwiWBPHOT. Nceda ukufikelela kwimizuzu ejoliswe kuyo ngezikhulu zempilo. Yenza ukuzinza komphakathi kunye nokudalisa inzulu ngamachaphazezela empilo ngeenkampu zodumo kwaye ubuze iimfuno zomphakathi. Ukubhala kunye nokuchaza ngazo onke amanyathulo njengoko kuboniswe kwiindlela zokuchaza iimfuno zaseNamakwa District.

jobs.title: Outreach Team Leaders (WBPHCOT Programme)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Lead the WBPHCOT Programme in Pixley ka Seme District, managing community health outreach with salaries ranging from R337,359 to R495,423 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Driver’s license. Experience: Grade 1: None, Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ experience appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing, Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ experience appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing.
jobs.duties: To lead and manage the WBPHCOT to achieve defined population coverage and measurable improvements in community health through prevention, early identification, referral, linkage and follow-up. Provide direction and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice/quality patient care). Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with other health facilities, strengthening community based services. Objectives: Continuity of health care services to individuals and households. Provide management, supervision and oversight leadership for the WBPHOT. Monitoring and Reporting of WBPHOT. Guidance and expert support to WBPHOT. Assist with achieving targets as identified by health facilities. Facilitate community mobilisation and create awareness on health diseases through awareness campaigns and mobilise around community needs. Recording and Reporting all activities as per reporting tools Applications for Pixley Ka Seme District
jobs.enquiries: Mrs B Jack HRA/Ms McCloen (District Director) – District Office/ Tel No: (053) 632 4000
jobs.applications: must be emailed to nchealthhr-Pixley@ncpg.gov.za or hand delivered or couriered via postal to Van der Merwe Street, De Aar,7000.
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed application form Z83 obtainable from any Public Service Department or any Public Service Administration website. The fully completed and signed Z83 should be accompanied by a detailed/comprehensive Curriculum Vitae, indicating positions held, dates and key performance responsibilities. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of their qualifications and relevant documents on or before the day of the interview proceedings following communication from the Human Resource Management Recruitment and Selection Unit. Failure to submit the requested documents or information will result in your application not being considered. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) with a candidate whose transfer/promotion / appointment will promote representivity in line with the numerical targets as contained in our Employment Equity Plan. If you have not been contacted within eight (8) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, qualification verification and employment verification). Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills/knowledge test. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the above post. The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement. The Department of Health is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The request for certified documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Human Resource Administration of the Department will inform shortlisted candidate for a post to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. Should an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for all posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Uitreikspanleiers (WBPHCOT-program)
af.summary: Lei die WBPHCOT-program in Pixley ka Seme Distrik en bestuur gemeenskapsgesondheidsuitreik met salarisse wat wissel van R337,359 tot R495,423 per jaar.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Bestuurslisensie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen, Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde.
af.duties: Om die WBPHCOT te lei en te bestuur om gedefinieerde bevolkingsdekking en meetbare verbeterings in gemeenskapsgesondheid te bereik deur voorkoming, vroeë identifikasie, verwysing, koppeling en opvolg. Voorsien rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasientversorging). Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat relevant is tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met ander gesondheidsfasiliteite en versterk gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. Doelwitte: Kontinuïteit van gesondheidsorgdienste aan individue en huishoudings. Verskaf bestuur, toesig en toesighoudende leierskap vir die WBPHOT. Monitering en verslagdoening van WBPHOT. Leiding en kundige ondersteuning aan WBPHOT. Bied bystand met die bereiking van teikens soos geïdentifiseer deur gesondheidsfasiliteite. Fasiliteer gemeenskapsmobilisering en skep bewustheid oor gesondheidsiektes deur bewusmakingsveldtogte en mobiliseer rondom gemeenskapsbehoeftes. Rekordhouding en verslagdoening van alle aktiwiteite volgens verslagdoeningsinstrumente. Aansoeke vir Pixley Ka Seme Distrik.

zu.title: Abahola Iqembu Lokuthumela Emandla (Uhlelo lwe-WBPHCOT)
zu.summary: Hola uhlelo lwe-WBPHCOT kwi-District yase-Pixley ka Seme, ulawule ukuthumela ezindaweni zomphakathi mayelana nempilo ngamaholo asuka ku-R337,359 kuya ku-R495,423 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisisekelo ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iquphe ekufundeleni bokuhlola) noma iziqu ezingokucofanayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ne-SANC njengenesi ohlonishwayo. Ukubhaliswa ne-SANC njengenesi ohlonishwayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isipiliwo: Izinga 1: Alikho, Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliwo esifanele/esibonakalayo kuhloleni emva kokubhaliswa njengenesi ohlonishwayo ne-SANC ekuhloleni ngokujwayelekile, Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yesipiliwo esifanele/esibonakalayo kuhloleni emva kokubhaliswa njengenesi ohlonishwayo ne-SANC ekuhloleni ngokujwayelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhola futhi ulawule i-WBPHCOT ukuze kufinyelelwe ekuguqulweni kwabantu okushiwowe futhi kube nokuthuthuka okubonakalayo empilweni yomphakathi ngokuthintela, ukuthola kusenesikhathi, ukuthumela, ukuxhumanisa nokulandela. Nikeza isiqondiso nokuqapha ukuphumeza ihlelo lokuhlola (umkhiqizo wesiguli/ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwesiguli). Phumeza amaphuzu, amasu, izindinganiso nezinkomba zekhwalithi yokuhlola (ikhwalithi yomkhiqizo). Yenza ukunakekela kokuhlole futhi ugcine impilo ngokwemithetho nemithethelwana ehlobene nokuhlole nempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza namanye amasikhungo empilo, uqinise ukulekelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Izigqibo: Ukuqhubekeka kwezinsiza zempilo kubantu namakhaya. Nikeza ulawulo, ukuqapha nokuhola okubhekele kakhulu i-WBPHOT. Ukubuka nokubika nge-WBPHOT. Ukulekelela nokuweseka ngokobuchwepheshe i-WBPHOT. Siza ekufezeni amaphuzu njengoba kushiwo amasikhungo empilo. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi futhi udale ukwazi ngezifo zempilo ngokuhlela imikhankaso yokwazisa futhi uhlanganise ngemidingo yomphakathi. Ukubhala nokubika ngazo zonke izenzakalo njengoba kushoyo izinkomba zokubika Izicelo zase-Pixley Ka Seme District

xh.title: Abaphathi Beqela Lokwenzeela (Inkqubo yeWBPHCOT)
xh.summary: Yiba ngabaphathi beNkqubo yeWBPHCOT kwiSithili sasePixley ka Seme, ulawule ukwenzeela kwempilo yommandla ngemivuzo eqala ukusuka kwiR337,359 ukuya kwiR495,423 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisisoko seR425 (okunokuthi idiploma/igreyid yookhathalelo) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqirha wokhathalelo. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqirha wokhathalelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Isipiliwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho, Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-10 isipiliwo esifanelekileyo/esibonakalayo ekhathalelweni emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wokhathalelo kwiSANC kuKhathalelo jikelele, Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-20 isipiliwo esifanelekileyo/esibonakalayo ekhathalelweni emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wokhathalelo kwiSANC kuKhathalelo jikelele.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba ula ulawule iWBPHCOT ukufeza ukubanzelwa kwabantu abachaziweyo nokuphucula okubalulekileyo empilweni yommandla ngokuthintela, ukuqaphela kusenokuswisa, ukuthumela, ukunxulumanisa nokulandelela. Nikela isalathiso nolawulo ekuphumezeni icebo lokhathalelo (umzobo wokwenza/ukhathalelo olulinganeyo lwesiguli). Phumeza izigqibo, iinkqubo, iimeko nezalathiso zokhathalelo olulinganeyo (ikhwalithi yomzobo). Yenza ukhathalelo nonyango lweempilo ngokwemithetho nemigaqo ephathelene nokhathalelo nonyango lweempilo. GCina ubudlelwane obakhiqityiweyo bokusebenza nabanye izinto ezinikezela ngonyango lweempilo, ukuqinisa iinkonzo ezingommandla. Iinjongo: Ukuqhubekeka kweenkonzo zonyango lweempilo kumntu nabawo. Nikela ulawulo, ulawulo nolawulo olubalaseleyo lweWBPHOT. Ukuqaphela nokubika ngeWBPHOT. Isalathiso nolonxaxheba lwamagcisa kwiWBPHOT. Siza ekufezeni iinjongo ezichaziweyo zizinto ezinikezela ngonyango lweempilo. Yenza ukudityaniswa kommandla udale ulwazi ngezigulo zempilo ngeeminyhadala yolwazi udityanise ngemfuno yommandla. Ukugcina nokubika ngeenkonzo zonke njengoko kuboniswe kwiithuluzi zokubika Iimfuneko zasePixley Ka Seme District

jobs.title: Artisan Grade A-C
jobs.summary: Artisan needed at the ZF Mgcawu District Office to provide technical design, maintenance and repair services across building, mechanical or printing trades.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Senior Certificate. A valid Driver's License. The incumbent must be in possession of a prescribed level of qualification as determined by the relevant trade and meet the relevant statutory requirements by successful completion of a recognised trade test. Appropriate trade test certificate in the following identified fields; building environment, mechanical environment, printing environment, electrical environment, electrical environment, industrial environment and textile environment. Competencies Technical - Technical analysis knowledge, computer aided technical applications, knowledge of legal compliance, technical report writing, production, process knowledge and skills. Competencies Generic - problem solving and analysis, decision making, team work, analytical skills, creativity, self-management, customer focus and responsiveness, communication, computer skills, planning and organizing.
jobs.duties: To render technical design, production, operation and maintenance services. Inspect equipment and/or facilities for technical faults. Repair equipment and facilities according to standards. Test repair equipment and/or facilities against specifications. Service equipment and/or facilities against specifications. Service equipment and/or facilities according to schedule. Quality assure serviced and maintained equipment .and/or facilities. Perform administrative and related functions. Compile and submit reports. Provide inputs to the operational plan. Keep and maintain job record/register. Supervise and mentor staff. Maintain expertise - continuous individual development to keep up with new technologies and procedures.

af.title: Ambagsman Vlak A-C
af.summary: Ambagsman benodig by die ZF Mgcawu Distrikkantoor om tegniese ontwerp-, onderhouds- en hersteldienste oor bou-, meganiese- of drukkersvakke te lewer.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die ampshouer moet oor 'n voorgeskrewe vlak van kwalifikasie beskik soos bepaal deur die relevante vak en aan die relevante statutêre vereistes voldoen deur suksesvolle voltooiing van 'n erkende vaktoets. Toepaslike vaktoetsertifikaat in die volgende geïdentifiseerde velde; bou-omgewing, meganiese omgewing, drukkersomgewing, elektriese omgewing, elektriese omgewing, nywerheidsomgewing en tekstielomgewing. Bevoegdhede Tegnies - Tegniese ontledingskennis, rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings, kennis van regsvoorskrif nakoming, tegniese verslagskrywing, produksie, proseskennis en vaardighede. Bevoegdhede Algemeen - probleemoplossing en ontleding, besluitneming, spanwerk, analitiese vaardighede, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, klienfokus en reaksievernuf, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardighede, beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Om tegniese ontwerp-, produksie-, bedryfs- en onderhoudsdienste te lewer. Inspekteer toerusting en/of fasiliteite vir tegniese foute. Herstel toerusting en fasiliteite volgens standaarde. Toets herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite teen spesifikasies. Onderhou toerusting en/of fasiliteite volgens skedule. Verseker gehalte van onderhoude en herstelde toerusting en/of fasiliteite. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Stel verslae op en dien dit in. Verskaf insette tot die operasionele plan. Hou en onderhou taakrekord/register. Toesig en mentoraat van personeel. Onderhou kundigheid - deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.title: Umntwabiwomsebenzi Isigaba A-C
zu.summary: Umntwabiwomsebenzi odingekayo eZF Mgcawu District Office ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokwakheka kobuchwepheshe, okuqashelwa nokulungiswa kuzohlelo lwezokwakha, ezobuchwepheshe bezemishini noma kwezoshicilelo.
zu.requirements: Isigaba 12/Isitifiketi sabaphakeme. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Umgangezimi kufanele abe nesizinda samabhalo esibalwa njengoba kucatshangelwa uhlebo oluhlobene nokuhlinzeka aze ahlangabezane nezindingo eziyimithetho ahlobene ngempumelelo yesivivinyo sokuhlinza esihlonishwa. Isitifiketi esifanele sokuvivinywa kwahlinza kule minyakulu edingiweyo; indawo yokwakha, indawo yobuchwepheshe bengamashini, indawu yokushicilela, indawo yombane, indawo yombane, indawo yembonini nendawo yamagugu. Ikhono Lobuchwepheshe - Ulwazi lokuqapha kobuchwepheshe, izinhlelo zokweluleka ngekhompyuta, ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho, ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe, ukukhiqiza, ulwazi nobukhulu bezenzakalo. Ikhono Lindiwe - ukusombulula izinkinga nokuqapha, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengolelo, amakhono okuqapha, ukubumbuza, ukuzilawula, ukugxila kumthengi nokuPhilipisela, ukuxhumana, amakhono ekhompyutha, ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Izidingo: Isigaba 12 noma Isitifiketi Seziqu Eziphakeme. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Umgangezimi kufunle abe nalolu hlobo lweziqu olumiswe ngowona mmandla wohlelo, aze ahlangabezane nezidingo ngokusemthethweni ngokuqeda ngempumelelo isivivinyo sohlelo olusolunyulwa. Isitifikedi sohlebo esifanele kule minyakulu elandelayo edayiswe; indawo yokwakha, indawo yemishini, indawo yokushicilelwa, indawo yombane, indawo yombane, indawo yezimboni, kanye nendawo yamadayidi. Ukukhona kwezakhono Zobuchwepheshe - Ulwazi lwezazivosho zobuchwepheshe, usetelwezimali ezisiza ezobuchwepheshe, ulwazi lokuziphatha ngokomthetho, ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, ukukhiqa, ulwazi nobukhulu bezenziso. Ukukhona kwezakhono Eziyisisekelo - ukuxazulula izinkalo nokuhlaziya, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengesiIeti, izikhonzo zoku hlaziya, ukudala, ukuziphathel, ukunaka abathengi nokuphendula, ukuxhuman, izikhonzo zekhompyutha, ukuhlela futhi uhlele.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe zokwakheka, ukukhiqiza, ukusebenza nokugcinwa kwezinto. Ukuhlola izinto zokusebenza kanye/noma izakhiwo ukutholwa iziphazamiso zobuchwepheshe. Ukulungisa izinto zokusebenza nezakhiwa ngokwemigidingwano. Ukuvivinya ukulungiswa kwakho konke okusebenzayo nezakhiwa ngokwesicikizo. Ukukhwezela izinto ezisebenzayo kanye/noma izakhiwa ngokwesicikizo. Ukukhwezela izinto ezisebenzayo kanye/noma izakhiwa ngokweluhla. Ukuqinisekisela izinga lokukhwezela nokugcinwa kwezinto ezisebenzayo .kanye/noma izakhiwa. Ukwenza imisebenzi yohlupha nezohlelo abahlobene nayo. Ukulungiselela futhi unikeze imibiko. Ukunikeza imibiko ohlelweni lwezokusenzakalo. Ukulondoloza ukubhaliseka kwakho ukuqagwe imisebenzi noma ukusifakwa kwebalukhulu. Ukugada futhi unake amalungu othisha. Ukugcina ukukhalipha - ngokuziphucakel kokunyuka komuntu ngamunye ukuze agcine ulwazi ngezinguquko zobuchwepheshe nezindlela ezintsha.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi wezandla inqanaba A-C
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umsebenzisi wezandla kwiZiko leSithili i-ZF Mgcawu ukunika iinkonzo zolwakhiwo lobugcisa, zonqulo zokuqulunqa nokulungisa kumashishini abakhiyo, ezentlalo okanye ephosa baprinta.
xh.requirements: I-Grau 12/Isetifikathi esiba sevulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Kufuneka abe nokufanelekile kwinqanaba elicetyisiweyo njengoko kumiswe ngumsebenzi ofaneleyo aze adibanise nemfuno ezemthetho ngokuphumelela kuvavanyo lomsebenzi owaziwayo. Isitifikati sevavanyo lomsebenzi esifanelekileyo kwalawa mandla alandelayo alandelayo; indawo yokwakha, indawo yamashishini, indawo yokuprinta, indawo yombane, indawo yamashishini, indawo yamashishini nendawo yamaphaphu. Amakhono Obugcisa - Ulwazi olubalulekileyo ngokwahlulela ubugcisa, izicelo zobugcisa ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi ngokuhana namagunya, ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ulwakhiwo lwamashishini, ulwazi namakhono ezenzo. Amakhono Ngamagunya - ukusombulula iingxaki nokuzihlengahlenga, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza njengesebe, amakhono okuhlengahlenga, ubuchule, ukuzilawula, ukuzeka kumthengi nokuphendula, unxibelelwano, amakhono ekhompyutha, ucoco nokuhlela.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngolonikezelo lobugcisa bokwakha, ukwenza amashishini, ukusebenza nokonqulula. Ukupima ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo noma iziseko zeempahla ukujonga iingxaki zobugcisa. Ukulungisa iinkqubo neziseko zeempahla ngokwemilinganiselo. Ukuvavanya iinkqubo ezilungisiweyo noma iziseko zeempahla ngokwemilinganiselo. Ukunika inkonzo kwiinkqubo noma iziseko zeempahla ngokwemilinganiselo. Ukunika inkonzo kwiinkqubo noma iziseko zeempahla ngokweliso. Ukuthembisa ukhwalithi kwiinkqubo ezinikiwe inkonzo nokuqulunqwa noma iziseko zeempahla. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo edityaniswe nayo. Ukuyila nokungenisa iingxelo. Ukubonelela ngenkcazelo kwicandelo lokuqulunqa. Ukugcina nokulawula irekhodi lesebe nesebe. Ukulawula nokukhokela abasebenzi. Ukugcina ulwazi - ukuphuhliswa kwakho ngokungemi ukuze uqhubeke namateknoloji nokuqulunqa amatyala.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R194 988 per annum Grade 3: R226 701 per annum

af.title: Noodsorbeamptenaar
af.summary: Noodsorbeamptenaar gesoek vir ZF Mgcawu-distrik om basiese ambulansondersteuning, pasiëntvervoer en nood mediese sorg te bied onder die Northern Cape Department of Health.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Suksesvolle voltooiing van 'n toepaslike Basic Life Support (BLS)-kursus wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Basic Ambulance Assistant moontlik maak. Vervoer pasiënte as deel van Planned Patient Transport en inter-fasiliteitsoorplasingstelsel onder Emergency Medical Services. zu.title: Iofisa Wezempo Eziphuthumayo
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iofisa Wezempo Eziphuthumayo osebenza e-ZF Mgcawu District ukuze anikeze inkxaso ebalulekile yebhasi elibuyisa abagulayo kumathilini, ukuhamba kwabantu abagula kanye nenyongo yezokwelapha eziphuthumayo ngaphansi kwe-Northern Cape Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Ukugcina konke okufunekayo kwelaphu le-Basic Life Support (BLS) okuvumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomncedi webhasi elibuyisa abagulayo. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomncedi webhasi elibuyisa abagulayo (BAA). Izinga 3: Ukugcina konke okufunekayo kwelaphu le-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) okuvumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcedi wezempo zibuyisa abagulayo. Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcedi wezempo zibuyisa abagulayo (AEA). Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomncedi webhasi elibuyisa abagulayo. Izinga 3: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcedi wezempo zibuyisa abagulayo.
zu.duties: Ungamele ukwelapha umuntu ogulayo ngaphakathi kwesigaba sokwenza umsebenzi womncedi webhasi elibuyisa abagulayo. Thwala abantu abagulayo njengengxenye yohlelo lokuhamba kwabantu abagulayo abacubunguliweyo nendlela yokudlulisela abagulayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezingaphansi kwezinkonzo zezempo eziphuthumayo. Nikeza ngenyongo yezokwelapha eziphuthumayo ngenkxaso eholelwayo ngexesha leziganeko eziqhelekileyo. Ungamele ukunakekelwa kolungelelwaniso olufanele lweenkonzo zezempo eziphuthumayo. Nikeza ngenkxaso yezokwelapha eziphuthumayo neminye imisebenzi efunwa ngumphathi wezempo. Yenza nawo nawuphi na umsebenzi onikezwa ngumphathi wakho. Kulindeleke ukuba abagqibile bathatha isikhundla sokusebenza ngokutshintshiselana kwamashifti. Kulindeleke nakho ukuba abagqibi badinga ukuqondiswa ngokwemivalo yomzimba nezokugangathezwa kwezonyango.

xh.title: I-Emergency Care Officer
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-Emergency Care Officer kwi-ZF Mgcawu District ukuze kube noluxhaso olusentsimini lwe-ambulance, ukuhamba kolunyukiweyo kwezigulana kunye nonyango lwezémfu ephuthumayo ngaphansi kwi-Northern Cape Department of Health.

Inqanaba 3: Ukugqiba ngempumelelo kwesifundo esifanelekileyo se-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant. Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njenge-Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Okunokubakho: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ndawo ukuba kubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njenge-Basic Ambulance Assistant. xh.duties: Uxanduva lonyango lwegulana ngaphakathi kwesibiyelo sokusebenza se-Basic Ambulance Assistant. Ukuhamba laba sigulana njengesiqulatho se-Planned Patient Transport kunye nondlela lokudluliselwa phakathi kweziko ngaphansi kwe-Emergency Medical Services. Ukunika unyango lwezémfu ephuthumayo noluxhaso oluhlobene nalo ngexesha leziganeko ezikhethekileyo. Uxanduva lokuqonda nokulawula kakuhle amacebo e-Emergency Medical Services. Ukunika uluxhaso lwezémfu ephuthumayo nemisebenzi eminye efunwa yi-Directorate. Ukwenza nalo naliphi na enye imisebenzi enikwe ngurhwebo. Abasebenzi belindlele lokusebenza kumashifu. Abasebenzi belindlele nokuba phantsi kolawulo olomzimba nokwenzwa i-Medical surveillance.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Performance Monitoring Data
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate provincial performance monitoring data for reporting and analysis at the Office of the Premier in Kimberley.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a 3-year tertiary qualification in Public Administration, Development Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation. Post Graduate Degree will serve as an added advantage. 5- years Practical Experience in Monitoring and Evaluation and Planning. 3 years Assistant Management experience. Knowledge in Financial Management, Human Re source Management, Government Planning Frameworks, Government Monitoring and Evaluation Frameworks, Policy Development, Planning and co- ordination, Data base management, Computer Literacy – advanced, Compilation of management reports, Research Methodology, Managerial functions, Project Management, Public Administration and Management. Performance Information Management, data analysis and interpretation, data quality assurance and verification, and development and maintenance of performance monitoring and data management systems. Advanced Knowledge of Impact Assessment, Project Management, Evaluation and Research Methodology. A valid driver’s licence. Competencies: The following key competencies and skills are required for the position: Mathematics & analytical, Computer Literacy, Written and verbal, Organizing and administrative planning, Formal Presentation, Interpersonal relationship, Budgeting, Problem solving, Time Management, Conflict Management, Policy formulation, Research methodology, Facilitation and coordination, develop new ideas that impact on existing methods/ policies / understanding. Data and Performance Information Management: Data interpretation, data management and quality assurance, and performance information management.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following key functions: To manage and coordinate provincial performance data for reporting and performance analysis on national and provincial priorities, through integrated monitoring data management systems, Management of, and contributing to, the development of an integrated monitoring and evaluation assessment on performance reports of departments; Coordination and monitoring of the implementation of the Annual Performance Plans; Monitor the submission of quarterly performance reports by all provincial departments in accordance with the regulated timeframes. Ensure the quality, accuracy and reliability of provincial performance data; Coordination and monitoring of the development of provincial information management reporting systems and capacity development; Guide the business processes and reporting requirements for data management and reporting of government priorities and sector development indicators, Provisioning of support to Internal and external stakeholders; Operational Management and Governance within the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. S. Vallabh Tel No: (053) 030 0654
jobs.applications: Email applications to: ddpmdms2026@ncotp.gov.za
jobs.notes: Compliance: Applications must be submitted on the approved New Amended Z83 Form (No.81/971431) as prescribed with effect from 01 January 2021, which must be signed, initialled and dated; however, the initial on the second page of the form is not mandatory. The form is obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website, www.dpsa.gov.za. Applicants must indicate the post and the correct reference number on the Z83 application Form. The New Z83 Form must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae clearly indicating positions held, period in the position and key responsibilities with three contactable referees, and it is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). DPSA Circular 03 of 2025 states that the form must be completed in a manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post applied for by completing all relevant fields. Please note that Part A must be fully completed. Part B, C and D questions of the Z83 may be left blank, marked as not relevant, and use dashes or N/A if they do not apply to you or the position applied for. Part E, F and G do not need to be completed if the CV has been attached and provides the required information. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part F is compulsory for applicants seeking re-employment into the Public Service. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re- employment. Failure to provide information on the CV as requested the applicant may be disqualified. Applications received after the closing date will, as a rule, not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It will be expected of candidate(s) to be available for the interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA, which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS, and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ Shortlisted candidate(s) will be required to undergo personal suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification, verification of any dismissal for misconduct, and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. Candidates will be subject to security screening and vetting. Applicants must disclose if he/she is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting 162 any business with an Organ of State and whether he/she is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS
