af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer provinsiale prestasiemoniteringsdata vir verslagdoening en ontleding by die Kantoor van die Premier in Kimberley.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n 3-jarige tersiêre kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie, Ontwikkelingsbeplanning, Monitering en Evaluering hê. 'n Nagraadse graad sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 5- jaar praktiese ervaring in monitering en evaluering en beplanning. 3 jaar assistentbestuurservaring. Kennis van finansiële bestuur, menslike hulpbronbestuur, regeringsbeplanningsraamwerke, regeringsmoniterings- en evalueringsraamwerke, beleidsontwikkeling, beplanning en koördinering, databasisbestuur, rekenaarvaardigheid – gevorderd, samestelling van bestuursverslae, navorsingsmetodologie, bestuursfunksies, projektebestuur, openbare administrasie en bestuur. Prestasie-inligtingbestuur, data-ontleding en -interpretasie, datakwaliteitsversekering en -verifikasie, en ontwikkeling en instandhouding van prestasie-moniterings- en databestuurstelsels. Gevorderde kennis van impakbeoordeling, projektebestuur, evaluering en navorsingsmetodologie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Die volgende sleutelbevoegdhede en vaardighede word vir die pos vereis: Wiskunde en analities, rekenaarvaardigheid, skriftelik en verbaal, organising en administratiewe beplanning, formele voorlegging, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, begroting, probleemoplossing, tydbestuur, konflikbestuur, beleidsformulering, navorsingsmetodologie, fasilitering en koördinering, ontwikkel nuwe idees wat 'n impak het op bestaande metodes/beleid/insig. Data- en prestasie-inligtingbestuur: data-interpretasie, databestuur en kwaliteitsversekering, en prestasie-inligtingbestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende sleutelfunksies verantwoordelik wees: Om provinsiale prestasiedata te bestuur en te koördineer vir verslagdoening en prestasie-ontleding oor nasionale en provinsiale prioriteite, deur geïntegreerde moniteringsdatabestuurstelsels; Bestuur van, en bydrae tot, die ontwikkeling van 'n geïntegreerde moniterings- en evalueringsbeoordeling oor prestasieverslae van departemente; Koördinering en monitering van die implementering van die Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne; Monitor die indiening van kwartaalprestasieverslae deur alle provinsiale departemente in ooreenstemming met die gereguleerde tydraamwerke. Verseker die kwaliteit, akkuraatheid en betroubaarheid van provinsiale prestasiedata; Koördinering en monitering van die ontwikkeling van provinsiale inligtingbestuursverslagdoeningstelsels en kapasiteitsontwikkeling; Rig die besigheidsprosesse en verslagdoeningsvereistes vir databestuur en verslagdoening van regeringsprioriteite en sektorontwikkelingsaanwysers; Verskaffing van ondersteunings aan interne en eksterne belanghebbendes; Operasionele bestuur en bestuur binne die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Isikhundla Somgunjathi: Imininingwane Yokugcina amaphuzu asho isiphumo
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhloboze imininingwane yokugcina amaphuzu asho isiphumo esifundeni ukuze kubikwe futhi kuqashelwe eNyaveni kaMongameli eKimberley.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kumele babe noma yisiphi isiqu saseYunivesithi seminyaka engu-3 ezingqikithini ezifana nokuphathwa kwezabalomphakathi, ukuhlela okuhlobene nentuthuko, ukuqaphela nokuhlola umphumela wesidingo. Isiqu esithweswe ngemuva kokuqeda izifundo ezingaphezulu sibe luncedo. Unyaka angu-5 wobugcwethi bokuhlela ukuze kuqashelwe umphumela wesidingo nokuhlela. Unyaka angu-3 ngaphansi kobuhlakani bokuphatha. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ohhlelo lukahulumendi oluphathelene nokuhlela, ohhlelo lukahulumende bokuzilibazisa nokuhlolwa kwemiphumela yesidingo, ukuthuthukisa amapholisi, ukuhlanzwa ngokusabalalisa izinsiza, ukuphatha idathabhensi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuphezulu, ukubhalwa kwezibiko zabaphathi, izindlela zocwaningo, imisebenzi yabaphathi, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezomphakathi nokuqashelwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane yemiphumela yesidingo, ukuhlola nokuthathwa kwemininingwane njengoba iyilowo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane ilungile nokuyihlola nokugunyaza, kanye nokuthuthukisa nokugcina izinhlelo zokuhlola amaphuzu asho isiphumo nezinhlelo zokuphatha imininingwane. Ukuqonda okuphezulu nokuqinisekiswa kwemiphumela, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuhlola nokutholakala kwezindlela zocwaningo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amaphuzu abalulekile: Abasebenzisi badinga amaphuzu abalulekile nezakhono ezilandelayo: Izibalo nokuqhathanisa izinto, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala nokukhuluma, ukuhlela nokumiswa kwemisebenzi, okuqukethe imibhalo esobala, ubudlelwano nabantu, ukwabiwa kwemali, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukumiswa kwamapholisi, izindlela zocwaningo, ukukhuthaza nokubumbana kokuhamba kahle komsebenzi, ukuthuthukisa imibono emitsha engaba nomthelela kwezindlela ezisemandleni namapholisi/okokuqonda. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane yemiphumela yesidingo nokuqinisekiswa kwemiphumela yesidingo: Ukuqhathanisa imininingwane, ukuphathwa kwemininingwane nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ilungile, nokuphathwa kwemininingwane yemiphumela yesidingo.
zu.duties: Umuntu ozothola leso sikhundla uzobe negunya lokuphatha, kwezinye izinto, okulandelayo: Ukuphatha futhi uhloboze imininingwane yemiphumela yesidingo esifundeni ukusetshenziswa ekubikweni nasekuqashelweni kwezidingo kazwelonke nas esifundeni, ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlotshanisiwe zokuphathwa kwemininingwane yokugcina amaphuzu asho isiphumo; Ukuphathwa, kanye nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukisweni kokuqashelwa okuhlotshanisiwe kokuhlolwa kokusebenza kwemiphumela yesidingo emibikweni yeminyango; Ukubumbana nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zeminyaka yonke zokugcina amaphuzu asho isiphumo; Ukugcina amaphuzu asho isiphumu emabikweni ahamba nenyanga ngayinye ngenyanga ngamunye ngenkathi yonke kuzo zonke izinhlelo zesifunda ngokuhambisana nesikhathi esimiswe ngumthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yemiphumela yesidingo esifundeni ilungile, iqinisekile futhi ethembekile; Ukubumbana kanye nokuhlola ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zobikwa imininingwane kwezokuphatha imininingwane esifundeni kanye nokuthuthukiswa kobuso; Ukukhombisa izindlela ezisetshenziswa ekuqashelweni kwezidingo zokuphathwa kwemininingwane nokubikwa kwemiphumela yezidingo ezibalulekile zahulumende kanye nezimpawu zentuthuko kumkhakha, Ukwabiwa kwezinsiza ezingaphakathi nangaphandle; Ukuphathwa kwezokusebenza nokuBusa ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuphathwa.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ulawulo Lwemida Yentlalo
xh.summary: Ukulawula nokuhlanganisa iimveliso zemida yolusekelo kwiphondo ngenjongo yokwenza iingxelo nokuqonda iziphumo kwi-Office of the Premier eKimberley.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesisindiso se-3-year kwisikolo samabanga aphakamileyo kwimizi yolawulo kahulumendi, iplani yokuphuhlisa, ulawulo nokuhlelwa kokusebenza. Isidanga sokuphuma kwisikolo samabanga aphakamileko siza kuba yinzuzo enkulu. 5- years amava obomi ekulawulweni nokuhlelweni kokusebenza nakuqumbiselwa nokuqwalaselwa. 3 years amava ekusekeleni ulawulo. Ulwazi kwintengiso yokulawula imali, ulawulo lweempahla zomntu, oonqwenela behlala langqondo kahulumendi, iinjongo zokuhlela ukulawula nokuhlelwa kokusebenza kahulumendi, ukwenza inkqubo ehle, uqale lokuqwalaselwa nokusetyenziswa kolwazi olwenziwe ngokwenza into ngolwazi olutsha, ukuphatha iikhompyutha – eliphezulu, ukulungelelanisa iingxelo zolawulo, iindlela zokuphonononga, iinkqubo zokulawula, ukulawulwa kwephulo, isoqulu semisebenzi yoluntu nolawulo. Ukuphatha ulwazi ngemida yolusekelo, ukuhlalutywa nokutolikwa kolwazi, ukuqinisekiswa ngexabiso nokuqinisekiswa kwemida yolwazi, nokusetyenziswa kolwazi nolondoloziwa ngokusetyenziswa kwesixokeleledano sazo obukhoyo ulawulo lwale mida. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo ngokuqwalaselwa koloyiko, ukulawulwa kwephulo, ukuhlelwa nokuphonononga iindlela zenziwa. Ilayisenisi yokushayela elifanelekileyo. Iimpawu eziphambili: ezi zakhona zibalulekile kulo msebenzi: Itheonerot kuso isibalo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubhala nokuqamba, ukuhlelwa nokulungiselela ngokusemthethweni, iinkalo zemveliso yangaphakathi, ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, ukwenza ibhajethi, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukulawulwa kwexesha, ukulawulwa koloyiko lweMfaca, ukwenza izigqibo, iindlela zophando, ukukhuthaza nokuhlanganisa, ukuphuhliswa kwezimvo ezitsha eziba nemo kwiindlela ezikho / iingcali zokwenza izinto. Iindlela ezizaku zisetyenziselwa ulawulo lweenkqubo zolwazi: Ukuhlalutywa kolwazi, ulawulo lolwazi nokwamkelwa kwexabiso, nokulawulo lweemveliso ezikhoyo zolwazi.
xh.duties: Umntu ofikelwe yilumonde uyakuba netyala nokuqhuba, phakathi kwezinye, ezi nkqubo ezibalulekileyo zilandelayo: Ukulawula nokuhlanganisa iimveliso ezikhoyo ngemida yolusekelo zelifa kwiphondo ngenjongo yokwenza iingxelo nokuhlelwa koloyiko lweenkalo ezibalulekileyo kwiphondo lenalo nkqubela yesizwe, ukuba ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo eziguqukayo ekulawulweni kwenkqubo yemida yolwazi, ulawulo lokwenza, nokunikela ngesandla ekwakhiweni kwento ethi yenzeke ngaphezulu kweyakho nasekujolisweni kolwazi ekuhlelweni kwemida yemisebenzi eyenziwayo kwiiSebe ezahlukeneyo; Ukulungelelanisa nokuqwalasela ulawulo lolwazi olwenzeka ekuhleni iNgaba zemida; Ukujongana neNgxoxo eyimfihlo nokuhlelwa kolwazi abanikezelayo ukuba kwakhona iNgxoxo yefuthe. Ilungelelanisa iNgaba ekuqwalaselweni okusemthethweni kwamaza amabini aphakathi kwamathuba okuqwalaselwa kwamaza; Ukugcina imifanekiso yeNgxoxo abayifumene ngokukhawuleza ngokweemfuno ezingaphezu kwakunye isebi ngokulandela isithuba esichaziweyo ngokomthetho wekhabhini, ukulungelelanisa neNgaba ngokomthetho wekhabhini. Ukulungelelanisa nokuyiqwalasela ulwazi ngolu hlobo lweNgaba; Ukulungelelanisa nokulawula ngokukhuselekileyo ngokomthetho wekhabhini; ukulungelelwa kokulawula iNgaba esemthethweni, yokuhlangabezana nemida yokusebenza, ukunikwa kwesixa okubalulekileyo sokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi, ukulungelelanisa iNgaba kunye nezinye iindaba ezingeyonto yokudluliselwa kwamaza amathathu aphefumla kuwo; ulawulo lokuqaliswa nokugqibiselwa kwamaza amathathu anegalelo lokusetyenziswa kolwazi lo msebenzi kwaye nalawo abanegalelo ekulungelelaniseni kwamaza amathathu, ukubonelela ngolwazi kubasebenzisi bomkhakhe welizwe, ukulungelelanisa kwamaza ngokulawulo okuhleliweyo, nasekuyonwabeni ngamaza nasekuboneni ukusetyenziswa ngokomthetho, nokulungelelanisa nokwenza imibe yamaza asemthethweni ngokusebenzisa ulwazi, ukuphuhliswa kolwazi, nokwamkelwa kolwazi kwindalo ekujoliswe kuyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: HRA, HR Planning and Systems
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for HR planning and systems in the Office of the Premier, Kimberley, coordinating HR administration and recruitment compliance across provincial departments.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Human Resource Management or Public Administration/Management qualification. Three (3) years’ proven experience at supervisory level in Human Resource Management. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). A valid driver’s licence. Skills: Database and HR Systems Management, Research and analytical skills, Numerical and statistical skills, Information management skills, Communications skills (written and verbal), Interpersonal relations, Client service orientation, Problem solving skills, Conflict management, Ability to work under pressure, Time management, Planning and organising skills, Attention to detail, Confidentiality and professional ethics, Team work and collaboration, Adaptability and initiative. Competencies: The following key competencies and skills are required for the position: In depth knowledge of the Public Service Act and Regulations, DPSA directives and HR prescripts. Experience in PERSAL system and HR information systems; HR administration and compliance monitoring, Report writing, Policy analysis and development, HR planning and workforce analysis, Recruitment and selection monitoring, Employment Equity coordination, PERSAL Reporting, Data analysis and interpretation, Presentation and facilitation skills, Records and document management. Knowledge of the Public Service Act and Regulations, DPSA directives and HR prescripts, Employment Equity Act and related reporting requirements, Recruitment and Selection transcripts, Job Evaluation principles and processes, PERSAL and vacancy management reporting, HR Planning Frameworks and reporting requirements, HR policy development and consultation processes, Public administration and governance structures, Departmental strategic planning and reporting processes.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following key responsibilities: Coordinate and monitor the implementation of Human Resource administration practices, recruitment and appointment processes across provincial departments; Monitor departmental compliance with applicable HR legislation, regulations, policies, circulars, determinations, directives and recruitment and selection prescripts; Analyse departmental HR administration, recruitment, vacancy and compliance information to identify trends, risks, gaps and areas of non-compliance; Provide recruitment and selection support in relation to the appointment of Heads of Departments; Monitor and track the filling of funded vacant posts, vacancy rates, recruitment turnaround times and departmental progress against Employment Equity and workforce transformation targets; Compile and maintain consolidated provincial reports, records and supporting evidence on HR administration, recruitment, vacancies, Employment Equity and compliance for management, governance, audit and oversight purposes; Provide inputs with the development and review provincial transversal HRA policies, frameworks, guidelines and plans; Conduct research on relevant HRA prescripts, DPSA directives, collective agreements and best practices; Prepare draft HRA policies in line with applicable legislation, national frameworks, organisational strategy and provincial priorities; Ensure the coordination and support of provincial HR governance structures and inter-departmental forums; Monitor departmental compliance with PILIR requirements and quarterly reporting obligations; Analyse PERSAL and other HR information system data to identify trends and risks; Prepare consolidated reports on PILIR, HR information, staff establishment and compensation of employee costing; Conduct annual provincial HR Planning assessments; Compile provincial HR Planning compliance report. Provide operational leadership, supervision and the management of staff performance.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. V. Fredericks Tel No: (053) 030 0690
jobs.applications: Email applications to: adhraplansystems2026@ncotp.gov.za
jobs.notes: Compliance: Applications must be submitted on the approved New Amended Z83 Form (No.81/971431) as prescribed with effect from 01 January 2021, which must be signed, initialled and dated; however, the initial on the second page of the form is not mandatory. The form is obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website, www.dpsa.gov.za. Applicants must indicate the post and the correct reference number on the Z83 application Form. The New Z83 Form must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae clearly indicating positions held, period in the position and key responsibilities with three contactable referees, and it is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). DPSA Circular 03 of 2025 states that the form must be completed in a manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post applied for by completing all relevant fields. Please note that Part A must be fully completed. Part B, C and D questions of the Z83 may be left blank, marked as not relevant, and use dashes or N/A if they do not apply to you or the position applied for. Part E, F and G do not need to be completed if the CV has been attached and provides the required information. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part F is compulsory for applicants seeking re-employment into the Public Service. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re- employment. Failure to provide information on the CV as requested the applicant may be disqualified. Applications received after the closing date will, as a rule, not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It will be expected of candidate(s) to be available for the interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA, which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS, and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ Shortlisted candidate(s) will be required to undergo personal suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification, verification of any dismissal for misconduct, and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. Candidates will be subject to security screening and vetting. Applicants must disclose if he/she is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting 162 any business with an Organ of State and whether he/she is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: HRA, HR-beplanning en -stelsels
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir HR-beplanning en -stelsels in die Kantoor van die Premier, Kimberley, wat HR-administrasie en die nakoming van werwing vereistes oor provinsiale departemente koördineer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF level 6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n Public Administration/Management-kwalifikasie hê. Drie (3) jaar se bewese ervaring op toesigvlak in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede: Databasis- en HR-stelselbestuur, navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede, numeriese en statistiese vaardighede, inligtingsbestuursvaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike verhoudings, kliëntediensgerigtheid, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, konflikbestuur, vermoë om onder druk te werk, tydbestuur, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, aandag aan detail, vertroulikheid en professionele etiek, spanwerk en samewerking, aanpasbaarheid en inisiatief. Bevoegdhede: Die volgende sleutelbevoegdhede en vaardighede word vir die pos vereis: Diepgaande kennis van die Public Service Act en Regulasies, DPSA-direktiewe en HR-voorskifte. Ervaring in die PERSAL-stelsel en HR-inligtingstelsels; HR-administrasie en die monitering van nakoming, verslagskrywing, beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling, HR-beplanning en werksmagontleding, monitering van werwing en seleksie, koördinering van indiensnemingsgelykheid, PERSAL-verslagdoening, data-ontleding en -interpretasie, voorleggings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, rekord- en dokumentbestuur. Kennis van die Public Service Act en Regulasies, DPSA-direktiewe en HR-voorskifte, Employment Equity Act en verwante verslagdoeningsvereistes, Recruitment and Selection-transkripsies, Job Evaluation-beginsels en -prosesse, PERSAL- en vakaturebestuurverslagdoening, HR-beplanningsraamwerke en verslagdoeningsvereistes, HR-beleidsontwikkeling en konsultasieprosesse, openbare administrasie en goewerancestrukture, departementele strategiese beplanning en verslagdoeningsprosesse.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende sleutelverantwoordelikhede verantwoordelik wees: Koördineer en monitor die implementering van Menslike Hulpbronadministrasiepraktyke, werwings- en aanstellingsprosesse oor provinsiale departemente; Monitor departementele nakoming van toepaslike HR-wetgewing, regulasies, beleide, sirkuliere, bepalings, direktiewe en werwings- en seleksievoorskifte; Ontleed departementele HR-administrasie-, werwing-, vakature- en nakomingsinligting om neigings, risiko's, gapings en areas van nie-nakoming te identifiseer; Verskaf werwing- en seleksiesteun met betrekking tot die aanstelling van Hoofde van Departemente; Monitor en spoor die vul van befondsde vakante poste, vakaturekoerse, werwingsomkeertye en departementele vordering teen Employment Equity- en werksmagtransformasieteikens na; Stel en handhaaf gekonsolideerde provinsiale verslae, rekords en ondersteunende getuienis oor HR-administrasie, werwing, vakatures, Employment Equity en nakoming vir bestuurs-, goewerance-, oudit- en toesigdoeleindes saam; Verskaf insette met die ontwikkeling en hersiening van provinsiale transversale HRA-beleide, raamwerke, riglyne en planne; Doen navorsing oor relevante HRA-voorskifte, DPSA-direktiewe, kollektiewe ooreenkomste en beste praktyke; Berei konsep-HRA-beleide voor in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing, nasionale raamwerke, organisasiestrategie en provinsiale prioriteite; Verseker die koördinering en ondersteuning van provinsiale HR-goewerancestrukture en interdepartementele forums; Monitor departementele nakoming van PILIR-vereistes en kwartaallikse verslagdoeningsverpligtinge; Ontleed PERSAL- en ander HR-inligtingstelseldata om neigings en risiko's te identifiseer; Berei gekonsolideerde verslae oor PILIR, HR-inligting, personeelvestiging en koste van vergoeding van werknemers voor; Voer jaarlikse provinsiale HR-beplanningsassesserings uit; Stel 'n provinsiale HR-beplanningsnakomingsverslag op. Verskaf operasionele leierskap, toesig en die bestuur van personeelprestasie.

zu.title: Ongezwayo Ophethe: HRA, Ukuhlelwa kwe-HR kanye Nasenhlelweni
zu.summary: Ongezwayo ophethe ngekuhlelwa kwe-HR kanye nasenhlelweni ehhovisi likaNdunankulu, eKimberley, ohlela kahle izinto zokuphathwa kwe-HR kanye nokuziphendulela ekubhadeni abasebenzi kuzo zonko izigaba zeminyango yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-National Diploma (NQF level 6) kwi-Human Resource Management noma i-Public Administration/Management qualification. Emuva kweminyaka emithathu (3) okube konke ukuhlolwa ngokuhlelekile komsebenzi ongeniswe ezingeni labaphathi kwi-Human Resource Management. Ukubuka kwengqondo ngomkhakha wekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Izindimi: Ukuphathwa kwe-Databases kanye ne-HR Systems Management, izindimi zocwaningo kanye nokucazulula, izindimi ezibanzi kanye nezenani nezibalo, izindimi zokulawula ulwazi, izindimi zokuxhumana (ezibhalwayo noma ezikhulumayo), ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu, ukuthola isikhundla kubathengi, izindimi zokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga ezingaqondani, isibindi sokusebenzela ngaphansi komfutho, ukuphatha isikhathi, izindimi zokuqasha zokubamba izinkundla nezinto ezidingekayo, ukugqamisa izinhlangothi zonke, ukugcina imfihlo kanye nokuziphatha ngendlela yekhono lemfunda, ukusebenza njengesiqephu ekuzameni ukuphumelela, ukuziphendulela ekushintsheni izinkomba. Izindinganiso: Kudingeka izingcono eziyisisekelo nezimpawu ezilandelayo zikulelo msebenzi: ukuqonda kubanzi komthetho we-Public Service Act kanye nemiyalo yokuzelelana kwezinto, imiyalo ye-DPSA kanye ne-HR prescripts. Okuhloliwe ngokuhlelekile kwe-PERSAL kanye nasenhlelweni yolwazi lwe-HR; ukulawulwa kwe-HR kanye nokubuka ukuziphendulela, ukubhala umbiko, ukucazulula kanye nokwakheka komthetho, ukuhlelwa kwe-HR kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezemisebenzi ekhaya, ukugcina isikhundla ekugcineni kwezikhundla, ukuhlelwa komnotho wamaphoyintsi ahanjwayo, ukubhala imibiko ye-PERSAL, ukwehlukanisa kanye necwazimbe lolwazi, izindimi zokusiza izinkomba zokuqashwa kwezinto nezimpawu, ukulawulwa kwezinkomba zokuqashwa kanye nesibhaxu. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Act kanye nemithetho ezelelana nezinto, imiyalo ye-DPSA kanye ne-HR prescripts, umthetho we-Employment Equity Act kanye nezigaba ezidinga ukubhalwa, i-Recruitment and Selection transcripts, imigomo nemikhuba ye-Job Evaluation, imibiko ye-PERSAL kanye nokuphathwa kwamathunxa azele, imigqaniselo yokuqashwa kwe-HR kanye nezigaba ezidinga ukubhalwa, ukwakheka komthetho we-HR kanye nokuzelelana kwemikhuba, izakhiwo zocwango lomphakathi nokubuswa kwesigaba, imikhuba yokuzelelana nezinhlelo zokuqashwa komnyango namaphuzu okubhalwa imibiko.
zu.duties: Umqashi ophumelelayo uzobe enesibindi phakathi kwezinye izinto ezibalulekile kule minikelo yemisebenzi: Ukuzelelana kanye nokubuka ukuhlelwa kolwazi lwe-HR, imikhuba yokuzelelana nezinto ezidinga ukuba ngomthetho phakathi kwezigaba zeminyango yomphakathi. Ukubuka ukuziphendulela komnyango ngokuhambisana nomthetho we-HR, imiyalo, imigomo, amakhasimende ahanjwayo, ukumiswa kwemigomo, imiyalo kanye nokuhlonza abantu abangaba ngabahleli noma abaqashiwe. Ukucwazulula imibiko ye-HR yomnyango, ukubala abantu abangenayo, i-vacancies kanye nokubuka ngokwethula ukuze kutholakale izigaba ezithinta imisebenzi, amabi, izigcawu ezishiyekile kanye nezindawo ezingakwenzi umthetho nokuhamba kahle emsebenzini. Ukulungiselela abantu abafakwe ohlelweni lokuzelelana nokuhambisana nomthetho ngokubhadwa kwezikhundla zabaphathi beminyango kanye nezaqashiwe; ukubuka kubanzi ukugcwala kwezikhundla ezingena bantu abazigcwalisile, ukwehla kokungaluki kwabasebenzi, izinga lokubhadwa labantu, isikhathi esithathwe ukubhadwa kanye nokuqhubekela phambili komnyango ukubhadwa kwe-Employment Equity kanye nokugcina amaphoyintsi okushintsha abasebenzi. Ukuqoqa kanye nokugcina imibiko yomphakathi eqoqekile, amaphuzu abhalwayo kanye nobufakazi obuhleliwe kokuqashwa kwe-HR, ukuhlabe amaqembu okuqashwa, izikhundla ezingagcwaliswanga, i-Employment Equity kanye nokuziphendulela kubaphathi, ekubusweni, ukubheka izimpahla ezibalulekile, ukuhlolwa kanye nokuxazulula izinto ngokubuka konke. Ukunikeza izinkomba ngokwakha nokubuka ngosuku lwonke imigqaniselo ye-HRA yomphakathi, imigomo, imigqaniselo eceleni kanye nezeqembu. Ukwenza ucwaningo nge-HRA ephathwa okumele kuhlelwe, imiyalo ye-DPSA, izivumelano ngokuhlanganyela kanye nezingcaca ezingcono zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuqamba imigomo ye-HRA ngokuhambisana nomthetho osezwa, imigqaniselo yesizwe, umgomo wokuqashwa kanye nezenzo ezibalulekile zomphakathi. Ukuzelelana nokulungiselela izakhiwo zokuzelelana kwe-HR yomphakathi kanye namafomethi azelelana phakathi kweminyango; ukubuka ukuziphendulela komnyango kumthetho we-PILIR kanye nokubhalwa imibiko njalo ngesikhathi. Ukucwazulula ukuphathwa kwelungu lomnyango, ukubhadwa ngokusemthethweni kwamaphoyintsi kokuzelelana ezweni, ukuxazulula kwemibiko, ukusetshenziswa okuphathwayo kwabasebenzi; ukwenza ukubukeka komsebenzi wonyaka we-HR Planning komphakathi. Ukuqoqa imibiko yokuziphendulela ngokuqashwa kwe-HR Planning kwomphakathi. Ukunika isikhundla ngokuhola, ukuphatha kanye nokubuka ukuphumelela kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umcedisi weMongameli: HRA, Uqikelelo lwe-HR kunye neNkqubo
xh.summary: Umcedisi weMongameli othe ngaphaya kwamagumbi eqhutywa yiNkundla yoMongameli, eKIMBERLEY, elungisa ulawulo lweqela leziphatha-mandla kunye nokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa komthetho wokwamkela abasebenzi kwizinyanzela iisebe zephononongo lulwimi.
xh.requirements: Iingcali kufuneka zibe neDiploma yaseLlizwe (iNqanaba 6 leNQF) kuLawulo lweZempilo yokuSebenza okanye nesiPapu seZezenukatholiko yoLawulo. Ithathu (3) iminyaka yamava aqinisekisiweyo kwinqanaba lokuqondisa kulaLawulo lweZempilo yokuSebenza. Ukwaziswa ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, i-Outlook). ILayisenisi yokuQhuba esebenzayo. Amakhono: Ulawulo lweDatabase kwaye neNkqubo yeHR, amakhono oPhando nokuHlola, amakhono eBalo lwezibalo, amakhono oLawulo lweNkcukacha, amakhono oThetho (okubhalisiweyo nokuKhulunywa), uQuqulo lwaBantu, uMiso oqondiswe kumXhasi, amakhono oSombululo lweengxaki, uLawulo lweNxaxheba, ukuSebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, uLawulo lwexesha, uQekelelo lokuCwangcisa nokuhlela, uQwalaselo lweenkcukacha, uGcino lweMfihlo nokuZiphatha ngokobugcisa, uKusebenza ngokwengqondo noselulelo, uKuzinza noQhubeleko phambili. Iinkalo ezibalulekileyo: Kufuneka zibe nalamakhono abalulekileyo nalawo anikiweyo apha ngezantsi: Ukuqonda ngokujulileko uMthetho woNyango lwaseLlizwe namagunya, izalathiso zeDPSA namagunya e-HR. UQeqeshelo kunkqubo yePERSAL nolwazi lwe-HR; ulawulo lweqela leziphatha-mandla nokwenziwa kokuqinisekisa, ukubhala iNgxelo, uQwalaselo lweNgqungqutha nokuyphuhlisa, uQekelelo lwe-HR nokuHlola amagumbi, uLawulo lokuKhetha nokwamkela abantu, uLungelelwaniso lweNgqalakelwa yethutyana, iNgxelo yePERSAL, uHlolo olubalo lwedatha ngokuchanekileyo, amakhono oBoniso noQeqesho, uLawulo lweNkcukacha zamafayili. ULwazi ngeMithetho yoNyango lwaseLlizwe namagunya, izalathiso zeDPSA namagunya e-HR, uMthetho woLungelelwaniso lwabaNtu namagunya okwenza iNgxelo, oOnke bamagunya aBambeleyo bokuKhetha, iNgqinisekiso yaseMsebenzini, nokuQinisekiswa kwenkqubo, uPERSAL nokuQwalasela iNgxelo ezeNtshukumo, uMisilo lokuQeqelela lwe-HR namagunya okwenza iNgxelo, uPhuhliso lweNgqungqutha ye-HR nendlela yokucela izimvo, uLawulo lwaseLlizwe nemixhantile yommandu, iNkqubo yoQekelelo lweNgqungqutha yesebe nokwenza iNgxelo.
xh.duties: Umfundi opumelelayo uzakuba nesibopho esilandelayo, phakathi kwamanye: Ukulungisa nokulawula ukusebenza kolawulo lweqela leziphatha-mandla zeZempilo yokuSebenza, iinkqubo zokuKhetha nokuQinisekisa kwiziphatha-mandla nakuzo zonke iisebe; UkuQwalasela ukwamkelwa komthetho ngabasebenzi basebe, ukulawula iNgqungqutha, iNgqungqutha yabasebenzi, amagunya, izaziso, iingqibo, izalathiso namagunya okuKhetha nokuQinisekisa; UkuHlola ulawulo lweqela leZiphatha-mandla, ulwazi lokuKhetha, oluNgatshongo kunye nolunye oluQinisekisa ukubakho komthetho ukubona iNdlela eziya kulo, iingozi, amathuba amathathu noguquko olungalunganga; UkuNika inkxaso ngesiQinisekiso sokubeka ngqo iNkokheli yezisebe ezahlukeneyo; UkuQwalasela nokubeka indlela egqitywa ngayo iindawo ezize kungamntu, inqanaba lokuVala izithuba, iNqanaba lokuzala iNtshukumo ixesha elifutshane kwaye umbhalo ngokuQhubela phambili nguMthetho wokuQinisekisa ukubakho ngokulingana kwaye nokuGuqula iNgqungqutha; UKwazi ukugcina iNgxelo yoluntu, iNkcukacha namagunya eNgqungqutha kwaye ukukha iNgxelo ejolise kumXhasi, uLawulo, uVavvo nokuSetyenziswa kolunye usetyenziso ngokweHlabathi lokuLawula iNgqungqutha iNgqinisekiso eyodwa; UKwazi ukusetyenziswa nokwenza iNgxelo ngokuzinza kolawulo lweNgqungqutha yeNqanaba le-HR kuyo yonke imibutho yaseburhulimeni, ePILIR kwakunye noMthetho wokwenza iNgxelo ngokweenyanga ezintathu; UkuHlolo idatha yePERSAL kwakunye neNkqubo yamanye amaNkcukacha i-HR ukubona ukuba zikho na iNdlela ezixake kakhulu; UkuLungiselela iNgxelo eQinisekiswe ngokweenyanga ezintathu kwiPILIR, iNkcukacha ze-HR, ukumiswa kukaBantu baseNkundla nokuSetyenziswa kweMali ekuBekelwa abaSebenzi; UKwenza uQeqesho lokubekwa koluntu kwiNgqungqutha iNqanaba le-HR; Ukwakha iNgxelo yoluntu yokwamkela iNgqungqutha ye-HR. UKunika isikhokelo ngokusebenza, ukuQondisa kwaye ukwazi ukuLawula iMisebenzi yabaSebenzi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Desktop Support
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Desktop Support role in Kimberley requiring a National Diploma in IT and three years of supervisory ICT support experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma (NQF level 6) in Information Technology/Computer Science-related qualification. Three (3) years’ proven experience at supervisory level in Information Communication Technology support. Specialist training with desktop and network support is essential. Experience in Microsoft Systems and Server administration including Active Directory Users and Computers, Group Policy Management, Desktop Virtualisation Administration, and associated software. Good computer skills (including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook). A valid driver’s licence. Competencies: The following key competencies and skills are required for the position: Good computer skills (including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook). Good interpersonal skills and communication skills (verbal and written). Good administration, presentation and reporting skills. Leadership and management skills. Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Responsible for assisting in planning of ICT desktop support for the Department. Ensuring data integrity and computer maintenance. Configure computer hardware and software. Configure network devices and email accounts for all users in the Department. IT equipment maintenance and disposal by following prescribed procedure. Assist with specification of ICT equipment. Attend relevant meetings and development opportunities. Develop, implement and monitor related risks, IT-related policies and procedures. Relevant Public Service Regulations. Supervising the ICT Infrastructure team, providing direction and developing staff to ensure team members are effective, motivated, accountable and provide a high level of service. Oversees ICT project implementation, application support and ensures compliance with IT security standards. Provides supervision and technical guidance to IT Support Technicians, manages service desk escalations, and ensures SLA adherence. Supports interactive technologies and maintains IT asset registers while staying aligned with IT best practices and policies.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. T. Toloane Tel No: (053) 030 0752
jobs.applications: Email applications to: asdds@ncotp.gov.za
jobs.notes: Compliance: Applications must be submitted on the approved New Amended Z83 Form (No.81/971431) as prescribed with effect from 01 January 2021, which must be signed, initialled and dated; however, the initial on the second page of the form is not mandatory. The form is obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website, www.dpsa.gov.za. Applicants must indicate the post and the correct reference number on the Z83 application Form. The New Z83 Form must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae clearly indicating positions held, period in the position and key responsibilities with three contactable referees, and it is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). DPSA Circular 03 of 2025 states that the form must be completed in a manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post applied for by completing all relevant fields. Please note that Part A must be fully completed. Part B, C and D questions of the Z83 may be left blank, marked as not relevant, and use dashes or N/A if they do not apply to you or the position applied for. Part E, F and G do not need to be completed if the CV has been attached and provides the required information. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re- appointment under Part F is compulsory for applicants seeking re-employment into the Public Service. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete the section as it is intended for those seeking re- employment. Failure to provide information on the CV as requested the applicant may be disqualified. Applications received after the closing date will, as a rule, not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates for the post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interviews. It will be expected of candidate(s) to be available for the interview process on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA, which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS, and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ Shortlisted candidate(s) will be required to undergo personal suitability checks, which include criminal records, citizenship, financial credits/assets, qualifications verification, verification of any dismissal for misconduct, and previous employment background/reference checks will be verified. Candidates will be subject to security screening and vetting. Applicants must disclose if he/she is not a Director/Shareholder of a company or conducting 162 any business with an Organ of State and whether he/she is performing any additional remunerative work outside his/her normal duties. The successful candidate will enter into an Annual Performance Agreement, and also annually disclose his/her financial interest. The Department reserves the right not to make appointments. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post must direct their enquiries to the relevant person indicated. Communication and Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Werkskermondersteuning
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Werkskermondersteuning-pos in Kimberley wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en drie jaar se toesigervaring in ICT-ondersteuning vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) in Inligtingstegnologie/'n rekenaarwetenskap-verwante kwalifikasie beskik. Drie (3) jaar se bewese ervaring op toesigvlak in Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie-ondersteuning. Spesialisopleiding in werkskerm- en netwerkondersteuning is noodsaaklik. Ervaring in Microsoft-stelsels en bedieneradministrasie, insluitend Active Directory Users and Computers, Group Policy Management, Desktop Virtualisation Administration en geassosieerde sagteware. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (insluitend Excel, Word, PowerPoint en Outlook). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Die volgende sleutelbevoegdhede en vaardighede word vir die pos vereis: Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (insluitend Excel, Word, PowerPoint en Outlook). Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie administratiewe, aanbiedings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om 'n hoë vlak van vertroulikheid te handhaaf.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir bystand met die beplanning van ICT-werkskermondersteuning vir die Departement. Verseker data-integriteit en rekenaaronderhoud. Konfigureer rekenaarhardeware en -sagteware. Konfigureer netwerktoestelle en e-posrekeninge vir alle gebruikers in die Departement. IT-toerustingonderhoud en -beskikking deur voorgeskrewe prosedures te volg. Bystand met spesifikasie van ICT-toerusting. Byswoon relevante vergaderings en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor verwante risiko's, IT-verwante beleide en prosedures. Relevante Staatsdiensregulasies. Toesig oor die ICT-infrastruktuurspan, verskaf rigting en ontwikkel personeel om te verseker dat spanlede effektief, gemotiveerd en verantwoordelik is en 'n hoë vlak van diens lewer. Hou toesig oor ICT-projekimplementering, toepassingsondersteuning en verseker voldoening aan IT-sekuriteitsstandaarde. Verskaf toesig en tegniese leiding aan IT-ondersteuningstegnici, bestuur diensbank-eskalerings en verseker SLA-nakoming. Ondersteun interaktiewe tegnologieë en handhaaf IT-batesregisters terwyl in lyn gebly word met IT-bestuurspraktyke en -beleid.

zu.title: Umcedisi Wezikhundla: Ukweseka Kwezikhompyutha Ezidakayo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somCedisi Wezikhundla: Ukweseka Kwezikhompyutha Ezidakayo eKimberley esidinga iDiploma Yezwe kwi-IT kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava okubheka abasebenzi kwinkxaso ye-ICT.
zu.requirements: Abafakiswa kufanele babe neDiploma Yezwe (NQF level 6) kwimfundo yeThuluzi LwoluLwazi/Ezolimo LweKhompyutha. Three (3) years’ proven experience at supervisory level in Information Communication Technology support. Ukuqeqesha okukhethekile ngokweseka kwezikhompyutha ezidakayo nethuluzi lokuxhumana kubaluleke kakhulu. Amanqamu ekhompyutha nakumasevisi weMicrosoft kumbhalo we-Active Directory Users and Computers, i-Group Policy Management, i-Desktop Virtualisation Administration, kanye nohlelo oluhlobene nalo. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi ngekhompyutha (ehlanganisa i-Excel, i-Word, i-PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izakhiwo: Ezilandelayo ezibalulekile kanye n amandla ayadingeka kuleso sikhundla: Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi ngekhompyutha (ehlanganisa i-Excel, i-Word, i-PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Amandla okuxhumana kanye n amandla okukhuluma (okuswatshwe nokubhaliwe). Amandla okulawula okuhle, okuwethula nokubika. Amandla okuba ngumholi nokuqondisa. Amandla okugcina inqanaba eliphezulu lokubeka iyimfihlo.
zu.duties: Ukuba necountable ekwabeleni inkxaso yezikhompyutha ezidakayo ze-ICT kulo Mnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthi idatha ilungile kanye n ezokulondoloza ikhompyutha. Misela izinhlablhalo kanye nohlelo lwekhompyutha. Misela amathuluzi oxhumo namagebhu abasebenzi bonke abasebenzi kulo Mnyango. Ukulondolozwa nokulahlwa kwezinto ze-IT ngokulandela inqubo ebekiwe. Ukusiza ekucaciseni izinto ze-ICT. Ukuba namuhla kumihlangano engokwethuthukiswa. Yakha, faka ekusebenzeni futhi uqaphe izengozi ezihlobene, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo ze-IT. Izinqubomgomo Zabe Lomphakathi ezihlobene. Ukubheka iqembu le-ICT Infrastructure, ukunika isiqondiso kanye nokuthuthukisa abasebenzi ukuze qinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eqembu asebenza kahle, anomyalezo, anecountable futhi anikeze inqanaba eliphezulu lesevisi. Buka ukusetshenziswa kwamaphulothi e-ICT, inkxaso yohlelo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlonishwa amazinga okuphatha kwe-IT. Nikeza isiqondiso kanye nokuqondisa ngobuchwepheshe kubasebenzi be-IT Support Technicians, uphathe izinkinga ezikhishwe kuso isikhundla sesevisi, futhi uqinisekise ukuhlonishwa kwe-SLA. Sekela izinthobuchwepheshe ezixhumayo futhi zigcine izinto ze-IT ezibalulekile ngokuqondana n amasu amahle kanye nezinqubo ze-IT.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkokheli: Inkxaso yeDesktop
xh.summary: Indima kaMncedi weNkokheli: Inkxaso yeDesktop eKimberley efuna iDiploma yeSizwe kwi-IT kunye neminyaka emithandathu yamava okulawula kwinxaxheba yenkxaso ye-ICT.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neDiploma yeSizwe (inqanaba le-NQF 6) kwiTekhnoloji yolwazi/Isayensi yeKhompyutha okanye isidanga esinxulumeneyo. Iimbonelelo (3) eminyaka yamava aqinisekisiweyo kwinqanaba lolawulo kwinxaxheba yenkxaso yeTekhnoloji yolwazi nokuThunyelwana. Uqeqesho lolwazi oluchasene nenkxaso yedesktop kunye nenethiwekhi lubalulekile. Amava kwiMicrosoft Systems kunye nolawulo lweServer kuquka i-Active Directory Users and Computers, iGroup Policy Management, uLawulo lweDesktop Virtualisation, kunye nesoftware exhubekanayo. Amakhono amade khompyutha (kuquka i-Excel, i-Word, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook). Iilayisensi ezivumelekileyo zokhombisikhombisi. Iikhompetensi: Ezi khompetensi nakhono aphantsi afunwa kulesi sithuba: Amakhono amade khompyutha (kuquka i-Excel, i-Word, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook). Amakhono amade okusebenza nabantu kunye namakhono othetha kunye nokubhala (olomlomo nolubhalweyo). Amakhono amade lolawulo, okubonisa kunye nokuchaza iingxelo. Amakhono okukhokela kunye nokulawula. Ukwazi ukugcina ixabiso eliphezulu lokubhala iimfihlo.
xh.duties: Ukungcangcxela ekucecelweni kweplani yenkxaso ye-ICT desktop yeSebe. Qinisekisa ukusekwa kwedata nokunyanzelekile kokugcinwa kwekhompyutha. Misela i-hardware kunye nesoftware yekhompyutha. Misela amadivayisi enethiwekhi kunye neakhawunti ze-imeyile yabo bonke abasebenzisi eSebeni. Ukugcinwa kokhululwa kwekhompyutha yekhompyutha nokutshazwa ngokulandela inkqubo echaziweyo. Unceda ekuchazeni komgangatho weqela le-ICT. Zibandakanya kwiindaba ezinxulumeneyo kunye nemisebenzi yokuphucula. Yakha, yenzise kunye nokujonga iingozi ezinxulumeneyo, iindaba ze-IT kunye nenkqubo ezinxulumeneyo. Iimgaqo zeNkonzo zoLuntu ezinxulumeneyo. zu.title: I-Nkulu Yomphathi Womsebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Nkulu Yomphathi Womsebenzi esibhedlela samaphovinsi i-North West esidinga idigri ye-Health Sciences, iminyaka emihlanu yohlu lwamava lokuqondisa kanye nesitifiketi sokuqala ngaphambi kokuqashwa kwi-SMS.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor’s Degree in Health Sciences (NQF Level 7) njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. I-Post-Graduate Diploma in Management izoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ezingeni loPhathi Wegunya Ephakathi/Phezulu kumkhakha Wezempilo. Isitifiketi sokuqala ngaphambi kokuqashwa kumasebenzi e-Senior Management Services (SMS) njengoba kugqashwa yi-National School of Government, sinikezwa ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Ilayisensi yokuqamba ehambisana namaphoyisa. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuqinile ngamasevisi esibhedlela kanye nemibuzo enemininingwane yokuletha izinsizakalo ezinkulu zempilo, i-District Health System, Abasebenzi Abantu, Izimali, i-Supply Chain Management, i-Public Health Policy kanye neminye imibuzo ehlobene. Amakhono okuphatha abaluleke kakhulu: Ikhono lokubamba ihlelo kanye nokuqonda ukuba ngumholi, Ukuphatha abantu kanye nokubanika amandla, Ukuphatha amahlelo namaphrojekthi, Ukuphatha izimali, Ukuphatha izinguquko, Ukuphatha ulwazi, Ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, Ukuphatha imibhidlangwano, ukuqondiswa kwezikhasimba nokunakekelwa kabhasikidi kanye Nokuquhumusha. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngendawo yesibhedlela.
zu.duties: Uxolule ekuphatheni isibhedlela sonke. Unikeze ukulondoloza nokuqondisa njengomholi. Uphathe ukuletha izinsizakalo zempilo ezinhle kanye nezingathunyelwanga ezingenaphikho, Ukuphathwa kwezokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa kophakeme. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kule mingcelelandawo elandelayo: Ukuphathwa kokunakekela kanye nokuphathwa kwezokwelapha, Ukuphathwa kwezimali (okuhlanganisa i-Revenue), i-Supply Chain Management, Ukulawula Ngaphakathi & Ukuphatha Izingozi, Ukuphathwa kwe-Abasebenzi Abantu, Ukuxhumana kanye Nokuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi. Phatha amafayini asemthethweni ahlobene kanye nemali ejezwele iziphrojekthi ezikhethe zempilo. Qinisekisa ukuqatshuliswa ukusebenza nokuphathwa kwamalayisensi emagatsha ahlukene noma kuyinto enzuzo. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kahle kwesiguli. Phatha ngempumelelo izinkomba zokusebenza zesibhedlela kanye nokusebenza kwabajwayelekile. Xhumana ne-District Management Team ukuze uthole uhlelo lokuqondiswa olulungile. Akha imithetho elawula imithethonqongo kanye nebhizinisi lesibhedlela.

xh.title: Chief Executive Officer
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaChief Executive Officer kumazibeki ephondo laseNorth West esifuna isidanga kwiZizekelo zezeMfundo ezeNzululwazi zeMpilo (Health Sciences), iminyaka emihlanu yamava olawulo nesatifiketi songeniso kwi-SMS.

Isatifiketi songeniso se-Senior Management Services (SMS) njengokuqinisekiswa yi-National School of Government, esinikwa phambi kokuziswa esikhundleni. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egqityiweyo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuchanekileyo ngamasebe ezibekiweyo nemiiba egqithisileyo ehambelana nokunikwa iinkonzo zeempilo, iNkqubo yezeMpilo yoMmandla, uLawulo lweNhlangano yabantu, izimali, uLawulo lweNkqubo yeSikhundla sokunikezela, iNkqubo kaRhulumente yazeMpilo, namaxa ahlobeneyo. Amandla abalulekileyo oLawulo: Amandla okuqamba amacebo okuhamba phambili nokuqhatha, uLawulo lwabantu noku bayakha, uLawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi, uLawulo lweziMali, uLawulo lotshintsho, uLawulo lolwazi, intsingiselo yokunikwa iinkonzo, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuzahlulela, uLawulo lweengxabano, ukujolisa kwiklayenti nokuqonda ukunikelwa kweenkonzo, nokuThetha. Ulwazi nokuqonda indalo yezibekiweyo.
xh.duties: Uxanduva loLawulo jikelele leSibekiweyo. Nikela nobuqhathi bokuhamba phambili kokwenza amacebo. Lawula ukunikwa iinkonzo zeempilo ezintsonkothileyo nendibeneyo, ulawulo lweClinical nolwezinkampani. Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo kwimimandla elandelayo: uLawulo lwe-Clinical nolweBantu abahlala njalo abanakekela bagula, uLawulo lweMali (kuquka nedayim yoshishino), uLawulo loNikezelo lweVimba yamathuba, ulawulo lwangaphakathi noLawulo lweengozi, uLawulo lwenhlangano yabantu, ukunxibelelana, nokuQinisekisa ubungakanani obuhle. Lawula imibuzo yemali engenayo ekuthengiselwa kuyo naxa anikwa iinkonzo ezizezelwa iiprojekthi ezizodwa zempilo. Qinisekisa isatifikethi nakugqitywa ukuvunywa kweziko kwimimandla eyahlukeneyo nanakwenzeka. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuhle koluguli. Lawula ngokusebenzayo inkqubo yokulinganisa ukusebenza kwesibekiweyo, nangokusebenza koluguli. Thethathu nenyathelo olandelayo lawula ipalini yabasebenzi isebenze ngokulinganiselwa. Misa iprotocol ebalulekileyo nendlela yokwenza izinto kwisibekiweyo.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL)
jobs.centre: Klerksdorp/ Tshepong Hospital Complex: Paediatric Surgery (Five Years Contract) Anaesthesia (Four Years Contract) (X2 Posts) Joe Morolong Memorial Hospital: General Surgery (Five Years Contract) Mafikeng Provincial Hospital: General Surgery (Five Years Contract) Potchefstroom Hospital: General Surgery (Five Years Contract)
jobs.summary: Medical registrar positions across North West hospitals in paediatric surgery, anaesthesia, and general surgery on fixed-term contracts with supernumerary placements at Gauteng academic institutions.
jobs.requirements: Paediatric Surgery: This position will be the appointment of the North West Department of Health and the successful candidate will be sent to Gauteng as a supernumerary in either of the following academic institutions: University of Witwatersrand/ University of Pretoria and/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. General Surgery: Joint appointment with Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria & Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Registrars will be appointed jointly between the North West Department of Health and the University of the Witwatersrand/ Pretoria/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science and will rotate through the training platforms in Gauteng and North West Province. Anaesthesia: Joint appointment with Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria, Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Registrars will be appointed jointly between the North West Department of Health and the University of the Witwatersrand, will be based in Klerksdorp/ Tshepong Hospital Complex/ Witrand Hospital, and may be required to rotate through the training platforms in Gauteng. Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Registrar (Independent Practitioner). Must have completed Post Community Service. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit current proof of registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as Medical Practitioner in Independent Practice. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a valid work permit for Non-South African Citizens. Registrars will be rotated between institutions. The following will be an added advantage: Work experience in the field of Paediatrics Surgery or General Surgery as a Medical Practitioner for the period of 12 months, CMSA part 1 examinations and auxiliary courses relevant to the field of Medical Practitioner: ACLS, BSS and ATLS.
jobs.duties: Interview, investigate, diagnose, and oversee the treatment of patients. Supervise junior doctors (Undergraduate Students, Interns and Community Service Doctors). Attend of relevant administrative meetings like mortality meetings, near MISS meetings and completing MEDICO Legal Documents timeously (e.g. Death Certificate). af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES)
af.summary: Mediese registrateurposte by verskeie hospitale in North West in kindergeneeskundige chirurgie, narkose en algemene chirurgie op kontrakte vir 'n vaste termyn, met supernumerere plaserings by akademiese instellings in Gauteng.
af.requirements: Kindergeneeskundige chirurgie: Hierdie pos behels die aanstelling deur die North West Department of Health en die suksesvolle kandidaat sal na Gauteng gestuur word as 'n supernumerer by een van die volgende akademiese instellings: University of Witwatersrand/ University of Pretoria en/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. Algemene chirurgie: Gesamentlike aanstelling met die Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria & Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Registrateurs sal gesamentlik aangestel word tussen die North West Department of Health en die University of the Witwatersrand/ Pretoria/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science en sal roteer deur die opleidingsplatforms in Gauteng en North West Province. Narkose: Gesamentlike aanstelling met die Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria, Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Registrateurs sal gesamentlik aangestel word tussen die North West Department of Health en die University of the Witwatersrand, sal in Klerksdorp/ Tshepong Hospital Complex/ Witrand Hospital gebaseer wees, en kan verlang word om deur die opleidingsplatforms in Gauteng te roteer. Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Registrateur (Independent Practitioner) moontlik maak. Moet Gemeenskapsdiens voltooi het. Kandidate wat op die kortlys geplaas is, sal vereis word om huidige bewys van registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Medical Practitioner in Independent Practice voor te lê. Kandidate wat op die kortlys geplaas is, sal vereis word om 'n geldige werkpermit vir nie-Suid-Afrikaanse burgers voor te lê. Registrateurs sal tussen instellings geroteer word. Die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: Werkervaring in die veld van Kindergeneeskundige Chirurgie of Algemene Chirurgie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vir 'n tydperk van 12 maande, CMSA deel 1 eksamens en bykomende kursusse wat relevant is tot die veld van Mediese Praktisyn: ACLS, BSS en ATLS.
af.duties: Ondervra, ondersoek, diagnoseer en hou toesig oor die behandeling van pasiënte. Hou toesig oor junior dokters (Voorgraadse Studente, Interns en Community Service Doctors). Bywoon van relevante administratiewe vergaderings soos mortaliteitsvergaderings, near MISS vergaderings en die tydige voltooiing van MEDICO Legal Dokumente (bv. Death Certificate). Verbeter kwaliteit van sorg deur toepaslike kliniese sorg te verskaf. Verminder mediese litigasie deur goeie kliniese etos toe te pas. Implementeer en monitor die nakoming van National Core Standards (norme en standaarde). Neem deel aan alle aktiwiteite van die dissipline met betrekking tot onderrig en navorsing. Neem deel in 'n multidissiplinêre span tot die bestuur van pasiënte. Uitvoer van praktiese prosedures wat relevant is tot die sorg van pasiënte. Verseker effektiewe administrasie en die byhou van veiligheidsrekords in die departement. Bereid om buite kantoorure (nag, naweek en openbare vakansiedag) te werk om deurlopende ononderbroke sorg van pasiënte te verskaf.

zu.title: Umlobi wezokwelapha (MEDICAL)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabalobi bezokwelapha kulo onke amasibhedlela e North West kuyilwelwa ukwelashwa kwabantwana, i-anaesthesia, kanye nokwelashwa jikelele ngokwesivumelwano sokuqashwa isikhathi esibekiwe nokuqashwa ngaphezulu kwesibalo emanyuvesi e Gauteng.
zu.requirements: Ukwelashwa kwabantwana: Le sikhundla sizokuba yisigungwabe sempi lo North West Department of Health futhi umuntu oqeqeshiweyo uzothunyelwa e Gauteng njengomuntu oqashiwe ngaphezulu kwesibalo kwenye yalezi manyuvesi aqeqesha: University of Witwatersrand/ University of Pretoria ne/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. Ukwelashwa jikelele: Ukuqashwa ngokubambisana ne Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria & Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Abalobi bazokqashwa ngokubambisana phakathi kuka North West Department of Health kanye ne University of the Witwatersrand/ Pretoria/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science baze benzululwe emaplathafomu okuqeqesha e Gauteng nase North West Province. I-anaesthesia: Ukuqashwa ngokubambisana ne Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria, Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Abalobi bazokqashwa ngokubambisana phakathi kuko North West Department of Health kanye ne University of the Witwatersrand, bazobe besekwa e Klerksdorp/ Tshepong Hospital Complex/ Witrand Hospital, futhi badingwa ukuba bazinze emaplathafomu okuqeqesha e Gauteng. Ithobele elifanele elicubungula ukubhaliswa kwi Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoBhali (Umenzi welokusebenza eyedwa). Kumele abe eqede i Post Community Service. Abantu abakleliswe ohlwini bazodingwa ukuba basinike isibonakaliso samanje sokubhaliswa kwi Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoNyazi wezokwelapha olusebenzela eyedwa. Abantu abakleliswe ohlwini bazodingwa ukuba basinike iviza yokusebenza esebenzayo kubantu abangesi izingwe zansi se South African Citizens. Abalobi bazozulwa phakathi kwezikhungo. Okulandelayo kuzoba kube lusizo: Iminyaka yokuqeqesha emkhakheni we Surgery of Paediatrics noma i Surgery General njengoNyazi wezokwelapha isikhathi esingana zinyanga ezi 12, ukuhlolwa kwe CMSA ingxenye 1 kanye nokufunda izifundo ezihambisana nomkhakha kaNyazi wezokwelapha: ACLS, BSS ne ATLS.
zu.duties: Kubuzwe, kuphenywe, kutholwe izifo, kugadwe ukwelashwa kwabaguli. Kuqeqeshwe abanyazi abancane (Abafundi abangakafundi, Abaqeqeshi kanye Nonyazi we Post Community Service). Kubandakanyeke emihlanganweni yezezokulawula ehlobene nalokho njengemihlangano yokushona, emihlanganweni eduze lokuhamba kabi, nokugcwalisa imibhalo ye MEDICO Legal ngokushesha (isb. Isitifikedi Sokufa). Kuthuthukiswe inhlelankathi yokunakekelwa ngokunikeza ukwelashwa okufanele. Kuncishwe izinkantolo zezokwelapha ngokuziphatha kahle emsebenzini wezokwelapha. Kusetshenziswe futhi kulandelwe ukuzigcina kwe National Core Standards (izimiso kanye nezindinganiso). Kubandakanywe kuyo yonke imisebenzi yokufunda nokufunda kwesifundo. Kubandakanywe eqoqo leminyaka ukuze kuqashwe abaguli. Kwenziwe izinkulumo ezibalulekile ukwenzela ukunakekelwa kwabaguli. Kuqiniseliswe ukulawula kuhle nokuphathwa kohlaka lwezokuphepha esikhungweni. Kubengukuthanda ukusebenza ngemva kwamasikhathi (ebusuku, nge sikhashana namaholide zomphakathi) ukunikezela ukwelashwa okuphathikizi okungaphazanyiswa kwabaguli.

xh.title: UMgcini weziqu (EZONYANGO)
xh.summary: Izithuba zabagcini beziqu bokhwezo kumazibhilekisi e-North West ezokudluliselwa kwezinqola, kudaro nobunye, ngomthetho wemivuzo ehlangabezweyo inani namabakh' eweplasi kwiiqhinga zesizwe ze-academic e-Gauteng.
xh.requirements: Kudaro nokudluliselwa: Esi sithuba siza kuba yinhlanganisela phakathi kwesebe lezempilo laMaphondo ase-North West kumntu ofake isicelo kwaye oza kuthunyelwa e-Gauteng njengomntu ongazange afakwe kuluhlu lokuqeqeswa kwelinye lale ziqhinga zesizwe: University of Witwatersrand/ University of Pretoria kunye/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. Izibhedlele eziNqamlezayo: Ukuhlanganiswa kwengxowa-mali yezobuqu e-Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria & Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Abagcini beziqu baza kuba nhlanganisela phakathi kwesebe lezezempilo elikaNorth West Department of Health, University of Witwatersrand/ Pretoria/ Sefako Makgatho Health Science kwaye bazakutshintshiselwa phakathi kwendawo zokukhulisa iinkxaso-mali ezikwela-Gauteng nakwi-Province yase-North West. Ukwenziwa kwezinto ezithile: Ukuhlanganiswa kwesiphelo sezobuqu ne-Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Witwatersrand, University of Pretoria, Sefako Makgatho Health Science University. NB: Abagcini beziqu baya kuba ngumhlangano phakathi kuka-North West Department of Health kwaye abakho e-Klerksdorp/ Tshepong Hospital Complex/ Witrand Hospital, kwaye banokufuneka ukuba bajikeleze ngokuzonqumama kwizixhobo zokufunda ezisesixekweni se-Gauteng. Iipaspoti ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukuqeshwa kwi-HPCSA njengomgcinamafa wemithetho ekwincwadi yabaphili (Independent Practitioner). Kufuneka agqibe izikwere zokuqeqeshwa. Olu lulo ohlu lwezinyani abazakuthunyelwa kuyo ukuba banike isiqinisekiso sokugqiba kwexesha lemidla yokuzilawula ne-HPCSA njengomgcinamafa ngobugqirha. Olu lulo ohlu lwezinyani abazakuthunyelwa kuyo ukuba banike isiqinisekiso sokugqiba kwexesha lemidla yokuzilawula kubantu abangesiwo amaNingizimu Afrika. Abagcini beziqu bazakujikeleza phakathi kweziqhinga. Oku kulandelayo kuya kuba luncedo: Ixesha lokuba nomsebenzi ekwindla yokudluliselwa iintsana kumathuba e-Medical Practitioner ixesha elingangeenyanga ezingama-12, i-CMSA part 1 exams kunye nezifundo ezuncedayo ngokwendlela ejelwe kubagcini beziqu bokhwezo: i-ACLS, i-BSS kunye ne-ATLS.
xh.duties: Kuphenye, uphando, uxaku, kwaye ulawule unyango lwezigulane. Qeqesha oogqirha abancinci (Abaqudi be-Undergraduate, Oogqirha abangenamvuzo, Oogqirha abakhokhelwayo ngokwesebe leNyango). Makathathe inkxaxheba kwiindawo ezikwiofisi, njengokudibana ngokufa, okungalolunye ukuhlangeneyo kwaye agqibe imibhalo yeMEDICO Legal ngokwexesha elifanelekileyo (umzekelo: i-Certificate yoKufa). Ukusuka ngcono ubundle bomnqweno wokuba nolawulo oluqinisekileyo lokwenzakalo. Ukususa iinkxaxheba zobugqirha ngokuphumeza inkqubo yokulawula ezobugqirha ezilungileyo. Yakha kwaye ulawule ukuhambelana nemigangatho eNgokwenyango yeSizwe (i-norms and standards). Thabatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izikwere zendalo ngokwemigaqo yokufundisa nophando. Thabatha inxaxheba kwikomiti yolwazi lolunye ngokulawula iindlela ezixhobileyo ekusingathweni kwezigulane. Zenza iinkqubo zokusebenza ezahlukeneyo ezingezantsi ekunyamezeleni izigulane. Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo nokugcina izipheto ngokomgca kwisebe. Yiba nokulungele ukusebenza ngenxweme (emini ubusuku, ngeerekhedi kunye nangamaholide esizwe) ukunikela ngokusikelelwa okuqhubekayo okungapheliyo kwezigulane.
