af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: SUB Distrikbestuurder
af.summary: Bestuur primêre gesondheidsorgdienste, gesondheidsfasiliteite en prestasie-aanwysers oor verskeie sub-distrikte in die North West Province.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma / Bachelors-graad in Gesondheidswetenskappe. Vyf (5) jaar se bestuurservaring waarvan 3 jaar as Assistent-bestuurder Verpleegkunde moet wees wat met Primêre Gesondheidsorg (PHC)-aktiwiteite werksaam is. 'n Sertifikaat in Kliniese Assessering, Diagnose en Behandeling sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van die Grondwet, Public Service Act 1994 soos gewysig, Public Service Amendment Regulations 2023 en toepaslike gesondheidswetgewing/beleide. Kennis en begrip van Primêre Gesondheidsorg en gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. District Health System (DHS)-ontwikkeling en District Health Information System (DHIS) en werkskennis van Geographical Information System (GIS). Kortlys-kandidate sal 'n geldige werkpermit vir nie-Suid-Afrikaanse burgers moet voorlê. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), probleemoplossing, beleidsontwikkeling, analities, koördinasie, finansiële beplanning, beplanning, organisering, onderhandeling. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur sleutelprestasie-gesondheidsaanwysers met betrekking tot strategiese gesondheidsprogramme, Menslike Hulpbronne, Finansiële Bestuur en Toeskakelbestuur. Algehele bestuur van gesondheidsfasiliteite en PHC-dienste op Sub-Distrik-vlak. Bestuur die verskaffing van geïntegreerde en gehalte-gesondheidsdiens. Verskaf leierskap aan die Sub-Distrik-bestuur. Bestuur voorwaardelike toelaes en befondsingsverskaffing vir spesiale gesondheidsprojekte. Hou toesig oor Assistent-bestuurders wat verantwoordelik is vir administrasie, gemeenskapsgesondheidsdiens en plaaslike gesondheidsorgbestuur. Koördineer gesondheidsbestuur, verwante gesondheids-NGO's en CBO's binne die Sub-Distrik.

zu.title: Onozimayela: Umphathi Wezesibonda
zu.summary: Phatha izinsizakalo ezingunomfuyana zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izakhiwo zezempilo kanye namashadi okuqinisekisa ukusebenza kuleyo minyuzi ehlukene yamagesi kwi North West Province.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe / I-degree ye-Bachelor kwezSayensi Yezempilo. Ukuhlola iminyaka eyihlanu (5) ekuphatheni okuyilawo iminyaka emithathu kufanele ibe ngumPhathi omsiza weNesingi obhekene nemisebenzi ye-Primary Health Care (PHC). Isitifikedi e-Clinical Assessment Diagnosis and Treatment sizoba ngusizo olwengeziwe. Ilayisense yomshayeli esemthethweni. Ulwazi loMthethosisekelo, uMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 njengoba ushintshiwe, Imlawulo Yokushintsha Komthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-2023 kanye nomthetho/inqubomgomo yezempilo efanele. Ulwazi kanye neqondo ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwe-District Health System (DHS) kanye ne-District Health Information System (DHIS) kanye nolwazi lokusebenza lwe-Geographical Information System (GIS). Osekelayo abayisikhundla abafushanisiwe bazodinga ukuthumela i-Work Permit esemthethweni yabantu abangesona izakhamuzi zase-Ningizimu Afrika. Isikhulumi esihle (esishoyo kanye nesibhaliwe), ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlanganisa, kwezimali, ukweluleka, ukuhlela, ukuxoxisana. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Phatha amashadi abalulekile okuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwezempilo mayelana namaphrogramu ezempilo abalulekile, abantu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuPhathwa kweSonto Sokuheha. Ukuphatha ngokuphelele izakhiwo zezempilo kanye nezinsizakalo ze-PHC ezingeni Lezesibonda. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezihlangene futhi ezinhle. Nikeza igunya lokuhola ekuPhathweni kwezesibonda. Phatha izibonelelo zezimo ezithile kanye nokunikezwa kwezimali zamaphrojekthi ezempilo ezikhethekile. Qaphisise abaPhathi bomsiza ababhekene nokuphathwa, izinsizakalo zezempilo zomphakathi kanye nokuphathwa kwezempilo endaweni. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezempilo, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ezihlobene nezempilo kanye ne-CBO ngaphakathi kwesibonda.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Umphathi we-SUB District
xh.summary: Lawulwa iinkonzo ezizeNqanaba lokuQala lezeMpilo, iziseko zezeMpilo neziqulatho zokusebenza kumazana amaninzi ahlukeneyo e-North West Province.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma / I-Bachelor's Degree kwiZeNzululwazi ezeMpilo. Amava eminyaka emihlanu (5) yolawulo apho eminyaka mithathu kufuneka ibe ngumPhathi oNcedisayo weZemempilo osebenza nento kwi-Nkonzo yezeMpilo ezeNqanaba lokuQala (PHC). Isatifikethi sokuvavanya ukuNxibelelaniswa, ukuQwalasela ukuGula nokuNyanga siya kuba lusizo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi nge-Mgaqo-siseko, uMthetho woNkonzo kaWongo ka-1994 njengoko ulungisiwe, iZimiso zokuLungisa uNkonzo kaWongo ka-2023 namagazethi/oMthetho alawula izeMpilo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNkonzo yezeMpilo ezeNqanaba lokuQala nezeNkonzo zoLuntu. Ukuphuhliswa kweNkqubo yezeMpilo zeZithili (DHS) neNkqubo yoLwazi lwezeMpilo zeZithili (DHIS) nolwazi lokusebenza ngenkqubo yoLwazi lweNdwelilo (GIS). BaKhethiweyo abaya kufuna ukungenisa iVume yokusebenza esemthethweni abaNgabi ngabemi baseMzantsi Afrika. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwesinyi nolubhalwayo), ukuxazula iingxaki, ukuphuhliswa kwezixhobo-mthetho zolawulo, ukwahlulahlula, ulungisaniso lomsebenzi, ezemali, ukuLungiselela, ukuQamba. Ukuba lwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Lawula iziqulatho ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza ngokubhekisa kuminxaxheba ebalulekileyo yezeMpilo, amagosa oLuntu, iLawulo leMali nokuLawulwa kweNkqubo yokunikezela. UkuLawulwa ngokupheleleyo kweSiseko sezeMpilo nezeNkonzo i-PHC kwinqanaba leSithili. Lawula ukunikwa kwenkonzo ezeMpilo ehlangene nendla. Nikezela ngolawulo kuBaphathi beSithili. Lawula imali ekuNikwayo ngemigaqo neNkqubo yokuxhasa imixholo yamaphulo ezeMpilo. Qwalasela abaPhathi abaNcedisayo abaphethe ulawulo olunjalo, inkonzo yeseMpilo yoluntu nokuLawulwa kweNkonzo yeseMpilo yendawo. Linganisela ulawulo lwezeMpilo, i-Ngo eziDibana nayo ne-CBO ezingaphakathi kwiSithili.

jobs.title: Director: District Health Services
jobs.centre: Southern/Western Sub-Structure (SWSS) (X1 Post) Klipfontein Mitchell’s Plain Sub-Structure (KMPSS) (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs).
jobs.summary: Director of District Health Services to manage and provide strategic leadership for health services within the Western Cape sub-structures.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in a Health-related field, Post Graduate Diploma/Degree in Public Health, or Management as recognized by SAQA with at least 5 years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Services is a requirement (Candidates not in possession of this entry requirement can still apply but are requested to register for the course and complete it as no appointment can be made in the absence thereof. The course is available at the National School of Governance (NSG) under the name “Certificate for entry into the SMS” and the full details can be sourced from the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. All costs associated herewith are the responsibility of the applicant). Experience: Appropriate experience and proven track record in all major aspects of management within a health care environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and understanding of Metro Health Services (MHS). Knowledge of financial and people resource management applicable to the Public Service. Proven experience in the provision and management of health services. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Internet and email). High level of communication skills. Advanced leadership and management skills. Advanced planning and organising skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of health services (inclusive of district hospitals, primary health care, community-based and specialised services) within the Southern/Western or Klipfontein/Mitchell’s Plain Sub-Structure, in line with the relevant Departmental policies. Provide strategic leadership and direction for health service within the respective sub-structure. Collaborate with key stake holders within the respective sub-structure within the Metro health ecosystem, including other government departments, community structures, non-profit organisations (NPOs) and local government and the private sector. Co- ordinate the rendering of professional support service (including pharmacy services) within the respective sub-structure. Ensure the quality of care is maintained and improved in the respective sub-structure in line with the National Core Standards. Manage the corporate services of the respective sub-structure. This includes Financial, Supply Chain, Human Resources, Information Management and Support Services.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Z Brickles Tel No: (021) 815-8668
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. OTHER POSTS It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Distriksgesondheidsdienste
af.summary: Direkteur van Distriksgesondheidsdienste om gesondheidsdienste binne die Western Cape substrukture te bestuur en strategiese leierskap daarvoor te verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in 'n gesondheidsverwante veld, 'n Nagraadse Diploma/Grade in Openbare Gesondheid of Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken, met ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. 'n Voor-toetingsertifikaat vir die Senior Management Services is 'n vereiste (Kandidate wat nie oor hierdie toetingsvereiste beskik nie, kan steeds aansoek doen, maar word versoek om vir die kursus te registreer en dit te voltooi aangesien geen aanstelling gemaak kan word in die afwesigheid daarvan nie. Die kursus is beskikbaar by die National School of Governance (NSG) onder die naam "Certificate for entry into the SMS" en die volledige besonderhede kan by die volgende skakel verkry word: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. Alle koste wat hiermee gepaard gaan, is die verantwoordelikheid van die aansoeker). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring en 'n bewese rekord in alle hoofaspekte van bestuur binne 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing. Innewoonde vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van Metro Health Services (MHS). Kennis van finansiële en personeelbronbestuur van toepassing op die Openbare Diens. Bewese ervaring in die verskaffing en bestuur van gesondheidsdienste. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Internet en e-pos). Hoë vlak van kommunikasievaardighede. Gevorderde leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Gevorderde beplannings- en organisingvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van gesondheidsdienste (insluitend distrikshospitale, primêre gesondheidsorg, gemeenskapsgebaseerde en gespesialiseerde dienste) binne die Southern/Western of Klipfontein/Mitchell's Plain Substruktuur, in ooreenstemming met die relevante departementbeleide. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en rigting vir gesondheidsdienste binne die onderskeie substruktuur. Werk saam met sleutelbelanghebbendes binne die onderskeie substruktuur binne die Metro-gesondheids-ekosisteem, insluitend ander regeringsdepartemente, gemeenskapsstrukture, nie-winsgewende organisasies (NPO's) en plaaslike regering en die privaatsektor. Koördineer die lewer van professionele ondersteuningsdienste (insluitend apteekdienste) binne die onderskeie substruktuur. Verseker dat die gehalte van sorg gehandhaaf en verbeter word in die onderskeie substruktuur in ooreenstemming met die National Core Standards. Bestuur die korporatiewe dienste van die onderskeie substruktuur. Dit sluit Finansiële, Supply Chain, Menslike Hulpbronne, Inligtingsbestuur en Ondersteuningsdienste in.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Izinsizakalo Zezempilo Ezingxenyeni
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wezinsizakalo Zezempilo Ezingxenyeni ukuphatha futhi anikeze ubuholi bokuhlela izinsizakalo ezempilo ngaphakathi kwezinhlobo ezincane ze-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwemfundo esiphezulu: Isidingo sehle lokufunda eNQF level 7 endaweni ehlotshaniswe nezempilo, i-Post Graduate Diploma/Degree kuPublic Health, noma eNdaweni yoMlawulo njengoba kuhlonishwe yi-SAQA okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yohlu lwaphezulu waba ngumphathi wesigaba somphakathi nesesiphezulu. Isitifikedi sokungena phambi kokuba ngumsebenzi kwe-Senior Management Service siyisidingo (Abafaki bezicelo abanayo lesi sidingo bangasakwazi ukufaka isicelo kodwa bayacelwa ukuthi babhalise kule khosi bayiqede ngoba akukho muntu ongathunyelwa esikhundleni angakaligqoki. Le kholi iyatholakala e-National School of Governance (NSG) ngaphansi kwegama elithi "Certificate for entry into the SMS" futhi imininingwane ephelele ingatholakala kule link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Zonke izindleko eziqhathaniswa nalezi zinzuzo ziyibhekiwe ngumfaki wesicelo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele kanye nomkhondo ohlolwayo kuwo wonke amagatsha aphezulu omphathi endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Isidingo esibekelwe umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nokuthanda ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi nokuqonda izinsizakalo ezinkulu ezempilo (MHS). Ulwazi lokuphatha izimali nokuqasha abantu okusetshenziswa kumnyango. Isipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe ekunikeni nasekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo ezempilo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, i-Internet nama-email). Izinga eliphezulu lekhono lokuxhumana. Ikhono eliphezulu lebuholi nokuphatha. Ikhono eliphezulu lokuhlela nokuhlela izinto.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuqalwa kwezinsizakalo ezempilo (okuhlanganisa izibhedlela ezincane, izinsizakalo zokuqala ezingeni lezempilo, izinsizakalo zomphakathi nezinsizakalo ezikhethekile) ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esincane sase-Southern/Western noma sase-Klipfontein/Mitchell's Plain, ngokuvumelana nemigomo ethize kumnyango. Nikeza ubuholi bokuhlela kanye nesinqondisi sezinsizakalo ezempilo ngaphakathi kulesi sakhiwo esincane. Sebenzisana nababanzi abahlomula kuleyo sakhiwo esincane ngaphakathi kwendawo enkulu yezinsizakalo ezinkulu ezempilo, okuhlanganisa namanye amanyango kahulumeni, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano ezingezona ezenzuzwana (NPOs) kahulumeni wendawo kanye nesigaba sangasese. Linganisela ukunikwa kwezinsizakalo zokusekela nabasebenzi bemisebenzi (okuhlanganisa nezinsizakalo zogqitha) kule sakhiwo esincane. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikhono eliphezulu lokunakekelwa ligcinwa futhi ithuthuke kwesakhiwo esincane ngokuvumelana Nemigomo ePhakeme e-Yizwe. Phatha izinsizakalo zeshanguzi ze-sakhiwo esincane. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izimali, ukuhweba kwezinsizakalo, abasebenzi, ukuphatha ulwazi kanye nezinsizakalo zokusekela.

xh.title: Umongameli: Iinkonzo zezeMpilo zoMmandla
xh.summary: Umongameli wezeNkonzo zezeMpilo zoMmandla ukulawula nokuqhuba inkokeliyo eyintsika yeenkonzo zeempilo ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo ezincinci zeWestern Cape.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifunekayo zinisindwa: Isidanga esisezantsi (NQF level 7) kwilahleko ezinxulumene nezeMpilo, iPost Graduate Diploma/Degree kuZamazinga oLuntu, okanye uLawulo njengoko eqatshelwa yiSAQA ngenye yeminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo. Isatifikethi sokuqalisa iinkonzo zoLawulo eziPhakamileyo sifuneka (Abagqatswayo abanalo oku kufuneka basenokufaka isicelo kodwa bacedelwe ukuba bayibhalele kwaye bagqibe le nkqubo njengoko akukho nantoni na inqanawa elungiselelwa ukuba yenziwe ngaphandle kwako. Le nkqubo iyafumaneka kwiNational School of Governance (NSG) ngegama elithi "Certificate for entry into the SMS" naye wonke amanani angafumaniswa kulengthi elandelayo: https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre- entry-programme/. Zonke iindleko ezinxulumene nalo ziyabeka kwisicelo). Amava: Amava afanelekileyo nerekhodi eqinisekisiweyo kuyo yonke iindawo eziphambili zolawulo ngaphakathi kwendawo yokunakekela impilo. Ifuno engaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo nolungele ukuhamba. Iakhono (ulwazi/akhono): Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkonzo zezeMpilo zeMetro (MHS). Ulwazi lolawulo lweemali namathuba abantu olusebenzayo kuLawulo loLuntu. Amava aqinisekisiweyo ekuboneleleni nolawulweni lweenkonzo zeempilo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomputa (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Internet and email). Inqanaba eliphezulu lezakhono zoxhumo. Aakhono aphambili bokuba nekhuselo nolawulo. Aakhono aphambili bokucwangcisa nokuqamba.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphunyezwa kweenkonzo zeempilo (kuquka iibhedlele zommandla, unakekelo lwempilo yokuqala, iinkonzo ezisekelwe kummandla nezeenkqubo ezizodwa) ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esincinci saseSouthern/Western okanye saseKlipfontein/Mitchell's Plain, ngokuvumelana neenqobo malunga neesebe. Bonelela ngokuba yinkokeli eyintsika yamacebo kwaye uzalise inkqubo yeenkonzo zeempilo ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esincinci esihambelanayo. Sebenzisana neqela labathathi nxaxheba abasemva phakathi kwesakhiwo esincinci ngaphakathi kwendalo yeempilo zeMetro, kuquka nanye iisebe zorhulumente, izakhiwo zommandla, iinkonzo ezingenangenziso (NPOs) norhulumente wendawo n candungu yimarike. Lawula ngokubonelela ngenkonzo yexhaso eyilwe ngamava (kuquka iinkonzo zamayeza) ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esincinci esihambelanayo. Qinisekisa ukuba umgangatho wonakekelo ulondolozwe waphuculwa kwisakhiwo esincinci esihambelanayo ngokuvumelana namagama azeNgangingoqondisa oLuntu. Lawula iinkonzo zeshishini lesakhiwo esincinci esihambelanayo. Oku kuquka iimali, uLawulo lwesixhasimveliso, amathuba abantu, uLawulo lolwazi neenkonzo zoxhaso.

jobs.title: Senior Registrar (MEDICAL) (CLINICAL Haematology)
jobs.salary_text: R1 395 528 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Senior Registrar (MEDICAL) (CLINICAL Haematology) at Department of Health and Wellness in Parow Valley.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine or Hematopathology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine or Hematopathology (Independent Practice). Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Commuted overtime is compulsory. Willingness to work after hours. The position will be full- time (40 hours per week). Registration with Stellenbosch University as a postgraduate student (MPhil Haematology). Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills. Able to cope in a busy clinical environment. Experience in Haematology. Previous research experience. Previous attendance of Haematology workshops or conferences.
jobs.duties: Successful completion of the Cert Clinical Haematology (Phys/Path) (SA) which includes all the logbook requirements of the College of Medicine, including a mandatory laboratory training period for physician candidates. Participate fully in clinical and academic activities of the division. Maintain accurate medical and chemotherapy records. Conduct research in Haematology that is relevant to the South African context with successful completion of the MPhil (Haematology).
jobs.enquiries: Dr F Fazel, Email: fbfazel@sun.ac.za, Tel No: (021) 938-5888/9486
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 2 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Senior Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment as a Senior Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personnel. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Senior Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Senior Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their senior registrar contract should they not be successful for advertised Medical Sub-Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Senior Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Senior Registrars will be required to register as postgraduate students with Stellenbosch University according to the yearbook and guidelines. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine or Hematopathology with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status).” It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Registra (MEDIES) (KLINIESE Haematology)
af.summary: Senior Registra (MEDIES) (KLINIESE Haematology) by Department of Health and Wellness in Parow Valley.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde of Hematopatologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde of Hematopatologie (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Gekommuteerde oortyd is verpligtend. Bereidwilligheid om buite kantoorure te werk. Die posisie sal voltyds wees (40 ure per week). Registrasie by Stellenbosch University as 'n nagraadse student (MPhil Haematology). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. In staat om in 'n besige kliniese omgewing te cope. Ervaring in Haematology. Vorige navorsingservaring. Vorige bywoning van Haematology-werkswinkels of konferensies.
af.duties: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Cert Clinical Haematology (Phys/Path) (SA) wat al die logboekvereistes van die College of Medicine insluit, insluitend 'n verpligte laboratoriumopleidingsperiode vir geneeskundige kandidate. Volle deelname aan kliniese en akademiese aktiwiteite van die afdeling. Onderhou akkurate mediese en chemoterapierekords. Voer navorsing in Haematology uit wat relevant is tot die Suid-Afrikaanse konteks met suksesvolle voltooiing van die MPhil (Haematology).

zu.title: Onogqaji Omkhulu (EZEZOKWELAPHA) (EZEKLINIKA i-Haematology)
zu.summary: Onogqaji Omkhulu (EZEZOKWELAPHA) (EZEKLINIKA i-Haematology) e Department of Health and Wellness e Parow Valley.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesokudla: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengongwelaphi wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine noma i-Hematopathology. Ukubhalisa kolungele olunamandla: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengongwelaphi wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine noma i-Hematopathology (Independent Practice). Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha evumelekile (i-Code B/EB). Ukusebenza ngemahora engeyona emsebenzini okuyisinyathelo esiphoqiwe. Ukulungele ukusebenza ngemahora adlule. Isikhundla sizoba isikhathi esigcwele (amahora angu-40 ngesonto). Ukubhalisa e Stellenbosch University njengomfundi wesiqu samabanga aphezulu (i-MPhil Haematology). Izindlela zokusebenza (ulwazi/iziqhawekazi): Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Ukukwazi ukumelana nomoya ongaphakathi kwesikhungo esigcwele iziguli. Uqeqesho kwi-Haematology. Uqeqesho oluqedile lokucwaninga. Ukuthobela phambilini izinkomfa noma amakilasi e-Haematology.
zu.duties: Ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-Cert Clinical Haematology (Phys/Path) (SA) okuhlanganisa yonke imithetho yalebhu yokugcina amarekhodi e-College of Medicine, okuhlanganisa nesikhathi esiphoqiwe soqeqesho lwebhu labafundi abayizifo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuphelele kumsebenzi wezokwelapha nokuqeqeshwa wesigaba. Ukugcina amarekhodi aphelele ezokwelapha namakhemiotheraphi. Ukwenza ucwaningo kwi-Haematology oluhambisana nomumo waseNingizimu Afrika ukuqedela ngempumelelo i-MPhil (Haematology).

xh.title: Umceleli womlinganiselo ophezulu (EZOBUMINI) (I-CLINICAL Haematology)
xh.summary: Umceleli womlinganiselo ophezulu (EZOBUMINI) (I-CLINICAL Haematology) kwisebe lezeMpilo neMpilo eParow Valley.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kolulinganiselweyo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongchwepheshe WezobuGqirha kwi-Internal Medicine okanye i-Hematopathology. Ukubhalisa koluntu lwebhunga: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongchwepheshe WezobuGqirha kwi-Internal Medicine okanye i-Hematopathology (Ukuzilolonga ngokuzimela). Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense elisezantsi (Code B/EB) elisebenzayo. I-overtime ephethwe ngokutshatshalaliswa yinyanzeliso. Koluleko lokusebenza emva kweyure. Esi sithuba siza kuba ngosuku lonke (40 hours per week). Ukubhalisa kwi-Stellenbosch University njengomfundi wezomgangatho ophezulu (MPhil Haematology). Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono wokunxibelelana oluhle. Ukwazi ukumelana nendawo esebenzayo edolophu. Ulwazi kwi-Haematology. Ulwazi lokwenza ucando olwangaphambili. Ukuhlasela izindaba ze-Haematology okanye iinkqubo zokuxoxwa ngokwamazwi olwangaphambili.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela ngempumelelo i-Cert Clinical Haematology (Phys/Path) (SA) equka zonke iimfuno zalebulo yecandelo lezeZoBuchwepheshe, kuquka nephakamiso labala lokuzilolonga elinyanzelekileyo kumagqabi abaGqirha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo kumasebenzi ezobugqirha nezemfundo yecandelo. Ukugcina iirekhodi ezobugqirha netshemo ezicace gca. Ukuqhuba ucando kwi-Haematology oluhambelana nendawo yoMzantsi Afrika ngokuqwalasela okuphumeleleyo kwe-MPhil (Haematology).

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (TRAUMA/ Acute
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical specialist in neurosurgery needed at Tygerberg Hospital to provide trauma and acute care across emergency, inpatient and operative settings.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery. Experience: Grade 1: No experience required after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign professional council in the case of a foreign-qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign professional council in the case of a foreign-qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver's license. Commuted overtime is compulsory and participation in the after-hours neurosurgical call system is required. Ability to provide emergency specialist neurosurgical care in a high-acuity, high-volume tertiary trauma environment. Ability to work across inpatient, theatre, critical care, emergency and consultative service areas, and to support referral pathways within the Tygerberg Hospital ecosystem when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Advanced clinical, peri-operative and operative competency in Neurosurgery, with particular competence in traumatic brain injury, spinal trauma and other acute neurosurgical emergencies. Sound specialist judgement, prioritisation and decision-making in time-critical neurological emergencies, including appropriate escalation and resource stewardship. Ability to function effectively in a complex, resource- constrained public health system and within multidisciplinary trauma, critical care and surgical teams. Effective leadership, communication and interpersonal skills, including supervision and training of junior medical staff and students. Computer literacy and the ability to use clinical data, audit, morbidity and mortality review and outcomes tracking to support service improvement. Insight into clinical governance, patient safety, equity, transformation and the challenges of local healthcare delivery. Research, audit, publication or formal quality-improvement experience.
jobs.duties: Provide safe, timely and evidence-informed specialist neurosurgical care for emergency, trauma, inpatient, outpatient and operative patients. Participate actively in the neurosurgical emergency and after-hours service, including assessment, prioritisation and definitive management of acute referrals. Provide specialist care for traumatic brain injury, spinal trauma and other acute cranial and spinal neurosurgical conditions, including peri-operative and critical care decision-making. Contribute to efficient theatre utilisation, patient flow, referral management and multidisciplinary trauma and critical care pathways. Supervise, mentor and train registrars, medical officers, interns, students and other healthcare professionals, and participate in undergraduate and postgraduate academic programmes. Participate in clinical governance, morbidity and mortality review, audit, quality improvement, protocol development and patient-safety activities. Contribute to research, data collection and data-driven service redesign aimed at improving access, quality, safety and outcomes across the neurosurgical and trauma ecosystem. Undertake relevant administrative, medico-legal and departmental responsibilities as delegated by the Head of Neurosurgery and institutional management.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (TRAUMA/ Akute
af.summary: Mediese spesialis in neurochirurguur word benodig by Tygerberg Hospital om trauma- en akutsorg oor noodgevalle, inpasiente en operatiewe omgewings te bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen ervaring word vereis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse professionele raad in die geval van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse professionele raad in die geval van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Pendeloortyd is verpligtend en deelname aan die buite-ure neurochirurgiese oproepstelsel word vereis. Vermoë om noodgeval spesialistiese neurochirurgiese sorg in 'n hoë-akute, hoë-volume tersiêre trauma-omgewing te bied. Vermoë om oor inpasient-, teater-, kritiekesorg-, noodgeval- en konsultatiewe diensareas te werk, en verwysingsroetes binne die Tygerberg Hospital-ekosisteel te ondersteun wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Gevorderde kliniese, peri-operatiewe en operatiewe bevoegdheid in Neurochirurgie, met spesifieke bevoegdheid in traumatiese breinbesering, spinale trauma en ander akute neurochirurgiese noodgevalle. Deklike spesialiste-oordeel, prioritisering en besluitneming in tydkritieke neurologiese noodgevalle, insluitend toepaslike eskalasie en hulpbronbestuur. Vermoë om doeltreffend te funksioneer in 'n komplekse, hulpbronbeperkte openbare gesondheidstelsel en binne multidissiplinêre trauma-, kritiekesorg- en chirurgiese spanne. Effektiewe leierskap, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, insluitend toesig en opleiding van junior mediese personeel en studente. Rekenaarvaardigheid en die vermoë om kliniese data, oudit, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsverslag en uitkomste-opvolging te gebruik om diensverbetering te ondersteun. Insig in kliniese bestuur, pasientveiligheid, gelykheid, transformasie en die uitdagings van plaaslike gesondheidsorgverskaffing. Ondersoek, oudit, publikasie of formele gehalteverbeteringservaring.
af.duties: Verskaf veilige, tydige en bewysgebaseerde spesialistiese neurochirurgiese sorg vir noodgeval-, trauma-, inpasient-, buitepasient- en operatiewe pasiente. Neem aktief deel aan die neurochirurgiese noodgeval- en buite-ure diens, insluitend assessering, prioritisering en definitiewe bestuur van akute verwysings. Verskaf spesialiste-sorg vir traumatiese breinbesering, spinale trauma en ander akute kraniële en spinale neurochirurgiese toestande, insluitend peri-operatiewe en kritiekesorg-besluitneming. Dra by tot doeltreffende teaterbenutting, pasientvloei, verwysingsbestuur en multidissiplinêre trauma- en kritiekesorg-roetes. Hou toesig oor, mentoreer en train registrateurs, mediese beamptes, interniste, studente en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionals, en neem deel aan voor- en nagraadse akademiese programme. Neem deel aan kliniese bestuur, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsverslag, oudit, gehalteverbetering, protokolontwikkeling en pasientveiligheidsaktiwiteite. Dra by tot navorsing, data-insameling en data-gedrewe diensherontwerp wat gemik is op die verbetering van toegang, gehalte, veiligheid en uitkomste oor die neurochirurgiese en trauma-ekosisteel. Onderneem toepaslike administratiewe, medies-regtelike en departementele verantwoordelikhede soos gedelegeer deur die Hoof van Neurochirurgie en instellingsbestuur.

zu.title: Izakhiwo Zezokwelapha Zizinga 1 kuye ku-3 (TRAUMA/ Acute
zu.summary: Kudingeka izakhiwo sezokwelapha ezingxenyeni yokuqala ubuchopho (neurosurgery) esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital ukuze kunikezwe ukunakekelwa kwezomlilo nezesheshi kumango ongaphansi kwejubane lomshini, abagula abahlinzekiwe baye bayobhaliswa phantsi, nendawo yokusebenza inkqubo yokuhlinza.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesakhiwo sezokwelapha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho. Ukubhalisa kwi-phofoshinal council: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesakhiwo sezokwelapha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho. Iminyaka yomsebenzi: Izinga 1: Akukho minyaka yomsebenzi efunekayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesakhiwo sezokwelapha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho. Izinga 2: Inani elingaphansi kweminyaka eli-5 lomsebenzi ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kumagazini wesizwe esaziwayo ngaphandle esime ngokwemigaqo ye-forensic Professional Council) njengesakhiwo sezokwelapha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho. Izinga 3: Inani elingaphansi kweminyaka eli-10 lomsebenzi ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kumagazini wesizwe esaziwayo ngaphandle esime ngokwemigaqo ye-forensic Professional Council) njengesakhiwo sezokwelapha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho. Izidingo ezingaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. I-overtime ebalulekileko njengesinyathelo esibambe kwaye ukuthathwa kwabaqathi abangenayo emini ngosuku olubambe kwingxenxe yokuqala ubuchopho kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi lokunikezela isixhobo sokunakekela ngokutsha kwindawo ephakamileyo yomshini wezempilo, ebandakanya amaxhoba amaninzi njengesinyathelo esinegazi eliphezulu. Ulwazi lokusebenza kumawonke amaxesho okulawula, ukupaka abagula baye bayobhaliswa phantsi, iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zokunakekelwa, iindawo zokungena kakhulu kwinkqubo yejubane lomshini kunye nezikhululo zokuhamba phantsi, naxa kunokwenzeka ukuba kuthathwa iinkxaso ngeendlela zokuhamba phakathi kwe-ecosystem yase-Tygerberg Hospital. Iinkqubo zolwazi (ulwazi/ amandla): Ulwazi oluphezulu lwezamaphila, iziseko zokusebenza nobuchule bokuhlinza kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho, ngethuba elibalulekileyo kwindawo engozi yobuchopho, iingozi zomqolo nezinye iingozi ezingezantsi ezingaze zenzekise ukutsha kwezokuqala ubuchopho.
zu.duties: Kunika isixhobo esikho, ngexesha elifanelekileyo, kunye nolwazi oluncinci kwindawo ekuqala ubuchopho, ukunakekela kumawonke amaxeshu wezomlilo, iingozi, abagula baye bayobhaliswa phantsi, abantu abangangeni, kunye nabantu abangenwayo kwindawo yokusebenza inkqubo yokuhlinza. Kuthelekisa ngokwasebenzisanayo kwindawo yokungena ngokutsha kwingxenye yokuqala ubuchopho, kubandakanywa ukuhlola, ukubeka ngaphambili, nokuqamba iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokunakekela iingxaki ezizezelwe ngokukhawuleza. Kunika izixhobo ezingenxa yobuchule ezingenzelwa ubuchopho obuhlutshwe nguwo, iingozi zomqolo nezinye iingxaki ezenzeka kumqolo nasekunxwemeni ezingahlinzakho ngokukhawuleza, kubandakanya iziseko zokusebenza ezikumgangatho ophezulu nokuqamba iindlela zokunakekelwa. Kuye kwanikezela ngomsebenzi ophumelelayo wokusebenzisa indawo yokuhlinza, ukutshaya kwamagqabantshishi, ukulawula iingxaki ezingene ngaphakathi, nendlela efanayo yokusebenza ngokutsha kweqembu labantu abangenangxaki ezingangeniswa ngokukhawuleza. kulawula, kuyalathisa kwakhona ukuba kufundise abantu abangangenwa yiNkosi, abantu abangangenwa ngokutsha, abantu abangenwa ngemithetho, abafundi, nabanye abantu abasebenza ngokwemfuneko yamaphila, kwaye kukwabandakanya ukuthatha inxaxheba kwizixhobo zokufunda nangemfundo ezingeni eliphezulu. Kuthatha inxaxheba kwindawo yokulawula imithetho yesigqiki sabantu, ukulawula iingxaki ezinga bantu bengafi, ukuphepha ukunakekelwa, ukuphucula, ukwakhiwa kweenkqubo nezinkqubo zokuphepha umntu. Kube yinxalenye yokuphucula iinkqubo ezikwazi ukubakela abantu, ukuphepha, nokuphucula ulwazi lwabantu ngokutsha kwezempilo, ukhuseleko, iindlela zokwenza okuhle ngokutsha kokunakekelwa kwabantu abangenwa yindlela yokutsha kwindawo ebalulekileyo. ukwenza imisebenzi engemva komyalelo, iinkqubo zomthetho wesixhobo, namanyathelo abalulekileyo othunjwe nguMntu ongumlawuli wokuqala ubuchopho nomphathi wesixhobo.

xh.title: Uchwepheshe Wezonyango Isixa 1 ukuya ku-3 (IINGOZI/ Acute
xh.summary: Kufuneka uchwepheshe wezonyango we-neurosurgery eTygerberg Hospital ukunikela ngonzizo zengozi nenzozo ezikhethekileyo kwiindawo zeemergency, abasemibhedaniso nasemthethweni wokusebenza.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esisezingeni elisezantsi: Isidanga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe wezonyango we-Neurosurgery. Ukubhaliswa kwikhabhonthi yomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezonyango we-Neurosurgery. Amava: Isixa 1: Akukho naliphi ilifa lamava elidingwa emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezonyango we-Neurosurgery. Isixa 2: Ubuncinane iminyaka emi-5 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ikhabhonthi yomsebenzi yangaphandle eqapheliweyo kwindoda okanye umfazi oqeqeshiwe elwandle) njengochwepheshe wezonyango we-Neurosurgery. Isixa 3: Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ikhabhonthi yomsebenzi yangaphandle eqapheliweyo kwindoda okanye umfazi oqeqeshiwe elwandle) njengochwepheshe wezonyango we-Neurosurgery. Iimfuno ezizalo zenkqubo yomsebenzi: Iilayisensi zokweshesha ezisebenzayo. I-overtime eqhelekileko iyachajiwe kwaye kukho printable ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yophendlo we-neurosurgery emva kweeyure zomsebenzi. Amandla okunikela ngokunciphisa ingozi ezikhethekileyo zezonyango ze-neurosurgery kwimeko ese nzima kakhulu, ingxolo eninzi yasebhedlele letrauma. Amandla okusebenza kwindawo zabasemibhedaniso, kwitheatre, kwizinto eziyingozi kakhulu, zeemergency nezenkonzo zoBulumko, nokuxhasa iindlela zokuthumela abagula kwisimo seTygerberg Hospital xa kufuneka. Iimpawu zokwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukwazi okuphakamileyo, okusemthethweni kwaye okusemthethweni kwe-Neurosurgery, ngakumbi ekubonakaliseni amava aphakamileyo e-engcisweni yobuchophu, ukulimala kwegazi kwezilumkisiweyo nolunye ulwazi olumande lwe-neurosurgery. Ukuqonda okusemthethweni, ukubaluleka kokugqiba kwamanye amanqanaba nokwenza izigqibo kwimeko ezinzima zeengxaki zezitho ezithile, kuquka ukwaziswa ngcono nokusetyenziswa kwezinto ezilinganayo. Amandla okusebenza ngokusebenza kwenkqubo eluncedo elinganiselweyo loluntu lokunikela ngonyango, nakwiindawo ezinxulumene neengozi, ukunakekelwa okungcangcazelayo neqela labantu abasebenza ngokuhlanganisweyo. Amakhono okukhokela, okunceda nokwenza ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu, kuquka ukulawula nokufundisa abasebenzi bezonyango abasesantsini nabaFundi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha namandla okusebenzisa ulwazi ngonyango, iaudit, ukuhlolwa kokugula nokufa, nokulandelela iziphumo ukuze kukhuthazwe inkqubo yenkonzo. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kokusebenza ngokwezomthetho zonyango, ukhuseleko lomguli, ulwazi loluntu, utshintsho neendibaniselwano zonyango olwalulwayo loluntu. Amava okuphanda, iaudit, ukushicilela okanye ulwazi olusemthethweni lokuphucula ubuniingi bentlalo.
xh.duties: Nikela ngoncedo olukhuselekileyo, olungakhangeli ixesha nolusekwe elwazini lolwazi ngolu chwepheshe we-neurosurgery kubaguli beemergency, bengozi, abasemibhedaniso, abangaphandle nabasebenzi ngeempawu ezikhethekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenza kwinkqubo yeemergency yezonyango ze-neurosurgery kunye noncedo lwangaphakathi kwiindawo zangaphakathi kweeyure zemisebenzi, kuquka ukuhlola, ukubaluleka nokugqiba kwameko ezinxulumene nazo. Nikela ngolonwabo lwechwepheshe kwiindawo ezinxulumene neengozi zobuchophu, ezinxulumene nokulimala kwegazi kwezilumkisiweyo nolunye ulwazi olumande lwe-neurosurgery, kuquka ukwenza izigqibo zangaphambi nangaphakathi kwendawo yokusebenza okunzima. Kunceda ukusebenza kwezikhululo zokusebenza, ukuthuthwa kwabaguli, ukuphathwa kokuthunyelwa kwabanye abantu, nokuhamba koluntu ngokunjalo kwiindawo zeengozi, ezinzima ukunakekelwa kwaye ezosulelayo. Lawula, khokela nokufundisa abantu abanjengabarejistra, abantu abayiNkundla kaZwelonke, abaFundi abangafundelanga, abantu abasebenza ngokusebenza ngezinye iindawo, nokuthatha inxaxheba kwiindawo zokufundisa abantu abangenayo nakwiiNkundla ezikwaziyo. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni kokusebenza ngokwezomthetho, ukuhlolwa kokugula nokufa, iaudit, ukuphucula ubuniingi bentlalo, ukwakhiwa kolwazi nokukhuseleka lomguli. Nikela ngolonwabo lolwazi, ukuqokelela ulwazi lokusebenza ngokweenkcukacha nokuqwalasela ulwazi lokusebenza ukulungiselela ukufikelela, ubuniingi bentlalo, ukhuseleko neziphumo kwinkqubo yezonyango ze-neurosurgery kunye neengozi. Yiba nabomnye wabaNtsatu kwiindawo zokulawula, ezinye iindawo ezilawulwayo kwinkqubo yaseTygerberg.

Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ekugonyweni kwezifo ezithinta amathambo. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingajwayelekile sokungenwa emva kwawonyaka wama-5 emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma i-foreign Health Professional Council evunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqashiwe kwamanye amazwe) njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ekugonyweni kwezifo ezithinta amathambo. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esingajwayelekile sokungenwa emva kwawonyaka wama-10 emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (Noma i-foreign Health Professional Council evunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqashiwe kwamanye amazwe) njengesikhulu sezokwelapha ekugonyweni kwezifo ezithinta amathambo. Amandla okusebenza (ulwazi/izikhono): Izikhono zokwelapha ezivumela ukunikezelwa kwezinsiza ezifanele kubaphathi bangesikhathi nokubaphathi basemhlabeni jikelele. Ukwazi ukugonywa kwezifo ezithinta amathambo kubantwana. Ukukwazi ukusebenza endaweni enomsindo ophakeme, enenani eliphezimu kanye nendawo enezinsiza ezingajwayelekile. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ndawonye. Ukukwazi ukudlulisela izikhono kanye nokufundisa abasebenzi abancane kanye nabafundi. Izikhono zekhompyutha ezivumela ukusebenza kwangempela emhlabeni wamabanga aphakeme/mathuluzi anjalo. Ulwazi lokusebenza nekhompyutha kanye nokuqondwa komtholampilo. Ukuyisa isibonelo, ukuthumela imilayezo, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezingangeniswa namaphoyinti amahle, abaphathi basemhlabeni kanye nokugonywa kwabantwana abanesifo sezathambo. Ukuphathwa kwendlela yokuthumela iziguli ezinodluliselo ngqo mayelana nezifo ezithinta amathambo kubantwana kanye nezinkomba zendawo yokugonywa. Ukugcina kanye nokubuka imigqaqo yabafundi. Ukwaziswa kanye nokugadwa kwemisebenzi kubasebenzi abahlukene. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emigqweni ebalulekile yocwaningo emnyakathweni. Ukuphathwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi emhlabeni ukuze kubalulekile ukulungiswa kwempahla ngaphezu kwezinye izinsiza.

Isipilo: Inqanaba lesi-1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhululi semiziGqalwa iMfama kwiNqanaba lesiThulu leNgqondo nobunyulu bokuzalwa ngokunyula kwezamahlule. Iimpawu zokwaziswa: Isethi yezakhono zokunyula kwezamahlule ezinika inqanaba eliseziko nakwindlu nakwisibhedlele. Ulwazi lokungenisa iindlela ezindala kwiziguli ezikhethwe ngokunyula kwezamahlule kwiziguli zocacileyo. Isipho sokuqhelana kwinzuzo ephakamileyo nengqwembele ephakamileyo nendlela ezingqamileyo zokuzinza. Isipho sokuqhelana nabantu. Isipho sokuqukuqela izakhono nokufundisa abantu abangagqibekanga nabafundi. Isipho sekhompyutha sokuvumela ukusebenza kwindlela ezingqamileyo / ezixhobo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nendlela yokulawula iindawo zokubhala. Isiphakamiso, ngenjongo yolwimi, nezakhono zokuqhelana.

Ukulawula indlela yokubuyela kumagqabo nokulungiselela iindlela zokungenisa iziguli ezinyuleweyo ngokunyula kwezamahlule kwiziguli zocacileyo. Ukuqhelisa abaqeqeshwa. Ukulawula ngokusebenzela kwizinto ezinkulu ezinkulu ezisezindlini ukwenzela ukuqinisekiswa kokuba izinto zinkulu zinkulu zingalungiswa ngokunyula kwezamahlule kwiziguli zocacileyo ezinyuleweyo. Ability to supervise junior team members and medical officers in acquiring appropriate skills. Ability to teach undergraduate students and other staff categories. Basic computer skills in programs on the MS platform including MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, or similar applications. Commitment to learning, research, inclusive and wholistic patient management and surgical skills. Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience since obtaining the degree of MBChB and after completion of internal rotations. Previous research experience (publication/conference presentation). jobs.enquiries: Prof S Cox Tel No: (021) 658-5012, email: Sharon.cox@uct.ac.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Please ensure that you attach an updated CV. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post- graduates with University of the Western Cape according to the yearbook and guidelines. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as a Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 5 years. (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrar ship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment of Registrar also discontinues. Applicants must indicate whether they have bursary obligations. af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES) (PEDIATRIESE Chirurgie)
af.summary: Registrateur in Pediaturiese Chirurgure by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Practikus en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Practitus toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practikus (Onafhanklike praktyk). Inheemse vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid, databasisbestuur. Vermoe om in 'n span te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterk morele en etiese rekord in chirurgiese praktyk. Die vermoe om in 'n besige tersiere sorghospitaal te werk wat spesialistiese pediaturiese chirurgiese, trauma- en brandwondsversorging en chirurgie bied. Toewyding aan leer, navorsing, inklusiewe en holistiese pasientbestuur en chirurgiese vaardighede. Toepaslike en voldoende kliniese ervaring sedert die verkryging van die MBChB-graad en na voltooiing van interne rotasies. Vorige navorsingservaring (publikasie/konferensie-aanbieding). zu.title: Umlobi (WOKWESIBAYA) (UQOBO LWEZOKUQUKA Ukuhlinza)
zu.summary: Umlobi kuhlinza lwezingane esibhedlela i-Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela kanye nelayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sesimiso semfundo: Iqualifications ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu webanga: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela (Ukwenza ngokuzimele). Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha idatha. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Irekhodi eqinileyo yokuziphatha ngokwesibindi namaphiko enkolo enkqeqyweni yokuhlinza. Ikhono lokusebenza esibhedlela esimatra sibukhulu esinikeza ukunakekelwa nokuhlinza okuthize kwabantwana, iingcilongo kanye nokuqothula, nokuhlinza. Ikhono lokuyala amalungu aseqeni elingangeni ndawo kanye namadokotela ekufundeni namakhono afanelekileyo. Ikhono lokufundisa abafundi abangakafikelwa iziqu nezinye izigaba zabasebenzi. Amandla abahlalo bekhompyutha kumilezwe ohlanganisa i-MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, okanye izicelo ezifanayo. Ukuzinika kofundo, ucwaningo, ukunakekelwa komzimba ogcwele nobanzi kwabayini kanye namakhono okuhlinza. Isipili sokugula esifanelekileyo nokuanele kusukela ekutholweni isiqu se-MBChB nakugqityweni kokujikeleza ngaphakathi. Isipili sangaphambili socwaningo (ushicilelo/mboniso yomzimbomzimbo). Isipili ngemuva kokukhonza isizwe ekuhlinzeni kwezingane. Isivivinyo esiphakathi se-FCS (SA).

Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zobugcisa bomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulawulo lwegcina idatha. Ikhono lokusebenza kwithimba. Ikhono lokusebenza esibhedlele esinomsebenzi onzima esibonelela ngokuhlola ngokuchanekileyo i-PAEDIATRIC Surgery, iinkathazo ezibangele ukushaqeka kanye nokusika kwemithambo-lunga yokunakekelwa nokwenza izikhokelo. Ikhono lokukhokela amalungu ethimba elinganemvelaphi nabaqashi bezokwelapha ekufundeni amakhono afanelekileyo. Ikhono lokufundisa abafundi abangangenangxaxheba kwiyunivesithi nabanomsebenzi abanye. Amakhono emveliso ekhompyutha abhalisileyo ohlelweni lwe-MS akuquka i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS PowerPoint, okanye iinkqubo ezifanayo. jobs.title: Pharmacy Supervisor Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Pharmacy Supervisor Grade 1 position at Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre, requiring SAPC registration as a Pharmacist with at least 3 years of post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic qualification accredited with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as Pharmacist. Experience: A minimum of 3 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. To be registered as Responsible Pharmacist with the SAPC when appointed. Prepared to be registered as a tutor with the SAPC. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Extensive knowledge of Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP). Appropriate knowledge of National and Provincial Health Policies and Pharmaceutical acts and laws. Supervision, management &, leadership skills. Communication and conflict handling skills. Experience or knowledge of Medsas. Experience or knowledge of JAC. Computer literacy Proof of Continuous Professional Development. Appropriate ability to tutor Pharmacist’s Assistants and/or Intern Pharmacists. Extensive Knowledge on CDU, Differential model of care, COPC and Principals.

Ensure adherence to minimum standards for dispensing as well as accessibility to medication and pharmaceutical care to patients. Manage, assess, and monitor compliance w.r.t Good Pharmacy Practice, Ideal Clinic and National Core Standards. Effective monitoring of pharmaceutical expenditure, implementation, and evaluation of budgetary control measures. Human Resource Management which includes tutoring of Pharmacist Assistants as well as development of pharmacy staff. Maintain and improve the quality of patient care as a member of the multi-disciplinary team within the primary health setting.

af.summary: Apteekopsigter Graad 1 pos by Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre, wat SAPC-registrasie as 'n Apteker met ten minste 3 jaar se na-registrasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Apteker moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as Apteker. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie as 'n Apteker by die SAPC. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Om as Verantwoordelike Apteker by die SAPC geregistreer te word by aanstelling. Bereid om as 'n tutor by die SAPC geregistreer te word. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitgebreide kennis van Good Pharmacy Practice (GPP). Toepaslike kennis van Nasionale en Provinsiale Gesondheidsbeleid en Farmaseutiese wette en verordeninge. Toesig, bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Kommunikasie- en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Ervaring of kennis van Medsas. Ervaring of kennis van JAC. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Bewys van Continue Professionele Ontwikkeling. Toepaslike vermoë om Aptekerassistente en/of Intern Aptekers te onderrig. Uitgebreide kennis van CDU, Differensiële sorgmodel, COPC en Beginsels.
af.duties: Neem leierskap in die apteek om 'n waardegedrewe apteekdiens te vestig en beleide en riglyne te implementeer in ooreenstemming met die Batho Pele-, SAPC- en Nasionale Dwelmbeleid en Nasionale en Provinsiale behandelingsriglyne. Verseker nakoming van minimum standaarde vir aflewering sowel as toeganklikheid tot medikasie en farmaseutiese sorg vir pasiënte. Bestuur, assesseer en monitor nakoming m.b.t. Good Pharmacy Practice, Ideal Clinic en National Core Standards. Effektiewe monitering van farmaseutiese besteding, implementering en evaluering van begrotingsbeheermaatreëls. Menslike hulpbronbestuur wat onderrig van Aptekerassistente sowel as ontwikkeling van apteekpersoneel insluit. Handhaaf en verbeter die gehalte van pasiëntesorg as 'n lid van die multidissiplinêre span binne die primêre gesondheidsopset.

zu.title: Umphathi Weshibheli Izinga 1
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi Weshibheli Izinga 1 e Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengogqithi wezamabhakisiya ongavela unyaka owengu-3 uphelele wokuhlangenwe nakho emva kokuqashwa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwaleli qophelo: Isiqu esisisiseko esamkelwe yi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC njengogqithi wezamabhakisiya. Ukubhaliswa komphakathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengogqithi wezamabhakisiya. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Isikhashana sayunyaka owengu-3 sokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile emva kokuqashwa njengogqithi wezamabhakisiya e-SAPC. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhayiya (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Kufanele abhaliswe njengoGqithi Oyedwa e-SAPC ngesikhathi eseqeshwa. Kufanele abhaliswe njengoGqithi e-SAPC. Izikhitshi (ulwazi/izikhitshi): Ulwazi olunzulu ngokuQhashwa kwamabhakisiya kahle (GPP). Ulwazi olufanelekile ngezinqumo ezimbalwa namaphoyisa ezempilo amazwe nasemaphandleni kanye nemithetho yamabhakisiya. Izikhitshi zokuqondisa, zokuphatha nezokuhola. Izikhitshi zokuxoxa nokuphatha izinkinga. Ulwazi noma okuhlangenwe nakho ngokuSebenza kwesiKhungo sezamabhakisiya (Medsas). Ulwazi noma okuhlangenwe nakho nge-JAC. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isibonakaliso sokuQhubela phambili kakhulu ngomsebenzi. Isikhundla esifanelekile sokufundisa oGqithi abancedwayo nabahola baye bathole isiqu. Ulwazi olunzulu nge-CDU, i-Differential model of care, i-COPC nemitfopho yesiFunda.
zu.duties: Thatha isikhundla sokuba ngumhola kwishibheli ukuze usungule isevisi yamabhakisiya esinikwe amagugu kanye nokusebenzisa izinqumo nemitfopho kumaphoyisa e-Batho Pele, e-SAPC nase-National Drug policy kanye nemithfopho yamaphoyisa ezwe nasephandleni. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izilinganiselo ezingaphansi kwesibopho samabhakisiya kanye nokuvunyelwa ukutholakala kwemithi kanye nonakekelo lwezamabhakisiya kubantu abagulayo. Phatha, hlolisisa futhi ulawule ukuthobela ngokuQhashwa kwamabhakisiya kahle, i-Ideal Clinic kanye nezilinganiselo eziyisiseko i-National Core Standards. Ukuphathwa kwemithi yeshibheli, ukuqashwa kanye nokuqashwa kwemali yebhajethi ngokusebenza kakhulu nangokuhlangenwe nakho. Ukuphathwa kwe-Human Resource okufaka nokufundisa oGqithi abancedwayo kanye nokuqhubela phambili abasebenzi beshibheli. Qhubeka ukugcina futhi ukuphucula ikhwalithi yonakekelo lwabaguli njengelungu leqembu elisebenza ngokuhlanganisa izinto eziningi endaweni yesiguli esihamba kakhulu phambili.

xh.title: Umphathi wePharmaci inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi wePharmaci inqanaba 1 e Mitchells Plain Community Health Centre, esifuna ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomGuliwe phasmaci ophilangawonyaka weminyaka engu-3 wamava emva kokubhalisa.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezisezantsi ezidingekayo: Isifundo esisisiseko esamkelwe ngumBongo woPharmaci waseMzantsi Afrika (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomGuliwe phasmaci. Ukubhalisa kwibhongo yabaprofeshoni: Ukubhalisa kwiBhongo yoPharmaci waseMzantsi Afrika (SAPC) njengomGuliwe phasmaci. Amanyava: Iminyaka engu-3 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomGuliwe phasmaci kwi-SAPC. Ifuno elingaphakathi lwemisebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuba kubhaliswe njengoGuliwe phasmaci oNoxabo kwi-SAPC xa ugqitywa ukumiswa. Ukuzilungiselela ukubhaliswa njengomFundisi kwi-SAPC. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nokuZinza okuBalulekileyo kwiPharmaci (GPP). Ulwazi olufanelekileyo malunga neNqamlamano yeZwezo nasephondo malunga namagunya namawulu epharmaci. Amakhono okulawula, okulawula nokuqhatha. Amakhono okuNxibelelwana nokusombulula iingxabano. Amanyava okanye ulwazi lwe-Medsas. Amanyava okanye ulwazi lwe-JAC. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Isiqinisekiso soPhuhliso oluQhubekayo oluBungcali. Ikhono elifanelekileyo lokufundisa oBambe basiPharmaci nabaGqatswa bepharmaci. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga ne-CDU, iDifferential model of care, iCOPC nabaPapashi.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni ipharmaci ukuze miselwe inkonzo yepharmaci ethobelwe ziixabiso ukuze kusebenziswe iinkqamlamano neensetluzelo ngokwamagama eBatho Pele, i-SAPC ngenkqubo yamayeza eZazwe neseensetluzelo zokwelapha eZazwe nasephondo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iimagazidi ezisezantsi zokuhanjiswa kwaye nakho ukufikelelwa kweyaza nkonzo yepharmaci kumaguli. Lawula, hlola, uze ulonde ukuthobela ngokwendlela eZinze okuBalulekileyo kwiPharmaci, iKliniki eQeqeshiweyo neMagazidi eSisiseko eZazwe. OkuBalulekileyo ukulondolozwa kokuchithwa kwamayeza epharmaci, ukusebenzisa, nokuqwalasela iinyuzelo zokulawula imali. UkuLawulwa kwabantu abaqeshwa bako oquka ukufundisa oBambe basiPharmaci nakuphuhliso lwabasebenzi bepharmaci. Hlola uze uphucule umgangatho wokunaka amaguli njengelungu leqela elinabasebenzi beemfundo ngeendlela ezininzi kwisetingi yempilo ephakathi.
