Akademiese onderrig, opleiding en navorsing.

zu.title: Umlobi wezokwelapha (PSYCHIATRY)
zu.summary: Umlobi wezokwelapha ku-psychiatry esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur Hospital, ezungeza emasibhedlela okhothiza a-UCT, edinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.requirements: Izifundo zemininingwane edingekayo: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomunyuzi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa eqokobhe lemhaka: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyuzi wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Isidingo esibulele kulesi sikhundla: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (code B/EB). Kuzofuneka umuntu oqokiweyo athathe inxaxheba kusistimu yamasihlobo okusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esikhokhelwayo. Kuzofuneka umuntu oqokiweyo enze ukwengamela izimo eziphuthumayo nangemvavamisa wokusebenza. Ukufezwa kwezifundo ze-FC Psych Part I Colleges of Medicine South Africa. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziqu): Amandla okucwaninga kokwelapha. Ulwazi neziqu ezifanele ku-Psychiatry. Amakhono ahle okuxoxa nokubhalwa kwemibhalo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi yokulawula imithetho yezokwelapha noshishino ehlobene nezinkonzo ezinikezwa endaweni okubekwe kuyo. Ukufaka isandla ekufundiseni nasekukhothizeni abafundi abangenamabanga wezobungcweti kwe-Health Sciences. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokugcwele emisebenzini yezemfundo enyuvesi ekhethiwe njengoba kudingwa ngemithetho ukuze kuzuze izifundo ze-MMed (Psych) / FC Psych. Ukunikeza izinkonzo ze-psychiatry kubantu abagulayo abalayedwa nabalangeni kumawindi okukhethiwe lapho kubekwe khona kanye nemisebenzi yezokwelapha edingiwe esifundazweni nasezingeni eliphakeme. Ukunikeza ukulawula nokhothiza abafundi abasha nabanye abasebenzi ngesikhathi sokusebenza. Okuhlangenwe nakho okufanele ekwelapheni i-psychiatry ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomunyuzi wezokwelapha. Ukufundisa, ukukhothiza nokucwaninga kolwazi.

xh.title: Registrar (PSYCHIATRY)
xh.summary: I-Registrar kwi-psychiatry eGroote Schuur Hospital, ijikeleza kwiispitale zokuqeqesha zeUCT training platform, efunayo ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA nepharma yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esingaphantsi: Ifundo elufaneleyo elicelisa ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomPraktisa wezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kwikomiti yobuchwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengomPraktisa wezempilo (Indlela yokuzilolonga ezigqithisileyo). Isimfuno esingaphakathi kwesithuba: Iphrema yokushayela (code B/EB) esebenzayo. Kuya kulindeleke kumkhethiweyo ukuba athathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yolahleko lokusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha ehlawulwayo. Kuya kulindeleke kumkhethiweyo ukuba anikeze inkxaso yabasebenzi phakathi kweyure ezingaqhelekanga nasezithubeni sezihloko. Ifundo eligqityiweyo leFC Psych Part I Colleges of Medicine South Africa. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokuphanda kwamaziko ezempilo. Ulwazi namakhono afanelekileyo kwiPsychiatry. Amakhono alungileyo othungelwano lolwazi nolawulo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Imisebenzi yolawulo lenkqubo yempilo nakwinkampani njengoko iphathelene nesebenzo ekinikezwe kule nyanga. Ukuxhasa ukufundisa nokuqeqesha abafundi abangafundi ngaphantsi kwezempilo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo kwimisebenzi yezemfundo yeyunivesithi ezelwe njengoko kulindelekile ngokomthetho ukuze kufikelelwe kwifomula yemfundo yeMMed (Psych) / FC Psych. Ukunikezela ngenkonzo yezengqondo kubafundi bengaphakathi nangaphandle kumawele alawe ekuqhelweyo nendawo abekiweyo kuyo nakwimisebenzi yezobuchwepheshe ebalulekileyo ebekelwe kwisebe. Ukunika inkathazo nokuqeqesha abasebenzi abasezantsi kunye nabanye basebenzi. Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo sezobuchwepheshe kwi-psychiatry emva kokubhaliswa njengompraktisa wezempilo. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuphanda kwemfundo yezemfundo.

jobs.title: Registrar (FAMILY Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar in Family Medicine at Hermanus Hospital providing quality primary healthcare and outreach services across the Overstrand sub-district.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (code B/EB/C1) driver’s license. Compulsory Remunerated Commuted Overtime (COT) duties. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of general medical and surgical conditions at district hospital and Primary Health Care level and knowledge. Comprehensive evidence-informed, direct patient-centered approaches to care. Clinical service provision in district level health care services. Computer literacy (MS Excel, Word, Outlook etc.) and good interpersonal, organisational and teamwork skills. Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. -Recent experience with performing district level procedures including performance of caesarian sections, administration of spinal and general anaesthesia, management of chronic conditions and HIV/TB care, maternal and child health as well as emergency medical care including adult and neonatal resuscitations. Ability to guide health care colleagues in managing difficult district-level cases.
jobs.duties: Provide quality health care to patients in the Overstrand sub-district including Hermanus Hospital and surrounding clinics, healthcare facilities and communities as part of community oriented primary care. Provide Outreach and Support service to PHC facilities and communities in the Overstrand sub- district. Actively participate in skills transfer, training, teaching and academic opportunities relevant to the post. Active involvement in the clinical governance of Overstrand sub-district facilities as required. -Performing administrative duties. Supporting the Sub-district management team, while maintaining professional ethical standards. Research and Professional Development (incl. completion of MMED).
jobs.enquiries: Dr Z Leff Tel No: (028) 312-1166
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency assessment as part of the interview process. Appointment as Registrar will be on contract and will be for a maximum contract period of 5 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship, should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. -Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with the University of Stellenbosch or the University of Cape Town according to the yearbook and guidelines.” - Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason, the appointment as a Registrar also discontinues. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may apply on condition that proof of application and payment of prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the interview date. This concession applies only to first-time registrations or change in registration status. -It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Registrar (FAMILY Medicine)
af.summary: Registrar in Family Medicine by Hermanus Hospital wat gehalte primêre gesondheidsorg en uitreikdienste regoor die Overstrand sub-distrik verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (kode B/EB/C1) bestuurslisensie. Verpligte Remunerated Commuted Overtime (COT) pligte. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van algemene mediese en chirurgiese toestande op distrikshospitaal- en Primêre Gesondheidsorgvlak en kennis. Omvattende getuigde-geïnformeerde, direkte pasiënt-gesentreerde benaderings tot sorg. Kliniese diensverskaffing in distriksvlak gesondheidsorgdienste. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Excel, Word, Outlook ens.) en goeie interpersoonlike, organisatoriese en spanwerkvaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend binne 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Onlangse ervaring met die uitvoer van distriksvlakprosedures insluitend die uitvoer van keisersnee, toediening van spinale en algemene narkose, bestuur van chroniese toestande en HIV/TB-sorg, moeder- en kindergesondheid asook nood mediese sorg insluitend volwasse en neonatale resussitasies. Vermoë om gesondheidsorgkollegas te lei in die bestuur van moeilike distriksvlakgevalle.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte gesondheidsorg aan pasiënte in die Overstrand sub-distrik insluitend Hermanus Hospital en omliggende klinieke, gesondheidsorgfasiliteite en gemeenskappe as deel van gemeenskapsgeoriënteerde primêre sorg. Verskaf Uitreik- en Ondersteuningsdienste aan PHC-fasiliteite en gemeenskappe in die Overstrand sub-distrik. Neem aktief deel aan vaardigheidsoordrag, opleiding, onderrig en akademiese geleenthede relevant tot die pos. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by die kliniese bestuur van Overstrand sub-distrikfasiliteite soos vereis. -Uitvoer van administratiewe pligte. Ondersteun die sub-distrikbestuurspan terwyl professionele etiese standaarde gehandhaaf word. Navorsing en Professionele Ontwikkeling (insl. voltooiing van MMED).

zu.title: Umbhalisi (FAMILY Medicine)
zu.summary: Umbhalisi kwi-Family Medicine e-Hermanus Hospital ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwempilo okusezingeni eliphezulu kanye nensekelo yabezimo ezibalulekile kulo lonke i-Overstrand sub-district.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingavunyelwe ukuba ngaphansi kwalezi: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqaji wezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kubhalwe lomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengogqaji wezempilo (Independent Practice). Isidingo esibalulekile somsebenzi: Ilayisense lokushayela (code B/EB/C1) elsebenzayo. Imisebenzi ye-Compulsory Remunerated Commuted Overtime (COT). Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi oluhle ngemimo yezifo zezokwelapha kanye nezeziwundo ezingeni lesikhungo sezokwelapha kanye nelinga lokunakekelwa kwempilo lokuqala. Izindlela ezibanzi ezinolwazi lokufakazela ukuthi ziqondene naye owogwayo. Ukunikeza inkonzo yezokwelapha ezinsizeni zokunakekelwa kwempilo ezingeni lesikhungo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Excel, Word, Outlook okunye) kanye namakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, ukuhlela kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo eqenjini elihlanganene izinkalo ezahlukene. -Isipiliwu esisanda sokwenza izinkalo ezingeni lesikhungo okuhlanganisa ukwenza i-caesarian sections, ukuphatha i-spinal kanye ne-general anaesthesia, ukuphatha izifo ezingapheli kanye n ukunakekelwa kwe-HIV/TB, impilo yabomama kanye neyabantwana kanye nenkonzo yezokwelapha ebalulekile okuhlanganisa nokuvusa kabusha abadala kanye nezesi sabantwana. Ikhono lokuhola oshokunakekelwa kwempilo ekuphatweni kwezimo ezinzima ezingeni lesikhungo.
zu.duties: Nika inani lokunakekelwa kwempilo ogwayweni e-Overstrand sub-district okuhlanganisa i-Hermanus Hospital namaklinikhi aseduze, izikhungo zokunakekelwa kwempilo kanye nemiphakathi njengengxenye yokunakekelwa kwempilo okuqaliswe emphakathini. Nikeza inkonzo yokwelula kanye noku nikela ngenkxaso kwizikhungo ze-PHC kanye nemiphakathi e-Overstrand sub-district. Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo ekudlulisweni amakhono, ekuqeqesheni, ekufundiseni kanye namathuba wezemfundo ahlobene nalesikhundla. Ukubandakanyeka ngokusebenzayo ekulawulweni okusemthethweni kwezokwelapha kwezikhungo ze-Overstrand sub-district njengoba kudingeka. -Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa. Ukukwesekela iqembu lolawulo le-Sub-district, ngenkathi zigcinwa izidingo zomondeko zomuntu (okuhlanganisa nokuphela kwe-MMED).

xh.title: Umregistrara (FAMILY Medicine)
xh.summary: Umregistrara kwiFamili Medicine eHermanus Hospital ebonelela ngkunyathiswa kolunxubo lwempilo olulingenelo nolungcono kunye neenkonzo zokufikelela kwindawo yaseOverstrand sub-district.
xh.requirements: Isidingo sokugqiba izifundo esingasenanzo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezempilo. Ukubhalisa kwikhorum yabasebenzi bempilo: Ukubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengogqirha wezempilo (Independent Practice). Isidingo esibalulekileyo somsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqamba (code B/EB/C1) esebenzayo. Iinkonzo zeCompulsory Remunerated Commuted Overtime (COT). Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olulungileyo malunga nemizekelo yezempilo nakwisibhedlele esijolise kwiisithili ezingoonomathotholo kunye nolunxubo lwePrimary Health Care. Iindlela ezinamacebo athembekileyo, ezijolise kwakhona kumntu ofunyanwa kukunyanga. Bonelela iinkonzo zonyango kwiinkonzo zeempilo zesithili. Ukuba nokwazi nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Excel, Word, Outlook etc.) kunye namakhono amabalini okusebenza nabantu, okuhlelwayo nakwindawo yokusebenza njengorhanwe. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle kurhanwe olunamabanga amaninzi. -Soloko unamava akutsha ngenkwenza iinkqubo zamacandelo amabakweiisithili kuquka nokuwenza amava okusika abafazi ukuzala, ukunikela i-anesthesia yomongo nakwjikelele, ulawulo lweemeko ezihlala zingapheli nokuqonda ngokwelashwa kweHIV/TB, impilo yomama kunye nencwadi nakunye nonganyelwe olubuthathaka nolufuna ukunyathelwa ngokukhawuleza kuquka nokuvusa abadala kunye neentsana ebeswelekile. Ikhono lokuyalela abasebenza beempilo ekulawuleni iimeko ezinzima ezikumazinga obukhulu bezithili.
xh.duties: Bonelela iinkonzo zempilo ezilungileyo kwabaguli kwiOverstrand sub-district kuquka iHermanus Hospital nakwiikliniki ezikujikeleze, iindawo zempilo kunye namabango njengengxenye yokunyathelwa kokunyathela kolunxubo lweempilo olujolise kuluntu. Bonelela iinkonzo zokufikelela nokuxhasa iindawo zePHC kunye namabango kwiOverstrand sub-district. Thatha inxaxheba ngokusebenzayo ekudluliseni amakhono, kwilungiselelo, ekufundiseni nakuthothothotho lwemisebenzi engowemfundo ehambelana nesithuba. Ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenzayo kulawulo lokusebenza kwamaza obuchule kwiindawo zesithili seOverstrand sub-district xa kufuneka. -Kwenza imisebenzi yolawulo. Ukuxhasa iqela elilawula iSub-district, ngelixa zigcina iindlela zobugcisa obuzelwe ngokomgaqo-nkqubo. Uphando nokuQukuqela ngamava obugcisa (kuquka nokugqiba iMMED).

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (ANAESTHETICS)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical officer in anaesthetics and critical care sought for Khayelitsha District Hospital, offering a salary between R1,041,402 and R1,375,245 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work after hours, including shifts, weekends, public holidays and call out work from home. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Diploma in Anaesthesia with appropriate experience and competency in General and Regional Anaesthesia. Sound general medical knowledge and skills. Professional working attitude and compassionate towards patients.
jobs.duties: Provide meticulous pre-, intra- and post-operative care at the standards required of a medical officer in Anaesthesiology and Critical care. Participate in normal and after hour duties in operating theatres. Teaching and training of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care to undergraduate students, interns and peers in clinical areas. Achieve Part one FCA (SA) exam and staying abreast of latest developments in the field of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care. Complete the required CPD activities to maintain registration with the HPCSA. Maintain accurate and detailed patient records of acceptable medico-legal standard. Execute administrative duties required to maintain efficient service delivery. Interest in Research and audit required.
jobs.enquiries: Dr S Ikram, email: sarwat.ikram-hameed@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Mediese Offisier Vlak 1 tot 3 (NARKOSE)
af.summary: Mediese offisier in narkose en kritiese sorg gesoek vir Khayelitsha Distrikshospitaal, met 'n salaris tussen R1,041,402 en R1,375,245 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Gesondheidsprofessieraad van Suid-Afrika (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessieraad ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessieraad ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessieraad ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om buite kantoorure te werk, insluitend skofte, naweke, openbare vakansiedae en oproepwerk vanaf die huis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Diploma in Narkose met toepaslike ervaring en bevoegdheid in Algemene en Regionale Narkose. Deeglike algemene mediese kennis en vaardighede. Professionele werkhouding en simpatiek teenoor pasiënte.
af.duties: Verskaf deeglike pre-, intra- en post-operatiewe sorg volgens die standaarde wat van 'n mediese offisier in Narkose en Kritiese sorg vereis word. Neem deel aan normale en buite-ure pligte in operasiesale. Onderrig en opleiding van Narkose en Kritiese sorg aan voorgraadse studente, internes en eweknieë in kliniese areas. Behaal Deel een FCA (SA)-eksamen en bly op hoogte van die jongste ontwikkelings in die veld van Narkose en Kritieke Sorg. Voltooi die vereiste VPK-aktiwiteite om registrasie by die HPCSA te handhaaf. Handhaaf akkurate en gedetailleerde pasiëntrekords van aanvaarbare medies-regtelike standaard. Voer administratiewe pligte uit wat vereis word om doeltreffende dienslewering te handhaaf. Belangstelling in Navorsing en oudit vereis.

zu.title: Umoguli wezinga 1 kuye ku-3 (ANAESTHETICS)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umogulu kumojula wokuvaleka nokunakekelwa okubalulekile eKhayelitsha District Hospital, ohlinzeka ngeholo eliphakathi kwe-R1,041,402 ne-R1,375,245 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoguli. Ukubhalisa kubungephi bemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoguli. Isipilingo: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule eNingizimu Afrika. Isipilingo esifanele senyanga ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli kuKhansoli Yezempilo Yomuntu Ochwephishe ekuhlonzwe khona mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule kunye nezwe elingakhegemule, okungenadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Isipilingo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-5 esifanele njengoguli ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoguli mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule eNingizimu Afrika. Isipilingo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-6 esifanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli kuKhansoli Yezempilo Yomuntu Ochwephishe ekuhlonzwe khona mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule kunye nezwe elingakhegemule, okungenadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Isipilingo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 esifanele njengoguli ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoguli mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule eNingizimu Afrika. Isipilingo esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-11 esifanele ngemva kokubhalisa njengoguli kuKhansoli Yezempilo Yomuntu Ochwephishe ekuhlonzwe khona mayelana nabasebenzi abakhegemule kunye nezwe elingakhegemule, okungenadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemva kwamasheya, okuhlanganisa oshifti, amasonto emphakathi, iholide yomphakathi nokusebenza kusuka endlini uma kuthunyelwa. Amandla (ulwazi/iziqu): Isitifiketi se-Diploma in Anaesthesia esinesipilingo esifanele namandla e-General and Regional Anaesthesia. Ulwazi neziqu ezinhle zezokwelapha jikelele. Buhle bokusebenza ngobungcwathi kanye nobubele kubantu abagulayo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okucophelela okwangaphambili, okungaphakathi nangemva kweqhubo ngesithombe esidingwa umogulu osezinhlobeni zokuvaleka nokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Thatha inxaxheba kumisebenzi evamile nangemva kwamasheya kumathetha abo. Ukwefundisa nokholisa abafundi abangakakhishi iziqu, abaqeqeshi kanye nabalingane ngokuvaleka nokunakekelwa okubalulekile kolwandle lwemisebenzi yezokwelapha. Finyelela ukuhlolelwa ukuthola i-Part one FCA (SA) futhi uhlale ulandela izinto ezintsha ezinkundleni zokuvaleka nokunakekelwa okubalulekile. Qedela imisebenzi ye-CPD edingekayo ukuze ugcine ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA. Gcina amapheshana abantu agembile abenu okusemthethweni ezokwelapha. Phatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa ehlinzeka ngokulethwa kwebhalo ephumelelayo. Into ethakazelisayo ukuphenya nokuhlola iyadingeka.

xh.title: Isebe Lemedyi Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (I-ANAESTHETICS)
xh.summary: Kufunwa isebe lemedyi kumanesthetiki kunye nolonakeko olubalulekileyo e Khayelitsha District Hospital, linikezela umvuzo ophakathi kwR1,041,402 nR1,375,245 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona: Ifikeloelifaneleyo elivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo. Ukbhaliso koluntu bomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo. Isiphaluka: Inqanaba 1: Akukho kufunekayo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho eSouth Africa. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo kwiqumrhu elaziwayo lemfundo yamayeza ebusapho malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho ngaphandle, abangekadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Unga-phantsi kweminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho eSouth Africa. Unga-phantsi kweminyaka esi-6 yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo kwiqumrhu elaziwayo lemfundo yamayeza ebusapho malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho ngaphandle, abangekadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Unga-phantsi kweminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho eSouth Africa. Unga-phantsi kweminyaka elishumi elinanye yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa njengompraktisi wezamanye izifo kwiqumrhu elaziwayo lemfundo yamayeza ebusapho malunga nabasebenzi abathe gustho ngaphandle, abangekadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufunekayo eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezisingathwe kumsebenzi: Ukulungelelana ukusebenza emva kweyure zemisebenzi, kuquka iishifti, amawekend, iholideyisi zomphakathi kunye nokuza kubiza emva kweyure emakhaya. Iimpawu zokuziphatha (ulwazi/izakhono): I-Diploma kumanesthetiki enamava afanelekileyo nolwazi lokusebenza kumanesthetiki jikelele nezindinganiso. Ulwazi nezakhono ezibalulekileyo ngamayeza ajikeleleyo. Iimpopoki ezisebenzayo ngokwamanye abasebenzi kwaye uzinake ngokwempatho kubakhweleri.
xh.duties: Kuze kubonelelwe ngolonakeko olucocileyo ngaphambi, ngexesha nangemva kwenkqubo yokuqhuba izifo kumgangatho ofunekayo kwisibaba sompraktisi wezamanye izifo kumanesthetiki nolonakeko olubalulekileyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumsebenzi wemiyalezo nangemva kweyure kwindlu yokwenza iindlela zokuqhuba izifo. Ukwafundisa nokuqeqesha inqeqheba yamanesthetiki nolonakeko olubalulekileyo kumfundi abangagqityanga, abafundi abangenamsebenzi nabahlalanayo kummandla wezamanye izifo. Ukufezisa uvavanyo lwePart one FCA (SA) kwaye uhlale ulandela iinkqubela zamva nje kwikhondo lemanesthetiki nolonakeko olubalulekileyo. Ukuqwalasela imisebenzi efunekayo ye-CPD ukuze kugcinwe ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. Ukugcina irekhodi elichanekileyo nezicatshulwayo zabakhweli kumgangatho oqinisekileyo ngokomthetho wezonyango. Ukuqhuba imisebenzi yolawulo efunekayo ukuze kugcinwe ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olusebenzayo. Kufunekwe inkatha yolwazi kunye nokuqwalasela izinto ezenziwayo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (ANAESTHESIA)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer in Anaesthesia sought for Mitchells Plain District Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration, with salaries graded from R1,041,402 to R1,375,245 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. -Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Participation in commuted overtime is compulsory on a shared 24-hour roster, requiring after-hours, weekend and public holiday participation. Willingness to participate in teaching, audits, research and quality improvement projects. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Delivery of Anaesthesia and related services and care (resuscitation) in high- acuity trauma and non-trauma General Surgery patients, Anaesthesia for Orthopaedic Surgery and Obstetrics & Gynaecology and Paediatrics. Ability to cope independently in an environment where there is a disproportionate high- volume of emergency service workload, in a resource-constrained setting, where there may be delays to after-hours assistance or back-up. Ability to work and make clinical decisions independently. Good organisational and communication skills, and the ability to perform tasks cost-effectively and efficiently. Excellent individual interpersonal and coping skills, and an ability to perform well within a multi-disciplinary team context. Enthusiasm to attend training and educational courses to broaden clinical and managerial skills and knowledge.
jobs.duties: Administration of anaesthesia and related duties pre-operative assessments and resuscitation, intra-operative management and post-operative care in the recovery unit and surgical wards. Ensure fully functional operating theatre equipment, including consumable equipment stocks and capital equipment functionality. General and neuraxial anaesthesia, procedural sedation and regional nerve plexus blocks where required. Management and coordination of theatre lists in terms of efficient utilisation of operative resources. Proactive consultation with other theatre users and theatre nursing staff on a shared- utilisation surgical platform. Diligent attention to all aspects of medical record- keeping. Teaching, lecturing and clinical supervision of medical students, interns, rotating supernumerary registrars, new medical officers and nursing staff. Participation in clinical audits, surveys, gathering of theatre statistics and involvement in research projects where required.
jobs.enquiries: Dr J Roos Tel No: (021) 377-4703
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Mediese Offisier Vlak 1 tot 3 (NARKOSE)
af.summary: Mediese Offisier in Narkose gesoek vir Mitchells Plain Distrikshospitaal, vereis HPCSA-registrasie, met salarisse gegradeer van R1,041,402 tot R1,375,245 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis uit te voer nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis uit te voer nie. -Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn met 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis uit te voer nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Deelname aan omruiloortyd is verpligtend op 'n gedeelde 24-uur rooster, wat na-ure, naweek en openbare vakansiedae-deelname vereis. Bereidwilligheid om deel te neem aan onderrig, oudits, navorsing en kwaliteitsverbeteringsprojekte. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Lewering van narkose en verwante dienste en sorg (reanimasie) by hoë-akute trauma- en nie-trauma Algemene Chirurgie-pasiënte, narkose vir Ortopediese Chirurgie en Verloskunde & Ginekologie en Kindergeneeskunde. Vermoë om onafhanklik te cope in 'n omgewing waar daar 'n buite verhouding hoë-volume nooddienswerklast is, in 'n hulpbronne-beperkte omgewing, waar daar vertragings tot na-ure bystand of rugsteun kan wees. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en kliniese besluite te neem. Goeie organisatoriese en kommunikasievaardighede, en die vermoë om take koste-doeltreffend en doeltreffend uit te voer. Uitstekende individuele interpersoonlike en cope-vaardighede, en 'n vermoë om goed te presteer binne 'n multidissiplinêre spankonteks. Entoesiasme om opleidings- en opvoedkundige kursusse by te woon om kliniese en bestuursvaardighede en -kennis te verbreed.
af.duties: Administrasie van narkose en verwante pligte vooroperatiewe assesserings en reanimasie, intra-operatiewe bestuur en na-operatiewe sorg in die herstelleenheid en chirurgiese saale. Verseker ten volle funksionele teater-toerusting, insluitend verbruikbare toerusting-voorrade en kapitaaltoerusting-funksionaliteit. Algemene en neuro-aksiale narkose, prosedurale sedasie en regionale senuwee-pleksus-blokkering waar vereis. Bestuur en koördinering van teaterlyste in terme van doeltreffende benutting van operatiewe hulpbronne. Proaktiewe konsultasie met ander teatergebruikers en teater-verpleegpersoneel op 'n gedeelde-benutting chirurgiese platform. Ywerige aandag aan alle aspekte van mediese rekordhouding. Onderrig, voordragte en kliniese toesig van mediese studente, internes, roterende supernumerêre registrateurs, nuwe mediese offisiers en verpleegpersoneel. Deelname aan kliniese oudits, opnames, versameling van teaterstatistieke en betrokkenheid by navorsingsprojekte waar vereis.

zu.title: Umoguli Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (I-ANAESTHESIA)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umoguli wezokwelapha kwi-ANAESTHESIA e-Mitchells Plain District Hospital, kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, amaholo abeka kusukela ku-R1,041,402 kuya ku-R1,375,245 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kwemfundo: Ithifikheyithi elifanele elivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa khabhini yezomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqinisekiswa njengompraktisela wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka oyedwa wesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqinisekiswa njengompraktisela wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA eyaziwayo yezezempilo mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwenye izwe, abangeke bakwenze umsebenzi wasekhaya njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengompraktisela wezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-6 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqinisekiswa njengompraktisela wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA eyaziwayo yezezempilo mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwenye izwe, abangeke bakwenze umsebenzi wasekhaya njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. -Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengompraktisela wezokwelapha emva kokuqinisekiswa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokuqinisekiswa njengompraktisela wezokwelapha ku-HPCSA eyaziwayo yezezempilo mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwenye izwe, abangeke bakwenze umsebenzi wasekhaya njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibonakalayo somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) elisebenzayo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwikhonthracti yokusebenza ihora elingaphezulu kokuqashiwe kuyadingeka kwishejuli yamahora angu-24 abukhoma, kudingeka ukubamba iqhaza ngemva kwamahora okusebenza, ngekwe_sonto nangamaholide omphakathi. Ukuzithoba ukubamba iqhaza ekufundiseni, okuhlwayweni, ocwaningweni naseziprojekthini zokuthuthukisa izinga. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukunikeza i-ANAESTHESIA nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo nekunakekelwa (ukuvusa abantu ababulawe yisifo) kubaphathi be-General Surgery abasezingeni eliphezulu ntaba kanye nabo abayizonjulwane, i-ANAESTHESIA ye-Orthopaedic Surgery kanye ne-Obstetrics & Gynaecology kanye ne-Paediatrics. Ikono lokumelela nokuhlala kuqondo kwendawo lapho kunomthwalo omkhulu wemisebenzi yesimo esiphuthumayo, endaweni lapho kwanele izinsiza, lapho kungase kubambezele ukusiza noma ukwesekwa ngemva kwamahora okusebenza. Ikono lokusebenza nokwenza izinqumo zezokwelapha ngokuzimele. Amakhono ahle wokuhlela nokuxhumana, nekono lokwenza imisebenzi ngendlela egcina imali futhi esebenza kahle. Amakhono aphumelelayo omuntu siqu wokuxhumana nokumelana nobunzima, nekono lokusebenza kahle phakathi kwenqubo yeqembu elibandakanya izigaba ezahlukene. Ukuthanda ukuhamba uyofunda izifundo zokuqeqesha nemfundo ukuze kube khona ulwazi olubanzi lwamakhono ezokwelapha nakwezabaphathi.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha i-ANAESTHESIA nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo okuhlanganisa ukuhlola ngaphambi kokusebenza nokuvusa abantu ababulawe yisifo, ukuphatha ngesikhathi sokusebenza nokunakekelwa ngemva kokusebenza kwiyunithi yokuphila nakumagumbi okwelapha ngokushaya inhliziyo. Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla esebenzayo yethiyetha yasebenza ngokugcwele, okuhlanganisa izinto ezisetshenziswa ezikhishwayo nokusebenza kwempahla enkulu. I-ANAESTHESIA evamile nakuleyo yesinxibelelwana sezinzwa, ukubamba kwengqondo kwezinqubo kanye namabhulokisi ezinzwa kuleyo yendawo ethile lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuphatha nokuhlela izinhlu zethiyetha ngokwendlela yokusebenzisa ngokuphelele izinsiza zokusebenza. Ukubonisana ngokuyiqondisile nabanye abasebenzisa ithiyetha kanye nabahlengikile be-Surgical platform lapho kusetshenziswa khona ngokuhlanganyela. Ukunaka ngokuzinakekela zonke izinhlobo zokugcina amarekhodi ezokwelapha. Ukufundisa, ukukhuluma nokugcina iliso lokuhola izifundo abafundi bezokwelapha, abaqeqeshiwe, ababhalisile abajikelezayo abangu-registrar, abadokotela bezokwelapha abasha kanye nabahlengikile. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuhlwayweni kwezokwelapha, ocwaningweni, ukuqoqa izibalo zethiyetha nokubandakanyana kweziprojekthini zocwaningo lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Isebe Lemimisela Yezempilo Inqanaba 1 ukuye ku-3 (I-ANAESTHESIA)
xh.summary: Kufunwa Isebe Lemimisela Yezempilo kwi-Anaesthesia kwi-Mitchells Plain District Hospital, lifuna ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA, inomvuzo oqulunqwe ukusuka kwi-R1,041,402 ukuya kwi-R1,375,245 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isiqu esingemva kwemfundo: Isiqu esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomPraktisa wezempilo. Ukubhalisa koluntu lobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomPraktisa wezempilo. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mfuno yokuba namava emva kokubhalisa njengomPraktisa wezempilo kwi-HPCSA ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Ukuba n1 unyaka wamava ahambelana nesebe emva kokubhalisa njengomPraktisa wezempilo kuluntu lobuchwepheshe bezempilo lwamanye amazwe olumanyelweyo, ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe kumazwe ngamanye, abangekho mfuno wokwenza iNkonzo yeQela njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengomPraktisa wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomPraktisa wezempilo ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-6 yamava ahambelana nesebe emva kokubhalisa njengomPraktisa wezempilo kuluntu lobuchwepheshe bezempilo lwamanye amazwe olumanyelweyo, ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe kumazwe ngamanye, abangekho mfuno wokwenza iNkonzo yeQela njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. -Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengomPraktisa wezempilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomPraktisa wezempilo ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-11 yamava ahambelana nesebe emva kokubhalisa njengomPraktisa wezempilo kuluntu lobuchwepheshe bezempilo lwamanye amazwe olumanyelweyo, ngokumalunga nabasebenzi ababhaliswe kumazwe ngamanye, abangekho mfuno wokwenza iNkonzo yeQela njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba (i-Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Kulawulo wokusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelwe ziyayinyanzelekile kwijadwe eliye lakhonza iiyure ezingama-24 ngemigaqo, elifuna ukuthatha inxaxheba ngeyure zangaphandle, ngeempelaveki nakumihla yeholide yorhwebo. Ulungelelwaniso lokuthatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni, ekuphandweni, ekuphononongeni nakumaphulo aphucula umgangatho. Iimfuno (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuhanthiswa kwe-anaesthesia nezinkonzo ezinxulumene nayo kunye nolunyango (ukuvusa okuzalayo) kumagosa aneengxaki ezinzima e-General Surgery abangenazo naba nazo iingozi, i-anaesthesia kwi-Orthopaedic Surgery nase-Obstetrics & Gynaecology nase-Paediatrics. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimela kwindawo apho kukho isixa esikhulu sangaphakathi esingaqathaniswa somsebenzi wezithuba ezingozi, kwindawo ethanda kwiyobarha amacebo, apho kubakho mandla amancinane ekubeni nanceba ngemini ekuphela kwemini nakwiweekends nakumihla yeholide. Ikhono lokusebenza nokwenza iigqibo zezempilo ngokuzimela. Amakhono amabalulu okuqamba nokuquumba, nokuzelelwa ngamakhono okwenza imisebenzi ngokuchiphiza iindleko nangokusebenza kakuhle. Ikhono elingagqibekanga lokuziphathisa nendlela yokuphathwa kumanzi, nokuzelelwa ngokusebenza kakuhle ngaphakathi kweqela elilodwa elibumba iinkonzo ezininzi. Ukuzimisela ngokuzimela kwindawo ethanda ukuba namakhono amaninzi emfundo nokuqeqesha ukubakho ukusasaza ulwazi ngokwenza iinkonzo ezikwiye.
xh.duties: Ukuhanthiswa kwe-anaesthesia nobunye bomsebenzi ekubakeni ngeenkqubo zangaphambi kwe-operation nokuvusa okuzalayo, ulawulo olwangaphakathi kwe-operation nolunyango olubhalwe ngaphakathi kwakunye nokubhalisa okubuyela kwithuba elipheleleyo langaphakathi. Ukubakho isixhobo esisebenzayo nangaphezu koko amacebo esixhobo asezantsi, aquka izinto ezisebenzayo ezibakho kwindawo ngokubakho nokubakho. I-anaesthesia yonke nokusingatha iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iindlela zokutsha ixesha elifutshane lokuvala isazela nesiqhinga samacandelo eziqukumbu kwiziqu eziqinileyo kwaye iimfuno zenziwa ngokomthetho ongundoqo. Ukulawula nokubakho inkqubo yokubeka amaxhobo ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezisebenzayo ezahlukeneyo. Ukubakho ingqungquthela ebalulekileyo nokuzelelwa ngokusebenza nabanye abantu abasebenza kwithiyetha nabanabikazi bokufundisa ezesikolo ngendlela yokugcinwa ezona. Ukubakho ngokuzinikela kuwo onke amagatya egcinwe iirekhodi zempilo. Ukufundisa, ukunika izifundo nokuqeqesha ngokusesikweni abafundi bemizi, iintsapho ezisebenzayo, nabafundi abavela kwamanye amazwe abangabanye abasha abafundi bemizi, izikhulu zemizi, kunye nabasebenzi bemizi ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Engineer Production Grade a to C (MECHANICAL)
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 per annum Grade B: R1 030 296 per annum Grade C: R1 172 184 per annum A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Mechanical engineer needed at Western Cape Health Head Office to develop engineering norms and standards, investigate installations, and compile specifications. Requires ECSA registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate 4-year degree in Mechanical Engineering (Beng/BScEng). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineer. Experience: Grade A: At least 3 years appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the relevant qualification e.g. B Eng / BSc (Eng.). Grade B: At least 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration as a Professional Engineer. Grade C: At least 26 years appropriate/recognisable after registration as a Professional Engineer. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code BlEB) driver's license. Willingness to travel within the Western Cape, and occasionally, nationally. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Office) Experience in designing building services engineering systems (air conditioning, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, medical gas, fire reticulation, vertical transportation) for healthcare facilities. Experience in and understanding the design and construction of complex buildings (e.g. Hospitals). Proven experience with feasibility studies in terms of life cycle costing of mechanical elements, green building technologies, technical specifications and commissioning principles for both Capital and Maintenance projects. -Understand how to interpret existing and develop new Functional and Technical Norms and Standards. Knowledge of risk analysis and risk mitigation strategies. Knowledge and experience in terms of fire regulations and vertical transportation systems. Experience in the preparation of reports, submissions and presentations in English. Sound interpersonal and good verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Development, interpretation and customisation of functional and technical norms and standards Investigate proposals for innovative service delivery mechanisms and undertake feasibility studies; Compile briefing documentation and specifications; Investigate mechanical engineering installations and equipment, undertake design work and implement corrective measures, where necessary; Oversee implementation (construction) and commissioning of mechanical engineering installations; Research/literature studies to keep up with new technologies and procedures including interaction with professional Councils/Boards.
jobs.enquiries: Mr I Parker, email: Imran.Parker@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of compliance with the requirements, including the academic qualification, as prescribed by the relevant professional council for registration in the applicable professional category; proof of application for registration as a Professional Engineer with ECSA and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the council are submitted on or before the day of the interview.” Appointment is subject to compulsory (actual) registration within six (6) calendar months after appointment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Ingenieur Produksie Graad A tot C (Meganies)

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike 4-jarige graad in Meganiese Ingenieurswese (Beng/BScEng). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Ervaring: Graad A: Ten minste 3 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na die verwerwing van die tersaaklike kwalifikasie bv. B Eng / BSc (Eng.). Graad B: Ten minste 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Graad C: Ten minste 26 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Ingenieur. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Code BlEB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om binne die Western Cape te reis, en af en toe, nasionaal. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office) Ervaring in die ontwerp van geboudiens ingenieurswese stelsels (lugversorging, ventilasie, loodgieterswerk, dreinering, mediese gas, brandretikulasie, vertikale vervoer) vir gesondheidsorgfasiliteite. Ervaring in en begrip van die ontwerp en konstruksie van komplekse geboue (bv. hospitale). Bewese ervaring met haalbaarheidstudies ten opsigte van lewenssikluskostes van meganiese elemente, groengeboutegnologie, tegniese spesifikasies en ingebruikneemingsbeginsels vir beide Kapitaal- en Onderhoudsprojekte. -Begryp hoe om bestaande te interpreteer en nuwe Funksionele en Tegniese Norme en Standaarde te ontwikkel. Kennis van risiko-analise en risikobeperkingsstrategieë. Kennis en ervaring ten opsigte van brandregulasies en vertikale vervoerstelsels. Ervaring in die voorbereiding van verslae, voorleggings en aanbiedings in Engels. Sterk interpersoonlike en goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling, interpretasie en aanpassing van funksionele en tegniese norme en standaarde Ondersoek voorstelle vir innoverende diensleweringmeganismes en onderneem haalbaarheidstudies; Stel briefdokumentasie en spesifikasies op; Ondersoek meganiese ingenieurswese installasies en toerusting, onderneem ontwerwerk en implementeer regstellende maatreëls waar nodig; Hou toezig op implementering (konstruksie) en ingebruikneming van meganiese ingenieurswese installasies; Navorsing/literatuurstudies om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologie en prosedures insluitend interaksie met professionele rade/rade.

zu.title: Injiniyezokukhiqiza Izinga a kuya ku C (ESICWEPHILE)

zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi semfundo: I-degree yesikhathi esingaphezu konyaka wayedwa (4-year degree) efanele enzimeni yezokwakha esicwephile (Beng/BScEng). Ukubhaliswa kwi-khansili yezisebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengo-Injiniye osebenzayo. Isipiliyoni: Izinga A: Okungenani unyaka abangaphezu kwayedwa eziyi-3 (3 years) wokusebenza okufanele/okungashiyekiwe ngemuva kokuthola iziqu ezihambisana nalesi sikhathi (B Eng / BSc (Eng.)). Izinga B: Okungenani unyaka abangaphezu kwayedwa eziyi-14 (14 years) wokusebenza okufanele/okungashiyekiwe ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengo-Injiniye osebenzayo. Izinga C: Okungenani unyaka abangaphezu kwayedwa eziyi-26 (26 years) wokusebenza okufanele/okungashiyekiwe ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengo-Injiniye osebenzayo. Isidingo esibangelwe umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code BlEB) esevumelekile. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba ngaphakathi Western Cape, futhi ngesikhathi esithile, emazweni aphathe kakhulu. Iziqu (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office) Isipiliyoni ekwakheni amasistimu okwakha izinsizakusebenzi (ukulawula umoya, ukuxhuma, izindwangu eziswela isiphethu, ukuphuma kwamanzi, amagesi okwelapha, ukuthelelana komlilo, ukuhamba phezulu) ezindaweni ezinabantu abagulayo. Isipiliyoni ekuzameni nasekuqondeni ukuhlelwa kwemikhiqizo nezakhiwo ezididiyene (Kuyisibonelo, izibhedlela). Isipiliyoni esibonisiwe ngamaphuzu okulinganisela okuhambisana nenani leminyaka yokusebenza nokuqedisisa izinto ezenza umshini, amasu okwakha okuluhlaza, izimiso ezibalulekile nezimiso zokuqeqeshwa ezenza umsebenzi omkhulu nasekuqhubekiseni imisebenzi yonke. -Ukuqonda indlela yokuhlaziya okukhona nokwakha izimiso Ezibalulekile Nezobuchwepheshe Ezintsha. Ulwazi ngokuhlola amaphuzu engozi nezindlela zokwehlisa ingozi. Ulwazi nesipiliyono ngemithetho emayelana nomlilo nezinhlela zokuhamba phezulu. Isipiliyono ekulungiseni imibiko, izindatshana kanye nezethulo ngesiNgisi. Ukuxhumana kahle nabantu nokuxhuma ngolimi nokubhala okuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa, ukuhlaziya nokulungisa ngokwendawo izimiso ezibalulekile nezobuchwepheshe Ukuhlola izindatshana ezincoma izindlela ezintsha zokuletha izinsizakusebenza nokwenza izifundo ezilinganisa ukwenzeka; Ukwenza imibhalo yesinqumo kanye nezimiso; Ukuhlola izinto ezifakwe kumesini esicwephile, ukwenza umsebenzi wokuhlela futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa, lapho kudingeka; Ukuphepha ukusebenzisa (ukwakha) nokuqeqesha izinto ezifakwe kumesini esicwephile; Izifundo zocwaningo/ngezesikhashana ukuze ugcine ezinhlelweni zobuchwepheshe ezintsha nokuqhathanisa ngokusebenzisana nezi-Khansili/Amabhodi ezingabalulekile.

jobs.summary: Registered Counsellor position in Witzenberg Sub-district offering preventative and developmental counselling services across three graded salary levels.

Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Registered Counsellor. Grade 2: A minimum of 8 years appropriate experience as a Counsellor after registration with Health Professional Council (HPCSA) as a Counsellor. Grade 3: A minimum of 16 years appropriate experience as a Counsellor after registration with Health Professional Council (HPCSA) as a Counsellor. Work within your professional scope of practice. Refer appropriately. Knowledge and experience in providing mentoring and supervision of other lay health workers. Able to work independently and in a team, demonstrate good presentation skills; the ability to conduct training; Good intra- and interpersonal skills, maintenance of good professional relations, effective conflict resolution and to be adaptable and innovative in a high-pressured environment. Computer literacy (i.e. MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel).

Performing supportive psychological interventions to enhance mental well-being on an individual basis, group basis and at community level. Work within the multidisciplinary team and form part of the sub district and district mental health teams. Report writing and providing feedback to clients/supervisor(s) on interventions. Perform clinical administrative duties as keep accurate statistics and conduct training and workshops. af.title: Geregistreerde Raadgewer Vlak 1 tot 3

Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 8 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Raadgewer na registrasie by die Health Professional Council (HPCSA) as 'n Raadgewer. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 16 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Raadgewer na registrasie by die Health Professional Council (HPCSA) as 'n Raadgewer. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewese voorligtingsvaardighede met individue en groepe; opstelling van getuienisgebaseerde gemeenskapsintervensies; kennis en/of ervaring in psigometriese assesserings, identifisering van geestesgesondheidsuitdagings en die verskaffing van opleiding. Werk binne jou professionele omvang van praktyk. Verwys toepaslik. Kennis en ervaring in die verskaffing van mentorskap en toesig van ander lek-gesondheidswerkers. In staat om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk, toon goeie aanbiedingsvaardighede; die vermoë om opleiding te gee; Goeie intra- en interpersoonlike vaardighede, onderhoud van goeie professionele verhoudinge, effektiewe konflikoplossing en om aanpasbaar en innoverend te wees in 'n hoëdrukomgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid (d.w.s. MS Word, PowerPoint en Excel).
af.duties: Verskaffing van voorkomende en ontwikkelende voorligtingsdienste aan kinders, volwassenes, paartjies en gesinne insluitend geestesgesondheidskeuring van alle pasiënte, psigo-opvoeding en geestesgesondheidsbevordering. Uitvoering van ondersteunende sielkundige intervensies om geesteswelstand te verbeter op 'n individuele basis, groepbasis en op gemeenskapsvlak. Werk binne die multidissiplinêre span en vorm deel van die sub-distrik en distrik se geestesgesondheidspanne. Verslagskrywing en die verskaffing van terugvoer aan kliënte/toesighouer(s) oor intervensies. Verrig kliniese administratiewe pligte soos om akkurate statistieke te hou en opleiding en werkswinkels aan te bied. Verskaf toesig, mentorskap en ondersteuning aan lek-gesondheidswerkers en bywoon van gereelde kliniese toesig.

zu.title: Umeluleki Oqashiwe Wezinga 1 ukuya ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumeluleki oqashiwe e-Witzenberg Sub-district esinikeza imisebenzi yokweluleka ngokuzivikela nokuthuthukisa kumazinga amathathu eholo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezincane: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomeluleki oqashiwe. Ukubhaliswa kwinhlangano yomhlotfana: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomeluleki oqashiwe. Okufunwa yiminyaka yokusebenza: Izinga 1: Akukho okunye okudingwa emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomeluleki. Izinga 2: Okuncane ukusebenza iminyaka eyi-8 njengomeluleki emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA. Izinga 3: Okuncane ukusebenza iminyaka eyi-16 njengomeluleki emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA. Izidingo ezingokwendalo: Ilayisense yokushayela elikhonza (Code B/EB). Ulwazi neziqu ezifanele: Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokweluleka abantu abanye kanye nabeZingane; ukuqalisa izinkundla ezisekwa ngolwazi kumphakathi; ulwazi noma okuhlangenwe nakho ekuhloleni imithetho yokusebenza kwengqondo, ukuhlonza izinkinga zempilo yengqondo nokuba nokuqeqesha. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesikhungla sakho sokusebenza esifanele. Ukweluleka ngendlela efanele. Ulwazi nokuqeqesha abanye abasebenzi ngomzimba wokusesi. Ukuba nengqondo ephilile kwiqembu noma eyedwa, ukubonisa ubuchwephesh bokulungiselela izinkulumo; ikhono lokwenza ukuqeqesha; Ulwazi oluhle lokuba kubantu, ukugcina ubuhle bokuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokuphumelelayo nokuqamba izindlela ezintsha.
zu.duties: Ikwethukela kwabantwana, abadult, amapelisi nemindu imihangawusebenzi yokwelapha ukuzivikela nenhlahlelelo kwezempilo yengqondo. Ikwakho isikeningi semiphumela yengqondo, ukwazisa abafundi nokuqalisa izindaba empilweni yengqondo yonke. Ukwenza okukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwengqondo ngqo komuntu alicediswa, kwabaqeqeshi nakomphakathi jikelele. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesosi esisebenza kusungula ukulawula nokuqonda imisebenzi yonke, bese kuba ningxenye yaseMnyangweni wezeMpilo weSifunda nakwisifunda. Ukubhala imibhalo yokusebenza nokuwukhombisela ngemphumela kubathintu noma kabalawuli abaphezulu. Ukwenza imihangawusebenzi yokulawula imininingwane, ukubala izibalo ezinhle, ukuqeqesha abafundi nakunyikinyiko. Ukulawula, ukwesaba khona nokwelusa izinkundla nokuqasha abasebenzi besilimo bese baye ukulandelwa njalo.

xh.title: Umcebisi Obhalisiwe inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somcebisi obhalisiwe kummandla ongaphantsi we-Witzenberg esinika iinkonzo zokucinga ezenzelwa ukuthintela nokuthuthukisa kwamakinqanaba amathathu omvuzo.
xh.requirements: I ngonobangela elincinci lemfuno yesiqu: Isiqu esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcebisi obhalisiwe. Ukubhalisa kumrhwebi wenkulu: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcebisi obhalisiwe. Iimbonakalo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcebisi. Inqanaba 2: Okungaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-8 yamava afanelekileyo njengomcebisi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcebisi. Inqanaba 3: Okungaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-16 yamava afanelekileyo njengomcebisi emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomcebisi. Iimfuno ezinjalo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono elibonisiweyo lokucinga nabantu nababini/babini; ukumila kwezintatho ezigqithiswe ngolwazi olusemsebenzini loluntu; ulwazi nakho okanye amava kokuhlola ngokwengqondo, ukuqonda iingxaki zempilo yengqondo nokuzelela uqeqesho. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesithuba sakho sobugcisa bokusebenza. Ukuqamba ngokufanelekileyo. Ulwazi namava ekunika isikhokelo nexesha lokulawula kwezinye iziguli ezibhencayo. Ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nakwindyangu, ukubonisa izakhono ezilungileyo zokubonisa; ikhono lokuqeqesha; Ikhono elilungileyo langaphakathi nakumaxhesha, ukugcina ubudlelwane obulungileyo obungcali, ukulungisa iziphithiphathi ngokuchanekileyo nokuba nobume obutsha nokuba nolwazi olutsha endaweni enomngcango ophakamileyo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (njengoko MS Word, PowerPoint nesitya).
xh.duties: Ukuzelela iinkonzo zokucinga ezenzelwa ukuthintela nokuthuthukisa kubantwana, omdala, abashana nolwaphulana okubandakanya ukuhlola impilo yengqondo yazo zonke iziguli, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo nokukhuthaza impilo yengqondo. Ukwenza ukungenelela okuxhasa imicimbi yengqondo ukuphucula impilo yengqondo ngabanye, njengamalungu nangoommandla. Ukusebenza kwindyani ebandakanya izifundo ezininzi nokuba yinxalenye yeenthaphu zempilo yengqondo zommandla ongaphantsi nengingaphantsi. Ukubhala iingxelo nokunika ulwazi kumxhasi/abaphathi ngezintatho. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo yeziguli njengokugcina izibalo ezichanekileyo, ukuqeqesha nokuba namalungu abasebenzi. Ukuzelela isikhokelo, ixesha lokulawula nenuxhaso kubasebenzi basesikhundleni nokuza ekulawulweni oluchanekileyo.

Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Amptenaar. af.duties: Verskaf omvattende Oor-, Neus- en Keelsorg aan pasiënte deur siektes en ander gesondheidstoestande te diagnoseer en te behandel. Finansiële bestuur deur doeltreffende en effektiewe gebruik van hulpbronne. Voltooi die vereiste VOO-aktiwiteite om registrasie by die HPCSA te handhaaf. Neem deel aan opleidings- en opvoedkundige programme vir gesondheidsorgprofessionele. Voltooi en dien vereiste mediese verslae en dokumentasie vir regtelike en administratiewe doeleindes in. zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphezulu: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoMedical Officer. Umkhombandlela weminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esihambisana nomkhombo ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoMedical Practitioner nekhanda elaziwayo lezempilo lezisebenzi ngezobuchwepheshe lasemazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqetshiwe koMazwe ngaphandle, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Isigaba 2: Umkhomole weminyaka emihlanu yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoMedical Practitioner ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoMedical Practitioner mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqetshiwe e-South Africa. Umkhombandlela weminyaka eyisithupha yesipiliyoni esihambisana nomkhombo ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoMedical Practitioner nekhanda elaziwayo lezempilo lasemazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqetshiwe koMazwe ngaphandle, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Isigaba 1: Akukho lutho ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoMedical Practitioner ku-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqetshiwe e-South Africa. Unyaka oyedwa wesipiliyoni esihambisana nomkhombo ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoMedical Practitioner nekhanda elaziwayo lezimpilo lasemazwe ngaphandle mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqetshiwe koMazwe ngaphandle, owungadingeki ukuba enze isevisi Yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka e-South Africa. Izidingo eziyimvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB) esevisi. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhindi): Isipiliyoni esifanele kuEar, Nose, and Throat. Isipiliyoni esivezwe sezikhindi zokwenza imisebenzi ezifanele indlela yeEar, Nose, and Throat. Ulwazi oluveziwe lomthetho wezempilo yomphakathi, imihlahlandlela nezinye iziqondiso ukuze kuphathwe amasimba ngempumelelo. Ikono lokusebenza kozibophelele nokuphatha isikhathi nomisebenzi wezokuphatha ngempumelelo. Isimo esihle somsebenzi njengomsebenzi ngezobuchwepheshe. Ikono lokuxhumana.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kwezindlebe, ikhala nomqala kwabaguli ngokuhlonza nokwelapha izifo nezinye izimo zempilo. Bhala futhi uphathe izindlela zokwelapha, okuhlanganisa nemithi nezindlela zokwelapha ezisekelwe kumthetho. Gcina amarekhodi abaguli aphelele futhi alungele. Thumela abaguli ezikhundleni zokwelapha eziphezulu noma kwezinye izinikezeli zezempilo uma kunesidingo. Ukubamba iqhaza kuzinsizakalo zokwethula ezinikezwa umnyango weEar, Nose, and Throat. Ukuphathwa kwezezimali ngokusebenzisa amasimba ngempumelelo nekhorayishi. Qedisa imisebenzi eyidingekile yeCPD ukuze kugcinwe ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA. Bamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha nemfundo yezisebenzi zezokwelapha. Qedisa futhi uthumele imibiko yezokwelapha eyidingekanye noshicilelo olufanele ngenxa yezomthetho nezokuphatha. Gimba igama lendabuko yokwelapha.

Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Iimpawu zokuziphatha (ulwazi/akhoni): Amanqanaba amava afanelekileyo kwindawo yamakhandlela, impumlo, nomqala. Amava abonisiweyo kwakhona ezakhono zokwenza izixelo ezifanelekileyo kwilizwe lamakhandlela, impumlo, nomqala. Ulwazi olubonisiweyo ngezicwangciso zamaphulo emphakathi, izikhokelo namagazethi ahambelanayo okulawula iithemplomnadi ngokusebenzayo. Ikhono lokusebenza yedwa nokulawula isixa nexesha nemisebenzi yolawulo ngokusebenzayo. Imo yobungcali obuhle. Ikhono lokuthetha.

Thumela amaguli kulawulo lothuthuko okanye kubakho bokunika imibonelela yempilo xa kuyimfuneko. Inkcitha kumabhongo akrwada kunyango luthunyelwa ngaphandle olunikwa ngundluwo we-Ear, Nose, and Throat department. Ulawulo lwemali ngokusetyenziswa kolusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo kwezitholakalo. Qedela imisebenzi ye-CPD efunekayo ukuze ugcine ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. Zibandakanye kwimisebenzi yokuqeqesha iinkqubo zemfundo zabakho bokunika imibonelela yempilo. Qedela ukuze ungenise amawebakhasi afunekayo kwizibalo nembekiso ngemigangatho yamagqabantshintshi ngexesha langempela. Ncita kwaye ulawule imeko negunya lokuziphatha ngokomthetho ngokwemeko emsebenzini. Zama ukuba ngumntu ozimelayo kumagazi abantu abagulayo nokulinganisa amagatya abo obukho kweli 'Patient Blood Oxygenation and Maintenance of Normothermia Specialist'.

jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. (This dispensation is only applicable for posts of Clinical Programme Coordinator where it is an inherent requirement of the post, incumbent to maintain registration with the SANC). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB/C1) driver’s license. Willingness to work overtime when necessary. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to function/make decisions independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Good interpersonal relations, exceptional leadership and conflict resolution skills. Knowledge of all relevant public service regulations and policies. Understanding the District Health System. Experience in Primary health care and statistical data. Understanding public/private partnerships. Good psychosocial, health assessment, planning, organisational, and training skills. Appropriate knowledge of mental health, rehab, eye care, infectious and HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, Chronic Conditions and community-based services. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Experience in Health programmes (women’s health, child health, mental health, chronic diseases, infectious diseases, community-based services).
jobs.duties: Ensure implementation, coordination, governance, monitoring and evaluation of the Sub-District District Chronic, rehabilitation, eyecare, mental health, HAST and Community Based services and strategies. Support the implementation of Mental health, rehab, eye care, chronic health, infectious diseases and HIV/AIDS/STI/TB services, establish linkages with integrated management of conditions and life stages Support the internal and external interface strengthening with the focus on the COPC Model. Monitor and evaluate programme goals and targets including the collection, validation and interpretation of statistical data. Involvement in training/capacity building programmes to develop skills and roll out training to support implementation and provision of services related to chronic, rehab, eyecare, mental, infections and HAST.
