af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder: Omvattende Gesondheid
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder-pos by Grabouw CHC vir 'n professionele verpleegkundige om sub-distrik chroniese, geestesgesondheids-, rehabilitasie- en gemeenskapsgebaseerde gesondheidsdienste te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. (Hierdie dispensasie is slegs van toepassing op poste van Kliniese Programkoördineerder waar dit 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is, om registrasie by die SANC te handhaaf). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleegkunde. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB/C1) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer/besluite te neem. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, uitsonderlike leierskap- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van alle relevante openbare diensregulasies en -beleide. Begrip van die Distrik Gesondheidstelsel. Ervaring in primêre gesondheidsorg en statistiese data. Begrip van openbare/private vennootskappe. Goeie psigososiale, gesondheidsassesserings-, beplannings-, organisatoriese en opleidingsvaardighede. Toepaslike kennis van geestesgesondheid, rehabilitasie, oogsorg, aansteeklike en MIV/VIGS/SOI/TB, chroniese toestande en gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Ervaring in Gesondheidsprogramme (vrouegesondheid, kindergesondheid, geestesgesondheid, chroniese siektes, aansteeklike siektes, gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste).
af.duties: Verseker implementering, koördinering, beheer, monitering en evaluering van die Sub-Distrik Distrik Chroniese, rehabilitasie-, oogsorg-, geestesgesondheids-, HAST- en Gemeenskapsgebaseerde dienste en -strategieë. Ondersteun die implementering van Geestesgesondheid-, rehabilitasie-, oogsorg-, chroniese gesondheids-, aansteeklike siektes- en MIV/VIGS/SOI/TB-dienste, vestig skakelings met geïntegreerde bestuur van toestande en lewensfases. Ondersteun die versterking van die interne en eksterne koppelvlak met die fokus op die COPC-model. Monitor en evalueer programdoelwitte en teikens insluitend die insameling, validasie en interpretasie van statistiese data. Betrokkenheid by opleidings/kapasiteitsbou-programme om vaardighede te ontwikkel en opleiding uit te rol om implementering en verskaffing van dienste rakende chroniese, rehabilitasie-, oogsorg-, geestesgesondheids-, aansteeklike en HAST te ondersteun. Effektiewe implementering van toepaslike projekte om die geïntegreerde primêre gesondheidsorgdienste in die sub-distrik te verbeter. Verseker gehalte pasiëntsorg deur professionele en tegniese ondersteuning aan gefinansierde Gemeenskapsgebaseerde Dienste (CBS) Nie-Winsgewende Organisasie (NPO)-programme binne die Sub-distrik. Monitor en evalueer die gehalte van die implementering van die verskillende programme van CBS in die gesondheidsfasiliteite, NPO-sektor en gemeenskappe binne die sub-distrik en verseker maandelikse/daartelike indiening van vorderingsverslae aan die Distrikskantoor. Koördineer en ondersteun Sub-distrikpersoneel met gesondheidsaktiwiteite in Primêre Gesondheidsorg-fasiliteite en in nie-gesondheidsgebaseerde terreine.

zu.title: Nhloko-Menkokuhlelwa kwezohlelo: Ezempilo Eziphelele
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNhloko-Menkokuhlelwa kwezohlelo e Grabouw CHC sokuthi umongi ophathekayo ahlele izinsiza zezigulo ezihlala isikhathi eside zesifunda esincane, ezempilo yengqondo, zokubuyisela umzimba nezinsiza zezempilo ezisemphakathini.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingaphansi: Ithifikheyithi le-R425 esisisekelo (okukuthi idiploma/idigri kokubongwa) noma isitifikheyithi esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongi Ophathekayo. Noma Idigri yeminyaka emi-4 yokubongwa (i-R174) noma isitifikheyithi esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongi Ophathekayo. (Le ndlela isebenzisa kuphela izikhundla zoNhloko-Menkokuhlelwa kwezohlelo lapho kuyisidingo sangaphakathi sesikhundla, ukuthi umuntu othathayo igunya agcine ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC). Ukubhaliswa kolwazi oluphathekayo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoMongi Ophathekayo. Isipiliyoni: Ube neminyaka engu-7 ubuncwane yesipiliyoni esifanele/esiqashelweyo kokubongwa emva kokubhaliswa njengoMongi Ophathekayo kwi-SANC kokubongwa jikelele. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB/C1) esevuliwe. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile uma kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Ikhono lokusebenza/kuthatha izinqumo ngokuzimele nangokuba yingxenye yethimba elinobunjalo obuningi. Ubudlelwane obuhleabantu, ubuholo obuvelekile namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngazo zonke izimiso nemihlela yomphakathi ehlobene. Ukuqonda Isimiso Sezempilo SesiFunda. Isipiliyoni kwezempilo eziphakathi nokwazi izibalo. Ukuqonda ubudlelwano phakathi kwabalinganiswa bomphakathi/bangasese. Amakhono amahle okuhlola impilo yengqondo nomzimba, ukuhlela, ukuqamba uhlelo, nokuhlola. Ulwazi olufanele ngezempilo yengqondo, ukubuyisela umzimba, ukunakekelwa kwamehlo, izifo ezithathelanayo ne-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, izigulo ezihlala isikhathi eside nezinsiza zesimiso somphakathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Isipiliyoni kuhlelo lwezempilo (izempilo zabesifazane, izempilo zabantwana, izempilo yengqondo, izifo ezihlala isikhathi eside, izifo ezithathelanayo, nezinsiza zomphakathi).
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphethwa, ukuhlelwa, ukuqashwa, ukulawula kanye nekuqashwa kokusebenza kwezinsiza ze-Sub-District District Chronic, rehabilitation, eyecare, mental health, HAST kanye nabaseCommunity Based services nezindlela zazo. Sekela ukuphathwa kwe-Mental health, rehab, eye care, chronic health, infectious diseases kanye ne-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, yize ukuxhumanisa nokuphathwa okuhlanganisayo kwezigulo namabalave asekelwe ukusekela ukuqhakamiswana kwangaphakathi nangaphandle okugxile kusimiso se-COPC. Londa futhi uhloliswe izinhloso nezinhloso zohlelo okuhlanganisa ukuqoqa, ukuqinisekisa nokuhumusha idatha yesibalo. Ukuba yingxenye yohlelo lokuqeqesha/okwakha amakhono ukuthuthukisa amakhono nokuhambisa ukuqeqeshwa ukuze kusekele ukuphathwa nokunikezwa kwezinsiza ezihlobene ne-chronic, rehab, eyecare, mental, infections kanye ne-HAST. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwamaphrojekthi afanele ukuthuthukisa izinsiza zezempilo eziyisisekelo ezihlanganiswe kusifunda. Qinisekisa inakekelo elihle kwesiguli ngokusekelwa ngamakhono aphathekayo nobuchwepheshe ezinsizeni ze-Community Based Services (CBS) Non-Profit Organisation (NPO) ezikhokhelwayo ngaphakathi kwe-Sub-district. Londa futhi uhloliswe ikhwalithi yokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene ze-CBS emitholampilo yezempilo, ekuhulumeni we-NPO kanye nasemiphakathini ngaphakathi kwesifunda futhi uqinisekise ukuthunyelwa kwezibalo zentuthuko ngenyanga/kota kwi-District Office Hlela futhi usekele abasebenzi be-Sub-district emisebenzini yezempilo emitholampilo ye-Primary Health Care nasemasiteshi angewona wezempilo.

xh.title: Umlondolozi WeNkqubo ZeZempilo: IzeZempilo Ezipheleleyo
xh.summary: Isithuba somlondolozi wenkqubo zempilo kwiGrabouw CHC somongikazi ochapelela iinkonzo zempilo ngaphaya kwezigqitha, impilo engaqondanga kakuhle, ukuphinda ubuyele kwindlela yokuvela kwimpilo yamayeza namagunya, kunye neenkonzo zempilo ezisekelwe kuluntu.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esincinci somfundo: Isigqibo esisisiseko seR425 (okt ndiploma/degree yokugqithwa kwamagunya) okt isigqibo esifanayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ochapelela. Okt Degree yeminyaka emi-4 yokugqithwa kwamagunya (R174) okt isigqibo esifanayo (R683 plus R1497 okt R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ochapelela. Le nkqubo isebenza kuphela kumagunya obekelo lomlondolozi wenkqubo zempilo apho kuyimfuno yesithuba ukuba umntu olu khwankqila kuhlale egqibiwe ukubhalisa kwi-SANC. Ukubhalisa kwibhunga lempilo: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ochapelela. Iimpazamo: Iimpono zonyaka abali-7 ngaphaya kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ochapelela kwi-SANC kwezonya zobugqatsha. Iimfuno ezingenakuphulwa zesithuba: Ilayiseni yokushayela (Code B/EB/C1) esemthethweni. Ilungelelaniso lokusebenza ngapha kwexesha elimisiweyo xa kuyimfuno. Iinkqubo ezisezinzweni (ulwazi/amaphantsu): Amandla okunxibelelana nokuchaza kakuhle (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo). Amandla okusebenza nokwenza izigqibo nokuzimela, kunye nokuvela kwethimba elihlanganisiweyo lezindlu zamagunya apho abantu bavela kumagunya amaninzi. Amandla aphambili okuchaza nokulunga ulwazi nokuxazulula iingxwabalwexa ezixhomekeke kumagunya amaninzi. Ulwazi ngamagunya amagunya nezithuba apho inkqubo kaRhulumde yamagunya neenkqubo zempilo zisebenza. Amandla okuqonda iNkqubo yeZempilo yoMmandla. Iimpono kwiZempilo eziBalulekileyo kumagunya nobukhulu bendalo. Amandla okusebenza ngokutshaya iinkqubo ezingabalulekanga nokuchaza iindidi ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngamagunya abantu abanika ngaphandle nokubeka imithetho. Amandla amakhulu okuqonda ukuxazulula iingxwabalwexa, ukuvakalisa iimfuno, ukulungiselela, ukuhlela, nokuyila iinkqubo zokuzilolonga. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo ngezempilo ezingaqondanga kakuhle, ukuphinda ubuyele kwindlela yokuvela kwimpilo, ukunakekelwa kwamehlo, izifo ezithathwa ngokudibana nabantu abangangenwa yizo, i-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, iimpo ezihlala ixesha elide, kunye neenkonzo ezisekelwe kuluntu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemiyalezo (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Iimpono kwinkqubo zempilo (impilo yabafazi, impilo yabantwana, impilo engaqondanga kakuhle, iimpo ezihlala ixesha elide, iimpo ezifakwa kwimizimba, iinkonzo ezisekelwe kuluntu).
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa, ukulungelelaniswa, ukulawulwa, nokugcinwa kweekhonthinethi namagunya obukummandla apho kubuyiswa khona iimpo ezihlala ixesha elide, ukuphinda ubuyele kwindlela yokuvela kwimpilo, ukunakekelwa kwamehlo, impilo engaqondanga kakuhle, i-HAST, neenkonzo ezisekelwe kuluntu, kunye neendlela ezahlukeneyo. Nceda ukuphathwa kweempilo ezimmandla, ukuphinda ubuyele kwindlela yokuvela kwimpilo, ukunakekelwa kwamehlo, impilo eqhubekayo, iimpo ezifakwa kwimizimba, iinkonzo ze-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB, uqhelanise nokulungelelanisa ukuphathwa kwezigaba ezahlukeneyo zamagunya apho bahlala kuwo kwaye uncedise ukuqhelana nokuphathwa kwezifo. Nceda ukulungelelaniswa ngaphakathi nangaphandle ngokusetyenziswa kwekonthinethi ezizezona zibalulekileyo ukuze kuqiniseke kumagunya ohambisa inkqubo kwaye uphuhlise ulwazi nokuqonda okupheleleyo kokusingathwa kwempilo. Lilumise iinkqubo zokukhulisa amandla obugqatsha nokuhlela ukuphathwa kwezigaba ezahlukeneyo zamagunya aze akhangeleke ukuba aphuhlise ulwazi lokuqhuba nemisebenzi yakhe yakutsha kwindlela ekuhambelana namagunya akhululekileyo obugqatsha. Ukuyila iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezilungele ukuphucula iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo zabantu kunye nokuphathwa kwempilo yonke kulo lonke ummandla welizwe. Qinisekisa ukunikezelwa kokulungile kwempilo yonke ngokubonelela ngenkxaso yobugqatsha kwiinkonzo ezifakwa kumagunya obugqatsha abaxhaswa yiNkonzo ezisekelwe kuluntu (CBS) kwiiNkqubo zeOrganisazi ezingekho ngamagunya (NPO) kwisithuba samandla ukuze zibe namanqanaba afanelekileyo okufikelela kubo bonke abantu abasemmandla. Qinisekisa ukuba kuhlolwa ngokutsha nokuhlelwa ulwazi lobugqatsha, iindidi ezahlukeneyo zeNkonzo ezisekelwe kuluntu nakuluntu jikelele ukwazi ukuba imisebenzi ihamba njani ekunikezeleni ngokuhamba kwexesha okt ukwenza okwenyanga zininzi.

Ukuqonda uhlelo lwezempilo lwesifunda. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekhi. Amakhono okuphatha idatha, ukuhlaziya nokutoluka. Ulwazi lwesikhompuyutha (MS Word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint) namakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela okusebenzayo, ukuhlanganisa, nokuphoqa izinhlela ezihlangene Zezempilo Ezibonakalayo Ezingcondelwa/Izinkonzo, kufaka phakathi Izinkonzo Zomama, Abesifazane, Abantwana, Abelesente, Isondlo, Izempilo Zezikole, HIV/AIDS/STI/TB/VMMC, izinkonzo zezempilo yengqondo kanye nezinkonzo zezifo ezingapheli. Nikeza ukuhlanganisa inkxaso yokuqaliswa kwesevisi ekuphathweni kwezimo zezokwelapha eziphawulwa, ukubheka izifo, kanye nempendulo yokuhlasela ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo nezinkomba. Nikeza inkxaso yokulawula izensebenzo zokwelapha, uxhasa ukuqaliswa kwezinqubomgomo nezinkomba. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nokuqaliswa kwesevisi yezinkonzo zomphakathi ezisusekelwe emmangweni kanye nalokho okungcondisa impilo yomuntu. Qinisa ukuqaliswa kwe-Community-Orientated Primary Care. Qinisa ukusebenzisana nabahlanganyeli bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Xhasa ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka ze-NPO Ukubheka nokuhlola izinkomba eziyinhloko zokusenza kahle, okuhlosiwe ekulethweni kwezinkonzo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwe-data kahle kuyo yonke imikhakha. Xhasa futhi ukhuthaze izinhlelo zokusiza ekwenzeni izinga elikhona phakathi kwazo zonke imikhakha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana namazinga. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe, ukuqeqesha nokuhlakanisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwamandla abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umxhumanisi weNkqubo yoMthombo weMihlathi yezeMpilo eBandakanyayo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umxhumanisi wenkqubo yomthombo wemihlathi eWestern Cape ukuze axhume iinkqubo zemihlathi ebandakanyako ezizezona ezizezona ezibandakanya imisebenzi yabazali,abantwana, i-HIV/AIDS kunye nemisebenzi yeziqhinga ezihlala njalo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinane semfundo: Isigunyaziso se-Basic R425 (oktatho nje isidanga/idegree kwindyakamo yokunyanga) okanye isigunyaziso esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wokunyanga. OKTATHO Isidanga se-Bachelor Degree kwiminyaka emi-4 kwindyakamo yokunyanga (R174) okanye isigunyaziso esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 okanye R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wokunyanga. Ukubhalisa kwibhunga lomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wokunyanga. Isipili: Kufuneka kube khona iminyaka elishumi elinexesha elithile (7) yokwenza umsebenzi ochanekileyo / owaziwayo windyakamo yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wokunyanga kwi-SANC kwindyakamo ebanzi yokunyanga. Iimfuno ezingenaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushova (Code B/EB) esevela. Izakhono (ulwazi/amacandelo): Amandla okusebenza nosapho kunye nokuvela kwicandelo elijoyene amagqabi ahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuqonda nokusesula izigqibo, iinkqubo kunye nezikhokelo. Amandla okuzidibanisa, okudibana, okuxhuma, kunye nokulungelelanisa. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yezeMpilo yesiGanga. Amandla okulawula iiprojekthi. Amandla okulawula idatha, ukuhlalutya nokutolika. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, kunye ne-PowerPoint) kunye namandla okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa okusebenzayo, ukuxhuma, nokusesula iinkqubo zemihlathi ebandakanyayo ezeMpilo eBandakanyayo/Imisebenzi, kuquka imisebenzi yabazali, yabafazi, yabantwana, yeemphefumlo ezincinane, ezeMPHEZELA, ezesikolo, i-HIV/AIDS/STI/TB/VMMC, imisebenzi yokunyanga ingqondo kunye nemisebenzi yeziqhinga ezihlala njalo. Ukunikela inkxaso yokuxhuma nokusesula imisebenzi yokulawula iimeko zezempilo ezibaliswayo, ukuqaphela iinqebo ezikhoyo, kunye nokuphendula iintshebe zezifo ngokwelawulo leenkqubo nezikhokelo. Ukunikela inkxaso yokulawula inkqubo yamagqirha, ukuxhasa ukusesula iinkqubo kunye nezikhokelo. Ukunikela inkxaso yamandla okusebenza nokusesula imisebenzi esekelwe kwilali nakwilungelelaniso lwempilo. Ukomekeza ukusesula inkqubo yeSompilo sokuQala esekelwe kuLuntu. Ukomekeza ukudibana kunye nabalinganisi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuxhasa ukulawula iinkontrata ze-NPO, ukuqaphela nokuhlalutya iimpawu ezibalulekileyo zokusebenza, iinkqubo ezinqweniweyo zomsebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula idatha ngokuchanekileyo kuzo zonke iinkqubo. Ukukhuthaza nokuxhasa iinkqubo zokuphucula ngokuchanekileyo ngokuhamba kwexesha kuzo zonke iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela iinkqubo. Ukunikela inkxaso yamandla okusebenza, uqeqesho kunye nokulunga abasebenzi ukuze bathathe amandla okusebenza.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 (GENERAL)
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate quality nursing services as an Operational Manager at Tygerberg Hospital, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Or a 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate / recognisable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Ability and willingness to assist with shifts and after-hours hospital cover including weekends, public holidays, night duty relief and overtime as the need arises. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to function independently as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Effective communication, interpersonal, leadership, decision-making and conflict resolution skills. Good organisational skills and the ability to function under pressure. Basic computer literacy. Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to nursing within the public sector. Ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation and monitoring of standards.
jobs.duties: The candidate will be responsible for planning, managing, co-ordinating and maintaining an optimal quality Nursing Service as an Operational Manager. Participative management and utilisation of Human Resources to fulfil operational and developmental functions in the area. Manage and monitor the Financial Resources of the clinical area. Initiate and participate in training, development and research within the nursing department. Deliver a support service to the Nursing Service and the institution. To maintain ethical standards and promote professional growth and development.
jobs.enquiries: Ms V Dubase Tel No: (021) 938-4000
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical/ competency assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging Graad 1 (ALGEMEEN)
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer gehalte verpleegdienste as 'n Operasionele Bestuurder by Tygerberg Hospital, wat 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad met SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleging) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Of 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleging (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om met skofte en buite-kantoorure hospitaaldekking te help insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae, nagdiensverligting en oortyd soos die behoefte ontstaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Effektiewe kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Basiese rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis en insig van toepaslike wetgewing en beleid verbandhoudend met verpleging binne die publieke sektor. Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die instelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beplanning, bestuur, koördinering en in stand hou van 'n optimale gehalte Verpleegdiens as 'n Operasionele Bestuurder. Deelnemende bestuur en benutting van Menslike Hulpbronne om operasionele en ontwikkelingsfunksies in die area te vervul. Bestuur en moniter die Finansiële Hulpbronne van die kliniese area. Inisieer en neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegdepartement. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die Verpleegdiens en die instelling. Om etiese standaarde te handhaaf en professionele groei en ontwikkeling te bevorder.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomsebenzi Wezokwelapha Ezinga 1 (JIKELELE)
zu.summary: Phatha futhi hlela izinkonzo zezokwelapha ezinhle njengoba ungomphathi wezomsebenzi eTygerberg Hospital, kudingeka idiploma noma idigri ezokwelapha okubhalise kwiSANC.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesibalo: Ikhwalifayeshini yeBasic R425 (okunjengediploma/idigri ezokwelapha) noma ikhwalifayeshini efanayo (R683 plus R254) evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqaji Wezokwelapha. Noma idigri yeminyaka yamashumi amane eNursing (R174) noma ikhwalifayeshini efanayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqaji Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwiKhanseli yezomsebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqaji Wezokwelapha. Isipiliyoni: Ucishe uneminyaka eyisikhombisa ephumelelayo / esinganakwa ngokuphathelene neNursing ngemva kokubhalisa njengoGqaji Wezokwelapha kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Izidingo ezibhalwe emsebenzini: Ikhono nesithakazelelo sokusize ngesikhathi nokugqamela isibhedlela ngemva kwamahora okuvamile kuhlanganise amasonto, amaholide omphakathi, ukusiza ebunzini ebusuku nokugqamela isikhathi esingeziwe njengoba kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele kanye nokuwumunxabo wenqubomgomo eqoqwa abantu abaningi. Amakhono okuxoxa kahle, abantu, ukuba ngumgqugquzeli, okuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ohlelo oluhle kanye nekhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwesikhompiyutha. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda komthetho kanye nomthethosisekelo ohlobene nezokwelapha ngaphakathi komhlaba jikelele. Ikhono lokukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwegula elinhle ngokuhlela, ukusetshenziswa nokulandela izinga.
zu.duties: Umqashi uzobe nesibophezelo sokuhlela, ukuphatha, ukuhlela kanye nokugcina inkonzo yeNursing enhle njengoba ungomphathi wezomsebenzi. Ukuphatha ngokubambisene kanye nokusebenzisa abantu abenza umsebenzi ukuze kuqedele imisebenzi yokwenzeka nokuthuthuka kuleso sikhungo. Phatha kanye ukulandela imali kuleso sikhungo sezokwelapha. Qala kanye ukubamba iqhaza ekufundiseni, ekuqhubeni nokucwaningeni ngaphakathi komunyango wezokwelapha. Nikeza inkonzo yokusekela inkonzo yeNursing kanye nenhlangano. Ukugcina izinga zomthetho kanye nokukhuthaza ukukhula nokuqhubela phambili komsebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi weNursing inqanaba le-1 (JIKELELE)
xh.summary: Lawula kanjalo ulungelelanise iinkonzo zokunursa ezilumleyo njengoMphathi weMisebenzi eTygerberg Hospital, kufuneka ube nediploma okanye isidanga kunye nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt diploma/isidanga kwiziko) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNurse oYaziwayo. Okanye i-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka engama-4 kwiNursing (R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 okanye R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNurse oYiziPankathuli. Ukubhaliswa kwikomiti eYiziPankathuli: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengoNurse oYiziPankathuli. I-exp: Iminyaka engama-7 yamava aSOME / abalulekileyo kwiNursing emva kokubhaliswa njengoNurse oYiziPankathuli kwiSANC kwiNursing eJikelele. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ikhono elikhululekileyo kwaye ulungelelanise namabakardi okutyhala umsebenzi nasekuhlinzekwa isibhedlele nangemva kwamavesi kwakunangamaxesha aphela, kuquka iwekende, iintsuku zikahulumeni, iindutyana zokusinda ebusuku kwaye uncedisane kwakhona ukuba kukho isidingo. Iimpawu (ulwazi/izakhono): Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nakuxabanaeqondiswe icandelo labasebenzi abanengi. Ikhono elikhokelwayo lokuthethathetha, lokuziphatha nabantu, ukukhokela, ukwenza isigqibo kunye nokuzama ukulungisa iingxabano. Ikhono elihle lokumisimlo kwakhona nelifumanisele i-preconditioner ephezulu yoMthetho. Ulwazi olusikweni ngokuchazwa ngokusesikweni kwemigaqo nayiMithetho Yaseburhulumenteni. Ikhono lenkqubo kwi-services ezingatshatwa ngokuthengisa nasekubakela isiseko ngakumbi.
xh.duties: Umava uyakuba nesibopho sokuyila, ukulawula, ukulungelelanisa nokugcina iNkonzo yeNursingi esemgwangqweni omdlali njengomLawuliwo. Ukulawula ngokuthath' inxaxheba nokusebenzisa abasebenzi abanengi ukugcina isiseko sawo umsebenzi kwaye uphuhlise iimfuno ezingundo kwindawo. Lawula kanjalo ulandele imali engenkqubo yendawo esesixekweni. Qala kanjalo uthathe inxaxheba ekuletheni izazisi, ekuphuhliseni nasekutshintsheni iNkonzo yeNursing kwiziko. Zincedise ngemisebenzi yeNkonzo yeNursing kwakhona nasekwenzeni iziko elikhuselekileyo. Ukugcina iinkqubo ezilungileyo zokuziphatha ngokweenkqubo kwaye uphuhlise inkqubo yokhuseleko ekuqwalaselweni.

jobs.title: Ultrasound Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (SONOGRAPHER)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 per annum
jobs.summary: Ultrasound radiographer needed at Khayelitsha CHC to provide advanced diagnostic ultrasound services focused on obstetrics and gynaecology imaging within a multi-disciplinary team.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasound Radiography. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Ultrasound. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of RSA-qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of RSA-qualified employees. Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of RSA-qualified employees. Minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Ultrasound) in respect of foreign qualified employees. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Code B/EB driver’s license. Willingness to work overtime. Willingness to conduct outreaches to local clinics, community day/health centres and communities. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy in word processing, data management and analysis. Ability to work independently and in a team with good interpersonal skills. Thorough knowledge of ante-natal, ante-natal Doppler paediatric, gynaecology- and abdominal-ultrasound studies. Completion of supplementary courses on diagnostic ultrasound and knowledge and interest in teaching in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at both undergraduate and post-graduate level.
jobs.duties: Provide a comprehensive diagnostic ultrasound service at an advanced level with the focus on Obstetrics and Gynaecology (OSG) imaging in Khayelitsha CHC. General care of patients as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Effective administration within the ultrasound unit regarding patient service, appropriate referral as well as equipment management. Maintain case records and statistics. Actively take part in CPD- program, as a learner as well as In-service training.
jobs.enquiries: Mr DB Grootboom Tel No: (021) 360-5200
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a written practical test and oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Echografie-radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 (SONOGRAPHER)
af.summary: Echografie-radiograaf benodig by Khayelitsha CHC om gevorderde diagnostiese echografiedienste te lewer met die fokus op verloskunde- en ginekologie-beelding binne 'n multidissiplinêre span.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Echografie-radiografie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiograaf in Echografie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in Echografie-radiografie met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Een jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Echografie) met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Echografie) met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Echografie) met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in South Africa vereis nie. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Echografie) met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 21 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Echografie) met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk. Bereidwilligheid om uitreike na plaaslike klinieke, gemeenskapsdag/gesondheidsentrums en gemeenskappe te doen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid in woordverwerking, databestuur en -ontleding. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk met goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Deeglike kennis van voorgeboortelike-, voorgeboortelike Doppler-pediatriese-, ginekologie- en abdominale echografiestudies. Voltooiing van aanvullende kursusse in diagnostiese echografie en kennis en belangstelling in onderrig in Verloskunde en Ginekologie op beide voor- en nagraadse vlak.
af.duties: Lewer 'n omvattende diagnostiese echografiediens op 'n gevorderde vlak met die fokus op Verloskunde- en Ginekologie (OSG)-beelding by Khayelitsha CHC. Algemene sorg van pasiënte as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Effektiewe administrasie binne die echografie-eenheid met betrekking tot pasiëntediens, toepaslike verwysing asook toerustingbestuur. Onderhou gevalsrekords en statistieke. Neem aktief deel aan CPD-program, as 'n leerder sowel as in-diens opleiding.

zu.title: Umcebisi we-Ultrasound Onyakeni 1 kuye kwangu-3 (SONOGRAPHER)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umcebisi we-Ultrasound e-Khayelitsha CHC ukunikeza izinsizakusebenza ze-Ultrasound zokuhlolwa okuthuthukile ezigxile kwindlebe yokubonisana kanye nokuhlolwa kwezifo zabesifazane ngaphakathi kweqembu elihlukahlukene iziqu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezincane: Iqualification elifanele elivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwi-Ultrasound Radiography. Ukubhaliswa kubabhaliwe bezingcweti: Ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo-Radiographer kwi-Ultrasound. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Ultrasound Radiography kubasebenzi abathola iziqu e-RSA. Isipiliyoni esihambisanayo sonyaka owodwa ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Radiography (Ultrasound) kubasebenzi abathola izitezakude, abadingeki ukuba benze Isebenzi Somphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Grade 2: Uuncwane wesipiliyoni esihambisanayo seminyaka eyi-10 ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Radiography (Ultrasound) kubasebenzi abathola iziqu e-RSA. Uuncwane wesipiliyoni esihambisanayo seminyaka eyi-11 ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Radiography (Ultrasound) kubasebenzi abathola izitezakude abadingeki ukuba benze Isebenzi Somphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Grade 3: Uuncwane wesipiliyoni esihambisanayo seminyaka eyi-20 ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Radiography (Ultrasound) kubasebenzi abathola iziqu e-RSA. Uuncwane wesipiliyoni esihambisanayo seminyaka eyi-21 ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA kwi-Radiography (Ultrasound) kubasebenzi abathola izitezakude. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisenisi ye-Code B/EB ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza isikhathi esingaphezu kwasemsebenzini. Ukuzithoba ukwenza izinkalo kumakliniki endawo, izikhungo zansuku zonke/zempilo komphakathi nakuwo amaphakathi. Ukukwazi (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngakomshini ekucubunguleni amagama, ekuphatheni uchungechunge lwemininingwana nasekuhlaziyweni. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kodwa naseqenjini ngobuhlakani obuhle bokuxhumana nabantu. Ulwazi olujulile ngemidla yokuhlolwa kwe-ante-natal, i-ante-natal Doppler yezingane, i-gynaecology- kanye ne-abdominal-ultrasound. Ukugqamisa izifundo zokwengeza ngokuhlolwa kwe-Ultrasound kanye nolwazi nentshisekelo yokufundisa kwe-Obstetrics kanye ne-Gynaecology ezingeni lobudokotela obungaphansi nangaphezu kwalo.
zu.duties: Nikeza insizakusebenzi yokuhlolwa kwe-Ultrasound ngokubanzi ezingeni elithuthukile kugxilwe kundlebe yokubonisana nokuhlolwa kwezifo zabesifazane (OSG) e-Khayelitsha CHC. Ukunakekelwa okubanzi kwabagulayo njengengxenye eqenjini elihlukene iziqu. Ukuqondisa okusebenzayo ngaphakathi kweyuniti ye-Ultrasound ngokuqhathaniswa nensebenzo yabagulayo, ukuphathwa okufanele kanye nokuphathwa kweqembu. Ukugcina amarekhodi amacala nezibalo. Ukubamba iqhaza ngokuzimisela ohlelweni lwe-CPD, njengomfundi kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kwesevisi.

jobs.title: Ultrasound Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (SONOGRAPHER)
jobs.centre: Caledon Hospital, Theewaterskloof Sub-district Saxon Sea CDC (X2 Posts) Protea Park CDC (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 per annum Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Ultrasound radiographers wanted at Caledon Hospital and CDC sites in the Western Cape to perform obstetric and gynaecological ultrasound scans.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasound Radiography. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Ultrasound. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration In Ultrasound Radiography with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of qualified RSA employees. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of RSA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of RSA qualified employees. A Minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Comprehensive sonography education and extensive hands-on experience, with specific emphasis on ultrasound experience in obstetrics and gynaecology, demonstrating a strong commitment to professional growth and lifelong learning through advanced education, research, and staff training. A thorough understanding of human anatomy and physiology is required, along with knowledge of disease pathologies as they relate to sonographic findings. A commitment to ethical practice, maintaining patient confidentiality, a professional demeanour, and the capacity to manage a large clinical workload and stressful situations calmly are essential. Strong abilities to interact effectively with both patients and medical staff, clearly explaining technical information and collaborating on patient care. Understanding basic computer programs and the use of reporting systems. Meticulous reporting of ultrasound examination findings and attention to record-keeping and maintenance thereof. Adopting responsibility for the care of ultrasound equipment (functionality, quality checks, maintenance) within the department on a regular basis. Provision of a clinical service that is aligned with departmental management protocols with the most effective use of human and financial resources. Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e., diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic qualification, with a duration of at least a 1-year diploma, in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, accredited with the SANC (R 48) OR a 4-year Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A postgraduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Current registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years of appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or postgraduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license (Code B/EB). Willingness to work overtime when necessary. Competencies (knowledge/skills): NIMART training or experience. Basic computer skills in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies of the Department of Health Western Cape. Communication skills (written and verbal).
jobs.duties: Perform a full range of obstetric and gynaecological ultrasound scans, including routine, level II/III, and specialized assessments with adherence to departmental protocols and the most effective use of human and financial resources. Use advanced ultrasound equipment to produce accurate, high- quality diagnostic images. Identify normal and abnormal findings, and provide clear, structured reports. Adopt responsibility for regular back-up and storage of ultrasound images. Deliver compassionate, patient-centered care, ensuring comfort and dignity throughout the imaging process. Maintain continuity of care by undertaking follow-up scans and liaising with referring clinicians. Manage the administration and care of ultrasound equipment within the department. Participate actively in departmental meetings, case discussions and presentations. Contribute to clinical audits and quality assurance initiatives. Uphold professional, ethical and clinical governance standards at all times. Effective execution and assist with the management of relevant Curative Programmes within the scope of practice and to be an advocate for the patient to ensure the provision of necessary health care. Effective execution and assist with the management of relevant Child Health within the scope of practice and to be an advocate for the patient to ensure the provision of necessary health care. Effective execution and assist with the management of relevant Woman’s Health Services within the scope of practice and to be an advocate for the patient to ensure the provision of necessary health care. Effective execution and assist with the management of relevant HAST programmes within the scope of practice and to be an advocate for the patient to ensure the provision of necessary health care. The effective provision of high-quality services measured by outcomes of all of the quality assurance activities.

af.title: Echografie-radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 (SONOGRAPHER)
af.summary: Echografie-radiograwe benodig by Caledon Hospital en CDC-terreine in die Western Cape vir die uitvoer van verloskundige en ginekologiese ultraklankondersoeke.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Ultrasound Radiography toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiographer in Ultrasound. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen na registrasie In Ultrasound Radiography met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van gekwalifiseerde RSA-werknemers. Een jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Community Service te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Community Service te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA in Ultrasound Radiography ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Community Service te verrig nie, soos in South Africa vereis. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Omvattende sonografie-opleiding en uitgebreide praktiese ervaring, met spesifieke klem op ultraklankervaring in verloskunde en ginekologie, wat 'n sterk toewyding toon tot professionele groei en lewenslange leer deur gevorderde opvoeding, navorsing en personeelopleiding. 'n Deeglike begrip van menslike anatomie en fisiologie word vereis, tesame met kennis van siektepatologieë soos dit verband hou met sonografiese bevindings. 'n Toewyding aan etiese praktyk, die handhawing van pasientvertroulikheid, 'n professionele houding, en die vermoë om 'n groot kliniese werkslas en stresvolle situasies kalm te bestuur, is noodsaaklik. Sterk vermoëns om doeltreffend met beide pasiente en mediese personeel te kommunikeer, tegniese inligting duidelik te verduidelik en saam te werk aan pasientsorg. Begrip van basiese rekenaarprogramme en die gebruik van verslaenstelsels. Noukeurige verslagdoening van ultraklankondersoekbevindings en aandag aan rekordhouding en die instandhouding daarvan. Aanvaarding van verantwoordelikheid vir die sorg van ultraklanktoerusting (funksionaliteit, gehaltekontroles, instandhouding) binne die departement op 'n gereelde basis. Verskaffing van 'n kliniese diens wat in ooreenstemming is met departementele bestuursprotokolle met die doeltreffendste gebruik van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne. Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of equivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professional Nurse toelaat. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 'n 1-jaar diploma, in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, geakkrediteer by die SANC (R 48) OF 'n 4-jaar Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (R174) of equivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professional Nurse toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professional Nurse. Ervaring: Grade 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professional Nurse by die SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professional Nurse by die SANC in General Nursing. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): NIMART-opleiding of -ervaring. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleide van die Department of Health Western Cape. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling).
af.duties: Voer 'n volledige reeks verloskundige en ginekologiese ultraklankondersoeke uit, insluitend roetine-, vlak II/III- en gespesialiseerde assesserings met nakoming van departementele protokolle en die doeltreffendste gebruik van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne. Gebruik gevorderde ultraklanktoerusting om akkurate, hoë-kwaliteit diagnostiese beelde te produseer. Identifiseer normale en abnormale bevindings, en verskaf duidelike, gestruktureerde verslae. Aanvaar verantwoordelikheid vir gereelde rugsteun en berging van ultraklankbeelde. Lewer deernisvolle, pasiesgesentreerde sorg, en verseker gemak en waardigheid deurgaans tydens die beeldingsproses. Handhaaf kontinuïteit van sorg deur opvolgondersoeke te onderneem en te skakel met verwysende klinici. Bestuur die administrasie en sorg van ultraklanktoerusting binne die departement. Neem aktief deel aan departementele vergaderings, gevalbesprekings en voorleggings. Dra by tot kliniese oudits en gehalteversekeringsinisiatiewe. Handhaaf professionele, etiese en kliniese bestuursstandaarde te alle tye. Effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van tersaaklike Curative Programmes binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorstander vir die pasient te wees om die verskaffing van nodige gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van tersaaklike Child Health binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorstander vir die pasient te wees om die verskaffing van nodige gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van tersaaklike Woman's Health Services binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorstander vir die pasient te wees om die verskaffing van nodige gesondheidsorg te verseker. Effektiewe uitvoering en bystand met die bestuur van tersaaklike HAST-programme binne die omvang van praktyk en om 'n voorstander vir die pasient te wees om die verskaffing van nodige gesondheidsorg te verseker. Die effektiewe verskaffing van hoë-kwaliteit dienste gemeet aan die uitkomste van al die gehalteversekeringsaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Umlobi we-Ultrasound Oneminyaka Yemisebenzi Ephakeme Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-3 (SONOGRAPHER)
zu.summary: Kudingwa abalobi be-Ultrasound e-Caledon Hospital nasemasitesi e-CDC e-Western Cape ukwenza ukubuyelela kwe-Ultrasound kwabesimama abakhulelwe kanye nezifo zabesimama.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba besekela ukuqoqwa kobuchwepheshe be-Ultrasound. Ukubhaliswa eqoqo leziqu: ukubhaliswa kwesikhulu esibusayo sesikole esibhege abesimama ukuthi basebenze kumnyango wezempiIa njengoba besekela ukubhaliswa njengoba beseka isikhundla. Ukuze izinga le-1, izinga le-2, noma izinga le-3: Abafaki izicelo ababhalisile ngaphambi kuka-2017 badinga ukuthi bahlale basebenza ngemva kokubhaliswa. Isidingo esingokoqo: ukuba neqlq elitholakalayo esivumela ukubhaliswa eqoqo le-HPCSA njengoba besekela ukuqoqwa kobuchwepheshe be-Ultrasound. Ukubhaliswa eqoqo leziqu: Ukubhaliswa kwesikhulu esibusayo esibizwa ngokuthi yi-HPCSA njengoba besekela ukubhaliswa njengoba beseka isikhundla. Isipiliyoni: Izinga le-1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abagqamile abavela e-RSA. Unyaka owodwa wonzima emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abavela kwamanye amazwe, abayidingi ukuba baleke izidingo zenkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga le-2: Amayisha angu-10 wonzima emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abagqamile abavela e-RSA. Amayisha angu-11 wonzima emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abavela kwamanye amazwe abayidingi ukuba baleke izidingo zenkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga le-3: Amayisha angu-20 wonzima emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abagqamile abavela e-RSA. Amayisha angu-21 wonzima emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ngokugatsha kwabalobi be-Ultrasound ngokubheka abasebenzi abavela kwamanye amazwe abayidingi ukuba baleke izidingo zenkonzo yomphakathi, njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo eziseduzane nomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha (code B/EB). Isipiliyoni: Amakhono alondoloza ukuqoqwa kobuchwepheshe, alondoloza nokuthi abasebenzi bazikwazi ukuba nabasizi. Isiqu (ulwazi/amakhono): ulwazi olude lwemfundo yezinto ezihlobene nokubuyelelwa kwabesimama kanye nozela, okubonisa ukuzibophezela ekukhulekeni komuntu ngokobuchwepheshe nokufunda impilo yonke. Ulwazi oluphelele ngokwakheka komzimba kanye nemisebenzi yawo kuyadingeka kanye nolwazi ngezifo ezibangelwa izifo ezihlobene nokubonakala kwe-Ultrasound. Ukubandakanyeka ezintweni ezinhle zokwakheka komzimba, ukugcina imfihlo yegula, ukuziphatha ngendlela eqotho, nokuthi ukwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi omkhulu wezokwelapha kanye nezimo ezinengqondo kuyadingeka. Amakhono okusebenza ngokulingana nabagulayo kanye nabasebenzi bezokwelapha, nokucacisa ulwazi nge-Ultrasound.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukubuyelelwa kwe-Ultrasound kwabesimama abakhulelwe kanye nezifo zabesimaba, okuhlanganisa ukubuyelelwa okuvamile, okusesigabeni sesi-II/III, kanye nokubuyelelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu ngokulandela imithetho yomnyango nangokusebenzisa ngokugcizelela izinsiza zabantu kanye nezimali. Ukusebenzisa izinto zokubuyelelwa ezingcono ukukhiqiza izithombe ezifanele kakhulu zokwelapha. Ukwazi izinto ezizovela njengoba kuyindlela eqotho kanye neze ngokugqamisa ngokubonisa ngemibhalo ebonakala kahle. Ukubhekana nokugcina izithombe ezingangenwa muntu ngaphandle. Ukubuyelelwa ngobubele nokunakekelwa okuwumongo wegula ngokugcina ingqondo yokuzethemba. Ukwazi ukuxhumana kakhulu nabagulayo kanye nabasebenzi bempilo ukuba ucacise ulwazi olunamandla. Ukwazi ukulawula imisebenzi yasekhaya ngokulandela imithetho yomnyango. Ukuba nenhlanhla yokwakha umbhalo we-Ultrasound. Ukubandakanyeka emagunjini omnyango. Ukulandela imithetho yokugcina isikhundla.

Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwi-Ultrasound Radiography malunga nabasebenzi abagqibiliweyo base-RSA. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-11 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwi-Ultrasound Radiography malunga nabasebenzi abagqibiliweyo ngaphandle, abo akaqaliweyo ukwenza i-Community Service, njengoko kufunekwa e-South Africa. Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwi-Ultrasound Radiography malunga nabasebenzi abagqibiliweyo base-RSA. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-21 yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwi-Ultrasound Radiography malunga nabasebenzi abagqibiliweyo ngaphandle, abo akaqaliweyo ukwenza i-Community Service, njengoko kufunekwa e-South Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqhuba (code B/EB) esebenzayo. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/akhono): Imfundo ebanzi ye-sonography namava amaninzi okusebenza ngawo, nongqinelisano oluthile kwamava e-ultrasound ezokuzalwa nasezomzimba wabasetyhini, abonisa inkqubela eqinileyo ekukhuleni koprofeshonal nakuqeqesha impilo yonke ngefundo ephakamileyo, uphononongo, noqeqesho labasebenzi. Kufunekwe ukuqonda okujulileyo ngokwakheka komzimba walo mntu, kunye nolwazi ngezonyango ezichaphazela ulwakhiwo lomzimba njengoko zidityaniswe nemithelela ye-sonography. Kufunekwe isithembiso kwenkqubo yomaxa ngamaxa egazi, ukugcina ixhesha lomntu liyimfihlo, izimbo zoprofeshonal, nokuqinisekisa unako ukulawula isithwaxa esikhulu somsebenzi wekliniki nolawula iimeko ezinzima ngokuzolileyo. Ikhono eliqinileyo lokusebenzisana kakuhle nomntu onegazi kunye nabasebenzi bezonyango, ngokucacileyo okuchaza iinkcukacha ezobuchwepheshe kwaye nasekusebenzisaneni kulunyango lwegazi elikliniki. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezisisiseko nasekusetyenzisweni kweendlela zokurhweba. Ukuza kumbhalo ongqonge nokuchaza ngemigaqo yokuphonononga i-ultrasound kunye nokuqwalasela ulondolozo lweerekhodi, nakulondolozo kwazo. Ukuze uthathe isigqibo sokuziphendulela kulunyango lwendawo ye-ultrasound (ukusebenza, ukutshekha umgangatho, nokolondolozo) ngokujwayelekileyo kwisebe. Inkonzo yekliniki ekuqamaniswa neendlela zolawulo zesebe ngokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo koluntu lemali nethemba. Isidanga sokufunda esingezantsi: Isigaba esisisiseko se-R425 (eyona yidiploma/idigri kwizolunyango) okanye isigaba esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengesiNesi seProfeshonal. Isigaba esingaphezulu kwesiseko, ngesikhathi sobuncinane be-minyaka el-1 idiploma, kwisayensi yezolunyango zeKliniki: Iqwalaselo Lorenzima, Ulunyango noLunyingo, egqitywe kwi-SANC (R 48) OKANYE idigri yeminyaka emi-4 (R174) okanye isigaba esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengesiNesi seProfeshonal. Idiploma yesidanga saphezulu (R635) egqitywe kwi-SANC kwi-Primary Care Nursing. Ukubhalisa kwi council yabaprofeshonal: Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwi-South African Nursing Council njengesiNesi seProfeshonal. Isipilingo: Grade 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-4 yamava afanelekileyo / aqakableyo kwezonyango emva kokubhalisa njengesiNesi seProfeshonal kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-14 yamava afanelekileyo / aqakableyo kwezonyango emva kokubhalisa njengesiNesi seProfeshonal kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yexesha elichaziweyo ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo / aqakableyo emva kokufumana idiploma yeminyaka el-1 yesigaba esingaphezulu kwesiseko okanye idiploma yesidanga saphezulu kwigatya elifanelekileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqhuba esebenzayo (Code B/EB). Ukulungelelaniswa ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kufuneka. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/akhono): Uqeqesho okanye amava kwi-NIMART. Iakhono ezisisiseko zekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook. Ulwazi ngemithetho nayeendlela ezalulelekileyo ze-Department of Health Western Cape. Iakhono zokunxibelelana (ezibhalwayo nangomlomo).
xh.duties: Ukwenza iqela elize ngokupheleleyo lezikeni zobukhulebearha kwezokuzalwa kwaye kwezomzimba wabasetyhini, kuquka iindlela eziqhelekileyo, i-level II/III, nokulinganisa ngezindlela ezize ngobuchwepheshe ngokuthobela iindciza zesebe nangokusetyenziswa okusebenzayo koluntu nemali. Ukusebenzisa inkqubo yobuchwepheshe yonxibelelwano ye-ultrasound yokukhulisa ukusondela nokuqonda ukukhanya okusesikeni, ukukhulisa izifundo zomzimba ezigqithisileyo. Ukuchonga iindaba eziqhelekileyo nangaziqhelekanga, nokuze necandelo elicacileyo elakhiweyo. Ukuthatha isigqibo ngokujayelekileyo ngolondolozo nokugcina iinkcukacha ezithunyelwe kwi-ultrasound. Ukunikela nolunyango lwezimilo, olumiselwe kwigazi, ngokuqinisekisa iindawo zokukhululeka nendima enhle yegazi kuyo yonke inkqubo yokukhulisa isiko. Ukugcina uqhagamshelo lolunyango ngokwenza iziko ulandelelo lezikeni kwaye unxibelelane neengcali zekliniki ezigqithisa kwi-Gqithisiyo. Ukulawula ukulawuleka nokukhulisa imali yegazi kwisandisi sezoxhobo ze-ultrasound ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yesebe. Ukwenza umsebenzi wekliniki ongaphezulu nasekuqaleni kwezindawo zokulinganisa nokulunga izinto. Ukuthobela iindawo zolawulo ezilungelelanisa imigaqo yesebe nokuqwalasela imida yokugcina iqondo elincinci lenkqubo yaseburhulumente. Ukugcina izinga elicacileyo lophando nolunyango ngokulinganisa izindawo ezize ngobuchwepheshe kwaye uphinde unikele ngolwazi. Ukwenza okusebenzayo nokunceda ekulawulweni kweekhompyutha ze-Curative Programmes ezalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomsebenzi, nokuba ngumchithi wegazi ukuze ukhulise inkonzo yolunyango oluluncedo. Ukwenza okusebenzayo nokunceda ekulawulweni kweekhompyutha ze-Child Health ezalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomsebenzi, nokuba ngumchithi wegazi ukuze ukhulise inkonzo yolunyango oluluncedo. Ukwenza okusebenzayo nokunceda ekulawulweni kweekhompyutha ze-Woman's Health Services ezalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomsebenzi, nokuba ngumchithi wegazi ukuze ukhulise inkonzo yolunyango oluluncedo. Ukwenza okusebenzayo nokunceda ekulawulweni kweekhompyutha ze-HAST programmes ezalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yomsebenzi, nokuba ngumchithi wegazi ukuze ukhulise inkonzo yolunyango oluluncedo. Ukunikela ngokusebenzayo ngenkonzo yekliniki egqibeleleyo equkwa ngenkqubo yemveliso nengqiqo ekuzameni ukulunga kwazo zonke iindawo zekliniki.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 to 2 (PRIMARY Health
jobs.centre: Delft CHC (X1 Post) Fisantekraal CDC (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Two clinical nurse practitioner posts at primary health care facilities in the Western Cape, providing curative, child health, and chronic disease services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e., diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic qualification, with a duration of at least a 1-year diploma, in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, accredited with the SANC (R 48) OR a 4-year bachelor's degree in nursing (R174) OR equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A postgraduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A Minimum of 4 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A Minimum of 14 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the periods referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification as mentioned above. OR A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work after hours. Will be required to rotate within the facility. Competencies (knowledge/kills): NIMART training or experience. Knowledge and understanding of nursing Code of Ethics and Professional Practice of the SANC of nursing Standard of Practice and scope of practice. Computer literate in MS Office (Excel, Word and Power point) and MS Outlook.
jobs.duties: Treatment of patients on Primary Health Care level with regards to Curative Services, Communicable Diseases, Mental Health and Chronic Diseases within the scope of practice. Render effective child and school health services, including the integration of nutritional services, within the scope of practice. Render effective Women’s Health including Antenatal services within the scope of practice. Assist with management and execution of all relevant HAST Programmes (TB, STI and HIV/AIDS). Work as part of the multi-disciplinary team to ensure quality, promotive, preventive and curative Primary Health Care delivery. To be an advocate for patients to ensure the provision of quality Health Care necessary.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. S Zide Tel No: (021) 954-2237 (Delft CHC) / Ms N Forosi Tel No: (021) 826-2200 (Fisantekraal CDC)
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification: Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment Care or a post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 tot 2 (PRIMÊRE Gesondheid
af.summary: Twee kliniese verpleegpraktisyne poste by primêre gesondheidsorgfasiliteite in die Western Cape, wat kuratiewe, kinder-gesondheids- en chroniese siekte-dienslewering bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 'n 1-jaar diploma, in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap: Gesondheidassessering, Behandeling en Sorg, geakkrediteer by die SANC (R 48) OF 'n 4-jaar baccalaureusgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) OF ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorg-verpleging. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperke moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die een-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie soos hierbo genoem. OF 'n nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorg-verpleging. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om buite kantoorure te werk. Sal verplig wees om binne die fasiliteit te roteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): NIMART-opleiding of ervaring. Kennis en begrip van verpleegkode van Etiek en Professionele Praktyk van die SANC van verpleging se Standaard van Praktyk en omvang van praktyk. Rekenaargeletterd in MS Office (Excel, Word en Power point) en MS Outlook.
af.duties: Behandeling van pasiënte op Primêre Gesondheidsorg-vlak met betrekking tot Kuratiewe Dienste, Oordraagbare Siektes, Geestesgesondheid en Chroniese Siektes binne die omvang van praktyk. Lewer effektiewe kinder- en skoolgesondheidsdienste, insluitend die integrasie van voedingsdienste, binne die omvang van praktyk. Lewer effektiewe Vrouegesondheid insluitend Voorgeboortelike dienste binne die omvang van praktyk. Bystand met bestuur en uitvoering van alle relevante HAST-programme (TB, STI en MIV/VIGS). Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om kwaliteit, bevorderende, voorkomende en kuratiewe Primêre Gesondheidsorg-lewering te verseker. Wees 'n voorspraak vir pasiënte om die voorsiening van noodsaaklike gehalte-gesondheidsorg te verseker.

zu.title: Umqsazi Wezokwelapha Abayinikiwe Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (EzeMpilo Eyisiseko
zu.summary: Amasikhundla amabili oqsazi bezokwelapha abayinikiwe ezindaweni zempilo eyisiseko eWestern Cape, ahlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokwelapha, yempilo yabantwana, kanye nezifo ezingapheli.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezibalulekile kakhulu: Isidingo esiyisiseko se-R425 (okungukuthi, idiploma/iziqu kwezokunakekelwa kwesiguli) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 okanye R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengoGqaji Wezokunakekela Isiguli. Isidingo semuva kweziqu, ngesikhathi esingaphansi konyaka oyedwa wediploma, kweSayensi Yokunakekelwa Iziguli: Ukuvivinywa Kwezempilo, Ukunakekelwa Nokwelashwa, esevunyelwe yi-SANC (R 48) noma iziqu eziyisinkondwana emnyakeni we-4 wezokunakekela iziguli (R174) noma isidingo esilinganayo (R683 okanye R1497 noma R171 okanye R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengoGqaji Wezokunakekela Isiguli. Idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu (R635) evunyelwe yi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa ezindaweni eziyisiseko. Ukubhalisa ekubhungweni oqeqeshiwe: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqaji Wezokunakekela Isiguli. Isipili: Izinga 1: Ukuze ube neminyaka engu-4 okungenani ohambweni oluhambisana nalesikhundla noma esivelelwa ohlakaniphile emsebenzini wezokunakekelwa iziguli ngemuva kokubhalisa njengoGqaji Wezokunakekela Isiguli kwi-SANC kwezokunakekela ezijwayelekile. Izinga 2: Ukuze ube neminyaka engu-14 okungenani ohambweni oluhambisana nalesikhundla noma esivelelwa ohlakaniphile emsebenzini wezokunakekelwa iziguli ngemuva kokubhalisa njengoGqaji Wezokunakekela Isiguli kwi-SANC kwezokunakekela ezijwayelekile. Kufanele kube namakhulu ayi-10 okungenani ohambweni okushiwo ngenhla ohambisana nalesikhundla noma esivelelwa ohlakaniphile kohlobo oluthize lomsebenzi ngemuva kokuthola idiploma emnyakeni oyedwa esshiwo ngenhla. Noma Idiploma yesiqu esiphezulu (R635) evunyelwe yi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa ezindaweni eziyisiseko. Izidingo ezingokwalesikhundla: Ukubekezela ekusebenzeni ngemva kwezikhathi ezimisiwe. Uzodingeka ukushintsha ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwale ndawo. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuqeqeshwa noma isipili kwi-NIMART. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda Ikhodi Yokuziphatha Kwezokunakekela Iziguli kanye Nesekelwa Senkathi Esivela Kumthetho We-SANC mayelana Namazinga Okusebenza nomkhakazana wemisebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kufakelwe i-MS Office (Excel, Word kanye ne-Power point) kanye ne-MS Outlook.
zu.duties: Ukunakekelwa kwabagula ezingeni Lezempilo Ezisiseko mayelana Nemisebenzi Yokwelapha, Izifo Ezelusuleleka, Impilo Engqondweni Kanye Nezifo Ezingapheli ngaphakathi komkhakazana wemisebenzi. Ukunikeza ngempumelelo imisebenzi yempilo yabantwana nasesikoleni, okuhlanganisa nomsebenzi wokondleka ukudla, ngaphakathi komkhakazana wemisebenzi. Ukunikeza ngempumelelo imisebenzi yeMpilo Yabesifazane okuhlanganisa nezinkonzo zangaphambi kokubeletha ngaphakathi komkhakazana wemisebenzi. Ukusiza ekuphathweni nasekuqhubeni zonke izinhlelo ze-HAST ezihambisana nalezi (TB, STI kanye ne-HIV/AIDS). Ukusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elinezikhathi ezahlukahlukene ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuhlinzekwa ngemisebenzi ezingeni eliphezulu, ekhuthazayo, evikelayo nasekwelapheni mayelana Nezempilo Eziyisiselo. Ukuba ngumeli wabagala ukulondolozwa kwemfundo ekunikelwa ngayo imfudu emkhakazini wezokunakekela impilo.

xh.title: Ugqirha wezamalungu oqhoboshayo Onqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (EzoBomi eziNqabileyo
xh.summary: Amasithuba amabini ogqirha wezamalungu oqhoboshayo kumaziko ezempilo eziNqabileyo eWestern Cape, anika iinkonzo zokwelapha, ezempilo yabantwana, nezobuhlutyo bezifo.
xh.requirements: Iminyakazo yemfundo efunekayo: Iminyakazo yeR425 esiseko (oko kukuthi, idiploma/inqununuwo kukwezamalungu) okanye iminyakazo ezimerelayo (R683 engeR254) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengogqirha wezamalungu ozingelonqanaba. Iminyakazo ngaphezu kokesiseko, enesikhathi esingaphantsi konyaka wesekhondari, kwiClinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, evunyiwe kwiSANC (R 48) OKANE inqununuwo yeminyaka eli-4 kwezamalungu (R174) OKANYE iminyakazo ezimerelayo (R683 engeR1497 okanye R171 engeR1497) evumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengogqirha wezamalungu ozingelonqanaba. Isekhondari yengowunqunuluwo (R635) evunyiwe kwiSANC kwiPrimary Care Nursing. Ubhaliso koluntu lwabangcali: Ubhaliso kwiSANC njengogqirha wezamalungu ozingelonqanaba. Isipili: Inqanaba 1: Isipili esingaphantsi konyaka wonke kwimizuzu emine efanelekileyo / eqaqeke kwezamalungu emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezamalungu ozingelonqanaba kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Inqanaba 2: Isipili esingaphantsi konyaka wonke kwimizuzu eyishumi nane efanelekileyo / eqaqeke kwezamalungu emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha wezamalungu ozingelonqanaba kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka elishumi yexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka libe ngosipili olufanelekileyo / loqaqekileyo kwizinto ezithile ezigqithiswe ngaphandle emva kokufumana isekhondari yenyaka elinye ngaphezu kokesiseko njengoko kucatshuliwe ngasentla. OKANYE Isekhondari yengowunqunuluwo (R635) evunyiwe kwiSANC kwiPrimary Care Nursing. Iminyakazo yomkhakha wekwindla ephilayo: Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngemiyalelo yasemva kwesixa. Uza kufuneka ajikeleze ngaphakathi kwesikhululo. Iimfuno zobuchule (ulwazi/izakhono): uKumava okanye uKwaziswa kukaNIMART. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNqununuwo yeNguquko yolwimi ngokuziphatha ngokomthetho wezamalungu kanye noQeqesho lomakhulu wokuSebenza lweSANC lwamathuba okuqeqeshwa ngobubanzi bokuqeqeshwa. Ukuqonda ngokusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha kwiMS Office (Excel, Word nePower point) kanye neMS Outlook.
xh.duties: Unyango lwabagulwa kumanqanaba ezoBomi eziNqabileyo ngokwale Nzyme yokwamkeleka, uluntu olusuleleke, iMental Health ngeeZifo ezihlubulukayo ngaphakathi kweNdlela yokusebenza. Inikela ngenkonzo ezibalulekileyo yezempilo yabantwana nasesikolweni, kuquka nezempilo yokutya, ngaphakathi kweNdlela yokusebenza. Inikela ngexesha elisebenzayo leMikhakha kaBantu ngeenkonzo zokuqonda iMikhakha yokuHamba iNkonzo ngaphakathi kweNdlela yokusebenza. Nceda ngokulawula nangokuphumeza zonke iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zeHAST (TB, STI neHIV/AIDS). Usebenza njengenxalenyi yeqela elinabochwephesha abanengi ukuqinisekisa ukunikwa kweNkonzo eNqabileyo yeZoBomi eziNqabileyo ngokugqibeleleyo, ngokukhuthaza, ngokuthintela nangokwamkela ukuNyangwa. Ukuba ngumlawuli ngokomthetho wabagulwa ukuze uqinisekise ukunikwa kwezempilo ezibalulekileyo ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Mental Health)
jobs.centre: Khayelitsha CHC, Nomzamo CDC, Mental Health Roving Team (ACT) and Mfuleni CDC, Khayelitsha/ Eastern Sub-structure
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed to provide mental healthcare across Khayelitsha and Eastern sub-structure facilities, with duties including clinical care and community development support.
jobs.requirements: minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience in Psychiatry after obtaining the one- year post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal and communication skills. Computer literate (Microsoft Office). Knowledge of and insight into relevant legislation and policies related to mental illness. Ability to consult with clients who require mental health counselling.
jobs.duties: Actively participate in the clinical duties and nursing care to Mental Health patients within the Sub-structure. Provide support and capacity development to PHC personnel for Sub-structure level services and students and peers. Promote community development and participation in mental healthcare delivery. Liaise with other role players. Utilization of resources within the sub- structure. Conduct research related to mental health and service delivery.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Geestelike Gesondheid)
