af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/grade in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakrediteer is in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OF 'n 4 jaar Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakrediteer is in Mental Health Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Psigiatrie wees na verkryging van die eenjaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goëie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardig (Microsoft Office). Kennis van en insig in toepaslike wetgewing en beleide rakende geestelike siektes. Vermoë om kliënte wat geestelike gesondheidsberading benodig, te raadpleeg.
af.duties: Neem aktief deel aan die kliniese pligte en verpleegsorg aan Geestelike Gesondheidspasiënte binne die Sub-struktuur. Verskaf ondersteuning en kapasiteitsontwikkeling aan PHC-personeel vir sub-struktuurvlakdienste en aan studente en portuurlyke. Bevorder gemeenskapsontwikkeling en deelname aan geestelike gesondheidsorglewering. Skakel met ander rolspelers lid. Benutting van hulpbronne binne die sub-struktuur. Voer navorsing uit wat verband hou met geestelike gesondheid en dienslewering.

zu.title: U nesesi Ochwepheshe Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (UKHETHE: Impilo Yengqondo)
zu.summary: Kudingeka unesesi ochwepheshe ukuthi ahlinzeke ngokunakekela impilo yengqondo kulo onke amasikhungo ase Khayelitsha nasemagatsheni ase-Eastern, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kokwelapha nokusekela intuthuko yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zezimali ezingaphansi: Ithifikheyithi le-R425 elisisisekelo (okt. idiploma/idigri enesayensi yokunakekela) noma iziqu ezingalinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R880) ezivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba unesesi Ochwepheshe. Iziqu zesayensi yokunakekela ngemva kweziqu eziyisisekelo ezingaphezu kosuku olungu-1 ezagunyaziwe kwiSANC kwiSayensi Yokwelapha Esibambe Isikhathi Eside (R212). Noma Idigri yesi-4 eFunda inesayensi yokunakekela (R174) noma iziqu ezingalinganayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) ezivumela ukubhalisa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba unesesi Ochwepheshe. Idiploma yesayensi yokunakekela ngemva kweziqu (R635) esagunyaziwe yiSANC ekunakekelweni kwezimpilo zengqondo. Ukubhalisa kubungekelo bachwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kuSANC njengesesi Ochwepheshe. Isipiliyangi: Izinga 1: Ukwenzela okungaphezu kweminyaka engu-4 ukugunyaza / ukuphawula isipiliyangi esifanelekile ekunakekelweni kwezimpilo ngemva kokubhalisa njengesesi Ochwepheshe kuSANC ekunakekelweni Okuvamile. Izinga 2: Ukwenzela okungaphezu kweminyaka engu-14 ukugunyaza / ukuphawula isipiliyangi esifanelekile ekunakekelweni kwezimpilo ngemva kokubhalisa njengesesi Ochwepheshe kuSANC ekunakekelweni Okuvamile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yezikhathi ezithunyelwe ngenhla kufanele ibe ngumzamo ophawulekayo / ovunyelwe ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo ngemva kokuqeda isiqu samnyaka owodwa ngemva kweziqu eziyisisekelo ekwelapheni isifo sengqondo. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (Ikhodi B/EB). Amandla (ulwazi / amakhono): Amakhono amahle wokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuqondana. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Ulwazi neqonda ngezomthetho nezinqumo ezihlobene nesifo sengqondo. Ikono lokuxoxa nabantu abadinga usizo ngengqondo.
zu.duties: Ukubamba inxaxheba ngokuzimisela emisebenzini yokunakekelwa kokwelapha kanye nokuqondisa iziguli eziyingozi ezinokugula kengqondo ngaphakathi kwesigaba esingaphansi. Ukunikeza inkundla nokuthuthukiswa kwekhono abantu abahlinza ngokwemisebenzi yezigaba ezingaphansi kwezinsiza zikahulumeni ukwenzela imisebenzi yezigaba ezingaphansi kanye nabafundi nabanumzane. Ukukhuthaza intuthuko yomphakathi nokuthatha inxaxheba ekulethweni kwezinsiza zezempilo zengqondo. Ukuxhumana nabanye abadlali indima. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngaphakathi kwesigaba esingaphansi. Ukwenza ucwaningo oluhlobene nempilo yengqondo nokulethwa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Ukungenzi kweMisebenzi Gadi 1 ukuya kwi-2 (ISIMAMBA: Impilo yengqondo)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ugqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo ongomsebenzi ophatha iimpilo ezithile ezinikezela ngenkcubeko yempilo yengqondo kumaziko eKhayelitsha nasemazantsi ohlolojio, kunye nemisebenzi equka ukhathalelo lwekliliki kunye nenkxaso yophuhliso loluntu.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinane bemfuno yemfundo: Isiqinisekiso seR425 esisisiseko (okt. idiploma/idigri kukhathalelo lwamakazi) okt isiqinisekiso esilinganayo (iR683 ngeR880) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo. Isiqinisekiso se-post-basic kakhathalelo lwamakazi ngexesha elinganganye iminyaka elingu-1 esamkelwe yiSANC kwi-Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OKT Idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka engama-4 ekukhathalelweni kwamakazi (R174) okt isiqinisekiso esilinganayo (iR171 ngeR1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo. I-post graduate diploma (iR635) esamkelwe yiSANC ekukhathalelweni iMental Health Nursing. Ukubhalisa kolwazi olunenkqayi: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengogqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo. Ikwile ndalo: Inqanaba le-1: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-4 yendalo efanelekileyo/eqinisekiswayo ekukhathalelweni kwamakazi emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo kwiSANC ekukhathalelweni i-General Nursing. Inqanaba le-2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-14 yendalo efanelekileyo/eqinisekiswayo ekukhathalelweni kwamakazi emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha wokhathalelo lweempilo kwiSANC ekukhathalelweni i-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-10 kwelixesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka kube yindalo efanelekileyo / eqinisekiswayo kwi-Psychiatry emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso se-post-basic seminyaka eliyi-1 kwi-Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Amandla okuyazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabaliseleyo okuchaza nothetha nabantu. Ukuba nokuziqhelanisa ngekhompyutha (iMicrosoft Office). Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho nengodinga ezibalulekileyo ezinxulumene nesifo sengqondo. Amandla okubuzana nabathengi abadinga uncedo olulumkisa ngempilo yengqondo.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kwimisebenzi yekliniki nakukhathalelwa amakazi abaguli iMental Health ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esingaphantsi. Nikeza inkxaso nophuhliso lamandla kubasebenzi be-PHC kwinkonzo yasesakhiweni esingaphantsi nakumafundiswa nakwahlobo. Khuthaza uphuhliso loluntu nolunga-thatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yokunikezela nkqubo yempilo yengqondo. Chitha ngeentshaba-abadlali. Ukusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esingaphantsi. Qhuba uphononongo ngempilo yengqondo ngenkonzo yokunikezela inkqubo.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional nurse needed at Valkenberg Hospital to provide specialised psychiatric nursing care, requiring a basic nursing qualification and post-basic qualification in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent Requirements of the job: Willingness to perform shiftwork, rotation in night duty and over weekends/public holidays. It will be required of the incumbent to rotate within the hospital. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and experience of Community Mental Health at PHC level. Good interpersonal, planning, and organisational skills. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel & Outlook) Knowledge of the Mental Health Care Act, Child Care Act, Nursing Act and other relevant legislation.
jobs.duties: Provide optimal, holistic specialized psychiatric nursing care within set standards and professional/legal framework. Effective utilization of human, financial and physical resources (equipment and consumables). Participation in appropriate personal /professional development activities: Self, students, other categories of staff. Ensure efficient and accurate documentation, statistical data collection capturing and participation in research activities. Assist with the development and the implementation of nursing quality improvement plans, policies and standard operating procedures.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Geestelik, Akuut
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige benodig by Valkenberg Hospital om gespesialiseerde psigiatriese verpleegsorg te verskaf, wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie en 'n na-basiese kwalifikasie in Gevorderde Psigiatriese Verpleegkunde vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.i. Diploma/Graad in Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OF 'n 4 jaar Bachelorsgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Inherent vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofwerk te doen, rotasie in nagskof en oor naweke/openbare vakansiedae. Daar sal van die ampsdraer verwag word om binne die hospitaal te roteer. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel & Outlook). Kennis van die Mental Health Care Act, Child Care Act, Nursing Act en ander tersaaklike wetgewing.
af.duties: Verskaf optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde psigiatriese verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde en professionele/regtelike raamwerk. Effektiewe benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne (toerusting en verbruiksgoedere). Deelname aan toepaslike persoonlike/professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite: Self, studente, ander kategorieë personeel. Verseker doeltreffende en akkurate dokumentasie, statistiese data-insameling en -vaslegging en deelname aan navorsingsaktiwiteite. Bystaan met die ontwikkeling en implementering van verpleegkwaliteitsverbeteringsplanne, beleide en standaardbedryfsprosedures.

zu.title: Unesi Osezingeni Elikhulu 1 kuye kweli-2 (ISIKHWETO: Okwengqondo, Okusheshayo
zu.summary: Kudingeka unesi ochwepheshele e-Valkenberg Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kunesi okukhethiwe kokwengqondo, okudinga iziqu eziyisisekelo zokuba unesi kanye neziqu ezibhekise ngemva kwesisekelo e-Ukwazi Okuphakeme mayelana Nesayensi Yokunakekela Okwengqondo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezincane zemfundo: Iqualifying R425 eziyisisekelo (okungukuthi iziqu zeDiploma/Degree ekuNesweni) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R880) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi Ochwepheshele. Isiqu sokunesi esibhekise ngemva kwesisekelo esibude obunganisidi yunyaka osungunemvume kwi-SANC ekuKwazweni Okuphakeme Mayelana Nesayensi Yokunakekela Okwengqondo (R212). Noma Iziqu ze-Bachelor Degree ezinde iminyaka eyi-4 ekuNesweni (R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi Ochwepheshele. I-diploma yesiqu esibhekise ngemva kwesisekelo (R635) enemvume kwi-SANC ekuNakekeleni Kwempilo Yengqondo. Ukubhaliswa kubhodi yochwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoNesi Ochwepheshele. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ekuNesweni ngemva kokuqashwa njengoNesi Ochwepheshele kwi-SANC ekuNakekeleni Okujwayelekile. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-14 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ekuNesweni ngemva kokuqashwa njengoNesi Ochwepheshele kwi-SANC ekuNakekeleni Okujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo ngemva kokuthola isiqu sokunesi esibhekise ngemva kwesisekelo esinde unyaka eyodwa noma i-diploma yesiqu esibhekise ngemva kwesisekelo esikhethekile. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi yokushintshashintsha, ukujikeleza emsebenzini wabusuku nangaphezulu kwamasonto/iholide zomphakathi. Kuzodingeka kusuke kwenzakale ukujikeleza ngaphakathi kwe-hospital. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombo): Ulwazi nesipiliyoni mayelana Nemphilo Yengqondo Yomphakathi ezingeni le-PHC. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, okuhlela, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukubhaliswa kwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel & Outlook). Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezokunakekela Impilo Yengqondo, uMthetho Wezokunakekela Izinsana, uMthetho Wezokunesi kanye namanye omunye umthetho ohlobene.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okugcwele, okukhethiwe kakhulu kokwengqondo ngaphakathi kwezindinganiso ezihleliwe nesikhungko esichwepheshe/omthetho. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zabantu, ezezimali nezenzakalo (izinguxa nokuthengiswa). Ukubandakanyeka kumasebenzi okuthuthukisa okufanele komuntu/ochwepheshe: Ukuzenzela, abafundi, kanye nalelother abantu. Qinisekisa ukubhaliswa okusebenzayo kanye nesibalo, ukuqoqa imininingwane futhi ukubandakanyeka emisebenzini yokupenya. Siza ngokuqamba futhi ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuphucula izinga lokunesi, izinqubomgomo kanye nezenqubo eziyisiso ezihlala zisebenza.

xh.title: Umongameli weGazi ongwam 1 ukuya kwi-2 (ISIKHUMZO: Ekhayithayo, Ebulunge
xh.summary: Kufuneki umongameli wegazi eValkenberg Hospital ukunika inyango elibhekisa kuko kukhazimla lwegazi lenkathazo, kwaye kufuneka anelise isikhulumi sobugcisa begazi kwaye athobe ngemfundo yada-phakathi kwisayensi yonyango lweGazi elibhekisa kuko kukhazimla.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisezantsi samava: Isikhulumi se-R425 (okt. iDiploma/iNqanaba ezingangeni eGazini) okanye esikulinganayo (R683 kwaye nge-R880) esivumela ubhaliso kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongameli weGazi. Isikhulumi sobugcisa sbhaliweyo isithuba esingonyanga odidi-1 ubuncinane esamkelwe yi-SANC kwiSayensi yoNyango lokuQhubela phambili lweGazi lenkathazo (R212). OKT INqanaba eyiMinyaka emi-4 yeBachelors kwiGazi (R174) okanye isikhulumi esikulinganayo (R171 kwaye nge-R1497) esivumela ubhaliso kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongameli weGazi. iDiploma yada-phakamileyo (R635) esamkelwe yi-SANC kwiNyango leMpilo yengqondo. Ubhaliso kwiNkqubo yamagazati abungcweti: Ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomongameli weGazi. Iimava: Inqanaba 1: Iminyaka emi-4 ubuncinane yamava alungileyo/avakalayo kwinnyango legazi emva kobhaliso njengomongameli weGazi kwi-SANC kwiNyango iNqanaba eliPhantsi (i-PHC). Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka emi-14 ubuncinane yamava alungileyo/avakalayo kwinnyango legazi emva kobhaliso njengomongameli weGazi kwi-SANC kwiNyango iNqanaba eliPhantsi (i-PHC). Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 lexa elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava alungileyo/avakalayo emva kokufumana isikhulumi sobugcisa sonyaka owodwa we-post-basic okanye i-post-graduate diploma kwikhandidethi ekhethekileyo. Iimfanelo ezingaphakathi zendlela yokusebenza: Ukuze ukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi weshithi, ukujikeleza kumsebenzi wabaphindi bayo nobungangeemini zakawonke-wonke/iintsuku zeholide. Kuya kufuneka osebenzayo ajikeleze ngaphakathi kwitholwa. Iinkcukacha-mbuso (olwazi/amehlo): Ulwazi namava ngoNyango leMpilo yobuPhila beHlabathi kwinqanaba le-PHC. IPostgraduate Diploma (R635) esivunyiwe kwiSANC kunkqubo yokunyusa abantu. Ukubhalisa kolwazi lwebhunga: Ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengengcali yokusiQhela. IGadi 2: Inani leminyaka elingaphantsi kwe-14 yokusebenza okufanelekileyo/okuqondakalayo kunkqubo yokusiQhela emva kokubhalisa kwiSANC njengengcali yokusiQhela kunkqubo jikelele. Inani leminyaka elingange-10 elikhankanywe ngasentla kumele libe ngumsebenzi ofanelekileyo/okuqondakalayo emva kokufumana isalathiso sokuthweswa isidanga emva kwesidanga sokusiQhela okanye i-post-graduate diploma kule nzulu lwazi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemithombo yolwazi (MS Word and Excel). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esezele. Iimfuneko (ulwazi/abatali): Iimpawu ezilungileyo zokuqhakamshelana, ukulatha abantu nolwazi lokusebenza ngemithombo yolwazi (MS Word & Excel). Ukuba nakho ukulatha iqela ukuze kuqiniseke inkcitha yemiba yempilo ehlanganiswe kwaye kusebenze ngokuzimela kwindlu egcwele iintlobo. Ukuba nakho ukulatha iqela kwimeko ezinguqukileyo zokuqamba. Ukubonisa ulwazi olunzulu ngeendaba zokusiQhela nangemithetho yinkonzo zoluntu. Ulwazi ngeendaba zabo bantu, nezemali kwaye nemigaqo yokwenza iinkonzo, nezikhokelo.

Ukusebenzisa okusebenzisekayo iindonga zemali kwisebe. Ukuqinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kweNkcitha yeNdalo, iNkqubo yokulawula iNtsholongwane nokuYivisa & uLawulo lweNtsholongwane namPhezu koluntu kwisebe. Ukuza ngenkxaso kwiNtsholongwane yeNdalo kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelana kwento ngemva kweyure.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Theatre)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum (plus, a non-pensionable rural allowance of 8% of the basic annual salary)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse required at Oudtshoorn Hospital to provide specialised theatre nursing care within the multidisciplinary team.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing (212). OR A 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Peri-operative Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Willingness to work overtime, after hours, weekends, standby duties and Public Holidays when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills. Supervisory skills and optimal utilisation of subordinates. Knowledge of operating theatre services within a hospital setting, occupational health/ staff wellness and principles of infection prevention and control. Ability to manage consumable resources effectively. Computer literacy (i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive specialized nursing care provided within a professional / legal framework. Participate with the multi-disciplinary team to provide holistic health care, provide good documentation, care, planning and health education. To support and participate in clinical practice development initiatives, educational activities, and research. Effective utilization of human and financial resources. Provide support services to Supervisor and Nursing division.
jobs.enquiries: Mr CB Olivier Tel No: (044) 203 -7203/ 7344
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical/written and oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification or post graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Teater)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige benodig by Oudtshoorn Hospital om gespesialiseerde teaterverpleegsorg binne die multidissiplinêre span te verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/Grade in Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar geakkrediteer by die SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing (212). OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Peri-operative Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteitsrigting. Inherent vereistes van die pos: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, na ure, naweke, wagdienste en Openbare Vakansiedae wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Toesighoudende vaardighede en optimale benutting van ondergeskiktes. Kennis van teaterdienste binne 'n hospitaalopset, beroepsgesondheid/personelwelsyn en beginsels van infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Vermoë om verbruikbare hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid (d.w.s. Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook).

Neem deel met die multidissiplinêre span om holistiese gesondheidsorg te verskaf, verskaf goeie dokumentasie, sorg, beplanning en gesondheidsopvoeding. Ondersteun en neem deel aan kliniese praktikumontwikkelingsinisiatiewe, opvoedkundige aktiwiteite en navorsing. Doeltreffende benutting van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan die toesighouer en Verpleegafdeling.

zu.title: Uhlelekile Onethi Wezinga 1 kuya ku-2 (IKHONO: I-Theatre)
zu.summary: Kudingeka uhlelekile onethi e-Oudtshoorn Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kwe-theatre onethi ngaphakathi kweqembu elisebenza emikhakheni eminingi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesidingo: Isiqu se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree kwi-Nursing) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa e-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Professional Nurse. Isiqu se-post-basic nursing esinwesikhathi esingaphezu konyaka wesikhathi esisodwa esemukelwe yi-SANC kwi-Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing (212). Noma i-Bachelor's degree yeminyaka eyi-4 kwi-nursing (R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 noma R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa e-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Professional Nurse. I-post-graduate diploma (R635) esemukelwe yi-SANC kwi-Peri-operative Nursing. Ukubhalisa kubhaliswa lweziqu: Ukubhalisa e-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni esingaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-4 esifanele/esoqashwayo kwi-nursing emva kokuqashwa njengo-Professional Nurse e-SANC General Nursing. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-14 esifanele/esoqashwayo kwi-nursing emva kokuqashwa njengo-Professional Nurse e-SANC General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube isipiliyoni esifanele/esoqashwayo emva kokuthola isiqu se-post-basic seminyaka eyi-1 noma i-post-graduate diploma ekhonweni elifanayo. Izidingo ezidlulele zomsebenzi: Ilayisense lokushayela (i-Code B/EB) esivumelekile. Ukuzethemba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile, ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza, ngeza nsuku, ukulinda umsebenzi kanye namaholide omphakathi lapho kudingeka khona. Ukuzwana nemikhuba (ulwazi/amasikhombisa): Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Amakhono okuphepha abasebenzi abangaphansi kahle nokusetshenziswa kwabo ngokugcwele. Ulwazi ngesevisi ye-operating theatre esibhedlela, impilo yomsebenzi/impilo yabasebenzi kanye nemigomo yokuvimbela nokulawula ukutheleleka. Ikhono lokuphatha izinsiza ezithathwayo ngempumelelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (okungukuthi i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okukhulu okukhethekile kwezonsomaphakathi nangaphakathi komthetho. Zihlanganyele eqenjini elisebenza emikhakheni eminingi ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwemfamo ngokuphelele, nikeza ukulandisa ngokuhle, ukunakekelwa, ukuhlela kanye nemfundo yezempilo. Sekela futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni izinhloso zemisebenzi yezempilo, imikhakha yemfundo, kanye nokucwaninga. Ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwabasebenzi nezinsiza zezimali. Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela uMphathi kanye nomnyango wezoNethekazi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGqwesileyo Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEBELE: IThiyetha)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umongikazi ogqwesileyo eOudtshoorn Hospital ukunika inkathazo yokongamela egqwesileyo kwithiyetha ngaphakathi kweqela elisebenza ngokubanzi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: I qualification ye-Basic R425 (okt. iDiploma/Degree kwiNursing) okanye i-equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi oGqwesileyo. I-post-basic nursing qualification ngobude bexesha elingangenyanga e-1 evunyiwe yiSANC kwi-Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Operating Theatre Nursing (212). OKanye i-4-year bachelor's degree nursing (R174) okanye i-equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) evumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoMongikazi oGqwesileyo. I-post-graduate diploma (R635) evunyiwe yiSANC kwi-Peri-operative Nursing. Ukubhalisa kwikhowuncilo yamagqala: Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoMongikazi oGqwesileyo. Impazamo: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka e-4 yamava ahambelana/avunwa kwinkathazo yokongamela emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqwesileyo kwiSANC kwii-General Nursing. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka e-14 yamava ahambelana/avunwa kwinkathazo yokongamela emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqwesileyo kwiSANC kwii-General Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka e-10 yexesha elikhankanywe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava ahambelana/avunwa emva kokuwufumana umgangatho we-1-year post-basic okanye i-post-graduate diploma kwisebe elihambelana. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zendalo yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, emva kwamaxa, ngeempelaveki, kumisebenzi wokulindela nangeentsuku zikaRhulumente xa kufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ethetho elilungileyo. Amakhono okulawula nokusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo abo bahleli ngaphantsi. Ulwazi ngamasebenzi ethiyetha ngaphakathi kwisibhedlele, impilo yomsebenzi/impilo yezisebenzi neemvisiswelo zokuthintela nokulawula infeksi. Ukubakho ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo izixhobo ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (okt. i-Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Kunika inkathazo yokongamela egqwesileyo ebanziyo enikezwa ngaphakathi kolwalamko olugqwesileyo / lomthetho. Kuthatha inxaxheba eqela elisebenza ngokubanzi ukunika inkathazo yempilo ebanziyo, kuphathwe amaxwebhu ngokulungileyo, ukulungisa iplani yokhathalelo nolwazi ngempilo. Ukuxhasa kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwizityhilli zophuhliso lomsebenzi wezoqeqesho, iindalo zophuhliso zemfundo, nophando. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo abantu nezixhobo zemali. Kunika iinkonzo zoxhaso kumLawuli naseqeleni leNursing.

Noma iziqu ze-Bachelor Degree zeminyaka eyi-4 bokuhlolwa kwabagulayo (R174) noma isiphawuli esilinganayo (R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kuSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe. Idiploma yeziqu eziphezulu (R635) esimemezelekile esibhalwe ku-SANC ekuhlolweni kwabagulayo bezeNgqondo. Ukubhaliswa kubhalwe ngabahlinzeki besebenzi: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni esingangaphansi kweminyaka engu-4 esifanelekile/esiyaziwayo ekuhloleni abagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe ku-SANC ekuhlolelweni abantu jikelele. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingangaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 esifanelekile/esiyaziwayo ekuhloleni abagulayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe ku-SANC ekuhlolelweni abantu jikelele. Isidingo esibangelwa umsebenzi: ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, ukusebenza amashemu emini nasebusuku, ngezonqamile, nangamaholide abantu ukwanelisa izidingo zokusebenza. Kuzomele ukuthi umuntu othathiwe ajikeleze ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): amandla okuxhumana nabantu ngokusebenziseka kanye namakhono okusebenza nabantu. Abaqondiswe ekufezeni amagciselo abaphathi kanye nemigomo yeqoqo labagulayo bezeNgqondo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha emaphakheji we-MS (i-Word, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa okuphumelelayo, okuqukethwe ngokuphelele kokuhlolwa kwabagulayo bezeNgqondo ngaphakathi kwezindinganishiyo ezithi shut together njengomhlengikazi ochwepheshe ngaphansi kwezindinganishiyo nezinkambu zomsebenzi/ezomthetho. Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemali yezandla, nezinsizakusebenza nezenhluzo. Ukubamba iqhaza ezinkambini ezifanelekile zentuthuko yobuqu/yobuchwepheshe: uzikho, abafundi, kanye nohlobo olungawo lwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuqashelwa okuphelele kwegama, ukuqoqa imininingwane emibalabala, ukuyibhala kanye nokuqoqa imininingwane ephathelene nokuba yingxenye yocwaningo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni nasekuqaleni ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphucula izinga le-Administration and Nursing, amapholisi kanye nemigomo yokusebenza ephanayinganisile.

Effektiewe interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Wees goed ingelig oor die South African Triage Scale (SATS) en Emergency Nursing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaargeletterdheid (d.w.s. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook).
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg binne 'n professionele/wettige raamwerk. Neem deel met die multidissiplinêre span om holistiese gesondheidsorg te verskaf, verskaf goeie dokumentasie, sorg, beplanning en gesondheidsopvoeding. Ondersteun en neem deel aan inisiatiewe vir kliniese praktykontwikkeling, opvoedkundige aktiwiteite en navorsing. Effektiewe implementering van infeksiebeheerbeleid en gesondheids- en veiligheidswetgewing. Effektiewe benutting van menslike en finansiële hulpbronne. Neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegdepartement. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan Supervisor en verpleegafdeling.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Ohloniphekile Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (ISIKHUNZI: I-Trauma
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhlengikazi ohloniphekile osezimweni zokwelapha izilimalo kanye nokunakekelwa okubalulekile e-Oudtshoorn Hospital, enikeza inakekelo lezokwelapha elikhulu phakathi kweqembu elihlangene elinamakhono ahlukahlukene.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingavunyelwe ngaphansi kwalokhu: Isiqu esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu ezinhlobonhlobo kwezokunakekelwa) noma isiqu esilinganayo (u-R683 ohlangene no-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohloniphekile. Isiqu sokunakekelwa ngemva kwesiqu esiyisiseko ngokubamba isikhathi okungafika ngaphansi konyaka unyeka esamkelwe ngu-SANC kwezokunakekelwa okusesibhedlela kanye nesenzo sezokwelapha: Ukunakekelwa okubalulekile: Okujwayelekile noma iziendlalo ezisesibhedlela kanye nesenzo sezokwelapha: Ukunakekelwa okubalulekile: Izilimalo kanye Nezimo Eziphuthumayo. noma Iziqu ezingaba yiziqu zobudokotela ezinhlobonhlobo zokunakekelwa (u-R174) noma isiqu esilinganayo (u-R683 ohlangene no-R1497 noma u-R171 ohlangene no-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ngasemva kwe-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomhlengikazi ohloniphekile. Idiploma yesiqu samabanga aphezulu (u-R635) evunyiwe kwezokunakekelwa ezizimweni eziphuthumayo. Ukubhalisa kubhalisa ngesikhulu: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi ohloniphekile. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni esingangaphansi kweminyaka engu-4 esifanele/ esihlukisiswayo kwezokunakekelwa ngemva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohloniphekile kwi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esingangaphansi kweminyaka engu-14 esifanele/ esihlukisiswayo kwezokunakekelwa ngemva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ohloniphekile kwi-SANC kwezokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yaleso sikhathi esikhulumiwe ngenhla kufanele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/ esihlukisiswayo ngemva kokuthola isiqu sonyaka sokuqala esingemva kwesiqu esiyisiseko noma idiploma yesiqu samabanga aphezulu kuleso sikhundla. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense lokushayela (i-Code B/EB) elisebenzayo. Ukuzethemba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwezisindo, ngezikhitshana, imisebenzi yokulinda kanye Namasikhosini Okomphakathi lapho kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Kubonise ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho wezokunakekelwa kanye nokusebenza ngokomthetho nokuziphatha okufanele kwezokunakekelwa kanye nokuthi lokhu kuthinta kanjani ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Amakhono omuntu ngamunye okhona, aphambili, okuhlelwe kahle, okuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqonda kahle i-South African Triage Scale (SATS) kanye Nokunakekelwa Ezizimweni Eziphuthumayo. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle (okubalulekile nokubhaliwe). Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (okungukuthi i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook).
zu.duties: Nika inakekelo lokunakekelwa okukhethekile okuhleliwe okuhlinzekwe ngaphakathi kohlaka olungomthetho/ olusemthethweni. Thatha inxaxheba eqenjini elihlukahlukene lalamakhono ukuze uhlinzeke ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuphelele, uhlinzeke ngebhaladi elihle, ukweluleka kanye nezemfundo yezempilo. Ukusekela futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela zokusebenza ezisesibhedlela, izenzo zemfundo, kanye nokucwaninga. Ukuze kusetshenziswe ngokusebenzayo imithethonqondo yokulawula ukutheleleka kanye nomthetho wezempilo kanye nokuphepha. Ukuqashelwa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zabantu nezimali. Thatha inxaxheba ekugadeni, ekuqondiseni ukuthuthukiswa kwaye ocwaningweni ngaphakathi kumnyango wezokunakekelwa. Hlinzeka ngamasevisi okusekela ongumqondisi kanye nokuqhutshwa komnyango wezokunakekelwa.

xh.title: Umongikazi ophumeleleyo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEPEYILI: Icala kunye
xh.summary: Kufuneka umongikazi ophumeleleyo wonyulo lwecalà kunye nonyulo lwonakele kwiSibhedlele i-Oudtshoorn, kunika onyulo lwezilozo ezikhethekileyo kulo qela elisebenza ngokubambisana.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwemilinganiselo: Isifundo esiyisisiseko i-R425 (okt i-diploma/isidanga kumanyuzo) okt isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kwaye nge-R254) esivumela ubhaliso kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo. Isifundo sokwakuthi kumanyuzo ngesithuba esingaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-1 ubudala ubhalisiwe kwi-SANC kuzifundo zesiZulu nesíbâlo sómzimba: Unyulo lónakele: Jikelele okt izifundo zesiZulu nesíbalo sómzimba: Unyulo lónakele: Icala nobungeno obukhawulezayo. okt Isidanga se-4 kwamanyuzo (i-R174) okt isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kwaye nge-R1497 okt i-R171 kwaye nge-R1497) esivumela ubhaliso kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo. I-post-graduate diploma (i-R635) ebhalisiwe kwiZifundo zokuNgengiswa kwiZigulo ezikwingozí. Ubhaliso koludwi olungenisa isigwegwe: Ubhaliso kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo. Isipiliśongaka: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-4 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo ekunyulezweni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo nge-SANC kwiZifundo eZijikelezi. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-14 yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo ekunyulezweni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo nge-SANC kwiZifundo eZijikelezi. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 kule minyaka éthethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo emva kokufumana isifundo snyanga enye sokwakuthi okt i-post-graduate diploma kwisipeyili ethintelwe. Iimfúno ezíngaphakathi kwesithuba: Ilayisenisi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB) eseyile. Ulwelo yokusebenza ngeyure ezongezelelweyo, iintsuku zoweekendi, imisebenzi yokulindileyo kwaye ngezoNgcibelelo zeSizwe xa kufuneka. Ukuzinika (ulwazi/izikl): Tyhila kuqondelelo okusezantsi ngomthetho wezōngikazi nemithetho ehlobene nayoo nemithetho yenkqubo yamakhaladi nendlela ecebisa ngayo unikezelo lwenkonzo. Isipiliśongaka esísébenzayo kubantu, kobukhosi, yolulmo, womqobo wezigqibo nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukuva kobugcisa bobuncwadi buya kwi-South African Triage Scale (SATS) nakwiZifundo zokuNgengiswa kwiZigulo ezikwingozí. Amakhono athile wobuqhawe (ngomlomo nakubhalo). Ukuxhathisa kwi-computer (kt i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook).
xh.duties: Nika onyulo olubanzi lwezilozo obunikelwa ngaphakathi kwenkqubo yomsebenzi ophumeleleyo / omthetho. Thabatha inxaxheba ngeqela elisebenza ngokubambisana kumacandé amaniní ukunika onyulo jikelele lwempilo, nika ubuncwadi obutle, uqhubekele phambili kwaye ufunde ngempilo. Xhasa kwaye uthabathe inxaxheba kwizifundo zokwakhíwa ngokwemisebenzi yobugcisa, izinto zemfundo, noluphando. Usetyenziso oluphumeleleyo lwemithetho yokulawula igangató nobungozi bemithetho yempilo. Usetyenziso oluphumeleleyo wophando lobuqu nobugcisa bezimali. Thabatha inxaxheba ekulungenisweni, ekuveliseni nasekuphandweni ngaphakathi kwesebe lezōngikazi. Nika iinkonzo zoxhaso kuMlawuli naseQeleni lezōngikazi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Labour Relations
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Labour Relations position in the Western Cape Department of Health, coordinating collective bargaining forums and representing the employer at bargaining councils.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent in Human Resource Management or Labour Law or Labour Relations. Experience: Appropriate experience in Labour Relations, with specific reference to the collective bargaining sector, in the Public or Private Sector. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code (B/EB) driver’s license and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal, planning, organising skills and conflict management skills. Ability to think analytically and the ability to resolve problems. Bargaining skills and knowledge of collective bargaining structures and processes. Understanding of service delivery within essentials services sector and strike management. Investigative and presiding knowledge and skills in respect of disciplinary matters/hearings. Dispute resolution skills and knowledge Computer Literacy in Ms Office Skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate all administrative and logistical functions relating to the PHSDSBC, CCPWC forums, other collective bargaining structures and all relevant task teams, and committees emanating from it. Represent the employer at all relevant bargaining council’s, chambers and meetings. Monitoring and evaluation of Institutional Management and Labour Committees (IMLC’s) within the Department of Health and Wellness. Draft and present reports to management relating to all collective bargaining matters. Manage and co-ordinate any industrial action within the Department. Management of discipline and grievances when required. Represent the employer at conciliation and arbitration hearings. Management of employees within the sub-directorate. Conduct and facilitate relevant labour relations training.
jobs.enquiries: Mr FB Van Rooyen Tel No: (021) 831-58655 / Francios.VanRooyen@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge-pos in die Western Cape Department of Health, wat koördinering van kollektiewe onderhandelingsforums behoord en die werkgewer by onderhandelingsrade verteenwoordig.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of gelykwaardig in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of Arbeidsreg of Arbeidsverhoudinge. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Arbeidsverhoudinge, met spesifieke verwysing na die kollektiewe onderhandelingssektor, in die Publieke of Privaatsektor. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige Kode (B/EB)-bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike, beplannings-, organisasievaardighede en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om analities te dink en die vermoë om probleme op te los. Onderhandelingsvaardighede en kennis van kollektiewe onderhandelingsstrukture en -prosesse. Begrip van dienslewering binne die noodsaaklike dienste-sektor en stakingsbestuur. Ondersoekende en voorsittende kennis en vaardighede ten opsigte van dissiplinêre sake/verhore. Skillegingskennis en -vaardighede vir geskilbeslegting. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Ms Office-vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer alle administratiewe en logistieke funksies met betrekking tot die PHSDSBC, CCPWC-forums, ander kollektiewe onderhandelingsstrukture en alle relevante taakspanne, en komitees wat daaruit voortvloei. Verteenwoordig die werkgewer by alle relevante onderhandelingsrade, kamers en vergaderings. Monitering en evaluering van Institutional Management and Labour Committees (IMLC's) binne die Department of Health and Wellness. Opstel en voorlegging van verslae aan bestuur met betrekking tot alle kollektiewe onderhandelingssake. Bestuur en koördineer enige industriële optrede binne die Departement. Bestuur van dissipline en griewens wanneer vereis. Verteenwoordig die werkgewer by konsiliasie- en arbitrasieverhore. Bestuur van werknemers binne die sub-direktoraat. Voer uit en fasiliteer toepaslike arbeidsverhouding-opleiding.

zu.title: Onozimele: Izinqubo Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnozimele: Izinqubo Zabasebenzi kuMnyango Wezempilo eWestern Cape, ohlela amafikithi ezinkulumompikiswano zokuhlanganisa futhi emele umqashi emabhodini enkulumompikiswano.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kuye: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF 6) efanelekile noma okulingana nayo kokuPhathwa KweZinsiza Zabantu noma uMthetho Wabasebenzi noma Izinqubo Zabasebenzi. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanelekileso kuzo Izinqubo Zabasebenzi, ngokubhekisele ikakhulukazi kwingxenye yenkulumompikiswano zokuhlanganisa, kwisekithi Yomphakathi noma YobuSoma. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqasha esemthethweni leKodi (B/EB) kanye nesifiso sokuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amashebo): Amashebo mahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nakubhalwa. Amashebo aqinile okuzwana nabantu, ukuhlela, ukuqamba izinhlelo nakuphathwa kwezingxabano. Ikhono lokucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amashebo enkulumompikiswano nokwazi izakhiwo nokuqhubeka kwenkulumompikiswano zokuhlanganisa. Ukuqonda ukulethwa kwezinkonzo ngaphakathi kwisekithi yezinkonzo eziyisisekelo nakuphathwa kokushaya umgubho. Ulwazi namashebo okuphenya nokuhlala njengosihlalo ngokuqondene nezindaba/zinkululo zenyulwa. Amashebo okuxazulula izingxabano nokwazi ukuSebenzisa Ikhompyutha kwi-MS Office.
zu.duties: Qaphela futhi uhlele wonke amasevisi okuphathwa nendlela yokuhamba ehambisana ne-PHSDSBC, amafikithi e-CCPWC, ezinye izakhiwo zenkulumompikiswano zokuhlanganisa nawo wonke amaqembu emisebenzi ahambisanayo, kanye namakomidi aphuma kuyo. Mela umqashi kuzo zonke ibhodi zenkulumompikiswano ezifanelekile, izikamu namuhlangano. Ukulandelela nokuhlaziya AmaKomidi Okuphathwa Kwisekitha Nenhlangano Yabasebenzi (IMLC's) ngaphakathi kukaMnyango Wezempilo Nezempilo. Bhala futhi umbulele imibiko kubaphathi ehambisana nazo zonke izindaba zenkulumompikiswano zokuhlanganisa. Qaphela futhi uhlele noma yisiphi isenzo sabasebenzi ngaphakathi kuMnyango. Uphathwa kweNyulwa Nezikhulumi uma kudingeka. Mela umqashi kuzinkululo zokwaziswa nezomthetho wengxabano. Uphathwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweqophelo elingaphansi. Qhuba futhi uncede ngokufundisa izinqubo zabasebenzi ezifanelekile.

xh.title: Umcedisi weNkundla: IiNkcukacha ngoBudlelwane nabasebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMcedisi weQhankqalazo zoBudlelwane ngoBasebenzi kwisiKhalwe seNtshona eKolonisi kwiSebe lezeMpilo, lungelelanisa iindawo zokwabiwa koluntu nabasebenzi nokumela iqhawe kwiinkomityana zolwabiso.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esisezantsi semfundo: I-Diploma yeSizwe (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okuqapha ngayo kulungelelana koluntu nabasebenzi kwisebe loLawulo loLuntu. Izigqibo: Isigqibo esifanelekileyo kwimisebenzi ehamba nophando ngabasebenzi, ezizonkeledwa kwiinkqubo zokuziphatha, kuluntu koluntu namasebe apartheyido. Izinto ezingekoyo kumsebenzi: Amakhadi womnyhadala (B/EB) afanelekileyo kwaya kwindlela ngendlela, kwindawo yasendle nomchiza wobhadala. Ukuzinikelana koluntu nabasebenzi ezikolwa (ngolwazi/namava): Ukuzimisela kwimisebenzi ehamba namandla kwisixhobo somlomo, nokuqaqambisa imisebenzi nokuqokelelwa ngokulungelelana koluntu nabasebenzi. Amandla okubakela imisebenzi yabantu namandla okulawula ngokuchasene nabasebenzi.
xh.duties: Phepha zonke iinkqubo zolawulo nemisebenzi yokuhamba neendlela ezinxulumene namaPHSDSBC, namaCCPWC, nezinye iinkqubo zosethingo kolwabiso loluntu kunye naziphi na iinqcukumbana-misebenzi namakomiti aphuma kuzo. Mela iqhawe kuzo zonke iindawo zolwabiso oluchaseneyo, oonqamlezimvo nakwimihlangano. Ukuqwalasela nokulinganisa iKomiti zoLawulo zeSikhungo nezeBasebenzi (IMLC's) ngaphakathi kwisebe lezeMpilo loMnotho. Bhala uze ungenise iingxelo ekuqwalaselweni ezinxulumene zonke izinto ezimalana nolwabiso loluntu. Lawula uze ulungelelanise naliphi na isenzo sabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwiSebe. UkuLawulwa kobundlobongeli nokuqukunyabalwa kwezinxaxha xa kufuneka. Mela iqhawe kwimizuliswano nakwimibhalanisano yoxwebho. UkuLawulwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesiqulatho-esingaphantsi. Qhuba uze ulungelelanise imfundiso elifaneleyo yophando ngabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Clinical Technologist Grade 1 to 3 (PULMONOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Clinical Technologist in Pulmonology sought for Tygerberg Hospital to perform diagnostic procedures in pulmonology and critical care.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Clinical Technologist in Pulmonology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology in respect of RSA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology respect of SA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: After-hour’s service is compulsory. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills (verbal and written). Ability to work within a group at all levels of authority. Ability to work under pressure. Capable of maintaining confidentiality. Good computer skills in MS Word and MS Excel. Knowledge of ventilation and experience in Critical Care Area.
jobs.duties: Perform all diagnostic procedures in Pulmonology and Critical Care. Optimal Patient Care in Pulmonology able to do following investigations, Spirometry, Plethysmography, Gas Distribution, Exercise Testing, Compliance, NIOX, Provocation. Optimal Patient Care in Critical Care able to help with ventilation and haemodynamic monitoring. Training in Pulmonology according to ATS/ERS guidelines, Spirometry, Plethysmography, Gas Distribution, Exercise Testing, Compliance, NIOX, Provocation. Research with GCP.
jobs.enquiries: Mr F Swart Tel No: (021) 938-5789
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Clinical Technologist: Pulmonology with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Kliniese Tegnoloog Graad 1 tot 3 (PULMONOLOGIE)
af.summary: Kliniese Tegnoloog in Pulmonologie gesoek vir Tygerberg Hospital om diagnostiese procedures in pulmonologie en kritiese sorg uit te voer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog in Pulmonologie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Pulmonologie met betrekking tot buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Na-ure se diens is verpligtend. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om in 'n groep op alle vlakke van gesag te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. In staat om vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word en MS Excel. Kennis van ventilasie en ervaring in 'n Kritiese Sorg-omgeving.
af.duties: Voer alle diagnostiese procedures in Pulmonologie en Kritiese Sorg uit. Optimale pasiëntversorging in Pulmonologie in staat om die volgende ondersoeke te doen, Spirometrie, Plethysmografie, Gasverspreiding, Oefeningtoetse, Complyance, NIOX, Provokasie. Optimale pasiëntversorging in Kritiese Sorg in staat om met ventilasie en hemodinamiese monitering te help. Opleiding in Pulmonologie volgens ATS/ERS-riglyne, Spirometrie, Plethysmografie, Gasverspreiding, Oefeningtoetse, Complyance, NIOX, Provokasie. Navorsing met GCP.

zu.title: Umlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (PULMONOLOGY)

Ukubhalisa kubhaduni lokunakekelwa: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi ase-RSA. Unyaka o-1 wolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi angaphandle, okungadingekile ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoko kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi ase-SA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-11 yolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi angaphandle, okungadingekile ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoko kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi ase-SA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-21 yolwazi olufanele ngemva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomlobi wezobuchwepheshe wezokwelapha: Pulmonology mayelana namasevisi angaphandle, okungadingekile ukwenza isevisi yomphakathi njengoko kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibonakalayo somsebenzi: Isevisi yasemva kwamahola iyaphoqelelwa. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Amandla okuxhumana kahle (okuthiwayo nokubhalwayo). Isikhondo sokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu kuzo zonke izinga zegunya. Isikhondo sokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Isikhondo sokugcina imfihlo. Amandla kahle ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha kwi-MS Word naku-MS Excel. Ulwazi ngokuphefumula ngesisindo kanye nolwazi kwizindawo ezokunakekelwa okuphuthumayo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza zonke izinqubo zokuhlola ukugula kwi-Pulmonology nakwezokunakekelwa okuphuthumayo. Ukunakekelwa okuhlakaniphile kwesiguli kwi-Pulmonology, ukwazi ukwenza leziphenyo: i-Spirometry, i-Plethysmography, ukuqashelwa kwegesi, ukuhlolwa komzimba, ukuzwela, i-NIOX, nokuphazamiseka. Ukunakekelwa okuhlakaniphile kwesiguli kokunakekelwa okuphuthumayo, ukwasi ukusiza ngokuphefumula ngesisindo kanye nokuqapha ihaemodynamic. Ukugqiza i-Pulmonology ngokwesibekelo se-ATS/ERS: i-Spirometry, i-Plethysmography, ukuqashelwa kwegesi, ukuhlolwa komzimba, ukuzwela, i-NIOX, nokuphazamiseka. Ucwaningo ngokwe-GCP.

Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Inkonzo yemiyalelo ngemva kweyure ziyinyanzeliso. Iakhono (ulwazi/iakhono): Iakhono lokunxibelelana elilungileyo (elithethwayo neliqoshiweyo). Iakhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela kuzo zonke iinqanaba zolawulo. Iakhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Iakhono lokugcina iyimfihlo. Ukunakekelwa kweziguli okulungileyo kwiNyathelo elibalulekileyo akwazi ukuncedisa nokuphefumla nokuqaphela ihaemodynamic. Iqeqesho kwi-Pulmonology ngokwezikhokelo ze-ATS/ERS, i-Spirometry, i-Plethysmography, ukusabalwa kweGesi, ukuVavanywa koNyuko, i-Compliance, i-NIOX, i-Provocation. Uphononongo nge-GCP.

jobs.title: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (DIAGNOSTIC)
jobs.centre: Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, Rondebosch
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Diagnostic radiographer sought at Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital to provide paediatric imaging services including CT, fluoroscopy and digital radiography.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Diagnostic Radiography. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Diagnostic Radiographer. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Radiographer in Diagnostic Radiography in respect of RSA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Radiographer in Diagnostic Radiography in respect of SA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Radiographer in Diagnostic Radiography in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Render 40 - hours per week which includes after-hour services on weekends and night duty rotations as determined by the department. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Adhere to all departmental requirements and protocols. Knowledge of radiation protection, quality assurance and equipment safety. Provide paediatric radiography service independently and as part of a team. Knowledge of Digital Radiography imaging modalities and medical imaging workflow. Good computer skills (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Good interpersonal skills and perform effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Comply with National Core Standards requirements. Good time management. Knowledge of Picture Archiving and Communication Systems and Radiology Information Systems.
jobs.duties: Provide a radiographic service for paediatric patients and produce diagnostic images of high quality. Provide optimal patient care. Perform Imaging of paediatric patients in specialized areas. Perform CT Scan imaging, Digital Radiography, Fluoroscopy, Theatre, DR Mobiles, Panorex Imaging and Lodox. Optimal use and care of equipment and daily quality checks. Participate in personal, departmental and hospital in-service and training programs. Provide relief duty in absence of the colleagues and provide support to supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: Ms C Pietersen Tel No: (021) 658-5104
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Diagnostic Radiographer with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 (DIAGNOSTIES)
af.summary: Diagnostiese radiograaf gesoek by Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital om pediatriese beeldingsdienste te verskaf, insluitend CT, fluoroskopie en digitale radiografie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiograaf in Diagnostiese Radiografie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Diagnostiese Radiograaf. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Radiograaf in Diagnostiese Radiografie ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1-jarige relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante beroep (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Radiograaf in Diagnostiese Radiografie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante beroep (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Radiograaf in Diagnostiese Radiografie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die relevante beroep (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verlang word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Lewer 40 - ure per week wat buite-ure dienste op naweke en nagskof rotasies insluit soos deur die departement bepaal. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Hou aan alle departementele vereistes en protokolle. Kennis van stralingsbeskerming, gehalteversekering en toerustingveiligheid. Verskaf pediatriese radiografie diens onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span. Kennis van Digitale Radiografie beeldingsmodusse en mediese beeldingswerkvloei. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en tree doeltreffend op as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Voldoen aan National Core Standards vereistes. Goeie tydbestuur. Kennis van Picture Archiving and Communication Systems en Radiology Information Systems.
af.duties: Lewer 'n radiografiese diens vir pediatriese pasiënte en vervaardig hoë gehalte diagnostiese beelde. Verskaf optimale pasiëntsorg. Verrig beelding van pediatriese pasiënte in gespesialiseerde areas. Verrig CT Skandering, Digitale Radiografie, Fluoroskopie, Teater, DR Mobiele eenhede, Panorex Beelding en Lodox. Optimale gebruik en sorg van toerusting en daaglikse gehaltekontroles. Neem deel aan persoonlike, departementele en hospitaal indiens- en opleidingsprogramme. Verskaf aanvullingsdiens tydens afwesigheid van kollegas en bied ondersteuning aan toesighouer.

zu.title: Umuntu Othwebula Izifanekiso Ezingochweni Isikhundla Esinga 1 kuya ku-3 (UKUHLOLA)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni e Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukuthi anikeze izinsiza zokuthwebula izifanekiso zabantwana okuhlanganisa i-CT, i-fluoroscopy kanye nokuthwebula izifanekiso ngokwedijithali.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezincane zemfundo: Isidingo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni ekuhloleni izifanekiso. Ukubhalisa ekhomishini yezobuchwepheshe: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni ekuhloleni. Isiphiwo: Isikhundla 1: Asikho isiphiwo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni ekuhloleni mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-RSA. Isiphiwo esingeminyaka eyi-1 esihlobene emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA emsebenzini ohlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abadingekile ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengokuthiwa e-South Africa. Isikhundla 2: Isiphiwo esingeminyaka eyi-10 nangaphezulu esihlobene emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni ekuhloleni mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-SA. Isiphiwo esingeminyaka eyi-11 nangaphezulu esihlobene emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA emsebenzini ohlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abadingekile ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengokuthiwa e-South Africa. Isikhundla 3: Isiphiwo esingeminyaka eyi-20 nangaphezulu esihlobene emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomuntu othwebula izifanekiso ezingochweni ekuhloleni mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-SA. Isiphiwo esingeminyaka eyi-21 nangaphezulu esihlobene emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA emsebenzini ohlobene (lapho kusebenza khona) mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abadingekile ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengokuthiwa e-South Africa. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Nikeza amahora angu-40 ngesonto okuhlanganisa izinsiza emva kwamasikhathi nge zinsuku zokuphela kwesonto kanye nokujikeleza umsebenzi wabuhlulu njengokuqunywe umnyango. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhono): Landela yonke imigidingo nemitapo yezincwadi yomnyango. Ulwazi lokuvikela ukukhishwa komugqa, ukuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi kanye nephepha kwemishini. Nikeza insiza yokuthwebula izifanekiso zabantwana ngokuzimele nangokuba yingxenye yeqembu. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokuthwebula izifanekiso ngokwedijithali kanye nendlela yokusebenza kokuvezwa izifanekiso zokwelapha. Amakhono amahle ekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nalabo abakufinqile nokusebenza ngempumelelo njengengxenye yeqembu elinemikhakha eminingi. Hambisana nezidingo ze-National Core Standards. Ukuphatha isikhathi kahle. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zokugcina nokuxhumanisa izifanekiso kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi lwe-Radiology.
zu.duties: Nikeza insiza yokuthwebula izifanekiso kubasemncane baphila izifanekiso ezingochweni ezikhwalithi ephezulu. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kwesiguli. Yenza ukuthwebula izifanekiso kubasemncane kumikhakha ekhethekile. Yenza ukuthwebula izifanekiso ze-CT Scan, ukuthwebula izifanekiso ngokwedijithali, i-Fluoroscopy, i-Theatre, ama-DR Mobiles, ukuthwebula izifanekiso ze-Panorex kanye ne-Lodox. Ukusetshenziswa okuphelele nokunakekelwa kwemishini kanye nokuhlola ikhwalithi nsuku zonke. Thatha inhlanga ezinhleleni zokuhlolwa nokwelapha komuntu siqu, komnyango nasesibhedlela. Nikeza umsebenzi wokusiza ekungabeni babakwenu futhi nikeza inkxaso kumqondisi.

xh.title: Umzobi weX-ray weNqanaba 1 ukuya ko-3 (OKUQONDISIWEYO)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umzobi weX-ray wokuQondisiweyo eRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ukunika iinkonzo zokuzoba iithombe zabantwana, kuquka i-CT, i-floroskophu nokuzoba iithombe ngesixhobo sangokwaneleyo.
xh.requirements: Iminqopho yemfundo esemthethweni: Isiganga esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi weX-ray kuQondiso lokuZoba iithombe ngesixhobo sangokwaneleyo. Ukubhalisa koluntu olungamaphethelo: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi weX-ray wokuQondisiweyo. Imfundo enkulu: Iqondo 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi weX-ray kuQondiso lokuZoba iithombe ngesixhobo sangokwaneleyo ngeentsuku zabasebenzi abagqithiselwe eRSA. Unyaka o-1 wamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwiprofeshini ekufanelekileyo (xa kusebenza) ngeentsuku zabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kolunye ilizwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Iqondo 2: Utshelelo lokungenisa loo minyaka mva ekubhaliseni kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi weX-ray kuQondiso lokuZoba iithombe ngesixhobo sangokwaneleyo ngeentsuku zabasebenzi bagqithiselwe eRSA. Utshelelo lokungenisa i-11 yeminyaka yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwiprofeshini ekufanelekileyo (xa kusebenza) ngeentsuku zabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kulunye ilizwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Iqondo 3: Utshelelo lokungenisa i-20 yeminyaka yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomzobi weX-ray kuQondiso lokuZoba iithombe ngesixhobo sangokwaneleyo ngeentsuku zabasebenzi bagqithiselwe eRSA. Utshelelo lokungenisa i-21 yeminyaka yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kwiprofeshini ekufanelekileyo (xa kusebenza) ngeentsuku zabasebenzi bagqithiselwe kulunye ilizwe, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomntu wonke njengoko kufunekayo eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kufuneka usize iiyure ezili-40 ngeveki, ezingeza inkonzo emva kweyure ngeempelaveki kunye nokujikelwa kwabasebenzi basemva kweyure ebusuku njengoko kumiswe sisebe. Nikela ngenkonzo yokuzoba iithombe zabantwana ngokuzimeleyo nangaphezu kwesiqwenga sabathudi. af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte vir SCM-opleiding in infrastruktuuraankope by die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of ekwivalent in Aankope en/of Bou-omgewing. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n infrastruktuurverwante omgewing. Inhärente vereiste van die pos: Geldige Kode (B/EB) bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om lang afstande vir uitgebreide periodes te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitgebreide kennis van en praktiese ervaring in SCM-stelsels soos CIDB, ePS, CSD en WCSEB. Kennis en ervaring van infrastruktuuraankoopwetgewing en verskeie opleidingsmateriaal. Vermoë om opleiding te gee oor infrastruktuuraankope en verwante aangeleenthede en die vermoë om navrae wat uit opleidingsessies voortspruit, te ontleed en te beantwoord. Goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede. -Uitstekende bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring van die werk met infrastruktuurverwante wetgewing. Kennis van PFMA, Finansiële instruksies, Provinsiale en Tesourie-regulasies, CIDB-wetgewing, Infrastruktuurdelegerings en AOS en alle toepaslike infrastruktuuraankoopwetgewing Kennis van die Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act 5 van 2000 (PPPFA).
af.duties: Stel verskeie opleidingsmateriaal en gidse saam vir infrastruktuuraankoopprosesse en ander behoeftes verwant aan infrastruktuuraankope. Stel 'n opleidingsprospectus saam en verseker verspreiding daarvan aan alle Aankopende Entiteite. Stel SCM-sirkulieres en Instruksies op om te verseker dat opleidingsgidse versprei word aan alle Aankopende Entiteite wat gebruik kan word om bystand te verleen tydens die aankoopproses. Verseker dat alle opleidingsmateriaal in ooreenstemming is met huidige wetgewing en die bedryf se beste praktyke. Dateer opleidingsmateriaal op volgens veranderinge binne die bedryf en wetgewing. -Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes verwant aan infrastruktuuraankope en fasiliteer opleidingsessies om die behoeftes dienooreenkomstig aan te spreek. Ondersteun infrastruktuur Aankopende Entiteite deur die huidige aankoopprosesse te ontleed en gapings te identifiseer wat deur opleidingsintervensies aangespreek moet word, om nakoming deur die aankoopproses heen te verseker. Verskaf opleiding en ondersteuning op verskeie stelsels soos Eps, CIDB, CSD, WCSEB. Onderhou 'n sentrale databasis van alle opleidingsmateriaal en gidse wat deur alle Aankopende Entiteite binne die Departement toeganklik is. -Stel 'n debriefing-dokument na elke opleidingsessie saam, wat vrae en antwoorde aandui wat gebruik kan word om opleidingsmateriaal verder te ontwikkel, en lys die aksie-items wat tydens die opleidingsessie geïdentifiseer is. Verseker dat aksie-items tydig aangespreek word en verskaf terugvoer aan die betrokke Entiteit. Stel vraelyste saam en versprei dit om die doeltreffendheid van die opleidingsmateriaal te bepaal en moontlike areas vir verbetering te identifiseer. Onderhou 'n databasis met besonderhede van alle opleidingsessies wat gehou is. Verseker dat opleidingsstatistieke akkuraat is en aan Bestuur gerapporteer word.

zu.summary: Onogqosi omkhulu wezokuqondisa ohlinzeka ngemfundo ye-SCM ekuthengeni izakhiwo eKumnyangu Wezempiro nokuZinza e-Western Cape.
