zu.title: Ongwempela Omkhulu Wesigurathathu: Izimali
zu.summary: Qapha imisebenzi yemali engenayo, yokuchithwa kwemali, nokesibhalwa izimali ehhovisi lesiSifunda i-Overberg, okuhlanganisa ukugqamisa isabelo somali, ukucubungula ukukhokhelwa, nemisebenzi yokuphatha abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezidingekayo: I-Diploma noma i-Degree yezwe emayelana neminyaka emithathu. Isipiliyoni: Ukulawula ukuchithwa kwemali ezimali, imali engenayo nokukhokhelwa kwe-NPI kanye nalawulo lokuchithwa kwemali. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuqondweni kwesabelo, imali engenayo nolawulo. Isipiliyoni ekuqondeni ama-Akhawunti weziimpahla namaswele kanye nalawulo lamadebithi. Isipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe sokuphatha abantu. Izidingo zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esephila. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwizi olujulile nesipiliyoni esiphathekayo kwi-BAS kanye namakhono ahlelekile, okuphatha, okuhola kanye nolwazi lokusebenza ngamanani ezimali. Ulwizi olujulile ngemithetho ezimali, izinqumabomvu zomnyango, izinqumo kanye nezinqubo kanye namakhono anamandla okuphatha abantu, ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nokukhuthaza amalungu eqembu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi olujulile ngezinhlelo zekhompyutha (excel, BAS, Clinicom & Account Receivable). Amakhono ohlezi kahle (okukhuluma nokuqamba) kokungaphezulu kwezilimi ezimbili ezilimi ezintathu ezisemthethweni sawesifazane e-Western Cape. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Kawongo Mzomphakathi (PFMA), abalawuli bezezimali bonsindi kanye ne-National and Provincial Treasury Regulators.
zu.duties: Qondanisa futhi uxhase imali engenayo, i-NPI (Non-Patient Income), ukuchithwa kwemali, nemisebenzi yokesibhalwa kwemali kwi-Overberg District. Qapha ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwesabelo esivunyiwe umbiko wezehlakalo ezahlukene ukuxhasa ukuphathwa kwemali ngempumelelo. Qhubeka futhi uqinise ukukhokhelwa, amajenali, ukubuyisana, kanye nezenzo zemali engenayo ngohlelo nokuqinisekisa. Hlela imibiko yezimali usize nokuqulunqwa kwesitatimende sezimali sasemandulo nasetinhlanganweni zonyaka. Gcina futhi usule ama-akhawunti wezimpahla namaswele uxhase inqubo yokulawula amadebithi. Qapha imali engenayo kanye nokusebenza kwe-NPI uphenye izehlakalo ezingafani kwezimali. Phatha abantu okusesikhundweni sokulawula imali uze unikeze uxhaso lokusebenza nangasese kuMncediqa: Izimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemigomo yezimali, izinqubo, nezidingo zokuhlola.

xh.title: Mphathi wengqondo wezindleko: izebe
xh.summary: Ukuqwalasela kwaye ulawule iindleko, uphando lwezimali, nemiṣo yolawulo lwezebe kwiofisi yekaOverberg, kuquka nokuqwalasela ibhajethi, ukuqwalasela amaxwebhu okuhlawula, kunye nemiṣo yolawulo lwezisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isimiso somfundo: izidanga zobuchwephershe eziyi three-year national Diploma okanye i Degree. Isipiliṣo: ulawulo olufanelekileyo lwezigqibo zemali, ukwenza imali yongeniso kwaye nokulawula imali evela kwi NPI payments. Isipiliṣo sokwenza ibhajethi nokulawula imali yongeniso. Isipiliṣo sokulawula iakhawunti ze Assets & Liability kunye nokulawula amatyala. Isipiliṵo esiqinisekisiweyo sokuba ngumphathi wezisebenzi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: ilayisenisi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ulwazi (iimpawu/ukwaziswa): ulwazi olubanzi nolusebenzayo kwi BAS kwaye unobuntu obuhle, ulwazi lolawulo, lolawulo lwabaphathi, kwaye unothando lokusebenza nezibalo zemali. Ulwazi olubanzi ngeṁigaṣa zemali, iinkqubo zolawulo, izigqibo kunye neenkqubo, kwaye unamandla okulawula abantu, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba kwaye ukhuthaze amalungu ethimba. Ulwazi lokusebenzela kwi computer nolwazi olubanzi ngeenkqubo zecomputer (excel, BAS, Clinicom & Account Receivable). Ulwazi oluhle lokuziphatha (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo) kumzimba wezinye iilwimi ezintathu ezisemthethweni zase Western Cape. Ulwazi ngomthetho we Public Financial Management Act (PFMA), i National and Provincial Treasury Regulators.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa kwaye uxhase iindleko, ingeniso engelonnyegiso yegazi (NPI), ukugqiba kwaye ulawule imiṣo yemali kwicandelo lesi lendawo i Overberg District. Qwalasela imali echithwayo ngokuchasene ne bhajethi ekamisiweyo kwaye uchaze ukungahambelani ukuze uxhase ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezebe. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise imali ehlawulwayo, iijana, ukulinganisa, nentengiselwano yemali yongeniso ukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelanisa nokuchanekileyo. Hlanganisela iinkcazelo zemali kwaye uncede ekulungiseleleni iinkcazelo zemali ezikwithuba nazonyaka. Phatha kwaye usule iakhawunti zeasset kunye netyala, kwaye uxhase iinkqubo zolawulo lwamatyala. Qwalasela ukusebenza komvuzo nge NPI kwaye uphando iingxaki zemali. Lawula abasebenzi bengqondo yolawulo lwezebe kwaye unike ixhaso elisebenzayo nolwolawulo kumkhosi wabaphathi: izebe. Qinisekisa ukumiselwa ngemiṣo yemali, iinkqubo, nokuṣo kwe audit.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Finance (DICU)
jobs.centre: Head Office, Cape Town; Reporting at Stikland Nursing College (X6 Posts) West Coast Region (X1 Post) Cape Winelands (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Senior state accountant needed to evaluate accounting and supply chain transactions for compliance, with positions across the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate National Diploma (NQF 6) or equivalent in SCM, Finance, Accounting, Auditing, or related field. Experience: Appropriate experience in Internal Control, Finance and Supply Chain Management environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (/Code B/EB) manual driver’s license. Willingness to travel across the province. Competencies (knowledge/skills): The ability to interpret and apply financial and SCM policies, procedures, and prescripts. Ability to compile reports and presentation thereof. Knowledge of inventory, assets, irregular expenditure, commitments, and accruals. Knowledge of transfer payments Computer literacy (Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point).
jobs.duties: Evaluate Accounting and Supply Chain transactions for correctness and compliance with the legislative framework and financial prescripts. Evaluate inventory within the institutions and ensure that all inventory/warehouse items reconcile on the Accounting Systems of the department. Evaluate the use and management of all assets in the institution and ensure that all assets are correctly accounted for on accounting systems of the department. Report any discrepancies found and assist Institutional management to implement corrective measures.
jobs.enquiries: Mr A Moya, email: Anele.Moya@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Seniorstaatsrekenmeester: Finansies (DICU)
af.summary: Seniorstaatsrekenmeeter benodig om rekeningkundige en voorsieningskettingtransaksies te evalueer vir nakoming, met poste regoor die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) of ekwivalent in SCM, Finansies, Rekeningkunde, Oudit, of verwante veld. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Interne Beheer-, Finansies- en Voorsieningskettingbestuursomgewing. Inherent vereiste van die werk: Geldige (/Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie vir handrat. Bereidwilligheid om regoor die provinsie te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Die vermoë om finansiële en SCM-beleide, prosedures en voorskrifte te interpreteer en toe te pas. Vermoë om verslae op te stel en voor te lê. Kennis van voorraad, bates, onreëlmatige besteding, verbintenis en toerekenings. Kennis van oorplasingsbetalings. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point).
af.duties: Evalueer rekeningkundige en voorsieningskettingtransaksies vir korrektheid en nakoming van die wetgewende raamwerk en finansiële voorskrifte. Evalueer voorraad binne die instellings en verseker dat alle voorraad/warehouse-items versoen op die rekeningkundige stelsels van die departement. Evalueer die gebruik en bestuur van alle bates in die instelling en verseker dat alle bates korrek verantwoord word op die rekeningkundige stelsels van die departement. Rapporteer enige afwykings wat gevind word en help instellingsbestuur om korrektiewe maatreëls te implementeer.

zu.title: Umhlengikontshe Ohamba Phambili Wezimali: Izimali (DICU)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhlengikontshe ohamba phambili wezimali ukuze ahlaziye izimali kanye nezinkokhelo zohwebo ngenhlayo, nezikhundla ezingatholakala kulo lonke i-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izifundo edingekayo: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF 6) elifanele noma okulinganayo kwi-SCM, Izimali, Ukuhola izimali, noma ohlelo oluhlobene naleso. Isipiliyangqondo: Isipiliyangqondo esifanele sokulawula ngaphakathi, Izimali kanye nemvelo yoLawulo Lohwebo Lokuhlinzeka. Isidingo esingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha bhanoyi yedivayizi yesandla evela (/Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kulo lonke isifundazwe. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izinqubo, kanye nemibhalo yesimiso sezimali kanye ne-SCM. Ikhono lokuhlela imibiko nokuyiveza. Ulwazi ngezenhlalo zezimpahla, izimpahla, izinkokhelo ezingalawulwa kahle, izibambiso, kanye nezinkokhelo ezibekwe ihlobo. Ulwazi ngemali edluliselwa abanye. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point).
zu.duties: Hlaziya izimali kanye nezinkokhelo zohwebo ngokulunga nangokuziphatha ngokomthetho osungulwe kanye nemibhalo yesimiso sezimali. Hlaziya izenhlalo zezimpahla ezindaweni zesikhungo futhi qiniseka ukuthi zonke izinto ezenhlalweni/zemikhumbi zihambisana kumimiselo yokuHolela imali komnyango. Hlaziya ukusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezindaweni zesikhungo futhi qiniseka ukuthi zonke izimpahla ziholelwa kahle kumimiselo yokuHolela imali komnyango. Mela naluphi oluvela yini olungahambisani futhi siza abaphathi besikhungo ukusetha izinyathelo zokulungisa.

xh.title: Omlindi weSizwe oPhakamileyo: Izimali (DICU)
xh.summary: Kufuneka omlindi wesizwe ophakamileyo okulinganisa iintengiso zemali nezandiso zokusetyenziswa kweenkonzo ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo, nezithuba ezikulo i-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) efanelekileyo okanye esenokulingana nayo kwi-SCM, Izimali, uKulawula ii-akhawunti, okanye candelo elinxulumene nayo. I-expereyinsi: I-expereyinsi efanelekileyo kwilawulo langaphakathi, kwezimali nendalo yokulawula izandiso zokusetyenziswa kweenkonzo. I-requirement yomsebenzi ngokwemvelo: Ilayisensi yokushayela (manual) esemthethweni (/Code B/EB). Ukuzimisela ukuhamba kunye noonxibelelwano kulo lonke iphondo. Iimpawu zokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/amakhono): Iakhono lokutolika nokuqamba kumthetho iinkqubo nemiyalelo ezimalini nakwi-SCM. Iakhono bokulunga iindaba ezibalulwayo. Ulwazi ngezinto ezifuneka kwi-akhawunti, izinto ezingenanto, I-expensishi ezingalunganga, nemiqathango. Ulwazi ngeentlawulo zokusetyenziselwa ukudluliswa kweemali. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
xh.duties: Linganisa iintengiso zokulawula ii-akhawunti nezandiso zokusetyenziswa kweenkonzo ukumiselwa kwemigaqo nakumthetho oqhelekileyo wemali. Linganisa izinto ezikhoyo kwiintlanganiso kwaye uqinisekise ukuba zonke izinto ezikhoyo/ezisesikhundleni se-wareyiziya zihambelana noMthetho we-akhawunti wesebe. Linganisa ukusetyenziswa nolawulo lweempahla ezikwintlanganiso ukuze uqinisekise ukuba yonke impahla iyabhalwa kakuhle kwiinkqubo zokubhala ii-akhawunti zesebe. Iika nokubika naziphi na iingxaki ezifunyenwe kwaye uncede ulawulo loqeqesho lwe-akhawundi ekulawuleni iingxaki ezibekiweyo ngeendlela ezilungileyo.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Finance
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer needed for finance duties in the Western Cape, requiring a Senior Certificate with Mathematics or Accountancy and a valid code B driver's license.

Extensive knowledge of financial management in the public service, including the legislative framework. Computer skills and in- depth knowledge of transaction codes and reports on the following systems: BAS, LOGIS processes.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Finansies
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte benodig vir finansiele pligte in die Western Cape, wat 'n Senior Sertifikaat met Wiskunde of Rekeningkunde en 'n geldige kode B-bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Kernprestasiegebiede (KRA's) van die pos fokus. Uitgebreide kennis van finansiele bestuur in die staatsdiens, insluitend die wetlike raamwerk. Rekenaarvaardighede en diepgaande kennis van transaksiekodes en verslae op die volgende stelsels: BAS, LOGIS-prosesse.
af.duties: Identifiseer en korrigeer verkeerde uitgawes en spreek 'n behoefte aan opleiding aan indien/wanneer vereis. Tydige skakeling van Aktiva- en Pasiefrekeninge. Effektiewe monitering van Oordragbetalings en ondersteuning aan NPO-finansies en Programpersoneel. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende nakoming van diverse betalingsregulasies. Verskaf gedokumenteerde inligting rakende begrotingverwante aangeleenthede op versoek van die ASD & SAO.

zu.title: Inkantsela: Izimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkantsela ozosebenza nemali kwi-Western Cape, ofuna i-Senior Certificate ne-Mathematics noma i-Accountancy kanye nelayisensi yokushayela ye-code B evumelekile.

xh.title: Ofisa Ophatha Izindaba: Izimali
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho Ofisa Ophatha Izindaba ukwenza imisebenzi yezimali kwi-Western Cape, kwaye kufuneka abe ne-Senior Certificate ane-Mathematics okanye i-Accountancy kunye nelayisensi yokushayela ekwaziyo ye-code B.

Amava: Amava afanelekileyo aqaphakelayo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ekwaziyo ye-code B/EB. Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ixesha elingaphezu kwesiqendu. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasanse): Ikhono lokutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemali, iindlela zokwenza izinto nemiqathango. Ulwazi olubanzi lokulawula izimali kuluntu lomphakathi, kuquka nalulwesi-mthetho. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye nolwazi olunjengoko lweekhowudi zentsluvo nemiqulu kwezi nkqubo zilandelayo: BAS, iinkqubo ze-LOGIS.

Ukugcina iliso elisebenzayo kokuHlawula izimali zokuDlulisa kunye nenccedo kwezimali ze-NPO kunye nabasebenzi be-Programme. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela ngokusebenzisekileyo nangokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zokuHlawula iimali ezixubileyo. Kubhekwe ulwazi olubhaliweyo ngemiba ehlobene neswangcwa njengoko kucelwa yi-ASD & SAO.

Capability to handle a demanding clinical workload with effective time management, organisation and prioritisation skills. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Ukuqinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezithile ezinhle okulinganiswa ngemiphumela yezinkalo zokuqinisekisa izinga.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 (5/8TH Post)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R258 201 per annum Grade 2: R301 563 per annum Grade 3: R353 013 per annum
jobs.summary: Occupational Therapist Grade 1 to 3 sought for Caledon Hospital in the Theewaterskloof sub-district, providing patient care and outreach services across surrounding clinics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Occupational Therapist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Occupational Therapist with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration as Occupational Therapist with the HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as an Occupational Therapist in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Willingness to travel in the sub-district/ district to consult clients and attend meetings and training sessions. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal, planning and organisational skills, and computer literacy (MS Office). Knowledge of applicable health legislation, relevant acts and policies. Ability to adapt and work efficiently in a resource- constrained environment and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
jobs.duties: Provide quality care to patients in the Theewaterskloof sub-district including Caledon Hospital and surrounding clinics and healthcare facilities. Provide Outreach and Support service to PHC facilities in the Theewaterskloof sub- district. Actively participate in skills transfer, training, and academic opportunities relevant to the post. Active involvement in the clinical governance of Theewaterskloof sub-district facilities as required. Administrative duties and referral to secondary and tertiary hospitals. Support to sub-district management while maintaining professional ethics. To render a clinical occupational therapy service at district hospital and PHC level. Provide health promotion. Training and community service interventions. Render mobility assistive device service. Appropriate financial and administrative management. Professional ethics.
jobs.enquiries: Dr RJ Liebenberg Tel No: (028) 212-1070
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery." It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the Post 35/278: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting (X2 Posts), Centre: Directorate: Financial Accounting, R413 001 per annum has been cancelled. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Ergoterapeut Graad 1 tot 3 (5/8STE Pos)
af.summary: Ergoterapeut Graad 1 tot 3 gesoek vir Caledon Hospital in die Theewaterskloof sub-distrik, wat pasiëntsorg en uitreikdienste oor omliggende klinieke verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Ergoterapeut moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ergoterapeut. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Ergoterapeut by die HPCSA ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Ergoterapeut by die HPCSA ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ergoterapeut ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ergoterapeut ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ergoterapeut ten opsigte van Suid-Afrikaans gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Ergoterapeut ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om in die sub-distrik/distrik te reis om kliënte te raadpleeg en vergaderings en oefensessies by te woon. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie interpersoonlike, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, en rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office). Kennis van toepaslike gesondheidswetgewing, relevante wette en beleide. Vermoë om aan te pas en doeltreffend te werk in 'n hulpbronbeperkte omgewing en as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte sorg aan pasiënte in die Theewaterskloof sub-distrik insluitend Caledon Hospital en omliggende klinieke en gesondheidsorgfasiliteite. Verskaf Uitreik- en Ondersteuningsdiens aan PHC-fasiliteite in die Theewaterskloof sub-distrik. Neem aktief deel aan vaardigheidsoordrag, opleiding en akademiese geleenthede relevant tot die pos. Aktiewe betrokkenheid by die kliniese bestuur van Theewaterskloof sub-distrik fasiliteite soos vereis. Administratiewe pligte en verwysing na sekondêre en tersiêre hospitale. Ondersteuning aan sub-distrikbestuur terwyl professionele etiek gehandhaaf word. Om 'n kliniese ergoterapie-diens op distrikshospitaal- en PHC-vlak te lewer. Verskaf gesondheidsbevordering. Opleiding en gemeenskapsdiens ingrypings. Lewer mobiliteitsondersteunende toestel-diens. Toepaslike finansiële en administratiewe bestuur. Professionele etiek.

zu.title: Ukusebenza njengoba Therapist Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-3 (Isikhundla se-5/8TH)
zu.summary: Kufunwa u-Therapist Wezokusebenza Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-3 we-Caledon Hospital esifundeni esingaphansi kuka-Theewaterskloof, ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwegula nezinsizakalo zokuthumela kwezinye izikhungo kulo lonke izikhungo ezizungezile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza. Ukuze kubhaliswe komkhandlu ochwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza. Isiphephelo: Isikhundla 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza ne-HPCSA maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka owodwa wemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza ne-HPCSA maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele kwelinye izwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isikhundla 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe ne-HPCSA njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-11 yemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe ne-HPCSA njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele kwelinye izwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isikhundla 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-20 yemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe ne-HPCSA njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-21 yemisebenzi ehambisana naleyo ngemva kokuze kubhaliswe ne-HPCSA njengoba Therapist Wezokusebenza maqondana nezisebenzi ezifundele kwelinye izwe, okungadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzomphakathi njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo esibekwayo kulesi sikhundla: Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela (i-Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukuhamba esifundeni esingaphansi/nasendaweni ukuya kubuza abathunjwa futhi uye kwezeminikelo nezikhungo zokuqeqesha. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu, okuhlela nokuhlela izinto, kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (i-MS Office). Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo, imithetho kanye nenqubomgomo ephathelene nalokhu. Isikhathi sokuzidela nokusebenza ngempumelelo endaweni enezinsiza ezingenalutho futhi njengengxenye yeqembu labantu abanemikhakha ehlukene.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuhle kubagula esifundeni esingaphansi kuka-Theewaterskloof okuhlanganisa i-Caledon Hospital kanye nezikhungo ezizungezile nezinye izikhungo zezempilo. Nikeza insizakalo yokuthumela kwezinye izikhungo kanye noxhaso kuzikhungo ze-PHC esifundeni esingaphansi kuka-Theewaterskloof. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekudluliseni amakhono, ukuqeqesha, kanye namathuba emfundo ephathelene nalesi sikhundla. Ukubandakanyeka ngokuzimisela ekulawuleni izikhungo zezempilo esifundeni esingaphansi kuka-Theewaterskloof njengoba kudingeka. Imisebenzi yokulawula izinto kanye nokuthumela kwezibhedlela sesibili kanye nezithomu. Ukuxhasa ukuphathwa kwesifunda esingaphansi kanti kulondolozwa nezimiso zochwepheshe. Ukunikeza insizakalo yochwepheshe yokusebenza ngokwelashwa kwabagula esibhedlela sendawo kanye nazinga le-PHC. Nikeza ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Ukuqeqesha kanye nezindlela zokwenza inkonzomphakathi. Nikeza insizakalo yamadivayisi okusiza ekunyakazeni. Ukuphathwa okufanele kwezimali nokulawula izinto. Izimiso zochwepheshe.

xh.title: UmNgangingqangi weMisebenzi Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Isithuba se-5/8TH)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwa umNgangingqangi weMisebenzi Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 kwi-Caledon Hospital kummandla ongezantsi we-Theewaterskloof, ukubonelela ngenkathalo yabaguli nesevisi yokufikelela kumathuba akuzo iikliniki ezijikelezileyo.
xh.requirements: Iminyanya yemfundo esemthethweni: Isifikelelo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi. Ukubhaliswa koluntu lwabaphathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho okulingelayo emva kokubhaliswa njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi kwi-HPCSA ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe e-SA. Unyaka omnye wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi kwi-HPCSA ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunelwanga ukwenza inkonzo yomthonyama njengoko kufunekayo eS-A. Inqanaba 2: Umda weminyaka eli-10 ubudala wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe e-SA. Umda weminyaka eli-11 ubudala wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunelwanga ukwenza inkonzo yomthonyama njengoko kufunekayo eS-A. Inqanaba 3: Umda weminyaka amashumi amabini ubudala wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe e-SA. Umda weminyaka engama-21 ubudala wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi ngokuphathelele kubasebenzi abagqitywe kwamanye amazwe, abangafunelwanga ukwenza inkonzo yumthonyama njengoko kufunekayo eS-A. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba phakathi kommandla ongezantsi/nommandla jikelele ukuze udibane nabathengi nokuza kwindibano nemisebenzi yokuqeqesha. Iimpawu zekhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ikhono elihle lokubambisana nabantu, lokucwangcisa nololulungelelanisa, nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS Office). Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo esemthethweni, kwaye nemiqathango namagunya ahambelana nayo. Ikhono lokuzohlwayo nokusebenza ngokusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kwindawo ethanda kwaye njengengxenye yeqela elisebenza ngokubambisana ngamabala amaninzi.
xh.duties: Bonelela ngenkathalo yamgangatho aphaya kubaguli kummandla ongezantsi we-Theewaterskloof kuquka i-Caledon Hospital naziikliniki neziseko zezempilo ezijikelezileyo. Bonelela nesevisi yokufikelela nokuNxulumanisa kumathuba e-PHC kummandla ongezantsi we-Theewaterskloof. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ekudluliseni izikhono, kuqeqesho, nakumathuba emfundo ahambelana nalesi sithuba. Ukuqhutywa kwakho ngokuzimisela ekulawuleni iinkqubo zezempilo zeziseko zommandla ongezantsi we-Theewaterskloof njengoko kufunekayo. Imisebenzi yolawulo nokuqulunqa iingenelo ukuya kumaspitalla esiBini nesiThathu. Inkxaso ekulawulen iummandla ongezantsi nngexa ulondileziimigaqo yemisebenzi. Ukubonelela ngesevisi yomNgangingqangi weMisebenzi yekhlinikhi kumaspitala wommandla nakuqoqoselo lwe-PHC. Bonelela ngokukhuthaza izempilo. Iqeqesho nokuqhutywa kwezenzo zenkonzo yomthonyama. Bonelela nesevisi yezixhobo zosindululu ekunyakazeni. Ukuqulathwa ngokufanelekileyo kolawulo lwemali nolawulo. Iimigaqo yemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Supply Chain Management
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed for supply chain management duties including stock control, LOGIS updates and audit compliance at District Six CDC.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accountancy as a passed subject or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KPA's) of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in inventory and stores management, or supply chain management, and asset management administration. Appropriate experience working in a healthcare or clinical setting. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Driver’s License. Willingness to lift heavy boxes and assets. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Office: Word, Excel and PowerPoint, Outlook). Ability to function independently as well as in a multi-disciplinary team. Communication, interpersonal skills, organisational and time management skills. Knowledge and experience in Healthcare Supply Chain Management and Finance principles and administrative processes. Knowledge of the LOGIS systems, PFMA, Treasury Directives and Legislations on SCM and Assets Management. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines. Familiarity with medical supplies and equipment. Knowledge of inventory management software and systems (LOGIS).
jobs.duties: Issue and receive stock (physically and on LOGIS) and ensuring the safekeeping of stock. Update stock and perform regular spot checks of stock items, and regular stock takes. File all relevant documentation and ensure audit compliance and record keeping. Follow up on outstanding orders with suppliers and Hub Hospital. Assist with all general tasks within the SCM and Finance department. Perform the duties of procurement of goods/services and asset management. Ensure that the FIFO principle is maintained in the stores. Handle queries in all aspects within the SCM department.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Voorsieningskettingbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig vir voorsieningskettingbestuurpligte insluitend voorraadbeheer, LOGIS-opdaterings en ouditnakoming by District Six CDC.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak of Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Kernprestasiegebiede (KPA's) van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in voorraad- en magasynebestuur, of voorsieningskettingbestuur, en batesbestuuradministrasie. Toepaslike ervaring in werk binne 'n gesondheidsorg- of kliniese omgewing. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om swaar bokse en bates op te tel. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office: Word, Excel en PowerPoint, Outlook). Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Kommunikasie, interpersoonlike vaardighede, organisatoriese en tydbestuurvaardighede. Kennis en ervaring in Gesondheidsorg Voorsieningskettingbestuur en Finansie beginsels en administratiewe prosesse. Kennis van die LOGIS-stelsels, PFMA, Tesourie-riglyne en Wetgewing oor VKB en Batesbestuur. Vermoë om by veranderende prioriteite en sperdatums aan te pas. Bekendheid met mediese voorrade en toerusting. Kennis van voorraadbestuursagteware en -stelsels (LOGIS).
af.duties: Uitreik en ontvang van voorraad (fisies en op LOGIS) en verseker die veilige bewaring van voorraad. Opdateer voorraad en voer gereelde steekproefkontroles van voorraaditems uit, asook gereelde voorraadtellings. Lê alle relevante dokumentasie en verseker ouditnakoming en rekordhouding. Volg uitstaande bestellings by verskaffers en Hub-hospitaal op. Bystand met alle algemene take binne die VKB- en Finansie-departement. Verrig die pligte van verkryging van goedere/dienste en batesbestuur. Verseker dat die FIFO-beginsel in die magasin gehandhaaf word. Hanteer navrae in alle aspekte binne die VKB-departement.

zu.title: Iklerka wezokuphathwa: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklerka yokuphathwa kwezinsiza ukwenza imisebenzi ehlanganisa ukulawula impahla, ukubuyekezwa kwe-LOGIS kanye nokuhambisana nezokuhlola e-District Six CDC.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kakhulu: Isitifikedi sabangakwamabanga aphansi (noma esilinganayo) nge-Mathematics kanye/noma i-Accountancy njengesifundo esidlulile noma Isitifikedi sabangakwamabanga aphansi (noma esilinganayo) nolwazi/amakhono agqamisa Izindawo Zokusebenza Eziyinhloko (KPA's) zaleso sikhundla. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olufanele ekuphathweni kwenventory nezitolo, noma ekuphathweni kwezinsiza, kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla. Ulwazi olufanele lokusebenza esikhungweni sezokunakekelwa kwezempilo noma sezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingokwakheka kwomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuzithoba ukuphakamisa amabhokisi anzima kanye nempahla. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubhalisele ukusebenza ngakompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint, Outlook). Ikono lokusebenza ngabodwa kanye nasekuhlanganeni ngeqembu elinobuningi bamakhono. Amakhono okuxhumana, amakhono okusebenza nabantu, amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Ulwazi loluwo ekuphathweni kwezinsiza kwezempilo kanye nemigomoyezomali kanye nezinhlaka zokuphathwa. Ulwazi ngamasistimu e-LOGIS, i-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Treasury kanye neMithetho ye-SCM kanye Nokuphathwa Kwempahla. Ikono lokuzivumelanisa nobunjalo obashintshayo kanye nezinsuku ezingehla. Ukwazi ukuthi uhola ngokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye nempahla. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuphatha inventory kanye namasistimu (LOGIS).
zu.duties: Nika futhi uthole impahla (ngokubonakalayo nakwi-LOGIS) ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwempahla. Buyekeza impahla wenze ukuhlola okujwayelekile kwezinto zempahla, kanye nokubala impahla njalo. Faka wonke umxhumanisi ofanele futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nezokuhlola kanye nokugcina amarekhodi. Landela izinhlelo ezingegenziwe ngezibonelelo kanye ne-Hub Hospital. Siza ngenchubo yonke evamile ngaphakathi komnyango we-SCM kanye nezezimali. Yenza imisebenzi yokuthenga izimpahla/ezinsiza nokuphathwa kwempahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi umgomo we-FIFO ulandelwa ezitolo. Phathela imibuzo ngazo zonke izindawo ngaphakathi komnyango we-SCM.

Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokusebenza kwindawo yezempilo okanye yamagosa ekliniki. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zemisebenzi: I-License Yokushayela Esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukuphakamisa amabokisi anzima kunye neempahla. Amaphepha abalulekileyo (ulwazi/amaxabiso): Ukusebenza ngerekhthula (MS Office: Word, Excel no PowerPoint, Outlook). Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nakwinqanaba leqela elinabasebenzi bemimiselo yemithetho eyahlukeneyo. Ikhono lokunxibelelwana, lokuqhathaniswa nabantu, lokuhlela nokulawula ixesha. Ulwazi noluhlu lolwazi kulawulo lwe-Healthcare Supply Chain Management nemiYalelo yeMali kunye neenkqubo zolawulo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ze-LOGIS systems, i-PFMA, iTreasury Directives nemiThetho malunga ne-SCM nokulawulwa kweempahla. Ikhono lokuzivumelanisa noku_tshintsha iinDasheni ngeext ezibalulekileyo zamaxesha. Hlaziya isitokhisi uze wenze ukukhangwa rhoqo kwezinto zesitokhisi, wenze ukubala kwesitokhisi rhoqo. Faka iso kwiyure yonke imibhalo equkwa kwaye uqiniseke ukuzinikela kwi-odit kwaye kugcinwe irekhodi. Landelela iiodolo ezingekazigqitywa kunye neenkampani ezinikezela nangemibuzo ye-Hub Hospital. Nceda nako konke okusemthethweni wemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwisebe le-SCM neMali. Yenza imisebenzi yokuthengwa kwezinto/iinkonzo nolawulo lweempahla. Qinisekisa ukuba ithiyori ye-FIFO iyagcinwa kwindawo yokugcina. Phathisa imibuzo kuzo zonke iindawo ngaphakathi kwisebe le-SCM.

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van openbare diens administratiewe prosedures en kantoorbestuur. Kennis van pasiëntadministrasie, verwysingsroetes en medies-juridiese dokumentasie. Kennis van rekordbestuur en vertroulikheidsbeginsels. Uitstekende organisatoriese, beplannings- en tydbestuurvaardighede. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend notuleringsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Teams. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk terwyl veelvuldige prioriteite bestuur word. Vermoë om akkuraat te werk met aandag aan besonderhede. Goeie interpersoonlike, kliëntediens- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Handhaaf streng vertroulikheid en professionaliteit. af.duties: Bied omvattende sekretariële en uitvoerende ondersteuning aan Huisartse en die multidissiplinêre mediese span. Koördineer dagboeke, vergaderings, verlofadministrasie, HR-dokumentasie en kantooradministrasie. Bied kliniese administratiewe ondersteuning, insluitend pasiëntbesprekings, verwysings, medies-juridiese dokumentasie, HealthNet-koördinering en kommunikasie met pasiënte en gesinne. Hou toesig oor kantoorkommunikasieprosesse, insluitend telefoondistelsels, oproepdeursoei, boodskapbestuur en eskalering van dringende sake. Koördineer operatiewe administratiewe funksies, insluitend toegangsbeheer, toesig oor nagkamers, kantoorbenodigdhede, gehaltsverbeteringsprojekte en algemene bestuursondersteuning. Swang, oriënteer en mentor Mediese Sekretaresse-interne, insluitend taaktoewysing, prestasie-terugvoer en voltooiing van opleidingsdokumentasie. Handhaaf akkurate rekords en verseker vertroulikheid van alle administratiewe en kliniese inligting.

Izindawo zokwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lwezinqubo zoluphatho zesevisi yomphakathi nokuphathwa kwehhovisi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kweziguli, izindlela zokuqondisa kanye nama-dokhumenti wezomthetho wezokwelapha. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwamarekhodi kanye nemigomo yokuqinisekisa ukungathinteki kolwazi. Amakhono aphawulekayo okuhlela, ukwelula uhlelo kanye nokuphatha isikhathi. Amakhono aphawulekayo okuxhumana okubhaliwe nokuqamulayo okubukhulumayo, okuhlanganisa ukuthatha iminothi. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha ku-Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Teams. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nokubeke ukuphatha izinto eziningi ebalulekile ngesikhathi esinengcindezi. Ikono lokusebenza ngokuqinisekile ukuqaphela imininingwane. Amakhono aphawulekayo okuzwana, ukukhuluma okumnandi kanye nokuqonda nokuqasha izinkinga. Ukugcina ukuziphatha okungathintekiyo kanye nobungcweti. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwezokwelapha zikahulumeni (HealthNet, Clinicom, CAReS, PHCIS) noma amasistimu olwazi wezempilo afanayo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokusekela okuphelele okuyimfihlo kanye nokusekela abaphathi kubaphathi bemihayo yomndeni kuhlelo olusebenza ngokuhlangana kwezokwelapha. Hlela amadiari, izinkomfa, ukuphatha ukulahlwa kwemisebenzi, amadokhumenti wabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa kwehhovisi. Hlinzeka ngokusekela okuphathwa kwezokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukubhuka iziguli, ukuzilandelwa, amadokhumenti wezomthetho wezokwelapha, ukuhlanganisa i-HealthNet nokuxhumana neziguli namaphupho. Buza okuphathwa kwezokuxhumana ehhovisini, okuhlanganisa izistimu zocingo, ukuqondisa amakhol, ukuphathwa komyalezo kanye nokuqondoza izinto eziphuthumayo. Hlela imisebenzi yalolu phatho lwezokusebenza, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukufinyelela, ukubuka kwamakamelo angaphela, izimpahla zehhovisi, izinhlelo zokuphucula ikhwalithi kanye nokusekela ukuphathwa jikelele. Qaphisa, qondisa futhi ululele abathusi bayimfihlo bokwelapha, okuhlanganisa ukwabelwa imisebenzi, ukupha imibiko yekhono kanye nokuqedela amadokhumenti okuzilolonga. Gcina amarekhodi akhiyo futhi uqinisekise ukungathinteki kolwazi lwayo wonke oluphathwa lolwazi kwezokwelapha.

xh.title: Mmishinari woKulawulo: Inkxaso
xh.summary: Kufuneki abe ngumnikeli wokulawulo onikeze inkxaso yommishinari nengundoqo eqela labaguli beFamily Physician, egcina iidiary, amaqela, uxwebhu lwe-HR kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo yezempilo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona mancinci: Senior Certificate (okanye ezingangayo). Iakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lweenkqubo zolawulo zeNkonzo kaSebenzi kunye nokulawula ioifice. Ulwazi lolawulo labaguli, iindlela zokuqhubela abaguli phambili kunye nexwebhu le-medico-legal. Ulwazi lolawulo lugcino lwamaxwebhu kunye nemigaqo yabucala. Ikhono elingcono lokuhlela, ukucinga phambili kunye nokulawula ixesha. Ikhono elingcono lokunxibelelwana ngokubhalwayo nangokuthethwa, kuquka ukubhalwa kwemizuzu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye neTeams. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nokuba ngaphantsi koxinzelelo ngelixa ulawula izinto ezininzi ngaxeshanye. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwaye kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha. Ikhono elingcono lokunxibelelwana nabantu, ukukhonza abakhwelayo kunye nokuxazulula iingxaki. Ukugcina ubugcisa bokwethu nokungeneleli ngokungenamdla. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zeNkqubo yeZempilo yoLuntu (HealthNet, Clinicom, CAReS, PHCIS) okwezinye iinkqubo ezifanayo zelwazi lezempilo.
xh.duties: Unikeze inkxaso egqithisileyo yommishinari nengundoqo kwiFamily Physicians nakweliqela lezonyango elinabochwepheshe abahlukeneyo. Ulawule iidiary, amaqela, kulawulo lwamalanga ezikholelwa, uxwebhu lwe-HR nakulawulo lweoifice. Unike inkxaso yolawulo lwempilo, kuquka ukubhuka abaguli, ukuqhubela abaguli phambili, uxwebhu le-medico-legal, ulawulwano lweHealthNet kunye nokunxibelelana nabaguli neentsapho. Uqwalasele iinkqubo zokunxibelelana zeoifice, kuquka iinkqubo zefowuni, ukuqhuba amafowuni, ulawulo lwemiyalezo kunye nokuphakamisa izinto ezibalulekileyo ngokukhawuleza. Ulawule imisebenzi yolawulo yokusebenza, kuquka ulawulo lokungena, ukugcina amagumbi abahlali basenobusuku, izinto ezifuneka kwioifice, amaphulo okuphucula umgangatho kunye nenkxaso yolonke ulawulo. Ulawule, umkhokele kwaye unike iinkcukacha kwiMedical Secretary interns, kuquka ukwabelana imisebenzi, imvakemvo yomsebenzi kunye nokugqibezela uxwebhu lokholiso. Ugcine iirekhodi ezichanekileyo uze uqinisekise ubucala bolwazi ngokubanzi lwalayo olwaluyo ngolawulo nangempilo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Admissions

Good interpersonal skills. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills. Computer literacy in MS Office. Recordkeeping, compile new, retrieve, file, trace lost and manage duplicates and old folders as well as maintain a record system and archive. Perform relief duties as well as support to supervisor as required.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Toelatings
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig vir pasiënttoelatings, dataregistrasie en rekordhouding by Hermanus CDC in die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike pasiëntadministratiewe ervaring in 'n gesondheids-/pasiëntomgewing. Toepaslike Clinicom/PHCIS-ervaring. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (kode B/EB/C1) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk indien operasionele vereistes dit vereis. Goei interpersoonlike vaardighede. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goei kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office. Goei interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede, vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en as deel van 'n span, vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur met goeie organisatoriese vaardighede. Kennis van toepaslike beleide - Hospital Fees memorandum Hoofstuk 18, die Uniform. Patient Fee Schedule (UPFS), Finance Instructions & Medical Records beleide. Kennis van Clinicom.
af.duties: Toelating van pasiënte insluitend korrekte pasiëntassessering en akkurate data/inligtingregistrasie. Verseker korrekte bestuur van pasiëntlêers by onthalwe en skeduleer afsprake (nuut, opvolg en operasies) op die stelsel. Rekordhouding, saamstel van nuwe lêers, terugwin, lê, spoor verlore lêers op en bestuur duplikate en ou lêers asook handhaaf 'n rekordstelsel en argief. Akkurate invordering, veilige bewaring en deposito van staatsgeld. Hanteer skriftelike en/of telefoonnavrae of navrae met betrekking tot pasiënttoelatingsake. Voer verpligtingspligte uit asook ondersteuning aan toesighouer soos vereis.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphathe: Ukungena Kwabesiguli
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklerk yolawulo yokungena kwabesiguli, ukuqoqa idatha, nokugcina amarekhodi e-Hermanus CDC e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Ikhwalifayikheshini ephansi emfundo: Isitifikadi Samabanga Aphakeme (noma esilinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sikaqoqo loluholo lwabesiguli emvelwaneni wezempilo/abesiguli. Isipiliyoni esifanele se-Clinicom/PHCIS. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (ikhowudi B/EB/C1) esebenzayo. Ukuzithoba ekusebenzini ihora elengeziwe uma izidingo zokusebenza zibiza kanjalo. Amakhono ahle kahle okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ahle okuxhumana. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Office. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuxhumana, ikhono lokuzisebenzela, nangokuba yingxenye yeqembu, ikhono lokugcina imfihlo nokuxazulula izinkinga nokuphathwa kwezinxibelelhwa ngamakhono ahle okuhlela. Ulwazi ngemigomo esebenzayo - Imemo Yemali Eshawa Esibhedlela Isahluko 18, i-Uniform. Isheduli Yemali Eshawa Kubesiguli (UPFS), Imiyalo Yezimali & imigogo yamarekhodi ezokwelapha. Ulwazi nge-Clinicom.
zu.duties: Ukungena kwabesiguli kuhlanganise nokuhlolwa okufanele kwabesiguli nokuqoqa idatha/ulwazi ngokunembile. Qinisekisa ukuphatheka okufanele kwamafolda abesiguli esikhundleni sokwamukela bese uchaza izikhathi zokuhamba (entsha, ukuhola, kanye namasu) esistimeni. Ukugcina amarekhodi, loba uqambe amasha, uthole, ufake efayelini, uthole amalahlekelwe uphathe amafayela amathathelana kanye namadala kanye nokugcina isistimu yamarekhodi nokuqoqa. Ukuqoqwa okunembile, ukugcina ngokuphepha nokubeka imali yembuso. Phatha imibuzo ebhalwe noma yenziwa ngefoni noma imibuzo ngokuphatelene nezindaba zokungena kwabesiguli. Yenza imisebenzi yokumiswa kanye nokusekela umphathi njengoba kudingeka.

xh.title: Mntu wonxibelelwano: Ukungenwa kwabakholelwa
xh.summary: Kufuneka mntu wonxibelelwano wolawulo wokungenwa kwabakholelwa, ukubamba iinkcukacha, nokugcina amarekhodi kwiziko i-Hermanus CDC kwi-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Ingqiqo yemfundo ephantsi: I-Senior Certificate (okanye efanayo). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileko sokusebenza kolawulo lwabakholelwa kwindawo yempilo/abakholelwa. Isiphiwo esifanelekileko se-Clinicom/PHCIS. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (code B/EB/C1) esemthethweni. Ukuzikhululela ukusebenza ngaphezulu kweesikhathi ukuba iimfuno zokusebenza zifuna njalo. Amakhono amabalwe ahle aphakathi kwabantu. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono alo mthetho wokunxibelelwana alungileyo. Ukuba nokwazi ngokusebenzisa i-MS Office. Amakhono amabalwe ahle lokunxibelelana, ikhono lokusebenza kodwa, njengoko nengxenye yeqela, ikhono lokugcina IINKCUKACHA, ukusombulula iingxaki nolawulo lweengxabano kunye namakhono ahle olwazi. Ulwazi malunga neenqobo ezisezinyathelweni - Hospital Fees memorandum Chapter 18, the Uniform. Patient Fee Schedule (UPFS), Finance Instructions & Medical Records policies. Ulwazi lwe-Clinicom.
xh.duties: Ukungenisa abakholelwa kubandakanya ukulinganisela abakholelwa ngokuchanekileyo nokubamba ngokuchanekileyo iinkcukacha/olwazi. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluchanekileyo lweefolda zabakholelwa kwindawo yokwamkela abantu basishele iindawana (ezintsha, ezilandelwayo neendwendwe) kwinkqubo. Ukugcina iirekhodi, ukulungisa ezintsha, ukuzibuyisa, ukuzifaka, ukuzifumana ezilahlekileyo nokulawula eziphindwe kabini neefolda ezindala kanjalo nokugcina inkqubo yamarekhodi nendawo yokugcina iifayili. Ukuqokelela ngokuchanekileyo, ukugcina ngokukhuselekileyo nokubeka imali karhulumente. Ukuphatha iimbuzo ezbhaliweyo okanye ngentenghono okanye iimbuzo ngokubakhele kukungenwa kwabakholelwa. Ukwenza imisebenzi yesikhundla njengoko nasekunika inkxaso kumphathi njengoko kufuneka.

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Sale
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig by Victoria Hospital in die Wes-Kaap om pasiëntadministrasie, rekords en besprekings te bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ondervinding in Microsoft Office en Clinicom-inligtingbestuurstelsel. Toepaslike ondervinding in 'n hospitaalomgewing. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Verrig tydelike pligte soos vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie mondelinge, skriftelike en interpersoonlike Kommunikasievaardighede. Praktiese rekenaarvaardighede (MS Word, Outlook en Excel). Handhaaf en oefen vertroulikheid van pasiënt se inligting uit. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings, organisatoriese vaardighede en kliëntesorg.
af.duties: Effektiewe en doeltreffende pasiëntadministrasie deur skakeling met kliënte, rekordhouding, dokumentasie, lêerwerk en telefoonnaavrae. Effektiewe en doeltreffende pasiëntadministrasie insluitend die nagaan dat alle opvolgbesprekings vir alle buitepasiënte op Clinicom-stelsel bespreek is. Bywoningen en beskikking word daagliks hanteer. Vaslegging van ICD10-kodes. Verseker dat alle fooie en administratiefverwante dokumente geteken is, en verseker beskikbaarheid van lêers en nodige dokumente vir toelating. Effektiewe hantering van materiële hulpbronne, bates. Verrig administratiewe pligte in sale/afdelings. Verseker dat alle pasiëntprosesse en -aktiwiteite glad en doeltreffend in die sale/afdelings verloop. Ondersteuning aan toesighouer en kollegas met administratiewe take.

zu.title: Ikleli Lolulwazi: Amawadi
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikleli lolwazi esibhedlela i-Victoria Hospital e-Western Cape ukuphatha izindaba zomuntu siqu, amarekhodi, nokubhuka kwabeziguli.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi: Isitifikedi se-Senior (noma okulingana naso). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele kwi-Microsoft Office nesistimu yokuqonda ulwazi ye-Clinicom. Isipiliyoni esifanele emkhakheni wesibhedlela. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukwenza imisebenzi yokweseka njengoba kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Amakhono amahle okuxoxa abhalwayo nabantu. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Outlook kanye ne-Excel). Ukugcina futhi kuqinisekiswe ukungazwakali kolwazi lwesiguli. Izinhlobonhlobo zabantu ezinhle, amakhono okuhlelwa, kanye nokunakekelwa ikhaya labakhashuni.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwabeziguli okusebenzayo nokuqinisekile ngokuqhagamshelana namakhasimende, ukugcina amarekhodi, umbhalo wamaphepha, ukufaka efayini, nemibuzo yocingo. Ukuphathwa kwabeziguli okusebenzayo nokuqinisekile okuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukuthi konke ukubhuka okulandelwayo kwawo wonke amabhedi asuke evela esibhedlela esikulinganisweni se-Clinicom kubhukiwe. Izipho kanye nezinto ezingasebenza zithathwe nsuku zonke. Ukufaka amakhodi ICD10. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amafemu kanye namaphepha ahlobene nolwazi abhaywe, kuqinisekiswe ukuthethwa kwamafolda kanye namaphepha abadingekayo ukuze kungene. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwemithombo yezinto, izimpahla. Yenza imisebenzi yolwazi emawadi/izigaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaqoqo kanye nemisebenzi yesiguli ihamba kahle futhi ngempumelelo emawadi/izigaba. Ukusekela umqondisi nomqashi ngemisebenzi yolwazi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka kumcini wokolawulo eVictoria Hospital eWestern Cape ukulawula ulawulo lwabaguli, amarekhodi, kunye nokuqwalasela izicwangciso.
xh.requirements: Izembe loqeqesho elincinci: Senior Certificate (okanye elilinganayo). Iimava: Iimava ezifanelekileyo kwiMicrosoft Office kunye nenkqubo yolawulo lolwazi iClinicom. Iimava ezifanelekileko kwindawo yesibhedlele. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zemisebenzi: Kwenze imisebenzi yexesha elingapeli xa kufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabalwanesomoya, ebiweyo nethethwa nabathintwa nabo abakhoyo. Amakhono ekhompyutha obungapheleleko (MS Word, Outlook kunye neExcel). Alondoloze aphinde asebenzise ubumfihlo bolwazi lwomguli. Izihlobo ezilungileyo nabathintwa nabo, amakhono olawulo, kunye nonyango lwabakhoyo.
xh.duties: Ulawulo lwabaguli olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo ngokudibana namaxheshwe, ukugcina amarekhodi, uxwebhu, ukubeka kwiifayile, kunye nemibuzo yefowuni. Ulawulo lwabaguli olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo kuquka ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke izicwangciso zokuqwalasela kwakhona zabaguli abayiyo nayiyo kulwandle lwabantu kwindleba yeClinicom zibe ziqwalaselwe. Iindibano kunye neento ezingasetyenziswayo ziphatwa nsuku zonke. Ukufaka amakhodi iICD10. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imirhumo yamaxesha nokwaziswa kwamaxwebhu alawulwayo asayiniwe, kuqinisekiswa ukubakho kweekhava kunye namaxwebhu afunekayo ukwamkelwa. af.title: Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 3

Bereidwilligheid om in Forensiese Ondersoek en Disseksie opgelei te word. Vermoë om met lyke te werk en dit op te tel, (vermink, ontbind, aansteeklike virusse, oorgewig). af.duties: Doeltreffende en effektiewe herwinning, berging en verwerking van oorledenes. 'n Doeltreffende forensiese outopsieproses wat ooreenstemmig met vasgestelde standaarde en riglyne gelewer word. -Optimale beheer van verslae en verklarings gedurende en na die Forensiese Lykhuis-proses. 'n Doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur van onbekende lyke. 'n Effektiewe ondersteuningsdiens aan die Bestuurder ten opsigte van Korporatiewe en Kliniese Goeweransfunksies van die Forensiese Patologie-laboratorium.

zu.title: Umphathi we-Forensic Pathology izinga 1 kuya ku-2
zu.summary: Umphathi we-Forensic Pathology izinga 1 kuya ku-2 e-Worcester nase-Ceres Forensic Pathology Service, ofuna i-Senior Certificate ene-Mathematics ne-Life Science noma i-Biology nalayisensi yokuqasha ethize.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwemigomo: i-Senior Certificate enokuthola i-mathematics ne-Life Science kanye/noma i-Biology njengezifundo edlule. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho. Izinga 2: unyaka we-10 wesipiliyoni esifanele. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: ilayisensi ethize yokuqasha i-Code B/EB. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkalo. Ukuzithoba ukuyolalelwa kuqeqesha i-Forensic Investigation ne-Dissection. Ikhono lokusebenza nokuphakamisa izidumbu, (ezimeke, eziyonakalile, ezinamagciwe anemitshajwayo, ezinkulu kakhulu). Ukuzithoba ukuhamba ibanga elide nokusebenza imisebenzi yokulindela / ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Amakhono (ulwazi/ikhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakompyutha nesofthiwe. Ikhono lokuqeqeshwa ekuphatheni isithuthi i-4x4. Ikhono lokuqeqeshwa ekuthathweni kwezithombe. Ikhono lokukhuluma kucace futhi kungaboni bantu bobukhosi ngomzimba nangesibhali. Ukuzithoba ukusiza ngemisebenzi egumbini le-X-ray. Ikhono lokufinyelela nokuqeqeswa kobuhlobo obuhle nomsebenzi wansuku zonke nabasebenzi nakabathengi. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Kuzodingeka unike umbiko ezinkantolo ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinkantolo.
zu.duties: Ukuqoqwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokucutshungwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwabantu abashonile. Inqubo yobulwelwe-dala be-forensic edluliselwa ngokuvumelana nemigomo namasiko abekiwe. -Ukulawula okuphezulu kwemibiko nezinkulumo ngesikhathi nangemva kwenqubo ye-Forensic Mortuary. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwezidumbu ezingaziwa. Insiza ekusekeleni i-Manager mayelana nomsebenzi we-Corporate ne-Clinical Governance yoqoqo lwale-Forensic Pathology Laboratory.

xh.title: Iofisa wezoPhando loGqitho inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2
xh.summary: Iofisa wezoPhando loGqitho inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 e Worcester nase Ceres isebe lezoPhando loGqitho, elifuna iSertifikati esiPhezulu esineMathematics neLife Science okanye iBiology nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Izinga lokugqiba izifundo elingaphantsi kwayo: iSenior Certificate negqithiwe kuyo iMathematics neLife Science nokanye iBiology njengamagqithiweyo. Imfundo yamava: inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: i-10 yeminyaka yamava afanelekileyo. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba yeCode B/EB esebenzayo. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngaphantsi komxinwa. Ukuzimisela ukufundelwa uPhando loGqitho nokuSika. Ulawulo lokusebenza ngakwaye ukuphakamisa izidumbu, (ezonakalisiweyo, ebiyakubola, ezinogawulayo ezasasayo, ezinobunzima bomzimba). Ukuzimisela okuhamba iindawo ezinde nasekwenziweni imisebenzi yokulinda / ixesha elidlulileyo. Iimpawu zokwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha nesoftware. Ulawulo lokufundelwa ukuQhuba isiithuthi 4x4. Ulawulo lokufundelwa ukuthatha izifoto. Ulawulo lokuqhuba ngokucacileyo nangasese ngalomye nangesibhalo. Ukuzimisela ukuncedisa ngemisebenzi kwindlu yeX-ray. Ulawulo lokufikelela nokuqinisekisa ubudlelwane obulungileyo bomntu nomsebenzi nabasebenzi nakumaxhasha. Ulawulo lokutolika nokuqhuba iindlebe zopolitiko. Kuya kufuneka kubekho bubungqina benkundla kumacala entlango.
xh.duties: Ukuphinda usebenze ngokusebenzayo nangempumelelo ukubuyisa, ukugcina nokuqhuba abafileyo. Inkqubo yophando loGqitho olusebenzayo enikwa ngokwemigaqo nengangingaqwayi. -Ulawulo olugqithisileyo lemibiko neenkcazelo ngexesha nangemva kwenkqubo yeForensic Mortuary. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusembaxa wabafileyo abangaziwayo. Inkonzo yoncedo esebenzayo kumLawuli ngokumayelana nemisebenzi yeCorporate neClinical Governance yeLaboratori yoPhando loGqitho.

jobs.title: Artisan Assistant (TECHNICAL Services)
jobs.centre: West Coast TB Centre (Based at Sonstraal Hospital, Malmesbury)
jobs.summary: Assist with maintenance and repair of hospital equipment and infrastructure at Sonstraal Hospital in Malmesbury, requiring Grade 10 and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Educational qualification: Grade 10 (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in at least one of these fields: repairs and maintenance of hospital equipment, infrastructure, painting, air-conditioning, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical, carpentry. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB/C) driver’s license. Physically fit to perform duties, work at heights and in confined spaces. Must be prepared to work overtime and perform standby duties after hours, including weekends and Public Holidays. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Adherence to the Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 and its relevant regulations.
jobs.duties: Carry out ad-hoc maintenance and repair requests, perform or arrange preventative maintenance on plant and equipment, follow emergency maintenance protocols, at the hospital and health facilities within the sub- district under supervision of the Artisan. Carry out daily checks on generator, oxygen, and other machinery, adhere to the maintenance schedule for all facilities, and do regular facility inspections. Provide specifications under the supervision of the Artisan for service provider jobs, attend site meetings and manage contractors. Ensure an organised neat workshop, efficient and effective management and control of stock, tools, equipment, and perform administrative duties. Ensure excellent record keeping. Assist with the management and supervision of the maintenance team reporting to the Artisan Assistant. Provide assistance and support to Artisan, managers, supervisor and colleagues.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. HL Siegelaar Tel No: (021) 837-8097
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery." It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Ambagsman-assistent (Tegniese Dienste)
af.summary: Bystand verleen met onderhoud en herstel van hospitaaltoerusting en -infrastruktuur by Sonstraal Hospital in Malmesbury, waarvoor Graad 10 en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie vereis word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Graad 10 (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in ten minste een van hierdie velde: herstel en onderhoud van hospitaaltoerusting, infrastruktuur, verfwerk, lugversorging, verkoeling, loodgietery, elektriese werk, timmerwerk. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB/C) bestuurderslisensie. Fisies fiks om pligte uit te voer, op hoogtes en in beperkte ruimtes te werk. Moet bereid wees om oortyd te werk en standby-pligte na ure uit te voer, insluitend naweke en openbare vakansiedae. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Nakoming van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 1993 en sy relevante regulasies.
af.duties: Voer ad hoc-onderhouds- en herstelversoeke uit, voer of reël voorkomende onderhoud op aanleg en toerusting uit, volg noodonderhoudsprotokolle by die hospitaal en gesondheidsfasiliteite binne die sub-distrik onder toesig van die Ambagsman. Voer daaglikse kontroles op generator, suurstof en ander masjinerie uit, hou aan die onderhoudskedule vir alle fasiliteite, en doen gereelde fasiliteitsinspeksies. Verskaf spesifikasies onder toesig van die Ambagsman vir diensverskaffer se take, woon werfvergaderings by en bestaan kontrakteurs bestuur. Verseker 'n georganiseerde netjiese werkswinkel, doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur en beheer van voorraad, gereedskap, toerusting, en voer administratiewe pligte uit. Verseker uitstekende rekordhouding. Bystand verleen met die bestuur en toesig van die onderhoudspan wat aan die Ambagsman-assistent verslag doen. Verskaf bystand en ondersteuning aan Ambagsman, bestuurders, toesighouer en kollegas.

zu.title: Umncedi weNgcwele (Izinsebenzo zeBuchwepheshe)
zu.summary: Siza ekugcineni nasekulungiseni izinto zesibhedlela nokwakhiwa eSonstraal Hospital eMalmesbury, kudingeka ibe neGrade 10 nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane kakhulu: Grade 10 (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele esingenani elinye lamabalwe: ukulungisa nokugcina izinto zesibhedlela, ukwakhiwa, ukupenda, ukwelisa umoya, ukubanda izinto, izintsimbi zamanzi, kagesi, ubugwili. Izidingo ezingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code B/EB/C). Ukuba nenzuzo emzimbeni wenza imisebenzi, ukusebenza phezulu nasemzimbeni wezindawo ezincinci. Kufanele ukuba ulungele ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqashwa emva kwesikhathi, okuhlanganisa amasonto nezinsuku zomhlaka jinge. Izikhiwo (ulwazi/amasu): Ukuziphatha ngokomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 nasemthethweni ohlobene nawo.
zu.duties: Qhuba izicelo zokulungisa nasekulungiseni ezizezelwayo, yenza noma uhlele ukugcina okuvikela amadivayisi nezinto, landela izinqumo zokulungisa eziphuthumayo, esibhedlela nasemagunyeni empilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda-ngaphansi kokuhlakaniphwa kweNgcwele. Yenga ukubheka nsuku zonke isiginingidi, i-oksidejin, nasetinyameni, hambisana nalesikhathi sokugcina onke amagunye, futhi uqashe inspektheyini yamagunye njalo. Nikeza izinkomba ngaphansi kokuhlakaniphwa kweNgcwele emsebenzini wezinkampani ezikhonza, hamba kumihlangano yendawo uphathe abathengisi. Qinisekisa indawo yokusebenza elungiselelwe, elihlanzekile, ulawule kahle futhi ulawule impahla, izinsimbi, izinto, futhi wenze imisebenzi yohlu. Qinisekisa ukugcina amaphathi kahle. Siza ekulawuleni nasekuhlola iqembu lokugcina elibika kuMncedi weNgcwele. Nikeza usizo nasekusekeleni iNgcwele, abaphathi, umlawuli nakubanye abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedi we-Artisan (Iinkonzo zoBuchwephesha)
xh.summary: Nceda ekulondolozweni nokusilolweni kwempahla nakwizinzhiso zesibhedlele kwi-Sonstraal Hospital e-Malmesbury, kufuneka ube nam-Garde 10 nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Grade 10 (okanye ekanjwayo). Isipho sokusebenza: Isipho sokusebenza esifanelekileyo kwenye yale minyanga: ukusilola nokulondolozwa kwempahla yesibhedlele, izinzhiso, ukudonga, i-air-conditioning, ukubuyisa ubandixa, ulwatyholo lwamanja, umbane, ucando. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB/C) esebenzayo. Ukuba namandla emzimba ukuze wenze imisebenzi, ukusebenza phezulu nakwindawo ezivaliwe. Kufuneka ulungele ukusebenza i-overtime waze wenze imisebenzi yokumiselwa emva kweyure, kuquka nangaphezulu ngamasondo nangamaholide awohlangano. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuhlonipza i-Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 nemiqathango ehambelanayo nayo.
xh.duties: Yenza iimfuno zokusilola nokusilwa ezize ngexesha, wenze okulungelelani ukulondolozwa kwizityalo nempahla, landela iinkqubo zokusilwa kwaphakathi, kwisibhedlele nakwizifo ezithile ngaphantsi kolawulo lwe-Artisan kwisithili. Yenga iintsingiselo zansuku zonke kwi-jeneretha, i-oxygen, nenyunse enye, hlonipza umgca wolondolozo lwazo zonke izifo, uze uhlale uyihlola rhoqo. Nikezangokuqondiswe ngaphantsi kolawulo lwe-Artisan ezicatshulwa kumisebenzi wabakho abathintela inkonzo, thatha inkxaso ekuhlanganiseni iindawo ulawule abathengi bengenkqubo. Qinisekisa isebe elihle nelicocekileyo, ulawulo oluqinisekileyo nolusebenzayo koluhlu lwempahla, izixhobo, nemishini, uze ufeze imisebenzi yocwango. Qinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi ezilungileyo. Nceda ekulawulweni nasekuqwalaseleni iqela lolondolozo elingela kumncedi we-Artisan. Nikezisa uncedo nankxaso kwi-Artisan, abaphathi, omlawuli, nakubahlobo bakho.

af.title: Ambagsman-assistent (TEGNIESE Dienste)
af.summary: Bied bystand aan 'n ambagsman met instandhouding en tegniese ondersteuning by Swartland-hospitaal, met vereistes van Graad 10, ambagservaring en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Graad 10 of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in ten minste een van hierdie velde: sweiswerk, skilderwerk, timmerwerk en loodgieterswerk, met algemene elektriese kennis. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk en wagdienste te verrig, insluitend naweke en openbare vakansiedae. Fisies geskik om swaar toerusting en voorwerpe te hanteer. Moet in staat wees om op hoogtes te werk, d.w.s. op lere en steiers. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Nalewing van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 1993 en sy relevante regulasies. Lees, skryf en volg geskrewe instruksies, insluitend handleidings en geskrewe prosedures. Vermoë om toegekende hulpbronne soos gereedskap en materiaal optimaal te benut en bedryfsig te wees in die gebruik van 'n verskeidenheid gereedskap. Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk. Vermoë om aan veiligheidsstandaarde te voldoen. Vermoë om 'n konvensionele draaibank of freesmasjien te gebruik. Moet in staat wees om op hoogtes te werk, d.w.s. op lere en steiers.
af.duties: Bied die Ambagsman bystand met 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe instandhoudings- en tegniese ondersteuningsdiens aan die instellings. Bied die Ambagsman bystand met die instandhouding van installasies, masjinerie, toerusting asook die werkswinkel en tuimgereedskap. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsfunksie in die werkswinkel asook wagdienste. Onderhou professionele groei / etiese en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umhleli Wezesandla (Isevisi Yobuchwepheshe)
zu.summary: Siza umhleli wezesandla ngokulondolozwa nokuwesekwa ngokobuchwepheshe e-Swartland Hospital, kudingeka ibe nesithifithi se-Grade 10, ulwazi loluwohlobo lomsebenzi nephasipoti evumelekileyo yokuqhuba.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingezantsi: Grade 10 okanye okulinganayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olufanelekileyo kwelinye nangaphezulu lemiduze yemisebenzi: ukuthunga isintsibi, ukudweba izindlu, umsebenzi wezinkuni, nobuchwepheshe bamantonga oluvamile nolwazi ngamagesi. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Iphaspoti yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) evumelekile. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ihora elongeziwe nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqashwa ngokulindela, kubandakanya amasonto namaholide. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukwazi ukuphatha impahla ezisindayo nezinto ezisindayo. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza kumaphezulu, okukuthi phezu kohlamvu nasezixukwini. Ubuchwepheshe (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukulandela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 nemithetho ephathelene nawo. Ukufunda, ukubhala nokulandela imiyalelo ebhaliweyo, kubandakanya izikhokelo nemigaqo ebhaliweyo. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ngokugqithisileyo izinsiza ezabelwe wona ezifana nezinsiza neensimbi futhi ube namakhono ekusebenziseni iinhlobo ezahlukene zezinsiza. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele futhi njengengxenye yeqembu. Ikhono lokulandela izindinganiso zokuphepha. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ilathe eqhelekileyo noma umshini wokushuba. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza kumaphezulu, okukuthi phezu kohlamvu nasezixukwini.
zu.duties: Siza Umhleli Wezesandla ngesevisi yokuqinisekisa nokulondolozwa ngokusebenza ngokubuchwepheshe kulezi zikhungo. Siza Umhleli Wezesandla ngokulondolozwa kwezifakelo, izinsimbi, impahla kanye nezinsiza zomsebenzi wesikhungo negadi. Nikeza umsebenzi wokwesekwa kwisikhungo somsebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yokuqashwa ngokulindela. Qinisekisa ukukhula ngokobuchwepheshe / okusesikhundlweni nokuziphucela.

xh.title: Umncedi wentakusebenza (Iinkonzo ezizeNzulu)
xh.summary: Nceda intakusebenza ngolungiso ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe eSwartland Hospital, kufuneka ibe nesiQediwa sikaGrade 10, amava obuchwepheshe nedilesi yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kobuncwane: Grade 10 okanye eselingana nabo. Amaxesha amava: Amava afanelekileyo kwelinye nangaphezulu lawo masimba: ukubhaka, ukudaka, umsebenzi wosaphulo, nobugcisa bomlungiseleli ngolwazi olubanzi malunga nobugcisa bokuqhutywa kombane. Iimfuno ezibangelwa kakhulu ngumsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha kwaye uzenze imisebenzi yokulindela, kuquka iintsuku zokuphumla namhla zomthendeleko ekungeyonina. Ukuba nemithambo yomzimba ngokwaneleyo ukuphatha iinkqubo ezinzima namalungu. Makakwazi ukusebenza kubude obuphezulu oko kukuthi kwii-ladders ne-scaffolding. Iinkqubo (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuzinikela ngokomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act 1993 nangokwemigaqo yaayo. Ukufunda, ukubhala nokulandela iimiyalelo e bhaliweyo, kuquka iimanuali neendlela ezibhaliweyo. Ukuba namandla okusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo izixhobo ezabelwe wona njengamathuluzi nangomatiriyeli, kwaye ukhawuleze ekusebenziseni iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zethuluzi. Isakhono sokusebenza ngokuzimela nakuluntu. Isakhono sokuzinikela ngokumgangatho wokhuseleko. Isakhono sokusebenzisa i-lathe okanye i-milling machine eqhelekileyo. Makakwazi ukusebenza kubude obuphezulu oko kukuthi kwii-ladders ne-scaffolding.
xh.duties: Nceda intakusebenza ngolungiso olusebenzayo nolusezantsi ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumaziko. Nceda intakusebenza ngokolungiso lwezinto ezifakelwe ezindaweni, iimoto ezisebenza, izixhobo ngokunjalo nethuluzi lesweshini negadi. Zeka inkonzo yenkxazo esweshini ngokunjalo imisebenzi yokulindela. Lugcine inkqubo ekhula ngamava / ngokuziphatha ngokutsha nokuziphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 per annum
jobs.summary: Seek a SANC-registered Nursing Assistant at Lentegeur Hospital to support patient care across three graded levels.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Nursing Assistant. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognizable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ appropriate/recognizable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, day and night duty, weekends, and public holidays to meet the operational requirements. Must be prepared to assist in all departments according to operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Effective communication skills and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of nursing processes & procedures as outlined in Nursing, Health related & Public service legislation, regulations & policies. Function within the team and facilitate on the level of the post.
jobs.duties: Assist patients with activities of daily living which includes patient hygiene, provide nutrition, assist with mobility, and elimination processes. Ukubhalisa kwikhalendi lezobungcwathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomsizi wezokunakekela. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokuqashelwa ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomsizi wezokunakekela. Izinga 2: Isibopho esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 somlando/okuphawulekayo ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomsizi wezokunakekela kwi-SANC. Izinga 3: Isibopho esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 somlando/okuphawulekayo ezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomsizi wezokunakekela kwi-SANC. Izidingo ezibekiwe zomsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ekusebenzeni ngevasa uma kunesidingo. Kuzodingeka ukusebenze amashifu, amaholide omphakathi, ibanga ebusuku, emva kwamahola nangamasonto. Kumele ube selulekile ukusiza kwawo onke amnyango ngokwezidingo zokusebenza. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhokelo): Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nethonya lokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuthethwayo). Ikono lokusebenza kwindlela enabantu abaningi abanemikhakha ehlukene. Ukuphucula ukunakekelwa kwesiguli ngokusebenzisa i-SOP's, izinqubo nezinkomba.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha. Siza abasiguli ngemisebenzi yansuku zonke ehlanganisa ukuhlanzwa kwesiguli, ukunikeza ukudla, ukusiza lokuhamba kanye nezinqubo zokuqhumisa. Qapha izibalo eziyisisekelo zesiguli iwayini ulalele nalolu hlezi luhlezi kanye nalokhu okungeyona into ekuhlekiwe kakhulu. Ukwethula ngokwesiguli ipipi nokungabikeleli okuyinto embi. Ukusetshenziswa ngokugcwala kwezinto. Gcina ukukhula/izindinganiso zezizalo kanye nakhona okugqamile ekuqhubeni komuntu. Ukuthatha inhlangothi ngokuzimisela ekulelelweni olungaphakathi kwemikhakha.

Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-20 yamava afanelekileyo/abakhe wayaziwa kwindima yokunika amachiza emva kokuqeshwa njengomncedi weZempiqelelo kwi-SANC. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zemisebenzi: Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha xa kuyimfuneko. Iqonda iimpawu zempilo zesiguli yaye ichaze naziphi na iziphumo ezingaqhelekanga. Ukuchaza ngokhuseleko lwegula nezehlo ezingathandekiyo. Ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwezibonelelo. Ukugcina inkcubeko yentlalo/izingqiqo zemigaqo nokuziphucula. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kuzikhuliso-mfundiso ezingaphakathi.
