jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s license (Code B/EB) and willingness to travel in the district. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and understanding of Health Care 2030. Excellent administrative and research skills. Computer literacy in MS Office. Clinical competencies (training and teaching skills.)
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will report to the Medical Manager / Clinical Manager of the District Hospital and support the planning, governance and development of surgical services. Provide specialist General Surgery services at the District Hospital, including outpatient consultations, inpatient care, theatre services, minor procedures and management of complex surgical patients. Provide clinical leadership and governance for surgical services, including the development and monitoring of clinical protocols, referral pathways, quality- improvement initiatives and evidence-based standards of care. Provide supervision, mentoring and clinical support to Medical Officers, Community Service Medical Officers, interns and other health professionals, and support ongoing training and development of clinical competence. Strengthen access to appropriate surgical care through improved patient selection, theatre utilisation, waiting-list management and management of suitable patients closer to home. Conduct and support clinical audits, morbidity and mortality reviews, patient-safety initiatives and other quality-assurance activities relevant to surgical services. Liaise with surgical specialists and subspecialists at Regional and Tertiary Hospitals to strengthen referral, counter-referral, specialist outreach and shared management of patients. Support the decentralisation of surgical services through outreach, specialist clinics, procedural support, case discussions and clinical mentoring aimed at building local capacity. Participate in the training of health professionals and in research relevant to the clinical and service needs of the district.

af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Algemene Chirurgie. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om in die distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van Health Care 2030. Uitstekende administratiewe en navorsingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office. Kliniese bevoegdhede (opleidings- en onderrigvaardighede.)
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal aan die Mediese Bestuurder / Kliniese Bestuurder van die Distrikshospitaal rapporteer en die beplanning, bestuur en ontwikkeling van chirurgiese dienste ondersteun. Verskaf spesialis Algemene Chirurgie-dienste by die Distrikshospitaal, insluitend ambulante konsultasies, hospitale sorg, teaterdienste, klein prosedures en bestuur van komplekse chirurgiese pasiënte. Verskaf kliniese leierskap en bestuur vir chirurgiese dienste, insluitend die ontwikkeling en monitering van kliniese protokolle, verwysingsroetes, kwaliteitsverbeteringsinisiatiewe en getoetste standaarde van sorg. Verskaf toesig, mentorskap en kliniese ondersteuning aan Mediese Beamptes, Gemeenskapsdiens Mediese Beamptes, internes en ander gesondheidsprofessionals, en ondersteun deurlopende opleiding en ontwikkeling van kliniese bevoegdheid. Versterk toegang tot toepaslike chirurgiese sorg deur verbeterde pasiëntseleksie, teaterbenutting, waglysbestuur en bestuur van geskikte pasiënte nader aan die huis. Voer en ondersteun kliniese oudits, morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings, pasiëntveiligheidsinisiatiewe en ander kwaliteitsversekeringsaktiwiteite wat op chirurgiese dienste van toepassing is. Skakel met chirurgiese spesialiste en subspesialiste by Streeks- en Tersiêre Hospitale om verwysing, teenverwysing, spesialisuitreik en gedeelde bestuur van pasiënte te versterk. Ondersteun die desentralisering van chirurgiese dienste deur uitreik, spesialisklinieke, prosedurele ondersteuning, gevalbesprekings en kliniese mentorskap wat gemik is op die opbou van plaaslike kapasiteit. Neem deel aan die opleiding van gesondheidsprofessionals en aan navorsing wat relevant is vir die kliniese en diensbehoeftes van die distrik.

zu.title: Izikhulu Eziphezulu Zokwelapha Ezinga 1 kuya Ku-3 (GENERAL Surgery)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Izikhulu Eziphezulu Zokwelapha kwi-General Surgery esibhedlela i-Knysna Hospital ukuze kunikwe izinkonzo zokuhlola abagulayo bangelé nabanamakamelo abhedlela.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezincane zemfundo: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha kwi-General Surgery. Ukubhaliswa kumbhalo wezinsizakalo: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha kwi-General Surgery. Isiphephelo: Grade 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha kwi-General Surgery. Grade 2: Ukuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka engu-5 okufanele njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma u-HPC oqashwe kwamanye amazwe ngabasebenzi abafunde kwezinye izwe) njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha kwi-General Surgery. Grade 3: Ukubhaliswa okuncane kweminyakaengu-10 okufanele njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA (noma u-HPC oqashwe kwamanye amazwe ngabasebenzi abafunde kwezinye izwe) njengesikhulu esiphezulu sokwelapha kwi-General Surgery. Izindingo ezingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile (Code B/EB) nokuthanda ukuhamba esifundazweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ulwazi nokuqonda ngoku-Health Care 2030. Izindlela ezinhle zokulawula nokuphenya. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Office. Amakhono okwelapha (ukwazi ukuqeqesha nokufundisa).
zu.duties: Omunye oweme phansi uzothunyelwa kumenenja wokwelapha / kumenenja wezempilo wesibhedlela sesisifunda bese enikela inkxaso ekwelapheni, ukulawuleni kanye nentuthukweni kwezinkonzo ezingokuqashwa. Kubeke izinkonzo ze-General Surgery kusibhedlela sesisifunda okuhlanganisa ukubonisana nomagula bangelé, ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo abanamakamelo, izinkonzo zethiyetha, izindlela ezincane kanye nokuphathwa kwabagula ababinzima. Ukwethulele iqhaza elikhulu ekwelapheni nasekulawuleni izinkonzo ezingokuqashwa, okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa nokulandelwa kwezinqubo zokwelapha, izindlela zokuqashwa, izinhloso zokuthuthukisa izinga nemiGANGO yokunakekelwa ekelwe emaubuqothweni. Unikezelele ukubeka phansi inkinga, ukukhokha nokwesekela ngokwelapha oMphathwa bezokwela ngco, oMphathi bezinsizakalo Zokwelapha emphakathini, abaqeqeshi kanye nabanye ochwepheshe bezempilo, bese enika inkxaso eqhubekayo kokwazi nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono okwelapha. Ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelelela kokunakekelwa okufanele kwezokususa izifo ngokukhethwa okuthuthukisiwe kwabagulayo, ukusetshenziswa kwezinkonzo, ukulawula uhlu lalabo abalindile nokunakekelwa kwabagulayo abafanelekile eduze kwakhaya. Yenza futhi unikeze inkxaso kokuqashwa ngokwelapha, ukuhlola ukukhulelwa nokufa, izinhloso zokuphepha komgula kanye nezinye izinkalo zokuqinisekisa umkhakha ohlobene nezinkonzo zokususa izifo. Xhumana nabochwepheshe kanye nabochwepheshe abangaphansi kwezinsizakalo kumabhedlela amakhulu nakuwo amaphakeme ukwenzela ukuthi kube nzima ukuqashwa, ukuphinda kubhaliswe, ukunyukiwa kwabochwepheshe kanye nokuphathwa ngokuhlanganyela kwabagula. Unikezelele ngokulandelisa emakamelo izinsizakulo kusuka kwamanye amabhedlela ezinsizakulo eziyisikhulu kanye namakliniki okukhethwa, unikezelo lwezinsizakulo zokusiza, imibhalo yezezinkulumo kanye nokuqeqesha okuhlosa ukwakha amandla endawo. Thatha ingxenye eqoqweni lokuqeqesha ochwepheshe bempilo ekuphenyini okuhlobene nezidingo zokwelapha noma izidingo zokulawula esifundeni.

xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isifanelekileyo sokugqithiswa kumgangatho okuvumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele kwiqela loqhotho. Ukubhalisa kwikomiti yamakhwenkweziqhelo: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele kwiqela loqhotho. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto kubuyiselelwa ekubhaliseni kwi-HPCSA njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele kwiqela loqhotho. Inqanaba 2: Inani elingaphantsi le-5 eminyakeni yamava afanelekileyo njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ikomiti yamakhwenkweziqhelo yamazwe ngamazwe evunyiweyo ngokumalana nabaqeshwa bakhwenzileyo kumazwe ngamazwe) njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele kwiqela loqhotho. Inqanaba 3: Inani elingaphantsi le-10 eminyakeni yamava afanelekileyo njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye ikomiti yamakhwenkweziqhelo yamazwe ngamazwe evunyiweyo ngokumalana nabaqeshwa bakhwenzileyo kumazwe ngamazwe) njengesigqweqhwe sezamokhwele kwiqela loqhotho. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kule misebenzi: Ilayisenesi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo (Code B/EB) nokuzimisela okokuhamba kwidolophu. Amandla (ulwazi/isebezo): Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Health Care 2030. Amandla amakhulu olawulo nophando. Ukusebenzisaikhompyutha kwi-MS Office. Amandla okulolonga iziqhelo (ukuzidla nokufundisa.)
xh.duties: Umntu opumeleleyo uza kuvela kwi-Manager wezamokhwele / i-Manager yololongiwo lweqela lesibedele wasekuhlaleni aze axhase uqhotho, ulawulo nokuphuhliswa kweenkonzo zokuqhothwa. Kubonezelwe iinkonzo zesigqweqhwe kwiqela loqhotho kwisibedele sekuhlaleni, kuquka iingxoxo nabantu abangeni esibedelele, ukukhathalelwa kwabantu banikhuselwa esibedelele, iinkonzo zendlu yokwenziwa iziqhelo, iinkqubo ezincinci nolawulo lwabaguli abaxakekileyo bokwenziwa iziqhelo. Kubonezelwe ukulawula nolawulo olubukhali lweenkonzo zokuqhothwa, kuquka ukuphuhliswa nokulandelelwa kweenkqubo zokulolonga iziqhelo, iindlela zokuqamba, izinto zokuphucula izinga kweenkqubo ezisekwe kubungqina bobuchwepheshe. Kubonezelwe intshayo, ukuyalela nokuzelelwa ngamandla okulolonga iziqhelo kubaphathi bezamokhwele, abasebenzisi bezamokhwele basekuhlaleni, abaqeqeshwa nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo, axhase ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubelekayo nokuphuhliswa kwamandla okulolonga iziqhelo. Komeleze ukufikelela kweenkonzo zokuqhothwa ezifanelekileyo ngokuphucula ukhetho lwabaguli, ukusetyenziswa kwendlu yokwenziwa iziqhelo, ulawulo loluhlu lokulindileyo nolawulo lwabaguli abafanelekileyo kufutshane nasekhaya. Kwenziwe axhaswe iziqendu zobumbano bezamokhwele, ukuphononongwa kwengxaki nokuwafa, izinto zokhuseleko lwabaguli nolunye ulwazi oluqinisekisa isixa lweenkonzo zokuqhothwa. Axhaxhebe ngezigqweqhwe nezizelezigqweqhwe kumazibedele obukhulu kwaye nakwezobummandla ukomeleza ukuqamba, ukuqamba okubuyela umva, ukufikelela kwezigqweqhwe ngaphandle nokwahlulelana ngokulawula abaguli. Axhase ukusaswa kweenkonzo zokuqhothwa ngokufikelela kwindawo ngaphandle, iikliniki zezigqweqhwe, inkxaso yenkqubo, iingxoxo zeziqendu nokuzelelwa ngamandla okulolonga iziqhelo ukuqatshelwa ngakumbi ekwakheni amandla endawo. Athabathe inxaxheba ekufundiseni abasebenzi bezempilo nakuphandweni ngokwanele kwiimfuno zokulolonga iziqhelo ngenkonz'entlontlon ebeku ikomkhulu.

It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (Interne Geneeskunde)
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde word gesoek vir Knysna Hospitaal om spesialis-kliniese dienste te lewer, insluitend saalrondes en buitepasient-konsultasies.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om in die distrik te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en begrip van Health Care 2030. Uitstekende administratiewe en navorsingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office. Kliniese bevoegdhede (opleidings- en onderrigvaardighede).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal aan die Mediese Bestuurder / Kliniese Bestuurder van die Distrikshospitaal rapporteer en die beplanning, bestuur en ontwikkeling van kliniese dienste ondersteun. Verskaf spesialis Interne Geneeskunde-dienste by die Distrikshospitaal, insluitend saalrondes, buitepasient-konsultasies, bestuur van komplekse mediese pasiënte en spesialis-ondersteuning aan ander kliniese dissiplines. Verskaf kliniese leierskap en bestuur vir Interne Geneeskunde-dienste, insluitend die ontwikkeling en monitering van kliniese protokolle, verwysingsroetes, kwaliteitsverbeteringsinisiatiewe en bewysgebaseerde standaarde van sorg. Verskaf toesig, mentoring en kliniese ondersteuning aan Mediese Beamptes, Community Service Medical Officers, internes en ander gesondheidsprofessionals, en ondersteun voortgesette opleiding en ontwikkeling van kliniese bevoegdheid. Ondersteun die bestuur van komplekse en chroniese mediese toestande en versterk kontinuïteit van sorg tussen die hospitaal, Primêre Gesondheidsorg-dienste en hoër vlakke van sorg. Voer en ondersteun kliniese oudits, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsbesprekings, pasiëntveiligheidsinisiatiewe en ander kvaliteitsversekeringsaktiwiteite wat verband hou met Interne Geneeskunde. Skakel met spesialiste en subspesialiste by Streeks- en Tersiêre Hospitale om verwysing, teenverwysing, spesialis-uitreik en gesamentlike bestuur van pasiënte te versterk. Ondersteun die desentralisering van spesialis-dienste deur uitreik, spesialis-klinieke, gevalbesprekings en kliniese mentoring wat gemik is daarop om plaaslike kapasiteit te bou en geskikte pasiënte nader aan huis te bestuur. Neem deel aan die opleiding van gesondheidsprofessionals en aan navorsing wat relevant is vir die kliniese en diensbehoeftes van die distrik.

zu.title: Iziqu Eziseduze: 1 kuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
zu.summary: Kufunwa ungqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine, ozoze esibhedlela i-Knysna ukunikeza izinsiza zezokwelapha ezikhethekile, okuhlanganisa ukuvakasha abagulayo emiyalezweni kanye namakonsathi e- outpatient.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Iziqu ezifanelekile ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Ukubhalisa kubhaladi labochwepheshe: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Asikho isipiliyoni emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Isigaba 2: Ukwaziswa okuncane cishe okungeminyaka eyi-5 njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kubhaladi elitholakalayo lezwe langesaphethalasizinda mayelana neziqu zezwe langaphandle) njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Isigaba 3: Ukwaziswa okuncane cishe okungeminyaka eyi-10 njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kubhaladi elitholakalayo lezwe langesaphethalasizinda mayelana neziqu zezwe langaphandle) njengengqondo wezokwelapha ogqozayo, wesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Isidingo esingokoqobo somsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo kanye nesifiso sokuhamba endaweni. Izindawo zokusebenza (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi kanye nokuzwa ngamaphrohramu e- Health Care 2030. Amakhono aphambili okubuseka nokusebenza. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa i- MS Office. Amakhono wezokwelapha (ukufundisa nokukhuthaza ukuzikhethela).
zu.duties: Umuntu oyogqozwa kuzobe exoxa ne- Medical Manager / Clinical Manager yalesisibhedlela futhi aseke ukucubungula, ukulawula kanye nokuqhuba izinsiza zezokwelapha. Unikeze izinsiza ezikhethekile zesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine kulesisibhedlela, okuhlanganisa ukuvakasha abagulayo emiyalezweni, amakonsathi e- outpatient, ukuphathwa kwabagulayo ababucayi kanye nokuqondisa okukhethekile ezinye izigaba zezokwelapha. Unikeze ubuholo kanye nokuqondisa izinsiza zesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine, okuhlanganisa ukuqamba kanye nokuqapha imithetho yezokwelapha, izindlela zokuqondisa abagulayo, ukwenza izinto ngcono kanye nemigomo evuselelwa ngokuphila. Unikeze ukubeka amehlo, ukufundisa kanye nokuqondisa izinsiza zezokwelapha kubaduni bezokwelapha, abakhulekele bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, abafundi nabanye ochwepheshe bezezempilo, kanye nokuqondisa ukufundisa nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezokwelapha. Useke ukuphathwa kwezifo ezibucayi noma ezingapheli, futhi usize ukwenza uhlelo lwezinsiza zokwelapha phakathi kwesibhedlela, izinsizakalo ze- Primary Health Care kanye nezinye izigaba eziphakeme. Unikeze kanye nokuqondisa imibuzo yezokwelapha, ukubuka ukufa nokugula kubantu, izinhlelo zokuphepha abagulayo kanye nezinye izinto ezithinta inani lezinsizakalo ezihlobene nesigaba se-INTERNAL Medicine. Xoxa nabochwepheshe kumaphayona e- Regional and Tertiary Hospitals ukuze usize ukwenza izindlela zokuqondisa abagulayo, ukusebenza kwamaphrohramu we- specialist outreach, nokuhlanganyela ukuphathwa kwabagulayo. Useke ukwethula izinsizakalo ezikhethekile kubantu ngokuqondisa ezinye izibhedlela, ukuba namakliniki ezinsizakalo, uxoxo ngemikhuba nokukhuthaza abantu basekhaya ukuze bakwazi ukukhulisa abantu basekhaya kanye nokuphatha kahle abagulayo besebeduzane nasekhaya. Babambe iqhaza ekufundiseni abochwepheshe bezezempilo nakulolu hlelo lokuphenya mayelana nezidingo zezinsizakalo zalezondawo.

xh.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
xh.summary: Kufunwa uchwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine eKnysna Hospital ukuba unabukele iinkonzo ezinzimbasezokwelapha, kuquka ukujikeleza kwi-ward nokuphendula imibuzo yamangaphakathi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esincinci esifunekayo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine. Ubhaliso kwibhodi yezemisebenzi: Ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine. Amava: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane iimvelakuhle zeminyaka emi-5 njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA (okanye ibhodi yezempilo echazwe ngamazwe ngaphandle kubasebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe ngaphandle) njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane iimvelakuhle zeminyaka eli-10 njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA (okanye ibhodi yezempilo echazwe ngamazwe ngaphandle kubasebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe ngaphandle) njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha kwi-Internal Medicine. Isimemo esingaphakathi sesithuba somsebenzi: Ilayisense yomqhubi esebenzayo (Code B/EB) nokuthanda ukuhamba kwidolophu. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nokusiqonda i-Health Care 2030. Amakhona olawulo nophando aphezulu. Ukwazi kwi-computer kwi-MS Office. Amakhona ezokwelapha (amakhona okhokelisa nokuqeqesha.)
xh.duties: Umamkeli wesi sithuba uza kubika kwi-Manager Wezokwelapha / Manager Wezokwelapha zeKliniki kwi-District Hospital axhase ukuhlela, ulawulo nophuhliso lweekonzo zezokwelapha. Nikela iinkonzo zechwepheshe ze-Internal Medicine kwi-District Hospital, kuquka ukujikeleza kwi-ward, iinkqubo zamangaphakathi, ulawulo abaguli bezokwelapha banzima kunye nentengiso kwezinye iindawo zezokwelapha. Nikeza intsimbi yokhokelo nolawulo lweekonzo ze-Internal Medicine, kuquka uphuhliso nokuqinisekiswa kweendlela zokwenza iinkonzo ezinzimbasezokwelapha, iindlela zokudlulisa abaguli, iintshukubakho zokuphucula umgangatho kunye neendlela zokunyamekelwa ezingqiniswe luphando. Nikeza ulawulo, inkxaso yokhokelisa kunye nenkxaso yezokwelapha kubaphathi Wezokwelapha, abaphathi Bezokwelapha Benkonzo Yoluntu, abaqeqeshi kunye nabanye osebenzi beempilo, axhase ukuqeqesha nophuhliso oluzama kwakhona wamakhona ezokwelapha. Xhasa ulawulo lweemeko bezokwelapha banzima nezingasoqhushulwa ngokupheleleyo, uqinisekise ukunyamekelwa ngokuzinza phakathi kwesibhedlele, iinkonzo ze-Primary Health Care kunye namanqanaba aphezulu okunyamekelwa. Yenza uxhaso lwekwaphulwa kwezokwelapha, uphando lokubethwa kukufa nokungaphilanga, iintshukubakho zokhuseleko lomguli kunye nezinye iintshukubakho zokuqinisekisa umgangatho ngokufanelekileyo kwi-Internal Medicine. Thintana nabachwepheshe kunye nabachwepheshe abancinane kwi-Regional kunye ne-Tertiary Hospitals ukuze uqinisekise ukudluliselwa, ukudluliselwa emva, ukhangeleko lwechwepheshe kunye nolawulo loluntu lomguli. Xhasa ukusatshaliswa kwekonzo zochwepheshe ngokuhlala nabachwepheshe, amakliniki ochwepheshe, iingxoxo zeemeko kunye nokhokelisa ezokwelapha ukuqinisekisa amandla endawo nokuphatha abaguli abafanelekileyo ekufutshane nasekhaya. Thatha inxaxheba kwikuqeqesha basebenzi beempilo nakwiphando ngokufanelekileyo iimfuno zezokwelapha nekonzo zedolophu.
